name: roaming_creature_on_orbitable_subject
description: One small insect-like creature wanders continuously over the surface of a single centered, photoscanned subject under plain, even, non-directional light, its feet visibly clinging to every contour, while the viewer swings the viewpoint around the subject and moves closer or further to inspect the contact up close.

canonical_document.name: roaming_creature_on_orbitable_subject
canonical_document.description: One small insect-like creature wanders continuously over the surface of a single centered, photoscanned subject under plain, even, non-directional light, its feet visibly clinging to every contour, while the viewer swings the viewpoint around the subject and moves closer or further to inspect the contact up close.
canonical_document.experience_scope: A whole-view experience that is already in motion the moment it appears and has no beginning, ending, or completion; it occupies the full viewing area with no surrounding chrome, and it simply continues for as long as the view is present.
content_and_composition: One centered subject: a photoscanned organic surface with visible bumps, pores and irregularities, held at the center of the view at all times
Exactly one autonomous creature as the sole moving foreground element, small relative to the subject, always in surface contact
Plain, even illumination of any hue with an empty, uncluttered surround that sits at a clearly separated luminance from the subject, so nothing competes with the subject and creature
Persistent viewpoint framing: a fixed eye-level viewing height that circles the subject, with the subject continuously centered
No start button, timeline, labels or instructional overlay; the scene itself is the entire composition
attention_and_information_flow: Primary attention is anchored on the creature's feet and their contact with the surface; the grip and the way each step follows local bumps is the detail the composition is built to sell
Secondary attention is the creature's wandering path, which reads as self-directed rather than choreographed
Brief hesitations and rare startled wing flurries create short spikes of prominence that pull the eye back to the creature after it has been scanning the surface
Moving nearer reveals fine surface texture and the exactness of foot placement; moving further reveals the creature's position and route across the whole subject
Changing viewing angle reveals previously hidden regions of the subject without ever losing the creature-on-surface relationship as the subject of interest

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Any angle can be swung straight back with a reverse drag; a new drag immediately interrupts residual motion; the vertical height and centering cannot be knocked out of alignment
interaction_model.state_change: Viewing angle swings around the subject at a fixed eye-level height while the subject remains centered
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The subject appears to turn smoothly and continuously, exposing new sides; the creature stays attached to the surface and keeps moving throughout
interaction_model.input: Drag across the view
interaction_model.affected_object: Viewpoint circling the centered subject

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: The glide can be caught and redirected by grabbing again at any point during the settle
interaction_model.state_change: Rotation decays from its release speed to rest instead of halting instantly
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The view glides on briefly and settles, giving the turn a sense of weight rather than a hard stop
interaction_model.input: Release after dragging
interaction_model.affected_object: Viewpoint motion

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: The near and far limits are hard and cannot be pushed past; continued input at a limit produces no further movement; distance is immediately reversible in either direction
interaction_model.state_change: Viewpoint moves nearer or further along the current sight line between a fixed nearest and furthest limit
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The subject and creature scale smoothly; near the close limit, surface texture and foot contact become clearly readable; near the far limit, the whole subject and the creature's route are visible
interaction_model.input: Scroll or pinch
interaction_model.affected_object: Viewing distance to the subject

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: The user cannot start, stop, retrigger or steer it; it continues unaffected by any viewpoint change and never reaches a resting end state
interaction_model.state_change: Ongoing wandering across the surface, interspersed with brief pauses and rare sudden startle bursts
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The creature walks with its feet visibly gripping and conforming to bumps and dips, stops momentarily as if deciding, and occasionally erupts into a short wing flurry before resuming
interaction_model.input: Autonomous, continuous (no user input)
interaction_model.affected_object: The creature and its surface contact

experience_qualities: Unsettling and intimate because of how convincingly the creature grips a lifelike surface
Genuinely autonomous rather than looping choreography: hesitation and rare startle make timing feel unpredictable
Even, undramatic illumination set against restless motion in the subject
Weighted, uninterrupted inspection: turning and zooming feel physical and never jolt or reset the scene
Tactile: the interest is in contact and conformance, not in speed or spectacle
completion_and_return: No completion, no reward state and no return to a start pose; the scene runs indefinitely
Viewpoint keeps whatever angle and distance the user last left it at, with every angle reachable again
Creature behavior is unaffected by viewpoint changes, so returning to an earlier angle does not resume an earlier moment
locked_observable_requirements: The view is already in motion on arrival, with nothing to begin and nothing to finish
Exactly one autonomous creature on exactly one centered subject
Feet must visibly contact and conform to surface irregularities; the grip is the focal detail
Autonomous behavior includes brief hesitations and rare startled bursts, not uniform steady travel
Orbiting stays at a fixed viewing height and always keeps the subject centered
Rotation glides to rest after release instead of stopping dead, and can be caught mid-glide
Distance is bounded by hard nearest and furthest limits that cannot be exceeded
Creature motion is independent of and uninterrupted by viewpoint changes
Plain, even illumination at any hue and an uncluttered surround that stays low-distraction and clearly separated from the subject
adaptable_details: Which small creature and which scanned subject are used
Creature-to-subject scale, as long as surface contact detail remains legible when close
Illumination hue and warmth and the surround's luminance level, as long as the subject stays clearly separated from the surround and surface detail stays readable
Orbit sensitivity, settle duration and the exact near/far distances
How often hesitations and startle bursts occur, and the shape of the wandering path
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits any single centered inspectable subject with a detailed, irregular surface and one small autonomous agent traversing it, where the payoff is believable surface contact examined from freely chosen angles and distances. It stops being this Skill if the agent is multiplied into a swarm, if its movement becomes a directed narrative or user-steered sequence, if the camera becomes free-flying or leaves the subject off-center, or if surface-conforming contact is dropped so the agent merely floats or slides over the form.

name: orbitable_glass_case_of_squishy_blobs
description: A corner-balanced transparent case, slowly turning in an open, near-empty studio space, filled with soft heavy blobs that crowd and stretch its walls; drag to swing the view around it, zoom to come close, and every fresh contact inside updates numbers on the case faces and rings one soft low tone.

canonical_document.name: orbitable_glass_case_of_squishy_blobs
canonical_document.description: A corner-balanced transparent case, slowly turning in an open, near-empty studio space, filled with soft heavy blobs that crowd and stretch its walls; drag to swing the view around it, zoom to come close, and every fresh contact inside updates numbers on the case faces and rings one soft low tone.
canonical_document.experience_scope: Whole-view experience: begins with a brief, clearly signalled wait that opens onto the studio space and ends nowhere — it runs indefinitely as the page's only subject. Can be hosted as a full viewport view or as a large self-contained region, but it always owns its own space and holds a single subject.
content_and_composition: Exactly one primary subject: a transparent-walled container, held off-axis and balanced on a single corner, centred in the view
A small group of soft deformable bodies inside the container as the secondary content layer, visible through the walls and always fully enclosed
Live numeric readouts rendered on the container's own faces, reading as part of the object rather than as overlaid interface

Open, uncluttered, near-empty studio surround, low in visual noise and held at a clearly different luminance from the subject so its transparent walls, refraction and shadow read, with a ground plane the subject sits above; no scenery competing with the subject
One short line of text as the only copy, hinting that the object responds to the visitor
A synchronized audio layer of warm low tones tied to contacts inside the container
Persistent elements: the subject, its slow rotation, the readouts and the hint line remain present for the whole session
experience_progression: Brief, clearly signalled wait before the scene appears, read as anticipation rather than as an error or blank state
Opening onto the studio with the whole container as one legible object, turning slowly
Attention narrows from the container's silhouette to its interior as the blobs are seen crowding, leaning and pressing outward
First press brings the audio layer in, after which impacts are heard as well as seen
Open-ended calm loop: turning, drifting and colliding continue indefinitely with no completion, ending or exit
attention_and_information_flow: Emptiness of the surround forces initial prominence onto the single subject as a whole form
Deformation and crowding of the interior bodies pull attention inward from silhouette to contents
Readouts on the faces disclose live change quantitatively, giving a second, factual read of what the eye already sees
Impact tones mark moments of change, so attention is drawn to whichever contact just happened
Zooming in trades whole-object legibility for interior detail and readout readability; zooming out restores the object as one form
The single line of hint text is deliberately low in prominence and never competes with the subject

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: A new drag interrupts and takes over any ongoing glide; vertical range is bounded so the view never sinks below the ground plane; releasing hands control back to the autonomous slow turning
interaction_model.state_change: Viewing angle swings around the subject and continues briefly after release before easing to rest
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The container appears to turn to reveal other sides and other views into its interior; motion carries slight inertia and glides to a stop rather than snapping
interaction_model.input: Drag across the scene (pointer or touch)
interaction_model.affected_object: Viewpoint orbiting the single subject

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Clamped at a nearest and a furthest limit so the view can neither enter nor lose the subject; further input at a limit produces no runaway motion
interaction_model.state_change: View moves nearer or further, easing to rest
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The container grows or shrinks in frame; close in, interior deformation and face readouts become clearly readable; far out, the whole balanced form is legible
interaction_model.input: Wheel or pinch
interaction_model.affected_object: Viewing distance to the subject

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: The bias is gentle and never overrides containment; moving the view elsewhere lets the lean drift back over time; the bodies always remain enclosed
interaction_model.state_change: Their leaning bias gradually re-orients relative to the current viewpoint
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The mass of blobs slowly settles and presses more toward one side, bulging the walls there, so the interior seems subtly aware of where it is being watched from
interaction_model.input: Where the visitor is currently viewing from (continuous state, not a discrete action)
interaction_model.affected_object: Soft bodies inside the container

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: One-time transition; once enabled it stays enabled, and the scene remains fully watchable if audio never comes in
interaction_model.state_change: Silent to audible
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Ongoing contacts begin to sound; the visual scene is unchanged, so the gesture reads as unmuting rather than as starting the experience
interaction_model.input: First press anywhere in the scene
interaction_model.affected_object: Audio layer

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Sustained or resting contact does not re-ring; density of simultaneous impacts stays comfortable rather than clattering
interaction_model.state_change: One-shot tone fires and the live values update
interaction_model.visible_feedback: A single warm low tone per fresh contact — softer for gentle touches, stronger for hard ones — with the face readouts changing in step, so impacts are felt as much as seen
interaction_model.input: Autonomous driver: each newly made contact, body against wall or body against body
interaction_model.affected_object: Audio layer and the readouts on the container faces

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Never stalls, never demands input, and any input blends into the ongoing motion instead of restarting it
interaction_model.state_change: Continues turning, drifting and colliding unaided
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The subject keeps rotating slowly and the interior keeps settling and nudging itself, so the view is never static
interaction_model.input: Autonomous driver: idleness (no input at all)
interaction_model.affected_object: Whole scene

experience_qualities: Tactile and gummy: the interior reads as heavy, soft and pleasantly squishable
Calm and watchable, sustainable for long idle viewing
Playful and toy-like rather than instructional or transactional
Airy, open and clean, with the subject clearly separated from an unadorned surround as if set out on a studio table
Physically credible: weight, inertia and containment all behave consistently
Responsive in a low-key way — it acknowledges the visitor without demanding anything
completion_and_return: No completion, success state, ending or exit
Runs as an open loop for as long as anyone lingers
View position and zoom persist as left by the visitor; only momentum decays
Interior arrangement is never reset; it simply keeps evolving from wherever it is
Audio, once brought in, stays in for the session
locked_observable_requirements: Exactly one subject, a transparent-walled container, balanced off-axis on a single corner and rotating slowly on its own
Soft deformable bodies inside that visibly crowd, lean, stretch the walls and remain contained at all times

Near-empty studio surround, uniform and low in distraction, held at enough luminance separation from the subject that its transparent walls and shadow stay legible, with a ground plane and no competing scenery
Drag-to-orbit and zoom with slight inertia easing to rest, bounded above the ground and clamped at nearest and furthest distance
Viewpoint gently re-biases which way the interior bodies lean
Live readouts carried on the container's own faces, not as separate interface panels, at readable contrast against those faces
One soft low tone per newly made contact, scaled to impact strength, enabled by a first press
A brief, clearly signalled wait before the scene opens
At most one short line of hint copy, and no exit or completion
adaptable_details: Number, size and colouring of the interior bodies
Exact material look of the container walls and their degree of tint or clarity
Which quantities the face readouts show and their formatting
Colouring, lighting key and light temperature of the studio surround, light or dark, as long as the subject stays clearly separated from it
Timbre and pitch range of the impact tones
Rotation speed, inertia strength and zoom limits
Wording of the single hint line
Visual treatment of the opening wait signal
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits any context that can be reduced to one hero-scale object worth turning over and looking into, with a small population of soft, deformable contents whose behaviour is the point: brand toys, material or product feel demos, playful landing centrepieces, idle interludes. It fails where the foreground must carry dense text or interface, since the readouts and hint line are deliberately minimal. Replacing the single enclosed subject with a scattered field of objects, making the contents rigid and non-deforming, opening the container so contents can escape, adding goals, scoring or an exit, or turning it into a background substrate behind foreground content each produces a different Skill.

name: operable_interface_on_orbitable_machine
description: A small machine sits in open space and can be orbited and pulled nearer or further, while its tiny screen hosts a genuinely usable interface where menus open, list items select and a window closes or resizes.

canonical_document.name: operable_interface_on_orbitable_machine
canonical_document.description: A small machine sits in open space and can be orbited and pulled nearer or further, while its tiny screen hosts a genuinely usable interface where menus open, list items select and a window closes or resizes.
canonical_document.experience_scope: Whole-view experiment region presenting one object; it lasts as long as the visitor explores and operates the object, with no forced end. A persistent back affordance returns to the entry list.
content_and_composition: One machine object as the sole subject, staged in otherwise empty space
An inset screen on the object carrying a live, ordinary-looking interface
On-screen roles: a menu that opens, a list with selectable rows, and a window with close and resize affordances
Camera framing state comprising orbit angle and viewing distance
One persistent back affordance returning to the entry list
experience_progression: Arrival at a default framing where the object is whole and its screen legible
Free inspection by orbiting and changing distance
Engagement with the screen itself, where small interface tasks run their own short cycles
Exploration continues without a terminal state until the visitor returns to the list
attention_and_information_flow: Attention first reads the object as a whole form, since it is alone in the view
Moving nearer promotes the screen from a detail to the dominant content, and the interface becomes readable
Hover and selection feedback appears at screen scale, keeping attention inside the object while the surrounding stage stays quiet
Pulling back demotes the interface again and restores the object as a single silhouette

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Freely reversible by dragging back; orbit is bounded so the object never becomes unreadable
interaction_model.state_change: Orbit angle changes
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The machine turns smoothly, revealing other sides
interaction_model.input: Drag on the surrounding stage
interaction_model.affected_object: Viewpoint on the object

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Reversible at any time and limited at both ends so the screen stays usable and the object stays in view
interaction_model.state_change: Object comes nearer or moves further away
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The machine and its screen grow or shrink continuously
interaction_model.input: Zoom or pinch input
interaction_model.affected_object: Viewing distance

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Moving away clears the highlight; hovering the stage instead never affects the screen
interaction_model.state_change: Element becomes highlighted
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Hover state renders on the screen surface at the current angle and distance
interaction_model.input: Hover over an element on the small screen
interaction_model.affected_object: On-screen interface element

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Ordinary reversal through the same interface, such as closing a menu or reopening a window; camera state is unaffected by screen use
interaction_model.state_change: Menu opens, a list row becomes selected, or a window closes or resizes
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The interface responds on the object's screen exactly as an ordinary interface would
interaction_model.input: Click on the small screen
interaction_model.affected_object: On-screen interface element

experience_qualities: Believable as a real working interface rather than an image or video pasted on a surface
Inspectable and toy-like, rewarding close approach
Continuous and uninterrupted, since operating the screen never disturbs the framing and vice versa
Immediately understandable as an object one may turn and touch
completion_and_return: No forced completion; the piece is an open exploration
Each on-screen action resolves on its own, and the object returns to a calm state when the pointer leaves
The back affordance returns to the entry list at any time
Where the treatment cannot be presented at all, a calm plain-language notice stands in place of the stage
locked_observable_requirements: A single object is the whole subject and can be both orbited and brought nearer or further
Pointer input must land accurately on the small screen's elements from any angle or distance
Hover and selection feedback appears on the screen surface itself
The screen interface is genuinely operable, including opening menus, selecting list rows and closing or resizing a window
Camera control and screen use remain independent, neither interrupting the other
Framing is bounded so the screen stays legible
adaptable_details: Styling, era and form of the machine
Lighting, stage backdrop and shadowing
Which interface content the screen hosts
Default framing and the exact orbit and distance limits
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits showcases where a device, product or piece of software should be inspected in the round and actually used, with enough on-screen content to reward approaching. Flattening the interface into a plain framed panel, or reducing the screen to a non-interactive image, would be a different skill.

name: flat_poster_to_inhabited_depth
description: A calm readable poster of a headline and short blurb that scrolling gradually reveals to be the same wording standing in a lit three-dimensional space, then returns to the readable framing and can begin again.

canonical_document.name: flat_poster_to_inhabited_depth
canonical_document.description: A calm readable poster of a headline and short blurb that scrolling gradually reveals to be the same wording standing in a lit three-dimensional space, then returns to the readable framing and can begin again.
canonical_document.experience_scope: Whole-view experience that begins at the settled flat poster framing on arrival, spans the entire scroll-driven traversal of one fixed route, and ends when that route wraps back to the same readable framing; there is no separate page region and no other content competing with it.
content_and_composition: One primary headline statement as the dominant text object, sized to be read at a glance in the opening framing
One short secondary intro blurb subordinate to the headline in size and prominence
Both text elements exist as physical surfaces placed at different depths within a single continuous space rather than as flat overlay layers
A ground or backdrop surface that receives shading and cast shadows from the text surfaces, making the space readable as real
A single moving viewpoint that is the only element traversing the scene; the composition itself stays fixed in place
No visible controls, chrome, buttons, links, hover targets, progress bars or section dividers
The opening framing aligns all text into a flat, poster-like, fully legible arrangement in which depth is not yet apparent
experience_progression: Settled state: composition reads as a calm, flat, printed poster that can simply be taken in and read with no motion demanded
Onset: first scroll input eases the viewpoint off the poster alignment; depth separation between text surfaces becomes noticeable
Build: continued forward travel along the fixed route deepens perspective while shading and cast shadows accumulate, so the words are increasingly sensed as objects occupying space
Oblique passage: the viewpoint reaches unfamiliar off-axis framings where the wording remains recognizable even though it is no longer squarely presented
Wrap and resettle: the route continues around and eases back into the original flat readable arrangement, at which point the visit can begin again in the same way
Reverse travel retraces these same stages in exact opposite order rather than following a different path
attention_and_information_flow: Attention starts on reading the words as language in the flat framing
As depth builds, attention slides from reading toward sensing the space the words live in, spatial relationships and light becoming the new information
No new textual content is introduced during travel; everything revealed is spatial and material rather than informational
Headline keeps prominence over the blurb at every framing, so the message never loses its hierarchy
Legibility of the headline is preserved enough at all framings that a viewer arriving mid-travel can still recognize the wording and orient themselves
Returning to the settled framing restores reading as the primary mode, closing the loop

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Motion is smoothed rather than snapped; any stop leaves the traversal resumable from the reached point in either direction
interaction_model.state_change: Viewpoint advances along one fixed predetermined route; perspective, depth separation, shading and cast shadows intensify with distance traveled
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Eased, continuous camera movement with parallax between text surfaces and progressively stronger shadowing and modeling of the letterforms
interaction_model.input: Forward scroll by mouse wheel or touch drag
interaction_model.affected_object: The single viewpoint moving through the composed spatial scene

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Full reversibility means the readable poster framing is always reachable by scrolling back
interaction_model.state_change: Viewpoint retraces the identical route in reverse, unwinding depth and shadow build-up in the same order it accumulated
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The traversal visibly rewinds through framings already seen, with no alternate path or shortcut
interaction_model.input: Backward scroll by wheel or reverse touch drag
interaction_model.affected_object: The same viewpoint on the same route

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Resuming scroll in either direction continues from the held framing
interaction_model.state_change: Traversal holds exactly at the framing reached, with no drift, auto-advance or auto-return
interaction_model.visible_feedback: A still, held composition the viewer can inspect at that angle for as long as they like
interaction_model.input: Pausing input entirely
interaction_model.affected_object: Viewpoint and all depth, shading and shadow states

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: The loop is symmetrical: continuing in either direction eventually returns to the readable arrangement
interaction_model.state_change: Travel wraps continuously instead of hitting a hard end stop, coming back around to the settled framing
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Uninterrupted motion with no bounce, clamp, blocked feeling or visible seam at the wrap point
interaction_model.input: Continuing to scroll past the far extent of the route
interaction_model.affected_object: Route position

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Absence of pointer targets keeps the experience unambiguous, so scrolling is the only thing to try
interaction_model.state_change: No state change; scroll remains the only control
interaction_model.visible_feedback: No cursor affordances, highlight, focus outline or response of any kind
interaction_model.input: Pointer hover or click attempts anywhere in the composition
interaction_model.affected_object: Nothing

experience_qualities: Calm and readable before it is impressive
Quietly surprising rather than announced, since the depth is discovered rather than presented
Orienting and self-explanatory throughout, never leaving the viewer unsure where they are
Continuously eased and unhurried in motion, with no snapping or jolts
Fully viewer-paced, since nothing advances on its own
Material and lit, with depth conveyed by shading and cast shadows rather than by flat effects
Loopable and low-commitment, safe to explore because every framing is reversible
completion_and_return: The traversal has no terminal end state; it wraps continuously in both directions
The original flat readable poster arrangement is the natural rest point and is returned to by completing the loop in either direction
Reverse scrolling returns to that same arrangement exactly, along the same route
Pausing persists the reached framing indefinitely without decay or auto-reset
After a full loop the visit can effectively begin again from the same readable starting impression
locked_observable_requirements: Initial and returned-to framing must read as a flat, calm, fully legible poster in which depth is not yet apparent
The same composition must later be understood as occupying real depth, revealed only through viewpoint movement
Scroll (wheel or touch drag) must be the only control; nothing may be clickable, hoverable or focusable
Travel must follow exactly one fixed route, not a free-look or user-aimed camera
Backward scrolling must retrace the identical route, exactly reversing the accumulated depth and shadow state
Pausing must hold the reached framing with no autonomous motion
Depth must be carried by perspective, shading and cast shadows that build with travel
Headline wording must stay recognizable from unfamiliar, off-axis framings
There must be no hard end stop; travel wraps continuously in both directions
The passage must remain self-explanatory without instructions or visible progress indicators
adaptable_details: Exact headline wording, tone, language and typeface
Presence, length and placement of the secondary blurb
Hue family, material finish and lighting direction or warmth, as long as the text surfaces stay legibly separated from the backdrop
Shape, length and curvature of the fixed route
How far off-axis the most extreme framings go
Easing curve, scroll sensitivity and total travel distance per loop
Ground or backdrop treatment as long as it still reads as a shadow-receiving surface
Poster layout of the settled framing, including alignment and letter spacing
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits short, text-led single-view openings where one declarative statement plus a brief supporting line is the entire foreground content and the impression must come from the wording itself. Content-dense pages, multi-section scroll narratives with different subject matter per stage, or long-form reading break it, because the words must stay legible and recognizable while the frame moves and no new information is delivered during travel. Replacing scroll with pointer-aimed free look, giving the traversal a hard end and a destination section, adding clickable or hoverable objects inside the composition, or letting the flat readable framing never exist would each produce a different Skill.

name: trailing_soft_brush_inner_layer_reveal
description: Low-distraction scene of faintly outlined standing figures; a wide soft-edged brush lags behind the pointer and dissolves the outer bodies into the inner skeletal layer in irregular liquid tendrils, each opening healing shut on its own about a second after motion stops.

canonical_document.name: trailing_soft_brush_inner_layer_reveal
canonical_document.description: Low-distraction scene of faintly outlined standing figures; a wide soft-edged brush lags behind the pointer and dissolves the outer bodies into the inner skeletal layer in irregular liquid tendrils, each opening healing shut on its own about a second after motion stops.
canonical_document.experience_scope: A whole-view experience filling the primary viewport region: it begins once the figure content is ready and the plain holding state gives way to the low-distraction scene, and it continues indefinitely with no end state, no completion and no exit condition; every reveal is transient and local to the pointer's path.
content_and_composition: One shared subject presented as two co-located layers: an outer surface layer (bodies) and an inner layer (skeletons) occupying exactly the same silhouettes and positions, never displaced or offset beside one another
A small group of standing figures (two or more) distributed across the view as the only foreground subject
A quiet, near-clinical empty environment held at a uniform low-salience tone clearly separated from the subject, with no visible panels, captions, labels, instructions or reading material
Outer bodies rendered as faint glowing edge outlines that fall away into the surrounding tone rather than as solid opaque forms
A single soft-edged, wide, roughly circular region of legibility that follows the pointer and is the only place the inner layer is visible
Optional persistent element: the whole scene's viewpoint, which shifts slightly as a unit
attention_and_information_flow: Attention is anchored by the moving legible region: it is the highest-contrast, most detailed area in an otherwise low-salience field
Information is revealed only locally and momentarily; the viewer never accumulates a fully uncovered picture
Because openings close behind the pointer, prominence continuously migrates with the cursor instead of building up in one place
The revealed inner layer must read as belonging to the same bodies, so the viewer interprets it as looking through the figures rather than at added objects
No text or onboarding competes for attention; discovery is entirely visual and self-taught by moving the pointer

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Openings are always temporary and self-healing, so no reset, undo or clearing control exists; sweeping the same area again simply reopens it
interaction_model.state_change: The surface becomes locally transparent so the inner skeletal layer shows through along the swept path
interaction_model.visible_feedback: A wide soft-edged opening trails slightly behind the pointer, its border bleeding outward in irregular liquid tendrils rather than a clean circle; bones appear inside the figures' own outlines
interaction_model.input: Pointer movement across the view (the only user input)
interaction_model.affected_object: Outer surface layer of the figures within the brush region

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Resuming pointer movement immediately begins new openings; healing may be interrupted mid-way by sweeping back over a closing area
interaction_model.state_change: No new openings are created and existing openings close
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The exposed bone areas fade back under the outer bodies within roughly a second, returning the view to faint outlines against the low-salience surround
interaction_model.input: Pointer stops moving (autonomous timer thereafter)
interaction_model.affected_object: All currently open regions

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Motion is clamped and eased so it always settles; returning the pointer toward center eases the viewpoint back
interaction_model.state_change: Viewpoint nudges by a small, eased, bounded amount toward the pointer's side
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Gentle parallax-like drift of the whole figure group that never reaches an extreme angle or reveals the scene edges
interaction_model.input: Pointer position relative to the view (continuous)
interaction_model.affected_object: Scene viewpoint as a whole

experience_qualities: Eerie, hushed and clinical rather than playful
Soft, liquid and organic at the reveal boundary rather than hard-edged or geometric
Slightly laggy and weighty, so the brush feels like it is dragged through the scene
Non-destructive and forgiving: the scene never degrades or fills up

name: fuzzy_orbit_specimen_with_travelling_dimples

canonical_document.experience_scope: A whole-view experience that fills the frame from arrival and never ends: it begins already in motion with no entry sequence and has no finish, exit or completion point.
