canonical_document.name: drifting_luminous_web_with_tap_pulse_waves
canonical_document.description: A glowing branching web suspended in a quiet, low-distraction field of small distant light points that drifts slowly while the visitor orbits and zooms it, and each tap sends a high-salience expanding ring outward that flares the nodes and links it crosses before dissolving back into calm.
canonical_document.experience_scope: Whole-view ambient experience that begins as soon as the scene appears and never ends; the visitor arrives already inside a running, self-animating void and can leave at any moment without an unfinished state. The interactive surface is the entire scene area, not a control panel or overlay.
content_and_composition: Uninterrupted low-activity backdrop held far enough from the web in luminance that emitted light reads against it, scattered with many small distant points of light, reading as an open void rather than a flat panel
Exactly one branching connected web suspended at the centre of the view as the sole subject
Web composed of two content roles: luminous nodes and the links joining them, both emitting light rather than being outlined
Density and light-intensity gradient across the web: a dense, high-intensity, tightly packed core thinning outward into sparser, fainter, smaller tips
Layered depth cues, with nearer parts of the web reading clearly in front of farther parts so overall scale registers at a glance
Transient expanding rings of energy that appear over the scene on demand and can coexist, a few at a time, with each other and with the drifting web
No labels, captions, legends, instruction text or visible controls; the scene explains itself
experience_progression: Resting state: the web drifts slowly and continuously, breathing at a low amplitude so depth and structure are readable without any input
Surge: an input injects a wave of light that travels outward through the structure, briefly raising overall light intensity and activity
Decay: the wave weakens and vanishes on its own and flared elements sink back toward their resting intensity
Return: the scene eases back into the quiet drifting breathing state, ready for the next surge, with no accumulation or progress toward an end
attention_and_information_flow: First read pulls attention to the dense, highest-intensity core as the visual anchor
Attention then travels outward along the branches toward the thinning, fainter tips, so hierarchy and reach are understood in order
Slow drift keeps revealing new relative positions and occlusions, so the layered arrangement is progressively understood rather than shown all at once
During a surge, prominence shifts temporarily to the travelling ring front and to whatever it is currently sweeping across, tracing the structure's connectivity outward from the touched point
After the surge fades, prominence returns to the core-to-tips gradient so the resting composition is never permanently altered

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Dragging back at any time reverses the swing; a new drag immediately takes over from any coasting motion, and the structure can never be swung out of frame
interaction_model.state_change: Viewing angle swings around the structure while the web stays framed at the centre
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The web turns in step with the drag, revealing new faces, depth ordering and branch overlaps as the angle changes
interaction_model.input: Continuous drag across the scene
interaction_model.affected_object: Viewpoint orbiting the centred web

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: A fresh press interrupts the coast at once; if left alone, the coast always resolves into the calm resting drift
interaction_model.state_change: Orbit motion continues from the released velocity and decelerates to rest instead of stopping instantly
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The scene coasts smoothly onward and settles, leaving the slow ambient drift behind
interaction_model.input: Release at the end of a drag
interaction_model.affected_object: Viewpoint motion

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: The opposite gesture reverses it; both limits hold firmly so the web can never be zoomed past, lost, emptied out of view or pushed off-centre
interaction_model.state_change: The view moves closer or further along a clamped range between a fixed nearest and farthest distance
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The structure grows to show individual nodes and links, or recedes to show the whole silhouette separated from the surrounding point field, always remaining centred
interaction_model.input: Scroll or pinch
interaction_model.affected_object: Viewpoint distance from the web

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Each ring completes and clears itself with no dismissal needed; nothing stays lit, and the visitor cannot leave the scene in an altered state
interaction_model.state_change: A ring is born at the input location and expands outward; elements the ring front crosses shift from resting intensity into a brief flare and then relax back
interaction_model.visible_feedback: A high-salience ring swells outward from the touch point, lighting up nodes and links in sequence as it passes over them, then thins and fades away
interaction_model.input: Click or tap anywhere over the scene
interaction_model.affected_object: The web's nodes and links, plus a new transient energy ring originating at the touched point

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Concurrency is capped at a few simultaneous waves so the scene stays readable; all active waves fade out on their own and the scene returns to its quiet state
interaction_model.state_change: Several rings remain alive at once and continue independently instead of the newest replacing or cancelling earlier ones
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Overlapping wave fronts cross the web from different origins, briefly compounding light intensity where they meet
interaction_model.input: Repeated taps in quick succession
interaction_model.affected_object: Set of active energy rings

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Ambient motion never stops; interaction layers on top of it and always resolves back into it
interaction_model.state_change: Perpetual slow drift and gentle breathing of light intensity at rest
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The structure keeps turning and pulsing faintly, reading as alive rather than static
interaction_model.input: No input (autonomous driver)
interaction_model.affected_object: Whole web and its light level

experience_qualities: Calm, spacious and open-ended, with nothing to complete or dismiss
Alive and organic rather than mechanical, from continuous slow motion and soft breathing light
Playful and immediately rewarding, since a single tap produces a large visible bloom of light
Legible without instruction, because light intensity and density communicate structure and hierarchy
Weighted and physical, from inertial coasting rather than abrupt starts and stops
Safe to explore, because every viewpoint change is bounded and every effect self-clears
completion_and_return: No completion state, score, end screen or goal
Each pulse wave fades out on its own and leaves no residue
Viewpoint changes persist for as long as the visitor stays, with no forced snap back to a default angle
The scene always eases back to the quiet breathing drift after activity, making that resting state the effective home state
locked_observable_requirements: Open void backdrop of low visual activity, separated far enough in luminance from the web that its emitted light reads, scattered with small distant points of light
Exactly one branching connected web, luminous and centred, as the single subject
Continuous slow ambient drift that conveys depth and scale without input
Visible gradient from a dense, high-intensity core to thinning, fainter outer tips
Drag orbits the viewpoint around the web and, on release, coasts to a stop instead of cutting dead
Zoom is clamped between fixed near and far limits and the structure stays centred and never lost
Clicking or tapping anywhere over the scene spawns an expanding ring from that exact point
The ring flares the nodes and links it sweeps across in outward order, then fades out unaided
Several rings from repeated taps coexist and overlap rather than cancelling each other
No instructions, labels or visible controls are required to understand the scene
adaptable_details: Number of nodes and links and the exact branching arrangement
Hue family of the emitted light and of the background points, and whether the surround sits below or above the web in luminance
Drift speed, breathing amplitude and coast deceleration feel
Ring expansion speed, thickness, flare intensity and fade duration
Density of the background field of distant points
Exact near and far zoom distances and the cap on simultaneous waves
Whether the structure is symmetric or irregular
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits any abstract connected or branching subject that reads as one centred form with a dense middle and sparse periphery, presented in a low-distraction ambient context that reserves enough luminance range for the emitted light, flares and depth cues to read. It also fits section-sized showpieces as long as the scene owns its own ambient frame and that frame's luminance separation, and stays the focus of that region. Turning it into a labelled data-inspection tool with selection, hover detail, filtering or persistent highlighting, replacing the free orbit with a guided or scripted camera path, flattening it into a depth-free diagram where surround and structure sit at the same luminance, or letting foreground text sit over it as a passive backdrop would each create a different Skill.

name: orbitable_glowing_orb_in_speckled_void
description: A lone translucent sphere at the centre of a sparse, speckled emptiness holds a slowly churning glow that bends and smears through its shell; dragging swings the view around it, zooming carries the viewer from a full framing to inside the sphere and back out, and the glow never stops.

canonical_document.name: orbitable_glowing_orb_in_speckled_void
canonical_document.description: A lone translucent sphere at the centre of a sparse, speckled emptiness holds a slowly churning glow that bends and smears through its shell; dragging swings the view around it, zooming carries the viewer from a full framing to inside the sphere and back out, and the glow never stops.
canonical_document.experience_scope: Whole-view experience occupying the full viewport. It begins with a low-distraction holding screen shown before the scene is ready and continues indefinitely once the scene opens; it has no end state and is left only when the visitor navigates away.
content_and_composition: One translucent sphere as the single subject, fixed at the exact centre of the view and never displaced by interaction
One luminous swirling mass contained inside the sphere, seen only through its shell and visibly distorted/refracted by it
A quiet, near-empty surround speckled with small distant points of light that separate clearly from it, filling the full viewport as depthless backdrop
A single short line of framing text placed at an edge of the view, small and persistent, never competing with the subject
Entry-stage overlay: the same quiet speckled field with one slowly pulsing geometric mark at its centre, replaced by the scene when ready
No panels, controls, indicators or navigation furniture around the subject
experience_progression: Quiet holding stage: the low-distraction speckled field with a slow, rhythmically pulsing geometric mark at centre
Reveal: the holding stage gives way and the scene opens up with the sphere alone at the centre
Open-ended dwelling stage: the glow keeps churning and the viewer freely orbits and moves in or out, with no build-up, milestones or finish
attention_and_information_flow: During the holding stage attention rests on the single pulsing mark, which signals only that something is coming
At reveal, attention transfers to the centred sphere, the only strongly emissive element against a surround held well below it in luminance
Attention thereafter stays on the internal glow, whose shifting shapes and refracted highlights supply the changing information
Moving closer shifts emphasis from the whole object and its shell to the interior structure of the glow; passing inside makes the glow envelop the view entirely
Moving further out restores the whole object framed by the speckled surround; the edge caption remains a quiet secondary read at all distances

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Reversing the drag reverses the swing; a new press during coasting immediately takes over the motion; the subject can never be pushed off centre or out of view
interaction_model.state_change: Vantage point swings around the fixed subject following the drag direction and distance
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The sphere appears to turn in place as highlights, refraction and the visible face of the internal glow shift with the new angle; the subject stays centred
interaction_model.input: Press and drag anywhere in the view (pointer or touch, identical behaviour)
interaction_model.affected_object: The viewer's vantage point around the centred sphere

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: A new press interrupts the coast and resumes direct control; if left alone the motion settles to rest with the subject still centred
interaction_model.state_change: Motion continues from the release velocity and decays to rest instead of stopping instantly
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The view keeps gliding around the sphere and eases smoothly to a standstill
interaction_model.input: Release of the drag
interaction_model.affected_object: The orbiting motion

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: The range is clamped at both ends so the subject can never be lost, stranded behind the viewer or shrunk away; reversing the gesture retraces the same path back out
interaction_model.state_change: Distance moves continuously nearer or further within a bounded range
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The sphere grows or shrinks smoothly; at the far bound the whole ball is framed with surrounding emptiness, and pushing nearer passes through the shell into the glow, rising to full enveloping luminance, and out again
interaction_model.input: Scroll wheel or pinch gesture
interaction_model.affected_object: Viewing distance to the sphere

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Never pauses, resets or waits for input; unaffected by dragging, zooming or idleness
interaction_model.state_change: Continuous churning and reshaping of the glow, independent of any input
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Ceaseless slow movement of light inside the shell, with refracted highlights shifting on the surface
interaction_model.input: Autonomous, always running
interaction_model.affected_object: The internal glowing swirl

experience_qualities: Calm, unhurried and meditative
Endlessly alive rather than goal-directed
Luminous and depth-rich against a restrained, far-separated surround
Weighty, inertial motion that glides and settles rather than snapping
Sparse and uncluttered, with a single subject carrying the whole view
Safe to explore, since no gesture can break the framing
completion_and_return: No completion state; the experience loops perpetually through the ongoing motion of the glow
The subject always returns to a centred, viewable state after any interaction
Idle periods look the same as active ones except that the vantage point rests
Leaving is voluntary and requires no exit step; nothing must be finished or dismissed
locked_observable_requirements: Exactly one translucent subject, permanently fixed at the centre of the view
A continuously moving glow visible inside the subject and visibly distorted by its shell
A sparsely speckled, near-empty surround filling the viewport as the only backdrop, separated far enough in luminance for the glow to read as the brightest element
Drag swings the vantage point around the subject without moving the subject
Release coasts and eases to a smooth stop rather than halting instantly
Bounded zoom that reaches out far enough to frame the whole subject and in far enough to pass inside it and back out
No input can lose, strand or off-centre the subject
Touch and pointer behave identically
Internal motion never stops for any reason
Entry passes through a low-distraction holding view matching the surround, with a single slowly pulsing central mark, before the scene is revealed
One small persistent line of edge text as the only text content
No ending, score, milestone or progression toward a finish
adaptable_details: Hues and overall palette of the glow, the speckles and the surround, in any light or dark register, as long as the glow remains the most luminous element
Shape language of the pulsing entry mark and its pulse rhythm
Density and contrast of the speckles against the surround
Exact swirl morphology and its speed
Coasting duration and easing feel
Precise near and far zoom bounds, as long as both stated extremes remain reachable
Which edge holds the framing line and its wording
Degree of shell clarity, tint or surface sheen
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits any single self-contained luminous or translucent subject with visible internal motion presented as a lone centrepiece on a near-empty, low-distraction full-view canvas with only a caption for framing, in any colour register that keeps the subject clearly the brightest element. Suits ambient landings, meditative pages and single-object showcases. It becomes a different Skill if multiple co-equal subjects, a scene with environment or ground, dense surrounding foreground content, a scripted or scroll-driven sequence with a beginning and end, or a subject the viewer moves through space rather than orbits is introduced; likewise if the subject can be dragged off centre or the internal motion becomes something the viewer must start, stop or complete.

name: linked_orthogonal_slice_triptych
description: Three perpendicular cross-sections of one volume shown together on a quiet low-distraction field — one enlarged, two smaller alongside — each drawing crosshair lines at a single shared point, with wheel stepping one layer deeper, pointer aiming re-slicing all three, and a small numeric panel reporting position and measured value.

canonical_document.name: linked_orthogonal_slice_triptych
canonical_document.description: Three perpendicular cross-sections of one volume shown together on a quiet low-distraction field — one enlarged, two smaller alongside — each drawing crosshair lines at a single shared point, with wheel stepping one layer deeper, pointer aiming re-slicing all three, and a small numeric panel reporting position and measured value.
canonical_document.experience_scope: A self-contained region-to-full-view exploration surface that becomes active once the volumetric content is available and persists for the whole session; it has no ending state, only a continuously updated current location.
content_and_composition: Exactly three cross-section panels, each showing a different mutually perpendicular plane through the same subject
Size hierarchy: one panel enlarged as the primary reading surface, the other two rendered smaller beside it
One shared marked location represented in every panel by crosshair lines at the corresponding in-plane position
A compact persistent numeric readout panel overlaying or adjoining the panels, showing current position indices, real-world coordinates and the sampled value at the pointer
A quiet, uniform, low-noise backdrop unifying all panels, held far enough away in luminance from the cross-section content that the imagery and thin marker lines dominate
Continuous-tone cross-section imagery, with measured value carried by a monotonic luminance ramp, as the sole foreground content; no decorative chrome competing with it
experience_progression: Content becomes readable and all three panels appear together already pinned to an initial shared location near the middle of the subject
Visitor advances inward or outward one layer at a time in whichever panel they are over, the other two panels holding their planes and only sliding their marker lines
Visitor re-aims by pressing or dragging inside a panel, causing the other two panels to re-slice and recentre continuously while the pointer travels
Exploration continues indefinitely by alternating stepping and re-aiming; there is no terminal stage
attention_and_information_flow: The enlarged panel carries primary attention; the two smaller panels act as continuous orientation context showing where the enlarged view sits within the whole
Crosshair lines are the connective cue that makes the three panels read as one subject rather than three pictures
During re-aiming, attention follows the pointer while peripheral awareness registers the other panels changing in step
Hover turns the readout panel into the momentary focus of precise information, then it blanks when the pointer leaves so the imagery is unobstructed
Depth position and measured value are always available as plain text rather than inferred from the imagery

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Every step is reversible by rolling the opposite direction; stepping stops at the outer limits of the subject instead of wrapping or emptying
interaction_model.state_change: The shared location moves exactly one layer deeper or shallower along the axis perpendicular to the hovered panel
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The hovered panel immediately shows the adjacent cross-section, and the crosshair lines in the other two panels shift by the corresponding single step
interaction_model.input: Wheel roll over any one of the cross-section panels
interaction_model.affected_object: That panel's plane depth and the shared location

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: A subsequent press elsewhere replaces the location; the previous location can be returned to by pressing it again
interaction_model.state_change: The shared location jumps to the in-plane position under the pointer
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Crosshairs snap to the pressed spot and the other two panels re-slice and recentre on the new location
interaction_model.input: Press inside a cross-section panel
interaction_model.affected_object: The shared marked location

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Tracking continues even when the pointer leaves the panel bounds and ends cleanly on release; the location is clamped to remain inside the subject's extents, and any drag can be undone by re-aiming
interaction_model.state_change: The shared location follows the pointer continuously for the duration of the drag and settles where the pointer is released
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Crosshairs track the pointer and the other two panels update continuously, giving a live sense of sweeping through the subject
interaction_model.input: Drag inside a cross-section panel
interaction_model.affected_object: The shared marked location and the other two panels' displayed planes

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Readout blanks when the pointer leaves the panels, leaving the imagery uncluttered, and resumes on re-entry
interaction_model.state_change: Readout switches from blank to live reporting for the position under the pointer
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Layer indices, real-world coordinates and the sampled value at the pointer update as the pointer moves
interaction_model.input: Hover moving across a cross-section panel
interaction_model.affected_object: The numeric readout panel

experience_qualities: Continuous and non-disorienting: the subject never appears to jump or flip between unrelated views
Precise and quantitative, with single-layer granularity and explicit numeric confirmation
Calm and instrument-like, the restrained uniform surround making the cross-section imagery and thin marker lines the only visual emphasis
Immediately responsive, with no perceptible lag between input and the other panels updating
Fully reversible, so exploration feels safe and consequence-free
completion_and_return: No completion state; the experience is an open-ended loop of stepping and re-aiming
The shared location persists across interactions so returning to a panel resumes exactly where it was left
Hover-driven readout returns to a blank resting state rather than retaining a stale value
Reaching the outer limits of the subject is a soft boundary that holds position instead of resetting
locked_observable_requirements: Three mutually perpendicular cross-sections of one subject visible simultaneously
Asymmetric size hierarchy of one enlarged panel plus two smaller companion panels
A single shared location drawn as crosshair lines in all three panels at all times
Wheel input steps exactly one layer, never a coarse or accelerating jump
Press and drag inside any panel repositions the shared location and re-slices the other two
Drag continues tracking beyond the panel edge and ends on release
A compact always-present numeric panel reporting current position, real-world coordinates and sampled value, blanking when the pointer exits
Uniform, low-noise backdrop behind all panels, clearly separated in luminance from the cross-section imagery
Location clamped inside the subject's extents and every move reversible
adaptable_details: Which of the three planes occupies the enlarged slot, and whether the small panels sit vertically or horizontally beside it
Placement, styling and exact field list of the numeric readout
Crosshair line contrast treatment, thickness and whether centre ticks are drawn
Panel spacing, borders, labels and overall canvas proportions
Whether re-aiming supports keyboard stepping in addition to wheel and pointer
Which tonal or hue mapping renders the cross-section imagery, and whether the surrounding field reads darker or lighter than that imagery
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits any subject that exists as a dense stack of parallel planes with meaningful perpendicular sections and per-position measured values, where a single point of interest must be shown from several directions at once. Reducing it to a single view, unlinking the panels so they no longer share a marked location, replacing layer stepping with free rotation of a rendered solid body, or removing the numeric position and value readout would each produce a different skill.

name: articulated_subject_posing_stage
description: A centered articulated subject on a grounded stage of low-distraction tone that re-articulates all of its limbs in real time as body or per-limb controls are dragged, with clear scope highlighting, gentle refusal of impossible poses, an orbiting coasting camera and a one-press eased return to a neutral stance.

canonical_document.name: articulated_subject_posing_stage
canonical_document.description: A centered articulated subject on a grounded stage of low-distraction tone that re-articulates all of its limbs in real time as body or per-limb controls are dragged, with clear scope highlighting, gentle refusal of impossible poses, an orbiting coasting camera and a one-press eased return to a neutral stance.
canonical_document.experience_scope: A single continuous region built around one persistent visual stage plus its adjoining control surface; it begins with the subject settling into a ready stance on arrival and continues indefinitely as an inspect-adjust-recover loop, with no exit state other than the recoverable neutral pose. Can occupy a full view or a large dedicated section, but the stage and controls are one inseparable experience.
content_and_composition: One articulated subject with a central body and a repeated set of jointed limbs, standing alone at the centre of the frame as the sole foreground object
A calm, uncluttered surrounding space held at a low-distraction tone that stays clearly separated from the subject, with no competing decoration
A ground plane beneath the subject plus soft contact shadows that anchor each limb tip and communicate height, tilt and scale
A persistent control surface adjacent to the stage holding whole-body position and tilt controls
A small top-down miniature diagram of the limb layout used as a scope picker, offering single limb, alternating limb subgroup, and all-limbs choices
A per-limb control group holding contact-target and joint-rotation controls, active only when a scope is chosen and always pre-loaded with the current values of that scope
Numeric or slider readouts for every controllable value, all visibly synchronized with the subject's actual pose
A single reset affordance for returning to the neutral stance
experience_progression: Arrival: the subject eases from an unposed state into a ready stance so it reads as alive rather than inert
Free inspection: the viewer orbits the stage and reads posture, contact points and scale
Scope selection: the viewer picks whole body, a limb subgroup or one limb and sees that choice highlighted while its controls activate with current values
Adjustment loop: dragging re-poses the chosen scope with all other limbs and readouts updating in step; out-of-range attempts snap back
Recovery: a single press eases the whole subject back to neutral, after which the loop can start again
attention_and_information_flow: The subject holds primary prominence at all times; the calm low-distraction surround and floor exist only to make its silhouette and posture readable through sufficient tonal separation

Choosing a scope shifts secondary prominence onto the affected limb or limb subgroup through highlighting, so it is never ambiguous whether an adjustment concerns the whole body, one contact point or a single joint
The picker reveals the limb layout from above, giving a spatial map that the highlighted subject confirms
During an adjustment, the moving parts and their shadows carry attention while unchanged readouts still visibly update, revealing that a local change has global consequences
A refused value redirects attention briefly to the snapping control, teaching where the limit lies without an error state taking over the view
During the eased return to neutral, attention rests entirely on the subject because controls are visibly inactive

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Plays once without user input; the subject then remains in the ready stance until acted upon
interaction_model.state_change: From initial state into a settled ready stance
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Limbs and body ease into position with contact shadows forming beneath each limb tip, reading as a living subject taking its stance
interaction_model.input: Autonomous, on arrival
interaction_model.affected_object: The articulated subject as a whole

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Any value that would put a contact point out of reach or press the body into the floor is rejected and the control snaps back to its last valid setting; the pose never enters a broken state
interaction_model.state_change: Body slides, rises and leans while every limb re-articulates to keep its contact point planted
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Continuous coordinated limb motion with joints bending plausibly, contact points fixed on the floor, shadows tightening or spreading as the body lowers or lifts, and all readouts tracking live
interaction_model.input: Dragging whole-body position and tilt controls
interaction_model.affected_object: Body transform and all limbs simultaneously

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Selection is freely switchable at any time; changing scope never alters the current pose
interaction_model.state_change: Previous scope clears and the new scope becomes active with its controls enabled
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The chosen limbs highlight with a distinct accent both in the picker and on the subject, and the per-limb controls appear active and pre-loaded with the current values of that scope
interaction_model.input: Choosing a scope in the top-down limb picker (one limb, an alternating subgroup, or all limbs)
interaction_model.affected_object: Selection state, the highlighted limbs, and the per-limb control group

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Out-of-reach or floor-penetrating values are refused and the control snaps back to its last valid setting, so the refusal feels gentle rather than like a failure
interaction_model.state_change: Chosen contact points retarget across the floor or chosen joints rotate, with the rest of the pose held
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The highlighted limbs move in a physically plausible arc with their shadows following, while every other readout updates to stay consistent with the resulting pose
interaction_model.input: Dragging per-limb contact-target or joint-rotation controls
interaction_model.affected_object: The selected limb or limb subgroup, and all dependent readouts

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: A new drag interrupts the coast immediately; orbiting never changes the pose and the subject stays centered
interaction_model.state_change: The view orbits around the stationary subject
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The subject and its floor shadows rotate smoothly in view; on release the orbit coasts briefly and settles
interaction_model.input: Dragging inside the stage area
interaction_model.affected_object: The viewing angle around the subject

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Controls remain inactive until the return motion finishes, after which full adjustment resumes; the neutral stance is always reachable from any pose
interaction_model.state_change: Current pose transitions to the neutral standing stance
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The subject eases limb by limb back into the neutral stance while all readouts animate to their neutral values and controls appear visibly inactive
interaction_model.input: Single press of the reset affordance
interaction_model.affected_object: The whole subject and the control surface

experience_qualities: Calm and uncluttered, with a low-distraction surround whose tonal separation isolates the subject
Alive rather than inert, established by the arrival settle and eased transitions
Physically plausible motion at all times, never snapping through impossible configurations
Confidence-building: scope is always obvious and consequences are always visible
Gentle rather than punitive at limits, refusing instead of breaking
Grounded and readable in scale thanks to floor contact and soft shadows
Reversible, because a neutral pose is always one press away
completion_and_return: No terminal completion; the experience is an open inspect-and-adjust loop
The eased return to the neutral stance acts as the reset point and is always available
Pose, selected scope and viewing angle persist while the viewer keeps working, and the view stays wherever it was orbited to across pose changes
The orbit coast self-terminates rather than continuing indefinitely
locked_observable_requirements: One articulated subject alone at the centre of a calm low-distraction space that holds clear tonal separation from the subject, with a floor and soft contact shadows that make posture and scale readable
An arrival transition that settles the subject into a ready stance
Whole-body adjustment that re-articulates every limb at once while contact points stay planted
A scope picker offering single limb, limb subgroup and all limbs, with the chosen scope visibly highlighted on both picker and subject
Per-limb controls that activate only with a selection and open pre-loaded with that scope's current values
All non-driven readouts visibly updating to stay consistent with any change
Invalid values refused with the control snapping back to its last valid setting, never a broken or interpenetrating pose
Scene dragging that orbits the view and coasts briefly after release
A single press that eases the subject back to neutral while controls stay visibly inactive until the motion finishes
adaptable_details: The kind of articulated subject and its visual style
The number of limbs and joints, and the exact grouping used for the subgroup option
The distinct accent treatment used for highlighting and the overall luminance level or texture of the surrounding space
Floor material, shadow softness and whether any subtle grid or horizon is present
Control widget styling and whether values appear as sliders, dials or numbers
Placement of the control surface and picker relative to the stage
Exact easing curves and durations of the arrival, reset and orbit coast
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits any single subject built from a central body and repeated jointed limbs or arms whose contact points and reach limits are meaningful, presented as the sole hero of a stage for inspection and posing. It still holds for different limb counts, subject styles and control layouts. It becomes a different skill if multiple subjects share the stage, if the subject is rigid and only rotatable rather than re-articulated, if adjustments no longer propagate visibly to other limbs and readouts, if the surrounding space becomes a busy scene or environment rather than a calm low-distraction ground, or if limits are surfaced as error messaging instead of a snap-back refusal.

name: speck_swarm_mark_assembly_void
description: Countless faint specks hang in an empty, weightless expanse whose uniform surround sits far enough away in luminance for even the faintest speck to read, and they gather in uneven waves until a single mark snaps into crisp focus, then stays as a settled object the visitor can orbit, zoom, replay or hold mid-formation.

canonical_document.name: speck_swarm_mark_assembly_void
canonical_document.description: Countless faint specks hang in an empty, weightless expanse whose uniform surround sits far enough away in luminance for even the faintest speck to read, and they gather in uneven waves until a single mark snaps into crisp focus, then stays as a settled object the visitor can orbit, zoom, replay or hold mid-formation.
canonical_document.experience_scope: Whole-view, full-viewport experience. It begins with a brief holding moment before the scene appears, hands the visitor into the emptiness, and continues indefinitely as an inspectable settled scene; it has no built-in exit or transition to other page content.
content_and_composition: Exactly one focal mark as the only readable form in the view, held near the centre of attention
A very large population of small faint specks as the sole visual material, positioned in depth and initially dispersed with no legible structure

A uniform, empty surround with no horizon, ground plane, framing or decorative chrome, separated enough in luminance from the specks that the faintest of them stay visible, reading as open weightless space
A short pre-entry holding state that signals something is still preparing and is replaced by the empty expanse when ready
Minimal persistent controls kept visually subordinate to the scene: one replay trigger and one continuous formation control
Layering is purely depth-based: specks in front of and behind the forming mark share one continuous space rather than stacked flat layers
experience_progression: Holding moment: scene not yet present, visitor sees only that preparation is underway
Hand-off into the empty expanse: specks appear fully scattered, faint and formless, no recognizable subject
Uneven gathering: specks converge in waves over several seconds, some regions resolving ahead of others so partial hints of form emerge
Resolution: the mark becomes unmistakable while the overall haze gives way to crispness
Settled state: the completed mark persists as a finished object, stable and lingerable, and remains replayable from fully scattered
attention_and_information_flow: Attention starts spread evenly across a field of faint specks with nothing to fixate on
Prominence migrates inward as density concentrates, pulling the eye toward the emerging form before it is identifiable
Recognition arrives late rather than immediately, so the reveal is earned by watching
After resolution the mark holds nearly all prominence and remaining loose specks read as atmosphere
Camera movement re-weights attention by parallax: nearer specks sweep faster than the mark, reinforcing which element is the subject
Controls stay quiet until used and never outrank the mark

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Runs once to completion and then holds; can be restarted or overridden by the replay trigger or the continuous formation control at any time
interaction_model.state_change: Advances from fully scattered to fully formed over several seconds
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Specks migrate in uneven waves, density builds toward the mark, and hazy softness sharpens into crisp definition
interaction_model.input: Timed autonomous driver after the holding moment ends
interaction_model.affected_object: The speck population and overall image clarity

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Fully reversible by dragging back; a new drag interrupts the coast and takes over immediately; the view always comes to a stable rest
interaction_model.state_change: Viewing angle swings continuously with pointer movement and then decelerates to rest
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The whole speck field and the mark rotate together with depth parallax; after release motion continues briefly and eases to a stop rather than cutting dead
interaction_model.input: Drag across the scene
interaction_model.affected_object: Viewpoint around the mark

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Reversible in both directions; clamped at both bounds so the visitor can never lose the mark or pass through it
interaction_model.state_change: View moves nearer or farther within a bounded range
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The mark and surrounding specks grow or shrink in the frame; movement stops firmly at the near and far limits
interaction_model.input: Wheel or pinch
interaction_model.affected_object: Viewing distance to the mark

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Firing it again mid-run abandons the running pass and restarts cleanly with no blending, doubling or leftover motion from the previous pass
interaction_model.state_change: Any current state, mid-run or settled, is abandoned and the sequence restarts from fully scattered
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The mark disperses back to a formless field and the gathering waves begin again from the start
interaction_model.input: Replay trigger
interaction_model.affected_object: The formation sequence

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Scrubbing backward is as responsive as forward; releasing leaves the scene held at the chosen point; the replay trigger returns it to an autonomous pass from fully scattered
interaction_model.state_change: Formation is held at any chosen point instead of playing on its own
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The speck field tightens or loosens and clarity sharpens or softens immediately as the control moves, in either direction
interaction_model.input: One continuous formation control
interaction_model.affected_object: Position within the scattered-to-complete range

experience_qualities: Weightless and depthless, with no sense of ground or gravity
Atmospheric and quiet: an unbroken low-distraction surround dominates while the material itself reads as faintly self-luminous against it
Suspenseful then satisfying: unreadable for a while, then unmistakable
Hazy-to-crisp, so clarity itself is part of the payoff
Organic and uneven rather than mechanical or uniformly timed
Physical-feeling camera control with soft momentum instead of abrupt stops
Lingerable: the finished state invites dwelling and re-watching
completion_and_return: The sequence completes into a settled, stable mark that persists indefinitely without looping on its own
Replay resets to fully scattered and plays a fresh pass
Mid-run replay discards the in-progress pass and starts cleanly rather than resuming it
The continuous control leaves the scene parked at whatever intermediate point the visitor chose
Camera state persists across replays: rotating or zooming does not reset formation, and replaying does not reset the viewpoint
Zoom and drag always settle to a rest state within bounds
locked_observable_requirements: An empty, horizonless, uniform surround, held far enough from the specks in luminance for them to read, with the subject suspended in it
A very large number of small faint specks as the only material from which the subject is made
An initial state in which no readable form is discernible
Gathering that is uneven and wave-like and unfolds over seconds, never instantaneous
Softness or haze at the start giving way to crispness at resolution
A single unmistakable resolved mark that then holds as a completed object
Drag rotates the viewpoint around the subject and eases to a stop after release
Wheel or pinch changes distance within hard near and far limits
A trigger replays from fully scattered, and re-triggering mid-run abandons and cleanly restarts
One continuous control can hold formation at any intermediate point and updates immediately in both directions
A brief preparing state precedes the scene rather than showing a broken or empty expanse
adaptable_details: Which mark, glyph or simple silhouette is formed
Speck count, size, luminance, hue and falloff
Which luminance direction and hue family the surround and the glow take, so long as their separation still lets faint specks read
Duration and easing character of the formation pass
How wave unevenness is distributed across the form
Visual styling and placement of the replay trigger and continuous control
Styling of the preparing state
Near and far distance limits and rotation sensitivity
Whether faint stray specks remain as ambience after resolution
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits any single compact subject with a recognizable silhouette — an emblem, symbol, letterform, icon or simple shape — presented on a low-content view whose whole purpose is that subject. It stays the same skill across different marks, speck densities, timings, surround luminance directions and hue families. It becomes a different skill if multiple subjects form or coexist, if substantial reading content must sit over or beside it, if the surround gains scenery, environmental structure or spatial detail instead of staying an empty featureless field, if the material stops being a dispersed speck field, or if the scattered-to-resolved transition is removed and the subject is simply displayed and orbited.

name: scrubbable_surface_dissolve_of_orbiting_hero_form
description: A lone reflective form floats in an empty mirrored surround, frozen mid-dissolve with a luminous fringe and escaping sparks at the eaten edge; the visitor orbits and zooms freely and drags one continuous amount control to consume or rebuild the surface in either direction.

canonical_document.name: scrubbable_surface_dissolve_of_orbiting_hero_form
canonical_document.description: A lone reflective form floats in an empty mirrored surround, frozen mid-dissolve with a luminous fringe and escaping sparks at the eaten edge; the visitor orbits and zooms freely and drags one continuous amount control to consume or rebuild the surface in either direction.
canonical_document.experience_scope: Whole-view experience: begins on arrival in the spatial scene after a featureless entry hold and continues indefinitely as an inspectable region occupying the full viewport; it has no exit or hand-off to other content, and the single amount control plus the viewpoint are the only persistent foreground interface.
content_and_composition: Exactly one subject form, centered and hovering with no ground contact, as the sole content of interest

The luminous fringe is the highest-salience element and pulls the eye to the boundary between intact surface and consumed material
Escaping sparks lead attention outward from the boundary into the surrounding emptiness, then back to the remaining mass
Remaining material is legible instantly from the body itself and echoed by the position of the amount control
Orbiting redistributes prominence across the form's faces without ever introducing a second subject

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: View tracks the pointer continuously and settles immediately when the drag ends, with no drift or inertial overshoot; releasing and re-dragging resumes from the current angle so any side can be returned to
interaction_model.state_change: Viewing angle swings continuously around the subject while the subject stays centered
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The form and its reflections rotate under the pointer in step with the drag, revealing other sides of the dissolve boundary and highlights sliding across the metallic surface

interaction_model.affected_object: Viewpoint around the hovering form

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Continuous and immediately reversible in the opposite direction; distance holds where released and stays bounded so the subject is never lost from view
interaction_model.state_change: Camera pulls closer or further from the subject
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The form grows or shrinks in frame; close in, the fringe and individual particles become inspectable, further out the whole silhouette and remaining mass read at once
interaction_model.input: Wheel or pinch
interaction_model.affected_object: Viewing distance to the form

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Clamps at fully gone and holds there; the same control reversed rebuilds through the identical states
interaction_model.state_change: More of the surface is consumed, advancing the dissolve boundary across the body
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Surface is eaten away progressively while the luminous fringe sweeps across whatever remains and sparks stream off the advancing edge; the shrinking intact mass is visible at a glance
interaction_model.input: Dragging the single continuous amount control forward
interaction_model.affected_object: Subject surface material state

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Clamps at fully solid, guaranteeing the form can always be returned to intact; scrubbing can be interrupted and reversed mid-motion at any point
interaction_model.state_change: Consumed material is restored, retreating the dissolve boundary
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Surface reappears through the same intermediate appearances, with the fringe and sparks retreating with the boundary until the form is whole and unbroken
interaction_model.input: Dragging the same amount control backward
interaction_model.affected_object: Subject surface material state

experience_qualities: Quiet and unhurried; nothing competes for attention and nothing moves on its own
Fully reversible and consequence-free, so any stage invites study rather than commitment
Contemplative and exhibit-like, with the subject isolated as a specimen
Tactile and immediate: view and material both answer the pointer without lag or settling delay
Dramatic material contrast between the calm reflective intact surface and the high-salience luminous decay edge
completion_and_return: No completion, success state or dismissal; the experience persists as long as the view is open
Both extremes are stable resting states rather than endings: fully solid and fully gone can each be held indefinitely
Return to the intact form is always available through the same control, with no separate reset affordance required
Viewpoint and dissolve amount persist wherever the visitor left them; neither snaps back automatically
locked_observable_requirements: Exactly one subject, hovering, isolated in an empty reflective surround with no competing foreground content
The subject is already partway transformed on arrival, not intact
A visible boundary between intact and consumed material, marked by a luminous fringe with particles escaping from it
Remaining material is readable at a glance from the subject itself
One single continuous amount control that scrubs the transformation in both directions through the same intermediate states
Hard clamps at fully solid and fully gone
The transformation never advances autonomously
Orbit and distance control that follow the pointer continuously and settle immediately on release, always keeping the subject framed
adaptable_details: Identity, silhouette and complexity of the single subject
Specific reflective material character and colour treatment of the surroundings, whether light, mid or deep in overall level
Hue, brightness and thickness of the boundary fringe, provided it stays the most salient element
Density, size and drift behaviour of the escaping particles
Visual form and placement of the amount control
Presence and styling of the entry hold and its looping wait cue
Orbit and zoom limits and sensitivity
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits any single well-defined subject whose surface can be shown intact, partly consumed and gone, presented as an isolated exhibit with little or no surrounding copy. Adding multiple simultaneous subjects, placing the subject behind foreground text as a backdrop, making the transformation run automatically or one-way, or removing the visible boundary-and-particles treatment in favour of a plain fade would each produce a different Skill.

name: breathing_grass_island_orbit
description: A small isolated landform densely furred with layered grass strands that breathe in a constant breeze, its far edges dissolving into soft haze that washes out detail and contrast, with a chunky sculpted word lying in the grass casting soft pooled shadow; the view swings around it with weighted, coasting momentum and settles into a slow perpetual orbit when left alone.

canonical_document.name: breathing_grass_island_orbit
canonical_document.description: A small isolated landform densely furred with layered grass strands that breathe in a constant breeze, its far edges dissolving into soft haze that washes out detail and contrast, with a chunky sculpted word lying in the grass casting soft pooled shadow; the view swings around it with weighted, coasting momentum and settles into a slow perpetual orbit when left alone.
canonical_document.experience_scope: A self-contained scene region that fills its own view area; it begins fully alive at arrival with no build-in or intro sequence and never ends, having no completion state, exit condition or handoff to another view.
content_and_composition: One small landform as the single subject, held at the centre of the view at all times and readable as a complete silhouette when the camera is pulled back
One dense groundcover layer of many fine individual strands blanketing the landform, thick enough to read as soft fluffy volume from a distance and as separable strands up close
Patchy lighter-and-darker tonal variation distributed across the groundcover so the surface reads as uneven natural clumping rather than one uniform flat value
One chunky sculpted word resting down in the groundcover, partly settled into it rather than floating above it, with soft shadow pooling beneath and around its forms
A soft hazy atmosphere that thickens toward the outer edges of the landform, progressively lowering contrast and detail so far edges fade out instead of ending on a hard boundary
Calm, evenly diffuse overall lighting with no harsh highlight and no single dominant hotspot
Persistent elements: the landform stays centred, the wind motion never stops, and the haze and sculpted word remain present at every distance
experience_progression: Arrival: the scene is already mid-motion, the whole meadow breathing in a steady breeze, so nothing appears to start
Wide reading: the overall silhouette of the landform and its hazy dissolving edges dominate
Approach: as the camera pulls in, the surface resolves into layered strands, patchy tonal variation and the sculpted word's soft shadow pooling
Free travel: the viewer moves back and forth between whole-shape and close-up richness in any order, with no fixed sequence
Release: momentum from the last drag coasts and decays to rest instead of stopping dead
Idle: the viewpoint eases back into a slow continuous orbit that loops indefinitely
No resolved final state ever occurs; the scene stays somewhere to linger and keep looking
attention_and_information_flow: Attention starts at the outer silhouette of the landform and the soft fade of its edges into haze
Pulling closer trades silhouette for material information: strand layering, density and lighter-and-darker patchiness become the subject
The sculpted word acts as the one hard-edged, crisply lit anchor amid soft vegetation, drawing the eye down from the overall shape into the surface
The pooled shadow under the word communicates how deeply it sits in the groundcover and reinforces surface depth
Continuous breeze motion keeps low-level attention alive everywhere in the frame, so no single point holds the eye permanently
Idle auto-orbit slowly reveals previously hidden sides of the landform, feeding new information without any user action

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Drag can start, reverse or stop at any moment and immediately takes over from the idle orbit; the subject can never be pushed out of frame
interaction_model.state_change: Viewing angle swings around the subject while the subject remains centred
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The landform turns in place, revealing new sides and shifting the silhouette and the read of the sculpted word
interaction_model.input: Drag across the scene
interaction_model.affected_object: Viewpoint around the centred landform

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: A new drag interrupts the coast at once and resumes direct control
interaction_model.state_change: Motion continues with weight and decays to rest instead of halting instantly
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The scene keeps swinging briefly and coasts smoothly to a stop
interaction_model.input: Release after dragging
interaction_model.affected_object: Viewpoint motion

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Distance is bounded at both ends so the view cannot pass inside or lose the subject; reversing the gesture returns to the previous range
interaction_model.state_change: View moves between close range and full-shape range
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Close in, individual strands, tonal patchiness and the word's soft shadow become legible; pulled back, the whole landform silhouette and its hazy edges dominate
interaction_model.input: Wheel or pinch
interaction_model.affected_object: Camera distance to the landform

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Any drag or zoom takes over immediately; leaving it alone again returns to the same slow orbit, so fumbling always self-corrects
interaction_model.state_change: Control hands back from the user to a slow continuous automatic orbit
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The viewpoint eases, without a jump, into a gentle endless circling of the landform
interaction_model.input: Sustained absence of input
interaction_model.affected_object: Viewpoint

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Never pauses, never completes and is unaffected by user input or view distance
interaction_model.state_change: Steady breeze motion runs continuously and independently of the camera
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The entire meadow sways as one breathing mass with strands leaning and recovering
interaction_model.input: Autonomous ambient driver
interaction_model.affected_object: Groundcover strands across the whole landform

experience_qualities: Calm, airy and hazy
Soft, fluffy, tactile density
Breathing, never-still ambience
Weighted, coasting movement rather than snappy control
Forgiving: impossible to get lost or break the view
Unresolved and lingerable rather than finished
Intimate at close range, small-world and complete when pulled back
completion_and_return: No completion, success state or end frame exists
Idle behaviour loops indefinitely as a slow orbit
The view returns to autonomous orbit after every interaction rather than resetting to a fixed starting angle
Camera distance persists where the user left it until they change it again
Ambient breeze motion is permanent and unaffected by interaction history
locked_observable_requirements: Subject stays centred and can never be lost, pushed off frame or passed through
Groundcover reads as dense layered individual strands up close and as soft fluffy volume from afar
Patchy lighter-and-darker tonal variation across the groundcover, not one flat uniform value
Continuous unified breeze motion present at arrival and never stopping
Far edges dissolve into haze that progressively drops contrast and detail instead of ending at a hard boundary
A chunky sculpted word sits down in the groundcover with soft shadow pooling beneath it
Zoom range spans single-strand legibility to whole-silhouette reading, bounded at both ends
Drag carries momentum and coasts to rest after release
Unattended view eases back into a slow continuous orbit without a visible jump or snap
The scene never resolves into a static finished state
adaptable_details: Shape, scale and profile of the landform
Exact wording and letterform style of the sculpted word
Hues and overall tonal register of vegetation, lighting and haze, including whether the scene reads light or dark
Breeze speed, gust rhythm and sway amplitude
Auto-orbit speed and idle delay before it resumes
Zoom range endpoints and momentum decay feel
Presence of minor secondary scenery on the landform
Whether the scene fills the whole view or occupies a bounded region
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits any single small self-contained subject whose appeal is a dense field of fine repeating elements read at two scales, optionally carrying one short sculpted word or mark inside the scene; text-heavy pages that need copy overlaid on top of it do not fit because the moving surface and haze compete with reading. Replacing the always-centred orbit with free traversal or first-person walking, adding a goal, score or completion state, or letting the subject leave the frame would each create a different Skill, as would reducing the groundcover to a flat textured surface that never resolves into individual strands.

name: collapsing_liquid_column_orbit_view
description: A single body of liquid drops as a tall column into its container, sloshes, and settles into a restless pool on an empty backdrop of any luminance, while dragging swings the vantage point around it and scrolling steps closer or further.

canonical_document.name: collapsing_liquid_column_orbit_view
canonical_document.description: A single body of liquid drops as a tall column into its container, sloshes, and settles into a restless pool on an empty backdrop of any luminance, while dragging swings the vantage point around it and scrolling steps closer or further.

Surface material presence as primary content: a tint of any hue, transparency showing depth beneath, high-luminance specular highlights, and mirrored surroundings reflected on the surface

The opening collapse seizes attention through scale and speed of motion

interaction_model.input: Autonomous ongoing simulation
interaction_model.affected_object: The pool surface

interaction_model.affected_object: Vantage point elevation

canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits any single continuously simulated fluid or soft material presented as an isolated centerpiece on an empty backdrop of any luminance, where the visitor's only role is to look from chosen angles. It becomes a different skill if the subject is pushed behind foreground content as a background substrate, if visitor-authored disturbance of the material (pouring, splashing, stirring) becomes the primary interaction, if multiple subjects or a traversable scene replace the single centered subject, or if the one-time collapse reveal is dropped in favor of an already-settled state.

attention_and_information_flow: Attention starts on emptiness, so the first appearance of light is the only thing to look at
Prominence is carried entirely by the luminance separation between the emitted light and the quieter surround; the most luminous area is always the subject or the momentary gap under the pointer
Local brightening pulls the eye to wherever the pointer is, then releases it back to the whole silhouette as the light re-settles

New information is only positional: each drag angle reveals different contours and depth relationships of the same form, so understanding accumulates by re-viewing rather than by disclosure of new content

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Runs once on its own; it is not interruptible or repeatable within the session, and interaction becomes meaningful once the form is legible
interaction_model.state_change: Empty, subject-free view transitions into a coalescing haze that settles into the legible form
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Light gathers out of emptiness and condenses into the subject's contour and volume
interaction_model.input: Page arrival / passage of a short initial delay
interaction_model.affected_object: The void and the luminous subject

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: The instant the pointer moves along or slips off the form, the displaced light streams back onto the exact original contour and dims; onset and recovery are immediate, the reaction radius stays small, and no deformation persists
interaction_model.state_change: Those points are shoved outward from the pointer, opening a hole in the light field while the rest of the form is untouched
interaction_model.visible_feedback: An immediate high-luminance momentary gap tears open under the cursor, with displaced light flaring around its edge
interaction_model.input: Pointer moved across the form
interaction_model.affected_object: The luminous points in a small neighbourhood directly beneath the pointer

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: On release the rotation coasts smoothly to rest; framing and viewing distance are locked so the subject stays centered and can never be pushed offscreen, zoomed away or clipped; a new drag can seize the motion mid-coast
interaction_model.state_change: The view swings continuously around the sculpture, following the drag direction and speed
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The form rotates in place, revealing other contours and profiles while the quiet low-distraction surround stays constant
interaction_model.input: Drag across the view
interaction_model.affected_object: The viewing angle onto the whole subject

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Always running underneath and never blocking interaction; interaction overlays it and it continues unchanged afterwards
interaction_model.state_change: Continuous subtle internal drift and shimmer with no drift of the framing
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The form appears to breathe and stay alive rather than sit as a static image
interaction_model.input: Idle time with no input
interaction_model.affected_object: The luminous point field of the subject

experience_qualities: Hushed, empty and void-like on entry
Fragile and alive when held close, as though the light could scatter
Immediately, physically responsive under the pointer with no lag between touch and gap
Self-healing and consequence-free, so probing feels safe and repeatable
Weighted and smooth when spun, with an unhurried coast to stillness
Open-ended and meditative, rewarding lingering rather than completion
completion_and_return: No finish line, score, progress or unlockable end state
Every local disturbance returns the light exactly to the intact contour
Rotation persists only as the current viewing angle; it never accumulates damage or drift in framing
The lingering state is the resting state and is returned to automatically after any interaction
locked_observable_requirements: One subject only, alone in an empty, quiet, evenly toned surround whose luminance stays clearly separated from the emitted light
The subject is rendered as a field of drifting luminous particles/haze rather than an opaque solid surface
A short calm empty wait precedes the form resolving out of the haze
Pointer disturbance is strictly local to a small neighbourhood, begins immediately, and reads as a high-luminance torn-open gap
Displaced light restores exactly onto the original contour and dims as soon as the pointer leaves that spot; no permanent deformation is possible
Dragging orbits the whole view around the subject and coasts smoothly to rest after release
Framing and viewing distance are locked so the subject can never be lost, cropped away or zoomed out of relevance
Continuous subtle ambient motion keeps the form feeling alive at idle
No failure, completion or spoiled state exists
adaptable_details: Silhouette and identity of the depicted form
Hue, colour temperature and accent tint of the light, and the tone of the surround it is separated from
Particle density, grain size and haze softness
Length of the initial wait and the coalescence timing
Size of the reactive neighbourhood and strength of the outward shove
Drag sensitivity and duration of the coast to rest
Presence and wording of a small peripheral caption
Whether it fills the viewport or a large bounded region
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits any single iconic, sculptural or emblematic subject that can carry a view on its own and benefits from mood plus close inspection, with at most minimal peripheral text. It stops being this Skill if multiple subjects or a browsable set are introduced, if free zoom and pan replace locked orbit framing, if disturbances persist so the visitor can sculpt or damage the form, if the reaction becomes global rather than a small local neighbourhood, or if the subject is presented as an opaque solid surface instead of light-like particulate matter. It is a foreground stage and is not intended to sit behind dense readable content.

name: morphing_single_figure_variant_dial
description: A large centred silhouette figure that visibly reshapes itself through plausible in-between forms into whichever numbered variant the visitor selects, taking the shorter way round a closed loop and settling to rest, with a live fractional position readout beside the selectors.

canonical_document.name: morphing_single_figure_variant_dial
canonical_document.description: A large centred silhouette figure that visibly reshapes itself through plausible in-between forms into whichever numbered variant the visitor selects, taking the shorter way round a closed loop and settling to rest, with a live fractional position readout beside the selectors.
canonical_document.experience_scope: A self-contained region or small whole-view experience: one dominant figure area with a compact selector strip and readout beneath it. It begins when the view first settles after a brief indeterminate opening wait and the figure appears at its starting variant; it has no end state, remaining at rest on the currently viewed variant until the visitor chooses another.
content_and_composition: Exactly one foreground figure, large, centred, read as a backlit silhouette with strong luminance separation from the field behind it, dominating the region
Deliberately empty, low-distraction surrounding field: no captions, decoration or secondary imagery competing with the figure
A small fixed closed set of variants of that same figure (five in the source case), treated as one cycle with no first and no last member
One horizontal row of small round markers below the figure, one per variant, each labelled with its variant number
Marker order arranged so cycle neighbours sit side by side, with the starting variant positioned in the middle of the row rather than at an end
One small live numeric readout adjacent to the marker row showing the figure's fractional position between variants
Persistent elements across the whole experience: the figure, the marker row and the readout
experience_progression: Rest: the figure holds one exact variant and the readout shows that whole position
Depart: on selection the figure begins reshaping immediately from its current form, with no cut, fade or reset
Travel: a continuous sweep of roughly one second through intermediate forms along the shorter direction round the cycle, skipping variants that are not on that shorter path
Settle: the figure decelerates onto the chosen variant exactly and visibly comes to rest
Loop: the cycle has no beginning or end, so travel can continue indefinitely in either direction from any resting variant
attention_and_information_flow: The figure carries nearly all visual prominence at all times; markers are clearly secondary and the readout tertiary
During travel the halfway forms are as watchable as the endpoints, so attention stays on the transformation rather than waiting for the destination
The readout is the only continuously changing information channel during motion, quantifying how far along the cycle the figure currently is
The marker for the current variant reads as active while at rest, so the viewer always knows which of the set is on screen
Arrival is communicated by motion coming to rest and by the readout resolving to an exact whole position, not by a separate notice

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: The motion can be redirected at any moment by another selection; no separate cancel is needed and any variant remains directly reachable from any resting point
interaction_model.state_change: The figure leaves its resting variant and travels along the shorter direction round the closed cycle to the selected variant, then rests there
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Continuous reshaping of one body through believable intermediate forms for about a second, ending in a visible settle exactly on the target; the readout counts fractionally along the way and the selected marker becomes the active one
interaction_model.input: Click a marker for a variant other than the one currently shown, while the figure is at rest
interaction_model.affected_object: The centred figure and the readout

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Retargeting is repeatable without limit; the figure never lands on an unselected variant and always ends at rest on the last chosen one
interaction_model.state_change: The destination is replaced immediately and the figure continues from its current intermediate form toward the new target
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Uninterrupted motion that changes course without snapping back to the previous variant or jumping to a fresh start; the readout keeps reporting the live fractional position
interaction_model.input: Click a different marker while the figure is mid-travel
interaction_model.affected_object: The travelling figure and the readout

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Safe to repeat; the interaction never produces a full loop round the cycle or a stutter
interaction_model.state_change: No state change
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Nothing moves; the figure stays exactly at rest on that variant
interaction_model.input: Click the marker of the variant already on screen
interaction_model.affected_object: The figure

experience_qualities: One living body reshaping itself rather than images being swapped
Intermediate forms feel plausible and worth watching in their own right
Calm and uncluttered, with a single point of focus
Responsive and non-jarring: input changes course rather than restarting motion
Deliberate weight and finality in how the figure comes to rest
Endless and boundary-free: no sense of a first or last item
completion_and_return: Each selection completes by settling exactly on the chosen variant in roughly a second
The resting variant persists as the current state until the visitor selects another
The readout resolves from fractional to an exact whole position at rest
The cycle loops indefinitely with every variant reachable at any time; there is no terminal state, replay control or reset step
locked_observable_requirements: A single large centred figure is the only foreground content, clearly separated from an uncluttered, low-distraction surrounding field
Variant changes are continuous morphs of the same body through believable intermediate forms; cuts, crossfades, slides or photo swaps are excluded
Halfway forms must be as visually plausible and watchable as the endpoints
A small fixed set of variants forming a closed cycle with no first or last, every one directly selectable at any moment
Traversal always takes the shorter way round the cycle and never steps through every intervening variant
Travel lasts roughly a second and ends in a visible coming-to-rest exactly on the chosen variant
One small round labelled marker per variant, arranged in a single row so cycle neighbours are adjacent and the starting variant sits in the middle
A live numeric readout of fractional position visible while the figure moves
Mid-travel selection retargets immediately from the current intermediate form with no snap back or restart
Selecting the variant already displayed produces no visible change
adaptable_details: Subject type of the figure and its exact styling, silhouette treatment, direction and intensity of the backlighting, and the hue, luminance and tonal scheme chosen for figure and surrounding field, in either a light or dark register, as long as the figure stays clearly separated from its surround
Exact number of variants, as long as it stays a small closed cycle
Precise travel duration and easing character of departure and settling
Marker size, shape, labelling scheme, active-state styling and spacing
Readout format, precision and exact placement beside the markers
Whether an opening indeterminate wait is shown and how it is presented
Region size and whether it occupies a section or the full view
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits any context where the alternatives are forms of one continuous subject so that blended in-between states are meaningful and attractive — single-figure poses or portraits, one product outline, a single logo or shape, glyph forms — presented as a solitary spotlight with a small closed set of choices. It does not fit multi-item galleries or unrelated pictorial content where intermediate blends would be nonsense. Replacing the morph with discrete transitions, turning the closed cycle into a linear first-to-last sequence, showing several subjects at once, or driving the change autonomously instead of by visitor selection would each produce a different Skill.
