name: floating_platform_toy_robot_hold_to_study
description: A small mechanical character paces a softly glowing platform suspended in an empty, faintly speckled void, gauges twitching and gears turning; pressing and holding lifts it toward the viewer as the platform and its shadow shrink and sink away, and releasing eases everything back and resumes the pacing from the exact spot it paused.

canonical_document.name: floating_platform_toy_robot_hold_to_study
canonical_document.description: A small mechanical character paces a softly glowing platform suspended in an empty, faintly speckled void, gauges twitching and gears turning; pressing and holding lifts it toward the viewer as the platform and its shadow shrink and sink away, and releasing eases everything back and resumes the pacing from the exact spot it paused.
canonical_document.experience_scope: A self-contained single-subject stage, usable as a whole view or as a large region; it begins the moment the scene appears with the character already alive and pacing, and it has no end state. The hold interaction opens and closes a temporary close-study mode inside the same continuous scene rather than navigating anywhere.
content_and_composition: Single foreground character: a small mechanical figure with independently moving parts (limbs, eyes, dials/gauges, gears), centered as the sole attention anchor.
One luminous platform surface directly beneath the character, hanging in mid-air with no visible support, defining the walkable area of the wander.
A cast shadow on the platform tying the character to its surface and communicating height.

Featureless void backdrop scattered with faint pinpoint speckles and held at a luminance clearly separated from the platform and character, forming an unbroken low-distraction surround with no horizon, walls or furniture.
Ambient illumination emanating from the platform as the scene's dominant light source, giving the lit character clear luminance separation from the quieter surround.
No instructional copy, labels, hotspots, chrome or controls are required in the frame; the character and platform are the only meaningful content roles.
experience_progression: Ambient stage: wide framing, the character wanders the platform continuously with mechanical idle motion, indefinitely loopable and watchable with no input.
Transition inward while the press is held: the character eases up toward the viewer, its wandering settles where it stands, and the platform plus shadow shrink and sink out of sight.
Close study: the character is held still in place and near the viewer, its parts still moving, available for unhurried inspection with no timer and no next step.
Transition outward on release: the character eases back down and away, the platform and shadow rise and grow back into place.
Ambient stage resumes: the wander continues from the exact point at which it paused, so the loop reads as uninterrupted rather than restarted.
attention_and_information_flow: Opening framing puts attention on the character immediately: it is the only illuminated, moving, detailed element in an otherwise empty field.
Continuous small mechanical motion (twitching gauges, turning gears, shifting eyes) sustains attention without requiring any interaction.
During the inward transition, prominence transfers from the whole scene to the character alone as the platform and shadow withdraw from the frame.
In close study, previously hard-to-read detail becomes legible: individual joints, dial faces and surface detail become the revealed information.
On the outward transition, spatial context returns as the platform and shadow re-enter, restoring the sense of a figure standing on a floating stage in an open void.
No textual information is layered in; all revealed information is the character's own detail and continued liveliness.

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Runs indefinitely and needs no start or stop; any interaction interrupts it non-destructively and it can always resume from where it was
interaction_model.state_change: Continuous wandering across the platform plus perpetual idle mechanical motion
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The figure paces the luminous surface while gauges twitch, eyes shift and gears turn; its shadow tracks with it
interaction_model.input: Autonomous ambient loop with no user input
interaction_model.affected_object: The character and its moving parts

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: The whole press target is the platform and the character, so aiming is forgiving; holding sustains the close view for as long as the visitor wants with no timeout
interaction_model.state_change: Ambient stage transitions into close-study mode: the character rises toward the viewer, its travel pauses in place, and the platform and shadow shrink and sink away
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The figure eases nearer and larger and stops walking where it stands while its limbs, eyes and dials keep moving; the luminous platform and its shadow diminish and drop out of view
interaction_model.input: Press and hold anywhere on the platform area, including on the character itself
interaction_model.affected_object: Character position, character wandering, platform and cast shadow

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Always returns to the same ambient state; the wander's continuity across the pause is preserved
interaction_model.state_change: Close-study mode transitions back to the ambient stage and the paused wander resumes
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The figure eases back down and away as the platform and shadow rise and expand back into place, then the pacing continues from the exact point where it stopped rather than snapping to a new position or restarting
interaction_model.input: Release of the press
interaction_model.affected_object: Character position, character wandering, platform and cast shadow

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Interruption is always permitted at any moment and in either direction; repeated rapid presses and releases stay continuous and never leave the scene stranded between states
interaction_model.state_change: The transition reverses or re-enters from wherever it currently is
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Motion blends smoothly out of the current in-between state with no jump, snap or restart of the movement
interaction_model.input: Release or a new press part-way through either transition
interaction_model.affected_object: The entire coordinated transition (character height, platform scale and descent, shadow)

experience_qualities: Playful and mechanical: a toy-like little machine rather than a serious product model
Hypnotic and low-demand: pleasant to simply watch with nothing to learn or achieve
Calm and unhurried in the close view, with no pressure to finish or move on
Continuously alive: the figure never freezes completely, even while paused for inspection
Weightless and isolated: a lit island of activity floating in empty, featureless space
Fluid and forgiving: every change eases rather than cuts, and every interruption is absorbed
completion_and_return: No completion, goal, score or end state exists; the ambient stage loops indefinitely.
Release always returns the scene to the same ambient framing, so the experience is fully reversible.
The wander's paused position persists across the close-study mode and resumes from that exact point.
No state needs to persist beyond the session; re-entering simply resumes the ambient loop.
locked_observable_requirements: A single small mechanical character is the sole foreground subject and holds attention from the first moment.
The character wanders continuously across a luminous platform suspended in an empty, faintly speckled void with no visible support.
Idle mechanical detail motion (limbs, eyes, dials/gauges, gears) runs perpetually and continues even while the wander is paused.
A cast shadow on the platform relates the character to its surface and reads its height.
Press-and-hold anywhere on the platform or character eases the character toward the viewer for close study.
The platform and its shadow shrink and sink out of sight during the inward transition, leaving the character alone.
The wander stops in place on hold rather than returning to a home spot or restarting.
Release eases everything back to the ambient framing and continues the wander from the exact paused point.
Any release or new press mid-transition blends from the current in-between state; nothing snaps or restarts.
No instructions, onboarding, timers or end state are shown.
adaptable_details: The exact character design, proportions, color treatment, materials and which specific parts twitch or rotate
Platform shape, size, glow hue and intensity
Speckle density, backdrop luminance and any faint ambient haze
Wander speed, path pattern and pause cadence
Transition duration and easing feel, and how far the character approaches the viewer
Whether the close view is reached by the subject rising toward the camera or the framing tightening, as long as it reads as coming closer
Optional subtle ambient audio
Whether the scene fills the viewport or occupies a large bounded region
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits any single-subject, self-animating figure or small machine that can plausibly idle and wander on a small stage and reward a closer look: mascots, toy or collectible figures, characters, small devices or models. It requires an isolated, low-distraction surround whose luminance is clearly separated from the subject, one glowing supporting surface and a subject with continuous internal motion. Replacing the wandering, perpetually-animated subject with a static object turns it into a plain object viewer; adding multiple co-equal subjects, a scene with environment or narrative, scrollable steps, or explicit hotspots, labels and readable annotations creates a different Skill; converting the hold into a persistent toggled or navigated detail view removes the momentary, always-reversible close-study character that defines it; using the scene as a decorative substrate behind foreground text also breaks it, since the subject must remain the focus.

canonical_document.name: rippling_sample_sheet_with_finish_swatches
canonical_document.description: A broad soft sheet that slowly swells and ripples on its own, wearing one finish from the start; small thumbnails each show the exact look they apply and re-skin the sheet the instant they are picked, while press-and-drag swings the viewpoint around the sheet and coasts to a gentle stop.
canonical_document.experience_scope: A self-contained region built around one sample object: it is already animating on arrival, has no start or end state, and continues indefinitely; all interaction happens inside this region and nothing outside it changes.
content_and_composition: One large sample surface as the dominant visual mass, presented as a soft sheet with visible swell and folds
A small set of finish thumbnails (a handful, not a long catalog), each rendering the actual look it will apply rather than a name or abstract label
Exactly one selection marking that lives on the currently applied thumbnail and never appears on more than one
Thumbnails sit as a compact secondary cluster so attention can move easily between the small choices and the large sample without losing sight of either
The sheet's motion, its current finish and the viewpoint coexist as one continuous scene rather than separate modes
experience_progression: Arrival: already alive and calm, one finish applied so nothing reads as unconfigured
Open-ended session: finishes may be swapped and viewpoints shifted in any order, any number of times, with every earlier finish still revisitable
No terminal stage, no sequence to complete, no progress that accumulates
attention_and_information_flow: The large sample holds primary prominence at all times; the thumbnails read as small and subordinate
Each thumbnail communicates its outcome by appearance, so no explanatory text is needed to understand what a choice does
The active choice is always unmistakable through the single selection marking, so the viewer never has to guess which look is showing
Rotating the viewpoint reveals how the current finish behaves across highlights and folds, which is the real information the experience delivers

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Never pauses or restarts; persists unbroken through every finish change and every drag, including interrupted ones
interaction_model.state_change: Continuous slow swelling and rippling of the surface
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The sheet breathes and folds gently, so the region reads as alive and calm rather than static
interaction_model.input: Autonomous ambient motion, running from arrival without any input
interaction_model.affected_object: The sample sheet's form

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Picking a different thumbnail, or an earlier one again, swaps straight back with the same immediacy; no choice is ever consumed or locked out
interaction_model.state_change: The sheet takes on that finish immediately and the single marking moves onto the picked thumbnail
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The large sample appears re-skinned at once with no reloading, blanking or waiting state; exactly one thumbnail shows as marked
interaction_model.input: Picking one of the finish thumbnails
interaction_model.affected_object: The sample sheet's surface look and the selection marking

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: On release the motion coasts to a gentle stop; letting go mid-drag settles smoothly, and pushing past the tilt limit simply settles at the limit without any jolt or error signal, while the rippling continues throughout
interaction_model.state_change: The view swings around the sample, tracking the pointer as it moves
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The sheet turns with the pointer so highlights and folds shift and can be read from a new angle
interaction_model.input: Press and drag across the sample
interaction_model.affected_object: The viewpoint on the sample

experience_qualities: Calm and alive rather than idle or busy
Immediate comparison with no perceptible switching cost
Unambiguous current state
Tactile, weighted viewpoint control that feels hand-led and then eases off
Soft, cloth-like presence with light playing across curvature
Forgiving: no wrong move, no dead end
completion_and_return: No completion; the ambient motion loops indefinitely
The currently applied finish and the current viewpoint persist until the visitor changes them
Every previously seen finish remains reachable at any time, so the session stays open-ended
Interrupted or over-extended drags resolve into a settled resting viewpoint rather than snapping back to a default
locked_observable_requirements: The sample is already animating and already wearing one finish on arrival — never an unconfigured or empty state
Ambient swelling and rippling never stops, including during and after interaction
Options display the actual look they apply, not textual or abstract stand-ins
Exactly one option is marked as active at any moment, and the marking follows the applied finish
Finish changes apply instantly to the large sample with no reload, placeholder or interstitial
Any earlier finish can be reapplied at any time with identical immediacy
Drag tracks the pointer while held and coasts to a gentle stop on release

Interrupted drags and limit contact never interrupt the ambient motion
adaptable_details: Which finishes are offered and how many, so long as the set stays small
Exact ripple amplitude, wavelength and cadence
The visual form of the selection marking
Placement of the thumbnail cluster relative to the sample
Lighting mood, palette and overall scale of the region
How far the tilt bound allows the view to travel
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits any single soft or drapeable sample piece whose appeal is its surface behaviour under light and a small set of visually self-describing surface looks. It stops being this Skill if the option set grows into a browsable catalog needing labels or filtering, if multiple samples are compared side by side, if the sample becomes rigid and motionless, if zoom or panning is added so the view is free rather than a bounded orbit, or if selecting a finish leads onward into a configuration or purchase flow rather than simply re-skinning the sample in place.

name: lowfi_empty_surround_figure_stage_with_orbit_and_pose_toggle
description: A single coarse, hard-edged figure stands centered in a featureless empty surround on a small checkered patch of floor whose two alternating tones stay clearly distinguishable, and that dissolves outward into a soft haze carrying the floor toward the surround's tone; one click flips it between calm standing and energetic sprinting in place while the floor streams past underneath, and press-dragging swings the viewpoint around it at a fixed distance, with edges that shimmer and swim like an early console game.

canonical_document.name: lowfi_empty_surround_figure_stage_with_orbit_and_pose_toggle
canonical_document.description: A single coarse, hard-edged figure stands centered in a featureless empty surround on a small checkered patch of floor whose two alternating tones stay clearly distinguishable, and that dissolves outward into a soft haze carrying the floor toward the surround's tone; one click flips it between calm standing and energetic sprinting in place while the floor streams past underneath, and press-dragging swings the viewpoint around it at a fixed distance, with edges that shimmer and swim like an early console game.
canonical_document.experience_scope: Whole-view experience that begins the moment the visitor arrives and never ends: the scene fills the view for the entire visit, is entered without any intro or transition, and has no exit, completion screen or reset.
content_and_composition: Exactly one figure as the sole subject, standing centered in the view and dominating the composition
One small ground patch directly beneath the figure, rendered as a checkered surface of two clearly distinguishable tones that reads as a finite island rather than an endless plane

Ground patch edges dissolve outward into a soft haze that carries the floor's tone toward the surround's, blending the floor into the surrounding emptiness, with no hard horizon or visible boundary line

A featureless, uniform, low-distraction emptiness surrounds figure and floor on all sides, providing the only background material, sitting far enough from the figure in luminance to keep the silhouette clean whether it rests at the low or high end of the range

No persistent interface chrome, labels, captions, controls or instructional text competing with the subject

Visitor-triggered switch into an energetic sprinting state that stays in place, with the ground streaming past underneath to imply speed without travel

attention_and_information_flow: The figure holds attention continuously; nothing else in the view ever takes over as the focal element
The featureless surround and the fading floor edges suppress peripheral detail so contrast pushes prominence onto the subject
Streaming ground motion acts as a secondary, supporting cue that reads as energy belonging to the figure rather than as its own attraction

interaction_model.affected_object: The figure's pose and mood state, plus the ground's motion

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Vertical swing stops short of sinking below the floor and short of rising straight overhead, so the visitor can never reach a broken or disorienting vantage; releasing leaves the view at the chosen angle, and dragging back reverses it freely
interaction_model.state_change: Viewing angle swings horizontally and vertically around the subject while the viewing distance stays fixed
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The scene appears to rotate around the centered figure, revealing other sides of it and shifting how the checkered patch and its haze edges are seen
interaction_model.input: Press and drag anywhere in the view
interaction_model.affected_object: The viewpoint orbiting around the figure

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Sloppy or slightly moved taps resolve to one behavior only, keeping both interactions independently usable
interaction_model.state_change: A movement that qualifies as a drag never also counts as a click, so orbiting does not flip the pose
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Orbiting happens with the figure's current mood unchanged; pose flips only on a genuine tap

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Always present and never toggled off; independent of visitor input and unaffected by state transitions
interaction_model.state_change: Continuous low-fidelity instability persists in both mood states
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Hard-edged facets, coarse pixels and edges that shimmer and swim, evoking a half-remembered early console game

Replacing the single subject with a set of subjects to browse, adding scroll-driven narrative or content sections, opening the camera to free zoom and panning across a larger world, or switching to smooth high-fidelity realistic rendering would each produce a different Skill.

canonical_document.name: studio_device_focus_scene
canonical_document.description: Two closed devices idle on a softly shadowed low-distraction surface at a three-quarter angle; pointing makes one hint at opening, choosing it opens it fully while the view glides in to frame its screen and the other steps back, and dismissing eases everything back down to the relaxed wide view.
canonical_document.experience_scope: A whole-view experience filling the viewport: it begins when the scene settles in after a brief loading indication and has no end point, resting in the relaxed wide state between interactions and returning to it after every focus, endlessly repeatable.
content_and_composition: One staged environment: a low-distraction horizontal surface with soft contact shadows and calm, even diffuse lighting that separates the objects from their surround without competing with them, acting as the persistent backdrop for everything else
Exactly two hero objects of different form factors resting closed/idle on the surface, one larger and hinged, one smaller and upright-capable, both readable as inspectable at rest
Each hero object carries one flat display surface as its primary content role; both display surfaces show the same artwork by default
A single shared viewpoint onto the scene, initially at a slight three-quarter angle that shows depth and the spatial relationship between the two objects
One focus slot at a time: at most one object may hold the foreground role, the other holding a receded supporting role

The cycle can be entered again on either object indefinitely, with no terminal state and no accumulating change

name: scroll_scrubbed_two_sided_object_revolution
description: One flat, glossy, two-sided subject hangs alone in a quiet, low-distraction void under a single off-axis light and makes exactly one unhurried revolution as the page is scrolled top to bottom — detailed front, a moment where it thins almost to nothing edge-on, the patterned reverse, then a close back on its opening pose — pausing instantly wherever scrolling stops and unwinding through the same poses on the way back up.

canonical_document.name: scroll_scrubbed_two_sided_object_revolution
canonical_document.description: One flat, glossy, two-sided subject hangs alone in a quiet, low-distraction void under a single off-axis light and makes exactly one unhurried revolution as the page is scrolled top to bottom — detailed front, a moment where it thins almost to nothing edge-on, the patterned reverse, then a close back on its opening pose — pausing instantly wherever scrolling stops and unwinding through the same poses on the way back up.
canonical_document.experience_scope: Whole-view experience: the subject occupies its own full-viewport stage that persists for the entire scrollable range of the page. Reverse face swings into view and opens out to a readable, square-on presentation of the repeating back pattern
Final approach: rotation continues in the same direction and closes back onto the opening front-facing pose at the end of the range
The whole sequence is one continuous revolution, not a set of discrete slides, and the visitor's scroll speed sets its pace

Information is revealed by pose: front artwork detail first, then the subject's thinness and physicality at the edge-on moment, then the reverse pattern
The edge-on moment is a deliberate near-disappearance that heightens anticipation before the second face is disclosed

interaction_model.visible_feedback: The revolution plays backward exactly — reverse face, edge-on sliver, front face — with no alternate path or shortcut

interaction_model.affected_object: The focal subject's rotation angle

interaction_model.affected_object: The corner scroll cue

experience_qualities: Tactile and physical, like a slightly glossy card being turned over in the hand under a single nearby light
Unhurried and deliberate — a single revolution, never a spin
Directly responsive: motion feels attached to the fingers rather than played back
Self-explanatory within about a second of arriving, with no instructions to read
Intimate and theatrical, the soft directional light keeping the quiet surround inviting rather than austere
Playful rather than clinical, treating the subject as something worth showing off
completion_and_return: Completion is reaching the end of the scroll range with the subject returned to its opening front-facing pose, visually closing the loop
No autoplay, replay button, or automatic looping: the experience only advances while the visitor scrolls
State is fully derived from scroll position, so any pose can be revisited simply by returning to that point in the page
Both extremes rest on stable, intentional poses rather than arbitrary mid-turn angles
locked_observable_requirements: Exactly one full revolution mapped across the entire scroll range — no more, no less
Pose tracks scroll position exactly, with no easing lag, inertia, or continued motion after input stops
Instant freeze at the current pose whenever scrolling stops
Upward scroll retraces the identical intermediate poses in reverse
A visible near-zero-thickness edge-on moment partway through the revolution
Two distinct readable faces: detailed front artwork and patterned reverse
End pose matches the opening pose
Clean settling at both ends of the range with no overshoot or bounce-back
A single subject isolated on a plain, low-distraction backdrop with a controlled luminance falloff, clearly separated from the subject, and a light-responsive sheen implying gloss

adaptable_details: The subject's specific artwork, pattern, surface colouring, and proportions

canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits any single flat or near-flat subject with two meaningfully different faces worth disclosing in sequence — cards, coins, covers, tickets, plaques, badges — presented alone as the page's whole point. It survives changes of subject artwork, backdrop tone and lighting direction, and rotation axis, as long as the subject stays clearly separated from its surround. It becomes a different skill if the rotation autoplays instead of tracking scroll, if input becomes drag or pointer orbit, if the range covers multiple revolutions or several subjects in a sequence, if the second face carries no distinct content so the turn has nothing to reveal, or if surrounding foreground content shares the stage and the isolation is lost.

Highlights that slide across the enclosing surface as the view swings, distinguishing surface from interior
Drag-to-orbit that tracks the pointer continuously and eases to rest on release
Nearer/farther control via wheel or pinch
Full reversibility of viewpoint by dragging back

Progressive fill-in of the subject in place, without a separate loading view or substitute object
Visible grain and material imperfection retained on the subject
adaptable_details: What the captured subject is
Slab proportions, edge treatment and degree of translucency
Lighting direction, light hue and highlight sharpness
Exact grain intensity
Easing duration and orbit sensitivity
Zoom range within its bounds

Whether an idle drift suggests interactivity before the first input
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits any single real-world-captured or volumetric subject meant to be studied closely on its own — an artifact, specimen, product, keepsake or portrait — where the page can give it a quiet, low-distraction full-frame stage whose luminance sits well away from the lit slab, and the visitor is expected to linger rather than proceed. canonical_document.experience_scope: A whole-view experience: it begins the moment the page opens on the first frame of the series and ends when the scroll range is exhausted at the final frame. completion_and_return: Completion is reaching and settling on the final view at the bottom of the range

canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits small curated sets of objects with recognizable silhouettes that can each be approximated by the same fixed pool of small units, presented as a single inspectable centerpiece. Springy and hand-paced rather than mechanical
Fully visitor-paced and scrubbable in both directions

canonical_document.name: hand_sketched_turnable_subject

One supporting surface beneath the subject that grounds it in space
One cast shadow attaching the subject to that surface and signalling a light direction

canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits any single self-contained dimensional subject that benefits from being shown as artwork and inspected from all sides on a uniform, uncluttered field — hero forms, products, sculptures, characters, abstract shapes. canonical_document.name: breathing_cloud_lettering_typing_stage
canonical_document.description: Live-typed words appear as giant letters built from soft translucent puffs that keep swelling and settling; each new character blooms its own cluster, deletions shrink away, a blinking marker sits at the insertion point, and the viewpoint can be swung and pulled in while the framing widens itself to keep the whole word visible.
canonical_document.experience_scope: Whole-view experience occupying the entire page from arrival onward. It begins already populated with a sample word and never ends: there is no start screen, no submit step and no completion state, only continuous editing and looking.
content_and_composition: One primary text subject: the current word or lines of text, always the visual centre of the view and always wholly inside the frame.
Each letter is a volumetric form assembled from many soft translucent puffs, reading as cloud-like mass with real depth and interior volume rather than flat printed glyphs.

interaction_model.state_change: Continuous gentle swelling and settling
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The letters breathe softly and weightlessly, never fully still, reading as drifting vapour rather than solid type

interaction_model.affected_object: Every puff making up every letter

interaction_model.state_change: Marker blinking pauses and resumes

Playful and toy-like, inviting experimentation rather than task completion
Immediately self-explanatory thanks to the pre-filled sample word
Tactile and responsive: every keystroke has a visible, individually attributable consequence
Continuously alive through the ambient breathing motion
Calm and unhurried; growth, dissolution and reframing are all smooth rather than snapped
Sculptural and inspectable, with genuine depth rewarding a change of angle
completion_and_return: There is no completion, submit, confirm or finish step by design; the experience is a permanently open stage.
The ambient swelling loops indefinitely with no beginning or end.

locked_observable_requirements: Letters must be built from many soft translucent puffs with visible depth and volume, not flat or extruded solid glyphs.

Adding a character must grow only that character's cluster into being while all previously typed letters remain untouched.
Deleting must shrink away only the matching puffs, smoothly, to nothing.
A blinking insertion marker must track the insertion point across characters and new lines, and blink only while the page holds focus.
The current text must stay centred and wholly visible at any length, with the framing widening by itself as it grows.

canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits any experience whose subject is short visitor-authored or visitor-editable text meant to be admired as an object — playful toy pages, hero statements, name or greeting showpieces — where the text is the only foreground content and the view can be given over entirely to it. name: spotlit_drag_turned_card_with_glowing_core
description: One illuminated card suspended in an empty surround held well below it in luminance, whose frame shifts in tint with the angle it is turned to, with a luminous figure burning inside that keeps facing the viewer; dragging swings it through an edge-on sliver to a different emblem on the back and it rests wherever released, the front always returning to a slow eerie shimmer.

canonical_document.name: spotlit_drag_turned_card_with_glowing_core
canonical_document.description: One illuminated card suspended in an empty surround held well below it in luminance, whose frame shifts in tint with the angle it is turned to, with a luminous figure burning inside that keeps facing the viewer; dragging swings it through an edge-on sliver to a different emblem on the back and it rests wherever released, the front always returning to a slow eerie shimmer.
canonical_document.experience_scope: Whole-view experience: begins the moment the dimmed view is entered with the object already lit and idling, and never terminates; the entire viewport is both stage and drag surface, and the experience continues indefinitely as idle shimmer between turns.
content_and_composition: Exactly one foreground artifact, centred and the only illuminated element in the view
Empty low-luminance surround with no competing content, chrome or explanatory copy
Two distinct faces on the artifact: a primary face carrying an inner luminous focal figure, and a reverse face carrying a different single emblem
A framing border layer around the primary face's window, treated as an angle-reactive material whose tint and sheen shift with viewing angle and that conveys thickness
A thin physical edge revealed at profile, establishing the artifact as a solid slab rather than a printed image
The inner luminous figure sits in its own layer inside the frame window, visually decoupled from the frame's rotation
Persistent elements: the artifact, its light, and the dimmer surround; nothing enters or leaves the composition
experience_progression: Idle state: front face presented, glow and sheen shimmering slowly on repeat
Direct turn: continuous angle change tracking the pointer, sheen sweeping across the frame as the angle changes
Profile threshold: artifact narrows to an edge-on sliver, briefly reading as pure thickness
Reverse reveal: the second face with its own emblem comes round and can be held and examined
Retrace or rest: reversing the drag replays exactly the same angles in reverse; stopping leaves the artifact at that angle
Return to front restores the same idle shimmer, so inspection loops without a finish line
attention_and_information_flow: Arrival prominence order is enforced by lighting alone: the glowing inner figure reads first because it is the brightest thing in an empty field held far below it in luminance
Second-pass attention shifts to the frame once its sheen and tint change with angle, converting the object from picture to physical thing
Turning progressively trades face detail for edge and thickness information, then hands attention to the reverse emblem
The reverse face is withheld information, discoverable only by continuing the turn past profile
Attention never disperses to surrounding content because no surrounding content exists

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Dragging the opposite way retraces the identical angles; the turn can be interrupted at any moment and resumed from the same angle
interaction_model.state_change: Rotation angle about the artifact's own centre advances in direct proportion to drag movement
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The artifact swings in lockstep with the pointer with no lag or easing, sheen sweeping across the frame as the angle changes while the artifact stays centred
interaction_model.input: Press and drag anywhere over the view with a pointer
interaction_model.affected_object: The single artifact and its frame layer

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Same retrace, interrupt and resume behaviour as pointer drag
interaction_model.state_change: Same direct angle tracking as pointer drag
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Identical swinging and sheen response, so touch and pointer are indistinguishable in outcome
interaction_model.input: Touch drag anywhere over the view
interaction_model.affected_object: The single artifact and its frame layer

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Fully reversible by dragging back through profile to the front face; no committed or locked-in face
interaction_model.state_change: Front face passes through an edge-on sliver and the reverse face becomes the presented face
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The artifact thins to a narrow illuminated edge, then the reverse emblem rotates into view
interaction_model.input: Continuing a drag past the profile threshold
interaction_model.affected_object: The artifact's visible face

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: The resting angle is the starting point for the next drag; nothing needs to be re-established
interaction_model.state_change: Rotation stops and persists at the reached angle
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The artifact simply rests at that angle with no snap-back, spin-on or return-to-front animation
interaction_model.input: Releasing the drag
interaction_model.affected_object: Rotation state of the artifact

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Never ends and never blocks input; a drag can begin at any point in the cycle
interaction_model.state_change: Idle shimmer cycle runs continuously
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Slow repeating glow and sheen movement that keeps the object alive and unresolved
interaction_model.input: Passage of time with no input
interaction_model.affected_object: Inner luminous figure and frame sheen

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Holds across the entire angle range including near-profile, so the figure is never seen edge-on or from behind
interaction_model.state_change: Inner figure's facing is held toward the viewer rather than rotating with the frame
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The frame visibly turns around the figure while the figure continues to confront the viewer
interaction_model.input: Any rotation of the frame
interaction_model.affected_object: Inner luminous figure

experience_qualities: Eerie and hushed, lit like a display case whose surround sits far below the object in brightness
Physically credible: thickness, edge and angle-dependent sheen instead of flatness
Directly responsive, one-to-one hand-to-object coupling
Slow, repeatable and unhurried with no task pressure
Unresolved and haunted, sustained by a glow that never settles
completion_and_return: No completion state, success condition or exit
Rotation state persists at wherever it was released rather than resetting
Returning to the front face restores the identical idle shimmer, making the front an effective home state
Inspection is intended to loop indefinitely across repeated turns
locked_observable_requirements: Exactly one illuminated artifact as the only visible content in an otherwise empty view whose surround stays clearly below it in luminance
Drag anywhere in the view rotates the artifact about its own centre in direct, immediate proportion to pointer or touch movement
Reversing the drag retraces the same angles exactly
Frame sheen and tint visibly change with the viewing angle so the artifact reads as a thick solid object, not a printed picture
The artifact narrows to an edge-on sliver at profile before a distinct second face is revealed
The reverse face carries different content from the front and is reachable only by continuing the turn
The inner luminous element keeps facing the viewer while the frame turns around it
Viewing distance is fixed: the artifact cannot be scaled down, pushed away or moved off-screen
Release leaves the artifact resting at the reached angle with no automatic return
The front face has a continuously repeating idle glow and sheen state
adaptable_details: Subject depicted by the inner luminous element and by the reverse emblem
Hue family, tint-shift range and intensity of the glow and the angle-reactive sheen
Tempo and amplitude of the idle shimmer
Drag-to-angle sensitivity and how many faces-worth of turn a given drag covers
Artifact proportions, corner treatment and border ornamentation
Exact luminance level of the surround and any faint falloff toward its edges
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits any single two-sided slab-like artifact with a distinguishable inner focal element and a differing reverse face, presented alone as the subject of a view with essentially no surrounding copy. Introducing several artifacts to browse, arranging them in a gallery or carousel, adding zoom or pan, replacing free drag with an automatic tour, or dropping the fixed viewing distance so the object can recede would each produce a different Skill; so would removing the second face or the angle-reactive sheen, which reduces it to an illuminated flat image, or letting the surround rise to the artifact's own brightness, which erases the lighting separation the composition depends on.

name: mirror_hall_reflected_wordmark
description: An enclosing mirrored hall whose surround stays visually subordinate to its reflections, where a big repeated word is legible mostly inside the reflections of surrounding hue-shifting surfaces, and the whole arrangement tilts gently toward the pointer so the reflections sweep.

canonical_document.name: mirror_hall_reflected_wordmark
canonical_document.description: An enclosing mirrored hall whose surround stays visually subordinate to its reflections, where a big repeated word is legible mostly inside the reflections of surrounding hue-shifting surfaces, and the whole arrangement tilts gently toward the pointer so the reflections sweep.
canonical_document.experience_scope: Whole-view experience that begins with a brief entry load showing visible progress and then continues indefinitely; it fills the viewport and hosts a small set of interchangeable reflective arrangements, with only minimal variant labels overlaid.
content_and_composition: One short display word, repeated across the scene, whose primary legibility comes from mirrored surfaces rather than plain flat rendering
An enclosing, low-salience environment held clearly below the reflective highlights in brightness and busyness, which supplies what the surfaces reflect; it is visible mainly as reflected content
One foreground arrangement of reflective bodies at a time (for example flat polished panels, glowing faceted gems, or a stacked wall of blocks), each arrangement self-contained
An oily, angle-dependent sheen whose hue shifts with viewing angle, distributed across the reflective surfaces as the dominant material signature, with no fixed hue set
A persistent, low-prominence set of three variant labels as the only interface furniture
Constant low-amplitude motion in the scene so nothing is ever completely still
experience_progression: Entry: brief load with a visible sense of progress before the scene is shown
Reveal: the enclosing reflective hall appears and the shifting sheen reads first
Resolution: the repeated lettering becomes recognizable inside the reflections
Open-ended idle: the scene keeps drifting with no end state to reach and nothing accumulating
Re-entry: returning to a previously seen variant starts it fresh rather than resuming
attention_and_information_flow: The shifting sheen captures attention before any text is understood
Reading shifts from the flat screen surface into the mirrored faces, so the word is discovered rather than announced
Tilting sweeps the reflections and progressively exposes different parts of the surrounding environment and different fragments of the lettering
Variant labels stay quiet and never compete with the scene

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Returning the pointer toward the middle lets the arrangement settle level again; the shallow clamp guarantees the scene can never be tilted out of view
interaction_model.state_change: Pitch follows vertical pointer position and turn follows horizontal position, eased toward the target orientation instead of snapping, and clamped to a shallow range
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The arrangement leans toward the pointer while reflections sweep across the surfaces and uncover different parts of the surroundings and lettering
interaction_model.input: Pointer movement anywhere over the scene
interaction_model.affected_object: The entire reflective arrangement as one body

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Switching is always allowed and never blocked; nothing is carried over, so any variant can be left and returned to at will
interaction_model.state_change: The active variant is replaced by the chosen one; variants are equally reachable in any order and in either direction
interaction_model.visible_feedback: A visibly different reflective arrangement occupies the same enclosing hall, presenting the same word through new surfaces
interaction_model.input: Selecting one of the three variant labels
interaction_model.affected_object: Which self-contained reflective arrangement is on screen

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Not interruptible or dismissible; it persists under and between all other interactions
interaction_model.state_change: Continuous small movement independent of any input
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Sheen and reflections keep shifting so the scene never looks frozen
interaction_model.input: Autonomous idle motion
interaction_model.affected_object: The reflective surfaces and their reflections

experience_qualities: Quiet, enclosed and slightly mysterious, with the surround receding behind its own reflections
Playful and exploratory rather than instructional
Wet, oily, hue-shifting materiality
Weighted, eased motion that feels heavy rather than twitchy
Never fully at rest
completion_and_return: No end state, score or completion moment exists
The idle scene continues indefinitely while the view is open
Each variant starts fresh on entry; nothing accumulates or is remembered between visits
The level, untilted orientation is the natural resting state returned to whenever the pointer is centered
locked_observable_requirements: The word must be found primarily in reflections on surfaces, not read as plain flat text
The enclosing environment must stay low-salience and clearly separated in luminance from the reflective highlights so reflections and sheen dominate, in whatever tonality the host uses
An angle-dependent, hue-shifting sheen must be present on the reflective surfaces, with the particular hues left free
Pointer movement must tilt the whole arrangement with pitch from vertical and turn from horizontal movement, eased and clamped shallow, settling level when the pointer is centered
Multiple self-contained reflective variants must be equally reachable in any order, each starting fresh
Some motion must always be present, even without input
No end state, accumulation or persistent progress
adaptable_details: The specific word and how many times it repeats
Number, shape and layout of reflective bodies in each variant
Exact hue set, hue-shift range and intensity of the sheen, and the tonality of the surround
Tilt magnitude and easing feel within a shallow range
Styling and placement of the variant labels
Which particular reflective arrangements make up the variant set
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits one short word, wordmark or very brief phrase presented as the sole foreground content of a low-distraction showcase view; also fits a full-width hero band above sparse copy. It becomes a different skill if the text must be plainly and immediately readable as the primary readout, if the setting is non-reflective or its surround competes with the reflections in brightness or busyness, if long-form or dense content must be carried, or if the visitor is meant to progress toward a goal or accumulate state.

name: drifting_luminous_glass_display_block
description: One solid block of glowing glass hangs in an empty low-distraction room and drifts on its own; each face carries its own distinctly treated artwork that turns into view while accent light travels along the edges and softened copies of the artwork glow deeper inside the block.

canonical_document.name: drifting_luminous_glass_display_block
canonical_document.description: One solid block of glowing glass hangs in an empty low-distraction room and drifts on its own; each face carries its own distinctly treated artwork that turns into view while accent light travels along the edges and softened copies of the artwork glow deeper inside the block.
canonical_document.experience_scope: Whole-view experience that occupies the entire canvas from the moment the page appears; it has no entry sequence, no end state, and no bounded region other than the framed empty space around the centred block.
content_and_composition: One central solid translucent block read as a single piece of glass, not as assembled panels
One artwork per outward face, each with its own visually distinct treatment, typically a small set of faces covering an identity mark and a name
Accent light running along the block's edges as a persistent outline element, separated in tone from the block's body
Softened, dimmer copies of the face artwork visible deeper inside the block's interior volume
An empty low-distraction surround held at a controlled luminance offset from the block, with no scenery, ground plane, or competing foreground content
No controls, labels, captions, or affordance hints anywhere in the view
experience_progression: No goal-directed progression: motion begins by itself when the view appears and continues indefinitely
Ongoing cycle in which faces rotate out of and back into view, so any moment is a valid entry or exit point
attention_and_information_flow: The centred block holds all prominence because the surround is empty and low in visual activity
Prominence shifts between faces as the drift turns each artwork toward and away from the viewer, so the currently front-facing artwork reads clearly while others recede
Edge light draws the eye around the silhouette and defines the block's form through its separation from the surround
Interior soft copies read as secondary depth information, never competing with the front-facing artwork for legibility
Everything needed to understand the view is present at a glance; no information is withheld behind interaction

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: No start, pause, or stop affordance; watching is all that is asked, and leaving the view simply ends the experience
interaction_model.state_change: Drift starts from a fixed opening pose and continues without user involvement
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Continuous slow turning that brings successive faces and their distinct treatments into view
interaction_model.input: Autonomous driver: the view appearing
interaction_model.affected_object: The whole block and its edge light and interior reflections

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Refitting is instant and self-correcting; repeated or continuous resizing never breaks framing or interrupts the drift
interaction_model.state_change: The view refits immediately to the new frame while the drift continues uninterrupted
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Block stays centred and fully in frame; edge lines and interior reflections keep their proportions instead of stretching or skewing; no jump, restart, or reflow of the motion
interaction_model.input: Viewport resize or device reorientation
interaction_model.affected_object: Framing of the whole view including block, edge light, and interior reflections

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Reload is the only reset; no other state is remembered or restored
interaction_model.state_change: Experience restarts from the same opening pose
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The same recognizable first view appears again, then drift resumes as before
interaction_model.input: Page reload
interaction_model.affected_object: Block orientation

experience_qualities: Calm and unhurried
Immediately understandable with nothing to learn first
Luminous and material, reading as one solid piece of glass rather than a flat picture
Deep and internally lit rather than surface-decorated
Endless and drop-in, with no pressure to wait for a payoff
completion_and_return: Never completes and never climaxes; motion loops indefinitely
Visitors may linger for any length of time and leave at any moment without missing an ending
No persistent state across visits; reload returns to the fixed opening pose
locked_observable_requirements: The subject reads as one solid luminous glass block, not as separate flat surfaces
It hangs in an empty low-distraction surround, separated from the block by a clear luminance step, with no competing content
Each outward face carries its own visually distinct treatment of its artwork, readably different from the treatments on the other faces
Accent light visibly travels along the block's edges, distinguishable from the block's body and the surround
Softened copies of the artwork are visible deeper inside the block, dimmer than the front-facing artwork
Motion begins by itself and continues autonomously with no input affordance of any kind
There is no climax, completion, or end state
The block stays centred and fully in frame at any viewport size or orientation, with edge lines and interior reflections holding their proportions rather than stretching
Drift is never interrupted by refitting
Reload restarts from the same opening pose
adaptable_details: Number of faces carrying artwork and which faces carry a mark versus a name
Specific artwork content and the per-face treatments used to keep faces distinguishable
Drift speed, axis, and path irregularity
Overall block proportions and silhouette so long as it still reads as one solid glass volume
Intensity and tonal character of edge light and interior reflections
Luminance level and subtle tonal character of the empty surround, in either a low-key or high-key direction, so long as the block stays clearly separated from it
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits a small set of flat artworks, marks, or short wordmarks that benefit from being presented as one glowing object in an otherwise empty view, in landing, splash, or single-subject showpiece contexts. It stops being this Skill if user input drives the motion, if the block becomes a navigable selector where faces are chosen or clicked, if the surround gains scenery or substantial foreground copy that the block must sit behind as a background substrate, if the artwork becomes dense text or long-form content requiring sustained reading, or if the experience gains a build-up, ending, or required wait before it is understandable.

name: developing_long_exposure_focus_orb
description: A luminous woven-thread form presented alone against a plain surround held well below its own luminance, which surfaces out of coarse grain into a still, crisp image, keeps only a narrow band of depth sharp while nearer and farther threads and sparks bloom into soft glow, and re-develops from grain whenever the viewer orbits, zooms or holds a key to slide the focus plane, change blur width or tune brightness and light falloff.

canonical_document.name: developing_long_exposure_focus_orb
canonical_document.description: A luminous woven-thread form presented alone against a plain surround held well below its own luminance, which surfaces out of coarse grain into a still, crisp image, keeps only a narrow band of depth sharp while nearer and farther threads and sparks bloom into soft glow, and re-develops from grain whenever the viewer orbits, zooms or holds a key to slide the focus plane, change blur width or tune brightness and light falloff.
canonical_document.experience_scope: A single whole-view experience filling the viewport from first arrival; it has no end state and no exit — the artwork remains the entire view for as long as the visitor stays, with only a small persistent corner note layered on top.
content_and_composition: Exactly one generated luminous subject — a dense woven mass of fine threads — centered as the sole content of the view
A plain, unpatterned surrounding field held at a luminance far enough from the subject's that the subject reads as self-illuminated, with no competing foreground copy, panels or framing chrome
Scattered small bright points distributed through and around the thread mass, reading as sparks or distant lights
A depth-ordered composition: a narrow crisp band at one distance, with everything nearer and farther progressively dissolving into soft glowing shapes rather than blurred detail
One faint, small text note fixed in a corner listing the labelled keys, persistent and deliberately held at low contrast against its backing so it never competes with the artwork
Transient coarse grain rendered over the whole subject during any unsettled moment, replaced by clean luminance when settled
experience_progression: Arrival: the view carries almost no readable luminance structure and the image reads as coarse grain and noise with the subject only faintly discernible
Developing: the grain thins progressively, thread structure and bright points emerge, glow builds around out-of-focus regions
Settled: a still, clean, luminous image with a sharply readable narrow focus band and smooth glowing depths, holding indefinitely without motion
Any vantage or focus change re-enters the coarse state and repeats the develop-and-settle cycle from that new configuration; the cycle repeats without limit and has no terminal stage
attention_and_information_flow: The low-distraction surround and single subject remove all competing targets, so attention lands on the artwork immediately
Within the artwork, sharpness is the only prominence cue: the narrow crisp band pulls the eye while nearer and farther material recedes as soft glow
Sliding the focus plane moves this attention band through the structure, revealing detail in a different depth slice while the previously crisp region dissolves into glow
The develop-from-grain transition briefly suppresses all fine detail, then hands attention back to whatever region is now crisp
The corner key note discloses, from the first moment, that vantage and sharpness are shapeable, without drawing attention away from the image

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Runs on its own and always ends in a stable settled image; any user input during the develop simply restarts the develop from the new configuration
interaction_model.state_change: Progresses from coarse-grain unresolved to settled clean luminous image
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Grain visibly thins while threads and bright points sharpen and glow fills the out-of-focus depths
interaction_model.input: Autonomous driver at first arrival
interaction_model.affected_object: The whole view of the artwork

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Direction is reversible by dragging back at any time; there is no restricted arc, so any orientation is a valid resting state and no vantage can be lost
interaction_model.state_change: Viewing angle swings continuously and freely to any orientation around the piece
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The thread mass turns in step with the drag; on release the image returns to coarse grain and re-develops into a settled picture from the new angle
interaction_model.input: Press-and-drag across the view
interaction_model.affected_object: Viewpoint orientation around the subject

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: The opposite gesture reverses distance at any point; approach and retreat stay within a range that keeps the subject readable in frame
interaction_model.state_change: Viewpoint moves nearer or farther, changing the subject's scale in the frame
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The artwork grows or shrinks in the frame and then re-develops from grain into a settled image at the new distance
interaction_model.input: Wheel scroll or two-finger pinch
interaction_model.affected_object: Viewpoint distance from the subject

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Each key has a paired opposite key that reverses the same quality; releasing halts the change immediately, and repeated pressing walks the value back, so any setting can be undone by feel
interaction_model.state_change: The chosen quality slides continuously in one direction for as long as the key is held and stops where it is on release
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The crisp band travels through the structure while previously sharp regions melt into glow, or the soft-to-sharp falloff visibly tightens or widens, or the image brightens and distant sparks fade in or out; the image coarsens while changing and refines again once the key is released
interaction_model.input: Holding one of a few labelled keys
interaction_model.affected_object: Depth position of the crisp band, width of the blur transition, overall brightness, or the rate at which distant lights fade

experience_qualities: Calm, still and unhurried — the settled state has no idle motion
Development-bath feel: a self-illuminated subject set off from a quiet surround by a wide luminance separation, with grain reading as photographic rather than as an error
Photographic rather than digital in how change resolves, every adjustment reading as a fresh exposure developing
Open-ended and low-pressure, with no goal, sequence or completion to reach
Immediately legible affordance — the visitor knows from the first moment that vantage and sharpness are theirs to shape
Tactile continuity: held input produces continuous change rather than stepped jumps
completion_and_return: There is no completion; each interaction ends in a stable settled image that persists until the next input
Every vantage and adjustment change loops the same coarse-to-clean develop cycle rather than concluding
Adjusted focus depth, blur width, brightness and light falloff persist as the current viewing state after release and carry across subsequent vantage changes
No forced reset to an initial vantage or default settings; the visitor returns to any prior look by reversing the same inputs
locked_observable_requirements: Exactly one generated luminous subject on a plain, low-distraction field whose luminance stays clearly separated from the subject's, with no competing foreground content
Arrival begins visibly coarse and unresolved and resolves into a still, clean, luminous image
Only a narrow depth band reads as crisp; nearer and farther material dissolves into soft glowing shapes rather than sharp-but-blurred detail
Bright scattered points bloom into glow when outside the crisp band
Free unrestricted orbit and nearer/farther movement of the viewpoint
Held input produces continuous change that stops on release, with a paired opposite input reversing it
Any vantage or adjustment change visibly coarsens the image and then refines it again
The settled image holds still with no ambient motion
A faint, persistent corner note names the adjustable keys and is visible from the first moment
adaptable_details: The specific generated form of the subject (woven threads, filaments, particle mass or other dense luminous structure)
Hue family of the glow and the exact luminance level of the surrounding field, provided the separation that makes the subject read as self-illuminated is kept
Density and count of the bright scattered points
Which specific keys are labelled and how many adjustable qualities are offered
Duration of the develop-and-settle cycle and the coarseness of the initial grain
Placement and wording of the corner key note
Default starting vantage, focus depth, blur width and brightness
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits any single dimensional luminous or intricate subject that rewards being viewed from arbitrary angles and at selectable depths of sharpness, presented alone on a plain, low-distraction stage without foreground reading content. It stops being this Skill if multiple subjects or substantial overlaid copy compete for attention, if the surround's luminance closes on the subject's so the subject no longer reads as self-illuminated, if the crisp band widens until the whole subject is uniformly sharp, if arrival snaps to a finished image without the coarse-to-clean develop, or if viewing becomes a fixed guided sequence rather than free open-ended vantage control.

name: steerable_form_shatters_into_headline_and_lineup
description: A hushed, low-distraction stage holds one sculptural form that swings and lags behind the pointer; the single invitation, once triggered, bursts the form into tumbling shards as the view pulls back and the headline's letters pop in out of order, then the pieces snap back together and a calm list takes the foreground for good.

canonical_document.name: steerable_form_shatters_into_headline_and_lineup
canonical_document.description: A hushed, low-distraction stage holds one sculptural form that swings and lags behind the pointer; the single invitation, once triggered, bursts the form into tumbling shards as the view pulls back and the headline's letters pop in out of order, then the pieces snap back together and a calm list takes the foreground for good.
canonical_document.experience_scope: Whole-view experience that begins at first arrival on the quiet, low-distraction stage and ends when the reveal settles into the quiet list-reading state; the centerpiece, headline and list all live inside this one view rather than in separate scrolled sections.
content_and_composition: Exactly one sculptural centerpiece form, centred and dominant, as the sole focal object on a recessive, low-contrast field that sits at a clearly separated luminance from the form
Exactly one forward affordance (an invitation/call to enter), the only element allowed to compete with the form, and deliberately subordinate to it
One short identity headline block in the foreground carrying name, place and a two-date span, absent at arrival and revealed by the trigger
One compact roster list, split into two dated groups, that occupies the same foreground slot the headline vacates and becomes the final reading content
Layered depth: the centerpiece sits at mid-depth on the recessive field, text roles occupy a nearer foreground plane at readable contrast against it, and the viewpoint itself is a movable element
Nothing else on screen during arrival; any preparation of the scene happens quietly behind the single form
experience_progression: Quiet arrival: hushed, low-distraction screen held at one restrained tonal level, one sculptural form, one obvious way forward, scene still finishing its own preparation with no competing content
Ambient steering: the form continuously answers pointer or touch movement and drifts back toward its resting facing when input settles
Anticipation on hover of the invitation: the view eases slightly closer to the form
One-shot burst on trigger: the form breaks into outward-flying, tumbling shards while the viewpoint retreats, and the headline's letters pop in one at a time in scattered order
Resolution: the shards fly back together and the headline clears away
Settled state: the roster list occupies the foreground as the calm, final reading state, with steering still live
attention_and_information_flow: Arrival deliberately starves the screen of alternatives so all attention lands on the single form and, secondarily, the one invitation
Pointer-driven motion keeps the form the most alive thing on screen before any commitment is made
The trigger inverts prominence: the form disperses and recedes while text becomes the highest-salience, nearest information
Letter-by-letter scattered appearance draws the eye across the headline instead of presenting it as a finished block
Attention is handed off deliberately from spectacle to reading: headline first, then the roster, which is the only content left demanding attention
Information is disclosed in one direction only — identity before schedule detail — and never withdrawn once reached

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Always available, including during and after the reveal sequence; rotation is bounded near a half turn so the form never spins away; releasing or centring input restores the rest facing with no explicit reset
interaction_model.state_change: Facing swings toward the input position with visible lag, reaching roughly a half turn when the input travels to an edge, and eases back toward the resting facing as input returns to centre
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The form appears to follow the cursor or finger a beat behind, weighted rather than instant, settling smoothly rather than snapping
interaction_model.input: Pointer moved anywhere over the view, or a touch drag anywhere over the view
interaction_model.affected_object: Orientation of the sculptural centerpiece form

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Fully reversible — leaving the invitation eases the view back to its arrival distance
interaction_model.state_change: View eases a small step closer while hover is held
interaction_model.visible_feedback: A subtle pull-in that makes the form feel slightly nearer and the invitation feel consequential
interaction_model.input: Pointer hovering the invitation
interaction_model.affected_object: Viewpoint distance to the scene

Length and grouping of the final list
Typography and the wording of the invitation

canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits single-purpose pages whose payoff is one short identity headline plus a compact list or roster — announcements, invitations, launches, single-artefact showcases — and requires one dominant centerpiece object, one call to action, and a low-distraction surround that can hold clear separation from both form and text in any host palette. Turning it into a repeatable or looping transition, letting the visitor return to the arrival stage, using several focal objects or a browsable set, or placing the reveal inside a long scrolling multi-section page would make it a different Skill.

name: continuous_fold_progress_model_viewer
description: A flat patterned sheet closes into a finished three-dimensional shape under one continuous progress slider, arriving already partly folded, with a live percentage, snap-to-ends, free turning by dragging and limited zoom by wheel.

canonical_document.name: continuous_fold_progress_model_viewer
canonical_document.description: A flat patterned sheet closes into a finished three-dimensional shape under one continuous progress slider, arriving already partly folded, with a live percentage, snap-to-ends, free turning by dragging and limited zoom by wheel.
canonical_document.experience_scope: A self-contained region built around one object stage: it begins when the stage appears with the object already partway through its transformation and persists for the whole visit to that region; the object, its progress control and its readout are always present, and the experience never leaves the stage or enters a separate mode.
content_and_composition: One primary transforming object occupying the visual center of the stage, presented in depth against an otherwise plain, low-distraction surrounding space
The object carries a visible pattern of fold lines, legible against the object's own surface, that both explains the transformation and becomes the geometry of the finished form
One continuous progress control persistently available, paired with a numeric percentage readout of the current degree
Two one-step end controls for the fully flat and fully closed extremes, plus a reset back to the untouched flat state
One grouped list of ready-made starting patterns, grouped by kind, from which the current subject is chosen
Sparse or no explanatory copy: the mid-transformation state of the object is the explanation
experience_progression: Arrival: the object is already caught partway between flat and closed, so the nature of the transformation is legible before any input
Scrubbing: the object advances or retreats continuously in step with the control across the full range, every degree a stable state worth resting on
Endpoints: at one extreme the object reads as a single flat patterned sheet, at the other as a closed finished form
Inspection: at any degree the visitor turns the object and changes viewing distance without disturbing the progress value
Return: reset restores the flat sheet so the whole transformation can be run again
Substitution: choosing another ready-made pattern replaces the subject while keeping the current degree, so the same moment of the transformation can be compared across subjects
attention_and_information_flow: The transforming object holds primary attention at all times; controls and readout stay visually subordinate
During scrubbing attention is pulled to the object's changing silhouette while the percentage readout supplies the precise degree
Motion is the information: the eased, settling movement of the surfaces communicates that the material resists its own creases

During turning and zooming, revealed information shifts from overall silhouette to the relationships between individual folded surfaces, which stay separable from one another by shading or edge definition
Pattern choice momentarily shifts attention to the list, then returns it to the object as the new subject appears at the same degree

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Fully bidirectional: dragging back reverses the transformation through the same states; releasing leaves the object resting at the current degree
interaction_model.state_change: The degree of transformation moves continuously through intermediate values rather than stepping between presets
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The object deforms in step with the drag, surfaces easing and settling as they close, while the percentage readout updates live

interaction_model.affected_object: The primary transforming object

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Either extreme is reachable from anywhere and the opposite end control returns to the other extreme

interaction_model.visible_feedback: The object settles at the extreme form and the readout and control position match it

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Turning is unlimited and freely reversible; the object remains anchored in the stage so it cannot be dragged out of view

interaction_model.visible_feedback: The form rotates continuously with the drag, revealing other sides while the current degree stays unchanged

interaction_model.affected_object: The viewpoint on the object

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Hard limits at both ends guarantee the object can never become unreachably small or pass inside itself; reversing the wheel restores the previous distance

interaction_model.visible_feedback: The object grows or shrinks smoothly and stops advancing at the bounds

interaction_model.visible_feedback: The new subject appears already at the same degree of folding, so the comparison is immediate

interaction_model.affected_object: The subject of the stage

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Always available; the full transformation can be replayed immediately afterward
interaction_model.state_change: The degree returns to the fully flat untouched state
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The object opens back out to the plain flat patterned sheet and the readout returns to its lowest value

interaction_model.affected_object: The primary transforming object

experience_qualities: Physical and material: surfaces ease and settle as though resisting their own fold lines rather than snapping between poses
Continuous rather than stepwise: no discrete stages, every fractional degree is a valid resting state
Self-explanatory: the arrival state teaches the interaction without instructions
Effortless to inspect: turning and zooming never interfere with the transformation degree
Safe to explore: viewpoint limits and an always-available return to the flat state remove any fear of getting lost
completion_and_return: No terminal completion state: the closed form is one endpoint of a freely traversable range, not an end of the experience
The transformation degree and viewing angle persist across pattern changes
Reset returns the object to the untouched flat state, ready to be transformed again
The experience does not loop or advance on its own; it rests wherever the visitor leaves it
locked_observable_requirements: One continuous control drives the transformation through all intermediate degrees, not between discrete steps
The object arrives already partway through the transformation rather than at either extreme
The current degree is always visible as a numeric percentage, readable against whatever surface carries it
Motion is eased and settling so the object reads as physical material, not as an abstract interpolation
One-step access to both the fully open and fully closed extremes
Dragging over the object turns it in place while the viewpoint distance is bounded at both ends so the object can never be lost
Inspection input never alters the transformation degree, and transformation input never alters the viewing angle
Switching subjects preserves the current degree
A reset returns to the fully untouched starting state
adaptable_details: The nature of the subject and the visual character of its pattern or markings, provided the fold lines stay distinguishable from the surface they sit on
The surface treatment, colour choices, lighting direction and surrounding tone of the stage, provided the object separates clearly from its surround
The form of the continuous control and the placement of controls and readout around the stage
The grouping labels and number of ready-made subjects offered
The exact near and far viewing bounds and the easing timing
Whether the percentage is shown alone or alongside a descriptive label
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits any single object whose finished form can be reached from a simple starting form through one continuous parameter, where the intermediate states are themselves informative and the object benefits from being inspected from all sides, under any surface, lighting and surround treatment that keeps the object and its fold lines legible. It stops being this Skill if the transformation becomes an ordered sequence of discrete instructional steps, if it plays back autonomously as a timed animation rather than being scrubbed, if the visitor navigates a scene or multiple objects instead of turning one anchored subject, or if the intermediate states are treated as mere transitions rather than states worth resting on.

name: papery_toy_city_of_a_chosen_place
