canonical_document.description: A small handmade-looking paper city of a chosen real-world area that assembles itself into place with buildings rising, can be swung around and pulled closer for study, and is quietly remade whenever a corner locator or typed coordinates pick somewhere new.

content_and_composition: One central miniature world dominating the view, made of a ground plate, water bodies, street network and clustered building masses that read together as a single calm papery handmade object rather than separate layers
Exactly one world visible at a time; no side-by-side or comparison scenes
One small locator map anchored in a corner overlay, continuously visible above the scene, whose centre stands for the area being shown
A live coordinate readout tied to the locator centre, plus a direct typed-coordinate entry and a control that returns to the opening place
A thin progress line along the top edge of the view, present only while a new world is still being obtained or built
The scene stays visually centred and finished-looking at rest, never reading as an empty stage or bare grid
experience_progression: Arrival: the opening area's ground, water, streets and building clusters settle gently into place and buildings rise until the world reads as a finished miniature
Inspection: a stable, crisply resolved settled state in which the world can be swung and approached freely

Re-choice: panning the corner locator updates the coordinate readout continuously while the world still stands; shortly after panning stops the world is replaced by the newly centred area and assembles again with buildings rising
Return to inspection with an equally legible world; a choice made mid-assembly abandons the unfinished world so the sequence restarts for the newest pick only
attention_and_information_flow: The miniature holds primary attention throughout; its settling and rising assembly is the strongest motion in the view
During assembly attention follows the world coming together; once settled attention shifts to close study of streets, water and building clusters
The corner locator stays quiet but permanently legible, so it is always obvious which real area is shown and that another can be picked
The coordinate readout supplies precise identity of the shown area and updates live while the locator is panned, foreshadowing the rebuild before it happens
The top-edge progress line is peripheral and informational only, never competing with the miniature
Attention alternates comfortably between studying the model and reconsidering the area without either view being hidden

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Release simply leaves the world at its current orientation with no snap-back; turning is bounded so the model stays centred and never flips to an unreadable underside
interaction_model.state_change: Viewing angle swings around the world's centre
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The world turns continuously in step with the pointer while dragging, then resolves to a crisp image once movement stops
interaction_model.input: Dragging anywhere in the scene
interaction_model.affected_object: The miniature world as a whole

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Reversible by gesturing the other way; near and far limits keep the world whole and legible rather than clipped or lost
interaction_model.state_change: View moves nearer or is pushed back
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The world grows or recedes continuously under the pointer during the gesture and sharpens to a crisp image when the gesture ends

interaction_model.affected_object: Viewing distance to the miniature

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Continuing to pan defers the rebuild, so exploratory panning costs nothing; the return-to-opening-place control always restores the starting area
interaction_model.state_change: Shown area is re-aimed; after panning settles, the world is rebuilt for the newly centred area
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Coordinates update live as the locator moves while the standing world remains visible; shortly after panning stops the world is replaced and assembles again with buildings rising

interaction_model.affected_object: The in-flight world

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Always available as an unmistakable way back, from any explored position or mid-assembly
interaction_model.state_change: Everything returns to the arrival location
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The locator and readout snap back and the opening world assembles again as it did on arrival

interaction_model.affected_object: Shown area, locator and coordinate readout

experience_qualities: Handmade, papery and toy-like rather than technical or map-like
Calm and unhurried: assembly settles gently instead of snapping in
Feels already finished on arrival rather than like an empty stage waiting for input
Tactile and directly manipulable, with motion tracking the hand continuously

Consistently legible across every new choice, so no place feels like a broken result
completion_and_return: Each assembly completes in a settled, crisp, finished-looking world that then persists for study

canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits any content where a chosen area or comparable position-addressable subject can be rendered as one small stylised scene meant to be inspected as the page's foreground, with a compact chooser at the edge. It remains the same skill across different visual registers, subject matter and choosing controls. It becomes a different skill if the scene is entered and navigated from within instead of being turned as a held object, if several scenes are shown at once for comparison, if the assembly reveal is dropped so worlds simply appear, or if the presentation flattens into a conventional readable map rather than a toy-like miniature.

name: layered_motion_build_up_walkthrough
description: A blocky articulated figure animates continuously while its motion is built up one addition per stage; each step re-marks only the parts that just started moving with a high-salience highlight and swaps in a one-rule caption about their rhythm, with a stage readout and two step controls that wrap around for endless replay.

canonical_document.name: layered_motion_build_up_walkthrough
canonical_document.description: A blocky articulated figure animates continuously while its motion is built up one addition per stage; each step re-marks only the parts that just started moving with a high-salience highlight and swaps in a one-rule caption about their rhythm, with a stage readout and two step controls that wrap around for endless replay.
canonical_document.experience_scope: A single self-contained region that can occupy the whole view: it begins on an opening stage where the figure holds a motionless rest pose beneath a one-line title, and it has no terminal end because the fixed stage run wraps at both ends and can be replayed indefinitely.
content_and_composition: One animated articulated figure rendered from simple geometric segments, centred as the dominant foreground subject in a calm, low-distraction field
One short persistent title line above the figure
One compact caption block holding a single stage-specific rule describing which parts move and on what repeating rhythm; exactly one rule is shown at a time
One always-visible stage readout showing the current position within the fixed run of stages
Two labelled step controls, one for the previous stage and one for the next stage, placed together as the only interactive elements
A two-level marking scheme applied to the figure's parts: a base part treatment and one high-salience highlight treatment clearly separable from it
Attention is split between two zones only: the moving figure and the compact timing account beside or below it
experience_progression: Opening stage: the figure stands at rest, fully motionless, with no cyclic movement yet
Second stage onward: the repeating motion cycle begins and never stops or restarts for the remainder of the walkthrough
Each forward step adds one new movement layer that stacks on top of every layer introduced earlier, so the motion becomes progressively richer and more complete
Each backward step peels off only the newest layer, returning to the previously accumulated combination
Final stage of the fixed run lands on the complete motion at a noticeably brisker tempo
Stepping past either end wraps to the opposite end, so the progression loops as often as wanted
attention_and_information_flow: The stage change is announced simultaneously in three places: the readout increments or decrements by one, the caption is replaced, and the newly involved parts switch to the highlight treatment

Only the parts named by the current stage's rule carry the high-salience highlight; all other parts revert to the base part treatment, so the just-added contribution is instantly separable from the accumulated motion
Prominence stays on the figure while the caption supplies the reason for what is being seen; no other content competes
Information is revealed strictly incrementally: the visitor never sees the full rule set at once, only the rule for the layer currently in focus
The readout keeps the visitor's position within the whole progression legible at every moment

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Fully reversible by the backward control; pressing past the last stage wraps to the opening stage instead of stopping, so the control can never be pushed out of range
interaction_model.state_change: Advances immediately to the neighbouring later stage and adds one movement layer on top of all previously introduced layers
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Readout moves by one, caption is replaced by the rule for the newly introduced movement, the parts that rule acts on take on the high-salience highlight while every other part returns to the base part treatment, and the figure's ongoing cycle visibly gains the extra movement without pausing or restarting
interaction_model.input: Press the forward step control
interaction_model.affected_object: Current stage, the figure's motion layers, its part marking, the caption and the stage readout

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Fully reversible by the forward control; pressing past the opening stage wraps to the final stage, keeping the walkthrough permanently in range
interaction_model.state_change: Returns immediately to the neighbouring earlier stage and removes only the most recently added movement layer
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Readout moves back by one, caption is replaced by that stage's rule, the highlight treatment moves to that stage's parts while others revert to the base treatment, and the figure's cycle continues uninterrupted with the newest layer peeled off
interaction_model.input: Press the backward step control
interaction_model.affected_object: Current stage, the figure's motion layers, its part marking, the caption and the stage readout

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: The cycle is never stopped or restarted by stepping; layers are added and removed on top of a running motion, so timing continuity is preserved across every step
interaction_model.state_change: Parts swing on their stage-defined repeating rhythms in a continuously running cycle
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Steady looping movement whose rhythm and involved parts match the current caption
interaction_model.input: Autonomous repeating motion cycle once past the opening stage
interaction_model.affected_object: The figure's moving parts

experience_qualities: Calm, low-distraction and deliberately minimal
Instructional and legible rather than spectacular
Continuous and uninterrupted motion under discrete, self-paced control
Cumulative, with each step feeling like an addition rather than a replacement
Immediately responsive, with no transition delay between stages
Bounded and safe: the visitor cannot leave the valid range
completion_and_return: The final stage presents the complete, brisker motion as the natural conclusion of the run
Reaching either end wraps to the opposite end rather than terminating or disabling controls
The whole progression can be replayed from the beginning as often as wanted
Current stage, active layers, part marking and caption remain in a consistent combined state at all times
locked_observable_requirements: One animated articulated figure is the dominant foreground subject
A fixed, finite run of ordered stages with an always-visible position readout
Exactly two labelled controls, one step back and one step forward, as the only navigation
Each stage adds exactly one movement layer that stacks on all earlier layers; stepping back removes only the newest layer
Exactly one stage-specific rule caption visible at a time, replaced on every step
Only the parts introduced by the current stage carry a single high-salience highlight treatment clearly separable from the base part treatment; all others revert to the base treatment
The motion cycle runs continuously and is never stopped or restarted by stepping
The opening stage shows a motionless rest pose, with cyclic movement starting only from the following stage
The final stage shows the complete motion at a brisker tempo
Both ends wrap to the opposite end so the sequence can never go out of range and can loop indefinitely
adaptable_details: The exact number of stages in the fixed run
The specific subject and which parts each stage introduces

Which hues, tones or material treatments carry the base and highlight levels, provided the highlight stays plainly separable from the base and both stay readable against the surround, plus figure proportions and segment styling
Placement of the caption, readout and controls relative to the figure

canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits any subject whose continuous behaviour decomposes into separable parts that can be introduced one at a time with an explainable repeating rhythm, presented as the main content of a focused teaching view, under whatever palette or surround the host site already uses. experience_qualities: Unhurried and orderly, with each transition read as a deliberate step rather than a snap
Legible-first: the whole shape is understood before any narrowing occurs
Dimensional and physical, as though handling a stacked model rather than switching pages
Consistently reversible: widening out is never more than one move away

completion_and_return: No terminal end state; the experience rests at whichever of the three focus stages the viewer stops at
Detail close returns to the level it was opened from, preserving that level's focus and marker layout

locked_observable_requirements: Entry state shows the complete set of levels assembled as one stack over a low-contrast, clearly subordinate surrounding base plan
Exactly three nested focus stages — whole, one level, one entry — with widening out always one move away
Focusing a level advances and slightly tilts that plate toward the viewer while levels above depart upward, levels below depart downward and the base plan loses further contrast against that plate

canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits any subject that is genuinely composed of discrete stacked or nested levels each holding located entries, where a viewer benefits from seeing the whole before isolating a level and then one entry — multi-level venues, facilities, structures, terminals, vehicles, layered site models or layered datasets with per-layer points. It requires both a level dimension and per-level positioned entries plus a companion listing. Removing the stacked levels and keeping only a flat plan with pins, removing the per-entry detail surface, or allowing all levels to be visible and interactive at once instead of narrowing to a single focused plate would produce a different Skill.

name: orbitable_volumetric_plume_stage
description: A single wispy volumetric plume, fully formed and gently unfurling from the first moment, standing on a plain low-detail surface that stays clearly separated in tone from the subject, with a soft cast shadow; pressing and dragging anywhere swings the vantage around it, sideways with horizontal travel and tipping with vertical travel, and the released vantage simply holds.

canonical_document.name: orbitable_volumetric_plume_stage

interaction_model.affected_object: The visitor's vantage around the subject

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Clamped at both extremes with no inversion; reversing the drag direction immediately moves away from the limit
interaction_model.state_change: Vantage tips up or down proportionally, coming to rest at ground level at one extreme and straight overhead at the other

interaction_model.affected_object: The visitor's vantage height around the subject

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Returns to the grabbable state when the drag ends

interaction_model.visible_feedback: Cursor signals that the scene can be grabbed, then visibly changes while the drag is underway

interaction_model.affected_object: Cursor appearance

interaction_model.visible_feedback: Motion of the vantage stops and the settled vantage simply holds while the subject keeps flowing

experience_qualities: Calm, slow and unhurried with nothing to complete
Genuinely volumetric and sculptural rather than flat or graphic
Physically direct — like rotating an object held in the hand
Self-explanatory without instruction
Uninterrupted: the subject's life is never suspended by the visitor's actions
completion_and_return: No completion state, score, end frame or destination angle
Flow continues indefinitely as an open-ended loop with no visible seam or restart
The vantage chosen by the visitor persists after release and is the starting point for further dragging
No reset control and no return-to-default camera behavior
locked_observable_requirements: Subject is fully formed and already in motion the instant the view appears; no build-up, growth or loading state is ever shown
Subject reads as volumetric through density-based light and shade: bright where thin, deeply shaded where dense
A soft cast shadow grounds the subject on a plain, low-detail surface, with the subject and the shadow both separated in luminance from that surface
The whole stage is a press-and-drag surface that swings the vantage around the subject
Vantage change is proportional to pointer travel in both axes, sideways horizontally and tipping vertically

No instructions, labels or visible controls are needed to understand the interaction

Subject scale, height and proportion within the stage
Flow speed and turbulence character
Drag sensitivity and whether release eases briefly before settling
Exact cursor shapes used for grabbable and dragging states
Whether the stage fills the viewport or occupies a large bounded region
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits any single continuously flowing volumetric subject presented alone on a quiet, low-detail stage of any tonal register as the entire focus of a region or view, where the visitor's only action is choosing a vantage. It stops being this Skill if the stage gains a build-up or arrival sequence, discrete stops, hotspots or guided angles, an automatic camera tour, a goal or completion state, multiple competing subjects, a detailed environment that replaces the plain ground, or dense foreground text and controls layered over the drag surface; likewise if the subject is flat, hard-edged or static, if the ground loses enough tonal separation for the subject and shadow to read against it, or if changing vantage interrupts or restarts its motion.

name: openable_volume_row_with_paged_interior_and_reverse_side
description: Upright solid volumes stand side by side; hovering swivels one to expose its thickness and spine, a control swings its front face open on the hinge edge as the volume glides forward to become the sole focus, stepping arrows crossfade its interior text one passage at a time, and another control turns the whole volume around to read the text on its reverse.

canonical_document.name: openable_volume_row_with_paged_interior_and_reverse_side
canonical_document.description: Upright solid volumes stand side by side; hovering swivels one to expose its thickness and spine, a control swings its front face open on the hinge edge as the volume glides forward to become the sole focus, stepping arrows crossfade its interior text one passage at a time, and another control turns the whole volume around to read the text on its reverse.
canonical_document.experience_scope: A self-contained region holding one row of items on a shelf-like surface; the experience begins when the pointer enters or a control on any item is pressed and ends when the open item is closed and returns to its resting position in the row. Surrounding page content is unaffected and no full-view takeover occurs.
content_and_composition: One horizontal row of a few (roughly three to six) volumetric items resting upright, evenly spaced on a common baseline surface
Each item shows at least three distinct faces with real thickness: front face, hinge-side edge/spine, and a reverse face
Each item carries a short identifying label set: an originator name, a title, and a brief summary
Each item exposes two persistent controls placed beside or on it: one that opens/closes the front face, one that turns the item to its reverse
The opened item exposes an interior reading surface displaying one passage of longer text at a time
Stepping controls (backward/forward) appear on the opened interior surface only
The reverse face carries the brief summary rendered at full readability, not as a mirrored or decorative back
Neighbouring items remain visible and in place at rest behind/beside the focused item
experience_progression: Resting state: all items upright in a row, closed, equally weighted
Hover preview: the pointed item swivels slightly, revealing thickness and hinge edge, then settles back when the pointer leaves
Opening: front face swings open on the hinge edge while the whole item glides toward the viewer and layers in front of its neighbours
Reading: interior always begins at the first passage; forward/back stepping advances through passages with a crossfade
Alternate inspection: turning the item around presents its reverse face with the summary, closing any open front face during the turn
Return: closing or turning upright again restores the resting look and the row is ready for the next item
attention_and_information_flow: At rest, attention is distributed evenly across the row with only short labels legible
Hover produces a light, non-committal shift of attention to a single item without revealing new text
Opening collapses attention to one item: it advances in depth and becomes the clear focus while the others visually settle back
Long-form interior text is disclosed incrementally, a few passages at a time, so only one passage competes for reading attention
The reverse-side view swaps the reading target from interior passages to the single short summary
Closing redistributes attention back to the whole row

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Pointer leaving lets the item settle back to its resting orientation; the preview never persists and never opens the item
interaction_model.state_change: Item moves from flat-facing rest to a slightly swivelled orientation

interaction_model.affected_object: The pointed volumetric item

interaction_model.input: Press the open control beside an item
interaction_model.affected_object: That item's front face and the item as a whole

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Stepping simply stops at the first and last passage with no wrap-around; reopening the item always restarts at the first passage

interaction_model.visible_feedback: The outgoing passage gently crossfades into the incoming one while the item's position and openness stay unchanged

interaction_model.affected_object: The interior passage text of the open item

interaction_model.visible_feedback: The item rotates fully to present its reverse face with the readable summary; the front face is seen closing during the motion

interaction_model.affected_object: The whole volumetric item

experience_qualities: Tangible and object-like: items read as solid volumes with real thickness rather than flat panels
Calm and deliberate: motions are gentle swivels, swings, glides and crossfades rather than abrupt changes
Orderly: only one item is ever active, so the row never becomes visually noisy
Legible: every revealed text surface is presented for comfortable reading, including the reverse face
Reassuring: every state has an obvious, symmetric way back to rest
completion_and_return: Reading has no forced end; stepping halts at the last passage without wrapping or auto-advancing
Closing an item, or opening another, returns the previous item to its resting look and position in the row
Turning an item upright restores the front-facing resting state
The open-control marking persists only while its item is open and clears on close
Passage position is not remembered across openings: every opening starts at the first passage
The row always ends in a fully resting arrangement once nothing is open or reversed
locked_observable_requirements: Items are rendered as solid volumes with visible thickness and a hinge/spine edge, arranged in a single row on a shared surface
Pointer hover produces a partial swivel that reveals thickness and settles back on pointer exit, without opening anything
Opening hinges the front face along the item's edge while the whole item translates toward the viewer
The open item layers in front of neighbouring items and never appears to cut through them
At most one item is open at any moment; opening another closes the previous one
Interior long text is disclosed one passage at a time with a soft crossfade transition between passages
Interior stepping always starts from the first passage and clamps at the first and last passage
A full turn-around presents a readable reverse face carrying the short summary, and closes any open front face
Open and turned states are mutually exclusive
The control that opened an item remains visibly marked for the whole time the item stays open
Every state is reversible by pressing the same control again, returning the item to its resting look
adaptable_details: Number of items in the row and their proportions
Surface, lighting, shadow and material treatment of the objects
Exact swivel angle, glide distance, easing and durations of the motions
Placement, shape and labelling of the open and turn controls, and how the open state is marked
Arrow styling and placement of the stepping controls on the interior surface
Typography and layout of the identifying labels, interior passages and reverse-side summary
How many passages each item contains and how long each passage is
Whether the row scrolls or wraps to fit narrower viewports
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits small curated sets of items that genuinely have an inside and a back worth reading — publications, catalogue entries, portfolio pieces, packaged goods, case studies — where each item pairs short identifying labels with a longer body text that can be broken into a few passages plus one brief summary. It stops fitting when the collection is large enough to need paging or filtering, when items have no meaningful interior or reverse content, or when the body text cannot be segmented. Replacing the volumetric open/turn treatment with flat cards, an overlay panel, a full-view takeover, or allowing several items open at once produces a different skill; so does making the row auto-advance rather than respond to deliberate control presses.

name: line_drawn_world_globe_to_flat_morph_panel
description: A calm, low-distraction panel holding a whole planet drawn as thin outlines that read clearly against a plain uniform ground, which the visitor spins and tilts by dragging, and which reshapes in one unbroken motion between rounded globe form and flattened map form, with a separate return to the neutral orientation.

Continuous and unbroken — the form change reads as one reshaping rather than a switch between two pictures
Direct and hand-on — the subject answers the pointer immediately and holds where it is left
Predictable and safe — tilt has a clean limit, the change cannot be interrupted mid-way, and a neutral orientation is always one action away
Balanced — neither form feels like the primary state or a temporary detour
locked_observable_requirements: A single subject drawn only as thin outlines in one consistent line tone, held at readable contrast against a plain uniform ground, with no fills, textures or imagery

A separate control returns orientation to the default without altering the current form
A short heading and exactly one line of supporting text remain visible and make the panel's point immediately
canonical_document.name: line_drawn_world_globe_to_flat_morph_panel

interaction_model.affected_object: Orientation of the single drawn subject

interaction_model.visible_feedback: One uninterrupted reshaping in which landmasses stay recognizable throughout, with no snapping, no crossfade, no disappearance and no substitution of one drawing for another; when it finishes, the control's label names the opposite direction

interaction_model.affected_object: Orientation of the subject only

name: glass_block_word_sculpture

experience_qualities: Calm, premium and unhurried; nothing demands action

Physical momentum — drags carry and ease out instead of stopping dead

canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits one short high-impact word or a comparably compact single subject meant to be admired rather than operated, placed in a view with little competing foreground copy. Changing the word, the tint, block density, or the surround's character and luminance key keeps the same skill. It becomes a different skill if the subject grows into long-form text or many separate objects, if the surround turns into readable scenery or content, if the free drift and drag are replaced by scroll-driven or scripted camera choreography with fixed stages or snap-to-preset views, if the material stops reading as light-catching and see-through so the highlight-watching loop disappears, or if a foreground reading layer is placed over it and the sculpture is demoted to a background substrate.

All blocks share one polished, faintly see-through tinted material, of any single hue, that both transmits and mirrors its surroundings, so letter interiors and edges carry moving highlights

A hazy, low-detail environment wrapping the subject on every side, present as the source of light, highlights and reflections rather than as scenery to be read; its luminance sits far enough from the subject's highlights for them to register, at any overall key
No persistent foreground labels, controls or supporting copy; the subject is the whole foreground and the surround stays subordinate in salience and detail
Initial framing sits at an oblique three-quarter angle with the complete word inside the frame, so several faces and the object's depth are visible at once

Legibility peaks at oblique framings; as the drift turns the subject, edges, interior refractions and silhouette take over prominence from the word itself

No hidden information is progressively disclosed — all new detail comes from viewpoint change and moving light

name: unfolding_box_reveal
description: A sealed, question-marked box turns slowly on a quiet, low-distraction stage that it stands clearly apart from, beneath a chunky display title; one labelled button unhurriedly swings its four walls outward and down while the lid fades away and the hidden mark inside grows to full size, and the same button folds it back to a never-opened look.

Theatrical calm from the quiet, low-distraction, single-subject stage
One distinct, unmistakable payoff moment rather than a gradual fade-in of information
Toy-like, arcade character from the chunky lettering and question-mark motifs
Smooth and forgiving under rapid or repeated toggling, never jarring
Endlessly repeatable with no sense of a spent surprise

Turning it into an autoplaying reveal without a user trigger, a scroll-driven unfold, a multi-object gallery, or replacing the hinged-shell unfolding and interior growth with a curtain, fade or slide reveal would create a different Skill.

experience_qualities: Quiet, grainy, intimate room-like atmosphere with the surround held clearly apart from the covers
Physical, weighted dragging that answers the pointer instantly and one to one
Focus that visibly tightens when sound runs and relaxes when it stops
Colour-led mood that belongs to the current item rather than the page
Uninterrupted listening: information can be inspected without breaking the sound
Unhurried, self-continuing rather than demanding
completion_and_return: No terminal state: items hand over unattended and the ring keeps cycling in order
Short drags return exactly to their starting arrangement
Panel dismissal returns to the pre-panel ring position and playback state
Pausing returns the scene to the relaxed, untightened arrangement while keeping the current focal item and its backdrop tint
The current focal item, its playing state, and its backdrop tint persist across panel opens and closes
locked_observable_requirements: Covers arranged at visibly different depths around exactly one facing-forward focal slot
The focal item's title rendered large and clearly readable as the current one
Ring rotation that tracks pointer movement one to one and live across all covers while held
A short release threshold that either settles one position onto the neighbour or eases back to the origin
Playback state expressed by the focal cover growing and rising in luminance while all others shrink and recede in luminance
A full-view backdrop tinted from the playing item and breathing with the sound over a constant fine grain, kept as a low-distraction surround separated in luminance from the focal cover
A per-item overlay detail reveal that leaves the ring position and the sound untouched, dismissible from its own mark or the recessed surround
Playing from inside the overlay turns the ring to that item and starts it
Step and play/pause controls that produce the same visible state changes as the gestures, with light-flood hover and pressed-in click
Unattended handover to the next item without resetting the tightened focus state
adaptable_details: Number of items in the ring and the ring's radius and depth spacing
Exact threshold distance, easing curves, and settle duration
Grain density and the overall luminance level of the surround, light or dark, as long as the separation holds
How faithfully the backdrop tint matches the cover and the pulse shape
Placement, shape, and iconography of the transport controls
Typography of the large title and layout or side of the detail panel
Which secondary text roles appear in the panel
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits a small ordered collection of visually strong single images where exactly one is featured at a time and something continuous is running that can drive the backdrop and the unattended handover. It stops being this Skill if the items become an equal-weight grid or list without a single facing-forward focal slot, if the collection grows large enough to need scanning or search rather than one-step neighbour movement, or if the running medium and its play state are removed, since the tightening focus and breathing colour field then have nothing to express.

name: endless_photo_corridor_flythrough_with_pinned_message
description: A centered headline, short pitch and two buttons stay fixed mid-screen while scrolling drifts the viewpoint forward or backward through a photograph-lined corridor that recedes to a vanishing point and never ends.

canonical_document.name: endless_photo_corridor_flythrough_with_pinned_message
canonical_document.description: A centered headline, short pitch and two buttons stay fixed mid-screen while scrolling drifts the viewpoint forward or backward through a photograph-lined corridor that recedes to a vanishing point and never ends.
canonical_document.experience_scope: A whole-view experience filling the viewport at the top of the page: it begins with an eased arrival of the centered message and continues for as long as the visitor keeps scrolling, with no terminal state in either direction.
content_and_composition: One short headline plus one short supporting pitch line, stacked and optically centered in the viewport
Exactly two adjacent action buttons directly beneath the pitch line, part of the same pinned message block
A single persistent foreground text layer that never moves with the scene
A depth layer behind and around the text: many rectangular photographs arranged along the sides of a corridor that recedes toward a distant vanishing point aligned with the message
Unbounded image cardinality: new photographs continuously enter near the vanishing point while nearest ones grow and leave past the frame edges
Clear separation of roles: photographs are setting and never occlude legibility of the centered message
experience_progression: Arrival: the headline and pitch ease into their centered position so the offer registers first, with the corridor reading as the setting immediately after
Onward drift: sustained forward travel where fresh photographs keep coming into view and passing by, at a calm, weightless pace
Return drift: equally smooth backward travel toward and past the starting depth
No final stage: travel loops indefinitely in both directions with no arrival point, summary or end screen
attention_and_information_flow: The centered message holds primary prominence continuously; the corridor is read second as context
Individual photographs gain presence as they approach and enlarge, then release attention as they exit the frame, so no single image becomes the subject
Perceived speed and depth are the main changing information; text content itself never changes or reveals more
Hovering briefly raises one button above its neighbor in prominence without disturbing the surrounding scene

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Travel never meets a hard stop or bounce; input can be reversed or interrupted at any moment mid-glide without snapping
interaction_model.state_change: Viewpoint advances deeper along the corridor axis
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Surrounding photographs slide past and swell as they approach and exit the frame edges, while new ones surface near the vanishing point
interaction_model.input: Scroll down / forward wheel, drag or key input
interaction_model.affected_object: Viewpoint within the photograph corridor

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Backward travel is likewise unbounded; direction may flip again mid-motion with continuous velocity, never a jump
interaction_model.state_change: Viewpoint draws back toward and beyond the starting depth
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Photographs recede and shrink toward the vanishing point in the same smooth manner as forward travel
interaction_model.input: Scroll up / backward input
interaction_model.affected_object: Viewpoint within the photograph corridor

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: New input during the coast is absorbed into the ongoing motion; resumption continues from the current depth
interaction_model.state_change: Motion trails the input and decays to rest shortly after the last input
interaction_model.visible_feedback: A short weightless coast, with image growth and sliding slowing to a standstill rather than cutting off
interaction_model.input: Scrolling stops (no further input)
interaction_model.affected_object: Corridor motion as a whole

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Returns to rest when the pointer leaves; the corridor and message layout are unaffected
interaction_model.state_change: Button enters a raised emphasis state
interaction_model.visible_feedback: A subtle lift of the button relative to its resting position
interaction_model.input: Pointer hover over an action button
interaction_model.affected_object: The hovered button in the pinned message block

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Plays once on arrival; scrolling during or after arrival does not restart or interrupt the message's settled position
interaction_model.state_change: Message settles from an entering state into its pinned centered position
interaction_model.visible_feedback: A gentle eased-in placement of the text at center, with the corridor already framing it
interaction_model.input: Page arrival (autonomous)
interaction_model.affected_object: Headline and pitch block

experience_qualities: Calm, weightless and unhurried rather than fast or forceful
Continuous and seamless: no snapping, stepping or hard boundaries
Endless and open, with no sense of a destination or limit
Immersive depth while remaining fully legible at the center
Directly responsive but softened, with motion lagging and coasting after the hand
completion_and_return: No completion state: forward and backward travel are both unbounded and the experience simply loops onward
The centered message and its two buttons persist unchanged and readable at every depth
Interrupted motion resumes from the current depth rather than resetting to the start
Returning toward the start feels identical in smoothness to going onward; there is no distinct home or reset moment
locked_observable_requirements: Short message block with exactly two actions stays pinned mid-screen and legible throughout all travel
Scroll direction maps to forward and backward depth travel of the viewpoint, not to page flow
Surrounding images slide past and visibly swell as they approach the viewer
A continuous supply of new images so no far end is ever reached in either direction
Motion trails input and coasts to rest shortly after input ceases
Interruption and mid-glide reversal are accepted without any snap or jump
On arrival the message eases into place so the offer registers before the setting
Buttons lift subtly on hover without disturbing the scene
adaptable_details: Photograph subjects, aspect ratios, framing and color treatment
Corridor cross-section and arrangement of images along it, plus their spacing and density
Lighting, haze, vignette or focus falloff toward the vanishing point
Easing curve, travel speed and coast duration
Typography, message wording and button styling
Magnitude of the hover lift and of the arrival easing
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits sparse-copy openers where a single claim plus a small action set must stay readable in front of an atmospheric, interchangeable image supply. It stops being this Skill if the travel becomes a finite ordered sequence with a defined end or destination, if the images become primary content to be read, selected or navigated individually, if the centered message is unpinned and scrolls with the scene, or if depth approach is replaced by flat panning, paging or stepwise snapping.

name: converging_signal_channel_field
description: A screen-filling field on a uniform low-distraction ground where faint rippling lanes fan out wide and funnel endless high-contrast travellers into one concentrated glowing core.

canonical_document.name: converging_signal_channel_field
canonical_document.description: A screen-filling field on a uniform low-distraction ground where faint rippling lanes fan out wide and funnel endless high-contrast travellers into one concentrated glowing core.
canonical_document.experience_scope: Whole-view experience that fills the screen from the moment it appears, with no intro, title or preamble; it never ends, so there is no exit state — only the optional control panel overlaying one corner.
content_and_composition: Single uniform full-bleed ground as the base, occupying the entire view and held far enough in luminance from the travellers for them to separate cleanly
Many faint lane paths (dozens or more) spreading wide at one extent and gathering toward a single point, forming the readable funnel geometry
Continuous population of many small high-contrast travellers distributed along the lanes, each drawing a fading trail behind it
One intense concentrated convergence core where all lanes meet, the highest-contrast and densest region of the composition
Soft glow surrounding travellers and the core, separating them from the quiet lane web

Persistent small collapsible control panel tucked into an edge or corner, grouped by topic (colour, lane geometry and spread, ripple and flow speed, trail length, density counts, glow amount), visually subordinate to the field
attention_and_information_flow: Attention lands immediately on the convergence core because it is the highest-contrast, densest and most concentrated area
Lane web and outer spread remain low-contrast and secondary, read as context and depth rather than subject
Traveller motion continuously carries the eye inward from the wide spread toward the core, reinforcing direction without labels
Trails extend the perceived path of each traveller, making flow direction legible even in a still glance
Control panel stays visually quiet until approached, so it never competes with the field

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: No start or finish; any moment of arrival shows the same legible state, so a viewer can join or leave at any time
interaction_model.state_change: Travellers advance toward the convergence core while lanes rippling softly; population is replenished so the field never empties or completes
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Uninterrupted inward streaming with soft lateral rippling of the lanes and a steadily glowing core
interaction_model.input: Autonomous continuous animation with no user action
interaction_model.affected_object: Travellers along the lanes and the lane web itself

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Every control is clamped to a safe range and can be dragged straight back to its previous value, restoring the prior look with no broken or blank state
interaction_model.state_change: Field updates continuously during the drag with no reload and no restart of the scene
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Immediate frame-by-frame reshaping — lanes widen or tighten, ripple and flow quicken or slow, trails lengthen or shorten, glow swells or fades, the chosen colours shift — while travellers keep their continuity
interaction_model.input: Dragging a continuous appearance or motion control (lane geometry and spread, ripple speed, flow speed, trail length, glow amount) or picking a colour
interaction_model.affected_object: The corresponding visual property of the live field

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Rebuild happens in place so framing and geometry are preserved; the value can be dragged back and released to return to the previous density
interaction_model.state_change: Change commits on release rather than during the drag, rebuilding the field in place
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The field is rebuilt at the new density with travellers re-scattered across the lanes, without the view going empty or the composition relocating
interaction_model.input: Dragging a density or count control and releasing it
interaction_model.affected_object: The population of travellers and lanes

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Raising the value resumes travelling from the held positions; the zero end is a valid resting state, not a failure
interaction_model.state_change: Traveller advance halts while lane rippling continues
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Travellers hold still as frozen high-contrast points with their trails, while the lanes keep softly rippling so the scene still reads as alive rather than stalled
interaction_model.input: Setting flow speed to its zero boundary
interaction_model.affected_object: Travellers versus lane web

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Freely reversible at any time; the running field is unaffected by panel state
interaction_model.state_change: Panel groups fold away or open
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Panel shrinks back to an unobtrusive tucked state, leaving the field unobstructed, or opens to reveal grouped controls
interaction_model.input: Collapsing or expanding a control group
interaction_model.affected_object: The tucked-away panel

experience_qualities: Atmospheric, with a low-distraction surround holding the field together
Calm and hypnotic
Deep and layered, with a quiet background web behind high-contrast foreground motion
Endless and non-completing, rewarding both a glance and a long stare
Immediately legible without explanation
Responsive and unbreakable under experimentation
completion_and_return: No completion state; the flow runs indefinitely and the population is continuously replenished
Any arrival moment presents the same readable composition, so lingering for seconds or minutes is equivalent
Parameter changes take effect in place and persist for the session; the scene never restarts from a blank or loading state
Density commits rebuild the field without leaving the view empty
locked_observable_requirements: Screen-filling field on a uniform low-distraction ground, with no intro or preamble before it is visible
Wide spread of faint lanes narrowing into a single concentrated high-contrast convergence point, readable at first glance
Many small travellers moving along the lanes with fading trails, always flowing inward toward the convergence
Convergence core is the highest-contrast focus; surrounding lane web stays quiet and secondary
Soft continuous rippling of the lanes independent of traveller motion
Endless, never-emptying, never-completing flow
Compact tucked-away collapsible control panel that never dominates the field
Continuous controls update the visible field instantly during drag with no reload; density-style controls commit on release and rebuild in place with travellers re-scattered
All controls clamped to safe ranges and reversible by dragging back, with no reachable broken or blank state
At zero flow speed travellers hold still while lane rippling continues
adaptable_details: Exact hues of ground, lanes, travellers and core, whether the ground sits at the low or high end of the luminance scale, and any preset colour sets offered
Number of lanes and travellers within the clamped ranges
Whether the funnel points to a screen edge, centre or off-centre location, and the direction of flow
Trail length, glow strength and ripple amplitude defaults
Panel placement, grouping labels and expand/collapse styling
Whether extra parameters beyond the listed groups are exposed
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits any context wanting a full-view atmospheric abstract motion backdrop or a tunable visual sandbox, with or without small amounts of overlaid foreground text. Losing the single high-contrast convergence and letting travellers wander an even field, making the flow finish or empty, or replacing the abstract travellers with meaningful labelled data nodes that must be read or clicked would each create a different Skill.

name: rippling_water_photo_backdrop
description: A single photo presented as if seen through the glossy surface of a still pool filling the view, where moving the pointer trails faint spreading ripples that bend the image and a press punches one deeper ripple, all crossing, weakening and dying back to calm.

canonical_document.name: rippling_water_photo_backdrop
canonical_document.description: A single photo presented as if seen through the glossy surface of a still pool filling the view, where moving the pointer trails faint spreading ripples that bend the image and a press punches one deeper ripple, all crossing, weakening and dying back to calm.
canonical_document.experience_scope: Region- or whole-view backdrop layer that begins as soon as the view is entered and never ends; it has no start gate, no completion and no exit state, and it occupies the full area assigned to it while foreground content sits above.
content_and_composition: Exactly one source photograph as the entire visible substrate, framed to fill the assigned area edge to edge
One continuous simulated liquid surface layer covering the same area, read as being directly above the photo rather than beside it
Drifting specular highlights over the surface that soften the photo without hiding its subject
Transient ripple disturbances of two magnitudes co-existing in the same field: many faint trailing ones and occasional markedly deeper single ones
Optional foreground content (text, controls, navigation) layered above and never distorted by the surface
No labels, instructions, legends, counters or affordance hints of any kind
experience_progression: Resting state: still, glossy, unbroken surface with only slow highlight drift
Disturbance: ripples are seeded at the point of contact and swell outward
Travel and interference: expanding rings cross each other and the photo bends where they pass
Decay: amplitude weakens with distance and time until the disturbance vanishes
Return to resting state, unchanged and ready for another disturbance; the cycle loops indefinitely with no terminal stage
attention_and_information_flow: Attention slides back and forth between the photographic subject read through the surface and the moving light travelling over it
Newly seeded ripples are the local focus because they are the only fast-changing thing in an otherwise slow field
A pressed ripple briefly dominates attention over trailing ripples because of its markedly greater depth
As disturbances decay, prominence returns to the photo and the calm surface, restoring legibility for any foreground content
No information is disclosed or hidden by the effect; the photo's readability is the constant baseline

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Stopping movement stops new seeding; existing ripples keep travelling and fade on their own with no reset
interaction_model.state_change: Faint ripples are continuously seeded at the current pointer position and begin expanding outward
interaction_model.visible_feedback: A trail of soft spreading rings follows the moving point, visibly bending the photo as they travel
interaction_model.input: Pointer moving across the surface
interaction_model.affected_object: Liquid surface layer and the photo seen through it

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: No undo needed; the deep ripple weakens and disappears like the faint ones, always returning the surface to calm
interaction_model.state_change: One single disturbance of markedly greater depth is created at the exact contact point
interaction_model.visible_feedback: A pronounced ring with stronger image displacement pushes outward from that spot and stands out from the faint trailing ripples
interaction_model.input: Press, click or tap anywhere on the surface
interaction_model.affected_object: Liquid surface layer and the photo seen through it

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Lifting the finger ends seeding immediately; remaining ripples settle and normal page behavior resumes outside the surface
interaction_model.state_change: Identical continuous ripple seeding as pointer movement, while page scrolling and text selection are suppressed over the surface
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The same trailing ripples follow the finger, and the page stays put instead of scrolling or highlighting
interaction_model.input: Finger drag on a touch surface
interaction_model.affected_object: Liquid surface layer and the host page viewport

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Re-entering the area resumes seeding instantly from the new position with no restart or ramp-up
interaction_model.state_change: Seeding stops entirely while existing disturbances continue their decay
interaction_model.visible_feedback: No new rings appear; the remaining ones spread, weaken and vanish until the surface is still again
interaction_model.input: Pointer leaving the surface area
interaction_model.affected_object: Ripple field

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Never stops, never completes; unaffected by disturbances beginning or ending
interaction_model.state_change: Slow continuous drift of specular light across the still surface
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The surface reads as alive and glossy rather than as a static image, even when untouched
interaction_model.input: Autonomous idle behavior with no user input
interaction_model.affected_object: Highlights on the surface

experience_qualities: Calm, still and glossy at rest, like looking down into a pool
Physical and tactile: contact produces a proportional, believable swell
Naturally decaying rather than switched off, so calm always returns
Legible: the photograph stays readable through the surface at all times
Self-explanatory and inviting repeat play without any prompt
Endless and unhurried, with no goal, score or finish
completion_and_return: No completion state exists; the surface is permanently live
Every disturbance self-terminates by interference and decay, returning the field to the same calm baseline
No reset control, no persistent state and no accumulation between disturbances or between visits
locked_observable_requirements: One photograph fills the assigned area and remains recognizable through the surface at all times
The surface reads as a still, glossy liquid seen from above, softened by drifting highlights
Pointer movement continuously seeds faint ripples exactly under the moving point
Press or tap creates one distinctly deeper ripple originating at the exact contact point
Ripples travel outward, visibly bend the photo, cross and interfere with each other, weaken and disappear
Recovery is automatic and complete: calm always returns without any user action or reset affordance
Seeding ceases when the pointer leaves the area while remaining ripples finish settling
Touch dragging behaves identically to pointer movement and must not scroll or select the page
The experience carries no instructions, controls or completion state
adaptable_details: Choice and subject of the photograph
Ripple spread speed, decay duration, wavelength and depth contrast between trailing and pressed ripples
Density, brightness and drift speed of the highlights
Overall surface glossiness and how strongly the photo is softened
Assigned area size and aspect, from a bounded section to the entire view
Which foreground content is layered above
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits any single still image intended as a calm, continuously live substrate behind readable foreground content, where the subject must remain legible and interaction is incidental rather than instructional. It breaks if the photo is replaced by content that must be read precisely or by a set of images requiring navigation, if the disturbances persist, accumulate or must be cleared manually, if the effect is used as a foreground focal object with its own controls, progression or completion, or if the liquid surface is replaced by a different material metaphor such as glass shards, fabric folds or particle fields, which would be a different Skill.

canonical_document.name: framed_drifting_gradient_field_with_captioned_credits
canonical_document.description: An edge-to-edge generated color gradient surface that drifts slowly and never repeats, inset behind a plain, evenly toned frame margin whose luminance is clearly separated from the surface so the whole reads like a hung piece, with a short label, a title and a small credit list resting legibly on top; hovering a credit slides a thin underline in from one side and pulls it back out the other way.

canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits any single-view presentation whose foreground content is a short caption set (label, name, small link list) sitting on one continuous generated color or light surface — single-work exhibits, experiment pages, atmospheric landing views. name: drifting_two_tone_dot_field_with_cutout_word_and_press_flare_rings
description: A coarse two-tone dot field that drifts and thickens into soft never-repeating wisps, an oversized centered word that reads as an inverted cut-out wherever the pattern passes behind it, and high-salience flare rings that bloom from each press point, swell outward, thin and dissolve back into the drift.

canonical_document.name: drifting_two_tone_dot_field_with_cutout_word_and_press_flare_rings

interaction_model.state_change: Each press gets its own independent ring; rings run simultaneously and their flares combine where they cross

Hypnotic and calming, with nothing to work out
Alive on arrival, never idle-looking or waiting to be started
Playfully touchable — the whole surface responds, but no press has consequences
Self-settling: every flare returns to the same quiet baseline
completion_and_return: The surface experience never completes; it loops indefinitely as continuous drift

No state persists between presses or accumulates over time; flare intensity always sinks back to the resting drift
Retiring the oldest ring under rapid pressing is a graceful return to capacity, not a reset of the surface
locked_observable_requirements: Exactly two clearly separated tones — any hue pairing, either polarity — with a visibly coarse dot grain; no smooth gradients or photographic texture
The field is already drifting when the view appears and never repeats in a way the eye can catch
The field carries no readable information or decodable pattern
One oversized word centered on the surface, reading as an inversion of the pattern behind it rather than a solid opaque shape
A press produces a ring at exactly the contact point, not at a snapped, centered or approximate location
The ring expands while thinning and fully dissolves into the drift within roughly a second

The specific pair of tones, their hues, and which of the two reads as the flare

canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits full-view or full-section backdrops for text-light contexts — entry and landing views, teaser or coming-soon pages, sparse editorial, portfolio or poster-like layouts — where the foreground is a short word, headline or logo and the surface is meant to set mood while inviting aimless pressing. It adopts whatever tone pair the host provides, in either polarity, so long as the two tones stay clearly separated. It stops being this Skill if the field must carry meaning or data, if presses must leave persistent marks, accumulate flare or commit an action, if the two-tone limit expands into continuous multi-tone or photographic imagery so the coarse grain is lost, or if dense reading content sits directly on the field so the drift and flares must be suppressed.

name: failing_screen_prose_and_photo_scroll

Headings act as the strongest anchors and accumulate meaning across the page, so prominence is carried by type rather than by motion

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Fully reversible: scrolling back up brings earlier passages back unchanged, with no consumed or one-shot states

interaction_model.visible_feedback: The surface keeps trembling and flickering on its own instead of freezing

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: The legibility floor is a hard boundary; degradation varies within it and never peaks into unreadable noise
interaction_model.state_change: Continuous variation of warp and flicker
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Unsteady, uneasy rendering that stays above a readability floor so passages can actually be read
interaction_model.input: Autonomous instability while reading
interaction_model.affected_object: Text and photographs alike

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Repeated resizing does not accumulate drift; reading position and sequence remain intact
interaction_model.state_change: Re-flow and re-alignment at the new viewport size
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Everything stays aligned and the treatment stays registered to its element, with no residual offset

interaction_model.affected_object: Layout of passages and photographs plus their distorted rendering

experience_qualities: Subdued and oppressive, with a low-stimulation surround
Uneasy and unstable rather than merely noisy
Readable throughout despite constant degradation
Sparse, slow and quiet, with long empty intervals
Never granting a clean or repaired moment as relief
Cohesive: all content appears to live on the same failing surface
completion_and_return: Completion is the closing words resting over the final photograph — a definite end, not a loop or replay
The idle trembling persists after the ending; the surface never settles into stillness
Scrolling back up returns earlier passages exactly as they were, so the page can be re-read without change
No progress, dismissal or completion state is stored or displayed
locked_observable_requirements: Content is already degraded when it arrives; no clean baseline is ever shown
Warping, flickering and instability are applied to the actual headings, paragraphs and photographs, not to separate ornaments
Readability is preserved at all times — mood is uneasy, not illegible
Each element's distortion stays registered to that element while scrolling: no drift, lag, or loss of register
Vertical scrolling is the only control; there are no buttons, toggles or pointer-triggered effects
Scrolling upward restores earlier content unchanged
When scrolling stops, the surface continues to move on its own
Resizing keeps content and its treatment aligned
Sequential section headings compose one interrupted sentence across the page
The final beat is closing words positioned over the last photograph
A single restrained, low-distraction surface tone carrying readable text contrast, with sparse content density throughout
adaptable_details: Exact character and mix of the degradation (warping, scan disturbance, flicker, chromatic channel separation)
Amplitude and rhythm of instability, so long as legibility holds
Number of text stretches and paragraphs per stretch, provided the headings still form one interrupted sentence
Number, subject, crop and aspect of photographs
Typeface, type scale and measure
Surface and text hues, luminance direction and contrast level, provided separation stays above the readability floor
Amount of empty space between stretches
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits sparse, mood-led pages whose foreground is a small amount of prose plus photographs meant to be read straight through with no chrome. It stops being this Skill if the content becomes dense or utilitarian, if the degradation is confined to one accent element or hero block while the rest of the page renders cleanly, if content arrives clean and only degrades on a trigger such as hover or a scroll threshold (that is a reveal effect instead), if the instability is allowed to break readability, or if the treatment is demoted to a decorative substrate sitting behind separate clean foreground content.

name: typographic_hero_with_summoned_image_trail
description: Layered lettering and columns of single words drift out of soft blur in sequence, then pictures bloom at the moving cursor with a random tilt and spin away by themselves, leaving the quiet typography behind.

canonical_document.name: typographic_hero_with_summoned_image_trail
canonical_document.description: Layered lettering and columns of single words drift out of soft blur in sequence, then pictures bloom at the moving cursor with a random tilt and spin away by themselves, leaving the quiet typography behind.
canonical_document.experience_scope: A single bounded hero region occupying the first view of the page. The entrance reveal begins the moment the region is first shown and completes once; the summoning behavior lives for as long as the visitor's pointer or finger is inside the region, and ends whenever input stops or leaves. It is a region experience layered over its own background, not a whole-page or scroll-length experience.
content_and_composition: One oversized headline treatment built from several overlapping lettering layers, centered as the primary visual anchor and the largest element in the region

Two or more narrow columns of short single-word terms, set small and at clearly reduced emphasis relative to the headline while still readable, flanking or sitting beneath it as quiet secondary reading

A transient imagery layer above the typography: a handful of small-to-medium rectangular pictures may coexist at any instant, each centered where the input was, each at a slight random rotation, none of them permanent
A small intensity readout as a peripheral, low-weight element that is present only while movement is happening
A persistent top bar holding a short set of named trail-style options, one visibly marked as current
A calm, low-distraction background substrate that holds enough separation from both the typography and the pictures to keep each of them legible against it
experience_progression: Arrival: the region is quiet and soft-focused; headline layers resolve out of blur, then the word columns follow, one after another, with nothing else moving

attention_and_information_flow: During the entrance, the typography holds sole prominence so the headline and terms are read before any imagery exists
During exploration, the newest picture at the input point is the momentary focal element; older pictures recede as they shrink and rotate away
Pictures never accumulate into an opaque mass, so the typography stays continuously legible underneath
The intensity readout offers a peripheral echo of movement energy without competing with the headline
The current style marker in the top bar quietly communicates which treatment upcoming pictures will carry

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Plays once and is not replayed; if the visitor begins moving during the reveal, the reveal continues to completion rather than aborting

interaction_model.affected_object: Headline lettering layers and the word columns

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: No new picture appears while the pointer is stationary or outside the region; there is nothing for the visitor to dismiss or undo
interaction_model.state_change: A fresh picture is created at the current input position
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The picture grows from nothing, centered on the cursor, at a slight random tilt
interaction_model.input: Pointer travel accumulating a short distance inside the region
interaction_model.affected_object: Transient imagery layer

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Self-clearing by design, so the surface always empties without any reset control; departures continue even if the visitor stops moving
interaction_model.state_change: From settled to departing and then gone

interaction_model.affected_object: That individual picture

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: The readout fades out shortly after movement stops; slowing down immediately returns the effect to its calmer scale without any explicit switch
interaction_model.state_change: Faster travel raises the created size and the strength of tilt, and drives the readout upward
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Livelier exploration yields visibly larger, more strongly angled pictures alongside a rising readout; gentler movement yields smaller, barely tilted ones
interaction_model.input: Speed of travel across the region
interaction_model.affected_object: Newly created pictures and the intensity readout

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Lifting the finger ends creation; existing pictures still clear themselves
interaction_model.state_change: Identical creation, sizing, tilting and departure as pointer travel
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The same blooming and dissolving pictures follow the finger
interaction_model.input: Finger drag across the region
interaction_model.affected_object: Transient imagery layer and intensity readout

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Re-entering the region resumes summoning immediately with no re-arming step
interaction_model.state_change: Creation halts while existing pictures complete their lifecycle
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The imagery drains away and the still typographic composition is left alone
interaction_model.input: Pointer or finger leaving the region bounds
interaction_model.affected_object: Transient imagery layer and readout

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Pictures already on screen keep their original treatment and depart normally; the choice can be changed at any time and persists across rest and exploration cycles
interaction_model.state_change: The chosen option becomes the current one and governs creation from that point on
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The selected option is visibly marked as current, and pictures created afterwards carry that treatment
interaction_model.input: Choosing one of the named trail styles in the top bar
interaction_model.affected_object: Style mode and every subsequently created picture

experience_qualities: Calm and contemplative, with the words read before anything moves
Subdued and understated, imagery emerging from a quiet, low-distraction ground that it still reads clearly against
Ephemeral: nothing lingers, nothing piles up
Summoned rather than pre-placed, so the imagery feels caused by the visitor
Energy-proportional, with liveliness reading as scale and tilt intensity
Self-tidying, always returning to stillness
completion_and_return: The entrance reveal completes once and does not replay for the remainder of the visit
The summoning behavior has no end state; it loops between an empty resting composition and active exploration
Each picture completes its own appear-and-depart lifecycle independently of the visitor
The still typographic composition is the guaranteed return state whenever input stops or leaves
The only state that persists across cycles is the currently chosen trail style
locked_observable_requirements: Typography resolves out of soft blur in a staggered order and is readable before any imagery exists
Pictures appear only in response to movement, centered on the input point, growing from nothing at a slight random tilt
Every picture departs by itself by spinning off and shrinking away; no picture remains
No new imagery is created while the input is stationary or outside the region
Faster travel visibly produces larger and more strongly tilted pictures
A small intensity readout appears with movement and fades shortly after it stops
Touch drag behaves the same as pointer travel

The region clears itself back to the still typographic state with no reset control
Typography stays legible beneath the imagery at all times, holding readable separation from both the background and the pictures
adaptable_details: Wording, language and number of headline layers and single-word terms
Column count and placement of the word lists
Palette, background texture and overall luminance level, light or deep, as long as separation and legibility hold
Exact travel distance threshold and picture lifetime
Picture subject matter, aspect ratio and count in the available set
Numeric ranges for scale and tilt, and the easing of growth and departure
Format, wording and placement of the intensity readout
How many trail styles are offered, their names and their individual treatments
Top bar layout and how the current option is marked
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits bounded intro, hero or feature regions that carry a short, sparse typographic message over a small set of interchangeable pictures, where pointer or touch presence is expected and no information needs to be read from the imagery itself. It stops being this skill if the pictures persist or accumulate into a lasting collage, if they become clickable or navigational content, if they are driven by scrolling or autoplay instead of the visitor's movement, or if the settled typography is removed so the imagery becomes the permanent primary layer.
