content_and_composition: One short word as the only foreground content, never drawn as flat solid type but expressed as a faint raised or displaced relief within the surrounding texture, legible at a glance yet clearly subordinate to the texture that carries it

One continuous background field of many fine, evenly spaced, stacked horizontal threads filling the whole view edge to edge; the field is the visual material and the word is a deformation of it, so both occupy the same single visual layer rather than being stacked as separate graphics
One uniform, quiet ground with hairlines held at a gentle, clearly readable separation from it as the only tonal pairing, giving a calm, tactile, low-glare surface
One transient local disturbance region centered on the pointer position, small relative to the whole field, existing only while the pointer is active
No frames, controls, captions, instructions or secondary content
attention_and_information_flow: At rest, attention is drawn first to the word because it is the only structured break in an otherwise uniform texture, while the texture reads as an even, calm surface
Once the pointer moves, prominence shifts locally to the area around the cursor, where thread spacing and curvature become the most active part of the image, without ever overpowering the word
Displacement is strongest directly beneath the pointer and fades continuously to nothing at the edge of its reach, so the eye is guided to the pointer with a soft falloff rather than a hard boundary
No new information is revealed by interaction: the word remains the only message, and the reaction adds tactility and liveliness rather than content
As the field returns to rest, attention naturally settles back onto the word

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: The effect is strictly local and bounded by the reach radius; deformation never accumulates across repeated passes, so the field cannot be progressively distorted or broken no matter how much the visitor moves
interaction_model.state_change: Threads inside the reach shift from their resting contour to a bent, spread contour, displaced most directly beneath the pointer and tapering to zero displacement at the edge of the reach
interaction_model.visible_feedback: A soft lens-like swell of parted, curved hairlines that travels with the cursor, locally opening the texture while the rest of the field stays undisturbed
interaction_model.input: Pointer moving across the field
interaction_model.affected_object: Threads within a small radius around the pointer position

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Return to rest is automatic and always available; a new pointer movement during the settling motion is absorbed and simply forms a new swell from wherever the threads currently are
interaction_model.state_change: Disturbed threads relax from their bent contour back to the resting stacked contour
interaction_model.visible_feedback: A smooth springy settling of the hairlines back into even stacking, leaving no trace of the earlier swell
interaction_model.input: Pointer leaving an area, stopping, or exiting the field
interaction_model.affected_object: Previously disturbed threads

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Stillness is the default and the state the experience always returns to, so the surface never demands attention on its own
interaction_model.state_change: Field holds its resting configuration with no motion at all
interaction_model.visible_feedback: A perfectly still, evenly stacked hairline texture with the word visible as a faint relief
interaction_model.input: No pointer activity yet (initial state)
interaction_model.affected_object: Whole field

experience_qualities: Quiet, restrained and tactile rather than glaring or flashy
Playful and alive precisely where attention lands, calm everywhere else
The word feels embossed into a material instead of printed on top of it
Half-buried legibility: readable at a glance while remaining part of the texture
Open-ended and forgiving, with nothing to complete and nothing that can be left damaged
completion_and_return: There is no completion state, score, sequence or end; the experience is indefinitely explorable
Every local disturbance resolves on its own back to the shared resting field, which is the single canonical state
No state persists between interactions; leaving and returning the pointer starts from the same still field
locked_observable_requirements: The short word must appear as a faint relief formed within the thread texture, never as flat solid lettering placed over it
The texture must be a dense field of fine, evenly stacked, near-parallel horizontal threads filling the whole region

Ground and hairlines must stay within a narrow tonal range with restrained, low-glare separation — enough for the hairlines to read distinctly and for the word's relief to remain faint, with either the threads or the ground free to be the lighter of the two

Pointer proximity must displace threads with maximum effect directly under the pointer and continuous falloff to zero at a small reach radius, producing a lens-like local swell that follows the cursor
Disturbance must be non-cumulative and must spring smoothly back to the resting contour after the pointer moves on or stops
The field must be completely still before any pointer movement
The word must remain legible at a glance despite being embedded in the texture
adaptable_details: The specific short word
Thread spacing, thickness and count, as long as the field still reads as dense and fine
The exact hues of the hairlines and the ground, and which of the two is lighter, as long as their separation stays gentle, low-glare and readable
Size of the pointer reach radius and the exact swell shape, as long as falloff remains continuous
Speed and springiness of the return to rest
Region proportions, from a short wide banner to a full viewport view
Whether displacement reads as spreading, bulging or gently lifting the threads
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits any context whose foreground message is a single very short word or mark that should feel materially embossed and atmospheric, in a banner, hero, splash or divider region with little or no other content. It does not fit regions carrying paragraphs, lists, dense data or interactive controls, because the texture and local deformation would compete with reading and clicking. Replacing the hairline field with a different visual material, letting the word sit as flat type above the texture, allowing deformation to accumulate or persist, making the reaction global rather than a small local lens, or adding progression, goals or revealed content would each create a different Skill.

name: endless_luminous_flythrough_toy_world
description: A chunky, toy-scaled landscape of emitted light rushing toward the viewer against a low-distraction surround while a small craft hovers centred and steady, its engine flickering, in a loop with no visible beginning or seam.

canonical_document.name: endless_luminous_flythrough_toy_world
canonical_document.description: A chunky, toy-scaled landscape of emitted light rushing toward the viewer against a low-distraction surround while a small craft hovers centred and steady, its engine flickering, in a loop with no visible beginning or seam.
canonical_document.experience_scope: A single region-or-whole-view scene that fills its frame and is anchored to the bottom edge; it begins running the moment it appears and continues indefinitely with no entry, exit or completion boundary, and it is designed to be layered behind other content.
content_and_composition: One persistent focal craft held at the middle of the frame, visually stable rather than travelling across the composition
Many small lit clusters of scenery distributed in depth, treated as a repeating population rather than named landmarks
A low-distraction surrounding field held far enough from the lit elements in luminance that emitted light reads as the dominant visual material
Distinct depth bands: far-distance emergence zone, mid-approach zone where clusters are largest, and a near zone where they leave past the viewer
Small flickering engine light attached to the focal craft as a continuous sign of life
Composition anchored on the bottom edge so the ground plane meets the frame edge and the sky occupies the upper area
Chunky, low-detail, toy-sized object scale so individual elements read as miniature objects rather than realistic architecture
experience_progression: Clusters appear faintly at the far distance
They grow in size and brightness as they approach
They pass the viewer at largest scale and slip out of frame
New clusters continuously replace them so the cycle repeats without any arrival, milestone or ending
attention_and_information_flow: The centred craft is the constant anchor of attention; everything else moves relative to it
Prominence transfers outward over time: far elements are dim and small, mid elements are brightest and largest, near elements exit and release attention
No new information is revealed over time, so the scene can be understood at a glance and re-entered at any moment without lost context
Attention is deliberately releasable: nothing accumulates, counts down or demands watching to completion

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: No user control, no pause, no start or finish to catch; motion simply continues for as long as the scene is present
interaction_model.state_change: Continuous forward travel: clusters change depth position, apparent size and brightness
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Steady rush of light-emitting clusters emerging, swelling and passing out of frame around a stationary centred craft
interaction_model.input: Autonomous time-based advance beginning as soon as the scene appears
interaction_model.affected_object: The population of lit clusters and the depth field they travel through

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Continuous and self-sustaining; never resolves to an on or off end state
interaction_model.state_change: Small irregular brightness sputters
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Tiny pulses of engine light that keep the otherwise steady craft feeling alive
interaction_model.input: Autonomous flicker driver on the focal craft
interaction_model.affected_object: Engine light on the centred craft

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Inertness is absolute and requires no recovery; input passes through to whatever sits in front
interaction_model.state_change: None; the scene remains completely inert
interaction_model.visible_feedback: No reaction whatsoever, so pointer and touch attention stays with the foreground content layered above
interaction_model.input: Cursor movement, hover, tap, drag or scroll over the scene
interaction_model.affected_object: The scene as a whole

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Returning to a wider viewport steps the scene back up with the same composition intact
interaction_model.state_change: The entire scene steps down to a smaller size while keeping its arrangement
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Same composition, smaller: no recomposition of elements, no cropping, no drift off centre, still anchored on the bottom edge
interaction_model.input: Viewport narrowing to phone width
interaction_model.affected_object: The whole picture as one unit

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Resumption is invisible by design; there is no re-entry animation or catch-up jolt
interaction_model.state_change: Motion continuity is preserved across the absence
interaction_model.visible_feedback: No jump, no restart, no visible seam on return; the journey appears to have simply carried on
interaction_model.input: Looking away and returning, or the scene leaving and re-entering view
interaction_model.affected_object: The running loop

experience_qualities: Hypnotic and repetitive rather than eventful
Dreamy and atmospheric, meant to be felt at a glance
Retro and stylised rather than photographic
Miniature and toy-like in scale, reading as emitted light set clearly apart from its surround
Calm and demand-free: watchable for seconds or minutes, abandonable without loss
completion_and_return: No completion state and no destination; the journey never arrives
Seamless perpetual looping with no perceptible cycle boundary
No reset, replay control or progress that persists between visits
Re-entry always looks like continuation, never a fresh start
locked_observable_requirements: Focal craft stays held at the middle of the frame while scenery moves, not the reverse
Scenery clusters must visibly emerge from far distance, swell on approach and pass out past the viewer
The loop must never show a jump, restart or seam, including after the scene is out of view
The scene must remain fully inert to cursor, tap, drag and scroll so it can sit behind foreground content
Scene fills its frame and stays anchored to the bottom edge
Narrow viewports scale the whole picture down without recomposing, cropping or off-centre drift
Continuous small engine-light flicker on the focal craft
Light-emitting elements kept in strong luminance separation from a low-distraction surround, at chunky miniature object scale
adaptable_details: Exact craft silhouette and its hovering bob amount
Hue family and overall key of the emitted light and of the surround behind it, in any combination that keeps the two clearly separated
Density, spacing and silhouette variety of the approaching clusters
Travel speed and flicker rhythm
Depth of field, haze or glow intensity in the far-distance zone
Amount of visible sky versus ground within the bottom-anchored framing
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits any context needing a demand-free atmospheric layer of continuous forward travel behind or beneath sparse foreground content, with any stylised miniature subject matter standing in for the craft and clusters, and any hue family for the emitted light and its surround. It stops being this Skill if the scene responds to pointer, scroll or tap, if the viewer gains navigational control over the travel, if the journey reaches a destination or plays as a finite sequence, if the focal object leaves the frame centre, or if narrow viewports rearrange or crop the composition instead of scaling it as one picture.

name: encoded_message_decoder_hero
description: A focused opening screen where an assembling headline points to a glowing capsule of unreadable symbols that a visitor can churn into a readable sentence and back, while faint fragments of short phrases keep surfacing and fading in the low-emphasis surround.

canonical_document.name: encoded_message_decoder_hero
canonical_document.description: A focused opening screen where an assembling headline points to a glowing capsule of unreadable symbols that a visitor can churn into a readable sentence and back, while faint fragments of short phrases keep surfacing and fading in the low-emphasis surround.
canonical_document.experience_scope: Whole-view opening region: begins with the arrival animation of the headline and focal capsule when the section is first shown, and continues indefinitely as a stable, repeatedly togglable state; the ambient field runs for as long as the section is on screen. Self-contained — nothing outside the section changes.
content_and_composition: One large multi-part headline, positioned above the focal element, whose wording frames the idea of hidden or encoded writing
One high-contrast capsule centered in the view, reading as clearly illuminated against its surround, holding a single line of fixed-length unreadable symbol characters as its primary content
One small round control attached at the capsule's right edge, carrying a short text label that names the action currently available
A quiet, strongly de-emphasized full-section field behind the headline and capsule, carrying many faint, low-emphasis fragments of short sayings at unpredictable positions
Layer order: recessive ambient field at the back, headline and capsule as the salient foreground; the capsule is the single most luminous, highest-emphasis element
Persistent elements: headline, capsule and its control remain present in every state; only the capsule's characters and the control's label change
experience_progression: Arrival: the headline assembles itself into final position while the capsule appears holding its unreadable symbol run; the ambient field begins its ongoing surfacing and dissolving
Rest in encoded state: unreadable symbols held steady, control offering the reveal action
Decoding transition: characters churn rapidly through random letters, then lock in position by position until the full sentence is readable
Rest in readable state: plain sentence held steady, control offering the opposite action
Encoding transition: the readable sentence churns back into the symbol run, returning to the encoded rest state
Decode and encode transitions can be repeated without limit; the encoded state is a real destination the visitor can return to, not a one-time opening trick
attention_and_information_flow: Arrival motion of the headline directs the eye downward to the capsule, which holds attention through its strong luminance and contrast separation from the recessive field
The unreadable symbol run reads as withheld information, creating the expectation that something is concealed
The ambient fragments stay deliberately below the threshold of reading effort — they suggest surrounding chatter and never compete with the capsule
During the transition, motion in the capsule is the only strong movement in the foreground, so the churn itself carries attention
Information is revealed progressively: the sentence becomes partly guessable as positions lock, and fully explicit at the end
The control's label carries the only instructional information and updates to always describe the next available action

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Runs once per arrival; the resulting encoded state is stable and waits indefinitely for input
interaction_model.state_change: From absent/unassembled to composed opening state in the encoded condition
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Headline parts move into their final places, the illuminated capsule presents its symbol run, faint phrase fragments begin appearing and dissolving in the recessive field
interaction_model.input: Section first becoming visible
interaction_model.affected_object: Headline, capsule, ambient field

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Fully reversible by pressing again; interruptible mid-transition
interaction_model.state_change: Encoded → decoding → readable
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Characters cycle rapidly through random letters, then settle one position at a time into the readable sentence; the label flips to offer the reverse action
interaction_model.input: Press of the small round control at the capsule's right edge while encoded
interaction_model.affected_object: Capsule character line and control label

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Restores the original opening state exactly; repeatable without degradation
interaction_model.state_change: Readable → encoding → encoded
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The sentence churns back into the unreadable symbol run; the label returns to its original wording
interaction_model.input: Press of the same control while readable
interaction_model.affected_object: Capsule character line and control label

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Latest request always wins; every settle ends in one of the two clean rest states and the label matches that state
interaction_model.state_change: Current transition redirects toward the most recently requested state instead of queueing
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The churn continues without stalling and resolves into whichever state was last asked for; no half-garbled leftover mixture of symbols and letters remains at rest
interaction_model.input: Repeated or rapid presses, including during an in-flight transition
interaction_model.affected_object: Capsule character line and control label

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Autonomous and endless; unaffected by the capsule's state and requiring no user action
interaction_model.state_change: Individual fragments fade in at unpredictable positions and dissolve away, continuously
interaction_model.visible_feedback: A quietly alive recessive field with faint short sayings surfacing and disappearing at irregular places and intervals
interaction_model.input: Ongoing passage of time while the section is visible
interaction_model.affected_object: Ambient phrase fragments in the recessive field

experience_qualities: Secretive and conspiratorial — writing that looks deliberately concealed
Quietly alive rather than busy; the surround feels populated but calm
Mechanical precision in the settling of characters, position by position
Rewarding: the payoff is a plainly readable human sentence emerging out of churn
Replayable and reversible — the concealed state is worth returning to
Visually stable; nothing around the focal element jumps or reflows
completion_and_return: Each transition completes at one of exactly two clean rest states: unreadable symbol run or plainly readable sentence
No terminal end state — the experience is an indefinite two-way toggle, not a one-shot reveal
The encoded state is fully restorable at any time and is identical to the state presented on arrival
The ambient field loops continuously and never resolves
The control label always reflects the current rest state, so the section is never left in an ambiguous condition
locked_observable_requirements: A single strongly illuminated focal capsule set against a markedly lower-emphasis field, holding one line of text as the section's most prominent element
An unreadable symbol run as the initial and returnable state of that text
Character-level churn through random letters that settles position by position into a plainly readable sentence
Two-way toggling driven by one small control attached at the capsule's edge, whose label flips to name the opposite action
Fixed capsule size across all states so surrounding content never shifts
The latest press always wins: mid-transition input redirects rather than queueing, and no half-garbled state is ever left at rest
Headline that assembles itself into place on arrival and frames the idea of hidden, encoded writing
A recessive surrounding field with faint short-phrase fragments surfacing and dissolving at unpredictable positions and times
adaptable_details: Exact wording of the headline, revealed sentence and control label
Choice of symbol set used for the encoded run and of characters cycled during the churn
Churn speed, settle rhythm and per-position timing
Accent hue, luminance direction and shape treatment of the capsule and its round control
Number, density, opacity and lifespan of the ambient phrase fragments
How the headline is subdivided for its assembly motion and the direction that motion takes
Overall section height and how the headline and capsule stack at narrow widths
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits any opening section built around one short, self-contained line of text whose meaning benefits from being withheld and then disclosed — a tagline, motto, promise or single-sentence claim — with sparse surrounding copy and a restrained, low-distraction surround that lets one element read as illuminated in either a light or a dark treatment. Requires the revealed text to stay short enough to hold a fixed-size single-line capsule. Making the reveal automatic and one-way, spreading it across long or multi-line body content, or removing the fixed-size focal capsule so surrounding layout reflows would each produce a different Skill.

name: depth_lit_photo_title_card
description: A still photo title card that leans toward the pointer with near surfaces moving more than far ones while a high-salience brightness pulse repeatedly travels from foreground to background, under a headline that arrives word by word above its caption.

canonical_document.name: depth_lit_photo_title_card
canonical_document.description: A still photo title card that leans toward the pointer with near surfaces moving more than far ones while a high-salience brightness pulse repeatedly travels from foreground to background, under a headline that arrives word by word above its caption.
canonical_document.experience_scope: A single framed region, typically occupying the whole first view: begins with a plain cover over everything until the picture is ready and continues indefinitely afterwards; it has no end state, no dismissal and no hand-off step.
content_and_composition: One photographic frame as the base surface, read as having distinguishable near and distant structure
One short headline as primary overlaid text, held at readable contrast against the frame beneath it, composed of several separately arriving words
One supporting caption line directly beneath the headline, always shown as a single line
A travelling brightness pass moving through the image's apparent depth, layered on the photo and beneath the text
A plain, low-distraction full-cover holding surface present only before the picture is ready
Text overlay is visually on top but never intercepts pointer movement at any point on the frame
experience_progression: Plain cover hides the entire frame while the picture is not yet ready
Cover clears to reveal the photo
Headline words arrive one after another above the already-placed supporting line
Ambient state: the brightness pulse traverses depth from near to far, returns and repeats without limit
Pointer-driven leaning is available throughout the ambient state and does not interrupt the pulse
attention_and_information_flow: Attention starts on the words as they accumulate, since they are the only changing element at reveal
Once the headline is complete, the repeating pulse pulls attention outward into the image, lighting near surfaces first and distant ones last so spatial layering becomes readable
Pointer leaning makes the near/far separation explicit, shifting interest from the message to the structure of the scene
No new information is disclosed at any stage; prominence shifts between text and image, and text remains continuously legible

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Fully reversible by moving the pointer; bringing it back toward the centre settles the frame to its resting alignment
interaction_model.state_change: The scene leans toward the pointer direction, with foreground displacement noticeably larger than distant displacement
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Continuous lean that follows the pointer position with no perceptible lag and no drifting offset
interaction_model.input: Pointer moved across the frame
interaction_model.affected_object: The photographic frame's apparent depth layers

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Resumes tracking immediately on the next pointer movement; re-entering the frame continues from the frozen lean without a jump
interaction_model.state_change: Lean freezes at its current value rather than springing back or continuing to move
interaction_model.visible_feedback: A held, motionless lean while the travelling pulse keeps running unchanged
interaction_model.input: Pointer held still, or moved off the frame entirely
interaction_model.affected_object: Current lean state

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Unaffected by pointer presence, stillness or exit; nothing can pause, complete or dismiss it
interaction_model.state_change: Pulse advances from near surfaces to distant ones, completes its pass, returns and repeats
interaction_model.visible_feedback: A clearly separated travelling highlight that reveals near surfaces first and distant ones last, looping indefinitely
interaction_model.input: Autonomous ambient driver
interaction_model.affected_object: Brightness pass across the image's depth

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Occurs once per arrival; not repeatable or skippable, and never re-triggered by pointer activity
interaction_model.state_change: Cover clears and the headline transitions from absent to assembled word by word
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Plain surface gives way to the photo, then words appear in sequence above the supporting line
interaction_model.input: Picture becomes ready
interaction_model.affected_object: Plain cover, headline and caption

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: No special case; tracking continuity is preserved across the entire frame
interaction_model.state_change: None; text areas behave identically to bare image areas
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Uninterrupted lean across the whole frame with no dead zones behind the text
interaction_model.input: Pointer moved over the overlaid words
interaction_model.affected_object: Lean tracking

experience_qualities: Quietly alive rather than busy or demanding
Spatially convincing: a still frame reads as real depth
Precise and responsive, with pointer-locked motion that feels physically attached
Calm and endless, with nothing to finish or close
Composed and legible, with sparse text holding its place over ambient motion
completion_and_return: No completion state and nothing to dismiss
The brightness pass loops continuously for as long as the frame is visible
Lean persists as a frozen value when input stops and is not auto-reset
Centring the pointer is the only route back to resting alignment
The entrance sequence does not repeat after it has played
locked_observable_requirements: Foreground surfaces displace noticeably more than distant surfaces under pointer movement
Lean tracks the pointer continuously with no perceptible lag and no accumulating drift
Centre pointer position corresponds to the resting alignment
Stillness or leaving the frame freezes the lean instead of recentring it
The travelling pulse lights near surfaces first and distant ones last, then returns and repeats without user action
The pulse continues undisturbed regardless of pointer state
Overlaid text never blocks pointer movement anywhere on the frame
Headline words arrive sequentially above an already-present single supporting line, only after the frame is revealed
Text stays at readable contrast against both the ambient pulse and any lean position
adaptable_details: Photo subject, colour treatment and aspect ratio
Headline and caption wording and length of the word sequence
Typography, text alignment and placement within the frame
Pulse intensity, hue, width, speed and repeat interval, provided it stays clearly separated from the underlying frame
Maximum lean magnitude and the near/far displacement ratio, as long as near clearly exceeds far
Word arrival cadence and reveal styling
Tone and treatment of the plain pre-reveal cover, light or dark
Number of resolvable depth strata in the image
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits one still photograph with legible near-to-far structure carrying a short headline and single supporting line as a title or feature stage. Replacing the single frame with a sequence, gallery or video, driving the depth motion by scroll or time instead of pointer position, removing the depth-differentiated displacement so the whole frame moves uniformly, or dropping the repeating near-to-far light pass would each produce a different Skill.

name: endless_receding_funnel_vortex
description: A full-screen field of one uniform low-distraction tone whose edges dissolve into that surround around a centred funnel that appears to recede forever toward one collapsing point, with a slow inward pull, faint specks rising out of the throat, a single accent glow sliding across the scene and a faint old-monitor texture.

canonical_document.name: endless_receding_funnel_vortex
canonical_document.description: A full-screen field of one uniform low-distraction tone whose edges dissolve into that surround around a centred funnel that appears to recede forever toward one collapsing point, with a slow inward pull, faint specks rising out of the throat, a single accent glow sliding across the scene and a faint old-monitor texture.
canonical_document.experience_scope: Whole-view experience occupying the entire viewport as a visual substrate; it begins as soon as the view exists and never ends, having no entry trigger, no completion and no bounded episode. It can also be scoped to a full-bleed region such as a hero band while keeping the same centred composition.
content_and_composition: Single dominant visual subject: one centred funnel or tunnel form receding toward a single point of collapse at the middle of the view
One vanishing focal point at the deepest end of the funnel, treated as the highest-salience, most concentrated locus of the composition relative to the surrounding field

Overall value key is one uniform low-distraction surround tone held well away from the focal point's luminance; the frame edges fade into that surround so no hard boundary or rectangle silhouette is visible
Sparse secondary layer of faint small specks emerging from the funnel throat and drifting outward/upward across the field
One soft accent glow layer, clearly distinct from the surround tone, that slides continuously down over the whole scene, tinting it unevenly over time
A subtle uniform grain or scanline-like texture overlaid across the full field, reading as an old monitor
Composition is centred and symmetrical enough that foreground content placed over it (text, headings, controls) remains readable against the quiet, low-activity edges
No labels, captions, controls, indicators or interface affordances belong to the visual
attention_and_information_flow: Muted, dissolving edges suppress peripheral prominence and funnel attention to the centre
The receding funnel and its collapsing point hold primary visual weight at all times
Rising specks and the sliding accent glow provide low-level change that keeps the field alive without ever becoming the focus
No new information is revealed over time; prominence distribution stays stable so a reader can stare into it or ignore it while reading foreground content
Foreground content, when present, outranks the backdrop; the visual never competes for or steals attention

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Cannot be started, paused, stopped, reset or broken by the visitor; there is nothing to interrupt and therefore nothing to recover from
interaction_model.state_change: Perpetual inward advance toward the collapsing point, outward drift of specks and downward slide of the accent glow
interaction_model.visible_feedback: A slow, steady, hypnotic pull inward, faint specks continually rising out of the throat and the accent tint gradually shifting across the scene
interaction_model.input: Autonomous continuous time-driven motion, requiring no user input of any kind
interaction_model.affected_object: Funnel depth field, rising specks and accent glow layer

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: No controls exist and none need to be learned; ignoring the visual is a fully supported way to experience it
interaction_model.state_change: None; the visual is fully independent of pointer, scroll and click state
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Identical behaviour whether the visitor engages with the page or not, with no hover or scroll-linked reaction to discover
interaction_model.input: Absence of interaction — no clicking, pointing, hovering or scrolling
interaction_model.affected_object: Whole visual field

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Repeated or continuous resizing remains safe; the visual re-fits each time without accumulating error, losing centring or reinitialising
interaction_model.state_change: The composition refits to the new proportions while ongoing motion continues from its current phase
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The funnel stays centred, correctly scaled and sharp at any aspect ratio; inward drift and rising specks carry on with no visible jump, flash or restart
interaction_model.input: Viewport change: window resize or device rotation to a new aspect ratio
interaction_model.affected_object: Funnel geometry, centring and scale, plus speck and glow layers

experience_qualities: Moody, cosmic and held within a narrow, restrained luminance range
Slow, steady and hypnotic rather than energetic
Endless and unresolved — nothing arrives, lands or concludes
Self-sustaining and calm, comfortable to look at or ignore for long periods
Quietly textured and slightly analogue, like an old monitor
Deep and spatially immersive despite minimal content
completion_and_return: No completion state, no final frame and no terminal event
Runs as a seamless continuous loop with no perceptible seam, restart or cycle boundary
No persisted progress or state to return to; the visual is always in the same steady ambient condition when the view is revisited
Viewport changes are absorbed as continuous adjustments rather than as resets
locked_observable_requirements: Fills the whole viewport (or full-bleed region) with one uniform low-distraction surround tone into which the edges dissolve, leaving no visible frame or silhouette
One centred funnel form that reads as receding endlessly toward a single collapsing point
Perceptible slow, steady inward pull that never arrives or concludes
Faint specks continually rising out of the funnel throat
A soft accent glow, clearly distinct from the surround tone, that continuously slides down over the scene
A faint old-monitor-like texture across the field
Fully autonomous: no start, stop, pause or break available to the visitor and no input required to see it
Remains centred, correctly scaled and sharp at any aspect ratio, with motion continuing across resize or rotation without jump or restart
Stays quiet enough that foreground reading content remains comfortably legible over it
adaptable_details: Exact hue, saturation and travel direction of the accent glow
Speed of the inward pull within a slow, hypnotic range
Density, size and drift path of the specks
Strength and character of the monitor-like texture
Precise funnel profile, wall detail and apparent depth
Whether it spans the entire page or one full-bleed section
Absolute luminance key of the field and its contrast ceiling, tuned to the legibility needs of overlaid content
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits any mood-led page that needs an unattended atmospheric ground behind reading content, sparse hero copy or navigation, in any subject area and at any host luminance key, since the visual carries no domain meaning and only needs a uniform low-distraction surround it can dissolve into. It stops being this Skill if the funnel loses its single collapsing focal point or endless recession, if the surround loses its uniform low-distraction character or the luminance separation collapses so the edge dissolve breaks, if motion gains a beginning, ending or narrative arc, or if the visual becomes pointer-, scroll- or click-driven or gains visitor controls — those become a different, interaction-led experience.

name: glass_ring_refracted_phrase
description: A short phrase floats in an empty, low-distraction field behind a single glowing glass ring; only the part crossing the glass is bent and split into separated hues, and slow drift lets the reader assemble the phrase over time while the whole form tilts gently toward the pointer.

canonical_document.name: glass_ring_refracted_phrase
canonical_document.description: A short phrase floats in an empty, low-distraction field behind a single glowing glass ring; only the part crossing the glass is bent and split into separated hues, and slow drift lets the reader assemble the phrase over time while the whole form tilts gently toward the pointer.
canonical_document.experience_scope: A whole-view experience that fills a single calm page or a self-contained full-width region: it begins as soon as the view is present and never ends, having no completion point, and it occupies the entire frame with the ring and phrase at the centre.
content_and_composition: Exactly one short phrase of a few words as the sole foreground text content, positioned at the optical centre of the view.
Exactly one luminous closed glass form (a ring) centred over the phrase, reading as a separate transparent layer in front of the lettering.
An essentially empty surrounding field that sits at a clearly separated luminance from the glass form, with no competing content, decoration, controls or navigation in the frame.
Layer relationship: background field behind, lettering in the middle, glass form in front; the glass and the lettering behave as one coupled arrangement when they tilt.
Persistent elements: the glow of the glass form, the quiet emptiness and steady luminance separation of the surround, and the centred framing of the pair remain constant throughout.
experience_progression: Continuous, unending drift rather than discrete steps: the letters move slowly in and out of the glass region.
At any instant only part of the wording is legible, so the phrase is understood cumulatively as different segments pass behind the glass.
Legibility cycles: clear where outside the glass, bent and hue-split where inside, repeatedly exchanging which fragment is distorted.
The scene always returns to the same calm resting motion, so lingering deepens comprehension without ever reaching an end state.
attention_and_information_flow: Attention lands immediately on the single luminous centred form because the surround is empty and held at a markedly different luminance.
Prominence then oscillates between the glass material and the wording: the distorted segment attracts the eye while the undistorted segment carries meaning.
Information is deliberately rationed — the full phrase is never fully plain at once — so the revealed meaning accumulates with dwell time.
Pointer movement adds a second, softer channel of attention: the tracking tilt confirms the scene is alive without pulling focus away from the wording.

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Tilt is clamped small: it never turns far enough to hide the phrase or flip the arrangement, and direction changes are absorbed smoothly at any moment
interaction_model.state_change: Orientation eases toward the direction of the input within a small bounded range, instead of snapping
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The bending and hue-splitting of the letters visibly shifts as the arrangement leans, so the refraction appears to track the hand
interaction_model.input: Cursor or finger moving across the view
interaction_model.affected_object: The coupled glass form and surrounding lettering

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: The drift is uninterruptible and continues underneath any pointer-driven tilt, resuming visibly as the sole motion once input stops
interaction_model.state_change: Different segments of the wording pass behind and out from behind the glass
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Letters travel in and out of clarity, alternately sharp and refracted with separated-hue fringing
interaction_model.input: Autonomous slow continuous drift (no user action required)
interaction_model.affected_object: The phrase's position relative to the glass form

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Nothing to reset or dismiss; new input can take over mid-relaxation and be picked up continuously
interaction_model.state_change: Tilt relaxes back to its neutral centred framing
interaction_model.visible_feedback: A smooth eased settle with no jump or snap back to the resting composition
interaction_model.input: Input stopping or leaving the view
interaction_model.affected_object: The tilt of the glass-and-lettering arrangement

experience_qualities: Quiet, unhurried and contemplative
Luminous and material — the glass reads as a physical substance over the words
Partially withheld legibility that rewards patience
Responsive but restrained, always easing and never snapping
Effortless: nothing to learn, achieve or finish
completion_and_return: No completion state and no success or end condition.
The drift loops indefinitely and always presents the same calm resting motion.
Tilt state is transient and self-clearing: absence of input returns the scene to neutral framing.
No persistent state is carried, so the experience looks identical whenever it is revisited.
locked_observable_requirements: A plain, near-empty surround with a single luminous centred form as the only focal object, separated from the surround by enough luminance difference that the form reads as self-illuminated.
Exactly one short phrase, presented behind a transparent glass form so that only the crossing portion is distorted.
Visible refraction that splits the letters into separated hues where they pass through the glass.
Slow continuous drift that makes segments of the phrase move between clear and distorted, so the wording is assembled gradually.
Pointer or touch position drives a small, bounded, eased tilt of the glass and lettering together, with the refraction visibly tracking the input direction.
The tilt never becomes large enough to conceal the phrase or invert the arrangement.
Smooth eased relaxation to the neutral framing when input stops, with no jump and nothing for the user to reset.
adaptable_details: The exact wording and length of the short phrase.
The closed glass silhouette (ring or other simple closed transparent shape) and its thickness.
Glow hue, the particular spread of fringing hues, and whether the surrounding field sits below or above the form in luminance and by how much.
Drift path, speed and the letterform styling.
Tilt magnitude, easing timing and how quickly it relaxes.
Overall scale of the arrangement relative to the frame.
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits any context where a few words are the entire foreground and partial illegibility is acceptable — a statement landing view, a quote moment, a title or motto showcase. It breaks with paragraphs, lists, dense information, multiple competing text blocks, or wording that must stay fully readable at all times. Turning the glass into a lens dragged over scrolling page content, making the form clickable or navigable, or adding discrete stages, targets or completion would create a different Skill.

name: trembling_sketchbook_scribble_surface
description: A full-screen hand-sketched page that never sits still: a soft drawing-tip ring trails the pointer and swells with speed, holding and dragging draws a continuous scribble that soon erases itself from its oldest end, and a large central hand-drawn shape re-forms while hovered.

canonical_document.name: trembling_sketchbook_scribble_surface
canonical_document.description: A full-screen hand-sketched page that never sits still: a soft drawing-tip ring trails the pointer and swells with speed, holding and dragging draws a continuous scribble that soon erases itself from its oldest end, and a large central hand-drawn shape re-forms while hovered.
canonical_document.experience_scope: Whole-view experience. It begins the moment the view appears in its calm resting composition and never formally ends: it continuously trembles, accepts marks, and empties itself back to the resting composition, remaining available for the entire time the view is on screen.
content_and_composition: One large hand-drawn shape occupying the middle of the view as the dominant visual anchor
One bold hand-lettered wordmark placed low on the screen
One short supporting note adjacent to the wordmark, low on the screen
One brief single-line invitation making the draw-here prompt obvious immediately
A soft ring following the pointer, reading as a drawing tip, rendered in the same hand-sketched language as everything else
Zero or more freehand stroke lines drawn on the same surface layer, coexisting above or alongside the central shape

All elements share one flat sketch surface, with marks, shape and lettering separated from that surround clearly enough to stay legible; text sits low, the shape sits central, and marks are made across the whole field
Persistent elements: the sketch surface, the central shape, the wordmark, the note and the invitation line
experience_progression: Arrival: the resting composition is already trembling, with the shape, wordmark, note and invitation line legible and no marks present
Idle: the pointer ring follows movement with a slight lag, swelling as travel speeds up and easing back down as it slows
Marking: a press-and-hold drag grows a continuous line along the travelled path while the ring stays attached to its leading tip
Release: the line stops growing and briefly holds attention as a finished mark
Decay: shortly after, the line eats itself away from its oldest end until nothing remains
Return: with all marks gone the view is back to its calm resting composition, endlessly ready for another attempt
Continuous, independent of the above: every contour keeps being re-drawn at a deliberately low, choppy handmade rhythm so nothing ever looks still
attention_and_information_flow: At rest, attention is split between the large central shape and the low-placed wordmark, note and invitation line
The invitation line front-loads the one thing to try, so no discovery is required
Once drawing starts, the freshest mark and the swelling ring take prominence over the standing composition
As a mark decays, prominence drains back toward the resting composition rather than shifting to any new element
Hovering the central shape momentarily concentrates attention there through its re-forming and the ballooning ring
No new textual information is revealed at any stage; changes are purely visual and behavioural

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Purely responsive; stopping movement returns the ring to its resting size, and leaving and re-entering the surface resumes tracking without residue
interaction_model.state_change: Ring position trails the true pointer with a slight lag; ring size scales up with travel speed and relaxes back down as speed drops
interaction_model.visible_feedback: A soft drawing-tip ring gliding slightly behind the pointer, breathing larger during fast sweeps and settling small when movement stops
interaction_model.input: Pointer movement across the surface without pressing
interaction_model.affected_object: Pointer ring

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Releasing stops growth immediately; the mark is never permanent, so no undo affordance is needed or offered
interaction_model.state_change: A fresh line is created at the press point and continuously extends along the travelled path for as long as the press is held
interaction_model.visible_feedback: A hand-drawn line growing behind the ring, tracing exactly where the pointer went
interaction_model.input: Press and hold while moving the pointer
interaction_model.affected_object: A newly started freehand stroke line

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Self-clearing by design; the surface always recovers to its resting composition without user action, and new presses can be made while older marks are still decaying
interaction_model.state_change: Line stops growing, holds briefly, then begins erasing progressively from its oldest end until fully gone
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The finished scribble lingers a moment, then unwinds from its starting end as if being rubbed out, shortening until the surface is clean
interaction_model.input: Releasing the press
interaction_model.affected_object: The just-completed stroke line

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Lines never merge or interfere; each disappears independently, bounding total clutter over time
interaction_model.state_change: Each press starts an independent line; several lines coexist and decay on their own schedules
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Several scribbles on the page at once, at different stages of growth and erasure
interaction_model.input: Repeated separate presses
interaction_model.affected_object: Multiple stroke lines

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Prevents unbounded accumulation during long drags; releasing hands the remainder over to normal decay
interaction_model.state_change: Line length is bounded: while the leading end keeps growing, the trailing end keeps trimming away
interaction_model.visible_feedback: A snake-like line of roughly constant length chasing the pointer, its tail continuously vanishing
interaction_model.input: One very long uninterrupted drag
interaction_model.affected_object: The single active stroke line

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: On leaving the shape, both the arrangement and the ring settle back toward their resting states; entering and leaving repeatedly is always reversible
interaction_model.state_change: Shape re-forms into a different arrangement while the ring expands well beyond its speed-driven size
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The central form visibly rearranges itself and the ring balloons around it, signalling the shape as reactive
interaction_model.input: Pointer moving over the large central shape
interaction_model.affected_object: Central shape and pointer ring

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Always running; independent of pointer activity and unaffected by marking or decay
interaction_model.state_change: Outlines are continually re-drawn with small positional jitter at a deliberately low, choppy cadence
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Constant trembling of all edges, as if the whole page were being sketched again and again by hand
interaction_model.input: Autonomous handmade redraw rhythm
interaction_model.affected_object: Every contour in the view, including text, shape, marks and ring

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Refit applies at any moment, including mid-drag, and the experience remains usable afterwards
interaction_model.state_change: Surface refits to the new viewport dimensions
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The sketch surface, central shape and low-placed text re-settle to the new frame and continue trembling
interaction_model.input: Window resize
interaction_model.affected_object: The whole sketch surface and its composition

experience_qualities: Playful and informal, closer to doodling than to a tool
Handmade and imperfect, with visible jitter and a choppy, non-smooth cadence
Consequence-free: marks are temporary, so experimentation carries no risk
Responsive and tactile through the lagging, speed-swelling ring
Calm at rest, with a composition that always returns to the same quiet state
Endlessly repeatable rather than goal-directed
completion_and_return: There is no completion state; the experience loops indefinitely
Every mark self-terminates by erasing from its oldest end, so the surface returns to the resting composition automatically
Nothing the visitor draws is retained, saved or carried forward
Hover-driven changes to the central shape and ring settle back rather than persisting
Standing elements (surface, central shape, wordmark, note, invitation) persist unchanged throughout
locked_observable_requirements: Nothing in the view is ever visually still: all contours are continuously re-drawn with jitter at a deliberately choppy, low-rate handmade cadence
A soft ring pointer that lags behind the true pointer and scales up with travel speed, easing back down as speed falls
Press-and-hold-plus-move draws a continuous line along the travelled path; release stops growth
Marks are ephemeral and self-erasing from their oldest end, with no undo or clear affordance anywhere
Multiple independently started and independently decaying marks may coexist
A single long uninterrupted drag is length-bounded by trimming its own tail while its head grows
A large central shape that re-forms into a different arrangement on pointer-over and settles back on leave, with the ring ballooning during that state
Bold hand-lettered wordmark and a short note placed low in the view, plus one brief line that makes the invitation to draw obvious on arrival
The surface always empties itself back to the same calm resting composition
adaptable_details: Identity and arrangement variants of the central shape
Wordmark, note and invitation wording
Surface and mark tones in any direction, as long as marks, shape and lettering stay plainly readable against their surround; surface texture and stroke weight
Hold time before decay begins, decay speed and maximum bounded stroke length
Ring resting size, swell range and lag amount
Exact jitter magnitude and redraw cadence, as long as it still reads as choppy and handmade
How the composition reflows across viewport sizes
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits text-sparse introduction and statement views where a short wordmark, a brief note and a one-line prompt are the only reading material and the surface itself is the main attraction; it suits playful, personal or craft-leaning tones, and it adopts whatever surface and mark tones the host uses so long as marks stay legible against the surround. It does not fit dense reading, form-filling or data views, since constant trembling and drawable space compete with content. Making marks permanent, saveable, shareable or editable, or adding brushes, selectable mark hues, layers and precision controls, turns it into a drawing tool and a different Skill; likewise, removing the ephemeral self-erasing behaviour or the continuous hand-redraw tremble breaks its identity.

name: cursor_bent_drifting_particle_current
description: A screen-filling mass of drifting particles that reads first as one broad current and then as smaller inner swirls, bending toward the pointer into thicker local streams that fade back into the untouched drift.

canonical_document.name: cursor_bent_drifting_particle_current
canonical_document.description: A screen-filling mass of drifting particles that reads first as one broad current and then as smaller inner swirls, bending toward the pointer into thicker local streams that fade back into the untouched drift.
canonical_document.experience_scope: Whole-view experience that is already in motion at arrival and never terminates; it fills the entire viewport edge to edge with no visible field boundary, no entry sequence and no end state. Deployable as a full-view region or as a full-bleed section band.
content_and_composition: One primary content role: a single dense particle mass treated as one coherent flowing body rather than a set of separate objects
Two simultaneous readings within the same mass: the broad overall drifting shape at large scale, and smaller swirls and denser streams at small scale
Density variation is a first-class visual element: streams appear thicker or thinner rather than the field being uniform
The mass extends past all view edges so no beginning, end or container is visible
One transient local role: a pointer-influenced zone and the thickened trail along its recent path, layered inside the same mass rather than drawn on top of it
No labels, instructions, controls, progress indicators or captions; any accompanying foreground copy is minimal and sits above the mass
experience_progression: Continuous advance with no staged sequence and no completion: the field is mid-flow on arrival and keeps flowing indefinitely
Attention progression rather than state progression: whole-mass shape first, then inner swirls and streams
Local, repeatable disturbance cycles: pointer influence builds, deepens with continued movement, then dissipates back toward the undisturbed drift
attention_and_information_flow: First read is the macro silhouette and overall drift direction of the entire mass
Attention then descends into interior detail: swirls, eddies and denser streams inside the mass
Pointer presence temporarily promotes its local neighborhood to the most prominent area because streams there are denser and more curved
Prominence returns to the whole-mass reading as the disturbance fades; no new information is ever revealed, only redistributed emphasis
Coherence is equal for a two-second glance and a multi-minute stare; nothing is withheld for viewers who wait

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Influence stays local and softly bounded so it never propagates across the whole field; the user can leave at any moment and the disturbance resolves itself
interaction_model.state_change: Nearby particle motion bends toward the pointer, local density rises and stream curvature increases along the traversed path, while the rest of the mass continues its independent drift
interaction_model.visible_feedback: A visibly thickened, swirling stream follows the pointer's route; the surrounding field looks untouched
interaction_model.input: Pointer moving across the field
interaction_model.affected_object: Particles within a bounded neighborhood of the pointer, and the swath along its recent path

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Response is amplitude-limited so repeated aggressive input has diminishing visible escalation; stopping input is always sufficient recovery
interaction_model.state_change: Accumulated influence deepens the swirl and concentrates streams further instead of exceeding a breaking point
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Richer, more tangled swirling in the worked area; the field never shatters, blanks, snaps or shows overload artifacts
interaction_model.input: Fast, erratic or repeated sweeps over the same area
interaction_model.affected_object: The local swirl and stream density in that area

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Self-recovering with no user action; re-entering mid-decay resumes the pull continuously from the current state
interaction_model.state_change: Local influence decays and the disturbed particles rejoin the ambient drift
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The thickened swirl loosens and fades smoothly, easing back into the untouched flow with no visible cut, snap or reset moment
interaction_model.input: Pointer stops, leaves the field or is absent
interaction_model.affected_object: The previously disturbed neighborhood and trail

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Runs unattended and is unaffected by whether anyone has interacted; interaction only modulates it locally
interaction_model.state_change: Perpetual, non-repeating flow that never settles into a static or finished arrangement
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Ongoing slow large-scale movement with continuously reforming inner swirls and streams
interaction_model.input: Autonomous drift of the field itself
interaction_model.affected_object: The entire particle mass

experience_qualities: Calm and unhurried, with slow large-scale movement
Immediately immersive: full-view and already alive at arrival, requiring no waiting or instruction
Reads as one living current rather than many independent dots
Endlessly watchable and never resolving
Tactile and responsive in a gentle way: the field yields rather than reacts sharply
Robust and unbreakable under aggressive input
Self-settling, so the untouched state is always the resting state
completion_and_return: No completion state and no finished arrangement; the experience loops only in the sense of continuing indefinitely
Each interaction resolves by dissipation back into ambient drift rather than by an explicit reset
No persistent record of past interaction: prior pointer paths leave no lasting mark once decayed
Leaving and returning attention costs nothing, since the field is equally coherent at any moment of entry
locked_observable_requirements: The particle mass occupies the entire view at once with no visible edge, container, entry animation or instruction
Motion is already underway at arrival and never reaches a static or completed state
The mass must read simultaneously as one coherent drifting whole and as internally varied swirls and denser streams
Pointer influence bends nearby particles toward the pointer and visibly thickens streams along its path
Influence remains spatially local and amplitude-bounded; the untouched remainder of the field keeps drifting undisturbed
Fast, erratic or repeated input deepens the local swirl rather than destabilizing, blanking or fragmenting the field
When input stops or leaves, the disturbance dissipates on its own and the flow eases smoothly back into its undisturbed drift with no snap or reset
Overall pacing stays calm and watchable rather than energetic or event-driven
adaptable_details: Color treatment, amount of contrast, and which direction the luminance separation runs, whether the mass sits brighter than its surround or darker than it
Particle count, individual particle size and rendering style (points, streaks, soft glows)
Overall drift direction, speed and macro silhouette of the mass
Radius and strength profile of the pointer influence, and how quickly the disturbance decays
Trail persistence length along the pointer path
Whether the field is presented alone or as a substrate behind a short headline
Viewport aspect ratio and section height
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits any context wanting a full-frame calm ambient visual with no informational payload, whether standalone, as an opening view, an idle screen, or a quiet substrate under sparse copy; it tolerates any color treatment, separation direction, density or drift character. It stops being this Skill if the field is bounded into a small discrete widget, if particles become individually meaningful or data-bound items to read or select, if pointer influence produces global rather than local change, if the disturbance requires an explicit reset or leaves permanent marks, if the motion resolves into a final composition or logo, or if progress, scroll position or staged narration drives the flow.

canonical_document.name: glowing_ripple_field_with_tap_recolor
canonical_document.description: A depth-rich field of soft glowing forms rippling slowly under two tinted light sources behind a crisp headline; tapping anywhere repaints the entire scene into a different colour atmosphere while the motion continues unbroken. canonical_document.experience_scope: Whole-view experience: the backdrop occupies the entire visible screen from arrival and persists for as long as the view is open, with no start or end state; the foreground heading layer sits on top of it and the tap surface covers the full screen.

interaction_model.affected_object: Foreground heading

experience_qualities: Alive on arrival rather than waking up
Layered and softly luminous rather than flat, at whatever overall lightness the current state uses
Slow, calm and loiter-friendly rather than urgent
Playful and chromatically varied without overwhelming the headline
Discoverable within moments that the whole mood can be traded

Motion never restarts, stalls or visibly stutters, including at the moment of a colour change

Dense text, scrolling content, forms or interactive foreground elements would conflict with a full-screen tap target and with constant background motion. Replacing the anywhere-tap mood trade with a visible colour control, tying the colour change to scroll or pointer position, fixing the scene to one colour set or one overall lightness, or making the backdrop depict recognizable subject matter rather than abstract glowing forms would each create a different Skill.

canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits a first-screen opening or any full-view region whose message is one short headline plus atmospheric imagery, where the following content is calm enough to be introduced by a fade into a uniform detail-free field. It does not fit dense regions with multiple competing text blocks, lists, controls or data that must remain readable while the scene separates, since the title's recession and the final luminance transition deliberately remove information. Replacing the single embedded title with several depth-ranked content items, driving the motion by pointer position, time or explicit controls instead of scroll, or making the separation irreversible or step-wise would each create a different Skill.

name: breathing_endless_text_spread
description: A print-like page spread that never stops moving: a still centre title trio is flanked by long text columns crawling in opposite directions, bending further sideways the harder the visitor pushes, with a slower portrait strip drifting behind the same gesture.

canonical_document.name: breathing_endless_text_spread
canonical_document.description: A print-like page spread that never stops moving: a still centre title trio is flanked by long text columns crawling in opposite directions, bending further sideways the harder the visitor pushes, with a slower portrait strip drifting behind the same gesture.
canonical_document.experience_scope: Whole-view experience filling the viewport. It begins after a brief hold in which nothing is shown, then the entire composition is present at once; it has no end state, no bottom and no exit stage, continuing for as long as the view is open.
content_and_composition: One persistent centre identity block holding three short text roles: a year or short label, the primary title, and a secondary personal name; it stays fixed and legible and never scrolls away
Two long-form text columns flanking the centre block on left and right, each an uninterrupted vertical stream of the same body write-up
The two flanking columns always travel in opposite vertical directions to one another
One portrait/image strip as a separate motion layer, sharing the same driving input but travelling at a visibly reduced rate, reading as a deeper plane
Layered depth order in which the centre block sits above all moving material, the text streams occupy the middle plane, and the imagery reads as further back or beside them

A print-like typographic and surface treatment across the whole spread — an even, low-distraction surround with body text held at comfortable reading contrast and no strong tonal breaks — so the moving text reads as a page rather than a screen widget
Whole composition arrives simultaneously; no element is staged, sequenced or assembled in front of the visitor
experience_progression: Brief blank pause, then the entire spread appears at once
Resting baseline: a slow continuous crawl with only gentle line bowing, the page appearing to breathe on its own
Excitation: sustained or forceful input builds travel speed and increases lateral bending until the text reads as turbulent
Decay: after release the motion keeps gliding and the bowing relaxes gradually back toward the calm baseline crawl
Endless loop: text recycles so fresh lines are always arriving; the cycle of calm, turbulence and return can repeat indefinitely with no finish
attention_and_information_flow: The still centre trio is the permanent anchor; identity is always readable regardless of how violent the surrounding motion becomes
Flanking prose is ambient and readable in passing; it never signals a start, a remainder or an end to finish
Opposite travel directions balance peripheral movement so neither flank dominates attention
The slower portrait layer reveals imagery gradually as it drifts, drawing attention in intervals without competing with the centre
At high input force motion and distortion dominate and prose legibility softens; as motion decays legibility returns and reading becomes possible again

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: On release the columns keep gliding in the last-driven direction and the bend eases back to the baseline crawl rather than stopping
interaction_model.state_change: Travel speed rises with input force and lateral bend magnitude rises with it; direction follows the direction driven
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Text streams faster while its lines curve further sideways, the harder the push the deeper the bow
interaction_model.input: Wheel, trackpad gesture or vertical drag
interaction_model.affected_object: The two flanking long-text columns

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Shares the same release-and-glide decay so all layers settle together without any layer stopping abruptly
interaction_model.state_change: Moves in coordinated response to the same gesture at a noticeably lower rate than the text
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Imagery drifts behind the text at a slower pace, producing a sense of depth between layers
interaction_model.input: The same wheel, trackpad or drag input
interaction_model.affected_object: The portrait/image strip layer

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Reversal is always available at any speed; there is no locked interval and no reset
interaction_model.state_change: Direction changes immediately from the current state
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The streams turn around continuously with no jump, no snap-back and no return to a start position
interaction_model.input: Direction reversal while motion is still in progress
interaction_model.affected_object: All moving layers together

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: There is no fully idle state; the resting condition is itself motion, and input can take over at any moment
interaction_model.state_change: Baseline crawl persists with minimal bending
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The page continues quietly breathing and fresh lines keep arriving even when untouched
interaction_model.input: No input (autonomous drift)
interaction_model.affected_object: The whole spread

experience_qualities: Page-like and printed in feel rather than screen-like, carried by typography, surface texture and restrained contrast rather than any particular hue
Quietly breathing, hypnotic and drift-inducing
Physically responsive: force felt in the hand is visible as speed and sideways bow
Bottomless and unfinishable, with nothing to complete
Turbulence and calm alternating, always resolving back toward calm
completion_and_return: No completion, no end of content and no bottom
Text loops endlessly so new lines always arrive
No reset to a starting position at any time
Residual motion and last-driven direction persist after release and carry into the next gesture
locked_observable_requirements: A still centre block of exactly three short text roles that never scrolls away and stays clearly separated in contrast from the moving material behind it during motion
At least two flanking long-text columns that always travel in opposite vertical directions to one another
Continuous baseline motion with no stopped state and no reachable end
Lateral bending of text lines whose magnitude scales with the force of the input
An image layer driven by the same input at a visibly slower rate
Inertial continuation in the last-driven direction after release, decaying back to the calm crawl
Immediate mid-motion reversal with no jump, snap-back or reset
The whole composition present at once after the initial pause, never progressively assembled
adaptable_details: Typeface, colour treatment and paper-like surface texture
Subject matter of the write-up and the specific wording of the three centre roles
Number, crop and orientation of portraits in the image strip
Baseline crawl speed, maximum bow curvature and decay rate
Length of the initial pause before the spread appears
Column widths and how far the flanks sit from the centre block
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits a short identity trio plus long ambient prose and portrait imagery where reading completion is unnecessary and mood is the point, in full-viewport feature, showcase or tribute views. Replacing the prose with finite, must-read, ordered or paginated content, requiring stable scroll position, end-of-content states, or precise line-level readability, or removing either the opposite-direction flanks or the slower image layer, would produce a different skill.
