name: receding_curve_tile_floor
description: A screen-filling floor of small curved tiles leaning away to a low-definition horizon, whose arcs connect across tile borders into long wandering loops; the pointer rerouted tiles as it sweeps, and clicking snaps everything into tidy orderings before returning to the original pattern.

canonical_document.name: receding_curve_tile_floor
canonical_document.description: A screen-filling floor of small curved tiles leaning away to a low-definition horizon, whose arcs connect across tile borders into long wandering loops; the pointer rerouted tiles as it sweeps, and clicking snaps everything into tidy orderings before returning to the original pattern.
canonical_document.experience_scope: Whole-view experience occupying the entire frame from the first painted moment, with no entry animation or teardown state; it persists for as long as the view is shown and has no end condition.
content_and_composition: One continuous field of many small square tiles filling the full frame edge to edge, with no visible gaps, borders or gutters between tiles
Each tile carries a simple curved mark that meets its edges at fixed points so neighbouring tiles' curves always align into continuous lines
The joined curves read as the primary content: long meandering loops and open paths crossing many tiles
The whole field is presented on a single plane tilted away from the viewer, near edge largest and closest, far edge compressed toward a horizon line

A controlled luminance transition toward the far edge that steadily reduces mark-to-surface separation, so distance dissolves into an indistinct atmospheric band while the near foreground holds full readable contrast
No foreground text, controls, labels or chrome are part of the experience; any page copy sits over it as a separate layer
experience_progression: Immediate full-coverage state: the tiled surface is already complete and in perspective when first seen, never assembling or fading in
Ambient drift: the field slowly and continuously reshuffles itself on its own so the pattern never settles
Visitor-driven divergence: pointer travel accumulates rerouted tiles, progressively tangling the paths away from any tidy state
Ordering cycle: successive clicks step through a short fixed sequence of regular arrangements and then land back on the original starting pattern, closing the loop
attention_and_information_flow: Attention lands first on the near, large tiles where curve junctions are most readable, then follows individual paths back toward the horizon
Depth and the falling contrast rank the field: the foreground is where changes are noticed, the low-separation distance reads as texture and atmosphere
Each hover draws the eye to the moment of rejoining, since a turned tile visibly re-splices the lines running through it
A sweep of the pointer leaves a readable trail of altered paths, making the visitor's own route through the surface legible
Clicking shifts attention from local detail to the global figure, because the entire field resolves into one recognizable order at once

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Re-entering the same tile turns it again; there is no per-tile undo, but any accumulated tangle is fully recoverable through the click orderings
interaction_model.state_change: The tile takes a quarter turn in a randomly chosen direction, adopting a new orientation and persisting in it
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The tile eases smoothly round rather than snapping, and as it lands its curves meet the neighbours at different edges so the paths crossing it are visibly rerouted
interaction_model.input: Pointer passes over a tile
interaction_model.affected_object: That single tile and its curve segments

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: The orderings form a short closed cycle, so repeated clicking always remains reachable calm and always returns to the initial pattern; no state is lost or unreachable
interaction_model.state_change: The whole field snaps from its current arrangement into a regular, ordered arrangement; further clicks advance through a couple more distinct orderings and then restore the original starting pattern
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The entire tilted surface resolves at once into a visibly systematic pattern, so scattered loops become an evidently repeating global figure
interaction_model.input: Click anywhere on the surface
interaction_model.affected_object: Every tile in the field simultaneously

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Drift resumes on its own once the pointer leaves the frame, with no reset of the current arrangement
interaction_model.state_change: Ambient drift pauses and holds still while the pointer is inside
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The surface becomes stable under the visitor's hand so only their own hover changes are visible
interaction_model.input: Pointer present anywhere inside the frame
interaction_model.affected_object: The field's autonomous slow shifting

experience_qualities: Continuous and seamless: unit boundaries disappear into one large figure
Spatial and atmospheric rather than decorative flatness, thanks to the lean into depth and the horizon where separation falls away
Never finished: a persistent quiet motion keeps the pattern alive without demanding attention
Tactile and consequential: every pointer move leaves a visible trace on the surface
Reassuring: order is always one click away, so experimentation carries no risk of ruining the view
Calm overall, with smooth easing rather than abrupt change on local edits
completion_and_return: There is no completion state; the experience runs indefinitely as an ambient surface
The click cycle is a closed loop that ends on the original starting pattern, making full return explicit
Tile orientations persist after each hover and after drift pauses, so the visitor's alterations remain until deliberately reset
Autonomous drift self-resumes after the pointer leaves, returning the view to its living idle behaviour
locked_observable_requirements: The unit field must fill the entire frame from the first moment, with no visible assembly, empty state or partial coverage
Unit marks must meet unit edges so they join across borders into continuous long paths; the joined lines, not the individual units, are the subject

The plane must be tilted away toward a horizon so it reads as a receding surface, not flat wallpaper, with the far region losing mark-to-surface separation through a controlled luminance transition into an indistinct horizon band
Hover must rotate exactly one unit by a quarter turn in an unpredictable direction, with smooth eased motion, and the new orientation must persist
Sweeping the pointer must leave a visible trail of rerouted paths rather than a transient highlight
Click must reorganize the entire field at once into a regular ordered arrangement, cycle through a small number of further orderings, and return to the initial pattern
Autonomous slow change must exist, must hold still while the pointer is inside the frame, and must resume when it leaves
adaptable_details: The specific curve motif on each unit and its stroke weight
Unit count, unit size and how strongly the surface is tilted
The host palette, the near-field contrast separation, and how far toward vanishing the distant luminance transition carries
Easing curve and duration of the quarter turn
Speed and rhythm of the ambient drift
The exact number and character of the ordered arrangements in the click cycle, as long as it is a small closed set ending at the start pattern
Whether the surface sits alone or as a substrate beneath sparse foreground copy
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits any view that can give up its full frame to an abstract edge-joining unit field, as an atmospheric opener or a quiet substrate under minimal text; the units must be interchangeable abstract marks with no individual meaning. It stops being this Skill if the units become meaningful items such as images, cards or data cells, if the surface is presented flat without recession into a horizon where separation falls away, if hover only highlights instead of permanently rerouting the joined paths, or if the global ordering cycle no longer guarantees a return to the starting pattern.

name: condensing_keyword_scroll_poem
description: Scrolling down a hushed page alternates readable text passages with screens holding one enormous word that condenses out of formless, illegible noise into perfect clarity, plays only once, keeps its clarity forever after, offers a plain replay button, and floats over slowly drifting atmospheric pictures until a closing word ends the run.

canonical_document.name: condensing_keyword_scroll_poem
canonical_document.description: Scrolling down a hushed page alternates readable text passages with screens holding one enormous word that condenses out of formless, illegible noise into perfect clarity, plays only once, keeps its clarity forever after, offers a plain replay button, and floats over slowly drifting atmospheric pictures until a closing word ends the run.
canonical_document.experience_scope: Whole-view experience covering the entire page, beginning at a quiet, nearly empty opening screen and ending on a terminal closing-word screen; every stage occupies a full viewport, and there is no separate region that carries the experience independently.
content_and_composition: One opening screen that is quiet and nearly empty, carrying little or no foreground text, establishing stillness before any content arrives
A repeating alternation of two full-viewport screen types: a short multi-line readable text passage, then a single-word screen
Each single-word screen holds exactly one word at screen-claiming display scale, with nothing else competing for the space
A small, plainly labelled replay control placed beside each single word, persistent and legible whenever its word is on screen

A continuous imagery layer behind all foreground text: multiple atmospheric pictures, deliberately held at much lower contrast than the foreground and clearly subordinate to it, each drifting at its own rate relative to the foreground and to one another
A final single-word screen that resolves the run of words and remains as the last thing seen
Persistent layer order throughout: subordinate imagery behind, sparse foreground text and its replay control in front
experience_progression: Near-empty opening screen: minimal stimulus, inviting the reader to settle before content begins
Steady alternation: read a text passage, then meet a single word owning a whole screen, repeated several times so reading and impact trade places rhythmically
Within each single-word screen: fully invisible word, then a one-time arrival in which formless illegible material condenses progressively into exact, crisp legibility
Cumulative effect of the alternation is gradual immersion rather than a single climax
The run resolves on the closing word, which holds as the terminal state
attention_and_information_flow: The empty opening lowers stimulus so everything that follows reads as louder by contrast
Text-passage screens invite sustained, quiet, self-paced reading with no motion competing
Single-word screens collapse attention onto one object at maximum prominence; the screen offers nothing else to look at

Legibility itself is the information gradient: the word carries no readable meaning at first and reaches full meaning only at the end of its arrival, so meaning appears to emerge from noise rather than to be placed on screen
Imagery contributes mood and depth but is held down in contrast and motion so it never draws attention from the words
Attention finally settles and stays on the closing word

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Movement can be interrupted, halted or reversed at any moment and always comes to a controlled rest; reversing direction re-shows earlier screens without disturbing what has already been revealed
interaction_model.state_change: Viewport position advances with added weight and inertia, decelerating into a resting position instead of snapping to it
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Content glides and eases to rest; motion feels heavy and deliberate rather than instantaneous
interaction_model.input: Downward or upward scrolling by wheel, trackpad, touch drag or keys
interaction_model.affected_object: The whole page of stacked full-viewport screens

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: The arrival never plays backwards and never un-does itself; scrolling back above the word leaves it crisp, and re-entering its screen does not retrigger it
interaction_model.state_change: Fully invisible, then a single one-time arrival, then permanently crisp
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The word emerges from formless, illegible material and condenses into perfect clarity, then holds still and sharp
interaction_model.input: The middle of a single word rising into the lower part of the viewport as the reader moves down
interaction_model.affected_object: That one keyword on its own screen

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Repeatable any number of times; cleanly interrupts and supersedes an arrival in progress; affects no other word and always finishes in the same crisp resting state
interaction_model.state_change: The arrival restarts from its very beginning, including when pressed while an arrival is still playing
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The word drops back to its formless illegible state and condenses into clarity again from the start
interaction_model.input: Pressing the plainly labelled replay control beside a word
interaction_model.affected_object: That word's arrival only

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Fully tied to position, so it reverses naturally with upward movement and has no state that needs resetting or recovering
interaction_model.state_change: Each picture offsets by its own amount as position changes, so the layers separate from the foreground and from each other
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Quiet drifting depth behind the words; images lag and lead one another instead of moving as one plate
interaction_model.input: Continued page movement acting as an autonomous driver for the backdrop
interaction_model.affected_object: The atmospheric imagery layers behind the text

experience_qualities: Hushed, low-stimulus and unhurried; the page feels weighted rather than responsive-snappy
Gradual sinking-in: immersion builds through repetition rather than a single spectacle
Each keyword feels monumental and earned because it owns a whole screen
A sense of meaning condensing or resolving out of noise, so clarity feels like an event
Atmospheric depth without decoration stealing focus
Reader-controlled and forgiving: nothing is missed, and any arrival can be seen again
completion_and_return: The sequence terminates on the closing word; there is no loop back to the start
Reveal states are one-way and persist for the visit, so revisiting earlier screens shows every word already crisp
The replay control is the only way to return a word to its pre-reveal state, and it always resolves back to the same crisp end state
Scrolling a word off screen never resets it, so nothing is lost by moving around the page
Backdrop drift has no completion state; it simply tracks position
locked_observable_requirements: A quiet, nearly empty opening screen precedes any content
Strict alternation between readable multi-line text screens and single-word screens
Exactly one word per single-word screen, sized to claim the whole screenful
A keyword is fully invisible until its middle rises into the lower part of the viewport, and only then arrives
The arrival is a condensation from formless, illegible material into perfect clarity, not a plain fade, slide or wipe
The arrival plays once and the word stays crisp; it never reverses or replays when moving back up
A plainly labelled replay control sits beside each word and restarts that word's arrival from the beginning at any time, including part way through one
Page movement is weighted and glides to rest rather than jumping

Backdrop imagery stays atmospheric and clearly subordinate, sitting well below the foreground text in contrast whatever colors either uses, and shifting at rates separate from the foreground and from each other
The run of words resolves on a closing word that remains as the final state
adaptable_details: Number of passage/word pairs and the wording or language used
Exact appearance of the formless pre-legible material and how the condensation resolves
Arrival duration, easing curve, and how much inertia the movement carries
Typeface, type scale, and the whole color treatment, including hue choices, light or dark tonal register, and overall color mood
Subject, number and drift rates of the backdrop pictures
Visual styling, placement offset and label wording of the replay control, as long as it remains plainly labelled and adjacent to its word
Precise trigger depth within the lower part of the viewport
Alignment and position of the single word within its screen
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits sparse, short, high-impact text where a handful of individual words deserve a full screen each and imagery is atmosphere rather than subject: poems, lyrics, manifestos, brand or campaign statements, chapter openers, memorial and editorial features. It requires low text density, a small closed set of keywords, and a definite final word. It works in any palette or tonal register as long as the foreground words hold readable contrast against the backdrop and the imagery stays well below them in contrast. It becomes a different skill if arrivals retrigger or reverse with scroll direction instead of playing once and persisting, if the reveal is scrubbed continuously by scroll position rather than played as a one-shot, if text density rises to normal article or documentation reading, if imagery becomes the foreground subject with text as caption, or if the condensation-from-noise reveal is replaced by ordinary entrance motion.

name: inward_gathering_speck_drift
description: Countless tiny confetti-like specks drift steadily inward across a uniform, low-visual-activity field, shrinking and fading out as they converge on the center, forming an endless calm current that a single click can ease to a still, composed halt and ease back into motion.

canonical_document.name: inward_gathering_speck_drift
canonical_document.description: Countless tiny confetti-like specks drift steadily inward across a uniform, low-visual-activity field, shrinking and fading out as they converge on the center, forming an endless calm current that a single click can ease to a still, composed halt and ease back into motion.
canonical_document.experience_scope: A region-or-full-view decorative surface that is already mid-motion the instant it appears and never concludes; it has no entry sequence, no end state, and occupies the whole area assigned to it, with any foreground content sitting above it.
content_and_composition: Uniform, low-visual-activity ground plane covering the entire assigned area, acting as the visual substrate and holding a consistent luminance separation from the specks so the material reads clearly without gaining weight.
Many small confetti-like graphic specks as the sole foreground material of the effect, numerous enough to read as a mass rather than as countable individuals.
A single implied convergence zone near the middle of the area where specks accumulate, diminish in size and disappear; it is never drawn as an object, only implied by speck behavior.
Specks distributed across the outer area with varied sizes and positions so the field looks uniformly populated at all times, with density visibly increasing toward the center.
Optional overlaid page content (headline, mark, short copy) sits on a layer above the drift and remains fully legible, the ground staying far enough from the content's tone to hold readable contrast.
No control affordances, labels, instructions, progress indicators or chrome are present anywhere on the surface.
experience_progression: Per-speck lifecycle only: a speck appears in the outer field, travels inward, shrinks and fades as it nears the center, then vanishes and is replaced, so the field as a whole never advances through stages.
The composition is stationary in character: it looks identical in kind at first glance and minutes later, with no build-up, climax or resolution.
attention_and_information_flow: Convergent motion vectors and rising density pull the eye inward to the center, making the middle the dominant focal area without any highlight, frame or brightness cue.
A low-contrast surround and small, subdued speck scale keep overall visual weight low so overlaid foreground content, when present, still reads first.
No information is progressively revealed; the surface communicates mood and liveliness rather than content.
When motion stops, attention settles into the frozen arrangement as a still composition and the inward pull persists as static implied direction.

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Runs indefinitely without user involvement; nothing to start, finish or dismiss
interaction_model.state_change: Perpetual inward travel with continuous speck replacement, entered already at full speed
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The surface appears mid-flow with a fully populated field in motion; there is never an empty, assembling or fading-in state
interaction_model.input: Autonomous continuous drift with no trigger, running from the first visible frame
interaction_model.affected_object: The whole speck field

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Interruptible at any point in the deceleration; a further click reverses direction of change immediately without waiting for the halt to finish
interaction_model.state_change: Full speed eases down to a complete standstill
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The whole drift decelerates smoothly and settles, never cutting out abruptly; the halted field reads as a deliberate still composition rather than a frozen glitch
interaction_model.input: Single click or tap anywhere on the surface while drifting
interaction_model.affected_object: Motion of the entire field at once

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Repeated or rapid toggling, including mid-transition, always lands on the state opposite to the current intent; no accumulated lag, stuck intermediate speed or desynchronized specks
interaction_model.state_change: Current stillness or partial speed eases back up to full drift speed
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Motion resumes from exactly the arrangement and moment where it rested, with no speck jumping, snapping back, respawning or restarting the scene
interaction_model.input: Single click or tap anywhere on the surface while stopped or slowing
interaction_model.affected_object: Motion of the entire field at once

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Current motion state is retained across the resize, so a stopped field stays stopped and a drifting field keeps drifting at its current speed
interaction_model.state_change: The scene refits to the new dimensions, with the convergence zone staying at the middle of the new area
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The field continues drifting through the resize with no pause, flash, reset or repopulation; coverage simply spans the new bounds
interaction_model.input: Viewport or container resize
interaction_model.affected_object: Extent and layout of the drift field and position of the convergence zone

experience_qualities: Calm and unhurried rather than energetic or attention-grabbing
Endless and seamless, with no perceptible beginning, end or repetition seam
Atmospheric and recessive, reading as depth and quiet space through a low-contrast surround
Immediately legible with nothing to learn, discover or operate
Composed even at rest, so stopping never looks broken
Smooth and continuous under interaction, never snapping or restarting
completion_and_return: Never completes; the drift loops indefinitely through continuous speck replacement.
Stopped state is a stable, indefinitely holdable resting state, not a timeout that auto-resumes.
Resuming returns to the same ongoing flow rather than to a fresh scene, so state is continuous across every toggle.
Motion state persists across resizing of the surface.
locked_observable_requirements: The surface is visible in full motion from the first frame, with no loading, assembly or fade-in stage.
The moving material is many tiny confetti-like specks on a uniform ground that stays clearly separated from them in luminance.
Specks travel inward and converge toward a center zone, shrinking and vanishing there.
Density visibly concentrates toward the middle, drawing attention inward.
The drift reads as endless with no discernible start, end or loop seam.
A click or tap anywhere on the surface toggles motion; no dedicated control, hint or label exists.
Stopping and starting are eased transitions, never instantaneous cuts.
Resuming continues from the exact frozen arrangement with no speck jump, respawn or scene restart.
Repeated toggling, including mid-transition, always resolves to the opposite state.
A halted field still reads as an intentional composition.
Resizing refits the scene without interrupting motion or resetting state.
adaptable_details: Speck shape, count, size range, hue treatment and opacity, provided each speck keeps its separation from the ground
Exact luminance level and tint of the ground plane, provided the speck-to-ground separation holds
Drift speed, inward path curvature and amount of per-speck variation
Duration and easing character of the stop and start transitions
Whether the convergence zone sits at the exact geometric center or slightly offset
Region size and aspect ratio, from a contained panel to a full view
Presence, amount and styling of any overlaid foreground content
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits any surface that wants a quiet, low-contrast atmospheric backdrop or standalone decorative panel where the moving specks carry mood rather than meaning, including landing surfaces, hero areas and section backgrounds behind sparse foreground content. It stops being this Skill if the specks carry data or represent discrete items to be read or selected, if they become individually hoverable, selectable or navigable targets, if the ground-to-speck separation collapses so the material must gain weight and contrast to survive, if motion disperses outward or scrolls laterally instead of converging inward, or if the effect gains an entrance build-up, a finite ending or visible controls, all of which change its identity from endless self-running atmosphere to a directed or interactive display.

name: roaming_lamp_over_giant_word
description: One oversized bold word sits alone on an evenly unlit field whose luminance stays far below the lit zone; a bright pool of light rides the pointer, and long shadows fan out from every stroke, re-aiming instantly and shifting between tight and hard-edged up close and long and soft when the light drifts away, with a faint iridescent tint along their flanks.

canonical_document.name: roaming_lamp_over_giant_word
canonical_document.description: One oversized bold word sits alone on an evenly unlit field whose luminance stays far below the lit zone; a bright pool of light rides the pointer, and long shadows fan out from every stroke, re-aiming instantly and shifting between tight and hard-edged up close and long and soft when the light drifts away, with a faint iridescent tint along their flanks.
canonical_document.experience_scope: Whole-view experience covering the entire unlit page surface; it begins immediately on arrival with the light already placed and never ends, exits or hands off to another state.
content_and_composition: Exactly one foreground text element: a single short word set very large and bold, centered as the sole subject
An unlit empty field filling the full view as the background stage, its luminance held far below the lit core, with no competing content or chrome
A single bright light pool on that field, brightest at its core and falling off smoothly toward the unlit baseline at the edges of the view
One shadow per letter stroke, all originating from the letterforms and directed away from the light position
Faint iridescent color, in any hue family, confined to the flanks/edges of the shadows, not on the letters themselves
Layer order that keeps the letters above both the light falloff and the shadows so glyph edges remain perfectly crisp and readable at all light positions
attention_and_information_flow: Attention is anchored on the single word at all times; nothing else competes for it
The lit region reads as the current point of interest and drags the eye with the pointer
Areas far from the light recede toward the unlit baseline, narrowing perceived scope to the illuminated zone
Shadow direction and length are the only changing information, read as evidence of where the light now stands

It stops being this Skill if the foreground grows into multiple text blocks or dense content, if the field becomes busy or its luminance closes on the haze so the soft coloured haze no longer reads, if the anchor word itself is allowed to blur or move, if the motion becomes a fixed repeating loop instead of a non-repeating wander, or if pointer input drives discrete selection or navigation rather than continuous drift direction.

The cloud's form continuously evolves so no shape appears copied or cyclically repeated

name: endless_light_streak_rush

canonical_document.name: endless_light_streak_rush
canonical_document.description: A depth scene of light trails streaming continuously toward the viewer and receding into a quiet, recessive distance, with still wording held above the rush; pressing and holding accelerates the flow and widens the view so streaks stretch and tear past, and releasing eases back to the calm cruise.

content_and_composition: Background layer: a quiet, low-distraction depth field, tonally recessive in whatever theme hosts it, forming the receding distance that the motion converges into

The cycle can be entered again at any moment from any point in the ramp

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: A new press during the ease-down smoothly redirects upward from the current state without resetting or snapping

Calm at rest, thrilling and forceful when pushed

name: glowing_glyph_depth_swell
description: A deep volume filled with repeated glowing metallic characters that bulge forward around the pointer and sink back into a quiet surround further away, with short copy floating legibly in front and the whole field easing back to a settled pose when movement stops.

canonical_document.name: glowing_glyph_depth_swell
canonical_document.description: A deep volume filled with repeated glowing metallic characters that bulge forward around the pointer and sink back into a quiet surround further away, with short copy floating legibly in front and the whole field easing back to a settled pose when movement stops.
canonical_document.experience_scope: Whole-view region occupying the entire opening viewport; it is present immediately on arrival in a settled resting pose, runs continuously as long as the view is visible, and has no start or end point the visitor must reach.
content_and_composition: One field of repeated character forms — a small vocabulary of glyphs, many instances — arranged across the view and distributed in apparent depth rather than on a single plane
Glyph rendering reads as glowing metallic material: specular highlight and sheen rather than flat fill
Outer and deeper ranks of the field dissolve toward the surrounding ground tone so the boundary of the field is never a hard edge, producing perceived depth instead of a flat pattern
A quiet, tonally uniform background substrate, held clearly apart in luminance from the illuminated glyphs, that the field fades into
A persistent foreground text layer in front of the field: one short headline, one italic tagline, one single line of supporting copy — small in quantity, always legible, never obscured by the field
Clear layer order: low-distraction ground behind, reactive glyph volume in the middle, static copy in front
attention_and_information_flow: Attention is drawn to whichever part of the field is currently nearest the pointer, because those glyphs are most luminous, largest and closest to the viewer
Prominence continuously migrates with the pointer rather than stepping between fixed focal points
Regions away from the pointer lose prominence by receding and fading toward the ground, which keeps the composition from competing everywhere at once
The foreground copy holds a constant, quiet level of prominence throughout and is never the thing that changes
No new information is revealed by interaction; the changing element is depth, luminance and lighting, not content

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Fully reversible at any moment — moving back over previously raised glyphs reverses the swell along the same path; the visitor can never push the field into an unrecoverable state
interaction_model.state_change: Nearby glyphs advance toward the viewer and gain presence; more distant glyphs recede and fade toward the ground, forming one soft continuous swell centered on the pointer
interaction_model.visible_feedback: A travelling bulge of larger, more luminous, closer glyphs that follows the pointer, with surrounding glyphs losing intensity and sinking away
interaction_model.input: Pointer moves horizontally and vertically across the view
interaction_model.affected_object: Glyphs in the field, according to their proximity to the pointer

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Lag is bounded — the field always catches up rather than drifting or accumulating offset
interaction_model.state_change: Near glyphs begin responding almost immediately while further glyphs trail behind by a growing delay
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The swell reads as elastic and tactile: the crest tracks the pointer closely while the outskirts visibly lag and settle afterwards
interaction_model.input: Pointer distance from a given glyph (proximity as an implicit input)
interaction_model.affected_object: Timing of each glyph's response

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Continuous and reversible with pointer movement; returns to a neutral lighting attitude as part of settling
interaction_model.state_change: The light direction slides as the pointer rises or falls
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Highlights and sheen shift across the glyph surfaces, changing which faces catch light and reinforcing that the forms are solid material
interaction_model.input: Vertical pointer position
interaction_model.affected_object: Lighting of the metallic glyph field

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Settling is interruptible — new pointer movement picks up from the current state without a reset or jump
interaction_model.state_change: Motion decays and the composition eases into a stable held state instead of freezing abruptly or continuing to drift
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The swell smoothly relaxes and the field comes to rest, quiet and stable, ready to be disturbed again
interaction_model.input: Pointer movement stops
interaction_model.affected_object: Entire field and lighting

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: This resting pose is the state the experience always returns toward
interaction_model.state_change: The field presents a deliberate, composed resting pose rather than an empty, collapsed or arbitrary state
interaction_model.visible_feedback: An immediately attractive settled arrangement of glowing glyphs with the copy legible in front, inviting the first movement
interaction_model.input: Arrival with no pointer movement yet
interaction_model.affected_object: Field and lighting

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Adjustment happens without losing the current settled or in-motion state
interaction_model.state_change: Framing is recomputed so the field still fills the view and the copy stays in place
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The composition remains correctly framed and uncropped, with depth and copy legibility preserved
interaction_model.input: Viewport resize or orientation change
interaction_model.affected_object: Whole composition — field extent and foreground copy

experience_qualities: Atmospheric and deep rather than flat, the field trailing off into its surround
Alive and aware of the visitor without demanding anything
Unhurried and tactile: soft swelling, elastic lag, gentle easing
Materially rich — glowing metallic surfaces that respond to light
Nothing to complete, no task, no score, no goal

completion_and_return: No completion state; the experience is open-ended and endlessly resumable
Every interaction ends by easing back toward a settled pose and holding there

It stops being this Skill if the field becomes flat and non-depthed, if elements stop reacting to pointer proximity as one continuous swell, if the material loses its glowing metallic light response, if the ground stops being quiet enough for the field to fade into and for the lit material to separate against, if dense foreground content must sit over it and force the field into a quiet static texture, or if the interaction gains a goal, score or completion state instead of always easing back to rest.

canonical_document.name: kinetic_title_index_over_drifting_image_stacks
canonical_document.description: A quiet full-screen list of a few oversized hollow titles suspended in front of heavily suppressed standing stacks of photographs that drift with the pointer, where hovering a title fills its letters and makes some of them ride and tip, and committing to one title sweeps the whole atmosphere away to leave a single story's image and words alone on screen.

content_and_composition: Background layer: several separate standing stacks of photographic images distributed across the view, all held far back in contrast and presence relative to the titles — pushed toward the surround in whichever luminance direction the host surface runs — so they read as atmosphere rather than as pictures to study.

Hover engagement: an individual title solidifies and animates its letters under the pointer, then releases and springs back when the pointer leaves.

Return changeover: the same sweep runs in reverse and the untouched index view comes back in its original state.

Hover concentrates attention on a single title by making it solid and physically responsive while the others remain hollow and quiet.

interaction_model.visible_feedback: Continuous soft parallax drift at differing depths that keeps the surface feeling alive and slightly restless
interaction_model.input: Pointer movement anywhere in the view
interaction_model.affected_object: Background stacks of photographic images

interaction_model.affected_object: Trailing ring companion

interaction_model.visible_feedback: A full-view sweep that clears the imagery and remaining titles away, ending on an uncluttered focused story view

interaction_model.affected_object: Whole index view and the chosen story view

interaction_model.state_change: The sweep reverses and the index view is restored to its original untouched arrangement

interaction_model.state_change: Idle empty field becomes an active emitting trail along the exact path just travelled

Making the marks persist and accumulate into a drawing, letting sparks respond to each other or to simulated physics, or replacing the transient trail with a permanent canvas would each produce a different Skill, as would removing the one-time self-drawing title reveal that establishes the mood.

interaction_model.visible_feedback: Slow, smooth movement of colour boundaries that never settles into an obvious loop or recognizable repeat
interaction_model.input: Autonomous time-based drift with no user input
interaction_model.affected_object: Layered bands of hue across the whole field

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Fully reversible by moving away; no state accumulates, and rapid or erratic movement never breaks the field or the underlying drift
interaction_model.state_change: A soft rounded pocket of altered colour is drawn toward the pointer position, following with easing rather than snapping
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Bands inside the pocket shift position and hue and sit slightly lower in luminance than their surroundings; the pocket lags visibly behind the cursor and catches up smoothly
interaction_model.input: Pointer moved anywhere over the field
interaction_model.affected_object: Local region of the field near the pointer

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Resumes following immediately on the next pointer movement with no re-entry transition
interaction_model.state_change: Pocket glides to rest at the last pointer location and stays there
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Pocket coasts to a stop instead of vanishing or jumping, and remains as a soft local variation while bands keep drifting through it
interaction_model.input: Pointer stops moving
interaction_model.affected_object: The pocket

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Not user-controllable; continues while the pocket is at rest
interaction_model.state_change: Effective radius slowly widens and narrows on its own cycle, independent of pointer speed
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The blurred edge gently expands and contracts so the pocket feels alive even when the pointer is still
interaction_model.input: Autonomous breathing of the pocket edge
interaction_model.affected_object: The pocket's soft boundary

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: No recovery step needed; resizing is undisruptive at any speed
interaction_model.state_change: Field re-fits the new viewport while motion state carries over
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Colour continues to fill the view edge to edge with no reset, flash, letterboxing or restart of the drift
interaction_model.input: Window resized
interaction_model.affected_object: Whole field

experience_qualities: Calm, immersive and enveloping rather than energetic
Hypnotic: slow enough to follow effortlessly, varied enough never to feel like a repeating loop
Soft-edged and continuous, with no hard boundaries, snapping or abrupt transitions
Effortless: nothing to click, drag, read at length or decide
Lightly humorous through a single small line of copy that keeps the tone unserious
completion_and_return: No completion state, end frame or success condition; the experience is open-ended by design.
Pointer influence is transient and self-resetting: the pocket rests where it was left and never needs dismissal.
Nothing persists between visits; each arrival is simply the field already in motion.
locked_observable_requirements: Colour field fills the entire viewport with no scrolling and no competing foreground content.
Multiple layered bands of hue that drift and reshape continuously and never resolve into an obvious repeat.
Motion speed slow enough that the eye follows it without strain; it must read as hypnotic, not busy.
Pointer movement produces a soft rounded pocket of altered colour that follows with visible easing lag, never snapping to the cursor.
Inside the pocket, nearby bands shift position, shift hue and sit slightly lower in luminance than the surrounding field, in whatever hue family the field uses.
Pocket edge is soft and slowly breathes wider and narrower on its own.
When the pointer stops, the pocket glides to rest at that location instead of disappearing.
Underlying field motion is never interrupted, reset or paused by pointer behaviour or window resizing.
Interaction requires no clicking, dragging or any discrete control.
Exactly one short, light-hearted line of text in a corner, legible yet clearly subordinate in contrast to the field.
adaptable_details: Specific hues and palette family, number of bands and their orientation or curvature
Drift direction and exact pace within the slow, followable range
Pocket size, lag amount, luminance-offset depth and breathing period
Which corner the line of copy occupies and its exact wording
Typography and opacity of that line
Behaviour on touch-only devices where no pointer hover exists
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits any view whose entire purpose is an ambient colour environment with at most one line of sparse copy — idle screens, mood landings, waiting or between-task views, in any hue family the host chooses. It remains recognizable if used as a full-bleed backdrop only when foreground content stays extremely sparse and the field keeps its full-view continuity. Adding readable content blocks, scrolling sections, or navigation over it, making the pocket snap to the cursor or trigger on click, letting the pocket persist as accumulating marks, or introducing an obvious repeating loop or a defined start-and-finish sequence would each create a different Skill.

name: curtain_lift_scroll_morphing_field
description: A viewport-locked abstract field that reveals itself after a held, near-featureless obscured pulse, then tightens, twists and converges toward a single unified tone in exact step with scroll position until it settles into a calm solid panel behind a short closing line, unwinding identically on the way back up.

canonical_document.name: curtain_lift_scroll_morphing_field
canonical_document.description: A viewport-locked abstract field that reveals itself after a held, near-featureless obscured pulse, then tightens, twists and converges toward a single unified tone in exact step with scroll position until it settles into a calm solid panel behind a short closing line, unwinding identically on the way back up.
canonical_document.experience_scope: Whole-view experience: it begins at page entry with an obscured hold covering the entire viewport and ends at the bottom of a page several viewport heights tall, where the field has resolved into a calm panel. The field layer occupies the full viewport for the entire scroll travel; the scrolling text is the only element that moves through it.
content_and_composition: One full-viewport abstract pattern field, single instance, pinned to the viewport and rendered behind everything else for the entire travel
One short title line, small and sparse, overlaid on the field near the start of the travel and deliberately weighted as a caption rather than a headline
One short closing text block at the far end of the travel, sitting on the resolved calm panel
One small affordance mark near the bottom edge of the first view indicating that more exists below
A scroll container several viewport heights tall whose only purpose is to supply travel distance; text passes over the stationary field rather than the field scrolling with the text
experience_progression: Concealed hold: the view is a near-uniform, low-information surface with nothing legible, carrying only a quiet pulse, like a closed curtain
Reveal and settle: the field lifts into visibility and stabilizes; the sparse title resolves at caption prominence beneath the visual
Continuous deepening under scroll: the field tightens, twists and drifts toward a more unified, simpler tone, giving the sense of sinking into it
Resolution: near the end the field flattens into a calm, near-solid panel with the motion receded behind the closing text
Unwind: scrolling back upward continuously reverses the same stages to the opening state
attention_and_information_flow: At entry nothing is readable; the concealing surface and its pulse hold attention entirely
After the reveal the field carries visual dominance and the title reads as a subordinate caption, not the main event
Mid-travel prominence stays with the field as complexity increases and the tone unifies; text remains sparse and secondary
At the far end prominence inverts: the field quiets to a flat panel and the closing text becomes the clearest, easiest-to-read element
The small bottom-edge mark is the only signal that further content exists, and is the sole prompt to begin the progression

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: The intro plays once; if the view is entered at a position other than the top, the field presents the stage matching that position instead of replaying the opening
interaction_model.state_change: Concealed held state transitions to settled, fully visible field with the title at caption prominence
interaction_model.visible_feedback: A short concealed hold at very low visual information carrying a quiet pulse, then a curtain-like lift as the field appears and steadies while the title fades in beneath it in weight
interaction_model.input: Page entry (autonomous timed intro)
interaction_model.affected_object: Whole viewport: field layer and title

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Reversing direction retraces the identical stages because state is positional; no drift or accumulation builds up across repeated passes
interaction_model.state_change: Continuous one-to-one advance of the field's density, twist and tonal unification across the full stage range
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The field visibly tightens, twists and unifies in tone in lockstep with travel; any point part-way down looks like a deliberate, stable intermediate stage rather than a transition frame
interaction_model.input: Vertical scroll position (absolute position between top and bottom, not accumulated movement)
interaction_model.affected_object: Pinned abstract field

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Resuming scroll re-engages positional mapping seamlessly from the held stage
interaction_model.state_change: The positional stage is held while a slow idle motion continues
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The field stays at its current stage but keeps drifting gently in place, so the view never looks frozen
interaction_model.input: Pausing scroll / no input
interaction_model.affected_object: Pinned abstract field

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Scrolling back upward unwinds the transformation continuously from that endpoint
interaction_model.state_change: Field state resolves immediately to the final stage
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The view lands cleanly on the calm solid panel with the closing text readable, without catch-up motion or a half-formed intermediate look
interaction_model.input: Jumping straight to the end of the travel (scrollbar drag, keyboard jump, restored position)
interaction_model.affected_object: Field layer and closing text

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Scroll mapping stays valid after resize; travel continues from the same stage
interaction_model.state_change: The field refits the new viewport while keeping its current positional stage
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Proportions of the pattern remain undistorted — no stretching or skewing — and the stage on screen is unchanged
interaction_model.input: Window resize
interaction_model.affected_object: Pinned field layer

experience_qualities: Hushed and cinematic, with a theatrical curtain-lift entry
Sense of physical descent and depth, as if sinking into the field
Continuous, reversible and stable at every point rather than snapping between states
Emotional arc from multi-toned complexity toward unified simplicity and calm
Typographically restrained: text is sparse and deliberately outranked by the visual until the end
completion_and_return: Completes at the far end on a calm near-solid panel where motion has receded and the closing text reads plainly
No looping: the arc has a definite start and a definite resolved end
Return is by reverse scroll, unwinding the whole transformation continuously rather than resetting
Idle drift persists at whatever stage is held, including the resolved end
State is determined entirely by position, so returning to or reloading at any position reproduces the same stage
locked_observable_requirements: One abstract field pinned to the viewport for the entire travel while text passes over it
Field state maps continuously and one-to-one onto scroll position between top and bottom, never onto accumulated input or elapsed time
Every intermediate position reads as a stable, intentional stage
Reversing direction retraces exactly the same stages; jumping lands cleanly on the corresponding stage
Entry begins with a short concealed, near-featureless hold carrying a quiet pulse before the field is revealed
The opening text reads as a subordinate caption, not as the primary content
The transformation arc moves toward tighter, more tonally unified and visually simpler, ending in a calm near-solid panel with readable closing text
A slow idle drift continues while the stage is held
The field's proportions remain undistorted at any viewport size
A small mark near the bottom edge signals that more lies below
Travel spans several viewport heights
adaptable_details: The specific abstract motif and texture of the field
Exact hues and palette, provided the arc runs from more varied and complex toward more unified and simpler
Total travel length beyond several screens
Duration of the concealed hold and character of its pulse
Typeface, size and wording of the opening caption and closing text
Shape and styling of the bottom-edge affordance mark
Whether one or two short text blocks appear along the travel
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits sparse-text views — opening covers, single-statement landing pages, intro or closing sections — where one abstract visual carries the mood and the foreground copy is a caption-scale line or short paragraph that stays legible over it. It stops being this skill if the foreground gains dense content that must be read carefully while the field is still transforming, if the field's state becomes time-driven or accumulated instead of positional and therefore no longer retraces exactly, if the field scrolls away with the content instead of staying pinned, or if the far end remains busy rather than resolving into a calm readable panel.

name: refracting_air_scene_with_terrain_buried_headline
description: An atmospheric landscape view whose air ripples and warps without pause while a large headline sits partially swallowed by the ground plane, and pointer or tilt movement leans the whole scene into shallow parallax depth that eases back to rest at centre.

canonical_document.name: refracting_air_scene_with_terrain_buried_headline
canonical_document.description: An atmospheric landscape view whose air ripples and warps without pause while a large headline sits partially swallowed by the ground plane, and pointer or tilt movement leans the whole scene into shallow parallax depth that eases back to rest at centre.
canonical_document.experience_scope: A single region-or-whole-view image area that is fully present from arrival: it begins already running with no build-up or entrance sequence, has no end state, and persists as ambience for as long as the view is open. Boundaries are the edges of the image area itself; nothing extends beyond it and no empty margin is ever revealed at its edges.
content_and_composition: One atmospheric landscape image as the sole visual substrate, presented whole from the first moment with no piecemeal or staged appearance
One short headline as the only foreground text, positioned so its lower portion is occluded by the terrain in the image rather than floating above it
At least two implied depth layers within the flat image: nearer ground and far horizon, which move at visibly different rates
The headline is bound to a specific depth position in the scene, so its occluded edge travels together with the terrain that hides it
The distorting air band reads as a region of the scene above the ground rather than a filter over the whole frame including the text's legibility
The image extends beyond the visible frame on all sides to provide reserve for movement
attention_and_information_flow: Attention lands first on the moving air, which signals immediately that the view is not a still photograph
The headline holds continuous secondary prominence: it wavers with the scene yet never drops below comfortable readability
Prominence never reorders and no new information is revealed over time; the shimmer is steady ambience rather than an attention event
Pointer or tilt movement temporarily raises interest in the depth relationship between near ground and far horizon without displacing the headline as the informational focus

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Never interrupted by interaction; runs during, before and after any lean and has no user-facing stop or completion
interaction_model.state_change: Perpetual warping and rippling with no start, pause or resolution
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Ongoing refractive distortion that reads as unsettled, wavering air, continuing whether or not the pointer moves
interaction_model.input: Autonomous, continuous driver independent of any user action
interaction_model.affected_object: The air region of the scene above the ground

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Response follows continuously with easing rather than snapping, is clamped so image edges never expose empty borders, and returning the pointer toward centre settles the view back to rest
interaction_model.state_change: The scene offsets by pointer distance from centre, near ground shifting more than the far horizon, with the headline's buried edge travelling with its terrain
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The flat photograph reads as a shallow space that can be leaned into; response is gentle near the middle of the screen and firms toward the edges
interaction_model.input: Pointer movement across the view
interaction_model.affected_object: The layered scene and the headline anchored inside it

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Returning the device toward its neutral orientation settles the scene to rest; the shimmer continues regardless
interaction_model.state_change: Equivalent depth lean driven by device orientation instead of pointer position
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Identical shallow-depth shift with the same centre-soft, edge-firm falloff and clamped extents
interaction_model.input: Tilting a handheld device
interaction_model.affected_object: The same layered scene and anchored headline

experience_qualities: Heavy-aired and atmospheric, as though the space between viewer and horizon is itself a medium
Alive and unresting rather than staged or performed
Gentle and continuous in response, never jumpy or abrupt
Inhabited and dimensional despite originating from one flat image
Calm enough that the headline remains comfortably readable throughout
completion_and_return: No completion or conclusion exists; the ambient distortion loops indefinitely as the resting state
Rest state is the centred, unshifted scene; the lean always returns to it when input returns to centre or neutral
No persistent progress, no dismissal and no final frame to reach
locked_observable_requirements: Continuous, never-ending atmospheric distortion that makes the still image read as live air, running independently of user input
Headline visually embedded in the scene with part of it occluded by the terrain, not overlaid on top of it
Headline holds enough luminance separation from the imagery behind it to stay readable while it wavers
Multi-rate depth response so nearer ground and far horizon shift by different amounts
The occluded headline moves together with the terrain that buries it, preserving its depth placement
Continuous, eased response to pointer distance from centre, softer at the middle and firmer toward the edges
Movement bounded so no empty border is ever exposed
Return toward centre or neutral settles the scene to rest
Orientation tilt substitutes for pointer input on handheld devices
Imagery appears whole rather than assembling piecemeal
adaptable_details: Subject of the landscape and its entire colour treatment — hue family, light or dark tonality, warm or cool cast — together with the specific atmospheric read (rising heat, humidity, drifting dust), as long as the distortion is continuous
Distortion amplitude, speed and grain
Headline wording, typeface, size and placement within the scene
How much of the headline is buried and by which terrain feature
Number of depth layers beyond the required near/far distinction
Maximum lean distance and easing duration
Whether the region occupies a full view or a bounded section
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits a low-density opening or feature area whose foreground is one atmospheric scene image plus a single short headline, where a ground plane or comparable near-field feature exists to bury part of the text, the imagery leaves enough luminance separation for that text to stay readable, and reserve image area exists beyond the frame for clamped movement. Content-dense areas, scenes with no near-field element to occlude the text, or imagery that cannot be extended past the frame do not fit. Making the distortion respond to or start from user input, staging the imagery into an entrance sequence, letting the effect resolve to a still frame, or placing the text fully above the scene would each create a different Skill.

name: word_as_window_texture_variant_stage
description: One enormous word spans the view as the only content, its letters cut out to reveal a living textured fill that keeps drifting gently; picking a numbered entry swaps only the interior treatment while everything around it stays exactly in place.

canonical_document.name: word_as_window_texture_variant_stage
canonical_document.description: One enormous word spans the view as the only content, its letters cut out to reveal a living textured fill that keeps drifting gently; picking a numbered entry swaps only the interior treatment while everything around it stays exactly in place.
canonical_document.experience_scope: A whole-view experience: the stage occupies the full screen from arrival, with a compact index and a short label as the only additional elements. It has no end state; it persists while the visitor swaps between treatments, and can be embedded as a standalone full-bleed showcase region on a longer page without changing identity.
content_and_composition: One primary word rendered at display scale, stretched close to the horizontal edges so it is unmistakably the subject of the view
The letterforms act as apertures onto a fill layer behind them; the fill is only visible inside the glyph shapes, never outside
Exactly one fill treatment is shown at a time, drawn from an ordered series of several alternatives
A brief text label naming the current treatment and its position within the series
A persistent list of numbered entries, one per treatment, placed at the top of the view and holding a fixed position
A surrounding frame or margin band that stays visually identical across all treatments so the interior is the only variable
No secondary content, imagery or navigation competing with the word
experience_progression: Arrival: the word is already composed with the first treatment active and its fill already in motion
Ambient state: the interior material keeps stirring slowly and indefinitely with no user input required
Variant change: a chosen entry replaces the interior treatment immediately, with the word, frame and index unmoved
Free traversal: entries may be taken in any order and any earlier treatment can be returned to in a single step
The series has order and numbering but no terminal step; it is a comparison set rather than a sequence to finish
attention_and_information_flow: The word dominates attention at all times; scale alone establishes it as the subject before any label is read
Because the outer silhouette never changes, attention is directed inward to the interior material as the only thing that differs
The label supplies just enough information to identify what is on screen and how far into the series it falls, without drawing focus from the word
The index remains quietly available as an orientation and jump surface; the marked entry answers 'where am I' without the visitor having to re-read the label
Gentle continuous motion inside the letters holds low-level attention and signals the treatment is alive rather than a static image

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Runs unprompted and unbroken; requires no start or stop, continues across variant changes and is inherited by whichever treatment is active
interaction_model.state_change: Continuous slow drift or stirring of the interior material, never settling into stillness
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The interior of the letters is perceptibly moving while the letter outlines stay fixed
interaction_model.input: Autonomous ambient motion of the fill material
interaction_model.affected_object: The textured fill visible inside the letterforms

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Any entry can be chosen at any time in any order; returning to a previously seen treatment is a single action; the current position is always recoverable from the marked entry so the visitor cannot lose their place
interaction_model.state_change: The active treatment becomes the chosen one; the label text and series position update; the marked entry moves to the chosen entry
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The word reappears immediately wearing the new fill, already in motion; the label reads the new treatment and position; the chosen entry is visibly marked as current while the frame, word placement and index positions do not shift at all
interaction_model.input: Selecting a numbered entry from the index
interaction_model.affected_object: The interior fill treatment, the descriptive label, and the marked state of the index

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Selection behaves like ordinary text selection: it can be extended, redone or dismissed by clicking away, and never interferes with the ambient motion or the ability to swap treatments
interaction_model.state_change: The dragged characters enter a selected state and become copyable
interaction_model.visible_feedback: A selection highlight appears that follows the actual contours of the letter shapes rather than a plain rectangular block
interaction_model.input: Dragging across the letters
interaction_model.affected_object: The word treated as real text content

experience_qualities: Monumental and poster-like from the first moment because one word owns the entire view
Calm and unhurried, driven by slow ambient drift rather than abrupt animation
Analytical in a good way: a controlled side-by-side comparison where only one variable moves
Immediate and non-committal to browse, since every option is one click away and nothing is lost by exploring
Tactile and materially convincing, because the fill is felt as substance seen through the letters rather than colour applied to them
Legibly real text, not a picture of text
completion_and_return: No completion state; the experience persists in whichever treatment is active
Ambient interior motion loops indefinitely and never resolves to a still frame
The active treatment remains until the visitor chooses another; the marked entry preserves the current position
Every earlier treatment stays reachable, so return is always available and never requires stepping back through the series
locked_observable_requirements: One word only, scaled close to edge to edge, is the sole subject of the view
The letterforms must be large enough that the material inside them reads clearly as texture rather than tint
The visual material appears only inside the glyph shapes and is clipped away outside them
Between variants, only the interior changes: word, scale, position, frame and index all hold still
The interior treatment is in continuous gentle autonomous motion, never static
A short label states both the name of the current treatment and its place in the series
A persistent numbered index offers direct access to every treatment in any order
The current entry is always visibly marked
Variant changes are immediate with no layout shift and no loss of ambient motion
The word remains selectable, copyable text and the selection highlight traces the real letter shapes
adaptable_details: Which word is displayed and its length, as long as it stays short enough to span the view legibly
How many treatments the series contains
The nature of each fill treatment and its palette, density or apparent depth
Speed and character of the ambient stirring
Wording and typographic styling of the label
Visual styling, orientation and compactness of the numbered index and its marked state
Typeface choice, weight and letter spacing
Styling of the surrounding frame or margin band
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits any short single word or very short phrase that can be scaled to fill a view and still leave enough interior area to read a texture, paired with an ordered set of interchangeable interior treatments. It stops being this Skill if the type shrinks to ordinary heading or body scale, if multiple words or lines compete for the view, if other content shares the stage, if the variants change the outer form, layout or motion of the word instead of only its interior, if the interior becomes static, or if the word is rendered as imagery and loses real text selection.

name: pointer_lit_drifting_particle_hero
description: A photographic first screen held well back in contrast, carrying a slow-drifting cloud of fine specks and the threads between them, with the site name crisp in front and a soft halo of detail that gains luminance near the pointer and fades out behind it.

canonical_document.name: pointer_lit_drifting_particle_hero
canonical_document.description: A photographic first screen held well back in contrast, carrying a slow-drifting cloud of fine specks and the threads between them, with the site name crisp in front and a soft halo of detail that gains luminance near the pointer and fades out behind it.
canonical_document.experience_scope: A whole-view region occupying the entire first screen, beginning as soon as the page opens and ending at the boundary where the page content below scrolls into place; the region persists in the background of that first screen and re-engages whenever it is scrolled back into view.
content_and_composition: Back layer: one photographic image filling the whole first screen, held low enough in local contrast that the fine detail above it stays visible
Middle layer: a dispersed field of many small specks distributed across the full screen, plus fine threads drawn between specks that are near one another
Front layer: one short piece of prominent naming text, sharply rendered and clearly separated in contrast from everything behind it
Optional persistent front elements sharing the front layer with the name, kept sparse so the atmosphere remains the only busy layer
A pointer-anchored halo of visibility that has no visible border of its own and exists only as a gradient of speck and thread luminance separation from the backdrop
experience_progression: Opening state: the atmosphere is already drifting when the first screen appears, so the scene reads as ongoing rather than starting
Holding state: continuous slow drift with no beginning or end, inviting a short pause before scrolling
Release state: attention is handed downward as the first screen leaves the viewport and the movement idles
Rejoining state: returning upward resumes the same ongoing drift rather than replaying an introduction
attention_and_information_flow: The naming text holds primary prominence at all times; the atmosphere never overtakes it
Most of the speck field stays near the threshold of visibility, so the screen reads as texture rather than as countable objects

Pointer presence creates a temporary local peak of interest: nearest specks and their linking threads become clearly legible, moderately distant ones remain faint, and everything further is not shown at all
Withdrawing the pointer returns the screen to a uniform low-detail state with nothing singled out
Descending past the first screen removes the atmosphere from competition entirely so the following content owns attention

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: The halo follows continuously without lag traps; moving the pointer away or off the region fades the lit detail smoothly back out, leaving no residual highlight or stuck emphasis
interaction_model.state_change: Local visibility rises with nearness to the pointer and falls off with distance, with a cutoff beyond which nothing is shown
interaction_model.visible_feedback: A soft travelling halo of detail: crisp nearby specks and threads, barely-there mid-distance ones, and beyond the cutoff only the plain backdrop with no texture at all
interaction_model.input: Pointer movement anywhere across the first screen
interaction_model.affected_object: Specks and the threads linking them, in proximity bands around the pointer position

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Drift is self-sustaining and independent of pointer availability; absence of a pointer simply means no halo, never a static scene
interaction_model.state_change: Continuous slow repositioning of specks and consequent re-forming of the threads between them
interaction_model.visible_feedback: A quietly shifting atmosphere that never freezes and never resolves into a fixed picture
interaction_model.input: Autonomous passage of time with no user input, including on touch devices where no pointer exists
interaction_model.affected_object: The whole speck field and its threads

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Repeated or continuous resizing remains non-interrupting; the scene stays continuous throughout
interaction_model.state_change: The scene refits to the new dimensions while the ongoing drift continues
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The atmosphere continues without a visible restart, flash, jump or reset of the motion
interaction_model.input: Viewport resize or orientation change while the first screen is visible
interaction_model.affected_object: The full-screen atmosphere layer and the distribution of the speck field

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Idling and resumption are silent and repeatable in either scroll direction, with no replayed entrance and no visible catch-up
interaction_model.state_change: Motion idles while the region is out of view and resumes when it returns
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Returning upward shows the same ongoing scene continuing rather than a fresh introduction sequence
interaction_model.input: Scrolling the first screen out of view, then back into view
interaction_model.affected_object: The atmosphere's motion state

experience_qualities: Quietly alive rather than busy
Calm and unhurried, with slow rather than energetic motion
Atmospheric and depth-suggesting: a recessive low-contrast photographic distance behind, fine detail floating in front
Responsive in a gentle, exploratory way — detail is discovered by moving, not commanded
Continuous and endless, with no visible start or finish
completion_and_return: The experience never completes; it loops indefinitely by continuous drift
Pointer-driven emphasis always self-resolves back to the unlit baseline
Leaving the first screen idles the scene; returning rejoins it mid-motion instead of restarting it
No accumulated state is shown to the visitor across visits to the region
locked_observable_requirements: Fills the entire first screen as one whole-view opening region
A photographic backdrop held back in contrast sits behind an animated field of fine specks with threads between nearby specks
Short naming text stays crisply legible in front of the atmosphere at all times
Movement continues on its own, independent of any pointer input, including where no pointer exists
Pointer proximity produces a graded halo with three readable ranges: clear near, barely visible mid, invisible beyond
Both specks and their linking threads participate in the proximity reveal
Moving away fades highlighted detail fully out with nothing left emphasized
Resizing refits without visibly interrupting or restarting the motion
Motion idles when the region is scrolled past and resumes on return without replaying an entrance
adaptable_details: Choice of photographic backdrop subject and how far its contrast and salience are held back
Speck count, size, drift speed and thread thinness
Exact halo radius and the distances of the visibility falloff bands
Hue, warmth and luminance direction of the specks, threads and glow relative to the backdrop, whether they read lighter or darker than it
Typeface, size and placement of the naming text
Presence of a small number of additional sparse foreground elements alongside the name
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits any full-view opening or full-bleed section whose foreground is short, high-contrast and sparse — a site name, product name or single claim — over a photographic image held back in contrast, of either overall lightness, where a low-contrast animated texture can live without harming legibility. It stops being this Skill if the foreground becomes dense text or interactive content that the atmosphere must yield to, if the reveal is driven by clicks, scroll position or timed sequencing instead of continuous pointer proximity, if the motion stops when there is no pointer, or if the specks and threads become discrete labelled or clickable objects that carry meaning rather than atmosphere.
