canonical_document.name: endless_cube_rush_corridor
canonical_document.description: A quiet open field where small solids appear at the threshold of visibility far away, gain contrast and grow as they streak toward the viewer and vanish past the edges, with the pointer bending, speeding, reversing or freezing the rush.
canonical_document.experience_scope: A self-contained visual region or full-view scene that is already mid-motion the instant it appears; it has no beginning or end state and continues indefinitely while visible, so it can be entered, left and rejoined at any moment.
content_and_composition: An unbroken, low-distraction void of a single quiet tone that reads as open, unbounded space and dominates the frame
A large population of small cube-like solids distributed in depth, from barely visible far specks to large near forms that stand clearly apart from the surround
A vanishing/origin point from which the stream of cubes issues, normally near the visual center and treated as a movable point rather than a drawn object
A perceptual still center that stays visually calm while the surrounding swarm streams past it, giving the eye a place to rest
Each cube carries its own distinguishable tone and its own slow tumble, so the field reads as many independent objects rather than one moving mass
Illumination that makes near faces high-contrast and vivid against the surround while distant cubes stay faint and settle toward the surround's own tone, producing a continuous depth gradient
No text, chrome, controls, labels, counters or instructions inside the scene
experience_progression: Cubes surface far off as faint small forms at the threshold of visibility against the surround
They gather contrast, light and tonal distinction and grow as they close in on the viewer
They sweep past the viewer and out of frame, disappearing at the edges
New cubes continuously replace the departed ones so the stream never thins out or empties
Independently, the overall pace swells and settles again in a slow breathing cycle with no target speed, no start marker and no finish
attention_and_information_flow: Attention drifts freely between the quiet center and the swarm streaming past on the periphery, with neither permanently winning
Near, high-contrast, large cubes pull the eye momentarily, then release it as they exit frame
Depth is read purely from size, contrast against the surround and tonal intensity rather than from any explicit cue
Pointer movement shifts prominence toward the direction being pointed, because the corridor bends that way and the stream reorganizes around the new origin
During the braked light mode, attention concentrates on the newly lit faces of the now-still cubes, revealing form and surface detail that the rushing motion had hidden
No information is disclosed or unlocked; every change is a change of visual state, not of content

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Never stops on its own and needs no input; this is the resting state every other mode returns to
interaction_model.state_change: Continuous forward streaming at a gently varying pace, with each cube tumbling on its own
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Cubes endlessly surface out of the empty surround, gain light and separation as they approach and sweep past; overall speed swells and settles again
interaction_model.input: Autonomous drift with no user input
interaction_model.affected_object: The whole cube field and its forward travel

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Continuous and reversible: slowing or stopping pointer movement lets speed and turn ease back down, and the origin trails smoothly rather than snapping
interaction_model.state_change: Travel accelerates and the field's turn quickens while the origin point eases toward the pointer position
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The stream visibly speeds up and spins faster, and the corridor of cubes bends toward wherever the pointer is, so the viewer feels they are steering into that direction
interaction_model.input: Moving the cursor across the scene, or dragging a finger on it
interaction_model.affected_object: Rush speed, the field's turning motion, and the origin point the cubes stream from

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Releasing the press returns travel, turn and tumble to forward motion; the reversal is a temporary held mode that leaves no lasting state
interaction_model.state_change: All three motions invert for as long as the press is held
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Cubes retreat away toward the threshold of visibility instead of approaching, the field turns the other way and each cube tumbles backwards, reading as flying in reverse down the same corridor
interaction_model.input: Holding the primary press (main mouse button or sustained touch press)
interaction_model.affected_object: Direction of travel, the field's turn, and every cube's own tumble

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Releasing the secondary press resumes streaming from the stilled arrangement and hands lighting back to the default illumination; the frozen light study is entirely held-mode and reversible
interaction_model.state_change: Motion brakes to a full standstill, the origin point recenters, tumbling stills, and pointer offset from center becomes a movable light source
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The rush slows to frozen stillness with cubes hanging in place, then moving the pointer swings a bright light around the frozen field and relights every visible cube face, so highlights and shaded sides sweep across the solids
interaction_model.input: Holding the secondary press
interaction_model.affected_object: Travel speed, the origin point, each cube's tumble, and the scene's lighting

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: This is the universal recovery path: it resolves interrupted holds and pointer loss identically, guaranteeing the scene can never be left stuck in a reversed, frozen or off-center state
interaction_model.state_change: Any active mode is abandoned and every property eases back toward the default drift
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Speed, turn, direction, origin position and lighting glide smoothly back to the gentle baseline stream with no snap or stall
interaction_model.input: Taking the pointer off the scene, including mid-hold
interaction_model.affected_object: All active motion, direction, origin position and lighting modifications

experience_qualities: Hypnotic and meditative rather than demanding
Already underway on arrival, with no intro, countdown or entry moment
Deep and spacious, built on an empty low-distraction surround with form and contrast arriving out of it
Playful and toy-like: every gesture produces an immediate, legible change
Smoothly eased throughout, with speeds and positions gliding instead of snapping
Goalless and consequence-free, safe to abandon at any instant
completion_and_return: No completion, score, ending or success state exists
The forward stream loops indefinitely as cubes are continuously recycled from far distance
Pace swells and settles in an ongoing cycle rather than converging on a final value

No progress or preference persists between visits; the scene always resumes as a calm ongoing glide
locked_observable_requirements: Open, seemingly unbounded space of a single quiet, low-distraction tone as the visual ground
Many discrete cube-like solids, each tonally distinguishable from its neighbours, streaming from a distant origin toward and past the viewer

The scene is in motion the moment it appears, with no start, goal or finish
A calm still center coexisting with the streaming periphery

No text, controls or instructions inside the scene
adaptable_details: Exact cube count, size distribution and spacing in depth
Which hues the surround and the cubes use, and how saturated or muted the cubes read, as long as near cubes separate clearly from the surround and far ones fade toward it
Baseline drift speed and the depth and period of the swell-and-settle cycle
How sharply the corridor bends and how strongly pointer movement accelerates the rush
Tumble rate and axes of individual cubes
Brightness, tint, falloff and reach of the swingable light
Easing durations for acceleration, reversal, braking and return to default
Whether the scene fills the viewport or occupies a bounded panel
Whether the solids are strict cubes or another simple faceted solid of the same family
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits any context wanting a goalless ambient or interactive centerpiece built from many identical abstract solids in open depth: hero stages, idle toys, atmospheric section backdrops behind sparse text, or playful interactive demo blocks. It does not fit scenes that must carry meaningful per-object content, labels or data, since the cubes are interchangeable and unlabelled. Replacing the endless approach-and-pass travel with orbiting, clustering or a fixed arrangement, giving the cubes individual identities or destinations, adding a start-to-finish progression or goal, or making the lighting study the permanent primary mode rather than a held state would each create a different Skill.

name: breathing_light_field_behind_single_action

Responsive but gentle — every reaction eases rather than cuts or snaps

locked_observable_requirements: A quiet, low-distraction base surface held far enough from the luminous elements in luminance that they read as light, with one wide field of that soft light as the only ambient content

canonical_document.name: breathing_light_field_behind_single_action

It becomes a different skill if foreground density rises to multiple sections, cards or imagery over the field, if the field becomes a subject to explore or inspect rather than atmosphere, if the reaction is driven by scrolling, cursor position at large or many separate controls instead of one action's hover, or if the density change is instant, stepped or non-reversible instead of eased and resolvable from any intermediate state.

The backdrop remains a subordinate atmospheric presence, read as mood rather than as information

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Fully reversible with scroll; pausing leaves the band held at its intermediate lateral offset
interaction_model.state_change: The band shifts sideways proportionally to how far the visitor has advanced
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Large names travel horizontally alongside the photographs, moving forward and backward in lockstep with scroll direction
interaction_model.input: Overall progress through the column
interaction_model.affected_object: The oversized name band crossing the centre of the screen

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: No jump to the top, no loss of position, and no restart of the sequence
interaction_model.state_change: Composition re-fits to the new viewport while the current progress point is preserved

experience_qualities: Hushed and atmospheric, with the surround receding well behind the presented image
Weighted and eased rather than jumpy or literal
Tactile and physical, like leafing through printed photographs
Deliberately paced and singular in focus
Continuous and reversible, with no discrete steps or snapping
Calm resolution rather than a climax
completion_and_return: Ends held calmly on the final photograph; the sequence does not loop or auto-reset
Reverse scrolling replays the whole run backwards through the identical angles and positions
Any paused mid-turn state persists as long as the visitor leaves it alone, including across resize
locked_observable_requirements: Quiet, low-distraction stage clearly separated in luminance from the imagery, with only one photograph fully presented at a time
Single vertical column that meanders loosely rather than tracking a rigid straight line
Each image's arc from near edge-on, to fully square-on near the middle of the screen, to tipped away
Tilt and depth bound continuously to viewport position, so reversing scroll reproduces the same angles exactly
Stopping mid-scroll leaves an image frozen at an intermediate angle with no snapping or auto-advance
Weighted, eased scroll response rather than direct, immediate tracking
Oversized names crossing the centre of the screen and shifting sideways in step with overall progress
Overlapping hand-off between outgoing and incoming images
Calm finish on the final image with no loop or reset
Vertical scroll as the sole control
Progress preserved through viewport resize
adaptable_details: Number of items, as long as the collection stays small enough for one-at-a-time presentation
Exact tilt extremes, easing weight and scroll-to-motion ratio
Amount and shape of the column's lateral meander
Image aspect ratios and framing
Typeface, wording, colour treatment and vertical placement of the oversized name band
Specific stage palette and whether its luminance sits below or above the imagery, plus any subtle stage lighting or vignetting
Whether names correspond one-to-one with images or read as a continuous run of labels
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits small curated collections of visually strong, self-contained images or media where mood and one-at-a-time contemplation matter, and where scroll is allowed to be the sole pacing control. Large collections needing scanning or comparison, items requiring adjacent captions or dense metadata, or grid/multi-column layouts break it. Replacing the continuous position-bound turning with discrete snapping slides, adding autoplay or explicit next/previous controls, moving the type band into ordinary readable copy or navigation, or collapsing the separation between stage and imagery so the surround competes for attention each yields a different skill.

name: arc_fanned_stack_to_numbered_column_with_hero_view
description: A resting pile of images beside a labelled trigger; pressing it glides every image along a curved arc into an evenly spaced vertical column at the far side with a small ordinal beside each, while a large captioned image is revealed — and a second trigger runs the same motion exactly backwards.

canonical_document.name: arc_fanned_stack_to_numbered_column_with_hero_view
canonical_document.description: A resting pile of images beside a labelled trigger; pressing it glides every image along a curved arc into an evenly spaced vertical column at the far side with a small ordinal beside each, while a large captioned image is revealed — and a second trigger runs the same motion exactly backwards.
canonical_document.experience_scope: A self-contained region or whole-view experience that begins in the resting piled state after all images are ready, spans the open transition, the focused state and the close transition, and ends back at the identical resting pile; nothing persists outside this region.
content_and_composition: One collection of same-kind images, small countable cardinality, initially overlapped as a single tidy pile occupying one compact area
One labelled entry trigger positioned immediately beside the resting pile, visible only in the resting state
Post-open arrangement: the same images as an evenly spaced vertical column at the far side of the region, order preserved from the pile
One small ordinal label paired with each column image, sitting beside it
One enlarged focused image with an accompanying caption, occupying the dominant area freed by the column's displacement
One exit trigger present only while the focused state is shown
A plain, contentless waiting state that holds the region until every image is ready to show
experience_progression: Held waiting state until all images are ready
Resting state: single pile plus one adjacent labelled trigger, no other affordances
Open transition: images travel outward along curved arcs, spacing out into the column; ordinals arrive alongside them; entry trigger fades out; enlarged image and caption are revealed
Focused state: column of numbered images plus dominant enlarged image with caption and exit trigger
Close transition: the identical motion played backwards, images converging back along their arcs into the pile
Return to the resting state, repeatable indefinitely
attention_and_information_flow: Arrival deliberately offers a single obvious way in: the pile reads as one object and the labelled trigger is the only competing element
During opening, attention follows the outward travel of the images and then settles on the enlarged image as it appears
In the focused state, the large image plus caption holds primary prominence while the column stays secondary but countable at a glance
Ordinals add position/count information only once the set is spread out, never in the piled state
Closing withdraws information in reverse: the hero and caption give way, the set collapses back into an uncounted single mass

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Only one of the two triggers accepts input at a time; pressing the other while images are still travelling retraces the motion from wherever the images currently are rather than jumping to an end state or queueing a second run
interaction_model.state_change: Piled resting state transitions to spread focused state
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Each image glides along a curved arc out of the pile into its slot in the evenly spaced vertical column, a small ordinal appears beside each, the trigger fades away, and the enlarged image with its caption is revealed
interaction_model.input: Press the labelled entry trigger beside the resting pile
interaction_model.affected_object: The whole image collection, the ordinals, the entry trigger, and the focused image with caption

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Reversible mid-flight from the current positions; input is accepted by only one trigger at any moment so no run can overlap another
interaction_model.state_change: Spread focused state returns to the piled resting state
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The same arc motion runs backwards, images converge back into the pile, ordinals and the enlarged image with caption withdraw, and the entry trigger returns beside the pile
interaction_model.input: Press the exit trigger shown only with the focused view
interaction_model.affected_object: The image collection, ordinals, focused image with caption, and the entry trigger

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: No interaction is offered until the set is complete, so the first open never plays against missing images
interaction_model.state_change: Plain waiting state gives way to the resting piled state
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The tidy pile and its adjacent labelled trigger appear, uncluttered
interaction_model.input: All images becoming ready (autonomous driver)
interaction_model.affected_object: The region as a whole

experience_qualities: Calm, uncluttered arrival with a single unmistakable entry point
Reads as the collection sorting itself out rather than a page changing
Unhurried, exact and symmetric: closing mirrors opening precisely
Curved, gliding travel rather than snapping or sliding in straight lines
Countable at a glance in the spread state; monolithic in the resting state
Repeatable at will with no residue between runs
completion_and_return: Closing completes only when the pile is reassembled in its original resting arrangement and the entry trigger is present again
Interrupted runs resolve by retracing from the current positions to the opposite end state, never leaving images stranded
No progressive or accumulated state is retained across runs; each cycle starts from an identical resting state
locked_observable_requirements: Initial state is a single overlapped pile reading as one object, with exactly one labelled trigger beside it
Opening moves every image along a curved arc, not a straight path, into an evenly spaced arrangement
The spread arrangement is an evenly spaced vertical column placed away from the pile's original area, preserving order
A small ordinal label accompanies each spread image and exists only in the spread state
The entry trigger disappears as the set opens; a distinct exit trigger exists only in the focused state
One enlarged image with a caption dominates the focused state alongside the countable column
Closing is the same motion played backwards to the exact resting arrangement
Exactly one of the two triggers accepts input at any moment, and a mid-flight press retraces from current positions instead of jumping or queueing
The region is held behind a plain waiting state until every image is ready
adaptable_details: Number of images, provided the set stays small enough to remain countable at a glance
Which side the column occupies and which side holds the hero image
Motion duration, arc curvature and easing, as long as it stays unhurried and symmetric
Trigger wording and styling, ordinal numbering style, caption typography and placement relative to the hero image
Visual style of the plain waiting state
Whether images share identical proportions or vary
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits any small set of same-kind visual items that can plausibly sit as one pile and benefit from one item being studied large with a short caption. Replacing the pile-to-column unfolding with an always-visible grid, dropping the countable spread arrangement, making the return non-mirrored, or allowing overlapping/queued runs would produce a different Skill; scaling to a large paged set that cannot be counted at a glance also breaks it.

name: scroll_pinned_portrait_run_with_giant_names
description: A full-bleed portrait fills the screen behind the subject's name set in enormous condensed capitals; scrolling holds the stage in place and cross-fades to the next portrait while the name slides out and the next rises in, and a small solid block carrying the same pictures turns a quarter step and moves to a new spot each time.

canonical_document.name: scroll_pinned_portrait_run_with_giant_names
canonical_document.description: A full-bleed portrait fills the screen behind the subject's name set in enormous condensed capitals; scrolling holds the stage in place and cross-fades to the next portrait while the name slides out and the next rises in, and a small solid block carrying the same pictures turns a quarter step and moves to a new spot each time.
canonical_document.experience_scope: A whole-viewport region that begins when the picture stage reaches its holding position and ends when the run closes on the final entry; the surrounding page continues normally before and after.
content_and_composition: Background layer: one full-bleed single-subject portrait at a time, filling the entire stage
Foreground type layer: the current subject's name in enormous condensed capitals, overlaid on the portrait and readable as part of the frame
Persistent small solid block positioned within the frame, its faces carrying the same set of photographs used on the stage
Persistent position cue that makes the current place within the run obvious at all times
Fixed set of roughly six entries, each entry being exactly one image plus one short name
experience_progression: Stage settles into its held position and the first portrait plus its name are established
Each forward step retires the current portrait and name and installs the next, with the block turning and relocating in the same step
Steps can be halted part-way, leaving a visibly half-finished blend between two entries
Reverse scrolling walks the same steps backward so earlier entries become reachable again
The run closes on the final entry and cannot be pushed further
attention_and_information_flow: Only one subject is visible at a time so attention stays on a single face
The name competes with the portrait for prominence rather than sitting in a caption role, so identity and image are read together
The outgoing portrait's fade-out is what reveals the incoming one, keeping attention on the same central area across steps
Name exchange is vertical and directional, signalling that a set is being traversed rather than replaced
The block gives a peripheral, secondary read of the wider set while the stage stays singular
Position within the run remains continuously legible so visitors always know how much remains

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Progress follows scroll position, so stopping part-way holds a partially blended state and reverse scrolling restores the previous portrait

interaction_model.state_change: Current name leaves its slot as the next name takes it
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The current name slides out of sight while the next name rises into place
interaction_model.input: Forward scroll while the stage holds its position in the viewport
interaction_model.affected_object: Oversized name type layer

interaction_model.state_change: Block advances one quarter turn to present a different photograph and adopts a new position in the frame
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The block visibly rotates a quarter step onto another picture while drifting to a different spot on screen
interaction_model.input: Forward scroll while the stage holds its position in the viewport
interaction_model.affected_object: Small solid photo-carrying block

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Earlier entries remain reachable for as long as the stage is held
interaction_model.state_change: The run steps backward through previously seen entries
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Fade, name travel and block turn all play in reverse together

interaction_model.visible_feedback: The stage stays on the first or final portrait and no further advance is shown

experience_qualities: Cinematic and continuous rather than slide-by-slide
Singular and focused, with one face at a time commanding the frame
Bold and editorial through the scale of the lettering
Directly scroll-coupled, with a slight softening lag so motion feels weighted rather than snapped
Scrubbable and reversible, able to rest in intermediate states
completion_and_return: The run completes on the final entry and holds there instead of looping
Normal page scrolling resumes after the run has closed
Reverse scrolling returns to any earlier entry, restoring that entry's portrait, name and block state
Run position stays consistent with scroll position rather than resetting on direction change
locked_observable_requirements: Stage holds its place in the viewport while the run advances
Exactly one subject visible at a time, image filling the full stage
Subject name rendered in enormous condensed capitals overlaid on the image
Advance happens by the current image fading away to uncover the next
Names exchange by one sliding out while the next rises into place
A small solid block carries the same pictures, turning a quarter step and moving to a new frame position each step

adaptable_details: Number of entries in the set

canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits short fixed sets where each entry is a single strong full-frame image plus one short label, such as people, works, places or featured items, presented as a focused whole-viewport section. Entries carrying paragraphs of supporting copy, multiple items shown side by side, sets long enough that clamped scroll traversal becomes tedious, or advance driven by timers or explicit controls instead of scroll position would each produce a different Skill.

name: scroll_piloted_framed_photo_tour
description: One large image lives inside a single rounded frame on a visually quiet surround that clearly recedes behind it, already zoomed in, and scrolling steers a slow handheld camera from one resting region to the next with shifting zoom and tilt, clamped between a first and last stop and fully rewindable.

canonical_document.name: scroll_piloted_framed_photo_tour
canonical_document.description: One large image lives inside a single rounded frame on a visually quiet surround that clearly recedes behind it, already zoomed in, and scrolling steers a slow handheld camera from one resting region to the next with shifting zoom and tilt, clamped between a first and last stop and fully rewindable.
canonical_document.experience_scope: A self-contained full-screen region occupied almost entirely by one framed image; the experience begins at a fixed opening framing and ends at a final resting framing, with no content revealed outside or behind the frame.
content_and_composition: Exactly one large visual subject, cropped by the frame so only a portion is visible at any moment
One rounded-cornered frame as the persistent viewport; it stays fixed in place while the image moves within it
Quiet, low-distraction surrounding field held at a clearly separated luminance from the framed image, with no competing elements, so the frame is the only focal object
An ordered set of resting regions defined within the image, each becoming the momentary subject
Per-stop framing state combining position, zoom level and slight tilt
No body copy, controls or chrome required inside or beside the frame
experience_progression: Opens on a fixed, recognizable first framing that is already close in rather than showing the whole image
Each downward gesture advances the view continuously toward the next resting region while zoom tightens or loosens and tilt shifts along the path
The view settles on the resting region and keeps easing into place briefly after input stops
Successive stops repeat this advance-and-settle rhythm through the ordered sequence
Reaches a final resting framing that reads as an ending rather than an open-ended wander
Upward scrolling retraces the identical path and stops in reverse order back to the opening framing
attention_and_information_flow: Attention is always held by whichever region currently fills the frame; the recessive surround suppresses everything else
Detail is disclosed a region at a time, so the whole subject is only understood cumulatively across the tour
Tightening framing concentrates attention on fine detail; loosening framing gives momentary context before the next move
The continuous travel between stops shows spatial relationships between regions, so the viewer keeps a sense of where they are inside the image
Arrival is signalled purely by motion coming to rest, not by labels or indicators

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: A gesture always resolves onto the next resting region instead of stopping between stops; scrolling can be repeated immediately to continue
interaction_model.state_change: Framing advances from the current resting region toward the next one, with position, zoom and tilt changing together along the path
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The image glides continuously behind the fixed frame while the crop tightens or widens and tilts slightly, then comes to rest centered on the next region
interaction_model.input: Downward vertical scroll gesture
interaction_model.affected_object: Framed view of the single image
