interaction_model.state_change: Framing returns to the previous resting region along the same path in reverse
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The identical travel, zoom and tilt sequence plays backwards and settles on the earlier region
interaction_model.input: Upward vertical scroll gesture
interaction_model.affected_object: Framed view of the single image

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: New input interrupts the settling immediately and hands control back without a jump
interaction_model.state_change: Motion decays into the resting framing and then continues as a subtle idle drift
interaction_model.visible_feedback: A brief soft easing into place followed by a gentle handheld sway that keeps the still image feeling alive
interaction_model.input: Scrolling stops
interaction_model.affected_object: Current framing and its drift

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Scrolling in the opposite direction resumes the tour normally from the boundary stop
interaction_model.state_change: Travel clamps at the boundary stop
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The view holds at the opening or final framing; nothing beyond or behind the frame is exposed and no empty area appears
interaction_model.input: Continued scrolling past the first or last resting region
interaction_model.affected_object: Travel range of the framed view

experience_qualities: Unhurried and cinematic rather than snappy
Quiet and reverent, with the recessive surround doing the framing work
Handheld and breathing rather than mechanically rigid
Guided and finite, with a clear beginning and end
Continuous and legible, never teleporting between viewpoints
completion_and_return: The tour completes at the final resting framing and holds there; it does not loop into the beginning
The opening framing is reachable again only by scrolling back through the same path
The idle handheld drift persists at every stop, including the first and last
No progress is carried outside the experience; it reads the same whenever it is re-entered from its opening framing
locked_observable_requirements: One image only, presented inside a single rounded frame that stays put while the image moves
Initial state is already zoomed in so the full subject is never visible at once
Vertical scrolling is the sole control over the journey
Movement between stops is continuous and combines translation with zoom and tilt change
Each gesture settles onto a discrete resting region rather than stopping mid-travel
Motion keeps easing after input stops, plus a persistent gentle handheld drift
The reverse direction retraces the same path and stops
Travel clamps at the first and last stop and never reveals anything outside the frame
Quiet, uncluttered surroundings that stay clearly separated from and subordinate to the frame, with no competing foreground content
adaptable_details: Number and placement of resting regions
Specific zoom levels, tilt amounts and path curvature between stops
Pacing, easing character and drift amplitude
Corner radius and proportions of the frame
Exact luminance and tone of the surrounding field, as long as it stays clearly separated from the framed image
Subject matter of the single image
Optional minimal captioning tied to stops, as long as the frame remains dominant
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits any single large, detail-rich visual surface worth inspecting region by region where the page has little or no competing content. It stops being this Skill if multiple images are toured, if the whole subject is shown at once as a static display, if travel becomes free panning and zooming without discrete resting stops, if control moves to drag, pointer or arbitrary navigation instead of vertical scroll, or if the frame stops clamping and lets the journey continue into surrounding page content.

name: pointer_flung_falling_photo_burst
description: Sweeping the cursor across a quiet, near-empty screen drops weighty photo tiles at the pointer that are flung sideways with the motion, fall, bounce once at the bottom and disappear, leaving the screen empty again.

canonical_document.name: pointer_flung_falling_photo_burst
canonical_document.description: Sweeping the cursor across a quiet, near-empty screen drops weighty photo tiles at the pointer that are flung sideways with the motion, fall, bounce once at the bottom and disappear, leaving the screen empty again.
canonical_document.experience_scope: Whole-view experience filling one low-distraction screen-sized region: it begins the moment the visitor first moves the pointer inside the region and ends whenever movement stops, since every spawned photo removes itself; the region has no terminal state and can be re-entered indefinitely.
content_and_composition: Uniform, low-distraction, almost empty backdrop occupying the entire region, clearly separated in tone from the photo tiles, and acting as the stage for all motion
Exactly one short line of centered text, persistent and unchanged, held at readable contrast against the backdrop, sitting in the visual center as the only instruction-free explanation of the idea
A small fixed set of uniformly framed photo tiles used as the spawn material, reused repeatedly rather than exhausted
Zero to many transient photo tiles in flight, layered above the backdrop and passing over the centered line without altering it
A reserved empty band along the bottom edge where no tile is ever introduced, keeping the lower area visually calm
No panels, controls, counters or chrome of any kind
experience_progression: Arrival: quiet low-distraction screen with only the centered line, nothing in motion
First movement: pointer travel accumulates until a threshold of distance is covered, then a single photo appears at the current pointer position

Per-tile life: pop in slightly oversized and offset from the pointer, get flung sideways along the direction and proportional to the speed of the recent pointer motion, accelerate downward toward the bottom edge
Single rebound: one bounce off the bottom, then continued travel out of view and self-removal
Sustained sweeping: overlapping tile lifecycles read as a steady stream, each still resolving and leaving individually
Rest: movement stops, spawning stops, remaining tiles finish their own lifecycles and the screen returns to its quiet starting state, ready to loop again
attention_and_information_flow: The centered line is the only thing visible on arrival and therefore reads first
Attention transfers from the line to the photos as soon as the first tile appears, and stays with the moving tiles for as long as the visitor keeps moving
Prominence is governed by motion and recency: the newest tile at the pointer is the focal point, older tiles recede as they fall away and vanish
No new textual information is ever revealed; the only changing information is where and how fast the visitor is moving
Because tiles never accumulate, the view never becomes cluttered and the centered line remains legible throughout

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Spawning is purely a function of ongoing travel, so slowing down thins the stream and stopping ends it immediately with nothing to undo or clear
interaction_model.state_change: Each time accumulated pointer travel passes a set distance, one new tile is introduced at the current pointer position and enters its flight lifecycle
interaction_model.visible_feedback: A photo pops in slightly oversized and offset at the pointer, so brisk movement produces a steady trailing stream of tiles and slow movement produces widely spaced single tiles
interaction_model.input: Continuous pointer sweep or finger drag across the region
interaction_model.affected_object: Transient photo tiles drawn from the small image set

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Trajectories are set once at spawn and are not re-steerable; a tile always resolves to bounce and exit regardless of what the visitor does next
interaction_model.state_change: The tile receives a sideways launch matching the sweep direction and scaled to the sweep speed, then falls under accelerating downward motion
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Tiles visibly fly the way the hand was moving and travel farther when the sweep was faster, giving each one a springy, slightly unpredictable weighty character
interaction_model.input: Direction and speed of the recent pointer motion at the moment of spawn
interaction_model.affected_object: The newly introduced tile's trajectory

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Removal is automatic and final for that tile; the visitor never has to dismiss anything
interaction_model.state_change: One rebound off the edge, then departure and self-removal
interaction_model.visible_feedback: A single visible kick upward followed by the tile leaving the view and disappearing on its own
interaction_model.input: A falling tile reaching the bottom edge
interaction_model.affected_object: That tile

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Resuming movement restarts the stream instantly from the current pointer position; no reset action exists or is needed
interaction_model.state_change: No further tiles are introduced while remaining tiles finish their lifecycles
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The stream tapers off and the screen empties back to the quiet, uncluttered resting state with only the centered line
interaction_model.input: Pointer held still, or leaving the region entirely
interaction_model.affected_object: The spawning behavior and the overall screen state

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: The clamping is silent, with no error state or visible boundary marker
interaction_model.state_change: Spawn positions are clamped inside the region and suppressed within the reserved bottom band
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Tiles always appear fully inside the stage and never materialize in the strip closest to the bottom
interaction_model.input: Pointer moved toward or past the edges of the region
interaction_model.affected_object: Spawn position

experience_qualities: Instantly understandable with nothing to learn
Playful and toy-like, rewarding movement for its own sake
Physically weighty: tiles feel like solid objects with mass, launch, fall and rebound
Springy and slightly unpredictable rather than mechanically uniform
Quiet and uncluttered, with generous emptiness between bursts
Endless and low-stakes, with no score, goal or stopping point
completion_and_return: There is no completion state; the experience loops indefinitely
Every tile self-terminates after its single bounce and exit, so the screen self-clears
Rest state is always the original low-distraction empty screen with the centered line
No accumulated state, progress or history persists between bursts or visits
locked_observable_requirements: Uniform, low-distraction, near-empty stage whose only persistent content is one short centered line of text held at readable contrast against it
Tiles are introduced only when pointer or touch movement accumulates a set amount of travel, so brisk movement yields a steady stream and motionless input yields nothing
Each tile appears at the current pointer position, slightly oversized and offset from it
Each tile is flung sideways in the direction of the recent movement with magnitude tied to its speed
Each tile accelerates downward to the bottom edge, performs exactly one bounce, then leaves and removes itself
Tiles are clearly separated from the backdrop in tone and never persistently obscure the centered line, and they never accumulate
Spawn positions stay inside the stage and never occur in the band closest to the bottom edge
Stopping or leaving halts new tiles with nothing left for the visitor to clear
Photos are the flung objects, not decorative particles or abstract shapes
adaptable_details: How many images are in the small set and what they depict
Tile framing proportions and size relative to the screen
Exact travel threshold between spawns, oversize amount, offset distance, fall acceleration and bounce strength
Wording of the single centered line and its typographic treatment
Backdrop tone, hue and luminance level in either direction, and any subtle accent coloring, as long as tile separation and text readability hold
Depth of the reserved bottom band
Whether tiles carry slight rotation or tilt as they fly
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits any small curated set of uniformly framed pictures presented on a sparse, low-distraction full-screen stage of any tone where the pointer is the only driver and the pictures carry the message; the identity survives changes of subject matter, image count, stage tone and physics tuning. It becomes a different Skill if tiles persist and accumulate into a collage, if they arrange themselves into a layout or grid, if spawning is triggered by discrete clicks or scroll rather than accumulated movement, if the tiles become abstract particles instead of photos, or if the stage carries substantial foreground copy and controls that the falling tiles must avoid.

name: pointer_trailing_cell_zoom_photo
description: A full-view photo on a low-distraction surround that, wherever the pointer travels, splits into evenly spaced square cells zooming into their own centres — strongest at the pointer and fading with distance, with small high-contrast dots at cell corners growing in step — trailing behind the cursor, reaching further the faster it moves, and unwinding completely to the plain photo at rest.

canonical_document.name: pointer_trailing_cell_zoom_photo
canonical_document.description: A full-view photo on a low-distraction surround that, wherever the pointer travels, splits into evenly spaced square cells zooming into their own centres — strongest at the pointer and fading with distance, with small high-contrast dots at cell corners growing in step — trailing behind the cursor, reaching further the faster it moves, and unwinding completely to the plain photo at rest.
canonical_document.experience_scope: Whole-view region experience: begins on arrival with the untouched image filling the viewport and lasts as long as the view is present; each effect episode begins with pointer movement over the image and ends when movement stops and the image has fully resolved back.
content_and_composition: Exactly one photographic subject image, scaled to fill the view and read as a single unbroken picture at rest
Uniform low-distraction surround framing the image at a clear luminance separation from it and absorbing any letterboxing, so the subject is the only high-salience element
An invisible-at-rest uniform grid of equal square cells covering the image, each cell able to magnify its own contents about its own centre
Small high-contrast point markers positioned at cell corners, scaling together with the magnification of adjacent cells
A pointer-anchored zone of influence whose centre lags behind the actual cursor position; no visible cursor UI, labels, controls or instructional copy
No other foreground content layers; the image is both subject and interactive surface
experience_progression: Arrival: calm, unbroken, undistorted image legible before any interaction
Engagement: pointer motion raises coarse cell magnification locally, strongest under the trailing focus and falling off with distance while the overall picture stays recognisable
Intensification: sustained faster movement widens the affected area and drags the effect further behind the pointer
Relaxation: slowing contracts the affected area and lowers magnification
Resolution: on stillness the grid, magnification and corner markers unwind fully, returning the untouched photo
Episodes repeat indefinitely; every episode returns to the same clean baseline
attention_and_information_flow: At rest all prominence belongs to the whole subject, read as one image
During interaction prominence shifts to the swelling cluster of coarse cells, pulling the eye along the pointer path
Falloff with distance creates a soft, readable centre-to-edge gradient of disturbance rather than a hard boundary
High-contrast corner markers add a fine sparkle layer that signals where the effect is strongest
No new information is revealed; the effect re-presents the same photo at coarser grain, so the subject is never obscured or spoiled
Attention returns to the intact whole image whenever motion ceases

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Effect follows the pointer continuously; moving away restores previously affected cells; no state is locked in and nothing needs dismissing
interaction_model.state_change: Cells transition from flat, undistorted image to magnified-about-their-own-centre chunks, with magnitude highest nearest the lagging focus point and decreasing with distance
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Coarse square chunks swell out of the picture around the cursor path while the overall subject remains recognisable
interaction_model.input: Pointer movement across the view, without any click, drag or key press
interaction_model.affected_object: Image surface cells within the pointer's zone of influence

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Speed response is continuous and reversible in both directions; abrupt direction changes are smoothed by the trailing behaviour rather than snapping
interaction_model.state_change: Faster movement expands the affected radius and increases the trailing offset; slowing contracts the radius and lets the focus catch up
interaction_model.visible_feedback: A larger, more energetic wake of chunks during fast motion that visibly draws in and calms as motion slows
interaction_model.input: Pointer speed (fast sweeping versus slow drifting)
interaction_model.affected_object: Reach of the zone of influence and the lag between cursor and effect centre

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Cells outside the influence stay untouched; cells returning outside it relax smoothly to flat
interaction_model.state_change: Magnification and marker scale rise toward the focus and fall to zero with distance
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Chunk coarseness and marker prominence/size graded outward from the pointer
interaction_model.input: Proximity of each cell to the trailing focus point
interaction_model.affected_object: Cell magnification amount and corner marker size

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Renewed movement interrupts the decay and re-engages from the current partially relaxed state without a jump
interaction_model.state_change: All magnification and marker scale ease back to zero
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Chunks and dots unwind smoothly until the plain, unbroken photo is shown again
interaction_model.input: Cessation of pointer movement (autonomous decay driver)
interaction_model.affected_object: Entire image surface and marker layer

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Baseline is always reachable; the clean photo is the guaranteed resting state
interaction_model.state_change: Remains at or returns to the untouched baseline image
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Calm full-view photo on its uniform low-distraction surround
interaction_model.input: Pointer leaving the view or never entering it
interaction_model.affected_object: Whole experience

experience_qualities: Tactile and immediately self-explanatory without instructions
Playful and toy-like, rewarding aimless movement
Soft and inertial rather than snappy, because the response trails the pointer
Coarse and chunky in texture yet always legible as the original subject
Calm and non-destructive: nothing is hidden, cropped away or permanently altered
Quiet, recessive framing that keeps the effect the only source of visual energy
completion_and_return: No end state or goal; the experience loops through engage-and-relax episodes indefinitely
Every episode completes by fully resolving to the untouched photo
No accumulated or persistent distortion between episodes
Re-entry after leaving starts from the clean baseline
locked_observable_requirements: One image fills the view against a uniform low-distraction surround clearly separated from it in luminance, and reads as unbroken at rest
Pointer movement alone drives the effect; no click or other input is required
The image splits into evenly spaced square cells of uniform size
Each affected cell magnifies its own contents about its own centre rather than displacing the whole image
Magnification is strongest nearest the pointer-driven focus and falls off with distance
The overall subject remains recognisable at all times
Small markers of high contrast against the image appear at cell corners and grow in step with cell magnification
The response trails behind the pointer instead of snapping to it
Affected reach extends with faster pointer movement and contracts when movement slows
When movement stops the effect unwinds completely back to the untouched photo
adaptable_details: Subject matter and aspect ratio of the image
Cell size and grid density
Exact falloff curve, maximum magnification and lag amount
Colour, shape and size of the corner markers
Luminance direction and tone of the surround, provided its separation from the image and its low distraction hold
Decay duration and easing character
How the image is fitted or cropped to the viewport
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits any single strong photographic or illustrated subject presented full-view as the sole foreground content, where coarse chunking still leaves the subject readable and where no text or controls sit on top of the image. It stops fitting when the surface must carry legible copy, UI or multiple competing images, since cell magnification would break their legibility. Requiring a click or drag to trigger it, letting distortion persist instead of unwinding, or replacing the per-cell centre zoom with a whole-image warp, ripple or transition between different pictures would create a different Skill.

name: proximity_magnified_scattered_tile_field
description: A quiet, low-contrast expanse of small, loosely scattered and slightly tilted labeled tiles that all read equally until the pointer enters; the tile nearest the pointer swells to roughly twice its resting size and becomes the most legible, neighbours grow proportionally less with distance, and everything beyond a falloff radius stays untouched, so the highlight travels as one continuous wave and the whole field eases back to even rest when the pointer leaves.

canonical_document.name: proximity_magnified_scattered_tile_field
canonical_document.description: A quiet, low-contrast expanse of small, loosely scattered and slightly tilted labeled tiles that all read equally until the pointer enters; the tile nearest the pointer swells to roughly twice its resting size and becomes the most legible, neighbours grow proportionally less with distance, and everything beyond a falloff radius stays untouched, so the highlight travels as one continuous wave and the whole field eases back to even rest when the pointer leaves.
canonical_document.experience_scope: A bounded region experience: a single quiet, low-distraction field panel occupying a prominent area of the view, beginning when the pointer enters the field's bounds and ending when it leaves; a short explanatory passage sits below the field and is not part of the reactive region.
content_and_composition: One quiet, low-distraction field surface acting as the container and visual ground for the whole experience, held at a clearly separated luminance from the tiles that sit on it
Many small peer tiles (a set large enough to read as a field rather than a list), each pairing a compact glyph or mark with a short text label
Tiles are loosely scattered rather than aligned to a strict grid, each carrying a slight individual tilt so the resting arrangement reads as informal and playful
All tiles share identical visual weight, size and treatment at rest, establishing that none is pre-selected
A subtle persistent cue near or within the field, carried by a single distinct accent, inviting the visitor to move across it
A short explanatory passage placed below the field, persistent and always available, describing what the visitor just felt
Depth is expressed purely through scale and legibility differences between near and far tiles; the field ground itself never changes
experience_progression: Resting state: even, quiet field where every tile reads equally and the invitation cue is the only accent
Entry: pointer arrives and the nearest tiles begin growing immediately, without an introductory animation or delay
Exploration: the emphasis wave follows the pointer continuously across the field, one region rising as the previous one recedes, for as long as the visitor keeps moving
Exit: pointer leaves the field and all tiles ease back together in one slightly slower settle to the even resting state
The cycle can be re-entered any number of times with no accumulated change
attention_and_information_flow: At rest, attention is distributed evenly across the field and drawn only by the invitation cue
Under the pointer, a single local peak of size and legibility identifies the focal tile while all outer tiles remain recessed
Label readability scales with tile size, so the nearest tile's text is the most readable content in the field at any instant
Because falloff is gradual, the visitor perceives a moving neighbourhood of interest rather than a discrete highlighted item
Attention transfers to the explanation below only after the visitor stops exploring; the explanation never competes with the field

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Emphasis is a direct function of current pointer position, so the visitor can retrace or reverse at any moment and the field responds from wherever the pointer now is
interaction_model.state_change: Each tile's size is set continuously from its distance to the pointer: nearest reaches roughly double its resting size, closer neighbours scale proportionally more than distant ones, and tiles beyond the falloff distance remain exactly at rest
interaction_model.visible_feedback: A smooth swell-and-recede wave centred on the pointer, with the focal tile largest and most legible and no visible edge or step where the falloff ends
interaction_model.input: Pointer movement anywhere within the field
interaction_model.affected_object: Every tile in the field simultaneously

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Any in-progress growth can be interrupted mid-way; no motion has to complete before the next one is honoured
interaction_model.state_change: Growth is immediately redirected toward the new pointer position instead of finishing or queueing behind earlier motion
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The peak of the wave appears to stay attached to the pointer with no lag, overshoot or trailing catch-up
interaction_model.input: Fast sweeps and sudden reversals of direction
interaction_model.affected_object: The emphasis wave across the tile set

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Re-entering the field during the settle picks up emphasis immediately from the new pointer position rather than waiting for the settle to finish
interaction_model.state_change: Every tile transitions back to its resting size in a single coordinated settle, slightly slower than the responsive tracking
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The field relaxes evenly back to its quiet, uniform resting appearance
interaction_model.input: Pointer leaving the field bounds
interaction_model.affected_object: All tiles

experience_qualities: Instantly responsive and effortless, as if the field is being pushed by the pointer itself
Continuous and wave-like, never snapping between selected states
Quiet and restrained at rest, playful and tactile in motion
Calm on exit: the return to rest feels like relaxing rather than resetting
Boundary-free: the visitor cannot perceive where the effect's reach ends
completion_and_return: The experience has no completion goal; it loops through enter, explore and settle indefinitely
Exit always returns the field to the identical even resting state
No tile retains emphasis, selection or memory of prior exploration between visits to the field
The explanatory passage below remains available regardless of field state
locked_observable_requirements: Many small peer items presented as a loosely scattered, slightly tilted field on a quiet, low-distraction ground that sits at a clearly separated luminance from the items
All items read equally at rest, with no pre-emphasised item
Item scale is a continuous function of distance to the point of focus, applied to every item at once
The nearest item reaches a clearly dominant size, on the order of double its resting size, and is the most legible item
A falloff distance exists beyond which items remain exactly at rest, and its edge is never visible as a boundary or jump
Emphasis tracks the point of focus in real time; fast sweeps and reversals redirect growth immediately rather than queueing
Leaving the field returns all items to rest in one coordinated settle that is slightly slower than the tracking response
A subtle invitation cue carried by a single distinct accent exists at rest, and a short explanation of the effect sits below the field
adaptable_details: Exact number, spacing and scatter pattern of items
Tilt range and whether tilt varies per item
Glyph style, label wording and label placement relative to the mark
Exact peak magnification factor and falloff radius, as long as the peak clearly dominates and the falloff edge stays invisible
Palette specifics of the ground and item surfaces, in either a light or dark luminance direction, as long as the ground stays low-distraction and item labels stay readable against it
Form of the invitation cue and the wording and length of the explanation below
Whether item opacity or contrast also rides along with scale to reinforce legibility
Field aspect ratio and how the scatter reflows at different widths
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits any set of many small, mutually equivalent labeled items that benefit from playful exploration before selection, such as icon sets, skill or tag clouds, logo fields, capability chips or small thumbnail collections, placed as a showcase region on any quiet, low-distraction ground that separates cleanly from the items. It stops being this Skill if items carry unequal importance or hierarchy, if the set is small enough that individual items are inspected rather than swept across, if emphasis is committed by discrete selection or snaps to one item at a time, if the reaction is driven by something other than proximity to the point of focus (such as scroll position or time), or if the emphasised item opens detail content instead of simply reading larger and receding again.

name: hazy_depth_passage_gallery
description: Scrolling glides the viewer inward through images stacked in depth; only the nearest one is sharp while the rest dissolve into haze, the surrounding atmosphere re-tints toward whatever hues the active image itself carries, and a glowing ribbon in a single distinct accent trails behind to show how far in the journey has gone.

canonical_document.name: hazy_depth_passage_gallery
canonical_document.description: Scrolling glides the viewer inward through images stacked in depth; only the nearest one is sharp while the rest dissolve into haze, the surrounding atmosphere re-tints toward whatever hues the active image itself carries, and a glowing ribbon in a single distinct accent trails behind to show how far in the journey has gone.
canonical_document.experience_scope: Whole-view experience occupying the full viewport for the duration of the image set; begins at the first image at zero depth and ends when the last image is reached, with a fixed detail readout overlay that persists throughout.
content_and_composition: A small ordered sequence of images (a handful, not a large archive) positioned at increasing depth along a single travel axis
Exactly one image reads as the foreground subject at any moment; images further in are progressively hazier and less defined, blending into one another rather than appearing as discrete thumbnails
A whole-view atmospheric backdrop/haze layer that surrounds the images and carries the current ambient tint, that tint being taken from the active image rather than from any fixed scheme

A fixed-position detail readout for the active entry: its position in the sequence, its name, and a short set of accompanying readings or values, always in the same screen location, held at readable contrast against the haze whatever tint the haze currently has

A slender glowing ribbon in one distinct accent threading through the depth space, separated from the surround by luminance as well as hue, with a few drifting sparks clustered at its leading tip, whose length reflects how deep the traversal has gone
No visible list, grid or thumbnail strip competing with the foreground image
experience_progression: Start: first image sits nearest and fully legible; ribbon is at its shortest; atmosphere carries the tint sampled from the first image

Travel inward: the current image recedes and dissolves while the next resolves out of the haze into the foreground; the detail readout swaps to the newly active entry in place; the atmosphere re-tints toward the new image's own colouring; the ribbon lengthens
Continue through the sequence one image at a time, with a single foreground subject always established between transitions
End: the last image terminates the run; travel settles there and cannot continue into empty depth
Reverse travel retraces the identical passage in the opposite order, with the same dissolves, re-tinting and readout swaps
attention_and_information_flow: Clarity is the attention cue: sharpness and definition belong only to the nearest image, so prominence transfers by resolving out of haze rather than by moving or highlighting
Depth blur and tint blending suppress every non-active image so no competing focal point exists
The fixed readout means identity information never moves or has to be hunted for; only its contents change as the active entry changes

Ambient tint acts as a whole-view confirmation of which entry is active, reinforcing the readout without adding text; it stays a low-distraction surround so it never competes with the foreground image
Ribbon length gives a peripheral sense of progress and remaining journey without an explicit progress bar

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Motion continues to ease after input stops and comes to rest smoothly; reversing direction at any instant glides straight back with no lockout or waiting for the current transition to finish
interaction_model.state_change: Depth position advances or retreats continuously, easing toward the input rather than jumping to discrete stops
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Images slide through depth, the incoming one sharpening as the outgoing one dissolves; readout contents swap to the newly active entry; ambient tint interpolates toward the tint carried by the new image; ribbon grows or shortens
interaction_model.input: Wheel scroll or vertical drag
interaction_model.affected_object: Viewer position along the depth axis, and therefore which image occupies the clear foreground

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Input in the opposite direction immediately resumes normal travel from the boundary
interaction_model.state_change: Travel is softly clamped at the ends of the range
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Motion decelerates into a gentle settle at the boundary image instead of snapping or overshooting past it into empty space
interaction_model.input: Reaching the first or last image
interaction_model.affected_object: Depth travel at the sequence boundaries

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Fully continuous and self-recovering — reduced or stopped input returns the image and the surround's luminance to rest without any explicit reset
interaction_model.state_change: A speed-linked intensity state rises with faster travel and relaxes as travel slows
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The foreground image tilts and swells slightly, and the surround's luminance lifts a controlled amount above its resting level; both ease back to their calm state as speed drops
interaction_model.input: Travel speed (derived from how fast the user is scrolling or dragging)
interaction_model.affected_object: Current foreground image and the surrounding atmosphere

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Re-forming is automatic on every flip and can be triggered repeatedly without breaking the trail's continuity
interaction_model.state_change: The ribbon's path is re-formed to follow the new direction of travel
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The ribbon reshapes and its sparks re-gather at the new leading tip rather than the trail persisting in the stale direction
interaction_model.input: Direction change during travel
interaction_model.affected_object: Glowing ribbon and its spark tip

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: When the pointer leaves, the image drifts back to its centred position on its own
interaction_model.state_change: A small pointer-linked offset is applied to the foreground image
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The image nudges slightly toward or away from the cursor, giving a subtle parallax response distinct from depth travel
interaction_model.input: Cursor movement across the view
interaction_model.affected_object: The currently visible foreground image

experience_qualities: Quiet, hazy and atmospheric rather than crisp and informational
Sense of physically sinking inward through space rather than paging between slides
Weighted and inertial: motion trails the input and settles rather than snapping
Singular focus — never more than one subject legible at a time
Tint-immersive: the whole view takes on the mood of the active image itself, whatever that image's own colouring happens to be
Responsive at small scale, with tilt, swell, luminance lift and cursor nudge rewarding movement without demanding attention
completion_and_return: The last image is a definite terminus; the run does not loop back to the first
Reverse travel retraces the same passage in the same order, so returning is a continuous journey rather than a jump
Speed-driven tilt, swell and luminance lift self-restore to the calm state whenever travel slows
Cursor nudge self-restores to centre when the pointer leaves
Depth position, active entry, ambient tint and ribbon length remain in whatever state the user left them; nothing auto-advances or resets on its own
locked_observable_requirements: Images occupy distinct depths on a single travel axis and are traversed by scroll or vertical drag
Only the nearest image is clearly legible; all others are progressively hazy and dissolve into one another
Exactly one active entry at a time, with transitions that dissolve rather than cut
The whole-view ambient tint is derived from the currently active image and changes when the active image changes, with no fixed hue prescribed
Index, name and readings for the active entry stay in one fixed screen position, remain readable against the current ambient tint, and change contents in place
Travel eases toward the input with inertia; reversal is immediately possible at any moment
Soft clamping at the first and last image with no overshoot into empty depth
Faster travel visibly tilts and swells the foreground image and lifts the surround's luminance above its resting level, in either a light or dark surround
A slender glowing ribbon in one distinct accent, clearly separated from the surround, with a few sparks at its tip, lengthens with depth and re-forms on direction change
Cursor movement nudges the visible image and it drifts back to centre when the pointer leaves
The sequence terminates at the last image and reversing retraces the same passage
adaptable_details: Number of images in the sequence and their spacing in depth
Subject matter of the images and what the accompanying readings represent
Screen corner or edge where the fixed readout sits, and its typographic treatment
Haze density, resting luminance of the surround, depth falloff curve and how quickly the ambient tint interpolates
Easing stiffness and how long motion takes to settle
Magnitude of the speed-driven tilt, swell and luminance lift
Ribbon thickness, accent hue, glow strength and spark count
Strength of the cursor nudge and how quickly it recentres
Whether travel is driven by wheel, vertical drag or both
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits a small, ordered set of visually strong single images each carrying a short set of identifying details, presented as the main full-view experience where one-at-a-time contemplation is the point. Because the ambient tint is sampled from the active image and the ribbon needs only one distinct accent, it drops into a light or dark host surround without carrying a scheme with it. It stops being this Skill if items must be compared side by side, if the set grows large enough to need scanning, searching or an overview index, if each entry carries substantial text or interactive content that must stay readable, or if the depth axis is replaced by flat lateral paging — any of which produces a different, non-immersive browsing experience.

name: curved_drag_field_with_center_focus
description: One continuous field of product photos that assembles itself on arrival, bows away toward the edges so the middle reads nearest, follows the pointer with a slight lean when dragged, springs back at its outer limits, and brings a clicked pair to the centre in close-up with its name and price while the rest fades back.

canonical_document.name: curved_drag_field_with_center_focus
canonical_document.description: One continuous field of product photos that assembles itself on arrival, bows away toward the edges so the middle reads nearest, follows the pointer with a slight lean when dragged, springs back at its outer limits, and brings a clicked pair to the centre in close-up with its name and price while the rest fades back.
canonical_document.experience_scope: Whole-view experience: begins as the view loads and the items stream into place, continues for the entire browsing session as a single roamable field, and contains the focus state as an in-place mode rather than a separate page. It ends only when the visitor leaves the view; the focus mode begins on item selection and ends on release, always returning to the same field.
content_and_composition: Many uniform image tiles of the same content type (product shots) arranged in one continuous field that extends well beyond the visible frame in more than one direction, so edges of the collection are not visible at rest

A single shared spatial treatment across the whole field: it bows gently away toward its periphery so items near the centre of the view read as nearest and largest-feeling, and peripheral items read as receding
One optional focused item at a time, occupying the centre of the view at a noticeably larger scale than any field tile
A small text group bound to the focused item only: a name line and a price line, legible against the quieted field
A small dismiss mark associated with the focused item, present only while an item is focused
The field itself persists behind the focused item at all times, quieted or receded rather than replaced
experience_progression: Arrival: tiles stream into their positions and settle into the continuous curved field, immediately implying more content beyond the frame
Open browsing: the visitor drags the whole field around freely with no fixed start or end, the centre continuously changing
Focus: a chosen item travels to the centre, the view closes in on it, it enlarges with a brief light sweep across the photo, and its name and price appear while surrounding items fade back
Release: the item returns to the field and the view pulls back out to the centred full field, resuming open browsing at the same continuous state
attention_and_information_flow: At rest attention is spread evenly across many items, with the curvature giving mild priority to whatever sits in the middle of the view
During dragging attention follows the direction of travel; the lean and edge spring communicate movement and limits without any separate indicator
On focus attention collapses to a single item: it is the only high-contrast, sharp, large element while everything else recedes in prominence
Text information appears only in the focused state, so names and prices are never competing across the field
On release attention widens back to the whole field and the item's text disappears

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Runs once on arrival; the settled field is the resting state the experience always returns to
interaction_model.state_change: From absent to settled in their field positions
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Tiles stream into place and come to rest as one continuous field that visibly overflows the frame
interaction_model.input: View load / arrival
interaction_model.affected_object: All field tiles

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Release ends the drag and the field settles; motion can be interrupted and re-grabbed at any moment without losing position
interaction_model.state_change: From resting to being carried with the pointer in any direction
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The entire field translates with the pointer and leans slightly in the direction of travel; the lean settles out when motion stops
interaction_model.input: Press and drag anywhere on the view
interaction_model.affected_object: The whole field as a single body

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Self-correcting boundary: releasing at the edge always returns the field inside its limits
interaction_model.state_change: From free movement to resisted overshoot, then back inside bounds
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Movement becomes progressively harder past the edge and the field springs back so no empty space is left exposed
interaction_model.input: Drag beyond the outer limits of the field
interaction_model.affected_object: The whole field

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Protects browsing from accidental focus; a deliberate click still focuses normally
interaction_model.state_change: No selection occurs; remains browsing
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The field moves slightly and nothing is focused
interaction_model.input: Very small drag movement
interaction_model.affected_object: Selection state

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Reversible at any time; the field's position is preserved underneath so browsing resumes exactly where it was
interaction_model.state_change: From open browsing to focused mode on one item
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The item glides to the centre, the view closes in, the item enlarges with a brief light sweep across the photo, its name and price appear, and the rest of the field fades back
interaction_model.input: Click on a field item
interaction_model.affected_object: That item, its text group, and all surrounding items

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Two equivalent release affordances; either returns to the same browsing state
interaction_model.state_change: From focused mode back to open browsing
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The item shrinks back into the field, its name and price disappear, the surrounding items return to full prominence and the view pulls back out to the centred full field
interaction_model.input: Click the focused item again, or its small dismiss mark
interaction_model.affected_object: Focused item and field

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Focus never traps the visitor; any intent to browse dissolves the focused state without an extra dismiss step
interaction_model.state_change: Focus released and dragging begins in the same gesture
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The focused item returns to the field, its text disappears, the view pulls back out and the field immediately follows the pointer
interaction_model.input: Starting a new drag while an item is focused
interaction_model.affected_object: Focused item and field

experience_qualities: Calm, weightless and spacious
Continuous and boundless while browsing, with limits felt only as gentle resistance
Physical and responsive: the field feels like one body that leans, glides and settles
Depth without clutter, produced by the outward bowing rather than by decoration
Instant, unceremonious return from inspection to browsing
completion_and_return: Browsing has no completion state; it is an open loop the visitor leaves and re-enters
Focused mode always resolves back to the centred full field, never to a different view or destination
Field position and scroll state persist across focus and release so the visitor is never relocated
Only one item can be focused at a time; focusing another replaces rather than stacks
locked_observable_requirements: The item field must read as one continuous surface that clearly extends beyond the viewport in more than one direction
Items must recede toward the periphery so the middle of the view always reads as nearest
Dragging anywhere must carry the whole field with the pointer and include a slight lean in the direction of travel
Overshoot past the outer limits must resist and spring back
A tiny drag must never be interpreted as a selection
Selection must move the chosen item to the centre, close in, enlarge it, sweep a brief light across the photo, and reveal its name and price
Surrounding items must visibly quiet down while one item is focused, and the field must remain present rather than be replaced
Release must be possible by re-clicking the item, by a small dismiss mark, and by simply starting a new drag, and must pull back out to the centred full field
adaptable_details: Number of items, tile aspect ratio and field density
Strength of the outward bowing and of the drag lean
Timing and easing of the arrival stream-in, the close-in and the pull-back
Direction, speed and luminance of the light sweep across the focused image
Placement, typography and styling of the name and price lines and of the dismiss mark
How strongly the surrounding field is quieted (reduced contrast, softening or shrinking back)
Colour scheme, surround tone and the specific two facts shown alongside the name
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits any large collection of visually similar, image-first entries where each entry has a short identifying label and one or two supporting facts, and where browsing is meant to feel open-ended rather than paginated or ranked. It stops being this Skill if the field is bounded to a single screen or a one-axis strip, if the surface is flat with no peripheral recession, if selection navigates away to a separate detail view instead of promoting the item in place, or if items carry long text or unequal weighting that requires reading order rather than free roaming.

name: momentum_glide_horizontal_frame_procession
description: Framed pictures move as one long sideways band that keeps easing toward wherever the user's gesture pointed, emphasising each frame as it crosses the centre while the picture inside each frame drifts against the travel for inner depth, and stopping firmly at the two ends of the collection.

canonical_document.name: momentum_glide_horizontal_frame_procession
canonical_document.description: Framed pictures move as one long sideways band that keeps easing toward wherever the user's gesture pointed, emphasising each frame as it crosses the centre while the picture inside each frame drifts against the travel for inner depth, and stopping firmly at the two ends of the collection.
canonical_document.experience_scope: A whole-view foreground experience for one collection: it begins with a brief still hold before any travel is possible and ends only at the collection's first or last item, which act as hard stops; there is no exit state or separate detail view, the band remains the entire experience region for as long as the view is present.
content_and_composition: One ordered set of visual items, small enough that each item can hold attention individually
Each item sits inside its own fixed frame; frames are laid out along a single horizontal line as one continuous band, not paginated groups
Two layers per item: the outer frame, which holds its place in the band's layout, and the inner picture, which can shift independently within the frame

The centre of the view acts as a persistent emphasis position that no element occupies permanently; items pass through it
First and last items are the visible boundaries of the composition

Continuous bidirectional travel along the band, advancing or retreating according to accumulated input, with no fixed number of stages

Only one frame is the focus at a time, while its neighbours stay partly visible as context for what came before and what comes next

interaction_model.input: Vertical wheel or trackpad scroll gesture

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: A fresh gesture mid-glide immediately redirects travel to a new destination without waiting for the current settle to finish; otherwise the band comes to rest on its own
interaction_model.state_change: Travel continues autonomously, easing toward the pending destination and gradually settling
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Motion carries on smoothly after the user's hand stops, slowing into a rest position rather than halting at once
interaction_model.input: End of the gesture, with the band still short of its destination
interaction_model.affected_object: Band position

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Gesturing back releases the hold instantly and retraces the way in, with no lag or accumulated overshoot to unwind first
interaction_model.state_change: Destination is held at the boundary instead of extending past it
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The band stays put at the extremity, giving a firm sense of having reached the end of the collection
interaction_model.input: Continued gesturing while already at the first or last item
interaction_model.affected_object: Band position and its travel destination

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Offsets follow position continuously, so they resolve automatically whenever motion stops and never persist as a misalignment
interaction_model.state_change: Each inner picture is offset within its frame, counter to the travel direction, by an amount tied to that frame's distance from the centre of the view
interaction_model.visible_feedback: A subtle sense of depth inside every frame: pictures appear to lag slightly behind their frames, most visibly at the edges of the view and least at the centre
interaction_model.input: Band motion itself, as an autonomous driver of inner content
interaction_model.affected_object: The picture inside each fixed frame

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Travel remains bounded at the recomputed first and last positions; interaction continues uninterrupted
interaction_model.state_change: Frames and the end limits are refitted to the new viewport while the current place in the collection is retained

Continuous and journey-like, reading as one long band instead of separate screens
Contemplative, giving each item a moment of undivided attention at the centre
Quietly dimensional, with depth felt inside frames rather than through pronounced 3D staging
Responsive, since a new gesture takes over instantly even mid-motion
Bounded and reassuring, with unmistakable start and end of the collection
completion_and_return: No completion or dismissal: the experience persists and remains navigable in both directions for as long as the view is shown
Reaching either end is a stable resting state, not a wrap-around or a transition to something else
Returning over already-seen items is a first-class direction of travel with identical presentation
Position is retained across viewport changes rather than reset
locked_observable_requirements: All items form one continuous horizontally travelling band; no paged or screen-by-screen advance
Vertical wheel and trackpad gestures drive horizontal travel
Input accumulates a destination that the band keeps easing toward after the gesture stops
A new gesture during motion immediately redirects travel
Emphasis is tied to a frame's proximity to the centre of the view, rising on approach and releasing on departure
The picture inside each fixed frame is offset opposite to the travel direction, scaled by that frame's distance from the centre

adaptable_details: Number of items, and their aspect ratio, frame proportions and spacing
Visual styling of frames, borders, shadows and backdrop
Exact easing curve, glide duration and perceived weight
Magnitude of the inner counter-offset and the falloff toward the centre
How centre emphasis is expressed, such as scale, brightness, contrast or accompanying captions
Length of the opening hold
Presence of supplementary labels, captions or progress hints
Additional input methods layered alongside wheel and trackpad gestures
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits ordered sets of self-contained visual pieces small enough that each deserves individual attention as the main content of a view. Adding wrap-around looping, snapping to discrete positions, an infinite or generated feed, or replacing the single travelling band with a grid, stack or per-item full-screen detail mode would create a different Skill, as would removing the counter-drift depth inside frames or the centre-proximity emphasis, since those define its character.

canonical_document.name: endless_curved_media_wall_around_refractive_core
canonical_document.description: Images tile into one continuous curved wall wrapping a translucent glass form at the center; scrolling slides the wall vertically while spinning it, images distort as they pass behind the glass, and stopping eases into a slow endless drift.
canonical_document.experience_scope: Whole-view experience occupying the entire visit; it begins with a brief load-in and never ends, with no exit, no separate detail view, and no return path.
content_and_composition: One continuous wall of images, seamlessly tiled so no start, end or seam is visible; the wall is curved so it surrounds the viewpoint
A single translucent glass form fixed at the center of the view, in front of the far side of the wall and behind the near side, so images pass behind it
A recessive, low-distraction environment behind and between the images, held at a clearly separated luminance from the imagery so it reads as ambient space rather than a page background
A small soft marker replacing the standard pointer, persistent for the whole view
One transient per-image name label positioned beside the marker, present only while an image is pointed at

experience_progression: Brief load-in resolves into the assembled wall and centered glass form

attention_and_information_flow: Attention is carried by motion: whichever images are near the center and passing the glass form dominate, while others read as peripheral texture

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Reversing scroll direction reverses the rotation direction; travel is unbounded so continued scrolling never hits a limit, edge or visible seam
interaction_model.state_change: Wall translates vertically and simultaneously rotates about its central axis; scroll direction sets the rotation direction

interaction_model.input: Scroll step (wheel, trackpad or equivalent continuous scroll gesture)
interaction_model.affected_object: The whole curved image wall

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Any new scroll re-engages driven motion from the current drift without a stop or restart
interaction_model.state_change: Momentum eases out into a slow steady baseline drift instead of halting
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Motion decays smoothly and settles into perpetual gentle movement in the last-used direction
interaction_model.input: Scroll stops
interaction_model.affected_object: Wall motion

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Moving away restores full rotation speed and clears the name; hovering a different image swaps the name without interrupting motion
interaction_model.state_change: Rotation slows while the pointer remains on the image; that image's name becomes visible beside the marker
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Name appears next to the soft marker and follows it with a soft trailing lag; overall spin visibly eases; the ambient surround leans gently toward the marker
interaction_model.input: Pointing at an image
interaction_model.affected_object: Rotation speed, the pointed image's name label, ambient lighting

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Marker and ambient lean persist for the whole view; no dismissal or reset state
interaction_model.state_change: Marker position updates; ambient emphasis shifts toward it
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Small soft marker tracks the pointer while the recessive surround takes on a subtle localized illumination shift in its direction
interaction_model.input: Pointer movement anywhere in the view
interaction_model.affected_object: Soft pointer marker and ambient environment

experience_qualities: Weightless and endless, with no beginning, end or empty state
Atmospheric and recessive, with the imagery carrying the only visually strong material against a quiet surround
Continuous and uninterrupted; nothing to enter, exit or come back from
Effortless settling: focus is achieved by slowing rather than stopping
Quietly informative, with names stated softly rather than displayed persistently
completion_and_return: No completion state; the experience loops perpetually through the tiled wall
Idle state is slow drift rather than a stopped or reset state
No navigation away, no detail view and no restored prior state; the visit remains one view
locked_observable_requirements: Images form one continuous curved wall that surrounds the viewpoint, with no visible start, end or seam
A translucent form sits at the center and visibly distorts images passing behind it
Scroll simultaneously drives vertical sliding and axial rotation, with direction of scroll setting rotation direction
Stopping input eases into a persistent slow drift rather than a halt
Travel is unbounded in both directions and never reaches a limit or empty region
Pointing at an image reveals only that image's name beside the pointer with trailing lag and slows rotation; leaving restores speed and clears the name
The default cursor is replaced by a small soft marker and the recessive surround's illumination leans toward it
Single uninterrupted view with no exit or return affordance
adaptable_details: Number of distinct images and how densely the wall is tiled
Curvature radius, wall height and apparent distance from the viewpoint
Shape and degree of translucency or distortion of the central form
Drift speed, easing durations, hover slow-down amount and label lag amount
Label typography and offset from the marker
Marker size, softness, the surround's overall luminance level and the intensity of the ambient lean
Character of the brief load-in
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits small to moderate sets of visually strong still imagery presented for atmospheric browsing, where per-item identity is a short name and no other metadata or action is needed. Introducing item selection that opens a detail view, ordered narrative sequencing, text-heavy or mixed-media items, a bounded finite track with visible ends, or removing either the enveloping curved wall or the central refractive form would create a different Skill.

name: opposed_wave_columns_with_centred_focus_image
description: Full-screen run of paired names split into two side columns that glide horizontally in opposite directions along an undulating path as you scroll, while the single pairing nearest the vertical centre rises to peak contrast against a quiet uniform surround and drives a large centre image.

canonical_document.name: opposed_wave_columns_with_centred_focus_image
canonical_document.description: Full-screen run of paired names split into two side columns that glide horizontally in opposite directions along an undulating path as you scroll, while the single pairing nearest the vertical centre rises to peak contrast against a quiet uniform surround and drives a large centre image.
canonical_document.experience_scope: A whole-view experience occupying the full viewport over one uniform low-distraction surround. It begins with a brief loading beat on a near-empty screen, continues for the entire length of the scrollable run, and ends when the last entry has passed and the view resolves into quiet empty space; the same view is re-traversable by scrolling back.
content_and_composition: One long ordered sequence of paired text entries; each entry has two text parts and one associated image.
Left region: a vertical stack of one text part per entry; right region: the vertical stack of the matching second text part, aligned row-by-row with the left so each row reads as one pairing.
Centre region: a single large image layer, positioned at the middle of the screen, holding exactly one image at a time — the image belonging to the currently focused pairing.
A single uniform, low-distraction backdrop tone held constant as the substrate for all layers, of unspecified luminance and polarity; no competing decorative content.
Two salience states for text: a recessive but still legible state for all non-focused entries, and a peak-contrast state for the single focused pairing.
Both text columns follow a shared undulating horizontal path, so rows are staggered rather than flush, producing a wave-shaped edge down the run.
Trailing empty space after the final entry, and equivalent breathing room allowing the first entry to reach the centre.
experience_progression: Stage 1 — quiet open: a near-empty screen holds for a short loading beat with no content competing for attention.
Stage 2 — arrival in motion: entries appear already moving rather than snapping into a settled layout, so the run reads as continuous from the first moment.
Stage 3 — continuous traversal: scroll advances the run; text columns sweep in opposite directions, focus passes from one pairing to the next, and the centre image swaps in step.
Stage 4 — resolution: after the last entry the view empties into quiet unoccupied space, signalling the run is finished.
Reverse traversal: scrolling back re-runs the sweep in the opposite direction and steps focus and centre image back through earlier entries.
attention_and_information_flow: Attention is always resolved to exactly one pairing; ambiguity is avoided because only one entry carries peak contrast at any moment.
Contrast does the selecting: surrounding entries stay legible but recessive, forming a moving context around the high-salience focus.
Vertical middle of the screen is the fixed focus zone — proximity to it, not click or hover, determines prominence.
The centre image gives the focused pairing its largest, most detailed representation, so text and picture reinforce one another.
Peripheral motion communicates position within the run and its length without a numeric indicator.
The emptied ending removes all competing signals so completion is unmistakable.

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Fully bidirectional and continuous; direction reverses immediately with scroll direction and the sweep unwinds symmetrically
interaction_model.state_change: Scroll position advances or rewinds continuously with weighted smoothing rather than discrete per-row jumps
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Both columns travel along the undulating path — one side sliding one way horizontally, the other side the opposite way — while the stack moves vertically, reading as one coherent rhythmic body
interaction_model.input: Vertical scrolling (wheel, trackpad, touch drag or equivalent)
interaction_model.affected_object: The whole run of paired text columns

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Focus follows position exactly, so reversing scroll restores the previous focus and image; no separate dismissal is needed
interaction_model.state_change: Focus transfers from the previous pairing to the new nearest-to-centre pairing
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The newly focused pairing shifts from its recessive state to peak contrast while the previous one recedes again; the centre image switches to the new entry's picture and holds at the middle of the screen while everything else continues moving
interaction_model.input: Change of scroll position bringing a different pairing nearest the vertical middle
interaction_model.affected_object: Focused pairing text and the centre image layer

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Resting mid-run is a valid state; resuming scroll picks up smoothly from the resting position without a jump
interaction_model.state_change: Motion decays to rest instead of terminating abruptly or snapping to an aligned row
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Lines ease gradually to a stop, holding whatever intermediate position and salience level they had settled toward
interaction_model.input: Stopping or releasing the scroll input mid-motion
interaction_model.affected_object: The moving text columns and their horizontal sweep

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Boundaries are hard stops rather than wraps; scrolling back from the end returns to the run and re-highlights earlier entries, making revisiting easy
interaction_model.state_change: Run reaches its boundary with the terminal entry still able to occupy the focus zone
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The first and last pairings can each be brought to full peak contrast at the vertical middle with their image centred; past the last entry the view opens into quiet unoccupied space
interaction_model.input: Scrolling to the extreme start or extreme end of the run
interaction_model.affected_object: First and last entries and the surrounding empty space

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: The opening beat is brief and one-time; scrolling during or right after it continues into normal traversal
interaction_model.state_change: Transition from near-empty holding state into the populated moving run
interaction_model.visible_feedback: A short quiet beat on the near-empty screen, then entries present themselves already in motion
interaction_model.input: Initial page open (autonomous driver)
interaction_model.affected_object: Whole view

experience_qualities: Rhythmic and continuous — the run reads as one living body rather than a set of separate rows
Weighted and inertial, with smoothed acceleration and gradual settling instead of stepwise snapping
Quiet and high-contrast, with peak salience reserved for the single focus
Unambiguous focus: exactly one entry is ever the subject
Editorial and typographic rather than decorative
Calm resolution at the end rather than an abrupt cut-off
completion_and_return: Completion is expressed spatially: after the final entry the view resolves into quiet unoccupied space with no remaining content.
No looping or wrapping — the run has a definite start and end.
Reverse scrolling fully re-traverses the run, restoring the earlier sweep positions, highlights and centre images in order.
Both terminal entries remain reachable at full centre focus, so the run can be revisited from either extreme.
Resting position persists when input stops; nothing auto-advances or resets on its own.
locked_observable_requirements: Two text columns on opposite sides, row-aligned so each row is one readable pairing.
The two columns slide horizontally in opposite directions as scroll position changes.
Column motion follows an undulating, wave-shaped path rather than straight rigid rows.
Exactly one pairing is highlighted at a time, determined by proximity to the vertical middle of the screen.
Highlight is expressed as a clear step up in contrast against the backdrop, from a recessive-but-legible state to the run's peak-contrast state, with all other entries held recessive.
A single large image sits at the middle of the screen and always shows the focused entry's picture, swapping as focus changes while holding its centre position.
Scroll motion is weighted and smoothed, continuous rather than jumping line by line, and eases to rest when input stops.
Scrolling backwards reverses the sweep and steps highlight and image back through earlier entries.
The run ends in quiet empty space, and the first and last entries can each be brought fully to the centre.
One uniform, low-distraction backdrop held throughout, opening with a short quiet beat before entries arrive already in motion.
adaptable_details: Number of entries in the run, provided it is long enough to feel continuous
Exact wave amplitude, wavelength and horizontal travel distance
Typeface, text scale and relative weight of the two paired text parts
Which text part occupies which side
Image shape, size and aspect within the centre slot, and the manner of the image swap
Precise smoothing strength, easing curves and settling duration
Exact backdrop luminance and polarity and the specific recessive and focus values, as long as the contrast gap stays clear and non-focused text stays readable
Duration and treatment of the opening beat
Amount of trailing empty space at the end
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits any long ordered set of two-part text entries where each entry has one representative image and each deserves a solo moment — name-plus-title listings, catalogue-style runs, credits, indexes or collections. It needs enough entries for continuous motion to read as rhythm, short text parts that survive horizontal drift, and one image per entry. It would become a different Skill if focus were chosen by click or hover instead of centre proximity, if multiple entries were highlighted or multiple images shown at once, if the columns moved together instead of in opposition, if the motion snapped row-to-row instead of flowing with weight, or if the sequence looped endlessly instead of resolving into empty space.

name: turnable_leaf_photo_album

canonical_document.name: turnable_leaf_photo_album
canonical_document.description: A closed photo album stands centred on a full-bleed photographic backdrop with two oversized words spread behind it; clicking a leaf swings it open around its inner edge to reveal the picture on its reverse plus the next one beneath, while the album glides sideways so the open spread stays centred, and a click off the album unhurriedly closes every turned leaf.

Full-bleed photographic backdrop filling the entire view behind everything

Two oversized words placed behind the album, spread wide so the album sits between and in front of them; they stay separated enough from the backdrop to remain readable and are partly occluded by the album

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Reversible at any point, including mid-turn, in either direction
interaction_model.state_change: Leaf returns from open to closed and the album shifts back toward its previous balance
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Leaf swings back onto the stack, the picture it revealed is covered again, the album glides back so the visible spread stays centred

interaction_model.state_change: Leaf signals that it is actionable

adaptable_details: Number of leaves and pictures, as long as the set stays small

canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits any small, finite, self-contained set of images or image-like panels worth viewing one at a time as the main attraction of a view, with a strong background image and a couple of large words as support, under any palette or luminance range that keeps the album dominant and the words readable. It stops being this Skill if the collection grows to a browsable many-item library, if images are shown side by side as a grid or wall, if the leaves stop pivoting on an inner edge and become sliding cards or a carousel, if the album no longer shifts to keep the open spread centred, if the reverse-face plus next-picture-beneath reveal is dropped, or if the off-object click no longer performs a single obvious return to the closed state.
