canonical_document.description: You are placed inside an edgeless field of images spread across depth: whatever is near reads sharply against a plain, uniform ground while everything further away loses contrast until it dissolves into that same empty ground, and dragging, zooming or keys glide the whole surrounding calmly past you with no beginning, end or stopping point.
canonical_document.experience_scope: Whole-view experience filling the entire viewport. It begins with a quiet waiting moment on the bare uniform ground that shows how much of the collection is ready, opens into the surrounding field once ready, and then never terminates: there is no exit state, final item or completed condition.
content_and_composition: One dominant content role: many visually similar image items of a single kind, all treated as equal peers with no featured, first or last item
Items are distributed across an unbounded plane and across depth, so the same view mixes near large items with progressively smaller, further ones
The empty uniform ground acts both as background and as atmospheric veil: distance is expressed as items losing contrast until they match the ground exactly, rather than as shrinking alone
No visible edges, boundary frames, pagination, page counters or scroll rails; nothing indicates a container the content sits inside
Interface is stripped to almost nothing: the cursor is effectively the only persistent element on screen
Before the field exists, the same empty ground holds a single quiet readiness indication expressing how much of the collection is prepared
experience_progression: Stage 1: quiet hold on the bare uniform ground that communicates how much is ready, with nothing of the collection yet visible
Stage 2: the field appears already surrounding the visitor rather than arriving as a page in front of them
Stage 3: continuous open-ended travel with no target, checkpoint or completion; every move simply reveals more of the same continuing field
The field wraps or continues indefinitely in every direction, so travelling far never produces an edge, empty region or terminal item
attention_and_information_flow: Prominence is set purely by proximity: the nearest items are sharp and clearly separated from the ground, everything beyond loses definition until it is indistinguishable from the empty ground
Because motion constantly changes what is nearest, attention repeatedly resettles rather than being held on one fixed focal point
Moving closer narrows breadth and raises detail on a few items; moving away widens breadth and trades individual legibility for a sense of quantity
No labels, counts or progress readouts compete with the images during exploration

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: A new press interrupts the glide and takes over immediately; direction can be reversed at any moment; motion always resolves to rest
interaction_model.state_change: Field position follows the cursor one-to-one while held, then continues on released momentum before settling
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The surroundings travel with the cursor; on release a short glide eases smoothly to rest instead of halting abruptly
interaction_model.input: Press and pull (pointer drag)
interaction_model.affected_object: The entire surrounding field of items

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Travelling past the intended depth range is undone by reversing the same gesture; no error or hard block is shown
interaction_model.state_change: Nearest works are drawn closer or pushed back toward the distance
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Near items grow and sharpen as they approach, or shrink and fade into the uniform ground as they recede, changing how many items are legible at once
interaction_model.input: Scroll or pinch
interaction_model.affected_object: Depth relationship between the visitor and the nearest items

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Releasing keys lets motion ease to rest; opposite keys reverse; keyboard and pointer can alternate without conflict
interaction_model.state_change: Equivalent lateral travel and depth change to pointer input
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The same gliding, eased movement seen with dragging and zooming, so keyboard travel is indistinguishable in feel
interaction_model.input: Letter and arrow key presses
interaction_model.affected_object: The same field position and depth

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: The drift is bounded and settles as the cursor settles; it never accumulates into unintended travel
interaction_model.state_change: Slight viewpoint offset that tracks cursor position, scaled by current depth
interaction_model.visible_feedback: A gentle drift of the surroundings that is more noticeable when far out and barely perceptible when close in, making the space feel responsive while idle
interaction_model.input: Cursor movement with nothing pressed
interaction_model.affected_object: Vantage point of the whole view

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: The cap holds regardless of input intensity or how many inputs combine
interaction_model.state_change: Speed rises only up to a fixed ceiling
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Motion never becomes fast enough to blur into chaos or feel like it has escaped control
interaction_model.input: Any sustained or repeated input
interaction_model.affected_object: Travel speed

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Returns to the grabbable reading the moment the press ends, including when a glide is still in progress
interaction_model.state_change: Idle state versus held state
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The cursor reads as grabbable while idle and as gripped while held, signalling that the whole surrounding is the draggable object
interaction_model.input: Pointer press and release over the field
interaction_model.affected_object: Cursor appearance

experience_qualities: Weightless and unhurried; nothing snaps, jolts or stops dead
Immediately understandable: one gesture explains the whole space
Calm and quiet, with emptiness doing as much work as the imagery
Endlessly continuable rather than finishable, with no sense of progress or remaining amount
Being inside the collection rather than looking at a presentation of it
completion_and_return: No completion, end screen or exhausted state exists
All motion resolves by easing to rest wherever the visitor stopped, and that resting position simply becomes the new vantage point
Overshoot in depth is self-correcting through the opposite gesture rather than through a snap-back
The opening quiet hold on the bare ground occurs once at entry and is not returned to during exploration
locked_observable_requirements: Edgeless continuation in all directions with no first or last item, no pagination and no visible container boundary

Distance expressed as a progressive loss of contrast until far items resolve exactly to the empty ground and become indistinguishable from it, while near items stay sharp and clearly separated from that ground
Whole surrounding moves with the cursor while pressed, and release produces a short eased glide rather than an instant stop
Scroll/pinch changes depth of the nearest items, and overshoot is undone by reversing the same gesture
Keyboard input produces the same movements with the same feel as pointer input
Idle cursor movement causes a slight vantage shift whose magnitude grows when far out and shrinks when close in
A hard ceiling on travel speed at all times
Cursor reads grabbable when idle and gripped while held
Entry is preceded by a quiet hold on that same empty ground that conveys how much of the collection is ready before any item appears
adaptable_details: Subject matter, era and palette of the imagery
Item density, size variation and distribution pattern across the field
Exact glide duration, easing curve, depth range and speed ceiling values
Visual form of the readiness indication during the opening hold
Which single flat ground value the fade resolves to, and how far away that fade into emptiness completes
Whether pinch, wheel or both are offered on a given device
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits large sets of homogeneous, self-explanatory visual items that are meant to be wandered through without ranking or reading order, presented as a full-view destination with minimal surrounding interface, over any single uniform ground value that near items can read clearly against. It stops being this Skill if the content requires an ordered sequence, text-heavy items or a defined start and finish, if visible edges, pages or a bounded canvas are introduced, if abrupt stops replace eased glides, if the ground becomes patterned or non-uniform so distance can no longer be read as dissolution into it, or if the field is demoted to a decorative substrate behind foreground content.

name: tile_zoom_out_pattern_reveal
description: A two-value dot-pattern rendering of one photo, built from two clearly separated tones in any hue pairing or polarity, opens so close that only a few tiles and their edges fill the frame as pure texture, then widens at an unhurried cinematic pace until the whole picture reads clearly, with pause, manual framing sweep, restart and instant style swapping at the held framing.

canonical_document.name: tile_zoom_out_pattern_reveal
canonical_document.description: A two-value dot-pattern rendering of one photo, built from two clearly separated tones in any hue pairing or polarity, opens so close that only a few tiles and their edges fill the frame as pure texture, then widens at an unhurried cinematic pace until the whole picture reads clearly, with pause, manual framing sweep, restart and instant style swapping at the held framing.
canonical_document.experience_scope: A self-contained whole-frame viewing stage with its own controls. It begins at the extreme tile-level opening framing and ends when the framing settles on the complete image with a short explanation shown; it can be restarted to the opening framing and remains a single region that could be embedded as the dominant element of a page rather than a whole multi-section page.
content_and_composition: One converted image as the sole foreground subject; there is no competing content inside the frame
The image material is a pattern of discrete tiles/dots reduced to two clearly separated tone values, whose individual cells and edges are visible at close framing and merge into tone at wide framing
Opening composition shows only single tiles and their boundaries, reading as abstract texture with no recognizable subject
Settled composition shows the full picture inside the frame, calm and legible, paired with one short plain-language explanation of what was just shown
Persistent controls sit outside the image: a single pause/resume control that becomes a restart control, a draggable zoom/framing control, and a small set of selectable pattern styles
The zoom control doubles as a position indicator, so the current framing is always readable
experience_progression: Stage 1 — abstract opening: framing is at its tightest, only individual tiles and their edges occupy the frame; the subject is unreadable

Stage 2 — continuous widening: framing pulls back smoothly and unhurriedly, no cuts or snaps, attention moving from single tiles to clusters of tiles to overall shapes as the pattern's logic becomes apparent
Stage 3 — level out and settle: the outward motion eases to a stop on the complete image and holds there
Stage 4 — explanation: a short plain description accompanies the settled image
Restart returns to Stage 1 and replays the same ordered advance
attention_and_information_flow: Prominence starts on material and texture: grain, cell shape and edges, with no semantic content available
As framing widens, local cells lose individual prominence and grouped tone gains it, producing a recognition moment when the subject resolves
Information is revealed monotonically: how the pattern is built is understood first, what it depicts second
At settle, attention shifts from motion to the still image and then to the short explanatory line, which lands only after the visual point has been made
Controls stay quiet during playback and become the focus of attention only once the viewer chooses to hold, sweep or compare

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: The advance is bounded at both ends and never overshoots the whole picture; the viewer can interrupt at any moment with the pause control
interaction_model.state_change: Framing advances continuously from tightest tile view to whole picture, then levels out and stops
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Slow, even outward widening of the frame with the tile grid growing denser and the subject emerging; the zoom control's position tracks the framing on its own
interaction_model.input: Autonomous playback driver after the experience opens
interaction_model.affected_object: Framing of the patterned image

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Activating the same control resumes from exactly the held point and pace, so pausing costs no progress
interaction_model.state_change: Motion freezes at exactly the framing currently on screen; framing is held rather than reset
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Motion stops with no jump or snap; the still framing remains on screen and the zoom control settles at that same point and becomes draggable
interaction_model.input: Activating the pause control during playback
interaction_model.affected_object: Playback motion and framing

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Both ends are hard stops: the sweep halts at the tightest tile view and at the whole picture and does not wrap or spring past them; releasing leaves the framing exactly where it was left
interaction_model.state_change: Framing sweeps smoothly in either direction anywhere between the tightest tile view and the whole picture
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Continuous zoom that follows the drag in real time, tiles enlarging or condensing under the cursor's control with no stepping
interaction_model.input: Dragging the zoom control while motion is held still
interaction_model.affected_object: Framing of the patterned image

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Manual control is regained immediately by pausing; no input is lost or queued
interaction_model.state_change: Control is locked to the automatic framing and refuses manual input
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The control visibly moves on its own in step with the reveal and does not respond to dragging, making the reveal read as authored rather than fought over
interaction_model.input: Attempting to use the zoom control during playback
interaction_model.affected_object: Zoom control

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Styles can be switched back and forth freely; position is never lost, and switching during playback does not restart or interrupt the reveal
interaction_model.state_change: Tiles re-form in the newly chosen style while the current framing and playback state are preserved
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The pattern changes in place immediately at the same framing, so the same tiles and region can be compared style to style without the view moving
interaction_model.input: Choosing a different pattern style at any moment
interaction_model.affected_object: Tile rendering of the image

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Restart is repeatable on demand and the chosen pattern style is carried over
interaction_model.state_change: Experience returns to the opening tile-level framing and the reveal plays again
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The same control now reads as a restart; the frame snaps back to abstract texture and the widening begins anew
interaction_model.input: Activating the control after the reveal has finished
interaction_model.affected_object: Whole experience

experience_qualities: Unhurried and cinematic, closer to a slow camera pull-back than a UI transition
Abstract at first and calmly legible at rest, with a distinct click of recognition in between
Tactile and material: the grain and edges of individual cells are meant to be seen up close
Fully interruptible without penalty, so viewers can stop and inspect at any depth
Comparison feels stable and non-disorienting because the viewpoint never shifts when the look changes
completion_and_return: Completion is a settled hold on the whole legible image, not a loop; the motion ends and stays ended
The short explanation persists with the settled image
After completion the primary control offers restart to the opening framing
Held framing persists across pauses, resumes and style changes
Resuming continues from the exact held framing rather than from the start
locked_observable_requirements: Opening framing is tight enough that only single tiles and their edges fill the frame and no subject is recognizable
The reveal is a continuous, monotonic widening at an unhurried pace that eases out and settles rather than cutting or snapping
Recognition happens progressively through the tile → cluster → whole picture ordering

The image material is a discrete tile/dot pattern reduced to exactly two tone values whose separation is strong enough that individual cells are clearly distinguishable at close framing, with no particular hues or luminance direction required
A short plain-language explanation accompanies the settled full image
Pause freezes at exactly the on-screen framing and resume continues from exactly that point
Manual framing sweep is bidirectional and continuous with hard stops at the tightest tile view and the whole picture
The framing control auto-follows and is locked during playback, and becomes manual only while held still
Switching pattern style re-forms the tiles immediately without changing the current framing
After completion the same control restarts from the opening framing
adaptable_details: Number and character of selectable pattern styles
Cell shape, spacing and density of the tiles
Total reveal duration and the exact easing of the level-out
Which of the two tone values carries the cells and which carries the surround, and the hue pairing chosen for them, in either luminance direction
Placement, styling and grouping of the pause, zoom and style controls
Wording of the closing explanation
Subject, aspect ratio and source of the image, including whether it is site-supplied or viewer-supplied
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits a single still image or artwork whose per-cell rendering is interesting up close and readable as a whole, presented as the dominant visual of a page or section with minimal surrounding content. It does not fit text-heavy views, multi-image galleries shown at once, or content whose meaning must be legible immediately. Removing the abstract-to-legible framing advance, driving the framing by page scroll or pointer position instead of authored playback plus a held scrub, or turning it into a narrated pan across several images would each create a different Skill.

name: boundless_drifting_card_depth_field
description: A boundless open expanse filled with small media cards that slowly drift by themselves; distant cards read as soft low-detail haze carrying only the ambient tint of their own imagery, while nearer ones resolve into crisp, readable artwork before passing on, and dragging or scrolling moves the whole field laterally or through depth with no edge to reach.

canonical_document.name: boundless_drifting_card_depth_field
canonical_document.description: A boundless open expanse filled with small media cards that slowly drift by themselves; distant cards read as soft low-detail haze carrying only the ambient tint of their own imagery, while nearer ones resolve into crisp, readable artwork before passing on, and dragging or scrolling moves the whole field laterally or through depth with no edge to reach.
canonical_document.experience_scope: Whole-view experience occupying the full frame from arrival; it has no entry step and no end state, so it begins already in motion when the view appears and continues for as long as the view is present.
content_and_composition: One quiet, empty-feeling backdrop held at a single uniform tone, separated enough in luminance from the items that it reads as open depth rather than a flat surface
Many small media cards distributed through that depth at varying distances, each presenting a single image as its dominant surface with a compact frame that reads as a small self-contained item
Distance layers: far items rendered as soft, low-detail haze tinted only by their own imagery; mid items partially resolved; near items fully legible artwork
No visible boundary, frame edge, container, scrollbar, page end or positional indicator
The field is a single coherent mass: all items share one continuous motion state rather than moving independently of one another
Optional persistent minimal overlay content may sit above the field without competing with it
experience_progression: Arrival: the field is already drifting slowly, so nothing must be triggered or dismissed first
Autonomous drift continues indefinitely whenever the visitor is not driving the field

Per-item cycle repeated endlessly as the field moves: soft haze in the distance carrying only the item's own tint, resolving into legible artwork as it nears, holding legibility briefly at closest range, then sweeping past or out of view
Depth travel: sustained forward input keeps drawing new far items into view and passing near items by; reversed input pulls items back into the distance
No completion stage, milestone or final view exists
attention_and_information_flow: Prominence is governed by depth: nearer items are larger, sharper and more chromatically present and therefore claim attention, while distant items act as ambient low-detail texture
Detail is revealed progressively rather than all at once, so only a few items are legible at any moment
Attention is handed off continuously as one item resolves, holds briefly, then yields to the next arriving item
The uniform low-distraction backdrop suppresses everything except the self-lit items, keeping the visitor's focus inside the field
Absence of edges, counters and progress cues keeps attention on the content rather than on position within a set

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Any user input takes over from the drift; when input ends, the field settles back into the same self-driven drift
interaction_model.state_change: Field moves slowly and continuously on its own
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Items glide gently across and through the scene, so the view is alive on arrival
interaction_model.input: Autonomous idle drift, with no user input
interaction_model.affected_object: The entire field of items

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Reversing pointer direction reverses field motion immediately; releasing lets the field coast and glide to rest; releasing outside the frame still ends the drag cleanly with the same settle, leaving no stuck dragging state
interaction_model.state_change: Field translates with the pointer both sideways and up and down while the press is held
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The whole field follows the pointer with a slight lag behind it, giving a weighted, weightless-glide feel rather than a rigid one-to-one lock
interaction_model.input: Press and move the pointer anywhere over the scene
interaction_model.affected_object: The entire field of items, moved as one mass

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Reversing scroll direction reverses depth motion immediately; continued scrolling in one direction never reaches a stop, end or bounce, and new items keep arriving
interaction_model.state_change: Items travel through depth toward and past the viewer, or recede back into the distance when scrolled the other way
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Approaching items grow and sharpen from haze into legible artwork then sweep past the viewer; receding items shrink, soften and dissolve back into soft haze holding only their own residual tint
interaction_model.input: Scroll input in either direction
interaction_model.affected_object: The depth position of the whole field relative to the viewer

experience_qualities: Calm and unhurried
Weightless and gliding, with motion that trails and settles instead of snapping
Deep and open, like looking into an unbounded expanse with no perceptible surface
Effortless: legible without instructions and with no wrong place to land
Ambient and endless, rewarding idle wandering over goal-seeking
completion_and_return: The experience never completes; it loops perceptually as items cycle from haze to legible to gone
After every interaction the field returns to its baseline autonomous drift rather than to a reset or home position
There is no saved position, end screen or return-to-start affordance; any landing point is a valid resting state
locked_observable_requirements: Open backdrop held at one uniform tone with enough luminance separation from the items to read as depth rather than a flat page
Many small media cards distributed at different depths, each dominated by a single image
Autonomous slow drift already running when the view appears, with no required first action
Depth-linked legibility: far items are soft, low-detail haze, near items resolve into clearly readable artwork, then pass on
Press-and-move anywhere moves the whole field horizontally and vertically as one mass, trailing slightly behind the pointer and gliding to rest on release
Scrolling drives travel through depth toward or away from the viewer
Immediate motion reversal when either input reverses
No edge, end, boundary or stop under continued input in any direction; every direction keeps yielding more items
Drag terminates cleanly even when the pointer is released outside the frame
adaptable_details: Exact drift speed, lag amount and settle duration
Number, density and size distribution of items
Card proportions and framing style, and whether items carry a small caption surface
Which tone and luminance level the backdrop settles on, and how much residual tint the distant haze keeps
How strongly distance blurs, dims or desaturates items
Whether a minimal persistent overlay of foreground content sits above the field
Whether nearing items can be selected or opened for a closer look
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits collections of many visually distinct, self-contained images where the picture itself is the point and items are interchangeable in reading order, and fits placement as a full-view arrival or immersive browse surface. It stops being this Skill if the field gains edges, a fixed item count with a beginning and end, ordered or paginated navigation, a required task or selection before motion, sequential text or narrative content that must be read in order, or if items stop being legibility-graded by depth and instead sit on one flat plane.

name: drifting_arced_image_current
description: Tall bands of pictures sweep in gentle arcs across the entire screen, each drifting at its own pace, all propelled by scrolling; pictures stretch and bow with the force of the gesture and dissolve into a quiet low-contrast surround at every edge, endlessly coming back around.

canonical_document.name: drifting_arced_image_current
canonical_document.description: Tall bands of pictures sweep in gentle arcs across the entire screen, each drifting at its own pace, all propelled by scrolling; pictures stretch and bow with the force of the gesture and dissolve into a quiet low-contrast surround at every edge, endlessly coming back around.
canonical_document.experience_scope: Whole-view experience filling the entire screen from arrival onward; it begins with a brief quiet hold before the bands sweep in and never terminates, since there is no end state, destination or return point within the field.
content_and_composition: Several tall picture bands, each a continuous run of images following its own gently curved path across the full viewport
Bands overlap in depth so some streams read as nearer and others as further away
A quiet, low-contrast surround behind and around the bands, held far enough from the pictures in luminance to read as separate, into which images dissolve at every screen edge
All images carry equal weight: no hero item, caption layer, index or persistent chrome competing with the field
No visible edge markers, ends, counters or position indicators anywhere in the composition
experience_progression: Brief still hold on the empty quiet field while pictures become ready
Bands sweep into place along their arcs, establishing the sense of an already-moving current
Continuous unbounded drift with per-band pacing, which the visitor can accelerate or reverse indefinitely
After a gesture stops, motion coasts and the whole field eases calmly back to rest by itself, then remains available for the next gesture without resetting position
attention_and_information_flow: Attention slides between nearer and further streams because bands travel at different paces rather than as one block
Prominence shifts continuously as images cross the middle of the view and fade toward the edges, so no single picture holds focus for long
Faster gestures pull attention to the deformation and flow of the whole field; coasting returns attention to individual pictures as the stretch relaxes
Absence of first, last or current position keeps the flow ambient rather than goal-directed

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Because the streams wrap around with no first or last item, they can never be pushed past an edge or emptied; there is no boundary to hit and nothing to recover from
interaction_model.state_change: All bands travel along their own lengths, some following the gesture direction and some running counter to it, each at its own rate
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The entire field flows at once with visibly differing band speeds and opposing directions
interaction_model.input: Wheel, trackpad scroll or touch drag anywhere in the view
interaction_model.affected_object: Every picture band simultaneously

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: The stretch relaxes away on its own as the movement coasts down, returning pictures to their undistorted shape
interaction_model.state_change: Each picture stretches and bows in its own direction of travel in proportion to how hard the gesture is
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Pictures visibly elongate and curve while the flow is fast, showing the strength of the gesture
interaction_model.input: Gesture force or velocity
interaction_model.affected_object: Individual pictures within the moving bands

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Reversal is always available and immediate; no lockout, queueing or settling period is required between changes of direction
interaction_model.state_change: Flow direction inverts immediately, with counter-running bands inverting correspondingly
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The current turns around at once and deformation reorients to the new direction of travel
interaction_model.input: Reversing the gesture direction
interaction_model.affected_object: The whole field of bands

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: A new gesture can interrupt the settling at any moment and resume flow from wherever the field currently sits
interaction_model.state_change: Motion decays toward rest and deformation resolves
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The field coasts down and eases calmly to a standstill without snapping to any position
interaction_model.input: Releasing or stopping the gesture (autonomous settling)
interaction_model.affected_object: Band motion and picture deformation

experience_qualities: Dreamy and weightless rather than mechanical
Calm and unhurried, settling by itself instead of stopping abruptly
Physically responsive: gesture force is legible in how far pictures stretch and bow
Layered and depth-suggesting through differing band paces
Boundless, with no sense of arriving at a beginning or an end
completion_and_return: No completion state, destination or return point exists; browsing simply continues or rests
Streams loop seamlessly so leaving one edge means re-entering from another
When gestures cease, the field autonomously eases to rest and holds its current position rather than resetting to an origin
locked_observable_requirements: Multiple tall picture bands following gently curved paths spanning the entire screen
Each band drifts at its own pace, with some bands running counter to the gesture direction
A single scroll or drag gesture drives every band at once; no other interaction is required
Picture stretch and bow scale with gesture force and are oriented along each picture's direction of travel
Deformation relaxes away as motion coasts down
Pictures dissolve into the quiet low-contrast surround at every edge and wrap back around, with no first or last item, no reachable edge and no empty state
Immediate reversal of flow when the gesture reverses
Motion eases to rest autonomously after gestures stop
An initial still hold followed by bands sweeping in along their arcs
adaptable_details: Number of bands and their arc curvature
Relative speeds and which bands run counter to the gesture
Picture aspect ratios, crops and subject matter
Surround luminance level and direction, and the softness or width of the edge dissolve
Magnitude of the stretch and bow, and how quickly it relaxes
Duration of the initial hold and the character of the sweep-in
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits sets of interchangeable, equally weighted images where mood and abundance matter more than any individual item, order or destination. Adding required selection, per-item detail views, ordered sequence, discrete paging, or replacing the endless wrap with a bounded track that can reach a first or last position would produce a different Skill.

name: encircling_image_band_scroll_flight
description: Images wrap into one continuous curved band slowly turning in an empty, unadorned void; scrolling flies the viewpoint from a distant view, over the rim, inside the surrounding band and back out to a wide closing frame, while single mood lines appear and clear and fast scrolling flares thin high-contrast arcs.

canonical_document.name: encircling_image_band_scroll_flight
canonical_document.description: Images wrap into one continuous curved band slowly turning in an empty, unadorned void; scrolling flies the viewpoint from a distant view, over the rim, inside the surrounding band and back out to a wide closing frame, while single mood lines appear and clear and fast scrolling flares thin high-contrast arcs.
canonical_document.experience_scope: Whole-view experience. Begins with a brief quiet hold while imagery prepares, then occupies the full viewport for the entire scroll range and ends on a wide closing frame at the far end of the range; it is the view rather than a component embedded beside other content.
content_and_composition: About a dozen atmospheric images, joined edge to edge into one continuous curved band that reads as a single ring-like surface rather than separate tiles
An empty, weightless surrounding void held at a uniform low-distraction level that separates clearly from the imagery, with no visible ground, horizon or framing furniture
One short tagline visible at a time, positioned as an overlay above the scene with enough separation from the imagery behind it to stay readable
Thin arcs of high contrast against the surround that can appear above and below the band, following its curve
A small looping downward marker persistently signalling that scrolling drives the view
A brief pre-experience quiet hold state shown before the scene settles in
experience_progression: Quiet hold while the imagery prepares, with nothing yet to act on
Settling into the empty void with the band established at a distance as an establishing view
Rising up and over the rim of the band as the viewpoint approaches
Passing inside the band so images fully surround the viewpoint on all sides
Drawing back out to a wide closing frame that presents the whole band again
The band itself turns steadily throughout, independent of which stage is on screen
attention_and_information_flow: Attention starts on the band as a whole object, then narrows to the surface and its imagery when inside, then widens again to the full formation at the close
Exactly one line of text carries the mood at any moment; lines appear and clear at scroll positions rather than accumulating, so text never competes with itself
Speed-triggered arcs briefly draw attention to the band's edges during fast movement and recede so they never dominate a held frame
The scroll marker holds low, constant prominence so the driving input is discoverable without pulling focus from the imagery

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Position is fully determined by scroll offset, so any point can be reached again by returning to that offset
interaction_model.state_change: Scroll position maps to a position along the journey, advancing from distant view toward and inside the band and out to the closing frame, and turns the band
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Continuous change of viewpoint and band orientation matching scroll amount, with no discrete jumps between stages
interaction_model.input: Vertical scrolling downward
interaction_model.affected_object: Viewpoint along its flight path and the turning band

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Reversal is available at any point and requires no reset; forward scrolling resumes from wherever it stopped
interaction_model.state_change: The same journey states are retraced in reverse order

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Purely responsive and self-clearing; repeated fast scrolling re-triggers the flare without any persistent buildup

canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits a modest set of atmospheric, tonally consistent images with a few short mood lines, where the collective impression matters more than individual items, presented as a full-view showcase. It stops being this Skill if items must be individually selected, opened or compared, if per-item titles, captions or metadata must be readable simultaneously, if the collection grows large enough to require browsing or filtering, if the band is broken into separate panels or laid out flat, or if the driver changes from scroll position to autoplay, pointer steering or discrete step navigation.

name: center_focused_endless_image_drift
description: A horizontal run of pictures that arrives out of a quiet waiting state and settles with one image centered and fully clear, its neighbours still readable and everything further out softened away, while the surrounding colour atmosphere carries no hue of its own and instead takes whatever colour the centered picture supplies, and the run glides endlessly under drag, fling and wheel input.

canonical_document.name: center_focused_endless_image_drift
canonical_document.description: A horizontal run of pictures that arrives out of a quiet waiting state and settles with one image centered and fully clear, its neighbours still readable and everything further out softened away, while the surrounding colour atmosphere carries no hue of its own and instead takes whatever colour the centered picture supplies, and the run glides endlessly under drag, fling and wheel input.
canonical_document.experience_scope: A self-contained browsing region that can occupy the whole view: it begins with the pre-arrival waiting state, continues through the arrival and settle, and then has no end point because the run loops without a first or last item. Ends only when the viewer leaves the view.
content_and_composition: One horizontal run of image-like items, around ten, laid out along a single travel axis
Exactly one center slot that holds the current focal item at full clarity and prominence
Immediate neighbouring items on both sides kept clearly readable at reduced prominence
Items further from the center progressively softened away until they no longer compete for attention
A surrounding colour atmosphere layer behind and around the run, holding no palette, theme or luminance level of its own and tinted entirely from the item currently in the center
A quiet waiting presentation shown while the pictures are not yet ready, occupying the same region
The run and the atmosphere layer are persistent; there is no edge, end cap, or first/last marker
experience_progression: Waiting: a quiet, low-activity holding state while the pictures are still being prepared; no browsing is possible
Arrival: the pictures come in and settle into their positions, resolving into the center-focused arrangement
Settled browsing: an open-ended, endlessly loopable state where the viewer moves the run at will and the center focus and derived colour atmosphere update continuously
No terminal stage; travel wraps so the viewer can keep going in either direction indefinitely
attention_and_information_flow: During waiting, attention rests on a single calm holding presentation with nothing to act on
At arrival, attention is pulled to the middle as items settle, landing at once on the centered picture
In the settled state, prominence is a gradient of distance from the center: the center reads fully, neighbours read enough to invite travel, outer items read only as atmosphere and continuation
As the run moves, focus transfers continuously from item to item; whichever item reaches the middle becomes the subject and re-tints the surrounding atmosphere from its own colour

The derived atmosphere stays low-distraction and reinforces rather than competes, keeping the centered picture the most salient thing in the view and giving the impression that the whole view belongs to it

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Direction can be changed within the same drag; there is no edge to run into, so travel never resists or stops at a boundary; releasing hands off to the glide
interaction_model.state_change: The run tracks the pointer one-to-one along the travel axis; center, neighbour and softened roles reassign as items pass through the middle
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The run follows the pointer exactly with no lag or offset; clarity, prominence and the item-derived surrounding atmosphere shift continuously as a new item moves into the middle
interaction_model.input: Press and drag sideways
interaction_model.affected_object: The whole run of pictures and the center focus assignment

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: The glide is interruptible at any point by a new press or gesture; a new press takes over tracking immediately from wherever the run currently is
interaction_model.state_change: Travel continues under its own momentum and then decays to rest
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The run keeps gliding in the direction it was thrown, slowing smoothly, and eases to a stop on its own with an item resting in the middle
interaction_model.input: Release after a drag
interaction_model.affected_object: The run of pictures

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Repeated gestures accumulate travel; opposite gestures reverse it; no edge is ever reached
interaction_model.state_change: Travel is pushed along the same single axis as dragging, then decays to rest the same way
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The run moves and glides identically to a drag-and-release, with the same continuous focus and derived-atmosphere updates
interaction_model.input: Wheel or trackpad gesture
interaction_model.affected_object: The run of pictures

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Reversal is always available and is itself reversible; the viewer is never locked into a direction
interaction_model.state_change: Travel reverses immediately instead of finishing the current motion
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The run flips direction at once with no bounce, pause, or wait for the previous glide to finish
interaction_model.input: Input pushing the opposite way at any moment, including mid-glide
interaction_model.affected_object: Travel direction of the run

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Full responsiveness begins on its own the moment the arrival settles; no viewer action is required to unlock it
interaction_model.state_change: No state change; input is discarded until the arrival has settled
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The waiting or arrival presentation continues undisturbed; nothing jumps or moves in response
interaction_model.input: Any input during waiting or arrival
interaction_model.affected_object: The run of pictures

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Reverses naturally when travel reverses; while travel is continuous the atmosphere keeps trailing the current center without ever settling on a colour taken from the wrong item
interaction_model.state_change: The atmosphere re-derives its colour cue from the newly centered picture
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The surround transitions smoothly toward the colour carried by the new picture rather than switching abruptly
interaction_model.input: Autonomous: a different item reaching the middle
interaction_model.affected_object: The surrounding derived colour atmosphere

experience_qualities: Calm and atmospheric rather than energetic
Unhurried, weighted motion with a natural coast and self-easing stop
Endless and boundary-free, with no sense of reaching a start or finish
Direct and physical, because travel matches the pointer exactly
Immediately responsive to reversal, so the viewer feels in constant control
Depth from distance, with a single clear subject and a soft periphery
completion_and_return: No completion state: the run loops so travel can continue indefinitely in either direction
Every glide resolves by easing to rest with an item occupying the middle, leaving the view in a readable settled state
The waiting-to-arrival sequence happens once and does not repeat during browsing
Whichever item is centered persists as the subject, along with the atmosphere derived from it, until travel moves another item into the middle
locked_observable_requirements: Exactly one centered focal item at a time, at full clarity
Legibility gradient by distance from center: neighbours clearly readable, further items softened away
Surrounding colour atmosphere derived entirely from whichever item currently holds the middle, with no hue, theme or luminance level fixed in advance
Seamless endless travel with no first or last item and no edge to collide with or bounce against
Pointer-exact one-to-one tracking while dragging
Momentum glide after release that eases to a stop on its own rather than snapping instantly
Immediate reversal on opposite input at any moment, including mid-glide
A quiet waiting state before the items arrive, followed by an arrival that settles attention on the middle
Input ignored until the arrival has settled, with responsiveness restored automatically
adaptable_details: Number of items in the run
How the softening is expressed (blur, fade, scale, or a combination)
Spacing, size ratio and whether the run reads as flat or slightly curved in depth
Whether wheel and drag share identical or merely comparable momentum feel
Duration and easing of the arrival, the glide decay and the atmosphere transition
Visual treatment of the quiet waiting state
How coarsely or finely the colour cue is taken from the centered item, and how strongly the derived tint reads against the host surroundings
Whether captions or minimal labels accompany the centered item
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits modest sets of image-like visual items of comparable weight where each deserves to be looked at one at a time and the mood should feel enveloping, as a full-view showcase or a wide feature band. Because the surround takes its colour from the items themselves, it adapts to any host palette and needs no particular background tone or dark stage. Text-heavy or mixed-density items break the distance-based legibility gradient. Introducing a real beginning and end, edge resistance or paged jumps, dropping the single centered focal subject, or breaking the link between the centered item and the surrounding derived atmosphere each produce a different skill.

name: roaming_contact_sheet_with_lifted_detail
description: After a short quiet load, the entire collection assembles into one oversized grid that spills past all four edges; the visitor drags it around with momentum and soft resistance at the limits, items fade toward the host surface as they leave the viewing area, and clicking one lifts it out into a large still view beside its number, title and short line before dropping it back into place.

canonical_document.name: roaming_contact_sheet_with_lifted_detail
canonical_document.description: After a short quiet load, the entire collection assembles into one oversized grid that spills past all four edges; the visitor drags it around with momentum and soft resistance at the limits, items fade toward the host surface as they leave the viewing area, and clicking one lifts it out into a large still view beside its number, title and short line before dropping it back into place.
canonical_document.experience_scope: Whole-view experience covering the page's primary viewing area: it begins with the entry loading moment, continues as the persistent draggable field, and includes the overlaid single-item detail state that opens above the field and closes back into it. No progression beyond that; the field remains the resting state.
content_and_composition: One continuous grid plane of many image items, sized substantially larger than the viewport in both axes so content is cut off on all edges

A brief pre-entry loading state occupying the same area before the field appears

A low-salience separating surround that pushes the field beneath the detail state back by a controlled luminance and contrast shift, in whichever direction the host surface requires
A persistent back/return affordance visible for the whole duration of the detail state
experience_progression: Quiet loading moment with no collection visible
Collection gathers itself into the single continuous field
Open-ended roaming of the field with no end state
Optional excursion into a single-item detail view and return to the same field position

Prominence is governed by current position relative to the viewing area rather than by ranking or ordering
Opening an item collapses attention onto that single image and its short text, pushing the surrounding field back visually
Closing restores the previous distribution of attention exactly, including where the visitor had roamed to

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Releasing hands off to momentum; reversing direction mid-drag is immediately honoured

Softly bounded rather than abruptly stopped

canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits any sizeable set of comparable visual items where each has a short caption and roaming is the intended way to browse, on either a light or dark host surface since the recede/return contrast shift can run in either direction. Requires enough items to exceed the viewport in both directions and a boundary set by real content extents. Replacing free dragging with paging, snapping to discrete cells, infinite or wrapping extents, or removing the return-to-original-slot detail view would each produce a different Skill.

name: depth_focused_infinite_photo_reel
description: A horizontal reel of photos in which the middle photo is large, sharp and at full luminance while its neighbours shrink into blur and reduced luminance; pressing and dragging carries the reel with the pointer, releasing flings it onward and it coasts to a soft settle, and the sequence never ends or rewinds because seen photos keep coming back around.

canonical_document.name: depth_focused_infinite_photo_reel
canonical_document.description: A horizontal reel of photos in which the middle photo is large, sharp and at full luminance while its neighbours shrink into blur and reduced luminance; pressing and dragging carries the reel with the pointer, releasing flings it onward and it coasts to a soft settle, and the sequence never ends or rewinds because seen photos keep coming back around.
canonical_document.experience_scope: A single continuous region that fills the main viewing area and is present from arrival onward; it has no start screen, no end state and no exit, so the region behaves as the whole view's primary experience for as long as the visitor stays.
content_and_composition: A handful of photos (small collection, roughly a dozen or fewer) arranged along one horizontal track in a fixed order
Exactly one photo occupies the visual middle at rest and is rendered largest, sharpest and at the highest luminance of the row
Neighbouring photos on both sides read as receding depth: progressively smaller or set back, softer/blurred and lower in luminance with distance from the middle
Each photo sits inside a frame boundary that crops it; the image can shift slightly within that frame independently of the frame's own travel
The surrounding page is quiet and near-empty: no competing panels, captions blocks or decorative layers demanding attention
The track reads as continuous in both directions, with no visible first or last item, edge marker or progress terminus
experience_progression: Arrival: the reel is at rest with one photo already centred, large and sharp, immediately establishing the single point of focus

Travel: photos advance along the track under drag, fling or wheel input, continuously exchanging roles as each one moves toward or away from the centre — gaining size, sharpness and luminance on approach, losing them on departure
Settle: motion always decelerates smoothly into a resting state with one photo again holding the middle, rather than halting abruptly
Loop: travel continues indefinitely in either direction and previously seen photos reappear, so the sequence cycles without a beginning or an end
attention_and_information_flow: Prominence is carried by a single centre position; only the photo in that position is fully legible in detail
Detail is progressively withheld from neighbours through blur and reduced luminance, so peripheral photos read as available-next rather than as content to inspect
Attention is handed from photo to photo continuously during travel rather than cut between discrete slides
During coasting, focus is soft and in motion; clarity is restored to a single image as the reel settles
The image's slight drift inside its frame adds a sense of depth and life without pulling attention away from the centred subject

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Dragging back in the opposite direction reverses travel with the same immediacy; there are no edges or limits in either direction, so drag can continue indefinitely without resistance, bounce or clamping
interaction_model.state_change: Reel enters a directly held state and tracks the input position one-to-one along the horizontal axis
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Photos follow the pointer or finger immediately with no lag; the photo entering the middle sharpens, enlarges and rises to full luminance while the departing one softens and drops in luminance; cursor switches to the held/grabbing appearance
interaction_model.input: Press and hold, then drag sideways with pointer or finger
interaction_model.affected_object: The whole horizontal reel of photos

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: A slow release yields a short glide, a fast release a long one; the coast can always be interrupted by grabbing again
interaction_model.state_change: Reel transitions from held to free momentum carrying the velocity of the release, then decelerates to rest
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Photos fling onward at the speed of the release and coast, gradually slowing and easing into a settle with one photo holding the middle, sharp and large; cursor returns to the grabbable appearance
interaction_model.input: Release the drag
interaction_model.affected_object: The whole reel

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Repeated turns accumulate travel; a grab cancels the resulting motion immediately
interaction_model.state_change: Reel receives travel in the same horizontal direction of motion as a drag, then eases to a settle
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Photos push along the track and coast to rest exactly as they do after a fling, with the same focus exchange at the centre
interaction_model.input: Wheel turn
interaction_model.affected_object: The whole reel

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Control passes straight back to the visitor at whatever position the reel had reached; releasing again restarts the fling-and-coast behaviour
interaction_model.state_change: Momentum is killed instantly and the reel returns to the directly held state at its current position
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Coasting stops dead at the moment of the grab with no drift-out or rebound, and the reel begins following the pointer at once; cursor changes to held
interaction_model.input: Press again while the reel is still coasting
interaction_model.affected_object: In-flight momentum of the reel

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Reverts to the grabbable appearance whenever the press ends
interaction_model.state_change: Cursor reflects grabbable versus currently held
interaction_model.visible_feedback: A distinct grabbable cursor invites the drag and a distinct held cursor confirms it during the drag
interaction_model.input: Pointer hovering over the reel without pressing
interaction_model.affected_object: Cursor appearance

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Drift follows travel in both directions and returns as the photo re-crosses; it never becomes a separate motion the visitor controls
interaction_model.state_change: Image offset within the frame shifts gradually as the photo crosses the screen
interaction_model.visible_feedback: A subtle drift of the picture inside its crop, lagging behind or leading the frame, giving a layered depth cue
interaction_model.input: Any horizontal travel of the reel (autonomous consequence of motion)
interaction_model.affected_object: Each photo's image relative to its own frame

experience_qualities: Calm and uncluttered, with one image at a time as the subject
Weighty yet effortless travel — mass and inertia without stiffness
Always easing to a settle rather than stopping flat
Endless and reassuring: no edges, no snap-back, no dead ends
Immediately obedient — a grab overrides motion with no fight or delay
Soft-focus depth around a single crisp centre
completion_and_return: There is no completion state; the experience loops indefinitely in both directions
Every episode of motion resolves by settling with a photo held in the middle, restoring the arrival composition
Previously viewed photos recur, so returning to an earlier image simply means continuing to travel rather than rewinding
No progress marker, end slide or reset to a first item ever appears
locked_observable_requirements: Exactly one photo is centred, large and sharp at rest while neighbours are visibly smaller, blurred and lowered in luminance in proportion to their distance from centre
Horizontal travel is bidirectional and endless, with no first or last item, no edge, no bounce and no snap to a beginning
Seen photos reappear as travel continues
Press-drag moves the reel one-to-one with the pointer or finger
Release throws the reel at the release speed and it decelerates to a smooth settle rather than stopping abruptly
Wheel input produces the same directional travel and the same eased settle
Grabbing during a coast kills momentum instantly and returns direct control with no residual drift
Cursor visibly distinguishes grabbable from held
Each photo's image drifts slightly within its frame as the photo crosses the screen
Surroundings stay quiet so nothing competes with the centred photo
adaptable_details: Number of photos in the collection and their aspect ratios
Exact spacing, scale ratio, blur strength and luminance falloff between centre and neighbours
Frame styling: crop shape, corner treatment, borders, shadows and how much the frame surface separates from its surround
Deceleration curve, glide length and how much velocity a fling carries
Magnitude and direction of the in-frame image drift
Specific cursor artwork used for grabbable and held states
Whether a small amount of accompanying text or a title sits outside the reel
Subject matter of the pictures
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits small to moderate collections of visually strong single images or media cards meant to be appreciated one at a time — photo sets, featured work, moments, products — in a quiet region or full view where browsing itself is the content. Content needing side-by-side comparison, dense reading, per-item copy or long lists does not fit, since only one item is ever legible. Introducing a defined start and end with edge resistance, replacing continuous drag-and-coast travel with discrete stepped slides, or giving every item equal clarity would each produce a different Skill.

name: liquid_glass_dissolve_photo_loop
description: Edge-to-edge photographs that trade places by dissolving and reforming as if seen through wet, moving glass, with a small name and position readout at the margins and a name row for jumping directly to any image.

canonical_document.name: liquid_glass_dissolve_photo_loop
canonical_document.description: Edge-to-edge photographs that trade places by dissolving and reforming as if seen through wet, moving glass, with a small name and position readout at the margins and a name row for jumping directly to any image.
canonical_document.experience_scope: A whole-view region that occupies the full viewport: it begins with a brief calm entry that settles into the first image and continues indefinitely as a looping sequence with no terminal end state; it is self-contained and can be embedded as a full-bleed section rather than only as a whole page.
content_and_composition: One primary visual at a time, filling the viewport edge to edge with no letterboxing or framing chrome
A small fixed set of images (roughly a handful, six in the observed case) forming an ordered cycle
A quiet text label naming the current image, held at a screen margin and low in visual weight
A position readout showing current index within the total set, also kept at a margin
A persistent row of all image names acting as direct-access marks, with the current one visibly marked as active
Overlay text and the name row persist across changes and stay legible against varying image tones
experience_progression: Entry: a short, calm hold before content appears, resolving rather than snapping into the first image
Steady state: one image displayed full-bleed with its label, position and the name row visible
Change: on a committed move the outgoing image breaks up and flows as though under wet glass while the incoming image gathers and settles into clarity
Settle: distortion clears fully, leaving the new image sharp and stable
Loop: continuing past the last item returns to the first and moving back from the first arrives at the last, with the same treatment as any other change so no boundary is felt
attention_and_information_flow: The image itself carries nearly all prominence; text stays deliberately subordinate at the edges
During a change, attention is held by the moving, refracting surface rather than by any interface element
The name and position identify the current image only after the move is committed, so information never contradicts what is on screen
The active mark in the name row communicates location within the set without the set competing with the image

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Further input during the change is ignored so moves cannot stack or queue; the display remains responsive again as soon as the new image has settled
interaction_model.state_change: Commits a move to the next image in the cycle
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The current image dissolves and refracts as the next one reforms into focus; the name, position readout and active mark switch to the new image
interaction_model.input: Click or tap anywhere on the displayed image
interaction_model.affected_object: The primary full-bleed visual and its margin labels

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Ignored while a change is in progress; wrapping past the last item continues into the first without interruption
interaction_model.state_change: Commits a move to the next image
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Same dissolving, glass-like reform into the next image with labels updating on commit
interaction_model.input: Forward key press (space or right arrow)
interaction_model.affected_object: The primary full-bleed visual and its margin labels

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Ignored while a change is in progress; moving back from the first item wraps to the last
interaction_model.state_change: Commits a move to the previous image
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The same glassy dissolve and reform treatment, showing the previous image; labels update on commit
interaction_model.input: Backward key press (left arrow)
interaction_model.affected_object: The primary full-bleed visual and its margin labels

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Ignored during an in-progress change; both ends wrap around
interaction_model.state_change: Commits a move one step forward or backward depending on swipe direction
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The same dissolve-and-reform change in the corresponding direction with labels updating
interaction_model.input: Swipe on the image surface (one direction forward, the opposite backward)
interaction_model.affected_object: The primary full-bleed visual and its margin labels

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Ignored during an in-progress change; selecting the already-current name causes no visible change
interaction_model.state_change: Jumps directly to the chosen image regardless of distance in the cycle
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The same glassy dissolve carries the view to the chosen image; the position readout and the marked name update to it
interaction_model.input: Selecting a name in the persistent name row
interaction_model.affected_object: The primary full-bleed visual, its margin labels and the active mark in the row

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Moves are accepted only once the first image has settled
interaction_model.state_change: Moves from a calm waiting state into the settled first image
interaction_model.visible_feedback: A short quiet hold that resolves into the first full-bleed image with its label and position appearing at the margins
interaction_model.input: Initial load of the region
interaction_model.affected_object: The whole view

experience_qualities: Calm and unbroken; no hard cuts, wipes or slides anywhere in the experience

Atmospheric and evocative, with the transition reading as a physical, liquid, refractive material, an atmosphere that comes from the material behavior itself and holds against either a light or a dark surround
Immersive through full-bleed scale and near-absent interface
Continuous and unhurried, with each change short enough to feel responsive yet long enough to be felt
Predictable: every committed move produces exactly one change and never a backlog
completion_and_return: There is no end state; the sequence cycles endlessly in both directions
Passing either boundary wraps silently, giving the loop no perceptible seam
After each change the view rests in a fully settled, undistorted state showing the current image and its matching label and position
Direct jumps leave the sequence in the same steady state as stepwise moves, so subsequent stepping continues from the newly chosen position
locked_observable_requirements: One image at a time filling the viewport edge to edge
Changes must appear as a wet, glassy dissolve-and-reform of the image surface, never a cut, wipe or slide
Both forward and backward moves use the same visible treatment
The set is a closed loop that wraps at both ends with no end-of-set signal
A quiet current-name label and position-in-set readout remain readable at the margins, holding sufficient contrast against whatever tones the image behind them presents
A persistent row of all names allows direct jumps and marks the current one, the active mark distinguished by a clearly perceptible difference from the inactive ones
Labels, readout and active mark update only when a move is committed
Input during a change is ignored so changes never overlap or queue
Entry resolves calmly into the first image rather than appearing abruptly
adaptable_details: Number of images in the set
Exact margin placement, typographic style and format of the name and position readout
Layout and styling of the name row, including horizontal or vertical arrangement
Duration and intensity of the dissolve, and how strongly the glassy distortion reads
Character of the opening hold before the first image appears
Which specific keys or gesture directions map to forward and backward, provided both directions exist
Subject matter and tonal treatment of the images, including overall lightness, and the means by which the margin text and active mark are kept legible over them
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits any small, ordered set of large single visuals meant to be viewed one at a time as the dominant content of a view, where mood continuity matters and per-item text is minimal. It stops being this Skill if multiple items are shown at once, if the visuals need substantial accompanying text or interactive content layered on them, if the sequence gains a start and finish instead of wrapping, or if the change becomes a cut, slide, wipe or non-material fade rather than a liquid glassy dissolve.

name: ripple_colour_bloom_image_set
description: A grid of captioned photos held at reduced chroma where the one you click blooms into its own full colour from the exact point struck while concentric ripples travel outward across its surface, then settles back to reduced chroma when attention moves on.

canonical_document.name: ripple_colour_bloom_image_set
canonical_document.description: A grid of captioned photos held at reduced chroma where the one you click blooms into its own full colour from the exact point struck while concentric ripples travel outward across its surface, then settles back to reduced chroma when attention moves on.
canonical_document.experience_scope: Whole-view experience for a single-purpose page: begins with a full-screen pre-arrival hold, continues through the revealed set of photos as the page's only content region, and ends whenever the visitor leaves; individual bloom episodes are scoped strictly to one photo's own surface.
content_and_composition: A small fixed set of large photographic tiles (four in the source case) arranged together in one composed view, all visible without progressive disclosure
One short caption bound to each photo, remaining legible against both the reduced-chroma and full-colour states

A uniform reduced-chroma treatment applied identically across all photos — a desaturation of each photo's own colours rather than an imposed tint or theme — forming the group baseline so no item reads as privileged
At most one photo restored to its own full colour in the 'alive' state at any moment, clearly separated in chroma from its still-desaturated siblings
Per-photo surface treatment layer confined to that photo's bounds: chroma spread plus concentric ripple rings, both originating at the struck point
Inert gap space between and around photos that carries no interactive treatment and no colour identity of its own, reading as a low-distraction surround at whatever luminance the host provides
During entry only: a full-screen low-distraction holding surround containing a single pulsing line as its sole element
experience_progression: Hold: full-screen quiet state with one pulsing line on a low-distraction surround, sustained until every photo is ready
Unified reveal: the complete set of photos appears together, all at the same reduced chroma, presented as one calm equal group
Calm baseline: the set rests fully desaturated, inviting a first touch
Bloom episode: a chosen photo travels from reduced chroma to its own full colour outward from the struck point with rippling surface motion, settling after roughly a second and a half

Return: the active photo drains back to reduced chroma (by a second click, or by another photo being chosen), restoring the original uniformly desaturated baseline; the cycle repeats indefinitely with no end state
attention_and_information_flow: The entry hold withholds all content and concentrates attention on one pulsing line, so nothing competes before the set is complete
The synchronized reduced-chroma reveal spreads attention evenly across the group; equality is the initial message
A single click converts one tile into the sole focal point through chroma and motion contrast while the rest stay desaturated background
The origin of the bloom is the visitor's own strike point, so the effect reads as caused by them rather than played back at them
Handing focus to a new photo visibly withdraws prominence from the previous one, keeping the number of focal points at one
Returning to the desaturated baseline flattens prominence again, resetting the group reading rather than leaving residue

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: One-way transition; the hold persists as long as readiness is incomplete and is never re-entered during the visit
interaction_model.state_change: Pre-arrival hold ends and the complete set enters the revealed reduced-chroma baseline together
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The pulsing line and holding surround give way to all photos appearing at once, uniformly desaturated
interaction_model.input: All photos finish becoming ready (autonomous driver)
interaction_model.affected_object: Whole view: holding state and the photo set

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Additional clicks on that same photo are ignored while its own transition is still running; the transition always completes to a settled full-colour state
interaction_model.state_change: The struck photo becomes the single active item and travels from reduced chroma to its own full colour
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Chroma spreads outward from the exact point struck while concentric ripple rings travel out from the same point across that photo's surface, settling after roughly a second and a half
interaction_model.input: Click or tap on a desaturated photo
interaction_model.affected_object: That photo's surface, plus any currently full-colour photo

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Reversal is available at any settled moment; repeat clicks during the running transition are ignored, and the outcome is a clean return to baseline
interaction_model.state_change: The photo leaves the active state and returns from full colour to reduced-chroma rest
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Desaturation spreads outward from the newly struck point with the same rippling surface motion, ending at the original baseline appearance
interaction_model.input: Click or tap the already full-colour photo again
interaction_model.affected_object: That photo's surface

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Handover happens without an intermediate all-desaturated pause; the outgoing photo always resolves to reduced-chroma rest even though the strike landed elsewhere
interaction_model.state_change: Exclusive activity moves from the old photo to the new one
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The earlier photo pulls its chroma back inward toward its own centre while the newly struck photo blooms outward from the point struck
interaction_model.input: Click or tap a different photo while one is in full colour
interaction_model.affected_object: The previously active photo and the newly struck photo

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Empty space is an explicit inert boundary rather than a dismiss or reset target
interaction_model.state_change: No state change
interaction_model.visible_feedback: No feedback of any kind; the current state simply persists
interaction_model.input: Click or tap in the gaps between or outside the photos
interaction_model.affected_object: Nothing

experience_qualities: Composed and unhurried on arrival; nothing appears half-assembled
Calm and egalitarian at rest, with the uniformly desaturated group reading as one quiet set
Tactile and liquid rather than switch-like: the surface behaves as if physically touched
Precisely attributable, because every change starts exactly where the visitor struck
Immediately legible and worth repeating, rewarding a second and third touch
Self-restoring, always able to return to the original quiet baseline
completion_and_return: Each bloom or unbloom completes on its own after roughly a second and a half and settles into a stable state
Deactivating the active photo restores the exact original uniformly desaturated baseline
The overall experience loops indefinitely through activate/return cycles with no terminal state or score
At most one photo remains in full colour between interactions; no accumulated highlights persist
locked_observable_requirements: Exactly one photo may be in the alive/full-colour state at any time, and that state is the photo's own colours at full chroma rather than any imposed hue or tint
Every activation begins at the exact point the visitor struck, and deactivation by re-clicking also begins at the newly struck point
Chroma spread and concentric surface ripples share the same origin point and run together as one effect, not as separate treatments
Deactivation caused by choosing another photo draws chroma inward to the outgoing photo's own centre rather than to any pointer position
A settle time of roughly one and a half seconds, slow enough to be read as a travelling surface event rather than an instant toggle

Uniform reduced-chroma group baseline, obtained by desaturating each photo's own colours with no added tint, fully restored after activity, with a clearly readable chroma separation between the baseline and the active state
Further clicks on a photo are ignored while that photo's own transition is running
Clicks outside photo surfaces produce no change at all

Entry withholds the set behind a quiet full-screen hold with a single pulsing element on a low-distraction surround of no fixed luminance polarity, and the whole set then appears together already desaturated
adaptable_details: Number of photos, as long as the set stays small and fully visible at once
Grid arrangement, tile proportions and spacing
Caption wording, placement and typography, provided it stays readable over both states
Exact settle duration around the one-and-a-half-second feel
Number, spacing and amplitude of ripple rings
Depth of the reduced-chroma treatment and the character of the full-colour state, provided the two remain clearly separated
Appearance and rhythm of the pulsing element in the entry hold, and the luminance and neutrality of the surround it sits on
Manner in which the revealed set arrives, provided all items arrive together
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits small, fully visible sets of large image-dominant tiles whose whole surface can carry a travelling visual treatment, with light captioning and browsing as the only task, and adopts the host's own surround luminance and neutral tones. Suits showcase, portfolio and visual-index views placed as the primary content of a page.
