Switching to continuous pointer-tracked treatment without a discrete strike point, allowing several items alive simultaneously, applying the treatment to text-dominant cards or long scrolling collections, or making activation open detail content instead of transforming the surface in place would each create a different Skill.

name: self_opening_cover_into_endless_receding_page_drift
description: A closed cover opens on its own and flips through its pages in quick staggered succession, the pages gather into one stack, then fan apart into a deep receding run of spreads that the visitor drifts through forever in either direction, with pages bowing and rippling when pushed hard and flattening as motion decays.

canonical_document.name: self_opening_cover_into_endless_receding_page_drift
canonical_document.description: A closed cover opens on its own and flips through its pages in quick staggered succession, the pages gather into one stack, then fan apart into a deep receding run of spreads that the visitor drifts through forever in either direction, with pages bowing and rippling when pushed hard and flattening as motion decays.
canonical_document.experience_scope: Whole-view region experience: begins automatically on arrival with a single closed cover filling the view, transitions through an unskippable opening sequence into a persistent free-browsing state that has no end condition and never returns to the cover.
content_and_composition: One cover item as the single initial focal object, centered and alone in the view
A sequence of image pages/spreads (many; count not fixed) drawn as the sole foreground content
After the opening, pages occupy a single depth corridor receding away from the viewer, spaced apart so several are visible simultaneously at different depths and scales
One transient composition state during the opening: all pages collapsed into a single stack before fanning apart
Small fixed textual markings (credit line, issue/label text) pinned at the view margins, in a separate persistent layer above the imagery, never moved or scaled by browsing
A low-distraction surround held at a luminance clearly separated from the imagery, so the imagery carries all contrast
experience_progression: Stage 1 — arrival: a single closed cover sits alone in view, no controls active
Stage 2 — self-opening: the cover opens without user input
Stage 3 — race-through: pages flip past in rapid staggered succession, offset in time rather than in unison
Stage 4 — settle: the pages come to rest as one consolidated stack
Stage 5 — fan out: the stack spreads apart into a deep receding run of spreads at increasing depth
Stage 6 — handoff: browsing control becomes available and the experience remains in an open-ended drift state indefinitely
attention_and_information_flow: Attention starts fully concentrated on one closed object, then is deliberately overwhelmed by rapid succession before being re-organized into an orderly readable depth run
Nearest pages read as the current subject; pages farther into the depth act as anticipation of what is coming and memory of what passed
Prominence transfers continuously as travel proceeds — a page grows into focus, occupies the foreground, then recedes and diminishes without ever being 'selected'
Margin markings stay legible but visually subordinate at all times; no captions, chrome or counters compete with the imagery
No progress indication, position marker or endpoint is ever revealed, so information flow is about the imagery only, not about location in a sequence

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Input has no effect until the sequence finishes; gestures made during it neither move the pages nor queue up, and control unlocks only at completion
interaction_model.state_change: Closed cover → opening → rapid staggered flip-through → consolidated stack → fanned receding depth run; control locked throughout
interaction_model.visible_feedback: A continuous self-playing sequence in which the pages visibly move, accumulate and then spread into depth without any user action
interaction_model.input: Autonomous driver on first arrival
interaction_model.affected_object: Cover, then the whole page sequence and its arrangement

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Travel is unlimited in both directions with no first or last page and no clamp or bounce at any edge; a new gesture during coasting takes over immediately
interaction_model.state_change: Travel position advances forward or backward through the depth corridor at a velocity set by input strength
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Pages move toward or away from the viewer, growing and shrinking as they pass through the foreground; after the gesture stops the motion coasts and eases smoothly to rest rather than halting
interaction_model.input: Wheel or trackpad scrolling
interaction_model.affected_object: The receding run of pages as a whole

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: The gesture is captured by the browsing surface only — surrounding text and margin markings never shift, scroll or rubber-band as a side effect
interaction_model.state_change: Same forward/backward travel through depth as pointer-based scrolling, driven by drag distance and release velocity
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Pages follow the finger through the depth during the drag and continue coasting after release before easing to rest
interaction_model.input: Horizontal drag on touch
interaction_model.affected_object: The receding run of pages as a whole

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Deformation is transient and self-correcting; it always returns to flat when motion settles, with no residual distortion
interaction_model.state_change: Pages deform in proportion to current travel intensity, then relax as intensity decays
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Page surfaces visibly bow and ripple while moving fast, and flatten back to rest shape as the drift slows
interaction_model.input: Stronger or faster input of either kind
interaction_model.affected_object: Individual page surfaces

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Reversal is available at any moment, including mid-coast, and is itself reversible; no gesture is ever locked out once control is active
interaction_model.state_change: Direction inverts immediately from the current position instead of finishing the prior movement
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The pages that just passed come back through the foreground in reverse order, retracing the path without a snap, jump or pause
interaction_model.input: Reversing direction mid-motion
interaction_model.affected_object: Travel position through the depth run

experience_qualities: Atmospheric and low-key, with the imagery reading as the only high-luminance material against a restrained surround
Weightless and inertial — momentum, coasting and easing rather than discrete steps
Endless and unhurried, with no destination, endpoint or sense of completion
Physical and tactile through bowing and rippling page surfaces that respond to force
Cinematic and self-assured at the opening: the page performs before the visitor is allowed to touch it
Deep and spatial rather than flat and paged
completion_and_return: The opening sequence completes once and is never replayed; the cover state is not returnable
Browsing has no completion state — travel loops through the run indefinitely with no first or last page to arrive at
After every gesture the motion resolves to a calm resting state with flat, undeformed pages
No position is persisted or exposed; there is no reset, restart or 'back to start' affordance
Margin credit and issue markings persist unchanged for the entire session
locked_observable_requirements: Entry begins on a single closed cover that opens without user input
The opening runs as one continuous sequence: staggered rapid flip-through, consolidation into one stack, then fan-out into a receding depth run
Browsing control is unavailable until the opening sequence finishes
Pages are arranged along depth with several visible at once at different scales, not as a flat one-at-a-time slideshow
Travel is unlimited in both directions with no first or last page and no boundary feedback
Motion is momentum-based: it coasts and eases to rest after the gesture ends
Mid-motion reversal immediately retraces the pages that just passed
Stronger input visibly bows and ripples page surfaces, which flatten again as motion decays
Both pointer-style scrolling and horizontal touch dragging drive the same travel
Gestures on the browsing surface never move the surrounding text
Small fixed credit/issue markings remain legible at the margins throughout
The imagery holds the strongest contrast and all visual attention against a quieter surround; no captions, counters or progress indicators
adaptable_details: Number, aspect ratio and subject matter of the image pages
Exact depth spacing, perceived corridor length and how many pages are visible at once
Timing, stagger interval and total duration of the opening sequence
Easing curves, coasting length and intensity thresholds for deformation
Amplitude and character of the bow/ripple deformation
Wording and corner placement of the margin markings
Exact surround treatment — its luminance level and direction of separation, plus any grain, vignetting or lighting character — as long as the imagery stays the highest-contrast material
Whether an idle auto-drift continues when the visitor stops interacting
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits any ordered set of visually strong, self-explanatory images that rewards wandering rather than targeted retrieval — editorial spreads, photo series, lookbooks, poster or artwork archives — presented as the main stage of a view with minimal accompanying text. It stops fitting when items need labels, metadata, comparison or a defined start and end, or when visitors must reach a specific item; adding selection, opening a detail view, snapping to discrete positions, bounded ends with edge feedback, or replacing the depth corridor with a flat plane or grid would each produce a different Skill.

name: boundless_dragged_field_with_travelling_detail
description: One edge-to-edge field of item images that the visitor grabs and flings in any direction with trailing momentum and springy outer limits, where clicking a piece sends that same image travelling into a quiet detail panel and closing drops it back into its exact slot.

canonical_document.name: boundless_dragged_field_with_travelling_detail
canonical_document.description: One edge-to-edge field of item images that the visitor grabs and flings in any direction with trailing momentum and springy outer limits, where clicking a piece sends that same image travelling into a quiet detail panel and closing drops it back into its exact slot.
canonical_document.experience_scope: Begins with a short calm pause at first load, continues as the whole-view field that owns the entire viewport and extends beyond all four edges, and includes the focused detail mode that opens over it; the detail mode ends by returning to the same field position, so the experience never leaves the single view.
content_and_composition: Many comparable item images (enough to overflow every screen edge) arranged across one continuous plane with no top, no visible page frame and no vertical reading order
Each image occupies a fixed slot on the plane; slots persist unchanged while the plane is moved
The plane itself is the only draggable surface and is grabbable at any point, including empty space between items
A focused detail layer holding the selected item's image plus its short text set: name, price, written description, and one add-to-cart action
A close marker that exists only during the detail mode and stays attached to the pointer
No persistent chrome competing with the field; whatever remains fixed stays visually subordinate to the images
experience_progression: Short calm loading pause with nothing to read or act on
The collection gathers into view as one continuous field rather than appearing item by item in a list
Open-ended roaming: the visitor pulls the field around at their own pace with no start or end point
Settling on one piece opens the quiet reading moment where that piece and its text take over attention
Closing returns the piece to its origin slot and resumes roaming from the identical field position
attention_and_information_flow: Attention rests only on whichever pieces currently fall inside the viewport; nothing off-screen competes for it
No headline or ranked entry point directs where to look first, so prominence follows the visitor's own movement
Pace stays unhurried: motion decelerates rather than snapping, and no item demands immediate action
On selection, attention collapses from the whole field to a single piece, and its written information arrives as the image lands
On close, attention re-diffuses across the visible neighbourhood of the returned piece

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Release at any moment ends the drag; a new grab can interrupt an ongoing glide and take over immediately
interaction_model.state_change: Field offset moves freely along both axes following pointer displacement
interaction_model.visible_feedback: All pieces trail the pointer together as a single mass, holding their relative slots
interaction_model.input: Press and drag anywhere on the field, including empty space
interaction_model.affected_object: The entire field of items as one plane

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Grabbing again during the glide cancels it and resumes direct following
interaction_model.state_change: Motion continues briefly and decelerates to rest
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The field glides on past the release point and settles smoothly rather than stopping dead
interaction_model.input: Release after a drag with velocity
interaction_model.affected_object: Field offset

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Dragging and wheel input act on the same offset and can be alternated freely
interaction_model.state_change: Same two-axis displacement as dragging, not a vertical-only scroll
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The field pushes in the direction of the gesture along both axes
interaction_model.input: Wheel or trackpad movement
interaction_model.affected_object: Field offset

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Boundary return happens on its own and can be overridden by a new grab; no state is lost
interaction_model.state_change: Movement becomes progressively resisted, then eases back inside the limit
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The field gives a little, slows against the push, and springs back so the collection can never be lost off-screen
interaction_model.input: Continuing to push past the outer limit of the field
interaction_model.affected_object: Field offset at its boundary

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: The origin slot is remembered for the return; opening is the only mode change and does not disturb field position
interaction_model.state_change: Field mode switches to detail mode for that single piece
interaction_model.visible_feedback: That very image travels out of its slot into the detail panel while the name, price, description and add-to-cart arrive with it
interaction_model.input: Click on a piece
interaction_model.affected_object: That piece's image and the detail layer

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: The marker disappears when the detail closes
interaction_model.state_change: Marker position tracks the pointer
interaction_model.visible_feedback: A close marker follows the pointer, signalling that anywhere off the panel dismisses the piece
interaction_model.input: Pointer movement while the detail is open
interaction_model.affected_object: Close marker

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Return is always available and always lands on the same slot and field offset
interaction_model.state_change: Detail mode returns to field mode
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The image travels back into the exact slot it left and the text clears, leaving the field exactly where it was
interaction_model.input: Click back on the field while the detail is open
interaction_model.affected_object: Selected piece and detail layer

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: The open detail stays stable until an explicit close, so rapid clicking cannot corrupt the return
interaction_model.state_change: None
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Nothing changes: no re-entry animation, no swap, no stacking of panels
interaction_model.input: Repeated clicks on pieces while a detail is already open
interaction_model.affected_object: Detail mode

experience_qualities: Boundless and non-directional: no top of page, no reading order
Tactile and weighted: the field follows the hand and carries momentum
Calm and unhurried, with easing rather than snapping
Physically continuous: the selected image is felt as the same object in both modes
Fully reversible with no loss of place
completion_and_return: Roaming has no completion state and continues indefinitely
Closing a detail always restores the exact origin slot and the exact field offset held before opening
Field position persists across repeated open/close cycles and is never reset to a default view
The entrance pause and gather-in happen once per load, not on each return
locked_observable_requirements: One continuous field of items extending past every screen edge, roamable in any direction
Grab-anywhere dragging where items trail the pointer as one mass, plus a brief inertial glide that settles after release
Wheel or trackpad input moving the same field along both axes
Resisting, self-easing outer limit so the collection can never be pushed off-screen
Clicking a piece sends that same image travelling from its slot into the detail view as its text arrives
A close marker bound to the pointer while the detail is open
Return places the image back in the exact slot it left with the field unmoved
Repeated open clicks while a detail is open produce no visible change
Short calm pause before the collection gathers into view as one field
adaptable_details: Number of items, image aspect ratios, spacing and the arrangement pattern across the plane
Panel placement, proportions, typography and colour treatment — any hues are free, as long as the panel reads as a low-distraction surround for the image and its text holds readable contrast
The specific short text set shown in the detail and the nature of its single action
Glide duration, resistance strength and easing character
Appearance of the close marker
Length and style of the opening pause and the gather-in motion
Input sensitivity for wheel versus drag
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits sets of visually distinct images of comparable importance, each with a short block of readable metadata and at most one primary action — product ranges, artwork or photo collections, project or case indexes. It becomes a different skill if the items need a ranked or sequential order, if the field is replaced by a paginated grid or vertical scroll, if the detail becomes a separate page or route without the travelling image and exact-slot return, or if the content is text-dominant so there is no image to carry between field and detail.

name: cursor_swept_image_pop_trail
description: Pictures from a small set drop in at the cursor as it sweeps across an empty surface, each popping to full size then shrinking away, so a fast stroke leaves a brief chronological trail with the newest image in front and the surface empties itself when movement stops.

canonical_document.name: cursor_swept_image_pop_trail
canonical_document.description: Pictures from a small set drop in at the cursor as it sweeps across an empty surface, each popping to full size then shrinking away, so a fast stroke leaves a brief chronological trail with the newest image in front and the surface empties itself when movement stops.
canonical_document.experience_scope: A whole-view surface experience covering the full page area as a transparent, non-blocking layer; it begins in a completely empty state on arrival, activates only while the cursor moves within the area, and ends by returning to the same empty state whenever movement settles.
content_and_composition: Primary content role: a small ordered set of pictures (a handful), cycled in sequence as spawn triggers occur
Each spawned picture is positioned at the cursor location at the moment of spawning, centered on that point
Multiple pictures can coexist; each newer picture stacks in front of older ones, so the visible trail reads newest-on-top
No text, buttons, labels, captions or navigation anywhere in the experience; the bare surface is the only persistent element
Background surface stays calm and unadorned so pictures are the sole focus; any underlying page content remains visible and fully interactive beneath the picture layer
experience_progression: Arrival: completely empty, quiet surface with nothing to read or click
First movement: one or more pictures surface at the pointer, making the rule self-evident within about a second
Sustained movement: a continuous few-at-a-time rhythm where only the most recent pictures are in view and older ones have already gone
Movement stops: no new pictures appear, remaining ones finish their own shrink-away
Settled: surface returns to completely empty, with nothing accumulated, ready to start again
attention_and_information_flow: Attention is anchored to the cursor, because that is where the next picture always appears
Prominence follows recency: the newest picture is largest, frontmost and fully sized, while older ones are already receding
During a fast wide sweep, attention widens to read a chronological path across the surface rather than a single point
As the surface clears, attention returns to whatever quiet content or emptiness lies underneath, with no residue competing for focus

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Each picture is self-limiting: shortly after appearing it shrinks away and disappears on its own, so no user action is needed to undo it
interaction_model.state_change: A new picture instance is created at the current cursor position and becomes the frontmost item
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The picture pops in, scaling up to full size at that spot, layered in front of any pictures already present
interaction_model.input: Cursor moved a sufficient distance across the surface
interaction_model.affected_object: The next picture in the set

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Trail length is bounded by each picture's short lifetime, so the surface never fills; stopping movement immediately halts new spawns
interaction_model.state_change: Rapid successive spawns produce an overlapping set of pictures in chronological order
interaction_model.visible_feedback: A short trail of several pictures traces the stroke, with the newest in front and earlier ones progressively further back and already shrinking
interaction_model.input: Quick, wide cursor movement across the surface
interaction_model.affected_object: Several picture instances along the path

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Resuming larger or faster movement immediately resumes spawning from where the picture sequence left off
interaction_model.state_change: No spawn occurs; the surface state is unchanged
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Nothing appears, so jitter and idle drift never flood the screen
interaction_model.input: Tiny or slow cursor movement
interaction_model.affected_object: The picture layer

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Clearing is never abrupt; moving again during the clear simply adds new pictures on top while the old ones finish
interaction_model.state_change: Existing pictures complete their lifetime and are removed; the surface returns to empty
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Remaining pictures shrink away one after another until nothing is left
interaction_model.input: Cursor comes to a stop
interaction_model.affected_object: All pictures still on screen

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: The picture layer is permanently non-blocking, so nothing underneath can become unreachable
interaction_model.state_change: The click passes through to the underlying content
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The underlying element responds normally; pictures neither highlight nor intercept the interaction
interaction_model.input: Click or press anywhere over the picture layer
interaction_model.affected_object: Whatever content sits beneath the layer

experience_qualities: Playful and spontaneous rather than deliberate or menu-driven
Calm and bare between strokes, with no accumulation or clutter
Immediately legible: the cause-and-effect rule is understood within about a second
Light and transient, with every appearance short-lived and self-clearing
Effortless and forgiving, since there is nothing to get wrong and no state to reset
completion_and_return: No terminal completion state; the experience loops indefinitely between empty and active
Every pause resolves to a fully empty surface, which is the canonical resting state
No persistent trace, history or accumulated gallery is left behind after clearing
The picture sequence continues in order across bursts rather than restarting from a fixed point on each new stroke
locked_observable_requirements: Arrival state is a completely empty, text-free and control-free surface
Pictures appear exactly at the cursor position at the moment of spawning
Each picture pops up to full size and then shrinks away on its own shortly after, without user action
Movement magnitude gates spawning: fast wide movement yields several pictures at once, tiny or slow movement yields none
Newest picture is layered in front, producing a readable chronological trail
Only the most recent pictures are ever visible; nothing accumulates over time
Stopping movement lets the remaining pictures finish and returns the surface to completely empty
The picture layer never captures clicks or blocks interaction with content beneath it
adaptable_details: Number and subject matter of the pictures in the set
Picture shape, size, framing and aspect handling
Exact pop-in and shrink-away timing, easing and overshoot character
Movement distance threshold that gates spawning
Whether pictures also carry slight rotation, offset or opacity change while receding
Background surface color or texture, as long as it stays calm and uncompetitive
Whether the sequence cycles in fixed order or reshuffles between passes
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits any sparse full-area surface whose foreground is a small set of self-contained visual items (photos, illustrations, product shots, marks) presented without captions or controls, including as a transparent layer above quiet existing content. It stops being this Skill if items persist and accumulate into a browsable arrangement, if they become clickable targets with their own destinations or detail views, if placement is driven by a fixed layout instead of the pointer position, or if the items require reading rather than glancing.

name: scanning_chamber_card_stream
description: A visually quiet enclosed chamber where cards glide sideways in an unbroken loop through a tall central column of light that converts clean artwork into dense flickering machine code, the column rising in intensity while a card is inside it, and reversing when a card is dragged back out.

canonical_document.name: scanning_chamber_card_stream
canonical_document.description: A visually quiet enclosed chamber where cards glide sideways in an unbroken loop through a tall central column of light that converts clean artwork into dense flickering machine code, the column rising in intensity while a card is inside it, and reversing when a card is dragged back out.
canonical_document.experience_scope: A full-viewport region that reads as one enclosed, low-distraction chamber; the experience is present from view entry and never completes, with the horizontal card lane and the central light column both living inside this single region.
content_and_composition: Uniform, low-distraction full-screen chamber backdrop, held far enough from the column's luminance that the column reads as the brightest thing present; it frames everything else and stays constant
One horizontal lane through the vertical middle of the region carrying a small handful of card-shaped items (roughly 4-8), evenly distributed and repeating endlessly
One tall vertical column of light standing at the horizontal centre of the region, spanning most of the chamber height, layered above the backdrop and intersecting the card lane

Each card carries two visual states of the same content: clean artwork and dense flickering machine-code text, occupying the same card footprint so the swap reads as one object changing rather than two objects
Cards may be split mid-conversion, showing artwork on the side that has not yet crossed and code on the side that has
Pointer/cursor treatment is a persistent element that signals grabbability and active grabbing
experience_progression: On entry the lane starts with brisk sideways travel and eases down into a slow constant crawl
Each card advances toward the centre as clean artwork, converts progressively while overlapping the light column, and exits the far side fully rendered as flickering code
The light column swells in intensity for as long as any card overlaps it and settles back when the lane is clear of it
Cards wrap around and re-enter from the opposite edge, so the cycle repeats with no finish line and no empty lane
attention_and_information_flow: The central light column is the strongest focal point; its luminance separation from the quiet surround and its intensity swell keep attention anchored there
The initial fast-to-slow easing draws the eye into the lane first, then hands attention to the centre once the crawl settles
Meaning is revealed by adjacency: because a card enters one side as artwork and leaves the other as code, the column's function is legible without any label
Legibility of individual card content is highest away from the column; near and past the column the content reads as texture and density rather than as image detail
During a drag, attention follows the card the user holds, and the split boundary on that card becomes the local point of interest

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Runs indefinitely; interrupted the moment the user grabs a card and resumed automatically after release
interaction_model.state_change: Continuous sideways advance, easing from a brisk initial speed into a slow constant crawl and holding it
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Cards travel steadily across the chamber, converting as they cross the light column, which gains intensity while occupied
interaction_model.input: Autonomous drift with no user input
interaction_model.affected_object: The full set of cards in the lane

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Releasing ends the hold; automatic crawl resumes from wherever the lane was left
interaction_model.state_change: Automatic travel halts and the lane becomes directly hand-driven
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Motion stops immediately under the hand and the pointer switches to a grabbing state
interaction_model.input: Press and hold on a card with mouse or touch
interaction_model.affected_object: The whole lane of cards

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Fully reversible at any point by dragging the other way; dragging backwards restores the original artwork
interaction_model.state_change: The lane follows the hand one-to-one in either direction, and conversion advances or rewinds according to where each card sits relative to the light column
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Cards track the pointer exactly; a card pushed into the column progressively turns into flickering code, a card pulled back out returns to clean artwork, and the column intensifies whenever a card overlaps it
interaction_model.input: Drag sideways while holding
interaction_model.affected_object: Card positions and each card's conversion state

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Held as long as the grab persists; releasing lets the crawl carry the card onward and finish the conversion
interaction_model.state_change: Conversion freezes at the held position
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The card holds a stable split, artwork on one side of the column boundary and dense code on the other, available for study
interaction_model.input: Stop mid-drag and hold a card partway inside the light column
interaction_model.affected_object: A single card straddling the column

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: A new grab interrupts the coast instantly; if left alone the lane always resolves to the crawl
interaction_model.state_change: Lane coasts in the flick direction, decelerates, and settles back into the constant crawl
interaction_model.visible_feedback: A fast glide in either direction with cards converting or un-converting as they sweep past the column, easing down into the ambient crawl
interaction_model.input: Flick and release with velocity
interaction_model.affected_object: The whole lane

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Pointer returns from grabbing to grabbable state
interaction_model.state_change: Direct hand control ends and ambient motion takes over
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Cards pick the crawl back up smoothly from their current positions with no jump
interaction_model.input: Gentle release without velocity
interaction_model.affected_object: The whole lane

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: No end stop, bounce or rubber-band; the loop makes over-dragging impossible
interaction_model.state_change: Sequence wraps continuously instead of hitting an end
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Cards re-enter from the opposite edge so the lane is never empty and no blank run appears at either extreme
interaction_model.input: Dragging far in either direction
interaction_model.affected_object: Lane boundaries and card sequence

experience_qualities: Futuristic, machine-lab atmosphere: a quiet, uncluttered surround with a strongly separated luminous instrument at its centre
Perpetual and unhurried once the opening ease-in settles
Physically direct — the lane feels held rather than commanded, with exact one-to-one tracking and momentum on release
Self-explanatory: the column's purpose is understood from watching one card cross it
Inspectable — the transformation can be slowed, frozen mid-way and rewound at will
completion_and_return: No completion state and no finish line; the lane loops endlessly
Every interruption returns to the same slow constant crawl as its resting state
Conversion state is a pure function of card position, so it is never latched — moving a card back always returns the earlier appearance
The lane never empties and never needs a reset
locked_observable_requirements: Low-distraction full-region chamber surround with a single tall vertical light column at the horizontal centre, clearly separated in luminance from that surround
Items travel along one horizontal axis through that column in an endless wrapping loop
Each item visibly changes from one content rendering to a denser, flickering alternate rendering by crossing the column, with a readable split state while straddling it
Conversion is bound to position and therefore fully reversible by moving the item backwards
The light column visibly rises in intensity for as long as an item overlaps it and falls back when clear
Automatic travel eases from a brisk start into a slow constant crawl and always returns to that crawl
Drag tracks the pointer exactly, pauses automatic travel while held, and shows a grabbing pointer state
Flick-and-release coasts in either direction before settling to the crawl
No reachable end of the lane in either direction
adaptable_details: Number, aspect ratio and spacing of items
Specific artwork subject and the exact character set or texture used for the dense rendering

Chamber surround treatment and the column's accent tint in any hue or theme, light or otherwise, provided the column stays the most luminous element and its separation from the surround remains unmistakable
Column width, glow softness and flicker cadence
Crawl speed, ease-in duration and coasting friction
Whether items sit flat or with slight depth/perspective in the lane
Extent of chrome or captions around the lane, so long as the column stays the focal point
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits a small set of visually rich, card-shaped items that each have a credible pair of renderings — a clean state and a denser, more mechanical or abstract state — presented as a centrepiece showcase strip on a landing, demo or gallery view. Content-heavy items that must stay readable throughout, or sets too large to loop as a perceivable sequence, do not fit. Replacing the position-bound reversible conversion with a one-way or timed change, dropping the endless wrap for a bounded track, or moving the transformation station off the travel axis so items no longer pass through it would each produce a different Skill.

name: recursive_image_depth_fan
description: A still picture that quietly opens into nested repeats of itself receding inward, leans as the pointer moves, and fans into a luminous layered sculpture while dragged, then unwinds back to one flat image.

canonical_document.name: recursive_image_depth_fan
canonical_document.description: A still picture that quietly opens into nested repeats of itself receding inward, leans as the pointer moves, and fans into a luminous layered sculpture while dragged, then unwinds back to one flat image.
canonical_document.experience_scope: A single focal region containing one image, centered on a low-distraction empty surround that reads as clearly separated from the picture; it can occupy a whole view or a bounded feature block. The experience begins when pointer or touch attention arrives over the image and ends when attention leaves, at which point the region returns to its plain single-picture rest state.
content_and_composition: One primary still image acts as the only content subject and as the source of every visible layer
Multiple copies of that same image are stacked as depth layers, scaled and offset so they read as nested repeats receding inward from the frontmost copy
A quiet, uncluttered surround holds the stack with enough tonal separation to set it apart, and stays empty of competing content, keeping the image the sole focus
Thin luminous edge lines, bright enough to separate from the layer surfaces they trace, outline the silhouettes of the copies and appear only while the stack is fanned
A small transient drag cue rides near the pointer while it hovers over the image; no instructional text or persistent controls are present
At rest the composition collapses to a single flat centered picture with no visible sign of the layers
experience_progression: Rest: one quiet, still, flat picture centered on the low-distraction surround, giving no hint of internal structure
Recognition: as attention settles on the image, nested copies open outward one after another in a staggered sequence, revealing inward recession and depth
Exploration: pointer movement tilts and shifts the stack, deeper copies trailing further than nearer ones, so the depth reads as continuously steerable

Unfolding: a sustained press-and-drag past a small initial slack progressively twists the copies into a fan with incrementally increasing rotation per layer and luminous edge outlines, up to a hard spread limit
Winding down: dragging back the opposite way reduces the fan; releasing lets it unwind smoothly to the nested state
Return: when attention moves away the whole arrangement settles calmly back to the single flat picture, ready to be discovered again
attention_and_information_flow: Initial stillness withholds everything, so the first reveal of nested copies is the discovery moment rather than a labeled affordance
Prominence stays on the same subject throughout; more of its internal structure, not new content, becomes visible at each stage
The staggered opening leads the eye inward along the recession before the fan spreads attention laterally across the layers
Luminous outlines mark layer boundaries only at maximum expressiveness, clarifying how many layers exist and how far each has turned
The trailing drag cue quietly signals that a press gesture is available and withdraws once that gesture is underway, so the visual is never obstructed at peak effect
Depth-proportional drift communicates which layers are nearer and which are deeper without any annotation

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Attention leaving at any point reverses the sequence and returns the stack to one flat picture
interaction_model.state_change: From collapsed single picture to opened nested stack
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Copies emerge outward one after another in a staggered sequence, revealing recession inward
interaction_model.input: Pointer or touch attention arriving over the image
interaction_model.affected_object: Nested copies of the image

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Motion is continuous and fully reversible by moving back; leaving the region eases the lean back to neutral
interaction_model.state_change: Continuous re-offset and lean of the layers toward the pointer position
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Deeper copies drift further than nearer ones so the whole stack tilts and parallaxes with the pointer
interaction_model.input: Pointer or touch movement across the image
interaction_model.affected_object: Depth layers of the stack

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: The initial slack prevents accidental fanning; dragging the other way winds the fan down; the spread stops growing at the limit instead of breaking apart
interaction_model.state_change: From nested stack to progressively fanned arrangement, bounded by a maximum spread
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Copies twist into a fan with each layer turning more than the one before it, thin luminous lines tracing their silhouettes
interaction_model.input: Press and drag upward or downward beyond a small initial slack
interaction_model.affected_object: Rotation of each image copy

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: A new press can be started mid-unwind and takes over from the current position
interaction_model.state_change: From held fan back to nested rest arrangement
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The fan unwinds smoothly rather than snapping
interaction_model.input: Releasing the press
interaction_model.affected_object: Fanned arrangement

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Recovery is unconditional from any partial state, so the effect can always be rediscovered from a clean start
interaction_model.state_change: From any intermediate open, leaned or fanned state to the flat single-picture rest state
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Layers close, rotation unwinds, lean neutralizes and luminous outlines fade until one plain picture remains
interaction_model.input: Attention moving away, including while a drag is abandoned midway
interaction_model.affected_object: Entire layered arrangement

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: The cue reappears on subsequent hovering without a press and never persists after attention leaves
interaction_model.state_change: Cue visible while hovering, hidden once the press begins
interaction_model.visible_feedback: A small cue trails the pointer and slips out of sight as the drag gesture takes over
interaction_model.input: Pointer hovering over the image, then beginning a press
interaction_model.affected_object: Small drag cue near the pointer

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Ending the touch unwinds the fan and returns the picture to its flat state, restoring normal page scrolling
interaction_model.state_change: Same open, lean, fan and unwind states as pointer input, with page scrolling suppressed for the duration of the gesture
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Identical layered opening, leaning and fanning behavior with no page movement underneath
interaction_model.input: Touch drag on the image
interaction_model.affected_object: Layered arrangement and page scrolling

experience_qualities: Quiet and withholding at first, then playfully generous once touched
Feels entirely under the visitor's command, with openness tracking gesture magnitude
Tactile and physical, with weighted drift, slack before response and smooth unwinding
Sculptural and dimensional rather than decorative overlay
Self-explanatory without instructions, discovered by poking
Calm and forgiving, always resolving back to stillness
completion_and_return: There is no terminal completion state; the experience is fully replayable
Release resolves to the nested rest arrangement rather than staying held
Attention leaving resets to the single flat picture regardless of how far the interaction progressed
No opened, fanned or leaned state persists after the visitor moves away
locked_observable_requirements: One image is the sole subject and every layer is a repeat of that same image
Rest state is a single flat still picture that hides all internal structure on an uncluttered low-distraction surround clearly separated in tone from the picture
Nested copies recede inward and open in a staggered one-after-another sequence rather than all at once
Pointer movement produces depth-proportional drift, with deeper copies moving further than nearer ones
Fanning requires a sustained press-and-drag past a small initial slack and is reversible by dragging the opposite way
Each copy rotates incrementally more than the one before it, forming a fan
Thin luminous edge lines, readably brighter than the surfaces they border, trace layer silhouettes while fanned
Spreading stops at a hard limit instead of continuing indefinitely
Release unwinds smoothly rather than snapping
Leaving returns everything to the flat single picture even from an abandoned mid-drag state
The only guidance is a small cue trailing the pointer that hides once the press starts
Touch reproduces the same behavior without scrolling the page
adaptable_details: Number of nested copies and their scale and offset spacing
Subject, aspect ratio and framing of the image
Exact luminance level and tone of the surrounding surround, whether light or dark, as long as it stays low-distraction and separated
Hue, thickness and intensity of the luminous edge lines
Timing, easing and stagger interval of opening and unwinding
Sensitivity, slack size and maximum spread of the drag
Shape and size of the trailing drag cue
Whether the region fills the viewport or sits as a bounded block
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits any single self-contained flat visual with a clear silhouette presented as a lone focal exhibit on a quiet low-distraction surround of any overall lightness, at any scale from a feature block to a full view. Replacing the repeated single image with a set of distinct images, or making the fanned copies persistent navigable items that each carry their own content or destination, would create a different Skill, as would removing the automatic return to a plain single picture in favor of a permanently expanded layout.

name: orbiting_image_sculpture
description: Many pictures are fused into one slowly rotating sculptural body floating on an empty, low-distraction field that keeps it clearly separated from its surround; visitors swing it with a drag, glide to a stop, and move the viewpoint closer to read single frames as they come around.

canonical_document.name: orbiting_image_sculpture
canonical_document.description: Many pictures are fused into one slowly rotating sculptural body floating on an empty, low-distraction field that keeps it clearly separated from its surround; visitors swing it with a drag, glide to a stop, and move the viewpoint closer to read single frames as they come around.
canonical_document.experience_scope: Whole-view experience that begins with a quiet waiting state on arrival, becomes the assembled rotating object filling the view, and never ends; it can also be deployed as a self-contained dominant region as long as it owns its own empty, undecorated backdrop and full pointer surface.
content_and_composition: One primary content role: a batch of images, many items rather than a handful, all treated as equal members with no single featured item
The images are composed into one coherent volumetric body arranged around a single upright axis, so the whole reads as one object rather than as separate tiles
An empty, uniform backdrop that holds a clear luminance separation from the images and carries no competing decoration, framing chrome or captions, so the assembly is the only figure in the view
A transient arrival message layer occupying the empty view before the object exists, replaced entirely rather than layered over the finished piece
No visible instructions, controls, labels or progress affordances in the steady state
experience_progression: Arrival: empty undecorated view with a calm waiting message that pulses gently, holding an unhurried pace instead of showing incremental assembly
Reveal: the completed assembly appears all at once in its opening framing, with nothing partially formed visible beforehand
Steady drift: a slow perpetual rotation around the upright axis begins and never stops, carrying each frame past the viewer and back again
Optional visitor episodes of turning, approaching and reframing that layer onto the drift and then subside back into it; no stage ever completes or terminates the experience
attention_and_information_flow: Attention is pulled first to the single object because the surrounding field is empty and uniform, offering nothing that competes for the eye
The slow continuous turn keeps the eye moving onward and gives each frame a turn at the front without ranking any of them
Detail is revealed by proximity: distant framing reads the collection as one sculptural whole, nearer framing makes individual pictures legible
During a drag, prominence follows the pointer, so the visitor's chosen part of the body swings to face them
No textual or numeric information is surfaced at any point; the pictures themselves are the only information

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Persists underneath and after every visitor interaction; resumes as the ambient state once input stops
interaction_model.state_change: Continuous slow rotation about the upright axis, never pausing or completing
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Frames travel steadily across the view and recur as the body comes around
interaction_model.input: Autonomous drift with no input
interaction_model.affected_object: The whole image assembly

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Interrupting or reversing mid-drag is picked up smoothly without snapping or losing position; the ambient drift continues throughout and reclaims motion afterward
interaction_model.state_change: Rotation is taken over by the pointer and swung around the upright center, then handed back to the drift
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The body tracks the pointer closely and immediately, then coasts with a brief glide that settles to rest after release
interaction_model.input: Primary drag anywhere across the view
interaction_model.affected_object: The whole image assembly

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: The limit is an absorbing boundary: continued input past it produces no further tilt, and dragging back moves smoothly away from the pole
interaction_model.state_change: Elevation changes up to a hard limit at the top and bottom poles
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The view rises or lowers over the object and simply stops at the poles, never flipping or inverting the scene
interaction_model.input: Vertical component of the drag (tilting the view up or down)
interaction_model.affected_object: Viewpoint elevation relative to the assembly

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Fully reversible in both directions at any time and combinable with an ongoing turn without disturbing it
interaction_model.state_change: Viewpoint moves nearer or further within a bounded range
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The object grows or shrinks in the view; near framing makes single pictures readable, far framing restores the sculptural read
interaction_model.input: Scroll or pinch
interaction_model.affected_object: Viewpoint distance from the assembly

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Reversible by dragging back; the opening framing remains the resting reference the view settles back into
interaction_model.state_change: The framing shifts so a different part of the assembly sits at the center of attention
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The object slides within the view while continuing to drift and hold its orientation
interaction_model.input: Secondary drag
interaction_model.affected_object: Framing of the view

experience_qualities: Unhurried and calm on arrival rather than eager or busy
Sculptural and monolithic: the collection reads as one built object, not a list
Hypnotic and endless, inviting lingering with no sense of a finish line
Physically responsive: close pointer tracking with weighty coasting rather than snapping
Instruction-free and self-explanatory
Airy and gallery-like because of the uninterrupted emptiness surrounding the object
completion_and_return: Nothing ever completes; the drift loops indefinitely so every frame recurs
Visitor-driven turning, zooming and reframing always subside back into the ambient drift
The opening framing acts as the natural resting reference the view settles back into
No progress, score, end state or dismissal; leaving and returning simply restarts from the calm wait and all-at-once reveal
locked_observable_requirements: Many images composed into one single body around one upright axis, reading as one object rather than a collection of separate items
An empty, chrome-free backdrop that stays uniform and clearly separated in luminance from the images, with the assembly as the only figure
A calm gently pulsing wait state that resolves into an all-at-once reveal of the finished piece, never a piecewise build-up
A slow perpetual rotation that never stops or completes and continues during and after visitor input
Drag-to-turn that follows the pointer closely and coasts to rest with a brief glide after release
Distance control that makes individual pictures readable up close and the whole sculptural again from afar
Hard stops at the top and bottom poles so the view never flips
Smooth pickup of interrupted or reversed drags
No instructions, labels or visible controls in the steady state
adaptable_details: Exact geometry of the assembled body and how images are distributed within it
Number, aspect ratio and cropping of the images
Drift speed and direction, glide duration and pointer sensitivity
Backdrop tone, hue and lightness anywhere in the quiet, low-distraction range that keeps the images clearly separated from it
Wording and typography of the wait message and the rhythm of its pulse
Near and far limits of the distance range and the amount of framing shift allowed
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits medium-to-large batches of equally weighted visual items whose collective mass is the message, in showcase, landing or collection views that can own the whole pointer surface and an empty, low-distraction field that separates cleanly from the items. It stops being this Skill if items gain individual selection, detail views or captions that turn it into a browsing interface, if the set is small enough to read as discrete pieces, if the arrangement flattens into a list or grid, if the motion becomes a finite sequence with an end state, or if the object must sit behind foreground text as a background substrate.

source_sites.title: Kinetic Images with React Three Fiber

name: cursor_trailed_single_image_reveal_over_text_list
description: A calm run of short text entries divided by thin rules that shows no pictures until a pointer settles on an entry, at which moment that entry's large photo appears exactly under the pointer and follows it with a soft trailing lag, handing over instantly to a neighbour's photo and fading out when the pointer leaves.

canonical_document.name: cursor_trailed_single_image_reveal_over_text_list
canonical_document.description: A calm run of short text entries divided by thin rules that shows no pictures until a pointer settles on an entry, at which moment that entry's large photo appears exactly under the pointer and follows it with a soft trailing lag, handing over instantly to a neighbour's photo and fading out when the pointer leaves.
canonical_document.experience_scope: Region experience confined to the block containing the run of entries. It begins the instant the pointer makes contact with any single entry, persists while the pointer stays within the run, and ends when the pointer leaves the entries and the block returns to its original text-only state. The rest of the page is unaffected.
content_and_composition: A small vertical run of short text entries, a handful in number, read top to bottom as one continuous list.
Thin hairline rules separate adjacent entries and are the only visual structure present at rest.
Each entry owns exactly one associated photo; the mapping is one-to-one.
At most one photo exists on screen at any moment, regardless of how quickly focus moves.
The photo sits on a floating layer above the text, positioned at the pointer rather than in a reserved slot in the layout, and it does not displace or reflow any text.
The photo is large enough to read as a real picture rather than a small thumbnail or icon, so the word–image pairing is unmistakable.
The photo layer is visually on top but never intercepts pointing at the entries beneath it, so entries under the image remain hoverable.
Persistent elements across all states: the text entries, their order and the separating rules.
experience_progression: Rest: quiet, text-only run with no imagery competing for attention.
Contact: focus lands on one entry and its photo materialises at the exact point of focus.
Tracking: while the pointer moves within that entry, the photo follows with a soft, slightly delayed chase rather than a rigid lock.
Handover: moving straight into an adjacent entry trades the current photo for the next one at once, keeping continuity of a single travelling image.
Withdrawal: drawing away from the entries fades the photo out and restores the rest state.
The cycle repeats per entry for as long as the viewer explores the run; there is no terminal end state.
attention_and_information_flow: At rest attention belongs entirely to the text; no image draws the eye, and the run reads as a calm reading surface.
On contact the revealed photo becomes the dominant visual element, but only locally, anchored to the pointer and therefore to the entry being read.
Because only one image ever exists, the visual system always answers exactly one question: what does this entry look like.
The trailing lag keeps a light trace of the direction of travel, so the eye follows movement along the run.
Withdrawal collapses the revealed information back to nothing, returning the viewer to the overview reading state.

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Moving back off immediately fades it out again; repeated contact always re-appears at the new contact point rather than resuming an old position
interaction_model.state_change: Hidden to visible, positioned at the contact point
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The photo appears exactly under the pointer at full presence, without gliding in from wherever an image last sat
interaction_model.input: Pointer makes first contact with an entry
interaction_model.affected_object: That entry's associated photo

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Motion can be interrupted at any moment by stopping, reversing or leaving; the photo simply settles or fades from wherever it currently is
interaction_model.state_change: Continuous position update toward the pointer with easing
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The photo chases the pointer with a soft trailing lag, catching up when the pointer slows, never snapping rigidly onto it
interaction_model.input: Pointer moves while inside an entry
interaction_model.affected_object: The currently visible photo

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Sweeping back reverses the handover the same way; only ever one photo remains on screen
interaction_model.state_change: Immediate handover from the outgoing photo to the incoming one
interaction_model.visible_feedback: One photo is traded for the next without a gap and without both being present, so the impression is of a single travelling image changing content
interaction_model.input: Pointer sweeps straight from one entry into a neighbouring entry
interaction_model.affected_object: The photo layer and the two entries' photos

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Re-entering restarts the reveal at the new contact point; nothing is left behind
interaction_model.state_change: Visible to hidden
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The photo fades away and the run returns to its quiet text-only appearance
interaction_model.input: Pointer leaves the entries
interaction_model.affected_object: The visible photo

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: The final resting state always matches where the pointer actually is; leaving the region guarantees a clean, empty rest state
interaction_model.state_change: Rapidly alternating reveal and hide requests resolve into a single coherent state
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The fade reverses smoothly mid-flight with no flicker, no duplicated images and never an image stranded on screen after the pointer has left
interaction_model.input: Quick in-and-out flicks across entry edges
interaction_model.affected_object: The photo layer

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: The image can never trap the pointer or cause a stuck reveal
interaction_model.state_change: None; targeting is unaffected by the overlapping image
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Hovering continues to respond to the entry actually under the pointer, so reveal and handover never stall or flicker because of the image itself
interaction_model.input: Pointer moves over an area where the photo overlaps the entries beneath it
interaction_model.affected_object: Hover targeting of the entries

experience_qualities: Quiet and text-forward at rest, almost editorial in restraint
Light, snappy and playful on contact rather than heavy or ceremonial
Soft trailing motion that feels loose and physical instead of mechanically locked
Unmistakable one-to-one pairing between the words being read and the image being shown
Reliable and forgiving under fast, erratic movement, never leaving visual debris
completion_and_return: There is no completion; the experience loops for as long as exploration continues.
Leaving the entries always returns the region to its original text-only rest state.
No revealed image persists after withdrawal, and no per-entry state is remembered between visits.
Each new contact starts fresh at the pointer's current position.
locked_observable_requirements: Rest state shows no imagery at all: only short text entries divided by thin rules.
Exactly one photo may be visible at any instant, never zero-plus-lingering and never two.
On first contact the photo appears at the pointer's exact position, not animated in from a previous or default location.
While tracking, the photo follows the pointer with a perceptible soft lag rather than a rigid one-to-one lock.
The photo is large enough to read as a real picture, not a small thumbnail.
The photo layer never blocks pointing at the entries beneath it, so hovering stays reliable everywhere it overlaps.
Entry-to-neighbour movement hands the photo over immediately, with no double-image and no gap in presence.
Fast in-and-out movement reverses the fade smoothly and never strands an image on screen after the pointer leaves.
Withdrawal restores the exact original quiet state.
adaptable_details: Number of entries and the length and typography of their text
Subject matter of the photos and of the entries
Image size, aspect ratio, framing, corner treatment and any subtle shadow or border
Amount of trailing lag and the speed and curve of the fade
Rule thickness, its contrast against the surrounding surface, spacing, and the overall colour treatment of the region
Whether the image is centred on the pointer or offset from it
Optional small text emphasis on the focused entry, as long as the resting state stays image-free
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits any short run of text entries where each entry maps to exactly one representative image and the page is meant to read as calm text at rest: indexes of works, articles, people, places, products or menu items. It depends on a hovering pointer within a single contained list region. It becomes a different skill if multiple images are shown at once, if images become persistent inline or grid thumbnails, if the image occupies a fixed panel instead of following the pointer, or if reveal is driven by scroll position, tap or selection rather than pointer presence. Very long lists or entries whose meaning needs several images also fall outside it.

name: depth_field_image_header_with_replayable_arrival
description: Pictures materialise into an open, low-distraction space at varied depths around a short title, tilt against one another as the pointer moves, then clear outward and past the viewer as you scroll to hand attention to a brief explanatory note; the opening can be restarted at any time.

canonical_document.name: depth_field_image_header_with_replayable_arrival
canonical_document.description: Pictures materialise into an open, low-distraction space at varied depths around a short title, tilt against one another as the pointer moves, then clear outward and past the viewer as you scroll to hand attention to a brief explanatory note; the opening can be restarted at any time.
canonical_document.experience_scope: A region experience occupying the first, full-width header view of a page. It begins on arrival in that view and ends when scroll-driven departure has carried the imagery past the viewer and the short note below it holds attention alone; it does not govern the rest of the page.
content_and_composition: One short primary title as the anchored foreground focus of the composition, persistent throughout the opening
A small set of pictures (a handful) distributed around the title at visibly different depths, overlapping and offset from one another rather than aligned in a plane
An open, low-density surrounding space acting as the substrate the pictures occupy, held far enough from them in tone that each picture's edges stay clearly readable against it
One short explanatory note positioned after the header as the destination of attention once the pictures clear
One persistent replay control that re-triggers the opening
experience_progression: Arrival: open, uncluttered space with the title registering first in clear contrast against it and no imagery competing with it
A beat later: pictures materialise into their positions around the title, settling at their respective depths
Settled idle state: arrangement remains alive, responding to pointer movement with bounded viewpoint tilt
Scroll-linked departure: pictures advance outward, upward and past the viewer in step with scroll position, thinning the field
Handoff: imagery has cleared and the short explanatory note holds attention
Replay: the opening can be restarted from its first stage at any point, including part-way through it
attention_and_information_flow: Message before imagery: the title claims attention alone, then the pictures join around it rather than with it
Pointer tilt shifts the pictures relative to one another so their spacing in depth becomes readable and the group is understood as layered, not flat
As scroll carries the pictures away, prominence transfers from the imagery to the short explanatory note
Scrolling back restores the imagery to exactly its prior prominence and arrangement

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Tilt never exceeds its bounded range and settles gently as it approaches the limits; the viewpoint returns toward rest when the pointer stops or leaves, and the effect remains continuously available
interaction_model.state_change: Viewpoint tilts away from rest by a small, bounded amount tracking pointer position; pictures displace relative to one another according to their depth
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Pictures shift against each other, revealing their separation in depth; motion eases into place instead of snapping
interaction_model.input: Pointer movement anywhere over the header region
interaction_model.affected_object: Viewpoint onto the depth arrangement of pictures

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Fully reversible: scrolling back returns each picture exactly to its previous position; there is no committed threshold or one-way transition
interaction_model.state_change: Pictures advance outward, upward and past the viewer in direct step with scroll offset rather than on a timed run
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The arrangement disperses and passes by, opening the view onto the short explanatory note
interaction_model.input: Scroll position within the header
interaction_model.affected_object: The set of pictures as a group

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: An in-progress opening is interrupted and replaced by a fresh run; the control stays available for repeated use
interaction_model.state_change: Opening restarts from its first stage, whether it has finished or is still part-way through
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The space clears and the title-then-imagery arrival plays again from the beginning
interaction_model.input: Single press of the replay control
interaction_model.affected_object: The whole opening sequence

experience_qualities: Open and uncluttered rather than dense or enclosed
Physically deep and alive rather than flat
Calm, eased motion with gentle settling at limits
Deliberately staggered and unhurried, so the message lands before the imagery
Rewarding a moment of looking and small exploratory pointer movement
completion_and_return: The opening completes into a settled, still-responsive idle state rather than stopping dead
Scroll departure is position-bound and exactly reversible in both directions
The replay control resets the experience to its first stage at any time
After departure, the short explanatory note is the resting destination of attention
locked_observable_requirements: Title registers first; the pictures materialise a beat afterwards
Several pictures occupy visibly distinct depths around the title, not a single plane
Pointer-driven viewpoint tilt is small, bounded, eased, and settles gently at its limits
Picture movement on scroll is tied to scroll position and reverses exactly on scrolling back
Departure direction carries the pictures outward, upward and past the viewer
Departure hands attention to a short explanatory note
The opening is restartable at any time, including mid-play
The surrounding space stays open and low-density around the imagery, holding enough tonal separation for each picture's edges and the title to read clearly against it
adaptable_details: Exact number of pictures within a handful, and their subject matter
Specific geometry of the arrangement around the title
Magnitude of the tilt, easing character and timing of the stagger
Typography and styling of the title and the explanatory note
Appearance and placement of the replay control
Palette and overall lightness of the surround, provided it stays low-density and low-distraction and keeps readable separation from the pictures and title
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits opening header regions that pair one short message with a small set of images worth close looking, where the reader is expected to scroll onward to a brief explanation. Large collections, grids that impose a reading order, imagery that must stay fixed and flat for legibility, or a scroll transition that commits irreversibly to the next section would each produce a different Skill.

name: scroll_pinned_image_run_with_rising_captions
description: A framed picture stage that locks mid-view, opens from a small centred window to a full-bleed image, then cross-fades through a picture run as short titles and one-line captions rise in and slide away, with a seconds-marked time scale beside it showing the pacing.

canonical_document.name: scroll_pinned_image_run_with_rising_captions
canonical_document.description: A framed picture stage that locks mid-view, opens from a small centred window to a full-bleed image, then cross-fades through a picture run as short titles and one-line captions rise in and slide away, with a seconds-marked time scale beside it showing the pacing.
canonical_document.experience_scope: A bounded region experience occupying a tall scroll passage in the middle of an ordinary page: it begins with a short written lead-in above the run, takes over the viewport while the frame is held in place, and ends when the window closes and the page releases to normal scrolling with further content below.
content_and_composition: A brief written lead-in above the run that explains what follows and visually points to where the run begins
One framed picture stage, centred in the view, showing exactly one image at a time from an ordered set of several images
A window/aperture layer inside the frame that starts small and centred and expands to the frame edges, defining how much of the picture is visible
Per-image text block containing one short title and one line of caption text, positioned as an overlay or adjacent band tied to the current picture
A time scale rendered beside the run as a persistent element, marking passing seconds and the start and end points of each caption span
Ordinary page content continuing below the run, outside the held frame
experience_progression: Lead-in text read, with the entry point to the run clearly indicated
Frame approaches the middle of the view and the small centred window begins widening outward
Window reaches the frame edges and the picture is shown edge to edge; the frame holds its position in the view
Held phase advances through the ordered pictures at fixed points along the scroll travel, one picture at a time
For each picture: image settles, then after a beat its title and caption arrive, and the text clears again before the next picture appears
After the last picture is spent, the window closes back down and the frame is released
Page resumes ordinary scrolling into the content below, with the whole run retraceable by scrolling back up
attention_and_information_flow: Attention starts wide on explanatory text, then narrows to a single framed picture as the window opens
Only one picture and one title/caption pair are readable at any moment; nothing competes for attention inside the held frame
Text arrives after the picture has settled so the image is seen first and the words are read second
The time scale beside the run carries secondary, ambient information about pacing and caption duration and is legible without stealing focus
Prominence returns to normal page reading once the window closes and the frame releases

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Scrolling back up narrows the window along the same path to its small centred state; stopping mid-way holds a stable partially opened window
interaction_model.state_change: Window transitions from small and centred to filling the frame edge to edge
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The visible picture area widens outward from the centre until the image is full-bleed within the frame
interaction_model.input: Vertical scrolling that brings the frame toward the middle of the view
interaction_model.affected_object: The window/aperture layer over the framed picture

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Scrolling backwards reverses the picture order and cross-fade exactly; pausing anywhere leaves a stable frame with no self-advancing motion
interaction_model.state_change: Advance from the current picture to the next at fixed points along the scroll travel
interaction_model.visible_feedback: One picture cross-fades into the next in the same frame position, with the frame itself not moving
interaction_model.input: Continued vertical scrolling while the frame is held in place
interaction_model.affected_object: The ordered picture set inside the frame

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Moving back reverses the direction of entry and exit so text returns the way it left; a paused scroll holds the caption in place
interaction_model.state_change: Caption enters a beat after the picture settles, then clears before the next picture arrives
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Text rises into place from below when moving forward and leaves upward as the run advances
interaction_model.input: Vertical scrolling past the point where a picture has settled
interaction_model.affected_object: The current picture's short title and one-line caption

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Scrolling back moves the indicated position back along the same scale, keeping the run retraceable
interaction_model.state_change: Position along the scale tracks the run's progress
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Marked seconds and per-caption start and end spans make the pacing of each picture and caption self-evident
interaction_model.input: Scroll progress through the held run
interaction_model.affected_object: The time scale beside the run

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Scrolling back up re-holds the frame, reopens the window and re-enters the run at the corresponding picture
interaction_model.state_change: Run completes, the window closes and the frame stops being held
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The visible picture area narrows back down and the page continues scrolling normally into content below
interaction_model.input: Scrolling past the last picture of the run
interaction_model.affected_object: The window layer and the held frame

experience_qualities: Deliberate and unhurried pacing rather than jumpy transitions
Cinematic focus on one large image at a time
Fully scrubbable and reversible under the user's own scroll speed
Nothing moves on its own; all motion is answerable to the input
Self-explanatory timing thanks to the visible time scale
Clean handoff back to ordinary page reading
completion_and_return: The run completes after the last picture, closing the window and releasing the frame to normal scrolling
No looping: the sequence has a definite start and end tied to the scroll passage
The entire run remains retraceable, with backward scrolling restoring picture, caption, window and time-scale states exactly
Pausing at any point persists that exact state until scrolling resumes
locked_observable_requirements: Vertical scroll is the only driver; no autoplay, timers or click controls advance the run
A written lead-in precedes the run and indicates where it begins
The frame holds in place in the view for the duration of the run and releases afterwards
The reveal begins as a small centred window that widens outward until the picture fills the frame edge to edge
Exactly one picture is visible at a time and pictures change by cross-fade at fixed points along the scroll travel
Each picture carries one short title and one line of caption text
Caption text arrives a beat after its picture settles and clears before the next picture appears
