Captions rise from below when moving forward and leave upward, reversing direction when moving back
A time scale sits beside the run marking passing seconds and the start and end of each caption
Backward scrolling undoes picture, caption and window states exactly; pausing yields a stable non-advancing frame
Past the end the window closes and the page returns to ordinary scrolling with content continuing below
adaptable_details: Number of pictures in the run and the length of the scroll passage
Frame proportions and whether the stage is full-viewport or inset
Placement of the title/caption block as overlay or adjacent band
Side and visual styling of the time scale and how its second marks are drawn
Wording and length of the lead-in text
Cross-fade duration and the size of the beat between picture settling and caption arrival
Shape and styling of the opening window as long as it grows outward from a small centred state
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits an ordered set of a handful of strong single images each paired with a very short title and one-line description, placed as a mid-page passage with content before and after and enough scroll length to give each image its own travel segment. It stops being this Skill if pictures advance on their own timer or by clicking arrows, if several images are visible simultaneously in a grid or track, if the frame scrolls past instead of holding, if the reveal is a plain fade instead of an outward-widening window, or if the per-image text grows into multi-paragraph content that becomes the primary reading material.

name: aperture_framed_scroll_scrubbed_clip
description: A framed clip that widens open from a small central aperture, parks mid-screen while scrolling scrubs its playback forward and backward frame by frame, surfaces one short caption at a time, and closes back down to release the page.

canonical_document.name: aperture_framed_scroll_scrubbed_clip
canonical_document.description: A framed clip that widens open from a small central aperture, parks mid-screen while scrolling scrubs its playback forward and backward frame by frame, surfaces one short caption at a time, and closes back down to release the page.
canonical_document.experience_scope: A self-contained region inside an ordinary scrolling page. It begins with a short written lead-in and a prompt to continue, takes over the viewport when the frame reaches mid-screen, and ends when the frame closes and normal page scrolling resumes; the surrounding page remains a conventional reading document.
content_and_composition: One framed media surface as the single focal object, centered and held at mid-screen for the duration of the section
A brief written lead-in above the frame plus an explicit prompt to continue scrolling, and a matching prompt after the section for readers arriving from the opposite direction
A small set of short captions, exactly one visible at any moment, layered with the frame rather than competing with it
A slim vertical scale of labelled markers running the length of the section: one marker per whole second of footage plus a marker at each caption's start and end point
The aperture mask that defines the frame's opening and closing shape, present at both boundaries of the section
experience_progression: Read the lead-in text and the prompt to continue
The frame widens open from a small central aperture as the section is entered
The frame holds at mid-screen and playback position tracks scroll position continuously, forward or backward
Captions replace one another in sequence as progress passes their start and end points
After the final caption the aperture closes back down and the frame is released
Ordinary reading resumes below, with the reverse direction offering the same staged sequence in mirror order
attention_and_information_flow: Attention narrows from full-width text to a single framed object as the aperture opens
Only one caption competes for reading attention at a time, so each moment of the footage stays legible
The labelled marker scale gives a persistent, low-prominence sense of position and of how much footage remains
Attention widens back to ordinary body reading once the aperture closes

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Stopping the scroll freezes the current frame indefinitely; no autonomous playback ever resumes on its own
interaction_model.state_change: Frame becomes held at mid-screen; playback position advances in direct proportion to scroll position, frame by frame
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Footage advances in lockstep with the scroll gesture; the frame stays fixed while the page behind it appears to pause
interaction_model.input: Scrolling downward through the section
interaction_model.affected_object: Framed media surface and its playback position

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Direction can be changed at any point; the sequence is fully reversible with no lost or skipped state
interaction_model.state_change: Playback position moves backward and caption order reverses
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Footage runs in reverse and captions change back through the sequence, each caption entering from the direction of travel
interaction_model.input: Scrolling upward within the section
interaction_model.affected_object: Framed media surface, caption sequence and marker alignment

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Reversing direction restores the previous caption with entry from the opposite side
interaction_model.state_change: One caption is exchanged for the next or previous one, never more than one visible
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The outgoing caption leaves and the incoming caption enters from the side matching the travel direction
interaction_model.input: Scroll progress crossing a caption's start or end point
interaction_model.affected_object: Caption layer

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Alignment is derived from progress, so it is always consistent after any stop or reversal
interaction_model.state_change: Marker highlighting stays aligned with current playback position
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Second markers and caption boundary markers track progress, showing position within the footage
interaction_model.input: Continuous scroll progress
interaction_model.affected_object: Slim labelled marker scale along the section

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Re-entering from either boundary re-opens the aperture and resumes the held, scroll-driven state
interaction_model.state_change: Frame is released from its held position and the page returns to normal scrolling
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Aperture closes down and the frame leaves the viewport with the surrounding content
interaction_model.input: Scrolling past either end of the section
interaction_model.affected_object: Frame and page scroll

experience_qualities: Calm and unhurried, with no motion the reader did not cause
Entirely viewer-paced: pace, pauses and direction all belong to the reader
Focused and cinematic through the aperture framing and single-caption discipline
Legible, because only one short line of text is ever competing with the footage
Reversible and forgiving, with symmetrical behavior in both travel directions
completion_and_return: Completion occurs after the last caption, when the aperture closes and the frame is released to normal page flow
No looping and no autonomous replay; the footage rests wherever the reader left it
Re-entering the section from either end restores the held, scroll-driven state and re-opens the aperture
A matching prompt at the far side signals the same experience when approached in reverse
locked_observable_requirements: The frame widens open from a small central aperture on entry and closes back down on exit
The frame is held at mid-screen for the whole section rather than scrolling past
Playback position follows scroll position continuously and frame by frame, so stopping freezes the current frame
Scrolling upward runs footage and caption changes in reverse
Exactly one short caption is visible at a time, entering from the direction of travel
A slim scale of labelled markers, one per whole second plus each caption's start and end point, stays aligned with progress
Written lead-in with a continue prompt precedes the section and a matching prompt supports arrival from the other direction
Passing either end releases the frame back to normal page scrolling
adaptable_details: Subject and length of the footage
Number and wording of captions
Aperture shape, frame proportions and opening/closing rate
Typography, color treatment and marker styling or label format
Caption placement relative to the frame and the distance of caption entry motion
Total scroll distance allocated to the section
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits short continuous footage or ordered image sequences whose interest lies in steady progression through a scene, carrying only a few short captions, placed as one region inside a text-first page. It stops being this Skill if playback runs on its own clock or on button controls instead of scroll position, if multiple captions or several media surfaces are shown at once, if the frame simply scrolls past instead of being held and released at boundaries, or if the footage is long enough that reading one caption at a time no longer covers it.

name: endless_drifting_image_field
description: An edgeless field of images that gathers out of the screen's center on arrival, then glides in any direction under drag or two-axis scroll with momentum, repeating forever while each image's details fade in as it comes into view.

canonical_document.name: endless_drifting_image_field
canonical_document.description: An edgeless field of images that gathers out of the screen's center on arrival, then glides in any direction under drag or two-axis scroll with momentum, repeating forever while each image's details fade in as it comes into view.
canonical_document.experience_scope: Whole-view, region-filling experience: it begins the moment the view opens with the center-out assembly and never terminates — there is no end state, exit boundary or destination view; it persists as the primary browsing surface for as long as the visitor stays.
content_and_composition: Primary role: many images of a single collection, comparable in role and treated as peers, laid out as one continuous two-dimensional field with even spacing and no visible container edge
Secondary role: a small compact metadata block bound to each image (four short facts, e.g. title, format, edition, year), positioned in fixed relation to its image and legible without obscuring it
The field is unbounded in all directions: content repeats so previously seen images reappear from any direction, and no row, column, first or last item is distinguishable
Persistent elements: the field itself and the cursor treatment; there is no visible chrome, pagination, minimap, scrollbar or edge indicator
Each image has an inner frame that can be offset independently of the image's placement in the field, so the visible crop can shift within its own bounds
experience_progression: On open, images emerge from the middle of the screen and travel outward to their places in the field
They settle into one continuous, evenly composed field with no residual motion
From there the experience is open-ended and non-linear: motion is entirely visitor-driven and the field loops indefinitely with no stages, milestones or arrival point
attention_and_information_flow: The assembly pulls attention to the center first, then hands it outward to the full field, establishing that the collection extends past the viewport
Attention follows the direction of travel; the field itself carries no ranking or highlight, so no single image is prioritized
Each image's metadata rises quietly into place as the image enters view and withdraws as it leaves, so only in-view items carry text and the field stays visually calm
Holding a press lifts the imagery slightly forward in prominence, marking the whole field as grasped rather than singling out one item

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Runs once on arrival; visitor input during the assembly is absorbed into the field's motion rather than blocked, and the field remains usable immediately afterward
interaction_model.state_change: Images move from a clustered center origin to their resting positions in the continuous field
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Pieces spread outward from the middle of the screen and come to rest as one even field
interaction_model.input: View opens (autonomous)
interaction_model.affected_object: The whole image field

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Motion decays to a soft stop when the gesture ends; reversing direction mid-motion turns the drift around immediately with no bounce, and because the field has no edges nothing can be pushed out of reach
interaction_model.state_change: The entire arrangement translates in the gesture's direction on both axes
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The field slides as one body; new images arrive from the leading edges and metadata fades in and out accordingly
interaction_model.input: Wheel or trackpad gesture on either axis
interaction_model.affected_object: The whole image field

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Releasing hands motion back to momentum and returns the swell and cursor to their resting state; reversing the drag reverses travel at once; a press with no movement simply holds the field still
interaction_model.state_change: The field is carried directly with the pointer, then released into momentum
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The field tracks the drag one-to-one, the cursor switches to its held state, the imagery swells slightly while the press is held, and on release the field glides on and eases to a soft stop
interaction_model.input: Press and drag anywhere over the imagery
interaction_model.affected_object: The whole image field

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: The nudge is small and self-settling; the framing returns toward neutral when the pointer stops, and it never competes with an active drag or momentum glide
interaction_model.state_change: The field is nudged gently toward the pointer's movement while each image's internal framing shifts
interaction_model.visible_feedback: A soft drift of the whole arrangement plus a subtle parallax of the picture inside its own frame, giving the field depth and tactility at rest
interaction_model.input: Pointer hovering over the imagery without pressing
interaction_model.affected_object: The image field and the crop inside each image

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Reverts to the grabbable state on release and to the default state when the pointer leaves the field
interaction_model.state_change: Cursor reads as grabbable, then as grabbing while held
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Two distinct cursor states signalling that the whole field can be taken hold of and is currently held
interaction_model.input: Pointer resting over the imagery
interaction_model.affected_object: The cursor

Calm and quiet, with information appearing only where the visitor is looking

Every gesture completes in the same resting condition: a settled field with no residual motion, resting cursor, resting scale and resting internal framing

locked_observable_requirements: Opens directly into the collection with a center-out assembly that settles into one continuous field

Momentum with a soft stop after release, and immediate direction reversal when the input reverses
Grabbable and grabbing cursor states, plus a slight swell of the imagery while held
Pointer movement alone nudges the field and shifts the framing inside each image
Per-item metadata rises into place as an item enters view and withdraws as it leaves

Which and how many short facts appear in the metadata block, and its placement relative to the image

Whether images are uniform or mixed in size, as long as the field stays evenly continuous
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits collections of many comparable, image-first items where order carries no meaning and any item is an acceptable starting point — visual work, product or object catalogues, photo archives, showcase reels. Requires enough items for the wrap to feel like abundance rather than obvious repetition. Introducing visible edges, a required sequence, ranked or hierarchical emphasis, a single hero focus, or text-primary items would make it a different Skill, as would replacing the free two-axis field with one-directional or paged movement.

name: lagging_column_shear_image_wall
description: A wall of evenly spaced vertical image columns that arrives complete after a short calm pause, then leans and staggers out of alignment as scrolling moves it, with outer columns trailing furthest behind and everything easing back into neat rows the moment motion stops.

canonical_document.name: lagging_column_shear_image_wall
canonical_document.description: A wall of evenly spaced vertical image columns that arrives complete after a short calm pause, then leans and staggers out of alignment as scrolling moves it, with outer columns trailing furthest behind and everything easing back into neat rows the moment motion stops.
canonical_document.experience_scope: Whole-view collection experience: begins with a brief quiet holding moment before anything is shown, occupies the entire browsing surface as the primary content region, and has no terminal state — it continues as long as the viewer keeps scrolling and can be left at any point.
content_and_composition: Primary role: a large set of upright portrait-oriented visual items, each paired with a short caption that travels with its item.
Items are distributed across multiple evenly spaced vertical columns forming a continuous wall; column count is uniform in width and spacing.
At rest, items align into readable horizontal rows across columns; in motion the rows visibly break into a staggered diagonal-feeling offset.
Depth ordering is implied by differential lag rather than overlap: centre columns read as leading, outer columns as trailing.
Before the collection appears, the view holds a calm empty or minimal state with no partial items visible.
experience_progression: Quiet hold: a short, deliberately calm waiting moment with nothing of the collection revealed piecemeal.
Unified arrival: the entire collection becomes visible in one coordinated moment as already-aligned even columns.
Open drift: continuous scroll-driven traversal with repeated shear-and-settle cycles, no required beginning, milestone or end.
Settle: whenever input stops, columns converge back to shared alignment and stillness.
attention_and_information_flow: The initial hold suppresses attention entirely, so the arrival of the full collection is the first visual event.
During motion, the staggered offset draws the eye across columns and emphasizes the collection as one moving mass rather than individual items.
At rest, restored row alignment shifts attention to individual items and their captions for reading and lingering.
Faster scrolling increases the sense of spread and motion; slowing restores calm legibility.
No single item is ever singled out as the focal point or destination.

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Input can stop at any moment; the collection always eases to a stable resting position and never overshoots into an unreadable state
interaction_model.state_change: Collection position follows the input with easing instead of tracking it exactly, so it lags and then converges toward the input position
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Soft, weighted travel of the entire collection that continues briefly after input pauses before coming to rest
interaction_model.input: Vertical scrolling of the view
interaction_model.affected_object: The whole column wall of items and captions

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Offset is bounded and stays visually coherent; releasing input removes it
interaction_model.state_change: Each column trails the overall movement by a different amount, with outer columns trailing further behind than central ones
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Tidy rows shear apart into a gently staggered offset that grows outward from the centre
interaction_model.input: Continued scrolling in one direction
interaction_model.affected_object: Individual columns relative to each other

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Spread relaxes proportionally as intensity drops; it does not latch at its widest value
interaction_model.state_change: Spread between leading and trailing columns widens with input intensity
interaction_model.visible_feedback: A more pronounced stagger and stronger sense of physical drag across the wall
interaction_model.input: Scrolling harder or faster
interaction_model.affected_object: Per-column offset spread

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Reversal is safe at any moment, including mid-settle, and never leaves a column stranded away from the group
interaction_model.state_change: The direction of the stagger inverts so trailing columns now lag on the opposite side
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The shear visibly flips through alignment and reforms mirrored
interaction_model.input: Reversing scroll direction
interaction_model.affected_object: Per-column offset spread

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Interrupting the catch-up with new input in either direction resumes smoothly from the current staggered state rather than snapping or resetting
interaction_model.state_change: Every column independently catches up to the shared position and re-aligns
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The stagger closes on its own into orderly rows and complete stillness
interaction_model.input: Easing off or stopping input
interaction_model.affected_object: All columns

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Trailing behaviour, easing and current alignment remain intact after reflow; item order is never scrambled
interaction_model.state_change: The wall reflows to a different number of columns while item sequence is preserved
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Columns re-form at new widths and spacing with the collection still reading as one evenly spaced wall
interaction_model.input: Resizing the viewport
interaction_model.affected_object: Column arrangement of the collection

experience_qualities: Calm and unhurried on entry, with no piecemeal popping-in
Physical and weighted rather than mechanical or step-locked
Soft, elastic shear that reads as drag rather than glitching
Orderly at rest, expressive in motion
Non-linear and open-ended: safe to drift, linger, or leave anywhere
completion_and_return: No completion state, milestone or end marker; the experience simply rests wherever the viewer stops.
Every motion cycle returns to the same canonical resting state of aligned, evenly spaced columns.
The collection reads as one coherent whole from any resting position, including immediately after entry.
locked_observable_requirements: A short quiet hold precedes any visible collection content; items never appear one by one on entry.
The full collection becomes visible in a single coordinated arrival as already-aligned even vertical columns.
Collection movement follows scroll input with easing, never rigid one-to-one tracking or snapping.
Columns trail the shared movement by differing amounts, with outer columns lagging more than central ones, visibly shearing the rows during motion.
Offset magnitude scales with input intensity and inverts with input direction.
Stopping input causes all columns to self-converge back into aligned stillness.
Direction changes or interruptions mid-convergence remain visually safe, with no column left stranded or permanently misaligned.
Viewport resizing changes the number of columns while preserving item order and the trailing behaviour.
adaptable_details: Exact number of columns and their widths and gaps
Duration of the entry hold and the easing feel or settle timing
Magnitude of the maximum stagger and how lag is distributed from centre to edge

Total collection size and whether traversal is finite or endlessly continuing
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits any large set of similarly shaped upright visual items with short accompanying labels where browsing is exploratory and no item is a required destination; the columned wall and centre-to-edge lag depend on many items of comparable proportion. It stops being this Skill if items become individually selectable focal destinations, if the layout abandons uniform columns for irregular or overlapping arrangement, if movement snaps rigidly to items or sections, or if the shear persists at rest instead of resolving into alignment.

name: dwell_opened_half_screen_item_preview
description: A screen-filling grid of items where resting on one tile dims and nudges the opposite half aside so that item resolves into a single large preview with its name, price and self-advancing extra shots, and leaving rewinds it back to the plain grid.

canonical_document.name: dwell_opened_half_screen_item_preview
canonical_document.description: A screen-filling grid of items where resting on one tile dims and nudges the opposite half aside so that item resolves into a single large preview with its name, price and self-advancing extra shots, and leaving rewinds it back to the plain grid.
canonical_document.experience_scope: One whole-view experience confined to a single screen: it begins when the assortment resolves to fill the viewport edge to edge and ends when the pointer leaves all items and the plain overview is restored. Dwell concentrates attention: half the grid recedes in brightness and position while one enlarged view becomes the dominant object
Information is revealed in a fixed order of increasing specificity: large image, then name and price, then further angles over time

interaction_model.visible_feedback: Nothing dims, drifts or opens, so sweeping across the assortment stays visually quiet
interaction_model.input: Pointer brushing across tiles faster than the intent dwell
interaction_model.affected_object: Grid and preview slot

interaction_model.input: Pointer moving directly from one item tile onto another
interaction_model.affected_object: The large preview and its accompanying name, price and shot sequence

interaction_model.state_change: Previewing state returns to plain overview
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The whole reveal plays in reverse: preview and labels withdraw, dimmed tiles brighten and drift back to place, caption disappears

interaction_model.affected_object: Preview region, dimmed tiles and hovered-tile caption

interaction_model.state_change: Current shot is replaced by the next additional shot of the same item
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Further angles arrive in place at an unhurried, self-explaining pace, in the same position and size, with name and price unchanged
interaction_model.input: Autonomous timed advance while an item stays previewed
interaction_model.affected_object: The single large preview slot

interaction_model.state_change: Tile gains a transient action affordance
interaction_model.visible_feedback: A small add-to-cart caption surfaces on the tile under the pointer
interaction_model.input: Pointer over an item tile
interaction_model.affected_object: The hovered tile

Deliberate rather than twitchy, because only a resting pointer opens anything
Spatially honest: the enlargement reads as the grid itself yielding room instead of a panel dropped on top
Unhurried and self-explaining, with extra angles arriving slowly enough to be read passively
Fully reversible, leaving no residue after any number of looks
completion_and_return: There is no terminal end state; the experience alternates between plain overview and one previewed item
Every preview returns to the same plain overview through a reversed transition
The shot sequence loops for as long as an item stays previewed and resets on close or handover
No previewed item, dimmed half or hover caption persists once the pointer leaves
locked_observable_requirements: The full set of items fills the viewport edge to edge as the only content on screen

Typography, label wording and the wording of the small action caption
How the assortment first arrives on screen before the interactive state begins
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits any set of visually comparable, image-led entries where the picture carries the decision and a couple of short facts are enough beside it, presented as a pointer-driven full-screen overview on a wide viewport. Replacing hover-dwell with clicking through to a separate detail view, letting the preview cover or scroll away the overview, allowing several previews open at once, or attaching long descriptive text and multiple controls to the enlarged view would create a different Skill.

name: orbiting_image_volume_drift
description: A viewer-centred, slowly turning volume of photographs that bursts open outward from the centre on arrival, drifts forever with no edges, and spins faster while images stream past and recede into depth as the visitor drags or scrolls.

canonical_document.name: orbiting_image_volume_drift
canonical_document.description: A viewer-centred, slowly turning volume of photographs that bursts open outward from the centre on arrival, drifts forever with no edges, and spins faster while images stream past and recede into depth as the visitor drags or scrolls.
canonical_document.experience_scope: Whole-view experience filling the entire viewport from arrival onward; it begins with a brief honest wait while images are gathered, opens with a single outward reveal, and then never ends, resets or hands off to another state.
content_and_composition: One large collection of images (many tens or more) as the sole foreground content, distributed all around the viewer rather than laid out in a readable grid or strip
The viewer's implied position is inside the volume: images appear at many depths, near ones larger and far ones smaller and fainter
No start item, no end item, no ordering the visitor can perceive; any image may be at the front at any moment
A single small centred caption overlay carrying a one-line hint about dragging and scrolling; it is the only element layered above the images
A quiet, low-distraction ground behind and between the images, held far enough apart from the imagery in luminance that depth separation and thinning-out remain legible
experience_progression: Short, plainly acknowledged wait while the images are gathered, with nothing pretending to be ready yet
Single high-salience opening sweep in which all images expand outward from the centre into their surrounding arrangement
Settled calm state: continuous slow autonomous turn at a resting depth
Excitation state driven by gesture strength: faster spin, images streaming past and pulling back into the distance, arrangement visibly thinner and airier
Relaxation back to the same calm drift as momentum bleeds away and depth returns to rest; this excite-and-relax cycle can recur indefinitely without ever changing the baseline state
attention_and_information_flow: Opening sweep pulls attention from the centre outward, establishing the scale of the whole collection before any single picture matters
In the calm state attention drifts freely between the overall turning pattern and individual pictures that pass near the front
Under strong input the overall pattern and motion dominate and individual pictures become impressionistic streaks receding away
As motion relaxes, individual pictures regain legibility and become inspectable again
The caption stays quietly subordinate at all times and never competes with the imagery

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: A drag the other way immediately counters the current spin; nothing stops abruptly, momentum bleeds away on its own and depth glides back to rest
interaction_model.state_change: Spin direction is set by gesture direction and spin rate rises with gesture strength; images simultaneously shift toward greater depth
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The volume turns the way the hand moves, images stream past and pull back into the distance, and the arrangement visibly thins out
interaction_model.input: Drag anywhere across the view
interaction_model.affected_object: The whole surrounding image volume

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Opposite-direction scrolling counters immediately; no travel limit, no snapping, no end of scroll to reach
interaction_model.state_change: Same spin and depth response as dragging, with direction taken from the scroll direction and intensity from its strength
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Identical streaming, recession and thinning as with dragging, so both inputs feel like the same single control
interaction_model.input: Wheel or trackpad scroll
interaction_model.affected_object: The whole surrounding image volume

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: This is the resting state the experience always returns to; it needs no trigger and offers nothing to reset
interaction_model.state_change: A slow baseline turn continues indefinitely at resting depth
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Gentle continuous rotation with images legible at their normal size and spacing
interaction_model.input: No input (autonomous drift)
interaction_model.affected_object: The whole surrounding image volume

experience_qualities: Calm and hypnotic at rest, with the surround receding quietly behind the imagery
Enveloping and vast, with a sense of standing inside rather than looking at
Physical and weighted: gestures build and shed momentum rather than switching states
Boundless — no edge to hit, nothing to finish, nothing to undo
Legible restraint: a single quiet hint is the only interface
completion_and_return: No completion, score, end screen or exit state exists
Every excitation relaxes back into the identical baseline drift, so the experience is self-returning
Depth always glides back to the resting depth; no reset control is offered or needed
The slow turn persists whether or not the visitor is interacting
locked_observable_requirements: Viewer sits inside a surrounding volume of images, not in front of a flat layout
Continuous slow autonomous turn with no start, no end and no completion
Single outward opening sweep from the centre after a brief acknowledged wait
Gesture strength continuously governs both spin speed and how far images recede and thin out
Gesture direction sets spin direction and an opposite gesture counters it immediately
Momentum decays on its own; no abrupt stops, no hard edges, no reset
Images always glide back to the same resting depth and calm drift
Drag and scroll feel like one unified control
Exactly one small centred hint overlay above the imagery
adaptable_details: Exact geometry of the surrounding arrangement and the number of images
Image aspect ratios, crops and framing treatment
Overall palette, how light or dark the surround sits, and glow or haze intensity
Duration of the opening sweep and the decay rate of momentum
Depth range travelled during excitation
Wording of the hint caption and whether it fades once the visitor gestures
Source of the images and how they are gathered
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits any large, roughly equal-weight set of visual items where browsing is open-ended and no item needs priority, sequence or completion; it does not depend on the subject matter of the pictures. Introducing an ordered path, a selected or detail state, per-item labels, filtering, or a finite end to reach would make it a different Skill, as would flattening the surrounding volume into a scrolling or paged layout or making motion discrete rather than momentum-based.

canonical_document.name: scroll_turned_photo_sets_with_drill_in_full_set_view

canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits small curated groups of images where each group has one short identifying label and each image has a short piece of per-image attribution worth revealing only on drill-in. It breaks if groups become large paginated catalogs that cannot be shown all at once, if groups lack a single short label to act as the entry point, or if images need to be compared across groups. Replacing the in-place drill-in with navigation to a separate page, letting motion play on its own instead of following scroll, or showing several sets on screen at once would each create a different Skill.
