canonical_document.description: Uniform image cards surface one after another into a centred pile, pause, then fan outward into a ring the visitor can drag-spin with glide; a small selector re-forms the same cards into other overall shapes, each settling calmly, with a reset that replays the opening.
canonical_document.experience_scope: A self-contained region-or-full-view stage occupied by the whole card collection plus a small arrangement bar; the experience begins with the automatic dealing sequence on entry and never terminates, remaining in whichever arrangement was last chosen and always offering a return to the opening state.
content_and_composition: One homogeneous set of image cards of roughly a dozen items, all equal in weight and visual treatment, presented as peers with no featured item
A single shared stage with a stable centre that anchors every arrangement; the pile, the ring and all later shapes are organized around that same centre
Cards persist as the same identifiable objects across every arrangement, so shape changes read as the group being reformed rather than the content being replaced
A small persistent selector bar along one edge listing the available arrangements, one of which is visibly marked as current
A reset entry available alongside the arrangement choices for the entire session
experience_progression: Cards surface sequentially into a centred stack, building a pile one item at a time
The completed pile holds still for a deliberate beat
The pile spreads outward into a ring that brings the whole collection into view simultaneously
The ring becomes the resting, explorable state where drag-spin and pointer response are available
On selection, all cards travel together into another overall shape and settle to calm rest; further selections move the group between shapes
Reset clears the current state and replays the dealing-and-spreading opening from the beginning
attention_and_information_flow: Attention starts tightly focused on the accumulating centre pile, where only the topmost card is legible
The hold beat marks the collection as complete before anything is revealed
The outward spread shifts attention from one point to the full perimeter, revealing every item at once as the payoff of the opening
During spin, prominence moves continuously around the ring as cards travel through nearer and farther positions, with no item claiming permanent priority
Arrangement changes redistribute prominence across the group as a whole; the marked selector entry is the only element that states which reading of the collection is active
Pointer drift or tilt adds a low-level sense of responsiveness without pulling focus to any single card

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Runs to completion on its own and settles in the ring; can be replayed at any later time from the reset entry
interaction_model.state_change: From nothing, to a sequentially built centred pile, to a held pile, to an outward-spread ring
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Cards appearing one after another at the centre, a visible pause on the finished stack, then a coordinated outward spread into the ring
interaction_model.input: Autonomous entry sequence
interaction_model.affected_object: The whole card set on the shared stage

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Rotation is unbounded in either direction with no start or end; a new drag can seize the glide mid-flight, and there is no wrong resting position to recover from
interaction_model.state_change: Rotation follows the pointer while held, then continues gliding after release and eases to rest
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The whole ring turns in step with the pointer, cards passing through nearer and farther positions while every image stays upright; after release the turn continues and slows smoothly to a stop
interaction_model.input: Drag across the ring, then release
interaction_model.affected_object: The collection as a rotating body around its centre

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Transitions are protected from interruption rather than cancelled; once settled, any other arrangement — including the opening one — can be chosen
interaction_model.state_change: The group re-forms from the current shape into the chosen shape and settles; the chosen entry becomes the marked current one; further choices are ignored until motion settles
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Every card travels together into the new overall shape and comes calmly to rest, while the selector shows which arrangement is now active and stays unresponsive to further presses during the transition
interaction_model.input: Choosing an arrangement from the selector bar
interaction_model.affected_object: All cards, as one group formation, plus the selector state

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Purely additive and continuously reversible by moving the pointer back; leaving the stage returns the set to its neutral resting pose, and arrangements without pointer response simply stay still
interaction_model.state_change: The group gains a gentle pointer-linked drift or tilt offset
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The entire set leans or slides slightly with the cursor, as one body rather than per-card reactions
interaction_model.input: Moving the pointer over an arrangement that responds to it
interaction_model.affected_object: The whole card set as a unit

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Available throughout the session as the guaranteed way back to the known initial state
interaction_model.state_change: All accumulated state is cleared and the opening sequence restarts
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The current shape gives way and the dealing-into-a-pile then spreading-into-a-ring sequence plays again from the start
interaction_model.input: Selecting the reset entry
interaction_model.affected_object: Arrangement state, rotation state and pointer-linked offsets

experience_qualities: Playful and showman-like, with the rhythm of a deck being dealt and fanned
Cohesive: the collection behaves as one body, so every change reads as reshaping the same set
Calm settling rather than snapping, with motion that decays smoothly into rest
Physically plausible drag with weight and glide, giving direct hands-on control
Legible throughout, because cards stay upright and readable no matter how far the group turns
Unhurried and open-ended: nothing expires, nothing must be completed
completion_and_return: The opening sequence completes into the ring as the default resting state
Each arrangement change completes when the group settles; the chosen shape then persists indefinitely
Drag rotation resolves by easing to rest at an arbitrary angle, with no snap-back and no canonical orientation
Pointer-linked drift or tilt returns to neutral when the pointer leaves
The reset entry restores the initial state and replays the opening at any time, and remains available in every arrangement
locked_observable_requirements: The opening must be staged: items surface one after another into a centred pile, the pile holds for a perceptible beat, then spreads outward into a ring revealing the whole collection at once
All arrangements must be built from the same persistent items around a shared centre, so changes read as reshaping and never as swapping content
The ring must be draggable around its centre, tracking the pointer, continuing to glide after release and easing to rest
Rotation must be unbounded in both directions with no start, end or snap position
Item images must remain upright at every rotation angle and in every arrangement
Arrangement selection must mark the current choice and ignore further choices until the transition settles
Where pointer response exists, it must move the whole set gently as one body, not individual items
A reset that clears state and replays the opening must be reachable at all times
adaptable_details: Exact item count and the aspect ratio or framing of the cards
Monochrome versus colour treatment and any card border, shadow or label styling
Which specific overall shapes are offered beyond the ring, and how many
Which arrangements respond to the pointer and whether that response reads as drift or tilt
Timing of the deal cadence, hold beat, spread and settle, and the easing curves used
Placement, wording and visual style of the arrangement bar and reset entry
Background treatment and framing of the stage
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits small-to-moderate sets of uniform, equal-weight visual items — portraits, photographs, covers, product shots, team or project cards — where the appeal is seeing the whole collection at once and playing with its shape, and where no single item needs priority. It stops fitting when items carry long text, differ greatly in size or importance, or must be read in a fixed order. Making individual items open into detail views, expand in place, or become the focus of navigation would replace group-level reshaping with per-item interaction and constitute a different Skill; likewise, dropping the persistent shared-centre group identity in favour of independently animated tiles would be a different Skill.

name: wave_clearing_traced_image_handoff
description: Picking a picture makes its neighbours fall away in a wave spreading outward, labels fade, and repeated copies of the picture step along the path to its enlarged place, where a tall view with its credit line settles opposite the click; closing runs the same journey backwards.

canonical_document.name: wave_clearing_traced_image_handoff
canonical_document.description: Picking a picture makes its neighbours fall away in a wave spreading outward, labels fade, and repeated copies of the picture step along the path to its enlarged place, where a tall view with its credit line settles opposite the click; closing runs the same journey backwards.
canonical_document.experience_scope: Whole-view experience beginning with a brief quiet load of the collection and spanning the collection surface plus the enlarged view; it begins on click of any picture, ends when the enlarged view has settled, and ends again when close returns the untouched collection.
content_and_composition: One long scrollable collection surface composed of several titled sets, each set holding many pictures
Each picture labelled only by a very short code, no descriptive caption in the collection state
Each set carries its own rhythm through differing sizing, spacing or pacing so sets read as distinct passages of one catalogue
Set titles sit alongside their pictures as secondary text, readable but held below the pictures in emphasis, and are treated as a fadeable layer
Transient layer of repeated copies of the chosen picture positioned along the route between its collection slot and its enlarged place
Enlarged state: one tall picture occupying the focus plus a short credit line, placed on the half of the screen opposite the click point, with a close control persistently available
experience_progression: Brief quiet load, then the collection reads as a catalogue to wander through
Free browsing with gliding movement through sets; hover marks individual pictures as openable
On pick: neighbouring pictures drop out in a wave radiating outward from the chosen one
Surrounding set titles fade out
Copies of the chosen picture appear one after another along the route toward its enlarged place
The enlarged picture and its credit line settle on the opposite half of the screen
On close: the same ordered sequence plays in reverse, ending on the collection exactly as it was
attention_and_information_flow: Collection state spreads attention evenly across many small, minimally labelled items so the eye wanders rather than being directed
The hover luminance shift gives a soft local signal of which single item is actionable
The outward wave and title fade strip competing content until only the chosen item's identity remains
The stepping copies keep the eye locked to one subject while its position and size change, making the handoff traceable
Detail information appears last and only in the enlarged state: the credit line is the sole added text, at readable contrast against its surround
Reversal re-broadens attention back to the whole catalogue

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Reverts immediately when the pointer leaves; independent per picture and never combines with other hovers
interaction_model.state_change: Picture shifts to a slightly de-emphasised, openable-looking state
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Subtle luminance shift on that picture alone, in whichever direction reads as recessive against the surround, while neighbours stay unchanged
interaction_model.input: Pointer moves onto a picture in the collection
interaction_model.affected_object: The hovered picture

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: The sequence runs to completion; further clicks arriving mid-transition are ignored so nothing overlaps or strands halfway
interaction_model.state_change: Collection clears and the chosen picture is handed off to its enlarged place
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Neighbours drop out in a wave spreading outward from the clicked picture, titles fade, successive copies of the chosen image appear along the route, then the tall picture and credit line settle on the half of the screen opposite the click
interaction_model.input: Click on a picture
interaction_model.affected_object: Neighbouring pictures, set titles, the chosen picture, the enlarged view

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Both close affordances behave identically; input is ignored while the reverse sequence is still running
interaction_model.state_change: Enlarged state unwinds back to the browsing state
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The whole sequence plays backwards: text and large picture leave, copies retrace the route, titles return and neighbours come back, landing on the untouched collection
interaction_model.input: Close control or the Escape key
interaction_model.affected_object: Enlarged view, copies layer, titles, neighbouring pictures

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Motion can be redirected or stopped at any time; bounded by the ends of the collection
interaction_model.state_change: Continuous positional movement across sets
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Movement glides with easing rather than jumping between positions
interaction_model.input: Scrolling or dragging through the collection
interaction_model.affected_object: The collection surface

experience_qualities: Calm and quiet, never busy or flashy
Catalogue-like: made for wandering rather than being guided
Decisive narrowing of attention on pick
Continuous and traceable rather than an abrupt cut
Gliding, weighted movement
Symmetric and dependable, with no half-finished or overlapping states
completion_and_return: Forward sequence completes with the enlarged picture and credit line at rest on the opposite half from the click
Enlarged state persists until an explicit close
Close completes only by restoring the collection to its prior, untouched appearance
Any picture can be opened again immediately after return, with the same behaviour
locked_observable_requirements: Hover produces a slight luminance shift on the pointed picture, away from the surround's level, that reads as openable
Neighbouring pictures leave in a wave that spreads outward from the chosen picture rather than all at once
Surrounding set labels fade during the clearing
Repeated copies of the chosen picture appear one after another along the route to its enlarged place, making the handoff visibly traceable
The enlarged picture is tall and paired with a short credit line at readable contrast
The enlarged view lands on the half of the screen opposite the click position
Closing plays the entire sequence in reverse and returns to the collection unchanged
Input during any running transition is ignored so sequences never overlap or strand
Collection items carry only very short code labels, with detail text reserved for the enlarged state
Movement through the collection is eased and continuous, not stepped
adaptable_details: Number of sets and pictures per set
Exact wording of set titles, code labels and credit line
Image aspect ratios within the collection and the specific rhythm of each set
Hue family, surround luminance level and typographic style, provided pictures stay separated from their surround and labels stay readable
Timing, easing and spacing of the wave and the stepping copies
Number of intermediate copies along the route
Placement and styling of the close control
Whether entry uses pointer, keyboard activation or both
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits any dense collection of visually comparable image-led items where each item has a single enlarged presentation with a short line of accompanying text, such as photo sets, artwork series or product shots, on any surround that keeps the pictures separated from it and the labels readable. Replacing the traced stepping handoff with a plain cross-fade or instant overlay, letting the enlarged view appear without clearing the surrounding field, or applying it to text-dominant items with no strong single image would produce a different skill.

name: focus_sweep_depth_photo_stage
description: One wide picture centered in a quiet, low-distraction surround that stays clearly separated from the frame, where pointer height sweeps the plane of sharpness from foreground to background and the frame leans slightly toward the pointer, close surfaces shifting more than far ones, so the scene's depth becomes readable; choosing another scene swaps the picture in place without resetting the current focus or lean.

canonical_document.name: focus_sweep_depth_photo_stage
canonical_document.description: One wide picture centered in a quiet, low-distraction surround that stays clearly separated from the frame, where pointer height sweeps the plane of sharpness from foreground to background and the frame leans slightly toward the pointer, close surfaces shifting more than far ones, so the scene's depth becomes readable; choosing another scene swaps the picture in place without resetting the current focus or lean.
canonical_document.experience_scope: A whole-view experience that occupies the opening screen and persists for the duration of the visit: it begins the moment the first picture is presented, remains continuously live while the pointer is over the picture, survives changes of subject, and has no terminating step.
content_and_composition: Exactly one large, wide picture visible at a time, held centered as the dominant element of the view.
A quiet, visually recessive surround occupying the remaining space, held at a luminance clearly separated from the picture and carrying no ornament, pattern or competing imagery.
The picture is understood as containing distinguishable near, middle and far content, so a plane of sharpness can travel through it and so lean can be differentiated by distance.
A small set of named scene choices as the only secondary content role, kept visually subordinate and unobtrusive.
No overlaid instructions, captions, controls or badges layered on top of the picture.
Persistent elements across subject changes: the centered frame position, the recessive surround, the scene names, and the currently held focus depth and lean.
experience_progression: Entry: the picture is already present and centered with an established default plane of sharpness, so the shallow-focus character is visible before any input.
Discovery: within roughly a second or two of moving the pointer, the link between pointer travel and moving sharpness becomes self-evident without being told.
Continuous exploration: focus depth and lean advance and retreat freely with pointer movement, with no stages, thresholds or completion point.
Subject change: another scene takes the frame while the exploration continues from the current focus and lean rather than restarting.
attention_and_information_flow: Attention settles first on whichever part of the scene currently reads crisp; softness elsewhere removes competition for notice.
As the sharp plane travels, prominence hands off from near content to distant content, revealing detail that was previously dissolved and dissolving detail that was previously legible.
Differentiated lean reveals spatial relationships between elements that a flat picture withholds, so depth becomes readable rather than implied.
The recessive surround contributes no information and continuously holds prominence on the single picture.
Scene names stay low in the attention order until the viewer is ready to move on.

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Response is immediate and continuous with no lag or stepping; retracing the same movement restores the earlier focus exactly, and vertical positions past the picture edges settle at the nearest or farthest extreme instead of snapping, wrapping or breaking
interaction_model.state_change: The rendered-sharp distance moves continuously along the scene's depth, from nearest content through to farthest
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The crisp region shifts to a new distance while nearer and farther areas dissolve softly, so different parts of the scene resolve and un-resolve as the pointer moves
interaction_model.input: Vertical pointer travel across the picture
interaction_model.affected_object: The plane of sharpness within the depicted scene

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Fully reversible and proportional: returning the pointer returns the lean; the amount stays subtle enough never to break the frame, and offsets beyond the picture edges hold at the maximum lean rather than jumping
interaction_model.state_change: The framing leans slightly toward the pointer, with nearer surfaces displacing more than distant ones
interaction_model.visible_feedback: A restrained parallax shift in which foreground content slides visibly against a barely-moving background, giving the still picture volume
interaction_model.input: Pointer position relative to the picture (horizontal and vertical offset from center)
interaction_model.affected_object: The framing of the scene and its depth ranges

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Any scene can be chosen again at any time; exploration resumes immediately on the new scene from the inherited state, and repeated switching never accumulates a reset or a visible settling step
interaction_model.state_change: The displayed scene is replaced in place while current focus depth and lean values are carried over unchanged
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The new scene appears in the same centered frame already sharp at the same depth and leaning the same way, with no flash, jump back to a default, or interruption of the mood
interaction_model.input: Choosing one of the named scenes
interaction_model.affected_object: The picture occupying the centered frame

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Re-entering resumes continuous control from the held state without a snap, and the held state is what the next scene inherits
interaction_model.state_change: Current values hold steady rather than decaying or resetting; boundary positions resolve to the extremes
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The picture simply holds its present focus and lean as a stable, calm still image
interaction_model.input: Pointer coming to rest, leaving the picture, or re-entering it
interaction_model.affected_object: Focus depth and lean

experience_qualities: Dreamy and quiet, with a shallow-focus, lens-like softness rather than a crisp graphic look
Calm and unhurried throughout, including across scene changes
Physically credible: the response feels like turning a real focus ring and shifting one's head slightly
Self-explanatory within a second or two, needing no instruction, hint or affordance text
Immediate, continuous and fully reversible, never stepped or latched
Spatial: the place feels like it has depth instead of being a flat surface
completion_and_return: There is no completion state or end; the experience remains live for as long as the view is present.
Focus depth and lean are persistent state that survive scene changes and pointer rest, and are never auto-reset to a default.
Return to any earlier appearance happens by retracing pointer movement rather than through a reset control.
Boundary conditions resolve by settling at the near and far extremes and holding there.
locked_observable_requirements: Exactly one wide picture visible at a time, centered and dominant against a quiet, non-competing surround whose luminance is clearly separated from the picture.
Only part of the depicted scene reads crisp at any moment; nearer and farther content dissolves softly rather than being uniformly sharp.
Vertical pointer travel maps continuously to the sharp distance across the full near-to-far range of the scene.
Framing leans toward the pointer with distance-differentiated magnitude: nearer surfaces shift more than distant ones.
Response is immediate, continuous and fully reversible, so retracing restores the previous focus and lean.
Positions beyond the picture edges settle at the extremes without snapping, wrapping or visual breakage.
Changing scenes swaps the picture in place and carries the current focus and lean over with no reset and no change of mood.
No instructional overlay is required for the interaction to be understood almost immediately.
adaptable_details: Number of selectable scenes and the wording, styling and placement of their names
Exact strength of the lean and the softness profile of the out-of-focus falloff
Aspect ratio and size of the frame, and how much surround is left around it
Tone, luminance level and texture-free treatment of the recessive surround, in either direction from the picture
How many distinguishable depth ranges a scene is built from
Whether the default focus on entry sits near, middle or far
Duration and easing of the in-place scene swap, as long as continuity and calm are preserved
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits views whose foreground content is a single depth-bearing scene or subject with clearly separable near and far material, presented with sparse surrounding copy, as an opening or full-attention panel. It transfers to other subject types as long as the imagery genuinely has depth to reveal. It becomes a different skill if several pictures are shown side by side or in a grid, if the effect is driven by scroll or timed playback instead of pointer position, if focus changes in discrete steps or is not reversible, if legible text must sit over the picture, or if the surround carries its own imagery or content that competes for attention.

name: scroll_speed_smeared_photo_run
description: A downward run of framed pictures that stretch into vertical streaks, tear into displaced horizontal slices and flare brighter the faster the page travels, then relax to sharp calm almost instantly whenever movement stops, framed by an oversized headline at the top and a giant sign-off wordmark at the end.

canonical_document.name: scroll_speed_smeared_photo_run
canonical_document.description: A downward run of framed pictures that stretch into vertical streaks, tear into displaced horizontal slices and flare brighter the faster the page travels, then relax to sharp calm almost instantly whenever movement stops, framed by an oversized headline at the top and a giant sign-off wordmark at the end.
canonical_document.experience_scope: Whole-view single-page experience: begins at the opening oversized headline on arrival and ends at the closing sign-off wordmark at the bottom of the page; the reactive treatment applies to every picture in the run, not to one isolated region.
content_and_composition: Opening block: one oversized headline in heavy uppercase type plus a single short line of supporting context, occupying the first view.

Body: an alternating vertical sequence of two picture arrangements — one single tall picture in a full-scale frame, then a clustered group of several narrower pictures side by side — repeating downward.
Every picture sits inside a fixed outline/frame it exactly fills; picture and frame read as one welded object with no gaps, overflow or drift.
Closing block: one giant sign-off wordmark in the same heavy uppercase type, terminating the run.

Unifying layer: one single coherent palette and one heavy uppercase type treatment shared by the opening, body and closing, with the page surround kept low-distraction relative to the pictures, so the whole page reads as one object.
Persistent elements: the frames and page rhythm remain constant; only the pictures' rendering changes with movement.
experience_progression: Arrival on a still, crisp opening statement: oversized headline plus one line of context.

Downward travel through the alternating rhythm of single tall picture and clustered narrower pictures, with each picture escalating into streaked, torn, flared rendering while the page is moving quickly.
Momentary settling into crisp, calm pictures whenever the reader slows or pauses to look.
Continuous alternation of tension and calm through the run, driven only by the reader's pace, with no scripted timeline.
Arrival at the closing sign-off wordmark, which reads as the end of the run.
attention_and_information_flow: The opening gives maximum typographic prominence first, so the statement is read before any picture.
Fast travel deliberately withholds picture detail: the imagery becomes energy and motion rather than legible subject matter.
Slowing or stopping shifts prominence back to picture content, which becomes fully legible only at rest.
The alternating single/clustered rhythm paces attention between one dominant image and a comparative group.
The closing wordmark reclaims prominence from the pictures to signal completion.

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Scroll is never captured, eased or replaced; native momentum, flick deceleration, key paging and immediate direction reversal all behave as the platform normally does, so the reader can stop or reverse at any instant
interaction_model.state_change: Page advances or retreats at exactly the pace the input produces
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Content translates in step with the input with no easing, lag, catch-up or substituted motion curve
interaction_model.input: Native vertical page movement from wheel, trackpad, touch flick or key press
interaction_model.affected_object: Page scroll position and the whole page content column

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Slowing, halting or reversing direction relaxes the picture back to a clean sharp state within a fraction of a second; reversal is treated as movement in the same way as forward travel, so there is no stuck or latched distorted state
interaction_model.state_change: Distortion intensity rises and falls continuously in proportion to current travel speed
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Pictures stretch into vertical streaks, tear into displaced horizontal slices and flare to a higher luminance as speed increases; all three intensify together
interaction_model.input: Instantaneous speed of that page movement (autonomous driver derived from the reader's pace)
interaction_model.affected_object: Every picture in the run

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Resuming movement immediately re-engages the reaction from the current rest state with no restart delay
interaction_model.state_change: Reactive state resolves to the baseline rendering
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Pictures become crisp and calm, fully legible in their frames
interaction_model.input: Attention resting — the reader stops moving the page
interaction_model.affected_object: Every picture in the run

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Re-fit is immediate rather than animated, and holds through continuous resizing; the welded picture-to-frame relationship is never broken mid-resize
interaction_model.state_change: Each picture re-fits to its outline at the new dimensions
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Pictures immediately fill their frames again with no letterboxing, cropping error, gap or visible reflow artifact
interaction_model.input: Window resize
interaction_model.affected_object: Picture frames and the pictures inside them

experience_qualities: Speed-charged and energetic while moving; still and composed at rest.
Physically direct — the page feels connected to the reader's hand because nothing intercepts or smooths their input.
Solid and precise: pictures never lag behind, float or slip out of their outlines.
Bold and graphic, carried by heavy uppercase type held at readable contrast against a single coherent palette used throughout.
Editorially paced, with alternating single and grouped imagery creating rhythm rather than uniform repetition.
completion_and_return: The run completes at the giant sign-off wordmark; there is no loop or auto-advance.
Scrolling upward retraces the same rhythm with the same speed-driven reaction, so the experience is fully reversible.
No progress is persisted or locked: picture rendering always resolves back to the crisp baseline whenever movement stops, wherever the reader is on the page.
locked_observable_requirements: Vertical page movement stays entirely native — never captured, eased, delayed or replaced by substituted motion.
Picture distortion intensity is driven by instantaneous page travel speed, not by scroll position, hover, click or a timed sequence.
The reactive treatment combines vertical streak-stretching, displaced horizontal slice tearing and a rise in luminance, escalating together with speed.
Pictures return to a clean, sharp state within a fraction of a second of slowing, halting or reversing.
Each picture remains welded to its outline at all times: no lag behind the frame, no slipping outside it, at any speed or size.
The body alternates between a single tall framed picture and a clustered group of narrower framed pictures.
An oversized heavy uppercase headline with one short line of context opens the run and a giant sign-off wordmark closes it.
One single coherent palette and one heavy uppercase type treatment unify the entire page, with type held at readable contrast and the surround kept low-distraction so the pictures stay dominant.
Resizing immediately re-fits every picture to its outline.
adaptable_details: Number of pictures and number of alternation cycles.
Exact count of pictures in each cluster.
Subject matter of the pictures.
The specific hue family, value range and light-or-dark direction of the unifying palette.
Specific uppercase typeface and headline wording.
Exact maximum distortion magnitude and the speed at which it saturates.
Whether the closing wordmark is a name, a phrase or a mark.
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits single-page runs where a set of full-bleed or framed pictures is the main foreground content and an energetic, physical browsing feel is wanted, with sparse heavy type as the only supporting content. It stops being this Skill if page movement is hijacked, smoothed or animated on a timeline, if the distortion is triggered by hover, click, position or autoplay instead of travel speed, if the pictures do not resolve to crisp almost immediately at rest, or if the treatment is pushed behind foreground content as a backdrop rather than being the content itself. Dense text-led pages or reading-focused layouts would require a different Skill, since the effect deliberately makes content illegible while moving.

name: scroll_scrubbed_foil_light_gallery
description: A quiet one-image-at-a-time showcase in which a band of light carrying a visible hue shift slides across each image's textured regions in direct proportion to scroll position, opening with a plain framing passage and an untreated-beside-treated pairing, and ending on a short credits note.

canonical_document.name: scroll_scrubbed_foil_light_gallery
canonical_document.description: A quiet one-image-at-a-time showcase in which a band of light carrying a visible hue shift slides across each image's textured regions in direct proportion to scroll position, opening with a plain framing passage and an untreated-beside-treated pairing, and ending on a short credits note.
canonical_document.experience_scope: Whole-view sequential experience: begins with a short plain text opening at the top of the page, continues through a small ordered series of full-attention image stages, and ends at a brief credits note. The lit-surface treatment is a per-image region effect nested inside this sequence, and it sits on whatever surface tone the host provides.
content_and_composition: Opening passage of two or three plain lines of text that set expectations for what follows, held at readable contrast against its surround; no imagery competing with it.
First image stage is a side-by-side pairing: one untreated copy of an image beside its treated twin, presented so the difference is visible without any caption or explanation.
Following stages each present a single image occupying the primary attention area, one per scroll stage, deliberately not a dense thumbnail grid.
Each treated image has two layers of visible material: the base picture and a band of hue-shifted light that moves over it, appearing only where the image reads as textured.
Closing short credits note as the final stage, plain like the opening.
Handful-scale set: a small number of images, all of comparable prominence; no persistent navigation chrome, controls, indicators or playback affordances.
experience_progression: Plain opening lines establish expectation.
Untreated-beside-treated pairing teaches the effect by direct comparison.
Each subsequent image enters view and, as it passes through, has the light band traverse it once from one edge toward the other.
Progression is continuous and bidirectional: it advances only while scrolling down and unwinds while scrolling up; there is no autonomous advance.
Sequence terminates at the credits note rather than looping.
attention_and_information_flow: Attention is held on one image at a time; density is kept low so no image competes with another, with a low-distraction surround of whatever luminance the host uses.
The moving light band is the momentary focal point within an image, drawing the eye across the textured areas and making surface detail legible that was flat before.
The opening pairing carries the highest informational load: it silently reveals what the treatment does, so later stages need no explanation.
Prominence shifts purely by scroll travel; nothing brightens or animates to solicit attention.
Closing note deliberately drops visual intensity to end the visit calmly.

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Stopping partway holds the band exactly where it is with no drift or settling; scrolling back up retraces the same path precisely in reverse; the band never continues on its own.
interaction_model.state_change: Band position along its sweep maps directly and continuously to how far the image has travelled through view
interaction_model.visible_feedback: A band of hue-shifted light slides across the picture, revealing texture as it passes and leaving it as it was behind, like light moving over a foil print
interaction_model.input: Continuous scroll position as the image passes through view
interaction_model.affected_object: The band of hue-shifted light over a single image's textured regions

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Position remains authoritative at all times, so any resting scroll position shows the correct band position; an image left out of view is never left stuck in a lit state.
interaction_model.state_change: The identical sweep is traversed more quickly, staying locked to scroll position
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The pass simply hurries; it does not lag behind, overshoot, restart, or stop mid-sweep leaving an image lit
interaction_model.input: Fast or stuttering scroll
interaction_model.affected_object: The same light band pass on the affected images

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Reversible in both directions by scrolling; no clicks, taps or autoplay exist anywhere in the experience.
interaction_model.state_change: One stage at a time comes to rest in view: opening lines, comparison pairing, single images, credits
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Each stage arrives unhurried and alone in the viewport-scale attention area
interaction_model.input: Scroll travel through the sequence of stages
interaction_model.affected_object: Which stage occupies the primary attention area

experience_qualities: Magical but restrained; alive rather than gimmicky
Unhurried, calm pacing with generous breathing room
Physical and material: reads as real light on a real foil surface, whatever surface tones the host page uses
Directly responsive and hand-controlled, since motion is only ever the user's own scroll
Self-explanatory through comparison rather than instruction
completion_and_return: Ends on the short credits note; no loop and no automatic restart.
Scrolling back up fully re-runs every sweep in reverse, so the experience is replayable in either direction.
No progress is persisted: the effect state is always simply whatever the current scroll position dictates.
Images outside the current view rest in their untreated state.
locked_observable_requirements: Scroll position is the sole driver: nothing is clicked or tapped and no highlight plays by itself.
The light band's position maps continuously to scroll, not to a fixed-duration animation; pausing freezes it exactly and reversing retraces it exactly.

The band is light carrying a visible hue shift across the image's textured regions — any hue family serves — reading as light on a real foil print rather than a flat sliding overlay, and it does not depend on a dark or specially tinted surround.
One image holds attention at a time; not a dense thumbnail wall.
The opening includes plain expectation-setting lines, followed by an untreated copy beside its treated twin, with the difference left unexplained.
Fast or stuttering scroll only hurries the same pass; no desynchronisation and no image left stuck lit.
The visit closes on a short credits note.
adaptable_details: Number of images beyond the opening pairing, as long as the set stays small
Which hues the band shifts through, plus its width, softness and sweep direction
Exact wording and typographic treatment of the opening lines and credits note
Whether the pairing is arranged left/right or stacked, and image aspect ratios
Vertical rhythm and spacing between stages
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits small curated sets of visually rich still imagery, or comparably textured single subjects such as artwork, photography, product shots or display type, where a slow scroll-paced viewing is acceptable, and it adopts the host page's own surface and text tones. It stops being this Skill if the effect becomes a time-based autoplaying animation, is triggered by pointer or tap instead of scroll, is applied uniformly regardless of surface texture, or if the imagery is presented as a dense browsable grid where no single item holds attention.

name: magnetic_focal_pool_thumbnail_field
description: An even, edge-to-edge field of small low-salience thumbnails that gathers into place on arrival, then swells and restores full vividness to the images nearest the pointer or finger into a soft focal pool that trails the cursor and dissolves back to a uniform resting state when the pointer leaves.

canonical_document.name: magnetic_focal_pool_thumbnail_field
canonical_document.description: An even, edge-to-edge field of small low-salience thumbnails that gathers into place on arrival, then swells and restores full vividness to the images nearest the pointer or finger into a soft focal pool that trails the cursor and dissolves back to a uniform resting state when the pointer leaves.
canonical_document.experience_scope: A region or whole-view experience covering one continuous media field: it begins with the assembly of the collection on arrival and continues indefinitely as an ambient, always-available browsing surface with no end state.
content_and_composition: One primary content role: many same-role media thumbnails, enough to fill the visible field with a dense, even distribution
Uniform resting presentation: small tile size, deliberately reduced-salience rendering of each image, regular spacing so no single item dominates
A transient focal neighbourhood centred near the pointer: the closest items at full size and full image vividness, surrounding items partially affected, distant items untouched
Overlap layer relationship: emphasised items rise in front of their neighbours; resting items sit on a single flat plane
No labels, captions, instructions or affordance hints on or around the field; the arrangement itself is the only persistent element
experience_progression: Arrival: items gather from a dispersed or incomplete state into their positions
Settling: the field resolves into an even, calm, uniform resting state that shows the extent of the whole set
Ambient browsing: continuous, non-terminating focus drift driven entirely by pointer or finger position, with repeated return to the resting state whenever input stops
attention_and_information_flow: Before interaction, prominence is deliberately flat so the set reads as one mass and its scale is legible at a glance
During interaction, prominence is concentrated in a single small moving region; enlargement, restored image vividness and forward stacking all reinforce the same focus point
Detail of an individual image is revealed only while it sits inside the focal pool; everything outside it recedes to secondary texture
Emphasis falls off gradually over a short radius so there is no hard boundary between focused and unfocused items
Only one focal region exists at a time, so attention is never split

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Nothing latches or requires dismissal; direction can be reversed at any moment and emphasis reflows immediately to the new position
interaction_model.state_change: Nearest items move from small/low-salience/in-plane to enlarged well past resting size, rendered at full image vividness and raised above overlapping neighbours, with intensity scaled by proximity
interaction_model.visible_feedback: A soft focal pool of larger, more vivid, higher-contrast overlapping images that follows the cursor and lags slightly behind it, keeping the motion weightless and continuous
interaction_model.input: Pointer movement across the field
interaction_model.affected_object: Thumbnails within a short radius of the pointer

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Lifting the finger releases emphasis with no selected or stuck item
interaction_model.state_change: Identical emphasis response as pointer input, tracking the moving contact point
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The same trailing focal pool under the finger
interaction_model.input: Finger movement on a touch screen
interaction_model.affected_object: Thumbnails within a short radius of the touch point

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Re-entering mid-return picks up from the current state without a jump or restart
interaction_model.state_change: Each item eases from enlarged/fully vivid/raised back to small, reduced-salience, in-plane rest
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The field smoothly re-flattens to its uniform resting appearance
interaction_model.input: Pointer or finger leaving the field, or input stopping
interaction_model.affected_object: All previously emphasised thumbnails

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Emphasis response continues working during and after the refit without breaking
interaction_model.state_change: The field refits to the new viewport while keeping its even distribution
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The collection remains a full, evenly filled field at the new size
interaction_model.input: Viewport resize
interaction_model.affected_object: The whole arrangement

experience_qualities: Playful and tactile, as if the images are drawn toward the cursor
Weightless and continuous, with soft trailing motion rather than snapping
Calm and even at rest, busy only where attention is placed
Self-explanatory: discoverable on the first pointer movement with no instruction
Non-committal, with no selection, dismissal or completion pressure
completion_and_return: There is nothing to finish; the experience loops indefinitely between resting field and moving focal pool
The uniform resting state is always reachable and is the default whenever input ceases
No emphasis or selection persists after the pointer leaves
locked_observable_requirements: Many same-role images presented as one dense, evenly distributed field that fills its view
A visible arrival sequence in which the collection gathers and settles into its resting arrangement
Small, uniformly reduced-salience resting appearance for all items, with no item privileged at rest
Emphasis driven continuously by pointer or touch position, never by click, tap or hover latching
Emphasised items simultaneously grow well beyond resting size, return to the image's full vividness and contrast, and stack in front of overlapping neighbours
Emphasis strength falls off smoothly across a short radius, forming a soft-edged focal pool
The focal pool trails slightly behind the input point
Full, smooth return to the uniform resting state when input stops or leaves
Identical response for touch movement as for pointer movement
The arrangement refits on viewport resize without losing the emphasis response
adaptable_details: Subject matter and aspect ratios of the media
Number of items and density of the field
Exact grid, staggered or packed distribution of the resting arrangement
Which reduction produces the resting low-salience state (desaturation, luminance shift toward the surround, reduced contrast)
Magnitude of enlargement, radius of the focal pool and amount of trailing lag
Style and duration of the arrival gathering motion
Low-distraction surround treatment behind the field, in any luminance direction, provided resting items stay separable from it and emphasised items read as the most salient layer
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits any collection of many visually similar, individually non-essential media items where scanning the whole set matters more than reading any one item, and where the field can occupy a full region or view. It stops being this Skill if items must be individually selected, opened or captioned, if the set is small enough that a flat resting state is unnecessary, if emphasis becomes a discrete per-item hover or click state instead of a continuous proximity falloff, or if the field is placed behind foreground content as a passive backdrop rather than being the content itself.

name: pinned_scroll_scrubbed_theme_chapters
description: Full-viewport themed chapters that each wipe open from the bottom, lift a two-line title and paired keywords into place, push their still backdrop down into a low-salience surround, and slide moving clip panels in side by side while the chapter holds pinned on screen, all scrubbed by scroll distance and fully reversible.

canonical_document.name: pinned_scroll_scrubbed_theme_chapters
canonical_document.description: Full-viewport themed chapters that each wipe open from the bottom, lift a two-line title and paired keywords into place, push their still backdrop down into a low-salience surround, and slide moving clip panels in side by side while the chapter holds pinned on screen, all scrubbed by scroll distance and fully reversible.
canonical_document.experience_scope: Whole-view experience spanning the entire run: it begins at an opening full-viewport statement frame over a single low-salience photograph, continues through several consecutive full-viewport theme chapters that each own the screen in turn, and ends at a closing full-viewport statement frame that marks the run as complete; earlier chapters remain reachable by scrolling back.
content_and_composition: One opening frame: a single oversized statement line set over one full-viewport photograph held at low visual salience so the statement clearly separates from it
Three themed chapters (a small fixed set, not an open-ended feed), each occupying the full viewport one at a time
Per chapter: one still photographic backdrop covering the viewport as the rearmost layer
Per chapter: one large two-line title as the dominant type element, with a short list of paired keyword lines directly beneath or beside it
Per chapter: a small group of moving clip panels (a few, not a grid) that come to rest side by side in the same horizontal band
Clear layer order back to front: still backdrop, then clip panels, then title and keyword type
One closing frame: a single oversized statement filling the viewport, matching the opening frame's treatment
No visible chapter boundary, divider or page break between consecutive chapters
One consistent low-distraction surround treatment across all frames, holding backdrops well below type and moving clips in contrast and salience so type and clips read as the most prominent elements
experience_progression: Opening statement holds the viewport over the low-salience photograph
The first chapter wipes open from its own bottom edge, progressively covering the previous frame upward until it owns the viewport

The chapter pins in place and its internal stages play out against scroll distance: title lines rise into position, keyword pairs follow, the still backdrop softens and drops in salience, and clip panels glide in from off-screen to settle side by side
The fully assembled chapter rests briefly as the settled state
The next chapter wipes open over the current one from its bottom edge with no seam, and the same internal stage order repeats for each remaining chapter
After the last chapter, the closing statement frame takes the viewport and signals the whole run has been seen
Reverse scrolling retraces every stage of every chapter in exact reverse order back to the opening frame
attention_and_information_flow: Opening frame concentrates attention on a single statement, with the photograph reading only as atmosphere
Within a chapter, the large two-line title claims attention first as the sole high-salience, moving element
Keyword pairs then read as a short, scannable amplification of the title
As the backdrop softens and loses salience it drops to atmosphere, transferring prominence to the arriving moving clips
The settled chapter leaves the clips as the visual focus with title and keywords persisting as quiet labels
Each chapter's arrival resets attention to type before returning it to motion, creating a repeating rhythm across the run
The closing statement collapses attention back to a single line, signalling that no further content follows

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Stopping holds a partially open wipe; scrolling back reverses the wipe and restores the previous frame's settled state
interaction_model.state_change: Incoming chapter advances from zero to full viewport coverage in proportion to scroll distance
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The new chapter wipes upward from its bottom edge, progressively concealing the previous frame with no divider or gap appearing
interaction_model.input: Continued forward scrolling at a chapter boundary
interaction_model.affected_object: Incoming full-viewport chapter and the frame currently on screen

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Stopping freezes the type exactly mid-rise; reverse scrolling lowers it back out in the same order
interaction_model.state_change: Type advances from off-position and hidden to fully placed and legible, sequenced by scroll distance
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Two title lines rise into their resting position, followed by the keyword pairs settling beneath them
interaction_model.input: Forward scrolling while a chapter is pinned
interaction_model.affected_object: Chapter title lines and paired keyword lines

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Any intermediate degree of softening is holdable and is walked back exactly on reverse scroll
interaction_model.state_change: Backdrop moves from crisp and prominent to softened, low-salience background material
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The photograph loses definition and contrast against its surround, visibly receding behind the type and clips
interaction_model.input: Forward scrolling while a chapter is pinned
interaction_model.affected_object: Still photographic backdrop of the active chapter

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Partial travel is frozen when scrolling stops; reverse scroll sends the panels back off-screen along the same paths
interaction_model.state_change: Panels travel from off-screen positions to their final side-by-side resting arrangement
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Panels glide inward and come to rest aligned in one band, with their motion continuing to play once settled
interaction_model.input: Forward scrolling while a chapter is pinned
interaction_model.affected_object: Moving clip panels of the active chapter

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Interruption is always safe and leaves a coherent intermediate frame; direction can be reversed at any point, and any earlier chapter can be re-entered and replayed by scrolling back
interaction_model.state_change: Every stage maps deterministically to how far the visitor has scrolled rather than to time spent
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Motion tracks the scroll with a weighted, gliding lag rather than snapping one-to-one with raw input, so stopping settles smoothly into the held state
interaction_model.input: Scroll position anywhere in the run (autonomous driver is scroll distance, never elapsed time)
interaction_model.affected_object: The entire chapter run and its internal stages

experience_qualities: Atmospheric and restrained, with a low-distraction surround as the default and salience concentrated in type and moving imagery
Cinematic and deliberate, as if chapters are being cut together rather than scrolled past
Seamless, with no perceptible section edges or page breaks
Weighted and glided rather than twitchy, giving motion a sense of mass
Held and inspectable: any moment can be paused and examined
Rhythmic through repetition of the same internal stage order in each chapter
completion_and_return: The closing full-viewport statement is the completion state, explicitly signalling the whole run has been seen
No auto-advance or looping: the run rests at whatever scroll position the visitor leaves it at
Reverse scrolling fully restores earlier chapters, including their settled assembled state, so nothing is consumed once passed
Re-entering a chapter replays its internal stages in the same order rather than jumping to its finished state
locked_observable_requirements: Scroll distance, not elapsed time, drives every stage
Each chapter stays pinned in the viewport while its internal stages play out instead of drifting past
Chapter changes occur as a bottom-edge wipe with no visible seam, divider or page break
Within a chapter the stage order is: title lines rise, keyword pairs follow, still backdrop softens and drops in salience, clip panels glide in to settle side by side
Still backdrop demonstrably recedes so moving clips inherit visual prominence
Full-viewport statement frames bracket the run at both the start and the end
Stopping mid-stage freezes the exact intermediate state, and reverse scrolling retraces every stage in exact reverse
Motion responds with weighted, glided smoothing rather than one-to-one tracking of raw scroll input
Earlier chapters remain reachable and replayable after the closing frame
A consistent low-distraction surround throughout, with backdrops held far enough below type and moving clips in contrast and salience that type and clips read as the most prominent elements
adaptable_details: Number of chapters beyond a small curated set
Exact wording of statements, titles and keyword pairs
Whether keyword pairs sit below or beside the title
Number of clip panels per chapter and their proportions within the side-by-side band
Scroll distance allotted to each stage and the strength of the smoothing
Specific hues, overall lightness level, type family and type scale, provided the required contrast separation holds
Direction of clip panel entry, provided they settle side by side
Subject matter of the still backdrops and clips
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits a small curated set of visually strong themed collections with very sparse copy, where each set deserves the whole screen and moving imagery is the payoff; it transfers to reels, shoots, collections, chaptered manifestos or product moods with one headline plus a few keywords per chapter. It breaks down for dense text, tabular or long-form reading content, and for open-ended or paginated feeds. Removing the pinned hold and the wipe so chapters simply scroll past, driving stages by time instead of scroll distance, making the progression non-reversible, or dropping the moving clips so only stills remain, each produces a different Skill.

name: scroll_scrubbed_focus_isolated_image_chapters
description: Themed image sets each sweep sideways into the full view under scroll control: two title lines rise and drop into place from behind clean edges while four framed photos fly in from far off-screen to settle into a centred row, then the finished set is pushed aside and pulled away in luminance from the focused level as the next arrives, bracketed by an opening and a closing card.

canonical_document.name: scroll_scrubbed_focus_isolated_image_chapters
canonical_document.description: Themed image sets each sweep sideways into the full view under scroll control: two title lines rise and drop into place from behind clean edges while four framed photos fly in from far off-screen to settle into a centred row, then the finished set is pushed aside and pulled away in luminance from the focused level as the next arrives, bracketed by an opening and a closing card.
canonical_document.experience_scope: A whole-view experience spanning the entire page: it begins on a single introductory card that signals gradual unfolding, runs through each themed set as a full-viewport chapter, and ends on a final card confirming the sequence is complete. Each chapter occupies the whole view rather than sitting in a region alongside other content.
content_and_composition: One introductory card as the opening stage, visually quiet and self-contained, whose role is to signal that the piece unfolds progressively
A small ordered series of themed sets (a handful, not a long list), each rendered as a full-viewport chapter
Per set: a two-line title treatment, each line animating independently from behind a clean masking edge
Per set: four framed photographs that come to rest as a single centred horizontal row, framing consistent across sets
One closing card as the terminal stage, confirming the sequence has finished
A surrounding field whose luminance and contrast are pulled away from the active set's, the separation widening as a set gains focus, so the active chapter is the only fully-emphasized content
Only one set is at full prominence at any moment; the departing set remains visible but pushed aside and reduced in emphasis during the handoff
experience_progression: Stage 0: introductory card holds the view and hints at gradual unfolding
Stage N entrance: the next set sweeps in laterally; its two title lines rise and drop into position from behind clean edges; its four framed photos travel in from far off-view
Stage N settle: photos land into the centred row, surroundings separate in luminance from the set and recede, attention rests wholly on this set
Stage N exit: continued forward scroll pushes the completed set aside while carrying it away from the focused luminance level, as the following set's entrance begins
Repeat entrance/settle/exit per set in fixed order
Final stage: closing card arrives, confirming completion
Reverse: scrolling backwards runs the identical progression in reverse through every intermediate state, so no stage can be skipped
attention_and_information_flow: Name before pictures: each set's title lands first, then its photographs gather into focus, so the viewer reads the theme before examining the images
Prominence is exclusive — the luminance separation of the surroundings removes competing content so a single set holds attention
Information accumulates within a chapter (title, then full photo row) and resets to the next chapter on handoff
The push-aside-and-recede handoff makes the outgoing set legible as 'already seen' rather than simply disappearing
Opening and closing cards frame the whole run, communicating position at the start and completion at the end

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Every position in the entrance is a valid rendered state; stopping mid-scroll holds the half-formed arrangement indefinitely, and scrolling back retraces the same intermediate states in reverse
interaction_model.state_change: Set translates laterally into the view; title lines move up and settle from behind their masking edges; photos travel inward from far off-view toward the centred row
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Continuous sideways sweep of the set, staged rise-and-drop of each title line emerging from a clean edge, and photos closing distance to lock into an evenly centred row
interaction_model.input: Forward scroll within a set's entrance range
interaction_model.affected_object: The incoming themed set: its two title lines and four framed photos

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Reversing the scroll restores the outgoing set's full-emphasis luminance and returns it to its centred, settled position while the incoming set withdraws; no stage can be jumped over
interaction_model.state_change: Outgoing set shifts aside and its luminance moves away from the focused level while the next set begins its entrance
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The finished set slides out and recedes into the de-emphasized surroundings as the new set sweeps in, reading as one continuous handoff rather than two separate transitions
interaction_model.input: Continued forward scroll past a settled set
interaction_model.affected_object: The completed (outgoing) set and the following set

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Resuming scroll in either direction continues from the held state; there is no autonomous playback to interrupt or wait out
interaction_model.state_change: State freezes exactly where scroll position left it; nothing continues on its own
interaction_model.visible_feedback: A held, half-formed composition — for example titles partly risen and photos still short of the row — with no autonomous drift or settling
interaction_model.input: Pausing scroll at any point
interaction_model.affected_object: Whatever stage is currently mid-transition

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: All earlier sets remain retraceable at any time; reversal is exact rather than an approximate or shortcut return
interaction_model.state_change: The progression runs backwards through the identical states in identical order
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Photos retreat off-view, title lines drop back behind their clean edges, sets slide back and return to full-emphasis luminance, earlier sets return to full focus
interaction_model.input: Reverse scroll anywhere in the sequence
interaction_model.affected_object: The entire chapter sequence including the opening and closing cards

experience_qualities: Calm and cinematic pacing — motion feels deliberate and unhurried rather than snappy
Hushed, atmospheric mood created by progressively pulling everything but the active set away in luminance and contrast
Fully user-governed timing: nothing plays by itself, so the piece feels scrubbed rather than watched
Precision and reversibility — every state is reachable in both directions with no skipped steps
Focus and singularity: exactly one set is the subject at a time
Anticipation from staged reveal, since the theme name arrives before its images
completion_and_return: The sequence terminates on a closing card that explicitly confirms the run is finished; it does not loop
No auto-reset: the final state persists until the user scrolls back
Backwards scrolling is the return path and reproduces every earlier stage exactly, keeping all prior sets retraceable
Because state derives from scroll position, the visible stage always matches where the user is in the page
locked_observable_requirements: Scroll position is the only driver; every reveal is bound to it and nothing animates autonomously
Each themed set claims the whole view in turn, with only one set at full prominence at a time
Title text appears as two lines that rise and drop into place from behind clean masking edges
Four framed photographs travel from far off-view and settle into a single centred row
Set names land before their photographs gather into focus
Sets enter with a lateral sweep; completed sets are pushed aside and carried through a controlled luminance shift away from the focused level rather than simply removed
Surroundings separate in luminance and contrast from the active set — in whichever direction the host surface allows — and recede as that set takes focus
The run is bracketed by an introductory card at the start and a completion-confirming card at the end
Pausing holds any half-formed intermediate state; reversing replays the identical progression backwards with nothing skippable
adaptable_details: Number of themed sets in the series
Specific subject matter and mood of the imagery
Exact depth, direction and falloff of the luminance separation applied to the receding surroundings
Sweep direction (left-to-right or right-to-left) and travel distance of the photos
Frame styling, aspect ratios and spacing within the centred row
Typographic treatment, size and wording of the title lines and the opening/closing cards
Scroll distance allotted to each chapter and the easing profile of the motion
Whether photo arrival is simultaneous or lightly staggered across the four items
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits a small ordered series of titled visual groups — each with a short two-line heading and a handful of images that read well as one centred row — presented as the primary full-view content of a page where slow, atmospheric, viewer-paced revelation is desirable. It stops being this Skill if content becomes a long or open-ended list needing browsing or filtering, if items must be viewable simultaneously or in arbitrary order, if the reveal is driven by timers, autoplay or clicks instead of scroll position, if the imagery must stay uniformly emphasized rather than isolated by a luminance separation from its surround, or if each group has many images requiring a grid or carousel instead of a single settled row.

name: seamless_word_wheel_with_bending_letterforms
description: Single-word titles orbit one shared center as an unbroken wheel you spin by scroll or drag; each word swings into a comfortable reading position and eases past, the wheel coasts to a weighted stop, and letters visibly bow while spinning fast then straighten crisp when it settles.

canonical_document.name: seamless_word_wheel_with_bending_letterforms
canonical_document.description: Single-word titles orbit one shared center as an unbroken wheel you spin by scroll or drag; each word swings into a comfortable reading position and eases past, the wheel coasts to a weighted stop, and letters visibly bow while spinning fast then straighten crisp when it settles.
canonical_document.experience_scope: A self-contained centered region that can occupy the whole view as the page's primary browsing surface; the experience begins as soon as the set of words is visible at rest and persists indefinitely, with no entry or exit stage and no terminal state.
content_and_composition: A small set of short single-word titles as the only foreground content, all belonging to one flat peer group with no ranking or numbering
One shared center around which every word is positioned, so the set reads as one continuous circular body rather than a row or column of separate items
One comfortable reading position along the wheel where a word is most legible and most prominent; neighboring words sit before and after it on the same path
Ample calm empty space around the wheel; no list markers, no progress indicator, no start or end cap, no directional arrows required
Persistent elements: the shared center, the constant word supply, and the reading position itself, all of which remain while the wheel turns
experience_progression: At rest: all words sit still, crisp and fully readable, with one word occupying the comfortable reading position
On input: the wheel begins to turn in the direction driven by the gesture, and words start moving along the shared path
During fast movement: letterforms bow along their length, the sense of individual word boundaries gives way to a continuous moving band of type
Coasting: speed falls off gradually after the gesture ends, bowing reduces as speed reduces
Settle: motion stops, letterforms straighten completely, a word again rests in the comfortable reading position, and the wheel is immediately ready to turn either way again
Looping: the same stages repeat endlessly in either direction; the supply of words never runs out and never dead-ends
attention_and_information_flow: Prominence is positional: whichever word occupies the comfortable reading position is the focus, and it hands that focus over to the next word as it eases past
During fast turning, attention shifts from any single word to the motion of the whole wheel, and legibility is deliberately traded for a sense of speed and weight
As the wheel slows, legibility returns progressively until every word is sharply readable again
The visible presence of words entering and leaving on both sides of the reading position signals that more content exists in both directions
Crisp resolution at rest is the cue that the set is browsable further or back, replacing any explicit affordance or indicator

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Direction can be reversed at any moment mid-motion; there is no edge or limit to reach, so nothing can be pushed past a boundary and no blocked or overscrolled state exists
interaction_model.state_change: The wheel accelerates and turns in the direction corresponding to the scroll direction, advancing words through the reading position
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Words travel along the path, the word at the reading position eases out as the next swings in, and letterforms bow as speed rises
interaction_model.input: Vertical wheel/scroll input
interaction_model.affected_object: The whole wheel of words and their positions along the shared circular path

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Reversing drag direction mid-gesture immediately reverses the turn; releasing hands the motion over to coasting rather than stopping it
interaction_model.state_change: The wheel turns following the drag, with the two opposite drag directions turning it opposite ways
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The wheel tracks the gesture continuously; bowing of letterforms increases with drag speed
interaction_model.input: Press-and-drag along the wheel's axis of travel
interaction_model.affected_object: The whole wheel of words

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: A fresh scroll or drag during the glide takes over immediately, cancelling the coast and adopting the new direction and energy without any wait
interaction_model.state_change: Rotation continues with the momentum of the input and decays gradually to a stop
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The wheel glides on after the hand or scroll stops, slowing progressively while letterforms straighten, ending with all words crisp and a word at the reading position
interaction_model.input: Release / end of gesture (autonomous coast)
interaction_model.affected_object: Wheel rotation speed and letterform shape

experience_qualities: Calm and minimal: sparse content, generous space, nothing competing with the words
Weighted and unhurried: motion has mass and follow-through rather than instant response and instant stop
Endless and orderless: no beginning, end, or position to keep track of
Tactile and forgiving: always reversible, always interruptible, never blocked
Expressive but legible: type distorts only while moving and resolves fully at rest
completion_and_return: There is no completion state; the experience loops indefinitely in both directions
Every motion resolves to a settled state with words crisp and one word in the comfortable reading position
After coasting stops, the wheel remains where it landed and is immediately available to turn again either way
No reset, no return to a canonical first item, and no memory of a list order
locked_observable_requirements: All items share one center and form one continuous wheel with no visible beginning, end, or order
The supply of items never exhausts and no limit or edge can be reached in either direction
Both vertical wheel input and press-and-drag turn the wheel, with the two drag directions turning it opposite ways
Either input is reversible at any moment, including mid-motion
Motion carries momentum past the end of the gesture and coasts to a stop rather than halting instantly
A fresh input during the glide takes over immediately
Letterforms visibly bow along their length during fast movement and straighten as motion settles
Every settled state leaves the words crisp and readable, with one item in a comfortable reading position
adaptable_details: Number of items in the set, as long as it stays small
Typeface, weight, size, casing and color of the words
Background treatment and amount of surrounding empty space
Orientation and apparent radius of the wheel, and how strongly words scale or fade away from the reading position
Exact amount of bowing, coast duration and settling feel
Whether words are selectable targets that lead elsewhere, and how selection is indicated
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits small sets of very short peer labels — single words or two- or three-word titles — where the set has no inherent order and the type itself is the visual material. Longer text blocks, thumbnails, or item cards break the continuous-wheel reading and the letterform bowing. Introducing a first and last item, a hard limit at either extreme, an instant stop on gesture end, or removing the motion-driven letterform deformation each produces a different Skill.
