name: endless_spinning_image_shaft_with_centered_feature
description: Images tile the inner walls of a deep vertical shaft that surrounds the viewer and recedes far above and below; scrolling flies the viewer along the shaft while it slowly twists, and a single large readable image stays held in the middle of the view, changing as travel accumulates.

canonical_document.name: endless_spinning_image_shaft_with_centered_feature
canonical_document.description: Images tile the inner walls of a deep vertical shaft that surrounds the viewer and recedes far above and below; scrolling flies the viewer along the shaft while it slowly twists, and a single large readable image stays held in the middle of the view, changing as travel accumulates.
canonical_document.experience_scope: Whole-view experience that fills the framing from first paint and never ends; there is no separate entry state, no final screen and no exit boundary within the experience itself.
content_and_composition: Many comparable visual items (a collection of flat image-like works) mapped onto the inner surface of an enclosing shaft or tube that wraps fully around the viewpoint
The shaft extends beyond the top and bottom of the framing into apparent distance in both directions, so no beginning or end of the surface is visible
Exactly one featured item held persistently large and fully readable at the center of the view, in front of or clear of the surrounding surface
Surrounding items are numerous and read as texture and abundance while remaining recognizable as individual works
The item sequence on the walls repeats seamlessly so the surroundings look continuous in either direction of travel
experience_progression: Continuous advance rather than staged: accumulated travel is the only progression axis
Surrounding items stream past the viewer along depth while the whole arrangement rotates about the travel axis
At intervals of accumulated travel the centered featured item is replaced by another item from the set
The surrounding content loops endlessly, so progression never terminates and never returns to a recognizable start
attention_and_information_flow: Primary attention rests on the centered featured item, which stays legible at all times regardless of travel speed
Secondary attention drifts to the enveloping walls, whose motion and depth communicate the size of the collection rather than the details of any one item
Items near the viewer read large and pass quickly; items toward the far distance read small and slow, creating a depth-based prominence gradient
New information arrives only as the featured item swaps and as fresh items emerge from the distance

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Gesture strength maps continuously to distance and pace; no snapping, no scroll limits, and no possibility of overrunning an end because the surface repeats
interaction_model.state_change: Travel along the depth axis accelerates and the shaft's rotation about that axis advances together with it
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Surrounding items rush past the viewpoint from the distance while the whole ring twists; distance covered and pace track the strength of the gesture
interaction_model.input: Wheel or trackpad scroll gesture in the forward direction
interaction_model.affected_object: The enclosing image shaft and the viewer's position along it

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Direction is fully reversible at any moment; reversing is instantaneous rather than requiring the previous motion to finish
interaction_model.state_change: Both the along-depth travel and the twist reverse immediately
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Items reverse course and the ring spins the other way without delay or perceptible fight against the previous direction
interaction_model.input: Wheel or trackpad scroll gesture in the opposite direction
interaction_model.affected_object: Travel direction and rotation direction of the shaft

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Idle drift persists indefinitely and can be re-accelerated or reversed by a new gesture at any time
interaction_model.state_change: Motion decays from gesture-driven speed to a slow sustained drift in the last used direction instead of stopping
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The rush eases off smoothly and the surroundings keep creeping and turning gently, so the scene is never completely still
interaction_model.input: Cessation of scrolling
interaction_model.affected_object: Travel and rotation of the shaft

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Swapping is driven only by travel, so it can be advanced or slowed by scrolling and never leaves the center empty
interaction_model.state_change: The held item is exchanged for another item from the collection
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The large central item becomes a different work while remaining in the same place, at the same size, and equally readable
interaction_model.input: Accumulated travel distance (autonomous consequence of movement, including idle drift)
interaction_model.affected_object: The centered featured item

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Motion continues uninterrupted through the resize; the viewer's place in the trip is not lost or reset
interaction_model.state_change: Composition and gesture response are preserved across the new viewport dimensions
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The surrounding walls still enclose the view, the shaft still recedes past top and bottom, the featured item stays centered and readable, and scrolling feels the same
interaction_model.input: Window resize
interaction_model.affected_object: Framing of the shaft and the centered featured item

experience_qualities: Hypnotic and unhurried rather than urgent
Enveloping: the collection is felt as a surrounding place rather than viewed as a surface
Deep, with strong near/far separation above and below the framing
Always alive, since motion never fully settles
Momentum-driven and responsive, with gesture strength audible in pace and distance
Safe and boundless: no dead ends, no snapping, no lost position
completion_and_return: No completion state and no final screen; the trip is endless in both directions
The surrounding item sequence loops seamlessly so neither a start nor an end can be reached
Idle state is a persistent slow drift in the last direction used, not a halt
Position along the shaft persists through resize and through direction reversals
locked_observable_requirements: Items must enclose the viewpoint on all sides and continue beyond the top and bottom of the framing into apparent distance
Exactly one item is always held large, centered and readable in the middle of the view
Scroll drives simultaneous travel along the depth axis and rotation about that axis, coupled together
Distance and pace scale with gesture strength
Reversing scroll flips both travel and rotation immediately
Stopping eases into a continuing slow drift in the last direction rather than an abrupt halt
The centered item changes as travel accumulates
The surroundings repeat endlessly with no reachable beginning or end
Framing and scroll feel are preserved across viewport size changes
adaptable_details: Kind of flat visual work shown (posters, prints, photographs, covers, artwork panels)
Number of distinct items in the set and how densely they tile the enclosing surface
Depth of the shaft, field of view, and how far items remain visible into the distance
Cross-sectional shape of the enclosure (round tube, faceted ring, or similar)
Rotation rate relative to travel rate, and the speed of the idle drift
Travel interval between featured-item swaps and the manner in which the swap becomes visible
Ambient palette, lighting, vignetting and atmospheric falloff
Whether the featured item carries a small caption or is presented bare
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits collections of many comparable flat visual items where abundance should be felt spatially and one item at a time still needs to be viewed properly, as a whole-view browsing or showcase experience. It stops being this Skill if the enclosure is flattened into a scrolling plane or grid, if the surroundings become a finite run with a reachable start or end, if the centered readable item is dropped or replaced by more than one focal item, if travel and twist are decoupled so scroll no longer produces both, or if stopping arrests motion completely instead of settling into drift. Content that demands ordered reading, comparison side by side, or precise selection of a specific item does not fit.

name: endless_pivoting_image_column
description: A single tall centre column of images that drifts vertically under wheel or drag, each picture turning on its own upright axis as it rises and falls so it faces the viewer at the screen edges, narrows to a sliver mid-screen, then shows its far side, looping forever with soft inertial settling.

canonical_document.name: endless_pivoting_image_column
canonical_document.description: A single tall centre column of images that drifts vertically under wheel or drag, each picture turning on its own upright axis as it rises and falls so it faces the viewer at the screen edges, narrows to a sliver mid-screen, then shows its far side, looping forever with soft inertial settling.
canonical_document.experience_scope: Whole-view experience: begins with a brief prepared-and-then-eased entrance covering the full viewport, continues indefinitely as the visitor browses, and has no end state or exit destination; input is accepted anywhere on the page.
content_and_composition: One vertical column centred horizontally, occupying the full height of the view
Multiple images of the same content family sequenced one after another down the column, roughly one dominant item in the prime viewing zone at a time
Generous vertical spacing so each item reads as a separate object rather than a continuous strip
Each image is a two-sided upright plane: a front face and a visible far side after it passes the pivot point
Quiet, uncluttered surroundings with no visible chrome, counters, pagination or instructional text competing with the column
No terminal item, end card or dead end anywhere in the run
experience_progression: Short quiet preparation pause with nothing yet presented
The whole gallery eases up into view as one coordinated arrival rather than snapping in or appearing piecewise

attention_and_information_flow: Position in the column determines prominence: items near the top and bottom of the view face the viewer and read fully; the item crossing the middle collapses to a sliver and momentarily yields attention
Only one image holds primary attention at a time, making the intended focus obvious without any instruction or highlight

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Reversing direction mid-motion is always accepted and immediately followed; the run never locks out input
interaction_model.state_change: Vertical travel position advances or retreats in the direction of the gesture
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Images glide vertically and each one's pivot angle updates continuously with its new height on screen
interaction_model.input: Wheel turn or trackpad swipe anywhere on the page
interaction_model.affected_object: The whole column of images

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Grabbing again mid-flight takes over control from ongoing motion; releasing hands motion back to coasting; direction can be reversed at any moment
interaction_model.state_change: Travel position follows the pointer or finger at a gentler, damped ratio rather than one-to-one
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The column trails the pointer with a soft lag, giving a weightless, slightly resistant feel while pivot angles keep updating
interaction_model.input: Press and drag up or down anywhere on the page
interaction_model.affected_object: The whole column of images

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Fully reversible — travelling back reverses the turn through the same states; no image ever gets stuck mid-turn
interaction_model.state_change: Rotation about its own upright axis progresses with height on screen
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Front face squarely presented near top and bottom, narrowing almost to a sliver while crossing the middle, far side revealed once past that point, with a slight warping of the surface as it turns instead of staying stiff
interaction_model.input: Vertical position of each image within the view (autonomous consequence of travel)
interaction_model.affected_object: Individual image plane

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: New input during coasting is accepted immediately and blends with the residual motion
interaction_model.state_change: Motion decays from its current speed toward rest
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The pictures keep coasting and settle softly instead of halting on the spot; pivot angles resolve smoothly along with the drift

experience_qualities: Slow, weightless and slightly hypnotic
Quiet and instruction-free — the intended focus is self-evident
Continuously fluid, with damped, never-abrupt motion
Always under the visitor's control, in either direction, at any moment
Boundless and low-pressure, suited to aimless drifting
completion_and_return: No completion state: the run loops endlessly and revisits earlier images
Every pause resolves into a soft settle rather than a hard stop; the experience simply rests until touched again
No saved position, selection or exit step — the visitor leaves whenever they choose
locked_observable_requirements: Single centred vertical column presenting roughly one dominant image at a time
Vertical travel driven by wheel/trackpath gestures and by press-and-drag, both accepted anywhere on the page
Drag follows the pointer at a damped, less-than-direct ratio
Each image pivots about its own upright axis by an amount tied to its current height in the view
Faces the viewer near top and bottom, narrows almost to a sliver crossing the middle, reveals its far side beyond that point
Visible non-rigid warping of the surface during the turn
Inertial coasting and soft settling after input ends; no instant halt
Reversal, release and re-grab mid-flight are always permitted
Endless sequence with no final item, wrapping back to already-seen images
Eased-up whole-gallery entrance after a brief quiet preparation pause, not a snap-in
adaptable_details: Number, aspect ratio and subject of the images
Column width and spacing between items
Exact damping ratio, coasting duration and easing character
Steepness of the rotation mapping and amount of warping
Background treatment and any minimal surrounding framing
Duration of the preparation pause and style of the entrance easing
Appearance of the far side of each plane
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits any collection of visually self-sufficient media items browsed for their own sake — photography sets, artwork, product shots, editorial imagery — where items need no accompanying text and no fixed reading order. It stops being this Skill if the column becomes multi-column or a grid, if travel becomes horizontal or snaps to discrete slots, if the run gains a defined beginning and end, if items must be read as captioned or comparative content, or if the position-driven axial turn with its mid-screen sliver and far-side reveal is replaced by a different treatment such as fading, scaling or parallax.

name: single_tile_grain_bloom_wake
description: Evenly subdued icon tiles on a quiet uniform field; attending one wakes it as its symbol gains contrast and swells in its own distinct accent, a fine cloud of accent-tinted grain blooms outward from the centre and keeps twinkling, the surrounding muting veil lifts locally, and releasing returns it to the identical calm resting look.

canonical_document.name: single_tile_grain_bloom_wake
canonical_document.description: Evenly subdued icon tiles on a quiet uniform field; attending one wakes it as its symbol gains contrast and swells in its own distinct accent, a fine cloud of accent-tinted grain blooms outward from the centre and keeps twinkling, the surrounding muting veil lifts locally, and releasing returns it to the identical calm resting look.
canonical_document.experience_scope: A bounded region containing a small set of tiles. The experience begins the moment attention lands on one tile and ends when attention leaves it and the tile has fully returned to its resting appearance; the region itself is always present as a quiet composition and is not a whole-view or full-page takeover.
content_and_composition: A small set of equally sized tiles arranged as one cohesive group on a uniform low-distraction background.
Each tile carries exactly one central symbol as its foreground content role.
Each tile owns a distinct accent, clearly separable from its neighbours' accents, used only when that tile is awake.
A per-tile grain layer of many fine accent-tinted specks, spatially centred on the symbol and sitting between the tile surface and the symbol's glow so the symbol remains legible.
A muting veil layer covering the tile area at rest that holds it at low emphasis, which lifts locally for the awake tile only.
All tiles persist and stay visible at all times; nothing enters or leaves the composition.
At rest all tiles read at identical low emphasis with no accent and no grain, so no tile pulls the eye.
experience_progression: Rest: uniformly subdued tiles, bare symbols, no grain, muting veil present.
Wake onset: from the instant attention arrives, the symbol gains contrast against the tile surface and swells toward its accent while grain begins accumulating outward from the tile centre.
Awake hold: grain reaches full spread and continues to twinkle softly and indefinitely while attention is held; the local veil stays lifted.
Release: grain contracts back toward the centre and thins out, symbol loses its added contrast and shrinks, veil settles back.
Return to rest: tile is bare and still, visually identical to its original resting state, ready to be woken again.
attention_and_information_flow: At rest prominence is deliberately flat across the whole set so the region reads as quiet background-weight content.
Waking a tile creates a single unmistakable focal point via three reinforcing cues at once: a luminance-contrast rise, growth in the tile's accent and outward grain.
The local veil lifting increases the separation between the awake tile and its still-subdued neighbours, strengthening the focus without moving or resizing other tiles.
Exclusivity keeps the information flow unambiguous: at most one tile is ever alive, so the eye is never asked to choose between two emphasized items.
No new textual or informational content is revealed; the change is purely one of emphasis and liveliness.

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Build starts immediately with no delay; if another tile was awake it is released so only one tile is alive
interaction_model.state_change: Tile transitions from resting to waking and then to fully awake, and becomes the single active tile
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Symbol gains contrast and swells in the tile's accent, grain immediately begins building and sweeping outward from the centre, the surrounding veil lifts, then grain settles into continuous soft twinkling
interaction_model.input: Pointer entering a tile
interaction_model.affected_object: That tile's symbol, accent, grain layer and local veil

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Return lands on exactly the resting appearance with no residue, keeping the tile inviting to try again
interaction_model.state_change: Tile transitions from awake back toward resting
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Grain shrinks back inward until the tile is bare and still; symbol returns to its resting contrast, size and neutral treatment; veil settles back
interaction_model.input: Pointer leaving a tile
interaction_model.affected_object: The awake tile's grain, symbol and local veil

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Internal attention shifts are absorbed and never retrigger the wake sequence
interaction_model.state_change: No state change; the tile remains continuously awake
interaction_model.visible_feedback: No restart, flicker or re-sweep; the twinkling continues uninterrupted
interaction_model.input: Pointer movement inside an already-awake tile, including crossing internal parts of the tile
interaction_model.affected_object: The awake tile's grain and symbol

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Focus moving on ends the effect with the same inward retraction and return to rest
interaction_model.state_change: Identical wake transition as pointer entry, and the tile becomes the single active tile
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The same contrast rise, swell, outward grain bloom and veil lift, with no reduced or alternate treatment
interaction_model.input: Keyboard focus arriving on a tile
interaction_model.affected_object: That tile's symbol, accent, grain layer and local veil

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Interruption is safe at any moment; repeated rapid reversals remain continuous
interaction_model.state_change: Direction flips from the current visual state rather than snapping or restarting
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Grain continues from exactly how much it currently shows and grows or shrinks from there, so no jump or flash is visible at any instant
interaction_model.input: Attention reversing mid-transition, in either direction
interaction_model.affected_object: The in-progress grain, symbol contrast/scale and veil

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Replay is repeatable indefinitely with identical results
interaction_model.state_change: Wake sequence restarts from the beginning
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The outward sweep replays from the tile centre rather than resuming mid-spread
interaction_model.input: A fresh approach after the tile has fully returned to rest
interaction_model.affected_object: That tile's grain layer

experience_qualities: Playful and lively without being loud.
Calm, evenly subdued and unassertive at rest.
Feels like waking something rather than switching it on.
Continuously alive while held, thanks to the ongoing twinkle rather than a one-shot flourish.
Responsive and immediate, with no lag between attention and grain build.
Smooth and unbreakable under rapid or erratic attention changes.
Repeatable and inviting, because the resting state is always restored exactly.
completion_and_return: The awake state has no self-terminating completion; it persists as long as attention is held.
Release always resolves to the exact original resting appearance, with no lingering added contrast, accent, grain or lifted veil.
No state persists between visits; each approach starts from the same rest.
Only one tile can be awake at any time, so activating another implicitly returns the previous one to rest.
locked_observable_requirements: Resting state is uniformly low-emphasis across all tiles with nothing pulling the eye.
Waking combines a rise in symbol luminance contrast, symbol growth in a tile-specific accent, outward-from-centre grain bloom and local lifting of the surrounding muting veil.
The grain is a fine cloud of many small accent-tinted specks that originates at the tile centre and expands outward.
Grain keeps softly twinkling for the entire duration of the awake state rather than playing once and stopping.
At most one tile is awake at any instant.
Grain builds immediately on attention arrival and retracts on attention departure.
Keyboard-reached tiles receive the exact same visible treatment as pointer-reached tiles.
Attention movement within an already-awake tile never retriggers or restarts the effect.
Reversal at any moment flips direction from the current visible grain state without snapping or flashing.
A fresh approach after full return replays the outward sweep from the centre.
Release restores the exact original resting appearance.
adaptable_details: Number of tiles and their grid arrangement.
Tile shape, size, corner treatment and spacing.
Which symbols are used and what they depict.
The specific accent hue assigned to each tile, as long as tile accents stay distinguishable from each other and from the surround.
Grain speck size, count, density and spread distance.
Twinkle rhythm and intensity.
Durations and easing of build, retraction, contrast rise and swell.
How much the local veil lifts, how far the lift extends, and whether the composition's luminance runs light-on-dark or dark-on-light.
Whether tiles are also links or plain decorative items.
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits small sets of equally weighted, symbol-centric tiles on a uniform surface where each item deserves an individually accented, playful focus reward and the resting composition must stay quiet. It also fits single isolated symbol or badge elements that need the same centre-out grain bloom. It stops fitting when items are text- or image-heavy so a centre-originating grain cloud would obscure content, when the surface leaves too little luminance headroom for a muted resting veil to separate visibly from a lifted awake state so the lift and the accent grain lose their contrast basis, or when many items must be emphasized at once. Making the effect multi-tile-simultaneous, replacing the persistent twinkle with a one-shot flourish, moving the grain origin off the centre, or letting attention reveal new informational content instead of emphasis would each create a different Skill.

name: scroll_scrubbed_artwork_procession
description: Artworks rise, straighten into full clarity while passing the middle of the view, then tilt away and dim, with names drifting alongside, an oversized interlude word, and a final dense mosaic — all scrubbed forward and backward by scroll alone.

canonical_document.name: scroll_scrubbed_artwork_procession
canonical_document.description: Artworks rise, straighten into full clarity while passing the middle of the view, then tilt away and dim, with names drifting alongside, an oversized interlude word, and a final dense mosaic — all scrubbed forward and backward by scroll alone.
canonical_document.experience_scope: Whole-view, whole-page experience: begins at a full-height opening title panel with a quiet hint of more below, continues through the entire vertical journey, and ends on a calm closing credit; there is no separate embeddable region.
content_and_composition: One full-height opening title panel occupying the entire view, carrying the set's title and a subdued cue that content continues below
A sequence of individual artwork frames (portrait-format visual items), presented so that roughly one at a time occupies the visitor's attention as it crosses the middle band of the view
A middle band of the view acting as the privileged 'focus zone' where an artwork sits at its full luminance and clarity, square-on to the viewer
Item names as a separate text layer that drifts steadily and horizontally through the middle of the view, paired with the artworks they belong to
One oversized single word rendered at display scale, occupying its own quiet interval between artwork chapters
One dense full-view mosaic composed of the whole set of artworks assembled into a single tiled field
A short closing credit line as the final content state
A persistent, always-readable indication of how far through the journey the visitor has travelled

Artworks arrive in an unhurried procession; each one rises from the lower edge, settles into full clarity in the middle, then departs upward, with attention held on roughly one at a time
Names drift through the middle of the view alongside the procession, advancing with it
An oversized word takes the whole view as a deliberate breath between chapters
The remaining chapter of artworks continues in the same procession rhythm
The whole set resolves into one dense full-view mosaic
A calm closing credit line assembles as the final state
Every stage is reversible: travelling back disassembles each stage through exactly the states it came from, and the whole journey is freely revisitable

The oversized word momentarily empties the view of imagery, resetting attention before the next chapter

The closing credit resolves attention to a single quiet line
Progress information remains continuously available so the visitor always knows how much of the journey remains

interaction_model.state_change: Journey position advances or retreats proportionally to scroll; every visual stage is a direct function of that position and nothing advances on its own

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Releasing mid-gesture leaves the composition in its reached intermediate state; dragging back retraces it exactly
interaction_model.state_change: Identical position-driven advance or retreat, fed into the same single smoothed motion as wheel input
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The composition glides with the same easing and clarity transitions regardless of which input was used, so the two inputs are experientially indistinguishable
interaction_model.input: Vertical scroll via touch drag or swipe
interaction_model.affected_object: Same whole-journey composition

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Each artwork's state is bound solely to its own position, so any partial state is holdable and exactly reversible; no artwork retains a state that its position does not justify
interaction_model.state_change: Continuous transition from strongly dimmed relative to the focus level, tilted and blurred at the far end, through rise and settling, to full luminance and square-on at the middle, then back to strongly dimmed, tilted and blurred as it departs

experience_qualities: Calm and unhurried, with no autonomous motion or urgency
Cinematic, with depth conveyed through tilt, dimming and defocus at the edges of attention
Effortless: a single continuous glide rather than discrete jumps or snapping
Fully scrubbable and trustworthy — the visitor feels in complete control of time
Legible about progress, so descent never feels open-ended
Serial and contemplative for most of the journey, then briefly dense and cumulative at the mosaic
completion_and_return: Completion is reaching the fully assembled closing credit at the end of the journey; there is no looping and no autoplay
Reversal is a first-class outcome: travelling upward disassembles every stage through its exact prior states back to the opening title panel
Any position can be revisited repeatedly with identical visual results, since all state derives from journey position
No stage remains 'already played' or locked in a completed state once the visitor travels away from it
locked_observable_requirements: Vertical scroll is the only driver; nothing animates on its own timeline
Every visual state is a pure function of journey position, so pausing holds partial states and reversing rewinds through exactly the states traversed
Wheel and touch feed one smoothed, gliding motion with matching feel

Each artwork reaches full luminance and a square-on orientation only while passing the middle of the view, and is dimmed well below that level, tilted and blurred at both the entering and departing ends
Roughly one artwork holds attention at a time during the procession
A full-height opening panel with a subdued cue that content continues below
Item names drift steadily through the middle of the view, paired to their artworks
One oversized word occupies its own interval as a deliberate break between chapters
The whole set resolves into one dense full-view mosaic before the ending
A calm closing credit as the final assembled state
Continuously visible indication of how far along the journey the visitor is
adaptable_details: Number of artworks in the set and how they are split into chapters
Exact wording of the title, the oversized interlude word, the names and the closing credit
Colour treatment and surround luminance level, typography and framing style of the artworks
Tile arrangement and density of the final mosaic
Magnitude of tilt, dimming and blur at the ends, and the smoothing strength of the glide
Direction and speed of the drifting name layer
Visual form of the progress indication
Whether names sit ahead of, behind or beside the artwork layer
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits finite curated sets of strong single-subject visuals with short accompanying titles — portraits, illustrations, photographs, product or project stills — where slow appreciation of one item at a time is the point and total item count stays small enough to traverse in one descent. Any colour treatment or surround luminance level works as long as the focused item stays clearly separated from its dimmed neighbours. It stops being this Skill if items must be scanned or compared simultaneously, if the content is text-dense or requires reading rather than viewing, if the collection is paginated, filtered or arbitrarily long, or if any stage advances on its own timeline instead of being scrubbed by scroll — an autonomous or timed presentation of the same content is a different experience.

name: submerged_photo_pool_view
description: One picture occupies the whole view as though lying just beneath water, perpetually distorted by slow ripples with a travelling light sheen sliding across the surface and soft edges that fade into the surrounding background; any picture the visitor supplies takes its place mid-motion without a break.

canonical_document.name: submerged_photo_pool_view
canonical_document.description: One picture occupies the whole view as though lying just beneath water, perpetually distorted by slow ripples with a travelling light sheen sliding across the surface and soft edges that fade into the surrounding background; any picture the visitor supplies takes its place mid-motion without a break.
canonical_document.experience_scope: Whole-view experience that begins the moment the view is entered and never concludes; it has no start screen, no end state, and continues for as long as the view is open, including across picture replacements and window resizes.
content_and_composition: Exactly one picture at a time, scaled to own the entire view rather than sitting inside a card, panel or gallery grid
A water-like surface layer occupying the same full-view area as the picture, reading as the medium the picture sits under rather than as a separate decorative overlay
A moving light treatment travelling across that surface layer, separated in luminance from the picture beneath so its travel is plainly visible, and sitting visually in front of the picture
Soft dissolving picture borders: the image fades outward into the surrounding background instead of terminating at a hard rectangular edge
A plain, low-distraction surrounding background that the picture's soft edges blend into, with no visible frame, caption, chrome or control furniture competing for attention
An unobtrusive means for the visitor to hand over a picture from their own machine, kept subordinate to the image and not allowed to dominate the composition
experience_progression: Continuous ambient motion with no stages, no completion point and no visible restart: the water carries on indefinitely from arrival onward
Picture replacement is a mid-stream substitution rather than a new stage: the incoming picture takes over at the moment it is ready while the surface motion continues uninterrupted
attention_and_information_flow: Attention lands first on the single picture because it owns the whole view and nothing else competes
Attention then drifts back and forth between the pictured subject and the water carrying it, because the picture stays readable yet never looks fully settled
The moving light periodically draws the eye across the surface, then releases it back to the subject
No information is progressively revealed or withheld; the same content remains legible throughout, with prominence shifting only through motion and light

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Nothing to start, pause, finish or dismiss; motion persists through every other interaction and is never reset
interaction_model.state_change: Ongoing, never-settling surface deformation and light movement with no beginning or end state
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The picture ripples softly and stays readable while the light sheen slides across the surface; edges remain soft against the background
interaction_model.input: Autonomous, continuously running ambient motion (no user input required)
interaction_model.affected_object: The picture and the water-like surface layer above it

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: The visitor may offer another picture again, as many times as wanted, each time swapping in place under the same continuous motion
interaction_model.state_change: The supplied picture replaces the current one at the moment it is ready to be shown
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The new picture appears already submerged and already in motion; the water shows no pause, jump or restart across the change
interaction_model.input: Visitor hands over a picture from their own machine
interaction_model.affected_object: The single displayed picture

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Abandoning the choice is always safe and repeatable; it never clears the view or interrupts the experience
interaction_model.state_change: No change of displayed content
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The existing picture remains exactly as it was, still rippling with unbroken motion
interaction_model.input: Visitor backs out of supplying a picture without choosing one
interaction_model.affected_object: The currently displayed picture

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Any number of resizes is tolerated; each re-fit preserves proportions and motion continuity
interaction_model.state_change: The picture re-fits to the new shape of the view while keeping its own proportions
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The picture fills the reshaped view without stretching or squashing, and the ripple and light motion continue without a visible break
interaction_model.input: Visitor resizes the window
interaction_model.affected_object: The picture's fit within the whole-view area and the water surface layer

experience_qualities: Calm, unhurried and ambient
Environmental rather than page-like: closer to leaning over a pool than opening a view
Never fully settled, yet the subject stays clearly readable
Softly lit and edgeless, with no hard framing
Uninterrupted, with no perceptible seams between states
completion_and_return: No completion state and nothing to finish; the experience loops indefinitely without a visible loop seam
No reset: replacing a picture or resizing the window continues the same ongoing motion rather than beginning it again
The currently displayed picture persists until the visitor deliberately supplies another one
locked_observable_requirements: One picture at a time occupies the entire view
The picture is continuously and softly distorted as if seen beneath water, while remaining readable
Light visibly slides across the water surface, distinct enough in luminance from the picture beneath for its travel to be seen
The picture's borders dissolve softly into the surrounding background with no hard frame
Motion is endless with no completion, no visible restart and no perceptible loop seam
A visitor-supplied picture replaces the current one at the moment it is ready, with the motion continuing across the swap
Backing out without choosing leaves the current picture untouched
Repeated swapping is supported indefinitely
Resizing re-fits the picture to the new view shape without distorting its proportions and without breaking the motion
adaptable_details: Subject matter, palette and aspect ratio of the picture
Ripple scale, speed and softness, provided the picture stays readable and never looks settled
Intensity, hue or colour temperature, direction and travel speed of the sliding light
Width and softness of the dissolving edge falloff
Tone and colour of the surrounding background the edges fade into, provided it stays low-distraction and lets the picture read clearly
Placement and styling of the unobtrusive means of handing over a picture
How gently the outgoing and incoming pictures give way to each other, as long as no pause or restart is visible
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits any single-image, whole-view presentation where one picture is meant to carry the entire message calmly and may be exchanged for a visitor's own — image-led openings, single-photo viewers, quiet portfolio or mood views. It stops fitting where multiple images must be compared side by side, where dense text or controls must sit legibly on top, or where the visitor needs a task to complete. Replacing the submerged, edgeless, endless water treatment with a framed gallery, a staged reveal, or a scroll-driven or pointer-driven transformation would create a different Skill.

name: speck_portrait_with_swept_chroma_seam
description: A focal subject image built from fine specks of light that sit far above the luminance of a quiet surround and tilts counter to the pointer to show its relief, while a soft vertical boundary sweeps sideways leaving desaturated flat specks ahead of it and fully saturated, grain-crawling specks behind it, divided by a thin chromatic seam.

canonical_document.name: speck_portrait_with_swept_chroma_seam
canonical_document.description: A focal subject image built from fine specks of light that sit far above the luminance of a quiet surround and tilts counter to the pointer to show its relief, while a soft vertical boundary sweeps sideways leaving desaturated flat specks ahead of it and fully saturated, grain-crawling specks behind it, divided by a thin chromatic seam.
canonical_document.experience_scope: A whole-view experience occupying the quiet, low-luminance surround around one focal image; it begins as soon as the speck field is visible and remains continuously live for as long as the view is shown, with no entry or exit ceremony and no terminal state.
content_and_composition: Exactly one focal subject image (a single face or comparably sculpted single subject) as the sole foreground content
The image is materialized as a dense field of fine, individually perceptible specks of light rather than a continuous flat surface

An empty surrounding field held far enough below the subject's luminance, in whatever tone the host uses, that the speck field is the only luminous mass and no competing foreground elements share the view
Subject edges fade outward into a faint chromatic shimmer of dust instead of a defined boundary, blurring where the subject stops and the surround starts
One soft vertical boundary spanning the image, positioned horizontally by the pointer, separating two renditions of the same speck field
Ahead of the boundary: desaturated, ghosted, flat-toned specks; behind it: full photographic saturation with a continuous crawling grain
A thin chromatic seam sits exactly where the two renditions meet and travels with the boundary
The speck field as a whole reads as a shallow relief with visible near and far depth, persistent across all states
attention_and_information_flow: Attention lands first on the overall solidity and sculpted form of the subject, read as a mass of light held apart from its surround by a wide luminance gap
Attention then travels laterally across the subject, pulled by the traveling boundary and its chromatic seam
Information about depth is revealed by the counter-tilt: parts of the relief that were foreshortened turn into view as the pointer moves

Information about saturation and texture is revealed progressively per region rather than globally: any given part of the subject is either in its desaturated ghosted reading or its fully saturated grainy reading depending on which side of the boundary it currently sits
No labels, captions or explanatory prominence changes; all revealed information is carried by the visual treatment itself

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Motion trails smoothly behind the pointer and retargets mid-move without snapping; drift and tilt are clamped to a limited range so extreme pointer positions cannot deform the subject; the field holds still while the pointer rests and returns along the same path when the pointer is swept back
interaction_model.state_change: Positional drift and tilt of the whole field oriented counter to the pointer's direction of travel, within a bounded range
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The relief turns and shows its depth, near specks displacing more than far ones, so the subject feels three-dimensional rather than painted on
interaction_model.input: Pointer movement anywhere across the view
interaction_model.affected_object: The speck field as a single body

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: The sweep is fully reversible at any moment; sweeping back restores the previous desaturated reading with no residue, every intermediate split position stays reachable, and the boundary follows with the same smooth trailing lag rather than jumping
interaction_model.state_change: The boundary moves sideways, reassigning regions of the subject between the desaturated flat rendition and the fully saturated, grain-crawling rendition
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Saturation and grain flood into the specks the boundary passes over, drain back out of specks it passes back over, and a thin chromatic seam rides along the meeting line
interaction_model.input: Horizontal pointer position
interaction_model.affected_object: The vertical dividing boundary and the two speck renditions on either side of it

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Any new pointer movement resumes drift, tilt and boundary travel from wherever they came to rest, without resetting to a neutral pose
interaction_model.state_change: Drift and tilt settle and stop; the boundary holds its last position
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The composition becomes still except for the continuing crawl of grain in the saturated region, so the image still reads as alive rather than frozen
interaction_model.input: Pointer at rest (autonomous idle state)
interaction_model.affected_object: The speck field and its saturated region

experience_qualities: Hushed and low-key, with light emerging out of a far dimmer surround
Sculptural and solid despite being made of discrete specks
Restless and alive, especially in the saturated region's crawling grain
Fragile and dust-like at the edges, with a faint chromatic shimmer
Smooth and unhurried in response, never abrupt or snapping
Exploratory and non-committal: nothing is completed or chosen
completion_and_return: There is no completion, success or end state; the experience is a continuously reachable state space
Every combination of drift, tilt and boundary position remains reachable at any time, in any order
Reversal is exact: sweeping the pointer back undoes both the counter-drift pose and the saturation sweep
State persists while the view is shown; the resting pose is wherever the pointer last left it, not a canonical default
The grain crawl loops indefinitely and independently of pointer state
locked_observable_requirements: The subject must be rendered as a field of fine individually perceptible specks of light, not as a flat continuous image
The surround must sit far enough below the subject in luminance, and stay quiet enough, that the subject reads as emerging light; no specific surround hue, tone or theme is required
Subject edges must dissolve into a faint chromatic shimmer of dust rather than terminate at a hard boundary
Whole-body drift and tilt must run counter to pointer direction and must legibly expose the subject's relief and depth

A single soft vertical boundary must be driven by horizontal pointer position and must divide the same subject into a desaturated flat rendition ahead and a fully saturated rendition with crawling grain behind
A thin seam, chromatically distinct from the renditions on both sides, must be visible at the meeting line and travel with the boundary
Response must trail smoothly, retarget mid-movement without snapping, remain within a bounded drift and tilt range, hold still at rest, and reverse fully when the pointer is swept back
No terminal or completed state; all states remain reachable and reversible
adaptable_details: Speck density, size and brightness distribution
Hue and chroma of the edge dust and of the seam, provided the seam stays distinct from both renditions
Softness and width of the dividing boundary
Magnitude of the permitted drift and tilt range and the length of the trailing lag
Speed and coarseness of the grain crawl
Framing, crop and aspect of the focal subject
Whether the desaturated rendition reads fully neutral or carries a slight warm or cool cast
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits any single focal image with strong tonal modelling and a clear silhouette, where that image is the entire foreground and a quiet surround well below the subject's luminance is acceptable; it does not fit multi-item grids, text-dense views or images that must stay legible as flat documents. Replacing the pointer-driven counter-tilt and reversible sweeping boundary with an autonomous timeline, or replacing the speck field with a continuous flat image, or splitting the boundary into a hard side-by-side comparison of two separate images, each produces a different Skill.

name: scroll_assembled_image_collections
description: Image groups that start scattered or absent and build into a composed formation exactly in step with scroll position, each group holding the screen until it lands, introduced by a full-height title panel that fades in prominence through a controlled luminance shift and slips away.

canonical_document.name: scroll_assembled_image_collections
canonical_document.description: Image groups that start scattered or absent and build into a composed formation exactly in step with scroll position, each group holding the screen until it lands, introduced by a full-height title panel that fades in prominence through a controlled luminance shift and slips away.
canonical_document.experience_scope: A whole-view experience spanning the page from the opening full-height title panel, through alternating written passages and image-collection sections, to a closing quiet note; each collection section is additionally a self-contained region that owns the viewport while it assembles.
content_and_composition: One full-height opening title panel filling the first viewport, sitting in front of the content that follows
Several image-collection sections, each a group of images arranged as one recognizable formation
Short low-density written passages, one between collections, acting as rests
Formation character deliberately varies across sections: a dense multi-image field, a single overlapped stack, wide cropped spreads
A persistent low-distraction surround and consistent tone across all sections, held quieter than the imagery it carries
A final short passage as a quiet closing note about getting in touch
experience_progression: Stage 1: title panel holds the entire view at rest, imagery unseen
Stage 2: as descent begins the title panel slips away while its luminance shifts toward the surround, transferring attention to imagery
Stage 3: alternation begins — written passage, then a collection section that takes the screen
Stage 4 (per collection): scattered or absent pieces move progressively into place, reach a fully composed arrangement, and are held long enough to be taken in whole
Stage 5: the section releases and the page continues to the next passage; formation character changes for the next collection so the pace stays unhurried
Stage 6: the descent ends on a quiet closing note rather than another visual peak
attention_and_information_flow: Opens with words dominant and imagery withheld
Handoff moment: the receding panel drops its own luminance contrast against the surround, lowering its prominence so images inherit attention
During assembly the collection is the only thing on screen because its section stays fixed, so partial arrangements are read as they form
Once composed, the full group is legible as a single arrangement before anything new appears
Passages lower intensity between visual peaks, releasing information in small readable increments
Varying formation density changes how much is revealed at once, from many-item fields to a single concentrated stack

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Scrolling back up brings the panel back to its full-prominence, present state along the same path
interaction_model.state_change: From full presence to departed and reduced in prominence
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The panel slips away while its luminance moves toward the surround, in step with the scroll, uncovering the imagery beneath it
interaction_model.input: Downward scroll from the opening view
interaction_model.affected_object: Full-height title panel

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Scrolling up runs the assembly backwards to the scattered start; the mapping is symmetric in both directions
interaction_model.state_change: Scattered or absent to partially assembled to fully composed
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Pieces travel into their final places continuously, progress tied directly to scroll position rather than triggered once
interaction_model.input: Continued downward scroll while a collection section is engaged
interaction_model.affected_object: The images of that collection

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Resuming in either direction continues from that exact point
interaction_model.state_change: Assembly freezes at its current fraction
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The half-formed arrangement stays exactly where it was left, with no drift toward or away from completion
interaction_model.input: Stopping scroll partway through an assembly
interaction_model.affected_object: The in-progress collection

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Scrolling back up re-engages the hold and disassembles the group again
interaction_model.state_change: Held fixed on screen to released
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The composed group rests briefly, then the page resumes moving past it toward the next passage
interaction_model.input: Assembly reaching completion
interaction_model.affected_object: The collection's section

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Motion damps to rest at page start and end; no stage is skipped by fast input
interaction_model.state_change: Eased continuous motion with a little inertia instead of discrete jumps
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The view glides and settles rather than snapping between positions
interaction_model.input: Any scroll gesture anywhere in the descent
interaction_model.affected_object: Page movement as a whole

experience_qualities: Restrained and low-distraction throughout, the surround staying quieter than the imagery
Unhurried, deliberate pacing with clear rests
Direct, tactile sense that the visitor's own movement is building the imagery
Cinematic handoff from words to pictures
Legible rather than busy: one thing to look at per moment
Rhythmic variation between dense and sparse arrangements
completion_and_return: No looping; the sequence resolves at the closing quiet note
Fully reversible: upward scroll restores every earlier stage, including scattered starts and the intact title panel
Each collection rests in its composed arrangement once assembled and stays composed while it remains behind the reader
Partial arrangements persist as a legitimate resting state whenever scrolling stops
The experience always begins at the very top; before imagery can be shown, a plain unstyled waiting state is presented instead of partial effects
locked_observable_requirements: Scroll is the only control; no buttons, autoplay or timed advance
Scroll position maps directly and continuously to each collection's assembly progress, forwards and backwards
A stopped scroll leaves the arrangement frozen at its exact partial state
A collection's section stays fixed on screen until its pieces have landed, then releases so the page continues
The opening panel is full-height and departs while its luminance shifts toward the surround, reducing its prominence as the descent starts
Every collection reaches a fully composed arrangement that is held long enough to be read whole
Formations differ in character between sections rather than repeating one arrangement
Short written passages alternate with the collections and the descent ends on a quiet closing note
Scroll motion glides with inertia rather than jumping
A consistent low-distraction surround that stays subdued relative to the imagery and text throughout
adaptable_details: Number of collections and number of images in each
Specific formation types and their exact geometry
Length, wording and typographic treatment of the passages
Paths, directions and offsets the images travel from
Amount of inertia and how long each section is held before release
Exact palette of the surround, whether it sits light or dark, and the size of the opening panel's luminance shift
Content of the closing note
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits content that arrives as discrete visual groups paired with short text and read top to bottom — portfolios, photo essays, product or archive selections, chaptered stories. It becomes a different Skill if scroll no longer drives assembly reversibly (one-shot triggered animation), if groups are browsed nonlinearly or opened by clicking, if sections no longer hold the screen while forming, or if the arrangement resolves into a uniform static grid rather than distinct composed formations.

name: wiping_panel_intro_into_looping_spotlight_stepper
description: A hero that opens with stacked panels wiping up, the outer pair parting to expose a square outline drawing itself around a counting number, then closing as the featured item begins looping with fine spec annotations and a position marker settling in; prev/next arrows then wipe each new item in from a corner while side image, tile column, position digit and spec lines change with it, looping endlessly.

canonical_document.name: wiping_panel_intro_into_looping_spotlight_stepper
canonical_document.description: A hero that opens with stacked panels wiping up, the outer pair parting to expose a square outline drawing itself around a counting number, then closing as the featured item begins looping with fine spec annotations and a position marker settling in; prev/next arrows then wipe each new item in from a corner while side image, tile column, position digit and spec lines change with it, looping endlessly.
canonical_document.experience_scope: A whole-view hero region: begins automatically on view entry with the entrance sequence and ends when the entrance resolves into the steady looping spotlight; the stepping experience then persists for as long as the region is present, with no terminal state.
content_and_composition: One large focal visual per item showing continuous looping motion, occupying the dominant area of the region
A set of stacked panels used as the entrance covering layer, clearly separated from the underlying visual, with an outer pair that can part and an inner area that stays as the focal aperture
A thin square outline framing mark, readably contrasted against whatever sits behind it, drawn around a numeric readout during the entrance
One position digit readout indicating which item of the small set currently holds attention
Several fine, small-type spec annotation lines placed around the focal visual, each carrying short codes tied to the current item and held at legible contrast at small size
One tall secondary image on a side of the region, keyed to the current item's distinguishing colour treatment, whatever hue family that treatment uses
One repeating column of small tiles along a side, all tiles sharing the current item's distinguishing colour treatment
A single pair of previous and next arrow controls as the only navigation affordance

Layer order: covering panels above the focal visual during entrance; annotations, position marker, side image and tile column sit around rather than over the focal subject in the steady state, kept low-distraction relative to it
experience_progression: Stage 1: stacked panels wipe upward into view, covering the region
Stage 2: the outer panels part to open an aperture
Stage 3: a thin square outline draws itself around a number that counts upward inside the aperture
Stage 4: the panels close again and clear as the featured item's looping motion takes over the focal area
Stage 5: fine spec annotations and the position marker settle into place around the focal visual
Stage 6: steady state — one item holds attention at a time; each arrow step is a short, snappy transition to the next or previous item, repeatable indefinitely and wrapping at both ends
attention_and_information_flow: Entrance pulls attention to a single centred aperture where the outline and counting number are the only readable information, the surrounding cover reading as quiet by comparison
Attention widens outward as the panels clear and the looping focal visual becomes the anchor
Peripheral information arrives last: spec codes and position marker appear only after the focal subject is established, so they read as supporting detail rather than competing content
In the steady state exactly one item is prominent; the side image and tile column carry the item's identity as a distinguishing colour treatment, not as competing focal content
During a step, the incoming focal visual leads the change while numeric and textual readouts update in the same beat, so the identity change is legible in one glance

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Self-contained and non-repeating; runs once to completion and resolves into the steady spotlight, which remains available regardless
interaction_model.state_change: Region transitions from covered to revealed steady spotlight through the ordered entrance stages
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Panels wipe up, outer panels part, square outline draws itself around an upward-counting number, panels close and clear, looping focal motion appears, annotations and marker settle in
interaction_model.input: View entry (autonomous driver)
interaction_model.affected_object: Stacked covering panels, framing outline, counting number, focal visual, annotations, position marker

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Outgoing visuals hold in place until the incoming ones finish uncovering, so nothing blanks out; stepping past the last item wraps to the first
interaction_model.state_change: Current item advances one step forward in the set; all linked readouts move to the new item's values
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The following item's looping footage wipes in over the current one from a corner; the side image and each tile in the column change to the new item's distinguishing colour treatment in a cascading wipe; the position digit rolls up by one; spec lines roll to the new item's codes
interaction_model.input: Activate next arrow
interaction_model.affected_object: Focal looping visual, tall side image, repeating side tile column, position digit, spec annotation lines

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Same hold-until-covered behaviour; stepping back from the first item wraps to the last, so neither direction dead-ends
interaction_model.state_change: Current item moves one step backward in the set with the identical coordinated chain reversed
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The preceding item's looping footage wipes in from a corner, cascading colour-treatment wipe across side image and tiles, position digit rolls down one, spec lines roll to the preceding item's codes
interaction_model.input: Activate previous arrow
interaction_model.affected_object: Focal looping visual, tall side image, repeating side tile column, position digit, spec annotation lines

experience_qualities: Deliberate, staged opening that feels like a device powering up rather than content merely appearing
Precise and technical, from the thin drawn outline and counting numeral to the fine spec codes
Snappy and decisive steps — each change reads as a single committed move, not a slow crossfade
Continuously alive in the steady state because the focal visual never stops looping
Solid and gapless: the composition is always filled, never showing an empty frame mid-change
completion_and_return: The entrance completes once and does not replay; it terminates in the steady looping spotlight
The focal visual loops continuously with no end state
Stepping wraps endlessly in both directions, so the set has no first-or-last boundary experience
The currently featured item persists as the region's state; reversing direction returns to a previously shown item in the same presentation
locked_observable_requirements: Entrance runs as an ordered, self-contained sequence: panels wipe up, outer panels part, square outline draws itself around an upward-counting number, panels close, focal loop begins, annotations and position marker settle last
Exactly one item holds focus at a time
Arrow pair is the only means of moving through the set
A step wipes the incoming focal visual in from a corner over the outgoing one

Side image and every tile in the repeating column change to the new item's distinguishing colour treatment — the linkage is required, the specific hues are not — with a cascading rather than simultaneous wipe
Position readout rolls by exactly one digit step per navigation step
Spec annotation lines roll to the new item's codes as part of the same coordinated change
Outgoing visuals remain visible until incoming visuals have fully uncovered them; no blank or empty intermediate frame
Both directions wrap around endlessly
The focal visual is continuously looping motion in the steady state
adaptable_details: Number of items in the small set
Panel count, direction subtleties and exact easing of the entrance wipes
Which corner the incoming focal visual wipes from
Cascade direction and stagger timing of the tile-column colour-treatment change
Count of spec annotation lines and the character of their short codes
Placement side of the tall image and tile column
The specific hues and overall palette used, including which colour each item is keyed to, plus type treatment and outline thickness
Position readout format, including whether it shows a total
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits a hero or spotlight region presenting a small curated set of visually distinct variants where each item has a dominant looping or moving visual, a signature distinguishing colour in any hue family, and a few short technical or descriptive codes to display alongside. Requires enough items to make wrapping meaningful and few enough that a position digit stays readable, and enough contrast between panels, outline, annotations and focal visual for each to stay readable in the host's own palette. Replacing single-item focus with a simultaneous grid or gallery, removing the coordinated multi-element change so only the focal visual updates, allowing blank frames between items, or dropping the staged panel-and-outline entrance would each produce a different Skill.

name: liquid_smear_photo_stage
description: One large centred photograph, introduced by a brief quiet wait, that drags and smears like liquid under the moving pointer with a faint fringe of separated colour channels along the strongest pull, then unwinds back to a perfectly clean print the moment the pointer stops.

canonical_document.name: liquid_smear_photo_stage
canonical_document.description: One large centred photograph, introduced by a brief quiet wait, that drags and smears like liquid under the moving pointer with a faint fringe of separated colour channels along the strongest pull, then unwinds back to a perfectly clean print the moment the pointer stops.
canonical_document.experience_scope: Whole-view experience: begins with a short preparation wait before the picture appears, occupies the full page with the image as the only substantial content, and the distortion behaviour is bounded to the image area itself; it never ends in a completed state, only in the picture's clean resting state.
content_and_composition: Exactly one photographic image as the dominant foreground subject, centred and large within an otherwise empty view
Exactly one thin line of small supporting text as the only other visible content, deliberately low in visual weight so it never competes with the image
No navigation, controls, buttons or reset affordance anywhere in the view
A single interactive layer coincident with the image: the distortion lives on the picture surface itself rather than in an overlay panel or frame
A soft circular zone of influence centred under the pointer, smaller than the image, so undisturbed regions of the photograph remain visible around it
A calm, low-distraction empty surround acts as the backdrop, held far enough back in visual weight that the image is the only focal layer
experience_progression: Brief quiet wait while the picture is being prepared, with nothing demanding attention
The photograph settles into place, centred and large, reaching its clean undistorted resting state
Open-ended interactive state: the surface responds to pointer movement and relaxes back, indefinitely, with no ordered stages or endpoint
Resting state is always the destination; repeated disturbance and relaxation form a loop rather than an advance
attention_and_information_flow: During the wait, attention is held loosely with nothing to read or do
On arrival, attention lands entirely on the centred image because scale and emptiness leave no alternative target
Under the pointer, attention concentrates in the local smear region while the rest of the picture stays legible, so the viewer keeps the whole image in mind while playing with a part of it
The channel-separation fringe appears only at the strongest part of the pull, drawing the eye to the leading edge of motion
As the distortion unwinds, prominence returns to the whole photograph and full legibility is restored
The single line of small text remains subordinate at all times and is never revealed or hidden by interaction

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Distortion is momentary and self-correcting; the viewer can never damage or permanently alter the picture
interaction_model.state_change: Surface is dragged along the direction of travel, smearing image content directionally; falloff makes displacement strongest at the pointer and fade to nothing at the edge of the zone
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The picture appears to be pulled like a liquid in the direction of the sweep, with a soft-edged local warp that blends seamlessly into the undisturbed image
interaction_model.input: Pointer moving across the image
interaction_model.affected_object: The photograph's surface within a soft circular falloff centred under the pointer

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Slowing the sweep immediately reduces both pull strength and fringing; fringing disappears entirely at rest
interaction_model.state_change: Displacement magnitude increases with speed and the image's own colour channels pry apart proportionally along the pull
interaction_model.visible_feedback: A harder, longer pull with a faint fringe of mutually offset colour channels appearing along the strongest part of the smear, giving an iridescent edge to fast gestures
interaction_model.input: Faster pointer sweep
interaction_model.affected_object: Strength of the smear and separation of the image's colour channels

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Accumulation is bounded by continuous relaxation, so the trail can grow but never freezes or compounds without limit
interaction_model.state_change: Successive displacements build on one another instead of replacing each other, forming a lingering trail
interaction_model.visible_feedback: A visible smeared trail following the path of travel that persists briefly behind the pointer
interaction_model.input: Repeated passes over the same or overlapping areas
interaction_model.affected_object: The accumulated disturbance on the image surface

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Recovery is autonomous and requires no control; a new pointer movement during unwinding simply re-disturbs the surface from wherever it currently is, with no snap or discontinuity
interaction_model.state_change: The pull unwinds automatically within a fraction of a second back to the undistorted photograph
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The smear and channel fringe visibly settle and resolve, leaving the picture perfectly legible again almost immediately
interaction_model.input: Pointer slows, halts, or leaves the image area
interaction_model.affected_object: All accumulated distortion and colour separation

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Interaction becomes meaningful only once the picture is visible; the wait is short and requires no user action
interaction_model.state_change: A brief quiet waiting state resolves into the settled clean image
interaction_model.visible_feedback: A short calm pause followed by the photograph arriving centred and large in its undistorted state
interaction_model.input: Page arrival, before the picture is ready
interaction_model.affected_object: The image's presence in the view

experience_qualities: Tactile and playful: the picture feels touchable rather than printed
Liquid and continuous, never stepped or snapping
Faintly iridescent only where disturbed, otherwise faithful to the image's own colour
Quiet and minimal, with restraint that keeps the image supreme
Forgiving: nothing can be broken and no cleanup is asked of the viewer
Fast to recover, so legibility feels like the picture's natural state
Taskless and open-ended, rewarding idle exploration
completion_and_return: There is no task and no completion; the undistorted photograph is the permanent resting state
Every disturbance self-resolves back to that resting state within a fraction of a second
No reset control exists or is needed, and no distortion state persists across visits
The disturb-and-relax cycle can repeat indefinitely without degradation
locked_observable_requirements: One image is the sole dominant subject, centred and large, with at most a single line of small subordinate text and no controls
A brief quiet wait precedes the image settling into view
Pointer movement drags the image surface directionally rather than merely highlighting or overlaying it
Displacement is confined to a soft circular falloff centred under the pointer, leaving the rest of the image undisturbed
Faster movement produces a stronger pull and visible separation of the image's colour channels into a fringe along the strongest part of the smear
Repeated passes accumulate into a lingering trail rather than resetting each pass
Slowing, stopping, or leaving the image triggers autonomous unwinding to the exact undistorted picture within a fraction of a second
The picture is always fully legible at rest and no broken or stuck state is reachable
No reset affordance is present
adaptable_details: Subject matter, aspect ratio and resolution of the photograph
Wording and placement of the single line of small text
Exact radius and softness profile of the circular falloff
Precise pull magnitude, speed sensitivity, fringe intensity and which opposed channel hues the separation resolves into, within the stated feel
Exact relaxation duration so long as it remains a fraction of a second
Tone and luminance of the empty surround, and page margins, so long as the surround stays low-distraction against the image
Nature of the brief waiting cue so long as it stays quiet and unobtrusive
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits any context where one still image deserves to be the whole view and can tolerate momentary local distortion: featured photographs, single artwork or portfolio pieces, a hero visual with a one-line caption. It stops being this Skill if multiple images or substantial adjacent content compete for attention, if the distortion is asked to persist as a drawn or saved mark, if it must sit behind readable foreground text as a background substrate, or if the disturbance is driven by something other than the viewer's pointer path such that speed-linked pull strength and self-unwinding no longer apply.
