name: scroll_paced_depth_dive_into_peeling_fullscreen_image_stack
description: Scroll pulls a sparse opening screen into a set of pictures that grow nearer and sweep outward past the viewer, then hands off to full-frame single-image viewing where each photo peels upward to expose the one behind it, with a credit line beside it, a small stacked miniature set marking position, and a closing screen that says the set can be retraced.

canonical_document.name: scroll_paced_depth_dive_into_peeling_fullscreen_image_stack
canonical_document.description: Scroll pulls a sparse opening screen into a set of pictures that grow nearer and sweep outward past the viewer, then hands off to full-frame single-image viewing where each photo peels upward to expose the one behind it, with a credit line beside it, a small stacked miniature set marking position, and a closing screen that says the set can be retraced.
canonical_document.experience_scope: Whole-view experience occupying the full viewport from first paint to a terminal closing screen; it spans several sequential stages that each hold the frame still while scroll progress is consumed inside them, and it ends when the closing screen is reached.
content_and_composition: A calm, almost empty opening screen with minimal foreground content and generous emptiness setting the initial mood
A small set (a handful, not a large library) of images that during the depth stage are arranged as a layered field in front of the viewer rather than as a flat gallery
One full-frame photograph at a time during the viewing stage, filling the entire viewport edge to edge
A compact credit block placed beside the full-frame image, legible against it, carrying a few short attribution fields (author, place, recency of publication, capture device)
A persistent small stack of miniature versions of the same images, offset to one side, giving a peripheral sense of position and remaining depth in the sequence
The image currently in front plus the next image waiting immediately behind it as a two-layer relationship during each hand-off
A closing screen at the end that makes clear the whole set can be retraced back to the beginning
experience_progression: Stage 1 — quiet arrival: near-empty screen, almost nothing to read, mood established before any motion
Stage 2 — depth dive: continued scrolling pushes the pictures nearer and larger so they sweep outward past the viewer, pulling attention forward into the set

Stage 3 — focused viewing: motion settles; one photograph fills the frame with its credit line, and each further increment of scroll peels the front photograph upward off the screen until the image beneath is fully exposed, repeating for each image in the set
Stage 4 — close: after the last image yields, a final screen presents the set as complete and retraceable
Each stage pins the frame, spends scroll progress inside itself, then releases the page onward to the next stage
attention_and_information_flow: Opening withholds detail so attention has nothing to fixate on and the later motion reads as an entrance
During the depth stage attention is pulled forward and outward by growth and proximity; no text competes for reading
At the viewing stage prominence collapses to exactly one image plus its short credit block, so reading and looking happen together without scanning
Sequence position stays peripheral: the miniature stack answers 'where am I' without drawing focus from the full-frame image
Each peel briefly reveals the next image beneath before it becomes the sole focus, so information arrives one item at a time
The closing screen releases attention and reframes the whole set as something that can be re-entered

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Reversing scroll runs the motion backward from the exact current point; pausing freezes it in place; progress clamps at both ends of the stage so it cannot be overshot
interaction_model.state_change: Depth progress advances proportionally to scroll distance
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Pictures move nearer and grow larger, sweeping outward past the viewer
interaction_model.input: Vertical scroll forward during the depth stage
interaction_model.affected_object: The layered field of images

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Scrolling back re-lays the peeled image down and restores the previous credit line; a stopped scroll leaves the peel frozen mid-motion; each hand-off clamps so it cannot end half-broken
interaction_model.state_change: Hand-off progress for the current image advances one-to-one with scroll
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The front photograph peels upward off the screen until the one beneath is fully exposed and becomes the new front image with its own credit line
interaction_model.input: Vertical scroll forward during the full-frame viewing stage
interaction_model.affected_object: The front photograph and the image waiting behind it

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Boundaries clamp at both ends so a stage is always fully entered or fully exited; reversing returns to the prior stage at the position it was left
interaction_model.state_change: The stage completes its internal progress and releases the page, or re-enters the previous stage when reversed
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The held frame gives way and the next stage takes over the viewport; the mood shift from sweeping depth to still, focused viewing is visible
interaction_model.input: Vertical scroll in either direction across a stage boundary
interaction_model.affected_object: The pinned stage and the page as a whole

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Stays consistent with the front image at all times, including mid-peel and while reversing
interaction_model.state_change: Current position within the sequence updates
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The stack reflects which image is in front and how much of the set remains
interaction_model.input: Any scroll progress through the viewing stage
interaction_model.affected_object: The small stack of miniature images at the side

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Resuming scroll in either direction continues from that exact point; nothing advances, drifts or settles on its own
interaction_model.state_change: All motion holds at its current fractional progress
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The scene sits frozen exactly where it stopped, including partially completed depth or peel motion
interaction_model.input: Scroll pause (no input)
interaction_model.affected_object: Every animated element in the active stage

experience_qualities: Calm and unhurried at entry, then forward-pulling during the depth stage, then still and focused
Fully scrubbable: the viewer feels they are driving playback rather than triggering animations
Deliberate and authored pacing, since each stage insists on being spent before the page continues
Gallery-scale intimacy in the viewing stage — one picture, one short credit, nothing else
Predictable and unbreakable: no overshoot, no half-finished state, no autonomous motion
completion_and_return: The sequence completes at a closing screen once the last image has yielded
The closing screen communicates that the set is finite and can be retraced from the beginning
Reverse scrolling is a full return path: the entire experience can be replayed backward through every stage
No looping and no auto-restart; the viewer's scroll position is the only state that determines what is shown
locked_observable_requirements: Vertical scroll is the only control and maps one-to-one to progress; nothing advances autonomously
Each stage pins the frame, consumes scroll progress internally, then releases the page onward
A depth stage in which images grow nearer and larger and sweep outward past the viewer
A viewing stage where one photograph fills the entire frame at a time
A short credit block placed beside the full-frame image and legible there
Hand-off between images is a peel of the front image upward until the one beneath is fully exposed
A persistent small stacked set of the same images off to one side indicating position in the sequence
Full reversibility at any point, freeze-in-place on pause, and clamping at both ends of every stage
A terminal closing screen presenting the set as complete and retraceable
A quiet, near-empty opening state before any motion begins
adaptable_details: Number of images in the set, as long as it stays a small curated group
Which and how many short credit fields appear, and their labels
Side and exact styling of the miniature stack
Easing, distance and duration-per-scroll of the depth and peel motions
Image aspect ratios and cropping strategy for full-frame fit
Typography, color treatment and the wording on the opening and closing screens
How the credit block is kept legible over varying imagery
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits small curated sets of full-bleed imagery paired with brief attribution or caption metadata, where the whole viewport can be devoted to one item at a time and the visitor is expected to move linearly. It stops fitting when the set is large enough to require browsing or filtering, when items carry dense body text that cannot sit beside the image, or when several items must be compared at once. Replacing scroll with autonomous playback, timed advance, or click/drag/swipe navigation, or presenting the images as a simultaneous grid instead of a single full-frame item, produces a different Skill.

name: weighted_scroll_reveal_with_pliable_photographs
description: Photographs appear one by one down a long, loosely staggered descent that glides with weight and slight elasticity; while the view travels each visible photograph bows and its surface smears with the speed and direction of travel, the currently attended piece carries a faint stirring grain, and pointing at an image pulls a lagging distortion around the pointer.

canonical_document.name: weighted_scroll_reveal_with_pliable_photographs
canonical_document.description: Photographs appear one by one down a long, loosely staggered descent that glides with weight and slight elasticity; while the view travels each visible photograph bows and its surface smears with the speed and direction of travel, the currently attended piece carries a faint stirring grain, and pointing at an image pulls a lagging distortion around the pointer.
canonical_document.experience_scope: Whole-view experience: begins with a brief blank hold on arrival before anything is shown, spans the entire scrollable descent, and ends when the last item closes the sequence. It is not a component that sits inside an otherwise conventional page.
content_and_composition: A small set of large image items, on the order of a handful rather than a grid of many
One short text label paired with each image, placed beside it and remaining legible while that image holds attention
Items distributed down a long vertical run with loose horizontal stagger so no two read as a symmetric pair
Vertical spacing generous enough that a single image occupies attention at any given moment
Each image behaves as a single pliable surface that can bend and smear as one plane, with its own local distortion field under the pointer
Quiet, near-empty surroundings with no competing foreground furniture
experience_progression: Arrival holds a blank, still view briefly while the experience prepares, with nothing partially formed on screen
Items then reveal themselves in sequence from top down, one after another rather than all at once
As the visitor descends, attention transfers from one image to the next; the newly attended image takes on the stirring surface grain and the previous one settles back
The final item closes the sequence, giving the descent a definite end rather than an open-ended feed
attention_and_information_flow: Only one image is the focus of attention at a time; its label is the only text competing for reading
The attended image is marked out by a fine grain stirring across its surface, which settles as attention moves on
During travel, legibility deliberately drops as surfaces smear, and returns fully when motion stops, so reading happens in the pauses
Under the pointer, prominence concentrates locally around the pointer position within the single image being touched

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Distortion magnitude stays bounded on very fast flicks so images never tear or break apart; reversing direction reverses the bow and smear; stopping at any moment resolves everything back to a clean, undistorted state
interaction_model.state_change: The view eases toward the new position with weight and slight overshoot instead of jumping; visible images enter a travelling state proportional to speed and direction
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The descent glides and feels faintly elastic; images bow and their surfaces smear along the direction of travel, more strongly the faster the travel, then flatten back to clean as soon as motion stops
interaction_model.input: Scrolling or flicking down or up the view
interaction_model.affected_object: The view position and every currently visible photograph

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Scrolling back up returns focus and the grain to the earlier item; the effect follows attention rather than latching
interaction_model.state_change: Focus transfers between items
interaction_model.visible_feedback: A fine grain begins stirring across the newly attended image's surface while the previous image's grain settles away
interaction_model.input: Continuing to descend so a different item comes into attention
interaction_model.affected_object: The attended photograph and the previously attended one

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Moving the pointer away eases the distortion back to the image centre and down to nothing from whatever strength it had reached, with no snap; re-entering ramps it up again from the current state
interaction_model.state_change: A local distortion ramps up from nothing to full strength and tracks the pointer path with a slight delay, confined within that image
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The surface visibly pulls and warps around the pointer and trails a little behind the pointer's movement, never spilling outside the image bounds
interaction_model.input: Pointing at or moving the pointer across a photograph
interaction_model.affected_object: That single photograph's surface, locally around the pointer

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Each contribution decays on its own terms; when both inputs cease the image returns fully to clean and centred
interaction_model.state_change: Travel-driven and pointer-driven distortion coexist on the same surface
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The image reads as one continuously pliable surface rather than two separate effects fighting
interaction_model.input: Pointing while the view is also travelling
interaction_model.affected_object: The pointed photograph

experience_qualities: Quiet, unhurried and deliberate
Weighty and faintly elastic rather than rigid or snappy
Tactile and material, as if the images were physical surfaces that can be pushed
Restrained: distortion is always temporary and always resolves to a clean image
Sparse, with attention held by a single object at a time
completion_and_return: The sequence has a defined end at the last item; it does not loop or feed endlessly
All distortion is transient and self-clearing: any pause in travel or pointer departure returns surfaces to clean
Focus grain follows current attention in both directions, so travelling back up restores the earlier state rather than replaying a one-shot reveal
No distorted or partially revealed state persists once inputs stop
locked_observable_requirements: A brief blank, still hold at arrival before any item appears
Items reveal sequentially down a long vertical descent, not simultaneously
Loose horizontal stagger of items rather than a regular aligned column or grid
One item holds attention at a time, with its own short label legible beside it
Travel is glided and weighty with slight elasticity, never instantaneous jumping
Speed- and direction-proportional bow plus surface smear on all visible images while travelling, flattening to clean when motion stops
Distortion is bounded on fast flicks so images stay coherent
A fine stirring grain marks the currently attended image and settles when attention moves on
Pointer-local distortion that ramps up, lags behind the pointer path, stays inside the image, and eases back to centre and nothing on exit
A definite closing item that ends the sequence
adaptable_details: Exact number of items, as long as it stays a small set
Subject matter of the images and wording of the labels
Label side, typography and offset relative to its image
Image sizes, aspect ratios and the amplitude of the horizontal stagger
Precise distortion strength, grain coarseness, easing curves and settle durations
Any palette and surround treatment, provided the surround stays low-distraction and images and labels keep readable separation from it
Reveal styling of each item's entrance, provided it remains sequential
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits sparse, image-led views with a small number of large visuals and short per-item captions, where the page itself is the sequence and slow reading is acceptable. It stops being this Skill if items are packed into a dense grid or endless feed, if several items compete for attention at once, if travel becomes instantaneous or rigid, if the distortion becomes permanent styling rather than an input-driven state that resolves to clean, or if the imagery is demoted to a background substrate behind other foreground content.

name: depth_of_field_scroll_gallery
description: A long, eased-scrolling image sequence in which only what sits near mid-height reads crisp while photos drifting toward the top and bottom edges melt into softness, with short typographic passages that resolve out of blur as they arrive.

canonical_document.name: depth_of_field_scroll_gallery
canonical_document.description: A long, eased-scrolling image sequence in which only what sits near mid-height reads crisp while photos drifting toward the top and bottom edges melt into softness, with short typographic passages that resolve out of blur as they arrive.
canonical_document.experience_scope: Whole-view experience covering the entire page: begins at a large titled opening image occupying the arrival view, continues through the full scrolled sequence, and ends at a single final image above a brief credit line. The clarity behavior applies to every media item in the flow, not to one isolated region.
content_and_composition: One large opening image at arrival, carrying an overlaid or adjacent title, sized to dominate the first view

A sequence of many images (a small-to-moderate collection) arranged in mixed groupings: single full-width pieces alongside smaller side-by-side or offset pairs and clusters, with varied aspect ratios and heights
Short typographic passages interleaved between image groupings, holding only brief names of place and subject, set as quiet punctuation rather than paragraphs of explanation
One final single image acting as the closing frame
A brief credit line beneath the closing image as the last element
A persistent invisible focal band around mid-height of the viewport that governs clarity for whatever passes through it; softness increases progressively toward the upper and lower viewport edges
Single continuous vertical flow with no chrome, panels or controls competing with the imagery
experience_progression: Arrival: opening image nearly clear at rest with its title, establishing scale and tone
Departure from top: opening image eases into its full softening while growing slightly taller, handing attention to the sequence

Middle: continuous advance through mixed image groupings, each item sharpening as it approaches mid-height and dissolving as it leaves, punctuated by typographic passages that resolve out of blur on first arrival and then stay settled
Close: arrival at the single final image, sharp at mid-height, followed by the short credit line ending the journey
Reverse traversal is fully available: scrolling back re-sharpens what had gone soft, with no fixed stopping points
attention_and_information_flow: Clarity is the sole attention cue: at any moment essentially one photo reads precise while its neighbors are legible only as soft shapes, so the eye rests on a single subject
Prominence transfers continuously as content crosses the mid-height band, producing a hand-off rather than a cut
Typographic passages briefly take the foreground when they resolve, supplying place and subject context in a few words, then recede into settled quietness
The opening image commands full attention at arrival and deliberately relinquishes it by softening and stretching as the user departs the top
Soft upper and lower edges suppress peripheral competition and imply that more exists above and below without labeling it

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Any input direction can be reversed at any time; stopping input lets motion decay smoothly to rest at an arbitrary position, and all inputs act on the same continuous position
interaction_model.state_change: Sequence position advances or reverses with eased, weighted momentum that settles rather than jumping to discrete positions
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Content glides with perceptible inertia; no snapping, stepping or locked slides at any point
interaction_model.input: Scroll by wheel, trackpad, touch drag or keyboard
interaction_model.affected_object: The entire vertical sequence of images and typographic passages

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Slowing, stopping or scrolling back re-sharpens whatever was soft moments earlier; the state is always derived from current position, so nothing is left stranded soft or stuck sharp
interaction_model.state_change: Per-item clarity updates continuously as a function of distance from the mid-height focal band: precise at mid-height, progressively softer toward the upper and lower edges
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Photos visibly sharpen while rising into the band and dissolve into softness while leaving it, updating every frame rather than switching between two states
interaction_model.input: Continuous change of each item's position relative to viewport mid-height (driven by scroll, not by a separate trigger)
interaction_model.affected_object: Each individual photo in the sequence

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Scrolling back to the top eases the opening image back toward clarity and its original height, tied to position rather than a one-shot trigger
interaction_model.state_change: Transitions from nearly clear at rest into its full softening while simultaneously gaining slight extra height
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The opening frame blurs and stretches taller as it exits, reading as a filmic dissolve out of the arrival state
interaction_model.input: Leaving the top of the page for the first time
interaction_model.affected_object: The large titled opening image

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: The reveal is one-time and non-reversing: revisiting the passage shows it already settled, so repeated scrolling never re-blurs or flickers the text
interaction_model.state_change: Resolves once from blurred to settled, then remains settled for the rest of the session
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Text emerges out of softness into crisp legibility and afterwards stays stable even as it moves through the view
interaction_model.input: A typographic passage entering view for the first time
interaction_model.affected_object: That short passage of place and subject names

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Position within the sequence and the mid-height focal relationship remain coherent after resize
interaction_model.state_change: Layout recomputes while each photo keeps its place in the sequence and its grouping relationship
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Groupings re-fit to the new width with no items reordered, detached or misaligned; clarity behavior continues from the new geometry
interaction_model.input: Viewport resize
interaction_model.affected_object: All images and their groupings

experience_qualities: Calm and unhurried
Filmic, with a shallow depth-of-field feel
Slightly dreamlike and atmospheric
Weighted and continuous rather than clicky or stepped
Self-explanatory without instructions or labels
Sparse and quiet, letting single images breathe
completion_and_return: Ends definitively at the single final image followed by the brief credit line; no loop and no auto-return
No completion gate or dismissal step: the journey simply concludes at the bottom
Fully re-traversable in reverse at any time, with clarity restored from position
One-time text resolutions persist as settled for the remainder of the visit while image clarity remains continuously position-derived
locked_observable_requirements: Clarity is continuously tied to vertical position: precise near mid-height, progressively soft toward upper and lower viewport edges
At most one photo reads fully clear at a time, so attention rests on a single image
Scrolling glides with eased weight; no snapping, stepping or fixed slide positions anywhere
Clarity keeps updating in both directions, so slowing, stopping or reversing re-sharpens previously soft content
Arrival is a large titled opening image that is nearly clear at rest and, on leaving the top, eases into full softening while growing slightly taller
Interleaved short typographic passages resolve out of blur on first view and then stay settled without re-blurring
The sequence uses mixed groupings of varied sizes and proportions rather than a uniform grid
Closing is a single final image above a brief credit line
Every photo keeps its place in the sequence across viewport resizes
The experience is understandable without explanatory instructions
adaptable_details: Number of images and how many groupings are singles versus pairs or clusters
Exact softening strength, focal band height and falloff steepness
Amount of eased momentum and settle duration
How much extra height the opening image gains on exit
Typography choices, wording and placement of the short passages
The low-distraction surround treatment and its degree of separation from the imagery, plus spacing rhythm between groupings
Whether the opening title sits over or beside the opening image
Wording of the closing credit line
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits image-led, sparsely captioned collections meant to be viewed one piece at a time in a fixed authored order down a full page: quiet portfolios, photo essays, exhibition walkthroughs, lookbooks and visual retrospectives where softness on non-focal content is acceptable. It stops fitting when content must be compared side by side, scanned quickly, filtered or read in volume, since blurring most of the view would obstruct that. Replacing the position-derived continuous clarity with discrete slide snapping, per-item click-to-open detail views, or a dense uniformly sharp grid would create a different Skill, as would applying it to running body text instead of imagery.

canonical_document.name: evenly_muted_field_with_directional_clearaway_fullscreen_focus
canonical_document.description: A uniformly de-emphasised grid of pictures on a quiet, low-distraction surround that appears all at once; clicking one grows it from its own slot to cover the screen while all the others glide off-frame in the direction they sit, and clicking again reverses the whole move exactly.
canonical_document.experience_scope: Region-to-whole-view experience: begins with a short readiness hold on the gallery surface, continues as an evenly spread browsing field, temporarily escalates to a full-viewport single-picture state layered above everything else, and ends when the view collapses back into the untouched field.
content_and_composition: One field of many pictures of comparable visual weight, evenly spread across multiple rows and columns
A uniform de-emphasis treatment applied at equal strength across the whole set so nothing competes for notice
A quiet, low-distraction surrounding surface, held clearly apart in tone from the pictures, that stays constant through browsing and focus
Each picture owns a fixed home slot that remains reserved even while the picture is off-frame
One selected picture that becomes a single full-viewport layer above all other page content
No competing overlay chrome, captions or controls during the enlarged state
experience_progression: Short, quiet hold while the entire set becomes ready; the field does not respond yet
The whole set is revealed together as a calm, evenly muted field with flat emphasis
A picture is chosen: it travels from its slot to full-viewport scale while every other picture leaves the frame at the same moment
Undisturbed full-view state with only the chosen picture present
Reverse move: the picture shrinks back into its slot while the rest slide back to their exact starting positions, restoring the browsing field
attention_and_information_flow: Attention starts deliberately unfocused and evenly distributed; no item is highlighted or ranked
On selection, prominence collapses to a single picture and all competing imagery is removed from view rather than merely held back in emphasis
The enlarged state reveals the picture's full-scale detail with nothing else visible to draw the eye
The direction each picture leaves in tells the viewer where it still lives, so spatial memory of the set survives the focus state
Returning restores flat, even attention and the viewer's original place in the set

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Clicks made before readiness produce no movement; the field simply becomes responsive once ready
interaction_model.state_change: Inert waiting state becomes a fully presented, interactive field
interaction_model.visible_feedback: A short quiet wait, then the complete set appears at once rather than filling in piece by piece
interaction_model.input: Completion of readiness for the whole picture set (autonomous)
interaction_model.affected_object: The gallery field and its responsiveness

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: The move is fully reversible; home slots and the set's arrangement are held unchanged underneath
interaction_model.state_change: Even browsing field becomes single-picture focus state
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The clicked picture moves smoothly and continuously from where it sits until it covers the whole screen, held above everything else, while in the same moment all other pictures glide out of frame — those above it exit past the top, those below exit past the bottom, and those level with it exit left or right according to which side they are on
interaction_model.input: Click directly on any picture in the field
interaction_model.affected_object: The clicked picture and every other picture in the set

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: The field is left precisely as it was, so browsing resumes without losing place; any picture can be focused again immediately
interaction_model.state_change: Single-picture focus state returns to the even browsing field
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The picture shrinks back along the same path into its own slot while all other pictures slide back in from the edges to their exact starting positions
interaction_model.input: Click on the enlarged picture
interaction_model.affected_object: The enlarged picture and the off-frame pictures

experience_qualities: Quiet and atmospheric, with the surround receding behind the imagery
Calm, unhurried and evenly weighted before selection
Decisive, whole-screen takeover on selection
Smooth continuous motion with picture and surroundings moving together
Spatially coherent: items leave and return along the direction they belong
Undisturbed viewing with no visual competition
Effortless, non-destructive return
completion_and_return: The focus state persists indefinitely until dismissed by a second click; it does not time out or advance on its own
Return restores the field to an identical arrangement, de-emphasis level and position
The cycle is fully repeatable for any picture, any number of times
No progress or place is lost between focus entries
locked_observable_requirements: The set is withheld during a short quiet wait and then presented all at once, not progressively
All pictures share the same de-emphasis strength and even spacing, with no pre-emphasized item
The selected picture animates continuously from its own slot to full-viewport coverage and sits above all other content
Every other picture exits the frame in the same moment, with exit direction determined by its position relative to the selected picture (past the top, past the bottom, or out the nearer side)
A second click reverses the identical motion, returning the picture to its slot and every other picture to its exact original position
Pictures do not respond to clicks until the whole set is ready
adaptable_details: Number of pictures, column count and aspect ratios
Exact easing, duration and stagger of the travel and exit motion
Depth of the de-emphasis and the tone, hue and light-or-dark direction of the surround
Spacing and margins of the field
Optional subtle hover response on tiles
Subject matter of the imagery
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits any set of uniform, comparably weighted visual items worth viewing large — photographs, artwork, frames, stills, product shots — laid out in a regular multi-row arrangement so the directional exits read as spatially truthful. Mixed-weight or text-heavy items with built-in hierarchy, single-row or irregular layouts, an overlay that leaves the rest of the set visible behind it, or sequential swipe-through browsing between enlarged items would each produce a different skill.

name: tonally_unified_still_wall_to_backdrop_handoff
description: A grid of picture rows under one shared tonal treatment that slides sideways with the pointer at different speeds per row and hardens into extreme tonal contrast away from center, until one legible cue expands the middle picture into a full-screen backdrop and releases the page for calm reading.

canonical_document.name: tonally_unified_still_wall_to_backdrop_handoff
canonical_document.description: A grid of picture rows under one shared tonal treatment that slides sideways with the pointer at different speeds per row and hardens into extreme tonal contrast away from center, until one legible cue expands the middle picture into a full-screen backdrop and releases the page for calm reading.
canonical_document.experience_scope: Whole-view experience that begins the moment the opening view is shown and ends when the visitor reaches the closing links of the reading section below; the wall stage occupies the entire viewport and is replaced, not scrolled past.
content_and_composition: Multiple horizontal rows of still images filling the entire viewport, more rows than can be fully seen at rest, forming one continuous wall with no visible outer edge or gap at any time
Rows are grouped by depth tier: rows nearer the vertical middle read as nearer, outer rows read as further back
One image located at the middle of the wall is implicitly the hero and later becomes the full-screen backdrop
One single persistent entry cue, short and self-explanatory, held at sufficient contrast against the imagery behind it to stay legible, without instructions or secondary options
After handoff: one full-bleed backdrop image, the studio or subject name surfacing over it, then a short body of reading text ending in a closing set of links
One uniform, low-variance tonal treatment applied across all imagery so the wall reads as a single continuous field
experience_progression: Held state: nothing half-formed is shown; the wall is withheld until every picture is fully ready
Alive-at-rest state: the wall appears already in motion in feel, atmospheric and uniformly toned, page scrolling locked
Exploration state: continuous sideways drift and contrast shifts respond to pointer or drag, indefinitely and reversibly
Handoff state: the middle image expands to fill the screen while the remaining stills fade away and the cue retires
Reading state: name surfaces over the backdrop, page scrolling is released, unhurried reading proceeds downward
Close: the sequence ends at the closing links; the wall stage never returns
attention_and_information_flow: At rest, attention is spread across the whole wall as one atmospheric field rather than any single picture
Row-speed differences and rising contrast extremes toward the edges push legibility toward the center, quietly making the middle picture the focal point
The single cue is the only piece of language present, so it carries all wayfinding weight without competing calls to action
At handoff, attention collapses from many pictures to one, then shifts from image to text as the name and body copy take over
After handoff the imagery becomes a passive setting and the reading order is strictly top-to-bottom to the closing links

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Fully reversible at any moment by moving back; no committed state; the wall never scrolls far enough to expose an outer edge or empty space
interaction_model.state_change: Every row shifts horizontally together, with center-tier rows following closely and outer-tier rows trailing further behind
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Continuous layered sideways sliding that reads as depth; motion always tracks the input without snapping, stepping or settling animations
interaction_model.input: Horizontal pointer movement across the view, or a finger dragging sideways
interaction_model.affected_object: All rows of the picture wall

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Continuous and reversible in both directions; no threshold or latched extreme state
interaction_model.state_change: Progressive contrast intensification into harsh tonal compression as distance from center grows
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Pictures crush toward their tonal extremes with clipped shadow ends and hard highlights at the far reaches, and ease smoothly back to the wall's baseline treatment as the pointer returns to center
interaction_model.input: Pointer distance from the horizontal center of the view
interaction_model.affected_object: Tonal treatment of the wall imagery

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Reveal happens once; the held state cannot recur later in the visit
interaction_model.state_change: Held back briefly, then revealed only once every picture is fully ready
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The first impression is a complete wall; no partially populated or progressively filling grid is ever visible
interaction_model.input: Readiness of all wall imagery (autonomous)
interaction_model.affected_object: The entire opening view

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Lock is lifted only by accepting the entry cue
interaction_model.state_change: Scrolling remains locked
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The view stays on the wall; nothing below is reachable or hinted at by movement
interaction_model.input: Attempt to scroll the page during the wall stage
interaction_model.affected_object: Page scroll position

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Irreversible within the visit; the wall and its motion do not come back and the cue does not reappear
interaction_model.state_change: One-way handoff: middle image expands to fill the screen, remaining stills fade out, cue retires, scrolling is released, pointer-driven drift and contrast response end permanently
interaction_model.visible_feedback: A continuous expansion in place that reads as the same picture becoming the backdrop rather than a navigation to another view, with the name surfacing over it
interaction_model.input: Click or tap on the entry cue
interaction_model.affected_object: Middle image, remaining stills, cue, page scroll, pointer-driven motion

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Ordinary scroll control in both directions within the reading section
interaction_model.state_change: Normal downward reading progression
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Unhurried text reading over the settled backdrop, concluding at the closing links
interaction_model.input: Scrolling after release
interaction_model.affected_object: Reading section over the backdrop

experience_qualities: Atmospheric and mood-led rather than product-catalog-like
Alive at rest: feels in motion even before the visitor acts
Continuous and elastic; never snaps, jumps or stutters
Depth-forward, with layered speeds standing in for physical distance
Deliberately restrained in language: one invitation, no explanation
Complete on arrival, never half-formed
Calm and unhurried once reading begins
completion_and_return: The experience completes at the closing links of the reading section
Handoff is terminal: pointer-driven motion, the cue and the multi-picture wall are retired for the remainder of the visit
No loop, replay affordance or way back to the wall stage from the reading state
A fresh arrival restarts from the held reveal
locked_observable_requirements: Multiple rows of stills filling the whole viewport as one wall with no edge ever exposed
Sideways pointer or drag input drives all rows simultaneously with center rows leading and outer rows trailing
Contrast intensification scales continuously with pointer distance from center and eases back near center
All motion and tonal change are continuous and reversible, never stepped or snapped
The opening view is withheld until every picture is fully ready
Page scrolling is locked for the entire wall stage
Exactly one entry cue, legible against the imagery behind it, with no explanatory copy
Accepting the cue expands the middle image in place into the full-screen backdrop while the other stills fade away
The name surfaces over that backdrop and reading proceeds to a closing link set
Wall motion and the cue end permanently after handoff
adaptable_details: Number of rows, images per row and image aspect ratios
Exact speed ratio between center and outer tiers and the easing character
How aggressive the contrast crush becomes at the extremes
Wording, size and placement of the single cue
Duration of the expansion and of the fade-out of the remaining stills
Length, typography and layout of the reading text and closing links
Which specific middle image serves as the backdrop
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits sites whose opening asset is a set of visually strong, tonally compatible stills or frames that can stand as pure mood and where the following content is short and text-led, with a single onward step. It stays the same skill across subject matter, row counts and copy length. It becomes a different skill if the wall persists as a browsable gallery after entry, if scrolling rather than a discrete accepted cue drives the transition, if individual pictures become separately selectable items with their own detail views, or if the imagery is tonally mismatched and edge-bounded instead of uniformly toned and edgeless.

name: pinned_scroll_zoom_into_image_grid
description: A tiled picture grid fitted to the screen locks in place and magnifies smoothly under scroll, moving from whole-collection overview to individual images filling the view, then releases the page to continue to the text below.

canonical_document.name: pinned_scroll_zoom_into_image_grid
canonical_document.description: A tiled picture grid fitted to the screen locks in place and magnifies smoothly under scroll, moving from whole-collection overview to individual images filling the view, then releases the page to continue to the text below.
canonical_document.experience_scope: A whole-view region that begins when the tiled arrangement reaches screen centre and holds the viewport, and ends when the magnification completes and the page resumes normal scrolling into the following text section; it is one self-contained act placed before the reading material.
content_and_composition: A small bounded set of pictures arranged as tiles in a single composed grid, readable at a glance as one unit on arrival
The grid is sized to fit the screen so no picture is cut off or stranded at the initial state
One magnification field: the same grid remains the sole subject throughout, growing rather than being replaced
Individual images become the dominant compositional element at the far end of the progression, large enough for their detail to be readable
A short text/reading section positioned after the region, entered only once the progression finishes
The viewport itself acts as a persistent frame: the arrangement stays centred within it while the transformation plays
experience_progression: Arrival: the full set reads as one composed screen-fitted arrangement of tiles
Pin: once centred, the arrangement holds in place and further scrolling feeds the transformation instead of moving the page
Continuous enlargement: pictures grow steadily inward without discrete jumps, every intermediate stage legible as a coherent composition
Detail dominance: individual images fill the field of view and their detail becomes readable
Release: with the enlargement complete, continued scrolling unpins the region and hands attention to the text section
Reverse: scrolling upward re-enters the region, recloses the enlargement through the same stages and returns to the screen-fitted overview
attention_and_information_flow: Attention starts distributed across the whole set, taking in the arrangement as a group
Attention travels inward as scale increases, narrowing from group composition to single-image content
Information gained shifts from 'how many and how they relate' to 'what each picture actually shows', with detail becoming legible only at the deep end
Scroll distance itself communicates position in the progression, so the viewer always knows how far in they are
Prominence transfers off the pictures entirely at release, so the reading material becomes the next focus without competition

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Scroll offset maps exactly onto progression amount, so the viewer can advance at any pace; the mapping is the only driver, never autonomous playback
interaction_model.state_change: Magnification advances proportionally, from screen-fitted overview toward individual images dominating the view
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Tiles grow continuously and smoothly; the composition stays centred and legible at every intermediate scale; picture detail becomes progressively readable
interaction_model.input: Scrolling downward while the arrangement is pinned
interaction_model.affected_object: The tiled picture grid and its scale

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Fully reversible at any point; direction can be changed mid-progression without losing position
interaction_model.state_change: Progression rewinds through the identical stages back toward the fitted overview
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The same enlargement replays exactly in reverse, with no shortcut, snap-back or alternate return path
interaction_model.input: Scrolling upward within the pinned region
interaction_model.affected_object: The magnification state of the grid

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Resuming scroll in either direction continues from the held point
interaction_model.state_change: State holds at exactly the reached point with no drift or settling
interaction_model.visible_feedback: A stable, coherent in-between composition that remains held indefinitely and stays visually legible as its own arrangement
interaction_model.input: Pausing scroll anywhere mid-progression
interaction_model.affected_object: The current intermediate scale state

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Scrolling back up re-enters the region and recloses the enlargement rather than skipping it; the boundary is passable in both directions
interaction_model.state_change: The region unpins and the page resumes normal scrolling
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The picture region gives way and the reading section arrives as the new focus
interaction_model.input: Continued scrolling after the enlargement is complete
interaction_model.affected_object: Page flow and the following text section

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: The progression remains usable and reversible after resize, with no requirement to restart
interaction_model.state_change: The arrangement refits to the new screen dimensions while the current progression state is respected
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Tiles remain correctly fitted and aligned with nothing stranded, cropped unintentionally or misplaced
interaction_model.input: Resizing the viewport at any progression state
interaction_model.affected_object: Grid fit and alignment

experience_qualities: One unbroken continuous motion rather than a sequence of separate transitions
Precisely scrubbable: the viewer feels in direct control of the pace and can stop anywhere
Always legible: every intermediate state is a valid composition, never a smeared or half-broken layout
Deliberate and immersive on the way in, then cleanly releasing rather than trapping the viewer
A sense of travelling into the collection rather than clicking through it
completion_and_return: Completion is reaching full enlargement, after which the page releases to the following text section
No looping and no autoplay; the state is entirely a function of scroll position
Returning upward re-enters and recloses the region through the same reversible stages, ending at the original screen-fitted overview
State persists exactly while paused, including across a viewport resize
locked_observable_requirements: The set must read on arrival as one composed arrangement of tiles fitted to the screen
The arrangement pins in place while the transformation consumes further scroll
Enlargement is continuous and monotonic, with individual images ultimately dominating the field of view and their detail readable
Scroll distance maps exactly and reversibly onto progression amount, with no independent animation timing
Pausing holds the exact intermediate state indefinitely
The page only advances to the following reading section after the enlargement is complete, and re-entering from below recloses it
Viewport resizing leaves the arrangement correctly fitted and aligned at any progression state
adaptable_details: Number of tiles and grid shape, as long as the set stays small enough to read at a glance
Which tile or region the magnification travels toward
Total scroll distance allocated to the progression
Easing profile of the scale mapping, provided it stays continuous and reversible
Tile spacing, aspect ratios, corner and border treatment
Content of the following reading section
Whether secondary captions or labels accompany the pictures
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits any bounded set of image-like tiles whose value lies in both group composition and individual detail — photo sets, portfolio pieces, product shots, artwork, map or document thumbnails — placed as a leading or mid-page act ahead of supporting copy. It requires enough tiles to form a composed grid and imagery whose detail rewards magnification. Replacing the continuous scroll-mapped magnification with discrete slides, click-to-open lightboxes, autoplaying animation, or an arrangement that scrolls past without pinning produces a different Skill, as does removing the reversible one-to-one scroll mapping or letting the region be skipped without recreation of its stages.

name: particle_gathered_glyph_procession
description: A quiet, low-distraction view where one large form at a time condenses out of drifting self-lit specks, holds clearly for viewing, then spins apart as the next form swirls in, advanced one item per scroll or drag with a slim edge progress marker and a soft pointer-following tilt.

canonical_document.name: particle_gathered_glyph_procession
canonical_document.description: A quiet, low-distraction view where one large form at a time condenses out of drifting self-lit specks, holds clearly for viewing, then spins apart as the next form swirls in, advanced one item per scroll or drag with a slim edge progress marker and a soft pointer-following tilt.
canonical_document.experience_scope: Whole-view experience occupying the full viewport from an initial quiet waiting stage through the last item of the set; it begins with the pre-reveal waiting state and ends when the viewer holds at the final item, with no exit into a different layout implied.
content_and_composition: One focal subject form at a time, centered and dominant, readable as a single clear shape
A field of small self-lit specks surrounding and composing the focal form, drifting continuously as a haze
A quiet, uniform, low-distraction ground held at a clear luminance separation from the specks, unchanged across the whole experience
A slim progress marker pinned along one screen edge, persistent after the waiting stage
A waiting-stage pair: a slowly climbing numeric count and a softly glowing circular emblem, both centered and both replaced by the focal subject once the passage begins
The focal form and speck field behave as one coordinated arrangement that tilts and shifts together as a unit
experience_progression: Quiet, near-empty waiting stage on the calm ground: count climbs slowly, wheel emblem glows softly, ceremonial tone established
First subject gathers out of the drifting specks until its form reads clearly
Hold stage: the assembled form rests legibly, attention parked on it, specks still drifting
On each advance the current form spins apart and scatters while the next swirls inward and squares up to face the viewer
Progression repeats item by item through the ordered set, always one item resolved at a time
Arrival at the last item is made self-evident by the edge marker reaching its full extent, and further gestures simply hold there
attention_and_information_flow: Attention is first held by the climbing count and glowing emblem in an otherwise empty, unadorned field
Attention then transfers to the single assembling form, which becomes the only legible element on screen
Legibility itself carries the information rhythm: unreadable haze, then clearly readable form, then dispersal
The edge marker carries all set-level orientation, telling the viewer how far through the collection they are without competing with the focal form
Only one item is ever readable at a time, so no comparison between items is offered

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Direction is reversible with an opposite gesture; at the first and last item the view simply holds with no movement or bounce
interaction_model.state_change: Advances or retreats exactly one item in the ordered set, in the direction of the turn
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Departing form spins apart and scatters into specks while the arriving form swirls inward and squares up to face the viewer; the motion coasts to a settled stop rather than snapping
interaction_model.input: Wheel turn anywhere over the view
interaction_model.affected_object: Focal subject and its speck field

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: One step per gesture regardless of drag length; repeated or continued gestures do not overshoot past the ends
interaction_model.state_change: Same one-item step in either direction as the wheel gesture
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Identical scatter-out and swirl-in exchange, settling to rest
interaction_model.input: Vertical drag anywhere over the view
interaction_model.affected_object: Focal subject and its speck field

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Marker follows steps backward as well as forward and stays fixed while held at either end
interaction_model.state_change: Marker extent updates to the new position in the set
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Marker grows or shrinks in step with the exchange, reaching its full extent at the last item
interaction_model.input: Any advance or retreat step
interaction_model.affected_object: Edge progress marker

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Continuous and always reversible by moving the pointer; comes to rest on its own without needing input
interaction_model.state_change: Arrangement tilts and shifts toward the pointer position
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Soft lagging tilt and offset of the entire arrangement, settling wherever the pointer comes to rest
interaction_model.input: Pointer movement across the view
interaction_model.affected_object: The whole arrangement of focal form and speck field

experience_qualities: Weightless and unhurried throughout, never abrupt
Quiet, hushed and ceremonial with a faintly occult mood
Coasting, inertial motion rather than instant jumps
A sense of matter gathering and dispersing rather than items sliding past
Calm one-thing-at-a-time focus
completion_and_return: No loop: the set has a definite first and last item and holds at both ends
Reaching the last item is the completion signal, communicated by the fully extended edge marker
Backward gestures return through the same sequence with the same exchange motion
The pointer-driven tilt persists at whatever rest position the pointer left it, rather than snapping back
locked_observable_requirements: Exactly one subject form is legible at any moment; items are never shown side by side
Each subject visibly composes from and dissolves back into a drifting field of small self-lit specks
The exchange is a paired motion: departing form spins apart and scatters while the arriving form swirls inward and squares up facing the viewer
One item per discrete gesture, whether wheel or vertical drag, in either direction
Movement coasts to a settled stop instead of jumping or snapping
Hard hold at the first and last item with no wrap-around and no elastic bounce
A slim edge-mounted progress marker that grows and shrinks with position and makes the end of the set self-evident
Whole arrangement tilts and shifts after the pointer with a soft lag and settles at rest
A quiet, uniform, low-distraction ground against which the specks and form are the only self-lit, clearly higher-luminance elements
A quiet pre-reveal stage with a slowly climbing count and a softly glowing circular emblem before the first subject gathers
adaptable_details: Number of items in the set
Identity and cultural origin of the individual forms
Speck density, size, drift speed and the accent hue of their glow
Which screen edge carries the progress marker and its exact thickness
Numeric styling of the waiting-stage count and the shape of the glowing emblem
Exact tilt magnitude and lag duration of the pointer response
Whether any label or caption accompanies the focal form
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits ordered sets of simple, strongly separated single forms that stay recognizable when built out of loose specks and shown alone at large size, such as symbol sets, letterforms, icons, silhouettes or single-object product shots. Detailed photographic or multi-element compositions break the assemble-from-specks legibility. Showing several items at once, wrapping continuously through the set, free continuous scrubbing instead of one item per gesture, or a busy ground whose luminance sits close enough to the specks that they stop reading as self-lit would each produce a different Skill.

name: hover_composed_fullscreen_title_previews
description: Pointing at a title in a quiet, low-distraction list composes that item across the whole screen — pictures wiping open from different edges at their own positions, the item name scaling into place, a tonally unified still settling behind — while the opening identity and moving backdrop fade out and return when the pointer leaves the list.

canonical_document.name: hover_composed_fullscreen_title_previews
canonical_document.description: Pointing at a title in a quiet, low-distraction list composes that item across the whole screen — pictures wiping open from different edges at their own positions, the item name scaling into place, a tonally unified still settling behind — while the opening identity and moving backdrop fade out and return when the pointer leaves the list.
canonical_document.experience_scope: Whole-view experience anchored on a single landing view: it begins in the calm opening state (identity plus moving backdrop plus title list), expands to fill the entire viewport behind and around the list while a title is pointed at, and ends by returning to the same opening state. No separate destination is entered at any point.
content_and_composition: A persistent list of short text entries, one per item, always visible and always topmost with clear contrast against whatever sits behind it; it is the only affordance for entering the previews
An opening identity block: a name and a single line of positioning, present only in the calm state
A recessed, low-contrast backdrop layer in continuous slow motion, filling the view behind everything in the calm state
Per item, a small set of pictures (several, not one) placed at distinct fixed positions spread across the viewport rather than in a single centered frame
Per item, a still image held under a single unifying tonal wash that occupies the rear plane behind the pictures
Per item, a large name rendered as part of the composed preview, distinct from the small list entry that triggered it
Layer order from rear to front: tonally washed still, positioned pictures, composed item name, title list
Exactly one item composed at any moment; the calm opening layers and the preview layers are mutually exclusive occupants of the backdrop plane
experience_progression: Calm opening: identity and single positioning line over the slowly moving low-distraction backdrop, with the title list offered as the way in
Attention shift: pointing at a title causes the opening identity and moving backdrop to fade out as that item's preview composes

Composition of one item: pictures wipe open from different edges toward their own positions, the item name scales into place, and the tonally unified still settles behind — read as a single brief atmospheric glimpse
Lateral survey: moving along the list replaces the composed item with the next one, so the range of the whole set accumulates in the viewer's mind within seconds
Return: leaving the list wipes the preview closed and restores the opening exactly as it was
attention_and_information_flow: In the calm state prominence sits with the identity line, with the title list reading as the obvious next step
The moment a title is engaged, prominence transfers from the identity to the full-screen imagery while the list itself stays legible for continued movement
Each preview reveals only enough to characterize an item — a few pictures, a unifying tonal wash and a name — never a full detail presentation
Because previews replace rather than accumulate, attention stays on one item at a time while the sequence of glimpses communicates breadth
Returning to the calm state removes all item-specific information and re-elevates the opening identity

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: The reveal begins immediately on engagement and is fully reversible; withdrawing the pointer at any point during the reveal turns it into a close
interaction_model.state_change: View moves from the calm opening state into that item's composed preview state
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Pictures wipe open from different edges to their own positions on screen, the item name scales into place, a tonally unified still settles behind, and the identity line and moving backdrop fade out
interaction_model.input: Pointer comes to rest on a title in the list
interaction_model.affected_object: That item's picture set, tonally washed still and composed name, plus the opening identity and moving backdrop

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: The most recently engaged title always wins; rapid direction changes along the list resolve to the title currently under the pointer without residue
interaction_model.state_change: Active item is replaced; only one preview is ever present
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The outgoing composition clears as the incoming one wipes open in the same full-view space, reading as a clean swap with no stacking, overlap or leftover imagery
interaction_model.input: Pointer slides continuously along the list from one title to another
interaction_model.affected_object: The currently composed preview and the newly engaged item's preview

canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits small-to-medium curated sets whose items each own a short title and a few strong images, presented on a low-density landing or index view with a restrained, low-distraction aesthetic and pointer-based engagement. It survives changes of subject matter, item count, palette and luminance direction, and wipe styling. It becomes a different Skill if previews persist simultaneously as a grid or gallery, if engaging an entry navigates to a detail destination, if entry is driven by clicking or scrolling instead of pointer proximity, if the imagery collapses into one centered frame instead of separately positioned pictures, or if the opening identity does not recede and return.

name: ambient_fullview_image_stream_with_focus_reveal
description: A one-at-a-time full-view image stream you push through with weighted momentum while the surrounding light field takes its hue from whatever colours the current picture happens to contain, the image tilts and tears into fine drifting bands around your pointer, an edge gauge stretches to show how far along you are, and a click lifts the nearest picture to the front with its title while everything else drops to low salience.

canonical_document.name: ambient_fullview_image_stream_with_focus_reveal

At any moment one picture owns the whole view as the dominant subject; neighbouring pictures in the sequence exist as the continuation of the stream rather than as a visible grid

A localized pointer-anchored disturbance zone on the current picture's surface, existing only while the pointer is over the imagery
