canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits small curated sets of full-bleed visual pieces where each item carries only a short label and the intent is atmospheric, one-at-a-time viewing with a closer look on demand. Transfers to imagery-led portfolio, campaign, editorial or product-hero views of similar scale, and adopts the host site's own surround tones since the ambient hue is sampled from the imagery rather than fixed. It becomes a different Skill if several items must be visible and comparable at once, if items carry substantial text or multi-field detail that cannot be reduced to a single title, if the set is long or endlessly wrapping so firm ends and a proportional gauge stop being meaningful, or if traversal must snap to discrete positions rather than glide to rest.

name: scroll_paced_image_procession_with_mirrored_ceiling
description: Images travel up through a full-view stage held in a quiet, low-distraction surround in named groups, each one peaking at mid-view then tilting, shrinking, dimming and zooming inward as it leaves, while a mirrored strip along the top edge reflects the same moment in perfect step and the journey settles into empty calm with a closing line.

canonical_document.name: scroll_paced_image_procession_with_mirrored_ceiling
canonical_document.description: Images travel up through a full-view stage held in a quiet, low-distraction surround in named groups, each one peaking at mid-view then tilting, shrinking, dimming and zooming inward as it leaves, while a mirrored strip along the top edge reflects the same moment in perfect step and the journey settles into empty calm with a closing line.
canonical_document.experience_scope: Whole-view experience covering the entire page: it begins with a single fully composed first screen once all imagery is ready, continues for the full length of the collection, and ends in a quiet empty closing region. It is not a widget dropped into an existing page; the scroll surface, stage and top strip form one continuous view.
content_and_composition: One full-viewport stage with a uniform, low-distraction surround that all content passes through, clearly separated in tone from the imagery and present for the whole experience
An ordered sequence of named clusters (groups of related images), each introduced by its own group label
Many individual images, one dominant at a time, moving through the stage along a single downward reading path
A mid-view focus zone where each image reaches its largest, clearest, most upright and highest-luminance state
A persistent mirrored strip along the top edge of the view that reflects whatever content currently occupies the stage, reading as a reflective ceiling above the procession
A terminal empty region with a single short closing note and no imagery
experience_progression: Entry: nothing partial is shown; the first view arrives already complete and composed
Descent begins: the first cluster label and its images rise into the stage
Per-image arc, repeated: image approaches from below, becomes upright/large/fully luminous at mid-view, then tilts, shrinks, dims and zooms inward as it continues past and fades out
Cluster-to-cluster advance: labelled groups succeed one another as one uninterrupted downward run, with no page breaks or mode changes
Close: imagery thins out into open, calm empty space holding only a brief closing note
Reverse: scrolling upward replays every stage backwards in the same order
attention_and_information_flow: Prominence is positional: whatever occupies mid-view is the single loudest element, and everything above or below it is visually receding
Departure is signalled by combined tilt, reduction in size, loss of luminance and inward zoom, so the eye is released rather than competing with the next arrival
Cluster labels give the collection its only structural information, orienting the viewer to which group they are in without pulling attention from the current image
The mirrored top strip doubles the current subject as ambience and enclosure, never as a separate thing to read
The empty closing region intentionally drops visual density to zero so the short note is the only remaining focus

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: A new gesture in either direction takes over the glide immediately; direction can be reversed at any moment; the settle always comes to rest, never overshoots into a broken position
interaction_model.state_change: Scroll position advances with weight and momentum rather than tracking the input one-to-one
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Content glides in the gesture's direction and keeps easing briefly after the input stops, settling smoothly instead of snapping
interaction_model.input: Wheel or touch scroll gesture
interaction_model.affected_object: The whole stage and the procession of content within it

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Stopping mid-travel holds the image frozen partway through its change; scrolling back up runs the same change exactly backwards to its earlier appearance, with no drift or snap to a nearest state
interaction_model.state_change: Tilt, scale, luminance and inner zoom advance in fixed proportion to the travelled distance
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The image visibly moves through its arc: upright, large and fully luminous at mid-view, then progressively tilted, smaller, dimmer and zoomed inward as it exits, fading out at the end
interaction_model.input: How far an individual image has travelled across the view (driven by scroll position, not elapsed time)
interaction_model.affected_object: That image's presentation

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Sync is unconditional in both scroll directions and at any speed; the strip never falls behind and never needs to catch up
interaction_model.state_change: The reflection updates to the current stage content in lockstep
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The strip always shows exactly the same moment as the content below it, with no lag, smearing or divergence during fast scrolling or during the post-gesture glide
interaction_model.input: Any change of scroll position
interaction_model.affected_object: The mirrored strip along the top edge

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Boundaries are hard but soft-edged: the glide eases to a stop rather than bouncing, and scrolling the other way immediately resumes the journey from that point
interaction_model.state_change: Advance stops at the top of the first view and at the closing empty region
interaction_model.visible_feedback: At the end the view rests in open empty space with the short closing note and nothing further arrives; at the start the first composed view is held
interaction_model.input: Reaching either end of the collection
interaction_model.affected_object: The journey as a whole

experience_qualities: Atmospheric and cinematic, with a low-distraction surround that keeps the imagery dominant
Weighted and gliding rather than immediate or snappy
Continuous and uninterrupted, one journey rather than a series of screens
Polished and enclosed, as if the space has a reflective ceiling
Fully scrubbable: every visual change is directly and reversibly tied to scroll position
Complete from the first frame, never half-formed
Calm and resolved at the end
completion_and_return: The experience completes in a deliberately quiet, empty region with a brief closing note; it does not loop back to the start
The end state persists as long as the viewer stays there
Scrolling upward is a full return path: the entire journey replays in reverse with identical per-image states
No stage is skipped or fast-forwarded on return
locked_observable_requirements: Every per-image visual change is bound to travelled distance across the view, so a halted scroll leaves the image visibly mid-change and reversed scroll runs it exactly backwards
Scroll carries weight and continues easing briefly after input stops, never snapping to positions
Scrolling is the only input required to experience the whole collection
Each image reaches a clear peak of prominence and luminance around mid-view before tilting, shrinking, dimming, zooming inward and fading away
A mirrored strip on the top edge reflects the current content with no perceptible lag or drift at any scroll speed
The collection reads as one continuous downward run through named clusters, not as discrete slides or pages
The first view appears only once fully composed, never partially populated
The journey ends in open empty space carrying a short closing note
adaptable_details: Number of clusters, their names, and how many images each holds
Image aspect ratios and orientation mix
Exact magnitudes of tilt, shrink, dimming and inner zoom, and the length of the travel over which they resolve
Amount of momentum and how long the glide keeps easing
Height, softness and intensity of the mirrored strip
Palette and typography, in any register whose surround stays low-distraction and holds readable contrast and clear separation from the imagery
Wording of cluster labels and of the closing note
How much empty space precedes the closing note
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits any ordered set of large single-subject visuals that benefits from being read one at a time in grouped succession, with sparse supporting copy and a restrained, low-distraction atmospheric surround in any tonal register. It requires a scroll surface tall enough for each item to fully traverse the view and a stage region directly beneath the top edge for the reflection to remain believable. Replacing scroll with clicks or discrete slide advance, driving the transformations by time instead of travelled distance, making them non-reversible, showing many items at equal prominence in a grid, or removing the mirrored top edge and the calm closing region would each produce a different skill.

name: liquid_droplet_dissolve_photo_viewer
description: One photo fills the view; advancing melts it into soft rising droplets that thin out while the next photo seeps through the gaps and settles whole, scrubbed directly by wheel or drag and looping endlessly.

canonical_document.name: liquid_droplet_dissolve_photo_viewer
canonical_document.description: One photo fills the view; advancing melts it into soft rising droplets that thin out while the next photo seeps through the gaps and settles whole, scrubbed directly by wheel or drag and looping endlessly.
canonical_document.experience_scope: A whole-view (viewport-filling) single-image stage that begins on arrival with the first photo fully settled and never ends: the sequence wraps in both directions. The experience owns the full surface as the primary content region, including its own gesture surface and step controls.
content_and_composition: One full-bleed photograph occupying the entire view at rest, presented clean and still with no decorative chrome competing with it
An ordered set of a few photographs (small count, roughly 3–8) forming a closed ring with no first or last
A persistent quiet hint that more photos follow, low in prominence and never obscuring the image
A pair of step controls for previous and next, persistent and unobtrusive over the image
During transition, two image layers coexist: the outgoing photo fragmented into droplet forms, and the incoming photo revealed through the widening gaps between them
The entire surface doubles as the gesture area; no separate track or scrollbar element
experience_progression: Rest state: current photo whole, still and clean
Onset: the current photo's surface coheres into soft liquid droplets that begin to detach
Middle: droplets rise and thin, gaps widen, and the next photo becomes visible seeping through those gaps
Settle: droplets dissipate entirely and the incoming photo resolves to a whole, still full-view image, becoming the new rest state
The progression is a single continuous scrubbable amount from 0 to 1 rather than a set of discrete jumps, and it can rest at any point in between
After settling, the same progression is available again in either direction indefinitely, wrapping past the ends of the set
attention_and_information_flow: At rest, attention belongs wholly to one photograph; supporting elements stay quiet
At onset, attention moves to the breaking surface itself, so the change is the event rather than an interruption of it
Mid-transition, attention is split legibly between the departing droplets and the emerging photo, so both are readable as pictures rather than as noise
As the transition completes, attention consolidates back onto a single whole image
The hint of further photos conveys continuation without ever competing with the current image
Any held mid-transition state must still read as an intentional in-between composition, never as a broken or glitched frame

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Stopping the wheel holds the visual at that exact mid-melt state with no glide or easing afterwards; continuing in the same direction completes the settle; reversing direction flows the droplets back down and re-coheres the photo just left
interaction_model.state_change: Transition progress advances or retreats in direct proportion to the accumulated wheel movement
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Droplets form, rise and thin, and the incoming photo shows through the gaps by exactly the amount corresponding to the gesture so far
interaction_model.input: Wheel movement over the surface
interaction_model.affected_object: The current-to-next photo transition amount

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Releasing mid-drag holds the current mid-melt state rather than snapping or coasting; dragging back returns to the previous whole photo; direction of drag selects which neighbour is being revealed
interaction_model.state_change: Transition progress tracks the drag distance one-to-one in the corresponding direction
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The break-up follows the finger or pointer continuously, so the visitor feels they are pulling the picture apart and letting the next one through
interaction_model.input: Drag across the surface
interaction_model.affected_object: The current-to-next photo transition amount

interaction_model.state_change: An unaided move carries the transition to the neighbouring photo on its own
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The same droplet dissolve plays through automatically to a fully settled neighbouring photo
interaction_model.input: Previous or next step control
interaction_model.affected_object: The photo sequence position

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: There is no reachable boundary in either direction; the visitor cannot become stuck at an end
interaction_model.state_change: The sequence wraps continuously to the opposite end
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The dissolve into the wrapped-to photo looks identical to any other transition, with no stop, bounce or edge signal
interaction_model.input: Reaching either end of the photo set in any direction
interaction_model.affected_object: The photo sequence position

experience_qualities: Liquid and organic rather than mechanical: no cut, no slide, no wipe
Soft and buoyant, with droplets rising and thinning rather than falling apart
Directly physical: the visual position belongs to the gesture, with no inertia or glide claiming it back
Calm and spacious at rest, with the photograph unencumbered
Every intermediate frame legible as a composed in-between rather than an artifact
Endless and unbounded, with no dead end in either direction
completion_and_return: A completed transition resolves to a whole, still photo that is indistinguishable in quality from the arrival state
An incomplete gesture leaves a stable held mid-melt state that persists until further input, with no auto-resolve
Reversing a partial transition returns fully to the photo just left, with no residue of the abandoned move
An interrupted unaided move resets to the nearest whole photo rather than to an arbitrary partial state
The sequence loops indefinitely in both directions with no terminal photo
locked_observable_requirements: One photo fills the whole view at rest, clean and still
Transitions read as a liquid break-up into droplets that rise and thin, never as a cut, slide or hard wipe
The incoming photo is revealed by seeping through the gaps between droplets, not by sliding in or fading over
Wheel and drag scrub the transition in direct proportion to the gesture, with no post-gesture glide or momentum
Stopping mid-gesture holds a legible half-finished state indefinitely
Reversing the gesture returns to the photo just left

Both directions wrap endlessly with no reachable end
A persistent quiet indication that more photos follow
adaptable_details: Exact number of photos in the ring
Droplet size, count, shape softness, rise distance and thinning profile
Duration and pacing of an unaided step move
Visual style and placement of the step controls and the continuation hint

canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits small ordered sets of visually strong full-bleed imagery meant to be viewed one at a time as the main content of a view — photography sets, artwork, hero visuals, product shots. It does not fit dense multi-item grids, text-heavy panels, scrolling article content, or any case where several items must be compared at once, since the effect requires exactly two image layers with the outgoing one fully consumed. Replacing the liquid droplet break-up with another transition character, allowing momentum or auto-resolve after a gesture, introducing hard ends to the sequence, or removing the ability to hold and reverse mid-transition would each create a different Skill.

name: scroll_wiped_coarse_to_clear_image_descent
description: A long, quiet downward descent where each large image wipes in from its left edge while resolving out of a blocky coarse under-state built from the image's own broad tones, holds sharp while in view, shows its caption only after it fully resolves, and unwinds to blank when pushed back out.

canonical_document.name: scroll_wiped_coarse_to_clear_image_descent
canonical_document.description: A long, quiet downward descent where each large image wipes in from its left edge while resolving out of a blocky coarse under-state built from the image's own broad tones, holds sharp while in view, shows its caption only after it fully resolves, and unwinds to blank when pushed back out.
canonical_document.experience_scope: Whole-view experience for a single continuous vertical page: begins on an opening screen dominated by a large title, continues through the sequence of full-width image slots as they pass through the viewport, and ends in a sparse closing area after the final image.
content_and_composition: Opening area: one oversized title occupying most of the first view, with no competing imagery.
Body: a vertical sequence of large image slots, spaced so only one or two are meaningfully in view at once.
Each slot holds one image plus a small caption pair (primary label and a short secondary datum such as a year) placed adjacent to the image and subordinate to it.
Each image occupies its slot's fixed footprint at all times, so its coarse under-state, partially wiped state and resolved state all share the same frame and page position with no layout shift.
Closing area: a quiet, mostly empty ending block that terminates the descent.
Persistent elements: generous negative space and consistent slot rhythm; no persistent overlay chrome competes with the current image.
experience_progression: Stage 1 — opening: large title alone establishes an unhurried, exhibition-like tone.
Stage 2 — entry: a slot crosses into view and its image begins wiping in from its left edge, revealed area shown as a coarse under-state made of large blocks carrying the image's own broad tones.
Stage 3 — resolution: the wipe advances across the frame while the revealed material hardens from coarse blocks toward full clarity.
Stage 4 — settled hold: the image stands fully resolved and stable for as long as any part of the slot remains in view.
Stage 5 — caption registration: only after full resolution do the label and secondary datum become readable.
Stage 6 — rewind: scrolling the slot back out of view unwinds it toward its blank starting state, leaving it ready to play again.
Stage 7 — closing: after the last slot resolves, the descent ends in the quiet closing area.
The identical per-slot cycle repeats for every image, so the rhythm becomes predictable after the first few.
attention_and_information_flow: Attention starts fully on the opening title, with nothing else legible.
Sparse spacing keeps at most one or two images competing, so the currently resolving image is the clear focus.
The left-to-right wipe gives a consistent direction of attention within each image.
Information arrives in a fixed order: coarse shape and broad tone first, then clarity, then text; captions never precede a readable image.
A rewinding image loses prominence as it degrades back toward blank, handing focus to the next incoming slot.
The closing area deliberately withdraws attention, signaling the end rather than offering new content.

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Reveal is bounded at fully resolved and holds there without further change while any part of the slot stays in view
interaction_model.state_change: Slot moves from blank/idle toward fully resolved
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Reveal edge advances from the image's left side; revealed area appears as coarse blocks carrying the image's own broad tones that sharpen into the finished picture; caption becomes readable only at full resolution
interaction_model.input: Downward scroll bringing any part of an image slot into the viewport
interaction_model.affected_object: That slot's image and its caption pair

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Returns to a clean replayable start, so re-entering the viewport plays the reveal again from the beginning
interaction_model.state_change: Resolved state unwinds back toward the blank starting state
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Image retreats toward its coarse state and empty frame, caption stops registering; frame footprint stays in place
interaction_model.input: Scrolling so the slot leaves the viewport entirely
interaction_model.affected_object: That slot's image and caption

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Any number of interruptions is tolerated; each retargets continuously and the slot still settles at a valid end state (fully resolved in view, blank out of view)
interaction_model.state_change: Target flips between resolving and unwinding from the current partial position
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Reveal continues smoothly from wherever it currently stands, with no jump, snap or restart
interaction_model.input: Reversing or changing scroll direction while a reveal is partway through
interaction_model.affected_object: The in-progress reveal of the current slot

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Scroll position and per-slot progress are preserved across the refit
interaction_model.state_change: Slots refit to the new dimensions while keeping their current reveal and resolution progress
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Images resize in place at their existing state; no reveal restarts, flashes or resets
interaction_model.input: Window resize
interaction_model.affected_object: Every image slot, including partially revealed ones

experience_qualities: Unhurried and exhibition-like rather than energetic
Subdued and sparse, with one subject at a time
Tactile, developing-into-being quality rather than fade-in
Predictable, rhythmic repetition after the first few items
Continuous and never jumpy, even under fast or reversed scrolling
Quiet, resolved ending
completion_and_return: Each slot completes at fully resolved and holds indefinitely while in view.
Leaving the viewport resets a slot to blank, making the whole sequence replayable in either scroll direction.
Progress is per-slot and derived from position, so returning to a previously seen slot replays its reveal rather than showing it pre-resolved.
The overall descent completes in the quiet closing area with no further reveals.
locked_observable_requirements: Downward page movement is the only driver of reveals; no clicks, hovers or autoplay.
Reveal begins as soon as any part of a slot crosses into view.
The reveal wipes directionally from the image's left edge.
Revealed material first appears as a coarse block under-state whose blocks carry the image's own broad tones, and then hardens into clarity in the same frame.
Fully resolved images hold stable while in view.
Caption text registers only after the image is fully resolved.
Pushing a slot out of view unwinds it to its blank starting state so it can play again.
Interrupting a reveal partway retargets smoothly from the current position with no jump or restart.
Resizing refits every image in place without restarting or resetting reveals.
Layout keeps only one or two images claiming attention at a time, opens on a large title and ends in a quiet closing area.
adaptable_details: Number of images in the sequence
Image subject matter and aspect ratios
Coarseness granularity of the under-state and how its block tones are derived from the image
Reveal duration and easing feel, as long as it stays unhurried and continuous
Caption typography, placement side and which short secondary datum is shown
Slot spacing and the low-distraction page surround treatment, in either a light or dark register
Content of the opening title view and closing area
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits sparse, image-forward vertical pages with a small-to-moderate set of large visuals and short labels, where each item deserves solitary attention. Content type matters only in that each item must be a single large image plus a brief caption. Changing the driver to hover, click or autoplay, packing images into a dense grid or carousel, revealing many items simultaneously, letting captions appear before resolution, or removing the coarse tonal under-state in favor of a plain fade or slide would each create a different skill.

name: assembling_endless_arc_gallery
description: Framed pictures rush in from all screen edges, huddle into a loose central pile, then fan out into one long, gently curving row; dragging sideways swings the whole arc with the pointer and it always settles with a single picture centered, with no beginning or end to the row.

canonical_document.name: assembling_endless_arc_gallery
canonical_document.description: Framed pictures rush in from all screen edges, huddle into a loose central pile, then fan out into one long, gently curving row; dragging sideways swings the whole arc with the pointer and it always settles with a single picture centered, with no beginning or end to the row.
canonical_document.experience_scope: A single full-width region that occupies the primary viewing area; the experience begins automatically as the view loads with the inward burst and never truly ends — after the arc forms it remains a continuously draggable browsing surface with no terminal state.
content_and_composition: One ordered set of pictures, many enough that the row extends well beyond the viewport on both sides

Each picture sits inside a thick, heavy frame treatment; every picture is rendered with the same restrained, low-variation treatment so the frames and composition read as the dominant graphic layer rather than any individual item's palette
Items are laid out along one long, gently curving horizontal path rather than a straight line, so the row reads as an arc receding toward both edges
Exactly one item occupies the middle resting slot at any settled moment and holds visual primacy
Neighbouring items trail off toward the left and right edges and are deliberately allowed to run past the viewport boundary, so the set is visibly cut off rather than fully contained
The arc itself is the persistent element; no per-item chrome, captions or controls are required for the experience to read
experience_progression: Stage 1 — arrival: pictures burst inward from the outer edges of the view from multiple directions
Stage 2 — gathering: incoming pictures converge into a loose, overlapping central pile that reads as an unsorted stack
Stage 3 — unfurling: the pile spreads apart along the curving path until the items resolve into one continuous row with a single picture centered
Stage 4 — open browsing: the arc becomes user-driven and loops indefinitely, with no further scripted stages
attention_and_information_flow: During arrival attention is pulled from the periphery inward toward the center point where the pile forms
The unfurling hands attention from the mass to a single item: the center picture becomes the focal subject
Off-center items act as information about extent — their run-off toward both edges communicates that more of the collection exists in both directions
While dragging, prominence continuously transfers from item to item as they pass through the middle position
On settling, prominence resolves onto exactly one item again, re-establishing a clear single subject

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: The sequence runs to completion on its own and ends in the browsable resting state; user input during or after it takes over the arc rather than restarting the sequence
interaction_model.state_change: From absent, to converged central pile, to fanned-out curving row resting on one centered item
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Pictures fly in from the edges, collect into a loose pile, then spread apart into the arc and come to rest
interaction_model.input: View load, no user input
interaction_model.affected_object: The whole picture set

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Dragging never meets an end stop or edge resistance in either direction; the row can be pulled indefinitely
interaction_model.state_change: The whole arc shifts along its path, tracking the pointer's sideways movement
interaction_model.visible_feedback: All pictures swing together in the drag direction, staying locked to the pointer so movement feels direct; items continuously enter and leave the middle position
interaction_model.input: Press anywhere on a frame and pull sideways in either direction
interaction_model.affected_object: The entire row as one body, not the individually grabbed picture

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: The settle can be interrupted at any moment by a new press, which reclaims control of the arc from its current position
interaction_model.state_change: The row eases back to the same centered picture it started from
interaction_model.visible_feedback: A soft return glide that settles the original picture back into the middle
interaction_model.input: Release after a short or gentle pull
interaction_model.affected_object: The arc's resting alignment

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: A fresh grab mid-settle takes over immediately without a jump; the row is never left stranded between resting positions
interaction_model.state_change: The row carries past the starting item and settles with a further picture centered
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Continued travel after release that decays into a clean stop with a new picture in the middle
interaction_model.input: Release after a firmer or faster pull
interaction_model.affected_object: The arc's resting alignment

experience_qualities: Theatrical opening that turns loading into a short performance
Physical, hand-driven feel: the row follows the pointer directly rather than stepping
Unforced and endless — no walls, no first or last item
Decisive resolution: every gesture lands on one clearly centered subject
Graphic and gallery-like, with heavy frames and uniformly treated imagery giving a curated exhibition tone
Depth and sweep from the curving path, so the collection feels larger than the screen
completion_and_return: The arrival choreography completes once and hands off to the browsing state
The row loops without end, so continued dragging in one direction eventually returns to the picture where browsing began
Every release resolves to a stable state with one item centered; there is no half-settled resting state
The centered item persists as the current focus until the next gesture
locked_observable_requirements: An inward burst from the view edges that gathers into a loose central pile before the row exists
A visible transition from that pile into one continuous, gently curving horizontal row
A single middle position that carries primacy, with neighbours running off past both edges to signal more content
Press-and-pull sideways moves the entire row as one body, tracking the pointer in either direction
Release always resolves to a centered resting item: gentle pull returns to the origin item, firmer pull advances to a further one
No travel limit in either direction and no reachable end of the sequence
A new grab during a settle takes over smoothly from the current position
adaptable_details: Number of items in the set, provided the row exceeds the viewport on both sides
Exact curvature, spacing and depth of the arc
Timing, easing and directional spread of the entrance burst
Frame thickness, proportion and material feel
Settle stiffness and how far a firm pull carries
Whether captions or supporting text accompany the centered item
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits any ordered set of visually strong, similarly-shaped items worth showing one at a time — photographs, artwork, covers, product shots, case thumbnails, profile portraits. It needs enough items for the row to overflow the viewport in both directions and content that reads at a glance without labels. Replacing the single centered focus with several equally weighted visible items, bounding the sequence with a real first and last item, or driving the row by autonomous scrolling or step buttons instead of a direct pointer drag would each produce a different Skill.

name: scrub_folded_image_metamorphosis_sequence
description: A slow, dreamlike full-view run in which each image collapses into itself and re-emerges as the next picture while its short phrase becomes legible letter by letter, every stage tied directly to scroll position so it holds, advances or unwinds with the reader.

canonical_document.name: scrub_folded_image_metamorphosis_sequence
canonical_document.description: A slow, dreamlike full-view run in which each image collapses into itself and re-emerges as the next picture while its short phrase becomes legible letter by letter, every stage tied directly to scroll position so it holds, advances or unwinds with the reader.
canonical_document.experience_scope: Whole-view experience spanning the entire page: it begins with a single quiet title view carrying a cue to advance, continues through a run of one-at-a-time full-attention visuals, and ends in a settled closing view after the final phrase.
content_and_composition: Opening view: one short title plus a low-emphasis cue inviting slow advance; nothing else competes for attention
Sequence body: an ordered set of large visuals, each occupying the view alone with no neighbouring item visible at the same time
One short phrase paired with each visual, positioned so it reads as part of that visual's moment rather than as separate caption furniture
Each visual owns its own stretch of page travel, so travel length is the spatial container for that visual's transformation
One designated oversized visual that fills the view and is held in place while its transformation plays across extra travel
Closing view: quiet, settled end state with no further transformation pending

Surround held at low visual salience with no competing accents of its own, so the visuals and single lines are the only prominent elements, while each phrase keeps readable contrast against whatever it sits on
experience_progression: Hushed title view with a cue to move slowly
First visual arrives alone and takes full attention
For each visual: the picture folds in on itself, re-emerges as a different picture, and its phrase resolves into legibility just as the image settles
Handoff to the next visual reads as continuation of one transformation rather than a slide change
At the oversized visual the view locks and the transformation plays out over a longer stretch of travel before releasing
After the last phrase the run eases into a quiet settled close
attention_and_information_flow: Attention is single-focus throughout: exactly one visual is legible and dominant at any moment
Text becomes readable late, timed to the image settling, so the picture leads and the phrase confirms
Legibility of the phrase increases progressively as characters appear, so partial travel yields partial information
The pinned oversized visual raises prominence by removing all page movement around it, making it the peak of the run
The opening cue is the only prominent instruction and recedes once the sequence begins
The closing view lowers stimulus deliberately, signalling there is nothing further to uncover

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Stopping holds the transformation exactly at the reached point with no drift or auto-completion; the reader resumes from that same point
interaction_model.state_change: Transformation progress advances proportionally: the fold-in, re-emergence as a different picture, and letter-by-letter phrase appearance move together in lockstep with position
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The picture visibly folds and resolves into a different picture while characters of the phrase appear one after another until it is fully legible as the image settles
interaction_model.input: Reader advances forward through a visual's own stretch of page travel
interaction_model.affected_object: The active visual and its paired phrase

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Fully reversible at any point and repeatable without a distinct rewind state; no stage is skipped or replayed differently
interaction_model.state_change: Progress decreases along the identical path
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The fold and the phrase unwind exactly in reverse, characters withdrawing and the earlier picture returning
interaction_model.input: Reader retreats back up through the same stretch
interaction_model.affected_object: The active visual and its paired phrase

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Retreating during the locked stretch reverses the transformation and returns to the entry boundary; the lock releases cleanly at both boundaries without jumping
interaction_model.state_change: The view locks with the visual filling it while transformation continues to consume additional travel, then releases
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The page appears to stop moving while the visual alone keeps changing, then the page resumes advancing past it
interaction_model.input: Reader reaches the oversized visual and keeps advancing
interaction_model.affected_object: The oversized visual and the surrounding view

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Always subordinate to the travel-driven transformation and self-recovering: it settles back to neutral on its own and never blocks or alters sequence progress
interaction_model.state_change: The visual leans toward the pointer position as a secondary offset layered on top of travel-driven progress
interaction_model.visible_feedback: A gentle tilt or lean toward the cursor that eases back to rest when the pointer stops or leaves, never snapping
interaction_model.input: Pointer movement across the view
interaction_model.affected_object: The currently visible visual

experience_qualities: Hushed and low-stimulus, with the surround receding behind the visuals
Continuous and dreamlike rather than segmented
Slow, deliberate pacing under the reader's control
Precise and predictable: position always maps to the same visual state
Weighted and unhurried motion with no snapping or abrupt cuts
completion_and_return: Completion is a settled quiet closing view reached after the final phrase resolves
No looping: the sequence has a defined beginning and end
Returning upward restores every earlier state exactly, including partially formed phrases
Arriving at any position shows the visual state that position implies, with no separate replay
Pointer-driven lean always returns to neutral rest
locked_observable_requirements: Every transformation stage is bound to travel position, holds when the reader stops, and unwinds exactly in reverse
Each visual appears alone with the full view to itself
Each visual folds in on itself and re-emerges as a visibly different picture
The paired phrase becomes legible character by character, timed to complete as the image settles
Transitions read as one continuous run, not discrete slides
One oversized visual holds the view in place while its transformation plays out over extra travel, then releases
Pointer movement adds a soft lean toward the cursor that drifts back smoothly and never snaps
A quiet single-title opening with an advance cue and a settled quiet close bracket the run
adaptable_details: Number of visuals in the run and the travel length assigned to each
Which visual is the oversized held one and how much extra travel it consumes
Exact fold geometry and direction of the collapse and re-emergence
Phrase length, typography, and placement relative to the visual
Colour treatment of the surround and text and the overall atmospheric register, in any light or dark direction, provided the surround stays low-salience and phrase text stays readable
Magnitude of the pointer lean and its settling speed
Wording and styling of the opening advance cue and the content of the closing view
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits curated sets of a small number of strong full-view visuals each paired with one short line, where slow single-focus pacing is desirable. It does not fit dense text, tabular or comparison content, or long lists needing scanning. Replacing position-bound scrubbing with autoplaying timed transitions, showing several visuals at once, or dropping the fold-and-re-emerge metamorphosis in favour of plain cross-transitions would create a different Skill.

name: movement_released_fleeting_photo_trail
description: A near-empty, low-distraction stage with a short label where each sweep of the pointer or finger releases the next photo from a small set; it springs from just behind the touch point, chases it, then shrinks and vanishes, so fast movement leaves a dense trail and stillness empties the stage again.

canonical_document.name: movement_released_fleeting_photo_trail
canonical_document.description: A near-empty, low-distraction stage with a short label where each sweep of the pointer or finger releases the next photo from a small set; it springs from just behind the touch point, chases it, then shrinks and vanishes, so fast movement leaves a dense trail and stillness empties the stage again.
canonical_document.experience_scope: A whole-view stage experience that begins on arrival after a brief hold while imagery is prepared, occupies the full visible surface as the interaction area, and ends whenever movement stops and the last photo fades; it can also be scoped to a single large region acting as its own stage.
content_and_composition: One uniform, essentially empty low-distraction background field acting as the stage and the resting state of the view
One short persistent text label as the only fixed foreground element, small and quiet relative to the imagery yet held at readable contrast against the field
A small finite ordered set of photographs, cycled through repeatedly rather than shown all at once
Only a few photos coexist at any moment, each positioned near the point of contact
Overlapping layer order in which the newest photo is drawn above older ones, so recency reads as depth
No frames, captions, grid, list or fixed arrangement for the photos
experience_progression: Arrival: quiet, near-empty stage with only the short label, imagery withheld during a brief wait
First movement: the first photo is released and the stage becomes active
Continued movement: successive photos are released each time enough distance has been covered, building a trail whose density follows movement speed
Each individual photo advances through its own short life: emerge behind the contact point, chase toward it, shrink, vanish
Stillness: no new releases, remaining photos finish their lives and the stage settles back to emptiness
Renewed movement resumes the cycle from wherever the set left off, with no start over and nothing to finish
attention_and_information_flow: Attention starts on the sparse label and the emptiness, establishing quiet before any imagery
Attention transfers to the moving point of contact once photos begin appearing, since that is where new content is born
The newest photo is the most prominent because it is largest, freshest and drawn on top; older photos recede as they shrink and fade
Photo content is revealed in glimpses rather than for study, so the set is perceived as a mood or collection instead of individual items
Speed of movement modulates visual density, so the visitor's own gesture controls how much is revealed at once

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: No release occurs before the distance threshold is met, keeping slow movement sparse; the visitor can stop at any time and nothing is pending or incomplete
interaction_model.state_change: A photo is released once a threshold of covered distance has passed since the previous release; slow drift releases rarely, fast sweeps release often
interaction_model.visible_feedback: A photo appears slightly behind the current point of contact and immediately begins moving toward it, layered above any earlier photos
interaction_model.input: Moving the pointer across the stage or dragging a finger over it
interaction_model.affected_object: The next photo in the small ordered set

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Older photos retire on their own so the trail cannot grow without bound; slowing down thins the trail immediately
interaction_model.state_change: New photos accumulate while older ones are already shrinking, so only a few overlap at once
interaction_model.visible_feedback: A dense visible trail of overlapping images along the path of movement, most salient and largest at the leading edge
interaction_model.input: Continuing to move while photos are already present
interaction_model.affected_object: The trail of coexisting photos

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Self-dismissing, so nothing needs closing or clearing; no dismissal control is presented
interaction_model.state_change: Photo chases the point of contact, then shrinks and disappears with no user action
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Trailing motion toward the contact point followed by a shrink-away exit
interaction_model.input: Autonomous lifetime of each released photo
interaction_model.affected_object: An individual photo

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Resuming movement restarts releases seamlessly from the current position in the set
interaction_model.state_change: Releases stop and remaining photos complete their exits
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The stage empties itself back to the quiet uniform field with only the short label
interaction_model.input: Pausing movement
interaction_model.affected_object: The whole stage

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Reuse never produces stuck or duplicated imagery
interaction_model.state_change: Its life restarts cleanly from the beginning instead of overlapping with its previous state
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The photo reappears fresh at full size near the new contact point with no doubled or glitched remnant
interaction_model.input: Movement that reaches a photo already visible on screen
interaction_model.affected_object: That already-visible photo

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Interaction continues normally after resize without a broken or frozen trail
interaction_model.state_change: The stage adapts to the new dimensions and in-flight imagery is resolved
interaction_model.visible_feedback: No stranded or orphaned photos remain outside or inside the resized stage
interaction_model.input: Resizing the view
interaction_model.affected_object: All in-flight photos and the stage bounds

experience_qualities: Quiet, almost empty arrival that feels like an unoccupied stage
Playful and discoverable, rewarding movement rather than reading
Fleeting and ephemeral: nothing persists, nothing is collected
Gesture-responsive density, so the visitor feels directly in control of how much appears
Sparse and uncluttered at rest, never presenting a fixed arrangement to survey
Low-stakes and forgiving, with nothing to complete and nothing lost by leaving
completion_and_return: There is no completion state or end condition; the experience is open-ended
Stillness resolves the stage back to its empty resting state on its own
The photo set loops continuously, so exploration can continue indefinitely
Returning after a pause resumes without penalty, reset prompt or lost progress
No persistent record of which photos were seen is presented to the visitor
locked_observable_requirements: Near-empty, low-distraction resting stage whose field is uniform enough that only a short readable text label is visible before any interaction
Imagery withheld behind a brief initial wait so arrival is empty rather than populated
Photos are released by pointer or touch movement, not by clicks, hovers over targets, or automatic playback
Release is gated by distance covered since the last release, so slow movement stays sparse and fast movement produces a dense trail
Each photo emerges slightly behind the point of contact and moves toward it
Each photo shrinks and disappears by itself with no dismissal affordance
Only a few photos coexist, with the newest layered above older ones and clearly separated from the surround
Stopping movement returns the stage to emptiness without user action
Re-triggering a still-visible photo restarts it cleanly with no duplicate or stuck remnant
No fixed grid, gallery arrangement, captions or navigation controls for the imagery
adaptable_details: Exact number of photos in the set and their subject matter
Wording, placement and typography of the short label
Precise distance threshold that governs release frequency
Photo dimensions, aspect ratios and how far behind the contact point they start
Duration and easing of the chase, shrink and vanish phases
Maximum number of coexisting photos, as long as it stays few
Exact hue, tone and luminance of the background field, whether recessive or bright, as long as it stays low-distraction and keeps imagery and label clearly separated from it
Whether the stage is the full view or a large bounded region
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits a small curated set of self-explanatory images or short visual clips that read at a glance and gain nothing from being studied, on views whose purpose is mood, playfulness or a teaser impression. It does not fit content that must be read, compared, selected or navigated, since captions, persistence or selection would break the fleeting self-dismissing behavior. Making the imagery persist, arranging it into a browsable layout, driving releases automatically instead of by movement, or requiring clicks to reveal or dismiss items would each create a different Skill.

source_sites.title: Ideas for Image Motion Trail Animations

name: inertial_chroma_reveal_photo_feature
description: A calm, low-distraction feature page where scrolling glides with inertia, each large photo arrives subdued and desaturated then resolves into full colour and detail once it holds its place, paired photos drift past at different rates while desaturating and growing, and text and images read as one continuous glassy material over a slowly drifting quiet backdrop.

canonical_document.name: inertial_chroma_reveal_photo_feature
canonical_document.description: A calm, low-distraction feature page where scrolling glides with inertia, each large photo arrives subdued and desaturated then resolves into full colour and detail once it holds its place, paired photos drift past at different rates while desaturating and growing, and text and images read as one continuous glassy material over a slowly drifting quiet backdrop.
canonical_document.experience_scope: A whole-view experience covering the full page: from a brief quiet loading moment and calm settled opening, through the scroll-driven sequence of photos and short text passages, to an ending that signals the full set has been seen and offers an easy way back to the top.
content_and_composition: One headline opening the feature
A few large photos as the dominant content, including at least one side-by-side pair and one picture presented as a soft solid block
Short text passages interleaved with the photos, sharing the same continuous glassy material rather than sitting in separate flat panels
A persistent low-distraction backdrop drifting slowly behind all content as the calm substrate, held clearly apart from the foreground without competing with it
A closing region that reads as the end of the set plus a return-to-top affordance
Layering reads as one connected translucent surface: text and images belong to a single material, backdrop behind, content in front
experience_progression: Brief quiet loading moment on arrival, then the visuals settle into a calm, low-distraction opening
Advancing moves photos through a travelling state where they desaturate and grow
Each photo enters subdued and desaturated, then resolves into full chroma and detail once it holds its place, so focus lands on one piece at a time
The solid-block picture springs into place on entry and jiggles more the faster the page is pushed
Reversing direction unwinds every one of these states back through the same appearances
The sequence closes with a clear sense of having seen the whole set and an easy return upward
attention_and_information_flow: Chroma is the prominence signal: desaturated and subdued means not yet the subject, full chroma and detail means this is the piece to read now
Only the settled photo holds full chroma, keeping attention on one item at a time
Photos leaving the held position lose chroma and grow, releasing attention as they travel
Differing drift rates within the side-by-side pair separate them in depth so the pair does not compete as one flat unit
The strength of the spring and jiggle communicates how hard the page is being pushed
The unified glassy material keeps words and pictures reading as one continuous flow rather than a checklist of blocks

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: A hard flick decelerates to rest without overrunning either end; interrupting a movement mid-flight simply re-aims it from where it is rather than queueing or snapping back
interaction_model.state_change: Position advances with inertia and glides to rest rather than jumping between stops
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Content slides smoothly and keeps coasting briefly after input stops, with all photo states moving in step with position
interaction_model.input: Scrolling, wheel, drag or flick to advance or reverse
interaction_model.affected_object: Overall page position and every scroll-linked photo state

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Reversing direction unwinds the resolve back to subdued and desaturated along the same path
interaction_model.state_change: From subdued and desaturated to full chroma and detail
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The photo visibly gains chroma and sharpens in place, becoming the single focal item
interaction_model.input: A photo reaching and holding its place while advancing
interaction_model.affected_object: That individual photo

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Reversing motion restores saturation and scale continuously, with no discrete reset
interaction_model.state_change: Desaturates and grows in size while moving
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Chroma drains and scale increases as the photo drifts past, with the paired photos moving at slightly different rates from each other
interaction_model.input: Advancing past a photo so it travels out of its held position
interaction_model.affected_object: Photos in the side-by-side pair and other travelling photos

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Interrupting mid-spring re-aims the motion rather than restarting it; leaving and re-entering replays entry cleanly
interaction_model.state_change: Springs into its resting position and oscillates before settling, with amplitude scaled to push speed
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The block visibly springs and jiggles on entry, jiggling harder for faster pushes, then comes to rest
interaction_model.input: The soft solid-block picture entering the view, with speed of the push as a modifier
interaction_model.affected_object: That picture block

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: The opening resolves on its own with no user action required
interaction_model.state_change: From a brief quiet loading moment to a settled calm, low-distraction opening
interaction_model.visible_feedback: A short unobtrusive wait, then the visuals settle with the backdrop already drifting slowly behind them at a clearly lower visual weight than the content
interaction_model.input: Initial page arrival
interaction_model.affected_object: The whole view and its backdrop

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: The return can be interrupted by user scrolling, which re-aims the motion; all photo states re-enter their appropriate appearances on the way

interaction_model.visible_feedback: A clear closing signal that the full set has been seen, then a glide back to the top rather than an abrupt jump
interaction_model.input: Reaching the end of the set and choosing the return-to-top affordance
interaction_model.affected_object: Page position

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Independent of scroll position; never demands attention and never stalls the foreground
interaction_model.state_change: Continues drifting slowly and endlessly
interaction_model.visible_feedback: A quiet, low-contrast, gently moving substrate behind the content
interaction_model.input: Time passing with no input
interaction_model.affected_object: Low-distraction backdrop

experience_qualities: Calm, low-distraction and unhurried throughout
Weighty and inertial rather than snappy or paged
Continuous glassy material uniting words and pictures instead of flat stacked blocks
One-piece-at-a-time focus created by chroma and luminance separation rather than by hiding content
Physical and springy at entry moments, responsive to how hard the page is pushed
Fully reversible, so nothing feels one-way or lost
completion_and_return: The ending communicates that the full set has been seen
An easy way back up is offered at the end and returns to the opening smoothly
All scroll-linked states are continuous functions of position, so they re-enter correctly on both forward and reverse travel
No accumulated state persists after returning to the top
locked_observable_requirements: Advancing glides with inertia and coasts to rest; it never jumps or snaps between fixed stops
Each photo enters subdued and desaturated and resolves into full chroma and detail only once it holds its place
Travelling photos desaturate and grow as they pass
The side-by-side pair drifts at slightly different rates from each other
One picture presents as a soft solid block that springs into place on entry and jiggles harder the faster the page is pushed
Reversing direction unwinds every one of these states rather than resetting them
Hard flicks decelerate to rest without overrunning either end
Interrupting a movement mid-flight re-aims it instead of queueing or restarting
Text and images read as one continuous glassy material, not separate flat panels
A backdrop of clearly lower visual weight than the content drifts slowly and persistently behind it
The opening includes only a brief, quiet loading moment before the visuals settle
The ending conveys completeness of the set and offers an easy return to the top
adaptable_details: Number of photos and length of the text passages
Headline wording and typographic treatment
Hue family and luminance level of the backdrop and the shape of its drift
Exact inertia duration, spring stiffness and jiggle amplitude
Layout proportions of the pair and the solid block, and whether other photos are full-width
How strongly the glassy material is tinted or blurred
Form of the return-to-top affordance
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits short, image-led feature or editorial views with a headline, a handful of large photos and brief text meant to be read in one calm pass, where scroll position can drive appearance continuously. Replacing continuous inertial travel with discrete snap-per-section paging, or moving the photos into a click-driven gallery or lightbox where entry states no longer track scroll position, would create a different skill.

name: endless_drag_photo_field_with_centre_focus
description: A low-distraction edge-to-edge plane of photographs pulled around by pointer drag or wheel that never reaches an edge, sharpening and saturating whatever drifts to the middle while outer pictures drain toward neutral and visibly lag, lean and bow during fast movement.

canonical_document.name: endless_drag_photo_field_with_centre_focus
canonical_document.description: A low-distraction edge-to-edge plane of photographs pulled around by pointer drag or wheel that never reaches an edge, sharpening and saturating whatever drifts to the middle while outer pictures drain toward neutral and visibly lag, lean and bow during fast movement.
canonical_document.experience_scope: Whole-view experience occupying the entire viewport from landing onward; it has no entry gate and no exit point, and the same field remains the only surface for the whole visit to the region.
content_and_composition: One continuous plane of many photographs arranged as a repeating field that fills the viewport edge to edge with no page margins
Recessive backdrop visible between and behind pictures, separated far enough from the imagery in luminance that the field reads as a quiet surround rather than a competing surface
No menus, captions, labels, counters, scrollbars or framing chrome of any kind; imagery is the only content role
An implicit central focus zone: the area near the middle of the viewport where a picture reads as the current subject
Peripheral zone toward all edges where pictures read as secondary, drained of saturation and receding
Field is layered as a single flat plane that only leaves flatness transiently during fast movement
experience_progression: Land directly in the field, already populated and legible as roamable in any direction
Grab and pull: field follows the pointer, subjects continuously exchange places through the centre

Centre picture presents at full saturation and full clarity; pictures drifting outward lose saturation toward neutral and fall back in prominence
Attention transfers continuously and smoothly as the field moves, so several pictures are mid-transition at any moment
During fast movement the periphery becomes visibly unstable while the centre stays the readable anchor
No new textual or metadata information is ever revealed; the only revealed information is more imagery

interaction_model.state_change: Plane translates with the pointer on both axes, closely tracking its movement
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Whole field slides under the hand; pictures entering the centre gain saturation and clarity while those leaving drain toward neutral and recede
interaction_model.input: Press anywhere on the field and drag
interaction_model.affected_object: The entire photograph plane

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: A pointer drag may take over at any moment during or after a wheel-driven move
interaction_model.state_change: Plane shifts vertically with the same feel and consequences as dragging
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Field travels upward or downward with identical saturation gain at the centre and draining toward neutral at the edges
interaction_model.input: Wheel or trackpad flick
interaction_model.affected_object: The entire photograph plane

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: A fresh press or a reversal of direction mid-glide takes control immediately without waiting for the glide to finish
interaction_model.state_change: Motion continues briefly under its own weight, then decelerates to a full stop
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Field keeps gliding a short distance and eases to rest, peripheral distortion relaxing back to flat as speed drops
interaction_model.input: Release at the end of a drag or flick
interaction_model.affected_object: The photograph plane's motion

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Distortion is fully self-resolving: it always relaxes to a flat, level plane once movement slows or stops
interaction_model.state_change: Outer pictures trail behind the field's motion and tilt or curve out of the flat plane in proportion to speed
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Visible lag, lean and outward bow of edge pictures while moving quickly, then a settle back to level and flat
interaction_model.input: Fast field movement (speed itself as driver)
interaction_model.affected_object: Pictures away from the centre

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Reversing direction brings a previously seen picture back into the centre, so returning to a liked image is a matter of drifting back
interaction_model.state_change: Pictures leaving one side re-enter from the opposite side
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The expanse reads as edgeless: no empty space, no wall and no snap-back is ever encountered
interaction_model.input: Continued travel in any direction
interaction_model.affected_object: Field boundaries

experience_qualities: Subdued and low-distraction, with full saturation reserved for the current subject
Weighty and unhurried, closer to shifting a heavy sheet than flicking a list
Endless and destination-free, encouraging aimless wandering rather than completion
Physical and responsive: the field feels attached to the hand and immediately obedient to a change of mind
Quietly unstable at speed, calm and flat at rest
completion_and_return: No completion state, no finish, no end-of-content signal
Field loops spatially forever through wrap-around rather than resetting
Every stop leaves a new resting composition with one clear centre subject
Returning to a previously seen picture is achieved by roaming back, not by history or navigation controls
locked_observable_requirements: Edge-to-edge field of photographs on a recessive backdrop clearly separated from the imagery in luminance, with no menus, captions or chrome
Free roaming on both axes with no reachable edge, achieved by pictures re-entering from the opposite side
Centre-position focus: full saturation and clarity near the middle, draining toward neutral and receding outward
Pointer drag pulls the whole field closely with the pointer; wheel or trackpad produces the equivalent vertical travel
Release produces a brief glide that eases to rest rather than an abrupt stop
New drag or direction reversal mid-glide takes over immediately
Fast movement makes outer pictures visibly lag, lean and bow out of the flat plane before settling level
Drag ends cleanly on release and on leaving the window while held
adaptable_details: Number, size, spacing and arrangement pattern of the photographs
Exact luminance and hue of the backdrop and of the muted peripheral state
How wide the central focus zone reads and how sharply saturation falls off outward
Glide length, deceleration feel and how strongly the periphery bows
Wheel and trackpad sensitivity relative to drag
Subject matter and aspect ratios of the imagery
Cursor treatment while pressing
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits large sets of visually self-sufficient images or media tiles meant to be browsed casually with no ranking, order or required item, and needs enough items for the edgeless wrap to read as an expanse rather than a repeat. It stops being this Skill if browsing becomes ordered or paged, if captions, metadata or detail reading become part of the view, if travel is bounded on one or both axes, or if prominence is decided by selection or sequence position instead of proximity to the centre.

name: corner_panel_reveal_image_cards
description: Full-bleed grid of picture-only cards on a low-distraction recessive ground; the card under the pointer pulls two information panels in from its corners while its artwork loses saturation and shifts scale, and its big number and label resolve letter by letter a moment later, then everything runs backwards to an untouched image.

canonical_document.name: corner_panel_reveal_image_cards
canonical_document.description: Full-bleed grid of picture-only cards on a low-distraction recessive ground; the card under the pointer pulls two information panels in from its corners while its artwork loses saturation and shifts scale, and its big number and label resolve letter by letter a moment later, then everything runs backwards to an untouched image.
canonical_document.experience_scope: Whole-view scrolling experience: begins when the full-bleed scene appears on its recessive ground with its imagery ready and ends at the last section; the reveal itself is a per-card region experience that starts and finishes entirely within one card's bounds.
content_and_composition: One edge-to-edge scene occupying the full viewport width over a single uniform low-distraction ground, with no contrasting framing band around the media
Multiple sections, each a grid of equally treated cards; sections are separated by oversized numbered markers that make the running order legible at a glance
Each card: a single full-cover photograph as the base layer, at rest showing nothing but the image
Per card, two information panels anchored at opposite corners, held outside or flush to the card edges until the card is attended to
Per card, a large ordinal number and a short place/identity label as the typographic layer above the artwork
Blank spacer cells interleaved in the grids to shape rhythm; they carry no image, panels or text
Persistent elements: the recessive ground, section number markers and the grid rhythm remain unchanged throughout
experience_progression: Entry: the scene withholds itself briefly, then the full-bleed composition and its photography appear together

Browsing downward: the same reveal recurs per card, but each successive section performs it more boldly than the one above (greater movement, stronger saturation and scale change, more emphatic typography)
No accumulation: every card returns to its untouched image state, so progression is carried by section order rather than by leftover state
attention_and_information_flow: At rest, all cards compete equally as pure imagery and no identifying text is available
When one card is attended to, its artwork deliberately recedes (saturation drains, scale shifts) so its surfacing text and panels win prominence inside that card
Information arrives in two beats: panels slide in first, then the number and label resolve character by character, so the eye lands on movement before reading
Only one card can be the centre of attention at a time; sweeping across neighbours shifts prominence immediately rather than leaving several cards half-revealed
Section markers provide the coarse orientation layer that stays readable regardless of card state

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Reversible at any moment; leaving slides them back out along the same paths
interaction_model.state_change: Panels move from off-edge/hidden to seated inside the card
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Both panels slide inward from the card's edges immediately, with no delay
interaction_model.input: Pointer enters a card
interaction_model.affected_object: The card's two corner information panels

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Returns exactly to the untouched saturation and scale on leaving; nothing persists
interaction_model.state_change: Artwork moves from untouched full-saturation rest state to a receded state
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Saturation drains out of the image and its scale changes so it reads as backdrop rather than subject
interaction_model.input: Pointer enters a card
interaction_model.affected_object: The card's photograph

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Unresolves on leaving; if interrupted mid-resolve it abandons its current position instead of finishing first
interaction_model.state_change: Text goes from absent/unresolved to fully legible
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Characters resolve one by one until the number and label read cleanly
interaction_model.input: Pointer entering a card, one beat after the panels start moving
interaction_model.affected_object: The card's large ordinal number and short identity label

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Retreat can itself be interrupted by re-entering the card, which reverses direction from wherever it is
interaction_model.state_change: Revealed state runs backwards to the untouched image-only state
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Panels retreat to the edges, saturation and scale restore, text unresolves — the card looks exactly as before it was touched
interaction_model.input: Pointer leaves a card
interaction_model.affected_object: The whole card reveal (panels, artwork, text)

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Each card independently settles to whichever end state matches the pointer's final position
interaction_model.state_change: In-flight motion is cut off rather than queued
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Cards drop whatever they were doing and follow the pointer's current position, so no backlog of animations plays out after the pointer has moved on
interaction_model.input: Pointer sweeps quickly across several neighbouring cards
interaction_model.affected_object: Any reveal or retreat still in flight

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Boundary behaviour — spacers never enter or block the reveal
interaction_model.state_change: None
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Nothing happens; the cell stays inert
interaction_model.input: Pointer over a blank spacer cell
interaction_model.affected_object: The spacer cell

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Direction is decided per entry, so re-entering from another edge produces the mirrored drift
interaction_model.state_change: Reveal direction is chosen from the crossed edge
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Artwork and panels drift in from the side the pointer came from, and drift back out the same way when it leaves
interaction_model.input: Pointer crossing a specific card edge (in one section only)
interaction_model.affected_object: Direction of artwork shift and panel travel for that card

experience_qualities: Atmospheric and image-dominant, with the surround receding well behind the media
Quiet at rest, decisive on attention
Layered two-beat reveal that feels mechanical and precise rather than soft
Immediately responsive with no lag or queueing under fast movement
Non-accumulating and self-cleaning: the grid always returns to pure imagery
Escalating intensity as the visitor moves downward
completion_and_return: Every card reveal completes by returning to the untouched image-only state; there is no sticky or selected card
Reveals are repeatable indefinitely and interruptible at any point in either direction
No state is carried between cards or sections; the only persistent condition is the recessive full-bleed ground and its ordering markers
locked_observable_requirements: Full-bleed scene on a uniform low-distraction ground where photography, not layout chrome, dominates
Cards show nothing but their image at rest; identifying text exists only during attention
Two information panels enter from the card's own edges/corners, not from the page
Artwork must visibly recede (saturation drain plus scale change) at the same time its text surfaces
Number and label resolve character by character, offset a beat after the panels begin moving
Leaving runs the entire reveal backwards to an untouched state with nothing left over
In-flight reveals and retreats are cut off, never queued, under rapid pointer movement
Oversized numbered section markers keep the running order legible independent of card state
Blank spacer cells remain completely inert
The reveal grows progressively bolder in later/lower sections
adaptable_details: Grid column counts, card aspect ratios and spacer placement
Exact saturation-reduction amount, scale direction (grow or shrink), easing character, and the hue and luminance of the ground so long as it stays recessive behind the imagery
Panel corner pairing and the size of the panel travel distance
Timing of the beat offset and speed of character resolution
Which specific section uses edge-derived drift direction, and whether more sections adopt it
How the scene withholds itself before the imagery is ready
Typographic styling of the ordinal numbers and labels
Number of sections and cards per section
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits any ordered set of visually strong, image-first entries with a short identifying label and an ordinal position — events, venues, chapters, works, locations, releases — presented on an immersive low-distraction surround where the picture can carry the tile alone. It breaks if entries need persistent visible text or dense metadata at rest, if cards must stay selected or expand into detail views, or if the primary content is not photographic; replacing the in-place recede-and-surface reveal with navigation to a detail state, a lightbox, or a persistent selected card would be a different Skill.

name: chained_image_procession_on_travel
description: A quiet, low-stimulus page where images appear one at a time, each emerging out of the edge of the one before it as you travel downward, its title and year arriving with it, every reveal advancing, pausing or unwinding exactly in step with how far you have moved.

canonical_document.name: chained_image_procession_on_travel
canonical_document.description: A quiet, low-stimulus page where images appear one at a time, each emerging out of the edge of the one before it as you travel downward, its title and year arriving with it, every reveal advancing, pausing or unwinding exactly in step with how far you have moved.
canonical_document.experience_scope: A whole-view experience covering the entire browsing run of the collection: it begins with a brief near-empty hold on the bare field before the first work forms, continues as one uninterrupted downward sequence through every item, and ends in a large calm empty area after the final work.
content_and_composition: One ordered set of images, presented sequentially rather than as a simultaneous overview
Exactly one work holds primary attention at any moment; neighbours are only partially present at the edges
Each image carries a short two-part caption (a name and a year) positioned alongside it, held at readable contrast against the field and treated as secondary to the picture

A visually quiet, near-empty field of even tone and minimal internal variation is the persistent substrate, separated clearly enough from the images that they read as figures on it; no competing interface, controls or overview chrome share the stage
Successive images are spatially linked: the next one grows out of the boundary or edge region of the current one, so the whole set reads as a single connected chain rather than separate cards
