A generous stretch of emptiness follows the last work as a deliberate closing pause
experience_progression: Opening: a short, still hold on an almost empty page of uniform quiet tone with nothing yet formed
First formation: the initial work fills in as travel begins

Chained advance: for each following item, nothing exists until travel reaches that item's threshold, then it progressively fills in out of the edge of the previous work as travel continues, and stays settled once complete
Closing: after the final work, an extended empty run lets the sequence end without an abrupt cut
The whole progression is positional, so it can be re-walked forward or backward at any time rather than being played once
attention_and_information_flow: Attention rests on a single work at a time; prominence transfers from one image to the next as travel advances
Information is withheld until earned: an item's picture and its name and year have no presence at all before its threshold is reached
Caption information arrives together with its image so identity and picture register as one unit
The connection between consecutive works keeps peripheral awareness of what is coming without letting it compete for focus
The empty opening and closing stretches lower stimulus at both ends and frame the sequence

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: A new gesture during the drift takes over the motion; travel can be reversed at any moment and the position remains wherever it settles
interaction_model.state_change: Motion eases in rather than tracking the gesture literally, and continues drifting for a short time after the gesture ends before settling
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The sequence advances with a weighted, gliding quality; content keeps moving briefly after the hand or wheel stops
interaction_model.input: Wheel scrolling or touch dragging through the page
interaction_model.affected_object: The travel position that governs the whole sequence

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Formation never runs on its own clock, so it cannot outrun or lag the visitor; completed entries stay settled rather than re-animating
interaction_model.state_change: That entry moves from completely unformed to progressively forming to fully settled, in direct proportion to distance travelled
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The image grows out of the edge of the preceding work and fills in incrementally while the caption arrives with it; once complete it holds steady and stops responding to further travel
interaction_model.input: Continued downward travel past an item's threshold
interaction_model.affected_object: The next image in the chain and its name-and-year caption

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Resuming travel in either direction continues the same change from that held point
interaction_model.state_change: The reveal freezes at its exact partial value
interaction_model.visible_feedback: A visibly half-formed entry is held on screen indefinitely, with no snapping to a finished or unformed state
interaction_model.input: Halting travel part-way through a reveal
interaction_model.affected_object: The item currently forming

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Direction may be changed at any point, mid-reveal, without discontinuity or replay artefacts
interaction_model.state_change: Each reveal runs backward through the same intermediate states
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Images and captions smoothly unbuild in reverse toward their unformed state as the chain retracts
interaction_model.input: Travelling back upward
interaction_model.affected_object: Already formed or partially formed entries

experience_qualities: Unhurried and calm, never rushing the viewer forward
Weighted and gliding rather than literal one-to-one scrolling
Quiet and low-distraction in the surround, with generous emptiness treated as part of the composition
Continuous and connected: one chain rather than a series of independent sections
Deterministic and trustworthy: the same travel position always shows the same state
completion_and_return: The sequence completes at the final work, followed by a long empty settling area rather than an ending flourish
No looping; the chain has a definite beginning and end
State is positional, so returning upward restores earlier stages exactly and travelling down again re-forms them the same way
There is no separate reset action; moving back to the start returns the page to its near-empty opening condition
locked_observable_requirements: One work holds attention at a time; the collection is never presented as a simultaneous at-a-glance overview
Each item visually emerges out of the edge of the previous item so the set reads as one connected chain
Each item's short label (name and year, or equivalent two-part metadata) arrives together with its image, not before or long after
All reveal progress is bound to distance travelled, never to a timer or autoplay
Nothing of an entry is visible before its travel threshold; it fills in progressively and stays settled once complete
Travel input is smoothed and carries residual drift after the gesture ends
Halting mid-reveal holds a visibly partial state
Upward travel replays the identical change in reverse
A quiet, sparse opening state and a generous empty closing stretch bound the sequence, the field kept low in visual activity so images and captions stay clearly separated from it
Travel is the only control; no overview, pagination or playback controls substitute for it
adaptable_details: Number of items in the collection
Exact edge or side from which each successive item emerges, and the direction of the chain's zig-zag or drift
Caption typography, placement relative to the image and the nature of the secondary metadata
Specific reveal treatment used to fill an entry in (wipe, expansion, clarification) as long as it is progressive and reversible
Amount of smoothing and drift length, threshold distances and overall pacing
Exact tone and luminance level of the field, whether low-key or high-key, provided images stay clearly separated from it, and image aspect ratios
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits ordered collections of visually strong single items that each carry a short label — image or artwork sets, project or case galleries, archival and exhibition runs, or chaptered visual stories — where the page can afford a long vertical run and full attention on one item at a time. It stops being this Skill if items are shown together as a browsable grid or overview, if reveals are driven by timers or autoplay instead of travel, if reveals are one-shot and non-reversible, if items appear as independent unconnected blocks instead of a chain, or if the content is dense text or data that cannot hold a screen on its own.

name: scroll_choreographed_image_movements
description: A cinematic downward journey through several image movements over a uniform low-distraction surround, where each stretch pins one short line at the centre while pictures glide, tilt, recede and shift luminance exactly in step with how far you have scrolled.

canonical_document.name: scroll_choreographed_image_movements
canonical_document.description: A cinematic downward journey through several image movements over a uniform low-distraction surround, where each stretch pins one short line at the centre while pictures glide, tilt, recede and shift luminance exactly in step with how far you have scrolled.
canonical_document.experience_scope: Whole-view experience for the full length of the page: begins with a near-full-height title area set on the same low-distraction surround, continues through a series of consecutive full-viewport image movements, and ends in a quiet closing stretch that signals the sequence is over.
content_and_composition: One opening title area occupying nearly the full viewport height, set on the quiet low-distraction surround, containing the collection name plus a brief quiet cue that the imagery unfolds gradually and rewards an unhurried pace
Six consecutive image movements (a small series of distinct stretches), each a full-viewport region of the descent
Exactly one short poetic line per movement, held at the visual centre as the stable anchor of that stretch
Multiple photographs per movement arranged around and behind the centred line, layered at differing apparent depths so some read as near and some as far
Consistent uniform low-distraction background acting as the connective substrate across the entire descent, holding enough separation from imagery and text to keep both clearly legible against it
A final quiet stretch with markedly reduced imagery and motion, serving as an explicit close
No persistent chrome competing with the imagery; the centred line and the uniform surround are the only elements common to every stretch
experience_progression: Stage 1: Near-full-height title holds the view against the quiet surround, naming the collection and setting an unhurried, gradual tone before any imagery moves
Stage 2: First image movement enters; its images begin moving slightly before the movement is fully in view and its centred line takes the middle of attention

Stage 3: Each successive movement replaces the previous one with a visibly different motion signature (differing drift direction, depth, tilt and luminance behaviour) so no stretch repeats the character of the one before
Stage 4: Movements settle just after they leave the view, so transitions overlap rather than snap between stretches
Stage 5: Final quiet stretch reduces motion and imagery density, making it unmistakable that the sequence has ended
Reverse scrolling retraces the same stages backwards in the same visual states
attention_and_information_flow: Attention starts fully on the title and its pacing cue, with no imagery yet competing
Within each movement the centred short line is the fixed focal point; imagery gains prominence by moving around and past it rather than by displacing it
Depth and luminance sort prominence continuously: nearer images and those separating more strongly from the surround pull attention forward, deeper and lower-separation ones recede into atmosphere
Information is revealed one line at a time, so reading load stays minimal and the pictures carry the experience
Motion speed conveys pacing: attention intensifies as scrolling accelerates and rests when scrolling stops
The closing stretch withdraws prominence from imagery entirely, resolving attention into stillness

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Fully continuous and positional, so any scroll position reproduces the same visual state; nothing is consumed or lost
interaction_model.state_change: Each image's sideways or upward offset, apparent depth, tilt angle and luminance are set directly by how far that movement has travelled through the view
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Pictures drift laterally or upward, move nearer or further, rotate slightly and rise or fall in luminance continuously as the page advances, with no discrete jumps
interaction_model.input: Vertical scroll (the only control) advancing the page downward
interaction_model.affected_object: Images within the movement currently traversing the view

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Slowing down immediately returns to a calmer rate without skipping intermediate states
interaction_model.state_change: Motion progresses through the same states over less time
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Drift, tilt, depth and luminance changes visibly speed up together
interaction_model.input: Faster scrolling
interaction_model.affected_object: All animated imagery in the active movement

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Resuming scroll continues from the frozen state; the freeze is a stable resting point, not a pause artifact
interaction_model.state_change: Motion halts at the exact current progress value
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Every image freezes mid-pose, held at its current offset, depth, tilt and luminance
interaction_model.input: Stopping scroll
interaction_model.affected_object: All animated imagery in the active movement

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Fully reversible; no state is permanently spent, so any earlier moment can be revisited exactly
interaction_model.state_change: Progress decreases and every visual property retraces its earlier values in reverse
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Images glide back through the same drifts, tilts, depths and luminance levels already seen
interaction_model.input: Scrolling upward / back
interaction_model.affected_object: Images of the movements being re-entered

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: A new gesture during the glide redirects it smoothly; all input devices produce the same eased feel
interaction_model.state_change: Position eases toward the input target with slight inertia rather than snapping
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The whole descent glides, with brief carry-over after the gesture ends instead of abrupt repositioning
interaction_model.input: Wheel, trackpad or touch gesture
interaction_model.affected_object: Overall scroll position of the descent

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Applies symmetrically when scrolling back upward
interaction_model.state_change: Its motion range starts slightly before entry and finishes slightly after exit
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Images are already in motion when the stretch appears and are still settling as it leaves, so stretches overlap seamlessly
interaction_model.input: A movement approaching or leaving the viewport
interaction_model.affected_object: That movement's imagery

experience_qualities: Dreamy and ethereal
Cinematic and spacious
Unhurried, encouraging slow scrolling
Continuously responsive rather than stepwise
Legible and easy to follow despite constant motion
Varied stretch to stretch, never feeling repeated
Atmospheric depth from layered near and far imagery
completion_and_return: Completion is marked by a quiet final stretch with reduced imagery and motion, clearly signalling the end of the sequence
No looping; the descent has a definite beginning and end
Scroll position is the entire state, so returning upward restores earlier stretches exactly as first seen
Stopping anywhere leaves a stable frozen composition rather than an unfinished animation
locked_observable_requirements: Vertical scrolling is the only control; no clicks, drags or buttons drive the experience
Image offset, depth, tilt and luminance are set directly and continuously by each group's travel through the view, not by timed playback
Motion is fully bidirectional and reversible, retracing identical states when scrolling back
Stopping scroll freezes every image mid-pose in a stable state
A near-full-height opening title area on the uniform low-distraction surround names the collection and signals a gradual, unhurried pace before imagery begins
Several distinct consecutive movements, each visibly different in motion character from its neighbours
Exactly one short line of text per movement, held at the centre of attention while imagery moves around and past it
Each movement's motion begins slightly before it enters the view and settles slightly after it leaves
Wheel, trackpad and touch input all move with slight inertia rather than jumping
A quiet closing stretch that makes the end of the sequence unmistakable
adaptable_details: Exact number of movements, provided there are several visibly distinct ones
Subject matter and aspect ratios of the photographs
Number and arrangement of images inside each movement
Which axes drift, and the precise tilt, depth and luminance ranges per movement
Wording of the centred lines and the opening title copy
Typography, the specific tone of the uniform surround and amount of vertical length given to each stretch
Strength of the inertial easing
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits sizeable curated visual collections carried by atmosphere with very sparse text — photo series, lookbooks, mood or archive features, campaign stories — where the full viewport can be devoted to the descent. It stops being this Skill if imagery is browsed through discrete slides or clicks, if scrolling snaps between fixed states instead of driving continuous reversible visual change, if text becomes long-form reading that shares the centre with the pictures, or if the material is reduced to a compact grid or single hero rather than a multi-stretch journey with a marked opening and close.

name: fullscreen_scatter_set_gallery_with_flying_swaps
description: One set of pictures spread loosely across the whole screen; pointing at a picture lifts it, pushes it into a markedly intensified, high-salience color treatment and eases its crop open, while clicking a corner cluster sends the current pictures tumbling into that cluster as the next set's pictures fly out from the opposite one.

canonical_document.name: fullscreen_scatter_set_gallery_with_flying_swaps
canonical_document.description: One set of pictures spread loosely across the whole screen; pointing at a picture lifts it, pushes it into a markedly intensified, high-salience color treatment and eases its crop open, while clicking a corner cluster sends the current pictures tumbling into that cluster as the next set's pictures fly out from the opposite one.
canonical_document.experience_scope: Whole-view experience: begins with an arrival warm-up that occupies the screen, continues as the resident browsing state for the entire view, and never ends — sets cycle endlessly with no terminal state.
content_and_composition: Several discrete image sets, only one active on screen at a time
Active set: multiple pictures distributed across the full viewport with no single dominant focal slot, so the eye can wander from picture to picture
Two small picture clusters placed near opposite corners of the view, persistent across all states, standing for the sets waiting ahead and behind
Arrival composition: a rising numeric count paired with a small stack of layered previews, occupying the view before the first set unfolds
Corner clusters act as both quiet signposts for adjacent sets and as the origin and destination of set-change motion
experience_progression: Warm-up: a count rises while a few stacked previews sit alongside it, deliberately delaying entry
Unfold: the first set opens out from that compact state to fill the whole screen
Free browsing: attention drifts across the spread pictures, with per-picture hover treatment available
Set step: on a corner-cluster click, the on-screen pictures fly into the opposite cluster while the chosen set's pictures fly out into their spread positions, tumbling as they travel
Cycle: stepping past either end wraps to the other end so browsing never reaches a dead end
attention_and_information_flow: Warm-up concentrates attention on a single rising count and a compact preview stack, withholding the pictures
Unfolding disperses attention outward from a compact center to the full viewport

During free browsing no picture is privileged; prominence is granted only momentarily to whichever picture the pointer rests on, which grows, intensifies into a visibly separated color treatment and reveals more of its frame
Corner clusters stay visually quiet and secondary, readable as 'more ahead' and 'more behind' rather than competing with the active set
During a set step attention follows the travelling pictures between the two corners, then settles back into the new spread

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Pointer leaving smoothly undoes size, color-treatment shift and crop together back to the resting state; other pictures are unaffected
interaction_model.state_change: Picture moves from resting state to a highlighted state: slightly larger, shifted into an intensified color treatment clearly separated from its resting one, crop eased open to expose more of the frame
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The picture lifts and grows a little, its color treatment surges into a distinctly stronger cast, and its visible framing widens to show more of the image
interaction_model.input: Pointer enters a picture of the active set
interaction_model.affected_object: That single picture in the active set

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Clicks during an in-flight transition are ignored; once a transition completes the direction may be reversed on the next click; stepping past either end wraps around to the opposite end
interaction_model.state_change: Active set is exchanged for the adjacent set in the clicked direction as one continuous motion, not a reload
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Pictures currently on screen fly into the cluster opposite the clicked one while the chosen set's pictures fly out from the clicked side into their spread positions, tumbling as they travel
interaction_model.input: Click on either corner cluster
interaction_model.affected_object: All pictures of the current set plus all pictures of the chosen adjacent set

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Runs once per arrival and resolves into the browsing state; it is not re-entered by set stepping
interaction_model.state_change: Warm-up state advances to the fully unfolded first set
interaction_model.visible_feedback: A count rises beside a small stack of previews, then the first set unfolds across the whole screen
interaction_model.input: Arrival of the view (autonomous)
interaction_model.affected_object: Count readout, stacked previews and the first set

experience_qualities: Deliberate, anticipatory opening rather than an immediate reveal
Open and wandering rather than guided — the spread invites free scanning
Intense, energetic response under the pointer
Continuous and physical set changes, with tumbling flight rather than cuts or fades
Endless and reassuring: no last set, no dead end
completion_and_return: Warm-up completes once and hands off to browsing
Each hover highlight fully reverses on pointer exit
Each set step completes with the new set at rest in its spread positions and both corner clusters restored
Set order loops in both directions so the experience has no completion state
Which set is active persists as the resident view state between steps
locked_observable_requirements: Only one set is on screen at a time, spread across the whole viewport with distributed rather than single-focus attention
Arrival shows a rising count together with a small stack of layered previews before the first set unfolds
Two small clusters sit near opposite corners and represent the adjacent sets in both directions
Hovering a picture simultaneously enlarges it, shifts it into a clearly separated, higher-intensity color state and opens its crop to reveal more of the frame; leaving reverses all three smoothly
A set step moves outgoing pictures into one corner cluster while incoming pictures emerge from the opposite one, with tumbling motion during travel
The step reads as one continuous exchange, never as a reload or instant replacement
Input during a transition is ignored; direction is reversible on the following step; ends wrap around
adaptable_details: Number of sets and number of pictures per set
Exact spread positions, spacing and image aspect ratios
Which corners host the clusters and how many previews each cluster shows
Counting range, pacing and typographic treatment of the arrival count
Which hue direction the hover shift takes and how strong the shift, size change and crop change are
Travel paths, tumble amount and duration of the set exchange
Whether keyboard or other inputs additionally trigger set steps
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits any modest number of curated image groups meant to be viewed one group at a time on a full view, where pictures carry the message and per-picture inspection is welcome. Replacing the whole-screen spread with a scrolling grid or list, giving one item permanent dominance, requiring long text or captions to be read alongside the pictures, or turning the corner clusters into ordinary offscreen navigation controls would create a different Skill.

name: pinned_image_set_converges_to_captioned_hero
description: A loose spread of images halts in the middle of the screen and, driven only by continued scrolling, rearranges step by step until it settles into one dominant framing where a short caption becomes readable, then releases the page.

canonical_document.name: pinned_image_set_converges_to_captioned_hero
canonical_document.description: A loose spread of images halts in the middle of the screen and, driven only by continued scrolling, rearranges step by step until it settles into one dominant framing where a short caption becomes readable, then releases the page.
canonical_document.experience_scope: A region-level experience. It begins when an image set reaches the middle of the viewport and the page stops advancing, and it ends when the arrangement resolves, the caption is readable, and normal downward reading resumes below.
content_and_composition: One set of several related images, initially arranged as a loose, uneven spread with varied positions and sizes across the viewport
One image within the set designated as the dominant final framing, considerably larger and centered in the resolved state
One short caption line bound to the set, absent or unreadable until the rearrangement resolves
Surrounding body text sections sit above and below in normal document flow and are not part of the pinned stage

A quiet, uniform low-distraction surround persists behind the set throughout, held at enough separation from the imagery to keep each frame distinct and the caption readable, and unchanged by the rearrangement
experience_progression: Set scrolls up into the middle of the viewport and the page becomes held in place
Continued scrolling advances the arrangement through discrete rearrangement steps, images consolidating from spread toward the dominant framing
Final step completes the dominant framing and the caption arrives and becomes readable at exactly that moment
Hold releases and ordinary downward reading continues into the following text section
attention_and_information_flow: Attention starts distributed and unfocused across many competing images of similar weight
Each step narrows the field, progressively subordinating peripheral images to the emerging dominant one
Final state carries a single visual focus plus one line of text, so the set delivers its meaning only at resolution
Once released, prominence returns to the running text and the set recedes as a completed chapter

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Progress is strictly bound to scroll position, never time; stopping scroll freezes the arrangement part-way in a stable intermediate state
interaction_model.state_change: Arrangement advances step by step from loose spread toward the single dominant framing; caption transitions to readable on the final step
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Images move and resize toward their resolved positions in direct proportion to scroll distance, ending on a centered dominant image with a legible caption
interaction_model.input: Continued downward scrolling while the set is held at the middle of the viewport
interaction_model.affected_object: The image set's arrangement and the set caption

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Reversal is exact and repeatable; progress is clamped at both extremes so the set cannot overshoot past the spread or past the resolved framing
interaction_model.state_change: Arrangement retraces its steps in reverse toward the original loose spread and the caption returns to unreadable
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The same intermediate positions replay backwards, retracing precisely to the starting arrangement
interaction_model.input: Scrolling back upward while the set is still held
interaction_model.affected_object: The image set's arrangement and the set caption

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: No trapped state; the set can always be left in either direction and its state always matches current scroll position
interaction_model.state_change: Hold releases into normal flow after resolution, or re-engages at the corresponding progress point when approached again
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The page resumes moving normally with the set left in its final framing; re-entering shows the arrangement at the state matching scroll position
interaction_model.input: Scrolling past the resolved set, or arriving at the set from below
interaction_model.affected_object: Page flow and the held region

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Motion settles rather than snapping when input stops, and remains interruptible by new input at any moment
interaction_model.state_change: Raw input is smoothed into weighted, eased movement
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Scrolling feels heavy and glided rather than jumpy, so rearrangement steps read as deliberate motion
interaction_model.input: Any scroll input across the region
interaction_model.affected_object: Overall page motion

experience_qualities: Cinematic and composed
Unhurried and deliberate, with weight behind every step
Precisely controllable, since the viewer can hold, reverse and re-inspect any intermediate arrangement
Resolving, giving a clear sense that the set finished before reading continues
Consistently legible, with text never competing with moving imagery
completion_and_return: The set is complete when the dominant framing is reached and the caption is readable
After completion the hold releases and the page returns to ordinary reading
The pattern repeats for each subsequent set rather than looping within one set
State is not persisted as a milestone; it is always recomputed from scroll position, so revisiting shows the same arrangement for the same position
locked_observable_requirements: Progress is bound strictly to scroll position, with no time-based autoplay
The set holds at the middle of the viewport while its rearrangement advances
Rearrangement proceeds through discernible steps rather than one continuous blur
The set converges from a loose multi-image spread to a single dominant framing
The caption becomes readable exactly as the rearrangement completes, not before
Reverse scrolling retraces the same intermediate states precisely back to the starting spread
Progress is clamped at both extremes and the page releases only after resolution
Overall scrolling is eased and weighted rather than jumpy
adaptable_details: Number of images in the set and the geometry of the initial spread
Number of rearrangement steps
Which image becomes dominant and its aspect ratio
Caption wording, length and placement relative to the dominant image
Surround tone, overall lightness direction and typographic treatment, provided image separation and caption legibility hold
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits any group of related images that share one short piece of explanatory text and benefit from a moment of consolidated focus inside a scrolling page. Replacing scroll-bound progress with click, drag or timed playback, removing the convergence onto a single dominant frame, or letting the caption appear independently of resolution would make it a different skill.

name: scroll_scrubbed_chapter_aperture_reveal
description: Each chapter begins as nothing but a centred two-word title on a quiet, strongly suppressed field; continued downward scrolling opens an aperture outward from the middle of the chapter's picture, sends the two words to their final positions around it, and enlarges the photo while raising its luminance through restless, unsettled edges until picture and caption read as one finished composition.

canonical_document.name: scroll_scrubbed_chapter_aperture_reveal
canonical_document.description: Each chapter begins as nothing but a centred two-word title on a quiet, strongly suppressed field; continued downward scrolling opens an aperture outward from the middle of the chapter's picture, sends the two words to their final positions around it, and enlarges the photo while raising its luminance through restless, unsettled edges until picture and caption read as one finished composition.
canonical_document.experience_scope: A whole-view sequential experience made of independent chapter regions: it begins with a quiet, near-empty opening view and ends when the final chapter's picture and caption have settled; each chapter's reveal begins when its title area sits near the bottom of the viewport and completes over its own short stretch of scrolling.
content_and_composition: One quiet opening view holding little more than a short lead-in line plus a cue that the page rewards slow scrolling
An ordered series of chapters, each with exactly one picture and one very short caption
Per chapter, a two-word title that is a single centred pairing in the pre-reveal state and becomes two separately placed words around the picture in the settled state
A near-empty surrounding field of markedly suppressed luminance and detail that the picture emerges out of and that keeps the title clearly readable before the picture exists visually
Picture, title words and caption occupy one shared composition frame per chapter; the picture is the spatial anchor and the aperture originates from its centre
Chapter compositions differ from one another in placement and framing rather than repeating a single fixed layout
experience_progression: Quiet, near-empty opening: lead-in plus a pacing cue, almost nothing else on screen
Chapter waiting state: only the two-word title, centred as a pair, holding attention on the words alone
Trigger point: the chapter's title area reaches near the bottom of the viewport and further downward scroll begins the reveal
Aperture stage: an opening expands outward from the centre of the picture, letting the image appear from the middle out
Title dispersal stage: the two words leave their centred pairing and travel to their final positions around the picture
Growth stage: the photograph gradually enlarges and its luminance rises while its edges remain restless and unsettled
Settled stage: motion resolves and picture, title words and caption read as one finished composition
Next chapter repeats the arc independently over its own short scroll stretch
attention_and_information_flow: Opening withholds content so the only information carried is the invitation to proceed slowly
Before a reveal, all prominence sits on the two-word title because nothing else is visible
Attention is handed from the words to the picture as the aperture grows and the picture's luminance rises
Restless edges keep the picture reading as unfinished, deferring resolution until the very end of the chapter's scroll stretch
Final settled state redistributes prominence: the picture dominates while the dispersed title words and caption become part of the frame rather than competing with it
Only one chapter holds attention at a time; each is a discrete beat in the sequence

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Progress is clamped at fully hidden and fully open; reversing scroll reverses the aperture to the exact matching point
interaction_model.state_change: Aperture progresses from fully closed toward fully open, mapped point-for-point to scroll offset within the chapter's stretch
interaction_model.visible_feedback: An opening expands outward from the centre of the picture, revealing more of the image from the middle out
interaction_model.input: Continued downward scrolling after a chapter's title area sits near the bottom of the viewport
interaction_model.affected_object: That chapter's aperture over its picture

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Halting the scroll freezes the words mid-journey; scrolling back returns them toward the centred pairing
interaction_model.state_change: Words move from a single centred pairing to their final separate positions around the picture
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The pair splits and travels outward, resolving into placed labels framing the image
interaction_model.input: The same scroll progress within the chapter's stretch
interaction_model.affected_object: The chapter's two title words

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Slowing scroll slows the growth; stopping holds it; scrolling back shrinks and dims it along the same path
interaction_model.state_change: Scale and luminance rise from minimal toward final while edge agitation decays toward stillness
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The picture grows and lifts clear of the suppressed surrounding field with unsettled, restless borders that calm as it approaches completion
interaction_model.input: The same scroll progress within the chapter's stretch
interaction_model.affected_object: The photograph's size and luminance, and its edge treatment

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Fully retraceable in both directions with no autonomous playback; no stage becomes permanent or skipped
interaction_model.state_change: Any reveal can be driven back to its fully unrevealed state and forward again
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The composition unwinds to the title-only state on the empty suppressed field and can be replayed by scrolling down again
interaction_model.input: Scrolling past a chapter and later returning upward to it
interaction_model.affected_object: The chapter's whole reveal state

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: No chapter's state is coupled to another's; each clamps independently at its own hidden and revealed ends
interaction_model.state_change: Each chapter's progress is computed independently over its own short scroll stretch
interaction_model.visible_feedback: One chapter can be mid-reveal while others remain title-only or already settled
interaction_model.input: Scroll position moving through consecutive chapters
interaction_model.affected_object: Neighbouring chapters

experience_qualities: Hushed and near-empty, with a heavily suppressed surround
Unhurried and deliberate, rewarding slow input
Directly hand-driven: motion answers the scroll instantly rather than running on a timer
Restless and unsettled during transit, resolved and composed at the end
Legible throughout, with text never sacrificed to the effect
Chapter-by-chapter, each moment feeling individually composed
completion_and_return: A chapter completes when its picture, title words and caption sit still as one finished composition and progress is clamped at fully revealed
Reverse scrolling unwinds any completed chapter back to fully hidden title-only state, exactly retracing the same intermediate points
No looping and no autonomous replay; state is always a direct function of current scroll position
Progress is clamped at both ends so over-scrolling in either direction cannot push a chapter past hidden or revealed
locked_observable_requirements: Reveal progress is bound to scroll position, not to an independent clock; slowing, halting and reversing hold, freeze and unwind it at the exactly matching point
Progress clamps at fully hidden and fully revealed
A chapter's reveal starts only once its title area sits near the bottom of the viewport, driven by continued downward scroll
Pre-reveal state shows the two-word title alone as a centred pair, clearly readable against the surround, with the picture not yet visible
The picture is revealed by an opening that expands outward from the centre of that picture
The two title words leave the centred pairing and end in distinct final positions around the picture
The photograph gradually enlarges and its luminance rises from strongly suppressed toward full across the reveal
Edges read as restless and unsettled during the reveal and resolve to stillness at completion
The end state reads as one finished composition of picture plus caption, not as separate elements
Chapters advance independently, each over its own short stretch of scrolling
Every reveal is fully retraceable to its unrevealed state
Quiet, near-empty opening that signals slow pacing before any chapter
Chapters vary in composition rather than repeating one identical layout
adaptable_details: Number of chapters and length of each scroll stretch
Aperture shape and the exact profile of its outward growth
Where each title word finally lands around the picture
Character of the unsettled edge treatment and how quickly it calms
Exact luminance and scale ranges, hue treatment, and how far the surround is suppressed
Wording of the opening lead-in and the slow-pacing cue
Image aspect ratios, typography and caption wording
Per-chapter compositional variation choices
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits ordered picture-led stories where each beat is one dominant image with an extremely short two-word title and a brief caption, on a page long enough to give every chapter its own scroll stretch. It stays the same Skill across subject matter, colour treatment and chapter count. It becomes a different Skill if titles grow into sentences or paragraphs that cannot be split into placed words, if a chapter must show several images at once as a grid or gallery, if the reveal plays on its own timeline or triggers once and stays revealed, or if the surrounding field carries competing detail and prominence so the picture no longer emerges out of near-emptiness.

name: glass_warped_staggered_image_column
description: Pictures stacked in a left-right staggered column over a slowly drifting low-contrast backdrop, each one arriving swollen and warped as if pressed through thick glass before easing into a clear photograph with a short word settling over it, and a rounded lens of distortion that swells under the pointer and trails it inside the picture's own frame.

canonical_document.name: glass_warped_staggered_image_column
canonical_document.description: Pictures stacked in a left-right staggered column over a slowly drifting low-contrast backdrop, each one arriving swollen and warped as if pressed through thick glass before easing into a clear photograph with a short word settling over it, and a rounded lens of distortion that swells under the pointer and trails it inside the picture's own frame.
canonical_document.experience_scope: Whole-view experience: it begins at the initial view showing the drifting backdrop, the first picture and a downward nudge, continues for the full scrollable length of the image column, and ends when the last picture has arrived; the drifting backdrop and the pointer-driven lens remain available throughout.
content_and_composition: A single full-view backdrop layer whose tone drifts slowly and continuously, sitting behind everything else and holding far less contrast than the pictures in front of it
One vertical column of a small set of pictures (a handful, not a dense grid), each occupying its own vertical band
Pictures staggered alternately toward the left and right of the column rather than centered in a single stack
One short word per picture, overlaid on the picture and appearing as part of that picture's arrival
A quiet downward nudge near the initial view encouraging further travel down the page, present only until movement down begins
A rounded lens of distortion as a transient layer belonging to a single picture, never spanning two pictures or the backdrop
experience_progression: Opening state: slowly drifting low-contrast backdrop, first picture region, and the downward nudge visible
Downward travel begins; the nudge fades away permanently
For each picture in turn: it enters swollen and warped as though pressed through thick glass
The warp eases out and the picture resolves into a clear photograph
The short word settles over the now-clear picture
Attention passes to the next picture down; only one picture is the focus at any moment
Pictures moved past are reset, so travelling back up presents them freshly and replays their arrival rather than showing them as already spent
attention_and_information_flow: Exactly one picture holds attention at a time; neighbouring pictures stay subordinate
The warped, swollen entry state withholds the photograph's detail, then releasing the warp delivers the image content as the payoff
The short word arrives after the picture is legible, so image reads first and label second
The backdrop stays low-contrast and slow, its drift perceptible but always weaker than the picture in focus, so it never competes with it
The downward nudge is the only prominence cue at the start and removes itself once its message has been acted on
Pointer presence adds a local, temporary emphasis on the hovered picture without promoting other pictures

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Only one picture arrives at a time; an arrival still playing can be taken over by pointer interaction on that picture
interaction_model.state_change: From not-yet-arrived to arriving to fully arrived and clear
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The picture appears swollen and warped as though behind thick glass, then eases into a clear photograph while the short word settles over it
interaction_model.input: Downward travel through the page bringing a picture into focus
interaction_model.affected_object: The individual picture entering focus and its short word

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Reset and replay are repeatable in both directions for the full length of the column
interaction_model.state_change: Arrived state is reset back to not-yet-arrived once the picture is left behind
interaction_model.visible_feedback: On returning upward the picture is presented freshly and its swollen-to-clear arrival plays again instead of remaining in a spent, static state
interaction_model.input: Travelling past a picture and later returning to it
interaction_model.affected_object: The passed picture's arrival state

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Moving the input away eases the picture flat again; the lens is bounded by the picture frame at all times
interaction_model.state_change: From flat to locally distorted, with the distortion tracking the input position
interaction_model.visible_feedback: A rounded lens of distortion swells centered beneath the pointer and follows its movement with a soft lag; the lens center stays inside that picture's own edges so it never slips outside the frame
interaction_model.input: Pointer moving over a picture, or a finger moving across it on a touch screen
interaction_model.affected_object: That picture's surface

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: When the pointer leaves, the picture eases back to flat and clear
interaction_model.state_change: Arrival-driven warp yields to pointer-driven lens warp
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The warp continuously becomes the pointer-following lens rather than fighting or double-warping
interaction_model.input: Pointing at a picture whose arrival animation is still playing
interaction_model.affected_object: That picture's warp state

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: One-way; travelling back up does not bring the nudge back
interaction_model.state_change: Visible to permanently hidden
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The nudge fades away and does not return for the rest of the visit
interaction_model.input: First downward movement through the page
interaction_model.affected_object: The downward nudge

experience_qualities: Playful and toy-like: the picture surface feels touchable and responds to being pushed around
Soft and unhurried, with slow drift and gentle easing rather than snap transitions
Tactile and material, as though images sit behind thick, liquid glass
Focused and one-thing-at-a-time despite a long scrollable view
Endlessly refreshable rather than exhausted, since revisiting replays arrivals
Quietly guided at the start, then self-directed
completion_and_return: Each picture's arrival completes in a clear, undistorted photograph with its short word settled in place
Pointer distortion always resolves back to a flat, clear picture when the input leaves
Passing a picture resets its arrival so the sequence is replayable in both travel directions
The downward nudge's dismissal is the only permanently persistent state
There is no terminal end state beyond the last picture having arrived; the column can be traversed repeatedly
locked_observable_requirements: A full-view backdrop behind the content whose tone drifts slowly and continuously, held at clearly lower contrast than the pictures so the drift reads as ambient rather than competing
A single column of a small number of pictures, staggered alternately left and right
Each picture arrives swollen and warped as though pressed through thick glass, then eases into a clear photograph
A short word settles over each picture as part of its arrival
Only one picture holds attention at any moment
A rounded lens of distortion swells centered beneath the pointer or finger and trails movement with a soft lag
The lens center is constrained inside the hovered picture's own edges and never slips outside the frame
Removing the pointer eases the picture flat again
Pointer interaction takes over from an arrival still in progress
Passing a picture resets it so returning replays the arrival instead of leaving it spent
A downward nudge on the opening view that fades permanently once downward movement begins
Touch input places the lens the same way pointer input does
adaptable_details: Number of pictures in the set, as long as it stays a small curated set
Which hue or tonal family the backdrop draws on, whether it reads light or dark, and its drift speed and drift pattern
Lens radius, warp intensity and lag amount
Easing durations for arrival and for flattening
Stagger offset amount and column width
Typography, size and placement of the short word within the picture
Visual form of the downward nudge
Subject matter of the photographs
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits pages built around a small curated set of photographic or otherwise image-like pictures presented one at a time down a long view, where each picture can carry a single short word and the page can afford slow, soft motion. It adopts the host page's own colour scheme, needing only that the backdrop can sit at lower contrast than the pictures. It does not fit dense grids, thumbnail sets or list views where many pictures must be compared at once, nor text-led pages where images are incidental. Removing the pointer-following bounded lens, giving each picture a permanent arrived state instead of resetting it, or letting several pictures hold attention simultaneously would each produce a different Skill.

name: blocks_to_sharp_scroll_lookbook
description: A quiet gated opening gives way to full-screen visual pieces that each enter as coarse blocks of flat, averaged tone and resolve into sharp detail once they are far enough into view, with the piece's name and blurb sliding at a different rate than the image and the run coming to rest on the final piece.

canonical_document.name: blocks_to_sharp_scroll_lookbook
canonical_document.description: A quiet gated opening gives way to full-screen visual pieces that each enter as coarse blocks of flat, averaged tone and resolve into sharp detail once they are far enough into view, with the piece's name and blurb sliding at a different rate than the image and the run coming to rest on the final piece.
canonical_document.experience_scope: Whole-view experience covering the entire scrollable run: it begins with a held, deliberately empty state before anything is shown and ends settled on the last piece with nothing further to reveal. Each piece occupies the full viewport in turn; the effect is not a region embedded beside other page content.
content_and_composition: A small ordered set of pieces (a handful, not a long catalogue), one per full viewport height
Per piece: one large image filling the view as the dominant layer
Per piece: a short text pairing of a name plus a brief blurb, layered over or beside the image and clearly subordinate to it
Image layer and wording layer are offset in apparent depth: they move at different rates so the wording reads as nearer than the imagery
An initial holding state that shows nothing partially formed until the experience is ready to present the first piece
No persistent chrome, counters, controls or navigation affordances are required; the imagery and its wording are the only content roles
experience_progression: Held opening: a quiet, blank-but-composed state, nothing half-formed on screen
Release: the first piece is presented already whole, at full view
Per piece, as it advances into view: coarse block state, readable only as broad masses of averaged tone
Per piece, once far enough into view: an unhurried settle from blocks to full sharpness, so the subject becomes legible exactly as it takes the centre of attention
Resolved state persists for that piece for the rest of the session
Run end: motion settles on the last piece with nothing left to reveal and no wrap to the start
attention_and_information_flow: During the held opening, prominence is deliberately withheld — there is nothing to read or study yet
An entering piece is low in information: broad tone and mass only, enough to sense the subject but not to inspect it
Detail arrives as the piece reaches its dominant position, so peak legibility and peak prominence coincide
The name and blurb stay secondary throughout, drifting relative to the image rather than competing with it
Only one piece is ever the subject; the previous and next pieces are off-view rather than peripherally competing
Once resolved, a piece stays fully legible, so returning upward is a re-reading rather than a re-reveal

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Fully bidirectional and interruptible at any moment; a new gesture during coasting redirects the travel without a jump. Travel stops at the first and last piece rather than looping or rubber-banding into emptiness
interaction_model.state_change: The view advances or retreats along the sequence, easing toward the input rather than snapping to it
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Smooth unhurried travel that continues coasting briefly after the gesture stops and then comes to rest
interaction_model.input: Scroll by wheel, trackpad, or touch drag — the single driver of the entire experience
interaction_model.affected_object: Position of the run of full-view pieces

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: The resolved state latches permanently: scrolling back up finds the piece already sharp instead of restarting the reveal, and reversing direction mid-resolve does not rewind or abort it
interaction_model.state_change: One-way transition from coarse blocks of averaged tone to full sharpness for that piece
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The blocks refine into detail at a calm pace and then hold, matched to the piece settling into the view
interaction_model.input: A piece crossing far enough into view during that travel (autonomous, not a separate gesture)
interaction_model.affected_object: That piece's image

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Instantly and symmetrically reversible — the wording follows position rather than playing a one-shot animation, so it never desynchronizes from where the visitor has scrolled to
interaction_model.state_change: The wording's offset tracks scroll position continuously at a rate different from the imagery
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The text slides as the piece passes and slides back when the direction reverses, reading as a nearer layer over the imagery with enough separation from it to stay readable
interaction_model.input: Continuous scroll position while a piece passes through the view
interaction_model.affected_object: That piece's name and blurb

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: However much clarity a piece has already gained is preserved across the refit; already-resolved pieces stay resolved
interaction_model.state_change: Pieces refit to the new full-view dimensions
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Imagery re-fills the view at the new size with no visible restart, flash of blocks, or loss of position in the sequence
interaction_model.input: Window resize
interaction_model.affected_object: Imagery of all pieces and the layout of the run

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Scroll input before release has no half-formed consequence; the run begins from the first piece
interaction_model.state_change: Held state releases into the first presented piece
interaction_model.visible_feedback: A quiet composed hold, then a whole first piece — never a partially built view
interaction_model.input: Initial arrival at the experience (autonomous readiness)
interaction_model.affected_object: The whole view

experience_qualities: Quiet, unhurried and editorial rather than energetic
Withheld then rewarded — the sense of a subject earning its own legibility
Weighted, gliding momentum with a soft settle instead of abrupt stops
Gentle depth between imagery and wording without literal three-dimensional space
Uninterrupted and clean: nothing is ever caught mid-construction
Finite and composed — an experience with a definite last page rather than an endless feed
completion_and_return: The run terminates on the final piece, settled, with no further reveal and no loop back to the first
Each piece's resolved-sharp state persists for the remainder of the session
Revisiting earlier pieces by scrolling up shows them fully resolved; only the wording's offset replays, and it does so by tracking position
No reset control and no automatic replay of the reveal
locked_observable_requirements: Nothing is ever visible half-formed: a holding state precedes the first presented piece
One piece per full viewport; each becomes the sole subject in turn
Every image first appears as coarse blocks of averaged tone — whatever hues the image itself carries — and later reaches full sharpness
The blocks-to-sharp transition is triggered by the piece coming far enough into view, not by a click or an unconditional page-load timer
The reveal is one-way and latched — never restarted or rewound on reverse scroll
Scroll is the sole driver, eased and with a brief coast after the gesture ends
Name and blurb move at a different rate than the imagery, tracking scroll position continuously in both directions, and stay legible against it
Resize refits imagery while preserving accumulated clarity
The run ends settled on the last piece without looping
adaptable_details: Number of pieces in the run, as long as it stays a small curated set
Coarseness of the initial blocks and the duration of the settle to sharp
How far into view a piece must come before it starts resolving
Amount of coast after a gesture and the easing character of the travel
Placement, alignment and typographic treatment of the name and blurb
Magnitude and direction of the wording's differential drift
Hues, tonal range and subject matter of the imagery, and the means by which the wording holds contrast against it
Presence of an incidental cue that more remains below
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits any small curated run of single strong images each paired with a short name and blurb, in any hue range or tonal register, where the visitor is meant to meet one subject at a time and the imagery can bear being studied — featured products, projects, editorial chapters, photographic series. It stops being this Skill if the pieces are shown together as a grid or a multi-item scroller, if the set grows into a long or paginated catalogue, if the reveal replays or reverses on scroll direction, if clarity is driven continuously by scroll position rather than latching once, if the run loops endlessly, or if the imagery is reduced to a decorative substrate behind unrelated foreground content instead of being the subject itself.

name: scattered_portrait_field_to_centered_focus_column
description: A quiet, low-distraction full-height composition of sparsely scattered portraits under presiding title wording; hover lifts a portrait's luminance and shifts its rendering away from its resting tones, clicking gathers all portraits into one centred vertical column with the chosen portrait held at viewport centre in its unmodified rendering while the wording changes to collection copy, and a dismiss control returns everything exactly as it was.

canonical_document.name: scattered_portrait_field_to_centered_focus_column
canonical_document.description: A quiet, low-distraction full-height composition of sparsely scattered portraits under presiding title wording; hover lifts a portrait's luminance and shifts its rendering away from its resting tones, clicking gathers all portraits into one centred vertical column with the chosen portrait held at viewport centre in its unmodified rendering while the wording changes to collection copy, and a dismiss control returns everything exactly as it was.
canonical_document.experience_scope: A whole-view, full-height experience that begins as a single opening composition occupying the entire viewport and ends when the visitor dismisses the focused reading and the opening composition is restored; both the overview and the focused reading are the same continuous surface, never two separate screens.
content_and_composition: One quiet, low-distraction full-height stage of a single uniform tone — light or dark, whichever keeps the imagery dominant and clearly separated from its surround — acting as the common ground for both the overview and the focused state
A small set of portrait-oriented photographs (a handful, not a grid-scale set) placed sparsely and irregularly across the stage with generous empty space between them
A primary typographic block that presides over the imagery in the opening state: a short label-level name plus secondary season wording
A secondary typographic block used in the focused state: a collection name plus a short statement about the subject matter, occupying the same typographic role and position as the opening wording
A dismiss control that exists only while the focused reading is active

In the focused state the same photographs form a single centred vertical column of equally sized upright frames, with the chosen photograph positioned at the centre of the viewport and the others continuing above and below it
experience_progression: Stage 0: nothing of the composition is shown until the photography is ready, so the first impression arrives already complete rather than assembling piece by piece
Stage 1: overview — scattered portraits under the presiding title and season wording, each portrait quietly inviting closer inspection

Stage 2: transition — on choosing a portrait, every portrait travels from its scattered placement into the centred column while the typographic block hands over from opening wording to collection name and statement, read as one continuous editorial move
Stage 3: focused reading — the chosen portrait rests at viewport centre in its unmodified rendering, the column is browsable as one aligned sequence, and the dismiss control is present
Stage 4: return — dismissing reverses the move so every portrait lands back on its original scattered placement and the opening wording returns, closing the loop
attention_and_information_flow: Opening prominence sits with the typographic name and season wording, with the sparse portraits reading as invitations rather than a dense grid
Pointer presence temporarily promotes a single portrait above its neighbours through a luminance lift and a shift in rendering, signalling choosability without changing layout
Choosing narrows attention from the whole arrangement to one portrait at a time by collapsing scattered placement into a single vertical reading axis
Information deepens rather than duplicates: general label and season wording is replaced by the collection name and a short statement about the subject
In the focused state the chosen portrait holds the strongest position at viewport centre while remaining photographs recede into the column above and below
On return, prominence hands back to the opening typography and the original scattered placement, with no reshuffling of positions

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Pointer leaving eases the portrait back to its resting appearance; the highlight is purely temporary and never persists
interaction_model.state_change: Portrait moves from resting appearance into a highlighted appearance
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The portrait gains luminance and its rendering shifts away from its resting tones while its placement stays unchanged
interaction_model.input: Pointer enters a portrait in the overview
interaction_model.affected_object: That single portrait's rendering

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Re-entering re-triggers the highlight; interleaved enter/leave never leaves a portrait stuck in the lifted appearance
interaction_model.state_change: Highlighted appearance releases back to resting appearance
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The luminance lift and rendering shift ease back rather than snapping
interaction_model.input: Pointer leaves a highlighted portrait
interaction_model.affected_object: That portrait's rendering

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: The move plays as one uninterrupted sequence; activations arriving while it plays are ignored so the arrangement cannot be left half-gathered
interaction_model.state_change: Overview state becomes focused state
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Every portrait travels out of its scattered placement into a single centred column of equally sized upright frames, the chosen portrait settles at viewport centre in its unmodified rendering with no highlight applied, the opening name and season wording gives way to the collection name and short statement, and a dismiss control appears
interaction_model.input: Click or activation of a portrait in the overview
interaction_model.affected_object: All portraits, the typographic block and the dismiss control

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Hover highlighting becomes available again only after the return to the overview completes
interaction_model.state_change: No appearance change occurs
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Portraits stay in their unmodified rendering; the luminance lift and rendering shift are suppressed for the whole focused state
interaction_model.input: Pointer moves over any portrait while the focused state is active
interaction_model.affected_object: Portrait rendering

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: The return plays as one uninterrupted sequence; further activations during it are ignored, and the restored overview is positionally identical to the original so nothing appears reshuffled or lost
interaction_model.state_change: Focused state returns to the original overview state
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Every portrait travels from the column back to exactly the placement it started from, the collection name and statement gives way to the opening name and season wording, and the dismiss control leaves
interaction_model.input: Activation of the dismiss control
interaction_model.affected_object: All portraits, the typographic block and the dismiss control

experience_qualities: Quiet and editorial rather than busy or promotional, with a restrained surround that stays behind the imagery
Sparse and generously spaced, with emptiness treated as composition
Deliberate and continuous: overview and focused reading feel like one sequence on one surface
Choosable: portraits respond to pointer presence before commitment
Composed at arrival, with no visible assembling of the first impression
Reliably reversible, with the opening arrangement preserved exactly
completion_and_return: The focused reading has no automatic end; it persists until the visitor dismisses it
Dismissal restores the opening composition to its exact original placement and wording, making the experience fully cyclical
The cycle can be repeated with any portrait, each time centring the newly chosen one
No state is carried over between cycles beyond the unchanged original arrangement
locked_observable_requirements: A quiet, low-distraction full-height stage of uniform tone, clearly separated from the imagery, holding both states, with the typographic block presiding over the imagery
A small set of portrait-oriented photographs placed sparsely and irregularly in the opening state
Pointer presence on a portrait produces a higher-luminance, tonally shifted appearance that eases back on leaving
Choosing a portrait moves every photograph, not only the chosen one, into a single centred column of equally sized upright frames
The chosen photograph settles at the centre of the viewport and is shown in its unmodified rendering with the highlight suppressed
The typographic block hands over from opening name and season wording to collection name plus a short statement, so the focused state reads as continuation rather than a second screen
A dismiss control appears only in the focused state and returns every photograph to its exact original placement
Activations during either transition are ignored so the arrangement is never left partially gathered
The highlight effect stays suppressed for the entire focused state
The composition is revealed as a finished whole rather than appearing progressively
adaptable_details: Exact number and original positions of the photographs
Precise direction of the rendering shift, amount of luminance lift and easing character of the highlight
Duration and travel style of the gather and return moves
Wording length and typographic treatment of both text blocks
Visual form and placement of the dismiss control
Column spacing, frame proportion and how far the column extends beyond the viewport
Whether the focused column is browsable by scrolling or by choosing another frame
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits any small set of strong, comparable, portrait-oriented images that deserve both a composed overview and one-at-a-time contemplation with a short accompanying statement — collections, portfolios, shoots, artist or venue imagery. It stops being this Skill if the image set becomes dense or grid-like, if the opening arrangement is regular rather than sparse and scattered, if choosing an image opens a separate screen or overlay instead of rearranging the same surface, if only the chosen image moves while the others stay put, or if the typographic block does not hand over to deeper copy as part of the same move.

source_sites.title: Ideas for Grid to Slideshow Switch Animations

name: inertial_center_focus_image_run_with_fullscreen_expand
description: A horizontal row of pictures that slides with weighty momentum under drag or scroll, promoting whichever picture sits nearest the centre while neighbours step down on both sides, blurring and splitting into separated colour channels with speed regardless of which hues the imagery contains, and expanding a clicked picture to fill the view before collapsing back into its place.

canonical_document.name: inertial_center_focus_image_run_with_fullscreen_expand
canonical_document.description: A horizontal row of pictures that slides with weighty momentum under drag or scroll, promoting whichever picture sits nearest the centre while neighbours step down on both sides, blurring and splitting into separated colour channels with speed regardless of which hues the imagery contains, and expanding a clicked picture to fill the view before collapsing back into its place.
canonical_document.experience_scope: Whole-view experience that begins the moment the page is presented, with the run already positioned on a focused picture, and continues for as long as the view is open; the expanded single-picture state is a temporary mode layered over the same experience rather than a separate destination.
content_and_composition: One continuous horizontal run of many visually rich single-frame items of comparable shape, ordered as one finite sequence
Exactly one item at a time occupies the centre focus position and is visibly raised above the rest
Neighbouring items on either side of the focus are progressively reduced and symmetric about the centre, so the focus reads as the peak of the row
Off-centre items remain visible on both edges as evidence that the run continues beyond the current position
No explanatory labels, captions or instructional overlays are required for the arrangement to be understood

The expanded state uses the full view as a single-item stage, held at a luminance that stays clearly separated from the imagery without requiring a dark or light backdrop, while the item's original slot in the run is conceptually preserved
Calm, glassy, low-distraction surrounding treatment separated in luminance from the pictures so the imagery carries the composition
experience_progression: Initial state: run pre-positioned with one item already focused and neighbours visible as context
Traversal: continuous, unhurried horizontal advance whose speed rises and decays with input force rather than snapping between fixed positions
Focus handover: as the run moves, focus transfers to whichever item passes nearest the centre, so promotion and demotion are continuous rather than stepped
Settling: motion decays to rest with the nearest item holding focus and the row returning to crisp clarity
Expansion: a chosen item is aligned to centre and grows to occupy the entire view
Collapse: the item returns into its slot and the run is available again at the same position it held before expansion
attention_and_information_flow: Attention is anchored at the centre of the view, where the focused item is largest and most prominent
Prominence falls off symmetrically outward, making the periphery read as context rather than content to inspect
During fast movement the whole row loses legibility to smear and channel-separation fringing, so detail is only offered once motion settles
Hover raises a single item slightly above its peers, signalling which item a click would act on before any commitment
Expansion removes all competing items from consideration and gives one image undivided attention
Collapse restores the earlier sense of position within the whole run rather than resetting orientation

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Direction can be reversed mid-motion; a new drag interrupts and takes over coasting motion; travel halts against the first and last item instead of wrapping, so the ends of the sequence are felt as limits; ignored entirely while an item is expanded
interaction_model.state_change: Run translates horizontally with weight and continues coasting after release before decaying to rest; focus reassigns to whichever item is nearest the centre
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Pictures slide together; the centre-most item rises above and enlarges while its neighbours step down symmetrically; speed-proportional smear and channel-separation fringing appear and ease back to crisp on settling
interaction_model.input: Sideways drag started anywhere in the view
interaction_model.affected_object: The entire horizontal run and its focus assignment

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Interchangeable with dragging so either input can continue or reverse motion begun by the other; stops at the sequence ends; ignored while an item is expanded
interaction_model.state_change: Same continuous horizontal traversal and focus handover as dragging, with speed following input intensity
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Identical sliding, focus promotion, neighbour step-down and speed-linked smear and channel-separation fringing, resolving crisp at rest
interaction_model.input: Wheel or trackpad scrolling
interaction_model.affected_object: The entire horizontal run and its focus assignment

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Reverts immediately when the pointer leaves; never competes with or overrides the centre focus emphasis
interaction_model.state_change: Item enters a lightly emphasised state
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The picture nudges slightly larger than its current size without disturbing the run's arrangement
interaction_model.input: Hovering a picture
interaction_model.affected_object: The hovered item only

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Traversal inputs are suspended for the duration of the expanded mode so no accidental movement occurs behind it
interaction_model.state_change: Run aligns to the clicked item, which becomes focus, then that item transitions into the full-view expanded mode
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The run glides until the chosen picture is centred, then the picture grows continuously until it occupies the entire view; the surrounding run recedes from consideration through a controlled luminance and prominence drop rather than any particular backdrop tone
interaction_model.input: Clicking a picture
interaction_model.affected_object: The clicked item plus the run's position

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Traversal by drag and scroll becomes available again only after the collapse completes, so the transition is never fought by movement
interaction_model.state_change: Expanded mode ends and the item returns to its position within the run
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The picture shrinks back into its own slot in the row, with the run reappearing at the same place in the sequence
interaction_model.input: A further click anywhere while expanded
interaction_model.affected_object: The expanded item

experience_qualities: Weighty and fluid rather than clicky or stepped
Calm, unhurried and glassy in atmosphere
Physically responsive, with visible cost to fast movement
Self-explanatory: the whole run and how to move through it read without instruction
Bounded and grounded, with the beginning and end of the set genuinely felt
Undistracted and reverent in the expanded single-item mode
completion_and_return: Traversal has no completion state; it rests wherever motion decays and holds that position
The sequence does not loop; both extremes are firm stopping points
Expansion completes when one item holds the full view; collapse completes when it is seated back in its slot
Position within the run persists across expansion and collapse, so leaving a close view resumes at the same place
locked_observable_requirements: Arrival shows one item already focused with the rest of the run visible around it as context
Exactly one centre-most item is focused and raised, with neighbours reduced symmetrically on both sides
Focus is decided by proximity to the centre and changes continuously as the run moves, not by discrete slide indexes
Movement is continuous and inertial, carrying past the end of the input before decaying
Sideways drag anywhere in the view and wheel or trackpad scrolling both drive the same traversal
Smear and visible channel-separation fringing, in whichever hues the separation produces, scale with movement speed and resolve back to crisp when motion stops
Travel stops hard at the first and last item; the run never wraps
Hover enlarges a single item slightly
Clicking aligns the run to that item and expands it to fill the entire view
A further click collapses the item back into its own slot in the run
Traversal input is ignored while expanded and resumes after collapse at the same position in the sequence
adaptable_details: Number of items in the run and how many neighbours remain visible at the edges
Exact spacing, size ratio between focus and neighbours and the steepness of the falloff
Duration and weight of the momentum decay and of expand and collapse transitions
Intensity ceiling of the smear and of the channel-separation fringing, including which channels are offset and in which direction
Magnitude of the hover enlargement
Item shape and aspect handling, and surrounding surface treatment including its tone and luminance as long as it stays calm, low-distraction and clearly separated from the imagery
