Any additional dismissal affordance alongside click-anywhere, provided click-anywhere still works
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits any finite, ordered set of visually rich single-frame items worth both scanning and inspecting closely, where each item can stand alone in a full view and the set is small enough to feel traversable as one run. It suits primary content regions or whole landing views carrying little accompanying text, in any host palette or theme polarity, since only luminance separation and prominence are relied upon. Changing traversal to discrete snapping between fixed positions, making the sequence loop endlessly, orienting it vertically as a page-scrolled feed, removing the centre-focus hierarchy so all items are equal, dropping the speed-linked smear and channel-separation fringing, or replacing the in-place expand-and-collapse with navigation to a separate detail view would each produce a different Skill. Items that depend on reading dense text or on side-by-side comparison also fall outside it.

name: tile_wall_to_fullscreen_feature_zoom
description: A dense grid of miniature image tiles fills the view as an atmospheric wall, then drives apart and enlarges in one unbroken movement until one featured image fills the screen with an oversized name and a row of small preview frames; the reverse movement retraces the same path back to the wall.

canonical_document.name: tile_wall_to_fullscreen_feature_zoom
canonical_document.description: A dense grid of miniature image tiles fills the view as an atmospheric wall, then drives apart and enlarges in one unbroken movement until one featured image fills the screen with an oversized name and a row of small preview frames; the reverse movement retraces the same path back to the wall.
canonical_document.experience_scope: Whole-view experience occupying the main viewing surface of a browse page: it begins after a brief hold that waits for every image to be ready, spans both the overview state and the single-feature state, and ends only when the viewer leaves the page. The two states are modes of one continuous space, not separate screens.
content_and_composition: One image set of many items, rendered simultaneously as small tiles packed into a dense wall that reads as texture and atmosphere rather than as individually inspectable pictures
One featured image from the same set, presented full-frame in the close state as the single subject
Oversized display type carrying the featured item's short label (a name), sized to compete with the image for visual weight
A row of small preview frames near the featured image, showing other items in the set as display-only context
A persistent, fixed pill-shaped badge holding two small view icons, present and legibly placed in both states
Shared spatial continuity: the wall and the featured image occupy the same coordinate space, so the featured image is the wall seen from close range rather than a new layout
experience_progression: A brief opening hold with nothing composed yet, released only once the whole set can appear together
The complete wall of shrunken tiles appears at once as an overview state and rests there
On request, tiles drive apart and scale up continuously, thinning the wall as neighbours move outward beyond the frame
The movement settles with one image filling the frame, the oversized name and the preview-frame row present as the close state
On request, the same movement runs in reverse, drawing the neighbours back inward until the full wall is re-composed at its original density
The two states can be alternated indefinitely; there is no terminal end state
attention_and_information_flow: Opening: attention is held with no content to read, so the wall's simultaneous arrival lands as a single impression
Overview: attention is spread across the whole field; the collection's scale, palette and mood are readable while individual subjects are not
During the movement: attention is carried outward and inward with the tiles, narrowing progressively onto the one item that stays in frame
Close state: attention concentrates on one image, with the oversized name as the second strongest element and the preview frames as a quiet reminder that a larger set exists
Returning: attention re-widens along the same path, so the viewer re-locates the featured item within the field rather than re-orienting from scratch
The control badge stays at constant low prominence throughout and never competes with the imagery

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: The active icon stops accepting presses while the opposite icon remains available, so the only move offered is the return; the transition always resolves to a settled state and never stops part-way
interaction_model.state_change: Overview state advances to close single-item state
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Tiles drive apart and enlarge in one continuous, unhurried movement until only the featured image remains in frame, with the oversized name and preview-frame row resolving in the settled state; the pressed icon becomes marked as active
interaction_model.input: Press of the close-view icon in the fixed pill badge
interaction_model.affected_object: The whole tile wall and the item that becomes featured

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Reverse of the outward move along the same path, so the viewer's bearings are preserved; once back, this icon stops accepting presses and the close-view icon becomes available again
interaction_model.state_change: Close single-item state collapses back to overview state
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The same movement runs in reverse, neighbouring tiles returning inward and shrinking until the full dense wall is re-composed at its original density and position; the overview icon becomes marked as active
interaction_model.input: Press of the overview icon in the fixed pill badge
interaction_model.affected_object: The featured image, its oversized name, the preview-frame row and the surrounding tiles

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Guarantees the two directions never overlap and the view can never be left half-changed; control is re-offered only once a state has settled
interaction_model.state_change: No state change; the input is ignored
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The movement in progress continues unbroken to its settled state with no stutter, reversal or blended motion
interaction_model.input: Any press made while a movement is still running
interaction_model.affected_object: The running transition

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Not applicable; navigation remains exclusively with the two view icons
interaction_model.state_change: None; the frames are display only
interaction_model.visible_feedback: No response, so the frames read as context rather than as controls
interaction_model.input: Press or hover on the small preview frames
interaction_model.affected_object: None

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: The hold is brief and self-releasing; no user action is required or accepted during it
interaction_model.state_change: Opening hold releases into the assembled wall
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The whole set appears together as one complete wall rather than filling in item by item
interaction_model.input: Autonomous readiness of the full image set
interaction_model.affected_object: The overview composition

experience_qualities: Atmospheric and immersive rather than catalogue-like in the overview
Unhurried, continuous and cinematic through the change of scale
Reads as one movement through a single space, never as a cut between pages
Editorial and confident in the close state, from the pairing of a full-frame image with oversized type
Reliably settled: every interaction ends in one of two clean states
Orienting, because the outward and inward paths mirror each other
completion_and_return: No completion; the experience alternates between two settled states for as long as the viewer stays
Return is a full retrace of the outward movement, restoring the wall's original density and arrangement rather than re-building it
The active-icon marking always reflects the current settled state, so the available direction is unambiguous
State is held only for the duration of the visit; there is no accumulated progress to preserve
locked_observable_requirements: The entire set appears at once as a dense wall of shrunken tiles that reads as an atmospheric field, not as a scrollable list of inspectable thumbnails
The change between the wide overview and the single close view is one continuous spatial movement of spreading and scaling, never a cut, fade-swap or page change
The close state settles on exactly one full-frame image accompanied by oversized name type and a row of small display-only preview frames
The return movement retraces the outward path in reverse and restores the original wall composition
Both directions are driven only by two small view icons in a single fixed pill badge, with the icon matching the current state marked active and non-pressable while the other stays available
Presses during a running movement are ignored, so the two directions never overlap and no half-changed view is ever visible
The movement is deliberately slow-paced rather than snappy
The preview frames give no interactive response
adaptable_details: Number of items in the set and the tile grid's exact density, proportions and packing
Which item is featured and how it is chosen
Exact duration and easing of the movement, provided it still reads as unhurried and continuous
Placement, shape and iconography of the fixed badge
Typeface, casing and position of the oversized label, provided it stays oversized
Count and placement of the preview frames in the row
How the opening hold is presented while the set becomes ready
Colour treatment, spacing and framing of the tiles and the featured image
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits sets of visually strong, similar-format images where the collection as a whole is worth seeing at once and any single item rewards a full-screen look with a short label — portfolios, lookbooks, cast or roster pages, product ranges, photo archives. It does not fit sparse sets too small to form a wall, or content whose items require reading rather than looking, since the shrunken overview would lose its meaning. Making the tiles individually selectable, replacing the continuous spread-and-scale with a cut or cross-fade, allowing the preview frames to switch the featured item, or letting the two directions interrupt each other would each produce a different Skill.

name: inline_image_statement_with_block_curtain_detail
description: An oversized gradient-filled phrase with photos embedded among its words; picking one slides the phrase away under a flood of solid square blocks, which then clear to reveal that item's full-screen detail, and a back arrow runs the same blocky passage in reverse.

canonical_document.name: inline_image_statement_with_block_curtain_detail
canonical_document.description: An oversized gradient-filled phrase with photos embedded among its words; picking one slides the phrase away under a flood of solid square blocks, which then clear to reveal that item's full-screen detail, and a back arrow runs the same blocky passage in reverse.
canonical_document.experience_scope: Whole-view experience occupying one fixed, non-scrolling viewport. It begins on the statement screen, spans the covered passage into a single-item detail state and back, and ends when the statement screen is restored unchanged. There is no third destination and nothing continues below the fold.
content_and_composition: Overview: one oversized multi-line statement of a few words, set at display scale across the full viewport, mixing distinctly heavier and lighter weights within the same phrase, with a continuous gradient transition filling the letterforms themselves rather than the background, in any hue pair whose midpoints keep the type clearly readable against its surround.

A small set of photos (roughly three to eight) placed inline inside the statement's line flow, sized and baseline-aligned so they act as words in the phrase; the collection is legible only as part of the sentence, never as a separate grid or strip.
No scrolling region, no persistent chrome competing with the statement; the composition is balanced to fill the single screen.
Detail: one large photo as the dominant element plus an accompanying metadata block naming the item title, catalogue code, author, year and series; a single back affordance is the only navigation.

Transient covering layer above all content: a field of solid, hard-edged square blocks that tile the viewport with no blur, feathering or opacity fade, and enough separation from the content beneath that coverage reads as total.
Only one item is ever open; the overview holds all items, the detail holds exactly one.
experience_progression: Rest: statement screen fully composed, inline photos at normal appearance.
Cue: pointer over an inline photo dims that photo slightly, marking it as openable.
Departure: on selection the statement slides downward out of frame while the square blocks flood in from the top edge until the viewport is fully covered.
Hidden swap: behind full coverage the detail view replaces the overview; nothing of the exchange is visible.
Arrival: the blocks clear away and the large photo settles downward into its final position, with the metadata readable alongside it.
Dwell: detail state persists until the back affordance is used.
Return: the same passage runs in reverse, with the blocks sweeping in from the bottom edge instead of the top, landing on the statement screen in its original state.
Repeat: the cycle can be run item by item through the set.
attention_and_information_flow: At rest attention is on the phrase as a whole; the photos are read as words, so the collection and the message are perceived together rather than in sequence.
Hover dimming narrows attention to one photo and signals depth behind it without changing the composition.
The blocky coverage deliberately extinguishes the previous view, so attention is reset rather than carried across; nothing from the overview remains visible to compare against.
On arrival attention narrows sharply to a single large photo, with the descriptive facts as a secondary read once the image has settled.
On return the full phrase reclaims attention unchanged, restoring the sense of one continuous set to work through.

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Reverts immediately when the pointer leaves; purely indicative and never blocks the underlying selection
interaction_model.state_change: Idle to openable-highlight state
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The photo dims slightly while surrounding type and other photos remain unchanged
interaction_model.input: Pointer hover over an inline photo in the statement

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: The passage runs to completion once started; further clicks during it are ignored so no second item can be opened and no partial state is reachable
interaction_model.state_change: Overview state to covered passage to single-item detail state
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Statement slides downward out of view as solid square blocks flood in from the top edge to full coverage, then the blocks clear and the chosen item's large photo settles downward into place beside its title, catalogue code, author, year and series
interaction_model.input: Click or tap on an inline photo
interaction_model.affected_object: Statement composition, block curtain layer, chosen item's detail view

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Not interruptible; input is ignored until the overview is restored, and it always lands on the same unchanged statement screen
interaction_model.state_change: Single-item detail state to covered passage to restored overview state
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The same blocky passage plays in reverse with the blocks sweeping in from the bottom edge, and the statement screen reappears in its original arrangement
interaction_model.input: Back affordance in the detail view
interaction_model.affected_object: Detail view, block curtain layer, statement composition

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Interaction becomes available again the moment the destination state is reached
interaction_model.state_change: None
interaction_model.visible_feedback: No response; the running passage continues undisturbed
interaction_model.input: Any click while a passage is running
interaction_model.affected_object: Whole view

experience_qualities: Editorial and declarative: the message reads first, the collection second, both in one glance.
Abrupt and mechanical rather than gentle; the screen feels briefly consumed and rebuilt.
Hard-edged and graphic, with solid shapes and no softness in the passage.
Directional and deliberate, with departure and return distinguishable by where the blocks come from.
Focused and exhibit-like in the detail state, one image commanding the screen.
Repeatable and stable, always returning to the same starting composition.
completion_and_return: Each cycle completes at a settled state: either the full statement screen or one fully revealed detail view.
Return restores the overview exactly as it was, with no residual highlight, offset or altered arrangement.
No progress accumulates across items and no item stays marked as visited; the set is worked through by repetition, not by advancing a track.
Exactly one item can be open at a time, so there is no stacked or partially open state to unwind.
locked_observable_requirements: One fixed non-scrolling viewport for both the overview and the detail state.

Oversized statement typography mixing heavier and lighter weights within the same phrase, with a continuous gradient transition filling the letterforms in any hue pair that stays readable against its surround.
Photos placed inline within the statement's line flow so the collection reads as part of the phrase, not as an adjacent gallery.
Inline photo dims slightly on pointer hover to signal it opens.
Transition is a discrete curtain of solid square blocks reaching full screen coverage, never a crossfade, blur or soft dissolve.
Statement exits by sliding downward out of view as the blocks arrive.
The view exchange happens hidden behind complete coverage.
On arrival the large photo settles downward into place after the blocks clear.
Detail state shows one dominant photo plus its title, catalogue code, author, year and series.
Reverse passage is directionally distinct: blocks sweep in from the bottom edge on return.
Input is ignored for the duration of any passage, and only one item is ever open.
The overview returns unchanged.
adaptable_details: Number of items and their inline positions within the phrase.
Wording and line breaks of the statement.
Gradient hues and direction, and the specific weight contrast used.
Block size, grid density, block tone and the order in which blocks fill and clear.
Passage duration and easing character, as long as it stays abrupt rather than soft.
Layout of the metadata beside, below or over the large photo.
Glyph, styling and placement of the back affordance.
Type family and image crop proportions.
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits small curated sets of images where the whole collection can be named in a single short phrase and each item merits a full-screen close-up with a few descriptive facts. It stops working for large or growing sets that cannot be embedded in one sentence on one screen, and for content whose detail needs long-form scrolling text. Replacing the blocky full-coverage passage with a soft fade or shared-element morph, letting the overview scroll, allowing several items open at once, or moving the photos out of the line flow into a separate grid each produce a different skill.

name: featured_photo_collapse_into_grid
description: A full-bleed featured photograph with the collection name spread across it shrinks and rounds down into its exact place inside a grid of smaller frames while the other photos drift forward out of depth and fade up; pressing the toggle again unfolds it back to full bleed with a bloom of brightness as the letters rise.

canonical_document.name: featured_photo_collapse_into_grid
canonical_document.description: A full-bleed featured photograph with the collection name spread across it shrinks and rounds down into its exact place inside a grid of smaller frames while the other photos drift forward out of depth and fade up; pressing the toggle again unfolds it back to full bleed with a bloom of brightness as the letters rise.
canonical_document.experience_scope: A whole-view experience for the imagery region: it begins on arrival in the full-bleed featured state and persists as a two-state viewing surface governed by one toggle; it has no terminal end, since either state can always be returned to.
content_and_composition: One featured photograph occupying the entire viewport in the focused state, treated as the visual substrate for overlaid text
The collection name rendered as individual letters spread across the featured image, sitting above it in layering with enough separation from the substrate to stay readable
A small set of remaining photographs arranged as a row/grid of smaller uniform frames, one slot of which is the destination the featured photo occupies in the overview state
A single labelled toggle control positioned over the imagery, persistent in both states and the only control present
In the overview state the former featured photo is visually peer-equal with the other frames — same slot size, rounded frame treatment, no residual dominance
experience_progression: Arrival: featured photograph at full bleed, name spread across it, attention held on the single image

Toggle press: featured image scales down and its corners round as it travels into its own slot in the grid; simultaneously the other photos move forward out of depth and fade up, and the letters of the name flatten away
Overview state: all photos legible as comparable peers at a glance, name recessed or gone, toggle still available
Toggle press again: the surrounding photos fall back into depth and fade out, the featured photo unfolds to full bleed with a brief bloom of brightness, and the letters rise back into place
Loop: the two states alternate indefinitely with the same coordinated movement
attention_and_information_flow: Focused state concentrates attention on one image and its mood; the name is the only competing information and reads as part of the image
Expanding to overview widens attention outward from one point to the whole set, trading depth of mood for breadth of comparison
The name recedes as the set gains prominence, so textual identity yields to visual browsing
Because the featured photo animates into its own slot rather than disappearing, the viewer keeps track of which image they were just inside
Returning inward re-narrows attention, and the brightness bloom marks the moment the single image reclaims dominance

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: The single-image view is always recoverable by pressing the toggle again; the toggle remains visible and labelled throughout
interaction_model.state_change: Focused state transitions to overview state
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The large picture shrinks and its corners round as it lands in its exact slot within the row of smaller frames; the other photos drift forward out of depth and fade up; the letters of the name flatten away
interaction_model.input: Press of the single labelled toggle while in the full-bleed focused state
interaction_model.affected_object: Featured photograph, overlaid name letters, and the set of remaining photos

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Fully symmetric reversal of the outward movement, returning to the arrival composition
interaction_model.state_change: Overview state reverses to the full-bleed focused state
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Surrounding photos fall back into depth and fade out; the selected picture unfolds to full bleed with a brief bloom of brightness; the letters of the name rise back across the image
interaction_model.input: Press of the same toggle while in the overview state
interaction_model.affected_object: Featured photograph, overlaid name letters, and the surrounding photos

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Guarantees the two states never desynchronize or half-play; the next press after completion is honored normally
interaction_model.state_change: No state change; the press is ignored
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The in-progress movement continues uninterrupted to its end state with no stutter, snap-back or partial play
interaction_model.input: Press that lands while a transition is still playing
interaction_model.affected_object: The transition as a whole

experience_qualities: Immersive and mood-led on arrival — the viewer feels placed inside the photograph rather than in front of a page
Continuous and elegant: one legible movement rather than a page change
Self-explanatory, requiring no instruction beyond the single labelled toggle
Spatially honest — depth, scale and position changes make the relationship between the featured shot and the set obvious
Composed and unhurried, with no visual glitching or competing motion
completion_and_return: Neither state is terminal; the experience alternates between them indefinitely
Each transition completes fully before another can start, so the view always rests in a clean focused or overview state
The focused single-image view remains permanently recoverable
Reversal restores the original arrival composition, including the name spread across the image
locked_observable_requirements: Arrival is inside a full-viewport featured image with the collection name spread across it and legible against it
The featured image animates into and out of its own exact slot within the grid of smaller frames rather than being replaced or cross-faded to a different screen
The featured image's scale change is accompanied by corner rounding in the overview state and full-bleed square-edged coverage in the focused state
The other photos change depth (forward on reveal, backward on hide) in combination with fading
The name is animated per-letter, flattening away outward and rising back inward
The inward transition includes a brief luminance bloom as the image reaches full bleed
Exactly one labelled toggle over the imagery controls both directions
Presses during a transition are ignored so the states cannot desynchronize or half-play
Outward and inward movements are mirror images of one another
adaptable_details: Number of photos in the set and the grid/row arrangement
Which slot the featured image occupies in the overview
Toggle label wording, styling and placement over the imagery
Typeface, size, color treatment and spread pattern of the collection name, as long as it separates readably from the image beneath
Exact timing, easing and stagger of the shrink, depth drift, fade and letter motion
Intensity and duration of the luminance bloom
Corner radius and frame treatment of the smaller photos
Subject matter and aspect ratio of the images
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits small to modest sets of visually comparable full-frame images or media stills where one item is meaningfully featured and the rest are worth browsing at a glance, with a short overlaid title. It breaks down for large sets requiring scrolling or filtering, for mixed-content items needing captions or metadata per frame, or for text-led content where a full-bleed image cannot serve as substrate. Replacing the single shared toggle with per-item selection, adding paging through many featured shots, or dropping the featured image's travel into its own grid slot in favor of a cross-fade would each create a different Skill.

name: scroll_hinged_depth_photo_stream
description: An unhurried endless image stream in which the centered photo is perfectly flat and evenly lit, while the outgoing one hinges away on a single corner, shrinks toward nothing and blows out to a much brighter luminance than the resting image as the next swings forward out of depth.

canonical_document.name: scroll_hinged_depth_photo_stream
canonical_document.description: An unhurried endless image stream in which the centered photo is perfectly flat and evenly lit, while the outgoing one hinges away on a single corner, shrinks toward nothing and blows out to a much brighter luminance than the resting image as the next swings forward out of depth.
canonical_document.experience_scope: A whole-view browsing experience for one media set: it begins the moment the fully prepared sequence appears with a photo already centered and never terminates, since the sequence loops; it has no separate entry animation, end state or exit view. Can also be deployed as a dedicated full-height region whose progression is bound to scroll within that region.
content_and_composition: One media set of a small number of large photos, presented one at a time as the dominant subject of the view
Exactly one focal photo occupying the middle of the view at any moment, rendered flat, undistorted and evenly lit
One outgoing photo simultaneously visible in transition: rotated about a single corner, reduced in size and elevated in luminance toward washout
One incoming photo simultaneously visible in transition: positioned deeper in space and angled, swinging forward toward the middle
A shared depth axis running from far (incoming) through the flat middle plane to the vanishing, over-bright outgoing state

A quiet, low-distraction surrounding field — of any tone, light or dark, so long as it holds clear luminance separation from the imagery — with no competing foreground content, captions or chrome required for the effect
Ordering of the set is cyclic rather than linear, with no first or last item marked visually
experience_progression: Approach: the next photo sits back in depth, angled and lower in luminance than the focal plane, gaining size and flattening as it advances
Takeover: the photo reaches the middle and settles perfectly flat and evenly lit, holding full attention as the single focal image
Handover: as scroll continues, the centered photo pivots on one corner, contracts and brightens toward blowout while the following photo assumes the middle
Continuation: the cycle repeats item after item at a pace set entirely by scroll speed
Fold: after the final item the first item continues in the same motion with no seam, jump or arrival, so progression is effectively unbounded
Reverse travel: scrolling back replays the identical stage sequence in the opposite order
attention_and_information_flow: Attention is always anchored to a single photo — the one occupying the middle plane — because it alone is flat, correctly proportioned and evenly lit

Prominence transfers by physical cue rather than by fading: the departing photo loses attention through skew, shrinkage and luminance washout, while the arriving one gains it through advance and flattening
Transitional photos remain visible but read as peripheral states rather than competing focal points
No progress indicator, count or position marker informs the viewer where they are in the set, reinforcing the sense of an endless stream
The first impression presents a complete, quiet composition rather than a partially populated view

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Fully driven by scroll position, so reversing scroll immediately reverses the same states; the photo can never be left partially collapsed once motion stops
interaction_model.state_change: Leaves the middle: rotates about one of its corners, shrinks toward nothing and rises in luminance toward full blowout
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The viewer sees the focal photo hinge away on a corner, contract and wash out to a far brighter state as it relinquishes focus
interaction_model.input: Scrolling onward
interaction_model.affected_object: The photo currently occupying the middle plane

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Continued scrolling hands it onward through the same departure sequence; reversed scrolling sends it back into depth along the identical path
interaction_model.state_change: Advances from depth, unskews and grows until it rests exactly flat and evenly lit at the middle
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The incoming photo swings forward out of depth and locks into a clean, level, well-lit presentation as it takes over focus
interaction_model.input: Scrolling onward
interaction_model.affected_object: The next photo in the cyclic order

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Backward travel is as unbounded as forward travel, continuing past the first item into the last with no seam
interaction_model.state_change: Every stage of orientation, scale, depth and luminance is retraced in the exact reverse order
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The stream appears to rewind: blown-out shrinking photos unfold back to flat centered images and previously advanced photos retreat into depth
interaction_model.input: Scrolling backward
interaction_model.affected_object: The photo pair in transition

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: No auto-advance, snapping or settling occurs; resuming scroll in either direction continues from the held pose
interaction_model.state_change: Holds its intermediate pose indefinitely at the exact scroll position reached
interaction_model.visible_feedback: A photo rests mid-swing, partially hinged and partially brightened, visibly under the viewer's direct control
interaction_model.input: Stopping mid-transition
interaction_model.affected_object: The photo between the middle plane and its departure or arrival state

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: The same seamless fold applies in the reverse direction when travelling back past the first item
interaction_model.state_change: Sequence order folds back to the first item while motion continues uninterrupted
interaction_model.visible_feedback: No jump, snap-back, flash or reload is perceptible; the stream simply keeps flowing
interaction_model.input: Passing the last item of the set
interaction_model.affected_object: The item sequence as a whole

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Positions remain consistent with the scroll amount so the viewer can always scroll a little either way to recover a clean centered photo
interaction_model.state_change: Every photo resolves to a valid state on the depth path for the reached position
interaction_model.visible_feedback: No photo is ever left stranded skewed, blown out or half-collapsed; the view always shows a coherent focal photo and coherent transitional neighbours
interaction_model.input: Fast flicking or abrupt high-velocity scrolling
interaction_model.affected_object: All photos in the stream

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Scroll control becomes meaningful only once the complete view is revealed
interaction_model.state_change: Nothing of the stream is revealed until all photos are ready, then the composed view appears at once
interaction_model.visible_feedback: A quiet, complete first impression with a photo already centered rather than a progressively filling stream
interaction_model.input: Initial arrival, before the media set is fully prepared
interaction_model.affected_object: The whole view

experience_qualities: Unhurried and meditative, with pace entirely set by the viewer
Atmospheric and restrained, with imagery dominating a deliberately low-salience surround of any tone
Physical and tactile: photos feel like objects hinging and receding in real space
Seamless and endless, with no start, finish or sense of arrival
Directly responsive, so the imagery feels attached to the viewer's hand
Composed and clean at rest, with the focal photo always presented undistorted
completion_and_return: There is no completion state; the sequence loops indefinitely in both directions
Returning is achieved by scrolling back through the identical reversed stages rather than by any jump or reset control
No end-of-set message, boundary bounce or reload occurs at the fold point
Stopping is itself a stable state: the held pose persists until the viewer scrolls again
locked_observable_requirements: Scroll is the single control and drives the entire progression; no autoplay, buttons or drag alternative is required for the effect
Exactly one photo is flat, correctly proportioned and evenly lit at the middle of the view at any resting moment
The outgoing photo departs by hinging on a single corner while shrinking toward nothing and rising clearly in luminance toward blowout, a change readable against any surround tone
The incoming photo arrives from depth with an angled pose that resolves to perfectly flat and evenly lit at the middle
Backward scroll reverses the exact same intermediate states, not an alternative or shortened transition
Stopping mid-transition holds the intermediate pose with no snapping, settling or auto-advance
The sequence folds from last item to first item, and first back to last, with no visible jump, snap-back or reload
Rapid scrolling never leaves any photo stranded skewed, blown out or half-collapsed
The view is revealed only once all photos are ready, as one complete quiet composition
No progress or position indicator reveals the finite length of the set
adaptable_details: Number of photos in the set, as long as it stays a small-to-moderate collection
Which corner the outgoing photo hinges on and the direction of the swing
Exact rotation amount, scale range, depth distance and luminance ceiling of the transition
Aspect ratio and framing of the media, and whether items are uniform or mixed in shape

Surrounding field treatment: any hue, overall lightness or darkness, texture or vignette, so long as it stays quiet enough for the imagery to dominate and keeps the focal photo clearly separated from it
Whether the experience fills the whole view or a dedicated full-height region
Optional minimal accompanying text, provided it does not compete with the focal photo and stays readable against its surround
Scroll-to-progress sensitivity and how much travel one handover consumes
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits any small-to-moderate set of large, self-contained visual items meant to be contemplated one at a time — photographs, artwork, stills, product or place imagery — in a view where imagery is the primary content and the surroundings stay quiet, in whatever palette or overall lightness the host uses. It stops being this Skill if multiple items must be comparable or readable at once, if items carry substantial text or interactive detail that must remain legible during transition, if progression is automatic or button-driven instead of scroll-bound, if the set gains a visible beginning and end or progress position, or if the departure loses the corner-hinge, shrink and luminance-blowout signature in favour of a generic slide or fade.

name: elastic_infinite_image_field
description: A dense, frame-filling field of image tiles that scrolls endlessly in both directions, with each tile stretching along the direction of travel and pinching across it as speed rises, then easing back to true proportions as motion settles.

canonical_document.name: elastic_infinite_image_field
canonical_document.description: A dense, frame-filling field of image tiles that scrolls endlessly in both directions, with each tile stretching along the direction of travel and pinching across it as speed rises, then easing back to true proportions as motion settles.
canonical_document.experience_scope: Whole-view experience that is already active at arrival and never terminates; it occupies the full frame from first paint and has no entry sequence, no completion state and no exit boundary. It can also be scoped to a single full-bleed region if that region is the dominant visual surface.
content_and_composition: Many image tiles as the sole foreground content, filling the frame in a dense field with no visible empty margin at the start
Field extends beyond the viewport in the travel direction so that partial tiles are visible at the leading and trailing edges, signalling continuation
No headings, captions, instructions, counters or progress indicators competing for first attention
Tile set is finite in truth but presented as an unbroken sequence: items already passed reappear later in the same field
Each tile is a single rectangular image cell whose proportions are the deformable visual unit
Persistent elements are limited to the field itself; the composition has no fixed chrome that would frame or interrupt it
experience_progression: Arrival: the field is already dense and mid-content, with no beginning marker
Travel: continuous advance in whichever direction the visitor pushes, at whatever pace they choose
Speed-linked deformation rises and falls with travel velocity as an ongoing, reversible modulation rather than a staged sequence
Wrap-around: content recirculates so travel can continue indefinitely without a terminal state
attention_and_information_flow: Attention lands on the imagery immediately because nothing textual precedes it
Prominence shifts continuously to whichever tiles occupy the centre of the frame as the field moves
At speed, individual images smear into streaks of their own colour and motion; legibility of any single image is deliberately traded for the sensation of travel
At rest, tiles resolve to their true proportions and become individually readable, inviting inspection
No revealed metadata layer: the information gained is the imagery itself, discovered by moving

interaction_model.state_change: Field position advances continuously in the scroll direction; travel speed tracks input intensity

interaction_model.affected_object: The entire field of image tiles

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: A new press during coasting captures the field immediately and returns it to direct control; release always resolves to rest
interaction_model.state_change: Field follows the drag one-to-one, then carries residual momentum on release
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Field tracks the hand while dragging with speed-linked stretch and pinch; on release it coasts and gradually settles rather than stopping abruptly
interaction_model.input: Pointer or touch drag along the travel axis
interaction_model.affected_object: The entire field of image tiles

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Reversal is always available and instant; there is no locked state, no snap-back and nothing to undo
interaction_model.state_change: Direction of travel inverts without hitting or waiting on any boundary
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The content just passed is retraced immediately; deformation collapses through true proportions at the turnaround and rebuilds in the new direction
interaction_model.input: Reversing travel direction mid-motion
interaction_model.affected_object: Field position and tile deformation axis

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Rest is a stable state that can be left again at any moment by any supported input
interaction_model.state_change: Motion decays to zero and deformation relaxes fully
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Field comes to rest with tiles at their natural proportions, showing a calm grid in which each image is clearly separated from its neighbours and readable on its own

Elastic and slightly physical, as though the imagery has give

completion_and_return: No completion state: the experience loops indefinitely by recirculating content

locked_observable_requirements: The field is dense and already fills the frame at arrival, with no intro, empty state or text to read first
No top or bottom boundary is ever reachable in either direction
Content recirculates so items already passed come back around
Tile deformation is tied to instantaneous travel speed: elongation along the travel axis with simultaneous narrowing across it
Deformation eases fully back to true proportions whenever speed drops toward zero
Reversing direction immediately retraces the content just passed, with no boundary interaction

adaptable_details: Number of tile columns or rows and the density of the field

Magnitude and easing character of the stretch-and-pinch response
How quickly momentum decays after release
Surround treatment behind and between tiles — any luminance level, light or deep, provided it stays low-distraction and keeps tile edges separable from one another
Whether an at-rest tile offers a further inspection affordance
Total number of source images and their subject matter
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits any large set of self-sufficient visual items — photographs, artwork, product shots, video stills — where browsing is exploratory and no single item must be found or completed, and where the surface can be given over to the media with minimal surrounding text. It does not fit content that must be read in order, compared side by side, or accompanied by captions that need to stay legible while moving. Introducing real boundaries with a start and end, page-by-page stepping, or replacing the speed-linked deformation of the items themselves with a fixed grid or overlay effect produces a different Skill.

source_sites.title: Sketch 028: Infinite Loop Scrolling (ScaleX and ScaleY Animation)

name: endless_looping_image_stream_with_speed_stretch
description: A screen-filling column of images that the visitor scrolls without ever hitting an edge; the field glides on after input stops, images smear and thin toward transparency along the travel direction at speed, then snap back to crisp, fully opaque stills when motion settles.

canonical_document.name: endless_looping_image_stream_with_speed_stretch
canonical_document.description: A screen-filling column of images that the visitor scrolls without ever hitting an edge; the field glides on after input stops, images smear and thin toward transparency along the travel direction at speed, then snap back to crisp, fully opaque stills when motion settles.
canonical_document.experience_scope: A whole-view experience: the image field occupies the full viewport and is the entire browsing surface from arrival onward. It has no start edge and no end edge, so it neither begins nor concludes at a boundary; it is entered by arriving and left only by navigating away.
content_and_composition: One primary content role: a set of images of the same visual weight, none framed as hero or thumbnail relative to the others
Images are arranged along a single vertical travel axis as one continuous field, read as a stream rather than as pages, slides or a bounded grid

The collection is finite in source material but presented as unbounded: after the last item the earlier items quietly reappear, with no visible seam, divider, counter or 'back to top' marker announcing the wrap
Imagery fills the viewport edge to edge; chrome, captions and supporting text are minimal or absent so nothing competes with the pictures

experience_progression: No goal-directed progression: the stream is a continuous, looping advance whose pace is fully set by the visitor

The loop of content repeats indefinitely, so extended browsing revisits earlier imagery instead of terminating
attention_and_information_flow: Attention is held by whichever image currently occupies the viewport; prominence shifts purely through travel, not through highlighting or scaling of a selected item
During fast travel individual images become less legible as they stretch and lose opacity, so the field reads as texture and motion rather than as distinct pictures
Legibility is restored to the resting frame, making the pause itself the moment of clear viewing and rewarding the visitor for slowing down
Because no boundary or count is ever revealed, no information about collection length or position competes for attention

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Both directions behave identically; reversing direction or interrupting mid-motion takes effect immediately with no lag, queued motion or ignored input
interaction_model.state_change: The field translates along the vertical axis at a velocity derived from the input; all images move together with no independent per-item behavior

interaction_model.input: Vertical scroll by mouse wheel, trackpad gesture, touch drag or keyboard keys
interaction_model.affected_object: The entire image field as one body

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: A new input during the glide is honored at once, either extending, slowing or reversing the travel; the glide can always be cut short by touching the field again
interaction_model.state_change: Velocity decays smoothly to zero over a short interval instead of stopping instantly
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The field glides briefly onward and eases to a halt
interaction_model.input: Release or cessation of input after movement
interaction_model.affected_object: Field velocity

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: The mapping is fully continuous and reversible in both directions, so the visitor can dial the distortion in and out at will simply by changing pace
interaction_model.state_change: Images progressively elongate along the travel axis and lose opacity as speed rises, and recover proportion and full opacity as speed falls
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Faster movement smears pictures into stretched, semi-transparent streaks through which the surround shows; easing off lets them contract back to true proportions and full opacity
interaction_model.input: Travel speed itself (autonomous driver derived from current velocity)
interaction_model.affected_object: Appearance of the images

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Resting state persists indefinitely until the next input, and is re-entered automatically after every burst of motion
interaction_model.state_change: The field enters a still resting state
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Images sit motionless at natural proportions, sharp and fully opaque
interaction_model.input: Pausing (no input, velocity at rest)
interaction_model.affected_object: The currently visible imagery

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: There is no limit, hard stop, edge resistance or bounce-back at any point in either direction
interaction_model.state_change: Earlier imagery re-enters the stream so travel continues uninterrupted
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Motion never decelerates, clamps or rebounds; pictures simply keep arriving
interaction_model.input: Continued scrolling past the extent of the collection in either direction
interaction_model.affected_object: Sequence of images in the field

experience_qualities: Calm and hypnotic rather than urgent
Visitor-paced, with the sense that nothing advances on its own
Physical and inertial, as if moving a weighted surface
Boundless, with no edges, ends or resistance to discover
A clear reward for stillness: crispness returns only when the visitor rests
completion_and_return: There is no completion state, terminal frame or summary; the experience is designed to be left rather than finished
Content loops seamlessly so extended browsing returns to earlier imagery without any transition or reset moment
Every motion burst returns the field to the same crisp, still resting state, which is the experience's stable default
No progress or position is presented to the visitor as something to preserve or resume
locked_observable_requirements: Imagery fills the viewport and reads as one continuous stream, not as separate pages, slides or bounded grid
Scrolling never reaches a limit, dead stop or bounce-back in either direction; the collection loops back to earlier images without a visible seam
Motion continues briefly with momentum after input stops and eases to rest rather than halting instantly
Travel speed continuously drives elongation along the travel axis together with loss of opacity, and easing off continuously reverses both

Pace is set entirely by the visitor; the field never advances on its own
adaptable_details: Number, aspect ratios and subject matter of the images
Column count or spacing of the field, as long as it still reads as one continuous stream
Exact magnitude of stretch and minimum opacity reached at peak speed
Duration and easing curve of the momentum glide
Treatment of the surround behind and between images, at any luminance level, as long as it stays quieter and lower-contrast than the imagery
Whether keyboard, wheel, trackpad or touch is the dominant input in a given context
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits any medium-to-large set of comparable images or visual media meant for open-ended, non-goal-directed browsing with little accompanying text, in any host visual scheme, since the field's surround only needs to read as quieter than the imagery. It stops being this Skill if the field gains real boundaries, pagination or a defined end, if the stream auto-advances rather than following the visitor's pace, if items become individually selectable or expandable so browsing becomes item-picking, or if the speed-driven stretch-and-transparency relationship is removed and only plain looping scroll remains.

source_sites.title: Sketch 027: Infinite Loop Scrolling (ScaleY and Opacity Animation)

name: looping_scroll_stream_with_speed_stretch
description: Images fill the view as one unbroken belt that scrolls along a single axis; items leaving one edge reappear at the other so there is no first or last item, motion coasts to a soft stop when input ends, and faster travel visibly stretches and softens the pictures.

canonical_document.name: looping_scroll_stream_with_speed_stretch
canonical_document.description: Images fill the view as one unbroken belt that scrolls along a single axis; items leaving one edge reappear at the other so there is no first or last item, motion coasts to a soft stop when input ends, and faster travel visibly stretches and softens the pictures.
canonical_document.experience_scope: A self-contained region or whole-view experience that is already populated and in a resting state on arrival; it has no entry sequence and no end state, so it begins the moment the region is visible and ends only when the visitor stops looking or scrolls the region away.
content_and_composition: A single stream of many visual items of the same kind (images), ordered along one travel axis
The stream is dense enough that multiple items are simultaneously visible and the view is filled on arrival, with no visible empty ends
One continuous flow, not multiple competing tracks; items share a consistent presentation so none reads as a special case
One item region occupies the focal centre of travel at any moment while neighbours are approaching or departing
No visible pagination, counters, scrollbar terminus, or progress indicator that would imply a finite extent
Any persistent overlay content stays fixed while the stream moves beneath or beside it, holding enough separation from the imagery to stay readable
experience_progression: Rest: the populated stream sits still, already filling the view
Travel: continuous advance in the input direction with items entering, centring, and leaving
Wrap: items that exit one edge re-enter at the opposite edge, so travel loops indefinitely in either direction with no boundary event
Coast: after input stops, travel continues briefly and decelerates smoothly back to rest
The loop has no completion; the cycle of rest, travel, and coast repeats for as long as the visitor engages
attention_and_information_flow: Prominence follows position along the travel axis: items rise into view, settle into a focused centre, then give way as they move off
Only one item at a time reads as the current focus; neighbours remain legible but subordinate
During fast travel the imagery reads as flowing material rather than discrete pictures, so individual detail recedes
As speed falls, detail and per-item clarity return and the focal item reasserts itself
No information is gated or unlocked by travel; the reward of moving is simply the next image

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Travel is bounded only by the loop, never by an end stop; input can be released at any moment and the stream settles on its own
interaction_model.state_change: Stream shifts along its single travel axis at a rate tied to input intensity
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Items translate together, entering at one edge and leaving at the other in step with the input
interaction_model.input: Wheel or trackpad scroll
interaction_model.affected_object: The whole image stream

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Lifting the finger hands motion over to the coast-and-ease behaviour rather than an abrupt halt
interaction_model.state_change: Stream follows the drag along the travel axis for the duration of the gesture
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The collection tracks the gesture directly so the visitor feels they are moving the belt itself
interaction_model.input: Finger or pointer drag
interaction_model.affected_object: The whole image stream

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Reversal is always available and symmetric; both directions are equally endless
interaction_model.state_change: Travel direction inverts immediately
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The stream turns around without pause, overshoot, or reset, and previously departed items return through the opposite edge
interaction_model.input: Reversing input direction mid-travel
interaction_model.affected_object: Direction of stream travel

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: New input during the coast is picked up immediately and blends into continued travel
interaction_model.state_change: Velocity decays from its current value to zero
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The collection coasts a short distance and eases to a standstill instead of snapping
interaction_model.input: Input stops
interaction_model.affected_object: Stream velocity

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: The effect is fully self-reversing and tied only to speed, so rest always restores undistorted imagery
interaction_model.state_change: Items deform and soften in proportion to current speed
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Pictures visibly stretch along the travel direction and lose crispness while moving fast, then relax back to their settled shape and clarity as speed falls
interaction_model.input: Travel speed (autonomous consequence of movement)
interaction_model.affected_object: Appearance of the individual images

experience_qualities: Calm and unhurried; the rhythm invites wandering rather than task completion
Boundless — no beginning, no end, no sense of missing anything or losing one's place
Physical and weighted, with momentum and soft settling rather than mechanical stepping
Fluid and elastic under speed, so motion feels like a material responding rather than a list jumping
Easy to enter and easy to abandon at any moment
completion_and_return: No completion state and no destination; the experience loops indefinitely
Position is never invalid — any resting point is a legitimate place to stop
Returning to travel from rest requires no re-entry sequence; the stream resumes from wherever it stopped
There is no reset affordance because there is no origin to return to
locked_observable_requirements: The visible collection fills the view on arrival with no empty or unpopulated state
Travel is continuous along a single axis with edge-to-edge wraparound so no first or last item is ever reachable
Travel is endless and symmetric in both directions
Direction reversal takes effect immediately without a pause or snap
Release of input produces a brief coast and eased settle, never an instant stop
Faster travel visibly stretches and softens the images, and they relax back as speed decreases
No visible ends, edges, boundaries, or progress markers of the collection
adaptable_details: Travel axis orientation (vertical or horizontal)
Item count, aspect ratios, spacing, and whether items sit in one line or a broader packed field
Coast distance, easing character, and how strongly speed maps to stretch and softening
Whether a fixed overlay, caption, or minimal chrome sits above the stream
Visual styling of items such as framing, luminance level, and how much the surrounding field recedes behind them
Whether items are individually selectable in addition to being browsable
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits sizeable sets of comparable visual items where browsing is exploratory and order carries no meaning, and where the imagery is the foreground content of the region. It stops being this Skill if the sequence gains a meaningful beginning or end, if travel snaps to discrete positions or reveals boundary resistance, if the loop is replaced by finite paging or infinite appending of new content, or if the speed-driven stretch and relaxation of the imagery is removed.

name: wrapping_tile_field_with_momentum_stretch
description: A viewport-filling dense grid of image tiles that the visitor throws in any direction; tiles that exit one edge return from the opposite edge, fast travel briefly stretches tiles along the direction of motion, and the field glides down to a still, readable rest.

canonical_document.name: wrapping_tile_field_with_momentum_stretch
canonical_document.description: A viewport-filling dense grid of image tiles that the visitor throws in any direction; tiles that exit one edge return from the opposite edge, fast travel briefly stretches tiles along the direction of motion, and the field glides down to a still, readable rest.
canonical_document.experience_scope: Whole-view experience that begins the moment the page appears, with the tile field already occupying the entire viewport and no introduction, instruction or entry step; it has no end state and remains the active surface for the whole visit.
content_and_composition: One primary layer: a dense, gapless-feeling field of many uniform image tiles covering the full viewport in both axes
Tile count is large enough that the field reads as a texture of pictures rather than a countable list; no single tile is privileged by size or position
No visible container edges, page boundaries, pagination controls, scrollbar-as-progress or 'last item' marker
The field itself is the only persistent element; any framing chrome stays minimal so pictures remain the foreground
Tiles remain individually legible as images at rest, never dissolving into abstract pattern
experience_progression: Immediate immersion: the visitor lands already inside the picture field with nothing to learn or dismiss
Impulse: input pushes the whole field along the input direction, tiles stretching while travel is fast
Glide: after input stops, travel continues and decelerates while stretch relaxes back to normal tile shape
Settle: motion reaches stillness at an arbitrary position that is fully readable, not a snapped or terminal position
The cycle repeats indefinitely in any direction; wrap-around means the sequence never resolves into a finish
attention_and_information_flow: Attention is distributed across the field rather than led to a focal point, letting the eye drift tile to tile
Motion temporarily lowers per-tile legibility, so attention shifts to the field's overall flow while travelling
Deceleration returns legibility, handing attention back to whichever tiles happen to be under the eye at rest
New tiles enter continuously from the trailing edges, so fresh content appears without any explicit 'load more' moment
No progress or position indicator is revealed; the visitor is never informed of how much remains

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Continuing input keeps extending travel; stopping input hands off to the glide; direction can be changed at any moment
interaction_model.state_change: Field position shifts along the input direction with velocity proportional to input speed
interaction_model.visible_feedback: All tiles translate together; tiles crossing an edge reappear from the opposite edge so the field never runs out
interaction_model.input: Wheel or trackpad gesture in any direction
interaction_model.affected_object: The entire tile field as a single moving body

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Releasing hands off to the glide; grabbing again mid-glide takes over control immediately with no bounce, snap-back or wait
interaction_model.state_change: Field follows the drag one-to-one, then releases into free travel carrying the drag's speed
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The field appears grabbed and carried, then continues past the release point before slowing
interaction_model.input: Finger or pointer drag across the field
interaction_model.affected_object: The entire tile field as a single moving body

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Stretch is strictly tied to current speed, so it always unwinds on its own as motion decays; no residual distortion persists at rest
interaction_model.state_change: Higher velocity increases travel distance and increases tile elongation along the travel axis
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Tiles briefly smear or stretch in the direction of motion during fast travel and return to true shape as speed falls
interaction_model.input: Fast input versus gentle input
interaction_model.affected_object: Individual tile shapes and total travel distance

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Rest is stable and indefinite; any new input resumes travel from that position
interaction_model.state_change: Velocity decays smoothly to zero
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Travel glides down to stillness and the field settles calmly in a readable state at an arbitrary offset
interaction_model.input: Easing off all input
interaction_model.affected_object: Field velocity and tile shape

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: The visitor always has authority over the field; no input is queued, ignored or blocked by ongoing motion
interaction_model.state_change: Prior momentum is overridden by the new input direction without waiting for the glide to finish
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The field turns and follows the new direction immediately, feeling handed over rather than fought
interaction_model.input: Reversing direction while the field is still gliding
interaction_model.affected_object: Field velocity direction

experience_qualities: Relaxed and unhurried; nothing pushes the visitor toward an end
Boundless, with no perceivable start, edge or dead end in any direction
Physical and weighty, as if a large sheet of pictures is being carried and released
Immediately responsive, never feeling locked out during motion
Calm at rest, always resolving to a readable field rather than an unresolved or distorted state
completion_and_return: There is no completion state: travel loops endlessly through wrap-around in every direction
The experience 'returns' only by settling to stillness wherever the visitor stops, keeping that position as the new resting state
No reset to an origin position, no snapping to a grid alignment and no terminal end-of-collection message
locked_observable_requirements: The tile field fills the entire viewport and is the first thing a visitor sees, with no preceding entry or instruction step
Movement is possible along the direction of the input, with tiles leaving one edge reappearing from the opposite edge so no start, edge or last item is ever reachable
The whole field moves as one body; tiles do not scatter or move independently
Faster input travels farther and visibly stretches tiles along the travel axis; the stretch relaxes as speed falls
Releasing input produces a smooth decelerating glide that ends in stillness, not an abrupt stop
New input, including reversal or a fresh grab mid-glide, takes over immediately
At rest the field is calm and legible, with tiles at their true shape and no snapped or terminal position
adaptable_details: Tile aspect ratio, size, spacing and how many tiles fit across the viewport
Image subject matter and whether tiles carry minimal captions or hover labels
How strongly stretch scales with speed and how long the glide takes to settle
Whether travel is free in both axes or constrained to one dominant axis
Ordering and repetition strategy of the underlying image set
Optional minimal overlay chrome such as a title or a single control, as long as pictures stay dominant
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits any large, roughly equal-weight set of visual items where relaxed open-ended browsing is the purpose and no item needs priority or sequence. It stops being this Skill if the surface gains real edges, pages, a defined last item or a snap-to-item rhythm; if items must be read in order or ranked; if items carry substantial text that must stay legible during travel; or if the field becomes a decorative backdrop behind foreground content instead of the browsing surface itself.

name: inline_image_statement_to_row_index_morph
description: An oversized statement with small photographs sitting inline among the words; on choosing the overview, the words scatter away and the bottom bar drops off-screen while every photograph, including the full-bleed backdrop, travels into its own row of a vertical index whose focused row reveals its number, title and a return arrow.

canonical_document.name: inline_image_statement_to_row_index_morph
canonical_document.description: An oversized statement with small photographs sitting inline among the words; on choosing the overview, the words scatter away and the bottom bar drops off-screen while every photograph, including the full-bleed backdrop, travels into its own row of a vertical index whose focused row reveals its number, title and a return arrow.

A handful of small photographs placed inline within the run of the statement text, sized to sit among the words rather than beside them
One large backdrop image behind the statement that participates as a collection item, not only as decoration
A persistent bottom-edge bar holding the site wordmark and a short menu, one menu item of which opens the overview
Index mode: one full-width row per photograph, including the former backdrop, stacked vertically to fill the view
Per-row revealed text: an ordinal number and a title, hidden until that row is focused

The opening layer persists beneath or behind the index rather than being discarded

Triggered change: statement text scatters out of sight and the bottom bar drops below the lower edge

interaction_model.state_change: Opening state transitions to index state as one coordinated change
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Words scatter out of sight, the bottom bar slides below the lower edge, and every image travels into its own row of a vertical list which then shows the focused row's number, title and return arrow
interaction_model.input: Selecting the overview item in the bottom-edge menu
interaction_model.affected_object: Statement text, bottom bar, all inline photographs and the backdrop image

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Leaving the row slides its number and title back out, returning it to image-only; movement between rows is freely reversible
interaction_model.state_change: Focus indication moves to the pointed row
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The row's number and title slide into view
interaction_model.input: Pointing at a row other than the focused one
interaction_model.affected_object: That row's number and title

interaction_model.state_change: Index state transitions back to opening state

interaction_model.affected_object: The whole view: rows, statement text and bottom bar

interaction_model.input: Pointing at the opening layer while the index is open

Image-led attention with text kept scarce and deliberate
Unambiguous focus in the index
Non-interruptible, settled transitions that never leave a half state
Exact, lossless return to the starting impression
completion_and_return: The forward change completes in the index state with one row focused and its number, title and arrow visible
The return arrow is the single completion path back and reverses the whole change
After return, the opening view is exactly as it was, including image placement within the statement and the resting bottom bar
The experience has two stable resting states and no partially-changed resting state
Only one mode responds to pointing at any time
locked_observable_requirements: Small photographs must sit inline within the oversized statement text in the opening state

Pacing and easing of the change and of the number/title slide

Which row is focused when the index first settles

canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits sites whose collection is a small-to-moderate set of images that can plausibly appear inline inside a short statement and also stand alone as full-width rows, with entries identified by little more than a number and a title. interaction_model.input: Autonomous playback advancing the transition over time
interaction_model.affected_object: The color boundary over the photograph

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Resuming continues from the frozen position rather than restarting; the toggle can be used repeatedly at any point
interaction_model.state_change: Playback switches between running and frozen
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The boundary stops exactly where it stands with no snap or jump, the toggle reflects the current mode, and the playhead holds its position
interaction_model.input: Activating the play/pause toggle
interaction_model.affected_object: Playback of the color pass

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Dragging is reversible at any moment; releasing leaves the frame at the held instant, and playback can be resumed from there
interaction_model.state_change: Transition progress follows the drag continuously in either direction
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The color boundary tracks the drag in real time, moving forward or backward across the frame so any instant can be held still and studied
interaction_model.input: Dragging the playhead along the playback bar
interaction_model.affected_object: The color boundary and the revealed extent of color

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Dragging back inward immediately resumes tracking from the clamped boundary
interaction_model.state_change: Progress clamps at the start or end limit
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The frame simply rests on the fully muted or fully colored image with no overshoot, wrap-around or visual glitch
interaction_model.input: Dragging past either end of the playback range
interaction_model.affected_object: The color boundary

experience_qualities: Calm and unhurried, reading as one continuous pass rather than a sequence of steps
Seamless, with no visible join between muted and colored portions of the same picture
Quiet and restrained, the low-distraction surround keeping all emphasis on the photograph
Inspectable, since any moment of the transition can be held still
Precise and responsive, the boundary answering the drag without lag, snapping or jumping
Repeatable, inviting the viewer to watch the pass again
completion_and_return: The pass completes by draining color and settling exactly on the original fully muted frame, not an approximate or slightly shifted version of it
After completion the experience is immediately ready to be replayed from the beginning
Paused and scrubbed positions persist until the viewer resumes, drags again, or the pass completes
locked_observable_requirements: One photograph only, presented alone against a quiet, low-emphasis surround that stays clearly separated in luminance from the image
The frame starts fully desaturated and ends fully desaturated in the same state
Color is revealed by a single boundary traveling across the frame in one continuous directional pass, not by fading the whole image at once or by revealing disconnected patches
The boundary is seamless: muted and colored areas belong to one continuous picture with no visible edge, misalignment or doubled image
The pass is timed so full color reaches the main subject as its emphatic moment
A slim playback bar below the image with a play/pause toggle and a draggable playhead
Dragging moves the boundary continuously in both directions and any instant can be held still
Pausing freezes the boundary exactly in place and resuming continues from that position
Overshooting either end rests on the fully muted or fully colored frame with no wrap or overshoot
adaptable_details: Direction of the sweep across the frame
Softness or width of the transition band at the boundary
Total duration and easing of the unhurried pass
Exact tone, luminance level and texture of the surrounding surface, whether lighter or heavier than the image, as long as it stays low-distraction and clearly separated from it
Subject matter and aspect ratio of the photograph, as long as it stays wide enough to read the pass across it
Visual styling, thickness and labeling of the playback bar and playhead
Whether the pass runs automatically on arrival or waits for the viewer to start it
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits any single photographic or richly colored image with a clear main subject wide enough that a traveling boundary is legible, placed as the focal element of a quiet section or minimal page, in a host of any theme or surround luminance. It does not fit galleries, grids or dense mixed content where multiple items compete for attention. Replacing the single traveling color boundary with a whole-frame fade, a cursor-following spotlight, per-region toggles, or a scroll-driven sequence across multiple images would create a different Skill, as would removing the scrub-and-hold playback control that makes any instant inspectable.

name: drifting_thumbnail_field_with_framed_focus
description: A low-distraction field of small photographs drifts endlessly in any direction, biggest and clearest at the centre and dissolving toward the edges, while a thin accent marker trails the pointer and locks around one picture that can be clicked open large over a strongly suppressed backdrop.

canonical_document.name: drifting_thumbnail_field_with_framed_focus
canonical_document.description: A low-distraction field of small photographs drifts endlessly in any direction, biggest and clearest at the centre and dissolving toward the edges, while a thin accent marker trails the pointer and locks around one picture that can be clicked open large over a strongly suppressed backdrop.
canonical_document.experience_scope: Whole-view experience: begins with a brief numeric count-up that marks the moment browsing becomes possible, continues as an unbounded browsing field occupying the full view, and includes the enlarged single-image overlay and the return to the untouched field.
content_and_composition: Uniform, quiet ground plane of a single flat tone occupying the entire view, held far enough in luminance from the images that they read as separate from it
Many small images of comparable weight distributed across a field that extends beyond the viewport on both axes
Centre-weighted emphasis: images nearest the middle read largest and most present, images toward the outside shrink and dissolve away
Intermittent electronic-interference flicker layered over the whole field as a mood texture
One thin accent-toned marker as a persistent single-selection indicator riding above the images, distinct from both the ground and the image content
Overlay layer holding one large centred image above a veil that pushes the whole field to markedly lower contrast and salience
Short-lived numeric counter shown before browsing begins
experience_progression: Counter climbs to completion, reassuring that pictures are arriving
