Field becomes live and slowly drifting; browsing is open-ended with no start or end point
Pointer movement produces a continuously updated single framed pick
Selection lifts one image into a large centred view and quiets everything else
Dismissal returns the field intact at the exact position it was left, and wandering resumes
attention_and_information_flow: Attention is continuously pulled inward because presence, scale and clarity peak at the centre and fade outward
The drifting motion keeps supplying new candidates into the high-attention centre
The accent marker makes the currently singled-out picture unmistakable at all times it is over an image
Opening one image collapses attention to a single subject; the surrounding field is suppressed rather than removed
Closing restores the diffuse, exploratory distribution of attention

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Reversing input direction changes course immediately; there is no edge, end or snap-back, so no recovery is ever needed
interaction_model.state_change: Field position advances continuously along the input axis with no boundary reached
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Images slide across the view; those entering the middle grow and gain presence while those leaving dissolve
interaction_model.input: Wheel or trackpad scrolling on either axis
interaction_model.affected_object: The whole image field

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Direction flips take effect at once; releasing simply leaves the field where it is, still slowly drifting
interaction_model.state_change: Field follows the drag direction continuously and endlessly
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Same centre-swelling, edge-dissolving travel as pointer-based scrolling
interaction_model.input: Finger drag
interaction_model.affected_object: The whole image field

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Moving on transfers the frame to another picture; the marker never leaves more than one picture framed
interaction_model.state_change: Marker eases toward the pointer and, on arriving at an image, resizes to frame exactly that image
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Marker glides rather than jumps, then snaps its outline to the picture's bounds; the cursor signals the picture can be enlarged
interaction_model.input: Pointer movement over the field
interaction_model.affected_object: Thin accent-toned selection marker

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Runs indefinitely; user input overrides or adds to the drift without stopping the mood texture
interaction_model.state_change: Field keeps moving slowly on its own and occasional flickers of electronic interference pass over it
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Unhurried continuous motion punctuated by raw analogue-feeling glitch flashes
interaction_model.input: Autonomous drift and interference timer
interaction_model.affected_object: Whole field and its surface texture

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Reversible by a further click anywhere, which dismisses the large view
interaction_model.state_change: Image enters an enlarged centred view; field is suppressed and quieted behind it
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The photo appears large and centred over a veiled backdrop whose contrast and presence drop sharply; the busy field recedes
interaction_model.input: Click on the framed picture
interaction_model.affected_object: Selected image and the surrounding field

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Browsing continues from where it stopped; the same or another picture can be opened again immediately
interaction_model.state_change: Overlay dismisses and the browsing field is handed back intact
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Large image and suppressing veil clear, revealing the field at the same position and scale it was left
interaction_model.input: Click anywhere while the large view is open
interaction_model.affected_object: Enlarged image overlay

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: No accidental opening or dismissal from misdirected clicks
interaction_model.state_change: No state change
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The field is unchanged, making the gaps read as inert
interaction_model.input: Click on empty space between pictures
interaction_model.affected_object: Nothing

experience_qualities: Moody, atmospherically subdued and analogue-raw
Unhurried and endless, with no destination or edge
Inward-pulling, with depth suggested by scale and dissolve rather than framing
Precise about what is currently chosen despite the constant drift
Calm and singular when one picture is open
completion_and_return: The count-up completes once and hands over to browsing
Browsing itself has no completion state and loops indefinitely in any direction
Opening and dismissing a large image is a fully reversible excursion
Field position and drift persist across the excursion so exploration resumes exactly where it paused
locked_observable_requirements: A quiet, uniform ground clearly separated in luminance from many small images forming a field larger than the viewport on both axes
Centre-most images are largest and most present; outward images shrink and dissolve
Continuous boundless panning on both axes from wheel, trackpad and drag, with immediate response to direction reversal and no edge or end
Slow autonomous drift plus intermittent electronic-interference flickers over the field

A single thin accent marker, in any hue that stays clearly distinguishable from both ground and images, that eases toward the pointer and grows to frame exactly one picture, with the cursor signalling enlargeability
Clicking the framed picture shows it large and centred over a veil that markedly suppresses the field's contrast and salience
A further click anywhere dismisses the large view and the field returns intact at its prior position
Clicks in the gaps between pictures do nothing
A brief numeric count-up precedes and gates the browsing state
adaptable_details: Marker hue and accent tone, thickness and easing speed
Number, aspect ratios and spacing of the images
Drift speed and direction, and the frequency and intensity of the interference flickers
Steepness of the centre-to-edge scale and dissolve falloff
Styling and duration of the opening counter
Whether the collection is photographs, artwork, frames or product shots
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits medium-to-large sets of visually comparable images with no required order, presented as the main content of a full view. Replacing the boundless drifting field with a paged, ordered or list-based layout, dropping the centre-weighted scale-and-dissolve depth cue, or moving to a surround that visually competes with the images and adds captions and reading order would create a different Skill; it also does not work as a substrate behind dense foreground text.

name: quiet_lineup_to_isolated_focus_sweep
description: An evenly spaced lineup of captioned pictures that respond on approach with a shrinking frame, swelling image and a name that flicks away and drops back, and that on selection is swallowed by an opaque mass sweeping diagonally across the screen to leave one picture alone on a low-distraction full-viewport ground with an oversized name and two short notes, reversed by a single control at the bottom edge.

canonical_document.name: quiet_lineup_to_isolated_focus_sweep
canonical_document.description: An evenly spaced lineup of captioned pictures that respond on approach with a shrinking frame, swelling image and a name that flicks away and drops back, and that on selection is swallowed by an opaque mass sweeping diagonally across the screen to leave one picture alone on a low-distraction full-viewport ground with an oversized name and two short notes, reversed by a single control at the bottom edge.
canonical_document.experience_scope: Whole-view experience: begins with the browsing lineup occupying the page, expands to cover the entire viewport during the concealing sweep and the focused detail state, and ends when the reverse sweep restores the original lineup unchanged. The lineup region and the focus state are two modes of one continuous experience, not separate pages.
content_and_composition: A small collection of picture items arranged as a calm, evenly spaced lineup with uniform rhythm and no item given more prominence than another at rest
Each lineup item carries an image plus a short name and a few lines of supporting text, deliberately low in visual weight so nothing competes for attention
Each item's image sits inside a frame that can move independently of the image it contains

Focused state composition: a uniform full-viewport ground held at a clearly separated luminance from the picture so it reads as an empty surround, the chosen picture as the single high-salience subject, an oversized rendering of its name, a year, and two short notes
A single persistent back control anchored at the bottom edge of the focused state
A large fully opaque mass that travels diagonally across the whole viewport as the transition layer between the two states
The lineup persists underneath the focused state in its original arrangement rather than being rebuilt on return
experience_progression: Rest: the full lineup is visible, evenly spaced and quiet, all items equal
Approach: a pointed item differentiates itself from its neighbours through frame, image and name behaviour while the rest of the lineup stays calm
Commitment: selection triggers an opaque mass sweeping diagonally across the entire screen, concealing the lineup
Focus: the surroundings are gone; only the chosen picture, its oversized name, year and two notes remain on the uniform isolating ground, with one exit control
Return: the sweep reverses, uncovering the lineup exactly as it was, ready for the next selection
The cycle can repeat for any item with no accumulated change to the lineup
attention_and_information_flow: At rest attention is distributed evenly across the lineup; short names and brief text keep reading effort low and encourage scanning
On approach attention narrows briefly to one item, with the shrinking frame and swelling image drawing the eye inward toward the picture itself
The name's flick-out and drop-back-in re-announces the label so the title reads as freshly delivered rather than statically present
During the sweep attention follows the travelling opaque edge, which removes competing content before new content is read

In focus, information hierarchy inverts: the name becomes oversized and dominant, the picture is the sole visual subject held clear of its surround, and year and notes read as a short quiet caption block
The exit control stays low and peripheral so it is findable without competing with the subject
On return, even distribution of attention is restored and no residual highlight marks the previously chosen item

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Moving the pointer off eases the frame, image and name smoothly back to their resting appearance; repeated rapid entry and exit resolves to the state matching the pointer's current position without leaving the item stuck
interaction_model.state_change: Item enters an approached state: frame eases slightly smaller while the image inside grows beyond its resting size, and the name is replaced by a fresh copy of itself
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The frame contracts, the picture swells and fills more of the tightened frame, and the name flicks away and drops back into place as a new copy
interaction_model.input: Pointer moves onto a lineup item
interaction_model.affected_object: That item's frame, contained image and name label

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Restoration is smooth and interruptible; re-approaching mid-restoration returns the item to the approached state without a visible reset
interaction_model.state_change: Item returns from approached state to rest
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Frame and image glide back to their original proportions and the name settles, with no snap or residual offset
interaction_model.input: Pointer leaves a lineup item
interaction_model.affected_object: That item's frame, image and name

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Activations that arrive while a transition is running are ignored so the sweep cannot be retriggered or stacked; while focus is open the lineup does not respond to pointing at all
interaction_model.state_change: Transition into focused detail mode for that item; lineup becomes concealed and inert
interaction_model.visible_feedback: An opaque mass sweeps diagonally across the entire screen, covering the lineup, and resolves into a uniform low-distraction field holding the chosen picture, its oversized name, its year, two short notes and one back control at the bottom edge
interaction_model.input: Click or activation on a lineup item
interaction_model.affected_object: Whole viewport, the lineup, and the chosen item's detail content

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Presses during the reverse sweep are ignored; once the sweep completes, pointer response on lineup items resumes immediately so the next selection feels effortless
interaction_model.state_change: Focused mode exits and the browsing lineup becomes active again
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The opaque mass sweeps back along the reverse of its original diagonal path, taking the detail content with it and revealing the lineup unchanged in its previous arrangement
interaction_model.input: Activation of the back control at the bottom edge of the focused state
interaction_model.affected_object: Whole viewport, focused detail content and the concealed lineup

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Inertness lifts only when the reverse sweep has finished and the lineup is fully handed back
interaction_model.state_change: No state change; the lineup remains inert
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Nothing reacts; no frames contract, no images swell and no names flick, keeping the focused isolation undisturbed
interaction_model.input: Pointer movement over the lineup area while a detail is open
interaction_model.affected_object: Lineup items beneath the focused state

experience_qualities: Calm, atmospheric and low-noise at rest, with even spacing and restrained captions
The approach response feels tactile and alive: frame and image move against each other rather than scaling together
The name's flick-out and drop-in reads as a small deliberate re-announcement, not decoration
Selection feels like a decisive change of scene rather than a panel opening
The focused state feels theatrical and isolating: an empty uniform surround clearly separated from the subject, one subject, oversized title, minimal text
Return feels effortless and lossless, encouraging repeated exploration of adjacent items
Transitions feel protected and never overlap or stutter under impatient input
completion_and_return: The focused state has no self-completion; it persists until the user exits with the back control
Exit always returns to the browsing lineup, never to a different arrangement or scroll rhythm
The lineup is restored unchanged, including item order, spacing and resting appearance
No item carries a visited or selected mark after return
The cycle is fully repeatable for any item any number of times
Any in-progress approach response is resolved rather than frozen when a transition begins or ends
locked_observable_requirements: A calm, evenly spaced lineup of picture items where each item carries only a short name and a few lines of text at rest
On approach, the frame eases slightly smaller while the image inside grows: the two must move in opposite directions, not together
On approach, the item's name flicks away and drops back in as a fresh copy rather than merely restyling, reweighting or shifting the existing label
Approach responses reverse smoothly when the pointer leaves
Selection triggers a fully opaque mass that travels diagonally across the entire viewport, concealing the lineup before the detail content is read

The focused state shows only the chosen picture, an oversized version of its name, a year and two short notes on a uniform full-viewport ground that stays clearly separated in luminance from the picture
Exactly one back control, positioned at the bottom edge of the focused state
Exit reverses the same diagonal sweep and reveals the lineup unchanged
Activations during any transition are ignored
The lineup gives no pointer response while a detail is open
adaptable_details: Number of items in the collection and whether the lineup runs as a row, column or grid rhythm
Exact diagonal direction, speed and easing of the sweeping mass
Exact magnitudes of frame contraction and image growth on approach
Typographic treatment and scale of the oversized name in the focused state
Wording, labelling and iconography of the back control
Luminance level, tone and any subtle texture of the concealing mass and the focused ground, in either direction of separation from the picture
Whether the two short notes are labelled or run as plain paragraphs
Whether keyboard or touch activation supplements pointer selection
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits small to medium collections of image-led items where each item has a short title, a date and one or two brief notes, and where one item deserves a full-screen isolated presentation: photo collections, project or case showcases, product or artwork lineups. It stops being this Skill if the detail view becomes a dense multi-section page, an overlay that leaves the lineup visible, or a separate navigated destination; if the concealing sweep is replaced by a fade, a card expanding in place or a plain content swap; if items respond on approach by scaling frame and image together; or if the lineup stays interactive underneath the focused state.

name: scroll_scrubbed_photo_crescendo_to_year_index
description: A single continuous scroll moves the page from a quiet full-screen name-and-statement opening, through photographs that expand to fill the view and reach a peak of atmosphere, into a calm year-grouped project listing with small previews as the resting point.

canonical_document.name: scroll_scrubbed_photo_crescendo_to_year_index
canonical_document.description: A single continuous scroll moves the page from a quiet full-screen name-and-statement opening, through photographs that expand to fill the view and reach a peak of atmosphere, into a calm year-grouped project listing with small previews as the resting point.
canonical_document.experience_scope: Whole-view experience covering one uninterrupted page journey: it begins at the full-screen title state on load and ends when the settled project listing is fully composed; the listing itself remains as the terminal readable region.
content_and_composition: Opening full-viewport title layer: one short name/identity line, one short statement line, and one small quiet continuation cue positioned away from the text block
Photograph layer: a small set of images (roughly 3-8) that can occupy the entire viewport, each with its own size, offset, tilt, sharpness and emphasis state driven by position
Peak state: photographs are the dominant full-view content with the title layer no longer competing for attention
Terminal listing region: projects grouped and ordered by year, each row pairing a project label with a small preview thumbnail drawn from the same visual material
Persistent element: the single continuous scroll position that all layers read from, so no layer animates independently
A brief pre-journey hold state on the opening title while images become ready, after which the journey is scrubbable
experience_progression: Stage 1 — calm open: full-screen title and statement at rest, continuation cue present, held briefly until imagery is ready
Stage 2 — entry: as scroll position advances, title recedes in emphasis while photographs begin to grow and shift
Stage 3 — takeover: photographs expand to occupy the whole view, with offsets, tilt and sharpness intensifying toward maximum atmosphere
Stage 4 — peak: the most immersive photographic state, the visual high point of the page
Stage 5 — withdrawal: photographs shrink, settle and lose emphasis as the work index composes into place
Stage 6 — rest: year-grouped project listing fully readable and stable, presented as the natural endpoint
Reverse traversal replays these stages in identical states back to Stage 1
attention_and_information_flow: Attention starts narrow on a few words of type in an otherwise empty full-screen field
A small quiet cue is the only hint that further content exists, without explaining it
Prominence transfers from type to photography as position advances, peaking when imagery is the sole full-view subject
Information density inverts at the end: atmosphere gives way to scannable, factual project rows where images become supporting thumbnails
Revealed information increases monotonically with position: identity, then atmosphere, then concrete work records

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Any input direction is accepted at any time; scrolling back retraces identical intermediate states to the opening view
interaction_model.state_change: Position advances or retreats by an increment; every stage state is a function of this one position
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Title emphasis, photograph size, offset, tilt, sharpness and emphasis, and listing composition all update together in direct proportion to the position
interaction_model.input: Wheel, trackpad, touch drag or keyboard nudge
interaction_model.affected_object: The single continuous journey position that governs all layers

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: The held mid-way state is a valid resting state; resuming input continues from exactly there in either direction
interaction_model.state_change: Position glides to rest at the visitor's stopping point rather than snapping to a stage
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Motion decelerates smoothly and holds an in-between composition indefinitely, with no self-playing animation continuing
interaction_model.input: Stopping input mid-journey
interaction_model.affected_object: All position-driven layers

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Once ready, the journey responds to input from the opening position
interaction_model.state_change: A brief hold on the calm title state until imagery is ready to be scrubbed
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Title and statement sit still and complete; the journey does not begin partway or with unready imagery
interaction_model.input: Initial page load
interaction_model.affected_object: Opening title layer and photograph layer

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Further forward input does not distort past the boundary; reverse input re-enters the journey
interaction_model.state_change: Journey position reaches its boundary and the listing becomes the stable final composition
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Photographic transformation ceases at its withdrawn state; the year-grouped listing is settled and readable
interaction_model.input: Reaching the end of the progression
interaction_model.affected_object: Project listing region

experience_qualities: Calm and unhurried at the open
Directly hand-controlled: nothing plays by itself, everything tracks the visitor's position
Gliding rather than abrupt, with soft settling instead of hard stops
Atmospheric and immersive at the midpoint
Resolving into quiet legibility at the end
Fully reversible and predictable, with no one-way surprises
completion_and_return: Completes at the settled year-grouped listing, which persists as the readable resting state
No looping; the progression has a defined start and end
Reverse scrolling returns through identical states to the original full-screen title
Mid-journey positions persist as long as the visitor gives no further input
locked_observable_requirements: One continuous scroll position drives every visual change; no layer animates autonomously
The journey opens on a full-viewport title with a short statement and a quiet continuation cue
Photographs must at some point occupy the entire view and reach an identifiable atmospheric peak
Photograph size, offset, tilt, sharpness and emphasis are all functions of the same position
Imagery withdraws as the work listing arrives; the listing is the terminal readable state
Final listing groups items by year and pairs each with a small preview
Motion eases to rest and holds any mid-journey position
Reverse scrolling reproduces identical intermediate states
Scrolling alone is sufficient to traverse the entire experience
adaptable_details: Number of photographs and their subject matter
Typographic treatment, wording and language of the title and statement
Visual form of the continuation cue
Exact easing feel and total scroll length of the journey
Magnitude of tilt, offset and sharpness change at the peak
Layout of the final listing rows and thumbnail shape or size
Grouping label style for years
Color palette and background treatment
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits any page that pairs a short identity or headline statement with a small set of strong photographic or image-based work samples and ends in a compact, factual index of those items; the image set must be small enough to transform meaningfully at full-view scale. Replacing scroll-position scrubbing with autonomous playback, removing the full-view photographic peak, or ending on something other than a settled compact index of the same items would produce a different Skill.

name: cinematic_scroll_descent_photo_sequence
description: A slow, momentum-smoothed descent through a photo collection where one large image dominates at a time, departing entries stretch taller and dissolve while their number and title slip upward behind a clean cut-off edge, and a persistent oversized headline drifts sideways in proportion to overall progress.

canonical_document.name: cinematic_scroll_descent_photo_sequence
canonical_document.description: A slow, momentum-smoothed descent through a photo collection where one large image dominates at a time, departing entries stretch taller and dissolve while their number and title slip upward behind a clean cut-off edge, and a persistent oversized headline drifts sideways in proportion to overall progress.
canonical_document.experience_scope: Whole-view experience beginning once the full set is available and the first entry is settled, spanning the entire scrollable collection through to the last entry; the drifting headline and the always-visible view controls persist across the whole view.
content_and_composition: One photo per entry, sized so a single entry dominates the viewport at any moment
An ordered sequence of many entries stacked along the vertical scroll flow
Per entry: an index number and a short title forming a small caption block, clipped by a fixed straight cut-off edge so text can never overflow past it
One persistent oversized headline spanning the view width behind or above the photo sequence, offset horizontally
One persistent small pair of view controls, always visible, unaffected by scroll position
Space above the current entry occupied by receding, dissolving earlier entries
experience_progression: Arrival: the next photo enters at full presence with its number and title fully legible
Hold: the photo dominates the view while scrolling is slow or paused, unhurried and quiet
Passing: as the entry rises past, its photo stretches taller and fades toward transparency while the number and title slide upward and disappear behind the cut-off edge
Continuous: the headline shifts sideways proportionally to overall scroll progress from the first entry to the last
End: the final entry becomes the resting point; the sequence does not loop back to the start
attention_and_information_flow: Attention always rests on the entry that is arriving; departing entries lose mass and contrast so they never compete
Caption information is revealed and withdrawn by masked upward motion, so a number and title read clearly only while their photo is current
The headline is a low-priority, continuously moving binding element that communicates overall position without carrying entry-level information
Legible density stays deliberately low: one entry's content at a time

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Fully reversible at any moment; scrolling back restores earlier entries to full presence and brings their captions back down from behind the edge; released input decelerates to rest instead of snapping
interaction_model.state_change: Sequence offset advances or retreats with smoothed momentum that keeps easing after input stops
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Photos glide rather than jump; the arriving photo settles into dominance while the passing photo stretches and fades and its caption slides behind the cut-off edge
interaction_model.input: Vertical scroll by wheel, touch drag or key
interaction_model.affected_object: Position of the whole entry sequence

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Drift is bounded at both ends of the collection and retraces exactly when scrolling upward
interaction_model.state_change: Horizontal offset changes in proportion to total progress
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The headline drifts sideways continuously as the reader descends
interaction_model.input: Overall scroll progress across the collection acting as an autonomous driver
interaction_model.affected_object: Persistent oversized headline

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Symmetric on reverse scroll, so a departed entry can be recovered to full presence
interaction_model.state_change: Transition from present to departed
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Photo grows taller while fading out; number and title travel upward and are clipped away by the straight cut-off edge
interaction_model.input: An entry crossing the exit region near the top of the view
interaction_model.affected_object: That entry's photo and caption block

experience_qualities: Calm and unhurried
Cinematic single-subject focus
Weighty, inertial movement
Quietly progressive, with a sense of descending through a set
Editorial restraint in typography and caption reveal
completion_and_return: Reaching the last entry rests at the end of the sequence without looping
Scroll offset is the meaningful persistent state
Returning to the experience restores the exact paused offset with the same entry current and the headline at the matching drift position
locked_observable_requirements: Exactly one large photo is dominant at any moment
Scrolling is smoothed with momentum rather than instant or snapped
A departing photo becomes taller while fading out
Number and title move upward and are clipped by a fixed straight cut-off edge, never crossing it
A persistent headline is displaced horizontally in proportion to total scroll progress
The view controls remain visible throughout the sequence
The reader's exact position is preserved on return
adaptable_details: Photo count, aspect ratio and crop
Easing curves and duration of the momentum
Headline wording, typeface and drift direction
Number formatting and caption placement relative to the photo
Palette, surround tone and background treatment, so long as the arriving entry reads with clear separation from a low-distraction surround
Position and iconography of the view controls
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits any ordered set of single hero images paired with short titles, such as project sets, editorial chapters or product stories, where slow single-subject reading is desirable. Showing several items per screen for comparison, entries with long text that must stay legible while moving, or discrete snap paging without inertial continuity would each create a different skill.

name: typographic_index_peek_to_focused_set
description: A calm list of large text entries; pointing at one brings its thumbnails in one after another and swaps its lettering, and pressing it makes the rest of the list clear away while that entry's images fill the view large and alone, dismissed by a close control in the top-right corner.

canonical_document.name: typographic_index_peek_to_focused_set
canonical_document.description: A calm list of large text entries; pointing at one brings its thumbnails in one after another and swaps its lettering, and pressing it makes the rest of the list clear away while that entry's images fill the view large and alone, dismissed by a close control in the top-right corner.
canonical_document.experience_scope: Whole-view experience with two coordinated modes: it begins at the quiet full list of entries, extends through per-entry peeking, continues into the opened full-view presentation of one entry's image set, and ends when the close control restores the original list.
content_and_composition: One vertical list of text entries, each a title rendered at typographic prominence with no imagery visible on arrival
Each entry owns a small set of thumbnail images that exist only as a peek layer near or within that entry's row while it is pointed at
Each entry title has two lettering states: the resting state and the swapped state used while pointed at
Opened mode presents one entry's image set at large scale as the sole occupant of the view, with the remaining entries no longer competing for space or attention
A single persistent close control anchored in the top-right corner of the opened view
Nothing else is foregrounded on arrival; the composition stays text-led and uncluttered until the visitor points or presses
experience_progression: Arrival: silent typographic list, no imagery, no element demanding attention
Peek: a pointed entry introduces its thumbnails one after another and its title changes lettering; withdrawing the pointer reverses both in the same terms
Commit: pressing an entry causes the surrounding entries to gather out of the way and the chosen image set to arrive large and alone
Study: the opened set is held stable and comfortable to examine, uninterrupted by list behavior
Return: the close control collapses the opened view and the list reappears exactly as it was before opening
attention_and_information_flow: Attention starts evenly distributed and low-energy because only lettering is present
Pointing concentrates attention on one entry through the sequential arrival of its thumbnails plus the lettering change, making that entry read as openable
Because entries respond independently, only the pointed entry gains prominence and the others stay at rest
Committing collapses attention to a single subject: peripheral entries surrender prominence and image content becomes the whole of the view
Returning restores the previous distribution of attention with no new information introduced

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Peeking is transient and non-committal; a second entry can take over the peek without disturbing the first beyond its own reversal
interaction_model.state_change: Entry moves from resting to peeking state, independently of every other entry
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Its thumbnails appear one after another rather than all at once, and its title swaps to the alternate lettering
interaction_model.input: Pointer enters an entry
interaction_model.affected_object: That entry's thumbnail peek layer and its title lettering

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Fully reversible; leaving always resolves the entry back to its arrival appearance
interaction_model.state_change: Entry returns from peeking to resting state
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Thumbnails withdraw and the lettering reverts, reversing the same treatment that introduced them
interaction_model.input: Pointer leaves an entry
interaction_model.affected_object: That entry's thumbnail peek layer and its title lettering

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: A further press during an unfinished open is ignored outright rather than queued for later, so no second transition can stack
interaction_model.state_change: List mode transitions to opened mode for that entry
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The other entries gather out of the way and the chosen image set arrives large and alone in the view, with a close control present in the top-right corner
interaction_model.input: Press anywhere on an entry
interaction_model.affected_object: The list as a whole and the pressed entry's image set

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: A further press during an unfinished close is ignored rather than queued; the return is the only exit and always lands on the unchanged list
interaction_model.state_change: Opened mode transitions back to list mode
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The large set departs and the list is shown again in exactly its prior arrangement and resting appearance
interaction_model.input: Press the top-right close control
interaction_model.affected_object: Opened image set and the underlying list

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Peek responsiveness resumes automatically once the list is returned to
interaction_model.state_change: Peek behavior is suspended for the duration of the opened mode
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Entries do not restyle or reveal thumbnails; nothing behind the opened set flickers or competes
interaction_model.input: Pointing at entries while one is open
interaction_model.affected_object: All list entries

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Normal scrolling of the list is restored on close
interaction_model.state_change: Background scrolling is disallowed while opened
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The page behind stays fixed so the enlarged set remains the stable subject
interaction_model.input: Scroll attempt while one entry is open
interaction_model.affected_object: The view behind the opened set

experience_qualities: Calm and typographic on arrival, with nothing competing for attention
Entries feel self-introducing: a quick glimpse suggests there is more worth opening
Sequential rather than simultaneous reveal gives the peek an unhurried cadence
Committing feels like everything else steps aside, leaving the chosen set solitary and comfortable to study
Return feels effortless and lossless
Transitions feel deliberate and uninterruptible rather than jumpy
completion_and_return: Peeking has no completion state; it resolves back to rest whenever the pointer leaves
Opened mode completes only through the top-right close control
Return restores the list exactly as it was, including scroll position and resting entry appearance
Transitions in progress complete on their own terms and absorb further presses without deferring them
No progress or selection is retained after return beyond the list's prior state
locked_observable_requirements: Arrival view is text-only and quiet, with entry imagery hidden until pointed at
Pointing an entry both reveals its thumbnails one after another and swaps that entry's lettering; leaving reverses both
Entries respond to pointing independently of one another
Pressing anywhere on an entry opens it; the remaining entries clear away and the chosen image set is presented large and alone
A close control sits in the top-right corner of the opened view and returns to the list
While opened, entries stop reacting to pointing and the view behind cannot be scrolled
Presses during an unfinished open or close are ignored, never queued
Return leaves the list in exactly its previous state
adaptable_details: Number of entries and number of thumbnails per entry
Exact lettering change used for the swapped title state
Placement, size and arrangement of the peeking thumbnails relative to the entry
Layout of the enlarged set in the opened view
Timing, easing and spacing of the sequential reveal and of the open and close transitions
Visual form of the close control
Typeface, color treatment and spacing of the list, provided titles stay legible against their surround
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits any collection whose items can be named as a short text entry and shown as a small group of images or comparable visual pieces worth viewing enlarged in isolation, and where a quiet text-first arrival is desirable. It stops being this Skill if imagery is visible for all entries at rest, if entries reveal only on press rather than on pointing, if the peek does not include a lettering change, if opening keeps the rest of the list co-present and competing instead of clearing it away, or if the chosen item is shown on a separate destination view rather than taking over the same view with a corner return.

name: lofi_glitch_twin_hover_gallery
description: A quiet grid of captioned photographs where the pointed-at photo dissolves into a chunky, blocky version of itself, leaning away into depth while horizontal strips of it jump and have their colour channels displaced, and its credit line switches to a clearly distinct accent treatment, restoring instantly on exit.

canonical_document.name: lofi_glitch_twin_hover_gallery
canonical_document.description: A quiet grid of captioned photographs where the pointed-at photo dissolves into a chunky, blocky version of itself, leaning away into depth while horizontal strips of it jump and have their colour channels displaced, and its credit line switches to a clearly distinct accent treatment, restoring instantly on exit.
canonical_document.experience_scope: A region experience: the works gallery section of a single-page view, framed above by an opening typographic statement with an identity line and an invitation and below by a short closing passage. The per-item effect begins the moment the pointer enters one work's area and ends when it leaves; the rest of the view is untouched.
content_and_composition: Many comparable work entries arranged for scanning, all sharing one visual baseline treatment.
Each entry: exactly one polished photograph plus a credit block naming the maker, the work title and the year.
Each entry carries a hidden coarse, blocky low-fidelity twin of its own photograph, occupying the same footprint as the photograph so the swap does not shift layout.
At most one entry is in the transformed state at any time; all other entries remain in the calm legible baseline.
Persistent page framing: loud oversized typographic statement with a one-line self-description and a join invitation above the gallery; a short poetic passage after the gallery.
Layer relationship inside an entry: photograph and blocky twin share one slot, the credit block sits adjacent and stays in place through the swap.
experience_progression: Baseline: the whole set reads as a calm, legible, evenly weighted collection with comfortable text contrast against a low-distraction surround.
Pointer settles on one entry: its photograph fades out and the blocky twin takes its place in the same slot.
The twin is pitched back into depth, as a plane laying away from the viewer, while the credit text flips to a high-salience accent clearly separated from its baseline treatment.
Sustained state: horizontal slices of the twin jump out of alignment and their colour channels are displaced continuously for as long as the pointer rests there.
Pointer leaves: instability stops at once and the photograph returns, the entry recomposing into the baseline so the set stays easy to scan.
attention_and_information_flow: Only the touched entry becomes loud and unstable; prominence is created by contrast with its still neighbours rather than by dimming or hiding them.
The credit line gains prominence through its accent state exactly when the image becomes least readable, keeping attribution the legible anchor of the disturbed entry.
Neighbouring entries remain fully legible throughout, so scanning can resume without waiting.
No new information is revealed by the effect; the same picture and the same credit are restated in a raw register.

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Entering a different work while one is active hands the state over cleanly; only one work is ever transformed
interaction_model.state_change: Entry moves from polished baseline to raw transformed state
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Photograph fades out as the blocky twin of the same picture appears in its place, tilted back into depth; credit text switches to a distinct accent state readable against its surround
interaction_model.input: Pointer enters one work's area
interaction_model.affected_object: That work's photograph and its credit text

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Instability is bound to pointer presence and never continues past it
interaction_model.state_change: Sustained instability rather than a one-shot transition
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Horizontal slices of the image jump sideways out of alignment and their colour channels separate, repeating for the whole duration of the rest
interaction_model.input: Pointer continues to rest on the transformed work
interaction_model.affected_object: The blocky twin image

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Restoration is immediate rather than easing out, so a fast pass over the set leaves nothing altered
interaction_model.state_change: Transformed state ends and baseline is reinstated
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Slice jumping and channel separation stop immediately, the photograph is shown again, the tilt is gone and the credit returns to its baseline treatment
interaction_model.input: Pointer leaves the work
interaction_model.affected_object: That work's image and credit text

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Interrupting a transition mid-way still resolves to the correct state for the current pointer position
interaction_model.state_change: Each entry transforms and restores independently without accumulating
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The raw state follows the cursor from work to work; no work is left stuck tilted, blocky or noisy behind it
interaction_model.input: Rapid entry into several works in quick succession
interaction_model.affected_object: All entries in the set

experience_qualities: Calm and legible by default, deliberately raw and unstable on contact.
Lo-fi, degraded, slightly broken character set against a polished source image.
Depth from the backward-leaning plane rather than from scaling or shadow.
Immediate and forgiving: no lag on exit, no residue after fast browsing.
Offbeat and expressive without sacrificing the scannability of the set.
completion_and_return: No completion or terminal state; the effect loops for as long as the pointer rests and ends when it leaves.
Every entry returns exactly to its baseline appearance; nothing about the effect persists after exit.
State is per entry and is not remembered on a later visit to the same entry.
locked_observable_requirements: The substituted image must be a coarse, blocky, low-fidelity rendering of the same picture, not a different image or a purely abstract overlay.
The swap happens in place, with the photograph fading out as the twin appears, and does not move surrounding content.
The transformed image leans back into depth like a plane laying away from the viewer.
Horizontal slice displacement combined with visible colour-channel displacement in those slices continues for the whole time the pointer rests, not as a single pulse; any hue set may carry it.
Credit text changes to a clearly distinct, higher-salience accent state while the entry is transformed, in whatever hue the host uses, and stays readable against its surround.
Only the pointed-at entry changes; the rest of the set stays in its calm legible state.
Leaving restores the photograph immediately and stops all instability; rapid successive entries never leave an entry stuck.
adaptable_details: Grid or list arrangement, column count and number of entries.
Coarseness of the blocky rendering and how strongly slices displace.
Tilt angle and direction of the backward lean.
Accent hue and the hues involved in the channel displacement, fade duration and rhythm of the slice jumps.
Credit field labels and ordering, typography and image aspect ratio.
Wording and styling of the opening statement and closing passage.
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits any set of image-led entries with short attribution or caption text where a raw, imperfect aesthetic is welcome and the set must stay scannable, under any host palette, light or dark surround. Turning the effect into a full-view takeover, making the instability run without pointer presence, applying the degraded treatment to all entries at once, or driving it on text-only or non-image content would create a different Skill.

name: momentum_gallery_stepping_into_reading_view
description: A weighty, eased-momentum vertical sequence of single full-view pictures whose images stretch taller as they travel and whose names drift upward past them; picking one lets that same picture glide and reshape into a reading layout as neighbours slide away and the full text arrives a beat later, with a back control replaying the motion in reverse to the exact paused position.

canonical_document.name: momentum_gallery_stepping_into_reading_view
canonical_document.description: A weighty, eased-momentum vertical sequence of single full-view pictures whose images stretch taller as they travel and whose names drift upward past them; picking one lets that same picture glide and reshape into a reading layout as neighbours slide away and the full text arrives a beat later, with a back control replaying the motion in reverse to the exact paused position.
canonical_document.experience_scope: A whole-view browsing region that fills the viewport and owns vertical scrolling, extending into an overlaid reading state built from the selected item's own picture; it begins when the sequence enters the view and ends when the visitor returns from the reading state to the same scroll position, so browsing and reading are two modes of one continuous region.
content_and_composition: One primary visual subject at a time occupies the dominant area of the view, with the surrounding sequence items positioned above and below it in a single vertical order
Each subject pairs its picture with a short name and a single-line supporting note, kept close to the picture as its label
The picture is the persistent element across both modes: the same image object that was browsed becomes the image in the reading arrangement
The reading state adds a longer description block, an author or contributor credit line, and a small set of a few additional detail images belonging to the same subject
The reading state also carries one persistent return control
Neighbouring sequence items are treated as a clearable surrounding layer that yields vertical space to the reading arrangement
experience_progression: Sequence browsing: subjects advance one at a time with slow, weighty easing; the item in transit stretches vertically from its top edge while its name drifts up past the picture
Commitment: the chosen picture is singled out; neighbouring items slide vertically out of the way and background scrolling locks
Settling: the selected picture moves and reshapes into its reading position and comes to rest
Delayed arrival: the long description, credit and extra detail shots appear a beat after the picture settles, each legible as it comes to rest rather than while still moving
Return: the same choreography plays backwards, the picture travels back to its place in the sequence, and browsing resumes at the identical offset and stretch state
attention_and_information_flow: Only one subject is ever competing for attention during browsing; the short name and one-line note give just enough identity to keep the picture primary
Vertical stretch and the drifting name signal travel and progress without adding separate progress indicators
On commitment, prominence collapses onto the single picture as competing neighbours leave the view
Information deepens in stages: image first, then extended reading text, credit and supporting detail shots, so the visitor reads only after the visual has stabilised
On return, attention is handed straight back to the subject that was being viewed, with no reorientation or lost place

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Motion is continuously interruptible by further scrolling; stretch and drift resolve back to the resting presentation as movement settles
interaction_model.state_change: Scroll offset advances with eased momentum and continuous deceleration instead of discrete jumps
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Subjects glide through the view with a slow, weighty feel; the travelling picture stretches taller from its top edge and its name drifts upward past the picture
interaction_model.input: Vertical scroll or wheel/drag gesture over the browsing region
interaction_model.affected_object: The sequence of picture-plus-label subjects

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Input arriving during the transition is ignored so overlapping transitions cannot interleave; the state resolves fully before further commands are accepted
interaction_model.state_change: The region enters the reading state for that subject and background scrolling locks
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Neighbouring items slide vertically out of the way, the selected picture moves and reshapes into its reading position, and the long description, credit and extra detail shots arrive a beat later and come to rest legibly
interaction_model.input: Selecting a picture in the sequence
interaction_model.affected_object: The selected picture, the neighbouring sequence items, and background scrolling

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Scrolling unlocks at the same offset and the same stretch presentation as before; input during the reverse transition is ignored, and the experience always lands in a valid browsing or reading state rather than a partial one
interaction_model.state_change: The reading state reverses back to browsing at the previously paused position
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The reading content leaves, the picture travels and reshapes back into its original place in the sequence, neighbours slide back in, and browsing appears exactly where it paused
interaction_model.input: Activating the return control in the reading state
interaction_model.affected_object: The expanded picture, the accompanying reading content, the neighbouring items, and scroll locking

experience_qualities: Slow, weighty and gallery-calm rather than snappy
Single-subject focus with nothing competing for attention
Physically continuous: the same picture is carried between browsing and reading rather than swapped
A sense of stepping into a subject and being handed back to exactly where you left
Staged legibility, where text becomes readable only after it stops moving
Predictable and unbreakable, because transitions cannot overlap
completion_and_return: The reading state is complete once the picture has settled and the description, credit and detail shots have arrived at rest
Returning restores the browsing mode at the identical scroll offset and the identical stretch presentation of the subject
Browsing position persists across any number of enter/return cycles; nothing is reloaded or reset
Browsing itself has no terminal state; it simply continues through the sequence
locked_observable_requirements: One subject at a time owns the view, paired with a short name and a one-line note
Scrolling advances with eased momentum and deceleration, never discrete jumps
While travelling, a subject's picture stretches taller from its top edge while its name drifts upward past it
The selected picture itself moves and reshapes into the reading arrangement; it is not replaced by a separate image or a new view
Neighbouring items clear vertically out of the way and background scrolling locks during the reading state
The full description, credit and a few extra detail shots arrive a beat after the picture settles and are legible as they come to rest
The return control plays the same choreography backwards and restores the exact prior scroll offset and stretch presentation
Input during either transition is ignored so transitions cannot overlap
adaptable_details: Subject matter of the images and the wording of names, notes and descriptions
Exact durations, easing curves, stretch amount and delay length before the reading content arrives
Number of supporting detail shots and their arrangement within the reading layout
Placement and styling of the return control and the credit line
Typography, colour, spacing and framing of the picture and text
Whether the reading layout puts text beside or beneath the settled picture
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits any sequence of visually strong single images that each deserve full attention and each have a short label plus a longer piece of reading material with attribution and a few supporting images: collections, portfolios, archives, product or artwork showcases. It stops fitting when items are too numerous or too low-value to justify one-per-view browsing, when items lack a dominant image to carry across the transition, or when the deep content is interactive rather than readable. Replacing the carried-picture transition with a separate detail page, showing multiple subjects side by side during browsing, or dropping the momentum-driven stretch and drift would each create a different Skill.

source_sites.title: Large Image to Content Page Transition

name: teaser_cluster_ripple_expansion_gallery
description: A quiet, low-distraction opening shows an identity line beside a condensed thumbnail teaser, its surround receding so the imagery and text hold all the contrast; one forward cue sends those same thumbnails rippling outward into their full gallery positions under a large heading, where each picture stretches and reveals its title on pointing, and a back control carries them home.

canonical_document.name: teaser_cluster_ripple_expansion_gallery
canonical_document.description: A quiet, low-distraction opening shows an identity line beside a condensed thumbnail teaser, its surround receding so the imagery and text hold all the contrast; one forward cue sends those same thumbnails rippling outward into their full gallery positions under a large heading, where each picture stretches and reveals its title on pointing, and a back control carries them home.
canonical_document.experience_scope: Whole-view experience covering two states of a single page: it begins at the restful opening state on arrival, spans the outward expansion into the full gallery state including per-item hover behavior there, and ends either on return to the opening state or when the visitor leaves. No separate page or route is entered.
content_and_composition: Opening state: a short identity block (name plus discipline or role line) placed beside a compact cluster of small image thumbnails that reads as a teaser of the full set rather than a complete list
A single forward cue element in the opening state, the only advancing affordance present
Gallery state: the same image items, now enlarged and distributed across their full gallery positions, each held in its own frame
One title per image item, hidden or illegible until that item holds focus
Gallery state persistent chrome: a large multi-line heading naming the body of work, and a back control occupying the role the forward cue vacated
A recessive, low-distraction surround in the opening, kept at deliberately low internal contrast so the imagery and identity text hold the strongest separation and carry all prominence
Small curated set: enough items to fill a gallery body, few enough that every one is reachable without paging
experience_progression: Stage 1 - restful opening: identity text and condensed thumbnail teaser at rest, forward cue available

Stage 2 - expansion: on the forward cue, thumbnails travel outward to their large gallery positions one after another in a rippling order, while the forward cue slides away and the heading lines and back control arrive in its place
Stage 3 - gallery browsing: the full set is settled and inspectable, each item responding individually to pointing
Stage 4 - return: the back control reverses the journey, carrying the same pictures back into the opening cluster and restoring the identity-and-cue arrangement
The two states alternate indefinitely; return is always offered and never a dead end
attention_and_information_flow: Attention starts narrow on the person: identity text dominates, imagery is present but deliberately compressed and unlabelled
During expansion attention widens outward with the traveling pictures, and the staggered order leads the eye across the set instead of presenting it all at once
In the gallery the enlarged imagery dominates and the large heading anchors the body of work; the identity role recedes
Item information is granted only on focus: a project's name becomes legible exactly when its picture is being attended to, so at most one title competes with the imagery at a time
On return, prominence collapses back onto the identity block and the set becomes a teaser again

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: The transition always runs to completion; further activations or pointing while it is in flight are ignored rather than truncating or restarting it. Once settled, the back control fully reverses the state.
interaction_model.state_change: Opening state advances to gallery state; each thumbnail moves from its cluster position to its large gallery position, with staggered start times producing a ripple across the set
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Pictures travel outward and grow one after another; the forward cue slides out of view as the heading lines and back control take its place
interaction_model.input: Activating the single forward cue in the opening state
interaction_model.affected_object: The thumbnail cluster plus the surrounding chrome (forward cue, heading lines, back control)

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Leaving the picture undoes all three changes together, returning frame height, photo scale and title to their resting state; moving between items focuses the new item and releases the previous one
interaction_model.state_change: The item enters a focused state: its frame stretches vertically, its photo eases to a larger scale inside the frame, and its title slides in from the side into legibility
interaction_model.visible_feedback: One picture becomes taller and its image fills more of the frame while its name arrives from the side; neighboring items stay at rest
interaction_model.input: Pointing at (hovering) a picture in the gallery state
interaction_model.affected_object: That single picture's frame, its photo inside the frame, and its title

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: The return likewise runs uninterrupted; re-triggering or hovering mid-transition is ignored. Arrival restores a fully interactive opening state.
interaction_model.state_change: Gallery state returns to the opening state; pictures travel back into the condensed cluster and the identity-and-cue arrangement is restored
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The same pictures retrace their journey home while the heading lines and back control give way to the forward cue
interaction_model.input: Activating the back control in the gallery state
interaction_model.affected_object: The same set of pictures plus the gallery chrome

experience_qualities: Calm, restful and unhurried; nothing flashes or competes
Continuous rather than page-like: the same imagery persists across states, so the change reads as expansion, not replacement
Rippling, one-after-another rhythm that makes a small set feel deliberately presented
Invitational opening that withholds the full list
Precise, restrained per-item response with a clear sense of focus
Protected transitions that never stutter or cut short
completion_and_return: Expansion completes when every picture has settled into its gallery position and the heading and back control are fully present
Return completes when every picture is back in the condensed cluster with the identity block and forward cue restored
Hover focus is momentary and always fully reversible; no item stays enlarged or labelled after the pointer leaves
The two states can be entered and left repeatedly with no accumulated or leftover state
Return to the opening is always available while in the gallery
locked_observable_requirements: A quiet opening state with a low-distraction surround that recedes behind its contents, pairing a short identity line at readable contrast with a condensed thumbnail teaser of the same images used later
Exactly one forward cue advancing the whole view, and that cue leaving as the back control and large heading arrive in its place
The identical picture items travel between the compact and full arrangements; they are not swapped for different assets or cross-faded into a new layout
Staggered, one-after-another outward motion producing a visible ripple across the set, not a simultaneous move
Per-item focus response combining three simultaneous changes: vertical stretch of the frame, the photo easing larger inside the frame, and the title sliding in from the side
All three focus changes reverse together when focus leaves, and titles are illegible when unfocused
A back control that reverses the same journey and is always reachable from the gallery
In-flight transitions ignore repeat triggers and pointing, always completing rather than being cut short
Attention widens from the identity in the opening to the image set in the gallery
adaptable_details: Number and aspect ratio of image items and the exact gallery arrangement
Palette, hues and overall luminance direction, as long as the opening still reads restful and low-distraction with the imagery and identity text clearly separated from their surround
Typography and wording of the identity, heading and control labels
Which side the title slides in from and how far the frame stretches
Durations, easing curves and the size of the stagger interval
Shape and styling of the forward and back cues
Placement of the identity block relative to the teaser cluster
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits small curated image sets with short per-item names where the same pictures can serve both as a compact teaser and as the full gallery, and where an identity or headline should greet visitors before the work. It stops being this Skill if the opening imagery is not the same items that expand, if the set is large enough to need paging or filtering so the full arrangement can no longer be reached in one move, if titles are permanently visible instead of focus-revealed, or if advancing navigates to a separate view instead of expanding in place.

name: in_place_photo_spotlight_with_yielding_neighbours
description: Picking a picture in a group makes it grow and lift forward right where it sits, while nearby pictures glide outward and tilt away from it — the closest ones moving furthest and leaning most — with a springy, slightly cheeky bounce; picking it again lets the group settle back to a calm even arrangement.

canonical_document.name: in_place_photo_spotlight_with_yielding_neighbours
canonical_document.description: Picking a picture in a group makes it grow and lift forward right where it sits, while nearby pictures glide outward and tilt away from it — the closest ones moving furthest and leaning most — with a springy, slightly cheeky bounce; picking it again lets the group settle back to a calm even arrangement.
canonical_document.experience_scope: A repeatable region experience: each picture set placed beneath a passage or heading behaves independently. It begins when a reader picks a picture within one set, is confined to that set's own area, and ends when the set returns to its resting arrangement. The page as a whole, its text and its scroll position are never taken over; there is no separate viewer, overlay state or full-view mode.
content_and_composition: Primary content role: short prose passages with headings, read top to bottom, forming the stable spine of the view.
Secondary content role: one picture set following each passage, containing several comparable images of equal resting prominence.
Within a set: at most one picture is emphasized at a time; all remaining pictures stay visible as displaced neighbours rather than being hidden or faded back.
Layer relationship: the emphasized picture is raised above its neighbours so its enlarged edges overlap them cleanly; neighbours share a lower layer.
Spatial relationship: neighbour displacement and tilt are graded by proximity to the emphasized picture — nearest neighbours travel furthest and tilt most, distant ones barely move.
Persistent elements: all passages, headings and the reader's scroll position hold exactly still; the gaps and spacing between pictures are inert and never expand, collapse or react.
The page is fully settled on arrival — no entrance staging or reveal precedes the reading.
experience_progression: Resting overview: the set sits as a calm, evenly arranged group of equally weighted pictures.
Emphasis: one chosen picture grows in place and rises forward while neighbours push outward and tilt away, all in one springy overshooting move.
Held focus: the enlarged picture remains the clear focus for as long as it is chosen, with the displaced neighbours framing it.

Transfer or release: emphasis either passes to another picture in the same set — the previous one easing back down as the new one grows — or is released entirely, returning the set to the calm overview so reading can continue.
The cycle is repeatable and non-terminal; there is no sequence to complete or advance through.
attention_and_information_flow: At rest, attention belongs to the prose; the picture set reads as a single grouped accent of even weight.
On emphasis, attention narrows decisively to one picture: it gains size, forward position and clear separation, so the focus is unmistakable on the first try.
Neighbours do not lose their presence — their outward drift and tilt actively signal deference, acting as pointers back toward the focus.
No additional information, caption panel or metadata is introduced; the revealed information is simply more of the same image at greater size.
Releasing emphasis flattens prominence back to even, handing attention back to the surrounding text without the reader hunting for their place.

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Always reversible by picking the same picture again; nothing is committed and no reading position is lost
interaction_model.state_change: Set moves from resting arrangement to emphasized state with that picture as focus
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The chosen picture enlarges in place and lifts above its neighbours; the neighbours glide outward away from it and tilt slightly, nearest ones travelling furthest and tilting most; the motion has a springy, slightly overshooting quality; surrounding text and the gaps between pictures do not move at all
interaction_model.input: Click or tap on a resting picture within a set
interaction_model.affected_object: The chosen picture and all its neighbours in the same set

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Restores the calm overview so downward reading resumes immediately; repeatable without limit
interaction_model.state_change: Set returns from emphasized state to resting arrangement
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The picture eases back down to its original size and layer while neighbours glide and untilt back into the even calm group
interaction_model.input: Click or tap the currently emphasized picture again
interaction_model.affected_object: The emphasized picture and its displaced neighbours

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: No intermediate return to the resting state is required; emphasis is single-occupancy so the set can never show two focuses
interaction_model.state_change: Emphasis is handed over within the same set
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The earlier choice eases back down as the new one grows, the two moves reading as one continuous exchange; the outward-and-tilt pattern of the neighbours re-forms around the new focus
interaction_model.input: Click or tap a different picture while one is already emphasized
interaction_model.affected_object: Previously emphasized picture, newly chosen picture, and the whole set's displacement pattern

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: The latest pick always wins and the set always ends in a coherent state matching the last input
interaction_model.state_change: In-flight motion is redirected toward the newest target state
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Pictures change course smoothly from wherever they currently are, with no snapping, no restart from the beginning, and no visible backlog of queued moves playing out afterwards
interaction_model.input: Impatient repeated or rapid picks while motion is still in flight
interaction_model.affected_object: All pictures currently in motion

experience_qualities: Immediately obvious on the first attempt — no instruction or discovery needed
Springy and slightly cheeky, with a playful overshoot rather than a stiff or clinical transition
Polite and deferential: neighbours make room rather than vanishing
Calm and unshifting for the reader — the text never jumps, so reading position is never lost
Responsive under impatience, feeling directly hand-driven rather than animation-bound
Settled and composed at rest, never fidgeting on its own
completion_and_return: No completion or end state: the experience loops between calm overview and single-picture focus indefinitely.
Return to the calm overview is always available by re-picking the emphasized picture.
Each picture set retains its own independent state; emphasis in one set does not disturb any other set.
Nothing about the emphasis needs to persist beyond the visit; the resting arrangement is the natural baseline.
locked_observable_requirements: Enlargement happens in place, in the picture's own position within the flow — no overlay, separate viewer, dedicated full-view or displacement of the reading column.
The emphasized picture is layered above its neighbours.
Neighbours respond by moving outward away from the focus and tilting slightly; they stay visible.
Neighbour response is graded by proximity: nearest travel furthest and tilt most.
At most one picture per set is emphasized at any moment.
Surrounding text and headings never shift; the gaps between pictures never react.
Re-picking the emphasized picture restores the resting arrangement.
Picking another picture transfers emphasis as one continuous exchange — the old one easing down while the new one grows.
Rapid repeated picks redirect motion already in flight instead of queueing or restarting.
Motion reads as springy with a slight overshoot, not linear or abrupt.
The page is fully settled on arrival with no entrance staging.
adaptable_details: Number of pictures in a set and their arrangement (row, cluster, grid or staggered group)
Number of passages and picture sets on the page
Image subject matter, aspect ratios and framing
Exact enlargement factor, outward travel distance, tilt magnitude and spring timing
Whether tilt direction is uniform or mirrored around the focus
Visual styling of the pictures themselves — edge treatment, corner shaping, depth shadow, and how strongly each picture's surface separates from the page behind it
Typographic treatment of the passages and headings
Whether pointer hover adds a small extra cue before the pick
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits any text-led reading view where groups of three or more comparable, similarly weighted media items sit inline and need close inspection without breaking the reader's place — illustrated writing, photo-rich bios, portfolio sections, product or menu grids. It requires enough space around each set for neighbours to drift outward, and requires the surrounding layout to stay fixed. It stops being this Skill if focus moves into a full-screen overlay or dedicated viewer, if neighbours are hidden, faded out or replaced instead of displaced, if the set becomes a stepped sequence or carousel with one item at a time, if the enlargement reflows the surrounding text, or if multiple items can be emphasized simultaneously.

name: liquid_edge_scroll_photo_descent
description: A single long descent of wide photographs, short reflective passages and small picture clusters whose outlines and section edges bend into soft liquid curves in exact proportion to how far they have travelled up the view, freezing when you stop and unwinding precisely when you scroll back.

canonical_document.name: liquid_edge_scroll_photo_descent
canonical_document.description: A single long descent of wide photographs, short reflective passages and small picture clusters whose outlines and section edges bend into soft liquid curves in exact proportion to how far they have travelled up the view, freezing when you stop and unwinding precisely when you scroll back.
canonical_document.experience_scope: Whole-view, whole-page experience. Begins with a full-height opening title screen that invites downward movement, continues through the entire scrollable body, and ends on a closing panel that carries the heaviest, quietest visual weight of the page; the edge-bending behavior applies to every media block and section boundary along that path, and there is no separate mode outside the scroll journey.
content_and_composition: One full-height opening panel holding a short title that reads as an invitation to continue downward, with nothing competing for attention on that first screen
A single vertical column of successive full-width or near-full-width photographic bands, each occupying a large share of the view height so only one dominates at a time
Short reflective text passages interleaved between photographic bands, sparse and low in word count so they read as pauses rather than as articles
Small clusters of two to a few grouped pictures appearing at intervals, forming a denser beat between single large photographs
One closing panel at the end, visually heavier and quieter than the bands above it and clearly separated from them by a step in luminance, acting as the resting point of the descent
The boundary between adjacent bands is itself a content role: a curved, liquid-looking edge rather than a straight horizontal cut, shared between the outgoing and incoming block
No persistent overlay, chrome or floating indicator competing with the imagery; the column of content is the whole composition
experience_progression: The opening is withheld through a brief quiet moment, then the full-height title settles into place as the first thing seen
Downward travel begins one continuous descent rather than a series of discrete steps or snaps
Each block enters from the bottom of the view with its outline in one extreme of its bend, straightens or reshapes progressively as it rises, and reaches its opposite shape as it leaves the top
Single wide photographs, short passages and small picture clusters arrive in turn, each holding attention briefly before yielding to the next
The visually heaviest closing panel arrives as a settled ending with no further onward motion suggested
Retracing upward replays the same stages in reverse with the same shapes at the same positions, so the return feels familiar rather than new
attention_and_information_flow: Attention rests on whichever band currently fills the middle of the view; its neighbours are partially bent away at the top and bottom edges
Prominence transfers by shape as much as by position: as an outline bends, that block reads as giving way and the following one reads as taking over
Text passages briefly reduce visual density and slow the pace before the next large image reasserts dominance
