Picture clusters raise local density for one beat, inviting a short scan across several images before the column returns to single-image rhythm
The heavy, low-activity closing panel absorbs attention and ends the flow instead of forwarding it
Because motion only exists while the visitor moves, information reveal is entirely paced by the visitor

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Stopping leaves every outline frozen exactly mid-shape; nothing continues, settles or animates on its own
interaction_model.state_change: Each element's bend amount advances monotonically with how far it has travelled from the bottom of the view toward the top
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Edges curve progressively more or less as the block rises, so boundaries appear to flex and flow while the visitor moves
interaction_model.input: Vertical page movement downward (wheel, touch drag, keyboard, scrollbar)
interaction_model.affected_object: Outline of each photographic band, text passage block and section boundary currently near or inside the view

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Direction may reverse at any moment without accumulating drift or leaving residual shapes
interaction_model.state_change: Bend amounts unwind along the identical position-to-shape relationship
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Shapes retrace precisely, giving the return trip the same appearance as the descent at every position
interaction_model.input: Vertical page movement upward
interaction_model.affected_object: The same outlines and section boundaries

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Arbitrary position changes are always valid entry points; the page is never mid-transition in an inconsistent way
interaction_model.state_change: Shapes resolve immediately to the values belonging to the new position
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Every edge matches its current place with no catching-up sweep, stale shape or visible correction
interaction_model.input: Fast flinging, momentum scrolling or jumping directly to a distant position
interaction_model.affected_object: All outlines in and around the view

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Resizing mid-descent leaves the visitor at the same content with correct shapes, no reset to the top
interaction_model.state_change: Shape values are re-derived for the new view height and layout positions
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Outlines remain consistent with where their blocks now sit rather than jumping to unrelated shapes
interaction_model.input: Window or viewport resize
interaction_model.affected_object: Whole column of bands and their boundaries

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Scrolling back up immediately re-engages the same reversible shape behavior
interaction_model.state_change: Deformation activity ceases as the final panel settles fully into view
interaction_model.visible_feedback: A quiet, static, visually heavy ending with no residual flexing
interaction_model.input: Reaching the closing panel
interaction_model.affected_object: End of the descent

experience_qualities: Calm and unhurried, with one subject dominating at a time
Liquid and alive at the seams rather than cleanly cut or rectangular
Entirely visitor-paced: motion exists only while the visitor moves
Continuous and reversible, so the journey feels like one descent rather than a sequence of slides
Predictable and familiar on the return trip
Restrained and photographic, with text as breathing space
completion_and_return: Completion is the closing panel — the heaviest, quietest note of the page — resting fully in view as a settled ending, with no loop back to the start
Upward retracing is a first-class return path that reproduces the same shapes at the same positions
No progress is consumed or locked: any position can be revisited and looks identical each time
Re-entering at an arbitrary position presents shapes consistent with that position rather than an opening state
locked_observable_requirements: Vertical page position is the only driver of shape change; nothing reshapes autonomously, on a timer or on hover
Bend amount maps continuously to a block's travel from the bottom of the view toward the top, so pausing freezes it mid-shape
Reversing direction unwinds shapes exactly along the same relationship, with no one-way or non-reversible transitions
Boundaries between successive blocks read as curved and liquid rather than as straight horizontal cuts
Opening is a full-height title screen whose sole job is to invite downward movement
The body reads as one continuous descent of alternating wide photographs, short passages and small picture clusters, each holding attention briefly

The final panel is the visually heaviest and quietest of the page, set apart from the bands above by a clear luminance step in whichever direction the page's scheme runs, ending the descent rather than suggesting more
Fast movement, jumps and resizes always leave every outline matching its current position
adaptable_details: Number and order of photographic bands, passages and picture clusters
How many images form a cluster and how they are arranged within it
Curvature magnitude, direction and edge silhouette, as long as it stays continuous and reversible
Photo aspect ratios and exact band heights
Typography, title wording and passage length
Colour scheme and overall luminance level of the upper page, provided the closing panel remains the heaviest, quietest note with a clear luminance separation from the bands above it
Whether the opening is held briefly before appearing, and how long that quiet moment lasts
Presence of subtle secondary cues such as spacing rhythm or caption placement
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits sparse, image-led long-form pages where a handful of large visuals and short text beats can each own the view in turn — visual essays, photographic series, project or brand narrative pages, single-story features. It stops working where content is dense, scannable or comparison-based (lists, tables, catalogues, dashboards, forms), where visitors must jump between many small items, or where reading must not be paced by scrolling. Driving the shape change by time, hover, pointer position or autoplay instead of scroll position, making transitions one-way or snapped between discrete full screens, or replacing the liquid curved seams with straight cuts each produces a different skill.

source_sites.title: How to Animate SVG Shapes on Scroll

name: corner_collapsing_scroll_gallery
description: Square photos drift up through a mostly empty page with a fixed centred wordmark behind them, each shrinking into one of its own bottom corners as it exits the top edge and growing back along the same path when the visitor scrolls back.

canonical_document.name: corner_collapsing_scroll_gallery
canonical_document.description: Square photos drift up through a mostly empty page with a fixed centred wordmark behind them, each shrinking into one of its own bottom corners as it exits the top edge and growing back along the same path when the visitor scrolls back.
canonical_document.experience_scope: Whole-view experience: begins with a brief quiet holding moment on entry before any element responds, runs through the entire scrollable page as the image sequence passes through, and ends at a full-height closing statement panel.
content_and_composition: One persistent word-level identity mark held centred in the viewport, staying put while imagery passes over or around it
A vertical sequence of square photographic items, sparsely positioned so only a small number (roughly two to four) are visible at any moment
Generous empty space surrounding every image, so items never crowd or tile
Images sit on a layer above the centred mark; the mark reads as a steady backdrop anchor rather than as a scrolling element
A final full-height statement panel occupying the entire viewport as the closing frame of the sequence
experience_progression: Entry: a still, quiet holding state with nothing reacting until the imagery is ready
Advance: each photo rises into view, occupies attention for a beat at full size, then begins collapsing once it crosses the upper edge
Continuous middle: collapse and re-expansion progress smoothly with scroll distance rather than in steps, so the page never accumulates a pile of images
Close: the full-height statement panel arrives and terminates the sequence
attention_and_information_flow: Attention lands on whichever one or two photos are currently at full size in open space
Prominence transfers forward as a departing image loses size and visual weight while the next arrives at full scale
The centred mark stays continuously legible as the constant reference point across the whole visit
The closing full-height panel takes over the entire field of attention, signalling that no further imagery follows

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Scrolling is the only input; any direction can be reversed at any time and motion settles rather than jumping
interaction_model.state_change: Scroll position advances or rewinds with soft inertia
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The page glides and eases into rest instead of snapping or stopping abruptly; imagery moves in step with the eased position
interaction_model.input: Wheel, trackpad, touch drag or keyboard scroll keys
interaction_model.affected_object: The whole page and the image sequence within it

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Reversing scroll direction grows the photo back to full size along the identical path, fully restoring its earlier appearance
interaction_model.state_change: Continuous scale reduction anchored toward one of the image's own lower corners until it disappears
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The photo shrinks into its own bottom corner and vanishes, leaving empty space rather than a stacked or overlapping remnant
interaction_model.input: Scroll distance an image has travelled past the upper viewport edge
interaction_model.affected_object: That individual photo

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Resuming scroll in either direction continues the same transformation from where it paused
interaction_model.state_change: Transformation freezes at its current partial value
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The image remains visibly half-collapsed and stable for as long as the visitor stays there
interaction_model.input: Stopping scroll mid-transition
interaction_model.affected_object: The photo currently collapsing or re-expanding

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Responsiveness begins once the imagery is ready; the experience then behaves normally from the top
interaction_model.state_change: Held, non-responsive quiet state
interaction_model.visible_feedback: A calm holding moment with no motion or reaction
interaction_model.input: Imagery not yet finished loading
interaction_model.affected_object: The entire view

experience_qualities: Unhurried and weightless
Sparse and airy, dominated by empty space
Calm and controlled, never abrupt or snapping
Fully reversible and scrubbable, so the visitor feels in direct command of the motion
Quietly branded through constant central presence rather than repeated labelling
completion_and_return: The sequence completes at the full-height statement panel; no loop back to the start
Scrolling upward at any point retraces the exact same visual states, including restoring vanished photos to full size
Partially collapsed states persist indefinitely while the visitor holds position
locked_observable_requirements: Only a few square images share the screen at once, always surrounded by generous empty space
A single identity mark stays centred and fixed for the whole scroll
Each image's disappearance is driven by how far it has passed the upper edge, not by time or discrete triggers
Collapse shrinks the image toward one of its own lower corners until fully gone
The collapse is symmetrical and reversible along the identical path when scroll direction reverses
Mid-transition pausing holds a stable partial state
Scroll motion carries soft inertia and eases into rest
Scrolling is the only interaction; nothing responds before imagery is ready
A full-height statement panel closes the sequence
adaptable_details: Exact number of simultaneously visible images and their horizontal placement
Which lower corner each image collapses toward, and whether it varies per item
Scroll distance thresholds and easing strength of the inertia
Typography, colour and size of the centred mark
Wording and styling of the closing full-height panel
Image subject matter and palette
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits pages whose foreground content is a modest sequence of self-contained square or near-square images meant to be looked at one or two at a time, paired with a short standing identity or title. Dense grids, long text blocks, or content needing side-by-side comparison break the sparse composition. Replacing scroll-distance-driven, reversible corner collapse with discrete slides, snapping sections, timed autoplay or a persistent stacked pile of images would create a different Skill.

name: shard_burst_artwork_swap_viewer
description: A hushed gallery-like viewer showing one artwork centered over a strongly subordinate lettered backdrop, where each scroll step breaks the picture into small tiles that fly out into a slowly turning ball of curved shards, exchanges it for the next artwork while dispersed, then draws the tiles back flat.

canonical_document.name: shard_burst_artwork_swap_viewer
canonical_document.description: A hushed gallery-like viewer showing one artwork centered over a strongly subordinate lettered backdrop, where each scroll step breaks the picture into small tiles that fly out into a slowly turning ball of curved shards, exchanges it for the next artwork while dispersed, then draws the tiles back flat.
canonical_document.experience_scope: Whole-view experience occupying the entire frame from an initial signalled loading wait through endless browsing; it has no end state and never hands off to a following section within itself.
content_and_composition: One artwork visible at a time, centered and alone in the frame, as the sole foreground subject
An ordered set of roughly a dozen artworks, cyclic with no first or last item
A low-emphasis backdrop layer behind the artwork carrying large lettering at reduced contrast, so it reads as texture rather than as readable copy
A quiet, persistent standing cue near the artwork that implies scrolling continues to the next piece, without instructional text
A brief entry state with an explicit progress or wait signal that precedes the first artwork
Layer order is constant: subdued lettered backdrop behind, single artwork in front, cue overlaid
experience_progression: Signalled wait while the pieces arrive, with the frame held quiet and empty of artwork
First artwork settles alone into the frame over the lettered backdrop, clearly separated from it, and the standing cue becomes noticeable

Each advance runs one continuous transformation: flat picture splits into a grid of small tiles, tiles fly outward into a slowly turning ball of curved shards, the outgoing image is exchanged for the incoming one while dispersed, then tiles draw back into a flat picture
Steps chain indefinitely in either direction and wrap past the ends, so viewing continues without arriving at a final piece
attention_and_information_flow: During the wait, attention rests on the arrival signal and the restrained, near-empty surround sets expectation before any artwork appears
At rest, the single artwork dominates and the backdrop lettering and cue stay clearly subordinate in contrast and emphasis
During a step, attention moves from the flat image to the dispersed volume of shards, which hides which image is which at the midpoint, then resolves back onto one flat artwork
Only one artwork's content is ever legible at a time; the exchange is never shown as two images side by side or cross-faded
Pointer-driven tilt and backdrop drift add ambient depth without competing for attention

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: The step always completes; wrapping past the end continues into the beginning so there is no dead end
interaction_model.state_change: Advances to the next artwork in the cycle through one dispersal-and-reassembly step
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Picture splits into small tiles that fly out into a slowly turning ball of curved shards, the image content changes while dispersed, then tiles draw back flat as the next artwork
interaction_model.input: Scroll down
interaction_model.affected_object: The single displayed artwork and its tile grid

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Wraps past the beginning into the end, so backward browsing is equally endless
interaction_model.state_change: Returns to the previous artwork in the cycle using the same step transformation
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Same burst, turn, exchange and reassembly, ending on the previous artwork
interaction_model.input: Scroll up
interaction_model.affected_object: The single displayed artwork and its tile grid

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Responsiveness returns automatically at the end of the step, so hurried input cannot stack or skip pieces
interaction_model.state_change: Input is ignored while the step runs and accepted again once it finishes
interaction_model.visible_feedback: No additional motion, no queued jumps and no skipped artworks; the running transformation plays through uninterrupted
interaction_model.input: Further scrolling during an in-progress step (roughly one and a half seconds)
interaction_model.affected_object: Step sequencing

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Motion is continuous and eased, follows the pointer back, and settles when the pointer stops or leaves
interaction_model.state_change: Ambient orientation and backdrop offset shift with pointer position
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The picture eases into a slight turn away from the cursor and the backdrop lettering drifts sideways
interaction_model.input: Pointer movement across the view
interaction_model.affected_object: The whole artwork and the backdrop lettering

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: The wait is short and its progress is legible so the quiet, artwork-free frame never reads as broken
interaction_model.state_change: Wait state resolves into the first artwork being shown
interaction_model.visible_feedback: A brief, clearly signalled wait in an intentionally sparse frame gives way to a single artwork settling in over the lettered backdrop
interaction_model.input: Initial arrival of the artworks
interaction_model.affected_object: Entry state of the whole view

experience_qualities: Hushed, low-distraction, exhibition-like
Volumetric and sculptural at the midpoint of each step
Deliberate and unhurried rather than snappy
Continuous and endless, never cut or jump
Instruction-free and self-evident
Subtly alive at rest through pointer-linked drift
completion_and_return: No terminal item and no completion state; the sequence loops in both directions
Each step always resolves back to one flat artwork at rest with the standing cue present
Interrupted or rapid input resolves by completing the current step and resuming acceptance, never by leaving a half-dispersed state
locked_observable_requirements: Exactly one artwork occupies the frame at rest, over a strongly subordinate backdrop whose lettering sits at low contrast and stays clearly separated from the artwork
Transitions never read as a cut, fade or slide: the outgoing picture must come apart into small tiles and settle into the incoming one
Dispersed tiles form a slowly turning volumetric mass of curved shards rather than staying in the flat picture plane
The image exchange happens while dispersed, so the swap itself is never directly visible
Tiles return to a flat, fully reassembled picture at the end of every step
Stepping is bidirectional and loops in both directions with no first or last piece
Input during a step is ignored and accepted again afterwards, so steps cannot stack or be skipped
A quiet standing cue conveys how to move on without instructional text
The entry wait is brief and clearly signalled before the first artwork appears
Pointer movement tilts the whole picture away from the cursor and drifts the backdrop lettering sideways
adaptable_details: Number of items beyond a small curated set
Tile grid density and shard curvature
Exact step duration around a second and a half
Direction and speed of the turning shard mass
Wording, size, typeface and tonal treatment of the reduced-contrast backdrop lettering
Visual form of the standing cue and of the arrival signal
Magnitude of the pointer tilt and lettering drift
Artwork aspect ratio and framing size within the view
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits a small curated set of self-contained full-frame visuals viewed one at a time where mood and presentation matter more than dense detail or accompanying text, and adopts the host's own palette and luminance level as long as the artwork stays clearly separated from its surround. It stops being this Skill if multiple items are shown simultaneously, if items carry substantial adjacent reading content or interactive detail that must stay legible during transitions, if transitions become flat cuts, fades or slides, or if the sequence gains a defined start and end that must be tracked as progress.

name: liquid_drifting_photo_on_quiet_canvas
description: One photograph floats centered on a quiet empty backdrop that sits clearly apart from it in luminance, trailing lazily toward the pointer with a slight tilt, smearing and rippling like liquid when the pointer moves fast, then re-sharpening and easing back to rest on its own.

canonical_document.name: liquid_drifting_photo_on_quiet_canvas
canonical_document.description: One photograph floats centered on a quiet empty backdrop that sits clearly apart from it in luminance, trailing lazily toward the pointer with a slight tilt, smearing and rippling like liquid when the pointer moves fast, then re-sharpening and easing back to rest on its own.
canonical_document.experience_scope: Whole-view experience: begins immediately on arrival with the photo at rest and continues indefinitely for as long as the view is open; the entire page area is the input surface, and there is no entry sequence, no exit condition and no other region competing with it.
content_and_composition: Exactly one photographic image as the sole foreground subject, presented at a size that leaves generous empty margin on all sides

A quiet, essentially featureless backdrop occupying the full view behind the image, held at a clearly different luminance level from the image so the picture separates cleanly, with no pattern or content that competes for attention
No captions, labels, buttons, instructions or navigation in the resting composition; the image is the only thing to look at
Two conceptual layers only: the still backdrop plane and the single displaced/deformable image plane above it
Bounded margin acts as a persistent visual reservoir: the image displaces within it and never crosses the view edge
attention_and_information_flow: On arrival, attention lands on the image immediately because nothing else is present and the low-distraction surround recedes behind it
Attention is held by motion rather than by revealed information: no new content is ever exposed, and the image's own subject remains the only information
Pointer movement momentarily shifts prominence to the deformation itself (the smear and ripple), then returns prominence to the sharp photographic subject as it settles
Legibility of the photograph is highest at rest and intentionally lowest at peak pointer speed, so the visitor oscillates between looking at the picture and playing with it

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Displacement is clamped to a small bounded range so the image never leaves the view or touches the edges; direction can be reversed at any moment simply by moving the pointer elsewhere
interaction_model.state_change: Image displaces from its rest position toward the pointer side and acquires a slight tilt, following with visible lag rather than tracking exactly
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The image drifts and leans behind the pointer, trailing its position with soft momentum; displacement magnitude and tilt direction correspond to pointer offset
interaction_model.input: Pointer moved anywhere within the view
interaction_model.affected_object: The single foreground image

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Distortion is proportional and continuous rather than triggered, so slowing the pointer immediately begins reducing it; no threshold traps the image in a distorted state
interaction_model.state_change: Image transitions from sharp to increasingly smeared and rippling in proportion to travel speed
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Liquid, unsettled distortion of the image surface that grows with speed, reading as motion smear and wobbling ripples through the picture
interaction_model.input: Pointer speed increasing across the view
interaction_model.affected_object: The image surface treatment

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Decay is self-driven and interruptible: renewed pointer movement re-energizes the distortion mid-decay without a restart
interaction_model.state_change: Ripple and smear decay back toward zero while the image re-sharpens
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Distortion visibly fades and the photograph resolves crisply again

interaction_model.affected_object: The focused preview's deployed trail

canonical_document.description: Item images scatter into place to form one long horizontal line that overruns both screen edges; the centred piece stays enlarged and at the highest luminance and contrast in the view while neighbours recede in tone, its name and collection notes swap in as focus shifts, motion bends the images with travel speed and magnetically settles on one piece, and clicking the centred piece turns it over to show a second image.
canonical_document.experience_scope: A single large region occupying the main viewing area, effectively the whole primary view of the page. It begins with the entry assembly animation on load and remains the persistent browsing surface; it ends only when the visitor leaves the view. The flip reveal happens inside this same region rather than in a separate screen.
content_and_composition: One continuous horizontal line of item images, evenly spaced, extending beyond both the left and right edges of the screen so no beginning or end is visible on screen at once
Exactly one item at a time occupies the centre spotlight position: rendered larger and at full salience, carrying the strongest luminance and contrast of anything in the view
All non-centred items are visibly reduced: smaller and pulled toward the surround's tone so they read as context rather than competition
A text pair tied to the spotlighted item: its individual name plus the descriptive notes for the group or collection it belongs to
Each item carries a second image of the same subject, hidden until the flip is triggered
The line and the text block are persistent elements; the text occupies a fixed area so successive entries exchange in place rather than shifting layout
experience_progression: Entry: images appear from scattered, disordered positions across the view
Assembly: they drift inward and settle into the single evenly spaced horizontal line, reading as the collection composing itself
Rest state: one piece holds the spotlight, others recede, its name and collection notes are present
Browsing loop: travel moves the line sideways, spotlight transfers from item to item, text exchanges quietly with each transfer
Optional per-item detour: the centred item turns around to its second image and back, then browsing resumes
attention_and_information_flow: Size and luminance separation makes the centred item unmistakably the subject; the rest form a low-contrast receding rhythm that implies more content in both directions
Only one item's information is shown at any moment, so reading load stays constant regardless of collection size
As travel proceeds the text does not accumulate or scroll: the outgoing name and notes leave and the incoming pair rises into view, keeping the pairing between image and words unambiguous
A slight salience lift on a receded item under the pointer signals that off-centre items are actionable targets without promoting them to spotlight status
The flip redirects attention from comparison across items to inspection of one item

interaction_model.state_change: Line position travels sideways following the pointer with easing rather than rigid tracking; the item nearest the centre becomes the spotlight as it passes
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Items slide sideways, individual images bend/skew in proportion to travel speed and straighten as it slows; the newly centred item grows and rises to full salience while the previous one shrinks and recedes in tone; name and collection notes exchange
interaction_model.input: Horizontal drag or swipe on the line
interaction_model.affected_object: The entire line of items and the spotlight assignment

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Reversible by scrolling the opposite direction; interruptible by a drag, which takes precedence
interaction_model.state_change: Equivalent sideways travel driven by wheel deltas instead of pointer position
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Same eased sideways motion, speed-linked bending, spotlight transfer and text exchange
interaction_model.input: Wheel or trackpad scroll
interaction_model.affected_object: The same line and spotlight assignment

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Travelling back inward from the boundary is immediately available
interaction_model.state_change: Travel is clamped at the range boundary; no wraparound

interaction_model.input: Travel reaching the first or last item
interaction_model.affected_object: Line position

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: A fresh grab or scroll cancels the settling instantly and hands control back to the visitor without a jump

interaction_model.visible_feedback: A short gentle glide that centres the nearest item and carries it to full salience, with its text resolving into place

interaction_model.affected_object: Line position and spotlight assignment

interaction_model.state_change: That item becomes the spotlighted item
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The line travels so the clicked item glides to the centre, growing and gaining salience as it arrives while the former centre recedes; its name and notes exchange in

interaction_model.affected_object: Line position and spotlight assignment

interaction_model.state_change: The item turns around to reveal a second image of the same subject

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Deliberate taps without meaningful movement still register normally
interaction_model.state_change: Motion below a small threshold is not treated as a click
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The line simply moves; no accidental centring or flip occurs

experience_qualities: Weightless and hand-made rather than mechanical or grid-like
Physical and momentum-driven: motion follows the hand with lag, bends with speed and stops firmly at the ends
Calm and singular in focus: one subject, one short text, everything else receding
Self-composing on arrival, so the collection feels gathered rather than laid out
Legibly reversible: getting a closer look and leaving that look again are both obvious
completion_and_return: No terminal completion state; the browsing loop continues indefinitely within the clamped range
Every travel gesture resolves to a settled, centred spotlight state rather than an in-between rest
The revealed second image always returns to the front view, either by a repeat click or automatically when focus moves to another item
Hover emphasis is transient and leaves no persistent state
The entry assembly plays once; subsequent browsing does not re-scatter the line
locked_observable_requirements: One continuous horizontal line of items that visibly overruns both screen edges
Entry animation in which items arrive from scattered positions and settle into that line
Exactly one centred item enlarged and at full salience, carrying the highest luminance and contrast in the view, while all others are reduced and pushed toward the surround's tone
Per-item name plus group/collection notes that exchange in place as the spotlight moves, showing only the current item's text
Sideways travel from both drag and wheel, following input with easing rather than rigid one-to-one tracking
Image deformation that scales with travel speed and resolves when motion slows
Hard, non-looping stop at both ends of the range
Magnetic settling onto the nearest item shortly after input stops, cancellable instantly by new input
Clicking an off-centre item carries it to the centre; clicking the centred item turns it to a second image of the same subject and back
A small hover salience lift on receded items that does not change which item is spotlighted
Drag-jitter suppression so incidental pointer movement never triggers a click action
adaptable_details: Item count, image aspect ratio and spacing along the line
Exact scale and salience difference between the centred and receding items
Placement of the name/notes block relative to the line and its typographic treatment
The specific transition used for the text exchange and for the turn-around reveal
Easing curves, settle delay, bend magnitude and travel sensitivity
Scatter pattern and duration of the entry assembly
Visual style, colour treatment and the overall luminance level of the surround, constrained only by keeping the centred item clearly separated from it and the receded items clearly subordinate
The nature of the second image (alternate angle, detail, context shot, reverse side)
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits collections of a modest, browsable number of visually rich items where each item has a short name, a shared group description and at least two images: products, artworks, portfolio pieces, dishes, garments, cases or profiles. It depends on there being one clear subject at a time and a finite range with real ends. Replacing single-item spotlight with a multi-item comparison grid, allowing endless wraparound instead of firm ends, showing all items' text simultaneously, or moving the closer look into a separate full-screen view or page would each produce a different Skill.

name: endless_depth_curved_image_track
description: A single unbroken line of pictures curves away into depth and past both screen edges; gestures carry the whole line past the viewer one-to-one, then it keeps gliding and eases to rest, with whatever is nearest reading as the current focus and items wrapping around so travel never ends.

canonical_document.name: endless_depth_curved_image_track
canonical_document.description: A single unbroken line of pictures curves away into depth and past both screen edges; gestures carry the whole line past the viewer one-to-one, then it keeps gliding and eases to rest, with whatever is nearest reading as the current focus and items wrapping around so travel never ends.
canonical_document.experience_scope: A whole-view browsing surface that owns the primary screen area. It begins already populated at rest on arrival, with several pictures in view, and has no end state: it is a persistent inhabited space rather than a sequence that finishes. The entire surface, not a designated control strip, is the gesture target.
content_and_composition: One continuous set of many uniform visual items (image tiles of comparable weight) treated as a single travelling track rather than independent cards
The track curves away from the viewer into depth, so items further along the curve read as smaller, further and lower-contrast in attention while remaining recognizable
One item at a time occupies the nearest position and reads as the current focus, largest and clearest in the composition
Immediate neighbours on both sides stay fully legible as context, so the focus is always seen amid its surroundings
The track visibly continues past both edges of the view, with items cropped at the boundaries to signal a much larger set beyond what is shown
Persistent absence of visible start, end, edge stop, page markers or count indicators; the surface offers no seams to read as a boundary
No mode-specific controls required for travel: the whole picture field is the control
experience_progression: Arrival: the track sits at rest with a few pictures in view, one nearest as focus, immediately readable with nothing to learn
Engagement: gesture displacement moves the whole track one-to-one in the gesture direction, focus handing off continuously from item to item
Release: travel continues under its own momentum, decelerating smoothly
Settle: motion eases to rest at an arbitrary position with a new item nearest as focus, ready for the next gesture
Loop: travel in either direction continues indefinitely, items re-entering from the opposite edge, so the cycle repeats without a terminal stage
attention_and_information_flow: Prominence is a direct function of depth position: nearest is dominant, further items progressively recede in visual weight
Focus is transferred continuously rather than assigned by a discrete highlight or selection state
Incoming items gain prominence as they approach the near position; outgoing items lose prominence as they curve away, so change of focus is legible as movement
At rest the composition resolves into a clear single foreground item plus legible context on both sides
The cropped edges continuously communicate scale of the collection without any numeric or textual cue

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Scrolling the other way turns the motion around immediately with no lag or bounce; there is no edge to collide with in either direction
interaction_model.state_change: Travel offset advances proportionally to scroll amount in the scrolled direction
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The entire set slides past the viewer, depth positions and therefore sizes shift, and the nearest/focus item changes as the track moves
interaction_model.input: Wheel or trackpad scroll anywhere over the surface
interaction_model.affected_object: The whole picture track as one unit

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Reversing mid-gesture reverses travel instantly; releasing hands motion off to momentum rather than snapping or jumping
interaction_model.state_change: Track position tracks gesture displacement one-to-one while held
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Pictures follow the finger or cursor exactly, so the set feels physically attached to the gesture
interaction_model.input: Touch swipe or pointer drag started anywhere on the surface
interaction_model.affected_object: The whole picture track as one unit

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Pressing or gesturing again mid-glide catches the motion and returns one-to-one control immediately, with no wait for the glide to finish and no discarded position
interaction_model.state_change: Velocity carries over from the gesture and decays to zero
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Travel keeps gliding and eases smoothly to rest instead of stopping dead at the moment of release
interaction_model.input: Release after a gesture (autonomous momentum)
interaction_model.affected_object: The whole picture track

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Travel can continue indefinitely in either direction; drifting back the other way re-presents the same items in the same arrangement, so returning reads as familiar ground
interaction_model.state_change: An item leaving one side re-enters from the opposite side, keeping the track continuously populated
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Seamless uninterrupted flow with no gap, empty stretch, blocked edge or rebound
interaction_model.input: Continued travel past the notional end of the set (autonomous wrap)
interaction_model.affected_object: Items at the leading and trailing edges of the view

experience_qualities: Calm and instantly readable on arrival, with no instruction or onboarding needed
Weightless and unending travel rather than paged or stepwise advance
Physical and inertial: the set feels like it has mass and glides rather than teleports
Continuously responsive, with control always retrievable mid-motion
Spatially deep, giving the sense of a much larger collection extending beyond view
Reassuring on reversal, because retracing feels like returning to known ground
completion_and_return: The experience never completes; it loops endlessly in both directions
It rests wherever momentum decays, with no snapping to a canonical position or index
Reverse travel returns through already-seen items in their original arrangement and relative order
No reset affordance and no end-of-collection state exist or are needed
The resting position is simply the current view; nothing is left in a partially advanced or broken state
locked_observable_requirements: Several items are already visible and legible at rest on arrival
Items are arranged along a path that curves away into depth, producing graded size and prominence
The nearest item reads as the current focus while its immediate neighbours remain legible as context
The track visibly extends past both view edges with cropped items implying a larger set
Any of wheel, trackpad, swipe or drag anywhere on the surface moves the whole set together in the gesture direction
Gesture-held movement tracks input one-to-one
After release, travel continues with momentum and eases to rest rather than halting abruptly

Items leaving one side reappear from the other, with no beginning, end or blocked edge anywhere
adaptable_details: Media type of the items (photographs, artwork, product shots, video stills, cover images)
Curve shape, radius and amount of depth recession
Number of items in view and total set size
Item aspect ratio, framing, spacing and any uniform border or shadow treatment

canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits large sets of uniform, self-similar visual items where every item carries comparable weight, order is not semantically important, and the goal is relaxed exploration of scale rather than locating one known item. It stays recognizable across image, artwork, product or cover collections. It becomes a different skill if the set is finite with a visible start and end, if travel snaps to discrete positions or indexes, if a single item is promoted to a hero with the rest demoted to a control strip, or if the primary presentation becomes a flat grid or a detail view with the collection reduced to secondary navigation.

name: full_bleed_photo_dissolve_stepper
description: One photograph fills the whole view with its name and city set large over it; stepping left or right makes the picture break into abstract graphic pieces and reassemble as the neighbouring entry while the ambient colour and the wording change with it, then everything settles into a still, fully composed state.

canonical_document.name: full_bleed_photo_dissolve_stepper
canonical_document.description: One photograph fills the whole view with its name and city set large over it; stepping left or right makes the picture break into abstract graphic pieces and reassemble as the neighbouring entry while the ambient colour and the wording change with it, then everything settles into a still, fully composed state.
canonical_document.experience_scope: Whole-view experience: it occupies the entire viewport from entry and persists as the only subject of the view; it begins in a settled state on one entry and has no end point, only successive settled states as the visitor steps through the set.
content_and_composition: Exactly one image visible as the subject at any resting moment, sized to hold the whole view

An ordered set of several entries, each pairing one image with its two text fields; only the current entry is represented on screen
Layering order from back to front: colour mood, image, large overlaid wording, edge controls

Fragments reassemble into the neighbouring image and the new wording resolves
New settled state on the neighbouring entry, visually indistinguishable in calmness from the previous resting state
The sequence loops without end: the last entry continues to the first and the first back to the last
attention_and_information_flow: At rest a single subject dominates and the overlaid wording is the only competing element, so identification is immediate and unambiguous

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: The change always runs to a complete settled state and never stops between two entries; stepping back with the opposite control returns to the previous entry
interaction_model.state_change: Position advances one step forward and the changeover to the following entry begins

interaction_model.affected_object: The visible image, its overlaid wording and the ambient colour mood

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Completes to a settled state; the forward control reverses the move
interaction_model.state_change: Position moves one step backward and the changeover to the preceding entry begins
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The same abstract break-up-and-reassemble change resolves onto the preceding entry with its wording and colour
interaction_model.input: Click on the previous control at the left edge
interaction_model.affected_object: The visible image, its overlaid wording and the ambient colour mood

interaction_model.state_change: No state change; the input is disregarded
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The change in progress continues undisturbed to its settled state with no jump, restart or queued extra step
interaction_model.input: Click on either control while a changeover is still running
interaction_model.affected_object: The running changeover

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Both directions wrap, so the set can be traversed endlessly either way
interaction_model.state_change: Position wraps to the opposite end of the set
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The identical changeover plays, so the wrap is visually indistinguishable from any other step and no edge or dead end is felt
interaction_model.input: Step forward from the last entry or backward from the first
interaction_model.affected_object: Position within the ordered set

experience_qualities: Feels like standing in front of one large print
Uncluttered and singular at rest, with nothing competing for attention
Abstract and graphic during change rather than photographic sliding or plain fading
Coordinated: picture, wording and colour move as one event
Calm and decisive resolution, never ambiguous about which piece is on show
Stable and unhurried under repeated input
completion_and_return: Each step completes only at a fully composed resting state on a single entry
There is no final entry and no ending screen; the set loops in both directions
No partial or intermediate resting position is reachable
The view holds the current entry indefinitely until the next step is taken
locked_observable_requirements: Exactly one image holds the whole view at rest, with no neighbouring items visible
The entry's two short text fields are set large directly over the image
Moving between entries reads as an abstract graphic break-up and reassembly, not as a slide, push or plain crossfade
The ambient colour mood and the wording change within the same changeover as the picture
Every changeover resolves into a still, fully composed state where the current entry is unambiguous

adaptable_details: Number of entries in the set
Fragment shape, granularity and dissolve pattern of the break-up
Duration and pacing of the changeover
Typeface, size, casing and exact placement of the overlaid wording within the view
How the colour mood is expressed (surrounding field, tint, glow) and which colours are used

Subject matter of the photographs and the meaning of the two text fields
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits small to moderate ordered sets where each entry is one visually strong full-frame image plus two short labels that can be read at a glance over the picture. Showing several entries at once, moving the wording out of the image into an adjacent panel, requiring scrollable or lengthy text per entry, or replacing the abstract break-up with a directional slide or plain fade would each create a different Skill.

name: vertical_scrub_torn_edge_dual_state_portrait
description: One framed image holds two versions of the same subject at once; moving the pointer up and down slides a ragged crossing edge between them while the light around the frame travels one continuous direction through its tint range, from dim and recessive to bright and prominent, as the second version takes over. canonical_document.experience_scope: A region that functions as the whole view: the framed media object plus its surrounding light on an otherwise sparse page whose surround sits well below the media in contrast and detail. A single irregular, torn-looking dividing boundary where the two variants meet, present as a restless edge layer whose shape is unsettled but whose position is strictly tied to the tracked height
A persistent print-like frame surrounding the media, fixed in position and scale throughout

Intensifying light raises the overall prominence of the composition as the second form nears completion, signalling progress without any readout or label
The revealed information is the relationship itself: mid states show both forms sharing one silhouette, making it evident they are the same subject

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Moving back upward rewinds the change just as smoothly through the same intermediate states; nothing is committed and no discrete steps are snapped to
interaction_model.state_change: Pointer height maps continuously and directly to the boundary's position between the two poles
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The torn edge tracks the pointer's height in real time and the visible share of each variant grows or shrinks accordingly

interaction_model.affected_object: The boundary between the two full-frame variants

interaction_model.state_change: Light intensity and position within its tint range follow the same progress value as the boundary
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Surrounding glow shifts from dim and recessive toward bright and prominent, traversing its tint range in one consistent direction, as the second variant approaches full coverage

interaction_model.affected_object: Ambient light layer around the framed media

interaction_model.state_change: Progress clamps to the corresponding pole instead of overshooting or wrapping
interaction_model.visible_feedback: One variant fills the frame completely with the light held at that pole's extreme

canonical_document.description: A large, low-distraction reading view holding one sentence, where a handful of words gain a sweeping accent underline on hover; choosing one slides those words into a single aligned column, fades the rest of the prose sideways, and brings that word's picture collection up behind them, with quiet swapping between collections and a close control that restores the sentence exactly.
canonical_document.experience_scope: Whole-view region experience with two states in one continuous place: it begins in the calm sentence-only reading state, opens into the word-column plus imagery state, and ends when the close control returns the intact sentence; no navigation to another page or overlay stack occurs at any point.
content_and_composition: One sentence of prose as the only foreground content on a large, nearly empty field that sits far enough from the text in luminance for comfortable reading
A small subset of that sentence's words (a handful) marked as choosable, visually part of the same running text
A horizontal accent bar, clearly distinguishable from both the text and the surrounding field, that appears beneath a single choosable word on hover
An aligned vertical column composed only of the choosable words, one per line, occupying the reading position after activation
Non-choosable remaining words of the sentence, which leave the composition rather than persist
A short prompt line that appears with the column and explains what the words now stand for
One image collection at a time as the layer behind the word column, filling the view as the subject
A persistent close control available for the whole duration of the open state
experience_progression: Calm, near-empty arrival: the sentence is the entire interface and only a few words hint at more
Hinting on attention: hovering a choosable word draws an accent bar sweeping in beneath it

Commit and transformation: the choosable words slide out of the sentence into one aligned column, remaining words drift sideways and fade out, the prompt appears, and the chosen collection's pictures fade up behind
Lateral browsing: collections exchange behind a stable column while the visitor stays in the same place
Return: the whole move reverses, each word travels back to its original position in the intact sentence and the pictures fade away
attention_and_information_flow: Initially attention is on reading; the only extra information is that a few words look different from the rest
Hover concentrates attention on one word and promises it is choosable before any commitment

On activation, prominence shifts from prose meaning to imagery: reading becomes looking, the sentence's non-choosable words give up their attention claim, and the chosen words are reframed as the way through the material
The prompt supplies just enough new information to reinterpret the words as collection labels
During swapping, attention stays on the changing imagery while the column remains a steady, low-motion anchor
On return, attention resolves back to the original sentence with no residue of the imagery state

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Leaving the word withdraws the bar and returns the word to plain reading appearance; hovering never commits anything
interaction_model.state_change: Word moves from plain-reading appearance to explicitly choosable
interaction_model.visible_feedback: A distinct accent bar sweeps in beneath the word
interaction_model.input: Pointer hover over one of the choosable words in the sentence
interaction_model.affected_object: That single word and its accent bar

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Clicks landing mid-transition are ignored so the move always completes cleanly; the close control is the sanctioned way back
interaction_model.state_change: Reading state transitions to open collection state with that word selected
interaction_model.visible_feedback: All choosable words slide out of the sentence into one aligned column, remaining words drift sideways and fade out, the prompt appears, and the clicked word's pictures fade up behind the column
interaction_model.input: Click a choosable word from the reading state
interaction_model.affected_object: The whole sentence, the prompt and the imagery layer

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Any other word can be chosen again freely; a click during the exchange changes nothing
interaction_model.state_change: Selected collection changes; column and layout state unchanged
interaction_model.visible_feedback: One set of pictures gives way to another in place, with the column holding still and undisturbed
interaction_model.input: Click a different word while the column is showing
interaction_model.affected_object: Only the imagery layer

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Acts as a boundary that prevents redundant or interrupted transitions; the visitor can act again once the view is settled
interaction_model.state_change: No state change
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Nothing changes; the current view stays exactly as it is
interaction_model.input: Click the already selected word, or any click during a transition
interaction_model.affected_object: None

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: The restored sentence reads exactly as it first did, so the experience can be entered again from a clean start
interaction_model.state_change: Open collection state returns to the original reading state
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The whole move plays in reverse: each word travels back to its original spot in the intact sentence and the pictures fade away
interaction_model.input: Activate the close control
interaction_model.affected_object: Word column, faded prose, prompt and imagery layer

experience_qualities: Understated, low-distraction and nearly empty on arrival
Quiet and unhurried, with motion that feels like sliding and drifting rather than snapping
Continuous and single-place, never like opening a new page
A single distinct accent standing out against an otherwise restrained, uniform field
Reversible and non-destructive, so exploring costs nothing
Shifts register from reading to looking without breaking spatial continuity
completion_and_return: There is no terminal end state; the open state persists until the visitor closes it
Switching between collections is open-ended and repeatable with no ordering or progress
Closing fully resets the view: the sentence is restored to its original wording and layout with every word back in place
No trace of the previously selected collection remains after return
locked_observable_requirements: Sparse, low-distraction arrival where a single run of prose is the entire interface and reads at comfortable contrast against its field
Only a handful of words in that prose are choosable and they remain visually part of the sentence until chosen
Hover on a choosable word produces an accent bar, clearly separated from the text and the field, sweeping in beneath it
Activation gathers all choosable words into one aligned column while the non-choosable words drift sideways and fade out
Imagery appears behind the word column as the subject, with the column remaining legible in front of it
The chosen words persist as the means of moving through the material after activation
A short prompt appears with the column to explain what the words now stand for
Switching collections exchanges imagery in place with no movement or disturbance of the column
Re-choosing the current word does nothing, and clicks during any transition do nothing
A close control reverses the entire move, returning each word to its exact original position in the intact sentence and fading the imagery away
The entire experience stays in one continuous place with no page change or stacked overlay
adaptable_details: Wording and length of the sentence
How many words are choosable and where they fall in the sentence
Palette and luminance direction of the field, the accent's hue, and the thickness of the hover bar and the direction it sweeps from
Column alignment and placement within the view
Wording of the explanatory prompt
Number, aspect ratio and arrangement of images within a collection
Timing, easing and stagger of the slide, drift, fade and exchange
Form and position of the close control
Typography of the sentence and column
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits text-led openings where a short piece of prose is worth reading on its own and a few of its words genuinely stand for distinct grouped media sets, such as an editorial lead-in, statement or portfolio intro fronting several bodies of visual work. It stays the same Skill across different copy, palettes and collection sizes, whether the field is light or deep, as long as the text stays comfortably readable and the accent stays distinct. It becomes a different Skill if the entry text is replaced by a menu, label list or thumbnail grid rather than readable prose, if choosing opens a separate page, modal or lightbox instead of transforming the same view, if the original sentence is not restorable, or if most words rather than a small subset are choosable and the sparse reading quality is lost.

name: parallax_photo_field_with_fullscreen_detail_takeover
description: Photos settle into a loose, restless field at mixed depths in front of an oversized heading; the whole field glides opposite the pointer and tilts for parallax while a trailing ring names the focused image, which swells and leans toward the pointer, and clicking it expands that item into a full-screen detail that clears the field until back returns it.

canonical_document.name: parallax_photo_field_with_fullscreen_detail_takeover
canonical_document.description: Photos settle into a loose, restless field at mixed depths in front of an oversized heading; the whole field glides opposite the pointer and tilts for parallax while a trailing ring names the focused image, which swells and leans toward the pointer, and clicking it expands that item into a full-screen detail that clears the field until back returns it.
canonical_document.experience_scope: Whole-view experience for the primary browsing area: begins with an entry hold and settle on first load, continues as a persistent steerable field, temporarily gives way to a full-screen detail state for one chosen item, and returns to the field state; ends only when the view is left.
content_and_composition: One oversized heading acting as a backdrop typographic layer behind everything else, remaining a fixed reference for the field
Many image items (a loose, uneven, non-grid field, not aligned rows) distributed across the view at mixed depth planes rather than a single flat layer
Each item carries a single photo in the resting field; its title is not shown in place at rest
A thin ring following the pointer, with the focused item's title set beside the ring as its only label surface
One detail state per chosen item containing its photo, name, secondary place line, date, short blurb and a single ticket-style primary action
At most one detail state present at any time; no second detail may coexist
experience_progression: Entry hold: a brief pause before the field is readable
Settle: photos move into their resting positions in the field, establishing depth layering against the oversized heading
Free exploration: field responds continuously to pointer movement with glide and tilt, focus passing from one item to another
Commit: chosen item expands and the surrounding field clears out as the detail takes the full screen
Return: detail exits, field is restored and becomes responsive again, exploration resumes from the field state
attention_and_information_flow: At rest, attention is spread across an atmospheric field where no single image is identifiable and the oversized heading sets context
Exactly one image is in focus at a time; it becomes identifiable while all others stay visually quiet
Identity information is revealed progressively: no title in the field, title only for the focused item beside the pointer ring, full facts and action only in the detail state
In the detail state, prominence collapses to a single item and its blurb plus primary action; the field contributes nothing to attention
Returning re-diffuses attention back to the whole field

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Runs once on entry; the settled field is the stable baseline that all later states return to
interaction_model.state_change: From held/unsettled to settled resting field
interaction_model.visible_feedback: A short hold, then photos move into their resting positions at their depth planes in front of the heading
interaction_model.input: Page entry / first view
interaction_model.affected_object: Whole image field and oversized heading layer

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Continuous and always reversible by moving back; field eases toward rest when the pointer stops or leaves; suspended entirely while a detail is open
interaction_model.state_change: Field offset and tilt track pointer position continuously
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Whole field glides opposite the direction of pointer motion and tilts slightly, so nearer and farther layers shift by different amounts and read as parallax; the scene feels hand-steered
interaction_model.input: Pointer movement across the view
interaction_model.affected_object: Entire field of images as one body, including its depth layers

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Focus transfers cleanly to a new item; on pointer leave the item eases back to its resting size and position and the title clears, remaining stable even after quick repeated passes with no accumulated drift or stuck focus
interaction_model.state_change: That image becomes the focused item; any previously focused item releases focus
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The focused image swells slightly and is pulled toward the pointer while the rest stay quiet; the thin trailing ring carries that image's title beside it
interaction_model.input: Pointer position relative to a specific image
interaction_model.affected_object: The single image nearest/under the pointer plus the pointer ring label

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Only one detail open at a time; further field interaction is inert while open; exit is available exclusively through the back control
interaction_model.state_change: From exploration state to single detail-open state; field becomes non-reactive
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The field clears out and the chosen show takes over the whole screen with its photo, name, city, date, blurb and ticket action
interaction_model.input: Click on an image
interaction_model.affected_object: Chosen item plus the surrounding field

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Restores the field to a responsive resting state so exploring continues; repeated open/close cycles behave identically
interaction_model.state_change: From detail-open back to exploration state
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Detail leaves and the field is brought back into view, resuming its steerable parallax behavior
interaction_model.input: Back control in the detail state
interaction_model.affected_object: Detail state and the image field

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Does not dismiss the detail by itself; the back control remains the way to return to the field
interaction_model.state_change: Commit action invoked from within the detail
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The action reads as the one decisive control inside the taken-over screen
interaction_model.input: Primary ticket-style action in the detail state
interaction_model.affected_object: Detail content's single call to action

experience_qualities: Atmospheric and poster-like rather than list-like
Loose, restless, alive even at rest
Hand-steered and physical, with depth read through differential motion
Quiet by default with a single point of clarity at a time
Decisive on commit: full-screen ownership and no competing content
Resilient and settled, with springy easing back to rest instead of jitter
completion_and_return: Entry settle completes once and is not repeated
Pointer-driven glide, tilt and item focus have no completion; they run continuously and idle back to rest
Detail state completes only via the back control, which restores the field and its responsiveness
Exploration resumes in the field state after every detail visit, so the loop browse → commit → return is unbounded
Field responsiveness state is strictly tied to whether a detail is open
locked_observable_requirements: Entry hold followed by photos settling into resting positions before the field is explorable
Items arranged as a loose non-grid field at mixed depth planes, not rows or a list
An oversized heading sits behind the field as a persistent backdrop layer
Whole field glides opposite pointer motion and tilts, producing visible parallax between depth layers
Exactly one item identifiable at a time while the rest stay visually quiet
A thin ring trails the pointer and carries the focused item's title beside it
Focused item swells slightly and is pulled toward the pointer, then eases back to rest on leave, stable under rapid repeated passes
Committing expands one item to full-screen with its photo, name, place, date, blurb and one primary action while the field clears
Field stops reacting to the pointer while a detail is open
At most one detail open at a time, exited only through a back control that restores the responsive field
adaptable_details: Number of items in the field and their exact scatter positions
Number of depth planes and the strength of glide, tilt and parallax offsets
Ring thickness, size, title placement side and typographic treatment
Amount of swell and pull toward the pointer, and easing timing
Length of the entry hold and the style of the settle motion
Wording and shape of the heading, the fact lines and the primary action label
Layout arrangement inside the detail state (image placement relative to text and action)
Palette, typography and image treatment
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits collections of roughly ten to a few dozen entries whose identity is carried by one strong image plus a short title, where each entry also has a few short facts, a brief description and one primary action, and where a pointer is the main driver. Replacing the scattered depth field with an aligned grid or scrolling list, showing all titles at rest, allowing multiple simultaneous details, keeping the field reactive beneath an open detail, or navigating away to a separate detail page instead of taking over the same screen would each create a different Skill. Reducing entries to text-only items or removing the pointer-focus relationship also breaks identity.

name: curved_photo_ring_drag_spin
description: Pictures gather into place and settle into a quiet low-distraction field as a concave ring curving around the viewer, spun endlessly by sideways dragging with inertial coasting, with the pointed-at picture rising to full strength while the rest fade back.

canonical_document.name: curved_photo_ring_drag_spin
canonical_document.description: Pictures gather into place and settle into a quiet low-distraction field as a concave ring curving around the viewer, spun endlessly by sideways dragging with inertial coasting, with the pointed-at picture rising to full strength while the rest fade back.
canonical_document.experience_scope: Whole-view experience: it begins at arrival with the images assembling into the ring and continues as the persistent primary view of the page; it has no exit stage, only a settled resting state after motion stops.
content_and_composition: A small set of images as the single foreground content role, each shown as an individual framed picture worth viewing on its own
Images distributed at even intervals around a closed concave ring that reads as the inner wall of a rotunda enclosing the viewer

Depth ordering across the ring: the picture directly ahead reads as deepest, its immediate neighbours lean nearer to the viewer, and further items taper off toward the left and right edges of the view
A quiet, visually recessive empty field as the persistent surrounding backdrop, held at a clearly separated luminance from the pictures and carrying no competing content
Each picture's visible framing (which part of the shot is presented within its frame) shifts as its position on the ring changes, so items read as physically placed rather than flat
No persistent chrome, labels, counters, arrows or progress indicators are required as part of the composition
experience_progression: Arrival: pictures come into place one after another in sequence rather than appearing all at once
Settling: the assembled set quiets into the recessive surrounding field and reads as a stable ring at rest
Open-ended browsing: the ring can be turned indefinitely in either direction with no first or last item, so no state reads as finished or lost
attention_and_information_flow: Attention is first carried by the sequenced arrival, which reveals the extent of the set before any interaction
At rest, prominence is distributed across the ring by depth and position rather than assigned to one item
When the pointer targets a picture, that item takes full visual strength and the remaining items recede in prominence, concentrating attention on a single image without hiding the rest
Withdrawing the pointer returns the whole set to even prominence together, restoring the overview reading
During spinning, prominence shifts continuously as items travel through the deepest centre position and out toward the tapering edges

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Rotation is unlimited in both directions and reversible at any instant mid-gesture; direction can be flipped without release
interaction_model.state_change: Ring rotation advances in step with the horizontal movement

interaction_model.input: Sideways drag or pointer/touch pull anywhere on the view, not only on an image
interaction_model.affected_object: The whole ring of pictures

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: A fresh drag started during the glide catches the ring mid-motion and takes control immediately without a jump or reset
interaction_model.state_change: Rotation decays from its released speed to rest instead of stopping abruptly
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The ring coasts on for a short glide and eases to a standstill
interaction_model.input: Release of the drag
interaction_model.affected_object: Ring rotation

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: When the pointer leaves, all items recover to their shared baseline together as one synchronized return, including when the pointer leaves during rotation
interaction_model.state_change: Targeted item enters emphasized state, others enter held-back state
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The pointed-at picture reads at full strength while the others fade back in presence
interaction_model.input: Pointer resting on or over one picture
interaction_model.affected_object: The targeted picture and all other pictures

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Returns to the grabbable reading as soon as the gesture ends
interaction_model.state_change: Idle grabbable state switches to actively held state for the duration of the gesture
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Cursor reads as something that can be grabbed at rest and as currently held while dragging
interaction_model.input: Pointer at rest over the view versus actively pressing and pulling
interaction_model.affected_object: Cursor presentation

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Gestures always resolve as ring turning, so a long or fast pull never leaves a stuck selected state
interaction_model.state_change: No selection or drag-out state is entered
interaction_model.visible_feedback: No selection highlight, ghost image or text-selection artifact ever appears during the gesture
interaction_model.input: Pressing or pulling across images and empty field
interaction_model.affected_object: Images and surrounding view

experience_qualities: Calm and gallery-like, with a low-stimulus recessive surround rather than a busy or clamorous one
Physically present and inhabited: the viewer feels surrounded rather than shown a flat strip
Weighted and continuous motion that trails, glides and settles instead of snapping
Endless and forgiving, with no beginning, end or lost position
Focused-on-demand, allowing one picture to hold attention while the set remains visible
completion_and_return: No completion or finish state; the ring loops indefinitely in either direction
Motion resolves by coasting to rest at whatever rotation the user left it at, which persists as the new resting view
Emphasis state always returns to the even baseline once the pointer leaves, with all items recovering together
locked_observable_requirements: Images arrive in sequence one after another before the view settles
Images sit on a closed concave ring that curves around the viewer, with the centre item reading deepest, neighbours nearer and outer items tapering toward the view edges
A quiet, low-emphasis field clearly separated in luminance from the images surrounds the ring with no competing foreground content
Each image's internal framing drifts as the ring turns
Sideways dragging anywhere in the view turns the ring in step with the movement, trailing the pointer smoothly

adaptable_details: Number of pictures, as long as the set stays small enough to read as one surrounding ring
Image aspect ratio and frame proportions
Ring radius, item spacing and how strongly depth and edge taper are exaggerated
Drag sensitivity, coast duration and easing character
