canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits small curated sets of self-contained visual items where each item is worth looking at individually and needs no accompanying reading material. Turning it into a flat side-scrolling strip without depth and curvature, adding a fixed first and last item, replacing the images with text-heavy cards requiring reading, scaling to a large indexable collection needing search or paging, or pushing it behind foreground content as a background substrate would each create a different Skill.

name: letter_scatter_photo_focus_row
description: A row of framed photos where hovering one scatters the letters of its short name around it and pushes the image in, and clicking clears the neighbours away so the letters gather into the name while large title words swing in from both sides, reversible via a close control.

canonical_document.name: letter_scatter_photo_focus_row
canonical_document.description: A row of framed photos where hovering one scatters the letters of its short name around it and pushes the image in, and clicking clears the neighbours away so the letters gather into the name while large title words swing in from both sides, reversible via a close control.
canonical_document.experience_scope: A region experience covering one numbered section containing a small row of image items, from the settled arrival of its imagery through hover browsing, one item's focused single-subject state, and the return to the intact row; the pattern repeats independently per section and never replaces the whole page or navigates away.
content_and_composition: One or more numbered sections, each carrying an index marker and a single plain line of copy hinting that the items can be explored
Three image items per section laid out as a row, each photo held inside a fixed frame that clips it
Per item: a short name label whose characters can act as individually movable letters, plus a longer multi-word title reserved for the focused state

Focused state composition: the chosen photo holds its place, its name assembled in position over or beside it, large title words arriving from the left and right edges of the section, and a close control present only while open
Persistent elements across states: the section index, the hint line, and the item frames that bound photo movement
experience_progression: Arrival: the imagery settles into a composed row before any affordance is offered, so nothing appears half-built and the hint line reads as an invitation once the layout is at rest
Browsing: pointer attention on any single item produces a fully reversible loose-letter and image-push reaction, repeatable across items in any order

Commit: selecting one item drives a single coordinated transition in which the neighbours drift aside and fade out, the loose letters draw in to spell the name in place, the big title words swing in from the sides, and the close control appears
Reading state: the section holds one subject only, with the chosen item's name and title as the sole things worth reading and the pointer letter reaction suspended
Return: closing runs the same move backwards, rebuilds the row with the neighbours restored, and re-enables hover browsing on all items
attention_and_information_flow: At rest, prominence is even across the row and the only text is the section index and the one short hint line, keeping the row scannable
Hover concentrates attention on one item by making its letters break loose and its image swell inside the frame, reading as reward and as a cue that the item is actionable
Opening strips competing prominence by removing the neighbouring images from view, so the focused photo, its assembled name and its incoming title words carry all the attention
The title words arriving from the sides deliver the item's full identity information only in the focused state, so detail appears as a consequence of commitment rather than upfront
Closing returns prominence to even distribution so remaining items stay easy to move through

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Fully reversible at any moment by moving the pointer away; no commitment implied and other items remain hoverable
interaction_model.state_change: Item goes from resting to hovered
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The name's letters become visible and scatter loosely around the photo while the photo pushes in slightly, staying clipped inside its frame
interaction_model.input: Pointer moves onto an item's photo while no item is open
interaction_model.affected_object: That item's short name letters and its framed photo

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Re-entering restarts the loose-letter reaction from the current position rather than requiring a completed rest
interaction_model.state_change: Hovered returns to resting
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Letters travel back to their resting arrangement and hide again, and the photo settles back to its framed size
interaction_model.input: Pointer leaves the hovered photo
interaction_model.affected_object: The scattered letters and the pushed-in photo

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Only one item may be open per section; further open or hover triggers are ignored while the transition runs, and the state is exited only through the close control
interaction_model.state_change: Section moves from row-browsing to single-subject open state
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Neighbouring photos drift aside and fade out, the loose letters draw inward and settle into the readable name in place, the large title words swing in from opposite sides, and a close control appears
interaction_model.input: Click or tap on an item's photo
interaction_model.affected_object: The whole section: chosen item, neighbouring items, title words, close control

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Repeat close triggers during the reverse transition are ignored; on completion hover browsing works again on every item
interaction_model.state_change: Open state returns to row-browsing
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The opening move plays backwards: title words leave to the sides, the name breaks back apart and hides, the neighbours fade back in and slide home, the row is rebuilt and the close control disappears
interaction_model.input: Trigger the close control
interaction_model.affected_object: Open item, faded neighbours, title words, close control

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Input is accepted again as soon as the transition settles
interaction_model.state_change: No state change
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The running move continues uninterrupted with no stutter, restart or overlap
interaction_model.input: Repeat open or close triggers during any transition
interaction_model.affected_object: The in-flight transition

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Resizing never closes an open item and never leaves the row in a half-built arrangement
interaction_model.state_change: Items re-fit to the new width
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Photos and frames re-fit into the row; an open item keeps its focused arrangement, name and title without being knocked out of the state
interaction_model.input: Window resize (autonomous, layout-driven)
interaction_model.affected_object: Row layout and item frames

experience_qualities: Composed and settled on arrival rather than assembling in front of the visitor
Playful and physical on hover, with letters behaving as loose objects and the image pressing forward
Rewarding attention: a light touch produces a noticeable, actionable reaction
Decisive on commitment, with clearing, gathering and sweeping motion reading as one coordinated move
Calm and singular in the reading state, with one name and one title as the only text worth reading
Trustworthy in return: the overview comes back whole so the rest stay easy to move through
completion_and_return: The focused state has no end of its own; it persists until the close control is used
Closing restores the row exactly as it was, including neighbour positions, opacity and hover responsiveness
No progress or selection is carried forward between items; each open and close is a complete round trip
Sections behave independently, so closing one leaves other sections untouched
locked_observable_requirements: Hover throws the letters of the item's own short name loose around the photo and reveals them only while hovered
The photo pushes in slightly on hover and remains clipped inside its frame rather than overflowing it
Moving off returns the letters to rest and hides them again
Opening moves the neighbouring items aside and fades them out instead of covering them with an overlay
The same loose letters draw in to spell the name in place, preserving continuity between hover and open states
The large title words enter from the sides in the open state and are absent before it
A close control exists only while an item is open
Closing plays the opening move in reverse and rebuilds the row
At most one item open at a time, with the pointer letter effect suspended while open
Triggers arriving during a transition are ignored rather than queued or overlapped
Resizing re-fits the row without disturbing an open item
adaptable_details: Number of items per row and number of sections, with three per section as the shown density
Photo aspect ratio and frame proportions
Scatter distances, dispersion pattern, timing and easing of letters and photo push
Which sides the title words enter from and whether they arrive together or staggered
Appearance and placement of the close control
Presence and wording of the section index and hint line
Whether the short label is a person, credit or other brief attribution and whether the title is one or several words
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits small curated sets of picture-first items where each item has a short label suitable for letter-by-letter motion plus a longer multi-word title, and where the focused state is a brief read rather than a full page. It stays the same Skill across different subject matter, item counts and motion timing. It becomes a different Skill if the label letters are not drawn from the item's own short text, if opening covers the row with an overlay or navigates to a separate view instead of transforming the row in place, if the focused state must hold long-form body copy or scrollable detail, or if the set grows large enough to need paging or scrolling inside the focus state.

content_and_composition: One continuous horizontal track containing an ordered sequence of image-led items (a bounded set, small to medium in count), traveling as a single unit
Exactly one dominant photograph per item, sized large enough that a single item commands the view while its neighbours are only partially visible at the edges
Per item caption cluster: one oversized ordinal number, one short title, and a few very short tags, plus one round explore link belonging to that item
Giant outlined display words placed between groups of items, acting as chapter markers that interrupt and segment the run
Layered depth: imagery, caption clusters and chapter words occupy distinct depth planes and shift by differing amounts as travel proceeds
Persistent overlay elements independent of track position: a slim progress indicator along the bottom edge and a small dot that trails the pointer
An opening holding state in which the first item and its caption are composed calmly with no motion
experience_progression: Arrival: still, calm holding state on the first item; nothing advances on its own
Departure: first gesture starts travel with eased acceleration rather than an instant jump
Travel: unbroken sideways glide in which items pass one at a time and caption layers drift against the imagery
Chaptering: giant outlined words move through the view between item groups, briefly dominating and then receding as the next item takes focus
Arrival at the end: the final item reads as a definite conclusion and travel settles softly against the boundary
Optional return: reversing input carries the run back through the same stages toward the opening state; the progression never loops or wraps
attention_and_information_flow: One work holds attention at a time; partial neighbours signal that more exists ahead and behind without competing for focus
The oversized ordinal registers first as an announcement, then the title, then the short tags as the item settles into view
Differing layer speeds make the caption cluster read as attached to but separable from its photograph, keeping text legible while imagery moves
Chapter words take momentary prominence as section breaks, resetting attention before the next group of items
Position information is withheld at rest and surfaces only while moving, so the indicator never competes with the imagery in the still state
The pointer-trailing dot directs attention to the current item's explore link by growing when it is over it

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Motion keeps gliding briefly after the gesture stops and reverses immediately when the gesture direction flips; travel settles softly against the first and last item without overshooting, bouncing back or wrapping around
interaction_model.state_change: Travel position advances or retreats along the single track; velocity eases in rather than starting abruptly
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The entire run glides sideways, items entering and leaving the view while caption clusters and chapter words shift by differing amounts
interaction_model.input: Wheel, trackpad or touch gesture on either the vertical or horizontal axis
interaction_model.affected_object: The whole horizontal run and everything composed on it

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Layer offsets remain consistent with travel position, so reversing the gesture unwinds the depth separation along the same path; layers stop drifting when travel settles at either end
interaction_model.state_change: Relative offsets between layers diverge in proportion to travel
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Layered parallax depth, with text and chapter words drifting at their own rates against the photographs
interaction_model.input: Continued travel in either direction
interaction_model.affected_object: Depth layers: imagery, oversized numbers, titles, tags and giant outlined chapter words

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Fading is reversible and re-triggers on any later motion; the indicator never blocks the imagery when at rest
interaction_model.state_change: Indicator visibility toggles with motion; its filled extent tracks progress through the run
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The bar fades in while the run is moving, showing how far along the journey the visitor is, and fades back out once motion settles
interaction_model.input: Motion starting and stopping (any travel driver)
interaction_model.affected_object: Slim indicator along the bottom edge

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Releasing hands control back to gesture-driven travel with momentum preserved; scrubbing is clamped to the first and last item and can be dragged back in the opposite direction at any time
interaction_model.state_change: Position is scrubbed directly to a further point in the sequence in proportion to the drag
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The run travels sideways under the drag with the same eased, layered motion, and the indicator stays visible while held
interaction_model.input: Grabbing and dragging the bottom-edge indicator
interaction_model.affected_object: Travel position of the whole run

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: The dot always catches up when the pointer stops and has no state to reset; it is a purely additive layer over the run
interaction_model.state_change: Dot position follows the pointer with a soft lag
interaction_model.visible_feedback: A small soft dot glides after the pointer instead of locking to it exactly
interaction_model.input: Pointer movement across the view
interaction_model.affected_object: Small dot that trails the pointer

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Swelling is fully reversible on exit and re-triggers on any item's link; the effect does not persist once the pointer moves away
interaction_model.state_change: Dot scale transitions between base size and an enlarged state over the link
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The dot swells around the round explore link, marking it as the way further into that item, and shrinks back on leaving
interaction_model.input: Pointer entering and leaving an item's round explore link
interaction_model.affected_object: The trailing dot and, through it, the item's explore affordance

experience_qualities: Weightless and gliding rather than clicked or stepped
Editorial and typographic, with dramatic scale contrast between giant words, oversized numbers and small tags
Layered and spatial, with a felt sense of depth between imagery and text
Calm and unhurried at rest, with a still opening state that invites rather than demands
Tactile momentum: motion that responds instantly to direction changes and decays naturally
Composed and bounded, with a definite beginning and a definite last work
completion_and_return: The run does not loop, wrap or auto-advance; it terminates at a clearly final image and holds there
Both ends absorb remaining momentum softly rather than snapping back or overshooting
The visitor can drift back through the whole run at any point and return to the calm opening holding state
The progress indicator returns to hidden whenever travel settles, in either direction
The trailing dot returns to its base size and the current travel position persists as long as the view is held
locked_observable_requirements: The collection reads as one continuous sideways run, never as stacked rows or a vertical page of items
Input on either axis (wheel, trackpad, touch) maps to horizontal travel of the whole run
Travel eases in, keeps gliding briefly after input stops, reverses immediately when input direction flips, and settles softly against the first and last item without overshooting
Each item is announced by an oversized ordinal number plus a short title and a few short tags
Giant outlined display words break the run into chapters between groups of items
Caption layers and chapter words shift by amounts different from the imagery, producing visible layered depth
Only one work holds primary attention at a time
A slim indicator along the bottom edge fades in while moving and can be grabbed to travel further
A small dot trails the pointer and swells over each item's round explore link
The experience opens in a calm, motionless holding state and ends on a clearly final image that can be drifted back from
adaptable_details: Number of items in the run and the subject matter, framing and aspect ratio of the photographs
Typeface choices, letterforms and whether the chapter words are outlined heavily or lightly
Wording and frequency of the chapter breaks, and how many tags each item carries
Exact easing curves, momentum decay length and end-settling softness
Palette, background treatment and spacing between items
Thickness, length and precise placement of the indicator within the bottom edge
Size and softness of the trailing dot and how much it grows over the explore link
Where the round explore link sits relative to each item's caption cluster
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits bounded, deliberately ordered collections of image-led entries carrying only short metadata — portfolio pieces, projects, exhibition works, lookbook shots, featured selections — where each entry deserves solo attention and the set is large enough to sustain a journey but small enough to have a felt last item. It stops being this Skill if the collection becomes a dense grid meant for side-by-side comparison, an endless or incrementally loaded feed with no final item, a vertical page of rows, or a set of text-heavy entries that must be read in place. Replacing the momentum glide with discrete snap-to-slide paging, adding automatic advance or looping, or dropping the oversized per-item announcement and giant chapter words also produces a different Skill.

name: withheld_stack_into_fullscreen_named_photo_run
description: A quiet text-first opening where a small round control teases a tilted stack of images on hover, then carries that same stack into a full-screen sideways run of named images with depth inside each frame, a thin position line, and a close that returns to the opening text at the start of the set.

canonical_document.name: withheld_stack_into_fullscreen_named_photo_run
canonical_document.description: A quiet text-first opening where a small round control teases a tilted stack of images on hover, then carries that same stack into a full-screen sideways run of named images with depth inside each frame, a thin position line, and a close that returns to the opening text at the start of the set.
canonical_document.experience_scope: Whole-view experience: begins on the quiet text-led opening state of the view, expands to occupy the full screen for the browsing state, and ends when the close control returns the view to the same opening state. Both states belong to the same view rather than separate pages.
content_and_composition: Opening state: a short reference line plus one lead paragraph as the only visible content, deliberately image-free so the imagery feels withheld
One small round entry control positioned within the opening state as the single affordance into the set
Hover preview layer: a tilted, overlapping stack of images that slides in near or from the entry control, reading as a partial glimpse rather than the full set
Browsing state: a single horizontal row of images, each frame large enough to fill the viewport region, traversed sideways
Per-image name label bound to each frame, presented one at a time so a name reads as belonging to the currently arrived image
Depth inside every frame: the image content sits on a layer that shifts relative to its frame, giving each frame interior dimension rather than flat placement
A thin continuous progress line persisting across the browsing state, reflecting the reached position through the set
A close control persisting in the browsing state
experience_progression: Quiet opening: text only, no imagery visible
Teased: hover on the entry control slides the tilted stack partially into view
Continuous entry: pressing the control carries that same stack forward into the full-screen set, so the hinted imagery becomes the imagery itself rather than being replaced by a new view
Browsing: the row glides sideways under user input, each name arriving as its own moment, with the progress line tracking how far through the set the viewer is
Return: the close control sends the photos away, restores the opening text, and rewinds the run to the first image so the next entry starts fresh
attention_and_information_flow: Attention starts on a small amount of text with nothing competing, establishing restraint before any imagery
Hover shifts a limited amount of attention to the stack as a glimpse, revealing that a set exists without revealing its contents
On entry, prominence transfers wholly to imagery; text recedes and the images become the dominant field
During browsing, prominence moves image to image as the row settles, with the arriving name carrying the identifying information for the frame currently in focus
The progress line supplies continuous low-prominence orientation so the viewer always knows position within the set without leaving the imagery
On close, prominence returns to the opening text and the imagery withdraws

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Moving the pointer off the control withdraws the preview and returns the opening state to text only; the preview is never a committed state
interaction_model.state_change: Preview stack transitions from hidden to partially revealed alongside the still-visible opening text
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The tilted, overlapping stack slides into view as a glimpse of the set
interaction_model.input: Pointer hover over the small round entry control
interaction_model.affected_object: Tilted preview stack of images

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: The close control reverses the entry and restores the opening text state
interaction_model.state_change: Opening state transitions to browsing state, with the previewed stack continuing into the opened set rather than being discarded
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The same stack carries forward and resolves into full-screen imagery; the opening text gives way and the first name and progress line become present
interaction_model.input: Press on the small round entry control
interaction_model.affected_object: Preview stack, opening text, full-screen image run

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Travel is clamped so the row never passes before the first or beyond the last image; further input in that direction produces no travel past the boundary
interaction_model.state_change: Row position advances or retreats along the set, then decelerates to a settled rest position
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Images glide sideways with an eased trailing stop; the arriving image's name reads as its own moment and the thin line updates to the reached position
interaction_model.input: Wheel or trackpad input during browsing
interaction_model.affected_object: Horizontal image row and progress line

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Releasing ends the drag where it stands; moving the pointer off the area also ends the drag in place rather than snapping or cancelling, and clamping at the first and last image still applies
interaction_model.state_change: Row follows the drag continuously while held, then ends at the position reached on release
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Images track the drag sideways and come to an eased trailing stop where the drag ended; the line reflects the reached position
interaction_model.input: Press-and-drag across the browsing area
interaction_model.affected_object: Horizontal image row and progress line

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Clamped at both ends of the set; a new swipe can interrupt and redirect an in-progress glide
interaction_model.state_change: Row glides sideways and settles at a clamped rest position
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Same eased sideways glide with trailing stop and updated position line
interaction_model.input: Swipe on a touch surface during browsing
interaction_model.affected_object: Horizontal image row and progress line

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Re-entering starts from the first image rather than the last viewed position
interaction_model.state_change: Browsing state transitions back to the quiet opening state and the run's position resets to the first image
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The photos are sent away, the reference line and lead paragraph return, and the entry control is available again
interaction_model.input: Press on the close control
interaction_model.affected_object: Image run, per-image name, progress line, opening text

experience_qualities: Quiet and withholding before entry; imagery feels earned rather than presented
Continuous rather than jump-cut: the teased stack becomes the opened set
Each image arrives as a distinct moment thanks to its own name and full-screen presence
Gliding, weighted motion with eased trailing stops rather than snapping
Bounded and predictable: motion never runs past the ends of the set
Dimensional: every frame has interior depth rather than reading as a flat picture
Oriented: position within the set is always legible without leaving the imagery
completion_and_return: No terminal completion during browsing; the run is bounded at the first and last image rather than looping
Closing is the defined return path and restores the exact quiet opening composition
Position resets to the first image on close, so the experience is not resumed mid-set
The hover preview is transient and leaves no persistent state when abandoned
locked_observable_requirements: A text-only opening state containing a short reference line and a lead paragraph with no imagery visible
A single small round entry control whose hover reveals a tilted, overlapping stack of images as a partial glimpse
Visual continuity from the previewed stack into the opened set, so entry reads as carrying the same imagery forward rather than swapping views
Full-screen imagery browsed as one horizontal run
A per-image name that arrives with its image so each image reads as its own moment
Depth inside each frame produced by image content shifting relative to its frame
A thin persistent line reflecting the reached position through the set
Eased sideways travel with a trailing stop, driven interchangeably by wheel/trackpad, press-and-drag, and swipe
Hard clamping at the first and last image with no travel beyond either end
Drag ends in place on release or on leaving the area
A close control that removes the imagery, restores the opening text, and rewinds to the first image
adaptable_details: Number of images in the set
Aspect ratio and framing of individual images
Placement, size and styling of the round entry control, close control and progress line
Tilt angle, count and offset of the previewed stack
Typography and exact wording of the reference line, lead paragraph and image names
Amount of interior depth shift and the exact easing curve and settle duration
Whether the progress line spans the full width or a portion of it
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits sets of individually named, visually strong images of comparable weight — architecture, product, artwork, project or place collections — where a short piece of lead copy should hold attention first and each item deserves full-screen attention. Item names must matter, since per-image naming is part of the identity. It suits small-to-moderate sets where sequential sideways travel between ends stays reasonable. Replacing full-screen sequential travel with a grid or vertical scroll, dropping the text-first withheld opening, removing continuity between the previewed stack and the opened set, or making entry a navigation to a separate view would each produce a different Skill.

name: oversized_title_index_with_trailing_preview_and_list_swap
description: A one-screen list of huge lowercase titles with small counts; hovering lifts a preview image behind the text that chases the pointer and tilts with its sweep, and clicking hurls the whole list off screen so the chosen entry's captioned media assembles in its place until a back arrow restores the list.

canonical_document.name: oversized_title_index_with_trailing_preview_and_list_swap
canonical_document.description: A one-screen list of huge lowercase titles with small counts; hovering lifts a preview image behind the text that chases the pointer and tilts with its sweep, and clicking hurls the whole list off screen so the chosen entry's captioned media assembles in its place until a back arrow restores the list.
canonical_document.experience_scope: Whole-view experience filling one fixed screen that never scrolls in either of its two modes; it begins when the initial load resolves into the index at rest and ends when the detail mode is dismissed and the index stands restored, ready for the next choice.
content_and_composition: Index mode: a single full-viewport stack of many oversized lowercase title entries, each paired with a small numeric count of the items it contains, sized so the entire body of work is readable at a glance without scrolling
One preview image layer sitting behind the title text, showing at most one image at a time, smaller than the viewport and positioned near the pointer so the title stays legible over it
Detail mode occupying the space the index vacated: the chosen entry's title, its count, and a set of captioned media items each carrying two short metadata fields (such as year and place)
A small marker (a plus) adjacent to each media item in detail mode that governs the reveal of that item's title
Exactly one persistent back control, present only while detail mode is open
No scrollbars, gutters of empty space or overflow in either mode; both compositions are fitted to the single screen
experience_progression: Initial load resolves into the complete index settled at rest, all titles equally prominent
Pointer rests on a title: a preview image rises behind the text, trailing the pointer with soft lag and leaning toward whichever side the pointer sweeps, then retracting when the pointer leaves
Selection: every title is thrown off screen and the chosen entry's title, count and captioned media assemble in the emptied space
Detail dwell: pointing at an item's marker eases that item slightly smaller and fans the letters of its title apart, relaxing when the pointer leaves
Return: the detail composition clears and the full index is restored intact, and the cycle can repeat indefinitely
attention_and_information_flow: At rest, typographic scale carries all prominence, so the number and names of entries read instantly; counts are quiet secondary information
Hovering shifts attention to the imagery behind the hovered title while the name stays readable on top, turning a blind choice into an informed one
Selection collapses attention to a single subject: every competing title is removed from view rather than dimmed
In detail mode, prominence rests on the media items; pointing at a marker momentarily promotes one item's title text above the rest
Returning re-flattens prominence across all titles, with no lingering trace of the entry just visited

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Retracts as the pointer leaves; fast repeated hovering interrupts and redirects whatever is still in motion instead of queueing it; no reaction at all while detail mode is open
interaction_model.state_change: Preview goes from absent to raised and continuously follows the pointer while it remains over the title
interaction_model.visible_feedback: An image emerges from behind the text, chases the pointer with a soft lag, and tips toward the side the pointer is sweeping
interaction_model.input: Pointer moves onto a title in the index
interaction_model.affected_object: Preview image layer behind the title text

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Motion always resolves to the state matching the pointer's current position, never to a stale queued state
interaction_model.state_change: The current raise/retract is cut short and re-aimed at the newly hovered title
interaction_model.visible_feedback: One preview at a time, changing direction and subject mid-motion with no backlog of delayed reveals
interaction_model.input: Pointer sweeps quickly across several titles in succession
interaction_model.affected_object: In-flight preview motion

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Undone by the single back control; while open, titles stop reacting to the pointer entirely
interaction_model.state_change: Index mode swaps to detail mode for the chosen entry
interaction_model.visible_feedback: All titles are thrown off screen, and the chosen entry's title, count and captioned media assemble in the space they vacated
interaction_model.input: Click on a title
interaction_model.affected_object: The entire index and the detail composition

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Relaxes back to rest on pointer exit; repeated quick hovering interrupts the in-progress motion rather than stacking it
interaction_model.state_change: Item shifts from resting to a revealed-title state
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The item eases slightly smaller while the letters of its title fan apart
interaction_model.input: Pointer moves onto the small marker beside a media item in detail mode
interaction_model.affected_object: That media item and its title text

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: The back control is live only while detail mode is open; on return, title hovering becomes responsive again
interaction_model.state_change: Detail mode closes and index mode is reinstated
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The focused entry clears and the complete list of titles returns intact and at rest
interaction_model.input: Click the back control
interaction_model.affected_object: Detail composition and index

experience_qualities: Unhurried and editorial, with weighty lowercase typography as the main visual material
Playful physicality in the trailing, tilting preview and the fanning letters
Decisive, whole-screen commitment on selection rather than incremental expansion
Single-subject calm in detail mode: one entry owns the space alone
Contained and screen-bound, with no scrolling and no sense of a longer page beyond the frame
Responsive rather than sluggish: motion always answers the pointer's latest position
completion_and_return: Detail mode has no end state of its own; it persists until dismissed
Dismissal restores the complete index unchanged, in the same arrangement and at rest, so repeated choices feel identical
No preview image remains visible after the pointer leaves or after a mode change
Hover-driven states always relax back to rest instead of accumulating
The overview–detail–overview cycle loops indefinitely
locked_observable_requirements: One fixed screen that never scrolls in either mode
Oversized lowercase title entries, each accompanied by a small count of the items it holds
A preview image that appears behind the hovered title, trails the pointer with visible lag, tilts according to sweep direction, and retracts on exit
Selection throws the entire list off screen and assembles the chosen entry's content in the space it vacated
Detail content includes the entry's title, its count, and captioned media items with short metadata
Exactly one back control, active only while detail mode is open
Titles are inert while detail mode is open
New pointer activity interrupts unfinished motion instead of queueing it
Returning restores the full list intact
Pointing at a media item's marker eases the item slightly smaller and fans its title letters apart, relaxing on exit
adaptable_details: Typeface, weight, color palette and background treatment
Number and ordering of title entries, and how counts are formatted
Which two short metadata fields accompany each media item and their labels
Media aspect ratios and the arrangement of items within detail mode
Magnitude of the pointer lag, tilt and the scale-down of a hovered item
Direction and choreography of the off-screen sweep and the assembly that replaces it
Glyph and styling of the per-item marker and the back control
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits curated collections small enough that all top-level entries fit one screen, where every entry has representative imagery worth previewing and a modest set of captioned media behind it. It stops being this skill if the entry list needs scrolling or pagination, if entries lack imagery to preview, if the preview becomes a static thumbnail unattached to pointer motion, or if selection expands content in place or navigates to a separate loaded view instead of clearing the list off screen and assembling the subject in the space it left.

name: eased_travel_layered_photo_and_text_descent
description: A full-page descent on a quiet, low-distraction ground where momentum-eased travel alternates dense layered photo bands with calm text stretches, neighbouring rows and oversized headings drifting against each other, and an oversized closing invitation that animates travel back to the opening.

canonical_document.name: eased_travel_layered_photo_and_text_descent
canonical_document.description: A full-page descent on a quiet, low-distraction ground where momentum-eased travel alternates dense layered photo bands with calm text stretches, neighbouring rows and oversized headings drifting against each other, and an oversized closing invitation that animates travel back to the opening.
canonical_document.experience_scope: Whole-view experience covering the entire page: it begins with a quiet holding state before content is ready, continues as the single travel surface through all alternating sections, and ends at the closing invitation, which can return travel to the opening.
content_and_composition: One continuous vertical travel surface holding the whole page; no separate scrolling panes
A quiet holding state occupying the view before imagery and lettering are ready
One opening statement revealed as the first content after readiness
Many dense image bands, each composed of multiple side-by-side photo rows stacked so imagery reads as weighty and layered in depth rather than flat on the page
Interleaved sparse writing stretches containing one short reading passage each, with generous empty space around them
Small section numbers placed alongside sections as a persistent sense-of-place marker
Oversized display phrases and headings sitting near the text passages at a larger scale than body copy
A slim progress marker persisting as a page-level overlay
One oversized closing invitation as the final section, inviting return to the opening
A quiet, uniform ground throughout, held clearly apart from the media so imagery and lettering carry the visual emphasis
experience_progression: Hold: visitors wait in a quiet, unhurried state while photographs and lettering become ready; nothing half-formed is shown
Arrival: the opening statement is revealed once ready, making entry feel deliberate
Descent: alternating rhythm of dense layered image bands and calm sparse writing stretches, section numbers tracking position
Close: the oversized invitation arrives as the resolving beat
Optional return: activating the invitation carries travel back to the opening, where the descent can begin again
attention_and_information_flow: Attention is withheld during the hold, then given a single focal statement on arrival
Prominence alternates by band: image bands pull attention wide and dense, writing stretches narrow it to one short passage in quiet space
Depth layering makes some photo rows read as nearer and others as farther, so foreground rows lead attention
Oversized phrases running ahead of or behind their passages briefly claim attention before the passage settles into reading focus
Section numbers stay peripheral, consulted rather than read
The progress marker surfaces only while moving, so position awareness rises during travel and recedes at rest
At the end, the oversized invitation dominates the view as the single remaining focus

interaction_model.state_change: Waiting state gives way to revealed opening content
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The quiet holding view resolves and the opening statement appears as a composed arrival rather than partially formed content

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: New input during the glide takes over immediately; travel stops firmly at the top and bottom limits without overshoot or bounce
interaction_model.state_change: Travel accelerates with input, keeps gliding after input stops, and eases to rest

interaction_model.affected_object: The whole travel surface and all sections on it

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Reversing travel direction immediately reverses the drift; offsets settle back toward their neutral relationship when motion rests

interaction_model.affected_object: Neighbouring photo rows within an image band

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Direction reversal instantly flips lead into lag; alignment recovers at rest
interaction_model.state_change: Display lettering leads or lags the passage it belongs to
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Oversized phrases visibly run ahead of or behind the body passage while moving, then align as motion stops
interaction_model.input: Active travel in a given direction
interaction_model.affected_object: Headings and oversized phrases relative to their text passages

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Any resumed movement brings it back; it never blocks or competes with content
interaction_model.state_change: Marker becomes visible during travel and hides when travel settles
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The marker fades in as movement starts, tracks position through the page, and fades out once at rest
interaction_model.input: Motion versus rest
interaction_model.affected_object: Slim progress marker

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Fresh wheel, trackpad or touch input interrupts the return at once and hands control back to the visitor at the current position
interaction_model.state_change: Travel animates continuously from the close back to the opening
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The page glides back through the sections, with the same drift and progress-marker behaviour visible during transit
interaction_model.input: Click or tap on the oversized closing invitation
interaction_model.affected_object: The whole travel surface

Deliberate, composed arrival rather than abrupt entry
Physical, weighted travel with momentum and soft settling
Alternating rhythm of density and calm
Layered depth rather than flat pinned imagery
Quiet, unobtrusive position awareness
Resolved, invitational ending
completion_and_return: The descent completes at the oversized closing invitation, which reads as a resolution rather than a dead end

Travel stops firmly at both extremes with no overshoot
Alternating rhythm of dense image bands and sparse writing stretches

Amount of lateral skew relative to horizontal travel
The way the name enters and exits (rise distance, fade, masking, staggering)
Typography, name placement across the image, and the tone and luminance level chosen for the surrounding field
Number of photographs in the cycle and their subject matter
Visual styling and exact position of the guidance line
Whether the same gesture is also driven by wheel, keyboard or touch equivalents
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits any small closed set of single, visually strong full-bleed images each carrying one short label, where one item at a time deserves undivided attention. Dense multi-item layouts, images that need surrounding descriptive text or controls, or sets large enough to require indexing and jumping do not fit. Replacing the proportional elastic deformation and distance-based commit with a plain slide, fade or wipe, dropping the drag gesture in favor of buttons or autoplay, or presenting several images simultaneously would each create a different Skill.

name: cursor_trailed_image_editorial_index
description: An oversized editorial index of names that unveils itself line by line after a short hold, then answers each hover with a picture that pops in at the cursor, trails it, and tilts and flares brighter the faster it is swept sideways.

canonical_document.name: cursor_trailed_image_editorial_index
canonical_document.description: An oversized editorial index of names that unveils itself line by line after a short hold, then answers each hover with a picture that pops in at the cursor, trails it, and tilts and flares brighter the faster it is swept sideways.
canonical_document.experience_scope: A whole-view list region: begins with a held-back blank state before entries appear, spans the entire scrollable list, and ends when the pointer leaves the list and the view returns to its calm resting state. Each hover episode begins and ends within this region.
content_and_composition: One vertical list of many text entries, each entry's name set at oversized editorial scale as the dominant layer
Per entry: a name, a sequence/entry number and a short secondary detail line, which surface together as one legible unit
Per entry: one associated picture that never occupies a fixed slot in the layout, rendered on a floating layer above the list and anchored to the pointer
At most one picture visible at any moment, regardless of how many entries were crossed
Non-focused entries remain present but visually quiet, preserving the full index as readable structure
Persistent elements: the list column itself and its resting typographic state
experience_progression: Held-back state: the list is withheld briefly while pictures are made ready, so the first impression is deliberate emptiness rather than partial content
Sequenced entrance: entries arrive one after another down the column, building the index as an editorial reveal
Steady browsing state: unhurried scanning where exactly one entry at a time steps into focus and the others stay quiet
Return: focus releases and the list settles back to its calm resting state, ready to be re-entered
attention_and_information_flow: Before entrance, attention has nowhere to land; the delay itself sets a composed tone
During entrance, attention travels downward with the arriving lines
On hover, prominence collapses to a single entry: its name, number, detail and picture read as one instantly legible unit while neighbours recede
The traveling picture keeps attention tied to the pointer, so the eye never has to jump between the name and a distant image slot
Fast sideways sweeps raise the picture's intensity, making speed itself a visible signal; slowing restores calm and lets the text lead again
Leaving the list returns prominence evenly to the whole index

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Any prior picture is cut short at once so only the current one is alive; a new picture always appears straight at the cursor rather than drifting from where the last one sat
interaction_model.state_change: Entry moves from quiet to focused; its picture becomes the single live floating preview
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The picture pops in immediately at the cursor position and the entry's number and detail surface together with the name as one readable unit
interaction_model.input: Pointer enters or rests on a list entry
interaction_model.affected_object: That entry's picture plus its name, entry number and secondary detail

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Motion is continuous and interruptible at any moment; stopping the pointer lets the picture catch up and rest
interaction_model.state_change: Picture continuously follows the pointer with a trailing lag
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The picture chases the cursor, staying near it without being rigidly locked to it
interaction_model.input: Pointer moves while over an entry
interaction_model.affected_object: The live floating picture

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: As movement slows the tilt eases back to level and brightness eases back to normal; no residual tilt or glow persists
interaction_model.state_change: Picture enters an energized state scaled to sweep speed, with lean determined by sweep direction
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The picture tilts toward the direction of travel and flares visibly brighter, more so the faster the sweep
interaction_model.input: Fast sideways sweep of the pointer
interaction_model.affected_object: The live floating picture

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Interruption is the expected behavior; the layer never accumulates leftovers and each new picture starts fresh at the cursor
interaction_model.state_change: Each crossing replaces the previous preview rather than queueing or overlapping
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Only the current entry's picture is ever visible; earlier pictures vanish mid-life instead of finishing their entrance
interaction_model.input: Pointer sweeps quickly across several entries in succession
interaction_model.affected_object: The floating preview layer as a whole

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Re-entering any entry starts a new preview immediately at the current cursor position
interaction_model.state_change: Preview retires and focus releases
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The picture shrinks and fades away and its following motion stops rather than coasting onward; the list returns to its calm resting state
interaction_model.input: Pointer moves off the entry or out of the list
interaction_model.affected_object: The live floating picture and the focused entry

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Placement is chosen per hover so the picture is never cut off wherever the entry sits
interaction_model.state_change: Preview anchor flips so the picture extends upward from the cursor
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The picture stays fully inside the window instead of being clipped at the bottom edge
interaction_model.input: Pointer hovers an entry positioned low in the viewport
interaction_model.affected_object: The floating picture's placement relative to the cursor

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Scrolling can be resumed or reversed at any time; the resting state is always reachable
interaction_model.state_change: List advances with momentum and comes to rest
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The column glides and settles with an eased finish rather than stopping abruptly
interaction_model.input: Scrolling the long list
interaction_model.affected_object: The list column

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Browsing gestures never produce stray highlights that the user must clear
interaction_model.state_change: Text remains unselected throughout the sweep
interaction_model.visible_feedback: No selection highlight appears to disrupt the clean editorial surface while browsing
interaction_model.input: Sweeping the pointer across entry text
interaction_model.affected_object: The list text

experience_qualities: Bold, oversized, editorial and print-like
Unhurried and fluid rather than snappy
Singular focus: one item alive at a time, everything else quiet
Physical and responsive, with speed and direction of the hand made visible
Always self-settling back to calm
completion_and_return: The entrance sequence completes once and is not repeated during browsing
Each hover episode is self-terminating: the picture retires on exit and leaves no trace
The list always returns to a single calm resting state between interactions
No accumulated or persisted preview state carries across hovers
locked_observable_requirements: A brief held-back state precedes the list rather than showing entries with unready pictures
Entries arrive in sequence down the column instead of appearing all at once
Names are set at oversized editorial scale and dominate the composition
Exactly one entry is focused and exactly one picture is alive at any moment
The picture appears at the cursor and trails it, never in a fixed layout slot
Tilt magnitude and brightness increase with sideways sweep speed, and tilt leans with sweep direction
Tilt and brightness ease back to level and normal as movement slows
Leaving an entry shrinks and fades the picture and halts its motion
A new picture starts at the current cursor position, never drifting in from the previous picture's location
A previous picture is cut short immediately when a new entry is crossed
Pictures are kept fully inside the window, extending upward from the cursor for entries low on screen
The picture surfaces together with the entry's number and secondary detail as one legible unit
Long-list scrolling glides to an eased settle
Text does not become selected while sweeping across it
adaptable_details: Exact entrance timing, stagger interval and hold duration
Typeface, weight, casing and column alignment of the oversized names
Picture aspect ratio, size and trailing lag amount
Maximum tilt angle and brightness range
How quietness of non-focused entries is expressed
Number of entries and length of the secondary detail line
Whether the entry number is a sequence, year or other short marker
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits any long single-column index of named items where each item has one representative image and one short supporting detail, and where names are the primary reading material. Requires a pointer with continuous movement to produce the trailing, tilt and brightness response. Placing the images in fixed slots beside the entries, allowing several previews to be alive at once, replacing the single-focus list with a grid of equally prominent tiles, or removing the speed- and direction-driven tilt and brightness response would each produce a different Skill.
