name: typographic_lineup_with_pointer_chased_image_reveal
description: A tall, quiet list of large text entries that arrive in sequence, where pointing at any entry snaps its picture in under the pointer and lets it chase, tilt and brighten with pointer speed while a two-digit index and a short caption slide in beside the name.

canonical_document.name: typographic_lineup_with_pointer_chased_image_reveal
canonical_document.description: A tall, quiet list of large text entries that arrive in sequence, where pointing at any entry snaps its picture in under the pointer and lets it chase, tilt and brighten with pointer speed while a two-digit index and a short caption slide in beside the name.
canonical_document.experience_scope: A region experience covering one scrollable list block: it begins with a short hold before the list appears, runs for as long as the visitor sweeps and scrolls through the entries, and ends whenever the pointer leaves the entries and the list returns to its plain typographic state.
content_and_composition: One vertical list of many entries, each entry a single line whose primary role is a name or title rendered at large typographic scale
Per entry: one image, one two-digit sequential index, and one short caption describing the entry's event or detail; all three are hidden by default
The revealed image is not laid out in the row's flow but is positioned freely, centred directly beneath the pointer and overlapping the list
Index and caption occupy inline positions beside the name, entering from the side rather than appearing in place
A soft translucent circle persistently trails the pointer across the whole region, independent of which entry is active
Default state is text-only: no borders, cards or thumbnails, so the resting composition reads as pure type
experience_progression: Brief quiet hold with nothing moving while imagery is prepared
Entries arrive one after another from top downward, drawing the eye down the lineup
Free exploration: the visitor scrolls the long list and moves between entries, each becoming the momentary focus
Leaving an entry returns that row to the plain list; leaving the region returns the whole lineup to its calm resting state, ready to be swept again
attention_and_information_flow: The opening staggered arrival directs attention down the list in reading order before any interaction
At any moment only one entry is enriched, so prominence is single-pointed while all other entries stay unemphasised and typographic
Hidden information is disclosed only on demand: identity is always visible, while picture, position number and event detail appear only for the pointed entry
Pointer speed modulates the intensity of the active picture, so faster movement reads as heightened energy and slowing movement settles attention back onto the entry

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Only one entry can be enriched at a time; entering a new entry immediately supersedes the previous one
interaction_model.state_change: Entry goes from plain text to enriched focus state
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Image snaps in from the horizontal side the pointer came from and settles centred under the pointer; index and caption slide in beside the name
interaction_model.input: Pointer enters an entry's row
interaction_model.affected_object: That entry's image, two-digit index and caption

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Motion-driven tilt and luminance lift always relax back to the neutral upright resting appearance when movement ceases, so the image never remains skewed or over-bright
interaction_model.state_change: Image position, rotation and luminance track pointer motion with lag
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The picture chases the pointer slightly behind it, tilting further and lifting in luminance the faster the pointer travels, then easing back to upright and its resting luminance as movement slows or stops
interaction_model.input: Continued pointer movement while inside an entry
interaction_model.affected_object: The revealed image

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Exit is fully reversible: re-entering re-triggers the reveal from the current pointer side
interaction_model.state_change: Enriched focus state returns to plain text
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Image slides out the opposite side from which it entered and clears; index and caption withdraw, leaving the bare name
interaction_model.input: Pointer leaves an entry
interaction_model.affected_object: That entry's image, index and caption

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Interrupted reveals resolve to the cleared state rather than finishing, guaranteeing a single active image
interaction_model.state_change: Each in-progress reveal is cut off cleanly as the next begins
interaction_model.visible_feedback: No trailing or stacked pictures accumulate; only the entry currently under the pointer holds a picture
interaction_model.input: Fast sweep across many entries in succession
interaction_model.affected_object: All entries touched during the sweep

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Scrolling never leaves more than one entry enriched; the resting list state is always reachable by moving the pointer off the entries
interaction_model.state_change: Different portions of the long lineup come into view
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Smooth, unhurried travel through the list while reveal behaviour continues to apply to whichever entry the pointer rests on
interaction_model.input: Scrolling the list
interaction_model.affected_object: The list of entries

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Persistent and non-blocking; it does not interfere with reveals and requires no dismissal
interaction_model.state_change: Marker position follows the pointer continuously
interaction_model.visible_feedback: A soft translucent circle trails just behind the pointer at all times, whether or not an entry is active
interaction_model.input: Any pointer movement in the region
interaction_model.affected_object: The trailing pointer marker

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: The arrival sequence completes on its own and leaves the list in its plain, interaction-ready resting state
interaction_model.state_change: From empty quiet hold to fully arrived lineup
interaction_model.visible_feedback: A short still pause, then entries appearing one after another down the list
interaction_model.input: Initial view of the region
interaction_model.affected_object: The whole list

experience_qualities: Calm and typographic at rest, lively only where the pointer is
Smooth and unhurried when travelling the long list
Playful, physical lag that makes imagery feel dragged along rather than pinned
Speed-responsive intensity: tilt and luminance lift escalate with haste and settle with stillness
Crisp and uncluttered even under fast sweeping, because only one picture ever survives
completion_and_return: No terminal end state; the experience returns to the plain list whenever the pointer leaves the entries
Every reveal is transient and self-clearing, so the lineup stays inviting to sweep through repeatedly
Motion-derived tilt and luminance lift always resolve back to neutral
The opening arrival sequence runs once and does not repeat during browsing
locked_observable_requirements: Resting state is text-only: names carry the composition with no visible imagery or containers
A short quiet hold precedes the list, then entries arrive sequentially top to bottom
Only one entry is enriched at any moment
The revealed image enters from the side the pointer approached from and exits the opposite side
The image is centred under the pointer and follows it with visible lag rather than sitting in fixed layout position
Tilt and luminance increase with pointer speed and ease back to upright and resting luminance as motion slows
A two-digit index and a short caption slide in beside the name during the reveal
Rapid sweeping cleanly cancels superseded reveals with no leftover or stacked images
A soft translucent circle continuously trails the pointer throughout the region
The list is long and scrollable, and travel through it feels smooth and unhurried
adaptable_details: Number of entries and length of the list
Typeface, type scale, host-supplied colour treatment and spacing of the entries
Image aspect ratio, size and crop
Exact lag amount, tilt range, luminance lift strength and easing timings
Stagger interval and duration of the opening arrival
Size, opacity and softness of the trailing pointer circle
Wording and length of the per-entry caption; index formatting so long as it stays a compact fixed-width number
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits any long roster of short text entries where each entry owns one representative image and one brief detail line — people, titles, works, sessions, products, places — presented as a scrollable index that should read as calm type until explored. Works in any host palette on light, mid or dark surrounds, provided type reads clearly against its surround and the active image can lift in luminance above its resting level. Requires a precise pointing device with continuous position and speed, since the reveal, lag, tilt and luminance response are all driven by pointer motion. Making the imagery permanently visible, placing it in fixed per-row slots, showing several pictures at once, or moving the focus mechanism to click, scroll position or automatic cycling produces a different Skill.

name: tearing_photo_quote_scene_stage
description: Scattered full-viewport photos with a very large quote across them that drift against the cursor, tear into flashing offset duplicates while a central round magnetic label is hovered, and are replaced scene by scene through small position markers.

canonical_document.name: tearing_photo_quote_scene_stage
canonical_document.description: Scattered full-viewport photos with a very large quote across them that drift against the cursor, tear into flashing offset duplicates while a central round magnetic label is hovered, and are replaced scene by scene through small position markers.
canonical_document.experience_scope: A whole-view, full-viewport experience. It begins after a short quiet wait with the first collection already composed, persists as the dominant view while the visitor moves the pointer and switches collections, and ends only when the visitor leaves the view; there is no internal sub-region that carries the experience alone.
content_and_composition: A single stage occupying the entire viewport, with no framing chrome competing for attention.
A small set of photos (a handful, not a grid-full) positioned unevenly across the viewport with deliberately irregular spacing and no aligned rows or columns.
One short quote per collection, set very large and laid across the photos so words and pictures overlap and read as one composition rather than caption-below-image pairs.
One round label near the centre of the stage acting as the focal interactive element and visual anchor.
A small persistent set of position markers, one per collection, indicating how many collections exist and which one is currently shown.
Layering: photos form the picture surface, the oversized quote sits across that surface, the round label and markers sit above both and remain present through every collection change.
experience_progression: Short quiet wait with the stage withheld, so the first impression is of arrival rather than assembly.
The first collection appears already composed, photos and quote presented together as a finished editorial layout.
Idle state that feels faintly alive and slightly unstable, as if the picture surface could tear apart at any moment.
On each marker choice, a deliberate scene change: the current collection gives way and the next collection arrives as a new composed stage, with markers updating to the new position.
The stage returns to its faintly unstable idle state after each scene change, ready to be reacted to and switched again in either direction.
attention_and_information_flow: Attention first lands on the composition as a whole because the oversized quote and the spread of photos are read together, not sequentially.
Continuous drift keeps low-level attention on the picture surface without revealing new information.
Cursor proximity promotes the round label to the focal point by pulling it toward the pointer, signalling that something will happen there.
Hovering the label briefly redirects attention to the instability itself: photos break into duplicates and the quote jolts, making the surface rather than its content the subject for a moment.
Markers hold quiet, persistent orientation information: how many collections exist and where the visitor currently is, only becoming prominent when the visitor looks for a way onward.

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Not interruptible or repeatable; the composed state is the stable resting state the rest of the experience returns to
interaction_model.state_change: Withheld stage becomes the first fully composed collection
interaction_model.visible_feedback: After a short quiet pause the composition appears already arranged, photos spaced across the viewport with the large quote across them
interaction_model.input: Autonomous timed reveal at first view
interaction_model.affected_object: The whole stage: photos, quote, label and markers

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Motion always eases rather than jumping; when the pointer slows, stops or leaves, photos ease back toward their resting arrangement, and drift never accumulates enough to break the composition
interaction_model.state_change: Resting positions shift to small offsets opposed to the pointer direction
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Photos drift smoothly a small distance against the pointer, easing continuously without snapping, while the overall arrangement stays intact and readable
interaction_model.input: Cursor movement anywhere in the view
interaction_model.affected_object: The visible photos as a group

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Moving the cursor away releases the label, which glides back to its rest position near the centre; leaving mid-pull simply returns it
interaction_model.state_change: Label leaves its rest position and follows the pointer while inside the proximity range
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The label is pulled toward the cursor as if magnetically attracted, tracking it smoothly
interaction_model.input: Cursor approaching within a short distance of the round central label
interaction_model.affected_object: The round central label

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: The effect lasts only while the label is hovered; on leaving, duplicates collapse and everything settles cleanly back to the stable composition with no residue
interaction_model.state_change: Stable picture surface enters a torn, unstable state and the quote receives a one-off displacement
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Photos tear into offset, flashing duplicates of themselves while the quote jolts once
interaction_model.input: Hovering the round central label
interaction_model.affected_object: The visible photos and the oversized quote

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Clicking the already-active marker does nothing; further clicks are ignored until the change has finished, after which any collection is reachable again in either direction
interaction_model.state_change: Current collection is replaced by the chosen collection and the active marker moves to the new position
interaction_model.visible_feedback: A deliberate scene change in which the current composition gives way and the new collection arrives as a composed stage, with the marker set visibly showing the new current position
interaction_model.input: Clicking an inactive position marker
interaction_model.affected_object: The whole collection stage and the marker set

experience_qualities: Editorial and composed rather than list-like
Faintly alive and slightly unstable at rest
Physically responsive, with easing and attraction rather than snapping
Momentarily violent on hover, then cleanly resolved
Deliberate and orienting when moving between collections
completion_and_return: No terminal end state: the stage remains available and every collection is reachable again in either direction.
The drift and magnetic pull always resolve back to the resting composition and resting label position.
The tearing state is strictly temporary and fully reverses on leaving the label.
The current collection stays identifiable at all times through the marker set, which persists across scene changes.
Scene changes are atomic: input is ignored until the change completes, then the new collection becomes the stable state.
locked_observable_requirements: Photos are spaced unevenly across the whole viewport and the quote is set very large across them so that pictures and words read as one composition.
The first collection is presented already composed after a short quiet wait, not assembled piece by piece in front of the visitor.
The idle stage reads as faintly alive and on the verge of tearing apart.
Pointer movement anywhere produces small, continuously eased photo drift opposed to the pointer direction that never breaks the arrangement.
A round central label is pulled toward the cursor on proximity and glides back to rest when the cursor withdraws.
Hovering that label tears the visible photos into offset flashing duplicates and jolts the quote once, then everything settles cleanly on leaving.
Collection changes read as deliberate scene changes, not as scrolling or list filtering.
The currently shown collection is always identifiable, and every collection is reachable again in both directions.
The active marker is inert to clicks and further input is ignored until a change has finished.
adaptable_details: Number of collections and number of photos per collection, as long as the count stays small enough to keep uneven spacing readable
Exact photo positions, sizes and crop proportions
Typeface, colour and line arrangement of the oversized quote, as long as the quote keeps readable contrast over the imagery it crosses
Visual treatment of the round label and its content, as long as it stays clearly separated from the picture surface behind it
Form and placement of the position markers, as long as the active one stays distinguishable from the inactive ones
Exact durations of the initial wait, drift easing, magnetic return and scene change
Drift distance, proximity radius and duplicate offset magnitude within the stated small ranges
Direction and choreography of the scene change transition
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits small curated image sets paired with one short piece of text per set, where the pairing is meant to be experienced as a single striking composition and text length stays short enough to be set very large across the imagery. It stops being this Skill if the imagery becomes a dense browsable grid or a scroll-driven feed, if the text grows into readable body copy that must sit outside the pictures, if the drift and tearing are removed so the stage becomes visually static, or if the stage is pushed behind other foreground content as a background layer rather than being the view the visitor is looking at.

name: scroll_swapped_caption_tile_grid
description: A screen-filling grid of same-sized captioned picture tiles that holds its position while scrolling swaps the contents of every tile at once, each picture and caption sliding up out of its frame as the replacement rises in from below, staggered tile by tile so the exchange ripples across the whole arrangement.

canonical_document.name: scroll_swapped_caption_tile_grid
canonical_document.description: A screen-filling grid of same-sized captioned picture tiles that holds its position while scrolling swaps the contents of every tile at once, each picture and caption sliding up out of its frame as the replacement rises in from below, staggered tile by tile so the exchange ripples across the whole arrangement.
canonical_document.experience_scope: A whole-view, screen-filling region that begins when the grid fills the viewport and locks in place, spans a scroll range covering a handful of successive exchanges, and ends when the final complete set is at rest and the page resumes normal scrolling. The grid frame itself never travels with the scroll; only its contents change.
content_and_composition: One grid of evenly sized picture tiles occupying the full viewport, all tiles equal in visual weight with no hero or featured slot
Each tile pairs one image with a short title caption directly beneath it, treated as a single unit that enters and leaves together
Tile frames are persistent containers: they stay fixed in position and size while their picture and caption contents are exchanged
Multiple ordered content sets of identical shape, each set filling every tile in the grid simultaneously
Each frame masks its contents so outgoing material disappears at the frame's top edge and incoming material appears from its bottom edge
No numbered pager, thumbnail rail or arrow controls are required; the grid is the whole composition
experience_progression: Grid arrives and settles as one complete, undisturbed set with all captions legible

Scrolling forward drives a single continuous exchange in which every tile's picture and caption leave upward and their replacements rise into place, with per-tile offsets producing a ripple that crosses the arrangement
The exchange eases in gently, accelerates through the middle, and decelerates to rest on the next complete set
This cycle repeats a small fixed number of times, one exchange per screen-height of scrolling
The sequence comes to rest on one complete final set rather than mid-exchange or on an empty state
attention_and_information_flow: Attention is distributed across the whole grid rather than led to a single focal item, because every tile changes in the same beat
The staggered offsets give the eye a readable direction of travel across the arrangement without any tile dominating
During an exchange, information is briefly doubled and partial: outgoing and incoming pictures and captions coexist, so momentary illegibility is expected mid-motion
Legibility is fully restored at rest, when a complete set of image-and-title pairs can be read together
Because the grid never scrolls away, the visitor's frame of reference stays constant and only the content identity shifts

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Progress tracks scroll position moment to moment, so the visitor can slow, hasten or halt the exchange at will; the grid stays in place throughout
interaction_model.state_change: Advance along a continuous exchange from the current complete set toward the next one, positioned directly by scroll offset
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Current picture and caption slide up and out of each frame while the replacement pair rises in from below, neighbouring tiles beginning slightly after one another so the change ripples across the grid; the motion begins gently, accelerates, then settles
interaction_model.input: Scrolling the page downward while the grid is pinned
interaction_model.affected_object: The picture and caption inside every tile of the grid

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Resuming scroll in either direction continues from exactly that held position with no jump
interaction_model.state_change: The exchange holds at its current partial position instead of snapping to either end
interaction_model.visible_feedback: A partly exchanged grid remains on screen, with outgoing and incoming pictures and captions visible at their intermediate offsets and neighbouring tiles held at slightly different points of the ripple
interaction_model.input: Stopping scrolling part way through an exchange
interaction_model.affected_object: The in-flight exchange across all tiles

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Retracing is symmetric and lossless: any earlier set can be returned to simply by scrolling back the same distance
interaction_model.state_change: The same exchange runs in reverse toward the previously shown set
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Incoming material retreats downward out of frame while the earlier picture and caption drop back into place, the ripple replaying in reverse order
interaction_model.input: Scrolling back upward
interaction_model.affected_object: The picture and caption inside every tile

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Overscrolling past an end does not distort the grid; the boundary set simply holds until scrolling moves back into range
interaction_model.state_change: Rest on a boundary set
interaction_model.visible_feedback: A complete, undisturbed set with all pictures and captions fully in frame; no partial or half-swapped state is ever left at an end
interaction_model.input: Reaching either end of the grid's scroll range
interaction_model.affected_object: The whole grid

experience_qualities: Self-explanatory: the coupling of scroll to exchange is understood without instructions or hints
Directly steerable, with the visitor feeling they are dragging the change rather than triggering an animation
Continuous and unbroken, reading as one sweeping change of the whole grid rather than many separate tile animations
Rhythmic and orderly, thanks to a fixed one-screen-per-exchange cadence and a consistent ripple direction
Composed and calm at rest, since the grid holds its position and settles into fully legible states
Finite and reassuring: a handful of exchanges with a definite last set, not an endless feed
completion_and_return: Completion is reaching the final exchange and resting on one complete final set, after which normal page scrolling continues
Fully reversible: scrolling up retraces every exchange back to the first complete set
No looping or wrap-around past the last set; both ends are stable, undisturbed complete sets
State is derived from scroll position, so returning to any scroll offset shows the same grid state as before
locked_observable_requirements: The grid stays in place, filling the screen, instead of travelling past the viewport during the exchanges
Every tile exchanges its picture and caption in the same continuous sweep, not one tile at a time on separate triggers
Picture and caption move together as one unit per tile
Outgoing content exits upward out of its frame while incoming content rises into place from below, clipped by the frame
Neighbouring tiles start a fraction behind one another so the change visibly ripples across the arrangement
Each exchange eases in, accelerates and settles rather than moving at constant speed
Exchange progress is bound to scroll position, so stopping holds a partly exchanged state on screen
Scrolling back upward plays the same exchange in reverse

Card stage: attribution lines surface and dissolve one after another on the otherwise empty holding field, building anticipation with small increments of text
Uncovering: the occlusion lifts off the key image, which fills the viewport, while the card stage concludes
Settling: title and credit block arrive over the artwork and come to rest in a stable, readable position
Sustained state: the picture stays unstill and audio-reactive indefinitely, with no terminal stage and no finish line to reach
attention_and_information_flow: At entry the occluding layer suppresses all content so the single start control is the only thing to look at or act on
During the card stage exactly one line is legible at a time, so information is released in a slow drip rather than as a block
At uncovering prominence transfers wholly from text to the full-frame image
Text returns as a calm, permanently readable overlay that competes with the artwork's motion without being disturbed by it
After settling no new information is revealed; attention is held only by low-amplitude continuous change synchronised to the sound

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: The control stops responding permanently once pressed; repeat presses cannot restart the sequence, replay the cards or stack a second soundtrack. There is no in-view way back to the holding screen.
interaction_model.state_change: Armed silent hold transitions to running; sound, the card sequence and the uncovering all begin together from this one press
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The first attribution card surfaces on the holding field and the occlusion begins to retract from the artwork as sound starts
interaction_model.input: Single press of the one start control on the occluding holding screen
interaction_model.affected_object: Holding screen, soundtrack, card sequence and the uncovering of the key image

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: The track rolls over into itself so the reaction never stops or falls flat; the user has no direct control over the warp, and quiet passages are the calm floor rather than a stopped state
interaction_model.state_change: Warp intensity rises on heavy low passages and relaxes on quiet ones, tracking the music continuously rather than in discrete beats
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The artwork swells and settles in a subtle, hypnotic distortion — always alive, never busy, and never resolving into a static poster
interaction_model.input: Autonomous soundtrack, sampled moment to moment (low-frequency energy and overall loudness)
interaction_model.affected_object: The revealed key image

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Sound playback and the audio-reactive motion continue uninterrupted; the opening stages are not replayed
interaction_model.state_change: Artwork refits to the new viewport and re-centres; overlay stays in its settled position
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The image continues to fill the frame and stay centred with no gaps, drift or crop jump
interaction_model.input: Viewport resize
interaction_model.affected_object: Framing of the key image and the overlaid title and credit block

experience_qualities: Hushed and low-stimulus, with the feeling of the surroundings being emptied of everything else just before something begins
Withheld then granted: anticipation is built by delay rather than by density
Hypnotic and unstill rather than busy or energetic
Calm, readable text held steady over continuously moving imagery
Endless and unresolved, with no completion to work toward
completion_and_return: No completion state: the sustained audio-reactive condition loops indefinitely
The soundtrack rolls over into itself seamlessly so the visual reaction has no gap or stopping point
The entry gate is one-shot for the life of the view; the opening cannot be re-watched without reloading
Title and credit overlay persist permanently once settled
locked_observable_requirements: The experience starts silent with all content occluded and exactly one actionable element on screen
Sound is requested before any content is shown, and one press starts sound, cards and uncovering together
Attribution cards appear and dissolve strictly one at a time, alone and clearly legible on the holding field
The key image is revealed by the occluding layer lifting off it and then fills the viewport
Title and credit block settle into a stable, calmly readable position over the artwork
The image's warping tracks the music moment to moment, swelling on heavy low passages and settling on quiet ones
The reaction never stops: the audio loops back into itself with no visible finish line
The start control becomes inert after its single use so the sequence cannot restart or double up
Resizing refits and re-centres the artwork without interrupting playback or motion
adaptable_details: Number, wording and pacing of the attribution cards
Duration of the occluded hold and of the uncovering
Subject and colour treatment of the key image, and the tone of the holding field, provided the field hides the artwork completely and keeps each card legible
Style of the warping (which direction or shape the distortion takes) as long as it stays subtle and music-linked
Label, shape and placement of the start control
Typography and placement of the title and credit block
How the occlusion retracts (direction or pattern of the lift)
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits single-purpose, low-text-density views built around one dominant image and a few lines of credit-style text, where sound is central to the message and lingering is the intended behaviour. It stays recognisable with different artwork, different attribution lines, a different holding-field treatment and a different track. It becomes a different Skill if the view must carry scrollable or dense content, several competing interactive regions, or must deliver its effect with no audio or while muted; likewise if the motion is driven by pointer, scroll or a fixed timeline instead of the playing sound, or if the opening becomes replayable and the experience gains a defined ending.

name: billowing_cloth_photo_column
description: An endlessly looping, gently tilted vertical column of photos with one held mid-screen as a rippling sheet of hung fabric; travelling flattens the fabric and hides titles while the view leans with speed, then it settles onto the nearest photo whose large title rises as the billowing restarts.

canonical_document.name: billowing_cloth_photo_column
canonical_document.description: An endlessly looping, gently tilted vertical column of photos with one held mid-screen as a rippling sheet of hung fabric; travelling flattens the fabric and hides titles while the view leans with speed, then it settles onto the nearest photo whose large title rises as the billowing restarts.
canonical_document.experience_scope: Whole-view experience filling the viewport, present from arrival already settled on one photo; it has no end state and no exit, continuing to loop in both directions for as long as the view is open.
content_and_composition: One vertical column carrying a small curated set of portrait images (a handful, roughly five to a dozen), repeating without seam in both directions
One image held in a fixed mid-screen focus slot at any moment; that image is the visual subject of the whole view
One short title per image, shown large and only for the currently settled focus image
Neighbouring images visible above and below the focus, progressively fading toward the top and bottom edges so more content is clearly implied in both directions
The whole column axis sits gently tilted off vertical rather than upright, and leans further while travelling
The focused image is presented as a suspended fabric sheet with continuous soft ripple, not as a flat picture
Persistent elements: the mid-screen focus slot, the edge fading, the tilt, and the endless neighbour images
experience_progression: Rest state: one photo centred, its large title in place, the sheet billowing continuously and never perfectly still
Travel begins on wheel or drag: ambient billowing stops, the sheet pulls flat, titles drop out of sight
Mid-journey: the whole view leans over further and the photos pinch inward in proportion to travel speed, so imagery smooths out and reads as motion rather than as pictures
Coast: motion carries on with inertia after input stops and eases to rest instead of halting abruptly
Brief pause after rest, then resolution: the nearest photo eases into the middle, its large title rises back into place, and the billowing picks up again
The cycle repeats indefinitely in either direction with no first or last item to reach
attention_and_information_flow: Attention lands immediately on the single large mid-screen photo; everything else is peripheral and faded
Text is withheld during travel so nothing competes for reading while imagery is in motion
Lean angle and inward pinch act as a continuous readout of travel speed
Arrival of the large title is the confirmation signal that a photo has been found and selected
Edge fading continuously communicates that more content waits above and below rather than being an edge or limit

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Further wheel input during coasting adds to or redirects momentum; the column cannot be overshot past a valid item and any deceleration always resolves onto a single photo
interaction_model.state_change: From settled to travelling with accumulated momentum
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Column moves along its tilted axis, ambient ripple stops and the sheet flattens, titles vanish, the whole view leans and photos pinch inward more strongly the faster it travels
interaction_model.input: Wheel gesture over the view
interaction_model.affected_object: The looping photo column and the focused sheet

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Releasing hands over to inertia and settling; dragging out of the window simply settles onto the closest photo instead of stalling or jumping
interaction_model.state_change: From settled to dragged travel, then handed off to inertial coasting on release
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The column follows the drag loosely with lag rather than tracking the pointer exactly, with the same flattening, title hiding, lean and pinch as wheel travel
interaction_model.input: Vertical press-and-drag
interaction_model.affected_object: The looping photo column

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: New input during the pause or the settle interrupts it and returns immediately to the travelling state; whatever happens, the view always ends on exactly one centred photo
interaction_model.state_change: From travelling to settled focus
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The nearest photo eases into the mid-screen slot, its large title rises back into place, the sheet begins to billow again and the view returns to its gentle resting tilt
interaction_model.input: Stopping or letting go (autonomous settle after a brief pause)
interaction_model.affected_object: The nearest photo and its title

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Continuous and always reversible by moving the pointer; leaving it still keeps ambient billowing going, and travel suppresses it entirely until the next settle
interaction_model.state_change: Ripple direction shifts to match where the pointer sits
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The breeze appears to push the fabric from the pointer's side, so the ambient motion feels steered by the visitor
interaction_model.input: Pointer position within the view while settled
interaction_model.affected_object: The billowing focused sheet

experience_qualities: Calm and weightless travel rather than mechanical stepping
Tactile and alive: the subject image is never perfectly still
Unhurried, with a deliberate pause before confirmation
Physical, as if a hung cloth is being moved past in a breeze
Endless and boundary-free, with no sense of hitting a start or finish
completion_and_return: No completion or end point; the column loops seamlessly in both directions
Every interaction returns to the same resting state: one centred photo, title visible, ambient billowing active
The resting focus persists until the next input, acting as the view's stable state
locked_observable_requirements: Gently tilted, seamlessly looping column with no reachable start or end
Exactly one photo held in a fixed mid-screen focus slot at rest
Neighbouring photos fade out toward the top and bottom edges
Continuous fabric-like billowing applied to the focused photo only
Lean of the whole view and inward pinching of photos scale with travel speed
Billowing stops, sheet flattens and titles disappear while travelling
Inertial coast that eases to rest, a brief pause, then a snap of the nearest photo into the centre
Large title rises back into place on settling and confirms the found photo
Pointer position steers the direction of the ambient billowing
Overshoot is impossible and leaving the window settles onto the closest photo
adaptable_details: Number of images in the set and their exact aspect ratio
Tilt angle, fade depth and spacing between neighbours
Ripple amplitude, speed and softness of the fabric motion
Typography, size and placement of the title relative to the focused photo
Duration of the settling pause and the easing character of coast and snap
Any colour and luminance treatment of the imagery and its low-distraction surround, provided the title stays clearly readable against it, and how strongly the pinch reads at high speed
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits small curated sets of single-subject imagery where each item carries one short label and browsing one item at a time is the point, used as a whole-view browsing surface. Dense grids, multi-field metadata, text-heavy items, or ordered content that needs a real beginning and end break its identity; so does removing the fabric behaviour and speed-reactive lean, which would reduce it to an ordinary snapping image carousel and make it a different skill.

name: torn_fragment_portrait_parallax_poster
description: A tall poster view where a bold uppercase headline sits over a single large portrait assembled from torn photo fragments; scrolling slides the fragments and headline past one another at different rates and directions so the face opens into separate layers, then closes back into perfect alignment on reverse scroll.

canonical_document.name: torn_fragment_portrait_parallax_poster
canonical_document.description: A tall poster view where a bold uppercase headline sits over a single large portrait assembled from torn photo fragments; scrolling slides the fragments and headline past one another at different rates and directions so the face opens into separate layers, then closes back into perfect alignment on reverse scroll.
canonical_document.experience_scope: A whole-view experience occupying the opening screen and continuing a short distance past it; it begins at arrival and ends once the layers have visibly separated, with nothing further offered below.
content_and_composition: One bold uppercase headline as the primary statement, sized to hold the view on its own and held at readable contrast against whatever sits beneath it
One large portrait subject occupying the dominant area of the view, composed of multiple torn-edged photo fragments that overlap into a single readable face
Each fragment is a distinct visual piece with its own torn boundary; overlaps are visible where pieces meet through edge separation rather than through any particular tint
A quiet supporting detail line (date and place role) placed at a side edge, small and secondary, persistent through the experience
Headline and fragments share the same visual field and overlap in layer order rather than sitting in separate columns
Tall portrait-oriented framing of the whole composition, taller than a single screen
experience_progression: Arrival: fragments sit nested in their exact alignment so the portrait reads as one flat assembled image under the headline
Early advance: individual fragments and the headline begin to displace by differing amounts, some following the scroll direction and some opposing it
Continued advance: overlaps visibly slide apart and the single picture reads as separate stacked planes rather than one flat surface
Reverse: displacement retraces the same positions and every fragment re-nests into its original alignment, restoring the flat assembled portrait
No further stage follows separation; the announcement reads as complete
attention_and_information_flow: The artwork holds first attention; the headline is read as part of the poster rather than as a separate banner
The supporting date and place detail stays deliberately low in prominence at the side edge and is found after the artwork
No new textual information is revealed by scrolling; what changes is the perceived depth and construction of the picture
Separation of layers makes the hand-assembled, torn-edge nature of the portrait more legible as the visitor advances

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Displacement maps directly to scroll position and is fully reversible; scrolling back re-nests every fragment into its original alignment with no residual offset
interaction_model.state_change: Each element displaces vertically by its own amount, some in the scroll direction and some against it, changing relative offsets between overlapping pieces
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Fragments slide across one another and the headline, overlaps open, and the portrait resolves into separate depth planes
interaction_model.input: Vertical scroll position, the only driver of the composition
interaction_model.affected_object: Each torn photo fragment and the headline, individually

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: No accumulated drift or misalignment after rapid movement
interaction_model.state_change: Positions remain bound to the current scroll position rather than lagging into an inconsistent arrangement
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The assembly stays coherent and returns to exact nesting when scroll returns to the top
interaction_model.input: Fast or abrupt scrolling
interaction_model.affected_object: Fragment and headline positions

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: No drift introduced by resizing
interaction_model.state_change: Composition re-fits and offsets remain correctly anchored to scroll position
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Fragments stay in their intended relationship; original alignment is still exact at the top of the view
interaction_model.input: Window resize or viewport change
interaction_model.affected_object: Whole composition and fragment offsets

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Static state is the complete experience for that visitor; nothing is missing from the announcement
interaction_model.state_change: Scroll-linked displacement is suppressed; the composition holds its nested arrangement
interaction_model.visible_feedback: A still poster: the flat assembled portrait, headline and side-edge detail remain fully readable
interaction_model.input: System request for reduced motion
interaction_model.affected_object: The entire assembled picture and headline

experience_qualities: Printed-poster stillness and boldness at first sight
Hand-torn, collaged, physically assembled character
Depth revealed through motion rather than shading or tonal modelling
Tight and finite: one statement, one image, no invitation to keep looking
Precise and mechanical reversibility that makes the layers feel like real stacked material
completion_and_return: The experience completes shortly after the layers separate; no additional content is promised or required below
Returning to the top restores the exact original nested composition every time
No persistent altered state remains after scrolling away and back
locked_observable_requirements: One tall single-view poster composition dominated by one bold uppercase headline and one large portrait subject
The portrait must be built from multiple overlapping torn-edged fragments that read as one face when nested
Vertical scroll must be the sole driver of the composition's movement
Fragments and headline must move by differing amounts, with some moving against the scroll direction, so overlaps visibly slide apart into separate planes
Displacement must track scroll position exactly and be fully reversible, re-nesting into the original alignment with no drift after fast scrolling or resizing
Supporting date and place detail must remain quiet at a side edge and never compete with the artwork
Under reduced-motion preference the composition holds completely still and remains fully readable
adaptable_details: Number, shapes and sizes of the fragments
Subject of the assembled image and the photographic material used
Specific headline wording, typeface, and the color treatment of type, fragments and surround, provided the headline keeps readable separation from what lies beneath it
Which side edge carries the supporting detail line
Exact displacement amounts and which fragments travel with versus against the scroll
How far past the opening view the separation continues before settling
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits single-message announcement or statement pages whose foreground is one dominant image subject plus one short bold headline and a small set of quiet particulars, and where the page is intentionally short. It stops being this Skill if the assembled subject is replaced by a full-bleed uniform background image behind unrelated foreground content, if the layered picture becomes a decorative substrate rather than the main subject, if scrolling instead drives sequential storytelling with new content sections, or if motion is driven by pointer, time or autoplay rather than mapped exactly to scroll position.

name: springy_photo_prints_on_giant_lettering
description: Huge display lettering fills a quiet single view while two photo cards lie on top of it like loose prints; each print can be grabbed and dragged, trailing behind the pointer, squeezing and swelling as it is carried, then settling exactly where it is dropped.

canonical_document.name: springy_photo_prints_on_giant_lettering
canonical_document.description: Huge display lettering fills a quiet single view while two photo cards lie on top of it like loose prints; each print can be grabbed and dragged, trailing behind the pointer, squeezing and swelling as it is carried, then settling exactly where it is dropped.
canonical_document.experience_scope: Whole-view experience: it begins with a full-bleed cover holding the view closed, opens into one settled composition that occupies the entire viewport, and continues indefinitely as an open-ended handling surface with no exit or next screen.
content_and_composition: One dominant layer of oversized display lettering carrying a short phrase (a pair of names), sized to be the first thing read
A small fixed set of photo cards, two in the supplied case, each a framed portrait image behaving as a loose print laid on the surface
Photo cards overlap the lettering layer and may overlap each other; z-order is not fixed and changes with handling
One small persistent hint element indicating the prints are meant to be handled, present from the settled state onward
A quiet full-bleed cover layer above everything before the reveal, then absent
Calm, uncluttered, low-distraction background surface with generous empty space, holding enough separation from the prints that displaced prints never look broken
experience_progression: Closed: a quiet full-bleed cover holds the whole view while imagery and display lettering are not yet ready to be shown together
Reveal: the cover gives way in one coordinated move to the finished composition rather than parts appearing piecemeal
Settled: lettering reads first, prints sit at rest in their initial arrangement, handling hint visible
Open handling: repeated pick-up, carry and release cycles with no ordered sequence, no goal and no end state
attention_and_information_flow: Before the reveal, attention is deliberately withheld; nothing partial competes for the eye
At reveal, the oversized lettering takes first read and establishes the message
The photo cards read second as tactile accents, promoted momentarily by the handling hint
During a drag, the held print becomes the visual focus: it comes forward over the other and its interior image enlarges, while the lettering recedes to backdrop
On release, focus relaxes back toward the lettering and the whole arrangement reads as one calm composition again

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: One-way and one-time; the cover does not return and the reveal is not repeated or skippable mid-way
interaction_model.state_change: View moves from held-closed to fully revealed
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The quiet cover clears and the settled composition of lettering plus resting prints appears as one finished picture
interaction_model.input: Assets and display lettering becoming ready to present together
interaction_model.affected_object: Full-bleed cover layer and the whole composition beneath it

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Only one card is held at a time; the other card remains untouched and at rest
interaction_model.state_change: Card moves from rest to held
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Card squeezes/deforms, its picture swells and shifts within its frame, and it lifts in front of the other card; the pointer reads as held instead of grabbable
interaction_model.input: Press and hold on a photo card with pointer or finger
interaction_model.affected_object: The pressed photo card and its stacking relationship to the other card

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Motion can stop, reverse or change speed at any moment; the card always converges back to the input without overshooting away
interaction_model.state_change: Card follows the input with lag rather than locking to it
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Card trails slightly behind the hand, stretches in the direction of travel, then springs forward to catch up as the motion slows; the interior picture keeps sliding inside its frame
interaction_model.input: Moving the pointer or finger while holding a card
interaction_model.affected_object: Held photo card position, shape and interior image offset

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: No snapping back to an original slot, no rejected drops, no invalid areas; releasing off the card or outside its start region still leaves it in place
interaction_model.state_change: Card moves from held back to rest at its dropped position
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Card stays exactly where it was let go while the squeeze and image swell ease back to their resting shape; the pointer returns to grabbable
interaction_model.input: Release anywhere in the view
interaction_model.affected_object: Held photo card

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Leaving the card returns the pointer to its normal state with no other change
interaction_model.state_change: Pointer reads as grabbable
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Cursor affordance signals the card can be picked up, reinforcing the persistent handling hint
interaction_model.input: Hovering a resting card without pressing
interaction_model.affected_object: Pointer state over the card

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Unlimited repetition; each card's last dropped position becomes its new resting position and the arrangement is never reset for the visitor
interaction_model.state_change: Card re-enters the held state from wherever it currently lies
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The same squeeze, swell, front-most lift and elastic follow as the first time
interaction_model.input: Repeated pick-up of any card from any position, including one previously dropped far from its start
interaction_model.affected_object: Any photo card in the set

experience_qualities: Calm and settled at rest, playful only when touched
Physical and elastic rather than precise or mechanical
Tactile, print-like, hand-arranged feel
Low pressure and consequence-free: nothing can be completed or ruined
Quiet entry with no piecemeal flicker of half-loaded content
completion_and_return: No completion state, score, sequence or success condition
The arrangement persists exactly as left for the rest of the visit
Only the deformation and interior image offset return to rest; position does not
No reset control and no automatic restoration of the initial layout
locked_observable_requirements: Nothing of the composition is shown until a quiet full-bleed cover gives way to the complete, already-settled view
Oversized display lettering dominates and is read before the imagery
Photo cards read as loose prints laid on the surface, free of any grid or slot, with enough separation from the lettering beneath to stay legible
A small persistent hint communicates that the prints are handleable
Dragging trails behind the input and springs to catch up as motion slows
While held, a card squeezes, its picture swells and slides inside its frame, and it rises above the other card
Pointer distinguishes grabbable at rest from held while moving
Release leaves the card exactly at the drop point while the deformation eases away
Any card can be picked up again from any position, indefinitely
adaptable_details: Exact wording and language of the display phrase
Number of photo cards beyond two, as long as the set stays small and individually recognizable
Typeface, colour palette, lightness or darkness of the surround, surface texture and frame styling
Initial resting positions and rotations of the prints
Form of the handling hint (small mark, word or icon)
Exact lag, springiness, squeeze amount and image-swell magnitude
Visual treatment of the cover layer before it clears
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits single-view, low-density compositions where a short phrase or set of names is the message and a small number of images act as tactile accents, on both pointer and touch input, in any palette or lightness scheme. It stops being this Skill if the images must land in ordered slots or snap to a grid, if the set grows into a gallery or feed requiring scrolling and pagination, if placement carries meaning or must be saved or scored, or if the elastic lag and squeeze are replaced by rigid one-to-one dragging.

name: coiled_photo_unfurl_descent
description: Large photographs stacked in an overlapping vertical descent with small sideways captions; each featured photograph arrives tightly coiled and unfurls into its exact flat position when it climbs past mid-screen, re-coiling only if pushed back down.

canonical_document.name: coiled_photo_unfurl_descent
canonical_document.description: Large photographs stacked in an overlapping vertical descent with small sideways captions; each featured photograph arrives tightly coiled and unfurls into its exact flat position when it climbs past mid-screen, re-coiling only if pushed back down.
canonical_document.experience_scope: Whole-view experience of a single scrolling page: it begins after a brief composed hold before the first content is shown, runs through the entire vertical descent of the image sequence, and ends on the last photograph, which is the final item in the flow.
content_and_composition: A handful of large photographs (roughly a small, countable set) as the primary foreground content, each one intended to be looked at on its own
Photographs are placed as overlapping, offset layers along a vertical axis rather than in an even grid, so adjacent images partially cover one another
One small caption per photograph, set sideways (rotated to run along an edge of its image) and clearly subordinate in weight to the picture
One photograph at a time occupies the featured position near the vertical middle of the viewport; neighbours remain partially visible above and below
Each featured photograph has two visible states: a tight coiled/rolled-up form and its exact flat resting form at final size and position
A final closing photograph terminates the sequence
experience_progression: A short quiet hold before anything is presented, so the first view arrives already composed
Continuous downward descent: the sequence advances only as the user scrolls, with content following the scroll with a slight glide rather than locking to it
Per-item stage: photograph enters coiled, crosses the mid-screen threshold, unfurls at its own steady pace into the flat position, and stays open
The first unfurl establishes the rhythm; every following item repeats it, so the pattern becomes predictable and anticipated
Upward travel can return an already-opened photograph to its coiled state, making earlier pictures feel new again on a second pass
The sequence resolves on one final photograph rather than looping
attention_and_information_flow: Prominence is granted to whichever photograph currently occupies the mid-screen featured position; overlapping neighbours read as context, not competition
The coiled state withholds the image content, so the unfurl is the moment the picture becomes readable — information is released gradually rather than presented at once
Sideways captions read as quiet annotation and only become legible attention targets once their photograph is flat and settled
Because the reveal pace is fixed, attention is held on one picture for a consistent, unhurried beat regardless of how fast the user scrolls
Predictability after the first reveal shifts attention forward: the user begins anticipating the next unfurl

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Stopping scrolling lets the glide settle to rest; direction can be changed at any moment and the column follows smoothly
interaction_model.state_change: Column position advances toward the scroll target with easing instead of matching it instantly
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Content glides and settles slightly behind the scroll gesture; motion never snaps or hard-stops
interaction_model.input: Vertical scrolling (the only accepted input)
interaction_model.affected_object: The whole overlapping image-and-caption column

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: The reveal never fires a second time while it remains open; it plays only once per approach and cannot be re-triggered by jitter around the threshold
interaction_model.state_change: Coiled → unfurling → flat and open at its exact final position and size, then latched open
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The tight coil unrolls into the full flat picture with weighty, unhurried motion and comes to rest precisely in its layout slot
interaction_model.input: A featured photograph climbing past the vertical middle of the viewport while scrolling down
interaction_model.affected_object: That photograph's coiled form

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Continuing to scroll during a reveal does not skip, stall or fast-forward it; the picture still lands exactly flat
interaction_model.state_change: Reveal timing stays on its own internal pace, independent of scroll velocity
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The unfurl looks identical whether the user scrolls quickly or slowly — never rushed, never scrubbed frame-by-frame
interaction_model.input: Scroll speed varying during a reveal (fast flick or slow drag)
interaction_model.affected_object: The in-progress unfurl of the featured photograph

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Direction change interrupts and reverses an in-progress reveal immediately; the item is re-armed only after crossing back below the half-visible boundary, so hovering near the threshold does not flicker
interaction_model.state_change: Flat and open → re-coiled and armed for another reveal
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The picture rolls back into its tight coil, so the descent past it can unveil it again
interaction_model.input: Reversing direction (scrolling upward) so an opened photograph falls to less than half visible
interaction_model.affected_object: The previously opened photograph

experience_qualities: Composed and calm from the first moment, with nothing appearing half-assembled
Weighty and unhurried — motion has mass rather than snap
Predictable rhythm after the first reveal, which makes the descent feel intentional rather than surprising
Deliberate withholding then release: pictures earn their presence instead of just being there
Editorial and quiet, with text kept small and sideways so photographs dominate
Repeatable rather than one-shot: a second pass upward restores the sense of first discovery
completion_and_return: The descent terminates on a single final photograph; there is no loop back to the start
Opened photographs stay open as long as they remain at least half visible, so returning downward through them does not re-run a reveal that was not undone
Re-coiling is the explicit reset: any photograph pushed back out of view below the half-visible boundary returns to its coiled starting state and can be revealed again
Reveal state persists across direction changes only according to the threshold rules, so the page never ends up in a partially unfurled resting state
locked_observable_requirements: Vertical scrolling is the only input driving the experience
Scroll-following motion is eased/gliding, never instant or snapping to positions
Photographs overlap as offset vertical layers rather than sitting in an even non-overlapping grid
Each photograph carries one small sideways-set caption subordinate to the image
Exactly one photograph is featured at a time, near the vertical middle of the view
The reveal is a coil-to-flat unfurl that ends at the photograph's exact flat layout position and size
The reveal is triggered by the featured photograph passing the mid-screen line while scrolling down
Reveal duration and pacing are fixed and independent of scroll speed
A reveal never plays twice while the item stays open, and reverses immediately on direction change
Falling back below half visible while moving upward re-coils the photograph and re-arms it
Opened photographs stay open (no idle auto-close)
The sequence ends on one final photograph
A brief quiet hold precedes the first presented view so arrival looks finished
adaptable_details: Exact number of photographs, as long as it stays a small showcase set
Image subject matter, aspect ratios and crop treatment
Amount and side of overlap between adjacent images, and horizontal offsets
Which edge the sideways caption runs along, and its typographic styling
Exact reveal duration and easing shape, provided it reads as weighty and unhurried
Coil tightness, coil axis and visual character of the rolled state

Page surround, margins and overall tonal treatment, provided the surround stays low-distraction so photographs read as the dominant layer and captions keep readable contrast against whatever they sit on
Length and styling of the initial hold before content is shown
Whether the final photograph carries any closing caption
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits small curated sets of large, individually worth-viewing images presented as a single vertical showcase with minimal accompanying text — portfolios, editorial spreads, product or place galleries. It stops being this Skill if the images become a dense browsable index or thumbnail grid, if multiple items must be featured and revealed simultaneously, if the reveal is scrubbed by scroll position instead of playing at its own fixed pace, if reveals become one-time-only with no re-coil on upward travel, if inputs other than vertical scroll drive the sequence, or if the coil-to-flat unfurl is swapped for a generic fade or slide.

name: drifting_speck_photo_stepper
description: Each photo materializes from a swarm of tiny suspended specks that sweep in from one side and settle unevenly into a recognizable picture, then keeps drifting and breathing; the pointer pushes nearby specks aside in a soft trailing bulge, and arrows blow the current photo off in the chosen direction while the next streams in from the opposite side, looping endlessly.

canonical_document.name: drifting_speck_photo_stepper
canonical_document.description: Each photo materializes from a swarm of tiny suspended specks that sweep in from one side and settle unevenly into a recognizable picture, then keeps drifting and breathing; the pointer pushes nearby specks aside in a soft trailing bulge, and arrows blow the current photo off in the chosen direction while the next streams in from the opposite side, looping endlessly.
canonical_document.experience_scope: A single self-contained region that holds one image stage at a time, occupying the primary attention area of the view against a quiet low-distraction backdrop carrying faint oversized outlined lettering behind it; the experience begins when the first image assembles and never truly ends, continuing to drift and cycling back to the first image after the last.
content_and_composition: One image stage at a time, rendered as a dense field of many small suspended pieces whose arrangement and coloring form the picture
A short ordered set of images (a handful, not a long feed) forming a closed cycle
A quiet background plane behind the speck field, low in internal contrast and clearly separated in luminance from the pieces so they read as suspended in front of it
Faint oversized outlined lettering on the backdrop layer, only slightly separated from the backdrop itself, that remains visible behind and around the image and never competes with it
Two persistent directional step controls, forward and back
Depth impression from pieces sitting slightly apart from one another rather than a single flat surface
experience_progression: Entry: pieces sweep in from one side as a loose swarm
Resolution: the swarm settles into the recognizable picture unevenly, with stragglers arriving after the bulk has landed
Rest: settled arrangement persists while pieces continue drifting and breathing gently
Handoff: on a step, the current picture's pieces stream off toward the chosen direction while the next picture's pieces flow in from the opposite side
Loop: stepping past the last image continues into the first and past the first continues into the last, with no visible end of sequence
attention_and_information_flow: Exactly one image holds attention; there is no competing thumbnail strip or simultaneous second image
Recognition of the subject arrives gradually as the swarm resolves, so meaning is revealed rather than presented at once
The uneven settling keeps the eye moving across the picture during arrival, then the gentle drift holds a low, steady level of liveliness
Backdrop lettering stays at a whisper level of prominence, present as atmosphere and never read as the main content
During a handoff, attention travels with the direction of motion, carried from the departing image to the arriving one

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: When the pointer moves away or leaves the area, displaced pieces ease back to their exact resting arrangement, so the picture is never left permanently broken; the push can be applied and released repeatedly with no accumulated distortion
interaction_model.state_change: Nearby pieces displace outward from the pointer, forming a localized bulge that lags slightly behind the pointer's travel
interaction_model.visible_feedback: A soft parting or swell in the image that follows the pointer with a trailing feel, softening toward the edge of the radius rather than cutting off sharply
interaction_model.input: Pointer moved over the picture area
interaction_model.affected_object: Pieces within a soft radius of the pointer

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Activating a step again mid-flight retargets the pieces from wherever they currently are, continuing smoothly without a jump or restart; stepping past either end of the sequence wraps to the opposite end
interaction_model.state_change: Current pieces stream off toward the chosen direction while the next image's pieces flow in from the opposite side and settle
interaction_model.visible_feedback: One continuous directional sweep across the stage in which departure and arrival read as a single movement, ending in the newly settled picture
interaction_model.input: Forward or back step control activated
interaction_model.affected_object: The whole current image field and the incoming image field

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Stepping remains fully available as the means of progressing; the experience stays complete without the push
interaction_model.state_change: The push effect is simply absent
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The image still assembles, drifts and breathes, and stepping still streams between images; no substitute distortion appears and nothing looks broken or missing
interaction_model.input: Touch-only input (no hovering pointer available)
interaction_model.affected_object: The pointer-driven push

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Drift persists indefinitely and resumes as the baseline state after any push or handoff completes
interaction_model.state_change: Continuous small wandering and breathing around each piece's resting position
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The picture stays recognizable while subtly alive, calm rather than busy
interaction_model.input: Autonomous drift (no user input)
interaction_model.affected_object: All settled pieces

experience_qualities: Calm and slightly dreamlike rather than energetic or busy
Suspended and weightless, as if the picture is held in air
Tactile and yielding under the pointer, with softness at the edges of the effect
Uneven, organic resolution rather than mechanical assembly
Continuous and unbroken: no hard cuts, no snapping, no visibly discarded motion
completion_and_return: No terminal state; the sequence wraps around in both directions and can be traversed indefinitely
Every disturbance resolves back to the same exact resting arrangement of the current picture
The settled-and-drifting state is the persistent baseline the experience always returns to
Interrupted handoffs complete into a properly settled picture rather than leaving a half-formed swarm
locked_observable_requirements: The picture must be visibly composed of many small separate suspended pieces, not a solid image with an overlay
First appearance must be an inward sweep from one side that resolves unevenly, with late-arriving stragglers
Settled pictures must keep a gentle, continuous drift and breathing motion
Only one image occupies attention at a time
Pointer proximity must push nearby pieces outward within a soft radius, with the bulge trailing the pointer
The push must fully ease back to the exact resting arrangement, never leaving the image degraded
Stepping must show the outgoing image leaving in the chosen direction and the incoming image entering from the opposite side
Re-stepping mid-motion must retarget in place with no jump or restart
The sequence must wrap around at both ends

A quiet backdrop, low in internal contrast and set clearly apart in luminance from the speck field, must remain visible behind the image and must carry faint oversized outlined lettering that stays only just discernible against it
Where hovering is unavailable, the push is omitted rather than replaced
adaptable_details: Number of images in the cycle
Density and size of the individual pieces
Exact radius, strength and easing feel of the push
Speed and travel distance of the entry sweep and the handoff streaming
Amplitude and tempo of the resting drift
Wording, typeface and placement of the faint backdrop lettering
Visual styling and placement of the two step controls
Backdrop hue and overall luminance level, whether the surround sits lighter or darker than the pieces, as long as it stays low in internal contrast and clearly separated from the speck field
Whether the cycle can also advance on its own in addition to the arrows
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits a small curated set of visually rich, recognizable single-subject images shown one at a time as the main attraction of a region or page, where a slow contemplative mood is wanted. Images that depend on fine text, thin detail or exact color fidelity do not survive being rendered as a speck field. Expanding to a long scrolling library, showing several images at once, or requiring dense readable captions inside the stage would create a different Skill, as would replacing the soft reversible push with a destructive or permanently scattering effect, or replacing the directional streaming handoff with a cut or crossfade.
