name: momentum_dragged_endless_image_run
description: A quiet, low-distraction full-screen row of large pictures pulled sideways by hand at exaggerated speed, smearing and bowing as it flies, coasting to rest anywhere, with a giant centered title that hands off to whichever picture takes the middle.

canonical_document.name: momentum_dragged_endless_image_run
canonical_document.description: A quiet, low-distraction full-screen row of large pictures pulled sideways by hand at exaggerated speed, smearing and bowing as it flies, coasting to rest anywhere, with a giant centered title that hands off to whichever picture takes the middle.
canonical_document.experience_scope: Whole-view experience occupying the full viewport with a deliberately recessive surround from arrival onward; it begins already composed with one image centered and never terminates, so it has no exit state or handoff to another view.
content_and_composition: One continuous horizontal run of large images, each item consisting of an image plus a short title; a handful of items is enough because the run repeats endlessly
Exactly one image occupies the optical center of the screen at any settled moment; neighbors are partially visible to the left and right, signaling the run continues both ways

A single oversized title reads large across the middle of the screen, layered over or across the centered image rather than beside it, held at readable contrast against whatever sits behind it, and is the only text of substance
A quiet, near-empty backdrop that stays visually recessive and clearly separated from the images, with no descriptive copy, captions, arrows or item chrome competing with them
A thin bar along the bottom edge as the only persistent status element, kept just distinct enough from the surround to be read, indicating position within the cycle
A grab affordance on the surface communicating that the whole field is draggable
experience_progression: Arrival: composition is already settled with one image centered and its name reading across the middle, requiring no explanation or first action
Continuous hand-guided travel: images pass through the center one after another as the visitor pulls, with no discrete steps, pages or stops
Free settling: after release the run coasts and eases to rest wherever it lands, leaving whatever image is nearest the center in focus
Endless cycling: the run has no first or last item and no finish state, so travel in either direction can continue or reverse indefinitely
attention_and_information_flow: Attention is anchored to the screen center; whichever image is there is the subject and everything else reads as periphery
The centered name is the only information layer that changes identity, so reading it is how the visitor knows what is on show
During fast travel the images become gestural and smeared, so attention shifts from individual subjects to the sense of motion, then resolves back to a single image as motion decays
The bottom bar carries only coarse positional awareness and never pulls attention from the image

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Pulling the opposite way reverses just as freely at any moment; no edge or resistance is ever reached in either direction
interaction_model.state_change: The run tracks the hand continuously in the pulled direction, displaced roughly twice the distance the hand travels
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Images slide with the hand at amplified speed under a grabbing affordance; travel follows the hand one-to-one in timing but exaggerated in distance
interaction_model.input: Press anywhere on the view and pull sideways with pointer or finger
interaction_model.affected_object: The whole row of images as one body

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Resting position is accepted as-is; no correction, realignment or return to a nearest item occurs
interaction_model.state_change: Travel continues briefly on its own, decaying to a stop at an arbitrary position
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The pictures keep coasting after the hand leaves, then ease to rest wherever they land instead of snapping to align an item
interaction_model.input: Release the press
interaction_model.affected_object: The row of images

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Interruption is always available; repeated grabs can chain indefinitely without settling in between
interaction_model.state_change: Autonomous coasting is replaced immediately by hand-driven travel
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The run is caught mid-flight with no pause, bounce or restart; motion continues seamlessly under the new hand direction
interaction_model.input: Press again while the run is still coasting
interaction_model.affected_object: The row of images

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Deformation is fully reversible and self-resolving; at rest images always read as normal, undistorted pictures
interaction_model.state_change: Visual deformation scales with travel speed
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Faster travel makes the pictures visibly smear along the direction of motion and bow out of their rectangular shape; deformation relaxes back to clean, undistorted images as speed falls
interaction_model.input: Speed of the pull or of the current coast
interaction_model.affected_object: The images themselves

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Handoff happens equally in either travel direction and mid-coast; reversing direction hands the previous name back
interaction_model.state_change: The displayed name hands off from the outgoing item to the arriving one
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The large centered name changes over as each picture reaches the middle, so title and centered image always agree
interaction_model.input: An image arriving at the center during travel
interaction_model.affected_object: The oversized centered title

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Because the run is endless, the bar cycles rather than filling to an end; it never reads as complete or exhausted
interaction_model.state_change: Its indicated position advances or retreats with the run
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The bar tracks the current position through the cycle continuously rather than in steps
interaction_model.input: Any travel of the run
interaction_model.affected_object: The thin bar along the bottom

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Normal behavior applies again once the pull ends
interaction_model.state_change: Native text selection and image dragging are suppressed for the duration of the pull
interaction_model.visible_feedback: No text highlights and no image is peeled loose from the page; the gesture reads purely as carrying the run
interaction_model.input: A sideways pull that begins on text or on an image
interaction_model.affected_object: Text and image content under the pointer

experience_qualities: Cinematic and hand-guided rather than stepwise or mechanical
Quiet and visually recessive in the surround, with the images supplying nearly all the visual energy
Physical and weighty, with clear amplification, coasting and give in the motion
Immediately legible on arrival with nothing to explain
Open-ended and unhurried, with no sense of progress to complete
completion_and_return: No completion state exists; the run cycles endlessly in both directions
Each release resolves into a stable resting composition with one image effectively centered and named
Doubling back returns to previously seen images without any reset, restart or replay of an intro state
The view holds whatever position it was left at rather than returning to an origin item
locked_observable_requirements: Quiet, near-empty surroundings that visibly recede behind the imagery, with one large image holding the center from the moment of arrival
One oversized title reading large across the middle of the screen at readable contrast, always matching the centered image
Pressing anywhere and pulling sideways carries the whole run, displaced markedly further than the hand travels
Motion continues after release and eases to rest at an arbitrary position, never snapping or aligning to an item
No first or last item, no edge, no bound and no finish state in either direction
Grabbing during coast takes over immediately with no visible interruption
Speed-proportional smearing and bowing of the images that relaxes back to clean shapes at rest
Title handoff occurs as each image reaches the center, in either direction
A single thin bar along the bottom, distinguishable from the surround, tracking cyclic position
A visible grab affordance, and sideways pulls that never select text or drag an image loose
adaptable_details: Number of items in the run and their subject matter
Image aspect ratio and how much of the neighbors is visible
Typeface, weight, coloring and exact placement of the centered name, as long as it stays clearly readable over what sits behind it
Exact travel multiplier, coast duration and easing character, as long as amplification and free settling remain obvious
Intensity and styling of the smear and bow at a given speed
Thickness, coloring and precise position of the bottom bar, as long as it remains discernible
Palette and overall lightness of the recessive backdrop, whether light, mid or deep, as long as the images stay clearly separated from it, plus the specific grab affordance styling
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits a modest set of large single-image works with short titles that can each stand alone as a centered subject, presented as an entry or primary full-viewport view. It stops being this Skill if travel snaps or pages to discrete items, if the run gains a start and end with edge resistance or a completion state, if items require dense multi-field text or interactive detail alongside the image, or if the images must stay geometrically undistorted during motion.

name: melting_fullscreen_photo_sequence
description: Full-bleed photos advanced by clicking anywhere, where the current picture appears to melt and warp into the arriving one in a single uninterruptible motion that settles cleanly, looping back to the first photo after the last.

canonical_document.name: melting_fullscreen_photo_sequence
canonical_document.description: Full-bleed photos advanced by clicking anywhere, where the current picture appears to melt and warp into the arriving one in a single uninterruptible motion that settles cleanly, looping back to the first photo after the last.
canonical_document.experience_scope: Whole-view experience occupying the entire viewport for its lifetime; it begins on the first photo shown at rest and has no end state, cycling indefinitely through the fixed set of photos. Can also be deployed as a self-contained full-bleed region if it owns the whole visible area of that region.
content_and_composition: One photographic image at a time, scaled to fill the whole viewport edge to edge with no letterboxing and no visible distortion of its proportions
A small set (a handful, not a long feed) of photos in a fixed order forming a closed cycle
A single restrained text layer floating above the image: sparse, low-weight overlay copy holding just enough contrast against the picture to be read while never competing with it
A short persistent standing hint line indicating that clicking advances to the next photo
No visible chrome otherwise: no arrows, thumbnails, counters, panels or surrounding layout competing for attention
Layer order is constant: image substrate at the back, text and hint above it, both remaining legible while the image beneath changes
experience_progression: Rest state: one photo fully settled and readable full-screen with overlay text above it
Triggered transition: the resting photo begins to melt and warp, deforming continuously rather than cutting or cross-fading abruptly
Mid-transition: the outgoing and incoming pictures are bound into one flowing deformation so the change reads as a single motion, not two stacked images
Settling: the deformation resolves onto the arriving photo, ending clearly and unambiguously on it rather than trailing off
New rest state: the arriving photo is simply what is on screen and becomes the origin of the next advance
After the final photo, the cycle returns to the first and continues endlessly
attention_and_information_flow: The image holds essentially all prominence; overlay text is deliberately low-emphasis, carrying only the contrast it needs to be read so it informs without pulling focus
During the transition attention is carried by the moving deformation itself, which guides the eye from the departing picture to the arriving one
Settling restores the calm single-subject reading of the new photo, making it obvious which image is now current
The standing hint removes guesswork about how to proceed without adding visual weight or occupying a prominent position
No progress indicator or index is required for the experience to read correctly; arrival clarity carries orientation

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: The whole surface is the target, so no aiming is needed; the sequence never dead-ends because it wraps around
interaction_model.state_change: Advance from the current photo to the next in the fixed order, wrapping to the first after the last
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The current picture melts and warps continuously into the next and settles clearly on the arriving image
interaction_model.input: Click or tap anywhere on the picture area while a photo is at rest
interaction_model.affected_object: The full-screen photo and its accompanying overlay text

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Input is accepted again once the arriving photo has settled, and the next advance starts from that photo
interaction_model.state_change: Ignored; the transition is neither restarted, queued nor cut short
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The motion continues undisturbed to its natural settling point with no flicker, jump or double advance
interaction_model.input: Further clicks or taps while a transition is already running
interaction_model.affected_object: The running transition

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Refit is immediate and does not restart, skip or interrupt the sequence position
interaction_model.state_change: The image refits to the new viewport dimensions
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The photo immediately fills the new area still covering edge to edge and still undistorted, with overlay text staying positioned and legible
interaction_model.input: Viewport or window resize
interaction_model.affected_object: The currently displayed photo and its overlay layers

experience_qualities: Immersive and uncluttered: one picture, whole screen, almost nothing else
Liquid and organic rather than mechanical; the change feels like material deforming, not panels sliding
Continuous and singular: one motion from departure to arrival instead of two separate events
Decisive arrival: the motion resolves rather than fades ambiguously
Calm and endless, suited to unhurried repeated viewing
Predictable: every click behaves the same way and the hint states the rule plainly
completion_and_return: No terminal state; the sequence loops endlessly and returns to the starting photo after the last one
Each transition completes on its own once started and cannot be abandoned midway
The arriving photo persists indefinitely as the current state until the next advance
Resize preserves the current position in the cycle
locked_observable_requirements: One image at a time filling the entire viewport with no distortion of its proportions
Only a low-emphasis overlay text layer that keeps readable contrast against the image beneath it, plus a small standing advance hint above the image; no competing interface
Advance is triggered by clicking anywhere on the picture surface
The change between photos is a continuous melting/warping deformation of the current picture into the next, not a cut, slide or plain fade
The transition is a single motion that settles clearly and identifiably on the arriving image
Input during a transition is ignored: no restart, no truncation, no queued double advance
The order is fixed and the sequence loops endlessly back to the first photo
Resize refits the current image immediately while preserving both full coverage and undistorted proportions
adaptable_details: Number of photos in the cycle, as long as it stays a small handful rather than an endless feed
Subject matter and color character of the photos, which carry their own identity as the presented subject
Exact wording, size, placement and styling of the restrained overlay text and the standing hint, provided each keeps enough separation from the image to stay readable
Duration and easing character of the melt, and how strong or subtle the warping looks
Whether keyboard or touch gestures are offered as additional equivalents to the click
Whether the overlay text changes per photo or stays constant
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits any small ordered set of strong single images meant to be viewed one at a time with minimal supporting copy: photo portfolios, place or product showcases, hero sequences, ambient or kiosk displays. It stops being this Skill if images share the screen with substantial competing content or grid layouts, if the set becomes a long browsable or paginated feed needing indexes and direct jumps, if the transition becomes an instant cut or an ordinary fade/slide, if transitions become interruptible or scrubbable so the change is no longer one settled motion, or if the image is cropped or stretched in a way that breaks full undistorted coverage.

name: sideways_photo_row_with_liquid_hover_and_expanding_detail_panel
description: A low-distraction stage where photographs hang at staggered heights along a sideways row that glides with inertia past a huge faint background word; hovering melts a photo into a second image around the cursor and retones the page into that entry's own paired tones, and clicking grows it into a tall detail panel with wiped-in text that reverses back to the same spot.

canonical_document.name: sideways_photo_row_with_liquid_hover_and_expanding_detail_panel
canonical_document.description: A low-distraction stage where photographs hang at staggered heights along a sideways row that glides with inertia past a huge faint background word; hovering melts a photo into a second image around the cursor and retones the page into that entry's own paired tones, and clicking grows it into a tall detail panel with wiped-in text that reverses back to the same spot.
canonical_document.experience_scope: A whole-view experience occupying the full viewport: it begins on arrival with the row at rest and the background word visible, contains both the browsing mode and the expanded detail mode, and ends only when the visitor leaves the view; the detail mode opens and closes inside the same view rather than navigating away.
content_and_composition: Low-distraction full-viewport stage acting as the base layer for everything else, its tone taken from the active entry rather than from any fixed theme
One oversized, very faint word or short question set behind all other content, larger than the viewport width and readable as texture rather than as a heading

A single sideways row of image entries (roughly six to twelve), each entry consisting of a primary photograph, a hidden secondary image, a short caption, a longer descriptive text and an associated pair of two clearly separated tones (one for the surround, one for text and accents) carrying no fixed hue
Entries placed at staggered vertical offsets rather than a single baseline, and spaced so only two or three are within view at once
A slim horizontal position bar as a persistent progress cue for how far along the row the visitor has travelled

In the expanded mode: one tall image panel occupying one side of the view, with the entry's name and long description occupying the remaining space; the background word and the active entry's stage tones persist behind it
experience_progression: Calm resting state: quiet low-distraction stage, faint background word, one entry effectively centred with the page already in a neutral or first entry's tone mood
Continuous sideways travel driven by the visitor, with entries entering and leaving view and the position bar filling; travel has no fixed end other than the two ends of the row
Per-entry inspection: pointer dwell melts the hovered photograph and shifts the whole page's tone mood to that entry
Mode change on selection: the chosen photograph leaves the row and becomes a tall panel while the rest of the collection recedes and travel is suspended
Reading state: spacious, slow, text-led, with the chosen photograph still present
Return: the reverse of the mode change, restoring the browsing state at the identical travel position
attention_and_information_flow: Attention rests on one entry at a time because only two or three are ever visible and the staggered heights prevent the row reading as a uniform grid
The background word stays subordinate: large but barely separated from the surround, drifting opposite to travel so it reads as depth rather than as content
Hover concentrates attention locally by changing the image itself, and globally by retoning the page to that entry's pair, so the whole view confirms which entry is active
Only a short caption is offered during browsing; the entry's full name and long description are withheld until selection
In the expanded mode prominence splits between one large photograph and a block of slow-reading text, with all sibling entries suppressed to remove competing focus

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Reaching either end lets travel overshoot slightly and spring softly back instead of stopping hard; new input during momentum blends into the existing motion rather than resetting it
interaction_model.state_change: Travel position advances with momentum and decays gradually after input stops; travel speed becomes an active value that also drives distortion
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The row carries sideways with weight and continues drifting after the gesture ends; the background word drifts in the opposite direction; the position bar fills proportionally; photographs squeeze inward while travel is fast and relax back to their natural width as it slows
interaction_model.input: Wheel roll or trackpad swipe anywhere in the browsing view
interaction_model.affected_object: The sideways row of entries, the oversized background word, the position bar and the entry photographs' shape

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Moving the pointer away plays the melt smoothly in reverse and returns the previous tones; rapid entry and exit across several photographs resolves to the last hovered entry without leaving a partial melt behind
interaction_model.state_change: The entry becomes the active one; a localised reveal region is bound to the pointer position
interaction_model.visible_feedback: A second image emerges around the cursor with a soft liquid edge that lags slightly behind pointer movement, with a visibly different distortion character per entry; the page surround and text tones cross over to that entry's pair in one controlled transition, keeping text clearly readable against the new surround
interaction_model.input: Pointer moving onto and across a photograph
interaction_model.affected_object: The hovered photograph's imagery and the page's surround and text tones

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: The opening transition is treated as one coordinated move; further input during it is absorbed so no photograph is left half-lifted or stranded between row and panel
interaction_model.state_change: The view switches from browsing mode to detail mode with travel suspended and the travel position retained
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The chosen photograph lifts out of the row and grows into a tall panel on one side; the other photographs fade away; the short caption wipes out; the entry name and long description wipe in; sideways travel holds still
interaction_model.input: Click or tap on a photograph
interaction_model.affected_object: The chosen photograph, the sibling photographs, the caption, the entry's name and long description, and sideways travel

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: One close action reverses the whole opening sequence rather than requiring several steps; input during the closing transition is absorbed so the row always ends complete and travel-ready
interaction_model.state_change: The view returns to browsing mode with the previously stored travel position
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Text wipes away, the photograph shrinks and settles back into its original slot and staggered height, the other photographs fade in, and sideways travel becomes available again at exactly the position it was left
interaction_model.input: A single close action in detail mode
interaction_model.affected_object: The expanded panel, the text block, the sibling photographs and sideways travel

experience_qualities: Calm and unhurried, with a quiet surround and nothing competing for attention on arrival
Physical and weighty: travel has mass, inertia and a soft spring at the limits
Tactile: imagery reacts under the cursor with a liquid, slightly lagging feel
Immersive: the whole view adopts the active entry's tone pairing
Editorial and spacious in the reading state, with text arriving by wipe rather than appearing abruptly
Self-explanatory: exploration is invited by motion and reaction rather than by instructions or labels
completion_and_return: Browsing has no completion state; it continues indefinitely between the two sprung ends of the row
Opening an entry is a reversible mode rather than a destination; closing always returns to browsing
Travel position persists across open and close, so the collection resumes exactly where it was left

Adding a second competing subject, a gallery or list to browse, substantial text to read alongside the subject, or making the closer framing a persistent latched mode that must be dismissed would create a different Skill. Using it as a decorative substrate behind foreground content, or attaching the smear-and-zoom treatment to per-item thumbnails in a grid, also changes its identity.

name: ephemeral_pointer_trail_photo_reveal
description: A bare intro view holding only a short identity line and one oversized graphic word, where moving the pointer emits photos one at a time that appear just behind it, glide to catch up, then shrink and fade so the view returns to empty.

canonical_document.name: ephemeral_pointer_trail_photo_reveal
canonical_document.description: A bare intro view holding only a short identity line and one oversized graphic word, where moving the pointer emits photos one at a time that appear just behind it, glide to catch up, then shrink and fade so the view returns to empty.
canonical_document.experience_scope: Whole-view experience covering the opening screen: it begins when the sparse composition settles after a short load, spans the entire pointer-reachable area of that view as its interactive field, and ends whenever pointer motion stops and the last emitted image finishes disappearing; it can be re-entered indefinitely without any reset action.
content_and_composition: Persistent foreground text layer: a name, a secondary role or descriptor line, and one oversized graphic word treated as the dominant typographic mass; composed and deliberately under-filled with generous empty space.
No imagery present in the resting composition; the photo set exists entirely off-view until motion summons it.
An ordered image set of modest size (a handful to a few dozen) consumed in fixed sequence and wrapped around endlessly.
Transient image layer stacked above the empty space and around the text, each newly emitted image drawn over previously emitted ones so overlaps read as a shallow pile rather than a flat arrangement.
Each transient image is a single self-contained visual object positioned relative to the pointer, not aligned to any grid, column or fixed slot.
Emitted images are glimpse-scale: large enough to register as photographs, small enough that several can coexist without the view reading as cluttered.
experience_progression: Short load, then the sparse text composition arrives already settled and quiet, with nothing to view but the words.
First pointer travel crosses a short distance threshold and the first image of the sequence appears, establishing that the empty space is what holds the collection.
Sustained movement produces a rolling stream: each new threshold crossing emits the next image while older ones are still shrinking away, so a loose layered trail follows the pointer.
Continued exploration cycles through the full set and wraps back to its start, so long passes keep producing images without an end state.
Pause: emissions stop, in-flight images complete their disappearance, and the view returns to the bare opening composition, ready for another pass.
attention_and_information_flow: At rest, attention belongs entirely to the oversized graphic word, with the name and role read as a small supporting line.
Once motion starts, attention follows the pointer, because the newest image is always the freshest, largest-presence element and sits on top of the pile.
Each image holds prominence only briefly: it is legible as a glimpse of subject and style rather than an item to study, and it yields to the next emission.
Older trailing images recede in prominence as they shrink and lose presence, producing a gradient of attention from pointer outward along the recent path.
As the view empties on pause, prominence hands back to the typographic layer, so the composition always resolves to its calm statement.

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Distance-gated rather than time-gated: slow or tiny movement emits nothing, and a fresh emission requires crossing the threshold again from the last emission point, so the view cannot flood while the pointer lingers
interaction_model.state_change: Hidden to active: the image enters the transient layer at the pointer's vicinity and begins its own timed life
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The image pops into view slightly behind the pointer along its path, then glides forward to catch up with the pointer before settling
interaction_model.input: Pointer movement across the view accumulating a short travel distance beyond the position where the previous image appeared
interaction_model.affected_object: The next image in the ordered set

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Each image manages its own disappearance independently, so the pile self-limits without any explicit clearing action; the visitor can change direction or speed at any moment and the trail follows
interaction_model.state_change: Multiple images coexist in overlapping stages of their lives while the sequence advances and wraps around
interaction_model.visible_feedback: A layered trail of photographs, newest on top and most present, older ones progressively smaller and less present along the traveled path
interaction_model.input: Sustained continuous pointer movement
interaction_model.affected_object: The transient image layer as a whole and the sequence position within the set

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Autonomous and unattended; requires no pointer involvement and cannot leave a stalled remnant on screen
interaction_model.state_change: Active to gone: the image completes its own exit and leaves the layer
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The image fades out while shrinking down until it is absent, leaving empty space behind
interaction_model.input: Time elapsing on an emitted image, with no user action
interaction_model.affected_object: That individual image

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Restart fully supersedes the interrupted pass; no residue of the previous appearance remains
interaction_model.state_change: Its in-progress life restarts from the beginning at the current pointer location
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The image reappears cleanly at the pointer at full presence and repeats the appear-glide-fade pass, with no visible stutter, jump from its old spot or doubled copy
interaction_model.input: Movement that re-triggers a set position whose image is still mid-animation (reached by cycling around the set)
interaction_model.affected_object: That same image object

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Resuming movement starts a new pass immediately from the current pointer position, continuing the sequence; no reset, dismissal or re-entry step is needed
interaction_model.state_change: Emission halts and every in-flight image runs out to gone
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The trail finishes fading and shrinking away and the view resolves to the bare text-only composition
interaction_model.input: Pointer movement stopping or leaving the interactive field
interaction_model.affected_object: All remaining visible images

experience_qualities: Playful and responsive: the view feels like it answers the hand rather than presenting itself.
Discovered rather than displayed: imagery is found by exploring emptiness, never offered as a browsable set.
Fleeting and glimpse-like: each photograph is an impression, not an item for inspection.
Uncluttered by construction: self-expiring images mean density never accumulates.
Composed and calm at rest, with the typographic statement always intact.
Continuous and unbroken: emission, chasing motion and disappearance overlap smoothly with no perceptible seams or stalls.
completion_and_return: No terminal completion state: the image sequence loops endlessly as exploration continues.
Every pause returns the view to the identical quiet opening composition, so the resting state is the natural home.
The returned state carries no marks of prior passes: no leftover images, thumbnails, counters or traces of what was already seen.
Sequence position carries forward across pauses so successive passes continue through the set rather than repeating from the first image.
locked_observable_requirements: The resting view shows no imagery at all, only the sparse text composition with one oversized graphic word dominant.
Pointer motion is the sole driver of image appearance; no click, hover target, scroll or control surfaces the collection.
Emission is gated by distance traveled since the last image, not by elapsed time, so images space themselves along the path of movement.
Each image appears offset behind the pointer along its path and then moves to catch up with it before settling.
Each image ends itself by simultaneously fading and shrinking, without user action.
Concurrent images layer with the newest on top and the set is consumed in order and cycled endlessly.
Re-triggering an image that is still animating restarts it cleanly at the pointer with no doubled or displaced remnant.
Stopping movement always drains the view back to the bare opening composition.
adaptable_details: Number of images in the set and their subject matter.
Exact travel distance that triggers the next emission.
Emission size, aspect ratio, framing shape, slight rotation or offset variation of each image.
Durations and easing of the pop-in, the catch-up glide and the fade-and-shrink exit.
Wording, typeface, weight, scale relationship and placement of the name, role line and oversized graphic word.

Surround treatment of the resting composition, including its overall luminance level and the degree of separation and readable contrast between the typographic layer, the emitted images and their low-distraction backdrop.
The character of the short lead-in before the composition settles.
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits any single-view opening or statement region that pairs a sparse typographic composition with a modest ordered set of images to be sensed rather than browsed, and that relies on a continuously tracked pointer as its driver. It survives changes of subject matter, set size, typographic styling and host visual treatment. It becomes a different Skill if images persist for study, arrange into a gallery, grid or slideshow, become selectable or navigable, or carry captions and links; if surfacing is triggered by clicks, scroll position, hover targets or timers instead of accumulated pointer travel; if the images act as a background substrate beneath other foreground content instead of a foreground trail; or if the view retains any imagery at rest.

name: patch_dissolve_tilting_photo_panel
description: One upright picture panel on a quiet, uniform low-distraction stage that glides, leans and grows toward the pointer, and lets a second picture seep through it in irregular patches while the pointer hovers, easing back to the first picture when the pointer leaves.

canonical_document.name: patch_dissolve_tilting_photo_panel
canonical_document.description: One upright picture panel on a quiet, uniform low-distraction stage that glides, leans and grows toward the pointer, and lets a second picture seep through it in irregular patches while the pointer hovers, easing back to the first picture when the pointer leaves.
canonical_document.experience_scope: A whole-view experience: the stage fills the viewport with the panel as its only subject; the experience is continuously active from view entry, has no entry gate and no terminal end state, and is bounded only by pointer presence within the view.
content_and_composition: Exactly one visual subject: an upright, portrait-oriented rectangular panel centered on the stage
Exactly two images bound to that single panel: a resting image and a hover image occupying the identical frame
A single uniform, flat background field held clearly quieter in luminance and contrast than the panel, with no competing text, controls, decoration or secondary panels
Panel reads as one tangible slab sitting in depth in front of the background rather than a flat inline picture
Both images share the same footprint and aspect so the change is perceived as one object transforming, not two elements crossfading in different places
The panel remains persistently visible at all times; only its pose and surface content change
experience_progression: Resting state: panel holds the first image, settled at its neutral pose on the uniform quiet stage

Approach: pointer movement anywhere in the view continuously pulls the panel horizontally toward the pointer, angles it to face the pointer on both axes, and slightly enlarges or reduces it according to pointer height
Contact: with the pointer over the panel, the second image begins seeping through in scattered patches that spread until it fully occupies the frame
Release: when the pointer slips off the panel, the patches recede and the first image reclaims the frame
Loop: the panel returns to the first image every time attention drifts, so the reveal can be replayed indefinitely
attention_and_information_flow: The uniform, unbroken emptiness of the surround gives attention nowhere to go except the single panel
Motion prominence tracks the pointer: the panel is always the moving, tilting, scaling element and therefore always the focal object
Information density rises only on contact, when the second image's content is progressively disclosed through the growing patches
Partial states are meaningful: mid-dissolve both images are simultaneously legible in different regions of the frame, inviting comparison
Prominence never transfers to another element, since no other element exists on the stage

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: All motion eases rather than snaps, so direction changes are absorbed smoothly from the current pose; tilt is clamped to a modest range so the panel never flips, over-rotates or shows an implausible angle; the panel drifts back toward its neutral pose when the pointer stops driving it
interaction_model.state_change: Panel slides horizontally toward the pointer, rotates on both axes to face it, and scales slightly up or down with the pointer's vertical position
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Continuous eased drift, lean and swell of the panel that reads as the object turning to face the visitor in real space
interaction_model.input: Pointer movement anywhere within the view
interaction_model.affected_object: The panel's position, orientation and size

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: The transition is continuous and never locks in; interrupting it mid-way is allowed at any point
interaction_model.state_change: Transition advances from the resting image toward the second image
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The second image appears in irregular patches that seep and spread across the frame in an organic, material way rather than a uniform fade or geometric wipe
interaction_model.input: Pointer entering and remaining over the panel
interaction_model.affected_object: The panel's surface imagery

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Reversal begins from the exact current blend rather than restarting or jumping, and re-entering mid-retreat resumes forward from that same point
interaction_model.state_change: Transition retreats from the second image back to the resting image
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Patches of the second image recede until the first image fully occupies the frame again
interaction_model.input: Pointer leaving the panel
interaction_model.affected_object: The panel's surface imagery

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: This resting state is the stable default the experience always converges to, making the effect endlessly repeatable
interaction_model.state_change: Return to the resting composition
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Panel eases back toward its neutral pose showing the first image
interaction_model.input: Absence of pointer activity or pointer far from the panel
interaction_model.affected_object: Whole panel state

experience_qualities: Quiet, subdued and singular, with an almost gallery-like focus on one subject
Organic and material rather than mechanical: the change looks like something seeping through a surface
Physically present: the panel feels like a tangible object angled in real space toward the viewer
Continuously responsive and eased, never abrupt or snapped
Effortless and commitment-free, since nothing needs to be clicked and no state is ever finalized
Replayable and inviting, rewarding repeated approach and withdrawal
completion_and_return: No completion or terminal state: the experience loops between resting and revealed for as long as the view is present
Removing the pointer always returns the panel to the first image and its neutral pose
No revealed state persists after the pointer leaves, so every visit begins from the same resting composition
locked_observable_requirements: A single upright panel is the only subject on a uniform, near-empty stage that stays visibly quieter than the panel
Two images share one identical frame on that panel
The image change is a patchy, organic seep across the frame, not a uniform crossfade or straight-edged wipe
The panel continuously slides, tilts on two axes and scales in response to pointer position, reading as an object in depth
All pose and blend changes are eased and continuous, never snapped
Hover advances the reveal and leaving reverses it, always resuming from the current mid-state
Tilt stays within a modest, plausible range
The resting image is the persistent default that the experience always returns to
No click, tap or explicit control is required to drive any part of the experience
adaptable_details: Subject matter of the two images
Panel aspect ratio and absolute size, as long as it stays upright and singular
Exact patch shape, grain, scale and spread direction of the seeping reveal
Transition and easing durations
Precise magnitudes of horizontal travel, tilt limits and scale range
Exact background tone and luminance level, and any subtle ambient shading on the panel
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits any context with one deliberately featured image pair that benefits from a sparse, focused stage — a hero portrait, an artwork or cover, a product shot with an alternate view, a before/after pair. It stops being this Skill if the single subject becomes a grid or gallery of several simultaneously interactive panels, if the surround gains competing foreground content or visual activity that dilutes the sole focus, if the reveal becomes a uniform crossfade or hard swap instead of an organic patchy seep, if the pose response is dropped so the panel reads as a flat inline picture, or if the revealed state must be committed by a click and persist rather than always returning to the resting image.

name: drag_handover_name_row_with_preview_scatter
description: A giant collection name centered on screen with a faint scatter of its pictures behind it and neighbouring names peeking off both edges; pulling sideways drags the whole row so the outgoing and incoming names and pictures trade places progressively, and opening the active collection lets its pictures gather into a full-strength scrollable arrangement that collapses back to the same place in the row.

canonical_document.name: drag_handover_name_row_with_preview_scatter
canonical_document.description: A giant collection name centered on screen with a faint scatter of its pictures behind it and neighbouring names peeking off both edges; pulling sideways drags the whole row so the outgoing and incoming names and pictures trade places progressively, and opening the active collection lets its pictures gather into a full-strength scrollable arrangement that collapses back to the same place in the row.
canonical_document.experience_scope: Whole-view region-free experience: it occupies the entire viewport from the moment the browsing surface is shown, spans both the row-of-names state and the entered-collection state, and ends when the visitor leaves the surface entirely; the entered state is a mode of the same experience rather than a separate screen.
content_and_composition: Exactly one active collection at a time, identified by a very short name rendered at very large display scale as the primary foreground element, centered in the view
A loose, irregular scatter of several preview pictures belonging to the active collection, sitting behind the name at reduced visual strength so it reads as a hint of contents rather than a gallery
The immediately neighbouring collection names held partially visible just beyond the left and right edges so the whole set reads as one continuous horizontal row instead of a list
A small persistent action label beneath the active name inviting entry into that collection
A small ring overlay that follows the pointer above all other layers
Entered state: the same collection's pictures at full strength in a calm, deliberate arrangement that extends beyond the viewport and scrolls, plus a persistent back control
Layer order throughout: pointer ring in front, oversized name in the middle, pictures behind
experience_progression: Rest: one collection centered, its name dominant, its previews faint behind, neighbours waiting off both edges

Held pull: the whole row follows the pointer sideways and the outgoing and incoming names and preview pictures exchange prominence continuously, so a half-completed pull looks half-changed and the arriving collection is already identifiable
Release past a short threshold: the pull completes as one handover and the next collection settles dead centre, becoming the new rest state
Release early or reversal before release: the exchange runs backwards and eases fully back to the original collection
Entering: the active collection's faint scatter resolves and gathers into its full-strength arrangement, shifting the view into slow-looking mode with scrolling available
Exiting: the arrangement collapses back into the faint scatter and the row of names reappears at the same collection the visitor left from
attention_and_information_flow: At rest attention is pinned to the single oversized name; pictures register only as texture and colour hinting at contents

During a pull attention splits and transfers proportionally: the departing name and previews recede as the arriving ones strengthen, so identity of the incoming collection is legible before the move finishes
Edge-peeking neighbours continuously advertise that more collections exist without competing for focus
On entry the hierarchy inverts: pictures take full prominence and the name's dominance gives way to unhurried image viewing
The pointer ring gives a constant low-level read of pointer position and of whether the row is currently being held

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Direction may be reversed at any time before release; the exchange follows the pointer both ways
interaction_model.state_change: Row offset tracks the pointer continuously, with roughly one screen width of pull equal to exactly one step between collections
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Names and preview pictures slide with the pointer and trade prominence progressively with no hard cut, so partial pulls look partially changed
interaction_model.input: Press anywhere on the browsing surface and pull sideways
interaction_model.affected_object: The entire row of collection names together with the preview scatters of the outgoing and incoming collections

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Further pulls are ignored until the settling motion finishes, so a move can never be half-abandoned
interaction_model.state_change: Committed advance by exactly one step to the neighbouring collection
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The incoming name and previews settle dead centre in one continuous easing motion from wherever the pull stopped
interaction_model.input: Release after pulling past a short distance
interaction_model.affected_object: Active collection selection and its name and previews

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Cancellation is always available up to the moment of release
interaction_model.state_change: Cancellation back to the collection that was already active
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Everything eases smoothly back to the original centred arrangement with no jump
interaction_model.input: Release before the short distance, or reverse direction before releasing
interaction_model.affected_object: Row offset and the partially exchanged names and previews

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: The set never wraps and never leaves the visitor beyond the ends
interaction_model.state_change: Bounded overshoot only; no new collection is reached
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The pull visibly resists, moves less than the pointer, and always springs back to the end collection
interaction_model.input: Pulling further outward at the first or last collection
interaction_model.affected_object: Row offset at the ends of the set

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Returns to its resting form whenever the hold ends
interaction_model.state_change: Ring trails the pointer and switches into an engaged appearance while a hold is active
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The ring grows and sprouts short side marks while the row is held, then returns to its plain small form on release
interaction_model.input: Pointer movement, and holding the row
interaction_model.affected_object: The small pointer-following ring

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: The back control is present throughout the entered state
interaction_model.state_change: Transition from row browsing into the entered collection view
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The faint scattered previews gather and resolve into their full-strength arrangement while the row of names gives way
interaction_model.input: Activating the explore label beneath the active name
interaction_model.affected_object: The active collection's preview pictures and the row of names

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Scrolling is bounded by the extent of the arrangement and can be reversed freely
interaction_model.state_change: Progress through the collection's pictures
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Calm, unhurried movement through the arrangement that rewards slow looking
interaction_model.input: Scrolling inside the entered collection
interaction_model.affected_object: The full-strength picture arrangement

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Row browsing resumes immediately from that position with neighbours again peeking at the edges
interaction_model.state_change: Return from entered mode to row browsing at the same position
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The arrangement collapses and the oversized name with its faint scatter returns, centred on the same collection that was entered
interaction_model.input: Activating the back control
interaction_model.affected_object: Entered arrangement and the row of names

experience_qualities: Physical, hand-led: the row feels grabbed and dragged rather than clicked through
Continuous and uncut: every change is a proportional exchange, never a swap between finished states
Spacious and low-density, with one name commanding the screen
Legible mid-motion, so the arriving collection is identifiable before it arrives
Calm and unhurried once inside a collection, encouraging slow looking
Bounded and forgiving: ends resist, mistakes cancel, moves always resolve
completion_and_return: Every pull resolves to a settled, centred collection: either the next one or the original
The set does not loop; the first and last collections are hard ends that spring back
Entering and leaving a collection is fully reversible, and leaving restores the row at the same collection rather than at the start
Row position persists across entry and exit for the duration of the visit
locked_observable_requirements: One collection at a time owns the whole view, its short name at very large display scale as the dominant element
Its pictures appear as a loose, faint scatter behind the name in the row state, and at full strength only inside the entered state
Neighbouring names remain partially visible just off both edges so the set reads as one continuous row
Sideways pull drags the entire row with the pointer, with about one screen width of pull equal to exactly one step
Outgoing and incoming names and previews exchange progressively so a half-finished pull looks half-changed, with no hard cut at any point
A short release threshold decides commit versus cancel, and reversal before release cancels
The two ends resist and always spring back; the set never wraps
Additional pulls are ignored until the current move finishes settling
A small ring trails the pointer and grows with short side marks while the row is held
Entering gathers the previews into a scrollable full-strength arrangement, and returning lands on the same collection in the row
adaptable_details: Number of collections, provided it stays a small set, and number of preview pictures per collection
Exact scatter positions, sizes and faintness of the previews
Typeface, letter case, colour palette and background treatment
Exact release threshold, easing curves and settle duration
Ring size, growth amount and number or length of its side marks
Wording and placement of the enter label and the back control
Layout of the entered full-strength arrangement and its scroll direction
Whether the pull comes from pointer drag, touch drag or both
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits a small, ordered set of named collections that each own a short identifying name and a handful of images, where the site wants one immersive browsing surface leading into closer viewing. It transfers to project sets, chapters, story groups or themed image sets. It becomes a different skill if the set grows large enough to need a scrolling list or index, if the collections carry no imagery so the faint scatter has nothing to show, if the oversized name stops being the dominant foreground element, or if stepping between collections becomes a discrete click or cut instead of a continuous pull whose progress is proportional to the pointer.

source_sites.title: Draggable Menu with Image Grid Previews

name: weighted_endless_photo_run_with_drag_deformation
description: A single continuous row of pictures that visibly extends past both edges of the screen, dragged sideways with heavy trailing motion; while dragging, the frames dim and shrink, the images inside push closer, and the collection title swells large behind everything, with elastic resistance at each end and a custom pointer marker that reacts to labels and edge hints.

canonical_document.name: weighted_endless_photo_run_with_drag_deformation
canonical_document.description: A single continuous row of pictures that visibly extends past both edges of the screen, dragged sideways with heavy trailing motion; while dragging, the frames dim and shrink, the images inside push closer, and the collection title swells large behind everything, with elastic resistance at each end and a custom pointer marker that reacts to labels and edge hints.
canonical_document.experience_scope: Whole-view experience occupying the entire viewport, beginning after an initial calm holding state and continuing for the whole browsing session; it includes the optional full-screen single-picture stop and the return to the same point in the run.
content_and_composition: One horizontal run of many equally weighted picture frames, laid out along a single line that continues beyond both the left and right edges of the viewport so no start or end is visible on screen
Each frame contains one photograph that can be scaled independently of the frame it sits in
A set of small index labels associated with the pictures, each acting as an entry point to that picture
One large collection title rendered behind all pictures as a background layer, normally recessed or subdued
A persistent custom pointer marker rendered above all other layers, replacing or accompanying the ordinary cursor
A calm placeholder view that holds the whole screen before the run appears
In the single-picture stop: one photograph dominating the screen, a short note associated with it, and one close control; no competing collection chrome
experience_progression: Stage 1 — Hold: a quiet placeholder occupies the view and nothing of the run is shown or moved until every photograph is ready
Stage 2 — Reveal: the continuous run replaces the placeholder in its calm resting state, already extending past both edges

Stage 3 — Travel: dragging carries the run laterally with trailing lag; frames dim and shrink, inner photographs push closer, and the collection title surfaces large behind everything for as long as the gesture continues
Stage 4 — Settle: on release, motion decays gradually rather than stopping instantly, and the frames, photographs, title and pointer return to their resting appearance
Stage 5 — Boundary: pushing past either end enters a resisted overscroll that follows the pointer only partially, then eases back to the limit on release
Stage 6 — Stop: activating an index label opens the corresponding photograph as a full-screen undistracted view with its short note
Stage 7 — Return: the close control restores the run at exactly the same position it held before the stop
attention_and_information_flow: At rest, attention sits on the pictures themselves, which read as the clear foreground
During dragging, attention widens from individual pictures to the run as a whole because frames recede in brightness and size while the sequence keeps moving
The collection title becomes readable only while travelling, giving the gesture a secondary informational payoff without competing with pictures at rest
The pointer marker draws attention to what is actionable: it widens with directional hints during dragging and swells over index labels to signal that they can be opened
In the single-picture stop, attention collapses onto one photograph and its short note; everything else is withdrawn
On return, attention resumes at the same place in the run rather than resetting to a beginning

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Releasing the gesture lets motion decay gradually and returns frames, photographs and title to their resting appearance; a new drag can begin at any moment and re-enters the travelling state without a reset
interaction_model.state_change: Run travels laterally following the gesture with deliberate trailing lag; frames reduce in brightness and size; inner photographs scale up within their frames; background title scales up and becomes prominent
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Weighted, slightly delayed lateral movement of all pictures; dimmed and shrunken frames; photographs pressing closer inside their frames; a large title appearing behind everything
interaction_model.input: Sideways drag or pointer press-and-move anywhere across the run
interaction_model.affected_object: The whole run of picture frames, the photographs inside them, and the background collection title

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: On release, the run eases back to the exact limit position; the boundary is never crossed and no error state is shown
interaction_model.state_change: Enters a resisted state where displacement tracks the pointer at roughly half its distance
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The run visibly lags and refuses to keep pace with the pointer, making the limit felt rather than announced
interaction_model.input: Continued drag beyond either end of the run
interaction_model.affected_object: The run as a whole at its boundary

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: The marker returns to its small resting form as soon as the gesture ends or the pointer leaves a label
interaction_model.state_change: Marker changes between resting, dragging and label-hover states
interaction_model.visible_feedback: A small marker at rest; a widened marker carrying directional side hints while dragging; a swollen marker while over an index label
interaction_model.input: Pointer movement across the view
interaction_model.affected_object: The custom pointer marker

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: One close control exits the stop and restores the run at the identical position and scroll state held before opening
interaction_model.state_change: Transitions from run-browsing to a single-photograph full-screen stop with its short note
interaction_model.visible_feedback: One photograph takes over the screen as a quiet, undistracted view; collection layers and travel affordances withdraw
interaction_model.input: Click or activation on an index label
interaction_model.affected_object: The corresponding photograph and the surrounding collection view

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Travel is not offered while held, so the visitor cannot enter an incomplete run
interaction_model.state_change: Held state releases into the resting run only once every photograph is ready
interaction_model.visible_feedback: A calm placeholder gives way to the complete continuous run with no partially populated or shifting frames
interaction_model.input: Autonomous readiness of all photographs
interaction_model.affected_object: The holding placeholder and the run

experience_qualities: Quiet and unhurried rather than snappy
Weighted and physical, as if pulling something with mass
Continuous and open-ended, with always more to reach for beyond both edges
Coherent as a sequence rather than a set of separate cards
Focused and undistracted in the single-picture stop
Tactile, with the pointer itself participating in the effect
completion_and_return: The run has no completion: it continues past both edges and is bounded only by resisted ends that always spring back to the limit
Each travel gesture completes by decaying to rest and restoring frames, photographs, title and pointer to their resting appearance
The single-picture stop completes only by the close control, which returns the visitor to the same position in the run
Run position persists across entering and leaving the single-picture stop
locked_observable_requirements: The picture run must visibly continue past both the left and right edges so neither a first nor last item is presented as an endpoint
Lateral travel must feel weighted and trailing, with delayed following and gradual decay rather than immediate stop
Dragging must simultaneously dim and shrink the frames while the photographs inside them scale closer
The collection title must surface large behind all pictures during dragging and recede at rest
Overscroll past either end must move less than the pointer and ease back to the limit on release
A custom pointer marker must be present, widening with directional hints while dragging and swelling over index labels
Travel must not be available until every photograph is ready; a calm holding view precedes the run
Opening a single picture must produce a quiet full-screen stop with a short note and a single close control
Leaving the single-picture stop must return to the same position in the run
adaptable_details: Number of pictures, their aspect ratios and frame proportions
Exact lag amount, decay duration and easing character, as long as the feeling stays weighted
Exact dim and shrink amounts for frames and push-in amount for photographs
Typography, size and treatment of the collection title
Shape, size and hint styling of the pointer marker
Form of the index labels and their placement along or beside the run
Visual style of the calm holding placeholder
Layout and typography of the short note in the single-picture stop
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits any moderately large set of equally weighted visual items with optional short per-item text where lateral, unhurried browsing is the primary mode and each item can bear a focused full-screen view. Requires items uniform enough to read as one continuous run and a collection-level title worth revealing behind them. Replacing lateral drag travel with vertical page scroll, giving the run a visible beginning and end, removing the coordinated dim/shrink/push-in deformation during travel, or turning the single-item stop into a multi-pane detail layout would each create a different Skill.

name: tilted_depth_assembly_picture_cycle
description: Illustrations assemble themselves piece by piece into a tilted, depth-separated arrangement filling a full-screen field held at one uniform low-distraction tone, hold long enough to be taken in, then tilt and sink away as the next one builds and the surrounding tone shifts, cycling forever behind one large fixed caption.

canonical_document.name: tilted_depth_assembly_picture_cycle
canonical_document.description: Illustrations assemble themselves piece by piece into a tilted, depth-separated arrangement filling a full-screen field held at one uniform low-distraction tone, hold long enough to be taken in, then tilt and sink away as the next one builds and the surrounding tone shifts, cycling forever behind one large fixed caption.
canonical_document.experience_scope: Whole-view experience that occupies the entire screen and begins automatically the moment the view opens; it has no end state and continues cycling for as long as the view is present.
content_and_composition: One full-screen field held at a single uniform, low-distraction tone acting as the surrounding ground for everything else, whose tone shifts with the current picture
One illustration shown at a time, composed of several separated pieces rather than a single flat image
Pieces positioned at visibly different depths and viewed from a tilted, off-center angle so the arrangement never reads as flat
A small ordered set of illustrations forming a repeating run

One large caption fixed in front of the changing artwork, persistent and unchanged across every picture, visually the topmost layer, held at enough separation from the surround to stay readable as that surround shifts
During changeovers, outgoing and incoming pieces may coexist in the same field at different depths and opacities
experience_progression: View opens and the first illustration builds up from separated pieces that drift forward and settle
Pieces settle one shortly after another rather than all at once, so the picture visibly assembles
The completed arrangement holds still long enough to be taken in
The picture releases: pieces continue tilting and sinking away while fading out
The surrounding tone shifts toward the tone belonging to the next picture as the exchange happens
The next illustration builds up in the same manner, overlapping the outgoing one when timing requires
After the last illustration the run returns to the first and continues without end
attention_and_information_flow: Attention is drawn to the assembling pieces because they are the only things moving in an otherwise still field
Prominence shifts from incoming motion to the settled, held arrangement, which is the moment the picture is legible
Outgoing pieces recede in emphasis as they tilt, sink and fade, handing attention to the newly arriving ones
The surrounding tone shift signals the change of subject peripherally, staying low enough in salience never to compete with the artwork
The fixed caption remains a constant reference point and never loses prominence to the changing imagery

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Runs unattended with no start, pause or skip; if a new change begins before the previous picture has fully cleared, both sets animate concurrently so the field never shows a half-built or stalled arrangement
interaction_model.state_change: Current picture transitions from held to releasing while the next transitions from absent to assembling; the surrounding tone moves to the one belonging to the next picture
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Outgoing pieces tilt and sink away while fading; incoming pieces drift forward and settle one shortly after another; the surrounding tone shifts with them
interaction_model.input: Autonomous timer running on a steady, unhurried beat from the moment the view opens
interaction_model.affected_object: The current illustration, its pieces, and the surrounding tone

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: The caption stays click-through so it never intercepts pointer activity; the experience remains purely observational
interaction_model.state_change: No state change; the cycle is unaffected and no text becomes selected
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Nothing responds; no highlight, no selection, no interruption of the running cycle
interaction_model.input: Clicking, dragging or attempted text selection anywhere in the view
interaction_model.affected_object: The whole view including artwork, surrounding field and caption

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: No restart, no reset to the first picture, no visible gap during refitting
interaction_model.state_change: Composition refits to the new dimensions while cycle position is retained
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The arrangement and caption resettle into the new frame with the tilted depth relationship preserved; the current picture and its timing continue uninterrupted
interaction_model.input: Resizing the view
interaction_model.affected_object: The full-screen toned field, the piece arrangement and the caption

experience_qualities: Calm and effortless to follow
Playful and visually lively
Spatial and constructed rather than flat
Unhurried, with holds long enough to actually read each picture
Continuous and seamless, never stalling or showing an incomplete frame
Purely observational, demanding nothing from the viewer
completion_and_return: No completion state; the run loops back to its start and continues indefinitely
Each picture completes only in the sense of settling, holding, then releasing
Cycle position persists across view resizing rather than restarting
The caption persists unchanged through every loop
locked_observable_requirements: Full-view field held at one uniform, low-distraction tone as the single surrounding ground
Each picture visibly assembles from separated pieces rather than appearing whole
Pieces occupy visibly different depths and are seen from a tilted, off-center angle so the result never reads flat
Each settled picture holds still long enough to be taken in before releasing
Outgoing pieces leave by continuing to tilt and sink while fading, not by cutting or simply disappearing
The surrounding tone shifts together with the change of picture, as a controlled transition that stays subordinate to the artwork
Overlapping changeovers animate both sets concurrently and never leave a half-built or stalled frame

Pointer activity and text selection produce no response anywhere, and the caption does not intercept pointer activity
One large caption stays fixed in front of the changing artwork across all pictures, readable against the surround at every point in the cycle
adaptable_details: Number of illustrations in the run
Number, shape and arrangement of pieces per illustration
Which surrounding tones are used, whether they run light or dark, and how far the tone shifts between pictures
Exact hold duration, beat interval and stagger between settling pieces

Caption wording, typeface, size and anchor position
Direction from which pieces drift in and sink out
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits any small set of self-contained pictorial works that can be separated into pieces and read at a glance, presented on a page whose only foreground text is a short fixed caption; the works carry their own coloring and the surround only has to stay separable from them and from the caption. Introducing viewer control over which picture shows, requiring readable detail or dense text inside the artwork, placing scrollable or interactive content over the field, or flattening the pieces onto one plane would each create a different Skill.
