name: elastic_stretch_fullscreen_photo_traversal
description: A single full-bleed photograph per place fills the whole view, held at a luminance clearly separated from the type above it; press-hold and drag vertically to stretch it into depth with a taffy-like pull while names thin into hollow outlines and imagery dissolves toward the place being passed, then release to spring back sharp and snapped onto one place, with a soft ripple whose edges split into separated hues trailing the pointer at rest.

canonical_document.name: elastic_stretch_fullscreen_photo_traversal
canonical_document.description: A single full-bleed photograph per place fills the whole view, held at a luminance clearly separated from the type above it; press-hold and drag vertically to stretch it into depth with a taffy-like pull while names thin into hollow outlines and imagery dissolves toward the place being passed, then release to spring back sharp and snapped onto one place, with a soft ripple whose edges split into separated hues trailing the pointer at rest.
canonical_document.experience_scope: Whole-view experience filling the entire viewport with no surrounding chrome; begins immediately on arrival already inside one destination and continues indefinitely as an ongoing browse, each traversal ending when the view settles on a single destination. There is no terminal completion state, only a current settled place.
content_and_composition: Exactly one full-bleed, tonally unified cinematic photograph visible at a time, filling the whole view as the base layer and sitting at a luminance well separated from the type over it
One dominant large place name set over the photograph as the primary type layer
One subordinate secondary label (region or category) and one quiet further-reading cue, both legible but visually recessive, grouped with the primary name
A vertically ordered stack of the neighbouring places' names that shares the same position as the current name and moves as one body with the traversal
A persistent indicator of position within the finite collection, readable at rest and throughout motion
A pointer-reactive overlay effect layer above the photograph, active only while the picture is at rest
Layer order from back to front: photograph, name stack with secondary label and cue, pointer ripple overlay, position indicator always visible
experience_progression: Arrival: one destination at rest, photograph whole and sharp, place name large, secondary label and further-reading cue quietly legible
Grab: press and hold anywhere in the view registers a hold and the whole view becomes draggable

Travel: as the drag moves vertically, the photograph peels away into depth with a taffy-like stretch whose edges trail behind its centre, the name stack glides in lockstep with the drag, the names lose their fill and become hollow outlines, the imagery cross-dissolves toward whichever place is being passed, and the position indicator advances with the movement
Release: the picture springs elastically back to flat and sharp while settling onto the nearest place rather than halting between two
Settle: motion comes to rest, the naming details return to solid legibility and the arrival reads as deliberate
Idle: while the picture rests, moving the pointer across it raises a soft ripple with hue-split fringing that trails behind the pointer path
Loop: any new press-and-hold restarts the travel stage from the current place
attention_and_information_flow: At rest, attention is shared between the large place name and the photograph, with the secondary label and further-reading cue available on quiet inspection
The moment travel starts, attention is pulled away from reading and toward looking: type de-emphasises into hollow outlines while the deforming, dissolving imagery becomes the loudest element
Position within the collection is the one piece of information that never loses legibility, so the visitor always knows where they are while text is de-emphasised
Identity of the destination being approached is revealed progressively through the cross-dissolve before its name resolves
On settling, prominence returns to the naming details, restoring readable identity and making the further-reading cue the natural next step

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Traversal comes to a hard stop at either end of the finite set with no wrap-around; the drag can be reversed mid-gesture and simply follows the pointer back
interaction_model.state_change: Continuous traversal offset tracks the drag distance, moving the collection toward the neighbouring place
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The photograph peels into depth with a taffy-like stretch whose edges lag its centre, the name stack glides in step with the drag, names thin into hollow outlines, imagery dissolves toward the place being passed, and the position indicator advances
interaction_model.input: Press and hold anywhere in the view, then drag vertically (pointer or touch, identical behaviour)
interaction_model.affected_object: The full-bleed photograph together with the name stack and position indicator

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: The settling motion is interruptible; the view always resolves to a valid single destination even if released mid-stretch or against an end boundary
interaction_model.state_change: Free traversal ends and resolves to exactly one destination, never a position between two
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The stretched picture springs back flat and sharp, the dissolve resolves to a single image, and the naming details return to solid legibility
interaction_model.input: Releasing the hold
interaction_model.affected_object: The photograph, name stack and traversal position

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Repeated grabs can be chained without the view ever snapping back to a prior place
interaction_model.state_change: Momentum is captured and traversal resumes from wherever the motion currently is
interaction_model.visible_feedback: No jump or restart: the stretch and dissolve continue from their current appearance under the new drag
interaction_model.input: A fresh press-and-hold while the view is still in flight from a previous release
interaction_model.affected_object: The in-motion photograph and name stack

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: The ripple fades on its own when the pointer stops or leaves, and never persists into or disturbs the traversal state
interaction_model.state_change: A transient local disturbance follows the pointer path
interaction_model.visible_feedback: A soft ripple rises under the pointer with its edges dispersing into separated hues, and trails behind its movement
interaction_model.input: Drifting the pointer across a resting picture without pressing
interaction_model.affected_object: The settled photograph surface

experience_qualities: Cinematic and atmospheric, dominated by tonally unified imagery that outweighs the recessive type
Tactile and material, as if the picture is a stretchable physical sheet
Weighted and elastic, with trailing edges and spring-back giving a sense of mass
Single-focus and uncluttered, one place at a time with no competing content
Calm and deliberate at rest, energetic and blurred while travelling
Reassuring in orientation despite de-emphasised text, because position stays visible
Uniform across pointer and touch so the gesture feels native either way
completion_and_return: Every traversal completes by resting on exactly one destination, with naming details restored
No resting position between two destinations is possible
The set does not loop: both ends behave as hard boundaries the traversal cannot pass
The currently settled destination persists as the view state until the next grab
The pointer ripple self-completes by fading and leaves no residual state
locked_observable_requirements: One tonally unified cinematic photograph, held at a luminance clearly separated from the type over it, fills the entire view and only one is current at any moment
A large place name plus a quiet secondary label and further-reading cue sit over the photograph
Traversal is driven by press-and-hold followed by vertical drag anywhere in the view
During traversal the photograph stretches into depth with its edges trailing its centre
The name stack moves in lockstep with the drag and its names become hollow outlines while travelling
Imagery cross-dissolves toward the place being passed rather than cutting
Release springs the picture back flat and sharp and snaps to the nearest single place
Both ends of the set are hard stops with no wrap-around
A new grab during the settling motion continues from the current motion state
Position within the collection remains visible at all times, including mid-motion
A resting picture raises a soft ripple whose edges split into separated hues, of any hue family, and trails the drifting pointer
Touch behaves identically to pointer input
adaptable_details: Number of places in the set, as long as it is finite and browsable one at a time
Photographic subject matter and grading, provided the imagery stays tonally unified, cinematic and low in distraction behind the type
Typeface, case and exact placement of the name stack within the view
Wording and role of the secondary label and the further-reading cue
Hue set and intensity of the ripple's dispersion fringing, as long as the hues read as separated
Amplitude of the stretch, dissolve softness and spring timing of the settle
Visual form of the position indicator
Whether an additional pointer affordance hints that the view is holdable
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits any finite curated set of single strong images that each carry one short title, one small secondary label and an optional link, presented as the whole view and browsed one at a time. It suits mood-led collection browsing where imagery outranks text. It stops being this skill if multiple items become simultaneously visible in a grid or peeking carousel, if text-heavy content must remain readable during transitions, if advancement becomes automatic or click/step driven rather than held-drag driven, if the set wraps endlessly instead of hard-stopping, or if the elastic stretch and snap-to-nearest settle are replaced by plain fades or slides.

name: tilted_editorial_photo_row_with_fullscreen_entry
description: A slightly off-axis row of three photographs with the current one centred, its name set enormously across the composition, drifting sideways as one continuous strip when stepped, with pointer-driven counter-motion between images and titles, and the centre image opening into a full-screen entry that closes back to the untouched row.

canonical_document.name: tilted_editorial_photo_row_with_fullscreen_entry
canonical_document.description: A slightly off-axis row of three photographs with the current one centred, its name set enormously across the composition, drifting sideways as one continuous strip when stepped, with pointer-driven counter-motion between images and titles, and the centre image opening into a full-screen entry that closes back to the untouched row.
canonical_document.experience_scope: A whole-view experience occupying the full viewport: it begins with the tilted three-image row and its oversized title, extends through stepping and pointer-driven drift, temporarily becomes a full-screen single-entry reading state, and ends when that state is closed and the row is restored as it stood.
content_and_composition: One ordered set of a few entries; each entry carries one photograph, a short name/title, a place label, a date and a body text
Three photographs visible at once: one centred and dominant, two neighbours flanking it to left and right as partial previews signalling that more entries sit either side
The current entry's name set at enormous scale across the composition, overlapping or spanning the images as a typographic layer rather than a caption
The entire arrangement (images plus oversized title) tipped slightly off the horizontal/vertical axis so it reads as a bold editorial spread instead of a plain viewer
Two invisible interactive zones occupying the left and right thirds of the viewport, and a central zone over the middle photograph

Persistent throughout the row state: the centred-dominant-plus-two-neighbours structure, the oversized current title, and the off-axis tilt

The oversized name gives the current entry an editorial headline weight and reads as the strongest textual element, identifying which entry is current at a glance
During a step, attention follows the whole row's motion; the arriving off-screen preview signals continuation of the set and the new centre takes over prominence as the title changes with it
Pointer-driven counter-motion between images and titles adds depth cues that keep the eye on the centre band without revealing new information
A slight swell of the centre photograph under a dwelling pointer marks it as the openable element
Opening an entry collapses information hierarchy to one subject: the photograph plus its full text detail, with sequence context deliberately withdrawn

interaction_model.state_change: The current position steps one place in that direction
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The entire row slides continuously that way as one strip, a fresh preview arrives from off-screen on the leading side, the new entry becomes the dominant centre and the oversized name changes to the new current entry

interaction_model.affected_object: The whole photograph row and its oversized current title

interaction_model.visible_feedback: Each third carries its own distinct pointer cue, so the available action is legible before committing
interaction_model.input: Pointer hovering over the left, centre or right third of the viewport
interaction_model.affected_object: The pointer cue for the hovered zone

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: The offset follows the pointer continuously and eases back toward the neutral arrangement as the pointer returns or leaves; it never displaces the composition far enough to obscure which entry is current
interaction_model.state_change: A continuous parallax offset tracks pointer position
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The photographs drift in the direction of the pointer while the oversized titles glide the opposite way, producing a layered, depth-suggesting counter-motion
interaction_model.input: Moving the pointer sideways across the composition
interaction_model.affected_object: The photograph layer and the oversized title layer

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: It returns to its resting size when the pointer moves off
interaction_model.state_change: Enters an emphasised hover state
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The centre photograph swells slightly, marking it as the element that can be opened
interaction_model.input: Pointer dwelling on the centre photograph
interaction_model.affected_object: The centre photograph

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Input is ignored while the opening transition runs; the row position is retained underneath so it can be restored
interaction_model.state_change: Transitions from row state into the full-screen entry state
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The flanking previews and row title are cleared away and the chosen photograph together with its title, place, date and text takes the full screen
interaction_model.input: Choosing the centre photograph
interaction_model.affected_object: The whole composition

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Input is ignored while the closing transition runs; the restored row is identical to the pre-open state, so nothing about the browsing position is lost
interaction_model.state_change: Transitions back from the entry state to the row state
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The full-screen entry closes and the tilted three-image row reappears at exactly the position and arrangement it had before opening

interaction_model.affected_object: The full-screen entry

experience_qualities: Bold and editorial, closer to a magazine spread than a media viewer
Continuous and gliding rather than stepped or snapped between discrete frames
Layered and depth-suggesting through opposing motion of images and typography
Always orienting: it stays obvious which entry is current and that more sit on either side
Deliberate and unbreakable, since transitions always complete before new input is accepted
Typographically dominant, with entry names scaled large enough to act as composition rather than label
completion_and_return: Stepping has no terminal end state; the row remains available for further steps in either direction
Opening an entry is a temporary excursion rather than a destination change; it always has a return
Closing an entry restores the row's exact prior position and arrangement instead of resetting to the first entry
Pointer-driven drift and the centre swell are transient and settle back to the resting composition on their own
locked_observable_requirements: One dominant centred photograph flanked by two partially visible neighbour previews at all times in the row state
The current entry's name rendered at enormous scale across the composition
The whole arrangement tipped slightly off-axis
Stepping moves the entire row as one continuous drift, with a new preview arriving from off-screen, never a cut or crossfade in place
Left and right thirds of the viewport act as step controls and each third presents its own distinct pointer cue
Sideways pointer movement drifts photographs one way while oversized titles move the opposite way
The centre photograph swells slightly while the pointer dwells on it
Choosing the centre photograph clears the previews and gives that entry's photograph, title, place, date and text the full screen; choosing it again closes it
Closing restores the row exactly as it stood, at the same position
Input is ignored for the duration of any running transition so no half-finished state is reachable
adaptable_details: Number of entries in the set, as long as it stays a small browsable sequence
Exact tilt angle, drift distance, swell amount and transition durations
Typeface, tonal treatment and exact placement of the oversized name, provided it stays readable against the photographs beneath it
The specific metadata labels accompanying the body text
Visual form of the per-third pointer cues
Whether stepping wraps around at the ends of the set or stops
Whether additional inputs (keyboard, swipe, wheel) also drive stepping alongside the third-zone activation
Subject matter of the photographs and tone of the accompanying text
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits small ordered sets of a few visually strong images that each own a short name and a longer piece of text worth reading on its own, presented as the primary attraction of a view. It needs full-viewport space and images strong enough to survive being cropped by neighbours and overlaid by huge type. Growing the set into a browsable many-item library, or reducing it to a bounded panel inside a scrolling page, or replacing the oversized-title-plus-three-image tilted composition with a conventional aligned carousel, or making the expanded entry a separate destination that does not return the row untouched, each produces a different Skill.

name: liquid_photo_trailing_a_typographic_name_list
description: A still page of large stacked names; pointing at one summons its photo under the pointer, warped and liquid on arrival before settling sharp, dragging behind pointer movement and smearing more violently the faster the pointer moves, while the pointed name's letters scatter in the direction of travel and snap back.

canonical_document.name: liquid_photo_trailing_a_typographic_name_list
canonical_document.description: A still page of large stacked names; pointing at one summons its photo under the pointer, warped and liquid on arrival before settling sharp, dragging behind pointer movement and smearing more violently the faster the pointer moves, while the pointed name's letters scatter in the direction of travel and snap back.
canonical_document.experience_scope: A whole-view experience anchored on one region: the list of names occupies the view and the summoned image layer spans the same view behind the text. content_and_composition: One vertically stacked list of short names, set large, as the only foreground content; no accompanying descriptions, thumbnails, controls or decoration competing for attention
Exactly one photograph per name, none of them present in the page's resting state
At most one photograph visible at any moment, drawn as a single free-floating image layer positioned near the pointer rather than in a fixed slot or frame
The image layer sits behind the names in stacking order and never captures pointing, so the names remain reliably targetable even where the picture overlaps them
The name list is the persistent element across the whole experience; the image layer is transient

Attention enters a name: that name's photo appears at the pointer in an unsettled, liquid, heavily warped condition

Traversal: sliding to a neighbouring name exchanges the picture instantly for the new one, restarting the arrival-and-settle behaviour without an intervening empty state

attention_and_information_flow: In the resting state all prominence belongs to the typography, so the names are read first and as a set
Imagery is revealed strictly one place at a time, so places are taken in individually rather than compared side by side
The picture appears where the reader is already looking, so no attention shift is required to connect name and image
Text stays legible and dominant over the image layer; the picture reads as atmosphere behind the name rather than as a competing subject
Fast pointer motion reads as unresolved and in-transit; stillness reads as arrival, which pushes the reader to pause on a single name to actually see its place

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Stopping the pointer lets the image settle at the pointer position; the lag never leaves the image stranded or detached from the pointer
interaction_model.state_change: Image position chases the pointer with damped lag instead of locking to it

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Re-pointing at any name re-establishes its image; rapid traversal across several names remains coherent because only one picture is ever shown

interaction_model.visible_feedback: That name's photo appears at the pointer in an unsettled liquid state; moving to a neighbouring name exchanges it instantly for the new picture with no gap or crossfade

interaction_model.state_change: Letters displace from their set positions and return
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The letters scatter briefly in the direction of travel, then snap back into their original arrangement
interaction_model.input: Pointing at a name and moving across it

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Coming back to the list fades the next picture in rather than snapping it on, so repeat passes begin as calmly as the first
interaction_model.state_change: From showing an image to the resting image-free state
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The photo fades out to nothing, leaving the original still, purely typographic page
interaction_model.input: Attention leaving the list entirely
interaction_model.affected_object: Image layer and the whole view

experience_qualities: Opens quiet, restrained and purely typographic
Liquid, unsettled arrival resolving into calm sharpness
Physical and weighted, through trailing lag and speed-reactive smearing
Alive and immediately legible letterforms that never sacrifice readability
One-at-a-time, contemplative pacing rather than gallery-style comparison
Bounded and self-correcting: every distortion returns to a clean image
completion_and_return: No terminal completion state; the experience is repeatable and returns to its resting state indefinitely
Leaving the list fades imagery to nothing and fully restores the opening still, image-free typographic page
Re-entry fades the next picture in, so the page is always ready for another pass
No selection, highlight or image persists after attention leaves
locked_observable_requirements: Resting state is purely typographic with no imagery visible
Names are set large and stacked as the only competing content
At most one photograph visible at a time, tied to the single name currently under attention
The photograph appears at the pointer position, not in a fixed frame or slot
Image position follows the pointer with a soft trailing lag rather than rigid attachment
The photograph arrives visibly warped and liquid and settles into a sharp, calm picture
Distortion intensity scales with pointer speed and eases back to a clean image when motion slows or stops
Distortion is capped at a fixed maximum so the picture never becomes unrecognisable
Moving to a neighbouring name swaps the image instantly, with no empty interval
The pointed name's letters scatter in the direction of travel and snap back to their original positions
Leaving the list fades the image out to nothing and restores the resting state; returning fades the next image in
Imagery never intercepts pointing, so names stay reliably targetable underneath it
adaptable_details: Number of names in the list (a short list rather than a long index)
Typeface, weight, casing, colour and vertical rhythm of the names
Subject matter and aspect ratio of the photographs
Displayed image size relative to the view
Exact character of the distortion (smear, ripple, wobble) and its visual grain
Amount of trailing lag and the settle timing
Fade-out and fade-in durations
Letter-scatter distance, spread pattern and snap-back timing
Whether the list is centred or offset within the view
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits short, curated lists of named items where each item has exactly one representative image and the text must remain the dominant foreground content — place names, project or work titles, chapter or section names, people or product names on a minimal landing or index view. It depends on a sparse text-led layout with room for a full-view image layer behind it. Showing several images at once, placing the image in a fixed panel or thumbnail slot, laying the pictures out permanently as a grid or gallery, or making the images the primary content with text as caption would each produce a different Skill. Removing either the pointer-tracked liquid image or the letter scatter yields a thinner, differently recognisable effect.

name: title_burst_slide_carousel
description: One large photo with its single-word title centred over it; pressing previous or next explodes that word into a dense outward-repeating stack while the old picture slides off one edge and the new one arrives from the opposite edge, then the stack retracts to a single legible title.

canonical_document.name: title_burst_slide_carousel
canonical_document.description: One large photo with its single-word title centred over it; pressing previous or next explodes that word into a dense outward-repeating stack while the old picture slides off one edge and the new one arrives from the opposite edge, then the stack retracts to a single legible title.
canonical_document.experience_scope: A self-contained region or full-view showcase that begins once the image set is ready to display and persists as the whole browsing surface for that set; each transition begins on control activation and ends when only one title and one settled picture remain.
content_and_composition: Exactly one item visible at a time from an ordered set of image-plus-short-title pairs
Photograph occupies the dominant visual area of the region
A single short title word rests centred over or within the image as the focal caption, separated enough from the picture beneath to stay readable
A paired previous/next control cluster sits together as a persistent element, not split to opposite edges
During transition the title occupies a transient layer of many repeated copies fanned outward from the centre position, above the moving pictures
Outgoing and incoming pictures coexist briefly on opposing sides along one horizontal axis
experience_progression: Hold: one picture settled, one quiet centred title, controls available
Burst: the centred word multiplies outward into a dense stack, seizing attention
Exchange: current picture slides off one side while the next arrives from the other side, sides mirrored for backward movement
Thin out: repeated copies retract inward until a single title remains
Settle: new picture and its single title become the resting state, ready for the next step
Wrapping order: continued movement in one direction eventually returns to the opening item
attention_and_information_flow: At rest, attention is unambiguous: exactly one picture and one title, so the current item is never in doubt
The typographic burst momentarily outweighs the imagery and masks the swap, pulling the eye to the centre
Directional sliding communicates which way the set moved without any positional indicator
As repetitions retract, prominence returns to the photograph with the title reduced to quiet legible caption weight
Only the current item's information is ever exposed; neighbouring items are not previewed

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Presses during an in-progress move are ignored so runs never overlap; the control becomes responsive again once the item has settled
interaction_model.state_change: Set advances one position forward, wrapping to the first item after the last
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Title repeats outward into a dense stack, current picture slides off one side while the incoming picture arrives from the other, then repetitions retract to a single new title
interaction_model.input: Activating the next control
interaction_model.affected_object: The visible photograph and its centred title

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Ignored while a move is running; after a move completes, pressing the opposite control steps straight back to the previous item
interaction_model.state_change: Set steps one position backward, wrapping to the last item before the first
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Same burst-exchange-retract sequence with the entry and exit sides mirrored, so the motion reads as reversed
interaction_model.input: Activating the previous control
interaction_model.affected_object: The visible photograph and its centred title

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Nothing is stepped through before this point; the opening item defines the wrap-around return position
interaction_model.state_change: Region moves from withheld to showing the opening item at rest
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The first picture with its single centred title appears as the settled starting state
interaction_model.input: Set becoming ready for display
interaction_model.affected_object: The showcase region as a whole

experience_qualities: Abrupt and graphic rather than soft or gradual
Typographically loud at the moment of change, quiet and legible at rest
Decisive and directional, with an obvious sense of moving through an ordered set
Uncluttered: one item, one word, one paired control cluster
Endless, with no visible beginning or end to the sequence
completion_and_return: Each move completes by collapsing to exactly one picture and one single title
The order wraps, so continued stepping loops back to the opening item indefinitely
The most recently reached item persists as the resting state until another control press
An immediate opposite press after completion returns to the item just left
locked_observable_requirements: Exactly one item visible at rest, with its short title centred, readably separated from the picture and unambiguous
Title multiplies outward from the centre into a dense stack during the change, then retracts to one copy
Picture exchange is a directional slide with outgoing and incoming items on opposite sides
Backward movement mirrors the entry and exit sides of forward movement
Paired previous and next controls sit together
Order wraps continuously in both directions
Overlapping runs are impossible: inputs during a move produce no additional change
The stack burst overlaps the picture exchange so the swap happens under the typographic peak
adaptable_details: Number of items in the set
Count, spacing and spread geometry of the repeated title copies
Transition duration, easing and how abrupt the burst feels
Typeface, size, hue choice and contrast treatment of the title, any of which may be used as long as it stays legible over the picture
Image aspect ratio, crop and whether the region is full-view or inset
Visual style, labelling and placement of the paired control cluster within the region
Whether the slide axis is horizontal or another single consistent axis
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits ordered sets of visually strong images each paired with a very short label, browsed deliberately one at a time, where low copy density lets the word carry graphic weight. Longer captions, multi-line body text, or showing several items at once would break the burst's legibility and the single-current-item clarity. Replacing the directional slide with a non-positional change, previewing neighbouring items, allowing continuous free scrubbing, or dropping the typographic multiplication would each produce a different Skill.

name: liquid_ripple_swipe_photo_carousel
description: A single photograph centred in an otherwise empty full-height view; pressing anywhere sends a soft liquid ripple outward from that point while a boundary sweeps sideways to uncover the next photograph, cycling forever back to the first.

canonical_document.name: liquid_ripple_swipe_photo_carousel
canonical_document.description: A single photograph centred in an otherwise empty full-height view; pressing anywhere sends a soft liquid ripple outward from that point while a boundary sweeps sideways to uncover the next photograph, cycling forever back to the first.
canonical_document.experience_scope: Whole-view experience occupying the full height of the viewport as the primary presentation; begins on arrival with the first photograph at rest and never ends, since the sequence loops indefinitely. Each individual handover is a self-contained event beginning at a press and ending when the incoming photograph is fully in place and at rest.
content_and_composition: One photograph visible at a time, centred in the frame, as the sole foreground content
An ordered set of a handful of photographs (roughly a few, not a large archive) forming a closed cycle
A bare full-height stage that stays a low-distraction surround, with no captions, counters, arrows, thumbnails, or chrome competing for attention
During a handover, two photographs momentarily coexist: the outgoing one being displaced and the incoming one being uncovered, separated by a single travelling boundary
The liquid disturbance is a transient layer over the imagery itself, centred on the press point, not a separate decorative element
experience_progression: Arrival: one photograph at rest, centred, alone in the empty view
Press: a liquid ripple is born at the exact contact point and spreads outward through the image
Handover: a boundary sweeps sideways across the frame, progressively uncovering the next photograph while the ripple continues to pulse through the imagery
Settle: the boundary completes its pass, the incoming photograph fully occupies the frame and comes to rest, ripple subsides
Repeat forward through the set, then wrap from the last photograph back to the opening one and continue without any visible seam or end state
attention_and_information_flow: Attention rests entirely on the single centred photograph because nothing else is present to compete
At the moment of press, attention is pulled to the contact point as the ripple originates there, then follows the disturbance outward
Attention then rides the sideways boundary across the frame as new imagery is revealed behind it
After settling, prominence returns fully to the newly arrived photograph as a calm single subject
No progress indicator, position label, or set size is revealed; the sequence deliberately reads as endless

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: The event always runs to completion as one whole gesture; it cannot be reversed or cut short, and it resolves to the incoming photograph at rest
interaction_model.state_change: Advances one step forward in the sequence and starts a single handover event seeded at the press coordinates
interaction_model.visible_feedback: A soft liquid ripple blooms outward from the exact pressed point through the imagery, and a boundary sweeps sideways across the frame uncovering the incoming photograph until it fully replaces the previous one
interaction_model.input: Press anywhere on the full-height view
interaction_model.affected_object: The currently displayed photograph and the next photograph in the set

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Pressability resumes as soon as the handover settles, so a further press immediately starts the next event
interaction_model.state_change: No new state; extra presses are ignored until the current change settles
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Nothing new appears; the running ripple and sweep continue undisturbed to their natural finish
interaction_model.input: Additional presses landing while a handover is still running
interaction_model.affected_object: The in-progress handover

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Persistent while the experience is on screen; no separate hit target to find or leave
interaction_model.state_change: Surface is continuously signalled as pressable
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The cursor form marks the entire surface as interactive rather than any localized control
interaction_model.input: Cursor resting anywhere over the view
interaction_model.affected_object: The whole visible surface

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Cycling continues indefinitely; there is no end screen and no backward step
interaction_model.state_change: Wraps to the opening photograph
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The same ripple and sideways sweep hand over to the first image with no different or terminal treatment
interaction_model.input: Reaching the final photograph of the set and pressing again
interaction_model.affected_object: The sequence order

experience_qualities: Fluid and unhurried rather than snappy or abrupt
Soft, liquid, organic disturbance rather than mechanical sliding
Calm and spacious, with a single subject in an uncluttered field
Directly responsive, because the reaction visibly originates where the user touched
Each change reads as one complete, self-contained event with a clear beginning and settling
Endless and unhurried, with no sense of a finish line
completion_and_return: Each handover completes when the incoming photograph fully occupies the frame and the ripple has subsided
The set loops: after the last photograph the cycle returns to the opening image and continues seamlessly
No terminal or exhausted state, no completion message, no reset control
Progression is forward-only, so there is no return to a previously shown photograph except by continuing around the loop
locked_observable_requirements: Exactly one photograph is the visible subject at rest, centred in an otherwise bare full-height view whose surround stays visibly separated from the image and free of competing content
Advancing is triggered by pressing anywhere on the view, with no visible arrows or controls required
The liquid disturbance originates at the exact pressed coordinates, not at a fixed or centre point
The incoming image is uncovered by a single boundary sweeping sideways across the frame until replacement is complete
The motion is fluid and unhurried, never an instant cut
One press produces exactly one complete handover; presses during a running handover are ignored until it settles
Progression is forward-only and the set cycles endlessly back to the opening image
The entire surface is signalled as pressable
adaptable_details: Number of images in the set, as long as it stays a small closed cycle
Exact duration and easing of the ripple and sweep, within a fluid, unhurried feel
Ripple amplitude, softness, spread rate and decay character
Direction and shape of the sweeping boundary (which side it travels toward, how straight or wavy the edge reads)
Image subject matter, aspect ratio handling and how the photograph is fitted to the full-height stage
Specific cursor form used to mark the surface as pressable
Tone and luminance of the bare surround, in either a light or dark direction, provided it stays low-distraction and keeps the photograph clearly separated from it
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits any small closed set of full-frame visuals meant to be shown one at a time as the dominant subject of a view, where the moment of change should feel crafted and pointer-anchored. Adding persistent surrounding content, captions, counters, thumbnails, or navigation controls, allowing backward or arbitrary jumping between items, showing several items at once, queueing or interrupting overlapping handovers, or replacing the pointer-seeded liquid ripple and sideways uncovering boundary with a different transition treatment would each create a different Skill.

name: pointer_steered_photographic_parallax_view
description: One edge-to-edge photograph reads as a scene with real foreground and distance; the cursor or a device tilt continuously glides nearer parts further than far parts so you seem to peek around them, then everything relaxes back to the calm centered picture.

canonical_document.name: pointer_steered_photographic_parallax_view
canonical_document.description: One edge-to-edge photograph reads as a scene with real foreground and distance; the cursor or a device tilt continuously glides nearer parts further than far parts so you seem to peek around them, then everything relaxes back to the calm centered picture.
canonical_document.experience_scope: Whole-view experience beginning at arrival, occupying the full viewport edge to edge; it has no end state and remains continuously available, resting at a neutral centered picture whenever input stops or returns to the middle.
content_and_composition: One primary photograph filling the entire view edge to edge, serving as both subject and visual substrate
Interpreted depth separation within that single image: at least a nearer foreground layer and a more distant background layer that move by different amounts
One short movement hint, low prominence, inviting the viewer to move the pointer or tilt
One small title, minimal in weight and unobtrusive
One block of oversized lettering resting softly inside the picture, visually seated within the scene's depth rather than pasted flatly on top
Almost nothing else competes: no dense chrome, panels or lists in the initial view
Overlay text elements persist through all movement and stay legible against the shifting image
experience_progression: Arrival: flat full-view photograph with the hint, small title and oversized lettering settled in a neutral centered state
Within moments of first movement: the frame begins reading as a scene with genuine foreground and distance
Ongoing exploration: continuous look-around movement steered by pointer position or tilt, with no completion or goal
Relaxation: input returning toward the middle, or stopping, eases the view back to the neutral undistorted picture, still inviting another attempt
attention_and_information_flow: Attention is dominated by the photograph; supporting text is deliberately quiet so nothing competes on arrival
The movement hint carries just enough prominence to suggest the interaction, then recedes in importance once movement begins
Revealed information is spatial rather than textual: differing layer displacement exposes slivers just around nearer elements, deepening the sense of a real space
The oversized lettering gains presence as depth becomes readable, since it appears to occupy the scene rather than the screen
Returning to neutral restores the original calm reading of the image, resetting attention to the picture as a whole

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Fully reversible at any moment by moving the pointer; motion is bounded so no smearing, tearing or empty edge can appear, and it can be interrupted or resumed freely
interaction_model.state_change: Continuous change of viewing offset proportional to pointer position, with nearer layers displaced more than distant layers
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The scene shifts with visible parallax so the viewer appears to glimpse just around nearer elements; movement glides after the pointer with a soft lag instead of snapping
interaction_model.input: Pointer movement anywhere across the view
interaction_model.affected_object: Depth layers of the photograph and the overlaid lettering seated within it

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Resting state is stable and remains inviting; any new movement immediately resumes exploration from that rest
interaction_model.state_change: Displacement relaxes toward zero and the view settles at the neutral undistorted state
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The scene eases smoothly back to the flat, centered photograph and comes to rest
interaction_model.input: Pointer returning toward the middle of the view, or movement ceasing
interaction_model.affected_object: All depth layers and overlay text

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Strong tilts are capped so displacement never exceeds the bounded range; returning the device toward level eases the scene back to neutral
interaction_model.state_change: Identical viewing-offset change driven by tilt magnitude and direction instead of pointer position
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The same parallax look-around movement with the same soft lag, so the two input modes are experientially indistinguishable
interaction_model.input: Device tilt on a handheld
interaction_model.affected_object: The same depth layers and overlay text

experience_qualities: Calm and uncluttered rather than busy or demonstrative
Alive: a still photograph that feels inhabited and spatially real
Soft and gliding, with lagged easing rather than immediate one-to-one snapping
Exploratory and open-ended, with no task, score or completion
Bounded and safe: the effect never breaks the image or reveals its edges
Repeatably inviting, always returning to a welcoming resting state
completion_and_return: No completion state exists and nothing must be finished by the viewer
The neutral centered undistorted picture is the canonical resting state and is returned to whenever input relaxes
The experience is endlessly re-enterable with no persisted progress or changed state between attempts
The resting state visibly remains an invitation to try the movement again
locked_observable_requirements: A single photographic image fills the view edge to edge and is the dominant attention target
Nearer parts of the image displace more than distant parts, producing readable foreground-versus-distance separation from one still picture
Movement is continuously steered by pointer position across the whole view, not by clicks, drags or discrete steps
Response glides after the input with a soft lag; it never snaps instantly to the input position
Displacement is bounded so no smearing, tearing or empty edge is ever visible
Input returning toward the middle, or stopping, relaxes the view to a neutral undistorted centered state
Device tilt on handhelds drives the identical movement, with strong tilts capped
Supporting overlay content is limited to a short movement hint, a small title and oversized lettering that sits inside the picture's depth
The experience never completes and stays inviting to repeat
adaptable_details: Subject matter, palette and mood of the photograph
Wording, typeface, size and placement of the title, hint and oversized lettering
Number of interpreted depth layers and the exact ratio between near and far displacement
Magnitude of the bounded shift and the amount of lag in the easing
How quickly depth becomes readable after the first movement
Whether the hint fades, dims or persists once movement begins
Aspect-ratio and cropping strategy used to keep the image filling the view
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits any single strong image intended to be shown alone at full view with minimal accompanying text, such as an arrival view, photo-led hero or story opener, where the image has usable foreground-versus-distance structure. It stops being this Skill if the movement becomes discrete or step-based, if it snaps without lag, if the shift is unbounded so edges or tearing appear, if the image is reduced to a small framed element among dense competing content, if multiple images are sequenced or swapped, or if the viewer is given a goal or completion state to reach.
