name: wave_dissolve_photo_wall
description: A dense reduced-chroma thumbnail wall that drifts vertically with the pointer under a trailing labelled ring cursor, and clears itself away in an outward wave so one picture at its own full chroma and its name own the screen, rebuilding in reverse on return.

canonical_document.name: wave_dissolve_photo_wall
canonical_document.description: A dense reduced-chroma thumbnail wall that drifts vertically with the pointer under a trailing labelled ring cursor, and clears itself away in an outward wave so one picture at its own full chroma and its name own the screen, rebuilding in reverse on return.
canonical_document.experience_scope: Whole-view experience: it begins as the visitor arrives on the view, occupies the full screen for both the collection state and the single-item state, and ends only when the visitor leaves the view. The collection state and the opened-item state are two modes of the same continuous experience, not separate pages.
content_and_composition: A single grid of many small image thumbnails, dense enough to fill the viewport edge to edge and visibly continue past the lower edge so more rows are implied
Thumbnails rendered with reduced chroma and reduced luminance contrast as their resting state, so the collection reads as a calm uniform field rather than competing highlights
One persistent cursor-attached marker: a ring outline that tracks the pointer
One persistent text label riding immediately beside the ring marker, always showing the name of the item currently under attention, so the name never has to be hunted for
One large picture shown at its own full chroma with its name, revealed in place of the grid in the opened state and occupying the screen alone
No scrollbar, no pagination controls and no separate caption region; the marker and its label are the only chrome
experience_progression: Arrival: the dense reduced-chroma wall is present and continues past the lower edge, with the marker following the pointer
Browsing: the wall glides up or down as the pointer moves, lower rows come within reach, and each thumbnail passed under the pointer rises in luminance while its name appears beside the marker
Selection: an outward wave of vanishing tiles spreads from the chosen thumbnail across the whole wall until nothing covers the large picture
Opened: the large picture at its own full chroma and its name hold the screen alone and the marker reads as a close mark
Return: the wave runs backwards from the same origin, tiles reappear and the wall is reconstituted in exactly its previous position and state
Browsing resumes seamlessly, so opening an item never feels like leaving the collection
attention_and_information_flow: In the collection state attention is diffuse across a uniform reduced-chroma field; the brightened thumbnail under the pointer is the only local emphasis
The name of the attended item is always readable at the pointer, so identification travels with the visitor's gaze instead of living in a fixed caption slot
Selection collapses attention from many items to exactly one: full chroma returns only for the opened picture while every other item is removed from view
The vanishing wave directs the eye outward from the chosen tile, making the origin of the reveal legible
Returning re-expands attention back to the full field, with the previously attended region still where the visitor left it

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Motion is fully reversible by moving the pointer the other way and comes to rest when the pointer stops; travel is bounded by the ends of the collection so the wall cannot glide away from its content; this driver is inactive while an item is open
interaction_model.state_change: Vertical offset of the wall changes in response to pointer position, revealing rows below or above
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The whole spread glides vertically with a soft trailing lag that continues briefly after the pointer settles, with no scrollbar present
interaction_model.input: Pointer moved upward or downward within the view
interaction_model.affected_object: The entire thumbnail wall as one body

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: The marker always catches up to the resting pointer position; it persists across both modes rather than disappearing
interaction_model.state_change: Marker position updates toward the pointer with delay
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The ring trails the pointer instead of locking to it, and the label rides just beside the ring at contrast sufficient to stay readable over the imagery beneath
interaction_model.input: Pointer moved anywhere in the view
interaction_model.affected_object: Cursor ring marker and its adjacent label

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Leaving the thumbnail returns it to the reduced-chroma resting state and hands the label to the next attended item; no thumbnail remains stuck in the attended state
interaction_model.state_change: Thumbnail enters an attended state
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The thumbnail separates from the field by a clear rise in luminance and its name appears beside the marker
interaction_model.input: Pointer resting over a thumbnail
interaction_model.affected_object: That single thumbnail and the marker label

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Further activations are ignored for the whole duration of the transition; once the picture is open the covered thumbnails no longer respond to pointer or activation
interaction_model.state_change: Collection mode transitions to opened-item mode
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Tiles vanish in a wave that spreads outward from the chosen tile until the picture at its own full chroma and its name are completely uncovered; the ring marker becomes a close mark
interaction_model.input: Activating a thumbnail
interaction_model.affected_object: Whole thumbnail wall and the large picture layer beneath it

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Further activations are ignored while the reverse transition runs; on completion the wall is restored to exactly the vertical position and appearance it had before opening, and pointer-driven gliding and hover response become active again
interaction_model.state_change: Opened-item mode transitions back to collection mode
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The same wave runs backwards, tiles reappear in reverse order and rebuild the spread; the close mark reverts to the ring marker
interaction_model.input: Activating the uncovered large picture
interaction_model.affected_object: Large picture and the thumbnail wall

experience_qualities: Calm and unhurried rather than snappy
Continuous and physical, through trailing lag in both the wall and the marker
Dense and abundant, with the collection visibly exceeding the screen
Restrained low-chroma overview against a single full-chroma focal payoff
Choreographed reveal with a legible origin point
Non-destructive: exploring and opening feel like one place rather than two
completion_and_return: Opening an item completes when the large picture and its name are fully uncovered and the marker has become a close mark
Return completes when the wave has fully rebuilt the wall and the marker has reverted
The collection's vertical position and attended-item labelling survive the round trip, so the visitor resumes exactly where they were
The experience loops indefinitely between the two modes with no terminal end state and no reset of the collection view
locked_observable_requirements: A dense grid of reduced-chroma thumbnails filling the viewport and visibly continuing past the lower edge
Vertical movement of the whole grid driven by pointer position with trailing lag, and no scrollbar
The attended thumbnail separates from the field by a visible luminance rise and its name is always legible beside a lagging cursor ring marker
Selection removes the tiles in a wave spreading outward from the chosen tile until a single picture shown at its own full chroma and its name own the screen
The marker changes into a close mark while an item is open
Activating the open picture runs the same wave in reverse to rebuild the grid
Input during either transition is ignored, and covered thumbnails stop responding while an item is open
Returning restores the collection exactly as it was left
adaptable_details: Number of columns, tile aspect ratio and grid density
Exact chroma-reduction treatment of resting thumbnails and the amount of luminance rise on attention
Duration, easing and lag amount of the glide, the marker trail and the wave
Wave geometry and ordering as long as it reads as spreading outward from the chosen tile
Shape and size of the marker and close mark, and label typography and side placement
Layout of the opened picture and where its name sits
Whether a brief holding state precedes arrival while imagery becomes ready
Whether keyboard or touch equivalents supplement pointer input
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits any large, visually homogeneous set of images or image-like items where each has a short name and a full-screen presentation is the payoff, and where the region can claim the entire viewport; it carries no assumed stage tone or host palette, since the resting field is defined only by reduced chroma relative to the opened item. It does not fit sparse sets that cannot fill and overflow the screen, mixed text-heavy items, or embedding inside a scrolling page that already owns vertical movement. Replacing pointer-driven gliding with conventional scrolling, keeping surrounding thumbnails visible around the opened item, or opening the item on a separate view without the reversing wave would each create a different Skill.

name: scroll_speed_warped_letter_titles
description: Each picture in a sparse vertical run is anchored by a huge short character mark that turns molten and barely legible while the visitor scrolls hard, and resolves into clean crisp type the moment they settle.

canonical_document.name: scroll_speed_warped_letter_titles
canonical_document.description: Each picture in a sparse vertical run is anchored by a huge short character mark that turns molten and barely legible while the visitor scrolls hard, and resolves into clean crisp type the moment they settle.
canonical_document.experience_scope: Whole-view scrolling experience: begins at arrival on the page after a brief withheld moment and ends at the last item of the sequence; the warping behavior applies to every character mark in the run simultaneously, not to a single isolated widget.
content_and_composition: A single vertical sequence of images as the underlying media layer, presented sparsely so only one or two images hold attention at any moment
One oversized very short character mark per image, scaled to read as the item's title rather than as a caption, spatially anchored to its image
Staggered placement of image/mark pairs along the scroll so items do not read as a uniform grid or catalogue rows
Restrained, low-noise surrounding field with no competing chrome, so the marks and their host images dominate every viewport state

The character marks are the persistent element across the whole run: they are always present and always the top visual layer of each pair, holding enough separation from their image to stay readable at rest
experience_progression: Brief held-back arrival moment before the sequence becomes available, so entry feels like a deliberate start rather than a page load
Unhurried staggered advance in which pairs enter and leave attention one or two at a time
Continuous instability layered over that advance: legibility of every mark rises and falls with the visitor's own pace throughout the run
Arrival at the final item, where the cumulative impression is of a typographic study rather than a photo gallery
attention_and_information_flow: Attention is deliberately narrow: sparse staggering keeps at most one or two pairs competing at a time
Within a pair, the character mark outranks its image in prominence, so the label is read first and the photograph second
Information availability is pace-dependent: at speed, marks are legible only as gesture and mass; at rest, they resolve into readable type
Repeated melt-and-resolve cycles teach the pace-shapes-legibility relationship without instructional text
By the end, the accumulated attention on marks over images reframes the whole set as typography

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Deformation is capped so a mark never dissolves past recognition, and depends only on how fast the page moves rather than which way, so reversing direction changes nothing about the warp character
interaction_model.state_change: Deformation strength is bound continuously to the instantaneous movement speed of the page, from nearly intact at a gentle nudge to heaviest warp at a hard flick
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Marks smear and turn molten in proportion to speed, uniformly across all visible marks, while the underlying images continue advancing normally
interaction_model.input: Vertical scrolling at any speed (the only control in the experience)
interaction_model.affected_object: Every oversized character mark in the sequence at once

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Self-recovering with no reset control, button or explicit action; a new scroll at any point during the settle simply re-drives the warp from wherever it currently is, with no snap or discontinuity
interaction_model.state_change: Warp decays on its own toward the clean resting type state within a moment of movement ceasing
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Marks settle back into crisp, fully legible letterforms
interaction_model.input: Stopping, easing off, or an interrupted or overshooting fling
interaction_model.affected_object: Every oversized character mark

experience_qualities: Hushed and low-key rather than promotional, the surround kept quiet enough that nothing competes with the marks
Feels like entering a small experiment rather than opening a catalogue
Unhurried but slightly unstable
Physical and elastic: the type feels like a material that responds to force
Self-explanatory cause and effect between the visitor's pace and what is readable
Typographic rather than photographic in final impression
completion_and_return: Ends at the last item of the sequence with no summary panel or call-to-action state
Marks always return to the crisp resting state whenever movement stops, at any point in the run
No persistent per-item state and no accumulated progress state; the resting appearance is identical wherever the visitor pauses
No reset affordance is ever needed because recovery is automatic
locked_observable_requirements: Every image is titled by exactly one oversized very short character mark that visually outranks the image
Warp strength is continuously bound to instantaneous scroll speed, not to scroll position, offset or item index
Warp is direction-independent: scrolling up and down at the same speed looks the same
Warp is capped so labels stay recognizable at maximum speed
Marks ease back to clean type automatically within a moment of stopping, with no reset action
Vertical scrolling is the only control in the experience
Sparse, staggered pacing so only one or two image/mark pairs hold attention at a time
All visible marks respond together to the same pace, as one coherent field
adaptable_details: Subject matter and colour treatment of the images, and the tonal register of the surrounding field, as long as marks keep readable separation from their host image
Exact glyph count of the short marks and the typeface used
Precise stagger positions, alignment and offsets of pairs
Number of items in the sequence
Warp cap magnitude and the exact settle duration and easing feel
Visual character of the deformation (liquid smear, stretch, blur-like melt) as long as it is capped and speed-driven
Length and treatment of the withheld arrival moment
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits any sparse vertical run of media items where each item can be titled by a very short mark that is allowed to dominate its image — image showcases, project or chapter indexes, editorial sets — under any host tonal register, light or dark, provided the marks keep readable separation from their images. It stops being this Skill if labels become full words or sentences that cannot survive heavy warping, if items are packed into a dense uniform grid where many marks read at once, if the deformation is driven by pointer position, hover or scroll direction instead of scroll speed, if the warp is uncapped so labels become unreadable, or if the type is demoted to a caption beneath a dominant photograph.

name: granular_portrait_assembly_showcase
description: A photograph forms out of a wide sparse scatter of countless tiny self-lit grains held against a quiet, low-distraction surround, shimmers gently while it is readable, scatters and glows where the cursor sweeps across it before healing back, then loosens and falls into depth as the next photograph gathers in its place.

canonical_document.name: granular_portrait_assembly_showcase
canonical_document.description: A photograph forms out of a wide sparse scatter of countless tiny self-lit grains held against a quiet, low-distraction surround, shimmers gently while it is readable, scatters and glows where the cursor sweeps across it before healing back, then loosens and falls into depth as the next photograph gathers in its place.
canonical_document.experience_scope: A whole-view, single-stage experience: it begins with the first image assembling on an otherwise empty, low-distraction field and continues indefinitely as a looping run of images; no other content shares the view, and the grain surface occupies one defined picture area within that field.
content_and_composition: One quiet, near-empty field acting as the stage and depth backdrop, held in wide luminance separation from the grains, persistent across the entire run
Exactly one image visible at a time, rendered as a dense field of countless very small self-lit grains whose individual emission level reproduces the picture's tonal values
The grain field occupies a single bounded picture area within the stage; that boundary also defines where interaction is felt
A small ordered set of images (a handful) forming a cyclic sequence; only the current one is present, the outgoing one overlaps only as departing debris
No captions, chrome, counters, arrows or other competing elements; the subject and its granular texture are the only foreground
experience_progression: Gather: grains are widely scattered in depth and drift inward, converging and settling until the subject is clearly readable
Alive hold: the assembled picture holds legibility while a faint continuous shimmer keeps the grains subtly in motion, never fully frozen
Disturb and heal: local sweeps knock patches out of place and those patches ease back, returning the picture to its settled readable state
Release: on advance, the current picture loosens as a whole, falls away into depth and vanishes
Re-gather: only after the previous picture has cleared do new grains gather into the next subject
Loop: after the last image the run returns to the first, so a next image always exists
attention_and_information_flow: Attention starts diffuse across a field of scattered points and tightens as convergence resolves recognizable form, so legibility itself is the reveal
Once assembled, the subject holds attention through its contrast against the empty surrounding field rather than through any labeling or framing
The shimmer keeps low-level motion present so the eye never treats the picture as a static plate
Pointer movement temporarily pulls attention to the disturbed patch and its glowing wake, then attention returns to the whole subject as the patch heals
During release, attention follows the departing grains into depth, leaving the stage empty and priming the next gather

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Runs to completion on its own; the settled readable state is the resting state the experience always returns to
interaction_model.state_change: Scattered dispersed grains converge to their picture positions and settle
interaction_model.visible_feedback: A sparse cloud of self-lit points pulls inward out of the quiet field until a clear subject becomes readable
interaction_model.input: Arrival at the view, or the moment a new image becomes current
interaction_model.affected_object: Grain field of the incoming image

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Every disturbed patch eases back into the picture within roughly two seconds; disturbance is registered only inside the picture's own area, and when the pointer halts or leaves the boundary the picture settles completely
interaction_model.state_change: Local grains leave their picture positions, are pushed toward the viewer and flung outward along their own scattered directions
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The picture visibly breaks up along the swept path, displaced grains read as nearer to the viewer, and a soft glowing wake trails the movement
interaction_model.input: Cursor sweeping across the picture area
interaction_model.affected_object: Grains directly beneath and near the pointer path

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Slow or stopped movement decays toward no disturbance; the same healing return applies regardless of how hard the surface was hit
interaction_model.state_change: Displacement magnitude and wake intensity scale with movement speed
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Fast sweeps tear open high-intensity, far-flung disruption; slow drifts barely register as a faint stir
interaction_model.input: Pointer speed while sweeping
interaction_model.affected_object: Strength of the local disturbance

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Advance is one-directional through a closed loop; after the last image it returns to the first, so there is always a next and no dead end
interaction_model.state_change: Current image is released and the next image in the cycle becomes current
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The whole picture loosens, falls away into depth and vanishes, after which new grains gather into the following subject
interaction_model.input: Click or tap anywhere
interaction_model.affected_object: Current image and the sequence position

experience_qualities: Playful and tactile: the picture reads as loose, physically disturbable material rather than something sealed behind glass
Alive but calm: continuous faint shimmer without restlessness or distraction
Deep and luminous: tiny self-lit points suspended in open space, with a sense of near and far
Forgiving: any mess the visitor makes repairs itself quickly and completely
Focused and quiet: nothing competes with the single subject
completion_and_return: The disturbance state always returns to the fully settled readable picture within about two seconds of being left alone
The pointer leaving or halting resolves the surface to complete stillness apart from the baseline shimmer
Each image ends by fully clearing into depth before the next begins, so no two subjects are legible at once
The image run loops back to the first after the last, giving the experience no terminal state
No progress, score or selection persists; the resting state after any interaction is simply the current picture, assembled and shimmering
locked_observable_requirements: A quiet, otherwise empty stage with no competing foreground content, held far enough from the grains in luminance that the grains read as emissive against it
The image is visibly composed of countless very small self-lit grains, and the grain texture is part of what the visitor looks at
Arrival is an inward convergence from wide scatter to a clearly readable subject, not a fade or slide
A faint continuous shimmer persists while the image is held, so it is never fully frozen
Cursor sweeps displace only local grains, pushing them toward the viewer and outward along scattered directions, with a soft glowing trailing wake
Disturbance strength scales with pointer speed
Disturbed areas self-heal back into the picture within roughly two seconds, restoring the original subject exactly
Disturbance is confined to the picture's own area and ceases when the pointer stops or leaves
Advancing releases the current image as a loosening fall into depth that fully clears before the next image gathers
The sequence is cyclic, returning to the first image after the last
Advance is triggered by a click or tap anywhere in the view, with no visible controls
adaptable_details: Number of images in the cycle
Subject matter of the images and whether they are single-toned or tinted, as long as a clear focal form remains readable
Grain count, grain size and density of the field
Hue and intensity of the grain glow and of the disturbance wake, and whether the surround sits below or above the grains in luminance
Exact durations of gather, release and shimmer, and the precise healing curve within the seconds-scale return
Depth range and perceived distance of scatter and departure
Size and aspect of the picture area within the stage
Whether advance is also driven by an autonomous timer in addition to click or tap
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits any small cyclic set of single-subject images with a clear focal form and enough tonal contrast to stay readable when rendered as self-lit points against a plainly separated, low-distraction field, shown one at a time as the sole foreground of a view. It stops being this Skill if several images are shown at once or arranged as a browsable grid, if the grain surface must sit behind live foreground content as a background substrate, if disturbance persists instead of healing, if the surface stops reacting to pointer movement, or if the transition between images becomes an ordinary fade or slide instead of a loosening fall into depth followed by re-gathering.

name: impact_swap_captioned_image_stage
description: One photo owns the stage with its name set large across it; each step flings the current photo out and shatters its name away while the next photo rushes in, springs into place, and its name snaps in just behind it.

canonical_document.name: impact_swap_captioned_image_stage
canonical_document.description: One photo owns the stage with its name set large across it; each step flings the current photo out and shatters its name away while the next photo rushes in, springs into place, and its name snaps in just behind it.
canonical_document.experience_scope: A self-contained stage region that can also fill the whole view. It begins with a brief quiet hold before the first image is presented, then persists as an indefinite stepped experience with no end state; it ends only when the viewer leaves.
content_and_composition: Exactly one image visible at a time, filling the stage as the dominant visual layer
One short name per image, set large and overlaid directly across the image as a foreground text layer
A persistent pair of step controls, one for the previous item and one for the next, positioned on opposing sides of the stage
The stage frame itself acts as a participating element rather than a static container: it is part of what moves during a change
Ordered sequence of at least two items forming a closed loop with no visible first or last position
A brief pre-start state before any image is presented, occupying the same stage area and kept quiet and empty of motion
experience_progression: Quiet hold: the stage is calm and inactive while content becomes ready, with no motion or partial content shown
Resting presentation: one image at full stage with its name legible across it, no ambient motion, attention settled
Step triggered: the change begins immediately on input, with a burst of energy in which the whole frame shudders
Outgoing departure: the current image stretches and flies toward the side matching the direction of travel; its name first jitters in place, then its letters break apart and leave the same way
Incoming arrival: the next image rushes in from the opposite edge and springs into place with a settling overshoot
Name arrival: the incoming name snaps into position slightly after the image has settled, closing the change
Return to rest: motion fully stops and the stage is calm again, ready for the next step; the cycle repeats indefinitely
attention_and_information_flow: At rest, the image and its overlaid name share prominence and are read as a single unit
During a change, prominence shifts briefly to motion and direction rather than to any single item, so the viewer perceives that a replacement is happening and which way it went
The outgoing name loses legibility before the outgoing image is gone, so no two names compete for reading
Only one name is readable at any moment; the incoming name arrives last so it is the final thing attention lands on
After settling, prominence returns fully to the new image and name with no residual movement to pull the eye

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: The change runs to completion once started; further presses during it are ignored and produce no queued or partial motion, and the stage returns to a clean resting state afterwards
interaction_model.state_change: Advance from the current item to the following item in the sequence
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Frame shudders; current image stretches and flies off toward one side while its name jitters then bursts into departing letters; next image rushes in from the opposite edge and springs into place; its name snaps in just after
interaction_model.input: Activating the next step control or pressing the right arrow key
interaction_model.affected_object: The stage image, its overlaid name, and the frame

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Same completion behavior as forward stepping; direction is always readable from the motion, so a mistaken step can be undone by one step the other way
interaction_model.state_change: Move back to the preceding item in the sequence
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The same burst, mirrored: departure and letter scatter go toward the opposite side, and the arriving image enters from the side the previous one left toward, so direction of travel is unmistakable
interaction_model.input: Activating the previous step control or pressing the left arrow key
interaction_model.affected_object: The stage image, its overlaid name, and the frame

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Input becomes effective again the moment the change completes, so the viewer can immediately step again without any stuck or half-finished state
interaction_model.state_change: No additional transition begins; the in-progress change is unaffected
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Nothing new happens on screen; the running burst continues undisturbed to its settled end
interaction_model.input: Repeated or rapid input while a change is already in progress
interaction_model.affected_object: The stage as a whole

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Stepping is always available in both directions; there is no dead end and no need for recovery
interaction_model.state_change: Position wraps around to the opposite end of the sequence
interaction_model.visible_feedback: An ordinary step with identical motion and direction; nothing signals an edge or blocks the move
interaction_model.input: Stepping beyond the last item forward or the first item backward
interaction_model.affected_object: Sequence position

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: The hold is brief and self-resolving; stepping becomes meaningful only once the first item is on stage
interaction_model.state_change: From quiet hold to the first resting presentation
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The still, motionless hold gives way to the first image with its name across it, presented calmly rather than with the step burst
interaction_model.input: Content becoming ready at the start
interaction_model.affected_object: The stage

experience_qualities: Fast, physical and percussive at the moment of change
Directional and unambiguous, so the viewer always knows which way the sequence moved
Confident rather than delicate, with a deliberate jolt instead of a gentle fade
Calm and quiet at rest, with attention resolving cleanly onto the image and its name
Reliable and unhurried under fast input, never appearing frantic or half-transitioned
Bold and typographic, with the name treated as a full participant in the visual rather than a small caption
completion_and_return: Each change has a definite end: all motion stops and the stage is fully at rest before another can begin
The sequence loops endlessly in both directions with no terminal item and no end-of-list state
The current position persists as long as the viewer stays on the stage; there is no automatic advance or reset back to the beginning
Nothing from a completed change remains visible: departed letters and the outgoing image leave no trace
locked_observable_requirements: Exactly one image on stage at a time, with its name overlaid large across the image rather than beside or beneath it
A brief quiet, motionless hold before the first image is presented
Every change is a short, energetic burst that includes a shudder of the frame itself
The outgoing image stretches and departs toward the side corresponding to the direction of the step
The outgoing name jitters first, then breaks into letters that scatter away in the same direction as the image
The incoming image enters from the edge opposite the departure and springs into place with a settling overshoot
The incoming name arrives slightly after the incoming image has settled, not simultaneously
Backward and forward steps mirror each other so direction of travel is always visible
Additional input during a change is ignored, and no partial or overlapping transitions ever appear
Stepping wraps continuously at both ends with no visible boundary
Both on-screen step controls and left/right arrow keys move exactly one item per activation
Motion fully settles into a still, calm resting state after every change
adaptable_details: Number of items in the sequence
Subject matter and aspect handling of the images
Typeface, weight, color, casing and exact placement of the overlaid name
Exact durations, springiness and intensity of the shudder, stretch and overshoot
Visual styling, shape and placement of the step controls
Length and appearance of the initial quiet hold
Whether the stage is a bounded region or fills the entire view
Granularity of the letter scatter, such as by letter or by small groups
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits ordered sets of strong single visuals that each carry one short title meant to be read over the visual, presented as a deliberately stepped, one-at-a-time stage. It stops being this Skill if multiple items are visible at once, if the sequence advances on its own or scrolls continuously instead of stepping on discrete input, if the name moves outside the image into a separate caption area, if the change becomes a soft cross-fade instead of a directional physical burst, or if items carry substantial body content that cannot survive the shudder and departure treatment.

name: cursor_tracked_word_picture_peek
description: On a calm, low-distraction reading page, pointing at any word instantly lifts a picture beside the cursor that follows it while the letters of the word restage in place; leaving whips the picture away much faster than it arrived, and each group of words peeks in a noticeably different way.

canonical_document.name: cursor_tracked_word_picture_peek
canonical_document.description: On a calm, low-distraction reading page, pointing at any word instantly lifts a picture beside the cursor that follows it while the letters of the word restage in place; leaving whips the picture away much faster than it arrived, and each group of words peeks in a noticeably different way.
canonical_document.experience_scope: A whole-view reading experience covering the page's grouped word lists and closing prose paragraph; each individual peek begins when the pointer enters a word and ends when it leaves that word, while the page as a container stays in its quiet resting state throughout.
content_and_composition: Low-stimulus page ground with little internal contrast, so it reads as quiet by default while keeping text comfortably legible against it
Several labelled groups of interactive words, each group holding many words, plus a closing paragraph whose inline words are interactive in the same way
One picture layer floating above the text, anchored near the pointer rather than at a fixed slot, separating clearly from the page ground behind it
A handful of words carry a short ordered run of several pictures instead of a single picture
The word currently under the pointer is raised above its neighbouring words so no adjacent text or line clips its picture
The picture layer is visually above the text but never intercepts pointing, so words underneath stay directly targetable
A plain waiting state that holds all pictures back and shows nothing eye-catching until they can appear instantly
A plainly worded message shown in place of the list where previewing cannot work at all
experience_progression: Quiet low-distraction arrival with a plain held-back waiting state and no premature partial pictures
Pictures become ready and the page settles into calm readable rest
Reader works downward through group after group, each group's peek behaviour noticeably unlike the previous one, so comparison accumulates
The closing paragraph applies the same peeking inside running prose
After every peek the page returns to the same calm reading state so exploration can continue indefinitely
attention_and_information_flow: Attention stays anchored on the single word being read; its picture surfaces immediately beside it rather than elsewhere on the page
Only the pointed word and its picture change — nothing else on the page stirs during a peek
The pointed word gains prominence both by rising above its neighbours and by its own characters restaging
Revealed information is strictly one word's picture at a time; multi-picture words reveal successive frames while the pointer rests
Difference between groups is the page's secondary information channel: moving between groups is what the reader is being invited to notice
When previewing is impossible the page speaks plainly instead of presenting a silent unexplained list

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Reversible at any time by moving the pointer off the word; no click or commitment required
interaction_model.state_change: Picture goes from absent to present next to the pointer; word goes from resting type to restaged type at the same moment
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Picture arrives immediately beside the cursor and the word's characters visibly restage simultaneously; the word lifts above neighbouring words
interaction_model.input: Pointer enters a word
interaction_model.affected_object: That word's picture and the word's own characters

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Tracking is bounded by the word: it persists exactly while the pointer remains within it
interaction_model.state_change: Picture position continuously follows the pointer for as long as the pointer stays on that word
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Picture tracks the cursor rather than sitting at a fixed anchor
interaction_model.input: Pointer moves while remaining on the same word
interaction_model.affected_object: The visible picture

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Always returns to the same calm resting state, with no residue left behind
interaction_model.state_change: Picture exits and the word returns to its resting typographic state
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Picture whips out noticeably faster than it came in; the page returns to calm
interaction_model.input: Pointer leaves the word
interaction_model.affected_object: The visible picture and the restaged word

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Interruption is the expected path; rapid scanning across many words never accumulates stuck or half-shown pictures
interaction_model.state_change: Unfinished animation is cut short and the new peek begins from a clean start
interaction_model.visible_feedback: No overlapping or queued leftovers; the new word's picture appears cleanly
interaction_model.input: Pointer moves onto a different word while the previous peek is still animating
interaction_model.affected_object: The outgoing and incoming pictures and words

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Cycling stops and the run withdraws on pointer exit, resuming from a clean start on re-entry
interaction_model.state_change: Successive pictures cycle in place while the pointer rests
interaction_model.visible_feedback: A short run of images advances beside the cursor instead of a single still picture
interaction_model.input: Pointer rests on one of the words carrying a run of pictures
interaction_model.affected_object: That word's picture sequence

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: The picture layer never becomes a barrier, so no dead zones can trap the reader
interaction_model.state_change: The underlying word receives the pointer normally
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Pointing works as if the picture were not in the way; the newly pointed word takes over the peek
interaction_model.input: Pointer aimed at a word lying beneath a currently shown picture
interaction_model.affected_object: The word underneath

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Where previewing cannot work at all, a plainly worded statement replaces the silent list
interaction_model.state_change: Held-back waiting state gives way to the ready calm reading state
interaction_model.visible_feedback: A plain quiet waiting presentation with nothing shown prematurely, then a page that peeks instantly on first point
interaction_model.input: Page arrival before pictures can appear instantly
interaction_model.affected_object: The whole reveal system

experience_qualities: Quiet, low-distraction and calm at rest, with the surround receding behind the text
Instant and weightless on arrival of each picture, snappy and decisive on exit
Asymmetric timing: coming in feels immediate, going out feels whipped away
Focused and non-distracting — only the read word responds
Comparative and exploratory: the reward is feeling how one group differs from the next
Playful in the type itself without losing readability
completion_and_return: Each peek completes on pointer exit and returns fully to the calm reading state
Multi-picture words loop or run their sequence only while pointed, then reset
No accumulated state between peeks; the page is always re-enterable at any word in any order
The page as a whole has no end state — exploration can continue indefinitely
locked_observable_requirements: Picture appears immediately beside the pointer and tracks it while the pointer stays on the word
Exit is noticeably faster than entry
The word's own characters restage at the same moment its picture appears
Switching words mid-animation cuts the unfinished peek short and starts the new one cleanly
The picture layer never blocks pointing at words beneath it
The pointed word sits above its neighbours so nothing clips its picture
Only the pointed word and its picture change; the rest of the page stays still
Adjacent groups must differ noticeably from one another in how the peek looks
Some words show a short cycling run of pictures instead of one
A plain held-back waiting state until pictures can appear instantly, and a plainly worded message where previewing cannot work
adaptable_details: Exact entry and exit motion styles, easing and directions per group
Number of groups and number of words per group
Picture size, shape, framing and offset from the cursor
Which specific typographic restaging is used for a given group
Cycle speed and length of multi-picture runs

Exact palette, whatever its hues or overall lightness, as long as the page ground stays low-stimulus, text contrast stays comfortably readable, and the picture layer separates clearly from what is behind it
Wording of the plain unavailable-preview message
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits text-dense reading surfaces where individual words or short link phrases each have one representative image and readers benefit from peeking without navigating away — link lists, glossaries, indexes, name or project lists, and running prose. It stops being this Skill if the pictures move to a fixed panel or slot instead of tracking the pointer, if reveal requires a click or navigation, if the picture layer becomes clickable and blocks the words, if surrounding content also animates during a peek, or if every group reveals identically so there is nothing to compare.

name: leaf_turn_chaptered_photo_volume
description: A printed-volume reading experience where each section shows one composed arrangement of captioned photographs, and moving on plays a calm leaf sweep across both halves of the view before the next arrangement uncovers itself, with edge markers and an index list keeping the visitor's place clear.

canonical_document.name: leaf_turn_chaptered_photo_volume
canonical_document.description: A printed-volume reading experience where each section shows one composed arrangement of captioned photographs, and moving on plays a calm leaf sweep across both halves of the view before the next arrangement uncovers itself, with edge markers and an index list keeping the visitor's place clear.
canonical_document.experience_scope: A whole-view foreground experience: it begins on arrival with the opening section already settled into place and continues until the final section closes the sequence; it owns the entire viewing area including its side controls and edge markers, and does not extend to surrounding site chrome.
content_and_composition: One section (chapter) visible at a time, each containing a small fixed arrangement of images with a short title per image and optional caption text
Two halves of the view read as facing surfaces of an open volume, with the arrangement composed across them
Persistent stepping control at each side edge, one for backward and one for forward
Thin position markers running along the left and right edges, sized to indicate how much of the collection lies behind and ahead
Persistent index control that opens an overlay list of section titles paired with their starting page numbers
Opaque leaf surfaces that exist only during a change and sweep across both halves to hide the swap
experience_progression: Arrival: opening section's images settle into place and their titles appear, establishing one composed arrangement as the resting state
Step: a side control is used; opaque leaves sweep across both halves and fully cover the change
Uncover: as the leaves clear, the new images slide in and reveal themselves, with titles and captions arriving slightly behind the images
Settle: edge markers grow and shrink to the new position and attention rests on the new arrangement
Jump: choosing an index entry closes the list, riffles through every intervening section in sequence, and lands on the chosen one
Close: the final section ends the sequence forward; earlier sections remain reachable backward or by index
attention_and_information_flow: Attention rests on exactly one composed arrangement rather than a continuous stream, so each set of images is read as a deliberate composition
The covering leaves briefly take all attention and hide the swap, so the change reads as one motion rather than content rearranging
Images lead and their titles and captions follow slightly behind, so the visual composition registers before the words
Edge markers carry low-prominence but always-available position information about how much lies behind and ahead
The index overlay temporarily promotes the collection's overall structure over the current arrangement, then returns attention to the landed section
The visible presence or absence of a side control communicates whether there is anywhere further to go in that direction

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: The forward control is absent on the final section, so the boundary is visible rather than merely unresponsive; the change can be undone by stepping backward
interaction_model.state_change: Advances one section forward
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Opaque leaves sweep across both halves and cover the change; as they clear, the next arrangement's images slide in and uncover themselves, with titles and captions arriving slightly behind
interaction_model.input: Activating the forward control at the side edge
interaction_model.affected_object: Current section arrangement and its titles and captions

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: The backward control is absent on the first section; returning to an earlier section remains available at any other point
interaction_model.state_change: Returns one section backward
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The same leaf sweep and uncovering sequence plays in the returning direction
interaction_model.input: Activating the backward control at the side edge

interaction_model.state_change: No state change; the input is ignored
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The sweep and uncover sequence continues uninterrupted to its resting state
interaction_model.input: Any input arriving while a change is playing
interaction_model.affected_object: The change in progress

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: The list can be closed to return to the current section unchanged
interaction_model.state_change: Index list opens over the current arrangement
interaction_model.visible_feedback: A list of section titles paired with page numbers appears above the resting arrangement
interaction_model.input: Opening the index control
interaction_model.affected_object: Overlay list of section titles with their starting page numbers

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Markers always match the settled position, including at the first and last sections
interaction_model.state_change: Markers resize to reflect the new position in the sequence
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Markers grow and shrink so the amount behind and ahead stays readable
