experience_qualities: Calm and unhurried, with the deliberate beat of a leaf being turned
Tactile and physical, as if a bound volume is being handled
Composed and curated rather than continuous or scrolling
Legible orientation: it stays obvious which section is open and roughly how far through the collection it sits
Uninterrupted motion, since changes always play through to a settled state
completion_and_return: The final section closes the sequence forward and offers no further forward step
The sequence does not loop back to the beginning from the end
Returning to an earlier section stays easy at any point, by stepping backward or by index jump
Each change ends in a fully settled resting arrangement with position markers matching it
locked_observable_requirements: Exactly one composed arrangement of images is the resting state at a time; no continuous run of images
Every change is covered by opaque leaves sweeping across both halves of the view before the new content is seen
New images uncover themselves and their titles and captions arrive slightly after the images
Persistent stepping controls sit at the side edges, one per direction
The backward control is absent on the first section and the forward control is absent on the last
Thin edge markers on both left and right sides grow and shrink to indicate position, with a readable sense of amount behind and ahead
An index control opens a list of section titles paired with their starting page numbers
Choosing an index entry riffles through every intervening section rather than cutting directly to the target
Input during any change is ignored and the change plays to completion
Pacing reads as calm and unhurried rather than snappy
adaptable_details: Number of sections and number of images per arrangement
Exact grid or composition of images within a section
Typography, color, paper or surface texture of the leaves and background
Precise sweep direction, easing and duration within a calm range
Amount of delay before titles and captions arrive
Visual form of the edge markers, such as line thickness, length or spacing
Placement and iconography of the index control and styling of its overlay list
Whether captions accompany every image or only some
Keyboard or pointer means of activating the stepping and index controls
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits finite, curated collections of visual items with short accompanying text that are meaningfully grouped into a modest number of sections, where each group deserves to be seen as a composition. It does not fit open-ended, growing or very large collections where position markers and a section index lose meaning. Replacing the covered leaf sweep with an uncovered slide or crossfade, allowing a continuous scrolling run instead of discrete resting arrangements, cutting directly to an index target instead of riffling through, or dropping the always-visible position and boundary cues would each produce a different Skill.

name: inertial_skewing_photo_column
description: A single vertical run of large images, widely spaced, that drags behind your scroll input, shears toward the direction of travel while catching up, and unwinds flat when you stop.

canonical_document.name: inertial_skewing_photo_column
canonical_document.description: A single vertical run of large images, widely spaced, that drags behind your scroll input, shears toward the direction of travel while catching up, and unwinds flat when you stop.
canonical_document.experience_scope: A whole-view scrolling experience: it begins as soon as the visitor starts moving vertically anywhere in the sequence and persists across the entire run of items, ending only when motion stops and the column has settled flat. It is not a widget placed inside an otherwise static page; the scrolling view itself is the experience.
content_and_composition: One dominant media role: large images presented at a size where a single one commands the view.
Items arranged in a single vertical column, one after another, in a fixed authored order.
Generous empty space separating consecutive items so that only one image occupies attention at any moment and neighbours are not competing.
The column behaves as one coherent moving body rather than as independently animated tiles; all items share the same lag and lean at any instant.
Scrollable length of the view corresponds to the full extent of the column, so the scroll indicator reflects true progress through the whole sequence.
No persistent overlay chrome required beyond whatever minimal captioning the content needs; the images and the empty space are the composition.
experience_progression: At rest: the column is flat, upright and still, with one image centred in attention.
On input: the column starts moving but trails behind the input position, opening a visible gap between where the user has scrolled and where the images are.

While catching up: the images shear, tilted toward the direction of travel, with the amount of tilt scaling to how far behind the column currently is, so fast travel looks strongly sheared and slow travel barely so.
On release or slowdown: the column glides the remaining distance, the lag closes, the shear unwinds progressively back to flat, and the view straightens into stillness.
The sequence advances continuously through the items with no stepping, snapping or per-item locking; the same lag-lean-straighten cycle recurs for every burst of movement.
attention_and_information_flow: Prominence rests on whichever single image currently occupies the view; empty space suppresses competition from neighbours.
During fast travel the shear turns the images into a sense of speed and direction rather than something to read, so detail deliberately recedes while moving.
As motion decays the image resolves visually into an upright, still state, which is the cue that it is now the one to examine.
Direction of travel is legible at a glance from the lean, giving continuous feedback about where the visitor is heading in the sequence.
Progress through the whole sequence stays readable because scroll extent maps to the full column.

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Input can be interrupted or resumed at any moment; a new burst simply reopens the gap and the column continues converging from wherever it currently is, never snapping to a position
interaction_model.state_change: Target position advances immediately with the input while the column's actual position follows behind it, then converges
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Images move smoothly, visibly behind the input, and glide into place instead of jumping to it
interaction_model.input: Vertical scroll from wheel, trackpad, keyboard keys, or dragging the scrollbar
interaction_model.affected_object: The photo column as a single moving body

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Slowing reduces the shear continuously in step with the shrinking lag, with no discrete levels or thresholds
interaction_model.state_change: Amount of shear scales with how far the column is currently behind the input
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Faster travel shears the images more strongly; gentle travel shears them only slightly
interaction_model.input: Speed of the scroll input
interaction_model.affected_object: Visual form of the images

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Repeated reversals remain stable and continuous; the column keeps converging toward the current input position without visual glitching
interaction_model.state_change: Tilt sign inverts immediately toward the new direction of travel
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The lean flips at once rather than easing through flat, so reversal reads as decisive
interaction_model.input: Reversing scroll direction
interaction_model.affected_object: Direction of the lean

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: New input during the settle is absorbed smoothly, continuing motion from the current sheared state rather than restarting
interaction_model.state_change: Lag closes and shear returns to zero
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The images unwind back to flat and the column settles into complete stillness
interaction_model.input: Stopping input
interaction_model.affected_object: The column and image form

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Ends are stable resting places; the visitor can settle there or travel back with unbroken continuity
interaction_model.state_change: Motion arrives at the boundary and reverses
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Arrival and return are as smooth and weighted as travel in the middle, with no hard stop, bounce-step or abrupt cut
interaction_model.input: Reaching the first or last item and travelling back
interaction_model.affected_object: Position within the sequence

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Scrolling remains available throughout and the lag-and-lean behaviour continues unchanged after the resize
interaction_model.state_change: Item positions and total scroll length are recomputed for the new size
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Everything realigns to the new size while the visitor stays on the same part of the sequence, without a positional jump or flash
interaction_model.input: Resizing the viewport
interaction_model.affected_object: Column layout and scroll extent

experience_qualities: Weighty and physical, as if the column carries mass
Fluid and continuous, never stepped, snapped or abrupt
Calm and unhurried at rest, with one image at a time
Directionally expressive: the lean makes travel legible
Coherent: the whole column moves as one thing, not many separate animations
completion_and_return: There is no completion event; the experience simply comes to rest whenever the visitor stops.
Resting state is always flat, upright and still, regardless of how fast the preceding motion was.
The sequence does not loop; the first and last items are real boundaries that can be settled at and travelled back from continuously.
Position within the sequence persists while the visitor stays in the view, including across viewport resizing.
locked_observable_requirements: One large media item dominates attention at a time, with generous empty space between consecutive items.
Items form a single vertical column that moves as one body.
The column visibly lags behind the scroll input and glides into position rather than snapping.
Images shear, and the amount of shear is proportional to how far the column is behind the input.
The shear is tilted toward the current direction of travel and flips immediately on reversal.
Stopping unwinds the shear continuously back to flat and to complete stillness.
Scrollable extent corresponds to the full length of the column.
Both ends of the sequence, and returning from them, feel as continuous as mid-sequence travel.
All standard vertical input methods, including the scrollbar, drive the same behaviour identically.
Viewport resizing realigns the layout without a positional jump.
adaptable_details: Number of items in the sequence and their aspect ratios
Exact item size and the exact amount of separating empty space
Kind of large visual content shown, provided it rewards single-item viewing
How far the column trails and how quickly it converges
Maximum amount of shear at high speed
Presence, placement and styling of minimal captions or index indicators
Background treatment and surrounding page framing
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits tall, ordered sequences of a small-to-moderate number of large visuals meant to be looked at one at a time, where the page's main job is browsing that sequence and interface density is low. It does not fit dense grids, multi-column layouts, text-heavy reading views, or content that must remain legible while moving. Switching the travel axis to horizontal, locking each item into place with snap paging, applying the lag and lean to individual items independently instead of to one shared column, or decoupling scroll extent from the real sequence length would each produce a different skill.

name: scattered_teaser_index_to_composed_gallery
description: Named entries centered among a few dimmed, loosely scattered teaser images that parallax under the pointer, swap directionally when another name is chosen, and gather into a brightened composed arrangement with scrollable text when a collection is opened.

canonical_document.name: scattered_teaser_index_to_composed_gallery
canonical_document.description: Named entries centered among a few dimmed, loosely scattered teaser images that parallax under the pointer, swap directionally when another name is chosen, and gather into a brightened composed arrangement with scrollable text when a collection is opened.
canonical_document.experience_scope: Whole-view experience covering both states of one surface: it begins after a brief opening beat when the names and the active entry's scattered teasers appear, spans name-to-name switching and the commit into the composed viewing arrangement, and ends when the return control restores the browsing state; it does not extend to any separate page.
content_and_composition: Foreground stack of a handful of entry names, one of them highlighted as active, held as the primary legible layer at the center of the view
A small set of teaser images belonging only to the active entry, dispersed loosely and unevenly around the names at varying offsets, rendered dimmed so they sit visually behind the text layer
A short body text passage tied to the highlighted entry, subordinate to the names while browsing
A small action label beneath the highlighted name as the only commit affordance

In the viewing state: the same teaser images regrouped into a deliberate, brightened composed arrangement with a long readable text passage placed below it, the name list receded to a background role, and a return control present
Persistent across both states: the identity of the active entry, the same image set, and the single continuous canvas
experience_progression: Brief opening beat before the index becomes interactive
Browsing state: names foreground, active entry's dimmed teasers dispersed around them, pointer-driven depth active
Lateral progression: each name change replaces the whole teaser set with a directional sweep while highlight and body text change over together, remaining in the browsing state
Commit: teasers gather and brighten into the composed arrangement, names step back, long text becomes available and scrollable
Viewing state: sustained reading and image viewing with vertical scrolling unlocked
Return: scroll back to top, teasers re-disperse and dim, names come forward, pointer depth revives, and the browsing state resumes on the same entry as before
attention_and_information_flow: While browsing, contrast and legibility favor the names; the teasers are deliberately dimmed so they inform rather than compete
The scattered teasers make the currently previewed entry unmistakable without any extra labeling
A name change is read as one coordinated set exchange rather than several independent element updates, so attention stays on the list position
Commit inverts the hierarchy: images and text gain brightness, size and composure while the names lose prominence
Only the active entry's imagery and text are ever revealed; other entries stay as names until selected
The viewing state discloses substantially more information than the teaser preview, extending below the fold

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Purely responsive and continuous; images settle back when movement stops, cannot change selection, and this response is suspended in the viewing state and revived on return
interaction_model.state_change: Each teaser eases vertically by a different amount, producing layered depth; the active selection is unaffected
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Loose, unequal drifting of the scattered images that follows the pointer while names stay stable
interaction_model.input: Pointer movement across the browsing view
interaction_model.affected_object: The dispersed teaser images of the active entry

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Input arriving mid-transition is ignored rather than queued, and reselecting the already highlighted name does nothing; another name may be chosen freely once the exchange finishes
interaction_model.state_change: Current teaser set exits and the incoming entry's set replaces it, with direction determined by the chosen name's position relative to the current one
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Teasers sweep off the top edge when the chosen name sits lower in the list and off the bottom edge when it sits higher, replacements enter from the opposite edge, and highlight and body text change over with them as one motion
interaction_model.input: Choosing a different entry name
interaction_model.affected_object: The whole teaser set, the highlighted name and the body text passage together

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Triggers during the transition are ignored; the return control is the defined exit and no separate destination is entered
interaction_model.state_change: Browsing becomes viewing: scattered teasers gather into the composed arrangement and brighten, names recede, long text becomes readable below, vertical scrolling unlocks and pointer depth stops
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The same images visibly draw together into a settled, brighter composition with the readable passage beneath it, and a return control appears
interaction_model.input: Triggering the small action label beneath the highlighted name
interaction_model.affected_object: Teaser images, name list, text passage and view scrolling

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Restores the earlier browsing state unchanged, including which entry is active and its teaser set; mid-transition input is ignored
interaction_model.state_change: Viewing reverts to browsing on the same entry
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The view scrolls back up, the composed images re-disperse and dim, the names come forward again, and pointer-driven depth resumes
interaction_model.input: Triggering the return control
interaction_model.affected_object: The whole view

experience_qualities: Calm and legible while browsing, with imagery present but subdued
Sense of loose spatial depth rather than a flat grid
Continuity: every change reads as one surface rearranging itself, never as a screen swap
Directional coherence, so switching entries feels spatially consistent with list position
A clear shift in register from glancing to settled viewing
Deliberate and unhurried, with transitions protected from stutter by ignoring interrupting input
completion_and_return: The viewing state completes only by the return control; there is no automatic exit
Return re-establishes the prior browsing state exactly, preserving the active entry and its teaser arrangement role
Name switching has no terminal state and can continue indefinitely in either direction
Scrolling position resets to the top as part of returning
locked_observable_requirements: A handful of entry names hold the legible foreground with exactly one highlighted as active
Only the active entry's small set of images is shown, dispersed loosely and dimmed around the names
Pointer movement offsets the dispersed images vertically by differing amounts and never changes which entry is active
Changing entries exchanges the entire image set with exit direction keyed to the chosen name's position relative to the current one and entry from the opposite edge
Highlight and body text change over in the same coordinated motion as the image set
Committing gathers the same images into a composed, brightened arrangement with a readable passage below it while the names recede
Vertical scrolling is available only in the viewing state and a return control exists there
Returning restores the earlier browsing state unchanged and revives the pointer response
Input during a transition and reselection of the active entry are ignored rather than queued
Both states live on one continuous canvas with no jump to a separate screen
adaptable_details: Exact number of names and of teaser images per entry
Precise scatter positions, offset magnitudes, easing curves and transition durations
Geometry of the composed viewing arrangement
Typography, palette, dimming level and brightness contrast between states
Presence and styling of the brief opening beat
Wording and placement of the commit and return labels
Whether the imagery is photographic or another visual medium
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits surfaces offering a small, glanceable set of named items where each item owns a few representative images plus one longer text passage, and where the names must stay readable while previewing. It stops fitting when the item list is long enough to need its own scrolling or filtering, when many items' imagery must be visible at once for comparison, when items have no image material to disperse, or when the focused state must be a separate destination view; making the detail state a distinct screen, or the imagery the permanent foreground, produces a different Skill.

name: breathing_haunted_scene_panel
description: A square illustration centred on a uniform, low-distraction surround that never reads as flat: haze creeps, faint specks drift, irregular flashes pulse, and moving the pointer slides near layers against far ones while a small light travels with it, raising surface relief and rippling the patch beneath.

canonical_document.name: breathing_haunted_scene_panel
canonical_document.description: A square illustration centred on a uniform, low-distraction surround that never reads as flat: haze creeps, faint specks drift, irregular flashes pulse, and moving the pointer slides near layers against far ones while a small light travels with it, raising surface relief and rippling the patch beneath.
canonical_document.experience_scope: A single bounded square region centred in an otherwise empty, evenly toned full-view field; the experience begins when the whole layered artwork is ready and continues indefinitely while the visitor remains, with all interaction confined to the frame.
content_and_composition: One primary illustrated scene as the sole foreground content, presented as a square frame centred in the view
Surrounding field is a single flat, low-distraction tone with no competing content, chrome or captions
The scene is composed of separated near and far depth layers that can move independently against each other
A persistent atmospheric layer of creeping haze spread over the scene
A persistent field of dim drifting specks passing across near and far depth
An intermittent flash/glimmer layer distributed across the scene's depths
A small pointer-bound light that reveals surface relief within the scene
A localized ripple region beneath the pointer light
experience_progression: The plain empty surround holds with nothing shown while every layer of the artwork is still being prepared
The finished layered image settles into place as a centred square on the uniform field, drawing attention inward
Ambient life takes over indefinitely: haze creeping, specks drifting, irregular flashes recurring with no start or end state
Pointer movement adds a temporary depth-and-light exploration on top of the ambient loop and relaxes back when movement stops
attention_and_information_flow: The empty, uniformly toned field removes all alternative focus so the eye lands straight inside the square
Ambient haze, drift and flashes keep pulling the gaze between near and far parts of the scene rather than to a single point
The travelling light gives a moving local focus, momentarily raising the prominence of whatever surface it crosses
Parallax separation reveals spatial relationships between layers that are invisible when the pointer is still
No information is disclosed or withheld progressively; nothing must be learned or completed

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Fully reversible; sweeping back toward the earlier position restores the earlier view, and the response trails slightly behind the pointer and glides into place rather than snapping
interaction_model.state_change: Layers shift by differing amounts according to pointer position, opening apparent depth
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The image visibly separates into foreground and background planes that slide against each other
interaction_model.input: Pointer moved across the framed scene
interaction_model.affected_object: Near and far layers of the illustration

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Light follows with a slight lag and eases to rest where the pointer stops; leaving the frame or holding still returns the area to its unlit ambient appearance
interaction_model.state_change: Light travels with the pointer and relights the local area
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Surface relief and texture in the scene are picked out under the moving light
interaction_model.input: Pointer moved across the framed scene
interaction_model.affected_object: Small pointer-bound light and the surface it crosses

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Ripple is transient and self-settling; it fades once the pointer moves on or stops
interaction_model.state_change: Local surface enters a soft rippling state
interaction_model.visible_feedback: A gentle ripple disturbs the patch under the pointer and subsides behind it
interaction_model.input: Pointer moved across the framed scene
interaction_model.affected_object: Patch of the image directly beneath the pointer

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Same reversibility; dragging back restores the earlier view and releasing lets the scene settle
interaction_model.state_change: Identical response with slightly greater reach than pointer movement
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Same parallax, travelling light and ripple, extending a little further from the contact point
interaction_model.input: Finger dragged across the framed scene on touch
interaction_model.affected_object: Same depth, light and ripple responses

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Never stops or completes; continues through and after any pointer interaction, including while the picture settles from a hover
interaction_model.state_change: Continuous creeping, drifting and irregular flashing independent of interaction
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The scene keeps visibly breathing even when perfectly still and untouched
interaction_model.input: Autonomous ambient drivers with no user input
interaction_model.affected_object: Haze, drifting specks and flash layer

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Resumes immediately on the next movement from the settled position
interaction_model.state_change: Interactive responses relax toward a resting state
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The picture settles while haze, specks and flashes carry on unchanged
interaction_model.input: Pointer held still inside the frame
interaction_model.affected_object: Depth offset, light and ripple

experience_qualities: Eerie and unsettling rather than pleasant or playful
Never reads as a flat still image
Continuous, breathing, unresolved atmosphere
Soft, trailing, inertial response rather than immediate mechanical tracking
Contemplative and lingering — rewarding attention without asking for a task
Depth-revealing: a flat picture becomes near and far space
completion_and_return: No completion state, score, end or goal; the ambient life loops indefinitely for as long as the visitor lingers
Interactive depth, light and ripple return to a neutral resting appearance whenever input stops or leaves the frame
Any hover-induced view is fully recoverable by sweeping back over the same path
Nothing persists between visits beyond the same initial empty-surround-then-settle opening
locked_observable_requirements: Show the plain empty surround with no partial artwork until every layer is ready, then let the complete image settle in
One square scene centred on an otherwise contentless field held at a single uniform, low-distraction tone clearly separated in luminance from the artwork
The scene must never appear static: haze creep, dim drifting specks and irregular flashes run autonomously and continuously
Pointer or touch position must produce differential movement between near and far layers, reading as opened depth
A small light must travel with the pointer and reveal surface relief
The area beneath the pointer must ripple softly
Response must lag slightly behind input and glide into place, never snap
All pointer-driven change must be fully reversible by moving back, and must settle when input holds still
Ambient motion must continue during and after interaction, including at rest
Touch dragging must behave the same as pointer movement, with slightly greater reach
Interaction confined to the frame; leaving it returns the scene to its ambient resting state
adaptable_details: Subject and mood of the illustration, provided it supports separable near/far layers and surface relief
Number of depth layers and how far each shifts
Density, size, speed and path of drifting specks
Frequency, luminance rise and distribution of the irregular flashes
Haze thickness, tint and drift direction
Size, softness, tint and falloff of the travelling light
Ripple amplitude, wavelength and decay time
Amount of trailing lag and easing character
Exact reach multiplier for touch versus pointer
Square frame size relative to the viewport, any framing edge treatment, and the exact tone of the surround provided it stays low-distraction and separated from the artwork
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits any single richly layered image that can be split into near and far planes with visible surface texture and is meant to be contemplated alone on an empty, low-distraction field — illustrations, painted scenes, atmospheric photographs, poster or cover key visuals. It stops being this Skill if the image becomes a background substrate behind readable foreground content, if multiple images are sequenced or navigated, if the interaction is used to disclose information, labels or hotspots, if the ambient motion is removed so the picture is only alive while hovered, or if the response becomes instant and non-reversible instead of trailing and recoverable.

name: stretch_lift_layered_scene_swap
description: Full-screen image scenes — a centred pair of tall portraits over a low-distraction full-bleed backdrop that sits well below them in visual weight, with a short uppercase statement low in the frame — that change through three simultaneous but different layer behaviours on a single scroll gesture: the portraits lift and stretch vertically out through the top edge, slightly offset from each other, while the backdrop stays put and melts into the next image and the statement wipes upward behind its own mask edge revealing nothing past it; the incoming portraits then rise from below and settle. Further gestures are ignored mid-change so one gesture equals exactly one step, a numbered marker rises to high salience and draws its rule outward for the arriving scene, and a slim fixed frame of brand marks never moves with the scene. Transferable to any small ordered set of image-led subjects that each deserve the whole screen, giving a scene-cut feel that a plain slide or crossfade cannot produce.

canonical_document.name: stretch_lift_layered_scene_swap
canonical_document.description: Full-screen image scenes — a centred pair of tall portraits over a low-distraction full-bleed backdrop that sits well below them in visual weight, with a short uppercase statement low in the frame — that change through three simultaneous but different layer behaviours on a single scroll gesture: the portraits lift and stretch vertically out through the top edge, slightly offset from each other, while the backdrop stays put and melts into the next image and the statement wipes upward behind its own mask edge revealing nothing past it; the incoming portraits then rise from below and settle. Further gestures are ignored mid-change so one gesture equals exactly one step, a numbered marker rises to high salience and draws its rule outward for the arriving scene, and a slim fixed frame of brand marks never moves with the scene. Transferable to any small ordered set of image-led subjects that each deserve the whole screen, giving a scene-cut feel that a plain slide or crossfade cannot produce.
canonical_document.experience_scope: Whole-view experience occupying the entire viewport. It begins on the opening scene with its statement line and a quiet onward cue, and continues indefinitely as the visitor advances; the scene set cycles rather than terminating, so the experience has no exit state of its own. The persistent slim frame stays present across all scenes.
content_and_composition: One active scene fills the viewport at any moment; scenes are drawn from a small ordered set (three in the observed case) and repeat cyclically
Each scene centres a pair of tall portrait-orientation images, side by side, as the primary foreground subject
Behind the pair sits one large ambient backdrop image spanning the viewport as a full-bleed substrate, held at clearly lower visual weight than the foreground pair
A short uppercase statement of a few lines is anchored low in the composition on the opening scene, at readable contrast against whatever sits behind it
A small numbered position marker set — one entry per scene, each with an accompanying rule — persists at a fixed edge position and reflects which scene is active
A quiet onward cue appears on the opening state only, near the composition, inviting the first advance
A fixed slim frame around the view holds a brand mark, a short row of category labels, a cart count, and rotated vertical brand type along an edge; this frame never participates in scene motion
experience_progression: Opening state: first scene composed, statement line present low in the frame, onward cue visible, first marker entry active at high salience with its rule extended
On first advance the onward cue retires permanently and does not return for the remainder of the session

Advance stage: outgoing portraits lift and stretch upward out through the top edge with a slight timing offset between the two, statement lines wipe upward behind their own edges, and the backdrop melts into the incoming backdrop image
Arrival stage: incoming portraits rise in from below and settle into their centred rest position
Marker stage, concurrent with the change: the arriving entry rises to high salience and its rule draws outward while the departing entry recedes to low salience and its rule retracts
Sequence wraps from the last scene back to the first and can be advanced indefinitely in either direction
attention_and_information_flow: Attention rests on the centred portrait pair, framed and separated from the surroundings by the backdrop's clearly lower visual weight and reduced detail
The low statement provides the only verbal foreground content and reads as a closing note beneath the imagery on the opening scene
During a change, attention is pulled upward with the departing portraits and handed back downward as the arriving pair rises and settles, producing a continuous vertical sweep rather than a cut
Only one scene's information is legible at any moment; the previous scene's content is fully carried off rather than layered under the new one
The numbered marker carries positional information peripherally, becoming momentarily noticeable through its salience-rise-and-draw change and then receding
The slim surrounding frame stays quiet and constant, giving a stable reference that keeps the shifting centre readable

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Additional gestures during a transition are ignored entirely, so steps never stack, queue or skip; once the transition finishes the view accepts input again and the next gesture advances exactly one step
interaction_model.state_change: Active scene index moves one step forward or backward and a single transition begins; the view is marked busy for the duration
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Outgoing portraits lift and stretch out through the top edge with a slight offset between them, statement lines wipe upward behind their own edges, the backdrop melts into the next image, and the incoming portraits rise in from below and settle
interaction_model.input: Scroll gesture anywhere within the view, in either direction
interaction_model.affected_object: The active scene as a whole — portrait pair, backdrop, and statement together

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Marker state always matches the scene actually on screen; reversing direction returns the marker to the prior entry with the same salience-rise / salience-recede treatment
interaction_model.state_change: Active marker entry moves to the arriving scene
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The arriving entry rises to high salience and its rule draws outward while the previous entry recedes to low salience and its rule retracts
interaction_model.input: Completion of a scene change (autonomous, following any advance)
interaction_model.affected_object: Numbered position marker set

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: One-way and non-recoverable within the session; returning to the opening scene does not restore it
interaction_model.state_change: Cue transitions permanently from present to retired
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The cue quietly leaves the composition and does not reappear on later scenes or on returning to the first scene
interaction_model.input: First advance of the session
interaction_model.affected_object: Quiet onward cue on the opening scene

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: The cycle is endless in both directions, so there is no dead end to recover from
interaction_model.state_change: Position wraps around to the opposite end of the set
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The same full scene change plays, with no edge resistance, bounce or stop signal; the marker jumps to the wrapped entry
interaction_model.input: Advance past the last scene, or backward past the first
interaction_model.affected_object: Scene sequence position

experience_qualities: Slow and cinematic — changes read as a change of scene, never as a mechanical jump or instant swap
Immersive and atmospheric, driven by a large low-detail backdrop set clearly apart in luminance from the higher-salience foreground subjects, in whichever direction that separation runs
Editorial and composed, with generous emptiness around the centred subjects
Deliberate and one-thing-at-a-time; input pacing is enforced so the visitor cannot rush past a change
Vertically directional — content consistently departs upward and arrives from below
Slightly hand-authored, from the small timing offset between the paired portraits and the masked wipe of the text
completion_and_return: No terminal end state: the scene set cycles back to the first after the last and can be traversed indefinitely
Position is always represented by the numbered marker, so the visitor's place stays obvious after any number of advances
The retired onward cue is a persistent one-way session state and does not reset when the sequence wraps
Each transition resolves fully to a settled scene before further input is accepted, so the view never rests mid-change
The surrounding slim frame persists unchanged through every scene and every transition
locked_observable_requirements: One scene fills the entire viewport at a time; scenes never appear side by side or partially overlapped at rest
Each scene composes a pair of tall portrait-orientation images centred over a single full-bleed ambient backdrop that stays clearly lower in visual weight than the pair
Outgoing foreground imagery lifts and stretches out through the top edge, with a slight timing offset between the paired images
Incoming foreground imagery rises in from below and settles rather than fading or cutting in
The backdrop changes by melting one image into the next, distinct from the foreground's directional motion
Statement text leaves by wiping upward behind its own edge, revealing nothing beyond the edge as it goes
A single scroll gesture advances exactly one step, works in both directions, and is accepted anywhere in the view
Gestures arriving during a transition are ignored, so steps never stack or skip
A small numbered marker per scene shows position, with the active entry raised to high salience and its rule drawn outward and the inactive entries held at low salience with rules retracted
The sequence wraps from last to first with no edge stop
A slim fixed frame of surrounding marks persists across all scenes and never moves with the scene change
The onward cue appears only on the opening state and retires permanently after the first advance
adaptable_details: Number of scenes in the set
Subject matter of the imagery, as long as it suits tall portrait-orientation framing
Exact wording, line count and casing of the statement, and whether it appears on more than the opening scene
Hues, luminance direction and overall visual weight of the backdrop and its degree of atmosphere, provided it stays clearly separated from the foreground pair and the statement stays readable
Precise transition duration and easing, and the size of the offset between the paired images
Marker placement, numbering style and rule length, and how the active/inactive salience difference is expressed
Contents of the slim surrounding frame — which labels, counts or rotated type appear
Visual form of the onward cue
Whether keys or additional gestures also drive advancement, provided one gesture still equals one step
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits small ordered sets of image-led subjects that each deserve the whole screen and read best one at a time — collection pieces, featured projects, chapters of a visual story — with at most a short line of accompanying text and a stable surrounding frame. It depends on tall portrait-orientation imagery and a separate full-bleed backdrop that can be held at lower visual weight than the pair; a single wide image per scene, or many small items needing side-by-side comparison, breaks the composition. It also depends on large sets being avoided: a numbered marker for every scene stops working once the set grows past a handful. Allowing free continuous scrolling through the scenes, letting multiple scenes coexist on screen, replacing the directional lift-and-rise with a crossfade or slide, or making the surrounding frame move with the scene each produce a different Skill.

name: curtain_opened_elastic_horizontal_image_run
description: A branded cover holds the screen, pulls away to let the first captioned pictures arrive in sequence, then the whole set travels sideways as one weighted, squashing run driven by vertical scroll or direct dragging, with a hairline progress bar and firm ends.

canonical_document.name: curtain_opened_elastic_horizontal_image_run
canonical_document.description: A branded cover holds the screen, pulls away to let the first captioned pictures arrive in sequence, then the whole set travels sideways as one weighted, squashing run driven by vertical scroll or direct dragging, with a hairline progress bar and firm ends.
canonical_document.experience_scope: Whole-view experience: begins the moment the view is opened with the screen fully covered, continues through the uncover and staggered arrival of the first items, and persists as the primary traversal surface until the view is left; also re-runs from its start whenever a set-changing selection triggers the cover again.
content_and_composition: One full-screen opening cover layer with a small brand or identity mark, sitting above everything until it withdraws
One horizontal run of many image items arranged in a single row, extending beyond the viewport on both sides of the current position
Each item pairs one large picture with a short primary title and a smaller secondary credit line, kept adjacent so picture and text read as one unit
A persistent set of selectable category labels, one of which is visibly marked as current
A persistent hairline progress bar indicating position between the first and last item
Layer order: cover above run; labels and progress bar remain above the run and stay in place while the run moves
experience_progression: Covered state: screen fully occluded by the branded cover for a short beat, no traversal possible
Uncover: the cover pulls away to expose the viewing area
Introduction: the first pictures and their titles arrive one after another in sequence rather than all at once
Free traversal: the run responds to scroll and drag, moving sideways with weighted elasticity
End of run: travel halts firmly at the last item; no wrap into a repeat
Re-entry: a set-changing selection plays a full-screen cover, returns the run to its beginning and replays the uncover and staggered arrival
attention_and_information_flow: Attention is first held by the single branded cover with nothing else competing
As the cover leaves, attention lands on the first picture, then follows the sequenced arrival of subsequent items so the set announces its extent before exploring
During traversal, prominence belongs to the item currently centred in view; adjacent items are partially visible and pull attention toward the direction of travel
Each picture's title and credit become readable together with it, so identification travels with the image rather than being consulted separately
The hairline bar quietly reports how much of the run remains, giving a sense of finite length without competing with the imagery
Reaching either end concentrates attention on the terminal item by refusing further travel

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Scrolling in the opposite direction reverses travel; travel stops firmly at the first and last item instead of wrapping or bouncing into a loop
interaction_model.state_change: Vertical input is redirected into horizontal travel along the run; position advances or retreats
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The row slides sideways with weighted momentum, the progress bar fill updates, and new items enter from the leading edge
interaction_model.input: Vertical wheel or trackpad scrolling
interaction_model.affected_object: The horizontal run of image items

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Releasing hands control back to scroll-driven travel from exactly the position where the drag stopped, with no jump or snap; drag also cannot pass the first or last item
interaction_model.state_change: The run is grabbed and follows the pointer one-to-one for the duration of the drag
interaction_model.visible_feedback: A grab cursor invites the gesture, the row tracks the pointer exactly, and the progress bar updates continuously
interaction_model.input: Pointer press and drag on the run
interaction_model.affected_object: The horizontal run of image items

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Deformation always relaxes back to rest when input stops; continued fast input sustains it, and stopping is enough to recover the neutral state
interaction_model.state_change: Speed above rest deforms the run and tilts the pictures proportionally to how fast it is moving
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The row visibly squashes along the direction of travel and the photographs lean, then relax back to their undeformed upright rest state as motion settles
interaction_model.input: Fast movement from either scrolling or dragging
interaction_model.affected_object: The run and the individual pictures within it

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Further selections are ignored while the cover transition is in progress, so the transition always completes before another can start
interaction_model.state_change: The chosen label becomes the marked current one, a full-screen cover plays, and the run resets to its beginning
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The selected label appears marked, the screen is covered, then the opening uncover and sequenced arrival of the first items replay
interaction_model.input: Choosing one of the category labels
interaction_model.affected_object: The label set, the full-screen cover and the run's position

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Autonomous and self-completing; traversal becomes available once the introduction finishes
interaction_model.state_change: Covered state advances automatically through uncover into sequenced item arrival
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Brief branded cover, its withdrawal, then pictures with titles appearing one after another
interaction_model.input: Opening or re-entering the view
interaction_model.affected_object: The cover layer and the leading items of the run

experience_qualities: Staged and authored rather than instantly available
Weighted, elastic and hand-driven rather than mechanical or stepwise
Tactile, with content that visibly deforms under speed and settles when left alone
Finite and curated, with a definite beginning and end instead of an endless feed
Image-led, with titles and credits reading as part of each picture
Calm in its reporting: position is conveyed by a hairline indicator, not by heavy chrome
completion_and_return: The introduction completes on its own and hands control to free traversal
The run does not loop: it terminates firmly at the last item and at the first item
Selecting a category returns the run to its beginning and replays the same opening reveal, making re-entry a repeatable staged event
Position within the run persists between scroll and drag; a release resumes from the exact stopping point
The marked current category persists after its transition completes
locked_observable_requirements: The view begins fully covered by a brief branded cover that then pulls away
The first pictures and their titles arrive in sequence, not simultaneously
Vertical wheel or trackpad input produces horizontal travel of the run
The run can also be grabbed and pulled directly by the pointer, tracking it one-to-one, with a grab cursor
Releasing a drag resumes scroll-driven travel from exactly where the drag ended
Travel stops firmly at the first and last item with no wrapping or infinite loop
Faster movement visibly squashes the run and leans the pictures, relaxing back to rest as motion settles
A hairline bar fills to show position within the finite run
Each picture is paired with a short title and a secondary credit line
Choosing a category marks it, plays a full-screen cover, resets the run to its start and replays the opening reveal
Inputs that would start another such transition are ignored until the current one finishes
adaptable_details: Number of items in the run and their aspect ratios
Visual style of the cover and the identity mark it carries
Exact duration of the cover beat and the stagger interval between arriving items
Amount of squash and lean, and how quickly deformation relaxes
Placement, thickness and tonal treatment of the hairline progress bar, so long as it stays separable from its surround while remaining quieter than the imagery
Layout and styling of the category labels and the way the current one is marked
Wording of titles and credit lines, and typographic treatment
Direction of travel mapping (left-to-right or right-to-left) and item spacing
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits any finite, curated set of image-led items where each picture carries a short title and a secondary line, and where the set should introduce itself before being explored — showcases, portfolios, collections, editorial or product lineups. It stops being this Skill if the run becomes an endless or wrapping feed, if travel becomes discrete slide-by-slide stepping instead of continuous weighted motion, if the elastic squash-and-lean response is dropped, if vertical input no longer drives horizontal travel, or if the staged cover-and-sequenced-arrival opening is removed so the content is simply present on load.

name: hover_flipbook_preview_into_collection_reveal
description: One word in a spare typographic page blanks the text on dwell and flips full-bleed pictures past several a second; leaving reverts instantly, while choosing keeps the picture showing and lets the rest of the collection sweep in around it.

canonical_document.name: hover_flipbook_preview_into_collection_reveal
canonical_document.description: One word in a spare typographic page blanks the text on dwell and flips full-bleed pictures past several a second; leaving reverts instantly, while choosing keeps the picture showing and lets the rest of the collection sweep in around it.
canonical_document.experience_scope: Whole-view experience anchored on a single sparse text view. It begins when the pointer comes to rest on one entry within that text, and ends either by reverting to the untouched text on pointer exit, or by resolving into a full collection view that itself ends on an explicit return to the text view.
content_and_composition: One sparse typographic intro view holding a brief first-person note, a few short quotations and contact details, with generous empty space and no imagery at rest
Exactly one interactive entry word inside that text that stands for the whole visual collection
A persistent name or wordmark fixed at the top left across every state, doubling as a return affordance
One screen-filling image layer that covers the entire viewport and hides the text while active, showing a single picture at a time
A collection view containing the whole body of work as many items, each carrying a title, a year and a category label
Within the collection view, the one image carried over from the preview occupies its own fixed place among the others
A back control persistent while the collection view is open
A current-state mark on the entry that stands for the collection while it is open
experience_progression: A short quiet hold before the view resolves, while imagery becomes ready
Rest state: text-led intro, no imagery visible
Pointer dwells on the entry; after a barely noticeable delay the text drops away and the full-bleed image layer takes the screen
Preview state: pictures replace one another several times a second, looping through the set for as long as the pointer rests, with no beginning or end signalled
Branch A on pointer exit: cycling halts at once on whatever picture is showing, the image fades out and the text returns exactly as before
Branch B on activation: the picture currently showing is kept on screen, settles into its own place, and the remaining items of the collection sweep in around it
Collection state: the full set is browsable with titles, years and categories, and the originating entry reads as current
Return: the collection gives way and the intro text reappears in the same state it was found
attention_and_information_flow: At rest, attention belongs entirely to typography; the collection is only named, never shown
During preview, attention is seized wholesale by one picture at a time at full size, with no metadata, captions or chrome competing
Rapid succession communicates breadth and mood rather than any single image; nothing is legible long enough to study
On activation, attention narrows briefly to the single retained picture, which acts as the anchor for the incoming set
In the collection view, attention broadens to the whole range at a glance, and titles, years and categories supply the context withheld during the tease
The top-left name stays quietly available as the way back throughout

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Leaving before the delay elapses leaves the view untouched; nothing is committed at any point during preview
interaction_model.state_change: Idle text state becomes preview state after a short, barely perceptible dwell delay
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The text drops away and a screen-filling picture appears in its place
interaction_model.input: Pointer comes to rest on the single collection entry in the text
interaction_model.affected_object: Intro typography and the full-bleed image layer

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Cycling continues only while the pointer rests; it stops immediately when the pointer leaves and needs no user control
interaction_model.state_change: Advances from one picture to the next and wraps around endlessly
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Pictures flash past one at a time, several a second, at full-bleed size
interaction_model.input: Autonomous timing while the pointer keeps resting on the entry
interaction_model.affected_object: The single screen-filling image slot

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Fully reversible and repeatable; dwelling again restarts the tease from a clean state
interaction_model.state_change: Preview state reverts to the idle text state with nothing selected
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Cycling stops instantly on the current picture, the imagery fades out and the text fades back identical to before
interaction_model.input: Pointer moves off the entry during preview
interaction_model.affected_object: Image layer and intro typography

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Which picture is kept depends on the moment of activation; there is no chooser, and the return controls undo the whole move
interaction_model.state_change: Preview state resolves into the open collection view, and the entry becomes marked as current
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The picture on screen is kept rather than replaced, settles into its own position, and the remaining items sweep in around it with their titles, years and categories
interaction_model.input: Activation of the entry while a picture is showing
interaction_model.affected_object: The currently displayed picture and the rest of the collection

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Deliberate dead end that prevents the tease from interrupting the opened collection
interaction_model.state_change: No state change; the preview behaviour is suppressed
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Nothing changes on screen
interaction_model.input: Pointer rests on the same entry while the collection is already open
interaction_model.affected_object: Collection view

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Two equivalent routes back; the tease becomes available again immediately after returning
interaction_model.state_change: Collection view closes and the intro view is restored
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The intro text reappears looking exactly as it was left, with no imagery lingering
interaction_model.input: Back control or the persistent top-left name
interaction_model.affected_object: Collection view and intro view

experience_qualities: Quiet and editorial at rest, driven by type and empty space
Sudden and kinetic during the tease, almost flickering, far faster than a slideshow
Cinematic in scale: pictures always fill the screen with no frame or caption
Low-commitment and forgiving, since the whole tease can be abandoned with a movement
Continuous rather than jump-cut when opening, because one picture bridges the two views
Composed and unhurried once the collection is open, with range readable at a glance
completion_and_return: The tease has no completion of its own; it loops indefinitely and simply stops when the pointer leaves
Abandoning the tease commits nothing and leaves no trace in the text view
Activation is the only commitment, and it is marked by the entry reading as current
Returning restores the intro view in the same state it was found, so a visitor can leave and re-enter repeatedly
The picture kept on activation stays meaningful as that entry's place in the collection rather than being discarded
locked_observable_requirements: At rest the view shows only sparse typography with no imagery
A short, barely noticeable dwell delay precedes the tease so passing the pointer over does not trigger it
While teasing, the surrounding text is removed rather than dimmed or pushed aside
Preview pictures are screen-filling and shown one at a time
Succession is rapid, several pictures a second, and loops for as long as the pointer rests
Pointer exit halts the cycle immediately and restores the text unchanged, with nothing selected
The exact picture visible at the moment of activation is the one kept on screen
The kept picture settles into its own place while the rest of the collection arrives around it
The opened collection shows title, year and category context for its items
The originating entry is visibly marked as current while the collection is open
A back control and the persistent top-left name both return to the intro view
Dwelling on the entry does nothing while the collection is open
Returning leaves the intro view exactly as it was found
adaptable_details: Exact dwell delay and cycle rate, so long as the succession still reads as rapid
Number of pictures in the tease and whether the order is fixed or varied
Layout of the opened collection and how densely items are arranged
Which metadata labels accompany items and how they are typeset
Direction, timing and easing of the sweep that brings the collection in

Typeface, any colour treatment of the surround and the specific copy of the note, quotations and contact details, provided the text stays comfortably readable against its surround and the full-bleed imagery reads as clearly separate from it
Placement and styling of the back control
How the current mark on the entry is drawn, so long as it is distinguishable from the unmarked entry
Whether the initial hold shows a minimal indicator or nothing at all
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits pointer-driven views where a sparse text foreground stands in front of one large, visually cohesive image or video set, and where a single entry point should stand for that whole set. It transfers to portfolios, catalogues, editorial indexes and project lists whose items are strong enough to read at full-bleed for a fraction of a second. It becomes a different Skill if the tease is committed rather than abandonable, if many entries each preview their own set at once, if previews appear inline or thumbnail-sized instead of taking the whole view, if the succession slows into a browsable slideshow with controls, or if the underlying content is text or data that cannot carry meaning as a screen-filling flash.

name: staggered_work_grid_expanding_into_story_read
description: A quiet, unevenly stacked grid of labelled image works that reacts to the pointer with widening panels, scrambling code characters and layered drift, then lets a chosen work push its neighbours aside and swell into a full-screen opening image for a magazine-style story that reverses back into the grid.

canonical_document.name: staggered_work_grid_expanding_into_story_read
canonical_document.description: A quiet, unevenly stacked grid of labelled image works that reacts to the pointer with widening panels, scrambling code characters and layered drift, then lets a chosen work push its neighbours aside and swell into a full-screen opening image for a magazine-style story that reverses back into the grid.
canonical_document.experience_scope: Whole-view experience: begins in the collection view that fills the viewport, continues through the expansion of one chosen work into a full-screen story read, and ends when the return move restores the collection at the visitor's earlier position. The collection region and the story view are two states of the same experience, not separate destinations.
content_and_composition: One collection of many image works arranged in an airy, deliberately uneven stack so the set reads as an inventory rather than a regular matrix
Each work: a photographic image, a backing panel behind it that is narrower at rest, a title set along the side of the image, and a short catalogue-style code string
Generous empty space between works so individual items can grow and shift without collisions

Expanded state of a chosen work: a full-screen opening image occupying the whole view, a headline, a short quote, running body text, a persistent return control, and a small downward hint inviting scroll
The chosen work's own image is the single element shared between both states and remains continuously visible through the transition
experience_progression: Resting collection: works sit still and evenly quiet, inviting slow scanning of titles and codes

Pointer focus on one work: its backing panel eases wider, its code characters drop out and spring back one after another, and its image, side title and code drift by different amounts under pointer movement
Pointer leave: the layered offsets settle back with a slight overshoot and the panel and code return to rest

Activation: page scrolling locks, the neighbouring works clear outward in order of nearness to the chosen one, and the chosen panel expands until it fills the screen while its image lands in the place of the large opening image
Story arrival: headline, quote and body text appear together, accompanied by the return control and the downward hint; scrolling now belongs to the story
Return: the entire move replays backwards, works return inward, and the collection reappears at the visitor's earlier position with pointer response restored
attention_and_information_flow: At rest, attention is distributed evenly across many works; titles and codes carry just enough information to make scanning feel like reading an inventory
Pointer focus lifts one work above its neighbours through width, character motion and depth-suggesting differential drift, without hiding the rest
On activation, attention narrows hard: competing works are removed outward before the chosen one grows, so nothing else remains to look at
In the story, prominence moves from the full-screen image to the text as headline, quote and body appear, and the downward hint transfers initiative to the reader
On return, attention widens back out to the whole set from the position the visitor already knew

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Pointer leave reverses both treatments back to the resting state; entering another work applies the same treatment there independently
interaction_model.state_change: Panel eases from its resting width to a wider state; code characters cycle out and back sequentially rather than all at once
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The panel visibly broadens behind the image while the code's characters drop out and spring back one after another
interaction_model.input: Pointer enters a work
interaction_model.affected_object: That work's backing panel and code label

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: On pointer leave the elements settle back to rest with a slight overshoot rather than snapping
interaction_model.state_change: Each element offsets by a different amount in response to pointer position, producing layered depth
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Image, title and code drift at visibly different rates and distances, following the pointer
interaction_model.input: Pointer movement inside a hovered work
interaction_model.affected_object: The work's image, its side-set title and its code

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Further activations or presses while the transition is running are ignored; the transition always completes to the story state
interaction_model.state_change: Page scrolling locks; neighbouring works clear outward ordered by nearness; the chosen panel expands to fill the screen and its image takes the place of the large opening image; then the story text block arrives
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The surrounding works sweep away nearest-first, the chosen panel grows to full screen carrying its own photo, and headline, quote and body text appear together with a return control and a downward hint
interaction_model.input: Activating a work
interaction_model.affected_object: The whole collection view and the chosen work

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Scroll position in the story is independent of the collection's retained position
interaction_model.state_change: Scroll ownership belongs to the story rather than the collection
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The long-form read advances normally while the collection stays suspended behind the full-screen state
interaction_model.input: Scrolling once the story is present
interaction_model.affected_object: Story content

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Repeated presses during the running transition are ignored; scroll lock is released only once the collection is restored
interaction_model.state_change: The expansion sequence replays in reverse: story content leaves, the panel shrinks back to its item size with its image, and the cleared neighbours return
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The visitor sees the same move run backwards and lands on the collection at the exact place they left, with pointer response working again
interaction_model.input: Pressing the return control
interaction_model.affected_object: The whole view

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: This is the escape path for the mid-story state; the collection is left in a normal interactive state
interaction_model.state_change: The story state is abandoned and the collection state is reinstated immediately
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The view drops straight back to the collection without playing the reverse move
interaction_model.input: Resizing the window while the story is open
interaction_model.affected_object: The whole view

experience_qualities: Airy and unhurried, encouraging slow scanning rather than fast clicking
Inventory-like and catalogued, with codes lending a sense of archive
Tactile and springy at close range through staggered character motion and overshoot settling
Deferential: neighbours appear to politely step aside for the chosen work
Continuous: one photograph carries the visitor from set to story and back
Calm and editorial once reading begins
completion_and_return: The story read has no forced end; leaving is by the return control
Return restores the collection at the visitor's earlier position rather than resetting to the top
Pointer responsiveness and scroll ownership are restored on return to the collection
Mid-transition inputs are dropped rather than queued, so the experience always rests in either the collection or the story state
A mid-story window resize resolves to the collection state directly
locked_observable_requirements: Every work in the collection carries both a title and a short code label
The collection is airy and unevenly stacked rather than a uniform regular grid
Hover widens the work's backing panel and cycles its code characters sequentially, not simultaneously
Pointer movement inside a work offsets image, title and code by different amounts and settles them back with a slight overshoot
On activation, neighbouring works clear outward in order of nearness to the chosen work before it fills the screen
The chosen work's own image becomes the full-screen opening image, preserving visual continuity between set and story
Headline, quote and body text arrive together, accompanied by a return control and a downward scroll hint
Scrolling is locked during the transition and belongs to the story afterwards
The return move replays the expansion in reverse and lands on the collection at the previous position
Inputs during a running transition are ignored
adaptable_details: Number of works and the specific unevenness of the arrangement
Image aspect ratios and panel shape or corner treatment
Format and length of the code string, and the alphabet used while characters cycle
Typography, colour treatment and density of the story text
Timing, easing and offset magnitudes of the hover, clearing and expansion moves
Direction in which neighbours clear outward
Whether a quiet holding state precedes the first appearance of the collection
Form of the return control and the downward hint
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits any medium-to-large set of image-led items where each item has a short label plus a longer narrative behind it, such as selected works, projects, case studies, editions or products with stories, and where each item's own image is strong enough to serve as a full-screen opening image. It becomes a different skill if the detail opens as an overlay or separate route without carrying the item's own image into it, if the collection remains visible alongside the detail instead of being cleared, if items have no per-item narrative to read, or if the collection is a strict uniform grid without per-item labels and codes.

source_sites.title: Grid Layout with Scrollable Content View

name: gallery_wall_previews_with_panel_wipe_to_full_image
description: A sparse gallery-wall landing with sparse labels over faint vertical rules and a row of small previews at the bottom edge whose layers drift out of step under the cursor; choosing one lets a fully opaque flat-toned panel wipe up over everything and clear onto that work filling the view, with the return wiping back down.

canonical_document.name: gallery_wall_previews_with_panel_wipe_to_full_image
canonical_document.description: A sparse gallery-wall landing with sparse labels over faint vertical rules and a row of small previews at the bottom edge whose layers drift out of step under the cursor; choosing one lets a fully opaque flat-toned panel wipe up over everything and clear onto that work filling the view, with the return wiping back down.
canonical_document.experience_scope: Whole-view experience with two modes. It begins when all images are ready and the overview appears at once, spans hover behaviour in the overview, the entering transition, the focused single-work view, and the returning transition, and ends when the overview is restored in its original state.
content_and_composition: Persistent overview text block: a primary name, a short section label and a year, set as sparse type held at readable contrast against the surround
Faint vertical rules spanning the overview as a quiet background structure behind the text, separated from the surround only enough to be perceptible
A row of several small work previews resting along the bottom edge of the view
Each preview composed of separable layers: its picture, its title and its ordinal number
One tile positioned beside the preview row that acts as the activation-context element and later as the way back
Focused mode: a single large image filling the view, carrying only its ordinal number, its title and one short note kept legible against the image beneath

A full-viewport panel of one flat, fully opaque tone, clearly separated from both the overview surround and the focused image, that exists only during transitions and covers the entire view at its peak
experience_progression: Held blank until every image is ready, then the whole overview appears at once rather than filling in piecewise
Overview browsing: previews respond individually to pointer proximity
Entering: the opaque flat-toned panel wipes upward across the whole view while the preview row and adjoining tile fly off the top edge
Handoff: the chosen work's large image is already in place, so it is simply uncovered as the panel clears upward
Focused dwell: single work held with its number, title and note; previews absent and inert
Returning: the same motion undone, panel wipe reversed downward and the preview row brought back down into place
Overview restored, allowing the works to be opened one after another
attention_and_information_flow: On arrival attention is spread evenly across quiet type and a low row of equally weighted small previews; no single work is promoted
Pointer proximity temporarily promotes one preview by breaking its layers out of alignment, revealing it as a composed object rather than a flat thumbnail
Activation collapses attention from many small works to exactly one full-view image, with information reduced to number, title and a brief note
The covering panel briefly removes all information behind a single uniform field, so the focused view is met as a fresh full-frame image rather than as a grown thumbnail
Return re-spreads attention across the row so the collection is read sequentially

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Once the pointer leaves, the layers ease back to their aligned rest positions; no drift persists
interaction_model.state_change: Layers shift to slightly different offsets that track cursor movement at differing amounts, so they fall out of step with one another
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The preview's image, title and number drift apart softly and continuously as the cursor moves
interaction_model.input: Pointer moving over or near a preview in the overview
interaction_model.affected_object: That preview's picture, title and number layers

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Activations made while a transition is running are ignored; the transition always completes to the focused mode
interaction_model.state_change: Overview mode transitions to focused single-work mode
interaction_model.visible_feedback: An opaque flat-toned panel, distinct from the overview surround, wipes upward until it covers the whole screen while the preview row and the tile beside it fly off the top edge; as the panel continues clearing, the chosen work's large image is revealed already in position with its number, title and note
interaction_model.input: Activating a preview in the overview
interaction_model.affected_object: The entire view: preview row, adjoining tile, opaque transition panel, chosen work's large image

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Ignored if a transition is already running; completing the reverse leaves the overview exactly as first seen
interaction_model.state_change: Focused mode transitions back to overview mode
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The wipe runs in reverse downward and the preview row is brought back down into its resting place along the bottom edge, restoring the original overview composition
interaction_model.input: Activating the tile while a work is open
interaction_model.affected_object: The focused image, the opaque transition panel and the preview row

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Drift response resumes automatically once the overview is restored
interaction_model.state_change: Drift response suspended for the duration of the focused mode
interaction_model.visible_feedback: No layer drift occurs; the focused view stays undisturbed
