interaction_model.affected_object: Preview layer drift behaviour

experience_qualities: Quiet, sparse and gallery-like rather than promotional, with a low-distraction surround
Composed stillness on arrival, with motion reserved for hover and transition
Playful, tactile looseness in the drifting preview layers
A single decisive inward pull on entering, felt as one continuous sweep rather than several separate animations
Symmetry: leaving feels precisely like the entering movement undone
Uninterrupted, never showing a half-formed or loading image
completion_and_return: Each entry has exactly one matching return that restores the overview composition unchanged
The cycle can repeat for any work, supporting one-after-another viewing
Hover drift always resolves back to rest rather than remaining offset
No transition can be left partially applied; each runs to its end state
locked_observable_requirements: Nothing is shown until every image is ready; the overview then appears complete rather than progressively
Overview reads as sparse type at readable contrast over faint vertical rules with the works held as small previews along the bottom edge
Preview hover separates picture, title and number into out-of-step offsets that follow cursor movement and ease back on exit
Entering uses a single fully opaque panel of one flat tone, clearly separated from both the overview surround and the focused image, that wipes upward and fully covers the viewport
Preview row and its adjoining tile exit upward off the top edge during the entering wipe
The focused image is already in place when the panel clears, so it is uncovered rather than loaded or scaled in
Focused view carries only ordinal number, title and one short note, kept legible over one image filling the view
The same tile is the way back, and the return is the wipe reversed downward with the preview row brought back down
Activations during any transition are ignored, and previews stop reacting while a work is open
adaptable_details: Hue, lightness and saturation of the wiping panel and of the overview surround, in any direction, so long as the panel stays fully opaque and visibly separated from both surround and focused image
Typeface, label wording, and whether a year or other short label accompanies the name
Number and aspect ratio of previews, and the exact placement of the adjoining tile
Density and visibility of the vertical rules, provided they stay quieter than the type
Timing, easing and magnitude of the drift and wipe
Subject matter of the images and the wording of the short note
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits a small, curated set of single-image works where each item deserves the full viewport and the collection can rest in one row without scrolling. It remains the same Skill for different image subjects, counts within a single row, colour treatments in any hue or lightness direction, and typography. It becomes a different Skill if the collection grows into a scrolling or paginated grid, if the detail state becomes a scrolling page with extended text or mixed media, if the transition morphs the preview into the large image instead of being masked by a full-viewport opaque covering wipe, or if the entering and returning motions are no longer mirror images of one another.

name: tilting_layered_photo_cards_with_fullscreen_takeover
description: Loosely scattered photo items, each carrying an oversized hollow word, boxed label, printer's mark, short caption and offset shadow; the pointer makes each layer drift and lean by a different amount while the photo rises from muted to full chromatic strength and the hollow word fills solid, and clicking sweeps the collection aside to give that photo the whole screen.

canonical_document.name: tilting_layered_photo_cards_with_fullscreen_takeover
canonical_document.description: Loosely scattered photo items, each carrying an oversized hollow word, boxed label, printer's mark, short caption and offset shadow; the pointer makes each layer drift and lean by a different amount while the photo rises from muted to full chromatic strength and the hollow word fills solid, and clicking sweeps the collection aside to give that photo the whole screen.
canonical_document.experience_scope: Whole-view experience: begins once all pictures are ready and the held-back page is released into the scrollable collection, covers hover reactions on every item, extends into the single-item full-screen mode, and ends when dismissal restores the collection view.
content_and_composition: Many collection items arranged in a loose, deliberately off-kilter layout rather than an aligned grid, browsed by unhurried vertical scrolling

Each item is a small stack of five to six co-located roles: the picture itself, an oversized hollow outlined word overlapping it, a small boxed label, a stray printer's/registration-style mark, a short line of copy, and an offset drop shadow behind the stack
Layer roles sit at visibly different depths so they can separate from one another under pointer movement
Pictures rest at reduced chroma, whatever their own hues are, and the oversized word rests as outline-only, so the hover state is visibly a change of material rather than only of position
Full-screen mode presents one item's larger picture plus fuller text, plus a single persistent dismiss control; no collection items are visible during this mode
The collection layout, scroll position and per-item resting state persist behind the full-screen mode
experience_progression: Page is withheld while every picture becomes ready, so the collection is first seen complete rather than filling in piecemeal
Release into unhurried browsing down the loose arrangement
Per-item hover: layers separate and lean, the picture rises to full chroma, hollow word fills solid; leaving reverses it with the shadow lagging, overshooting, then settling
Selection: the whole collection is thrown aside and the chosen item is carried forward into full-screen viewing
Dismissal: the chosen item recedes and the collection is restored exactly as it was, ready to continue browsing
attention_and_information_flow: Before release, nothing competes for attention; the complete collection arrives as one impression
During browsing, attention is spread across many equally playful items; no single item is pre-emphasised
Hover concentrates attention on one item by making it the only full-chroma, filled, three-dimensionally separated stack among muted neighbours
Selection collapses attention to a single subject and removes all competing items and decorative layers
Full-screen mode reveals information the collection withheld: a larger picture and fuller text, with only the dismiss control remaining prominent
Dismissal returns attention to the collection at the same place, so orientation is never lost

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Continuously reversible: moving back toward the item's centre reduces the effect; withdrawal returns every layer to rest
interaction_model.state_change: Each layer drifts and leans by its own amount driven by where the pointer sits inside the item, so the stack separates into depth
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Parallax-like tilt and displacement that differs per layer and tracks the pointer continuously
interaction_model.input: Pointer moving across an item, with position measured relative to that item's own bounds
interaction_model.affected_object: The item's picture, hollow word, boxed label, printer's mark and offset shadow

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Reverts to the muted picture and hollow word when the pointer leaves
interaction_model.state_change: Picture moves from reduced chroma to its own full chromatic strength; hollow word moves from outline-only to solid fill
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The photo's chroma returns and the large word visibly fills in, marking the item as active regardless of which hues the image or fill use
interaction_model.input: Pointer entering or resting on an item
interaction_model.affected_object: The item's picture and its oversized hollow word

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Interruptible: re-entering during the return picks up from the current position without a jump
interaction_model.state_change: Layers glide back to their resting offsets; the shadow trails behind, overshoots its rest position, then settles
interaction_model.visible_feedback: A soft elastic return in which the shadow is visibly the last thing to come to rest
interaction_model.input: Pointer leaving an item
interaction_model.affected_object: All of the item's layers, especially the offset shadow

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Hurried repeated activations never stack or queue transitions; additional activations during a transition are absorbed rather than compounding it
interaction_model.state_change: Collection is thrown aside out of view while the chosen item is carried forward into the full-screen view
interaction_model.visible_feedback: One coordinated transition in which the surroundings sweep away and the selected subject enlarges into an uncluttered, low-distraction full-screen presentation with fuller text
interaction_model.input: Click or activation of an item
interaction_model.affected_object: The whole collection and the chosen item

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Dismissal is the single reliable exit; repeated dismiss presses do not stack transitions, and the restored collection resumes hover behaviour immediately
interaction_model.state_change: Full-screen view recedes and the collection is restored exactly as it was
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The reverse of the opening transition: the subject returns to its place as the collection sweeps back in at the same scroll position and layout
interaction_model.input: Single dismiss control in the full-screen view
interaction_model.affected_object: The full-screen item and the set-aside collection

experience_qualities: Playful and toylike rather than tidy or systematic
Unhurried, drifting browsing pace
Physical and springy, with lag and overshoot suggesting loose weight
Tactile depth from layers separating instead of a flat surface
Calm and undivided in the full-screen mode, in deliberate contrast to the busy collection
Reassuring continuity: the collection always comes back untouched
completion_and_return: Hover states have no completion; they fully reverse to rest whenever the pointer withdraws
Full-screen viewing ends only on explicit dismissal, never on a timer
Dismissal restores the collection's exact prior layout, scroll position and resting appearance
Only one item may hold the screen at a time; opening is always paired with a return path
The experience is re-enterable indefinitely without drift or residue from previous openings
locked_observable_requirements: The collection is visually loose and off-kilter, not an aligned tidy grid
Each item is a multi-layer stack including a picture, an oversized hollow word overlapping it, a small boxed label, a stray printer's-style mark, a short line of copy and an offset shadow
Pointer position within an item drives per-layer drift and lean by differing amounts, producing visible depth separation

Hover raises the picture from reduced chroma to its full chromatic strength and fills the hollow word solid; the rest state is muted and outline-only, with the separation between the two states large enough to read at a glance under any hue choice
The return to rest is springy, with the offset shadow lagging and overshooting before settling
Selecting an item sweeps the entire collection aside and gives that item the full screen with a larger picture and fuller text
A single dismiss control reverses the transition and restores the collection exactly as it was
Repeated rapid activations never stack or queue transitions
The collection is only revealed once every picture is ready, so it is first seen complete
adaptable_details: Number of items and density of the arrangement
Exact wording of the oversized word, label and caption
Amount of tilt, drift distance, and spring stiffness or duration
Hue family, surface tones, typography and shape of the boxed label and printer's mark, and the depth of the muted rest state
Direction and choreography of the collection sweeping aside
Appearance and placement of the dismiss control
Scroll orientation and responsive rearrangement of the loose layout
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits any browsable set of image-led items with a short piece of text per item and a longer detail text worth a full-screen read — showcases, portfolios, editorial line-ups, product or project collections. It works with any host hue family, background tone or light-versus-dark treatment, since the active state is defined by a chroma and fill contrast against the rest state rather than by particular colours. It depends on each item having several separable visual and typographic parts and a rest-versus-active material change; reducing items to a single flat image with a caption, aligning them into a tidy grid, or opening details in a panel beside a still-visible collection would each produce a different Skill.

name: liquid_melt_photo_panel_story
description: Oversized photo panels alternating with flat uniform-tone text panels; pointing at a photo melts it into a second view with pixels dragging and smearing while a caption line and inline link slide in one after the other, then melts back when the pointer leaves.

canonical_document.name: liquid_melt_photo_panel_story
canonical_document.description: Oversized photo panels alternating with flat uniform-tone text panels; pointing at a photo melts it into a second view with pixels dragging and smearing while a caption line and inline link slide in one after the other, then melts back when the pointer leaves.
canonical_document.experience_scope: A whole-view sequential region: it begins after a brief quiet hold that keeps the sequence hidden until the photography is ready, then runs as the primary body of the view through an ordered series of alternating panels; each melt interaction begins and ends within a single panel and leaves the sequence unchanged.
content_and_composition: Repeating two-kind panel rhythm: full-bleed image panels alternating with flat uniform-tone panels that read as clearly separate from the imagery
Each image panel carries two photographs of the same subject: a resting first view and a second alternate view occupying the same frame
Each image panel carries a single short caption line plus one inline link, both hidden at rest and positioned as an overlay on the picture
Flat uniform-tone panels carry only short written passages, with no imagery, acting as low-distraction breathing space between pictures
Panels span the full width edge to edge with no framing chrome, gutters or thumbnails; one panel dominates the view at a time
Many image panels exist in the sequence; each is an independent unit with its own pair of views, caption and link
experience_progression: Quiet held state where nothing of the sequence is shown yet
Sequence opens and the first oversized panel takes the view
Advance through the alternating rhythm so each destination panel in turn becomes the single centre of attention, with a uniform-tone text panel resetting attention between pictures
Within a focused image panel: rest on first view, melt toward second view, second view held with caption and link present, melt back to first view so the next panel can take over
attention_and_information_flow: Only one subject is prominent at any moment; the alternating uniform-tone panels lower visual intensity between subjects
At rest an image panel shows picture only, no words, so the photograph carries all attention

Singling out a panel raises it from picture to picture-plus-story: the second view reveals more of the place while the caption line adds the only text, and the inline link appears last as the actionable element
Withdrawing attention returns the panel to picture-only, so revealed information is transient and never accumulates across panels

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: The crossing can be interrupted at any point; a reversal retargets smoothly from the current melt position instead of snapping or restarting
interaction_model.state_change: Panel crosses from its first photograph to its second photograph
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The picture melts across as a liquid transformation with pixels dragging and smearing along the direction of the crossing, rather than a plain opacity fade
interaction_model.input: Pointer moves onto an image panel
interaction_model.affected_object: That panel's photograph pair

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Leaving mid-reveal sends them back out along the same path from wherever they currently are, preserving the staggered relationship
interaction_model.state_change: Both move from hidden to present
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Caption line slides in from the side, then the inline link follows in a staggered second beat
interaction_model.input: Pointer moves onto an image panel
interaction_model.affected_object: That panel's caption line and its inline link

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Re-entering part-way through the return retargets forward again from the current point with no jump
interaction_model.state_change: Panel returns to its resting first photograph and text-free state
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The same melt runs backwards toward the original photograph while caption and link slide back out
interaction_model.input: Pointer moves away from an image panel
interaction_model.affected_object: That panel's photograph pair, caption line and inline link

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Release or interruption reverses smoothly from the reached point; the panel always resolves to one of its two stable states
interaction_model.state_change: Same forward crossing on press and same reverse crossing on release
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Identical melt, smear and staggered text slide as the pointer path produces
interaction_model.input: Press and release on a touch surface over an image panel
interaction_model.affected_object: That panel's photograph pair, caption line and inline link

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Multiple panels may be in different melt positions independently without contending for a shared state
interaction_model.state_change: No change; each panel holds its own state
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Neighbouring panels stay at their resting photographs with no words showing
interaction_model.input: Attention applied to any one panel
interaction_model.affected_object: All other panels in the sequence

experience_qualities: Calm and cinematic rather than energetic
Oversized and immersive, with pictures filling the view edge to edge
Material and tactile: the transition looks like the image is liquid, stretching and smearing rather than dissolving
Unhurried single-subject focus with deliberate pacing between subjects
Responsive and forgiving, never snapping or jumping when attention changes direction
Quiet, restrained typography that appears only on demand
completion_and_return: Every panel interaction completes by settling on one of two stable states: the original photograph with no text, or the second view with caption and link present
Withdrawing attention always returns the panel to its original photograph, so the sequence resets itself and the next subject can take over
No progress or revealed text persists after attention leaves; the sequence has no end state of its own beyond the last panel
The opening hold happens once and is not re-entered
locked_observable_requirements: Alternating rhythm of full-bleed image panels and flat uniform-tone text panels held at a lower visual intensity than the imagery
Two photographs of the same subject per image panel, with the second reachable only through attention
Transition between the two photographs rendered as a liquid melt with pixels dragging and smearing, not a plain fade or hard cut
Caption line and inline link hidden at rest and revealed by sliding in from the side in a staggered order, caption first
Withdrawal reverses the same melt back to the original photograph
Interruption mid-transition retargets continuously from the current point with no snap
Touch press and release reproduce the same forward and reverse behaviour
Panels animate independently of one another
One subject at a time is the centre of attention, with edge-to-edge panels and no framing chrome
adaptable_details: Subject matter of the photography and the wording of the short written passages
Number of panels and length of the sequence
Tone and hue chosen for the flat text panels, so long as their passages stay comfortably readable against them, and typographic treatment of captions
Direction, distance and exact easing of the melt and the caption/link slide
Duration of the melt and of the stagger between caption and link
Side from which caption and link enter
Whether the opening hold precedes the sequence and how quiet it is
Panel aspect ratio and how much vertical space each panel claims
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits any sequence of visually strong single subjects that each have a second worthwhile view and one short line of text plus one link: places, properties, projects, dishes, garments, performers. It requires large single-subject imagery and sparse text; it breaks down for dense grids of small thumbnails, data-heavy or list-like content, or items with long copy that cannot live as one caption line. Replacing the liquid melt with a plain fade, slide or hard swap, revealing text permanently instead of on attention, or making one panel's state drive the whole sequence would each create a different Skill.

name: corrupting_image_switcher_with_word_titles
description: A full-view picture set against a recessive, low-distraction surround that a visitor changes by picking one of a few one-word titles; the current image tears apart and corrupts itself for about a second before resolving cleanly into the chosen picture.

canonical_document.name: corrupting_image_switcher_with_word_titles
canonical_document.description: A full-view picture set against a recessive, low-distraction surround that a visitor changes by picking one of a few one-word titles; the current image tears apart and corrupts itself for about a second before resolving cleanly into the chosen picture.
canonical_document.experience_scope: A self-contained region or whole-view experience that begins with a quiet, image-free holding state before the imagery is ready and continues indefinitely as the visitor browses; there is no terminal state and no handoff to a following section.
content_and_composition: One dominant image occupying the primary visual area and carrying essentially all of the visual weight
A short set of one-word titles as the only text in the experience, each naming exactly one image
Exactly one title marked as active at any time, plainly enough that a first-time visitor infers the mapping without instruction
Recessive, low-distraction surrounding treatment that keeps the imagery as the only high-salience focus
Title set persists unchanged across every image change; the image layer is the only content that swaps
experience_progression: Quiet, image-free initial state held deliberately while imagery is not yet ready, with nothing popping into view
First image eased in gently through a controlled luminance transition rather than appearing abruptly, establishing the dominant picture and its active title
Settled browsing state: one image dominant, one title marked active, all titles available
On a pick: active marking moves immediately, then the visible image destabilizes, tears and corrupts
Resolution: the disturbance clears and the newly named image stands clean and dominant
Return to the settled browsing state; the loop repeats in any order the visitor chooses, with no sequence and no end
attention_and_information_flow: Attention rests on the single large image; text never competes with it
The active marking is the only status information, and it tells the visitor where they are within the set
During the change, attention is pulled to the image's breakup, so the swap itself is the momentary focus
After resolution, prominence returns fully to the new image and the marking quietly confirms the choice
No progress indicator, counter or end-of-set signal is revealed at any point

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: The transition always completes on its own and settles on the picked image; it is not reversible or cancellable mid-change, and no error or empty state is shown
interaction_model.state_change: Active marking transfers immediately to the picked title; the image enters a transition state and then becomes the named image
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Picked title is plainly marked at once, the visible image destabilizes, tears and corrupts, then resolves cleanly as the named image
interaction_model.input: Visitor picks a non-active title
interaction_model.affected_object: Active marking on the title set and the dominant image

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Once the image has settled, every title becomes selectable again, including ones already visited
interaction_model.state_change: Input is ignored outright and not queued; the running change is unaffected
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Nothing new happens; the in-progress breakup and resolution continue undisturbed
interaction_model.input: Visitor picks any title while a change is running
interaction_model.affected_object: Ongoing transition and title set

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: The experience remains fully interactive; other titles stay available
interaction_model.state_change: No state change at all
interaction_model.visible_feedback: No transition, no flicker, no re-reveal; the view stays exactly as it was
interaction_model.input: Visitor picks the already-active title
interaction_model.affected_object: Dominant image and active marking

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: The holding state simply persists until readiness; the reveal happens once and is not repeated on later changes
interaction_model.state_change: Holding state releases and the first image is eased in
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The quiet, image-free view gives way to a gentle arrival of the image rather than an abrupt appearance
interaction_model.input: Imagery becoming ready (autonomous driver)
interaction_model.affected_object: Initial quiet holding state and first image

experience_qualities: Restrained, moody and quiet, with the surround receding well behind the imagery
Deliberate and composed on arrival
Abrupt and aggressive at the moment of change, then clean and calm again
Non-linear and exploratory, with no pressure to follow an order
Minimal and text-sparse, so the imagery carries the mood
completion_and_return: No completion state and no end of sequence; browsing can continue indefinitely in any order
Each change ends by settling on a clean, fully resolved image with its title marked active
Visited titles are not consumed or dimmed out; they can be chosen again
The state persists as whichever image was last chosen, with no automatic reset or auto-advance
locked_observable_requirements: A single image dominates the view at any moment
A short set of one-word titles is the only text, and each names one image
Exactly one title is plainly marked active and the marking moves immediately on a pick, before the image resolves
The view stays quiet and image-free against a recessive surround until imagery is ready, then the first image is eased in rather than popping
Changing images visibly tears apart and corrupts the current picture before it resolves cleanly into the named one
The change lasts a little over a second, and during it further picks are ignored rather than queued
Picking the already-active title produces no visible change whatsoever
Any order of browsing is allowed, with no forced sequence and no end state
After settling, all titles including already-visited ones are selectable again
adaptable_details: Number of images and titles, as long as the set stays short
Wording of the one-word titles and the subject matter of the imagery
Placement and arrangement of the title set relative to the image
How the active marking is expressed visually
Exact texture and intensity of the corruption, and the exact duration within a roughly one-second-plus range
Precise hue and luminance of the recessive surround, and the easing used for the initial arrival
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits small curated image sets where each picture deserves the full view and a single evocative word is enough to identify it, in atmospheric hero, gallery or portfolio contexts. Turning it into a thumbnail grid or side-by-side comparison, adding captions or descriptive body text alongside the image, introducing automatic advancing or a fixed sequence with a beginning and end, or replacing the destabilize-and-resolve change with a plain crossfade or slide would each create a different Skill.

name: shard_assembly_image_stepper
description: One picture at a time coalesces into place out of thin slivers, rests with a faint restless shimmer alongside its title and count as graphic accents, then breaks into drifting slivers as the next formation gathers in its place; steps wrap endlessly in both directions.

canonical_document.name: shard_assembly_image_stepper
canonical_document.description: One picture at a time coalesces into place out of thin slivers, rests with a faint restless shimmer alongside its title and count as graphic accents, then breaks into drifting slivers as the next formation gathers in its place; steps wrap endlessly in both directions.
canonical_document.experience_scope: A single self-contained region or whole-view stage holding exactly one visible picture plus its lettering and its two edge step controls; the experience begins when the entire image set is ready, holds indefinitely while the visitor browses, and has no terminal end.
content_and_composition: One primary image occupying the central visual field, rendered as a formation of many thin slivers rather than a flat plate
One short title for the current image, presented as a graphic accent set apart from the picture rather than as a caption inside or under it
One position indicator showing the current item's number within the set, treated with the same accent-lettering role as the title
Exactly two persistent step controls, one pinned against the left edge and one against the right edge, both vertically centered at mid-height
Lettering occupies its own layer distinct from the image formation, but shares the image's assembly and dispersal behavior
Nothing else is visible before the first formation: no partial picture, placeholder, or progressive fill precedes it
experience_progression: Blank stage held until every picture in the set is ready
First picture and its lettering open out of nothing as slivers travel into register, resolving piece by piece into a coherent whole
Settled state: the formation holds legibly but keeps a faint continuous restlessness so it never reads as a frozen still
On each step, the standing formation fractures into slivers that shrink away while the incoming formation simultaneously opens out of nothing and travels into register
Cycle continues indefinitely; passing either end of the set wraps to the opposite end so browsing never reaches a dead stop
Each picture re-forms in its own recurring, recognizable sliver pattern, so returning to it feels familiar
attention_and_information_flow: Attention is first pulled by convergent sliver motion toward the center, arriving at the resolved picture as the focal point
Title and count read as secondary graphic accents that gain legibility only after the formation settles, never competing with the picture at peak motion
During a step, prominence shifts from the dispersing formation to the gathering one; the departing content loses mass and presence as the arriving content gains it
Only one image's information is legible at any moment; the set's extent is communicated solely through the position accent

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Triggering again mid-transition redirects the slivers from wherever they currently sit toward the new target, with no snap, no queued replay, and no leftover fragments
interaction_model.state_change: Current item is released and the previous item becomes current, wrapping to the last item when stepping past the beginning
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Standing picture and lettering immediately break into thin slivers that shrink to nothing while drifting away, as the previous picture's slivers open out of nothing and travel into register
interaction_model.input: Activating the left-edge step-backward control or pressing the left arrow key
interaction_model.affected_object: Current image formation and its lettering accents, plus the previous item in the set

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Rapid repeated triggering stays continuous and safe: an unfinished transition is retargeted in place rather than restarted or stacked
interaction_model.state_change: Current item is released and the next item becomes current, wrapping to the first item when stepping past the end
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Identical sliver break-up and gather-in hand-off in the opposite direction of travel through the set
interaction_model.input: Activating the right-edge step-forward control or pressing the right arrow key
interaction_model.affected_object: Current image formation and its lettering accents, plus the next item in the set

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Any step interrupts the rest motion immediately from its current appearance
interaction_model.state_change: Rest state remains active rather than static
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Faint continuous restlessness across the slivers, keeping the composition subtly alive
interaction_model.input: Idle time with no input
interaction_model.affected_object: Settled image formation and lettering

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Position in the set is never lost or reset; the same item returns after the re-form
interaction_model.state_change: Formation is rebuilt for the new dimensions while the current position in the set is preserved
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Current picture dims out and then re-forms at the new size, with edge controls remaining pinned at mid-height on both sides
