interaction_model.affected_object: Current image formation, lettering accents, and edge control placement

experience_qualities: Material and granular: images read as many thin pieces that can come apart and reconvene
Alive at rest rather than frozen
Continuous and interruptible: motion redirects instead of snapping or replaying
Endless and non-terminal: no first or last dead end
Restrained typography that behaves as ornament in motion rather than a label
completion_and_return: No completion state; the experience loops through the set indefinitely in both directions
Each item's formation pattern recurs consistently on every return to it
Interruption resolves into the newest target formation, always ending in a single settled restless composition
Viewing-area changes reset only geometry, never position within the set
locked_observable_requirements: Exactly one image visible at a time, with its title and its ordinal position shown as separate graphic accents
Nothing is displayed until the whole set is ready; the first appearance is already a full formation-in-progress, not a partial page
Appearance and disappearance happen as many thin slivers travelling into or out of register, never as a plain fade, cut, or slide of a whole plate
Outgoing dispersal and incoming gathering overlap as one hand-off
Settled state retains a faint ongoing motion
Two step controls pinned at left and right edges at mid-height, mirrored exactly by left/right arrow keys
Stepping past either end wraps to the opposite end
Mid-transition input redirects from current sliver positions with no snapping, queueing, or orphaned fragments
Viewing-area change dims out and re-forms the current item at the new size without changing which item is current
Each item's sliver pattern is stable and recognizable across repeat visits
adaptable_details: Number of images in the set
Sliver thickness, count, orientation, drift direction and travel distance
Duration and easing of dispersal, gathering, and re-form after resizing
Amplitude and character of the restless rest motion
Typographic style, size and exact placement of the title and position accents
Visual form of the two step controls
Subject matter of the pictures
Whether additional step inputs beyond edge controls and arrow keys are offered
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits any small-to-moderate curated set of single full-view still images with a short title and a position cue, where the transition itself is meant to be noticed. Showing multiple items at once, adding thumbnails or a visible track, replacing the sliver dispersal with a whole-image fade or slide, letting the set end instead of wrap, or driving it with continuous drag or scroll position instead of discrete steps would each produce a different Skill.

name: scroll_tracked_decoding_title_showcase
description: Large works advance one at a time as you scroll while a single oversized title, always in the same low spot on screen, decodes character by character out of flickering random symbols to name whichever work is currently dominant.

canonical_document.name: scroll_tracked_decoding_title_showcase
canonical_document.description: Large works advance one at a time as you scroll while a single oversized title, always in the same low spot on screen, decodes character by character out of flickering random symbols to name whichever work is currently dominant.
canonical_document.experience_scope: Whole-view, whole-page experience: begins at a full-height opening panel, runs through the sequence of work sections, and ends at a full-height closing contact panel. The title slot is a persistent overlay region that lives across the entire scroll rather than inside any one section.
content_and_composition: One full-height opening panel containing only two text roles: a large personal or brand identifier and a small section label; no imagery, deliberately sparse
A middle sequence of several work sections (typically 3–12), each dominated by one large image occupying most of the viewport height
Exactly one title element visible at any moment, oversized relative to all other type, fixed at the same low position on the screen and shared by every work section rather than duplicated per section
One full-height closing contact panel that reads as a terminal statement rather than another work
Minimal supporting chrome; the composition's weight is carried by full-bleed imagery plus the single persistent title
experience_progression: Quiet typographic opening: identifier and label only, no work visible yet, establishing a restrained tone
Entry into the work sequence: the first work becomes dominant and its title decodes into the previously empty title slot
Linear advance: each subsequent work becomes dominant in turn, its title replacing the previous one in the same slot with a fresh decode
Reverse traversal: scrolling back up re-activates earlier works and replays the identical decode, so a second pass is indistinguishable from the first
Close: the contact panel takes over the full height and the work-title rhythm ends, signalling the sequence is finished
attention_and_information_flow: The opening withholds all work imagery so attention rests entirely on type before the sequence starts
Imagery carries visual weight; the fixed title slot carries identification, so the eye learns one place to look for 'what am I seeing'
Each transition briefly spikes attention at the title slot: noise appears, then resolves into readable words, pulling the eye down to confirm the current item
Only one item is named at a time, so the current work is never ambiguous and no competing labels dilute focus
The closing panel drops the per-item naming rhythm entirely, which reads as an end-of-sequence signal

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Activation is fully driven by scroll position, so the user can stop, hold or reverse at any time; the currently active title stays legible whenever scrolling pauses
interaction_model.state_change: That section becomes the single active item; the previous item is deactivated
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The outgoing title disappears instantly with no fade or crossfade, and the incoming title resolves in place character by character, each character flashing one or more random symbols before snapping to its real glyph
interaction_model.input: Vertical scrolling that makes a new section dominantly occupy the view
interaction_model.affected_object: The shared oversized title slot and the newly dominant section

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: No 'already seen' shortcut or reduced variant; repeat passes remain visually identical, so backtracking is never penalised or confusing
interaction_model.state_change: The earlier item becomes active again as if seen for the first time
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The same character-by-character decode replays in full, identical to the original arrival
interaction_model.input: Scrolling back upward to an earlier section
interaction_model.affected_object: Earlier work titles

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: The newest dominant item always wins; rapid direction changes cannot accumulate overlapping or leftover text states
interaction_model.state_change: The unfinished decode is cut short and abandoned when a newer item takes over
interaction_model.visible_feedback: No scrambled or half-resolved text is ever left stranded on screen; the slot shows either a fully resolved title or the decode of the current item
interaction_model.input: Fast scrolling that races past an item before its decode finishes
interaction_model.affected_object: The in-progress decoding title

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Scrolling back into the sequence re-activates the nearest work with a normal decode
interaction_model.state_change: No work is active while a bookend panel dominates the view
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The work title slot holds no work name; the panel's own sparse type occupies the view, giving a clear start and a clear end
interaction_model.input: Scrolling into the opening or closing full-height panel
interaction_model.affected_object: The title slot and the panel content

experience_qualities: Quiet, restrained and typographic overall, with imagery doing the showing and type doing the naming
Machine-like, decoding-readout texture in the moment of each reveal, contrasted against otherwise still composition
Unambiguous: one name, one place, one current item
Rhythmic and predictable, so the page feels navigable rather than surprising after the first transition
Tidy under fast input: never leaves visual debris
completion_and_return: The closing full-height contact panel is the definitive end state; nothing loops back to the first work automatically
Returning upward restores earlier states exactly, with full decode replay rather than a persisted 'already revealed' state
No progress is memorised: the experience is a pure function of current scroll position
Interrupted decodes resolve into the current item's finished title rather than remaining partial
locked_observable_requirements: A full-height opening panel holding only a primary identifier and a small section label, with no work imagery
Exactly one title visible at a time, always in the same fixed low screen position, shared across all items
The title is oversized relative to every other text element
Item activation is determined by which section dominantly occupies the view while scrolling
Incoming titles resolve character by character, each character flashing random symbols before snapping to its real glyph
The outgoing title is removed instantly, with no fade, slide or crossfade overlap
Reverse scrolling replays the identical decode for earlier items
Fast pass-through truncates the unfinished decode so no scrambled residue remains on screen
A full-height closing panel terminates the sequence and clearly reads as the end
adaptable_details: Number of work items and their order
Typeface, weight, casing and exact type scale
The pool of symbols used during the noise moment
Decode duration, per-character stagger and number of flickers before settling
Exact low offset and horizontal alignment of the title slot
Hue choices across imagery, type and surround, image aspect ratios and framing (full-bleed versus inset)
Wording of the section label and the content of the closing panel
Whether each work section carries any small secondary metadata
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits image-led item sequences with short, headline-length names — creative work, products, projects, chapters — presented on a page tall enough that one item at a time can dominate the viewport. It stops being this Skill if multiple item labels are visible at once, if the title is inline within each section instead of a single fixed slot, if titles become multi-line descriptive copy that cannot survive character-level scrambling, or if advancement is driven by discrete clicks or slides rather than continuous scroll dominance.

name: banded_curtain_photo_stepper
description: One large photograph at a time, changed by opaque bands that sweep across to hide it completely and then sweep away to unveil the next image as it eases down from slightly enlarged, with a small numbered marker row showing how many there are and which is in view, and endless wraparound stepping.

canonical_document.name: banded_curtain_photo_stepper
canonical_document.description: One large photograph at a time, changed by opaque bands that sweep across to hide it completely and then sweep away to unveil the next image as it eases down from slightly enlarged, with a small numbered marker row showing how many there are and which is in view, and endless wraparound stepping.
canonical_document.experience_scope: A self-contained region built around one large image frame plus its marker row; it begins with a composed arrival in which the first photograph is uncovered rather than simply shown, and it continues indefinitely as the visitor steps or jumps between images, with no terminal state.
content_and_composition: One dominant photograph occupying the main frame, only ever one visible at rest
A small finite set of photographs of equal weight, typically a handful, all sharing the same frame
An overlay layer of fully opaque bands that sits above the photograph during changes and is absent at rest
A persistent compact row of numeric markers, one per photograph, matching the set size and ordering
The marker corresponding to the image in view is visually highlighted and clearly distinct from the rest
Marker row is spatially separate from and subordinate to the photograph, present at all times including during a change
experience_progression: Arrival: the region presents itself as already composed, with no partially assembled or half-ready state visible
Opening reveal: the first photograph is unveiled by the covering layer clearing away rather than appearing outright
Rest: a single photograph is fully visible with its marker highlighted and no overlay present
Change stage one: fully opaque bands travel across the visible photograph until it is entirely hidden
Change stage two: the bands sweep away, exposing the newly chosen photograph beneath
Change stage three: the incoming photograph eases down from a slightly enlarged state to its resting size, settling into rest
Loop: stepping past either end continues into the opposite end of the set, so the sequence never dead-ends
attention_and_information_flow: Attention is held on one large photograph for as long as the visitor stays, with nothing competing for the same visual weight
During a change the overlay bands briefly become the focus, deliberately withholding the image before granting it
The reveal returns attention to the photograph, and the slight settling motion draws the eye inward as it lands
Set size and current position remain continuously readable from the marker row, so the visitor always knows how much remains
The target marker highlights immediately on choice, confirming intent before the new photograph is visible

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Choosing the photograph already in view does nothing; choices made while a change is running are ignored so transitions never overlap; the visitor can choose again once the region is at rest
interaction_model.state_change: Direct jump from the currently shown photograph to the chosen one, regardless of distance in the set
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Chosen marker highlights at once, bands sweep across to fully cover the current photograph, then sweep away to expose the chosen one as it eases down from slightly enlarged
interaction_model.input: Choosing a specific numeric marker from the row
interaction_model.affected_object: The main photograph frame and the marker row

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Key presses during an in-progress change are ignored rather than queued; stepping has no boundary to bump against because both ends wrap
interaction_model.state_change: Step one position backward or forward through the set, continuing past either end into the opposite end
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The same cover-then-unveil band sequence plays and the newly current marker becomes the highlighted one
interaction_model.input: Left or right arrow key
interaction_model.affected_object: The main photograph frame and the marker row

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: The opening reveal completes on its own and leaves the region at rest, ready for input
interaction_model.state_change: From concealed to revealed initial state
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The first photograph is uncovered by the bands clearing away instead of appearing already displayed, and nothing in the region is seen in a half-ready state
interaction_model.input: Entering or first seeing the region
interaction_model.affected_object: The first photograph and the covering band layer

experience_qualities: Composed and intentional from the first moment, never piecemeal
Slow and graphic rather than quick and utilitarian
Each change reads as a deliberate covering then unveiling with its own rhythm
Confident and uninterrupted, since overlapping or half-covered states never occur
Endless and circular, with no sense of reaching an end
completion_and_return: Each change completes at a stable rest state with one fully visible photograph, no overlay, and one highlighted marker
The set loops in both directions, so browsing can keep circling back to the beginning
Current position persists between changes and is always mirrored by the highlighted marker
There is no final or closing state; the region simply waits at rest for the next choice
locked_observable_requirements: Exactly one photograph fully visible at rest, at large scale
Every change is a two-part sequence: fully opaque bands completely conceal the outgoing image before the incoming one is exposed
The incoming photograph arrives from a slightly enlarged state and eases down to its resting size
A persistent marker row reveals the total count and the current position, with the current marker highlighted in a way plainly separable from the unhighlighted ones
The target marker highlights immediately on choice, before the new photograph is visible
Both direct jumping to any position and one-step backward/forward movement are available
Stepping wraps at both ends with no dead end
Inputs during an in-progress change are ignored, and re-selecting the current photograph does nothing
No half-covered or partially revealed resting state is ever left on screen
The first photograph is unveiled by the covering layer clearing rather than simply appearing, with no half-ready arrival
adaptable_details: Number of photographs in the set
Number, thickness, orientation and travel direction of the bands, and whether they move in unison or in a staggered rhythm
Band fill treatment — any hue, tone or texture is acceptable so long as it is fully opaque and hides the image beneath
Duration and easing of the cover, unveil and settle stages
Amount of initial enlargement on the incoming image
Visual style, shape and placement of the marker row and the treatment used to distinguish its highlighted marker
Frame aspect ratio and how images fill it
Additional equivalent stepping inputs alongside arrow keys and markers
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits small curated sets of full-frame visual items of roughly equal importance, where each deserves sustained attention and the change between them should feel staged; the images can be swapped for any full-frame visual content, and the bands and markers can take on any host styling, without changing identity. It stops being this Skill if many items must be compared side by side or scanned as a grid, if the set becomes long or continuously scrolled so position markers lose meaning, if changes must be fast and unobtrusive or continuously scrubbable, if the transition is reduced to a plain crossfade or slide with no full concealment stage, or if per-item narrative text or captions become the primary content driving progression.

name: glitch_focus_image_sequence
description: A staggered column of large captioned images where the focused one tears into reshuffling slices with hard high-contrast flashes and stutters out a hidden second caption line, returning to a clean still on release.

canonical_document.name: glitch_focus_image_sequence
canonical_document.description: A staggered column of large captioned images where the focused one tears into reshuffling slices with hard high-contrast flashes and stutters out a hidden second caption line, returning to a clean still on release.
canonical_document.experience_scope: A region-level experience covering the whole showcase sequence: it begins with a brief hold before the sequence appears and softly settles into view, continues for as long as the visitor moves through the images, and ends only when the visitor leaves the sequence. Each individual image's transformation is a self-contained episode inside that region, bounded strictly by pointer presence on that image.
content_and_composition: A small, finite set of large images (a handful rather than a dense grid), each occupying enough of the view that only one is fully dominant at a time
Each image carries a bold primary name rendered over or against it, plus a second, initially hidden caption line belonging to the same name block
Images are horizontally offset from one another down the sequence so no two are equally weighted in the same glance
Vertical arrangement requiring scroll to reach the remaining images; no thumbnail rail, counter or navigation chrome is required
A quiet, low-distraction surrounding field held clearly apart from the images' own tonal range, so image edges and flashes read strongly against it
Caption text sits as an overlay layer above the image but is transparent to the pointer, so the entire image area behaves as one continuous focus target
experience_progression: Entry hold: the sequence is withheld briefly, nothing partially formed or jumping is shown
Settle: the sequence appears and eases softly into its resting composition
Browse: the visitor advances downward, each offset image taking its turn as the dominant piece
Per-image episode: focus begins the unstable state, sustains it while focus is held, and ends it immediately on release, with no carry-over between episodes
attention_and_information_flow: Offsetting plus image scale keeps prominence on a single piece at a time as the visitor advances
Focus sharply escalates the prominence of one image by making it the only moving, flashing element in an otherwise still, visually quiet view
The hidden second caption line is the only new information the experience reveals, and it is available exclusively during focus
Release collapses prominence back to parity, restoring a calm reading of the composition

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: The unstable state persists only while the pointer remains; it is fully bounded to that one image and never affects neighbours
interaction_model.state_change: Image moves from clean resting still into a sustained unstable state; the second caption line moves from hidden to shown
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The image tears into horizontally displaced slices that keep reshuffling, punctuated by hard flashes that jump far in luminance from the resting image; the second caption line arrives with one quick stutter
interaction_model.input: Pointer coming to rest anywhere over an image
interaction_model.affected_object: The focused image and its caption block

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Interruption at any point in the episode is safe; nothing accumulates, and re-entering restarts the full response from its beginning
interaction_model.state_change: Unstable state ends at once and the resting state is restored; second caption line returns to hidden
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The clean, whole still image snaps back with no residual displacement, colour shift or offset; the extra caption line disappears instantly with no fade-out
interaction_model.input: Pointer leaving the image
interaction_model.affected_object: The previously focused image and its caption block

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Text is never a dead zone or a separate target; the whole image face behaves as one region
interaction_model.state_change: No change — focus is unbroken
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The unstable state continues uninterrupted; no flicker or drop-out where text overlaps the image
interaction_model.input: Pointer moving over caption text lying on the image
interaction_model.affected_object: Focus target of the image

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Freely reversible in both directions; any image can be revisited and re-triggered as many times as desired with an identical response
interaction_model.state_change: Later images come into reach and take their turn as the dominant piece
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Offset images advance into view against the quiet surrounding field
interaction_model.input: Scrolling
interaction_model.affected_object: The sequence position

experience_qualities: Moody and cinematic at rest, with a hushed, low-distraction surround
Electric and unstable under focus, like a signal breaking up
Harsh and percussive rather than smooth, thanks to the flashes and reshuffling
Instant and clean on release, giving a sense of crisp control
Stateless and repeatable, so exploration feels consequence-free
completion_and_return: No end state or completion reward; the sequence simply runs out of images
Each focus episode loops its instability for as long as focus is held
Release is a hard reset to the exact resting appearance, leaving no trace
No visited, seen or persistent marks are kept on any image between episodes
locked_observable_requirements: One focused image at a time is transformed; unfocused images stay clean and still
The transformation must read as torn, displaced slices that keep reshuffling, not as a smooth scale, blur or overall tonal wash
Hard, abrupt flashes of high luminance contrast against the resting image punctuate the unstable state
A second caption line exists, is hidden at rest, and appears only during focus with a quick stuttered entrance
Release restores the clean whole image and hides the second line immediately, with no lingering artefacts and nothing accumulated
Re-entering focus replays the entire response from the start
Overlaid caption text never intercepts the pointer, so any point on the image sustains focus
Images are offset from one another so attention rarely lands on two at once
Nothing of the sequence is shown until it can appear settled, after which it eases in softly
adaptable_details: Number of images beyond a small handful
Slice thickness, displacement distance, reshuffle rate and flash frequency or luminance amplitude
Direction and magnitude of the horizontal offsets
Typeface, size, colour and placement of the name block within or beside the image
Exact wording of the primary and secondary caption lines
Duration and easing of the initial settle
Exact tone, hue and texture of the surrounding field, as long as it stays low-distraction and clearly separated from the images
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits small, curated sets of large single-subject visuals with short titles and an optional secondary line, presented as the main body of a page in an expressive register with a quiet, low-distraction surround. Making the unstable state persistent or click-latched, running it on all items at once without pointer focus, applying it to dense grids or thumbnail sets where several items are equally prominent, or replacing torn-slice displacement and flashing with smooth motion would each produce a different Skill.

name: live_sketched_subject_with_roll_off_handoff
description: One large line-drawn subject sketches itself into existence with restless, incomplete strokes that grow steadier until the drawing locks crisp and colour-complete; picking another entry tips the finished drawing up and rolls it off-screen, then the new subject enters from a corner and redraws itself in its own distinct colour identity — any hue set, so long as it reads as that entry's own — with its name taking over as the active label.

canonical_document.name: live_sketched_subject_with_roll_off_handoff
canonical_document.description: One large line-drawn subject sketches itself into existence with restless, incomplete strokes that grow steadier until the drawing locks crisp and colour-complete; picking another entry tips the finished drawing up and rolls it off-screen, then the new subject enters from a corner and redraws itself in its own distinct colour identity — any hue set, so long as it reads as that entry's own — with its name taking over as the active label.
canonical_document.experience_scope: A region-scale showcase stage occupying the dominant area of the view, plus its adjacent selectable lineup and persistent caption text. Begins automatically on view open with the featured subject sketching itself in, and each cycle ends when the subject has locked into its settled finished state; the experience continues indefinitely as further selections are made.
content_and_composition: Exactly one showcased line-drawn subject at a time, centred and the largest element on the stage
A lineup of selectable entries (typically several, small and secondary) from which the showcased subject is chosen; exactly one is marked active at any moment
An active label naming the currently showcased entry, changing in step with the subject
Persistent supporting text set — a title, a year or edition marker, and short descriptive detail lines — held quietly readable at low prominence and unchanged across swaps

Layering: subject artwork on the foreground stage layer; supporting text and lineup on a stable, low-distraction surrounding frame layer that never animates with the subject and stays separated enough from the artwork for the linework to read clearly
Per-entry colour identity applied to the finished subject artwork — each entry distinguishable from the others, with no particular hues required
experience_progression: Stage 1 — unsettled sketching: strokes appear incomplete and restless, visibly in flux, as if being drawn at that moment
Stage 2 — steadying: the jitter and incompleteness reduce progressively, outlines converge toward their true shape
Stage 3 — lock: linework snaps to crisp final form and the artwork fills in to full colour completeness, producing a clearly settled resting state that reads as the payoff
Stage 4 — hold: the finished drawing rests unchanged until another entry is chosen
Stage 5 — departure (on selection): the finished drawing tips up and travels off the edge of the stage
Stage 6 — arrival: the newly chosen subject enters from a corner of the stage, then repeats stages 1–4 in its own colour identity
attention_and_information_flow: Attention is pulled to the stage centre by the motion and instability of the unfinished linework, and rewarded by the still, colour-complete finished state
The showcased subject remains unmistakably the primary focus at every moment, including mid-handover
Supporting title, year and detail text stays legible but deliberately subordinate, never competing with the subject and never interrupted by the reveal
Identity information resolves progressively: shape emerges first as line, then colour identity, with the active name label confirming which entry is on show
The lineup communicates state through prominence only — the active entry reads as selected, the rest read as available

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Runs once to completion on its own; if interrupted by a selection it hands off rather than aborting into an unfinished resting state
interaction_model.state_change: From absent to sketching, then to steadied, then to locked finished drawing
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Restless partial strokes that firm up into a crisp, colour-complete illustration while the surrounding text stays static
interaction_model.input: View opens (autonomous driver, no user action)
interaction_model.affected_object: The default featured subject on the stage

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: The full out-and-in sequence always runs to a settled finished state; it is never left partially complete
interaction_model.state_change: Current subject transitions out, chosen subject becomes active and transitions in, then completes its own sketch-to-locked sequence
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Finished drawing tips up and rolls off-screen, chosen subject rides in from a corner and redraws itself in its own colour identity, the new name replaces the previous active label, and the lineup's active marker moves
interaction_model.input: Selecting an inactive entry from the lineup
interaction_model.affected_object: Showcased subject, active label, lineup selection marker

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Deliberately inert so the resting state is never disturbed without a change of subject
interaction_model.state_change: None
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Nothing changes; the settled drawing stays as it is
interaction_model.input: Selecting the entry already on show
interaction_model.affected_object: Showcased subject

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Selection becomes available again once the current subject has locked into its finished state
interaction_model.state_change: Ignored; the running sequence continues undisturbed
interaction_model.visible_feedback: No second subject appears and no restart occurs — only one departure/arrival/redraw is ever visible at once
interaction_model.input: Selecting any entry while a hand-off is still running
interaction_model.affected_object: In-progress hand-off sequence

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Reverts immediately when the pointer leaves; the active entry does not respond to hover
interaction_model.state_change: From at-rest to hinted-as-selectable
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The entry steps down slightly in luminance, reading as dimmed relative to its at-rest state
interaction_model.input: Hover over an inactive lineup entry
interaction_model.affected_object: The hovered lineup entry

experience_qualities: Handmade and in-progress: the subject reads as being drawn live rather than displayed
Restless then resolved — instability that visibly earns a calm, crisp payoff
Deliberate and paced, with a physical roll-off and ride-in that give the swap weight
Orderly: exactly one thing happening at a time, never overlapping or stuttering
Egalitarian — every entry receives an identical hand-off and identical reveal, differing only in its colour identity and name
completion_and_return: Each cycle completes in a stable, fully drawn, colour-complete resting state that persists indefinitely
No automatic looping or auto-advance; further motion happens only on selection
The selected entry persists as the active subject and active label until another is chosen
Reopening the view restarts from the default featured subject's sketch-in reveal
locked_observable_requirements: The subject must visibly progress from unfinished, unsteady linework to a crisp, colour-complete locked state, with the settled state clearly reading as the reward and the linework holding readable contrast against whatever stage surround is used
Exactly one showcased subject is visible at any time, and it is always the dominant focus
Changing subjects must show a departure of the outgoing drawing off the stage followed by an arrival of the incoming one, not an instant replacement or crossfade

The incoming subject must perform the same sketch-to-locked reveal as the initial one, in its own colour identity — hues chosen freely, only distinctness from the other entries matters — with its name shown as the active label
Selecting the already-showcased entry, or selecting during a hand-off, must produce no change so sequences never overlap or restart
Supporting title, edition/year and detail text remains continuously readable and visually subordinate throughout every stage
Inactive lineup entries give a hover hint through a slight, controlled drop in luminance
adaptable_details: Subject matter of the illustration and the type of roster it belongs to
Number of selectable entries and whether the lineup sits alongside, below or around the stage
Exact durations, easing and degree of jitter in the unsettled stage
Which corner or edge is used for arrival and departure, and the amount of tipping rotation

Line weight, stroke texture, the specific hues making up each entry's colour identity, and the surround treatment — light or dark, provided it stays low-distraction and separated enough for the linework to read
Wording and arrangement of the persistent supporting text
Whether selection happens by clicking thumbnails, names or another compact list form
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits any set of comparable single-subject illustrations or line-based graphics — vehicles, products, garments, tools, mascots, landmarks, portraits — where each entry deserves an identical, ceremonious individual reveal and only one is shown at a time, supported by light persistent caption text, and where each entry can carry some distinguishing colour identity of its own regardless of which hues the host site uses. Replacing the draw-in-then-lock reveal with an immediate static swap, showing several subjects simultaneously or in a grid, allowing overlapping or restartable hand-offs, or moving the animated artwork behind foreground content as a decorative substrate would each create a different Skill.

name: liquid_drift_fullscreen_photo_stepper
description: One photograph fills the whole screen and never sits perfectly still, drifting with a slow liquid shimmer; clicking an edge arrow makes it dissolve into the neighbouring photo through a surge of watery warping that then calms back to the same gentle drift, wrapping around forever in both directions.

canonical_document.name: liquid_drift_fullscreen_photo_stepper
canonical_document.description: One photograph fills the whole screen and never sits perfectly still, drifting with a slow liquid shimmer; clicking an edge arrow makes it dissolve into the neighbouring photo through a surge of watery warping that then calms back to the same gentle drift, wrapping around forever in both directions.
canonical_document.experience_scope: Whole-view experience occupying the entire viewport for the duration of browsing; begins when the first photograph is displayed and continues indefinitely with no terminal state, since the sequence loops in both directions. Can also be deployed as a self-contained full-bleed region that owns its whole area.
content_and_composition: Exactly one photograph visible at a time, scaled to fill the entire viewport edge to edge with no letterboxing gaps
A small ordered set of photographs (a handful) treated as equal peers with no hierarchy or featured item
No captions, counters, titles, thumbnails or decorative chrome competing with the image surface
Two persistent stepping arrows as the only overlaid elements: one pinned at the left edge, one at the right edge, both vertically centred

Layer relationship: image surface as the sole content plane; arrows float above it as a thin persistent control layer; during a change the outgoing and incoming images occupy the same full-screen plane and intermix rather than sitting side by side
experience_progression: Resting state: the visible photograph is continuously animated by a slow, barely perceptible liquid drift so the surface always looks alive while the viewer lingers
On a directional step: warping intensity surges and the current photograph appears to liquefy
Mid-step: the liquefied surface bleeds into the neighbouring photograph so the two read as one flowing material rather than two stacked pictures
Settling: the warping decays back to the calm ambient drift, now carrying the newly arrived photograph
The sequence advances endlessly, returning to the resting state after every step, with no beginning or end reachable
attention_and_information_flow: Attention rests entirely on the image surface because nothing else holds visual weight
The ambient drift sustains low-level attention during dwell without pulling focus away from the picture
A step temporarily moves attention to the motion itself, which is the loudest moment of the experience, then hands attention back to the newly revealed photograph as motion decays
Arrows stay quietly available at the extreme edges, readable as the only offered action without drawing attention inward
Only one image's information is ever available at once; neighbouring content is never previewed or indexed

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Runs indefinitely without user control; unaffected by dwell time and resumed automatically after every step completes
interaction_model.state_change: Never fully static; the surface is perpetually and subtly deformed over time
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Slow, barely perceptible liquid drift across the image, low enough in amplitude that the photograph remains clearly legible
interaction_model.input: Autonomous continuous driver while a photograph is at rest
interaction_model.affected_object: The full-screen photograph surface

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Starts without delay on click; the step always runs to completion and cannot be cancelled or reversed mid-flight; the calm resting state is the guaranteed recovery point
interaction_model.state_change: Immediately enters a directional handover toward the following image, then returns to the resting drift state carrying the new image
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Warping surges, the current image liquefies and bleeds forward into the next, then the turbulence settles back to calm drift
interaction_model.input: Click on the right-edge arrow
interaction_model.affected_object: Current photograph and the next photograph in the sequence

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Same completion guarantee as the forward step; direction is the only difference in outcome
interaction_model.state_change: Immediately enters the same handover in the backward direction, then returns to the resting drift state
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Identical liquefying and bleeding treatment resolved toward the previous image, settling back to calm
interaction_model.input: Click on the left-edge arrow
interaction_model.affected_object: Current photograph and the preceding photograph in the sequence

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Input becomes effective again once the surface has returned to rest, so rapid clicking can never stack, stutter or leave a half-warped surface
interaction_model.state_change: No state change; the extra input is discarded rather than queued or overlapped
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Nothing new happens; the running effect continues undisturbed to its clean settle
interaction_model.input: Additional clicks on either arrow while a handover is still running
interaction_model.affected_object: The in-progress handover

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Both arrows remain permanently active, so the run feels endless in either direction
interaction_model.state_change: Wraps to the opposite end of the set instead of stopping
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The same liquid handover in the requested direction, with no edge resistance, disabled arrow or dead-end cue
interaction_model.input: Forward click while the last photograph is shown, or backward click while the first is shown
interaction_model.affected_object: Sequence position

experience_qualities: Immersive and exhibition-like, with the image given the whole screen
Alive and breathing rather than static, even when untouched
Fluid and material, as if the photographs were surfaces of liquid
Deliberate and clean, since every step resolves fully before another can begin
Endless and unbounded, with no sense of reaching a first or last item
completion_and_return: Each step completes by fully settling into the calm ambient drift of the newly shown photograph
There is no end state; the sequence loops continuously in both directions
The resting drift is the single stable state the experience always returns to
No progress, position or history is surfaced to the viewer between steps
locked_observable_requirements: One photograph at a time filling the entire viewport with nothing else competing for attention
The resting image is never completely still; a slow, barely perceptible liquid drift persists continuously
Advancing reads as the current image liquefying and bleeding into the neighbour through a surge of watery warping, not as a cut, fade or geometric slide
The warp surge decays back to the same calm ambient drift after every step
Exactly two stepping affordances, one at the left edge and one at the right edge, vertically centred
A step begins immediately on click and always runs to a clean completion
Inputs arriving during a step are ignored, never queued or overlapped
The sequence wraps in both directions with no reachable dead end
adaptable_details: Number of images in the set, as long as it stays a small browsable handful
Subject matter and aspect ratios of the images
Visual styling, size and hover treatment of the two edge arrows
Duration, intensity, turbulence character and directional bias of the warp surge
Amplitude and speed of the ambient drift, provided it stays subtle
Addition of equivalent directional inputs such as keyboard or swipe that behave identically, including the ignore-while-running rule
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits small sets of standalone full-bleed visuals that are meant to be viewed one at a time with minimal or no accompanying text, such as photographic showcases, hero sequences or dedicated viewing modes. It stops being this Skill if several images are shown at once in a grid or filmstrip, if text, captions or interface panels become primary content over the image, if the handover is replaced by a non-fluid treatment such as a hard cut, cross-fade or geometric slide, if the resting image is allowed to be fully static, if stepping is driven by autoplay or scroll instead of discrete directional clicks, or if the sequence gains explicit ends with disabled arrows.

name: shattering_tile_portrait_spotlight
description: A single large portrait holds the stage next to a marked list of names; choosing another name shatters the picture into a dense field of small rectangles that scatter and fade, then new rectangles rush up from below and lock into the next complete picture, while the image leans gently with the cursor as if it were a living surface.

canonical_document.name: shattering_tile_portrait_spotlight
canonical_document.description: A single large portrait holds the stage next to a marked list of names; choosing another name shatters the picture into a dense field of small rectangles that scatter and fade, then new rectangles rush up from below and lock into the next complete picture, while the image leans gently with the cursor as if it were a living surface.
canonical_document.experience_scope: A region experience occupying the main content area: one dominant image panel plus an adjacent selection list. It begins when all images are ready and the first image opens complete, and it has no end state; it remains available for repeated exchanges as long as the region is on screen.
content_and_composition: One dominant image panel that visually owns most of the region and is always shown as a single clean, complete picture at rest
One adjacent roster of selectable entries, each carrying a short primary label and a secondary descriptor, ordered and fully visible without needing the image to change
Exactly one roster entry is marked as active at any time, always matching the picture on screen
A transient layer of many small rectangular fragments that tile the image area only during an exchange, replacing the single picture with a dense grid-like field
Persistent elements across exchanges: the panel's position and footprint, the roster and its order, and the surrounding layout
experience_progression: Quiet held entry state with no partial or blank picture, resolving into the first complete image
Resting state: one complete picture plus one marked roster entry
Exchange stage one: the visible picture fragments into small rectangles that fly apart upward and sideways, tumble slightly and fade away
Exchange stage two: fragments carrying the newly chosen picture rush in from below and lock together into one seamless image
Return to resting state with the new picture and the new active marking; the cycle repeats in any order, with no overall completion or sequence
attention_and_information_flow: The large picture is the primary attention anchor; the roster is the secondary, always-legible index of what else exists
During an exchange, attention is pulled to the outgoing and incoming motion, which is brief enough that the region never reads as empty or broken
The active marking in the roster and the picture on screen always agree, so identity of the current subject is never ambiguous
Names and descriptors stay readable throughout; the exchange reveals a new subject's likeness rather than new text hidden elsewhere
Cursor-driven leaning adds low-level liveliness without competing with the picture or the roster for attention

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: The exchange runs to completion on its own; selections made while it is in progress are ignored, and the region always settles on one complete picture matching the marked entry
interaction_model.state_change: Resting single picture becomes a transient fragment field, then resolves to a new resting single picture; active marking moves to the chosen entry
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The visible picture breaks into a dense field of small rectangles that fly apart upward and sideways, tumble slightly and fade out; fragments then rush in from below carrying the new picture and lock together into one clean image, while emphasis in the roster shifts to the chosen entry
interaction_model.input: Selecting an entry in the roster that is not the current one
interaction_model.affected_object: The dominant image panel and the roster's active marking

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: The no-op is silent, leaving the resting state and the existing marking untouched
interaction_model.state_change: No state change
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Nothing changes; the picture stays whole and still
interaction_model.input: Selecting the entry already on show
interaction_model.affected_object: The dominant image panel

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Fully continuous and reversible; motion always eases to a settled orientation, never accumulates, and does not block or interfere with an exchange
interaction_model.state_change: Resting orientation shifts continuously toward a tilt and slight offset that follow the pointer position
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The picture leans and drifts a little, reading as a slightly living, dimensional surface rather than a flat panel, and settles smoothly wherever the pointer comes to rest
interaction_model.input: Pointer movement across the region or page (autonomous of selection)
interaction_model.affected_object: The whole picture as a single three-dimensional-feeling surface

experience_qualities: Abrupt and physical rather than soft or dissolving
Quick enough to feel effortless and repeatable
Never ambiguous about which subject is currently shown
Dense, granular, particle-like breakup with a sense of weight and direction
Subtly alive and dimensional at rest
Free and non-linear: any subject reachable at any time, in any order
completion_and_return: There is nothing to finish; the experience has no terminal or reward state
Every exchange returns to the same kind of resting state: one complete picture plus one matching active marking
The current selection persists until the visitor changes it; there is no auto-advance and no reset to a default subject
The pointer-driven lean always resolves to a settled orientation rather than remaining in motion
locked_observable_requirements: One dominant image at a time, shown as a single seamless picture whenever at rest
A persistent adjacent list of selectable labeled entries with exactly one clearly marked active entry that always matches the visible image

Image change occurs through a two-part fragment exchange: outgoing fragments scatter upward and sideways with slight tumbling and fading, incoming fragments arrive from below and assemble into the new picture
Fragments are numerous and small enough to read as a dense field, not a few large slices
Outgoing and incoming directions are distinct and consistent, giving the exchange a physical up-and-away then up-from-below reading
The transition is fast and hard-edged, explicitly not a soft crossfade or blur
Selections during an in-progress exchange are ignored, and reselecting the current subject produces no change
The picture responds to pointer position with a subtle lean and drift that settles smoothly
Entry never displays partial or empty imagery; the first picture appears already complete
adaptable_details: Number of selectable entries and the roster's placement, orientation and density
Exact fragment count, tile proportions, scatter spread, tumble amount and easing
Exact duration of each exchange stage, as long as it stays brief
How the active entry is emphasized (weight, any distinguishing accent treatment, marker, indentation)
Tilt magnitude and settle speed of the pointer-driven lean
Panel aspect ratio, cropping and surrounding layout and typography
What the quiet pre-entry hold looks like before the first complete picture appears
Whether the secondary descriptor appears in the roster, near the picture, or both
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits any small-to-moderate set of single-subject images with short labels and descriptors that a visitor browses freely — people, products, artworks, locations, team or cast style rosters — where one image should dominate and identity must stay unambiguous. It stops being this Skill if multiple images are shown simultaneously, if the change becomes a soft dissolve or slide, if the exchange is driven by scroll position or an enforced sequence instead of direct selection, or if the region's main purpose becomes dense text or data rather than a single dominant image.

name: dwell_held_morphing_media_entry
description: A picture-and-name entry that, only after sustained pointing or touch, comes alive: its container silhouette reshapes and drifts, the image inside enlarges and turns, a shape behind it shifts, the name flicks out and back, and a second label line slides up beneath it, all easing back when attention leaves.

canonical_document.name: dwell_held_morphing_media_entry
canonical_document.description: A picture-and-name entry that, only after sustained pointing or touch, comes alive: its container silhouette reshapes and drifts, the image inside enlarges and turns, a shape behind it shifts, the name flicks out and back, and a second label line slides up beneath it, all easing back when attention leaves.
canonical_document.experience_scope: A per-entry region experience inside a collection listing. It begins when a pointer or touch rests on one entry long enough to pass an intent threshold and ends when input moves or lifts away and that entry has eased back to its resting look. It never takes over the view, blocks scrolling or changes the surrounding layout, and several entries may be in different stages at the same time.
content_and_composition: One image per entry, held inside a soft irregular container silhouette that visibly crops and frames it
A separate shape layer sitting behind the framed image, offset enough to read as a second plane
A short primary label (the item's name) anchored with the image, always visible
A secondary identification line, hidden at rest and occupying no space until revealed, positioned directly beneath the primary label
Entries arranged in a single long vertical flow with generous surrounding emptiness, sized so roughly one entry dominates the viewport at a time
Persistent elements: the resting silhouette, image and primary label remain recognizable as the same entry throughout the transformation
experience_progression: Resting state: framed image, backing shape and primary label sit still; the secondary line is absent
Held-intent threshold: brief sustained contact before anything changes, so a passing sweep leaves the entry untouched

Activation and continuous liveliness while held: the silhouette reshapes and slowly drifts, the inner image scales up and rotates, the backing shape shifts against it, the primary label flicks out and back into place, and the secondary line slides up into view
Held plateau: the entry keeps a living, drifting quality rather than freezing on a final pose, for as long as contact continues
Release: every change eases back toward the resting state along the same visual path, secondary line sliding away last
Each entry runs this progression on its own tempo, so two active entries are visibly out of step with each other
attention_and_information_flow: At rest the entry offers only picture and short name, keeping the page scannable and quiet
Sustained attention is what completes the identification: the secondary line makes the full label readable only while the entry is engaged
The active entry gains visual weight through growth, rotation and motion while unengaged entries stay unchanged, so prominence follows the pointer rather than being pre-assigned
Motion is concentrated in one entry at a time, keeping the surrounding page calm

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Contact shorter than the intent delay produces no change at all, so brushing past the entry leaves it visually untouched
interaction_model.state_change: Resting state transitions into the held, alive state
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Silhouette reshapes and drifts, image enlarges and turns inside it, backing shape shifts, name flicks out and back, secondary line slides up beneath the name
interaction_model.input: Pointer resting on, or touch held over, a single entry past a brief intent delay
interaction_model.affected_object: That entry's container silhouette, inner image, backing shape, primary label and secondary label line

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Release is always available and never blocks scrolling or further browsing; the entry is immediately re-activatable
interaction_model.state_change: Held state releases back toward resting state
interaction_model.visible_feedback: All transformations ease back: shape settles, image returns to its framed size and orientation, backing shape realigns, secondary line slides away
interaction_model.input: Pointer moving off the entry, or touch lifting
interaction_model.affected_object: The same entry's transformed layers and labels

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Rapid back-and-forth remains smooth and never accumulates into a stuck or half-broken pose
interaction_model.state_change: Direction of the transition reverses or resumes from the current in-between position
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Shapes, scale, rotation and label positions continue from wherever they currently sit; no snap back to start, no restart from the beginning
interaction_model.input: Attention moving to another entry, or returning, while a transition is still running
interaction_model.affected_object: The interrupted entry and the newly engaged entry

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Drift stops and unwinds on release; each entry's tempo is independent of the others
interaction_model.state_change: Continuous, non-repeating-feeling drift rather than a single settled end pose
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The entry reads as breathing or alive instead of printed and static
interaction_model.input: Autonomous per-entry timing while an entry is held
interaction_model.affected_object: Silhouette drift and internal motion of the active entry

experience_qualities: Alive and organic rather than printed or mechanical
Deliberate: rewards intent, ignores accidental passes
Smooth and non-jarring even under rapid changes of focus
Calm surroundings with motion concentrated in one place
Tactile, as if the item can be handled
Individual: entries feel like separate living things with their own timing
completion_and_return: There is no terminal or completed state; the experience is a hold-and-release loop
Every entry returns fully to its resting look, with nothing left enlarged, rotated or expanded
The revealed secondary line does not persist after release
Browsing continues uninterrupted throughout; nothing is latched, selected or remembered between activations
locked_observable_requirements: Activation requires a brief held intent; instantaneous or passing contact must produce no visible change
Both the framing silhouette and the image inside it transform together, not just one of them
A distinct layer behind the image also shifts, so the entry reads as more than one plane
The primary label performs a brief flick out and back rather than simply fading
A second label line reveals additional identification only while the entry is engaged
Every transformation is fully reversible and returns to the exact resting look
Interrupted transitions continue from current visual positions instead of snapping or restarting
Entries respond independently and with individually varying tempo
The effect stays inside the entry's own area and never blocks or hijacks page browsing
adaptable_details: Number of entries and their subject matter
Exact silhouette forms and how far the shape deviates from its resting outline
Amount of enlargement and rotation applied to the image
Direction and distance of the backing shape's shift and the secondary line's slide
Length of the intent delay and overall speed of the transition
Color treatment, typography and label wording
Whether the secondary line carries a classification, a caption or a numeric detail
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits collections of picture-plus-short-label items that are meant to be inspected one at a time with room to breathe: curated showcases, lineups, field-guide style listings, portfolio entries. It relies on entries large enough that one can hold attention and on a second short label worth withholding until engaged. Turning activation into a click that opens a detail view or overlay, making all entries react in unison to a single shared driver, or packing entries into a dense grid where many transform at once would each produce a different skill.
