name: drifting_room_showcase_with_morphing_soft_form
description: One item at a time is centred with its name dominating and a maker line plus one line of context settling around it, while a single large soft form behind eases into a new silhouette, size, tilt and position for each item, and pointing at the item slides its image with the cursor as the huge title drifts counter to it.

canonical_document.name: drifting_room_showcase_with_morphing_soft_form
canonical_document.description: One item at a time is centred with its name dominating and a maker line plus one line of context settling around it, while a single large soft form behind eases into a new silhouette, size, tilt and position for each item, and pointing at the item slides its image with the cursor as the huge title drifts counter to it.
canonical_document.experience_scope: A whole-view sequential experience covering the full set of items from the first centred item to a quiet closing panel that marks the end of the set; it begins once the view has settled from a brief preparatory hold and remains a single continuous scene throughout rather than a series of separate places.
content_and_composition: A small set (a handful) of featured items, each occupying the view in turn as the single focal subject

Per item: one loose, tangible-feeling image or object that reads as unpinned rather than flat-mounted, one oversized name that visually dominates the composition, one short attribution line, and one single line of context
One persistent large soft form layered behind the focal item, shared across the entire set as the same continuous element rather than one form per item
A quiet closing panel after the last item, low in visual energy, marking the end of the set
Layer order stays constant: soft form behind, item image in the middle, oversized name in front of or overlapping the image
experience_progression: Focus rests on one item, its name dominant and the supporting lines settled around it
As the visitor advances and the next item travels well inside the view, focus transfers to it and the backdrop form eases toward that item's silhouette, size, tilt and position
The sequence repeats item by item, each transition changing the atmosphere while the space still reads as one room
The closing panel arrives as a quiet end to the set
Retreating back through the set reverses the same transitions in order, restoring earlier moods in reverse
attention_and_information_flow: The item name carries the greatest visual weight; attribution and the single context line read as secondary detail resolved around it
Only one item holds attention at a time; neighbours do not compete for focus
The backdrop form supplies mood and continuity without ever competing with the name or image for prominence
Pointer interaction momentarily heightens the tangibility of the focused item by separating image and title in opposite directions
Information density stays deliberately low throughout: a name, a maker, one line

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Retreating re-centres the previous item; each crossing commits once so a boundary is never triggered twice, and hovering near a threshold does not cause flicker between items
interaction_model.state_change: The next item becomes the centred focus once it has travelled well inside the view, rather than at the moment it first appears
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The new item settles into the centre with its name dominant and its supporting lines resolving around it
interaction_model.input: Advancing forward through the page
interaction_model.affected_object: The centred item slot and its name, attribution and context line

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Turning back restores the previous form state through the same kind of eased transition without stuttering or double-firing
interaction_model.state_change: The form transitions from its current silhouette, size, tilt and position to the set belonging to the newly focused item
interaction_model.visible_feedback: A smooth eased morph of one continuous shape, changing the atmosphere behind the item without any cut, jump or replacement
interaction_model.input: Advancing or retreating so that focus changes items
interaction_model.affected_object: The single large soft form behind the focal item

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Direction may be reversed repeatedly; the form always continues from its present shape and position
interaction_model.state_change: The form is redirected from wherever it currently is toward the newly targeted state
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Continuous redirection with no snap back to a start state and no visible restart of the motion
interaction_model.input: Reversing direction while a backdrop transition is still in motion
interaction_model.affected_object: The soft form mid-morph

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Moving the cursor away lets both elements spring back to their resting alignment; re-entering resumes tracking from the current position
interaction_model.state_change: Image and name take on opposed offsets tied to cursor position
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The image slides along with the cursor while the huge title drifts the opposite way, producing a loose, layered, hand-held feel
interaction_model.input: Pointing at the focused item and moving the cursor
interaction_model.affected_object: The item image and the oversized name

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Retreating from the closing panel re-enters the set and retraces the same moods in reverse
interaction_model.state_change: The sequence resolves into the quiet closing panel
interaction_model.visible_feedback: A calm, low-energy panel signalling that the set is finished
interaction_model.input: Advancing past the last item
interaction_model.affected_object: The end of the set

experience_qualities: Calm, unhurried and gallery-like
Continuous and singular in place, even as atmosphere changes
Focused: one subject at a time, sparse text, dominant name
Tangible and loose rather than flat and pinned
Motion that always feels eased and redirectable, never abrupt or repeated
completion_and_return: The set completes at the quiet closing panel rather than looping
Reversing through the sequence restores each prior focus and each prior backdrop state in reverse order
The backdrop form persists as a single element across the whole experience and holds whatever state matches the current focus
Pointer-driven offsets are transient and always return to rest
locked_observable_requirements: Exactly one item holds centred focus at a time, with its name visually dominant over a short attribution and a single context line
One continuous soft form behind the items, never duplicated or swapped, morphing silhouette, size, tilt and position per focused item
Focus and backdrop change only after an item has travelled well inside the view, committing once per crossing in each direction
Reversal mid-transition redirects the form from its current state instead of snapping or restarting
Pointer movement over the focused item moves the image with the cursor and the oversized name in the opposite direction, with a spring back to rest on leaving
A quiet closing panel ends the set, and returning back through it replays the same mood sequence in reverse
The whole set reads as one continuous space rather than distinct places
adaptable_details: Number of items in the set, as long as it stays a small curated handful
Subject matter of the items and the wording of the attribution and context line
Any palette, texture and tonal range for the soft form and the surrounding space, provided the form stays a low-distraction surround that the item image and name read clearly against
Exact silhouettes, tilts and sizes chosen per item
Typeface and precise scale of the dominant name and its overlap with the image
Easing character and duration of transitions and of the pointer spring-back
Layout of the closing panel and its copy
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits small curated sets where each entry can carry a short dominant title, a brief attribution and one line of context, and where a calm one-at-a-time walk is desirable; it does not fit dense catalogues, comparison views or long-form text sections that need several items or paragraphs visible at once. Replacing the single continuous morphing form with per-item background images or hard section changes, allowing multiple items to hold focus simultaneously, or removing the pointer-driven opposed drift would each create a different Skill.

name: two_sided_portrait_tile_dissolve
description: A tall portrait owns the screen with the name above it and section links beside it; choosing the second of two bottom labels shatters the photo into tiles that drift inward and sweep upward out of frame as they fade, uncovering the same face composed entirely of binary digits held at lower contrast behind an attenuating veil, while the name, links and menu glyph shrink away and type themselves back in character by character; the first label reverses everything, raining the tiles back down until the photograph is whole.

canonical_document.name: two_sided_portrait_tile_dissolve
canonical_document.description: A tall portrait owns the screen with the name above it and section links beside it; choosing the second of two bottom labels shatters the photo into tiles that drift inward and sweep upward out of frame as they fade, uncovering the same face composed entirely of binary digits held at lower contrast behind an attenuating veil, while the name, links and menu glyph shrink away and type themselves back in character by character; the first label reverses everything, raining the tiles back down until the photograph is whole.
canonical_document.experience_scope: Whole-view experience occupying the opening screen. It begins after a brief quiet beat on a near-empty surround as the portrait takes the screen, persists as the resident state of that view, and has no end point: it alternates between two stable identity states, each fully returnable.
content_and_composition: One tall portrait of a single person as the dominant visual mass, vertically filling and owning the screen.
Name treated as a short text mark positioned above the portrait.
A short set of section links placed beside the portrait rather than across the top.
A single menu glyph as a compact persistent affordance alongside the text elements.
Two side labels anchored at the bottom, always both visible, one per identity, with the active one carrying a clearly higher-salience treatment than the inactive one.
A second rendering of the same face, composed entirely of binary digits, occupying the same frame as the photograph but layered behind it.
An attenuating veil layered over the digit rendering, holding it at lower contrast and presence than the photographic state.
The portrait behaves as a single plate: a coherent surface that can tilt as one object, and that can subdivide into a regular grid of tiles.
Two visual registers over identical content: one quiet, atmospheric and faintly restless; one starker, harder-edged and machine-like.
experience_progression: Brief quiet beat on a near-empty surround, then the portrait settles into full-screen presence in the first identity.
First identity holds as a calm, subtly unsettled resting state that hints another identity is present.
On switching forward: the portrait subdivides into a grid of tiles.
Tiles drift inward, then sweep upward out of frame while fading, progressively uncovering the digit-rendered face behind the attenuating veil.
Concurrently the name, links and menu glyph shrink away to nothing, then retype themselves character by character in the machine-like register.
Second identity holds as the new resting state with its label carrying the active-state salience.
On switching back: tiles rain back down into place until the photograph is whole again and the text retypes in the first register, returning exactly to the opening resting state.
The two states alternate indefinitely; neither is terminal.
attention_and_information_flow: Attention starts on the face because of its scale and screen ownership; name and links read as secondary satellites.
During a switch, motion of the departing tiles pulls the eye upward and outward, then hands attention back to the face that emerges underneath.
The subject remains the constant focal point across both states; what changes is how it is rendered, so recognition of sameness is the payoff.
Character-by-character retyping of name and links draws brief attention to the text after the image has resolved, staggering the two reveals instead of competing.
The higher-salience label continuously discloses which identity is active and that the other is one press away.
No new information appears in the second state: the same name, same sections, same face, restated in another voice.

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Fully reversible at any time after the transition settles by pressing the other label; the resting state is stable and no state is lost
interaction_model.state_change: View transitions from the photographic identity to the machine-like identity
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Photo splits into a grid of tiles that drift inward and sweep upward out of frame while fading, revealing the binary-digit face held at lower contrast behind the attenuating veil; text elements shrink away and retype character by character; the pressed label takes on the active-state salience
interaction_model.input: Pressing the second identity label at the bottom
interaction_model.affected_object: Portrait plate, the digit-rendered face beneath it, and the name, links and menu glyph

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Restores the original resting state exactly; symmetric with the forward switch
interaction_model.state_change: View returns to the photographic identity
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Tiles rain back down into their grid positions until the photograph is whole again; text shrinks away and retypes in the original register; that label takes on the active-state salience
interaction_model.input: Pressing the first identity label at the bottom
interaction_model.affected_object: Tiles, the photograph, and the text elements

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Presses are ignored rather than queued or interrupted, so the transition can never be left half-resolved; control returns once the target state is reached
interaction_model.state_change: None
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Nothing changes; the running transition continues uninterrupted to its target state
interaction_model.input: Additional label presses while a switch is running
interaction_model.affected_object: The in-progress transition

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Continuous and always available in both identities; eases back toward rest when the pointer settles or leaves, and never fights the switch transition
interaction_model.state_change: Plate orientation shifts continuously toward the pointer position
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The whole portrait tilts gently toward the cursor, giving the plate a slight physical presence
interaction_model.input: Pointer movement anywhere over the view
interaction_model.affected_object: The portrait plate as a whole

experience_qualities: Quiet and atmospheric, with a faint restlessness that implies something hidden.
Starker, harder-edged and machine-like in the second register, without becoming a different subject.
Physical and tactile: tiles have weight, drifting and raining rather than simply cross-fading.
Deliberate and legible: one clear switch, one clear active state, no ambiguity about how to get back.
Recognition-driven: the impact comes from the same face reappearing in another material.
completion_and_return: Each switch completes in a stable resting identity rather than an animated end state.
The reverse switch returns the view exactly to the opening photographic state.
The active identity persists until the user switches again; the alternate label stays visible as the way back.
No looping animation drives the identity change; only the resting registers may carry their own ambient quality.
locked_observable_requirements: A single tall subject image owns the whole screen as the dominant element.
Name above the image and a short link set beside it, plus a compact menu glyph.
Exactly two identity labels anchored at the bottom, both always visible, acting as the only switch.
The active label is always clearly separated from the inactive one by a visibly higher-salience treatment.
Forward switch fragments the image into a regular grid of tiles that drift inward, sweep upward out of frame, and fade.
The uncovered second state is the same face rendered entirely in digits, layered behind an attenuating veil that holds it at lower contrast than the photographic state.
Text elements shrink away and then retype themselves character by character on every switch.
The reverse switch rains the tiles back down until the image is whole again.
Extra switch presses during a transition are ignored, never interrupting or queueing.
The image behaves as one plate that tilts toward the pointer in both states.
adaptable_details: Tile grid density, tile shape and the exact drift and fade timing.
Duration and easing of the sweep-out and rain-back motion.
Typing speed and character order of the retyped text.
Hue choices for either register, veil strength and the exact character set used for the digit rendering.
Tilt magnitude and responsiveness of the pointer-following plate.
Number and wording of the section links, and whether an opening quiet beat precedes the portrait.
How the salience of the active label is expressed.
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits any view built around one dominant subject image that can be meaningfully restated in a second visual material, with a small amount of surrounding text and links, and exactly two identities to alternate between. Content type matters only in that the second rendering must be recognizably the same subject as the first. Extending to three or more modes, to a gallery of several images, to a scroll- or timer-driven change instead of a deliberate two-label switch, or to a transition that swaps in genuinely different content rather than restating the same subject would create a different Skill.

name: upright_label_cover_to_fullscreen_poster
description: A cover-like opening with a large title and a slim edge column of upright section labels; clicking one sweeps its distinctly toned bar open across the screen while the cover slides away, then that section's poster image, title, caption and number slide in and settle, with a corner control that reverses the whole move.

canonical_document.name: upright_label_cover_to_fullscreen_poster
canonical_document.description: A cover-like opening with a large title and a slim edge column of upright section labels; clicking one sweeps its distinctly toned bar open across the screen while the cover slides away, then that section's poster image, title, caption and number slide in and settle, with a corner control that reverses the whole move.
canonical_document.experience_scope: Whole-view experience: it begins at the opening cover state that presents the full set of choices, spans one section's full-screen takeover, and ends when the return control restores the opening cover intact. There is no separate page beyond this single view.
content_and_composition: One oversized title anchoring the opening cover composition
A cover panel that occupies the main area of the opening state alongside the title
A slim column of a few upright (rotated) section labels aligned along one edge of the view, all visible simultaneously so the complete choice set is legible before opening
One bar bound to each label, carrying that label's own tone kept clearly separable from its neighbours', acting as that section's expanding surface
Per opened section: a featured image plus a title, a caption and a section number, entering as a coordinated group from one side
A small return control placed in a corner, present only while a section is open
The label column persists as a constant frame across states so it stays evident which sections have not yet been opened
Exactly one section can be open at a time; no cover content remains competing with an opened section's artwork
experience_progression: Opening cover state: large title, cover panel and the full column of upright labels at rest
Selection: the chosen label's toned bar sweeps open, growing until it fills the screen, while the remaining labels and the cover panel slide outward toward the edges
Mid-sweep overlap: before the sweep completes, the chosen section's image, title, caption and number slide in from the side and settle into place
Settled full-screen section state: the section's artwork owns the whole view, then the small return control pops into a corner
Return: the section's elements are pushed back out, and the bars and cover panel are pulled back to their resting positions
Restored opening cover state, identical to the original, ready for another choice
attention_and_information_flow: At rest, prominence is split between the oversized title and the legible full list of section labels, so the visitor first grasps identity and the complete range of choices
On selection, prominence collapses from many choices to exactly one: the expanding toned bar becomes the dominant surface and clears the cover from contention
Revealed information increases in stages — first the bar's tone and area, then the section's image, then its title, caption and number as supporting detail
The return affordance is the last thing to appear, so it does not compete with the artwork's arrival
The persistent label column carries progress information throughout, indicating which sections remain unseen

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Only one section may ever be open; further clicks during the opening transition are ignored until the transition finishes
interaction_model.state_change: Closed cover state transitions to opening state for exactly one section
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The chosen label's toned bar sweeps open until it fills the screen while the other labels and the cover panel slide away toward the edges
interaction_model.input: Click on one of the upright section labels
interaction_model.affected_object: That label's toned bar, the other labels, the cover panel

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Timed against the sweep so content arrival always overlaps rather than follows it as a separate step
interaction_model.state_change: Section content moves from off-view to settled in place, overlapping the tail of the sweep
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The image, title, caption and number slide in from the side and settle rather than appearing at once
interaction_model.input: Continuation of the same opening sweep past a partway point
interaction_model.affected_object: The chosen section's image, title, caption and number

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: It exists only while a section is open and leaves with the section
interaction_model.state_change: Return affordance becomes available in the open state
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The control pops into a corner of the view, held at readable contrast against the filled bar behind it
interaction_model.input: Completion of the section's arrival
interaction_model.affected_object: Small return control in a corner

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Extra clicks during the closing transition are ignored; the restored cover matches the original opening state exactly, so choosing again is always possible
interaction_model.state_change: Open section state reverses to the opening cover state
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Section image, title, caption and number are pushed back out, then the bars and cover panel are pulled back to their resting places
interaction_model.input: Activating the corner return control
interaction_model.affected_object: The open section's content group, the toned bars, the cover panel and labels

experience_qualities: Bold, graphic and poster-like rather than conventionally page-like
Decisive and singular: one choice takes over everything with nothing left competing
Coordinated and choreographed, with overlapping rather than sequential moves
Directional, built from sweeping and sliding motion along one axis
Reliable and reversible, always returning to a known intact starting state
completion_and_return: An open section persists until the return control is activated; it does not auto-dismiss
Return fully restores the opening cover state, including title, cover panel and the complete label column
The cycle can be repeated for any section any number of times
The persistent label frame continues to communicate which sections have not yet been opened after returning
locked_observable_requirements: The opening state reads as one graphic cover composition: an oversized title plus a slim edge column of upright labels showing the complete choice set at once
Each label owns a bar in its own tone, distinguishable from the other labels' bars, that expands by sweeping until it fills the whole view
The cover panel and the non-chosen labels move away toward the edges during opening
The chosen section's image, title, caption and number enter from the side and settle, beginning partway through the sweep rather than after it
An opened section owns the whole view with no cover content competing, its title, caption and number staying legible against the filled bar
A small return control appears in a corner only after the section has settled
Return reverses the sequence and restores the opening state intact
Exactly one section open at a time, and inputs during either transition are ignored
The label column remains a constant frame indicating unseen sections
adaptable_details: Which edge holds the label column and which side content enters from
The number of sections, as long as the full set stays legible at once
The particular tone assigned to each bar, and the overall light-or-dark register of the composition, provided the bars stay mutually distinguishable and section text stays readable over them
Typographic treatment and relative size of the oversized title
Transition durations and easing, provided the sweep and content arrival still overlap
Corner chosen for the return control and its exact glyph or shape
Subject matter of the featured artwork and the wording of caption text
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits a small, fixed set of parallel topics where each one has a single strong visual centerpiece plus a short title, caption and ordinal marker, and where a bold graphic identity is wanted on arrival. It stops being this Skill if the choice set grows large enough to require scrolling or filtering, if opened content becomes long-form or scrollable rather than a single full-view composition, if several sections can be open or compared at once, or if the opening cover is replaced by conventional page navigation so the expanding toned bar is no longer the transition surface.

name: scattered_sliver_poster_sequence
description: Tall photo posters that each look like one picture cut apart, with thin slivers of the same image strewn around it under an oversized word and a highlighted quote; slivers drift at differing depths under the pointer and posters alternate sides as the reader scrolls through to a quiet end.

canonical_document.name: scattered_sliver_poster_sequence
canonical_document.description: Tall photo posters that each look like one picture cut apart, with thin slivers of the same image strewn around it under an oversized word and a highlighted quote; slivers drift at differing depths under the pointer and posters alternate sides as the reader scrolls through to a quiet end.
canonical_document.experience_scope: Whole-view experience: begins with a plain covering screen and its small pulsing marker, opens onto the first poster shown already complete, continues as each subsequent poster takes the entire screen, and ends at the final poster with no further advance.
content_and_composition: One tall photographic image per poster, read as the primary subject of that view
Several thin slivers cut from that very same photograph, loosely strewn around the main image at varied positions and angles rather than in a regular grid
One oversized single word per poster, laid over the image-and-sliver composition
One quote per poster, visually highlighted, laid over the same composition
Slivers sit as separate visual layers between or around the main image and the type; the word and quote remain the topmost readable layer
Each poster occupies one side of the screen, and successive posters alternate which side they sit on
The opening covering screen holds only a small pulsing marker and no content
A small number of posters in total, sparse content per view
experience_progression: Covering screen with pulsing marker while the pictures are not yet ready
Cover lifts to the first poster, already complete rather than assembling in view
First view quietly suggests more posters lie further along the sequence
Each following poster claims the full screen in order, its side alternating from the previous one so attention swings across
Sequence arrives at a final poster and comes to a quiet end with no further advance
attention_and_information_flow: Attention is first held by a single small living marker on an otherwise empty screen
On reveal, attention lands on a finished composition: the photograph and its oversized word read first, the highlighted quote second
The scattered slivers read as texture and depth around the subject rather than as competing content
Alternating sides move the focal mass across the screen from one poster to the next, so each advance re-aims attention
Pointer movement adds depth without shifting what is legible; the word and quote stay readable at all times
Prominence tapers to a settled final view signalling the series is complete

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: The cover persists for as long as needed and shows only the pulsing marker while waiting; the reveal happens once and is not re-entered
interaction_model.state_change: Holding state ends and the first poster is presented already complete
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The covering screen and marker give way to a finished first poster, with no visible assembly of image, slivers or type
interaction_model.input: Pictures becoming ready
interaction_model.affected_object: Plain covering screen with its small pulsing marker

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Advance stops at the final poster; the sequence rests at that quiet end
interaction_model.state_change: Advance from the current poster to the next in order
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The next full-screen poster takes over, sitting on the opposite side from the previous one so the focal mass swings across
interaction_model.input: Working downward through the view
interaction_model.affected_object: Poster sequence

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Backward travel stops at the first poster; direction can be reversed at any moment mid-sequence
interaction_model.state_change: Return to earlier posters in reverse order
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Previously seen posters reappear in their alternating sides, restoring the earlier state of the sequence
interaction_model.input: Coming back up through the view
interaction_model.affected_object: Poster sequence

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Movement is continuous and eased, so interruption or direction change mid-travel is absorbed smoothly rather than jumping
interaction_model.state_change: Each sliver displaces by its own differing amount and eases into place rather than snapping
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Slivers drift unequally so the picture reads as layered in depth, while the oversized word and highlighted quote stay legible
interaction_model.input: Pointer travelling across a poster
interaction_model.affected_object: The scattered slivers of that poster

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Return is a glide rather than a snap and can be cut short by the pointer re-entering, which resumes drift from the current position
interaction_model.state_change: Displacement releases back to the resting composition
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Slivers glide back to rest, restoring the poster's settled arrangement
interaction_model.input: Pointer leaving the poster
interaction_model.affected_object: The scattered slivers of that poster

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: No poster breaks apart, overflows unrecognizably or loses its full-screen ownership at any size
interaction_model.state_change: Composition refits to the new viewport
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Poster, slivers and type re-place themselves so the strewn arrangement, alternating side and overlay reading order still hold
interaction_model.input: Resizing the window
interaction_model.affected_object: Each poster with its main image, slivers and type

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Drift and reading remain unaffected wherever the pointer sits within the poster
interaction_model.state_change: None; they stay non-capturing
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The pointer keeps travelling and driving sliver drift instead of being caught, and nothing obscures the quote or word
interaction_model.input: Pointer over slivers or type
interaction_model.affected_object: Slivers and overlaid word and quote

experience_qualities: Calm and unhurried
Crafted, cut-and-strewn physicality rather than flat placement
Layered depth that responds softly to presence
Sparse and poster-like, one statement per screen
Eased motion throughout, never snapping
Deliberate rhythm from side-to-side alternation
completion_and_return: The opening cover completes once when the pictures are ready and hands over a finished first poster
Each pointer interaction completes by gliding slivers back to their resting arrangement
The sequence completes at a final poster and holds there quietly without looping
Backward travel restores earlier posters in their original composition and sides, so the sequence is fully retraceable
locked_observable_requirements: A plain covering screen showing only a small pulsing marker precedes any content, and the first poster appears already complete
Each poster reads as one tall photograph cut apart, with thin slivers of that same picture strewn loosely around it
An oversized single word and a highlighted quote are laid over the image-and-sliver composition and remain readable
Slivers displace by differing amounts with easing while the pointer travels, giving layered depth, and glide back to rest when it leaves
Every poster after the first owns the whole screen and alternates which side it sits on
Forward travel advances the sequence and backward travel returns to earlier posters, ending quietly at the last one
Slivers and type never capture the pointer or obscure reading
Resizing refits poster, slivers and type without breaking the composition
adaptable_details: Number of posters, so long as the set stays small
Number, size, angle and scatter placement of slivers
Photographic subject matter and palette
Word and quote wording, typeface and highlight treatment
Exact displacement magnitudes, easing character and settle duration
Appearance and rhythm of the pulsing marker
Whether the first view's hint of more posters is a mark, partial edge or spatial cue
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits small curated sets of image-led statement views where a single photograph plus a few words carries each screen and sparse text keeps the layered depth readable. Replacing the single-source slivers with unrelated images, filling the screen with dense text or media that must stay stable, removing the finished-on-reveal opening, or driving progression by autonomous timing or discrete jumps instead of the reader's forward and backward travel would each create a different Skill.

name: mirrored_feature_swap_stage
description: One subject holds a quiet, low-distraction stage as a symmetrically doubled image under its oversized name; choosing another name plays an outward retreat and fade of the current subject, then a sweep-in from both sides that settles with the new name rising into place.

canonical_document.name: mirrored_feature_swap_stage
canonical_document.description: One subject holds a quiet, low-distraction stage as a symmetrically doubled image under its oversized name; choosing another name plays an outward retreat and fade of the current subject, then a sweep-in from both sides that settles with the new name rising into place.
canonical_document.experience_scope: A self-contained region or whole-view centerpiece that begins when the imagery is ready and the first subject appears fully formed, persists for the entire browsing session over the small set, and ends only when the visitor leaves the view; there is no terminal state.
content_and_composition: Exactly one featured subject visible at any moment, drawn from a small fixed set
The featured image is doubled into a left/right mirrored pair that reads as one symmetrical face or form centered on the stage
Oversized name type for the featured subject, treated as a primary visual element rather than a caption, layered with the mirrored image
A persistent list of all subject names, always visible alongside the stage, with the active name distinctly marked
A quiet, low-noise background stage with no competing decoration, held clearly separated in luminance from the featured image and type so that image and type carry all contrast
Implicit set awareness: the visitor can always see which subject is current and how many others remain unvisited or waiting
experience_progression: Entry: a brief calm holding state occupies the stage; nothing partial is shown
First reveal: the holding state clears only when imagery is ready, and the initial subject appears already complete on the stage
Resting state: one mirrored subject and its oversized name hold the stage indefinitely until a pick occurs
Exit stage of a swap: current image retreats outward and fades while its name drops away and out of view
Entry stage of a swap: the chosen image sweeps in from both left and right edges toward the center and settles into symmetry
Settle: the new name rises into its resting position and the list marking updates to match
Return to resting state, repeatable in any order across the set without a fixed sequence
attention_and_information_flow: Attention rests on a single subject at a time; the mirrored symmetry pulls the eye to the center axis
Oversized type competes deliberately with the image, so identity and likeness are read together
During a swap, prominence transfers by opposing motion: outward-and-away for the departing subject, inward-and-together for the arriving one
The list stays secondary and informational but always answers where the visitor is within the set and what else is available
No information is hidden behind hover or discovery; the only revealed information is the identity and image of the chosen subject

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: The sequence always completes to a stable resting state; any earlier subject can be re-picked afterward, and the return is paced as an unhurried exchange rather than an abrupt cut
interaction_model.state_change: Featured subject transitions from the current one to the chosen one through a paired exit and entry sequence
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Current image scales/moves outward and fades while its name drops away; the chosen image sweeps in from both sides and settles into symmetry; the new name rises into place; the list marking moves to the picked name
interaction_model.input: Visitor picks a non-active name from the persistent list
interaction_model.affected_object: Featured mirrored image, oversized name, and list marking

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: The resting state is preserved, so repeated picking cannot disturb the current view
interaction_model.state_change: None
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Nothing changes; the stage and marking remain exactly as they are, with no flicker or replay
interaction_model.input: Visitor picks the name that is already featured
interaction_model.affected_object: Featured stage

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Picks become effective again only after the stage has settled, guaranteeing the sequence never breaks or shows two subjects at once
interaction_model.state_change: The new pick is ignored and the running swap continues to its settled end
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The motion continues uninterrupted; no overlap, no snap-back, no partially exchanged state
interaction_model.input: Visitor picks another name while a swap is still playing
interaction_model.affected_object: In-progress swap sequence

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: The stage never shows an incomplete or progressively assembling first subject
interaction_model.state_change: Holding state clears to the first featured subject
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The calm holding presentation gives way to a fully formed first mirrored subject with its name already in resting position
interaction_model.input: Autonomous readiness of the imagery on entry
interaction_model.affected_object: Stage and holding state

experience_qualities: Calm, low-distraction and cinematic rather than busy
Symmetrical and poster-like, with a strong central axis
Typographically bold, with name and likeness weighted almost equally
Unhurried, deliberate pacing on every exchange
Uninterruptible and orderly: one subject in, one subject out, never both
completion_and_return: No end state; the experience rests on whichever subject was last chosen
Every swap returns the stage to the same resting composition, differing only in subject and name
Revisiting an earlier subject replays the same exchange in the same paced manner, so order of visits is free
The list marking always persists in agreement with what is on the stage
locked_observable_requirements: Only one subject is featured at any moment; two subjects are never simultaneously visible on the stage
The featured image is presented as a left/right mirrored symmetrical double, not a single un-mirrored image
The subject's name appears in oversized type as a primary composition element
The stage stays visually quiet and undecorated, with a clear luminance separation from the featured image and type, so image and type dominate
A swap has a distinct outward-retreat-and-fade exit and a two-sided sweep-in-and-settle entry, with the name dropping away and then rising into place
The name list persistently marks the active subject in agreement with the stage
Re-picking the active subject produces no change; picks during a running swap are ignored and the swap completes
The first featured subject appears fully formed after a calm holding state, never partially assembled
Which subject is current and how many others are available remain visible without extra action
adaptable_details: Number of subjects in the set, as long as it stays small enough to list in full
Placement and orientation of the name list relative to the stage
Exact typeface, casing and coloring of the oversized name, provided it keeps readable contrast against the stage
Exact easing, distances and durations of retreat, sweep and name motion, provided the exchange still reads as unhurried
Visual treatment used to mark the active name
Precise mirror axis position and how much of the doubled image is visible
Visual character of the calm holding state, including whether the stage sits at the low or high end of the luminance range
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits any small, fully enumerable set of visually strong single-focus images with short names — portraits, creatures, products, artworks, characters, team members — where identity and image are the whole message. The stage may be tuned to any host palette, light or deep, as long as it stays quiet and clearly separated from image and type. It stops being this Skill if multiple subjects are shown at once as a grid or carousel of peers, if the mirrored symmetry is dropped, if the name loses its oversized primary role, if swaps become instant or interruptible with overlapping subjects, or if the stage must carry substantial body text, controls or dense secondary content.

name: layered_lift_portrait_pair_run
description: A downward run of tall, distinctly toned panels presenting two big portrait cards at a time; the card under the pointer lifts and leans like a separate plate while its label, outline frame, tonal wash and sliding highlight each move by different amounts, then springs back to a calm rest when the pointer leaves.

canonical_document.name: layered_lift_portrait_pair_run
canonical_document.description: A downward run of tall, distinctly toned panels presenting two big portrait cards at a time; the card under the pointer lifts and leans like a separate plate while its label, outline frame, tonal wash and sliding highlight each move by different amounts, then springs back to a calm rest when the pointer leaves.
canonical_document.experience_scope: A whole-view, page-length experience: it begins once the imagery is ready and the first pair of panels is presented, continues as the visitor works downward through successive pairs, and ends at the last pair. Each individual card is also a self-contained interactive region — its response never spills into neighboring cards or the page around it.
content_and_composition: Primary content role: large portrait-oriented images, presented one per card, occupying most of the card area.
Two cards visible side by side as a pair; pairs stack vertically into a long run of many pairs.
Each card is a tall panel whose ground is a single uniform tonal field held clearly apart from the image plate and from the surrounding page.

Per-card layers, ordered from back to front: tonal ground/wash, outline frame inset within the card, the image plate, a short two-part text label (a primary name line plus a secondary place/qualifier line) kept at readable contrast against whatever sits behind it, and a gliding highlight that passes over the plate.
Successive pairs differ in temperament — each pair carries its own tonal character and its own flavor of movement — while sharing the same card anatomy.
Persistent elements: card ground, image plate and card boundary remain visible at all times; frame and label may be held back until the pointer arrives on some cards.
Only one card is in a lifted state at a time; all others hold a calm, settled resting composition.
experience_progression: Imagery-ready hold resolves into the first pair presented in resting composition.
Visitor moves downward pair by pair; each new pair reads as an answer to the previous one with its own tonal and motion temperament.
Within any card: rest → engaged lift with layers separated and tracking the pointer → release → spring-settle back to rest.
A card left behind returns to the same calm resting composition it started from, so the run always reads as at most one lifted card among settled ones.
The run has an end; there is no loop back to the first pair.
attention_and_information_flow: At rest, attention is distributed across the pair by ground tone and image alone; nothing competes for focus.
Pointing at a card makes it the unambiguous focal object: it lifts off the surface while its neighbor stays flat and quiet.
Depth separation is the attention cue — because label, frame, wash, highlight and plate move by different amounts, the card reads as physically raised rather than merely styled.
On cards that withhold frame and label, arrival of the pointer reveals identifying text and framing, so information density increases exactly where attention is.
Withdrawal returns the card to low prominence, restoring even attention across the visible pair and inviting continued downward scanning.

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Tracking is instantaneous and bound to the pointed-at card only; leaving the card releases the plate back toward rest
interaction_model.state_change: Plate leans and slides toward the pointer, tracking its position continuously
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The picture appears to tip and shift as a rigid plate lifted off the card surface, following the pointer moment to moment
interaction_model.input: Pointer position moving within the bounds of a single card
interaction_model.affected_object: That card's image plate

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: All layers stay inside the card's bounds; on release each returns to its own rest offset without residual drift after repeated passes
interaction_model.state_change: Each layer displaces by its own differing amount and direction relative to the plate
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The card visibly resolves into separate depths — text sitting above the frame, frame above the wash, highlight gliding across — producing a tactile, physical, instantly readable sense of lift
interaction_model.input: Same pointer movement within the card
interaction_model.affected_object: Label text, outline frame, tonal wash and gliding highlight of that card

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Departure returns them to the withheld resting state; re-entry brings them back into place
interaction_model.state_change: Hidden or offset state transitions into placed, present state
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Frame and label come into place as part of the same arrival gesture that lifts the plate
interaction_model.input: Pointer arriving on a card that withholds framing and text
interaction_model.affected_object: Outline frame and label of that card

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Return is fully interruptible
interaction_model.state_change: Engaged state releases into a spring-like return to rest
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Each part springs back with its own settling motion until the calm resting composition is restored
interaction_model.input: Pointer leaving a card
interaction_model.affected_object: All layers of that card

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Repeated rapid entries and exits leave no cumulative misalignment; every part remains registered to its rest position
interaction_model.state_change: Return is cancelled and direct pointer tracking resumes from the current position
interaction_model.visible_feedback: No jump, snap or backtrack — the card hands control straight back and continues to follow the pointer from wherever it had settled to
interaction_model.input: Pointer re-entering a card mid-settle
interaction_model.affected_object: The still-returning card

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Movement in either direction is always available; no pair locks the visitor in place
interaction_model.state_change: New pairs come into view in their resting composition; passed cards hold rest
interaction_model.visible_feedback: A rhythm of differently tempered pairs, each announcing its own tonal and movement character
interaction_model.input: Visitor moving downward through the run
interaction_model.affected_object: Successive pairs of cards

experience_qualities: Playful and tactile — cards feel like physical plates that can be nudged
Immediately legible: the depth relationship is understood without explanation
Direct and instant, with no perceptible lag between pointer and response
Bold and high-contrast through ground fields held well apart from the imagery and the surround
Calm at rest, lively only where touched
Rhythmic down the page, with each pair having its own temperament
Stable and trustworthy under fast, repeated interaction
completion_and_return: Each card's interaction completes by springing back to exactly its calm resting composition; no engaged state persists after the pointer leaves.
Cards that withhold frame and label return to that withheld state.
The run itself completes at its final pair rather than looping.
No card retains a memory of prior passes; rest positions are identical before and after any number of interactions.
locked_observable_requirements: A vertical run of tall panels presenting exactly two portrait cards at a time, each panel ground clearly separated from the imagery it holds and from the page around it.
The pointed-at card must read as a physical plate lifting off the surface, not as a flat highlight or a mere tint change.
Image plate, label, outline frame, tonal wash and a gliding highlight must each displace by different amounts so they read as separate depths.
Response must be driven directly and continuously by pointer position inside the card, and feel instant.
Response is strictly confined to the single card being pointed at; at most one card is lifted at a time.
Departure produces a spring-like settle back to a calm resting composition.
Re-entry during the settle cancels the return and hands control back immediately, with no snapping.
No cumulative drift or misalignment after repeated passes.
Successive pairs must be distinguishable from one another by ground tone and motion temperament while sharing the card anatomy.
Each card carries a short two-part label (primary identifying line plus a secondary line) legible against whatever sits behind it.
adaptable_details: Exact hues, intensity and tonal pairing of the panel grounds, and whether the run reads light or dark overall.
Number of pairs in the run and total page length.
Precise lean, slide and displacement magnitudes per layer, and settle firmness.
Highlight shape, softness and travel path.
Which cards withhold frame and label until pointer arrival.
Frame thickness, inset, corner treatment and label typography and placement.
Exact wording and semantic meaning of the two label lines.
How the imagery-ready hold before the first pair is presented.
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits collections of portrait-oriented, image-dominant items with short two-line captions that a visitor scans downward on a pointer-capable surface — rosters, casts, portfolios, profile sets, product or place features. It remains the same Skill when the images, ground tones, overall lightness, count and displacement amounts change. It becomes a different Skill if the pair-at-a-time tall-panel rhythm is replaced by a dense multi-column grid or a single full-bleed item, if the depth separation is driven by scroll position or autonomous motion instead of pointer position within a card, if the effect spreads across the page instead of staying inside one card, or if the content becomes text-led with images as secondary decoration.

name: brushed_away_fullscreen_quote_gallery
description: Edge-to-edge images shown one at a time under a large flowing quote and a small corner credit, where each advance erases the current picture in hand-brushed strokes to uncover the next, looping forever in both directions.

canonical_document.name: brushed_away_fullscreen_quote_gallery
canonical_document.description: Edge-to-edge images shown one at a time under a large flowing quote and a small corner credit, where each advance erases the current picture in hand-brushed strokes to uncover the next, looping forever in both directions.
canonical_document.experience_scope: A whole-view experience: it claims the entire viewport from the moment the first image is presented and continues for as long as the visitor keeps browsing; there is no defined end state because browsing wraps endlessly, and the experience is the page rather than a component embedded in other content.
content_and_composition: One primary image at a time, filling the viewport edge to edge with no framing, margins or letterboxing.
A small ordered set of such images (a handful, not a long feed), arranged as a closed ring with no visible first or last member.
A single large flowing quotation set across the middle of the view, layered above the image and sized to be read as the second focal element.
A small credit line for the current photo tucked near one corner, deliberately understated so it never competes with the picture.
A pair of small arrow controls, forward and back, placed together low in one corner, persistently visible above the image.
Layer order from back to front: image plane, centered quote, corner credit, corner arrow pair.
During a change, two image planes coexist briefly: the outgoing picture on top being removed and the incoming picture beneath being uncovered.
experience_progression: An image rests full-screen with its quote and credit, holding a quiet moment with no motion demanded of the visitor.
On a directional request, the top picture begins to be erased in hand-made strokes, progressively uncovering the neighboring picture already in place underneath.
The erasure completes, the uncovered picture becomes the resting picture, and its accompanying text settles into place.
The cycle repeats indefinitely in either direction, wrapping past the ends so the sequence never terminates.
attention_and_information_flow: The photograph holds primary prominence at all times because it occupies the full frame and nothing is placed over it beyond sparse text.
The centered quote is the only substantial reading target and draws the eye second, after the picture registers.
The credit is intentionally near-peripheral, discoverable but never a focal point.
During a change, attention shifts to the moving edge of the erasure itself, which reveals the incoming picture piece by piece rather than all at once.
Attention returns to the whole frame once the erasure finishes and the new picture is complete.

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Direction can be reversed on any later request; the arrow controls stay visible and available throughout, and the change always runs to a complete resting state rather than stopping partway
interaction_model.state_change: Advances to the following picture in the ring; the outgoing picture is removed from the top and the following picture becomes the resting picture
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The picture on screen is progressively erased in hand-brushed strokes, uncovering the following picture beneath as the strokes sweep across, until only the new picture and its text remain
interaction_model.input: Click on the forward arrow control while no change is playing
interaction_model.affected_object: The currently displayed full-screen picture and its accompanying quote and credit

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Same availability and completion guarantee as the forward direction; movement is symmetrical in both directions
interaction_model.state_change: Moves to the preceding picture in the ring using the same removal behavior
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Identical hand-brushed erasure of the current picture, uncovering the preceding picture underneath
interaction_model.input: Click on the back arrow control while no change is playing
interaction_model.affected_object: The currently displayed full-screen picture and its accompanying quote and credit

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Once the change finishes, the very next click is honored normally, so rapid clicking degrades into orderly one-at-a-time movement rather than stalling
interaction_model.state_change: No new change is queued or started; the running change continues undisturbed
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The ongoing erasure simply continues to completion with no stutter, jump, restart or half-finished frame; the controls remain on screen and do not disappear or visibly lock out
interaction_model.input: Additional clicks on either arrow that land while an erasure is still playing
interaction_model.affected_object: The in-progress change

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: There is no dead end and no disabled control in either direction
interaction_model.state_change: Wraps around to the opposite end and continues
interaction_model.visible_feedback: No boundary cue of any kind: the same erasure plays and browsing feels continuous, with nothing to signal a first or last picture
interaction_model.input: Reaching either end of the picture set
interaction_model.affected_object: The ordering of the picture ring

experience_qualities: Immersive and uncluttered, with the photograph given the whole frame
Hand-made and painterly rather than mechanical, so the change feels authored by a brush instead of a machine
Unhurried and contemplative, granting each picture its own quiet pause
Continuous and boundless, with no sense of a start or finish to run into
Reliable and unbroken, because every change resolves cleanly no matter how impatiently the controls are used
completion_and_return: Each change completes as a discrete, fully resolved step ending in a single resting full-screen picture with its quote and credit.
The overall experience loops endlessly in both directions and has no terminal or summary state.
The current picture persists on screen indefinitely with no autonomous advance; movement happens only when requested.
Requests arriving mid-change are dropped rather than deferred, so the resting state after a burst of clicks is one step onward, not many.
locked_observable_requirements: One picture at a time fills the entire viewport edge to edge with no frame or visible background.
A large flowing quotation is set across the middle of the view and a small credit sits near a corner, both layered over the picture and both kept subordinate to it.
Change between pictures reads as the top picture being erased or brushed away by hand, progressively uncovering the neighboring picture that is already present underneath.
The change is a removal-and-reveal, never a push, slide, wipe-in of new content, or plain crossfade.
Both directions behave identically and wrap endlessly, presenting no first or last picture and no boundary or disabled state.
A small pair of forward and back arrows sits together low in one corner and remains visible and reachable during changes.
Requests made during a change are ignored so that no change is ever interrupted, restarted or left half-finished.
adaptable_details: Number of pictures in the ring, and their subject matter
Which corner holds the arrow pair and which holds the credit, and the exact arrow styling
Typeface, size, line treatment and tonal or hue treatment of the centered quotation, any of which may be chosen freely as long as it stays clearly readable against the picture beneath
Stroke character of the erasure: brush width, texture, number of strokes, direction and coverage order
Duration and easing of the erasure, within a pace that still reads as deliberate rather than instant
Whether the quote and credit change with each picture or persist across them
Whether additional directional inputs beyond the arrows are offered, provided the arrow pair remains present
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits any small, curated set of full-bleed visuals meant to be admired one at a time with a short piece of overlaid text and an unhurried, artistic voice. Reuse survives changes of subject matter, stroke style, text content, text tone and arrow placement. It stops being this Skill if pictures are shown several at a time, in a boxed or gridded region, if the change becomes a slide, push or plain fade, if the sequence gains a visible beginning or end, if advancing happens automatically on a timer, or if the overlaid text grows into substantial body content that competes with the picture for primary attention.

name: photo_piece_liftoff_with_centering_word
description: A full-screen photo that, on a single press, pushes rectangular cut-outs of itself forward off the flat picture behind them with soft shadows, while a short word's letters slide in from both sides to the center, leaving a permanently layered image that drifts subtly with pointer or device tilt.

canonical_document.name: photo_piece_liftoff_with_centering_word
canonical_document.description: A full-screen photo that, on a single press, pushes rectangular cut-outs of itself forward off the flat picture behind them with soft shadows, while a short word's letters slide in from both sides to the center, leaving a permanently layered image that drifts subtly with pointer or device tilt.
canonical_document.experience_scope: Whole-view experience occupying the entire viewport. It begins the moment the photograph is fully loaded and displayed as a complete still image, runs its one-time reveal on a single press, and ends in a permanent layered composition that continues to respond quietly to pointer or tilt for the rest of the visit; it is not a region inside a larger scrolling page.
content_and_composition: One photograph filling the entire view edge to edge as the flat base layer; it is the sole subject and is never shown partially rendered
A small set of rectangular cut-outs, each showing the same part of the photograph that lies directly behind it, so at rest they are indistinguishable from the base image
A soft shadow associated with each cut-out, absent at rest and present once the cut-out is lifted, sitting between the cut-out and the flat picture beneath
One short title of a single word, composed of individually moving letters, which ends centered in the frame as the focal point
One start control, present only while the picture is still flat and unrevealed, and absent from the composition afterwards
No other foreground content, panels or interface competing with the image and the word
experience_progression: Arrival: the complete photograph fills the view, calm and completely still, with no partial, blurred or progressive appearance and no motion
Readiness: once the picture is fully loaded, the single start control becomes available over the still image

Reveal on one press: rectangular cut-outs detach and push forward off the flat copy behind them one after another in a staggered sequence, each gaining a soft shadow that fades in beneath it, while the word's letters glide inward from opposite sides toward the center of the frame
The start control withdraws during or at the end of the reveal and does not return
Settled state: the lifted layers and centered word hold as a finished composition — no looping, replay or reset
Ambient state thereafter: the lifted cut-outs glide by differing small amounts in response to pointer movement or device tilt while the base picture stays fixed
attention_and_information_flow: At first the whole photograph reads as one flat finished image, with nothing drawing the eye to a specific area
The only invitation on screen is the single start control, which appears solely once the picture is complete
During the reveal attention follows the staggered lift from one cut-out to the next; the fading-in shadows are what make the separation and depth legible
The inward-gliding letters accumulate into the center, so by the end of the reveal the word is the clear focal point over the layered picture
Removing the control after use leaves only image and word, so nothing competes with the final composition
In the settled state the differential drift of the lifted pieces keeps the depth relationship readable without introducing new information

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: The control is withheld until the picture is whole; the visitor must never see a half-loaded or progressively appearing image, so no reveal can be started before the picture is complete
interaction_model.state_change: From a view with no available action to a view offering exactly one start control
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The complete still photograph is shown and the start control becomes present over it
interaction_model.input: Autonomous driver: the photograph finishing loading completely
interaction_model.affected_object: The start control and the initial view

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Irreversible and non-repeatable: further presses neither restart nor compound the reveal, and no undo or replay is offered; the reveal always ends in the same settled layered state
interaction_model.state_change: One-time transition from the flat unrevealed picture to the lifted, layered, titled composition
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Cut-outs push forward off the flat picture one after another with a soft shadow fading in beneath each, the letters glide inward from opposite sides to gather in the center, and the control withdraws
interaction_model.input: A single press of the start control
interaction_model.affected_object: The rectangular cut-outs, their shadows, the word's letters and the control itself

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Motion stays within a small range and returns toward the settled offsets when input stops or is unavailable; the base photograph never moves and the composition cannot be pushed out of alignment or off screen
interaction_model.state_change: From settled resting offsets to small differing offsets per cut-out and back
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The lifted pieces glide by differing small amounts, reinforcing that they float above the flat picture
interaction_model.input: Pointer movement, or tilting a handheld device, after the reveal has completed
interaction_model.affected_object: The lifted cut-outs relative to the fixed base photograph

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Resizing never re-triggers, restarts or undoes the reveal, and never brings the start control back
interaction_model.state_change: Layout recomputed while the revealed layered state persists
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The photograph still fills the view and each cut-out still covers the same proportional part of the picture, so the pieces never slide onto the wrong content
interaction_model.input: Resizing the view
interaction_model.affected_object: The photograph and every cut-out

experience_qualities: Calm and complete on arrival — the first impression is a finished picture, not something assembling itself
A single deliberate, ceremonial moment rather than continuous decoration
Physical and tactile: pieces of the picture feel like they detach and hover slightly above it
Quiet and unhurried, with the staggered lift reading as one soft cascade
Subtly alive afterwards, responsive but never busy or distracting
Resolved: the word landing in the center gives the composition a clear ending
completion_and_return: The reveal completes exactly once per visit and its result is the permanent state of the view
No looping, replaying, resetting or returning to the flat unrevealed picture
The start control disappears permanently once used
Only the ambient pointer/tilt drift continues, always resolving back toward the settled resting arrangement
locked_observable_requirements: One photograph fills the whole view and is never seen half-loaded or progressively assembled
The start control appears only after the picture is fully shown and withdraws once used
The reveal is a single, one-shot, non-repeatable, non-compounding transition
Lifted pieces are rectangular cut-outs of the photograph itself, aligned exactly with the part of the picture behind them at rest
The cut-outs lift one after another rather than all at once
A soft shadow fades in beneath each lifted cut-out, giving a readable sense of depth
The short title's letters glide inward from opposite sides and gather centered in the frame as the final focal point
The end state is a static finished layered composition, not a loop
After the reveal, pointer movement or device tilt glides the lifted pieces by differing small amounts while the base image stays fixed
Each cut-out keeps covering the same proportional part of the picture across view sizes
adaptable_details: Number, size, aspect and placement of the cut-outs
Order, stagger interval, easing and total duration of the lift
Lift distance and shadow softness, spread and opacity
The word itself, its letter count, typeface, weight, size and whatever treatment gives it legible contrast against the picture beneath
Appearance, wording, placement and withdrawal manner of the start control
Subject and mood of the photograph
Magnitude and responsiveness of the pointer/tilt drift
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits any view built around a single strong full-bleed photograph or artwork paired with a very short one-word title and no competing foreground content, dense text or scrolling body. It transfers to openers for portfolios, campaigns, announcements and single-work presentations. It becomes a different Skill if the picture is replaced by multiple images or a gallery, if the reveal loops, resets or replays, if progression is driven by scrolling or automatic timing instead of one deliberate press, if the lifted pieces are non-rectangular or not drawn from the picture itself, or if substantial text and interface must sit over the image.

name: shape_wipe_tiled_batch_showcase
description: A screen-filling grid of a few large image tiles that advances in batches: flat shapes sweep across the tiles at slightly staggered moments to cover what is showing, then pull away to reveal the next batch in the same frame, cycling endlessly in either direction.

canonical_document.name: shape_wipe_tiled_batch_showcase
canonical_document.description: A screen-filling grid of a few large image tiles that advances in batches: flat shapes sweep across the tiles at slightly staggered moments to cover what is showing, then pull away to reveal the next batch in the same frame, cycling endlessly in either direction.
canonical_document.experience_scope: A self-contained viewing region that normally occupies the entire viewport; it begins when the first batch is revealed and has no end state, since batches cycle continuously in both directions.
content_and_composition: One media set divided into fixed-size batches; each batch shows several large image tiles at once (a small count, not a long list)
Tiles are laid out edge to edge with no surrounding page margin, gutters or per-item chrome, so a batch reads as one bold composition
A transient cover layer of flat, fully opaque graphic shapes sits above the tiles and is visible only during a change
A persistent pair of small forward/backward arrow controls anchored in one corner, overlaying the composition
Only the batch currently on screen is interactive; batches not on screen are absent from interaction entirely
experience_progression: A batch rests on screen as a static full-frame composition
On a forward or backward step, flat shapes sweep across the tiles at slightly offset moments until the batch is fully covered
Under the cover, the composition is replaced by the next or previous batch
The shapes clear away in the same staggered rhythm, uncovering the new batch tile by tile
The new batch rests, and the cycle can repeat indefinitely; passing the last batch continues into the first and passing the first continues into the last
attention_and_information_flow: At rest, attention is held by the batch as a whole rather than by any single tile, because the tiles share one uninterrupted frame
During a change, attention shifts to the sweeping shapes, which briefly become the dominant graphic element and hide all image content
The staggered timing pulls the eye across the composition in a consistent direction, so each change reads as one gesture with internal rhythm rather than simultaneous flicker
Controls stay quietly present and never compete with the media, but remain the obvious way onward
No progress count, batch index or end-of-set signal is surfaced; continuation always looks available

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: The step always completes on its own; it is not interruptible or reversible mid-change, and the view is never left partly covered
interaction_model.state_change: Current batch is covered, replaced by the next batch, then uncovered
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Flat shapes sweep across each tile at slightly offset moments to conceal the batch, then withdraw in the same staggered rhythm to expose the new one
interaction_model.input: Activating the forward arrow control or pressing the equivalent directional key
interaction_model.affected_object: The on-screen batch of image tiles

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Symmetric with the forward step; either direction is always available from any batch
interaction_model.state_change: Current batch is covered and replaced by the previous batch, then uncovered
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The same staggered cover-and-uncover gesture, resolving to the previous batch
interaction_model.input: Activating the backward arrow control or pressing the equivalent opposite directional key
interaction_model.affected_object: The on-screen batch of image tiles

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Input becomes effective again as soon as the new batch has settled, so rapid pressing cannot stack or desynchronize batches
interaction_model.state_change: The extra input is discarded; nothing is queued, accelerated or cut short
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The running gesture continues undisturbed at its own pace
interaction_model.input: Any further control activation or key press while a change is running
interaction_model.affected_object: The change in progress

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: There is no dead end and no empty screen in either direction
interaction_model.state_change: Continues around to the opposite end of the set
interaction_model.visible_feedback: An ordinary cover-and-uncover gesture identical to any other step, with no boundary cue, bounce or blank frame
interaction_model.input: Stepping past the last or first batch
interaction_model.affected_object: Batch order

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Controls only begin responding once the media for the view is ready, so the first gesture never runs over unresolved tiles
interaction_model.state_change: Only the visible batch responds; off-screen batches are inert
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Interaction affordance is confined to what is actually framed on screen
interaction_model.input: Clicking or tapping a tile
interaction_model.affected_object: Tiles of the batch currently on screen

experience_qualities: Bold and poster-like at rest, with images treated as one composed surface
Deliberate and graphic in motion, closer to a printed or title-sequence wipe than a soft crossfade
Rhythmic, because the offset timing repeats identically on every step
Composed and unhurried, since changes cannot be rushed or stacked
Continuous and open-ended, with no visible edge to the collection
completion_and_return: No terminal state: batches loop in both directions so viewing can continue indefinitely and return to the opening batch
Each change resolves fully to a settled, fully revealed batch before further input takes effect
The batch on screen persists unchanged until the viewer steps again
locked_observable_requirements: Several images shown simultaneously as edge-to-edge tiles filling the viewport, read as one composition
Advancing happens in whole batches, never one item at a time and never by continuous scrolling
Transition is a cover-then-uncover pass by flat, fully opaque shapes that completely conceal what is beneath, with the incoming batch revealed only after the outgoing one is hidden
Per-tile timing is offset rather than simultaneous, producing a visible sweep direction
Forward and backward controls in a fixed corner, mirrored by directional keys, both doing exactly the same thing
Changes are non-interruptible and extra input during a change is ignored, not queued
Both directions wrap around endlessly with no boundary state and no empty screen
adaptable_details: Number of tiles per batch and their grid arrangement
