Shape, fill appearance including any hue, and sweep direction of the covering forms
Exact duration and size of the per-tile timing offset
Visual style, size and corner placement of the arrow controls
Aspect ratios and subject matter of the media
Whether tiles carry any secondary caption or hover treatment
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits collections of visually strong, comparable items that gain from being seen several at a time and consumed in curated screenfuls, in a view that can claim the full viewport. Replacing batch stepping with continuous scrolling or one-item-at-a-time paging, letting the incoming batch appear before the outgoing one is hidden, allowing changes to be interrupted or queued, or reducing the layout to bounded cards inside a longer page would each produce a different Skill.

name: cover_wall_to_spinning_disc_player
description: A wall of cover artwork with legible labels opens one item full-view through a fully opaque circle, clearly separated in tone from the view it covers, expanding from the press point, slides between neighbours, fills a ring around the play control to commit, then turns the cover into a spinning disc with a draggable arm and live waveform before returning to the wall exactly as it was.

canonical_document.name: cover_wall_to_spinning_disc_player
canonical_document.description: A wall of cover artwork with legible labels opens one item full-view through a fully opaque circle, clearly separated in tone from the view it covers, expanding from the press point, slides between neighbours, fills a ring around the play control to commit, then turns the cover into a spinning disc with a draggable arm and live waveform before returning to the wall exactly as it was.
canonical_document.experience_scope: Whole-view experience with three connected states: the arrival collection view, the single-item focus view, and the playback stage. It begins when the collection view loads and ends when the visitor returns from playback to the collection, which is restored to its prior position; each state occupies the full view rather than a widget region.
content_and_composition: Collection view: many cover-artwork items laid out so the entire set can be taken in at once, each with three short text fields (creator, title, year) legible at overview size so items can be compared without opening them

Focus view: exactly one cover shown alone and large, with its identifying text, a central play control overlaid or adjacent, a previous and a next control on either side, and a persistent way back to the collection
Transition layer: a single fully opaque circle above the outgoing view, its tone clearly separated from what it covers, originating at the pressed coordinates

Playback stage: one circular disc whose face is the chosen artwork, one arm resting over the disc that can be taken hold of and moved across it, the currently playing track name, a live waveform trace, a stop control and a persistent return-to-collection control
The play control carries a ring around its perimeter that acts as both idle mark and progress mark
Layer relationship: collection sits beneath focus, focus is replaced by the playback stage as the cover clears away; controls for stopping and returning persist above the stage throughout
experience_progression: Overview: the whole collection is scanned and compared at a glance

Origin reveal: a fully opaque circle, distinctly separated in tone from the view beneath it, grows outward from the exact pressed point until it covers the view, then hands over to the single chosen item

Lateral browse: neighbours are moved through by sliding the current cover out while the next slides in, wrapping from the last item back to the first and vice versa, with the item remaining fully reversible
Readying: the ring around the play control fills over a short, visible interval
Hand-off: the cover clears away, the disc starts turning, the arm settles onto the disc's outer edge, and sound follows shortly after the motion has begun
Playing: the disc keeps turning while the track name and live waveform trace update
Handling: the arm can be taken hold of and moved across the disc, suspending sound and freezing the trace, then resuming from the released position
Return: leaving the stage restores the collection at the position it was left
attention_and_information_flow: At arrival attention is spread evenly across the whole set; label text is deliberately legible enough at overview size that comparison happens before selection
The expanding opaque circle briefly removes all competing information, so attention resets to the single item that emerges
In focus view all prominence belongs to one cover; neighbour controls are secondary and the play control is the single strongest call
The filling ring localises attention to the moment of commitment and makes elapsed readying legible without extra text
Entering playback shifts prominence from static artwork to continuous motion: the turning disc and moving trace lead, the track name supports
While the arm is handled, the frozen trace and silence make the arm the only active focus; the still-turning disc signals the experience is suspended rather than ended
Returning restores the earlier overview state so the visitor's prior scanning position remains the reference point

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: The persistent back affordance in focus view returns to the collection with the previous scan position intact
interaction_model.state_change: Collection view is covered and replaced by the single-item focus view for the pressed item
interaction_model.visible_feedback: A fully opaque circle, reading as clearly separated in tone from the outgoing view, grows outward from the exact pressed coordinates until it fills the view, then the chosen cover is shown alone
interaction_model.input: Press on a cover in the collection view at a specific point
interaction_model.affected_object: Whole view and the pressed item

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Direction is symmetric and immediately reversible; the set never dead-ends because both ends wrap
interaction_model.state_change: Focus moves to the adjacent item, wrapping around at either end of the set
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The current cover slides out while the neighbouring cover slides in from the opposite side, with its labels following it
interaction_model.input: Activate the forward or back control in focus view
interaction_model.affected_object: The currently shown cover and its neighbour

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Moving to another item or leaving part way abandons the fill and restores the idle mark, with no playback started
interaction_model.state_change: Idle mark transitions into a filling progress mark and, on completion, into the playback hand-off
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The ring fills progressively around the control over a short visible interval
interaction_model.input: Sustained engagement with the central play control
interaction_model.affected_object: The ring around the play control

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Stop and return-to-collection controls are present from the moment the stage appears
interaction_model.state_change: Focus view resolves into the playback stage
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The cover clears away, the artwork appears as a turning disc, the arm settles onto the disc's outer edge, and sound begins shortly after the motion is already visible
interaction_model.input: Completion of the readying interval
interaction_model.affected_object: Focus view cover, disc, arm and sound

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Playback can be stopped at any time or interrupted by handling the arm
interaction_model.state_change: Playback position advances continuously
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The disc keeps turning, the current track name is displayed, and the waveform trace updates live with the sound
interaction_model.input: Autonomous playback advance
interaction_model.affected_object: Disc, track name and waveform trace

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Releasing over the disc resumes from wherever the arm now sits; releasing past the disc's edges parks the arm and brings the disc to rest
interaction_model.state_change: Playback is suspended while position is being chosen by hand
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Sound goes silent and the trace freezes while the arm follows the pointer and the disc continues turning
interaction_model.input: Take hold of the arm and move it across the disc
interaction_model.affected_object: Arm position, sound and waveform trace

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Remains available throughout the stage; the return-to-collection control is unaffected
interaction_model.state_change: Playback ends and the stage settles into a resting state
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Sound stops, the disc comes to rest and the arm parks
interaction_model.input: Activate the stop control
interaction_model.affected_object: Playback stage

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Available at any point in the stage, including mid-playback and while readying
interaction_model.state_change: Playback stage is exited and the collection view is restored
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Browsing reappears at exactly the position it was left, not reset to the start
interaction_model.input: Activate the return-to-collection control
interaction_model.affected_object: Whole view

experience_qualities: Scannable and comparable at arrival rather than sequential
Stepping-closer intimacy when one item takes the whole view
Fluid and reversible lateral movement with no dead ends
Deliberate, visibly earned commitment rather than instant triggering
Unhurried, tactile and analog in the playback stage
Physical-object credibility: motion leads and sound follows the object
Direct manual control with a felt sense of grabbing and releasing
Continuity of place, so leaving and coming back does not lose the visitor's position
completion_and_return: The readying build-up either completes into playback or is fully abandoned, returning the control to its idle mark
Playback either continues until stopped or is ended by parking the arm past the disc's edges, which brings the disc to rest
Lateral browsing loops endlessly by wrapping at both ends of the set
Leaving the playback stage returns to the collection at the exact prior browsing position, making the browse state persistent across the whole experience
locked_observable_requirements: The entire collection is visible at once on arrival with per-item labels legible enough to compare without opening an item
Selection is carried by a fully opaque circular sweep, distinctly separated in tone from the view it covers, that grows from the exact pressed point and covers the view before handing over
The focused item occupies the view alone and large
Neighbour movement is a slide-out/slide-in pair that wraps at both ends
The play control is surrounded by a ring that visibly fills during a short readying interval and reverts to an idle mark if abandoned
Abandonment is triggered both by moving to another item and by leaving part way, and starts no playback
On hand-off the flat cover clears away and the same artwork becomes the face of a turning disc
The arm settles onto the disc's outer edge and sound starts after motion is already visible, not simultaneously
The playing track name and a live waveform trace are shown during playback
Grabbing and moving the arm silences sound and freezes the trace while the disc keeps turning
Releasing over the disc resumes from the arm's new position; releasing past the edges parks the arm and stops the disc
A stop control and a return-to-collection control remain available for the whole playback stage
Returning from playback restores the prior browsing position rather than resetting
adaptable_details: Layout shape of the overview (grid, wall, staggered rows) and how many items it holds
Which tone the expanding circle uses and whether it is derived from each item's own artwork
Exact durations of the sweep, slide, ring fill and disc spin-up
Whether the label fields are creator/title/year or another short comparable triplet
Visual style of the disc face, arm and waveform rendering
Placement and iconography of the previous, next, play, stop and return controls
Whether the readying ring is driven by a hold, a press-and-wait or another sustained engagement
Whether the trace shows amplitude, frequency or another live representation of the sound
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits any collection of visually distinctive square or card-like artwork items with short comparable labels that each front a continuous time-based media item, where a designer wants overview, focused single-item view and an object-like playback stage joined into one experience. It stays the same Skill if the media type, item count, layout or colour treatment change. It becomes a different Skill if the artwork no longer becomes the played object itself, if the position handle stops being directly grabbable across the object, if playback stops being presented as a continuously moving physical thing, or if the overview cannot be taken in at once and becomes a paged or scroll-fed list where comparison is impossible.

name: tilted_layered_tile_field
description: The full collection sits on a tilted plane as a layered field of stacked picture tiles that drifts diagonally with scroll; the pointed-at tile rises as a fanned floating stack with a spreading shadow and its credit shown, then drops back flat.

canonical_document.name: tilted_layered_tile_field
canonical_document.description: The full collection sits on a tilted plane as a layered field of stacked picture tiles that drifts diagonally with scroll; the pointed-at tile rises as a fanned floating stack with a spreading shadow and its credit shown, then drops back flat.
canonical_document.experience_scope: Whole-view experience: begins with a brief calm hold while the collection prepares, occupies the entire viewport as the travelling field, and ends when the far end of the collection is reached or a tile is activated to leave for its credited destination.
content_and_composition: One primary content role: many equal-weight picture tiles, cardinality large enough that the field reads as a collection rather than a handful of items
Each tile is itself a small stack of layered images that can separate vertically, plus an attached credit label
Tiles are arranged across a single tilted three-dimensional plane with depth layering, so nearer tiles read larger/closer and the whole reads as a miniature landscape rather than a flat page
A raised layer above the plane, occupied only by the currently attended tile and its outward-spreading shadow
Persistent elements: the tilted plane itself and the continuous field of tiles; the credit label is persistent per tile but only legible while that tile is attended
experience_progression: Short calm wait while the collection prepares, with no partial or jumbled field shown
The prepared set resolves into the tilted layered field
Tiles ease into place a few at a time rather than all at once, keeping arrival attention near the front edge
Continuous unhurried diagonal travel across the plane as scroll advances, in either direction
A hard end at the far extent of the collection, with the travelled path retraceable back to the start
Per-tile sub-progression: rise and fan on attention, settle flat on release
attention_and_information_flow: During arrival, prominence stays near the front edge of the field where tiles are still easing in
During travel, prominence belongs to the band of tiles crossing the foreground of the tilted plane
On attention, a single tile becomes unambiguously dominant: raised above its neighbours, layers separated, shadow spread outward, credit made legible
Credit information is revealed only for the attended tile, so identity is available on demand instead of competing across the whole field
After release the field returns to calm even order with no residual emphasis

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Reversible at any moment; motion stops at a real end of the collection rather than looping or rubber-banding into an endless field; the traversed path can be retraced back
interaction_model.state_change: Field position advances or retreats diagonally along the tilted plane; scrollable length corresponds to the full collection
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Continuous, unhurried diagonal drift of the whole field with depth-consistent motion of layered tiles
interaction_model.input: Scroll
interaction_model.affected_object: The entire tilted field of tiles

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Moving away settles the tile flat again quickly and hides the credit
interaction_model.state_change: Tile transitions from flat in-plane to raised fanned stack above the plane, with credit shown
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Stacked images pull apart into a floating stack sitting above neighbouring tiles, shadow spreads outward to read the lift, credit becomes legible
interaction_model.input: Pointing at / hovering a tile
interaction_model.affected_object: That tile's image stack, its shadow and its credit label

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Interruption is the recovery mechanism: every abandoned tile returns to the flat field state
interaction_model.state_change: In-progress lift/settle transitions are cut off and resolved rather than queued
interaction_model.visible_feedback: No tile is left half-lifted, fanned or stranded above the field; at most the currently attended tile is raised
interaction_model.input: Sweeping the pointer rapidly across many tiles
interaction_model.affected_object: Any tiles with lift or settle motion already underway

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Activation targets exactly the tile currently raised and credited, so the opened destination always matches the visible focus
interaction_model.state_change: Experience is exited toward the destination associated with that tile's credit
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Departure from the field view
interaction_model.input: Activating a tile
interaction_model.affected_object: The attended tile's credited destination

experience_qualities: Calm and unhurried rather than fast or energetic
Spatial and landscape-like, closer to travelling through a scene than paging a grid
Layered and tactile, with lift, separation and shadow reading as physical depth
Continuous and reversible, never disorienting or jumpy
Orderly at rest: the field always returns to even calm arrangement
completion_and_return: Reaching the far end of the collection is a genuine terminus, not a loop
The full path remains retraceable in the reverse direction
Tile lift always resolves back to the flat field state, including when interrupted
Activation completes the experience by leaving for the credited destination
locked_observable_requirements: The collection is presented on a tilted three-dimensional plane with depth layering, not as a flat grid
Scroll drives diagonal travel of the whole field, reversible at any time, with scrollable length matching the full collection and a hard end instead of looping
Tiles arrive staggered a few at a time, with attention held near the front edge
Only one tile is emphasized at a time, and it is raised above its neighbours
Emphasis is composed of three simultaneous cues: layered images pulling apart into a floating stack, shadow spreading outward, and the credit becoming legible
Release settles the tile flat quickly and the field returns to calm order
Rapid movement between tiles cancels in-flight motion so nothing remains half-lifted or stuck above the field
Activating the emphasized tile opens the destination belonging to its visible credit
adaptable_details: Tilt angle, travel direction and diagonal slope
Number of tiles, field width and how many images each tile stacks
Tile proportions, spacing and density of the field
Exact lift height, fan offset, shadow spread and timing of rise and settle
Number of tiles that ease in per arrival step and the length of the preparing hold
Credit label placement, typography and wording

Any palette, surface treatment and ambient styling of the plane and its surround, in any luminance range, as long as tiles stay separated from the surround, the raised tile stays visibly distinct from its neighbours, and the credit remains readable
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits collections of many comparable image-led items where each item has a short attribution or title and its own destination, and where the whole set is meant to be surveyed as one scene. Replacing the tilted travelling plane with an upright flat grid, making travel autonomous or looping instead of scroll-driven and finite, allowing several tiles to stay raised at once, or reducing items to single unstackable images without credits would each produce a different Skill.

name: framed_living_parallax_vista
description: An ornate border eases into place around an illustrated world that never stops breathing; pointer movement tilts near and far layers in opposite directions with a soft lag, and carrying the pointer rightward swells the scene outward from its centre.

canonical_document.name: framed_living_parallax_vista
canonical_document.description: An ornate border eases into place around an illustrated world that never stops breathing; pointer movement tilts near and far layers in opposite directions with a soft lag, and carrying the pointer rightward swells the scene outward from its centre.
canonical_document.experience_scope: A single whole-view experience occupying the entire visible stage: it begins the moment the view is entered, with the frame settling in and the scene starting to move, and has no end point while the view remains open. The frame plus the artwork it encloses form one indivisible region.
content_and_composition: One decorative border enclosing the entire composition, persistent for the whole experience
One dominant central subject inside the frame that anchors the composition and reads as the visual entry point
Multiple depth bands arranged from near to far: foreground/near elements, mid-distance landforms and water, and distant sky elements
Several small scattered secondary figures distributed outward from the centre across the depth bands, sparse enough that the centre stays dominant
Ornamental smallest-scale details treated as an optional outermost tier of richness
Layer order and depth cues are explicit: the composition must read as near versus far, not as a flat picture
The composition always reads as one balanced whole; nothing is cropped away at any size
experience_progression: Entry: the enclosing border eases into position around the artwork rather than appearing instantly, reading as a picture waking up
Settling: the enclosed world begins its quiet continuous motion as the frame arrives
Endless idle: layers keep drifting and breathing indefinitely with no completion, climax or final frame
Pointer-driven states overlay this idle motion continuously and are positional rather than staged
attention_and_information_flow: Attention lands first on the central dominant subject through its size, position and prominence
Attention then drifts outward to the scattered distant and mid-depth figures, which are discovered rather than announced
No labels, captions or callouts compete with the artwork; information is entirely pictorial
Depth separation guides the eye: opposing layer motion makes near and far legible and keeps the eye moving between them
Detail richness modulates prominence: when space is tight the outermost ornaments recede so the central subject and main depth bands stay clear

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Continuous and fully reversible; every pointer position is a valid view, returning the pointer retraces the tilt, and stopping leaves the scene resting at that view while the idle breathing continues
interaction_model.state_change: Each layer offsets by an amount tied to its depth, near layers shifting one direction and distant sky layers the opposite direction, producing a whole-world tilt
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The scene appears to tilt and open up in depth; layers glide rather than jump, each easing after the pointer a beat late so motion trails the cursor
interaction_model.input: Pointer moved across the artwork
interaction_model.affected_object: All depth layers of the scene

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Drifting back toward the left settles the scene back down along the same path, reversing the swell exactly; there is no committed state, no threshold and nothing to dismiss
interaction_model.state_change: The scene gradually swells, with layers pushed outward from the composition's centre in proportion to how far right the pointer has travelled
interaction_model.visible_feedback: A smooth, growing sense of moving into the scene: the world enlarges and its layers spread away from the centre, deepening the near/far separation
interaction_model.input: Pointer carried progressively toward the right side of the artwork
interaction_model.affected_object: The whole enclosed scene and its layers

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Fully reversible with size; the central subject and main depth bands are never removed, only the optional outermost detail tier
interaction_model.state_change: The frame and enclosed composition refit to the new space; the smallest ornaments fade or shrink out of the composition as room runs short and return as room comes back
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The picture stays whole and balanced with no cropping; ornamental richness eases away and eases back rather than popping
interaction_model.input: Window or container resized
interaction_model.affected_object: The border and the artwork it encloses, including the smallest ornamental figures

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Never terminates on its own; pointer interaction layers on top of it rather than replacing it
interaction_model.state_change: Layers drift and elements move continuously on their own
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The world keeps quietly breathing so the picture never looks paused or finished
interaction_model.input: No input (autonomous idle motion)
interaction_model.affected_object: All scene layers and their inhabitants

experience_qualities: Dreamy and calm rather than energetic
Alive and endless — never reads as finished or stalled
Soft and trailing: motion always eases and lags, never snaps
Spatially deep, with a clear read of near and far
Composed and picture-like because of the enclosing frame
Rewarding to linger over, with small details found by looking outward
completion_and_return: No completion state; the idle motion loops indefinitely
Pointer-driven tilt and swell hold whatever position the pointer leaves them at and reverse exactly on return
Resizing re-settles into an equivalent balanced composition rather than a different arrangement
Leaving and re-entering the view replays the frame settling in and the scene waking
locked_observable_requirements: A decorative enclosing border that eases into place at entry and always frames the artwork
Continuous autonomous motion inside the scene that never resolves or stops
At least three distinguishable depth bands whose pointer-driven offsets differ by depth, with near and distant layers moving in opposite directions
Every layer's response eases and trails the pointer instead of tracking it instantly
One dominant central subject that receives first attention, with secondary figures discovered outward from it
Horizontal pointer travel toward one side progressively swells the scene and pushes layers outward from the centre, and travelling back reverses it exactly
All pointer-driven states are continuous, positional and reversible, with no thresholds or committed states
The composition is never cropped; when space is short only the smallest ornamental details ease out of sight, returning when space allows
adaptable_details: Subject matter and art style of the illustrated world
Ornament style and thickness of the border
Which specific small figures populate the outer depth bands and how many
Exact tilt range, swell amount, lag duration and easing character
Colour palette and lighting mood
Which side of the artwork triggers the swell
Number of depth bands beyond the required minimum
Thresholds at which the smallest ornaments fade out
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits any single cohesive pictorial scene with a clear dominant subject and stackable near-to-far layers that is meant to be contemplated rather than acted upon, with little or no foreground copy over it. Replacing the pointer-position response with click, scroll or drag navigation, introducing discrete scenes or steps, adding a resolved ending, or letting the composition crop or reflow into separate blocks at small sizes would each produce a different Skill. Placing dense reading content or interactive controls on top of it also changes it, since the artwork is the foreground rather than a substrate.

name: scattered_teaser_photos_settling_into_captioned_collection
description: An opaque opening screen lifts upward to reveal that the few loose snapshots clustered around the product figure are the first members of the full captioned photo set, travelling into their real places as the rest of the collection appears around them.

canonical_document.name: scattered_teaser_photos_settling_into_captioned_collection
canonical_document.description: An opaque opening screen lifts upward to reveal that the few loose snapshots clustered around the product figure are the first members of the full captioned photo set, travelling into their real places as the rest of the collection appears around them.
canonical_document.experience_scope: A whole-view experience beginning the moment the view is first shown and held, covering the opening composition and the single reveal move, and ending when the full collection is in place and ordinary scrolling browses it; after that the region behaves as a plain browsable collection.
content_and_composition: One fully opaque, visually quiet opening cover layer occluding the entire view above everything else during the wait and the start of the reveal

One opening cluster centred in the view: a short product name, one single-line promise, one central product/device figure, and a small handful of loose snapshot cards scattered at irregular offsets and slight angles around that figure
One persistent downward-pointing cue pinned to the bottom edge of the view while the opening is on screen, signalling that more lies below
One full collection of captioned images in regular reading order below/around the opening area, each with a short caption
The few opening snapshots are the same objects that occupy their own positions inside the full collection; they are never swapped for different items
The opening cluster stays centred in the view as the view size changes
experience_progression: Held quiet wait: nothing revealed, the view cannot be scrolled
Opening moment arrives: name, promise, product figure and scattered snapshots read together as one idea within a second or two, with the downward cue visible

Single continuous reveal: the opaque cover layer clears upward while the loose snapshots travel from their scattered positions into their real places and the remaining collection items appear alongside them
Calm settled state: captioned shots are taken in one after another by ordinary scrolling, with no residue of the opening
attention_and_information_flow: During the wait, attention has nothing to act on; the opaque cover suppresses all content prominence
At the opening moment, prominence is concentrated in the centred cluster, with the promise line and product figure carrying the message and the loose snapshots hinting at the kind of imagery to come
The pinned cue holds a secondary but constant claim on attention, establishing that the experience continues downward
During the reveal, attention follows the upward clearing edge and the travelling snapshots, so the collection is understood as the opening growing rather than a new screen
In the settled state, prominence spreads evenly across the collection and shifts to whichever captioned shot the visitor has scrolled to

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Scroll and swipe gestures made during the wait are discarded rather than queued, so no fragment of the opening can be pushed away early
interaction_model.state_change: Held-and-unscrollable becomes openable while remaining visually unchanged
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The opaque cover layer simply persists with no movement or partial disclosure until readiness, after which the opening composition is presentable
interaction_model.input: Autonomous readiness of the images that the opening depends on
interaction_model.affected_object: The whole view: the opaque opening cover layer and page scrolling

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Further presses or gestures are ignored for the duration of the move; the move always completes to the settled state and is never left half-open
interaction_model.state_change: Opening state advances once into the full-collection state
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The opaque cover layer clears upward as the loose snapshots move into their real positions and the remaining captioned items appear alongside them, all as one continuous move
interaction_model.input: Press of the downward cue pinned at the bottom edge
interaction_model.affected_object: The opaque opening cover layer, the scattered snapshots and the rest of the collection

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: That first gesture is consumed as the trigger rather than scrolling the view; additional gestures during the move are ignored, and normal scrolling becomes available only once the move ends
interaction_model.state_change: Identical single advance from opening state to full-collection state
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The same upward clearing and snapshot travel as the cue press, so the two entry paths are indistinguishable
interaction_model.input: The visitor's very first scroll gesture after the wait
interaction_model.affected_object: The same opening cover layer, snapshots and collection

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Fully reversible in both directions; the opening is not re-entered
interaction_model.state_change: Progress through the collection advances and retreats freely
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Captioned shots come into view one after another in a calm, unforced rhythm
interaction_model.input: Ordinary scrolling after the reveal has finished
interaction_model.affected_object: The captioned collection

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Applies during the wait and the opening; the reveal remains available and correct afterwards
interaction_model.state_change: Cluster geometry is re-measured against the new view
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The arrangement stays correctly centred instead of drifting off-centre or jumping
interaction_model.input: Change of view size while the opening is on screen
interaction_model.affected_object: The scattered snapshot arrangement around the product figure

experience_qualities: Quiet and withheld at the start, then a compact arrival that reads instantly
Continuous rather than cut: one move, not two screens
Recognisable identity of the snapshots as they carry over, which makes the collection feel like an unfolding of the promise
Deliberate and uninterruptible while it runs, so the moment cannot be scrubbed or stuttered
Calm and unhurried once settled
completion_and_return: The reveal happens once per visit and does not loop or replay
No path back to the occluded opening state; the settled browsable state is persistent
Ordinary scroll position becomes the only state the visitor manages afterwards
locked_observable_requirements: Scrolling is held and early gestures discarded until the opening's images are ready
Two triggers, a pinned bottom-edge downward cue and the first scroll gesture, start exactly the same reveal
The reveal is a single continuous move, not a fade-out followed by a separate build
The same few opening snapshots travel into their real positions inside the full set and are never swapped for different items
The fully opaque opening cover layer clears upward
Additional triggers are ignored while the reveal runs, and it always completes
The opening composition combines a short name, a one-line promise, a central product figure and a small scattered snapshot cluster centred in the view
The opening makes it visible that more content lies further down
The end state is calm sequential browsing of captioned images
The scattered cluster stays centred when the view is resized during the opening
adaptable_details: Number of loose snapshots and their exact offsets and angles
Duration and easing of the wait and the reveal
Tone, hue and overall palette of the opening cover layer and the surrounding surfaces, provided the cover stays fully opaque and low-distraction and the opening text and figure keep readable contrast
Shape of the downward cue and whether it also animates in place
Nature of the central figure and the wording of name, promise and captions
Layout geometry of the final collection and how captions are placed
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits single-view entrances for image-led marketing, product or portfolio pages where a small teaser set of visual items is literally part of a larger collection shown below, and where the opening message is short enough to read at a glance. Substituting different items for the teaser ones instead of carrying them over, splitting the reveal into a separate exit and entrance, making the opening replayable or loopable, or applying it to text-only or data-dense content would create a different Skill.

source_sites.title: Polaroid Stack to Grid Intro Animation

name: cursor_led_layered_photo_depth
description: A photograph made of faint overlapping copies of itself that slide and rotate by differing amounts as the cursor travels over it, reading as gentle layered depth and easing back to perfectly flat when the cursor leaves.

canonical_document.name: cursor_led_layered_photo_depth
canonical_document.description: A photograph made of faint overlapping copies of itself that slide and rotate by differing amounts as the cursor travels over it, reading as gentle layered depth and easing back to perfectly flat when the cursor leaves.
canonical_document.experience_scope: Region experience attached to any single photograph, applied first to a full-viewport opening image whose entire visible frame is responsive and again to smaller sample photographs further down the same view; each photograph's experience begins when the cursor enters its frame and ends when the cursor leaves and it returns to flat.
content_and_composition: One dominant photograph filling the whole opening screen, carrying the mood on its own
One short title set quietly over the opening photograph, restrained in presence while staying readable rather than competing with the picture
Several faint overlapping copies of the same photograph stacked in register behind or over the base image, invisible as separate pictures at rest
A further-down group of smaller sample photographs, each self-contained, presented to show a range from mild to pronounced depth
A flat, calm resting appearance is the persistent baseline for every photograph on the view
experience_progression: Arrival: the full-screen photograph with its quiet overlaid title is met as a single still image
Within about a second of pointer movement the picture takes on a soft sense of depth without any announcing gesture
Continuing down the view, sample photographs demonstrate the same effect at increasing strength, from barely perceptible to clearly pronounced
Every photograph returns to and rests in the flat, calm state once the pointer is elsewhere
attention_and_information_flow: The photograph holds primary attention at all times; the title stays legible but secondary and never gains prominence from the motion
Depth appears only where the cursor is, so the moving picture is momentarily the focal region of the view
The graded sample photographs shift attention from atmosphere to comparison, letting the visitor read how much depth is available
No new textual information is revealed by the interaction; the only added information is the perceived layering of the image

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Motion is bounded so displacement stays small enough that the copies never visibly come apart into separate images or ghosting; movement is fully reversible by moving back toward the middle
interaction_model.state_change: Each copy takes a slightly different offset and rotation derived from cursor position: neutral when the cursor sits at the middle of the frame, widest as it approaches the edges
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The picture leans and drifts with the cursor and reads as layered depth rather than a flat plate, tracking continuously and immediately with no lag or stepping
interaction_model.input: Cursor moving across a photograph's frame, including the region behind the overlaid title on the opening image
interaction_model.affected_object: The stacked copies of that photograph

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Re-entering the frame resumes tracking immediately from the current position; interrupting the return mid-ease simply picks up live tracking again
interaction_model.state_change: Every copy transitions back to zero offset and zero rotation
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The layers ease straight back to a single flat image with no overshoot or wobble
interaction_model.input: Cursor leaving the photograph's frame
interaction_model.affected_object: All copies of that photograph

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Each photograph is independent, so leaving all of them restores the entirely flat resting view
interaction_model.state_change: The new photograph begins tracking at its own depth strength while the previous one returns to flat
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Only one photograph shows depth at a time; the rest of the view stays calm and flat
interaction_model.input: Pointer entering a different sample photograph
interaction_model.affected_object: The newly hovered photograph and the previously hovered one

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: No degraded or partial motion is attempted; the flat presentation is the complete fallback
interaction_model.state_change: The experience stays in its flat resting state
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The photographs remain intact and legible, and the limitation is stated plainly in plain language rather than left as a silently dead image
interaction_model.input: A device or context that cannot support the effect
interaction_model.affected_object: The photographs and the view as a whole

experience_qualities: Gently alive rather than attention-seeking
Grasped within about a second of movement
Soft, shallow depth instead of dramatic three-dimensional tilt
Continuous and immediate, feeling directly attached to the hand
Calm at rest, with flatness as the natural home state
Cohesive: the picture always reads as one photograph, never as separate stacked copies
completion_and_return: There is no completion state; the experience is an open loop of engage and release
Leaving a photograph always returns it exactly to flat, with no residual offset or rotation
Nothing about the interaction persists between visits or between photographs
The whole view's resting condition is a set of flat, still photographs
locked_observable_requirements: Multiple faint copies of the same photograph, offset and rotated by differing amounts, are what produce the depth
Response is continuous and immediate to cursor position, not stepped or delayed
Neutral, fully flat appearance when the cursor is at the middle of the frame; strongest displacement near the frame edges
Displacement magnitude is small enough that the copies never visibly separate from the base image
Cursor exit eases every copy straight back to flat with no residual state
The opening photograph fills the whole screen with a quiet title over it that stays readable against the image, and the entire visible frame, including the area behind the title, is responsive
Additional sample photographs demonstrate a range of depth strength from mild to pronounced
Flat and calm is the resting state of every photograph
adaptable_details: Photographic subject matter and aspect ratios
Number of stacked copies and their relative faintness
Exact maximum offset and rotation values and the strength assigned to each sample
Easing duration and curve of the return to flat
Title wording, typography, placement and treatment for legibility, including any hue, tone or backing used to hold readable contrast over the image
Number and layout of the sample photographs and the tone, lightness or treatment of the low-distraction surround they sit on
Exact wording and placement of the plain-language unsupported-device message
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits single-image photographic content that must stay legible and calm at rest, whether presented as a full-viewport opening or as inline sample or gallery images, and works on a light, dark or tinted surround as long as the surround stays low-distraction relative to the image. Splitting the image into separately authored foreground and background elements, driving the motion from scroll or time instead of pointer position, or increasing displacement until the copies read as visible duplicates, ghosting or a glitch treatment would create a different Skill.

name: cinematic_print_stack_carousel_with_inline_expansion
description: A full-screen photograph acts as a drifting backdrop while a low horizontal row of collection names, each drawn as a small pile of prints with only its top image faintly visible, loops endlessly; the centred pile reveals a downward marker that expands it into a large scrollable column of images with captions and dates, then eases back to the centred overview.

canonical_document.name: cinematic_print_stack_carousel_with_inline_expansion
canonical_document.description: A full-screen photograph acts as a drifting backdrop while a low horizontal row of collection names, each drawn as a small pile of prints with only its top image faintly visible, loops endlessly; the centred pile reveals a downward marker that expands it into a large scrollable column of images with captions and dates, then eases back to the centred overview.
canonical_document.experience_scope: Whole-view experience. Begins on arrival with the backdrop image filling the viewport and the label row settled low across it; ends either when the visitor leaves the view or when an expanded collection is collapsed back to the same centred overview. Expansion happens inside the same view rather than on a separate screen.
content_and_composition: One large backdrop image filling the viewport, serving as the calm cinematic substrate behind everything else
One horizontal row of collection entries positioned low across the backdrop, several entries visible at once
Each entry is a name plus a small stacked-prints motif whose topmost image shows faintly, suggesting hidden contents beneath
Exactly one entry occupies the centre as the active focus; flanking entries sit at the sides in a visibly quieter, de-emphasised treatment so their presence is obvious without competing
One small downward-pointing marker positioned above the centred name, present only when the row is at rest
Per collection, an expanded vertical column of large images, each accompanied by a caption and a date
Persistent elements across states: the backdrop surface and the centred entry's name and position
experience_progression: Arrival: full-bleed backdrop with the low row already settled, centre entry emphasised, sides quiet
Lateral browsing: entries travel sideways and a new one takes the centre, looping without end in either direction
Settling: motion comes to rest and the downward marker fades in above the centred name
Expansion: the centred stack opens into a tall scrollable column of large images with captions and dates while flanking entries drop away and the marker flips direction
Detailed viewing: the visitor scrolls through the collection's images at large size
Return: the view eases back to the top of the column, the stack collapses, flanking entries return, and the row is again at rest with the same entry centred and ready to move on
attention_and_information_flow: Attention is held on the single centred entry; peripheral entries are deliberately subdued to signal quantity without pulling focus
Each closed stack discloses only a faint top image, withholding the collection's contents until opened
The downward marker is the only new information that appears at rest, reading as an invitation to open
On expansion, prominence transfers from the row to the collection's images, which become the largest and only competing content; per-image caption and date appear alongside each image
On collapse, prominence returns to the row with no loss of position, so the visitor resumes from the same place in the sequence
Backdrop motion stills when the pointer rests on the centred name, quietening the periphery at the moment of intent

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Looping in either direction means no end is ever reached; dragging back reverses the change; the marker reappears only once motion has settled
interaction_model.state_change: The row translates sideways and a different entry becomes the centred, emphasised one; the sequence wraps continuously
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Entries slide laterally with momentum, the incoming entry gains centre emphasis, the outgoing one recedes into the quiet side treatment, and the downward marker is absent while moving
interaction_model.input: Horizontal drag or flick across the row
interaction_model.affected_object: The row of collection entries

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Another click on a different flanking name re-targets the movement; clicking the already-centred entry is instead the open/close action
interaction_model.state_change: That entry becomes the centred one
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The row slides so the chosen entry glides into the centre and takes on centre emphasis
interaction_model.input: Click on a flanking entry's name
interaction_model.affected_object: The row of collection entries

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Expansion requests made while the row is still moving are ignored, so the transition only starts from rest; the flipped marker and the centred name both provide the way back
interaction_model.state_change: The centred stack expands into a scrollable vertical column of its images; flanking entries are removed; sideways dragging is suspended; the marker reverses direction
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The stack opens out into large images with captions and dates, side entries drop away, and the marker flips to indicate the reverse action
interaction_model.input: Click on the downward marker above the centred name
interaction_model.affected_object: The centred stack, the flanking entries and the marker

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Scrolling is freely reversible; sideways browsing stays suspended until the collection is collapsed
interaction_model.state_change: Scroll position advances through the collection's images
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Large images with their captions and dates pass through the viewport
interaction_model.input: Vertical scroll within the expanded collection
interaction_model.affected_object: The expanded column of images

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: The same entry stays centred after collapse so browsing resumes exactly where it left off
interaction_model.state_change: The view returns to the top of the column, the stack collapses, flanking entries return and sideways dragging is re-enabled
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The view eases upward to the start of the column before the stack closes back into its pile form; side entries reappear quietly and the marker returns to its downward orientation
interaction_model.input: Click the centred name while expanded
interaction_model.affected_object: The expanded column, the flanking entries and the row

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: The backdrop settles back to a steady state whenever the pointer comes to rest on the centred name
interaction_model.state_change: The backdrop shifts and tilts, trailing the pointer with a lag
interaction_model.visible_feedback: A slow drifting and tilting of the full-screen image that follows the pointer rather than matching it exactly
interaction_model.input: Pointer movement anywhere in the view
interaction_model.affected_object: The backdrop image

experience_qualities: Calm, unhurried and cinematic rather than energetic
Curated and gallery-like, with one subject held in focus at a time
Depth and physicality from stacked prints and a lagging, tilting backdrop
Restrained periphery that communicates abundance without clutter
Continuous and endless lateral movement with no visible edges
Predictable, reversible transitions that always return to a known resting composition
completion_and_return: Lateral browsing has no completion state; it loops indefinitely in both directions
Collapsing an expanded collection always returns to the same overview with the same entry still centred
Return is preceded by easing the expanded column back to its top so the collapse begins from a consistent position
The at-rest overview with a visible downward marker is the canonical resting state of the experience
locked_observable_requirements: A full-viewport image substrate behind a low horizontal row of group entries
Group entries rendered as small stacks with only the top item faintly visible while closed
Exactly one centred, emphasised entry with visibly quietened neighbours at both sides
Endless looping lateral movement via drag or flick, plus click-a-neighbour to bring it to centre
A small directional marker that appears above the centred entry only when movement has settled, and that flips orientation when expanded
Expansion of the centred stack in place into a scrollable column of large items each with a caption and a date
Neighbours drop away and lateral dragging is suspended for the duration of expansion
Expansion requests during movement are ignored
Collapse eases back to the top of the column first, then restores the overview with the same entry centred and lateral dragging re-enabled
Backdrop drifts and tilts trailing the pointer, and steadies when the pointer rests on the centred entry
adaptable_details: Number of groups and number of items per group
Typography, capitalisation and size of the group names
Exact stack thickness, offset and rotation of the print motif
Amount of backdrop tilt, drift distance and lag
Transition durations and easing character, provided the pacing stays unhurried
Whether the metadata line reads as caption plus date or another short two-part descriptor
Column layout width and spacing of the expanded items
How separation between the names and the image substrate is achieved, including any veiling or luminance-damping layer, provided the names stay clearly readable and the substrate stays recognisable
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits any body of work organised into a small-to-moderate number of named groups whose items are large single images or image-like visuals carrying a short metadata line, where the intent is a calm, focused, gallery-style entry view. It stops being this Skill if all groups are shown open simultaneously, if the row gains visible ends instead of looping, if group entries stop reading as stacks that conceal their contents, if expansion navigates to a separate view instead of opening in place, or if the full-viewport backdrop substrate is dropped so the row no longer sits over a single large image.

name: momentum_strip_with_speed_smear_snap
description: A single-row picture strip where the centred picture is sharp and its neighbours are cut off at the edges; dragging carries the strip with the finger, flicking lets it coast while speed smears the pictures into horizontal streaks, and it re-sharpens as it settles onto the nearest picture.

canonical_document.name: momentum_strip_with_speed_smear_snap
canonical_document.description: A single-row picture strip where the centred picture is sharp and its neighbours are cut off at the edges; dragging carries the strip with the finger, flicking lets it coast while speed smears the pictures into horizontal streaks, and it re-sharpens as it settles onto the nearest picture.
canonical_document.experience_scope: A bounded horizontal region on the page, not a whole-view takeover. It begins in a settled state as soon as the region is visible, with one picture centred and sharp, and it remains available indefinitely; every transit begins on user input and ends when the strip has settled sharp on a single centred picture.
content_and_composition: One focal picture at a time, horizontally centred inside the region and rendered at full clarity when at rest
The immediately adjacent pictures on both sides partially visible, clipped by the region edges, so the collection reads as one continuous strip rather than separate slides
All items laid out in one uninterrupted horizontal line with consistent size and spacing, ordered as a fixed sequence with a definite first and last member
A persistent row of small position markers beneath the strip, one per picture, with the marker for the centred picture visibly distinguished
The strip and marker row persist across all states; no element appears or disappears during transit
experience_progression: Rest: one picture centred and sharp, neighbours peeking in, its marker distinguished
Grab: pointer takes hold and the strip follows movement exactly, smear appearing in proportion to how fast the hand moves
Release: the strip continues on the flick's momentum and decelerates, smear at its strongest during the fastest part of the coast
Resolve: smear fades out as speed drops and the strip eases onto the nearest picture's centred position
Rest again, on a new focal picture, with the marker having moved to match; the cycle repeats for each transit
Directed travel: choosing a picture or marker runs the same deceleration-and-resolve arc from wherever the strip currently is to the chosen picture
attention_and_information_flow: Sharpness is the primary attention cue: exactly one picture is fully readable at rest, and during motion nothing is fully readable, which shifts attention from image content to the act of travelling
Neighbour slivers advertise that more exists on both sides and imply direction of travel without labels
Smear intensity communicates current speed, so the visitor reads how far they have thrown the strip before it stops
The marker row carries sequence information at all times: how many items exist and which one is currently focal
Resistance at the two ends communicates the boundaries of the collection rather than any message

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Direction can be reversed mid-drag at any time; releasing without meaningful movement returns the strip to the nearest centred picture rather than leaving it stranded between items
interaction_model.state_change: Strip offset follows pointer displacement one-to-one; blur amount tracks instantaneous drag speed
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Pictures move exactly with the hand and stretch into horizontal streaks proportional to speed; slow dragging stays nearly sharp
interaction_model.input: Press and drag sideways within the strip region
interaction_model.affected_object: The whole strip and every picture in it

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: The coast always terminates on an exactly centred picture; it never rests between two pictures
interaction_model.state_change: Free coast with decaying momentum, then easing onto the nearest picture's centred position
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Pictures continue sweeping past as streaks, streaks thinning back to sharp as the strip slows and lands centred on one picture
interaction_model.input: Release after a fast drag (flick)
interaction_model.affected_object: Strip position and blur amount

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Handover happens on contact with no waiting period; releasing again starts a fresh coast from the new speed
interaction_model.state_change: Momentum is cancelled and pointer control resumes immediately from the current position
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Motion stops following its own decay and snaps to following the hand with no jump in position
interaction_model.input: Press again while the strip is still coasting
interaction_model.affected_object: Strip motion control

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: A movement that qualifies as a drag is never interpreted as a click, so releasing at the end of a drag selects nothing; a new grab during the travel takes control back
interaction_model.state_change: Target picture becomes the focal item and the strip travels to centre it
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Strip glides to the chosen picture, smearing while fast and sharpening as it settles; marker for that picture becomes the distinguished one
interaction_model.input: Click a visible picture (including a partially visible neighbour)
interaction_model.affected_object: Focal selection and strip position

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Selecting the already-centred marker leaves the strip settled; travel can be interrupted by grabbing the strip
interaction_model.state_change: Strip travels to the corresponding picture and the distinguished marker moves to it
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Same travel-and-settle motion as picture selection, with the marker state updating to match the centred picture
interaction_model.input: Click one of the small position markers beneath the strip
interaction_model.affected_object: Focal selection, strip position and marker row

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Dragging back toward the interior immediately works again from the boundary position
interaction_model.state_change: Travel is clamped so the first and last picture cannot be scrolled beyond
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The strip firmly refuses to advance past the end item and comes to rest with that item centred; no wrap to the opposite end
interaction_model.input: Dragging or coasting past the first or last picture
interaction_model.affected_object: Strip position at the sequence boundaries

experience_qualities: Weighted and physical, as if the strip has mass and is being thrown rather than stepped
Continuous rather than slide-by-slide, because neighbours are always partly in view
Direct and responsive, since motion is pinned to the pointer and can be seized back at any moment
Legible, because position in the sequence and current focus never become ambiguous
Bounded and reassuring, with the two ends behaving as firm walls
completion_and_return: Every interaction resolves to a settled state with exactly one picture centred and sharp
No looping or wrap-around: the sequence terminates at both ends
The focal picture persists after interaction stops; there is no autonomous drift or auto-advance back to a default item
Interrupted travel simply resolves from wherever it was taken over, never returning to the pre-interaction picture
locked_observable_requirements: One picture centred and fully sharp at rest, with adjacent pictures partially visible at both edges
Directional horizontal blur whose intensity varies with travel speed and disappears completely at rest
Pointer dragging that moves the strip one-to-one with the hand
Release produces momentum-based coasting with deceleration, followed by settling exactly centred on the nearest picture
Hard limits at the first and last picture with no wrap-around
A persistent per-item marker row where the marker for the centred picture is always the distinguished one
Selecting a picture or a marker travels to that item with the same motion character
Grabbing during a coast takes control back immediately, and drags are never resolved as selections
adaptable_details: Number of items in the collection and how much of the neighbours is exposed
Item aspect ratio, size and spacing
Shape and styling of the position markers and how the active one is distinguished
Maximum smear intensity and how quickly the coast decays
Easing curve and duration of the settle
Whether additional drivers such as wheel, keyboard or touch are offered alongside pointer dragging
Optional captions or metadata attached to the focal item
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits any ordered, finite set of comparable full-bleed media items where one item at a time deserves full attention and the collection is small enough for one marker per item to remain readable. Switching to a free-scrolling multi-item view with no single focal item, to a vertical or grid arrangement, to an endlessly wrapping loop, or removing either the speed-linked smear or the snap-to-item settle would produce a different Skill.

name: cut_glass_double_image_sweep
description: One large photograph shown twice at once — a plain full-frame version and the same image fractured into angular wedges that mirror and tilt its pieces like cut glass — with picture changes rendered as a single continuous sideways sweep past the in-between images that lands dead still on the arrival photo, tracked by a row of dots.

canonical_document.name: cut_glass_double_image_sweep
canonical_document.description: One large photograph shown twice at once — a plain full-frame version and the same image fractured into angular wedges that mirror and tilt its pieces like cut glass — with picture changes rendered as a single continuous sideways sweep past the in-between images that lands dead still on the arrival photo, tracked by a row of dots.
canonical_document.experience_scope: A self-contained region or full-view panel that is already showing its first picture the moment the visitor arrives; the experience persists as long as the region is on screen, beginning at the initial resting image and ending only when the visitor stops changing pictures, each sweep starting at one resting picture and ending at another.
content_and_composition: A small ordered set of large photographs, only one of which is the current picture at any resting moment

Two simultaneous renderings of the same current photograph: a plain, undistorted full-frame version, and a fractured version of the identical image broken into angular wedges whose pieces are mirrored and tilted like cut glass
The plain version and the fractured version occupy the same frame as coexisting layers of one composition, not as separate images or alternating states
A persistent row of small dots positioned low in the frame, exactly one dot per photograph in the set, in the same order as the pictures
The dot corresponding to the current picture is visibly highlighted against the others at all times
The photographs are arranged in a single horizontal order so travel between them reads as sideways movement along that order
experience_progression: Arrival: the region opens already settled on one picture, shown in its plain and fractured forms together, with its dot highlighted — no build-up or assembly stage
Departure: on a change request the imagery begins moving sideways, forward if the target sits after the current picture and backward if it sits before
Traverse: every picture between current and target flicks past within the same uninterrupted motion, so a multi-step jump is one longer sweep rather than a series of separate steps

Arrival and settle: motion decelerates onto the target picture and comes to a perfect standstill, precisely aligned in frame, with both the plain and fractured renderings now belonging to the arrival photograph
Rest: the region holds still, awaiting the next change request
attention_and_information_flow: At rest, attention is held by the single large photograph, with the plain version carrying legibility of the subject and the fractured wedges adding ornamental prominence around and across it
During a sweep, attention follows the horizontal travel; intermediate pictures register only as fleeting glimpses rather than as content to be read
The final settle returns full attention to one stationary, aligned photograph, making the arrival feel deliberate and complete
The dot row is a continuously available low-emphasis position indicator: it never competes with the photograph but always answers which picture of the set is showing and how many exist
Sweep length itself communicates distance travelled, so a long sweep signals a jump across several pictures and a short one signals a neighbouring picture

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Direction is chosen by whether the target sits after or before the current picture; a multi-picture jump is completed as one motion; the motion always resolves at a valid resting picture
interaction_model.state_change: Current picture changes from the previous one to the clicked target; the region leaves rest, sweeps, and re-enters rest on the target
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The clicked dot becomes the highlighted one while the imagery sweeps sideways toward its picture, in-between pictures flicking past in the same motion, ending with the arrival photograph perfectly still and aligned in both its plain and fractured forms
interaction_model.input: Click on a dot other than the currently highlighted one
interaction_model.affected_object: The photograph shown in both plain and fractured renderings, plus the dot row

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Treated as a no-op so that repeatedly selecting the current picture cannot disturb the settled composition
interaction_model.state_change: None; the region remains at rest on the current picture
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Nothing changes — no motion, no re-highlight, no restart of the current view
interaction_model.input: Click on the already-highlighted current dot
interaction_model.affected_object: The showcase region

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Inputs are ignored for the duration of the motion; control returns only once the arrival picture is fully settled, so a sweep is never cut short, reversed mid-flight or re-targeted
interaction_model.state_change: No state change; the ongoing sweep continues to its original target
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The imagery keeps travelling uninterrupted and the highlighted dot stays as chosen, until the arrival picture comes to rest
interaction_model.input: Further clicks on any dot while a sweep is still in motion
interaction_model.affected_object: The in-progress sweep

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Movement beyond an end is simply not possible; the end pictures rest exactly like any interior picture
interaction_model.state_change: Travel stops at the set boundary; there is no continuation past either end
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The first and last pictures behave as hard ends — no wrap-around sweep from last back to first or first back to last ever appears
interaction_model.input: Reaching the first or last picture in the set
interaction_model.affected_object: Travel range across the ordered pictures

experience_qualities: Ornamental and jewel-like, evoking cut or refracted glass over a real photograph
Immediately impressive on arrival, with no waiting for the effect to appear
Continuous and sweeping rather than stepwise, giving changes a sense of travel and distance
Decisive and composed at the end of each change, with an exact, motionless alignment
Legible throughout — the subject of the photograph stays recognizable despite the fracturing, and the current position in the set is always evident
Deliberate and uninterruptible, so the effect always plays out cleanly
completion_and_return: Each change completes when the arrival photograph is fully still and aligned in frame, at which point the region accepts input again
The current picture and its highlighted dot persist as the resting state until the next change is requested
There is no looping and no automatic return to the starting picture; returning to an earlier picture requires selecting its dot, which sweeps backward across the intervening pictures
No end-of-set completion state exists beyond resting on the first or last picture
locked_observable_requirements: The same photograph is visible simultaneously in a plain full-frame rendering and in a fractured rendering of angular wedges whose pieces are mirrored and tilted
The fractured rendering derives from the identical current photograph, not from decoration or a different image
The region arrives already showing a picture in both renderings, with no build-in
A picture change is one continuous sideways sweep, never a cut, fade or sequence of discrete hops
All pictures between the current and target picture are crossed within that single motion when the jump spans several
Sweep direction is forward or backward according to the target's position relative to the current picture
Motion ends perfectly still and precisely aligned on the arrival picture
A row of small dots sits low in the frame, one per picture, with the current one visibly highlighted at all times
Selecting the current dot does nothing, and inputs during motion are ignored until the arrival picture rests
First and last pictures are hard ends with no wrap-around
adaptable_details: Number of photographs in the set, as long as it stays a small handful
Subject matter and aspect ratio of the photographs
Wedge count, wedge shapes, tilt angles and how the fractured pieces are distributed across the frame
How the plain and fractured renderings are balanced in the frame — which one dominates and how the fractured pieces overlay or frame the plain image
Sweep duration and easing, and how fast intermediate pictures flick past
Dot size, spacing, shape and the exact visual means of highlighting the current one
Whether the region fills the whole view or sits as a large panel within a page
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits a small ordered set of large, visually strong photographs meant to be admired one at a time in a prominent slot, where a decorative glass-like treatment can coexist with a legible plain view of the same image. It does not fit dense image grids, long image libraries, text-led content, or images that must remain undistorted and unadorned. Replacing the simultaneous plain-plus-fractured double rendering with a single treated image, replacing the continuous sideways sweep with cuts or fades, or letting travel wrap around past the ends would each produce a different Skill.

name: quartered_photo_handoff_backdrop
description: A full-view photo backdrop where advancing splits the current picture into four equal quarters that slide away in different directions inside their own frames, revealing the next picture as it eases forward to full size, with centred wording held still throughout.

canonical_document.name: quartered_photo_handoff_backdrop
canonical_document.description: A full-view photo backdrop where advancing splits the current picture into four equal quarters that slide away in different directions inside their own frames, revealing the next picture as it eases forward to full size, with centred wording held still throughout.
canonical_document.experience_scope: Whole-view (or full-bleed region) experience that begins the moment the view is entered with the first image already filling the frame, and continues indefinitely; each individual change begins on activation of a side control and ends when the incoming image has settled at its final size.
content_and_composition: One image visible at a time, filling the entire view edge to edge
An incoming image layer positioned behind the outgoing one, revealed as the outgoing image clears away
The outgoing image divided into four equal quarters, each moving inside its own frame so its content is masked to that quarter's bounds
A short block of wording held at the exact centre of the view, layered above all imagery and persistent across every change
Two large stepping controls, one at the left edge and one at the right edge, both vertically centred and persistent: backward at the left, forward at the right
An ordered sequence of images with no visible beginning or end
experience_progression: Arrival: first image already filling the view, wording centred and calm, attention resting on the imagery
Activation: the change starts immediately with no delay or preparatory state
Break-up: the visible image separates into four equal quarters that glide outward in differing directions, each clipped to its own frame
Reveal: the next image, sitting behind, is progressively uncovered while easing forward and growing to its final full-view size
Settle: the incoming image comes to rest as the sole full-view picture; the sequence is ready for another step
Continuous loop: stepping past either end wraps around, so the run never reaches a first or last image
attention_and_information_flow: Attention starts on the imagery, with the centred wording read as a calm overlay rather than a competing element
During a change, motion in four directions plus the forward-easing incoming image pulls attention outward and then back to the centre as the new picture settles
The forward motion of the incoming image creates a read of depth, so the change is perceived as one image handing off to another in space rather than as a flat blend
The centred wording never moves, dims or reflows, giving a fixed anchor while everything behind it changes
Side controls stay quietly available at the periphery and do not compete with the picture or the wording

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Once settled, the opposite (left) control steps straight back to the picture just left behind; stepping forward past the last item continues into the first without any edge or stop
interaction_model.state_change: Advance by one item: current image becomes outgoing, next becomes incoming and takes over the view
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Change starts at once; the current picture divides into four equal quarters that glide away in different directions within their own frames while the next picture is uncovered and eases forward to full size
interaction_model.input: Activation of the forward control at the right edge
interaction_model.affected_object: The visible image and the next image in the sequence

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Stepping back past the first item continues into the last without any edge or stop; the forward control returns to the picture just left behind
interaction_model.state_change: Step back by one item to the previous picture
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The same quartered break-up and depth reveal, resolving on the previous picture at full view size
interaction_model.input: Activation of the backward control at the left edge
interaction_model.affected_object: The visible image and the preceding image in the sequence

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Control is available again as soon as the change settles; nothing accumulates from the ignored inputs
interaction_model.state_change: No state change; the extra input is discarded rather than queued
