canonical_document.name: corner_stack_swing_browser
canonical_document.description: One item sits centred with its title and author caption; pressing a round step button swings it sideways and drops it onto a thin pile in a lower corner while the next item rises out of the opposite pile into the centre, and holding the button turns the exchange into a continuous stream of pieces passing through.
canonical_document.experience_scope: A self-contained region that owns one focal slot, its caption, two corner piles and a pair of step controls; it begins when the first item is centred and ends at the last item of the set, with no cycling past either end. It can occupy a whole view or sit as a bounded showcase region inside a page.
content_and_composition: Exactly one focal item held in the centre at the largest presented size and as the single point of attention
A caption bound to the focal item carrying two short text roles: item title and its author/attribution
Two thin piles, one at each lower corner, standing for pieces already passed and pieces still waiting; their relative thickness is visible at all times
Two round step controls, back and forward, grouped together at the bottom centre and persistent throughout
The surround and surrounding page kept sparse and low in visual competition, so the focal item, its caption and the two piles are the only elements contending for attention
experience_progression: Arrival: one item already centred and captioned, piles showing the set is at its very start
Single step: focal item swings out sideways, lands on the pile in the direction of travel, next item lifts off the opposite pile and settles centred, caption changes over as the new item settles
Held step: steps chain into a continuous run of pieces passing through the centre while both piles visibly trade thickness
Release: the run stops and leaves exactly one piece squarely centred and captioned, never mid-flight
End: the set terminates at a definite last piece; further steps in that direction leave the composition unchanged
attention_and_information_flow: Prominence stays with the centred item; outgoing and incoming pieces are momentarily in motion but never contest the centre once settled
The caption is the only textual information and always describes the currently centred item, never a piece in flight
The two pile thicknesses carry the sense of position in the set continuously, without counters demanding attention
During a held run, attention shifts from any single piece to the flow itself, then re-collects on the piece left centred
Step controls stay quietly available at the bottom centre and never take focus from the item

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: The opposite control steps back symmetrically, restoring the previous piece and caption and the previous pile thicknesses
interaction_model.state_change: The set advances one position in the pressed direction
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The centred item swings out sideways and drops onto the corner pile on the side it travelled to, the next item rises off the opposite pile into the centre, and the caption changes over as that item settles
interaction_model.input: Single press on the back or forward round control
interaction_model.affected_object: The centred item, its caption and the two corner piles

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Releasing the control, or sliding off it while still held, stops the run and settles exactly one piece squarely centred with its caption resolved; the run can be restarted or reversed immediately
interaction_model.state_change: Discrete stepping becomes a continuous run in the held direction
interaction_model.visible_feedback: A steady stream of pieces passes through the centre while the source pile thins and the destination pile thickens
interaction_model.input: Holding a step control down
interaction_model.affected_object: The sequence of items and both piles

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Stepping in the opposite direction remains fully available; the set never wraps around
interaction_model.state_change: None
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Nothing moves; the centred piece, caption and piles stay exactly as they are, making the end of the set legible
interaction_model.input: Press on a control while already at the first or last piece in that direction
interaction_model.affected_object: The whole region

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: After each settle, the newly centred item becomes the one that accepts clicks and the previous one stops responding
interaction_model.state_change: Only the currently centred, settled item is treatable as pressable
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Pieces in flight and pieces resting on the corner piles do not respond to clicks; only the centre responds
interaction_model.input: Click or tap on an item
interaction_model.affected_object: The item under the pointer

experience_qualities: Playful, lighthearted and toy-like rather than formal
Physical and weighted: pieces travel, tip and land instead of cross-fading in place
Constantly self-locating, so the viewer always senses how much has been seen and how much remains
Comfortable at two paces: lingering on one piece, or skimming quickly through the whole set
Calm and settled at rest, with a single unambiguous point of focus
completion_and_return: Reaching the last piece is a stop, not a wrap; the piece stays centred and the piles show the set is exhausted in that direction
The whole traversal is reversible: stepping back returns pieces from the pile to the centre in reverse order
Every interaction resolves to a single squarely centred piece with a matching caption, including after an interrupted held run
locked_observable_requirements: Exactly one item is the focal point at rest, centred, with a caption naming it and its author
Stepping is a sideways swing-out plus a drop onto a pile, paired with a rise from the opposite pile into the centre
Two thin piles at the lower corners persistently express progress and remainder
Two round step controls grouped at the bottom centre
Holding a control produces a continuous run; releasing or sliding off it stops the run and settles one piece centred
The set is bounded with a definite first and last piece and never cycles
Steps beyond either end produce no movement at all
Only the settled centred item is pressable
No item ever appears half-formed in the centre or on a pile while its content is still arriving
adaptable_details: Exact swing arc, tilt, drop timing and run speed
Pile offsets, spread and how much of each buried piece peeks out
Caption placement relative to the focal item and how the text changes over
Control size, iconography and hit area, and mapping to keyboard or swipe as additional step inputs
Item aspect ratio, framing treatment, and the surround's tone or texture, in any direction of lightness, as long as it stays quiet enough for the focal item and caption to read clearly against it
Set size, and what a click on the centred item leads to
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits bounded, ordered sets of discrete visual pieces that each carry a short title-plus-attribution style label and deserve individual full attention, typically a few to a few dozen items. Replacing the bounded set with endless cycling or streamed content, showing several items side by side, dropping the corner piles that express progress, or replacing the swing-and-drop with an in-place fade or slide would each produce a different skill.

name: gathering_card_deck_spread_and_step_browser
description: A tidy pile of picture cards with short captions that fans open so all cards are visible together, pulls any chosen card forward to rest flat in front, steps through the set with a tilt-and-rejoin shuffle in either direction, and always collapses back into the same neat stack.

canonical_document.name: gathering_card_deck_spread_and_step_browser
canonical_document.description: A tidy pile of picture cards with short captions that fans open so all cards are visible together, pulls any chosen card forward to rest flat in front, steps through the set with a tilt-and-rejoin shuffle in either direction, and always collapses back into the same neat stack.
canonical_document.experience_scope: A self-contained foreground region holding the whole card set. The experience begins with the closed pile in its resting state, covers spreading, focusing, stepping and gathering, and ends when the set has returned to the identical closed pile. It does not extend to the surrounding page.
content_and_composition: One closed set of a handful of uniformly shaped cards; the set is small enough that the entire spread fits in view at once
Each card carries one picture plus one short caption, with the caption legible when the card is frontmost or spread
Closed state: cards layered in depth with slight offset so only the front face reads clearly, the rest suggested as thickness behind it
Open state: the same cards distributed side by side in a fanned arrangement anchored to the pile position, all faces simultaneously visible and comparable
Focused state: one card held flat and clear in front of the others, which recede or restack behind it
A persistent stack anchor position that every state returns to, so the region never shifts on the page
A persistent forward and back step affordance for advancing through the order
experience_progression: Stage 1 — gathered: compact pile, single readable front face, inviting to open
Stage 2 — spread: the whole set swings out together so every card is visible at once for comparison
Stage 3 — narrowed: attention collapses onto one card held clearly in front while the rest gather behind
Stage 4 — stepping: repeated forward or back moves cycle the order endlessly with the leading card handing off to the opposite end
Return: the set gathers into the same neat pile as stage 1, ready to begin again
attention_and_information_flow: Closed: attention concentrated on one front face; remaining content is present as depth only, not yet readable
Spread: attention distributed evenly across the whole set, favoring breadth and comparison over detail
Focused: attention narrows sharply to a single card whose picture and caption read most clearly; the rest drop to background support
Stepping: attention follows the moving card as it leaves, travels and is replaced, so the newly revealed card inherits prominence
Gathering: revealed information recedes back into the single front face, resetting the reading task

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Reversible by clicking the frontmost card; input arriving while the spread is still moving is ignored so the motion always completes
interaction_model.state_change: Closed pile becomes open spread
interaction_model.visible_feedback: All cards swing out together from the stack anchor into a fanned arrangement, every face becoming visible at once
interaction_model.input: Click on the gathered pile
interaction_model.affected_object: The whole card set

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Restores the original resting state exactly; further clicks during the gather are ignored
interaction_model.state_change: Open spread returns to the gathered pile
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Cards swing back together and restack into the identical neat pile with one readable front face
interaction_model.input: Click on the frontmost card while spread
interaction_model.affected_object: The whole card set

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: The set can be spread again or stepped from the new order; input during the sweep is ignored until the card has settled
interaction_model.state_change: The set collapses while the chosen card becomes the new top of the order
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The other cards fold back toward the stack as the chosen card sweeps in from an enlarged, tilted, semi-transparent state and settles flat and opaque at the top of the order
interaction_model.input: Click on any card other than the frontmost while spread
interaction_model.affected_object: The clicked card and the remaining set

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Cycles endlessly with no start or end; if the set is currently spread it gathers itself into the pile first and then performs the step; input during the move is ignored
interaction_model.state_change: The leading card moves to the opposite end and the next card becomes leading
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The leading card slides aside with a slight tilt, travels to the far end of the order and returns to place, revealing the card beneath it
interaction_model.input: Forward step
interaction_model.affected_object: The leading card and the order of the set

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Exactly reverses a forward step and also cycles endlessly; an open spread gathers first; input during the move is ignored
interaction_model.state_change: The order advances in the opposite direction, restoring the previous leading card
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The mirrored slide-aside, tilt, travel and return motion brings the previous card back to the front
interaction_model.input: Back step
interaction_model.affected_object: The trailing card and the order of the set

experience_qualities: Tactile and hand-like, as though real cards are being handled on a table
Unhurried, weighted motion rather than snappy switching
Playful and inviting, with the closed pile reading as something to be opened
Legible at every resting state: one clear front face, an evenly comparable spread, or one clearly held card
Predictable and forgiving, since every state has a way back to the same pile
completion_and_return: The gathered pile is the canonical resting and return state and is always reachable
Gathering reproduces the same neat pile, ready to begin again from the start of the experience
Forward and back stepping loops endlessly in either direction with no terminal item
The current leading card persists as the visible front face after a spread is gathered
locked_observable_requirements: A closed state in which the set reads as one compact pile with only the front face clearly legible
Opening moves the whole set out together so every card is simultaneously visible and comparable
Choosing a non-front card collapses the rest while that card arrives from an enlarged, tilted, transparent state and settles flat as the new top of the order
Stepping is expressed as the leading card sliding aside with a slight tilt, rejoining at the opposite end and returning to place to reveal the next
Stepping cycles endlessly in both directions with no beginning or end
The set can always be gathered back into the identical pile at the same anchor position
Input during any move is ignored, and a step performed while spread gathers the set first
Motion pacing reads as unhurried physical handling
adaptable_details: Number of cards, as long as the whole spread stays surveyable at once
Card proportions, corner treatment, borders and shadow depth
Fan direction, spread arc, offset amount and tilt magnitude
Caption placement and typography, and whether captions sit on or beneath the picture
Exact durations and easing within an unhurried feel
Form of the step affordance and whether keyboard or drag input also triggers steps
Background surface treatment behind the pile
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits small closed sets of uniform, visually dominant items with short accompanying text where comparing the whole set and then reading one item both matter, placed as a foreground region on a page. It stops being this Skill if the set grows large enough that the spread cannot be seen at once, if items become non-uniform or text-dominant so they cannot read as a stack of cards, if the pile never gathers back or the stepping loses its slide-tilt-rejoin handling motion, or if the arrangement becomes a scrolling list, grid or full-view takeover.

source_sites.title: Baraja: A Plugin for Spreading Items in a Card-Like Fashion

name: hover_revealed_lettering_stage
description: One large centred word held on a full-bleed textured stage; pointing at it makes its parts ease apart, unfold, lift or slide while a concealed second reading fades and scales in, and a numbered index swaps in the next lettering treatment in place.

canonical_document.name: hover_revealed_lettering_stage
canonical_document.description: One large centred word held on a full-bleed textured stage; pointing at it makes its parts ease apart, unfold, lift or slide while a concealed second reading fades and scales in, and a numbered index swaps in the next lettering treatment in place.
canonical_document.experience_scope: A whole-view experience: the stage occupies the full viewport with a single lettering specimen at its centre, a small heading above and a persistent numbered index of the set. The collection-level experience lasts as long as the visitor stays on the stage; the reveal micro-experience begins and ends entirely within the lettering itself and leaves the surrounding composition unchanged.
content_and_composition: Exactly one lettering specimen in view at a time, set large and centred as the sole foreground focus
A modest, deliberately low-prominence heading above the specimen, persistent across all views
A full-bleed textured backdrop filling the view behind the specimen, acting as a continuous substrate rather than competing content
A persistent numbered index listing every treatment in the set, making the total count visible and marking exactly one entry as active
Some specimens composed of separately addressable letters; others behaving as one unit
A concealed second reading held in reserve in the same space as the primary lettering, invisible at rest, present for several but not necessarily all treatments
No supporting body copy, controls or decoration inside the stage beyond heading, specimen and index
experience_progression: Rest: the specimen sits still and complete, giving no hint of a second state
Reveal on lingering attention: parts of the lettering ease apart, unfold, lift or slide into position while the concealed second reading fades and scales in
Held open: the revealed state stays while attention remains on the lettering
Return: the whole arrangement plays smoothly back to rest when attention leaves, including from a half-finished transition
Collection level: no forced order — treatments can be worked through one after another or jumped between freely, each arriving in its rest state
attention_and_information_flow: Scale, centring and the muted heading concentrate attention on the lettering before any interaction
The textured backdrop supplies atmosphere without pulling prominence away from the specimen
The numbered index continuously answers how large the set is and where the visitor currently stands, without narrating the effects
Information is withheld by design: the second reading exists only for a visitor who lingers, so discovery feels earned rather than explained
In per-letter treatments, prominence shifts to the single letter under the pointer while its neighbours stay quiet, localising attention within the word

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Moving the pointer away plays the whole transition smoothly back to rest; interruption at any point is handled by continuing from the current partial position rather than snapping
interaction_model.state_change: Specimen moves from rest state to revealed state
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Parts of the lettering ease apart, unfold, lift or slide into position while the hidden second reading fades and scales in over the same area
interaction_model.input: Pointer moves onto a lettering specimen that behaves as one unit
interaction_model.affected_object: The whole styled specimen and its concealed second reading

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Leaving the letter returns just that letter to rest smoothly, including mid-transition; moving across letters lets several returns and reveals overlap without disorder
interaction_model.state_change: That single letter moves from rest to revealed while sibling letters remain in rest
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The hovered letter separates, unfolds, lifts or slides and shows its concealed reading; neighbouring letters stay completely untouched
interaction_model.input: Pointer moves onto one letter of a treatment built from separate letters
interaction_model.affected_object: Only the letter under the pointer

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Any entry stays reachable at any time, so the set can be stepped through in order or revisited freely; a switch always lands in rest state regardless of any reveal in progress
interaction_model.state_change: The chosen treatment replaces the current one in place; the chosen index entry becomes the active one and the previous entry loses its active marking
interaction_model.visible_feedback: A new lettering specimen appears in the same centred position on the same backdrop, in its rest state, with the index clearly marking the new active entry
interaction_model.input: Visitor chooses an entry in the numbered index
interaction_model.affected_object: The staged specimen and the index itself

experience_qualities: Tactile and toy-like rather than explanatory
Calm and composed at rest, playful under attention
Mechanical and physical in feel: things come apart, unfold, lift, slide
Fully reversible, never leaving a half-broken arrangement
Specimen-like and uncluttered, with each treatment given the room to be judged on its own
Discoverable, rewarding lingering with information that was not advertised
completion_and_return: There is no terminal state; the experience rests between interactions
Every reveal returns completely to the untouched rest state, including when interrupted partway
Switching treatments resets the stage to a rest state rather than carrying a reveal across
The active marking in the index persists as the only retained state of where the visitor is in the set
The whole set remains revisitable in any order for as long as the visitor stays
locked_observable_requirements: One lettering specimen at a time, large and centred, as the dominant foreground element
Full-bleed textured backdrop behind the specimen
A modest heading above that stays subordinate to the lettering
A persistent index that makes the total number of treatments visible and marks exactly one entry as active
A concealed second reading that appears only on pointer attention, fading and scaling in
Physical displacement of lettering parts (separating, unfolding, lifting or sliding) accompanying the reveal
Smooth reversal to rest on pointer exit, correct even from a partially completed transition
Per-letter isolation: in letter-composed treatments only the hovered letter responds
Treatments are exchanged in place on the same stage, not opened elsewhere
adaptable_details: Which displacement each treatment uses and how many parts move
How many treatments the set holds
Backdrop texture, palette, typeface and lettering style
Heading wording and the wording of the concealed second reading
Index presentation (numerals, labels, dots) and its placement in the view
Motion timing, easing and stagger
Whether every treatment holds a second state or only some do
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits short display text — a word, name, tagline or a few characters — where the lettering itself is the message and a brief secondary reading can sit hidden inside it, presented one specimen at a time as a centrepiece. It stops fitting when the text is long-form reading content, when the concealed reading carries information the visitor must not miss, or when the hidden state must be reachable without pointing. Showing all treatments simultaneously in a grid, driving the reveals autonomously instead of by attention, or letting the reveal permanently rearrange the lettering would each produce a different skill.

name: depth_shaded_leaf_turn_gallery
description: One illustration fills the frame at a time and each step forward or back plays as a shaded leaf of a small bound booklet turning in depth, with direct jumps to the first and last leaf and a brief bounce that settles back when the visitor pushes past either end.

canonical_document.name: depth_shaded_leaf_turn_gallery
canonical_document.description: One illustration fills the frame at a time and each step forward or back plays as a shaded leaf of a small bound booklet turning in depth, with direct jumps to the first and last leaf and a brief bounce that settles back when the visitor pushes past either end.
canonical_document.experience_scope: A bounded region experience centred on a single framed artwork surface: it begins when the first illustration is presented in the frame and continues for as long as the visitor moves through the set; it may occupy most of a simple page but is defined by the frame and its controls, not by the whole viewport.
content_and_composition: One primary content role: a single large illustration occupying the whole framed surface at a time
A finite ordered sequence of such illustrations, small in count, with a definite first and last member
A turning leaf layer that appears only during a change: the outgoing artwork face and the incoming artwork face belong to the same hinged object seen in depth
Soft shading and depth cues attached to the turning leaf and its hinge, distinguishing the near face, the far face and the crease
Persistent step controls for forward and backward movement
Persistent direct controls for landing on the very first and the very last illustration
Position within the finite sequence is legible enough that the two extremes feel within easy reach at all times
experience_progression: Rest state: exactly one illustration shown flat and complete in the frame
Turn begins: the leaf lifts and rotates in depth, shading deepening along the hinge as the outgoing face angles away
Mid turn: both faces are momentarily readable as two sides of one physical leaf rather than two separate images
Turn settles: the incoming illustration lands flat and fully lit in the frame, shading resolving away
Movement is finite and reversible in both directions; the sequence does not wrap from last back to first
At either extreme the next request in that direction produces a short nudge and return instead of an advance, making plain that nothing lies further on
attention_and_information_flow: Attention rests on the single full-frame illustration between turns; nothing competes with it
During a turn attention follows the moving leaf and its shading, so the change reads as one object in motion rather than as new content appearing
The incoming illustration only becomes the attention centre once it has settled flat
Awareness of position and of the reachable start and end is available continuously but stays secondary to the artwork
At an extreme, the nudge briefly draws attention to the boundary and then hands it back to the unchanged illustration

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Reversible by a backward step; requests arriving while the turn is still resolving are ignored rather than queued, so turns never overlap
interaction_model.state_change: Current position advances by exactly one illustration
interaction_model.visible_feedback: A single leaf turns forward in depth with soft shading and settles flat on the next illustration
interaction_model.input: Forward step control
interaction_model.affected_object: The framed illustration and the turning leaf layer

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Reversible by a forward step; ignored while a turn is in progress
interaction_model.state_change: Current position rewinds by exactly one illustration
interaction_model.visible_feedback: A single leaf turns in the reverse direction and settles flat on the previous illustration
interaction_model.input: Backward step control
interaction_model.affected_object: The framed illustration and the turning leaf layer

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: A drag begun while a turn resolves has no effect; a drag toward an unavailable direction produces the boundary nudge instead of a turn
interaction_model.state_change: Position moves by exactly one illustration, forward or backward according to drag direction
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The same single depth-shaded leaf turn as the step controls, in the direction implied by the drag
interaction_model.input: Horizontal drag across the artwork
interaction_model.affected_object: The framed illustration and the turning leaf layer

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Repeated presses during a turn are ignored, so held or rapid keys cannot stack turns
interaction_model.state_change: Position moves by exactly one illustration in the corresponding direction
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The same single depth-shaded leaf turn as drag and controls, with no separate treatment for keyboard use
interaction_model.input: Left and right arrow keys
interaction_model.affected_object: The framed illustration and the turning leaf layer

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Reversible by stepping or by jumping to the opposite extreme; ignored while a turn is still resolving
interaction_model.state_change: Position moves directly to the first or the last illustration of the finite sequence
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The frame resolves onto the extreme illustration, ending in the same flat, fully settled rest state as a step turn
interaction_model.input: Jump to first or jump to last control
interaction_model.affected_object: The framed illustration

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Self-recovering: the nudge always returns to the same rest state, and movement in the available direction remains immediately possible
interaction_model.state_change: Position does not change
interaction_model.visible_feedback: A brief nudge in the requested direction that settles back onto the illustration already shown
interaction_model.input: Any forward request at the last illustration or backward request at the first
interaction_model.affected_object: The currently shown illustration

experience_qualities: Physical and hand-held: changes read as material turning, not as images being replaced
Finite and surveyable: the collection feels small and fully bounded
Reversible and unhurried: every move can be undone by the opposite move
Calm and singular: one artwork at a time, undisturbed between turns
Predictable: every input produces the same unit of movement and the same visible treatment
Honest at the edges: reaching an extreme is communicated by resistance rather than silence
completion_and_return: There is no terminal completion; the experience rests indefinitely on whichever illustration is shown
Every turn completes by settling flat and fully lit, never leaving a partially turned leaf
The sequence does not loop; the first and last illustrations are hard ends
Boundary nudges return to the exact prior rest state
The extremes remain directly reachable at any time, so the visitor can always return to the beginning or the end in one action
locked_observable_requirements: Exactly one illustration fills the frame in the rest state
Every change of illustration is rendered as a single hinged leaf turning in depth with soft shading, never as a cut, fade or slide
Step movement is exactly one illustration per request in either direction
Horizontal drag, arrow keys and step controls all produce the identical one-step turn
Direct means of landing on the very first and the very last illustration exist and are always available
Requests during an unresolved turn are discarded, never queued; turns never overlap
A request beyond either end produces a brief nudge that settles back on the unchanged illustration
The sequence is finite and does not wrap around
adaptable_details: Number of items in the small sequence
Frame proportions, margins and surrounding page treatment
Turn duration, easing and the exact strength and colour of the shading and depth cues
Whether the hinge sits at a side or elsewhere, and the visual style of the leaf edge
Form and placement of the step and extreme-jump controls
Amplitude and timing of the boundary nudge
How position within the sequence is indicated
Additional inputs that produce the same one-step move
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits any small finite ordered set of single, self-contained full-frame visuals where one item deserves the whole frame and the collection should feel bounded and hand-turnable. It stops being this Skill if several items are shown at once, if the sequence becomes long, endless or wrapping, if movement becomes free continuous scrolling or multi-step jumping through neighbours, if the change is rendered as a fade, cut or flat slide instead of a shaded leaf turning in depth, or if requests during a turn are queued so that turns chain and overlap.

name: direction_aware_caption_slide_over_tile
description: Each thumbnail stays bare while the grid is scanned; on hover a title panel slides in from the exact side the pointer crossed, covers that one picture, and slides back out through the side the pointer exits.

canonical_document.name: direction_aware_caption_slide_over_tile
canonical_document.description: Each thumbnail stays bare while the grid is scanned; on hover a title panel slides in from the exact side the pointer crossed, covers that one picture, and slides back out through the side the pointer exits.
canonical_document.experience_scope: A per-tile region experience repeated across every item of a media grid. It begins the moment the pointer enters a tile's bounds and ends when the panel has fully left that tile; nothing outside the hovered tile changes, and there is no whole-view or page-level state.
content_and_composition: A grid of many uniformly sized picture tiles, evenly spaced and visually equal in weight, with no item emphasized on arrival
One picture per tile as the base layer, always present underneath
One caption panel per tile as an overlay layer carrying that image's short title text, at rest positioned entirely outside the tile and invisible
Panel motion and visibility are clipped strictly to the tile's own bounds, so nothing overlaps neighbouring tiles or the surrounding layout
Each tile is also a link target to that image's full view, so the surfaced title reads as an invitation to open it
experience_progression: Resting state: all tiles plain, calm and evenly ordered for scanning
Entry: pointer crosses one tile boundary; the entry side is determined relative to the tile center
Cover: panel travels in from that side until it fully covers the picture and the title is readable
Held: panel remains fully covering while the pointer stays inside
Exit: exit side is recomputed and the same panel travels back out that way, progressively uncovering the picture
Return to resting state with the picture plain again
attention_and_information_flow: On arrival no single tile draws attention; prominence is deliberately flat so the collection can be swept visually
Prominence shifts only to the tile currently pointed at, and only while it is pointed at
Title information exists in exactly one place at a time: the hovered tile
The direction of the reveal follows the viewer's own movement, so the appearance feels caused by the user rather than announced to them
As the panel covers the picture, attention transfers from the image to its title; as it withdraws, attention returns to the image

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: If the pointer leaves mid-travel, the in-motion panel is redirected to exit rather than completing the cover; the tile never rests partly covered
interaction_model.state_change: Tile goes from plain to covered; entry side is resolved from the crossing position relative to the tile center
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Panel slides in from exactly that side, sweeping across the picture until the title fully covers it, clipped to the tile
interaction_model.input: Pointer crosses into a tile's bounds
interaction_model.affected_object: That tile's caption panel and its picture

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Re-entering during the exit interrupts the outward motion and starts a fresh inward reveal from the new entry side
interaction_model.state_change: Tile goes from covered back to plain; exit side is recomputed at the moment of leaving
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Panel slides out through the side the pointer actually exited, progressively revealing the picture again until the tile is bare
interaction_model.input: Pointer leaves a covered tile's bounds
interaction_model.affected_object: The same caption panel

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Latest pointer position always wins; every interrupted tile settles into a definite resting state
interaction_model.state_change: Any queued or still-moving panel motion on those tiles is cancelled and replaced by a clean restart from the newly resolved side
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Each tile resolves to either fully covered or fully plain; no tile is left stranded half covered and no stale motion continues after the pointer has gone

name: endless_oncoming_photo_stream
description: Photographs drift out of a quiet, low-distraction open depth one after another, sharpen to full clarity as they reach the viewer and dissolve as they pass; weighted wheel and arrow input accelerates, reverses and coasts the flow, the sheets bow and crease like cloth the faster they travel, and pointing at one makes just that one wave gently.

name: focal_item_tinted_ambient_stage

name: dot_field_ambient_map_view

Sparse and uncluttered; a single subject owns the view

name: pointer_bent_full_frame_visual_exhibit
description: A single item given the whole frame as a self-evolving visual that bends and lifts in luminance around the moving cursor with a soft trailing lag, eases back by itself when the cursor stops or leaves, and carries a couple of short notes plus a way onward to the next item or back to the collection.

experience_qualities: Immersive and exhibit-like, with the visual as the subject

The response eases back to rest by itself when the cursor stops or leaves the frame

canonical_document.name: pointer_bent_full_frame_visual_exhibit

Works at any overall lightness and in any hue family, since the pointer response is a relative luminance and deformation change rather than a fixed tone. Becomes a different skill if the frame must carry substantial reading content or controls, if the visual is static rather than self-evolving, if the pointer response snaps without lag and self-recovery, or if the visual is demoted to a background behind dense foreground content.

name: angled_overlapping_photo_run_scroll_traversal
description: One continuous diagonal run of heavily overlapped square photo frames on an empty, uniformly quiet field, carried along its own angled axis by page scrolling with a weighted lag, where pointing at a frame slides it sideways clear of its neighbours.

experience_qualities: Atmospheric and sparse, with the empty surround doing as much work as the images
Unhurried and weighted, as if the run has mass and trails the input
Continuous rather than stepped: no slide boundaries, snapping or discrete states
Selective legibility, so only a glimpse of the set is available at once and the rest is withheld
Responsive and forgiving under fast pointer movement, every motion interruptible and reversible
Gallery-like intimacy, one picture at a time lifting out for closer appreciation
locked_observable_requirements: A single continuous run of uniformly square framed images on one shared angled axis crossing the view.
Heavy overlap between neighbours so only a few frames are legible at a time.
An otherwise empty, uniformly toned field that sits back from the frames and separates clearly from their edges, with no competing foreground content.
The run stays anchored at the centre of the window while the page scrolls.
Vertical page scrolling is the sole driver of the run's travel.
Travel distance is smaller than scroll distance and eases into place a perceptible beat behind the input.
Reverse scrolling retraces the identical path and frame arrangement.
The run is finite with reachable ends rather than an endless loop.
Pointing at one frame slides that frame sideways clear of the overlap by a fraction of its width and it eases back on pointer leave.
Both the run's travel and a frame's sideways glide can be interrupted or reversed mid-motion without snapping.
canonical_document.name: angled_overlapping_photo_run_scroll_traversal
canonical_document.experience_scope: Region-sized composition that in practice fills the whole view: a single quiet, uniformly toned field containing one photo run, anchored at the centre of the window for the entire scrollable stretch assigned to it. The experience begins on arrival with the run already composed and ends when the finite run's far end is reached; it has no separate detail view or secondary screen.
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits small to moderate curated sets of visually strong, uniformly shaped images where browsing is casual and atmosphere matters more than comparison or fast lookup, presented as the main event of a view with little or no accompanying text. It does not transfer to dense catalogues needing scannable overview, heterogeneous media sizes, or content requiring reading alongside the images. Making the run endless or auto-playing, driving it by drag, pointer position or timers instead of page scroll, removing the overlap or the angled axis, letting scroll track travel one-to-one without lag, or opening a separate full-screen detail view on selection would each produce a different Skill.
content_and_composition: One run of uniformly framed square images as the only foreground content; a small curated set, few enough that the whole run is traversable in one unhurried pass.
All frames share a single straight axis angled across the viewport, neither horizontal nor vertical, so the run visibly cuts across the field and continues past both edges.
Neighbouring frames overlap heavily along that axis in a consistent stacking order, so each partially occludes the next and only a few frames are legible at any moment.

Surrounding field is empty and uniform, carrying clearly less visual weight than the frames and separating cleanly from their edges, with no competing imagery, panels or decoration, so the run alone carries the page.

The run as a whole is a single rigid unit anchored at the centre of the window; individual frames keep their place in it except for the one temporarily singled out by the pointer, which becomes the topmost and most legible element.
Both ends of the run are visible only as frames entering and leaving; there is no visible track, counter or thumbnail rail.
attention_and_information_flow: Legibility is granted by position along the axis and by overlap order: only the few frames near the middle of the run read as whole pictures, the rest are slivers or cut off at the ends.
Travel continuously reassigns that prominence, so attention drifts along the axis rather than jumping between discrete slides.
Pointing at a frame promotes it above its occluders and reveals the image area that the overlap was hiding, making it the single clear subject while the rest stay partial.
The lag and reduced travel rate make the run read as heavy and deliberate, encouraging slow looking instead of fast skimming.
The empty, low-distraction field withholds all other information, so every change in what is revealed comes from the run itself.

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Reversing scroll direction retraces the path exactly; stopping mid-scroll lets the run ease into place without snapping; travel is bounded by the finite start and end of the run, and the beginning can always be reached again by scrolling back
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Frames slide in at one end of the axis and away at the other while the run stays anchored at the centre of the window; motion continues briefly and settles after scrolling stops
interaction_model.input: Vertical page scrolling, the only driver of travel
interaction_model.state_change: Run translates along its own angled axis by an amount proportional to, but smaller than, the scrolled distance, easing toward that target rather than tracking it instantly
interaction_model.affected_object: The entire photo run as one unit

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: It eases back into its place in the run as soon as the pointer leaves; entering or leaving during the glide reverses or interrupts the motion from its current position without jumping, and the frame continues travelling with the run while offset
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The frame separates from the stack and its previously occluded portion becomes visible as one whole picture
interaction_model.input: Pointer entering one frame
interaction_model.state_change: Frame offsets sideways out of the overlap by a fraction of its own width and sits clear of its neighbours
interaction_model.affected_object: That single frame within the run

Exact overlap fraction and how many frames read as legible at once

Exact easing curve, lag duration and the ratio of travel distance to scroll distance
Which side the hovered frame slides toward and the exact offset within a fraction of its width

canonical_document.description: One continuous diagonal run of heavily overlapped square photo frames on an empty, uniformly quiet field, carried along its own angled axis by page scrolling with a weighted lag, where pointing at a frame slides it sideways clear of its neighbours.
experience_progression: Arrival: the run sits still, angled and overlapped, with a few legible frames around the centre of the view.
Forward travel: as the page is scrolled down the whole run slides along its angled axis, frames entering from one end and passing out at the other in a continuous, unbroken drift.
Travel advances a shorter distance than the page scrolls and keeps easing toward its target after the input pauses, so each stretch of travel settles a beat late.
Backward travel: scrolling back moves the run in reverse along the identical path, restoring exactly the same frame positions and overlap.
The run is finite: travel stops at its ends rather than wrapping, and the beginning remains reachable again by travelling back.
completion_and_return: No completion state or reward: the run simply reaches its finite ends and can be travelled back to the beginning.
Travel position is tied to page scroll position, so the run's offset is fully derived from where the page is and is re-established on return to that position.
Hover offsets always resolve back to rest; no frame stays singled out after the pointer leaves, so the run returns to its uniform overlapped state.
Nothing loops or auto-advances on its own; motion only exists while scroll or pointer drive it or while it eases to a stop.

name: space_trading_expanding_media_grid

canonical_document.name: space_trading_expanding_media_grid
canonical_document.experience_scope: A region experience inside a single-view page: a bounded tiled sample block placed alongside a vertical reading column. Exact falloff curve of size, contrast fade toward the field tone, and symbol fade
canonical_document.description: A quiet, low-contrast field of round items that blooms outward from a bundled middle into an even ringed cluster, then follows the pointer one-to-one so items stream through a fixed center mark, swelling and revealing their symbol at focus while outer items shrink to faint dots barely separated from the field tone; a picked item pops with a soft glow without disturbing the cluster.

canonical_document.name: scroll_flown_line_chart_growth
canonical_document.description: The viewer starts pressed close to the first point of a line graph and scrolling flies them along the line as it draws, each data point registering as it is reached, until the framing widens to the finished trend seen whole.
canonical_document.experience_scope: A single pinned graphic region: it begins with an on-screen invitation to continue, holds the graphic locked in view for a tall stretch of scrolling, and ends when the finished full-trend view is released back into normal page flow with a cue to scroll up again.
content_and_composition: One primary line graphic as the sole foreground subject, occupying the locked view for the whole stretch
A series of discrete points along the line acting as milestones, each with its own moment of acknowledgement
A short entry invitation to continue, shown before the journey starts
An implied viewpoint that sits close to the line at the start and far enough back at the end for the entire shape to be legible
A closing cue inviting an upward scroll, appearing at the end of the locked stretch
Any surrounding page content stays outside the locked region and does not compete during the reveal
experience_progression: Entry: brief invitation to continue, graphic framed tightly on its beginning so only the first stretch of the line reads

Prominence moves with the travelling viewpoint, so the currently drawn end of the line is always the focal edge
Each milestone briefly claims attention at the moment it is reached, then recedes as travel continues
Readable information accumulates monotonically with scroll depth: more of the line, more points passed, more of the overall shape
By the end attention is distributed across the whole trend rather than any single point, supporting comparison and summary reading

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Fully scrubbable and exactly reversible; stopping anywhere holds that partial state indefinitely, and reversing retraces the same states in opposite order
interaction_model.state_change: Scroll position maps directly and proportionally to how much of the line is drawn, which point has been reached, and how far back the view is pulled

interaction_model.input: Vertical scrolling within the locked stretch
interaction_model.affected_object: Line graphic, its drawn extent, the current milestone and the viewpoint framing

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: The settled partial state persists until scrolling resumes in either direction
interaction_model.state_change: Motion continues briefly past the input, then comes to rest at the position matching the current scroll
interaction_model.visible_feedback: A slight trailing lag followed by a smooth settle, with no snapping to a nearest step and no drift away from the held state
interaction_model.input: Stopping or pausing the scroll mid-journey
interaction_model.affected_object: All animated properties of the graphic

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Scrolling up immediately re-engages the locked stretch and rewinds the journey from wherever it was left
interaction_model.state_change: Graphic released from its locked position with the full trend visible; retrace cue appears
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The complete, calm overview stays legible and the page resumes normal scrolling, with a visible invitation to scroll back up
interaction_model.input: Reaching the end of the locked stretch
interaction_model.affected_object: The pinned region and the closing cue

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: No residual progress: the journey can be taken again from a clean start
interaction_model.state_change: Returns to the initial tight framing on the first point with the line undrawn
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The opening invitation and close-in starting frame reappear as they were
interaction_model.input: Scrolling back to the very beginning
interaction_model.affected_object: Whole experience state

experience_qualities: Guided and cinematic rather than clicked-through
Continuously scrubbable, never stepwise or locked into fixed slides
Weighted motion: slight trail, smooth settle, no jitter when scroll stops
Intimate at the start, calm and comprehensive at the end
Milestone moments give the journey rhythm and a sense of measurable progress
Fully reversible, so exploration back and forth feels safe
completion_and_return: Completion is the widest framing with the whole trend legible, held calmly rather than looping
Explicit invitation to retrace upward at the end
Partial states persist exactly where scrolling stopped
Reverse traversal restores the opening state completely, allowing unlimited replays in both directions
locked_observable_requirements: The graphic remains locked in view for a tall stretch while scroll drives the reveal
Scroll position maps directly and proportionally to drawn extent, milestone reached and framing distance simultaneously
Journey starts framed close enough that only the beginning of the line reads
Framing widens progressively and ends with the complete shape legible in one view
Each discrete point registers a visible acknowledgement at the moment it is reached
Motion trails slightly and settles smoothly when scroll stops, holding partial state
Reverse scrolling reverses the sequence exactly, with no irreversible steps
The end releases the graphic and cues an upward retrace
adaptable_details: Shape and length of the plotted line and number of milestones
Exact styling of the line, points and milestone acknowledgement
Wording and styling of the entry invitation and the retrace cue
How tall the locked stretch is and how fast the framing widens
Whether milestone acknowledgement includes an accompanying label or figure
Palette, typography and surround treatment of the region
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits any single continuous data path with a handful of meaningful marked points where the payoff is seeing the whole trend after traveling it — trends over time, progress or growth narratives, journeys along a route-like shape. It stops being this Skill if the graphic no longer holds still while scrolling, if travel and widening are replaced by discrete slides or step-snapping, if the reveal is autonomous rather than scrubbed by the reader, if it cannot be reversed exactly, or if the data becomes a dense multi-series comparison where no single path can be flown.

name: pinned_map_route_drawn_by_reading_progress
description: A spatial panel stays fixed while detail text scrolls past it; the path draws forward from its starting point with a leading marker and the framing follows the segment currently being described, ending with the whole path in view and offering a full-width settled version.

canonical_document.name: pinned_map_route_drawn_by_reading_progress
canonical_document.description: A spatial panel stays fixed while detail text scrolls past it; the path draws forward from its starting point with a leading marker and the framing follows the segment currently being described, ending with the whole path in view and offering a full-width settled version.
canonical_document.experience_scope: A bounded region of a longer page: the experience begins when the paired text-and-panel section is entered, holds the panel in place for the length of the text sequence, and ends when the last detail block is passed and the panel releases. The optional expanded mode temporarily becomes a whole-view experience covering the full width until it is closed and the reading view returns.
content_and_composition: One persistent spatial panel pinned within the section, occupying a fixed portion of the viewport while content moves past it
A sequence of readable detail blocks (several ordered items such as timing, gathering place and stage-by-stage schedule) that travel past the held panel
One continuous path drawn on the panel, anchored at a clearly emphasised origin point and extending toward its end
A single leading marker sitting at the current head of the drawn path
Panel framing (position and closeness of view) treated as a composed element that shifts with the described stage rather than staying static
One persistent control offering an expanded full-width presentation of the panel
In expanded mode: the panel fills the available width with the path shown complete, and the reading column is set aside behind it
experience_progression: Entry: panel becomes held in place, path is largely undrawn, origin point is emphasised and the view sits close to it
Advance: as each successive detail block comes forward, the drawn length grows, the leading marker moves along it and the framing travels to keep the currently described stretch in view
Settling: early emphasis on the origin gives way to a calmer, less insistent presentation as the middle of the sequence is read
Completion: at the end of the sequence the full path is framed in one view
Reverse: moving back through the detail blocks retraces the path and marker backwards to the corresponding earlier point, with framing following in the same continuous manner
attention_and_information_flow: Attention starts weighted toward the starting point of the path, making the beginning of the sequence unmistakable
Prominence then transfers to the leading marker and the freshly drawn segment, which act as the pointer to whatever the text is currently describing
Emphasis relaxes after the opening so that reading, not motion, carries the middle of the section
Spatial information is revealed incrementally: only the portion of the path already explained is visible, so the shape of the whole is withheld until the end
The closing full-path view shifts attention from part to whole, summarising what was read
The expanded mode removes the text from contention and gives the spatial view sole attention for inspection

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Motion is continuously tied to reading position, so pausing mid-stage leaves a stable intermediate state and resuming continues from exactly there
interaction_model.state_change: Progress along the sequence maps to a proportional position along the path; drawn extent, marker location and framing all move to that position
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Path extends, marker glides ahead of it, and the view travels and adjusts closeness so the described stretch stays visible, all easing into position rather than jumping
interaction_model.input: Reader advances through the section by scrolling forward
interaction_model.affected_object: Drawn path length, leading marker, panel framing

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Any earlier point can be returned to at will; forward and backward travel are symmetric and interruptible at any moment
interaction_model.state_change: Progress decreases and the path state rewinds to the earlier corresponding point
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The path shortens back along its own course with the marker retreating and the framing returning, reading as one continuous retrace rather than a reset and redraw
interaction_model.input: Reader scrolls back toward earlier detail blocks
interaction_model.affected_object: Drawn path length, leading marker, panel framing

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: A close action returns the reading view and restores page scrolling, with the reader left where they were rather than displaced
interaction_model.state_change: Panel takes over the full width, path is set to its finished complete state, and page scrolling is suspended
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The panel grows to fill the width with the entire path shown at rest; the reading column recedes behind it and the page no longer scrolls underneath
interaction_model.input: Reader activates the expand control
interaction_model.affected_object: Spatial panel, reading view, page scrolling

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Realignment happens without losing the reader's current position in the sequence
interaction_model.state_change: Measurements are recomputed against the new dimensions
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Path progress, marker and framing remain aligned with the detail block being read instead of drifting out of step
interaction_model.input: Viewport is resized (autonomous environmental change)
interaction_model.affected_object: Panel framing and progress-to-path mapping

experience_qualities: Steady and hand-guided: the visual feels led by the reader rather than playing on its own
Continuous and eased, never snapping between states
Anchored: a strong sense of where the journey begins
Unhurried after the opening, so text remains readable
Reversible and trustworthy — going back looks like the exact inverse of going forward
Culminating: the whole shape is earned at the end
completion_and_return: The section completes with the full path framed and at rest; nothing loops or replays automatically
Scrolling away and back re-establishes the state matching the reader's position rather than restarting from empty
Expanded mode always presents the finished complete state and returns cleanly to the reading view with scrolling restored
No progress is destroyed by reversal; the earlier state is reproduced faithfully
locked_observable_requirements: The spatial panel is held still while the accompanying detail text travels past it
Path drawn length, leading marker position and framing all advance together, driven by reading progress rather than by a timer
Drawing begins at an emphasised origin and reveals only as much of the path as has been described
Framing keeps the currently described stretch in view, starting close in on the origin and relaxing afterwards
All changes ease into place; no discrete jumps between stages
Backward movement retraces the same path in reverse to any earlier point, continuously
The sequence ends with the entire path visible in one view
An expanded full-width mode shows the path at its finished state and holds page scrolling; closing restores both the reading view and scrolling
Alignment between reading position and path position survives viewport size changes
adaptable_details: Number and wording of detail blocks
Which side of the viewport the panel occupies and its proportion of the screen
Visual styling of the path, origin emphasis and leading marker
How close the travelling view sits to the path and how much it widens at the end
Styling and placement of the expand and close controls
The subject matter of the spatial view, provided it supports a start-to-end path
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits any sequential explanation whose stages correspond to ordered positions along a single continuous path across a spatial view, where the text is long enough to justify holding the panel in place and the path's shape is worth withholding until the end. It stops being this Skill if the sequence has no single continuous path (isolated points or unrelated views), if the visual advances on its own timing instead of by reading position, if progress cannot be retraced backwards continuously, or if the panel scrolls away with the text instead of being held.

name: curved_waypoint_glide_along_scroll
description: A small graphic travels a softly bowed course between marked stops laid out down the page, moving forward or backward exactly as far as the visitor scrolls and settling into the nearest stop when scrolling pauses.

canonical_document.name: curved_waypoint_glide_along_scroll
canonical_document.description: A small graphic travels a softly bowed course between marked stops laid out down the page, moving forward or backward exactly as far as the visitor scrolls and settling into the nearest stop when scrolling pauses.
canonical_document.experience_scope: A whole-view vertical experience: it begins with the graphic at rest in the first marked stop near the top of the page and ends with the graphic settled in the last marked stop at the bottom; the plotted course spans the full scrollable length of the view.
content_and_composition: A single small travelling graphic as the only moving foreground object
An ordered series of marked stops (three or more) distributed down the page, each visually distinct as a frame or spot that can hold the graphic
A continuous curved course connecting consecutive stops, bowing between them rather than running as straight segments

A quiet cue near the top suggesting the course continues further down
Passed stops carry a visible confirmed appearance distinguishing them from stops not yet reached

interaction_model.affected_object: The travelling graphic's position along the curved course

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Resuming scroll interrupts the catch-up and hands motion back to scroll tracking without a visible jump
interaction_model.state_change: Graphic transitions from tracking to a settled resting position at the matching spot on the course
interaction_model.visible_feedback: A brief unhurried catch-up glide, then the graphic eases to rest without abrupt stopping
interaction_model.input: Scrolling stops at any point
interaction_model.affected_object: The travelling graphic

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Reversing past a stop returns it to its not-yet-reached appearance, keeping the trail truthful to current position
interaction_model.state_change: Stop changes from not-yet-reached to confirmed-passed
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The stop takes on its confirmed appearance, adding to the trail of covered ground
interaction_model.input: Graphic reaching a marked stop
interaction_model.affected_object: That marked stop

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Scrolling back inside the range immediately resumes normal tracking from the clamped end
interaction_model.state_change: Progress is clamped at the first and last stop
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The graphic holds inside the first or last marked stop and never overshoots past the ends of the course

interaction_model.affected_object: The travelling graphic's mapped position

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: No reset of position or of confirmed-stop states; the experience continues from where it was
interaction_model.state_change: Course geometry refits to the stops' new positions while current travel progress stays correct

experience_qualities: Playful and light rather than formal
Unhurried and continuous, never hopping or ticking between positions
Smoothly curving motion that feels like gliding along a route
Directly and reliably tied to the visitor's own scrolling, so it feels hand-driven
Legible as a whole: the complete course is graspable at a glance
completion_and_return: Completes with the graphic at rest inside the final marked stop and all stops shown as passed
No auto-advance and no looping; the end state simply holds

locked_observable_requirements: One small graphic travels along a single continuous course visiting an ordered series of marked stops

canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits vertically scrolled views with a small ordered set of fixed spatial waypoints and a single lightweight travelling marker, where content is sparse enough that the whole route stays visible and the marker can remain the main moving element. Replacing scroll-proportional tracking with autonomous playback or click-to-jump between stops, snapping the graphic discretely from stop to stop, moving several travellers at once, or making the route a dense scene rather than a legible single course would each create a different Skill.

name: day_night_globe_with_flowing_route_swarm
description: A planet suspended in a faint sparse speck field, framed so its illuminated and shaded halves are both in view, wrapped in thousands of thin arcs tinted only enough to separate groups, with small markers gliding along them; you drag to spin, scroll to move closer, and a live center coordinate readout tracks every move.

canonical_document.name: day_night_globe_with_flowing_route_swarm
canonical_document.description: A planet suspended in a faint sparse speck field, framed so its illuminated and shaded halves are both in view, wrapped in thousands of thin arcs tinted only enough to separate groups, with small markers gliding along them; you drag to spin, scroll to move closer, and a live center coordinate readout tracks every move.
canonical_document.experience_scope: Whole-view experience occupying the full viewport. It begins with a brief calm subject-free wait on an empty low-distraction surround while the dataset settles, resolves into the framed globe, and then never ends: the scene continues to move and re-light for as long as the view is open.
content_and_composition: Single primary subject: a spherical planet centered in the viewport, the sole focal object
Backdrop layer: a uniform low-distraction surround of any tone carrying a faint sparse star texture held at low contrast against it, so it never competes with the sphere

Route layer: thousands of thin arcs connecting point pairs on the surface, tinted only enough that grouping and density are readable in aggregate

Drawing nearer narrows attention to one region, where individual arcs, endpoints and mover motion become separately legible
Pulling back restores the aggregate reading; legibility must survive both ends of the range, so element sizing and arc weight stay readable near and far

Motion is the ambient attention anchor: the eye is drawn along flowing paths rather than to any highlighted item

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Fully and freely reversible: dragging the opposite way undoes any rotation. A new drag during the coast takes over immediately and cancels the remaining momentum. No orientation limits, no snap-back, no privileged home orientation.
interaction_model.state_change: Orientation turns to follow the pointer, then continues turning with decaying momentum after release until it settles
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The sphere rotates directly under the pointer with no lag, arcs and movers travel with the surface, the illuminated/shaded boundary shifts across the visible face, and the post-release coast slows smoothly to rest

interaction_model.affected_object: The globe and everything fixed to its surface

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Hard bounds: the near limit stops short of passing through the surface, and the far limit keeps the whole planet comfortably in frame. At either limit motion simply stops rather than overshooting or bouncing; the opposite gesture always recovers.
interaction_model.state_change: Viewpoint moves nearer or further, clamped at both ends of a fixed range
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The sphere grows or shrinks continuously; nearing reveals individual arcs, endpoints and mover motion in one region, retreating restores the whole-world framing
interaction_model.input: Scroll wheel or pinch gesture
interaction_model.affected_object: Viewpoint distance from the planet

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Always present and always current; it has no separate state to reset and simply reflects wherever the view has come to rest.
interaction_model.state_change: Readout recomputes to the surface position at the exact center of the view
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Latitude and longitude values update continuously and smoothly in step with the motion, including during the post-release coast, with no freezing or catch-up jumps
interaction_model.input: Any change of view — drag, coast, or distance change
interaction_model.affected_object: Persistent coordinate readout

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Never pauses, completes or resets. Viewer navigation changes the vantage point but never stops or restarts the underlying flow.
interaction_model.state_change: Movers advance along their paths; the illuminated/shaded division tracks the actual hour
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Continuous unhurried travel of many small markers plus a slowly drifting lighting boundary, both proceeding without any viewer input
interaction_model.input: Passage of real time (autonomous driver)
interaction_model.affected_object: Movers along the arcs and the surface lighting

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Current orientation and viewpoint distance carry through the resize unchanged.
interaction_model.state_change: Framing adapts to the new proportions
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The planet stays centered, whole and correctly proportioned; the coordinate overlay keeps its placement and legibility; no cropping of the sphere, distortion, or loss of the both-halves-visible framing
interaction_model.input: Window or container resize
interaction_model.affected_object: Whole-view framing

experience_qualities: Calm and unhurried despite very high element counts
Vast in scale, conveying global reach at first sight
Alive and current rather than authored or finished
Physically responsive, with weight and inertia in the spin
Legible at both extremes of the zoom range
Quiet in chrome: one subject, one numeric readout, no framing furniture
completion_and_return: No completion state and no end screen; the scene is indefinitely ongoing
No looping cycle either — flow and lighting follow real elapsed time rather than replaying
Return is achieved by the viewer's own reverse gesture rather than by any reset control or automatic re-centering
Orientation and viewpoint distance persist for the duration of the view, including across resizes
locked_observable_requirements: A short, calm, subject-free hold on the empty surround precedes the scene and resolves directly into the fully populated view
A single spherical subject centered against a faint sparse star texture held at low contrast to its surround
Framing on arrival shows an illuminated half and a shaded half at the same time, with a visible luminance boundary between them
Surface lighting corresponds to the actual current hour rather than a fixed or decorative light direction
Thousands of thin point-to-point arcs present simultaneously, tinted only enough to read as grouped aggregate density

Zoom bounded at both ends: never through the surface, never far enough to lose the whole planet
A persistent center latitude/longitude readout, legible against whatever is behind it, updating continuously with all view motion
Legibility preserved when narrowed to one region and again when widened to the whole world
Framing survives arbitrary container proportions with the subject whole and centered
adaptable_details: Exact duration and styling of the opening empty hold
Arc tinting scheme, opacity and curvature height
Marker shape and size, and how many markers occupy each path
Star density, contrast and the chosen tone of the surround
Numeric format, precision and corner placement of the coordinate readout

The specific point-to-point dataset carried on the surface
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits any dataset of many point-to-point connections between fixed surface locations with items in transit along them, where global scale is the message and the current real-world hour is meaningful — traffic of any kind, shipping, network links, migration, live sensor exchanges. Content type matters only in that the data must be geographic, dense, and continuously in motion; sparse datasets lose the aggregate density reading and static datasets lose the living quality. Replacing the sphere with a flat map, dropping real-hour lighting for fixed illumination, letting the flow terminate or loop as a finished animation, or foregrounding a single selected route with detail panels would each produce a different Skill.

experience_progression: Continuous advance: the point moves around the circle at a steady rate from load, with no build-in, intro or staged reveal
Each pass around the circle rejoins the previous one invisibly, so no cycle boundary, restart flash or accumulated drift is ever observable
Traces advance away from their originating axis by exactly the amount the point has turned, so trace length read across the region corresponds to elapsed rotation
attention_and_information_flow: The travelling point on the circle is the strongest moving element and reads first as the single cause of everything else
Attention passes outward from the point along the guide lines to each axis marker, establishing that the two values are produced by one source
Attention then follows each marker into its trace, where the shape of the value over time is revealed
Finally the two traces are compared against each other, at which point the quarter-cycle offset between them is self-evident from their relative positions rather than being stated
Prominence stays stable over time; no element gains or loses emphasis, so any arrival moment offers the same reading order

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: No controls are offered and none are needed; the motion is never blocked awaiting input and requires no reversal or resumption affordance
interaction_model.state_change: Angular position advances steadily and wraps seamlessly
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The point is seen circling at an even pace with no stutter, pause or jump at wrap
interaction_model.input: Autonomous continuous playback beginning at load, with no click, hover, scroll or setup
interaction_model.affected_object: Travelling point on the circular path

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Markers remain strictly on their axes at all times and never exceed the extent of the figure
interaction_model.state_change: Each marker slides along its own axis to the position projected from the point
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Two markers glide back and forth within their tracks, each reaching its extremes at a different moment from the other

interaction_model.affected_object: The two axis-constrained value markers

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Attachment is unconditional; the lines never detach, overshoot or leave a marker unconnected
interaction_model.state_change: Each guide line stretches and shortens to keep the point and its marker joined
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Two lines continuously change length while remaining visibly attached at both ends, so the causal link is never broken
interaction_model.input: Advance of the travelling point
interaction_model.affected_object: Guide lines between point and markers

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Traces scroll indefinitely without visible seams, snapping or drift relative to the circling point
interaction_model.state_change: Each trace slides away from its originating axis in proportion to the amount turned
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Two waves scroll steadily out of their axes at the same rate, holding a constant offset from one another
