interaction_model.affected_object: The two traces

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Relative geometry and the current moment of motion are preserved across the resize
interaction_model.state_change: The figure rescales in place while motion continues
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The entire composition grows or shrinks together with no clipping, reflow of relationships, restart or visible interruption
interaction_model.input: Window or container resize
interaction_model.affected_object: The whole figure including circle, markers, guide lines and traces

experience_qualities: Calm and unhurried, with a single steady tempo
Endless and arrival-agnostic: nothing needs to be started or finished
Self-explanatory without language; the relationship is shown rather than asserted
Causally legible, with one visible source driving every dependent element
Seamless, with no perceptible loop boundary or accumulating error
completion_and_return: There is no completion state, end frame or success moment
The cycle loops invisibly and indefinitely
No reset, replay or restore behavior is exposed, and no state needs to persist between arrivals
locked_observable_requirements: One steadily moving point on a closed circular path drives the entire figure
Exactly two derived values are shown separately, each confined to its own axis or track
Visible connecting lines continuously join the moving point to both derived markers
Each derived value produces its own trace that slides away from its axis in proportion to the amount the source has turned
The two traces hold a constant, visibly recognizable offset from one another
Playback is autonomous from load with no required input and no controls
The loop rejoins itself with no visible reset, seam or drift
Comprehension requires no labels, captions or instructions

adaptable_details: Rotation speed and trace scroll rate, as long as they stay steady and matched
Placement of the two trace regions relative to the circle (beside, below, or one of each)

Any palette, stroke weight, marker shape and surround treatment, provided the travelling point stays the most salient mark, the two traces remain distinguishable from each other, and all marks hold readable contrast against a low-distraction surround of either luminance polarity
Whether axes or the circular path are drawn faintly or implied
Direction of travel around the circle and direction the traces scroll
Overall figure size and aspect within its region
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits any explanation where one continuously advancing source produces two linked values whose relationship becomes obvious when shown side by side over time; the content type matters only in that two derived quantities must come from one visible moving source. Introducing user control over the motion, requiring labels or narration to be understood, showing only a single derived value, or making the figure a full-view background substrate behind other content would each create a different Skill.

name: arcing_vehicle_marker_route_strip
description: A small horizontal route between two named endpoints where a vehicle marker glides along, rising into an arc toward the midpoint and lowering again near the far endpoint, trailing a covered path held in clear tonal contrast to the route ahead, while the backdrop drifts behind it.

canonical_document.name: arcing_vehicle_marker_route_strip
canonical_document.description: A small horizontal route between two named endpoints where a vehicle marker glides along, rising into an arc toward the midpoint and lowering again near the far endpoint, trailing a covered path held in clear tonal contrast to the route ahead, while the backdrop drifts behind it.
canonical_document.experience_scope: A self-contained widget-sized region, not a whole view. It begins as a complete untraveled route at rest and ends when the marker reaches the far endpoint; it can be returned all the way to the undeparted start state and remains present in the layout throughout.
content_and_composition: Two fixed endpoint anchors, one at each end of the route, each carrying a short label and reading as a stop rather than a decoration
One continuous route line spanning the endpoints, drawn in two clearly separated segments: a covered segment behind the marker and an untraveled segment ahead of it
Exactly one traveling vehicle marker that acts as both the illustration and the draggable handle, sitting on or above the route line
A backdrop layer behind the route that reads as the surrounding environment and shifts opposite the marker's travel
A single share-complete value expressed as a percentage, available as an announced value for assistive technology and optionally shown as text
The whole assembly reads as one small scene: layered as backdrop, route line, covered trail, then marker on top
experience_progression: At rest: the full route reads as untraveled, marker parked at the origin endpoint, nothing covered
Early travel: the marker leaves the origin and lifts off the baseline, the covered trail begins to extend behind it
Mid travel: the marker rides at its highest offset from the route line around the halfway point, cruising
Late travel: the marker descends back toward the baseline as it approaches the far endpoint
Arrival: the marker settles onto the far endpoint, the covered trail spans the entire route, nothing untraveled remains
The whole progression is continuous and fully traversable in reverse, back to the not-yet-departed state
attention_and_information_flow: Before movement, attention rests on the two endpoint labels and the unbroken untraveled route, communicating a whole journey still ahead
During movement, the marker holds attention because it is the only element that changes position, with the marker's vertical arc signaling phase of journey
The proportion covered is legible at a glance from the length of the contrasting covered trail alone, without reading any number
Endpoint anchors stay visible at all times so the covered share is always read relative to a fixed whole
Backdrop drift is peripheral: it reinforces motion without competing for focus

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Direction can reverse mid-drag with no lock-in; movement clamps at each endpoint instead of overshooting past it; releasing leaves the marker wherever it landed
interaction_model.state_change: Covered share updates continuously and one-to-one with pointer travel along the route axis
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Marker follows the pointer without lag or easing offset, rising and falling along its arc according to where it sits, the contrasting covered trail extends or retracts to meet the marker exactly, and the backdrop slides past in the opposite direction
interaction_model.input: Pointer press and drag on the vehicle marker
interaction_model.affected_object: Marker position along the route, covered trail length, backdrop layer, announced percentage

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Stepping stops at the origin and destination endpoints rather than wrapping or overshooting; forward and backward stepping are equally available at any point; a visible focus treatment marks the strip while it is being stepped
interaction_model.state_change: Covered share moves one discrete notch forward or back per keypress
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Marker advances or retreats by a visible increment along the route with its arc height adjusting, the contrasting trail follows to meet it, and the backdrop shifts by the matching amount
interaction_model.input: Keyboard stepping while the route strip is focused
interaction_model.affected_object: Marker position along the route, covered trail length, backdrop layer, announced percentage

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: The announced value always matches the marker's current position, including at the clamped endpoints, and returns to the undeparted value when the marker is taken all the way back
interaction_model.state_change: Completed share is recomputed as a percentage of the full route
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The percentage is exposed for assistive technology so the covered share is available without seeing the trail
interaction_model.input: Any position change from drag or stepping
interaction_model.affected_object: Announced completion value

experience_qualities: Playful and toy-like, inviting a poke rather than reading as instrumentation
Self-explanatory: the meaning of endpoints, trail and marker is clear without a legend
Directly responsive, with position feeling physically attached to the drag
Small in footprint and calm at rest
Legible at a glance, with covered share readable as proportion rather than as a number
completion_and_return: Reaching the far endpoint is a resting completion state with the entire route shown as covered; nothing auto-resets and nothing loops
The experience is fully reversible: the marker can be taken back to the origin, restoring the untraveled route and the undeparted reading
Position persists wherever the user leaves it; interrupted drags simply end at the current position
Both endpoints act as hard stops rather than transitions into another state
locked_observable_requirements: Two fixed, labeled endpoint anchors bounding one continuous route
A single traveling marker that doubles as the drag handle
The marker departs from the baseline, reaches its greatest offset near the midpoint, and returns to the baseline at the far endpoint
A covered segment kept in unmistakable contrast against the untraveled segment, in either tonal direction, that always terminates exactly at the marker
Backdrop layer that shifts counter to the marker's travel
Position tracks pointer drag one-to-one along the route axis, with no overshoot past either endpoint
Discrete notch-by-notch stepping when the strip is focused, in both directions
Full reversibility to the not-yet-departed state
Completed share exposed as a percentage for assistive technology
adaptable_details: What the traveling marker depicts and what the backdrop depicts
Hues, tonal direction and surround brightness, line weight, marker scale and overall widget dimensions
Arc height and curve shape, so long as the rise-cruise-descend reading survives
Notch size for keyboard stepping
Endpoint label content and whether the percentage is also shown visibly
Horizontal versus other single-axis route orientation, and whether the route is straight or gently curved
Whether the marker's position can also be driven autonomously in addition to by the user
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits any single linear span with two meaningful, named endpoints and one continuous covered share, expressed in a compact widget-sized block. It stays the same Skill when the marker, backdrop, subject matter and color treatment change, including on light or dark surrounds, as long as covered and untraveled segments stay clearly separated. It becomes a different Skill if there are multiple intermediate stops or branches to select between, if the route becomes a full-view map or layout rather than a compact strip, if the marker stops being the handle, or if the covered share becomes a multi-value or non-monotonic range instead of one advancing position.

name: blur_sweep_counter_with_marked_stop_control
description: One giant centred number reading at high contrast against a flat, unbroken field that races up from zero on load, its digits smearing into half-legibility while moving and snapping crisp on arrival, with a horizontal row of marked stops above it that redirects the count up or down from wherever it currently stands.

canonical_document.name: blur_sweep_counter_with_marked_stop_control
canonical_document.description: One giant centred number reading at high contrast against a flat, unbroken field that races up from zero on load, its digits smearing into half-legibility while moving and snapping crisp on arrival, with a horizontal row of marked stops above it that redirects the count up or down from wherever it currently stands.
canonical_document.experience_scope: A whole-view experience for a deliberately sparse page: it begins the moment the view appears, with the figure sweeping from zero to its starting amount, and continues indefinitely as an interactive region, resting between runs rather than ending. The figure and its control together occupy the view; there is no surrounding content competing for the same space.
content_and_composition: Exactly one numeric figure, oversized relative to everything else, centred in the view as the sole focal object
One flat, single-tone field filling the view behind the figure, with no imagery, texture, or depth cues, separated far enough from the figure's own tone that the digits read at full contrast
One horizontal value control positioned above the figure, spanning a modest share of the width and reading as a single track
A handful of discrete marked stops along that track, from zero at one end up to the maximum at the other, each visibly indicated and each directly selectable
A persistent indicator on the track showing which stop is currently the target
Thousands grouping inside the figure so larger amounts stay parseable as grouped digits rather than an undifferentiated run
No secondary metrics, legends, captions, or decoration beyond the figure and its control
experience_progression: Arrival: the figure appears at zero and immediately begins travelling upward to its starting amount, unprompted, which demonstrates the behaviour before any input
Travel: digits change fast enough to read as motion rather than as a sequence of readable values, the figure feeling physically driven
Arrival at rest: motion resolves and the figure becomes crisp and completely legible at the target amount
Rest: the figure holds that amount indefinitely, fully legible, awaiting input
Any subsequent stop selection re-enters travel and rest from the current amount; the cycle repeats without ever returning to zero unless zero is the chosen stop
attention_and_information_flow: Attention sits on the figure at all times; the flat, undifferentiated surround and the absence of competing content leave nothing else to look at

Legibility is the main information variable: during travel the exact value is intentionally withheld and only magnitude and direction are perceivable, and at rest the precise value is delivered in full
The control is secondary in prominence but always visible, reading as the cause of what the figure is doing
Direction of travel is itself information — the figure visibly climbs or falls toward the newly chosen stop
Digit grouping keeps scale legible at the moment of arrival, so a large final amount registers as a magnitude rather than a wall of digits

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Self-completing; a stop selection made during this opening sweep is honoured immediately and redirects the run rather than being ignored or queued
interaction_model.state_change: Figure moves from zero to its starting amount
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Digits sweep upward with motion smear, then settle crisp and fully legible at the starting amount
interaction_model.input: View first appears (autonomous driver, no user action)
interaction_model.affected_object: The giant numeric figure

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Fully reversible by picking any other stop, including the previous one; every run terminates in a legible resting value
interaction_model.state_change: Target becomes the chosen stop; figure leaves rest and travels toward it in whichever direction is required
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Indicator moves to the picked stop; digits blur into motion, climbing or falling, then arrive crisp on exactly that amount
interaction_model.input: Selecting a marked stop on the horizontal control while the figure is at rest
interaction_model.affected_object: The figure and the control's current-target indicator

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Redirection can happen any number of times mid-run; the visible value is never discarded, so the figure always continues from its own current reading
interaction_model.state_change: Travel is redirected from whatever amount is currently displayed toward the new stop, reversing direction if needed
interaction_model.visible_feedback: No restart from zero, no discontinuous jump, no stall — the running digits simply continue from where they are toward the new target and then arrive crisp
interaction_model.input: Selecting a different stop while the figure is still travelling
interaction_model.affected_object: The in-flight figure

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Hard boundary: however fast the stops are changed, the figure must come to rest on exactly the finally chosen amount, never overshooting into a stale value or settling between stops
interaction_model.state_change: Each change supersedes the previous target while motion continues uninterrupted
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Continuous motion with changing direction, ending on the last-chosen amount only
interaction_model.input: Rapid repeated stop changes in quick succession
interaction_model.affected_object: The figure

experience_qualities: Weighty and energetic rather than decorative — the motion feels driven by force, not by a polite fade
Physically fast: during travel the digits feel like they are moving too quickly to read
Deliberate withholding then delivery: half-readable in motion, completely crisp at rest
Self-explanatory — the opening sweep teaches the behaviour with no prompt or instruction
Precise and obedient: the exact chosen amount always wins, no matter how erratically the input arrives
Bold and reductive, a single loud figure standing clear of one uninterrupted flat field
completion_and_return: Every run completes by resting exactly on the currently selected stop, in a fully legible state
No looping and no automatic reset: the figure stays at its last landed amount indefinitely
Re-entering the view restarts from zero and sweeps to the starting amount again, reproducing the introductory demonstration
The control's indicator persistently reflects the resting amount, so the figure and the control never disagree once motion stops
locked_observable_requirements: Exactly one oversized numeric figure, centred, as the sole focal content of the view
A flat, single-tone field behind it with no imagery or depth, held far enough from the figure's own tone that the digits read at full contrast
An unprompted opening sweep from zero to the starting amount on first appearance
Digits visibly degraded to half-legibility while travelling and crisp and completely legible at rest
Thousands grouping in the displayed figure so higher amounts read as grouped thousands
A single horizontal control above the figure with a small number of visibly marked, directly selectable stops running from zero to the maximum
Redirection from the currently displayed amount — never a restart from zero and never an instantaneous jump — when a new stop is chosen mid-travel
Travel in either direction, upward or downward, as required by the new target
Guaranteed rest on exactly the last-chosen amount regardless of how rapidly stops are changed
adaptable_details: The specific hue, saturation, and lightness of the field and of the digits, in either contrast polarity, as long as their separation keeps the figure fully readable
Typeface, weight, and exact size of the figure
How many stops the control offers and what values they carry, including the maximum
Whether the figure carries a unit, prefix, or suffix alongside the digits
The visual styling of the track, stop markers, and current-target indicator
Run duration and the exact character of the acceleration and settle, as long as it still reads as weighty and fast
The precise visual technique that makes moving digits half-readable
The digit-grouping separator convention
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits any single scalar magnitude that a visitor is meant to feel the size of and steer — a headline total, count, score, price point, or capacity figure — presented as the sole foreground content of a sparse view. It stays the same Skill across different value ranges, units, palettes, contrast polarities, and stop counts. It becomes a different Skill if the single figure is replaced by multiple simultaneous metrics or a chart, if the flat single-tone field becomes imagery or layered depth that the figure must sit within, if the digits stay fully legible throughout so there is no withheld-then-delivered legibility, or if the marked discrete stops are replaced by a control with no defined target amounts for the figure to rest on exactly.

name: weighty_readout_orbit_and_shove_scene
description: A short live reading assembled from solid blocks in an otherwise empty space, orbitable by dragging and scatterable by moving the pointer into it, rebuilt clean at the next update.

canonical_document.name: weighty_readout_orbit_and_shove_scene
canonical_document.description: A short live reading assembled from solid blocks in an otherwise empty space, orbitable by dragging and scatterable by moving the pointer into it, rebuilt clean at the next update.
canonical_document.experience_scope: Whole-view single-region experience: begins the moment the page appears with the reading already legible, continues indefinitely with no end state, and occupies the entire scene rather than sitting beside other content.
content_and_composition: One focal reading as the only foreground content, assembled from a small set of discrete solid pieces that together spell the current value
Empty, calm surround with no competing content, chrome, labels or instructions
An implied support surface and depth/lighting cues so the pieces read as volumes with mass rather than drawn glyphs
Persistent elements: the reading itself and a framing that keeps it legible from any permitted viewing angle
Displaced pieces remain in the same scene as visible debris until the next update, never leaving the view
experience_progression: Arrival: the reading is already correct, settled and readable without any interaction
Ongoing cycle: each change of the value is a small visible event as pieces change and settle into the new reading
Optional disturbance interlude: pieces are shoved out of place, tumble, knock together and come to rest in disorder
Return: the next change of the value restores an ordered, clean, legible reading, and the cycle repeats without limit
attention_and_information_flow: Attention is pinned to one object at all times; emptiness around it removes competition
Value changes briefly raise motion prominence at the reading itself, then subside to stillness
Disturbance creates temporary spectacle and disorder, which lowers readability only until the next update
Viewpoint changes reveal the reading's dimensionality and construction without revealing new information beyond the value
No progressive disclosure: the same single piece of information is always the payload

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Release comes to rest immediately at the current angle with no overshoot; dragging back reverses freely; vertical range is clamped so the view never tips past upright
interaction_model.state_change: Orbit angle changes in one-to-one correspondence with drag distance and holds at the angle where the drag was released
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The scene turns around the reading so it is seen from other sides, with depth and volume becoming apparent as it rotates
interaction_model.input: Drag across the scene
interaction_model.affected_object: Viewpoint orbiting the focal reading

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: No manual reset is needed or offered; the next change of the value rebuilds a clean, legible arrangement, so the display can never be left permanently unreadable
interaction_model.state_change: Contacted pieces leave their resting arrangement and become loose bodies in motion
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Pieces are shoved aside, tumble, knock against one another and the surface, then come to rest in a disordered pile
interaction_model.input: Pointer moved into the pieces that form the reading
interaction_model.affected_object: The solid pieces composing the reading

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Always converges to a correct, settled reading; glancing away and back shows the current value with no catch-up state
interaction_model.state_change: Outgoing pieces give way to the new value and any displaced pieces are returned to an ordered arrangement
interaction_model.visible_feedback: A short, watchable settling of solid pieces into the new reading
interaction_model.input: Autonomous passage of the underlying value (time advancing)
interaction_model.affected_object: The composition of the reading

experience_qualities: Tangible and weighty, as if the reading were built from real objects
Calm and uncluttered, with a single unmistakable focus
Playful and forgiving — poking has consequences but no penalty
Momentarily eventful at each change, still in between
Immediately legible with nothing to learn or complete
completion_and_return: No completion, score or end state; the experience runs continuously
Disorder is self-healing: the next value change is the reset
Viewpoint persists wherever the last drag left it and is not auto-recentred
Correctness of the displayed value is never sacrificed to the effect
locked_observable_requirements: The reading is correct and legible on arrival without interaction
One focal object in an otherwise empty space, with no competing foreground content
Pieces read as solid, weighty volumes with depth, not flat text
Each change of the value is a visible settling event rather than an instant swap
Dragging turns the viewpoint one-to-one and stops where released, with no inertial glide
Vertical viewing range is clamped so the scene never tips past upright
Pointer contact displaces pieces, which tumble, collide and come to rest in view
The next value change always restores a clean, ordered, legible reading with no user action
adaptable_details: Which value is shown (clock, countdown, counter, score, measurement)
Shape, material, colour and lighting of the pieces and the surround, so long as the pieces stay clearly separated from the surround and the reading keeps readable contrast
Glyph form and segmentation of the reading
Exact clamp angles, drag-to-rotation sensitivity and settling duration
Update cadence of the value and whether sound accompanies impacts
Whether displaced pieces are rebuilt in place or replaced by fresh ones
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits a single short, continuously updating reading or a small set of glyph-like tokens acting as the only focus of a full-view or hero region. It stays the same Skill across different displayed values, materials and scene styling. It becomes a different Skill if the content grows into dense multi-element layouts or text that must stay readable at all times, if the disturbance must persist as user-arranged state or be scored as a game, or if the viewpoint becomes a guided/automatic tour instead of a directly dragged one-to-one orbit.

name: water_shaped_period_row_with_in_column_time_scrub
description: A single screenful in which a few equal-width period columns share one unbroken water-like curve whose rise and fall ranks them at a glance; sweeping horizontally inside a column swaps its figures and condition symbol to the hours under the cursor, shifts the column's background along an ordered tonal progression that marks how far into the period the pointer sits, lifts the patch beneath the pointer, and snaps back to the period's own figures on exit, while choosing another data source bends the whole water into a new shape.

canonical_document.name: water_shaped_period_row_with_in_column_time_scrub
canonical_document.description: A single screenful in which a few equal-width period columns share one unbroken water-like curve whose rise and fall ranks them at a glance; sweeping horizontally inside a column swaps its figures and condition symbol to the hours under the cursor, shifts the column's background along an ordered tonal progression that marks how far into the period the pointer sits, lifts the patch beneath the pointer, and snaps back to the period's own figures on exit, while choosing another data source bends the whole water into a new shape.
canonical_document.experience_scope: One calm region occupying a single screenful, from arrival with the entire span visible to the moment the pointer leaves the region or another data source is chosen; no scrolling, no page or view transition, and no separate detail screen.
content_and_composition: One continuous water-like form spanning the full width of the region, its height and contour encoding the headline magnitude of each period so the whole span reads as one silhouette
A small set of equal-width period columns (roughly five to ten) laid side by side beneath and within the same water form, forming one scene rather than independent cards
Per column: a short period label, a small cluster of compact numeric figures, and one condition symbol
A transient sub-period range label that appears inside the column only while it is being swept
A short horizontal source selector strip at the top holding a few options with the current one marked

A per-column background tone that travels continuously along one ordered progression as sweep position advances through the period, held subdued enough that figures and symbol keep readable contrast against it throughout
A faintly raised patch under the cursor within the active column, reading as slight depth above the water surface
Everything fits one screenful with no scrolling and no overlay that covers the scene

Descent: the pointer enters one column and that column's readings narrow from the whole-period summary to a sub-period
