attention_and_information_flow: Shape carries the first read; numbers are secondary and only sharpen a judgment already made from the contour
The swept column gains prominence through its shifted background tone and the faint lift under the cursor while neighbouring columns stay fully legible and in place
The sub-period range label is the only text added during interaction, so information grows without the composition changing size or position
No modal, overlay or focus trap intervenes; the region never hands attention to another surface
After a source change attention returns to the whole-span silhouette rather than to any single period

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Sliding further re-reads without any commitment or selection; only one column is ever active; nothing is stored, so any position can be revisited freely
interaction_model.state_change: Column shifts from whole-period summary to the sub-period corresponding to the horizontal position, and tracks continuously as the position changes
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Figures and condition symbol swap instantly to the sub-period values, the covered sub-period range is spelled out in the column, the column's background moves along its ordered tonal progression in step with position so early, middle and late parts of the period are distinguishable from the surround alone, and the patch beneath the cursor lifts faintly
interaction_model.input: Pointer moving horizontally within one period column
interaction_model.affected_object: That column's numeric figures, condition symbol, background tone and the surface patch under the cursor

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Re-entering the column resumes sweeping immediately from the new pointer position; no residue of the previous sweep remains
interaction_model.state_change: Active sub-period state releases back to the whole-period summary state
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Figures and symbol return to the period's own values, the sub-period range label disappears, and the background tone and lift settle back to the resting scene
interaction_model.input: Pointer leaving the column
interaction_model.affected_object: The previously swept column

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Any option can be reselected at will; any active sweep state clears; the layout, region position and screenful composition are preserved with no reload or jump
interaction_model.state_change: The whole scene re-tunes to the newly selected source while staying in place
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The water bends from its old contour into the new one and all periods' figures and symbols are rewritten, with the selector marking the new current option
interaction_model.input: Choosing a different option from the short source selector at the top
interaction_model.affected_object: The shared water form and every period column's figures and condition symbols

experience_qualities: Calm and fluid, reading as one body of water rather than as a dashboard
Glanceable: relative quality is legible before reading
Continuous and fluid rather than stepped or paged
Immediate response with no perceptible delay while sweeping
Subtle, shallow depth rather than pronounced elevation
Unhurried retuning on source change instead of an abrupt swap
completion_and_return: The sweep has no completion state; it always resolves back to the period's own summary when the pointer withdraws
The chosen source persists as the new resting state of the scene until another is chosen
The region remains indefinitely available and re-enterable; nothing is dismissed, submitted or finished
locked_observable_requirements: One continuous water-like form shared across all periods whose rise and fall communicates relative magnitude across the whole span before any number is read
The entire span visible side by side within a single screenful without scrolling
Horizontal pointer position inside a period maps to a sub-period of that period
The swept column's figures and condition symbol change to the sub-period values
The covered sub-period range is explicitly spelled out while sweeping

The swept column's background travels along one continuous, ordered tonal progression driven by sweep position, so position within the period is readable from the surround alone while figures stay legible against it
A faint lift of the surface patch directly under the cursor
Continuous, instantaneous updating while sliding sideways
Leaving the column snaps it back to the period's own figures with the sub-period label removed
Changing the data source bends the water into a new shape and rewrites every period's figures in place, without changing the composition or leaving the view
adaptable_details: Number of periods shown and number of source options
Which and how many numeric figures each column carries, and their units
The condition symbol set and its visual style

Which hues, overall lightness and direction the scene and its sweep progression use, provided the progression stays continuous and ordered and text keeps readable contrast; also water contour smoothness and amplitude
Magnitude of the tonal shift and of the lifted patch
Whether sweeping is driven by pointer movement or by a dragging touch
Wording and placement of the sub-period range label
Pacing of the re-forming water on source change
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits any short set of comparable periods or units where each holds one headline magnitude plus finer sub-period readings and where relative comparison across the whole span is the main message. Content with no continuous magnitude to shape a shared form, or needing overlaid multi-source comparison, drill-down into a separate view, committed selection or pinning of a slice, becomes a different Skill. Replacing continuous sweeping with discrete tabs or steppers, or replacing the single unbroken form with independent per-period cards or charts, also produces a different Skill.

name: proximity_bleed_marker_story_map
description: A quiet low-contrast surface with a few marked spots; cursor nearness makes the nearest spot's photograph bleed through the surface with its name and teaser, and clicking locks the photograph fully open behind a longer dated account until the viewer steps back to the surface.

canonical_document.name: proximity_bleed_marker_story_map
canonical_document.description: A quiet low-contrast surface with a few marked spots; cursor nearness makes the nearest spot's photograph bleed through the surface with its name and teaser, and clicking locks the photograph fully open behind a longer dated account until the viewer steps back to the surface.
canonical_document.experience_scope: A single self-contained region that is the dominant view of the page: it begins on arrival at the surface, holds the entire reveal-and-read cycle for one spot at a time, and ends when the viewer returns to the untouched surface; nothing outside the region changes state.
content_and_composition: One large static illustrated surface, deliberately held low in contrast and visual intensity, acting as the persistent base layer and the calm visual ground for everything else
A small set of marked spots (a handful, not dozens) placed at fixed positions on the surface, all visible and equally weighted at rest
Per spot: one photographic image, a short place name, a one-line teaser, and one longer dated narrative passage
Photographic image sits in a layer between the surface and the text, becoming visible through the surface rather than replacing it abruptly
Caption block (name plus teaser) appears attached directly beneath the active marker rather than in a fixed side panel
Opened reading state: the photograph fully revealed as the backdrop with the longer passage laid over it at readable contrast, occupying the same region as the surface
experience_progression: Rest: quiet low-contrast surface, all markers plainly visible and inviting inspection, no imagery showing
Approach: continuous partial bleed-through of the nearest spot's photograph, proportional to cursor nearness
Engaged: past a nearness threshold the active marker grows and takes on a high-salience accent clearly separated from the resting markers, its caption appears beneath it, and the other markers recede
Committed: photograph fully open behind the longer dated account; proximity reveal is frozen
Return: opened view collapses, surface and all markers restored to rest
attention_and_information_flow: At rest attention is distributed across the marked spots because nothing is emphasised
Nearness concentrates attention on one spot by both adding its imagery and withdrawing the competing markers
Information arrives in increasing amounts: silhouette of an image, then identity and a teaser hint that more exists behind it, then the full account
In the committed state the written passage holds primary prominence and the photograph becomes atmospheric backing
Returning restores even distribution so the next spot can be chosen without residual emphasis

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Fully reversible by moving away; leaving the surface returns the region to rest with no lingering partial reveal
interaction_model.state_change: Reveal strength rises and falls continuously with nearness; falls back toward hidden as the cursor drifts away or leaves the surface entirely
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The photograph bleeds up through the surface and sinks back down, tracking movement without discrete steps
interaction_model.input: Continuous cursor movement across the surface
interaction_model.affected_object: Photograph layer of the spot nearest the cursor

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Leaving the threshold restores the marker's size and resting accent, hides the caption, and brings all markers back
interaction_model.state_change: Marker becomes the single active spot; caption becomes present; peer markers become subdued
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Active marker swells and switches to its distinct accent, its name and teaser appear directly beneath it, other markers drop away
interaction_model.input: Cursor crossing the nearness threshold of one spot
interaction_model.affected_object: That marker, its caption, and all other markers

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Only the active marker can be committed; a click elsewhere on the surface does not open a spot
interaction_model.state_change: Enters a locked reading state and suspends cursor-driven reveal
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Photograph settles at full visibility with the longer dated account over it; further cursor movement no longer changes anything
interaction_model.input: Click on the active accented marker
interaction_model.affected_object: The whole region: photograph, narrative text, and proximity behaviour

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Two equivalent exits are always available; exit is non-destructive and the same spot can be reopened immediately
interaction_model.state_change: Reading state dismissed and proximity reveal resumed
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Photograph and account withdraw, the surface returns, and every marker is live and responsive again
interaction_model.input: Click on the opened view, or pressing the escape key
interaction_model.affected_object: Locked reading state and marker set

experience_qualities: Quiet, restrained and low-contrast at rest so imagery reads as an intrusion of intensity and detail
Continuous and analogue rather than snapping between states
The sense of something showing through a surface instead of appearing on top of it
Calm and unhurried in the reading state, with no time pressure or auto-advance
Exit obviously available, so committing never feels like a trap
completion_and_return: No overall completion: spots may be inspected in any order, repeatedly, with no progress tracking or exhaustion state
Each cycle returns to the full rest state with all markers live
No persistent memory of which spots were opened; a visited spot behaves exactly as an unvisited one
Reading state persists until explicitly dismissed and is never dismissed by movement alone
locked_observable_requirements: One quiet low-contrast surface as persistent base with a small set of fixed marked spots
Reveal strength tied continuously to cursor nearness, rising and sinking, not toggled
Imagery emerges through the surface rather than replacing it in one step
A nearness threshold that simultaneously enlarges one marker and shifts it to a clearly separated accent, shows its caption beneath it, and subdues the others
Caption anchored beneath its own marker, carrying a name plus a teaser that implies more behind it
Commitment locks the image fully open behind a longer passage and freezes the proximity reveal
Two exits (clicking the opened view and the escape key) that both restore the surface with all markers live
adaptable_details: Subject matter of the surface (city plan, floor plan, illustration, technical diagram, product view)
Exact number and placement of marked spots
Visual style of the surface and the specific accent treatment marking the active marker
Nearness radius, reveal curve and transition timing
Typographic treatment and length of teaser and long-form passage
Layout of the passage over the opened image
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Transfers to any single-surface view carrying a handful of located points that each own one strong image, a short label and a longer passage, and that is large enough for cursor nearness to be meaningful. It stops being this Skill if the points become numerous enough to require search, filtering or clustering, if the surface pans and zooms so nearness loses meaning, if reveal becomes a discrete hover toggle rather than a continuous nearness gradient, or if committing navigates to a separate page instead of locking a reading state in place.

name: map_backed_chapter_journey_scroll
description: Chapters read in a narrow column while a full-bleed map behind them pans and zooms to each named stop and a solid travelled line grows along a faint full route, finishing with the entire journey visible.

canonical_document.name: map_backed_chapter_journey_scroll
canonical_document.description: Chapters read in a narrow column while a full-bleed map behind them pans and zooms to each named stop and a solid travelled line grows along a faint full route, finishing with the entire journey visible.
canonical_document.experience_scope: A whole-view experience spanning the entire page: it begins with a full-height photographic title screen carrying a short quotation, continues through the full sequence of chapters where the map layer occupies the whole viewport behind the text, and ends when the final chapter leaves the completed route fully framed. The map layer persists for the whole reading stretch and is not a detachable widget.
content_and_composition: Opening stage: one full-viewport photographic title panel with a title and a short quiet quotation, occupying the whole view before any narrative begins.
Background layer for the rest of the page: a continuous full-viewport map that is never fully covered and never scrolls away with the text.
Foreground layer: a single narrow reading column of chapter text, centred or offset over the map, deliberately much narrower than the viewport so the map stays legible around it.
Chapter sequence: multiple chapters (at least three to make progress legible), each bound to one named stop on the route.
Route graphic on the map: one faint full-route path visible from the start plus one solid travelled path drawn over it, with a distinct leading tip.
Stop markers: one marker per chapter stop with a text label; exactly one active stop at a time, others held in an understated state.
Photographic content: images placed within or beside the reading column, each associated with a specific point on the route.
A light-cone connector drawn from a photograph to its own point on the route, present only while that photograph is near mid-viewport.
One small travelling marker that appears on the leading tip of the travelled path during a single designated chapter.
experience_progression: Mood stage: the full-height photographic title and quotation hold the whole view, establishing tone with no map activity yet.
Handover: the narrative column begins and the map takes over the background, showing the faint full route so the whole journey is previewed before it is travelled.

Chapter stages: for each chapter in order, the map reframes onto the stretch of country being described, the travelled line advances to that chapter's marker, that stop becomes active, and the line then holds at the marker until the next chapter is entered.
Interlude stage: during one designated chapter a small travelling marker rides the leading tip of the growing line.
Closing stage: after the last chapter the map settles so the full completed route, with all stops travelled, remains in view.
attention_and_information_flow: Attention starts wholly on the photographic title and quotation, with no competing information.
Once chapters begin, reading attention stays in the narrow column while the map supplies ambient orientation in peripheral view; the map never demands to be read as the primary object.
Framing does the pointing: because the map recentres on the described stretch, the currently relevant geography is always the most visible geography.

Emphasis among stops is graded — the active stop's label strengthens once reached, already-visited stops read as travelled, and upcoming stops stay understated so the eye is not pulled ahead of the text.
The proportion of solid travelled path against faint remaining path is the at-a-glance progress signal, readable without stopping to interpret it.
A photograph momentarily raises the salience of its exact point on the route while it is centred, then releases that emphasis as it leaves.
At the end, prominence shifts from any single stop to the completed route as a whole.

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Reversible: scrolling back returns the framing to earlier chapters. Rapid scrolling is absorbed rather than obeyed literally — the framing settles smoothly to the correct position instead of snapping or jumping.
interaction_model.state_change: The map moves from the previous chapter's framing to the current chapter's location and scale
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Continuous panning and zooming toward the described stretch of country, arriving as the chapter takes the reading position
interaction_model.input: Scrolling downward through the narrative
interaction_model.affected_object: The full-view map framing

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Scrolling back retracts the line to its earlier extent; the faint full route always remains visible so the journey's total extent is never lost.
interaction_model.state_change: The travelled path extends along the route toward the current chapter's marker, then holds once it reaches it
interaction_model.visible_feedback: A solid line growing over the faint route with a visible leading tip, pausing at the reached marker until the next chapter begins
interaction_model.input: Scrolling downward through the narrative
interaction_model.affected_object: The travelled path over the faint full route

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Fully reversed on upward scroll, with a stop returning to its upcoming state when the reader moves back before it.
interaction_model.state_change: The stop tied to the current chapter becomes active while others remain visited or upcoming
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The active stop's label strengthens in prominence; visited stops read as already passed and upcoming stops stay understated
interaction_model.input: Scrolling into or out of a chapter
interaction_model.affected_object: Stop markers and their labels

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Symmetric in both scroll directions; the cone fades rather than disappearing abruptly, and multiple photographs do not hold their cones simultaneously once off-centre.
interaction_model.state_change: A connection between the image and its location becomes active, then deactivates as the image leaves centre
interaction_model.visible_feedback: A soft cone of light reaches from the photograph onto its point on the route, brightest near centre and fading out as the photograph moves away
interaction_model.input: A photograph approaching the middle of the viewport as the reader scrolls
interaction_model.affected_object: The photograph and its own point on the route

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Appears and withdraws with that chapter and reverses on upward scroll; it does not persist into neighbouring chapters.
interaction_model.state_change: A small travelling marker is present and advances with the tip for the duration of that chapter
interaction_model.visible_feedback: A small marker seen moving along the leading edge of the growing line
interaction_model.input: Scrolling through one designated chapter
interaction_model.affected_object: The leading tip of the travelled path

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Interruptible at any moment: a new scroll or resize during settling redirects the motion smoothly from wherever it currently is.
interaction_model.state_change: All driven states resolve to the values matching the new reading position and viewport
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Every element eases into place, arriving at a settled correct state rather than snapping or flickering
interaction_model.input: Rapid flicks, scroll jumps, or resizing the window
interaction_model.affected_object: Map framing, travelled path extent, marker emphasis and photograph cones

experience_qualities: Calm and cinematic rather than energetic or playful
Understandable with no instructions, prompts or controls to learn
Continuously legible progress — how much ground lies behind is readable at a glance
Ambient rather than interruptive: the map informs without stealing the reading
Smooth and settled under fast or careless input, never jittery
Fully scrubbable in both directions, so the journey can be re-read backwards
completion_and_return: Completion is reaching the end of the last chapter, at which point the whole finished route stays framed and in view rather than the map resetting or clearing.
No looping and no automatic replay; progression only ever follows reading position.
Scrolling back fully restores earlier states — retracted travelled line, earlier framing, upcoming stop emphasis — with no residue from having reached the end.
Progress is derived from reading position rather than remembered, so returning to a position reproduces the same visual state.
locked_observable_requirements: A full-viewport photographic opening with a title and a short quotation, holding the whole view before the narrative starts
A persistent whole-viewport map layer behind a single narrow reading column, with the column never widening to cover the map
Chapters bound one-to-one to named stops, advanced only by scroll position
Map framing that pans and zooms continuously to the stretch described by the current chapter
A faint full route visible from the outset with a solid travelled path growing over it and holding at each reached marker
Graded stop emphasis with exactly one active stop, understated upcoming stops, and visibly travelled past stops
Photograph-to-route light cones that appear near mid-viewport and fade on exit
A small travelling marker on the leading tip during one designated chapter
Full reversibility of every driven state on upward scroll
Smooth settling instead of jumping under rapid scrolling or window resizing
A closing state that leaves the entire completed route in view
adaptable_details: Number of chapters and stops, and their geographic spread
Which chapter carries the travelling marker
Column placement (centred or offset) and its exact width
Visual styling of the map surface, route colours, marker shapes and label typography
Opening photograph and quotation content and their typographic treatment
Number and placement of photographs per chapter
Zoom range and easing character of the framing moves
Softness, colour and length of the photograph cones
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits any sequential narrative whose sections each belong to a distinct location along a single connected path — trips, expeditions, itineraries, site tours, historical or logistical journeys — where the text is the primary content and the spatial view is ambient orientation. It requires an ordered set of named places and one continuous route linking them. It stops being this Skill if the spatial view becomes the primary interactive object the reader explores or clicks freely, if sections have no ordered locations or no single connecting route, if progression is driven by clicks, timers or autoplay rather than scroll position, or if the spatial layer is reduced to a per-section inset instead of a persistent whole-viewport backdrop.

source_sites.title: Animated Map Path for Interactive Storytelling

name: mosaic_dot_world_intensity_map
description: A world drawn as a coarse grid of tiny squares where busier regions read as denser, stronger-chroma clusters and quiet land fades to a near-colourless low-contrast state, with a few distinct site points that raise a single small label pinned above them on hover.

experience_qualities: Pre-verbal legibility: the shape of demand lands before reading
Coarse, blocky mosaic character rather than cartographic precision
A calm inert substrate with exactly one crisp reactive layer
Restrained hover payload — identification, not a data panel
Current and alive rather than frozen
locked_observable_requirements: The world must be rendered as a low-resolution mosaic of uniform tiny squares, not smooth vector shapes or imagery
Intensity encoded by density together with a graded colour step, with low or zero regions drained to a near-colourless, low-contrast state that recedes from its surround
Relative distribution must be readable before any text is read
Named locations appear as distinct points visually separable from the mosaic squares
Only the location markers respond to pointing; the mosaic field never reacts
Exactly one label visible at a time, pinned directly above its marker, holding short identity text only
Label clears immediately on pointer exit, with no delay, no pinned state and no dismiss control
canonical_document.name: mosaic_dot_world_intensity_map
canonical_document.experience_scope: A single map region that occupies the primary visual area of the view; it renders as a persistent, always-on visual with no entry sequence, and all of its state changes (labels appearing, intensity re-shading) stay inside the region's bounds.
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits any dataset where one magnitude varies by geographic region plus a small set of named locations that should be identified on demand — traffic, orders, users, deliveries, sensors, coverage. It becomes a different skill if the mosaic is replaced by a smooth choropleth, globe or terrain rendering, if the whole field becomes clickable with drill-down or selection, if multiple simultaneous or pinned callouts are shown, or if the map is pushed behind foreground content as a decorative substrate instead of being the primary read.
content_and_composition: One world landmass rendered as a low-resolution mosaic of many uniform tiny squares rather than smooth outlines

Per-region intensity encoded jointly by square density and colour step: high-volume regions carry the strongest chroma and tightest packing, low or zero regions fall to a near-colourless, low-contrast state that visually recedes
A small overlaid set of point markers (a handful to a few dozen) representing serving locations, styled so they read as discrete points clearly separable from the mosaic squares
At most one transient label at a time, pinned directly above the pointed marker, carrying two short identity lines (site name and city)
The map sits ahead of the figure content in reading order: headline totals adjacent or above, supporting detail beneath
attention_and_information_flow: Colour step and density carry the first read: relative global weight is grasped before any text is read
Lowest-intensity regions sit at the weakest chroma and contrast so they recede and busy clusters dominate the eye's entry point
Site markers form a second tier of attention — recognisable as distinct points while their identity is withheld
Naming detail is the third tier, revealed only on demand and only for one marker at a time
After inspection, attention falls back to the mosaic and the figures as the resting view

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Moving the pointer away clears the label immediately with no lingering or fade-lock; moving onto another marker replaces the label so exactly one is ever visible
interaction_model.visible_feedback: A compact label rises just above the marker naming the site and its city
interaction_model.input: Pointer enters one site marker
interaction_model.state_change: Marker becomes the active hovered target and gains an attached label
interaction_model.affected_object: That single marker

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Nothing to dismiss; markers remain the only reactive targets on the map
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The field stays completely inert — no highlight, ripple, cursor change or tooltip
interaction_model.input: Pointer crosses mosaic squares or empty map area
interaction_model.state_change: None
interaction_model.affected_object: The mosaic dot field

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: An open hover label survives the refresh; pointer state is never reset by an update
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Regions re-shade toward a denser, stronger-chroma step or settle back to the near-colourless low end
interaction_model.input: Underlying volume values refresh (autonomous)
interaction_model.state_change: Density and colour band per region re-evaluated
interaction_model.affected_object: Regional mosaic intensity

adaptable_details: Square size and grid resolution
Hue family of the intensity ramp and number of intensity bands
Map projection and cropping
Marker shape, size and accent hue
Label typography, padding and vertical offset
Refresh cadence, number of regions and number of markers
Presence or absence of a legend
canonical_document.description: A world drawn as a coarse grid of tiny squares where busier regions read as denser, stronger-chroma clusters and quiet land fades to a near-colourless low-contrast state, with a few distinct site points that raise a single small label pinned above them on hover.
experience_progression: No staged sequence: the mosaic is a persistent resting state rather than an animated build
Regional intensity re-shades as underlying values refresh, so the map reads as current rather than as a fixed snapshot
The only discrete, user-driven state change is label appearance, which is immediately reversible
completion_and_return: No completion state; the map is ambient and continuous
Label state returns to none whenever the pointer leaves a marker
The mosaic remains the visual the reader looks back at between inspections

name: bare_prompt_unfolds_into_growing_dual_view_console
description: A quiet monospaced screen on one uniform low-distraction surface holding nothing but a single text invitation until the first entry is committed, then unfolding into a working view where every entry appears twice at once — as a colour-identified breakdown card in a sideways-scrolling row and as a matching arrow in one shared spatial field — while the prompt stays ready and the view never concludes.

experience_qualities: Quiet and technical, closer to a console than a product page
Immediate: the next entry can follow with no cleanup or clicking
Accretive and open-ended, visibly denser the longer it is used
Openly unfinished, admitting its own simplification instead of claiming completeness
Tactile in the shared field, readable in the card row
locked_observable_requirements: Initial view contains only one quiet entry invitation on a single uniform low-distraction monospaced surface
The working layout appears only after the first successful commit, never on load
Every committed entry is shown simultaneously in two coordinated forms that share one distinct colour identity, the specific hue being unconstrained
One form is a readable breakdown of the entry into ordered smaller pieces with numeric identities and short numeric values; the other is direction from a single shared origin
The entry field is focused without user action, locks briefly during resolution, then empties and refocuses
A failed commit adds nothing and leaves the typed text editable with input still available
A persistent low-prominence note stating the visual is a simplified stand-in
Nothing concludes: accrual continues and the prompt stays ready indefinitely
canonical_document.name: bare_prompt_unfolds_into_growing_dual_view_console
canonical_document.experience_scope: Whole-view experience. Begins at load in a nearly empty state containing only the entry invitation, unfolds on the first successful commit, and continues indefinitely for the session with no end state, summary or exit.
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits short user-authored submissions that honestly decompose into a small ordered set of labelled numeric parts and also reduce to one comparable direction, in demos or tools where items are small enough that many can coexist on screen. Replacing endless accrual with a single result that is overwritten on each submit, presenting the layout fully on load instead of unfolding at first commit, or dropping either of the two coordinated representations produces a different skill.
content_and_composition: One single-line text entry field, focused from the moment the view loads, visually dominant in the bare state and persistently available after the unfold
One detail card per committed entry, showing that entry split into its smaller ordered pieces, each piece carrying a numeric identity and a short numeric value
Detail cards arranged in a single horizontal row that scrolls sideways only once the row overflows the viewport width
One shared spatial field containing a single common origin and one arrow per committed entry, where direction is the distinguishing attribute

One colour identity per entry, applied identically to that entry's card and its arrow so the two representations read as the same item; identities need only stay separable from one another and from the surrounding surface
A persistent low-prominence plain-text note admitting the visual is a simplified stand-in for something with far more dimensions
One uniform low-distraction surface treatment and monospaced type across every element, including cards, labels and note, with text held at readable contrast against that surface
attention_and_information_flow: In the bare state the single invitation carries all prominence, with nothing competing for the eye
After the unfold, attention alternates between the readable per-entry breakdown, which rewards reading, and the shared field, which rewards glancing
A newly committed entry is briefly the natural focus as its card and arrow appear
Hovering the field temporarily promotes one entry and recedes all the others, revealing that entry's text on demand
The caveat note is intentionally kept at the lowest prominence tier and never interrupts

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: If resolution fails nothing is added, the typed text stays present and editable and typing remains available; no blocking error state, no need to re-focus by hand
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Momentarily inert field, then an empty focused field ready for the next entry, a fresh card carrying that entry's colour identity at the end of the row and a matching arrow rising from the common origin
interaction_model.input: Typing into the already-focused entry field and confirming
interaction_model.state_change: Field locks for the moment resolution takes, then empties and refocuses; a new card and a new arrow are added; on the very first commit the whole working layout unfolds
interaction_model.affected_object: Entry field plus both representations of the committed entry

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Moving off the arrow restores equal prominence to all arrows and removes the label; only one arrow is isolated at a time
interaction_model.visible_feedback: One arrow raised to high salience among receded siblings and its text floating beside the cursor, tracking pointer movement
interaction_model.input: Pointer resting on one arrow in the shared field
interaction_model.state_change: The pointed arrow becomes emphasized while every other arrow recedes; that entry's text appears as a floating label
interaction_model.affected_object: All arrows plus a transient text label

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Releasing ends the gesture and the new orientation stays; the pointer leaving the viewing area ends the drag as if released and hover labelling returns
interaction_model.visible_feedback: All arrows swing together around the fixed origin while no floating label is shown
interaction_model.input: Pressing and dragging inside the shared field
interaction_model.state_change: The whole space turns around the common origin following the drag, and hover labelling is suppressed for the duration
interaction_model.affected_object: The entire arrow arrangement

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Scrolling engages only once the row overflows; every earlier card stays reachable and scroll position persists across new commits
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Cards slide laterally within their band while the rest of the view stays put
interaction_model.input: Sideways scroll or drag on the card row
interaction_model.state_change: The row shifts horizontally, bringing earlier or later cards into view
interaction_model.affected_object: The row of per-entry detail cards

adaptable_details: Which hues form the per-entry identity set and how they are assigned to entries
Card layout, how many pieces a card shows and the exact numeric fields displayed
Arrow styling, length treatment and whether the shared field reads as flat or spatial
Overflow handling of the card band beyond a sideways-scrolling row
Wording of the invitation and of the caveat note
Relative size and placement of the card band versus the shared field
canonical_document.description: A quiet monospaced screen on one uniform low-distraction surface holding nothing but a single text invitation until the first entry is committed, then unfolding into a working view where every entry appears twice at once — as a colour-identified breakdown card in a sideways-scrolling row and as a matching arrow in one shared spatial field — while the prompt stays ready and the view never concludes.
experience_progression: Bare state: a quiet invitation to type, with no cards, no field of arrows and no supporting chrome
First successful commit: the working view unfolds, revealing the card row, the shared arrow field and the caveat note together
Each later commit: one card and one matching arrow are appended to the existing set, nothing is replaced or cleared
Steady state: accrual continues without limit, the prompt remains ready and no stage ever closes the experience
completion_and_return: The experience never completes and offers no final or summary state
No clear, reset or start-over affordance; committed entries persist for the session
The prompt returns to a ready, focused, empty state after every commit
Field orientation and card-row scroll position persist across subsequent commits

name: shared_origin_direction_comparison_field
description: One bounded space where every collected item is an arrow in its own distinct identity colour springing from a single common origin, so items are compared by orientation at a glance; pointing at an arrow dims all the others and floats its label beside the cursor, while pressing and dragging turns the whole arrangement around the origin.

experience_qualities: Glanceable: differences read as spread before anything is inspected
Tangible and turnable under the pointer
Quiet at rest, with identity information appearing only when asked for
Focused isolation rather than simultaneous labelling
locked_observable_requirements: Every item radiates from exactly one shared origin and orientation is the distinguishing attribute
Each item carries a stable, mutually distinguishable colour identity that matches that same item's representation elsewhere when one exists; the particular hues are not fixed
Pointing at one item dims all the others rather than merely highlighting the target
The pointed item's label floats beside the cursor and tracks it rather than being pinned to the item
Dragging rotates the entire arrangement around the origin, never an individual item
The floating label is suppressed for the whole duration of a drag
The pointer leaving the viewing area terminates the drag gesture
The resting state shows no labels at all
canonical_document.name: shared_origin_direction_comparison_field
canonical_document.experience_scope: Region experience inside a larger view. Begins once at least one item exists, remains present as items accumulate, and has no end state or exit; all gestures are bounded by the region's viewing area.
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits small-to-moderate sets of comparable items whose difference can honestly be expressed as direction from one point and whose labels are short enough to float at the cursor. Giving items separate origins, placing them by absolute position rather than orientation, pinning labels permanently to every item, or making drag move individual items instead of the whole space creates a different skill.
content_and_composition: Exactly one shared origin from which every arrow departs

One arrow per collected item, each carrying that item's own distinct identity colour and matching the same item's representation elsewhere in the view when one exists; any set of mutually separable hues serves equally
Direction is the meaningful difference between arrows; arrows carry no permanent labels
A transient floating text label that exists only while an arrow is pointed at, positioned beside the cursor rather than attached to the arrow
A bounded viewing area whose edge terminates pointer gestures
Restrained, low-distraction surround of any tone, held far enough from the arrows in contrast that arrow identity and orientation dominate
attention_and_information_flow: At rest every arrow reads at equal prominence, so the overall spread is what is perceived first
Pointing creates a single focal arrow with all others receding, converting a glanceable overview into a single identified item
Item identity is revealed only on demand and only at the cursor, keeping the resting state label-free
During rotation no item is favoured and identity is withheld, directing attention to the arrangement as a whole

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Moving off restores every arrow to equal prominence and removes the label; only one arrow can be isolated at a time
interaction_model.visible_feedback: One arrow held at full prominence against clearly dimmed siblings, with its short text floating next to the cursor and following it
interaction_model.input: Pointer resting on a single arrow
interaction_model.state_change: Pointed arrow emphasized, all remaining arrows dimmed, that item's label brought in
interaction_model.affected_object: The full set of arrows plus a transient label

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Release ends the gesture and the reached orientation persists; the pointer leaving the viewing area ends the drag as if released and re-enables hover labelling
interaction_model.visible_feedback: All arrows swing together while the origin stays put and no floating label is visible
interaction_model.input: Press and drag anywhere in the viewing area
interaction_model.state_change: The whole space turns around the fixed common origin in response to drag, and hover labelling is suppressed for the duration
interaction_model.affected_object: The entire arrangement of arrows around the origin

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: No reset, re-centring or removal; the set only grows and persists
interaction_model.visible_feedback: A further distinct identity joins the spread without disturbing the existing arrows or the current viewpoint
interaction_model.input: A new item committed elsewhere in the view
interaction_model.state_change: One additional arrow appears from the same shared origin in the current orientation
interaction_model.affected_object: The arrow set

adaptable_details: Arrow rendering style, thickness and whether lengths vary
Number of items present and the specific palette used to distinguish them, provided the identities stay mutually separable
Whether the space reads as flat rotation or spatial depth
Rotation sensitivity and any easing of the turn
Label typography and offset from the cursor
Surround treatment, including whether it reads light or dark, and presence of a reference frame around the origin
canonical_document.description: One bounded space where every collected item is an arrow in its own distinct identity colour springing from a single common origin, so items are compared by orientation at a glance; pointing at an arrow dims all the others and floats its label beside the cursor, while pressing and dragging turns the whole arrangement around the origin.
experience_progression: Arrows accrue one at a time as items are committed elsewhere, joining the arrangement in its current orientation
Existing arrows keep their directions when new ones arrive; nothing is re-laid-out or re-centred
Viewpoint changes only through user drag and stays wherever the last gesture left it
completion_and_return: No completion; the field persists and accumulates for the session
Orientation persists after each gesture instead of springing back to a default view
Hover isolation reverses fully on pointer exit, returning all arrows to equal prominence

name: unit_mark_span_progress_with_forward_preview
description: A quiet field of one small mark per unit covering an entire in-progress span, marks behind the present position held at full emphasis and marks ahead of it set back at lower contrast against the same surround, where pointing or focusing any mark raises a compact label above it and probing a mark ahead of the present stretches the high-emphasis region forward while the remaining count recomputes, then snaps back to the truth.

experience_qualities: Calm, quiet and minimal; the whole span comprehensible at a glance with no explanation or legend
Self-evident boundary: the single step in emphasis alone communicates where the present sits, in any host surround
Dense but orderly texture, where individual units are still addressable
Lightweight and non-committal probing that feels like a passing thought rather than a choice
Immediate coupling between the pointed unit, the lengthened stretch and the recounted figure
Trustworthy: the true standing is always what remains after the hand or focus moves away
locked_observable_requirements: One mark per unit for the entire span, all visible together without scrolling inside the region

A two-tier emphasis split with consumed units at the high-emphasis tier and upcoming units held at a clearly lower-contrast tier against the same surround, producing a single visible boundary at the true current position; the two tiers must separate by contrast step alone and must read on either a light or a dark surround
A numeric remaining-units figure shown together with the field
A compact label that appears directly above the probed mark and names that unit with a secondary attribute, one at a time
Probing a mark ahead of the present position immediately extends the high-emphasis stretch to that mark and recounts the remaining figure to match
Probing a mark at or behind the present position shows the label only and leaves both boundary and figure untouched
Leaving the field, dismissing the label or losing focus restores the true boundary and true figure exactly
Keyboard focus produces the same label and the same forward projection as pointing
Quiet, low-distraction presentation with no competing motion or ornament around the split field
canonical_document.name: unit_mark_span_progress_with_forward_preview
canonical_document.experience_scope: A single self-contained region that can also fill a minimal whole view; it renders one complete span and its remaining figure. The experience begins on arrival with the true present state shown, extends through repeated probe-and-release cycles, and ends whenever the pointer or focus leaves the marks and the true state is restored. No navigation away from the region is involved.
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits any bounded, in-progress span made of many discrete, uniformly ordered units with a truthful current position and a meaningful remaining total: calendar spans, project or term timelines, subscription windows, reading or course progress, budget periods. It needs enough units for the field to read as a texture yet few enough that all fit in one view at a comfortable mark size. It becomes a different Skill if the forward probe commits and persists (turning the field into a selector or range picker), if the span must be scrolled or paginated so it cannot be read at once, if probing opens rich per-unit content panels instead of a compact identity label, if probing behind the present position also rewrites the boundary and figure, or if the discrete mark field is replaced by a single continuous bar that loses per-unit texture and unit-level probing.
content_and_composition: One continuous field of small uniform marks, exactly one mark per unit of the span, laid out in reading order from span start to span end and fully visible at once without scrolling within the region

Two emphasis tiers across that field: marks up to the present position read forward at full strength, marks after it sit back at reduced contrast against the same surround; their meeting point forms one visible boundary at the true current position
One persistent numeric figure reporting how many units remain, sized to be read as the headline value of the region
One transient label, at most one at a time, anchored just above the currently probed mark, naming that unit compactly with its secondary attribute (for example short date plus weekday)
Minimal, low-distraction surround only; nothing decorative competes with the split field, the boundary or the figure, and the field holds its reading whether the surround is light or dark
Exactly one probed mark at a time; the unprobed remainder of the field stays legible while a label is up
attention_and_information_flow: Initially the field's emphasis split carries all attention, with the boundary at the present position as the strongest edge and the remaining figure as the single number to read
During a probe attention narrows to one mark through its label while the span stays readable; the label sits above the mark so it does not cover the boundary or the neighbouring marks it explains
A forward probe shifts information to two coordinated changes at once: the lengthened high-emphasis stretch and the recounted figure, which read as provisional because they follow the pointer
Probing at or behind the present position adds only identity information and deliberately withholds any change to the figure, so the true standing is never in doubt
On release prominence returns to the true boundary and true figure with no visual residue of the hypothetical state

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: This baseline is the state every interaction returns to; it changes only as real time advances the present position
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Consumed marks at the high-emphasis tier, upcoming marks at the lower-contrast tier, one visible boundary at the present position, and the real remaining count displayed
interaction_model.input: Arrival in the region, driven by the real current position within the span
interaction_model.state_change: Truthful baseline state established
interaction_model.affected_object: The whole mark field and the remaining figure

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Moving to another mark moves the label to it; moving off the field, or dismissing the label, removes it immediately with no lingering highlight
interaction_model.visible_feedback: A small label rises just above that mark naming the unit compactly with its secondary attribute
interaction_model.input: Pointer hover or tap on any mark
interaction_model.state_change: Idle mark becomes the single probed mark
interaction_model.affected_object: The probed mark and its label

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Fully reversible at any moment: pointer exit, dismissal or focus loss retracts the stretch and restores the true figure; no confirmation and no committed selection
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The high-emphasis stretch reaches forward to the probed mark without delay while the remaining figure recounts down to the hypothetical total, alongside the mark's label
interaction_model.input: Pointer hover, tap or keyboard focus on a mark ahead of the present position
interaction_model.state_change: Truthful state becomes a hypothetical projected state
interaction_model.affected_object: The high-emphasis stretch and the remaining figure

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Nothing to reverse; the boundary never moves backwards, so past units cannot rewrite the standing
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Only the label appears; the boundary holds at the present position and the figure holds at the true remaining total
interaction_model.input: Pointer hover, tap or keyboard focus on a mark at or behind the present position
interaction_model.state_change: No state change beyond labeling
interaction_model.affected_object: The high-emphasis stretch and the remaining figure

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Always available as the escape from any probe; restoration is exact and immediate
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The label disappears, the high-emphasis stretch retracts to the present position and the figure shows the real remaining total again
interaction_model.input: Dismissing the label, or moving pointer and focus away from the field
interaction_model.state_change: Any probed or hypothetical state returns to the truthful baseline
interaction_model.affected_object: Label, high-emphasis stretch and remaining figure together

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Focus parity throughout: moving focus retargets the probe, leaving focus restores the truthful baseline
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The same label above the focused mark and the same forward stretch and recount when applicable
interaction_model.input: Keyboard focus moving across marks
interaction_model.state_change: Focus-driven probing equivalent to pointing
interaction_model.affected_object: The probed mark, its label, and the high-emphasis stretch and figure when the focused mark is ahead

adaptable_details: Mark shape and spacing: dots, ticks, bars, small squares or cells
Arrangement of the ordered field: one continuous run, wrapped rows or a grid, as long as order and a single boundary remain readable
Hue family and surround polarity, plus the exact size of the contrast step between the high-emphasis and lower-contrast tiers, provided the step still reads as one self-evident boundary
Label typography, offset distance above the mark, and whether the secondary attribute is spelled out or abbreviated
Wording and framing around the numeric figure, and whether a title accompanies the region
Unit granularity and span length, and whether faint group separators mark internal segments of the span
Whether the forward stretch snaps or eases over a very short duration, provided it reads as immediate
canonical_document.description: A quiet field of one small mark per unit covering an entire in-progress span, marks behind the present position held at full emphasis and marks ahead of it set back at lower contrast against the same surround, where pointing or focusing any mark raises a compact label above it and probing a mark ahead of the present stretches the high-emphasis region forward while the remaining count recomputes, then snaps back to the truth.
experience_progression: Arrival: the whole span is legible at a glance, the emphasis split and the boundary at the present position explain themselves, and the remaining figure states the current standing
Probe: a mark is pointed at, tapped or focused and its label rises just above it, identifying that unit without disturbing the overall reading

Forward what-if: when the probed mark lies ahead of the present position, the high-emphasis stretch immediately reaches forward to it and the remaining figure recounts to the hypothetical smaller total

Release: leaving the marks, dismissing the label or losing focus retracts the high-emphasis stretch to the present position and returns the figure to the true remaining total, leaving attention on today's real standing
The probe cycle repeats indefinitely from the truthful baseline; probes never accumulate
completion_and_return: No terminal completion; the region is a steady display with a repeatable probe loop
Every probe ends by returning to the truthful present-position state; hypothetical states are never persisted or remembered
The only persistent state is the real current position and the real remaining figure, which advance only with real time
At most one label and one hypothetical projection exist at a time, so returns are always complete

name: climb_then_descent_progress_curve_with_draggable_dots
description: A continuous rise-then-fall curve on which each item and each of its sub-pieces sits as a labelled dot; horizontal position tells whether the work is still uphill in uncertainty or downhill in confident execution, and any dot can be grabbed and slid along the curve to set its value with live percentage and numeric readout.

experience_qualities: Tactile and direct — values feel hauled uphill and let run downhill rather than typed
Continuous rather than stepped, with numbers moving in lockstep with the dot
Legible at a glance, since a shape read replaces reading many separate figures
Honest limits: ends of the curve feel like firm walls rather than glitches
Forgiving: any way of ending a drag keeps the result, nothing is lost by slipping off the chart
Calm and closed for settled work, active and inviting for live work
Consistent across scales, so the same gesture is trusted in both the summary and the detail view
locked_observable_requirements: A single continuous climb-then-descent curve serves as the positional track — not a straight bar, ring or linear meter
Horizontal position along that curve is the encoding of standing, with the uphill leg reading as unresolved and the downhill leg as confident execution
Every movable unit is a labelled dot sitting on the curve, including a dot for the whole item shown alongside its sub-piece dots
Pointing at a dot visibly highlights it and shows it is grabbable before any press occurs
Pressing and dragging slides the dot continuously along the curve while a percentage and numeric readout update in real time
Pushing past either end pins the dot at that extreme instead of detaching, wrapping or continuing
Releasing, or leaving the region mid-drag, ends the drag and keeps the last position
A short confirmation of the just-set value appears after a drag ends
Dots of settled items refuse to move and state the reason
The identical grab-and-slide behaviour is available at both the multi-item overview scale and the single-item focused scale
canonical_document.name: climb_then_descent_progress_curve_with_draggable_dots
canonical_document.experience_scope: A region experience: a chart area that carries the curve and its dots. The same region appears at two scales — an overview showing all active items and a focused single-item view showing that item plus its sub-pieces — and behaves identically in both. It begins when the curve region is visible and ends when a drag is released or the region is left; surrounding page content (item text, groupings, lists) is outside the skill but frames it.
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits any context where a set of related items each carry one adjustable 'how far along / how sure are we' value that gains meaning from a two-phase arc of exploration then execution, where owners should set that value in place, and where some items can reach a final locked standing — for example parallel efforts in a time-boxed cycle, campaign or production phases, learning or maturity tracks, or self-reported confidence across a portfolio. It requires items with a single scalar per mark, optional named sub-parts, and a settled/locked concept. Flattening the track to a straight bar, making the dots read-only markers, adding a second meaningful axis so dots are positioned in two dimensions, or removing the live readout and boundary pinning would create a different skill.
content_and_composition: One continuous climb-then-descent curve acting as the shared positional track for all marks in the region
Labelled dots placed on the curve: at overview scale one dot per active item; in focused view one dot for the item as a whole plus one dot per named sub-piece (0..n)
Each dot carries a short text label; in focused view sub-piece dots also carry the name of the owning team
A live value readout tied to the dot being manipulated, showing both a percentage and a numeric figure
A transient confirmation of the value just set, appearing after a drag ends
A transient explanatory message attached to a locked dot when movement is attempted
At overview scale, a surrounding read that separates work still awaiting commitment from work actively in flight, so the curve region carries only the in-flight set
Settled items (finished or abandoned) rendered in a visually quiet, non-active state, their dots frozen in place
In focused view, the curve sits alongside the item's problem statement, theory, success measure and sub-piece list, which are persistent while the curve is manipulated
attention_and_information_flow: At rest, no single dot dominates; the distribution of dots along the curve is the primary message
Pointing at a dot lifts it above its neighbours and reveals that it can be grabbed, surfacing its label
During a drag, attention narrows to the single moving dot and its continuously changing percentage and numeric readout; the rest of the curve stays as quiet reference
On release, prominence shifts briefly to the confirmation of the value just set, then returns to the collective view
Opening an item moves prominence from the crowd of items to one item's written framing and its named sub-pieces with owning teams, with the curve reduced to that item's own dots
Settled items recede visually so active work holds attention

interaction_model.visible_feedback: The dot gains emphasis, stands out from neighbouring dots, and visibly signals that it can be picked up

interaction_model.affected_object: The dot and its value readout

interaction_model.input: Continuing to drag beyond either end of the curve
interaction_model.state_change: Free movement → pinned at the extreme
interaction_model.affected_object: The dragged dot

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Both endings are equivalent and non-destructive; the dot can be grabbed again to change the value further
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The dot stays where it was last placed and a short confirmation of the value just set appears, then clears
interaction_model.input: Releasing the press, or leaving the chart region while still dragging
interaction_model.state_change: Actively dragged → settled at the last position with the value committed
interaction_model.affected_object: The dragged dot and the confirmation element

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: The attempt ends with no value change and no residual dragging state; the dot only becomes movable again if the work is no longer settled
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The dot refuses to follow the pointer and a short message states why it cannot be moved
interaction_model.input: Attempting to press and drag a dot belonging to finished or abandoned work
interaction_model.state_change: No movement; the dot remains locked at its position
interaction_model.affected_object: That settled dot

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Grab-and-slide works identically at both scales; values set at either scale are the ones shown when the other scale is next seen
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The same curve and dot treatment reappears at the new scale with labels for the item and its sub-pieces, and on return the overview shows the positions as they were last set
interaction_model.input: Opening an item from the overview, then returning
interaction_model.state_change: Many-item curve → single item plus its named sub-pieces on the same curve → back to the many-item curve
interaction_model.affected_object: The curve region's scope and the dots it carries

adaptable_details: Curve steepness, symmetry and overall proportions
Dot size, shape, colour and highlight styling
Label placement and whether an owning-team name accompanies each dot
Readout units and formatting alongside the percentage
Styling and duration of the confirmation and refusal messages
Number of dots shown and their ordering or grouping
Layout of the surrounding written content in the focused view
How the quiet state of settled items is styled
Timing and easing of highlight transitions
canonical_document.description: A continuous rise-then-fall curve on which each item and each of its sub-pieces sits as a labelled dot; horizontal position tells whether the work is still uphill in uncertainty or downhill in confident execution, and any dot can be grabbed and slid along the curve to set its value with live percentage and numeric readout.
experience_progression: The curve itself is the progression axis: the uphill leg reads as unresolved and exploratory, the crest as the turn, the downhill leg as confident execution — so a dot's position is read as a stage, not just a quantity
Collective read first: the spread of dots before and after the crest gives the immediate sense of how much work is still being figured out versus running
Per-dot interaction arc: resting → highlighted and grabbable on pointing → engaged on press → continuously sliding with live numbers → committed on release with a brief confirmation
Scale change: opening an item re-scopes the same curve from many items to one item and its sub-pieces; returning to the overview shows the updated dot positions
Settling is terminal: once work is finished or abandoned its dot stops participating in movement and reads as at rest
completion_and_return: A drag completes on release or on the pointer leaving the region, in both cases keeping the last position
A brief confirmation of the value just set follows completion and then clears, leaving the quiet resting state
Dot positions persist across moving between overview and focused item view and back
There is no reset or undo gesture inside the region; correcting a value means grabbing the dot again
Settled items end the cycle for their dots, which stay fixed and quiet

name: editable_round_span_dial_with_paired_breakdown
description: A closed dial marked with evenly spaced unit ticks, where labelled arcs in mutually distinct colors show the occupied stretches of one full cycle; arcs are started by clicking bare ring, reshaped by dragging round grips at their edges, and mirrored by an adjacent list of exact figures plus a running count of what is still unassigned.

experience_qualities: the whole bounded quantity is legible in one look
editing feels direct and physical rather than form-driven
motion is live under the pointer yet quietly disciplined by fixed increments
forgiving: refusals move nothing and every accepted change can be stepped back
trustworthy: the picture and the figures always agree
low ceremony, with a tidy shareable result at the end
locked_observable_requirements: the primary visual is a closed round dial standing for one complete bounded cycle, with evenly spaced marks for its units
occupied stretches appear as filled arcs on that ring, each with its own label and its own distinguishing color that separates it from the neighbouring spans, never overlapping
each span exposes a round grip at each of its two edges
dragging a grip moves only that edge, live under the pointer, settling on fixed sub-unit increments
an edge can never cross its own opposite edge and can never leave the bounded cycle
clicking a bare stretch of ring starts a new span at the clicked position
clicking a span opens an editor scoped to that span alone, covering label, its distinguishing color, both boundaries and discard
an adjacent plain list gives exact boundary figures for every span and matches the dial after every accepted change
a persistent readout shows how much of the whole is still unassigned
refused changes produce a brief message and leave the arrangement visibly untouched
a step-back action restores the previous arrangement
the finished arrangement can be handed off as a look-only version of the same dial-and-list composition, with one step to an editable copy
canonical_document.name: editable_round_span_dial_with_paired_breakdown
canonical_document.experience_scope: A whole-view working experience for a small single-purpose tool, occupying one two-part main area: the round dial and its adjacent breakdown list. It begins when the dial appears carrying whatever arrangement was last kept, continues as an open-ended editing session, and resolves either into a tidy snapshot picture of the dial or into the same composition opened by another person as a look-only version, from which one step yields an editable dial of their own.
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits any bounded whole that is split into a modest number of contiguous labelled parts owned by one person and read as a full cycle or fixed total — day and shift planning, coverage windows, slices of a fixed budget or capacity — and holds while the span count stays low enough for arcs to remain individually labelled, individually distinguishable by color and graspable. It becomes a different Skill if spans may overlap or stack in concentric layers, if the whole stops being a closed cycle and the ring is replaced by a linear track, if many parallel rows or resources are shown together, if editing moves off the graphic into forms only, or if the number of parts grows so large that direct arc dragging gives way to list-driven editing.
content_and_composition: one closed round dial as the dominant visual object, marked with evenly spaced ticks for every unit of the complete cycle

zero to many spans drawn as filled arcs on the ring, each covering one contiguous stretch between two boundary positions, each carrying its own short label and its own distinguishing color set far enough apart from its neighbours' to be told apart at a glance, never overlapping one another
two round drag grips per span, one at each edge of its arc, visible on the ring as the graspable part of the span
bare stretches of the ring left visibly empty and clearly separated from the filled arcs, readable as remaining capacity of the whole

an adjacent plain list with one row per span, giving that span's exact start and end figures and repeating its label and the same distinguishing color it carries on the ring, so the two representations are recognisably the same data
a persistent readout of how much of the bounded whole is still unaccounted for
a small on-demand editor scoped to a single span, holding its label, its distinguishing color and its two boundary values, plus a discard action for that span
a brief transient message shown when an attempted change is refused
a persistent step-back action available across the session
attention_and_information_flow: the dial holds primary attention as the single glanceable answer; the arcs' mutually distinct colors and on-arc labels carry the coarse reading, with labels kept readable against the arcs they sit on
the adjacent list is the secondary, precise reading, consulted for exact boundaries, and never disagrees with the dial
the unassigned readout supplies ongoing sense of completeness and draws attention to the bare stretches still available
during a drag the moving edge becomes momentarily dominant: the arc grows or shrinks live under the pointer while its list row's figures change in step
opening the single-span editor narrows attention to one span's label, distinguishing color and boundaries without hiding the dial behind it
a refused change surfaces a brief message while the dial and list stay visibly still, so attention returns to the intact arrangement
in look-only form the grips and editor are absent, so attention rests entirely on the composed arcs, labels and figures
