interaction_model.input: Hovering an item inside a nook
interaction_model.affected_object: That item and the pointer-adjacent label

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Dismissible three ways — its own close control, the surrounding area, or the escape key — each returning to the nook in the state it was left
interaction_model.state_change: Card opens over the nook view with one short note
interaction_model.visible_feedback: A compact card appears holding readable plain-language text, with the nook still legible around it
interaction_model.input: Selecting an item inside a nook
interaction_model.affected_object: The small text card

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Any nook can be re-entered immediately; the overview is always reachable in one obvious step
interaction_model.state_change: Closer view resolves back to the opening whole view
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The whole environment comes back into frame and the pointer lean widens again to its overview range
interaction_model.input: Returning from a nook
interaction_model.affected_object: The framing and lean behavior

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Movement is clamped to fixed near and far limits so the composition cannot be lost; the same limited behavior remains available inside closer views
interaction_model.state_change: Framing eases nearer or further
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The scene grows or recedes smoothly without snapping
interaction_model.input: Scroll or pinch
interaction_model.affected_object: The framing distance

experience_qualities: Cozy, hand-illustrated and storybook-like rather than technical or photographic
Never quite still — a continuous gentle life in the scene even with no input
Soft inertia: leaning, travelling and settling rather than cutting or snapping
Unhurried reading, with short low-pressure text and no timers or urgency
Legible and forgiving: content places advertise themselves and every depth has an obvious exit
Calm and reassuring in tone, low visual density outside the illustration itself
completion_and_return: No completion, score or end state; browsing is open-ended and nooks may be visited in any order and revisited
Card dismissal always returns to the nook it was opened from, unchanged
Returning from a nook always restores the same opening whole view and its wider lean
The chosen framing distance persists within its fixed limits and carries across into closer views
The opening quiet moment belongs to arrival and is not replayed on each return
locked_observable_requirements: A short quiet opening moment stating what the space is precedes the reveal of the whole scene
The entire environment is presented in one view, not paged or scrolled through
Continuous subtle motion persists in the scene while idle
Pointer position produces a proportional lean with depth separation that settles back when the pointer stills
Only a few places hold content and each announces its own name on pointer rest, so none must be hunted for
Selecting a place travels the framing smoothly into that nook; exactly one nook is in frame at a time
A visible route back to the whole view exists at every depth, and returning restores the wider lean
Item names appear beside the pointer and track it, separate from the text card
A note appears as a small card dismissible by its own close, the surrounding area, and the escape key
Input during a framing move in flight is ignored rather than accumulated
Zoom is bounded by fixed near and far limits and remains available in closer views
adaptable_details: Subject and setting of the illustrated environment and its art style, palette and rendering technique
Number, placement and naming of the content-bearing places and the items inside them
Topic and wording of the short notes
Whether the opening moment is text laid over the artwork or a distinct panel that gives way to it
Exact magnitudes and easing of lean, travel and zoom, and transition durations
Typography, shape and placement of the name labels and text card
Visual form of the return affordance
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits a small, flat set of short plain-language notes that gain warmth from being placed inside one illustrated environment, where the picture is the main content and reading is brief and optional. It survives changes of subject, art style, place count and note topic. It becomes a different skill if the content volume grows enough to need scrolling, search or long-form reading inside the scene, if the places become dense enough that finding them is the challenge, if the environment turns into a freely navigable walkthrough instead of a whole view with fixed nooks, or if the scene is demoted to a substrate behind conventional page content rather than being the interface itself.

name: endless_plain_third_person_wander
description: A few quiet lines on a low-distraction card give way, on one press, to a walkable figure seen from behind on a grass plain with no edge: grass bends underfoot, stars drift slowly above, and moving through the field provokes ground strikes that ripple outward and leave blooms in your wake.

canonical_document.name: endless_plain_third_person_wander
canonical_document.description: A few quiet lines on a low-distraction card give way, on one press, to a walkable figure seen from behind on a grass plain with no edge: grass bends underfoot, stars drift slowly above, and moving through the field provokes ground strikes that ripple outward and leave blooms in your wake.
canonical_document.experience_scope: Whole-view experience occupying the full viewport. It begins with a full-view low-distraction title overlay, transitions on a single press into controlled traversal, and has no terminal state — the wander continues for as long as the visitor stays.
content_and_composition: One controllable figure, always the compositional anchor, viewed from behind at a fixed trailing offset
A single continuous ground plane densely covered in grass, with no visible boundary, wall or edge in any direction
A distant horizon line that holds the same apparent distance no matter how far the figure travels
A broad sky above held at a luminance clearly separated from a sparse, slowly drifting star field, which is the only overhead motion
An entry overlay: a near-empty, low-distraction field carrying a few short lines of high-contrast text and a single implied prompt to continue
Transient ground events near the figure's path: a strike point, an outward-expanding ring, and a persisting bloom left at the site
No persistent interface furniture, readouts or markers once the overlay clears; the scene is the only foreground
experience_progression: Stage 1 — a sparse, low-distraction title card holds attention on a few lines of high-contrast framing text with nothing else competing
Stage 2 — one press clears the card and control passes to the visitor, attention settling in behind the figure
Stage 3 — open-ended wandering: direction and pace are the visitor's, the plain never runs out, the horizon never nears, and nothing announces an arrival or an ending
Across stage 3 the traversed ground gradually accumulates blooms as a visible trace of where the figure has been
attention_and_information_flow: Text first: the entry card is the only information given, delivered on an otherwise empty, low-distraction field that keeps the text plainly legible
On clearing, information gives way entirely to place — no labels, no progress indicators, nothing to read
Attention rests on the figure and the ground immediately around it, where grass reacts underfoot
Ground strikes and expanding ripples pull the eye briefly outward from the figure, then release it back
Sky drift supplies slow peripheral motion that never competes with the figure for prominence
Because the horizon never resolves into a destination, prominence never shifts to a goal or endpoint

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: One-way gate; the card is not returned to and no second press is required or possible
interaction_model.state_change: Overlay clears; view and control transfer to the trailing viewpoint behind the figure
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Text field falls away and the plain, figure and sky become the whole view with the figure framed from behind
interaction_model.input: Single press anywhere on the entry title card
interaction_model.affected_object: Entry overlay and control ownership

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Releasing keys halts the figure at once and returns it to a resting stance; movement can resume instantly in any direction; no boundary is ever reached
interaction_model.state_change: Figure advances, reverses or changes heading; viewpoint follows and re-settles behind the new heading
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Figure moves across the plain with grass parting and flattening underfoot; the view eases back into place behind it rather than snapping
interaction_model.input: Directional movement keys (forward, back, turn)
interaction_model.affected_object: Controllable figure and the trailing viewpoint

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Releasing the modifier drops back to walking without interruption; releasing movement stops travel immediately
interaction_model.state_change: Sustained travel shifts from a walk to a run for as long as the modifier is held
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Faster ground passage, more urgent gait and quicker grass disturbance underfoot
interaction_model.input: Held run modifier alongside movement keys
interaction_model.affected_object: Controllable figure's travel pace

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Freely reversible at any moment; once the figure moves again the viewpoint re-settles behind its heading
interaction_model.state_change: View swings around the figure independently of its heading
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Surroundings, horizon and sky sweep past while the figure stays framed ahead of the viewpoint
interaction_model.input: Mouse movement
interaction_model.affected_object: Viewing direction around the figure

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Not triggered or aimed by the visitor and not dismissable; stopping travel simply stops provoking new strikes while existing blooms remain
interaction_model.state_change: Strikes land on nearby ground, ripple outward, and settle into blooms that remain
interaction_model.visible_feedback: A brief impact near the path, an outward-expanding ring across the grass, then blooms left behind in the traversed area
interaction_model.input: Travel itself (autonomous, provoked by the figure's passage)
interaction_model.affected_object: Ground near the figure's path

experience_qualities: Calm and unhurried, with no timer, target or pressure
Vast and open — a sense that the world extends past any reachable point
Quietly solitary, a single figure against an unbroken plain and drifting sky
Responsive at close range: the ground acknowledges every step
Forgiving — nothing can be lost, failed or done wrong
Meditative rather than goal-driven; wandering is its own reward
completion_and_return: No completion state, arrival, score or ending is ever declared
The plain has no edge and the horizon never draws nearer, so travel can continue indefinitely
Releasing input halts the figure immediately and it rests in place until moved again
Blooms left along traversed ground persist as an accumulated trace of the visitor's path
No failure, restart or recovery flow exists
locked_observable_requirements: A sparse, text-only entry card whose few lines read at clearly readable contrast against an otherwise empty surround, and which clears on a single press and hands control over behind the figure
Figure viewed from behind at a trailing offset viewpoint that eases back into place behind the current heading rather than snapping
View direction steerable independently of the figure's heading
A walk-and-run distinction driven by a held modifier
Immediate stop the moment movement input is released
A grass plain with no reachable edge and a horizon that never gets closer
Grass visibly parting and flattening under the figure
Travel provoking ground strikes near the path that ripple outward and leave persisting blooms
Slow drifting star motion overhead, separated in luminance from the surrounding sky enough to read distinctly, as the only sky animation
Complete absence of failure states, objectives and declared completion
adaptable_details: Identity, silhouette and costume of the figure
Hue families, overall light level and time-of-day mood, in any combination that keeps the stated contrast and luminance-separation relationships
Ground cover type and density, and the look of the flattening reaction
Star density, drift speed and sky texture
Exact key bindings, walk and run speeds, and viewpoint distance
Frequency, spacing and visual form of the strikes, ripples and blooms
Wording and number of lines on the entry card
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits open-ended atmospheric traversal where wandering a place is the content and text is minimal — mood pieces, entered-from-a-title-card landing experiences, ambient interactive showcases. Introducing a destination, bounded level, objectives, scoring, failure, or a fixed-path or authored camera would create a different Skill, as would removing visitor control and reducing the scene to a non-interactive ambient loop or a decorative substrate behind page content.

name: endless_paper_cutout_travelling_tour
description: A continuous scrollable ride through themed paper cut-out dioramas, with content on small in-scene signs, a re-costumed mascot travelling alongside, props animating as they are passed, and both ends flowing seamlessly back into the route.

canonical_document.name: endless_paper_cutout_travelling_tour
canonical_document.description: A continuous scrollable ride through themed paper cut-out dioramas, with content on small in-scene signs, a re-costumed mascot travelling alongside, props animating as they are passed, and both ends flowing seamlessly back into the route.
canonical_document.experience_scope: Whole-view experience filling the viewport from arrival onward; it begins at the opening setting after a brief calm hold and has no end screen, because the far end of the route flows straight back into the opening.
content_and_composition: One travelling route through several distinct themed settings (roughly four to six) in a fixed order, e.g. water's edge, open water, arid land, eerie ground, a lit stage
Each setting built from multiple stacked cut-out layers with visible paper edges: near foreground props, mid-ground scenery, far backdrop, moving at different rates to read as depth
Short-form content carried by small paper signs or cards planted among the scenery, a few per setting, covering self-introduction, background, work history, and individual project notes
One persistent mascot character travelling with the viewer, restyled or re-costumed to suit the setting it is currently in
Travelling props embedded in the scenery that belong to their setting (a ridden vehicle, a walking animal, a closed gateway) and sit close enough to the route to be passed
Route continuity: the final setting's outgoing edge is composed to join the opening setting's incoming edge without a seam or terminal panel
experience_progression: Brief calm hold on arrival, then the opening setting is revealed already in place
Continuous forward travel through each themed setting in order, with settings blending into one another rather than switching as separate pages
Mascot restyling and prop behaviour change as each new setting is entered
Passing the last setting continues at a noticeably brisker clip straight into the opening setting again, starting a further pass
Backward travel replays the same route in reverse with the same continuity at the opening edge
attention_and_information_flow: Motion of near layers draws the eye first; the mascot acts as a constant anchor so the viewer always knows where the route is
Content is revealed only in small doses as each sign enters the frame, so no screen is dense with text
Pointing at a sign raises it above the scenery and makes it briefly the single most prominent element, then returns it to being part of the scene
Props gaining motion as they are approached and passed shifts attention toward the setting's theme before its signs are read
The brisker pass-through at the loop point signals continuation rather than a new destination, so attention stays on the route

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Input can stop at any point mid-setting; nothing is locked to section boundaries, and travel can resume in either direction
interaction_model.state_change: Route position advances forward or backward proportional to input
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The world glides through the viewport with layers separating by depth; motion eases toward rest instead of stopping abruptly or snapping to fixed stops
interaction_model.input: Vertical scroll or press-and-drag on the view
interaction_model.affected_object: Position along the travelling route and all scene layers

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Reversal is always available and never queued or ignored; the route position is never lost
interaction_model.state_change: Travel direction flips immediately rather than after the current motion finishes
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The world is pulled back the other way at once, with the mascot and props reversing their travel behaviour
interaction_model.input: Reversing scroll or drag direction while the view is still moving
interaction_model.affected_object: Direction of travel

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Neither end blocks; the viewer can keep going indefinitely in either direction with nothing skipped
interaction_model.state_change: Position wraps into the next pass instead of clamping
interaction_model.visible_feedback: No resistance, bounce, or end panel; the far edge flows straight into the opening setting, briefly at a faster clip
interaction_model.input: Continuing to travel past either end of the route
interaction_model.affected_object: Route boundary

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: The shift is small and bounded, and the view settles back toward neutral when the pointer stops or leaves
interaction_model.state_change: Viewpoint shifts and tilts slightly toward the pointer
interaction_model.visible_feedback: A gentle look-around: near layers offset more than far ones, giving the sense of peering into the diorama
interaction_model.input: Pointer drifting across the view without pressing
interaction_model.affected_object: Whole scene framing and layer offsets

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Leaving the sign lets it settle back into its original place in the scenery; travelling away while it is raised does not leave it stuck out
interaction_model.state_change: Sign lifts from its place in the scenery toward the viewer
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The sign floats forward and reads larger and clearer than the surrounding layers, separated from the scene behind it
interaction_model.input: Pointing at a paper content sign
interaction_model.affected_object: That individual sign

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Prop motion tracks travel, so stopping stops them and reversing runs them backward; they are never left mid-pose out of sync with the route
interaction_model.state_change: Each prop performs its own characteristic motion tied to travel amount and direction
interaction_model.visible_feedback: A ridden vehicle rolls with turning parts, an animal takes steps, a sealed gateway swings open as it is reached
interaction_model.input: Travel past a themed prop (driven by the same scroll or drag)
interaction_model.affected_object: Props embedded in the current setting

experience_qualities: Unhurried and calm rather than snappy or demanding
Storybook and handmade, with tactile cut-paper flatness given depth by stacking
Charming and lightly playful, carried by the costumed travelling companion
Continuous and reassuring: no dead ends, no punishment for scrolling too far
Exploratory in small ways, rewarding drifting and pointing without hiding content behind them
completion_and_return: No completion state or final screen; the route loops in both directions
Crossing the end joins the opening seamlessly and continues at a brisker pace for that transition
Raised signs and tilted framing always return to rest on their own
Nothing is consumed or exhausted by a pass, so a further pass shows the same world in the same order
locked_observable_requirements: Travel is driven by vertical scroll or drag and eases into place; it never snaps to fixed section stops
Direction reversal mid-motion takes effect immediately
Both ends of the route flow onward into the next pass with no block, bounce, or terminal panel, using a briskier transition at the join
Settings are built from stacked cut-out layers that offset at different rates to produce visible depth
Written content lives on small signs planted inside the scenery, not in overlaid text sections
A single mascot travels with the viewer throughout and is restyled per setting
Props respond to the same travel input with their own characteristic motion, matching travel amount and direction
Pointer drift shifts and tilts the framing slightly and returns to neutral
Pointing at a sign floats it toward the viewer and releasing it lets it settle back into place
adaptable_details: Number, order, and theme of the settings
Choice of mascot character and its per-setting costumes
Which props appear and what motion each performs
Illustration medium and colour scheme, in any hue family and any overall lightness, provided adjacent stacked layers stay separable enough for cut-out depth and sign text to read
Exact easing feel, travel speed, and how much faster the loop join runs
Wording, count, and shape of the content signs
Visual treatment of the brief arrival hold
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits sites with a small, ordered set of short content pieces that can each sit on a single in-scene sign, presented as one continuous illustrated route. It stops being this Skill if the route gains a real destination or ending, if content grows into long-form text that must be read outside the scene, if travel snaps between discrete full-screen sections, or if the scenery loses its stacked depth and travelling companion and becomes flat decoration behind conventional page sections.

name: looping_miniature_world_ride
description: After a short readiness wait and a sound-or-silence doorway, the visitor glides along one continuous path past small miniature scenes that swell into focus and slide away behind, and the path curls back so each further pass shows the same world under a different time of day, read as a shifted quality of light rather than any fixed colour scheme.

canonical_document.name: looping_miniature_world_ride
canonical_document.description: After a short readiness wait and a sound-or-silence doorway, the visitor glides along one continuous path past small miniature scenes that swell into focus and slide away behind, and the path curls back so each further pass shows the same world under a different time of day, read as a shifted quality of light rather than any fixed colour scheme.
canonical_document.experience_scope: Whole-view experience. Begins with a covering waiting layer over the not-yet-ready world, opens when the visitor chooses how to enter, and then never ends: travel continues indefinitely along a closed path with no terminal state or dead end.
content_and_composition: One continuous travelled path acting as the spine of the whole view; all content is positioned along it rather than in stacked page sections
Several discrete miniature scenes distributed along the path, each a self-contained little vignette that occupies the foreground only while it is nearest
A persistent surrounding world atmosphere (ground, sky, ambient setting) shared by all scenes and continuously visible between them, kept low-distraction so the nearest scene stays dominant
One small recurring character figure placed within reach of the pointer as a touchable inhabitant of the world

A full-cover entry layer present only before entry, carrying a filling progress bar whose filled portion separates clearly from its track, a numeric readiness percentage at readable contrast, and two entry choices (with sound, without sound)
Depth relationship between near foreground scene, mid world and far backdrop, expressed by graded separation in clarity, contrast and luminance, so the view can lean as a layered whole
experience_progression: Waiting: the covering layer reports readiness by a bar filling and a rising percentage, holding the visitor at a deliberate threshold
Doorway: at full readiness the way in appears as a two-option choice; picking either clears the covering layer and hands the world over
Travel: the viewpoint advances along the path, each scene approaching, gathering attention, then passing behind while the next opens ahead, entirely at the visitor's pace
Wrap: passing the far end continues straight on into a new pass of the same path with no break, stop or reset gesture
Re-pass: each subsequent pass presents the same world and same scene order under a shifted time of day, so repetition reads as a later hour rather than a restart
attention_and_information_flow: Prominence is governed by proximity along the path: the nearest scene is the single focal object and neighbours stay peripheral
Attention transfers by passage rather than replacement — the outgoing scene remains readable behind while the incoming one grows
Before entry, attention is deliberately narrowed to readiness feedback and then to the two-way entry choice, which carries the highest-salience treatment on that layer
Pointer movement supplies a constant low-level sense of depth without redirecting attention away from the current scene
Across passes, the shifted time of day re-lights already-seen scenes through a controlled change in illumination and luminance, so familiar content is re-read as new information

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Visitor cannot skip ahead; the doorway choice only becomes available once readiness is complete
interaction_model.state_change: Readiness advances from empty to complete
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Bar fills, its filled length clearly separated from the unfilled track, and the percentage figure climbs toward full
interaction_model.input: Waiting period while the world becomes ready
interaction_model.affected_object: Covering entry layer with progress bar and percentage

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Either choice leads to the same world; the entry layer does not return once cleared
interaction_model.state_change: Waiting state ends and travel state begins with the chosen sound condition
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The covering layer clears away and the world is revealed ready to be travelled
interaction_model.input: Choosing to enter with sound or in silence
interaction_model.affected_object: Covering entry layer and the world behind it

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Reversing the gesture retraces the path backwards through the same scenes; a new gesture during coasting takes over; pushing past either extreme continues straight into the next pass rather than blocking
interaction_model.state_change: Travel position moves forward or backward by an amount proportional to the size of the gesture, then decays to rest
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Scenes drift nearer or further with the motion and coast to a soft stop instead of snapping to a fixed stop
interaction_model.input: Wheel scrolling or a held vertical drag
interaction_model.affected_object: Viewpoint travelling the path, and every scene positioned on it

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Lean follows continuously and eases back as the pointer returns or leaves; it never displaces travel position
interaction_model.state_change: View orientation leans slightly toward the pointer position
interaction_model.visible_feedback: A small parallax tilt of the scene layers that follows the pointer
interaction_model.input: Moving the pointer without pressing
interaction_model.affected_object: Layered world view

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: On pointer leave the rocking settles back to its resting pose; it can be re-triggered any number of times and does not affect travel
interaction_model.state_change: Character enters a gentle rocking state
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Soft repeated rocking motion of the figure while hovered
interaction_model.input: Hovering the small character figure
interaction_model.affected_object: That character

experience_qualities: Cozy, handmade, small-scale
Unhurried and carried along rather than clicked through
Weighted and physical, with soft easing instead of snapping
Continuous and endless, with no dead ends
Alive and responsive to idle pointer presence
Quietly varied on repetition rather than exactly repeated
completion_and_return: No completion state: travel loops indefinitely in both directions
Crossing either end of the path continues seamlessly into the next pass of the same scene order
Each pass carries a different time-of-day lighting treatment, so return reads as the same place later rather than a reset
Character rocking and pointer lean always return to rest on their own
locked_observable_requirements: A single continuous travelled path holding all scenes, not discrete stacked sections or jump navigation
Travel driven entirely by the visitor's gesture, with distance following gesture size and motion easing to a stop rather than snapping to fixed positions
Reversal of the gesture retraces the same path backwards
Both ends of the path continue into a further pass without stopping, resetting or visibly restarting
Successive passes present the same world and scene order under a shifted time of day, observable as a controlled transition in illumination and luminance with no particular hue scheme required
Each scene becomes the focal object as it nears and remains visible slipping away behind as the next opens, staying readable against the surrounding world
A slight pointer-following lean of the layered view during idle pointer movement
At least one small character that rocks softly while hovered and settles back to rest when the pointer leaves

A pre-entry covering layer that reports readiness by a filling bar with clear separation between filled and unfilled and a percentage at readable contrast, cleared by an explicit entry choice offering sound or silence
adaptable_details: Number, subject and order of the miniature scenes
Art style, hue family and the specific times of day used per pass, including which direction the luminance shifts
Identity and pose vocabulary of the small character, and whether more than one exists
Path shape and travel axis, and the exact gesture-to-distance and easing feel
Wording and styling of the readiness indicator and the two entry options
Presence and character of ambient sound behind the sound entry choice
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits a small set of sparse, atmospheric vignettes where the place itself is the message and visitors are expected to wander and linger — greetings, story pieces, studio or craft showcases, seasonal experiences. Any hue family, light or dark surround will carry it as long as the nearest scene keeps enough separation from its surround and the per-pass lighting shift stays perceptible. Dense text, long-form reading or many equally weighted items would break the one-scene-at-a-time focus. Replacing continuous gesture-paced travel with snapped section stops, direct jump navigation, or an autonomous timed tour, or giving the path a real end state, would create a different Skill.

name: condition_driven_sky_view_with_expandable_day_windows
description: The whole view becomes the sky of a place, matched to its real condition and local time through whatever illumination and tonal range the host uses, with readings held quietly at the edges and a row of small labelled day windows below that each preview their own sky and expand to fill the view.

canonical_document.name: condition_driven_sky_view_with_expandable_day_windows
canonical_document.description: The whole view becomes the sky of a place, matched to its real condition and local time through whatever illumination and tonal range the host uses, with readings held quietly at the edges and a row of small labelled day windows below that each preview their own sky and expand to fill the view.
canonical_document.experience_scope: Whole-view experience covering the entire single-purpose page: it begins when a location resolves and the scene renders, spans free look-around and expansion of any preview window, and ends only on leaving the view; the preview row is part of the same experience rather than a separable region.
content_and_composition: One full-bleed environmental scene occupying the entire viewport, its appearance determined by the subject's actual condition and local time of day
One place label plus one headline value, positioned quietly at an edge over the scene
A small set of supporting readings grouped near the edges, carrying clearly less visual weight than the scene while staying legible against it
A row of several small labelled preview windows along the lower area, each showing a miniature scene in the same visual language as the full view
Each preview window carries a short period label, a high and low value, and a condition indicator
Scene and readings are one coordinated pair: they always describe the same subject and period
No chrome that frames the scene as a panel or widget; the scene is the page
experience_progression: Entry: the scene resolves to the current subject and settles into its condition-and-time appearance
Ambient dwell: the scene holds as the readable layer, inviting look-around before reading
Preview scan: the labelled windows below are read at a glance as upcoming states
Full-scale inspection: a chosen window expands to occupy the whole view and the readings swap to that period
Return: one back step restores the present-day scene and its readings
attention_and_information_flow: Attention lands on the environment first; textual readings are deliberately secondary and edge-held
Look-around shifts prominence within the scene without revealing new data
The preview row offers compressed comparison: several periods legible simultaneously at low detail
Expansion inverts the balance: one previewed period gains full spatial presence and its values replace the edge readings
The present state remains recoverable and conceptually foregrounded even while an expanded period is shown

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Movement stops at fixed horizontal and vertical limits; no zoom or pan is possible, so the subject can never be lost or left behind, and dragging back restores any prior orientation
interaction_model.state_change: View orientation turns horizontally and vertically within limited bounds
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The scene rotates around the viewer, revealing different parts of the same environment while edge readings stay fixed
interaction_model.input: Drag across the view
interaction_model.affected_object: The full-view environmental scene

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: A single back step returns to the present-scene state with its original readings; the present state is never destroyed by expansion
interaction_model.state_change: Selected period becomes the full-scale scene; readings switch to that period's values
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The chosen miniature expands to fill the view at full scale in the same visual language, and every edge reading changes to that period
interaction_model.input: Choosing one of the labelled preview windows
interaction_model.affected_object: The full-view scene and the edge readings together

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Committing another subject repeats the replacement; scene and readings always change as one unit
interaction_model.state_change: The whole view re-resolves to the new subject
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The scene is replaced with the new condition-and-time appearance and all readings and preview windows change together, never mismatched
interaction_model.input: A new subject location is committed
interaction_model.affected_object: Scene, edge readings and the entire preview row

experience_qualities: Felt before read: atmosphere carries the message ahead of the numbers
Inhabitable rather than illustrated — the viewer is inside the scene
Calm and uncluttered, with text yielding to the environment
Glanceable previews that are also fully enterable
Constrained freedom: movement feels open yet cannot break the framing
completion_and_return: No terminal completion; the view persists as an ambient state
Expansion is always reversible in one step back to the present-subject scene
Look-around orientation is a transient state with no penalty for leaving it anywhere within bounds
The present-subject scene acts as the resting state the experience always returns to
locked_observable_requirements: The environment fills the entire view rather than sitting in a panel

Scene appearance is determined by the subject's actual condition and its local time of day, not a generic decorative treatment; any hue family, tonal range or overall lightness may realize this as long as the state difference stays perceptible

Textual readings remain quiet and edge-held over the scene at a lower visual weight than it, never a centered content block, and never so faint that they lose readable separation from what sits behind them

How a subject is chosen or supplied
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits single-subject views where one live state has a plausible environmental depiction and a few comparable upcoming or alternate states can be previewed as miniature versions of that same environment, with only a handful of readings to display; the host's own tonal range and lightness may carry the depiction, since only the state-driven difference in illumination must survive. Allowing free navigation with zoom and pan, letting the scene become decorative rather than state-determined, turning the previews into a large browsable gallery without a persistent present state, or reducing the environment to an abstract chart or illustrated card would each create a different Skill.

experience_qualities: Unhurried and continuous — one uninterrupted ride with no cuts, pages or hard stops
Weighted and glide-like rather than immediate, so movement feels like carrying momentum
Atmospheric, with light and ambient sound doing equal work in setting mood

locked_observable_requirements: One confirming click visibly splits a full-screen cover apart to reveal the scene and hand over movement control

canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits a small, fixed-order set of short readable entries that benefit from being met inside an atmospheric place — curated collections, annotated archives, staged product or project stories — where a single guided route can carry the whole set. It stops being this Skill if the visitor gains free roaming or branching routes instead of one fixed line, if the entries are exposed as an ordinary scrollable list or grid rather than markers standing in the scene, if travel continues while a panel is open, or if the route terminates instead of wrapping.

name: glowing_translucent_interior_avatar_walkthrough

canonical_document.name: glowing_translucent_interior_avatar_walkthrough
canonical_document.description: The visitor stands as a small figure inside a large indoor space rendered as a self-illuminated translucent shell that separates from its surround by luminance rather than any particular hue, walks freely while nearby corridors, stairs and columns read clearly and distance dissolves into haze, sees the world above as low-contrast surrounding context, and uses a corner overview to stay oriented or jump elsewhere.
canonical_document.experience_scope: Whole-view experience: begins after a brief load with the figure already standing inside the space, continues as open-ended exploration with no end state, and persists across visits by resuming the last position and facing.
content_and_composition: One small human-scale figure as the user's persistent presence, always visible and always the compositional anchor, held distinct from the structure by contrast rather than by a specific colour

One large multi-level enclosed interior rendered as a translucent self-illuminated shell: walls, corridors, stairs, columns and floors readable as layered surfaces rather than solid opaque mass, the shell reading against its surround through luminance and transparency separation that works in either a light or dark surround
A depth gradient across the interior: near structure crisp and high-contrast, far structure progressively losing contrast into haze so the extent of the space is felt without visual noise

experience_progression: Short load, then arrival already standing inside the space rather than looking at it from outside

The corner overview carries continuous coarse orientation information (where and which way) at low prominence; expanding it briefly inverts the hierarchy so the whole plan dominates, then hands prominence straight back to the scene
Zooming out trades local detail for overall layout comprehension; zooming in trades layout for immediate surroundings

Ghostly and luminous rather than photographic; structure feels like a lit diagram one can walk inside, whatever hue family or surround tone is chosen
Legible depth: close things certain and high-contrast, far things suggested
Continuously oriented rather than maze-like, because presence, facing and wider context are always on screen
Weighty but gentle movement, with smooth turning and soft settling rather than snappy stops
completion_and_return: No completion state; the experience loops indefinitely as free wandering
Overview jumps return control immediately and leave the experience in its normal wandering state
Position and facing persist across sessions and become the entry state on return
locked_observable_requirements: A small human-scale figure is present inside the space at all times and is what the visitor moves
The enclosing structure is rendered as a translucent self-illuminated shell separated from its surround by luminance rather than by any specific hue or theme, not as opaque solid surfaces
Near structure reads at high contrast while distant structure progressively loses contrast into haze
A surrounding context layer above and around the interior remains visible at lower prominence during exploration

What the brief load state looks like

canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits any large enclosed multi-level built interior or underground layout that a visitor should understand by walking through it while still seeing what sits above and around it, including venues, terminals, complexes, campuses under a surface, and layered fictional structures, in any hue family and against either a light or dark surround. Removing the walked figure in favour of a guided flythrough or fixed viewpoint tour, or rendering the structure as opaque photoreal surfaces without the translucent self-illuminated shell and depth haze, would produce a different Skill; so would replacing free wandering with a stepped, waypointed or task-driven route.

name: boundless_quiet_field_walk_with_lasting_footprints
description: A lone figure stands in a vast, near-featureless expanse; holding a direction walks it forward with a trailing easing camera, and each step presses a permanent dent into the ground so the wandering path stays visible behind it.

canonical_document.name: boundless_quiet_field_walk_with_lasting_footprints
canonical_document.description: A lone figure stands in a vast, near-featureless expanse; holding a direction walks it forward with a trailing easing camera, and each step presses a permanent dent into the ground so the wandering path stays visible behind it.
canonical_document.experience_scope: A whole-view experience that fills the viewport and begins as soon as the scene appears, with the figure already at rest; it has no ending point and continues for as long as the view is open, alternating indefinitely between wandering and resting.
content_and_composition: Exactly one controllable figure as the sole foreground subject, held near the middle of the frame by the following camera
A single continuous, near-uniform ground surface whose tone reads clearly only close to the figure and fades into undifferentiated flatness further out, with no horizon landmarks, edges or walls
An accumulating trail of discrete footfall depressions on the ground, one per step, persisting behind the figure as the only spatial feature in the field
Camera framing fixed behind and slightly above the figure, following rather than static
A brief on-screen movement-control hint as the only overlay element, present only until the first input
No score, timer, destination marker, minimap or other HUD
experience_progression: Opening stillness: the figure stands motionless in an empty, undifferentiated expanse, with nothing else in view to look at
First input: the hint clears and the figure sets off, walking continuously while input is held
Ongoing accumulation: the trail lengthens step by step behind the figure and previously marked ground stays marked when re-crossed
Pause: input released, the figure glides to a stop and settles back into its resting stance while the trail remains
Open-ended resumption: wandering can begin again at any moment from wherever the figure stands, with no reset
attention_and_information_flow: At the start, emptiness gives the lone figure total prominence; there is nothing competing to look at
Once moving, attention divides between the figure ahead and the trail forming behind it
Because the surroundings carry no landmarks or boundaries, the accumulated marks become the only orientation information in the scene and grow steadily more informative
Re-crossing earlier ground reveals the older marks intact, layering history into the current view
Stopping returns prominence to the figure, now framed against its own visible history

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Movement continues as long as input is held and can be redirected mid-stride; there is no edge, wall or limit to collide with, so travel is never blocked or stopped by the environment
interaction_model.state_change: Resting stance transitions to sustained walking in the combined direction; simultaneous opposing directions cancel to no movement on that axis, diagonals combine
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The figure adopts a walking motion and travels across the surface, ground detail slides past, a step depression appears at each footfall, and a soft repeating crunch accompanies the walking
interaction_model.input: Holding one or more directional keys (arrow keys or W/A/S/D)
interaction_model.affected_object: The figure and the ground it travels over

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: New input during or after the glide immediately resumes wandering from the current position; the resting state is stable indefinitely
interaction_model.state_change: Walking decelerates into a stop and returns to the resting stance
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The figure glides briefly to a halt rather than stopping abruptly, settles into standing, and the step sound ceases a moment after the figure is already still
interaction_model.input: Releasing all directional input
interaction_model.affected_object: The figure and its accompanying step sound

interaction_model.state_change: Heading and travel are set by the drag's direction and distance from the original touch point, continuously updated while dragging
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The same walking motion, sliding surroundings, appearing step marks and step sound as with keys, following the dragged direction
interaction_model.input: Dragging from an initial touch point on a touchscreen
interaction_model.affected_object: The figure

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Marks never fade, expire or clear during the session; walking back over marked ground preserves the earlier marks instead of erasing or resetting them
interaction_model.state_change: The surface at the contact point changes permanently from smooth to visibly indented
interaction_model.visible_feedback: A distinct pressed dent appears where the foot landed and stays there
interaction_model.input: Each footfall while walking (autonomous, driven by the walking motion)
interaction_model.affected_object: The ground surface

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: It does not return, so the field stays clear for the rest of the session
interaction_model.state_change: Hint goes from visible to gone
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The hint clears from the view, leaving the scene unobstructed
interaction_model.input: Any first movement input
interaction_model.affected_object: The on-screen control hint

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: The camera always resolves to the trailing framing when movement stops, keeping the figure and the nearest trail in view
interaction_model.state_change: Camera lags slightly and then catches up to the figure's new position and heading
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The view eases smoothly into place behind and slightly above the figure instead of snapping to it
interaction_model.input: Figure movement (autonomous camera response)
interaction_model.affected_object: The viewing framing

experience_qualities: Hushed and quiet, with the emptiness produced by featureless uniformity rather than by any particular scene tone
Weighty and unhurried movement rather than fast or twitchy control
A sense of endless, directionless space with no pressure toward any goal
Meditative and self-paced, safe to stop and start at will
Quietly personal: the trail reads as evidence of the visitor's own passage
completion_and_return: No destination, score, ending or failure state exists
The figure idles in its resting stance indefinitely whenever wandering pauses
Accumulated marks persist for the duration of the view rather than being cleared between wanderings
Wandering can resume at any moment from the current position with no restart or reset step
locked_observable_requirements: A single figure is the only foreground subject and is directly driven by sustained input

The ground is a single continuous, near-featureless surface of uniform tone, legible only near the figure and fading into undifferentiated flatness further out, with no visible edge, wall or boundary to reach
Every footfall leaves a mark that stays clearly separated from the surrounding surface, persists, does not fade, and survives being walked over again
The accumulated trail is the only readable record of past movement in the scene
The camera trails from behind and slightly above and eases into place rather than snapping
Held input produces continuous travel with diagonals combining and opposing directions cancelling
Releasing input produces a glide to a halt and a return to a resting stance, not an instant stop
Touch dragging from the initial touch point provides equivalent directional steering, and lifting stops movement
No score, timer, objective, boundary warning or persistent HUD appears at any point
adaptable_details: Appearance and proportions of the figure
Exact tone, light quality and surface shading of the ground, as long as it stays near-uniform and keeps the figure and marks readable against it
Shape, depth and size of each pressed mark
Walking speed, step cadence and acceleration feel within a weighty range
Presence, character and volume of the accompanying step sound and ambience
Camera distance, height and easing duration
Wording, styling and placement of the initial control hint
Subtle ambient atmosphere such as drifting particles or gentle light variation
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits sparse, atmosphere-led views where movement itself is the content and almost no competing foreground text or controls are present, and where a visitor's accumulating trace is meant to be the memorable takeaway. Introducing a bounded arena, objectives, collectibles, scoring or an ending, letting the marks fade or clear, replacing the trailing eased camera with a fixed or snapping view, or filling the surroundings with dense readable landmarks would each produce a different skill.
