interaction_model.affected_object: Character on the ground

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Self-resolving; the character always returns to standing on the ground
interaction_model.state_change: Character leaves the ground briefly and returns
interaction_model.visible_feedback: A short hop arc that resolves back onto the ground
interaction_model.input: Jump key press
interaction_model.affected_object: Character

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Freely reversible at any time; clamping prevents disorienting angles, and release always eases to a stable resting view
interaction_model.state_change: View swings around the character, with vertical angle clamped short of directly overhead and directly underfoot
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The world rotates around the character while the character stays framed; the view resists further tilt at the limits and settles smoothly rather than stopping abruptly on release
interaction_model.input: Press and drag on the view
interaction_model.affected_object: Viewpoint orbiting the character

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Not reversible; found coins stay found so exploration can pause and resume anywhere without losing progress
interaction_model.state_change: Coin is permanently removed from the world and the found count increments
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The coin disappears with a chime and the tally advances one step toward the stated total
interaction_model.input: Character walks into a coin
interaction_model.affected_object: Coin and the tally overlay

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Toggle is reversible, but restoring is refused while the character is standing inside, so the visitor is never sealed in; leaving the interior makes restoration available again
interaction_model.state_change: Wall transitions to hidden, exposing the interior; clicking again restores it
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The wall fades away smoothly to open a view into the interior, and fades back in on the second click
interaction_model.input: Click on a cottage wall
interaction_model.affected_object: That exterior wall and the interior behind it

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Autonomous and uninterruptible by the visitor; continues regardless of where the character is or what is being collected
interaction_model.state_change: Illumination advances slowly along one continuous bright-to-dim arc
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The entire valley gradually shifts in overall tint and brightness together
interaction_model.input: Passage of time, with no user input
interaction_model.affected_object: Global illumination and sky of the whole scene

experience_qualities: Cozy, small and toy-like rather than vast or imposing
Unhurried; no timers, failure or pressure
Physically soft movement, with coasting stops and eased view settling instead of snapping
Legible at a glance because the whole place and its single destination are visible together
Rewarding curiosity with small, immediate confirmations
Quietly changing mood through drifting illumination
completion_and_return: Collection completes when the tally reaches the stated total; the world remains explorable afterward with no forced ending
Collected coins persist as found, so leaving and returning resumes progress in place
Wall visibility is a freely toggled state that can be returned to the closed exterior look at will, except while inside
The illumination cycle continues on its own and does not reset with the visitor's actions
locked_observable_requirements: The place is small and bounded and is revealed whole at once, not streamed or assembled in pieces
Exactly one focal building reads as the obvious destination within the landscape
Movement direction is interpreted relative to the current view facing, so turning the view re-maps held input
Movement stops by coasting, never by instant freeze
View orbits the character and is clamped short of overhead and underfoot, easing to rest on release
Collectibles vanish on contact with an audible chime and advance a persistent visible tally toward a stated total
Collected state is permanent, allowing pause and resume without loss
Building walls fade away on click to reveal the interior and fade back on a second click
Restoring a wall is blocked while the character is inside the building
A slow, autonomous whole-scene illumination drift traversing one continuous arc from its brightest to its dimmest state runs independently of interaction, with the scene staying legible throughout
Arrival is gated behind a quiet panel that visibly fills in until the world is ready
adaptable_details: Terrain shape, palette and scenery styling of the miniature place
Character appearance and hop height
Kind of collectible token and the exact chime
Total collectible count and their placement
Position and styling of the tally overlay
Duration, hues and color grading of the illumination cycle
Wording and fill styling of the entry panel
Exact key bindings and drag sensitivity
Which walls are clickable and how many interior rooms exist
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits any bounded, small stylized place with one focal structure and a countable set of findable tokens, where the whole space can be shown at once and wandering is the point. Expanding to a large continuous world that must be traversed beyond the visible frame, replacing the orbiting third-person presence with a first-person or on-rails viewpoint, removing the single focal destination, or removing the peel-away wall reveal so the interior is reached by loading a separate view would each create a different Skill.

name: drifting_aerial_city_expanse
description: A bird's-eye city of blocks, rooftops and streets slides continuously across the whole view, with a slow default drift that the visitor can gently steer by pointing or dragging toward the side they want to travel.

canonical_document.name: drifting_aerial_city_expanse
canonical_document.description: A bird's-eye city of blocks, rooftops and streets slides continuously across the whole view, with a slow default drift that the visitor can gently steer by pointing or dragging toward the side they want to travel.
canonical_document.experience_scope: Whole-view experience that fills the visible area with no frame, border, chrome, instructions or competing content; it begins already in motion the moment the view appears and never reaches an end state, continuing for as long as the view is present.
content_and_composition: One continuous aerial expanse occupying the entire view, read from above
Repeating urban vocabulary as the sole content: street pattern as the large-scale structure, blocks as mid-scale grouping, individual rooftops and facades as fine detail
Two simultaneous scales of interest: an overall street layout legible at a glance, and small per-building differences that reward closer looking
No labels, captions, controls, borders, edges or overlay elements; the expanse extends past every side of the view with no visible boundary
Each fresh start presents a different city layout while keeping the same visual vocabulary and density
experience_progression: Arrives already alive: the city is drifting before any input occurs, with nothing to dismiss or learn first
Continuous, endless travel with no destination, milestones or completion; new city material keeps entering the view as travel proceeds
Travel speed and direction vary over time in response to pointing, then settle back toward the slow default drift when left alone
attention_and_information_flow: Attention is free to wander between the overall street pattern and small differences between individual roofs and facades; nothing directs it
No element claims priority; prominence stays even across the expanse so no focal point pulls the eye
Newly revealed information is simply more city arriving from the direction of travel, so the sense is of ongoing discovery rather than staged reveals
Because motion is slow and eased, the view stays readable at all times instead of blurring into speed

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Always present as the resting behavior the experience returns to; never stops or stalls
interaction_model.state_change: Continuous slow travel in a gentle default direction
interaction_model.visible_feedback: City content glides steadily past, unhurried enough to study individual rooftops
interaction_model.input: Autonomous default drift with no user input
interaction_model.affected_object: The whole aerial expanse

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Crossing back through the center smoothly reverses travel through a slowdown rather than a jump; letting the cursor rest, or moving it off the view, hands control back to the slow default drift
interaction_model.state_change: Distance of the cursor from the center of the view sets travel speed; the city slides opposite to the pointer so the view advances toward the side being pointed at
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The expanse accelerates or slows and changes heading smoothly, easing into the new speed and direction instead of snapping
interaction_model.input: Cursor position within the view
interaction_model.affected_object: Travel speed and direction of the expanse

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Releasing the drag returns control to the slow default drift; the page itself never moves during steering
interaction_model.state_change: Same steering relationship as the cursor, driven by the drag position
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The city eases into travel toward the side being touched while the surrounding page stays still and does not scroll or bounce
interaction_model.input: Dragging finger across the view
interaction_model.affected_object: Travel speed and direction of the expanse

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Motion continues after refitting; the experience never lands in an empty, cropped or stalled state
interaction_model.state_change: The view refits to the new dimensions and a fresh city is laid out
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The expanse fills the new area completely with a newly arranged city, still drifting
interaction_model.input: View or window resize
interaction_model.affected_object: The whole aerial expanse

experience_qualities: Calm and unhurried; motion is slow enough to feel restful
Self-explanatory with no onboarding, goal or instructions
Borderless and endless, with no sense of a map edge or arena
Responsive but soft: steering feels like nudging a drifting mass rather than driving a vehicle
Freshly different on every visit, inviting a second look
completion_and_return: No completion state; travel loops indefinitely
Resting behavior is the slow default drift, which the experience always eases back into after steering stops
No progress is retained; a new visit or a refit produces a different city rather than resuming the previous one
locked_observable_requirements: Overhead view of a continuous built expanse that extends beyond every side of the view with no visible border
Motion is present on arrival, without any input or entry action
A slow autonomous drift is the resting state and is always returned to when input stops or leaves the view
Pointer or drag distance from the center controls speed; travel goes toward the pointed side, meaning content slides the opposite way
All speed and direction changes ease in and out, including a smooth reversal when passing back through the center
Touch steering never scrolls or moves the surrounding page
Nothing else occupies the view: no controls, labels, instructions, borders or overlaid content
Two readable scales at once: overall street pattern plus visible variation between individual rooftops and facades
Each fresh start or refit yields a different arrangement rather than a fixed scene
adaptable_details: Density, block size and street-grid regularity
Palette, lighting, time-of-day feel and level of rooftop detail
Default drift heading and baseline speed
Maximum steered speed and how sharply it ramps with distance from center
Degree of perspective versus flat overhead framing
Amount and kind of small per-building variation
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits any whole-view ambient scene made of a repeating, evenly interesting field of built or natural elements viewed from above, where the scene is the only content and exploration has no goal. Adding destinations, selectable or clickable elements, labels, an outer boundary, a completion condition, or foreground copy that must stay readable on top would make it a different Skill, as would replacing eased steering with direct one-to-one dragging of the view.

name: portal_linked_dual_landscape_tour
description: Stand inside a calm landscape, look around freely, notice a shimmering opening showing a different place behind it, and glide through it in one continuous motion into that second landscape, which offers the same calm view and a way back for endless round trips.

canonical_document.name: portal_linked_dual_landscape_tour
canonical_document.description: Stand inside a calm landscape, look around freely, notice a shimmering opening showing a different place behind it, and glide through it in one continuous motion into that second landscape, which offers the same calm view and a way back for endless round trips.
canonical_document.experience_scope: Whole-view experience occupying the full viewport. It begins with the visitor already positioned inside the first landscape at a calm establishing view, continues through free looking and any number of passages between the two landscapes, and never terminates: each side always offers a way back.
content_and_composition: Exactly two complete, visibly unrelated surrounding landscapes, only one of which contains the visitor at a time.
One shimmering opening per landscape, placed within the scene as a foreground focal element, showing the other landscape behind its surface as continuing space rather than as a flat picture or panel.
A ground plane in each landscape that acts as a lower boundary for the viewpoint.
The viewpoint itself is the persistent element across both landscapes; it carries orientation and distance behavior into whichever landscape is current.
Sparse composition: the scene and the opening are the content; no dense text or control chrome is required in view.
experience_progression: Arrival: visitor is already inside the first landscape at a calm, settled establishing view, free to take it in with no pending task.
Noticing: the shimmering opening draws attention as the one moving, differently-behaving element in the scene.
Confirmation: pointing at the opening makes its surface churn harder and faster, marking it as enterable.
Passage: one continuous forward glide through the opening, with no cut or reload, ending inside the second landscape.
Settling: the second landscape comes to rest in its own equally calm establishing view, with its own opening back.
Repetition: the same sequence runs in the opposite direction, looping indefinitely.
attention_and_information_flow: Initially attention is diffuse across the surrounding landscape, inviting unhurried inspection rather than action.
The opening's constant shimmer gradually pulls attention as the only actionable point in an otherwise still scene.
Hover concentrates attention sharply on the opening by intensifying its surface motion.
During passage attention is carried forward through the opening, so the second landscape is revealed progressively from the far side of the opening outward rather than appearing all at once.
After settling, attention releases back to diffuse inspection of the new landscape, with its return opening now the single actionable point.

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Available whenever the visitor is settled in a landscape; can be started, stopped and resumed freely; vertical swing is bounded so the viewpoint never sinks below the ground
interaction_model.state_change: Viewpoint swings around the surroundings, changing the visible portion of the scene
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The landscape rotates around the visitor in direct, continuous correspondence with the drag
interaction_model.input: Drag anywhere in the view with mouse or finger
interaction_model.affected_object: The visitor's viewpoint orientation within the current landscape

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Reversible at any time; bounded so the viewpoint can neither pass below the ground nor stray far out of the landscape
interaction_model.state_change: Viewpoint draws closer to or pulls back from the scene, within fixed near and far limits
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The scene grows or recedes smoothly and simply stops responding at the limits instead of overshooting
interaction_model.input: Wheel scroll or pinch gesture
interaction_model.affected_object: The visitor's viewing distance within the current landscape

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Eases smoothly back down to the idle shimmer when the pointer leaves, with no lingering state
interaction_model.state_change: Surface shifts from idle shimmer to heightened activity
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The surface churns visibly stronger and faster, reading as a cue that the opening can be entered
interaction_model.input: Pointer crosses onto the opening
interaction_model.affected_object: The opening's shimmering surface

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Look-around and distance control are withheld for the duration of the passage and handed back only once the far side has settled; further clicks during the passage are ignored so a trip can neither be doubled nor stranded
interaction_model.state_change: Viewpoint travels through the opening and the other landscape becomes the current one
interaction_model.visible_feedback: One unbroken forward glide through the opening's surface that resolves into the second landscape's calm establishing view, reading as continuous space rather than a jump
interaction_model.input: Click or tap on the opening
interaction_model.affected_object: The viewpoint and the current landscape

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Symmetric with the outbound trip, including withheld control and ignored clicks while in transit; the round trip can repeat without limit
interaction_model.state_change: Viewpoint travels back through to the first landscape
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The same unbroken glide in the reverse direction, ending in the first landscape's calm establishing view
interaction_model.input: Click or tap on the opening in the second landscape
interaction_model.affected_object: The viewpoint and the current landscape

experience_qualities: Calm and unhurried; nothing demands action on arrival
Inhabited rather than observed: the visitor feels positioned inside the scene
Spatially continuous: the far place reads as real space beyond the opening, not as an image or overlay
Directly responsive: looking and zooming track input immediately
Uninterrupted: the passage is one glide with no visible break, cut or reload
Safe and endless: every side has a way onward and nothing dead-ends
completion_and_return: No terminal state; the experience settles rather than completes.
Each passage completes when the destination landscape comes to rest in its calm establishing view and look-around control is returned.
Each landscape always exposes an opening back, so the trip loops indefinitely in both directions.
The visitor's freedom to look and zoom is restored identically on each side after settling.
locked_observable_requirements: The visitor begins already inside a landscape at a calm establishing view, not outside looking at it.
Free look-around by drag and closer/farther by wheel or pinch, both bounded so the viewpoint stays above ground and within the scene.
The opening shows the other landscape behind it as continuing space, so the two places appear spatially joined.
The opening's surface shimmers continuously and visibly churns stronger and faster while pointed at, easing back when the pointer leaves.
Entering is one unbroken forward glide through the opening, never a cut or instant swap.
Look-around control is withheld during the passage and returned only after the destination settles, and additional activations in the meantime are ignored.
Both landscapes offer a symmetric way back, allowing endless repetition.
adaptable_details: The subject, mood, color treatment and density of each landscape, as long as the two remain clearly distinguishable from one another
The shape, size, framing and placement of the opening within the scene
The visual character of the shimmer and the degree of its intensification
The duration and easing of the passage glide
The exact near and far distance limits and vertical swing limits
The starting orientation and framing of each establishing view
Whether more than two landscapes are chained, as long as each remains reachable and returnable
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits any context that can supply two or more complete surrounding settings worth inhabiting and inspecting, with one prominent opening acting as the link, and where sparse foreground content lets the scene itself carry meaning. It stops being this Skill if the opening merely previews a flat image or panel rather than continuing space, if arriving on the other side is a cut or reload instead of one continuous glide, if the viewpoint is fixed or on a rail instead of freely look-aroundable and bounded, or if a side offers no way back and the trip becomes one-directional.

name: scroll_piloted_village_flythrough
description: A hazy establishing view of a small scene that, as the visitor scrolls, glides forward along one fixed route while turning to face each landmark in turn, easing to a hold wherever scrolling stops and rewinding through the identical path when scrolled back.

canonical_document.name: scroll_piloted_village_flythrough
canonical_document.description: A hazy establishing view of a small scene that, as the visitor scrolls, glides forward along one fixed route while turning to face each landmark in turn, easing to a hold wherever scrolling stops and rewinding through the identical path when scrolled back.
canonical_document.experience_scope: A whole-view experience occupying the full viewport from arrival until the final resting framing; it begins at the opening hazy orientation view and ends parked on the last framing, with no separate entry or exit screen.
content_and_composition: One continuous inhabited scene presented as a single spatial world rather than separate sections or slides
One soft, hazy opening framing that establishes place and gives a moment of orientation before movement begins
An ordered set of roughly five scene subjects, each becoming the framed focus in turn (an expanse of water, a set of wooden piers, a cluster of buildings, small light sources, a single moored vessel)
One implied route through the scene: viewpoint position and heading are the only moving composition elements
One final settled resting framing that closes the journey
Atmospheric haze and ambient light persist across the whole journey as continuous scene-wide layers
No instructional overlay, progress chrome, captions or controls in the composition
experience_progression: Arrival: viewpoint sits inside the scene in a soft hazy framing, still, allowing brief orientation
Departure: first scroll starts a forward glide along the route, movement beginning gently rather than abruptly
Sequential framing: viewpoint continues forward while heading rotates so each subject enters, holds and leaves the frame in a fixed order, one at a time
Settling: forward travel and turning slow into the final framing
Rest: viewpoint parks on the closing framing and remains there
Retrace: scrolling upward reverses the same stages through identical positions and headings back to the opening framing
attention_and_information_flow: Attention is directed entirely by what the viewpoint's heading places in the frame; no highlighting, labeling or dimming is used
Prominence transfers from one subject to the next as the turn carries the previous subject out of frame and the next into it
The opening haze withholds detail so the scene reads as atmosphere first and specific subjects later
Only the currently framed portion of the scene carries information, so the visitor is never asked to choose where to look
The closing framing resolves into a stable composition that signals completion without any explicit end marker

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Direction can be reversed at any moment; progress is continuous rather than committed to a step, so the visitor is never locked into a segment
interaction_model.state_change: Progress along the fixed route advances, moving the viewpoint further forward while its heading rotates toward the next subject
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The scene glides past and pivots so the next landmark swings into frame and becomes the focus
interaction_model.input: Scrolling downward
interaction_model.affected_object: Viewpoint position and heading within the scene

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Rewind can be interrupted and re-advanced at any point; retracing all the way returns the opening hazy framing
interaction_model.state_change: Progress rewinds along the identical route, reproducing exactly the same positions and headings in reverse
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The journey plays backward with the same framings the visitor already saw, restoring earlier views precisely
interaction_model.input: Scrolling upward
interaction_model.affected_object: Viewpoint position and heading within the scene

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Resuming scrolling eases motion back up from the held view rather than jumping; the held framing is never skipped past
interaction_model.state_change: Motion decelerates to a hold at the current point of the route instead of stopping instantly or drifting onward
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The view eases to a standstill on whatever framing is current, holding it steady and inspectable, including framings between named subjects
interaction_model.input: Stopping scrolling anywhere along the route
interaction_model.affected_object: Viewpoint motion

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Scrolling in the opposite direction immediately resumes travel from that parked framing
interaction_model.state_change: Progress clamps at the first or last framing
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The viewpoint parks on the opening or closing framing with no overshoot, bounce, wrap or jump
interaction_model.input: Continuing to scroll past either end of the route
interaction_model.affected_object: Viewpoint position and heading

experience_qualities: Calm and unhurried, never rushing or snapping
Immersive: the visitor feels placed inside the scene rather than looking at pictures of it
Self-evident without instructions, prompts or affordance hints
Continuous and single-threaded, with no visible cuts between subjects
Reversible and trustworthy, since going back reproduces exactly what was seen
Soft and atmospheric, with haze and ambient light setting the mood
completion_and_return: Completion is a settled resting framing at the end of the route, held indefinitely rather than auto-advancing or looping
Full reverse traversal is always available and returns to the exact opening framing
No reset control is offered; retracing is the only return path
Any intermediate framing can be held indefinitely as a stable stopping point
locked_observable_requirements: A single continuous viewpoint journey through one scene, with no cuts, teleports or section jumps
Scroll position is the sole driver of progress along the route, in both directions
Forward and reverse traversal reproduce identical positions and headings
Viewpoint heading turns to bring each subject into frame in a fixed order, one subject at a time
A soft, hazy, initially still opening framing that permits orientation before movement
Motion eases into and out of a stop so no framing along the route is skipped
Progress clamps at both extremes with no overshoot, bounce or wrap
A final settled resting framing that ends the journey
No instructions, prompts or progress chrome are required to make the interaction understood
adaptable_details: The kind of place or environment depicted and its overall mood or time of day
The number and identity of framed subjects, provided they stay a small ordered handful
The route's shape, length and total travel distance
Amount of haze, ambient light quality and overall color treatment, with no particular hues required
Easing durations and how quickly motion settles into a hold
Whether faint ambient movement exists in the scene while the viewpoint is held
Whether the closing framing is wide or intimate
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits any content that can be laid out as one traversable spatial scene with a small ordered set of subjects worth framing in sequence, and where a calm guided pass is more appropriate than free exploration. Replacing scroll-linked traversal with free look or drag navigation, letting the visitor jump directly to subjects, cutting between discrete viewpoints instead of gliding continuously, or making forward and reverse paths differ would each create a different Skill.

name: side_scrolling_block_strike_timeline_run
description: A cartoon game world that slides sideways under a character running in place at the centre while vertical scrolling advances the journey; each dated entry sits on a block that the character automatically hops into, striking it so a reward pops out, and the final stretch passes through a controlled luminance shift into a low-distraction closing scene.

canonical_document.name: side_scrolling_block_strike_timeline_run
canonical_document.description: A cartoon game world that slides sideways under a character running in place at the centre while vertical scrolling advances the journey; each dated entry sits on a block that the character automatically hops into, striking it so a reward pops out, and the final stretch passes through a controlled luminance shift into a low-distraction closing scene.
canonical_document.experience_scope: A whole-view experience: it begins with an opening reveal of the heading and the earliest entry, occupies the full viewport for the entire sequence of dated entries as the visitor scrolls, and ends at the subdued closing scene around the last release; it is entered and exited only by scrolling within this stretch.
content_and_composition: One persistent character fixed near the horizontal centre of the view, animated in place rather than translating across the screen
Multiple layered scenery bands of a cartoon game world (background, midground, ground/platform level) that translate sideways as one coordinated world
An ordered series of milestone stations, one per dated entry, each composed of a strikable block plus its date and short label text
A reward object that emerges from a block only at the moment it is struck
A heading that is introduced with the earliest entry during the opening reveal
A blinking downward hint positioned at the start of the experience
A closing scene, produced by a controlled luminance shift of the surroundings, occupying the space near the final entry
Text and blocks sit on the same travelling plane as the ground layer, so entries move with the world while the character stays centred
experience_progression: Opening reveal: heading and the earliest entry are presented, with a blinking downward hint inviting movement
Movement begins: the hint slides away and the world starts travelling sideways beneath the running character
Approach: the next entry's words become legible slightly before that station is reached, so the upcoming item is always readable in advance
Arrival: an automatic hop lifts the character into the block, the strike lands, and a reward pops out of it
Repeat: the cycle of approach, legibility, hop, strike and reward repeats station by station in chronological order
Closing: as the last release nears, the surroundings pass through a controlled luminance shift into a quiet final scene that resolves the journey
attention_and_information_flow: Attention stays anchored on the centred character while information arrives from the leading edge of the travelling world
Only the current and imminent entries are readable; earlier entries recede with the scenery and later ones are not yet legible
Pre-arrival legibility means the visitor reads an entry, then watches it get opened, so reading and payoff are separated into two beats
The reward pop is the loudest momentary accent, marking that an entry has been registered
The closing luminance shift pulls prominence away from scenery detail and onto the final entry as a conclusion
The blinking hint is the single strongest cue before any movement and yields all prominence once travel starts

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Stopping the scroll halts world travel at that position; progress is always tied to the current scroll position rather than an unstoppable animation
interaction_model.state_change: Journey position advances forward through the world
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Scenery layers and entries slide sideways beneath the centred character, which runs in place
interaction_model.input: Scrolling down
interaction_model.affected_object: Layered scenery and the dated entry stations

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Slowing the scroll returns the cadence to a calmer pace without losing position
interaction_model.state_change: Locomotion tempo increases
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The running cadence quickens in step with the faster sideways travel
interaction_model.input: Faster scrolling
interaction_model.affected_object: The character's running animation and world travel

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Resuming scroll in either direction resumes locomotion from the same point
interaction_model.state_change: From running to idle
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The character settles into an idle stance while the world holds still
interaction_model.input: Stopping scrolling
interaction_model.affected_object: The character

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: The hop is driven by arrival rather than a separate command, so it cannot be missed or triggered out of order
interaction_model.state_change: Entry goes from legible-but-closed to struck-and-opened
interaction_model.visible_feedback: An automatic hop carries the character into the block, the strike registers on the block, and a reward pops out of it
interaction_model.input: Reaching a milestone station while travelling forward
interaction_model.affected_object: The station's block, its words and the reward object

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Reversal starts from wherever the visitor currently is, and scrolling down again resumes forward travel from that same point, so the sequence is fully rewindable and replayable
interaction_model.state_change: Journey direction reverses from the visitor's current position
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The character turns around and every hop, block strike and word reveal replays in reverse order as the world travels back
interaction_model.input: Scrolling back up
interaction_model.affected_object: Character facing, world travel, hops, strikes and word reveals

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Dismissal is tied to movement having begun rather than to a click, and the hint does not compete for attention afterwards
interaction_model.state_change: Hint goes from prompting to dismissed
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The hint slides away out of the composition
interaction_model.input: First movement of any kind
interaction_model.affected_object: The blinking downward hint

experience_qualities: Playful and cartoon-like rather than documentary
Continuous and unbroken, reading as one journey instead of separate sections
Effortless ordering, because chronology is carried by travel direction
Tactile and rewarding at each entry through strike-and-pop payoff
Directly responsive, with pace and direction of motion mirroring the visitor's own scrolling
Resolving, with a subdued final scene whose reduced surround contrast signals the end of the history
completion_and_return: The experience completes at the subdued closing scene around the final entry
It does not loop; the last entry is a terminal scene rather than a wrap to the start
Scrolling up from any point returns the visitor through the same stations with all beats replayed in reverse
Journey state is always derived from the current scroll position, so entries can be revisited and reopened repeatedly
locked_observable_requirements: Vertical scrolling is the sole driver of forward and backward travel
The protagonist stays fixed near the centre and animates in place while the world moves sideways beneath it
Scenery is composed of multiple layers that travel together as one coherent world
Each dated entry is a strikable station that is arrived at, hopped into, struck and opened with a reward emerging

name: cursor_tilted_scene_with_item_spotlight_card
description: One furnished scene fills the screen and leans a few degrees toward the cursor like a real space being looked around; hovering marks a purchasable piece, clicking stills the scene and lifts that piece forward onto a framed detail card while its neighbours sink back, and dismissing it returns the room to life.

canonical_document.description: One furnished scene fills the screen and leans a few degrees toward the cursor like a real space being looked around; hovering marks a purchasable piece, clicking stills the scene and lifts that piece forward onto a framed detail card while its neighbours sink back, and dismissing it returns the room to life.

experience_qualities: Calm and unhurried rather than energetic

completion_and_return: No end state; the experience persists as long as the view is open
Each item focus completes by dismissal and returns the scene to its prior ambient state
Each scene retains its own arrangement and focus history so revisiting it shows it undisturbed
Scene order does not wrap; the first and last scenes are hard edges

locked_observable_requirements: Exactly one scene occupies the whole screen at a time, with visible depth

adaptable_details: Exact tilt magnitude and easing, as long as it stays subtle

Wording of the mood line and the acquisition control label

canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits any small ordered set of staged, depth-bearing environments containing a handful of individually inspectable objects that each have a short label, a value and one primary action — interiors, workspaces, displays, collections. It stays the same Skill when the subject matter, styling or item count changes. It becomes a different Skill if the scene loses depth and pointer-driven leaning, if items are presented as a flat list or grid instead of embedded in a place, if multiple scenes are visible at once, if detail opens as a separate destination rather than a card over a stilled scene, or if progress through scenes becomes a continuous scroll-driven journey instead of discrete turns between preserved scenes.

name: walkable_pixel_room_with_avatar_anchored_talk

experience_qualities: Cozy and inhabited: a place to linger rather than a surface to read

Unhurried and low-pressure, with gentle notices instead of hard failures
Socially warm through visible co-presence and expressive gestures
Playfully embodied: talking and moving feel like acting in a room

locked_observable_requirements: A single small bounded room rendered as low-resolution pixel art from a tilted overhead angle, filling the main view

canonical_document.experience_scope: Whole-view region experience: it begins the moment the visitor arrives, with no lobby, setup step or entry gate, and continues for the entire visit. canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits small bounded social places where co-presence and location are the point and contributions are short conversational lines: community corners, event or open-hours lobbies, guestbook-style rooms, playful about or landing spaces, and lightweight persistent hangouts with a handful of visible participants. It stops being this Skill if speech is no longer anchored to where a speaker stands (leaving a plain message list beside decorative art), if the place grows into a large scrolling or camera-following world rather than one glanceable room, if the viewpoint shifts to first-person or free 3D, if the visitor is no longer embodied as a walkable figure among equals, or if the content becomes long-form or threaded so that lingering and spatial reading no longer carry the experience.

The visitor's own small character standing on the floor, facing one of a few discrete directions
Zero to many other characters representing the people currently present, drawn with the same treatment and scale as the visitor's own so no one reads as privileged
Short-lived speech bubbles anchored directly above individual characters' heads, positioned wherever that character happens to stand
A name label revealed only while a character is pointed at, attached to that character

name: tilted_toy_world_vessel_cruise
description: A tilted, miniature-looking overhead view of a wide open expanse in which the visitor's craft stays fixed at the center, gaining and losing speed gradually under held keys while landmarks rise out of distant haze ahead and fade back into haze behind; the plane, landmarks and haze band are set apart by value separation rather than any particular set of hues, so the view adopts the host's color treatment.

Toy-like and miniature in feel, thanks to the tilted overhead framing
Instantly legible: the whole situation is understandable at a glance with no explanation
Momentum that feels weighted but gentle, with a glide instead of hard starts and stops
Openness without limits or pressure
Fully forgiving: no way to fail, get stuck or make a wrong move that cannot be steered back
locked_observable_requirements: Fixed tilted overhead framing at a miniature scale, never switching to first-person, flat top-down or a cinematic scripted camera

canonical_document.name: tilted_toy_world_vessel_cruise
canonical_document.experience_scope: Whole-view, full-viewport experience that begins the instant the view appears, with the craft already placed in a live world and no menu, setup, intro or start gate; it has no end condition and continues until the visitor leaves. canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits any single-craft free traverse of a wide open plane dotted with sparse standalone landmarks, where wandering itself is the content and foreground text is minimal, such as playful hero views, brand or character worlds, and idle diversions. It becomes a different Skill if the framing shifts to first-person or an on-rails cinematic camera, if the craft stops being the fixed centered anchor, if obstacles, collisions, boundaries, objectives, scores, timers or fail states are introduced, if movement becomes instant, teleporting or path-following instead of held-input momentum, or if dense reading content and interface panels take over the view.
content_and_composition: One persistent hero craft acting as the permanent visual anchor, held at the center of the frame at a fixed tilted overhead angle and a constant apparent scale, and kept clearly separated in value from the plane it sits on

A hazy far band where the plane meets the sky, into which arriving landmarks emerge and departing landmarks dissolve through a gradual, even loss of contrast

name: glow_cluster_overview_to_node_flight
description: A quiet, low-distraction space filled with many small glowing points that together read as one large structure; hovering lifts and swells the points that lead somewhere, and choosing one flies the view smoothly inward until that point's small family of satellites is framed beside a short readable summary, with a return flight back to the untouched overview.

experience_qualities: Calm and unhurried: every change of vantage is travelled rather than cut
Cohesive: many small lights read as one glowing whole before they read as separate items
Legible at a glance: which items are worth visiting is discoverable without instructions
Deep and quiet: a low-distraction surround and clearly separated luminous points carry a strong sense of scale and distance
Controlled: bounded movement and locked-out input during flights keep the experience from ever feeling jarring or lost
Repeatable: the loop invites visiting one item after another
locked_observable_requirements: Many small glowing points set against a quiet, low-competition surround with a clear luminance separation between points and surround, reading as one large coherent structure, presented whole rather than built up progressively
Only a subset of points leads anywhere, and that distinction is revealed by pointer feedback (a high-salience luminance lift, swelling halo, clickable cursor) while the rest stay entirely inert
Free orbit and zoom under fixed near and far limits, so the visitor can never leave or pierce the structure
Selection produces one continuous decelerating flight, never a cut or fade, that ends framed on the chosen item's satellite set
The focused state shows the satellite arrangement and a short readable summary together in the same view, inside the same scene
Input is locked during flights: free looking suspended, repeat selections ignored
An explicitly offered return action flies the view back out to the identical opening overview
canonical_document.name: glow_cluster_overview_to_node_flight
canonical_document.experience_scope: A whole-view experience owning a full viewport or a large full-width region: it begins when the field becomes visible as one wide overview and covers the repeatable loop of free exploration, inward flight to a single focused item, resting focused state, and outward return; it ends back at the same overview, ready for the next visit.
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits any large collection in which items differ in whether they have deeper content, each deep item owns a small bounded set of sub-items, and a few lines of summary text are enough at the focused level — catalogs, portfolios, archives, release or project maps, relationship maps. It needs a quiet, uncluttered spatial substrate whose tone sits far enough from the points' luminance for the glow to carry, enough items for a whole-structure impression, and sub-item sets small enough to frame all at once. It becomes a different Skill if the overview is replaced by a flat list or grid, if the transition cuts, fades or swaps panels instead of travelling continuously, if every item is visitable so the discovery of destinations disappears, if focusing navigates away to a separate view instead of settling inside the same scene, or if long-form detail content replaces the short in-scene summary.
content_and_composition: One continuous three-dimensional field of many small glowing points arranged in a single recognizable large-scale form, so the field reads as one structure rather than scattered unrelated dots

Two classes of points: a visitable subset that owns deeper content, and an inert remainder with nothing behind it; the difference is not announced up front but becomes discoverable through pointer contact
A per-point glow or halo layer that can gain luminance and expand independently of the point itself
For each visitable point, a small bounded set of satellite sub-items that exists only in that point's focused state
A short text summary shown alongside the focused satellites: what the item is plus what belongs to or orbits it, a few lines readable at a glance without scrolling
A persistently offered return-to-overview affordance present whenever the view is focused

A uniform, visually quiet backdrop for the entire experience, held at a wide enough luminance separation from the points that all prominence is carried by glow and motion rather than by the surround itself
No competing chrome inside the scene during flight
attention_and_information_flow: At overview, prominence is spread across the whole field and reads as shape and density; individual identity is deliberately withheld
Pointer contact promotes exactly one point above its neighbours, converting an undifferentiated field into a set of candidate destinations
During the inward flight, the target grows in the frame while the surrounding field loses importance and becomes depth
At rest, prominence transfers to the satellite arrangement and the short summary; the field behind becomes a quiet substrate
The outward flight reverses the handover: text and satellites give up prominence and whole-structure legibility returns

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Freely reversible at any moment; unavailable while an inward or outward flight is in progress and automatically restored once the view settles
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The entire point field turns with parallax between near and far points, revealing the structure's form from new angles
interaction_model.input: Drag across the scene
interaction_model.state_change: View rotates around the structure's center
interaction_model.affected_object: Orientation of the whole field relative to the viewer

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Hard near and far stops hold the view inside a usable range with no overshoot beyond them; always reversible by zooming the other way
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Points spread apart and grow when approaching, condense into the overall structure when pulling back
interaction_model.input: Zoom input (wheel, pinch or equivalent)
interaction_model.state_change: View moves nearer or further along a clamped range
interaction_model.affected_object: Viewing distance to the field

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Moving away restores the base appearance immediately; points with nothing behind them stay completely inert and produce no highlight and no cursor change
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The point lifts in luminance well clear of its neighbours, its halo swells, and the cursor changes to a clickable indicator
interaction_model.input: Pointer over a visitable point
interaction_model.state_change: Idle to highlighted
interaction_model.affected_object: That single point and its halo

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Free looking is suspended and further selections are ignored until the flight finishes, so the journey cannot be interrupted, retargeted or stacked; control returns automatically at rest
interaction_model.visible_feedback: One smooth continuous flight inward that decelerates into a settled framing of that item's satellites, with the short summary readable alongside
interaction_model.input: Choosing a highlighted point
interaction_model.state_change: Free exploration to focused-on-one-item
interaction_model.affected_object: The view itself plus the focus target's satellites and summary

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Offered for the whole duration of the focused state so the visitor is never stranded; lands on the same opening overview, and input is again locked until the outward flight completes
interaction_model.visible_feedback: An outward flight releases the satellites and summary and re-establishes the wide overview of the whole structure

interaction_model.state_change: Focused back to free exploration
interaction_model.affected_object: The view plus the focused content

adaptable_details: Large-scale form of the field (spiral, cluster, sphere, drifting stream) and its point count, the coloring of points and surround, and glow intensity, in any direction of luminance contrast
Whether a blank, low-activity hold with a counting readiness readout precedes the whole-structure reveal
Arrangement of the satellites in the focused state (ring, arc, row) and the placement of the summary panel
Wording and length of the short summary, as long as it stays glanceable
Flight duration and easing curve, halo size, cursor style
Which concrete inputs drive orbit, zoom and return (pointer, touch, keys or on-screen controls)
The subject matter of the collection, as long as some items own a small set of sub-items
canonical_document.description: A quiet, low-distraction space filled with many small glowing points that together read as one large structure; hovering lifts and swells the points that lead somewhere, and choosing one flies the view smoothly inward until that point's small family of satellites is framed beside a short readable summary, with a return flight back to the untouched overview.
experience_progression: A blank, low-activity hold before the scene is available, ending with the complete structure appearing already whole rather than assembling piece by piece
Free exploration: the visitor orbits and zooms the whole structure within fixed limits, scanning for points that lead somewhere
Targeting: pointer contact with a visitable point lifts exactly that point out of the field, confirming it as a destination before any commitment
Descent: selection starts one continuous flight from wherever the view happens to be, decelerating rather than cutting, until it settles
Focused rest: the chosen item's satellites sit framed with the short summary readable; the wider field remains as context; the way back is offered
Return: an outward flight re-establishes the wide overview and hands control back, so the loop can repeat from an unchanged starting state
completion_and_return: The focused state persists indefinitely until the visitor chooses to return; nothing times out or advances on its own
Return always resolves to the same opening overview framing, so each visit ends exactly where the next one starts
The loop can be repeated any number of times without accumulating state or drifting away from the original vantage
Neither flight leaves a half-finished intermediate state: each ends either settled on an item or settled on the overview

name: typed_line_disperses_on_send

canonical_document.name: typed_line_disperses_on_send

One persistent back affordance returning to the entry list

interaction_model.affected_object: Committed line of characters

interaction_model.state_change: No state change
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Nothing happens; view stays still

experience_qualities: Immediately graspable within seconds with no instructions
Weightless and playful release of the typed message
Believable as an ordinary working input rather than a decorative picture of one
Rhythmic and repeatable, inviting line after line
completion_and_return: Each committed line has its own clear finished moment when the fragments have left and the field is blank
The field self-clears and self-focuses, so the piece loops without a reset control
The back affordance returns to the entry list at any time

name: magnetic_catch_area_variant_lab
description: A compact board of labelled elements on a uniform low-distraction ground, each parked in its own marked circle that catches the pointer: the element glides toward the cursor with its text trailing behind, springs back on withdrawal, and one variant deliberately snaps and gets yanked back out, with a per-element rule snippet openable before comparing.

canonical_document.name: magnetic_catch_area_variant_lab
canonical_document.description: A compact board of labelled elements on a uniform low-distraction ground, each parked in its own marked circle that catches the pointer: the element glides toward the cursor with its text trailing behind, springs back on withdrawal, and one variant deliberately snaps and gets yanked back out, with a per-element rule snippet openable before comparing.
canonical_document.experience_scope: A whole compact single-screen region: begins with a short framing question at the top and the set of parked elements at rest, ends when the visitor has sampled the variants and closed any opened rule snippet; the board is self-contained and does not depend on surrounding page scroll.
content_and_composition: One short framing question as a heading above the set, establishing what to compare
Four peer examples of the same simple interactive object, presented as equals with no ranking or highlight
Each example enclosed in its own visibly marked circular field that reads as both boundary and catch area
Each example carries a terse caption naming the rule it follows, positioned with the example rather than in a legend
Each example's visual body and its text treated as two loosely coupled layers, the text able to sit behind the body's motion
A small code marker adjacent to each example as the entry point to its rule
A readable rule snippet surface that appears above the board with the surrounding area visibly receded behind it
Uniform, instrument-panel-like ground held clearly apart in luminance from the elements, keeping all examples equally legible and letting motion read clearly
experience_progression: At rest: examples parked at the centre of their circles, a couple of them idling restlessly so the board is never fully still
Sampling: the visitor tries examples one after another in self-chosen order, each entry and withdrawal completing a full follow-and-settle cycle
Contrast: the deliberately unresolved example breaks the established settle pattern with its own snap-and-return cycle, making the difference obvious by feel
Checking: the rule behind any example can be opened and read before or between comparisons, then dismissed to resume sampling
Return: every example ends back at its parked centre, board returns to its idle state
attention_and_information_flow: Self-animating idle motion pulls attention to the board before any input or reading
Prominence follows the pointer: whichever circle holds the pointer becomes the active focus while the others stay quietly parked
The felt consequence of each rule arrives before its written explanation; captions confirm rather than teach
The odd-behaving example claims disproportionate attention through its discontinuity, not through size or colour
Opening a rule snippet temporarily promotes text to the foreground and recedes the board without discarding its state

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Motion tracks continuously with no commitment; displacement never exceeds the circle, so the element can never escape its field
interaction_model.state_change: Element offsets from its parked centre toward the current pointer position, displacement clamped to the circle
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The element glides after the cursor with its text lagging slightly behind the body, so the whole thing reads as stretched toward the pointer
interaction_model.input: Pointer travelling inside a marked circle
interaction_model.affected_object: The example inside that circle, body and trailing text layers

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Re-entering mid-return immediately redirects the element toward the pointer again with no visible jump or restart
interaction_model.state_change: Element transitions from pointer-following to returning to its parked centre
interaction_model.visible_feedback: It eases back to the middle and overshoots with a springy settle
interaction_model.input: Pointer withdrawn from the circle
interaction_model.affected_object: The example that was being followed

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Re-entry at any point in this cycle takes over and resumes pointer following; displacement remains bounded by the circle throughout
interaction_model.state_change: Element snaps discontinuously to the centre, is pulled back out, then drifts home again
interaction_model.visible_feedback: A visible jump to the middle, a yank back outward, then a slow creep home — clearly unlike the smooth springy settle of the others
interaction_model.input: Pointer withdrawn from the deliberately unresolved example's circle
interaction_model.affected_object: That single contrasting example

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Withdrawal hands off to the snap-and-return cycle rather than a clean settle
interaction_model.state_change: Element trails behind the pointer instead of settling toward it
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Perceptible lag between cursor and element, reading as unresolved or contested motion
interaction_model.input: Pointer following this contrasting example while inside its circle
interaction_model.affected_object: That example

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Pointer entry takes precedence over idle motion; idle motion resumes once the element is parked again
interaction_model.state_change: Idle restless motion continues autonomously
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Small persistent movement at the parked position that draws the eye
interaction_model.input: No input for a period
interaction_model.affected_object: A subset of the examples

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Closed by its own dismiss control or by clicking the receded area around it; the board underneath is unchanged and examples resume from their parked state
interaction_model.state_change: Rule snippet surface opens over the board, surroundings drop in luminance contrast
interaction_model.visible_feedback: A readable snippet of the governing rule appears in the foreground with the board visibly receded behind it
interaction_model.input: Activating the small code marker beside an example
interaction_model.affected_object: That example's rule

experience_qualities: Elastic and grabbable — elements feel physically pulled toward the cursor
Restless rather than inert, even untouched
Legible by feel: differences register as sensation before explanation
Deliberately imperfect in one place, so the contrast is felt as wrongness rather than variety
Bounded and safe — nothing can be dragged out of place or broken
Instrument-like and compact, closer to a bench of specimens than a page of content
completion_and_return: Every follow cycle completes by returning the element to its parked centre
Interrupted returns are absorbed rather than restarted, leaving no residual displacement
The board loops indefinitely and holds no accumulated state between samples
Dismissing a rule snippet returns to the board exactly as it was
locked_observable_requirements: Several peer examples of the same object, each inside its own visibly marked circular catch area, on one compact screen whose ground stays uniform and low-distraction behind them
A terse per-example caption naming the rule that example follows, plus a framing question above the set
Pointer presence inside a circle makes the example follow the cursor with its text trailing behind its body
Withdrawal produces an eased return to centre with springy overshoot for the well-behaved examples
At least one example deliberately breaks that pattern with lag while followed, a discontinuous snap to centre, an outward yank and a slow creep home
Displacement is always bounded by the enclosing circle
Re-entry during a return redirects motion immediately with no visible jump or restart
Some examples idle with autonomous restless motion at rest
Each example's rule can be opened as a readable snippet and dismissed by its own control or by clicking the receded surrounding area, without disturbing the board
adaptable_details: Exact number of examples, as long as several contrasting variants sit side by side
Hues, marker styling and circle size, provided the ground stays uniform and low-distraction with clear luminance separation from the elements and equal treatment of every example
Wording of the framing question and captions
Easing curves, overshoot magnitude, lag amount and creep duration
Which examples idle and how the idle motion is shaped
Presentation of the rule snippet surface and its dismiss control
The kind of simple object used as the specimen
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits small, dense sets of contrasting behavioral variants of one simple interactive object, each needing a short label and an inspectable rule, placed as a self-contained explainer or documentation board; a single catch area with its magnetic follow and springy return can also ship alone as a focal element in a hero or feature slot. Removing pointer-driven following, removing the bounded marked catch area, or expanding the set into a long scrolling gallery of unrelated content produces a different Skill.

name: pointer_following_magnifying_icon_strip
description: A slim translucent icon strip along the lower edge where the icon nearest the pointer swells upward out of the strip and neighbours shrink and slide aside in a smoothly travelling bulge, settling flat when the pointer leaves.

canonical_document.name: pointer_following_magnifying_icon_strip
canonical_document.description: A slim translucent icon strip along the lower edge where the icon nearest the pointer swells upward out of the strip and neighbours shrink and slide aside in a smoothly travelling bulge, settling flat when the pointer leaves.
canonical_document.experience_scope: A persistent region experience occupying a narrow horizontal band at the lower edge of the view, overlaying whatever content sits behind it; it begins when the pointer approaches or enters the strip and ends when the pointer leaves and every icon has eased back to rest. A small handful of equally sized shortcut icons (roughly 4-8) laid out in a single row with uniform spacing in the resting state
Each icon is an independent selectable target with a single compact glyph or symbol identity
The strip is anchored to the lower edge and persists across the view; icon order is fixed and stable

At rest no icon claims attention; the strip reads as a single quiet element and yields visual priority to the content behind it

interaction_model.state_change: A single continuous emphasis peak is positioned at the pointer, with magnitude falling off with distance on each side

interaction_model.visible_feedback: The bulge smoothly redirects and catches up to the new position instead of snapping or jumping; icons never flicker between sizes
interaction_model.input: Reversing direction or moving the pointer abruptly/erratically
interaction_model.affected_object: The travelling emphasis peak and the icon sizes and offsets composing it

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Re-entering during the settle animation resumes magnification from the current state rather than restarting from flat
interaction_model.state_change: Emphasis peak dissolves and the row returns to the uniform resting state
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Every icon eases back to its resting size and original position together; the strip flattens into a calm even row

interaction_model.affected_object: All icons in the strip

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Selection does not disturb the strip's resting geometry; the magnification state continues to be governed by pointer position
interaction_model.state_change: The icon is chosen while the strip retains its magnified shape under the pointer
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The enlarged icon reads unmistakably as the committed target at the moment of selection
interaction_model.input: Selecting the icon currently in focus
interaction_model.affected_object: The focused icon

experience_qualities: Quiet and unobtrusive at rest, translucent and deferential to whatever lies behind
Lively and playful in motion without feeling fussy or noisy
Continuous and fluid rather than stepped or snapping
Physically believable: icons appear to make room for one another
Legible: the intended target is never ambiguous
completion_and_return: No terminal completion state - the experience is a reversible response to attention
Always returns to the same uniform, evenly spaced resting row when attention leaves
No emphasis state persists after departure; the strip carries no memory of the last focused icon
locked_observable_requirements: The strip remains a slim, visually subordinate translucent band anchored along one edge and does not compete with the content behind it
Exactly one emphasis peak exists at a time, located at the pointer's position
Emphasis falls off progressively across neighbouring icons on both sides rather than applying to one icon alone
The focused icon grows outward away from the anchored edge, extending beyond the strip's band
Neighbouring icons displace outward along the strip to make room instead of overlapping or reordering
The bulge tracks the pointer continuously; direction reversals and jerky movement retarget smoothly with no snapping
Leaving the strip eases every icon back to uniform resting size and position
adaptable_details: Number of icons and their symbols or glyph style
Exact magnification ratio, falloff width and easing timing
Degree of translucency, strip thickness, corner treatment and any subtle separators
Which edge the strip is anchored to and whether the row is horizontal or vertical, provided growth is away from that edge
Whether labels or tooltips accompany the focused icon
Colour treatment, contrast level and any supplementary emphasis such as subtle lift or glow on the focused icon
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits small, fixed sets of compact equally weighted icon targets in a persistent edge-anchored band overlaying other content, where every item is visible at once and a single focused target must be readable at a glance. It stops fitting when the set is long enough to scroll or wrap, when items carry substantial text or thumbnails whose layout cannot be locally displaced, or when the strip must hold its own visual weight as a primary content surface. Replacing the continuous pointer-tracked falloff with discrete per-item hover states, or having the focused item grow in place without neighbours yielding, produces a different skill.
