canonical_document.description: A single-line run of equal icons in which the pointed-at icon swells and names itself above, neighbours grow by decreasing amounts and are pushed apart, and the whole bulge slides along with the pointer before springing back to uniform rest.
canonical_document.experience_scope: A self-contained region occupying one line of icons; it begins when the pointer enters any icon in the run and ends when the pointer leaves the run and every icon has settled back to its resting size. It is not a whole-view experience and it never overlays or reorganises surrounding page content beyond the label rising just above the focused icon.
content_and_composition: One run of many small symbolic shortcut items, all identical in size, spacing and visual weight at rest, arranged along a single axis in a fixed order
Each item carries a short human-readable name that is hidden at rest and shown only while that item is the focal one
The focal item's name appears immediately outside the run on the side away from the content, just beyond the enlarged symbol, and is tied positionally to that item
At most one focal item exists at any moment; neighbours form a symmetric size gradient outward from it on both sides
The run itself is a persistent element: it remains present, in the same place and same order, before, during and after the effect
Total run extent is not fixed: enlarged items displace their outer neighbours along the axis so the run visibly widens around the focal point
experience_progression: Resting state: all items equal, unlabelled, evenly weighted, nothing competing for attention
Focus arrival: the pointed-at item scales up to a peak while its name fades in, and successive neighbours scale up by decreasing amounts, forming a graded bulge

Focus travel: as the pointer moves to an adjacent item the peak transfers to the new item, the previous peak relaxes into the gradient, the outgoing name fades out and the incoming name fades in, so the bulge slides continuously and nothing stays enlarged behind
Edge state: when the focal item is at or near either end of the run, the gradient exists only on the inward side and the bulge is one-sided
Release: on leaving the run every item eases back to equal size, spacing closes, and all names fade out, returning to the resting state
attention_and_information_flow: At rest no item claims attention; prominence is deliberately flat so the run can be scanned as a whole
During focus exactly one item is the unambiguous centre of attention, established by both greatest size and the presence of its name
Identity information is revealed strictly on demand and strictly for the focal item, so recognition replaces guessing from the symbol alone without cluttering the run with labels
The decreasing neighbour sizes give a directional read of where attention currently sits and which items are adjacent, providing peripheral context for the focal choice
Prominence is exclusive and transient: transferring focus removes it entirely from the previous item, and leaving removes it from the run

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: The effect is purely transient and reversible; removing the pointer at any time, including mid-growth, eases the run back toward rest without a stuck enlarged item
interaction_model.state_change: That item becomes the single focal item; neighbour items enter graded intermediate states by distance; the run's occupied extent grows
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The item swells to its peak size and its name fades in just above it; the immediate neighbours grow less, the next ones out less again, and outer items are pushed apart so the run bulges around the pointer
interaction_model.input: Pointer moves onto an item in the run
interaction_model.affected_object: The pointed-at item, its ordered neighbours and its hidden name

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Continuous travel is interruptible and re-enterable at any speed or direction; reversing direction simply carries the bulge back, and a new target is always adopted from whatever state the run is currently in
interaction_model.state_change: Peak status transfers to the newly pointed item and the previous peak demotes into the gradient; the visible name switches
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The bulge travels with the pointer as one continuous deformation, the previous item shrinks back with nothing left enlarged behind it, and the previous name fades out as the new one fades in
interaction_model.input: Pointer slides along the run to the next item
interaction_model.affected_object: The whole gradient of item sizes and the visible name

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Re-entering the run mid-settle picks up the effect from the current sizes rather than snapping, so no reset flash occurs
interaction_model.state_change: No focal item exists; all sizes and spacings converge to the uniform resting configuration
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Everything eases back to equal size, the run narrows to its resting extent, and names fade out, leaving the calm scannable resting state
interaction_model.input: Pointer moves away from the run
interaction_model.affected_object: Every item in the run and all names

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: End items behave as ordinary focal items in every other respect, so travel into and out of the ends is continuous
interaction_model.state_change: The gradient is truncated where there are no further items
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The bulge is simply one-sided, growing inward only, with no artificial padding, wrap-around or shifting of the run to fake symmetry
interaction_model.input: Pointer focuses an item at or near either end of the run
interaction_model.affected_object: The gradient on the missing side

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Magnification and displacement never move an item out from under the pointer in a way that loses the activation, and the visual state continues to follow the pointer afterwards
interaction_model.state_change: The item performs its shortcut action; its focal appearance is unaffected by being activated
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The item remains an ordinary activatable shortcut with an unobstructed hit target throughout growth, travel and settling
interaction_model.input: Item is clicked or activated while enlarged
interaction_model.affected_object: The focal shortcut item

experience_qualities: Calm and evenly weighted at rest, with nothing competing for attention
Certain identification: the focal item is unmistakable and explicitly named rather than inferred
Soft, springy physicality, as if the run were an elastic strip deforming under the pointer
Continuous and pointer-tracking rather than stepped or snapping
Exclusive focus: never two centres of attention, never a leftover enlarged item
Compact and unobtrusive, with revealed information limited to the moment of attention
completion_and_return: There is no completion or end state to reach; the experience is a reversible excursion from a stable resting state
Leaving the run always returns it to the identical uniform resting configuration, with no residual enlargement, displacement or visible name
No state persists between visits: the run is always ready to be scanned again from the same quiet baseline
Repeated entry, travel and exit can occur indefinitely without accumulating drift in size, spacing or order
locked_observable_requirements: At rest all items are visually equal in size and weight with no names shown
Exactly one item is at peak emphasis at any moment while the pointer is in the run
Neighbour emphasis decreases monotonically with distance from the focal item, on both sides when both exist
The focal item's short name is revealed adjacent to it and only while it is focal, fading in and out rather than appearing abruptly
Enlargement displaces outer items along the axis so the run visibly bulges and spreads rather than items overlapping or staying in fixed slots
Moving to an adjacent item carries the bulge with it and leaves nothing enlarged behind
Near the ends the gradient is one-sided with no compensation or wrap-around
Leaving the run eases everything back to the uniform resting state and fades all names out
Motion is soft and springy and continuously follows the pointer, not stepwise
Items remain activatable shortcuts throughout every state
adaptable_details: Number of items in the run
Orientation of the single axis and which side the name appears on
Visual style of the symbols and of the run's container or backdrop
Peak magnification amount, how many neighbours are affected and the steepness of the falloff
Spring softness, settle duration and fade timing of the names
Label typography and whether the name sits in a plain or plated form
Resting size, spacing and overall footprint of the run
What each shortcut does when activated
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits any compact single-axis run of uniformly sized, symbol-only or near-symbol items with short identifying names that are not worth showing permanently, sitting as a persistent secondary region beside primary content. It stops being this Skill if items carry always-visible labels or substantial text, if the set wraps into a multi-row grid or scrolls under the pointer, if items are heterogeneous in size, if more than one item can be emphasised at once, or if the emphasis becomes a discrete selected state that persists after the pointer leaves instead of a transient pointer-tracking bulge.

name: retreating_wordmark_over_a_spacious_long_read
description: A sparse full-height reading descent under a small fixed mark that ducks away with a different playful gesture each time a passage reaches it and returns intact once the passage has passed.

canonical_document.name: retreating_wordmark_over_a_spacious_long_read
canonical_document.description: A sparse full-height reading descent under a small fixed mark that ducks away with a different playful gesture each time a passage reaches it and returns intact once the passage has passed.
canonical_document.experience_scope: Whole-view experience for one continuous scrolling read: begins at the full-height opening passage with the mark plainly legible and ends at a short closing credit, with the mark present and reactive across the entire scroll range.
content_and_composition: One small persistent mark fixed at a constant on-screen resting position, always in the top visual layer above the reading content
One full-height opening passage that fills the first screen and establishes the reading rhythm
A sequence of widely spaced text passages, each a distinct full-width block separated by large empty gaps
Exactly one oversized statement line used as the single typographic peak of the read
Exactly one broad full-width image as the only pictorial element
One short closing credit line that terminates the read
Only two layers: the scrolling reading column and the fixed mark above it; no persistent chrome, panels or navigation competing with either
experience_progression: Opens on the full-height first passage with the mark fully legible and undisturbed
Descends through the widely spaced passages, each arrival and departure producing one retreat-and-return cycle of the mark
Passes the single oversized statement line as the emphasis crest of the read
Passes the single broad image as the one visual pause
Settles on the short closing credit, mark intact, ending the read
Scrolling back upward retraces the identical sequence of cycles in reverse rather than starting a new progression
attention_and_information_flow: Words hold primary prominence throughout; the mark never grows, never captures the reading gaze and never overlaps live text
Wide spacing gives each passage the screen alone, so attention advances one block at a time
The mark's retreats are peripheral events: noticed as personality, not as content, and never carrying information the reader must act on
Varied retreat characters make the mark read as aware of what it meets, adding intermittent lightness without displacing the text
The oversized statement line briefly takes prominence from the body passages; the broad image briefly takes it from words entirely, then attention returns to reading

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Continuing or reversing the scroll immediately governs the mark; any exit already running can be cut short by the next threshold crossing
interaction_model.state_change: Mark goes from resting and whole to retreated and out of the reader's way
interaction_model.visible_feedback: A short exit performance with a distinct character - light, quick, good-humoured - rather than a plain fade or hide
interaction_model.input: Downward scroll bringing a passage up to the mark's resting height
interaction_model.affected_object: The small persistent mark

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: The whole resting state is the guaranteed settling state; a return interrupted mid-way still ends whole
interaction_model.state_change: Mark goes from retreated back to resting and fully whole
interaction_model.visible_feedback: A return performance that reassembles the mark completely, with no residue of the retreat left behind
interaction_model.input: Continued downward scroll until that passage's lower edge has cleared above the mark
interaction_model.affected_object: The small persistent mark

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Direction can reverse at any point, including mid-performance, and the mark follows the newest crossing
interaction_model.state_change: Exit state re-enters on re-crossing; return state re-enters on leaving again
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The same retreat-and-return behaviour as descending, mirrored exactly, so backtracking feels identical to reading forward
interaction_model.input: Upward scroll re-entering a passage the reader already passed
interaction_model.affected_object: The small persistent mark

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Latest crossing always wins; the terminal state after motion stops is a complete, unbroken mark
interaction_model.state_change: Any motion still running is cancelled in favour of the newest one
interaction_model.visible_feedback: No stacking, stuttering or half-drawn mark; motion re-aims and the mark still comes to rest perfectly intact
interaction_model.input: Fast, flung or jittery scrolling across several thresholds at once
interaction_model.affected_object: The mark's in-flight motion

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Current reading position and mark state stay coherent after resize; no reload or scroll nudge needed to restore correct behaviour
interaction_model.state_change: Thresholds are re-matched to the mark's real on-screen position
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Retreats keep triggering exactly as passages meet the mark, with no drift, early firing or mark stuck retreated
interaction_model.input: Window resize during the read
interaction_model.affected_object: The retreat and return switch points relative to the mark

experience_qualities: Words-first, calm and unhurried
Spacious, with emptiness doing much of the pacing
Playful and personable in the mark's behaviour, never loud
Aware rather than switched off: the mark seems to respond to what arrives
Reliable and self-repairing under rough scrolling
Symmetrical: reading back up feels the same as reading down
completion_and_return: The read completes at the short closing credit with the mark resting and whole
No looping; the experience is a single bidirectional descent that can be retraced at will
Every retreat cycle completes by restoring the mark fully, so the mark's resting state is the persistent default between cycles
Returning upward restores earlier cycles rather than leaving consumed states behind
locked_observable_requirements: A small mark stays at a fixed on-screen position for the entire read
The mark retreats when a passage reaches its resting height and returns once that passage has fully passed
Retreats are multiple visibly different characterful performances, not one repeated hide or opacity toggle
Every cycle ends with the mark completely intact; a partial, broken or missing mark is never a settled state
Reverse scrolling mirrors the behaviour exactly, re-running the exit on re-entry and the return on leaving
Interrupted motion is cancelled in favour of the newest crossing instead of queuing
Switch points remain tied to the mark's actual position across viewport size changes
The reading column stays sparse: full-height opening passage, widely spaced passages, one oversized statement line, one broad image, one closing credit
adaptable_details: The specific choreography and count of retreat gestures
The mark's content and form: wordmark, monogram, small emblem or short label
The mark's corner or edge placement and its size within small scale
Number and length of passages, typeface, colour palette and gap sizes
Timing and easing of exits and returns
Subject matter of the words and the image
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits text-led scrolling pages built from a few distinct, widely separated full-width blocks that pass beneath a small fixed overlay element, where low density lets each retreat be noticed as personality. Dense grids, feeds or multi-column layouts leave no clean crossing moments and break the effect. It becomes a different Skill if the mark expands into navigation or a menu, if it reacts to pointer position or time instead of block crossings, if it permanently transforms rather than returning whole, or if it carries state or information the reader must interpret.

source_sites.title: Exploring Playful Context-Aware Animations for Fixed Elements

name: block_assembling_cursor_glossary_panel
description: Hovering a marked word in the text materializes a compact explanation panel at the cursor out of small blocks filling in, its name and definition arriving a beat after the frame; the panel follows the pointer, flips sides to stay on screen, and un-builds in reverse when the pointer leaves.

canonical_document.name: block_assembling_cursor_glossary_panel
canonical_document.description: Hovering a marked word in the text materializes a compact explanation panel at the cursor out of small blocks filling in, its name and definition arriving a beat after the frame; the panel follows the pointer, flips sides to stay on screen, and un-builds in reverse when the pointer leaves.
canonical_document.experience_scope: Region-level, transient overlay experience local to marked terms inside a body of text; begins when the pointer enters a marked term and ends when the panel has fully un-built after the pointer leaves. The underlying text view is otherwise untouched.
content_and_composition: Marked terms distributed inline within running text, visually distinguished so they read as plainly inspectable before any interaction
One transient panel at a time, positioned adjacent to the pointer and offset so it does not sit under the cursor
Panel content: a short term label and a compact definition body, both sized for a quick read rather than extended study
Panel is composed of small discrete blocks or cells that form its surface
Panel floats above the text layer while the text beneath remains fully visible in the surrounding area and fully interactive
experience_progression: Marked terms sit dormant and legibly flagged within the text
Pointer enters a term: the panel's block surface begins filling in progressively at the cursor
Shortly after the surface establishes, the term label and definition arrive as a second beat
Panel remains readable and tracks the pointer while it stays within the term
Pointer leaves the term: the block fill plays in reverse until nothing remains
Text returns to its dormant flagged state
attention_and_information_flow: Explanation appears exactly where the reader is already looking, so no gaze relocation or scroll is required
Structure arrives before content: the assembling frame signals that an answer is coming, then the words land
Only one explanation is ever prominent, so attention is never split between competing panels
On withdrawal, prominence returns entirely to the text and the reader's reading position is preserved

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Leaving the term at any point during assembly reverses the build from its current state rather than completing first
interaction_model.state_change: Absent to assembling to fully present
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Small blocks progressively fill in at the cursor to form the panel surface, then the term name and meaning appear a beat later
interaction_model.input: Pointer enters a marked term
interaction_model.affected_object: Transient explanation panel

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Tracking is continuous and interruption-free; content stays stable while position updates
interaction_model.state_change: Panel anchor follows the pointer continuously
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The panel tracks alongside the moving cursor without rebuilding or flickering
interaction_model.input: Pointer drifts while remaining over the same term
interaction_model.affected_object: Position of the present panel

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Flipping is automatic and reversible as the pointer moves back; the panel never spills past the viewport
interaction_model.state_change: Panel flips to the opposite side of the cursor
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The panel jumps to the other side of the pointer and remains fully on screen instead of being clipped
interaction_model.input: Pointer approaches a viewport edge so the panel would overflow
interaction_model.affected_object: Panel placement relative to the cursor

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Re-entering the term during the reverse build resumes forward assembly from the current state rather than starting over
interaction_model.state_change: Present to un-building to absent
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The block fill plays in reverse until the panel is entirely gone
interaction_model.input: Pointer leaves the marked term
interaction_model.affected_object: Present explanation panel

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Late or superseded transitions are abandoned in favor of the current pointer position
interaction_model.state_change: Converges to a single settled state — one panel or none
interaction_model.visible_feedback: No stacking, duplication or lingering leftovers; the overlay resolves cleanly to a single outcome
interaction_model.input: Rapid repeated in-and-out passes across one or several marked terms
interaction_model.affected_object: Panel presence and count

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: The panel never captures the pointer or intercepts interaction with the content it floats over
interaction_model.state_change: Selection and click behavior proceed unimpeded
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Text highlights and responds normally even where the panel visually overlaps it
interaction_model.input: Reader selects or clicks the text beneath the panel
interaction_model.affected_object: Underlying text

experience_qualities: Assembled and machine-built rather than smoothly faded in
Anticipatory, with structure arriving before meaning
Compact and immediately readable
Pointer-obedient and unusually settled under erratic movement
Non-intrusive; it never costs the reader their place or their grip on the text
completion_and_return: No persistent state: every appearance is transient and fully reverses
Withdrawal always returns the view to its exact pre-hover appearance
Repeatable indefinitely across any marked term with identical behavior
locked_observable_requirements: Marked terms are visibly distinguishable as inspectable before interaction
Panel appears at the cursor rather than at a fixed page location
Panel materializes through progressive small-block fill, not a plain fade or scale
Term name and meaning arrive noticeably after the panel surface establishes
Panel continuously tracks pointer movement within the term
Panel flips to the cursor's opposite side rather than being clipped by the viewport
Dismissal is the fill animation played in reverse to nothing
At most one panel exists at any moment; rapid entry and exit settles cleanly
Underlying text remains selectable and clickable through the panel's area
adaptable_details: Block size, grain and fill order of the assembly
Assembly duration and the length of the delay before content arrives
Panel dimensions, palette and border treatment
How marked terms are visually flagged
Cursor offset distance and the edge threshold that triggers flipping
Length and structure of the definition text
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits any running text containing short, marked, look-up-able items whose explanation is brief enough to read at a glance in place. Requires pointer hover as the driver. Making the panel persistent, click-latched, scrollable, richly interactive, or large enough to become the reader's primary focus would create a different Skill (a detail pane or modal) rather than a transient in-place reveal.

name: trailing_glass_magnifier_cursor
description: A thick glass lens that trails the pointer with a slight lag and eases to a stop where it rests, magnifying and bending the content beneath it with faint colour fringing while never blocking clicks or text selection.

canonical_document.name: trailing_glass_magnifier_cursor
canonical_document.description: A thick glass lens that trails the pointer with a slight lag and eases to a stop where it rests, magnifying and bending the content beneath it with faint colour fringing while never blocking clicks or text selection.
canonical_document.experience_scope: A whole-view overlay layer that sits above all page content; it becomes active wherever the pointer moves within the view and stops being present when the pointer leaves. It is not tied to any single element or region and adds no chrome of its own.
content_and_composition: One lens shape as the only added visual object, drawn above every other layer
The page's own content beneath the lens is the entire subject: headline, large photos and short text passages all magnified alike
No frame, label, handle or control belongs to the lens; it is a bare optical object
Persistent presence across the whole view rather than per-element hotspots
attention_and_information_flow: The lens creates a single moving point of local focus that follows the user's own pointing
Detail under the lens is enlarged and revealed while everything outside it stays exactly as composed
Bending and faint colour fringing at the lens edge mark its boundary without hiding surrounding content
Prominence follows intent: whatever the user is already looking toward becomes the magnified subject

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Direction changes are followed immediately from the lens's current position; no queued or catch-up jump occurs
interaction_model.state_change: Lens position chases the pointer position with a slight lag rather than locking to it
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The lens visibly trails behind the pointer, sweeping magnification and bending across whatever it passes over
interaction_model.input: Pointer movement anywhere in the view
interaction_model.affected_object: The lens overlay

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Any new pointer movement resumes trailing from the settled position
interaction_model.state_change: Lens eases to a stop centred where the pointer rests
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Motion settles smoothly with no snap or overshoot, leaving a steady magnified view of that spot
interaction_model.input: Pointer coming to rest
interaction_model.affected_object: The lens overlay

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: The lens never intercepts or swallows input, so nothing needs to be dismissed to use the page
interaction_model.state_change: Input passes straight through the lens to the content beneath
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Links, buttons and text selection behave normally while the lens remains visible over them
interaction_model.input: Clicking, dragging to select text, or interacting with anything under the lens
interaction_model.affected_object: Underlying page content

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Re-entering with the pointer restores the lens without any residual distortion left behind
interaction_model.state_change: Lens ceases to be present over the content
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Content returns to its plain undistorted appearance
interaction_model.input: Pointer leaving the view
interaction_model.affected_object: The lens overlay

experience_qualities: Thick and weighty rather than thin or crisp
Calm, slightly lagging motion that feels dragged rather than snapped
Optically physical: real magnification and bending, not a tint or highlight
Playful and tactile yet unobtrusive to reading and clicking
completion_and_return: No completion state; the lens simply settles wherever the pointer stops
Leaves no persistent change to the content it passed over
Nothing to reset or dismiss between uses
locked_observable_requirements: The lens follows the pointer with a visible lag and eases to rest instead of tracking rigidly
Content under the lens is genuinely magnified and geometrically bent, not merely highlighted
Faint colour fringing appears in the lensed area as optical dispersion, with no particular hues required
The lens never intercepts clicks or text selection under it
The effect applies to whatever content sits beneath it, images and text alike, rather than to designated targets
The lens reads as thick glass, giving it visible weight
adaptable_details: Lens size and outline shape
Magnification strength and amount of bending
Intensity and hue pairing of the colour fringing
Amount of lag and the easing character of the stop
Whether an alternate pointerless presentation is offered on touch input
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits any view whose content rewards close inspection and whose composition should stay readable and clickable beneath the overlay, especially image-and-text feature pages. Constraining the lens to a fixed frame, requiring a click to activate or pin it, or letting it capture input and become a modal zoom tool would make it a different skill.

name: elastic_tapering_pointer_ribbon
description: A single soft ribbon that tapers to a point and trails the pointer with springy lag, whipping into loops on fast curves, straightening when slow, overshooting on sharp reversals, and coiling to rest at the last position when movement stops.

canonical_document.name: elastic_tapering_pointer_ribbon
canonical_document.description: A single soft ribbon that tapers to a point and trails the pointer with springy lag, whipping into loops on fast curves, straightening when slow, overshooting on sharp reversals, and coiling to rest at the last position when movement stops.
canonical_document.experience_scope: Whole-view region-free experience covering the entire window: it begins as soon as the pointer moves anywhere in the view and remains available continuously; there is no entry step, no end state, and no separate panel or container.
content_and_composition: Calm empty field as the sole backdrop: no text, no controls, no items to choose
Exactly one trailing ribbon following the pointer, drawn as a continuous soft line
Ribbon has a tapering profile: fuller near the trailing body and thinning toward its end
Leading tip visually anchored near, but lagging behind, the actual pointer position
Full-window active area, with no interior boundaries, zones or edges where the effect changes
Nothing accumulates: the ribbon is a single transient body, not a growing drawing or history of past strokes
attention_and_information_flow: Emptiness of the field removes all competing focal points so the ribbon is the only thing to look at
Attention rides the pointer: the eye follows the lagging tip and the shape it leaves behind
Faster or sharper gestures raise visual complexity and prominence; slow gestures reduce it to a simple line
When movement stops, prominence decays as the ribbon shortens and coils, returning the field to near-blank calm
Effect must be legible and understandable within roughly a second of first movement, with no explanation

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Continuous and always available; stopping simply lets the ribbon settle, and moving again immediately resumes following
interaction_model.state_change: Ribbon follows the pointer path with a delay, its leading tip lagging behind the current position
interaction_model.visible_feedback: A smooth continuous line pulled along behind the pointer, tapering toward its end
interaction_model.input: Pointer moved at moderate speed anywhere in the window
interaction_model.affected_object: Trailing ribbon following the pointer

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Loops relax on their own as movement slows; no clearing action is needed or offered
interaction_model.state_change: Accumulated lag lets the body fold over itself into curls
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Ribbon whips into loops and curls that briefly hold their shape before easing out
interaction_model.input: Quick curving or looping pointer movement
interaction_model.affected_object: Ribbon body shape

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Reversible at any time by moving faster again
interaction_model.state_change: Lag shrinks and curvature drains out of the body
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Ribbon straightens into a simple trailing line close behind the pointer
interaction_model.input: Slow, gentle pointer movement
interaction_model.affected_object: Ribbon body shape

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Overshoot always resolves back toward the pointer; repeated reversals simply keep it swinging without breaking or tangling permanently
interaction_model.state_change: Elastic overshoot past the turn point followed by a swing back
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The line carries beyond the reversal and swings back into line rather than snapping instantly to the new direction
interaction_model.input: Sharp reversal of pointer direction
interaction_model.affected_object: Ribbon tip and body

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Any new movement resumes the trail immediately from rest; no gesture is ever lost or unrecoverable
interaction_model.state_change: Motion decelerates and the body gathers at the last pointer position
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Tail slows and coils in at the resting point, easing everything back toward rest
interaction_model.input: Pointer movement stops
interaction_model.affected_object: Ribbon tail

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Lifting the finger behaves like stopping movement: the tail decelerates and coils to rest
interaction_model.state_change: Drag position drives the ribbon exactly as a pointer does
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Identical trailing, looping, straightening and coiling behavior under touch
interaction_model.input: Finger dragged across a touch screen
interaction_model.affected_object: Trailing ribbon

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Ongoing motion continues without needing to be restarted
interaction_model.state_change: Active area re-matches the new window dimensions
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The full window stays responsive with no dead margins or clipped region
interaction_model.input: Window resized
interaction_model.affected_object: Active play field

experience_qualities: Calm and uncluttered: nothing to read, nothing to decide
Elastic and weighty rather than mechanical or instantaneous
Immediately understandable within about a second
Playful and fiddle-worthy, rewarding repeated aimless gestures
Soft and fluid, with easing rather than snapping
Consequence-free: nothing builds up, nothing needs clearing
completion_and_return: No completion state and no goal; the experience is open-ended
Pauses in play resolve automatically to a rest state at the last pointer position
Rest state is visually equivalent to the starting calm field, ready to begin again
No persistent marks, score, history or accumulated state across gestures
locked_observable_requirements: Exactly one trailing body follows the pointer — not multiple trails, particles or scattered marks
The trailing body tapers, thinning toward its end
Leading tip lags behind the true pointer position rather than tracking it exactly

Repeated activation during either direction is ignored, guaranteeing the region always completes to one of the two resting states
The reading passage persists across the whole cycle and returns to its full resting luminance on close
locked_observable_requirements: A single word stands vertically on a narrow side strip and is the only visible stand-in for the destinations while closed
Each standing letter becomes the first letter of one destination name and keeps its vertical slot through the change
Letters tumble downward through a short run of unrelated letters before settling
The remaining letters of each name sweep in from the right in a quick top-to-bottom cascade
Destination count equals the letter count of the resting word
The strip widens into a full panel as part of the same change
The icon control's bars become a cross in the open state
The primary reading content steps down in luminance but stays legible behind the open panel
Names accept pointing and clicking only once fully revealed, and take on a distinct accent treatment under the pointer, with no particular hue required
Re-activating the control runs the entire change backwards to the single vertical word
Inputs during either transition are ignored so the region can never rest half-open
adaptable_details: The specific resting word and the specific destination names
Number of destinations, as long as it matches the resting word's letter count
Which side edge of the view carries the strip
The accent hue, the typeface, and the size of the luminance step applied to the background content
Exact tumble length, cascade speed and panel-widening duration
Icon glyph styling for the bars and cross states
The kind of long-form foreground content behind the panel
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits single-view or one-page sites whose foreground is a single block of continuous reading content and whose destination set is small enough that its names can be keyed to the letters of one short word. It fails where destinations are numerous, hierarchical, dynamically counted, or cannot be aligned to a fixed letter count, and where the background content must be fully replaced rather than dimmed and kept in view. Replacing the letter-level tumble-and-cascade resolution with a sliding, fading or unfolding panel, or letting the region rest partially open, produces a different Skill.

name: gliding_focus_marker_with_self_drawing_confirmations
description: One compact centered form in which a small accent marker glides to the left edge of whichever field has attention, overshooting and settling with a soft curved streak behind it, while a tick strokes itself in beside each field the instant its contents become acceptable and the marker swells to acknowledge it.

canonical_document.name: gliding_focus_marker_with_self_drawing_confirmations
canonical_document.description: One compact centered form in which a small accent marker glides to the left edge of whichever field has attention, overshooting and settling with a soft curved streak behind it, while a tick strokes itself in beside each field the instant its contents become acceptable and the marker swells to acknowledge it.
canonical_document.experience_scope: Region experience confined to a single compact form block and its immediate left and right margins on an otherwise calm, low-distraction page; it begins when a field first receives attention and continues for as long as the person is working within the form, ending at the closing submit action at the bottom.
content_and_composition: One compact form column centered on a clean, low-distraction surface, with generous quiet space around it and no competing foreground content
A short vertical stack of a few single-line entry fields, each with its own label and each judged acceptable or not on its own
One closing submit action as the last item in the stack, terminating the downward reading order
Exactly one small marker in a distinct accent that separates clearly from the surface and the field text, persistent for the whole form, positioned at the left edge of the currently attended field
A transient soft curved streak that trails the marker along its travel path and fades away after it settles
One confirmation glyph slot beside each field on the side opposite the marker, empty until that field's contents are acceptable
Marker, streak and glyphs read as an unobtrusive overlay layer around the fields and never intercept pointing or typing
experience_progression: Form at rest: no field emphasized, marker in a neutral resting position and size, no confirmation glyphs shown
Attention enters a field: marker travels to that field, overshoots slightly, recoils and settles, streak trails and fades
Characters are typed: at the moment contents become acceptable, that field's tick strokes itself in and the marker swells
Attention moves down to the next field: marker travels again from its current place, leaving already-confirmed ticks in place
All fields confirmed: the stack shows a column of settled ticks and attention arrives at the closing submit action
attention_and_information_flow: Only one field is emphasized at any moment, and the emphasis is carried by the marker's position rather than by any hard rectangle drawn around the field
The marker's travel and trailing streak momentarily reveal the direction of movement, so the person sees where attention came from and where it now rests
Acceptance information is revealed per field, at the exact moment it becomes true, next to the field it describes rather than in a separate summary area
Confirmed fields keep their quiet ticks so the eye can see remaining work without re-reading contents
Prominence drifts steadily downward through the stack toward the closing action

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: A new target reached mid-flight retargets the same marker without restarting from the top of the form; when attention leaves the form entirely the marker returns to its neutral resting position and size; the marker and streak never block clicks or typing on the fields beneath them
interaction_model.state_change: Marker moves from its previous anchor to the newly attended field's left edge and becomes that field's emphasis
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Marker glides along the path, overshoots the target and recoils briefly before settling, with a soft curved streak following its route and fading out; no outline appears around the field itself
interaction_model.input: Pointing at a field or stepping into it with the keyboard
interaction_model.affected_object: The single traveling marker and its trailing streak

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Deleting back to unacceptable contents withdraws the tick again; the transition can be crossed back and forth any number of times without accumulating leftovers
interaction_model.state_change: Slot goes from empty to confirmed at the instant acceptability is reached
interaction_model.visible_feedback: A tick strokes itself in beside the field as if being drawn, then remains
interaction_model.input: Typing characters until a field's contents become acceptable
interaction_model.affected_object: That field's confirmation glyph slot

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Returning the field to unacceptable contents returns the marker to its resting size; the marker keeps its anchor throughout and does not move during the size change
interaction_model.state_change: Marker grows from resting size to a swollen size in place
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Marker briefly swells beside the field being confirmed, tying the acknowledgement to the place attention already rests
interaction_model.input: The same moment a field's contents become acceptable
interaction_model.affected_object: The traveling marker at its current anchor

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Re-anchoring happens without replaying the travel animation or clearing existing confirmations
interaction_model.state_change: Marker position is re-established against the field's new on-screen edge
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Marker stays glued to the active field's left edge with no drift, lag or detachment
interaction_model.input: Window resizing or page scrolling while a field is active
interaction_model.affected_object: The marker's anchoring to the active field

experience_qualities: Playful and lively rather than strict
Fluid and springy, with motion that settles instead of snapping
Reassuring: acceptance is felt immediately so nothing is second-guessed or re-entered
Calm and uncluttered, one point of emphasis at a time on an open, low-distraction surface
Unobtrusive: decorative layers never get in the way of pointing or typing
completion_and_return: The experience completes when every field carries its tick and attention reaches the closing submit action
Confirmation glyphs persist for as long as their field's contents stay acceptable, and withdraw immediately when they stop being acceptable
The marker persists across the whole form rather than being created and destroyed per field, and returns to a neutral resting state when the form is no longer being worked on
There is no loop: progression runs downward, but attention may return upward at any time and the marker simply travels back
locked_observable_requirements: Active-field emphasis is carried by a single traveling marker at the field's edge, never by a hard rectangle drawn around the field
Exactly one marker exists for the whole form and it moves between fields rather than one indicator per field
Marker travel overshoots and recoils before settling
A soft curved streak trails the marker's path and fades
Attention may arrive by pointing or by keyboard stepping, with identical marker behavior
Per-field acceptance is shown by a tick that strokes itself in at the instant contents become acceptable, beside that field
Marker swelling coincides with a field's acceptance, and returns to resting size when acceptance is lost
Loss of acceptance withdraws the tick
The marker stays attached to the active field through resizing and scrolling
Marker, streak and glyphs never intercept clicks or typing
One compact form, centered on a calm, low-distraction surface that keeps labels and entered text readable and lets the marker stand out as a distinct accent, read downward to a closing action
adaptable_details: Marker accent hue and treatment, shape and size, and the surrounding surface and text palette in either a light or dark register
Timing, easing and overshoot amount of the travel and swell
Streak curvature, thickness, opacity and fade duration
Tick style and stroke direction, and whether it eases or snaps at the end of drawing
Number, order and labels of the fields, and what makes each acceptable
Whether the marker sits at the left edge or the mirrored edge, and which side carries the confirmation glyph
Form width, field spacing and label placement
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits a short vertical sequence of a few single-line entry fields presented as one compact foreground form on a calm, low-density surface, where each entry's acceptability can be judged continuously as characters change. It transfers to registration, contact, subscription, short application and simple settings forms. It becomes a different Skill if the form grows into a long or multi-column layout where a single traveling marker can no longer be followed, if acceptance can only be judged after submission so confirmations cannot appear mid-typing, or if emphasis and validation revert to static field outlines and separate message text.

name: frayed_crosshair_and_scattering_word_list
description: On a nearly empty page, two full-length hairlines cross at the pointer and trail slightly behind it; aiming at anything clickable frays the lines into noise, and aiming at one of the few oversized words scatters its letters before they snap back in an accent color distinct from their resting treatment.

canonical_document.name: frayed_crosshair_and_scattering_word_list
canonical_document.description: On a nearly empty page, two full-length hairlines cross at the pointer and trail slightly behind it; aiming at anything clickable frays the lines into noise, and aiming at one of the few oversized words scatters its letters before they snap back in an accent color distinct from their resting treatment.
canonical_document.experience_scope: Whole-view experience: the crossing hairlines occupy the full viewport as a persistent overlay from the visitor's first pointer movement until they leave, while the choice states occur inside the small list region at the center of the composition. Neither part has an end point; both return to rest.
content_and_composition: A single short list of oversized text labels, a few entries only, set on an otherwise empty ground with no decorative or supporting imagery.

One full-width horizontal hairline and one full-height vertical hairline, crossing at a single point, drawn above all content as a persistent overlay layer, held at readable contrast against the ground.
Empty space is a deliberate compositional element: the negative field around the labels is what the crossing lines travel through and measure.
Any clickable element on the view, including but not limited to the list entries, participates as an aim target for the line reaction.

One accent treatment reserved for the settled, chosen-looking label state, separated from the resting state by a clearly different hue rather than by any particular color; the resting state uses a single quiet, readable text treatment shared by all entries.
experience_progression: Resting arrival: only the oversized labels are visible; the overlay lines are absent until the visitor first moves the pointer.
First movement: the crossing hairlines appear and thereafter continuously track the pointer with a slight trailing lag.
Aim onto a target: a brief instability burst, lines fraying into noise and, for a list entry, letters scattering.
Settling: the noise decays back to clean hairlines and the letters snap into place in the accent treatment, reading as chosen while all other entries stay quiet.
Aim leaves: the entry eases back toward its resting look and the list returns to a uniformly legible short list, ready to be read through again.
attention_and_information_flow: The crossing lines make the current aim point unmistakable at every moment, so the visitor always knows where in the empty field their attention is pointed.
The fraying of the lines signals 'this is choosable' before any content changes, promoting targets over empty space.
Exactly one entry is prominent at a time; prominence comes from motion first, then from the accent treatment of the settled state.
Return to rest flattens prominence back to uniform, keeping the whole short list scannable rather than leaving residual emphasis.

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Before any movement the overlay stays hidden so the resting composition is untouched; once revealed it persists for the session on the view
interaction_model.state_change: Absent to present
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The full-width and full-height hairlines appear and begin following the pointer
interaction_model.input: Visitor's first pointer movement on the view
interaction_model.affected_object: The crossing hairline overlay

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Lag is bounded: fast movement never detaches the lines permanently; they always resolve onto the current pointer position at rest
interaction_model.state_change: Crossing point follows the pointer with a slight delay rather than locking to it
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The lines glide toward the pointer and catch up when movement stops, producing a soft trailing feel
interaction_model.input: Continuous pointer movement
interaction_model.affected_object: The crossing point of the two hairlines

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: The fray is a short burst that self-resolves rather than a held state, so lines never remain permanently noisy; leaving the target requires no cleanup
interaction_model.state_change: Clean straight lines to noisy frayed lines and back
interaction_model.visible_feedback: A brief noisy fraying tears along both lines, then decays back to clean thin hairlines while the aim is still held
interaction_model.input: Aiming at any clickable element
interaction_model.affected_object: Both hairlines

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: The scatter is a split-second burst that always resolves into the settled state; other entries are never disturbed
interaction_model.state_change: Resting type to scattered unstable type to settled chosen state
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Letters jump with quick random shifts and tilts with color flicker, then snap back into aligned position in the accent treatment while every other entry stays at rest
interaction_model.input: Aiming at a list entry
interaction_model.affected_object: The individual letters of that entry only

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: The relaxation is gradual and interruptible rather than an instant snap
interaction_model.state_change: Settled accent state to resting state
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The accent treatment eases back toward the quiet resting treatment with no residual displacement
interaction_model.input: Aim moving off a list entry
interaction_model.affected_object: The previously aimed entry

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Rapid repeated aiming stays responsive and never queues or stacks; each new aim supersedes the pending return
interaction_model.state_change: Return cancelled and the instability burst restarted from the current appearance
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The return toward the resting treatment stops immediately and the letters scatter again without waiting for the previous transition to finish
interaction_model.input: Aiming at the same entry again while it is still easing back
interaction_model.affected_object: The in-progress relaxation of that entry

experience_qualities: Spare and precise, almost empty
Surgical, instrument-like targeting
Brief electric instability that resolves into calm
Crisp hairline delicacy against oversized type
Immediately legible at rest, readable through again without effort
completion_and_return: No terminal state: every reaction returns to the resting look, and the list can be scanned repeatedly.
The overlay persists once revealed and continues tracking regardless of how many targets have been aimed at.
No aimed or settled state is retained after the aim leaves; emphasis is momentary, not sticky.
locked_observable_requirements: Two hairlines, one spanning the full width and one the full height, crossing at a single point that follows the pointer with a visible trailing lag.
The overlay is not shown until the visitor's first pointer movement.
Aiming at any clickable element produces a brief noisy fraying of both lines that decays back to clean straight hairlines.

Aiming at a text choice scatters its individual letters with random shifts, tilts and color flicker, then snaps them back into aligned position in a single accent treatment that is clearly separated in hue from the resting text, with no specific hue required.
Only the aimed entry reacts; all others remain in the quiet resting treatment.
Leaving an entry eases it back to rest, and re-aiming cancels that return and immediately restarts the scatter.
The resting composition stays near-empty, with the oversized labels as effectively the only content.
adaptable_details: Number of labels, as long as the list stays short
Typeface, weight, casing and label wording
Accent hue, resting text hue and the ground's luminance level, as long as text and hairlines stay readable and the accent stays distinguishable
Hairline thickness, lag amount, fray intensity and duration
Scatter amplitude, tilt range and flicker rate
Vertical or horizontal arrangement and alignment of the list
Whether non-list clickable elements exist alongside the list
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits sparse pointer-driven views whose foreground is a small number of oversized text targets on largely empty ground of any tone, where the site wants arrival to feel precise and instrument-like. It degrades where content is dense, targets are numerous or small, or input is touch-only, since the trailing crosshair loses both its readability and its purpose. Replacing the empty ground with busy imagery or an active background, making the settled state persist as a selection marker, or reacting on all entries at once would create a different skill.

name: letter_flip_name_list_with_cursor_pinned_photo
description: A quiet vertical list of short names, with faint running numbers and a brief prose passage, that settles into place line by line on arrival; dwelling on a name tumbles its letters away and replaces them with an identical set from the opposite side while that name's photo swings in beside the cursor, trailing and tilting with pointer movement, then drops away as attention leaves.

canonical_document.name: letter_flip_name_list_with_cursor_pinned_photo
canonical_document.description: A quiet vertical list of short names, with faint running numbers and a brief prose passage, that settles into place line by line on arrival; dwelling on a name tumbles its letters away and replaces them with an identical set from the opposite side while that name's photo swings in beside the cursor, trailing and tilting with pointer movement, then drops away as attention leaves.
canonical_document.experience_scope: A self-contained region occupying the main area of a small landing view: it begins with a held pre-arrival moment before the list is visible, covers the list, its numbers, the accompanying prose and the pointer-attached photo and dot, and ends when the pointer leaves the list and the resting state is restored. Its resting appearance is a plain readable list, so the region can sit inside an otherwise ordinary page.
content_and_composition: One primary vertical list of a small set of very short text labels (about half a dozen), set large enough to read as a single typographic block
A faint running number paired with each label, subordinate in weight and contrast so it reads as editorial marginalia rather than a second column of content
One short prose passage placed below the list, providing a quiet block of small text that balances the large labels
One image per label, absent from the layout at rest and appearing only while that label holds attention; at most one image visible at any time

The active image is anchored beside the pointer by its upper-right corner, so it hangs down and to the left of the cursor and overlaps the list and surrounding whitespace as a floating layer above the text
A small dot that persistently accompanies the pointer across the region, sitting above all other layers
Generous surrounding whitespace and a stable list position that never reflows when an image appears or leaves
experience_progression: Held opening: the view stays quiet and the list withheld for a short moment while the imagery is prepared, with nothing flickering or half-formed on screen
Composed settle: the labels arrive one after another in list order at a steady short interval, each coming to rest before the next begins, until the block reads as one finished whole
Resting read: calm, fully legible list with faint numbers and the prose passage, awaiting attention in any order
Focus: a dwelt-on label swaps its letters and its photo swings into view beside the pointer, making that entry the temporary subject of the page
Tracking: while focus is held, the photo continuously follows and reacts to pointer motion
Release: letters flip back and the photo drops away, returning the region to exactly the resting read state, ready for any other label with no fixed order
attention_and_information_flow: At rest, prominence is shared evenly across the labels; the numbers and prose stay clearly secondary
Dwell concentrates attention on one label by animating only that label while its neighbours remain still and unchanged
The arriving photo becomes the loudest element in the view for as long as focus is held, dominating by size, motion and layering while the label stays readable
Revealed information increases only during focus: the picture behind a name is disclosed, then withdrawn, so the resting state never accumulates imagery
The pointer dot signals actionability by swelling over labels, telling the user where the effect is available before committing
Because only one photo can exist at a time, attention is always singular; moving between labels transfers the subject rather than adding to it

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: The hold is short and self-resolving; once settled the list never replays the arrival, and pointer activity before completion does not leave the sequence half-finished
interaction_model.state_change: Withheld to fully present
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Labels settle into their final positions one after another in order, staggered so the arrival reads as a sequence rather than a single block appearing
interaction_model.input: Autonomous: all label imagery becomes ready after the held opening moment
interaction_model.affected_object: The label list as a whole

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: A quick brush across the label commits to nothing and leaves it untouched; the dwell requirement is what separates intent from passing movement
interaction_model.state_change: Idle entry becomes the focused subject
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The letters tumble away in quick succession one after another and an identical set arrives from the opposite side, reading as a flip-through rather than a fade; simultaneously the photo swings in beside the pointer, pinned by its upper-right corner
interaction_model.input: Pointer comes to rest on a label and stays for a brief moment
interaction_model.affected_object: That label's letters and its associated photo

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: When movement slows or stops the lag catches up and the tilt eases back toward neutral, so the photo always resolves to a settled hanging position
interaction_model.state_change: Position and orientation continuously chase the pointer
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The photo trails the pointer with a soft lag instead of locking to it, tips further as sideways movement gets faster, and leans one way or the other according to the direction of travel
interaction_model.input: Continued pointer movement while a label is focused
interaction_model.affected_object: The active photo

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: The label and list return to exactly the prior calm, readable state with no residue or shifted layout; re-entering restarts the focus cleanly
interaction_model.state_change: Focused subject returns to idle
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The letters flip back to their original set and the photo drops downward while adding a small extra twist as it goes
interaction_model.input: Pointer moves off the focused label to empty space
interaction_model.affected_object: The focused label's letters and its photo

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Only one label can be the subject at a time; rapid traversal of several labels never leaves multiple photos or half-flipped labels behind
interaction_model.state_change: Subject transfers between entries while motion is still in progress
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Whatever is mid-flight is interrupted and continues from where it currently is rather than snapping to a finished state or restarting, so the exchange reads as one continuous handover into the new label's flip and photo arrival
interaction_model.input: Pointer moves directly from one label to a neighbouring label
interaction_model.affected_object: Both the previously focused label and the newly targeted label

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: The dot persists through focus, release and interruption, and its swelling always reflects the current target
interaction_model.state_change: Neutral to over-target and back
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The dot follows the pointer continuously and swells whenever it is over one of the labels, shrinking back off them
interaction_model.input: Pointer movement anywhere in the region
interaction_model.affected_object: The small pointer dot

experience_qualities: Composed and unhurried on arrival, then suddenly bold when a name is chosen
Editorial and typographic: large names, faint numbers, a small block of prose, lots of quiet space
Physical and hand-held, because the photo hangs from a corner, lags behind the pointer and swings, tips and twists with movement
Deliberate rather than twitchy: the dwell requirement makes the effect feel invited rather than triggered by accident
Reversible and forgiving, with the list always returning to the same calm legibility
Continuous under fast use, since interrupted motion carries on instead of resetting
completion_and_return: The arrival sequence completes once and does not loop or replay
Each focus episode is a full out-and-back cycle that ends in the original resting state
No focus state persists after the pointer leaves; nothing is remembered or marked as visited
Labels can be focused any number of times in any order, with no sequence or exhaustion
Layout, spacing and legibility at rest are identical before and after any number of focus episodes
locked_observable_requirements: A brief quiet hold precedes the list's appearance, and the labels then settle in one after another in order rather than all at once
Focus requires a short dwell; a fast pass-through commits to nothing
The label's letters tumble away in quick succession and are replaced by an identical set arriving from the opposite side, and flip back on release
The photo appears beside the pointer anchored by its upper-right corner and trails pointer movement with a soft lag rather than tracking rigidly
Tilt magnitude scales with sideways pointer speed and tilt direction is signed by the direction of travel
Exit sends the photo downward with a small additional twist
Exactly one photo is visible at a time, and moving to a neighbouring label interrupts in-progress motion and continues from that point instead of restarting or snapping
Faint per-item running numbers and a short prose passage below the list are kept as part of the composition, both reading at lower contrast than the labels
A small pointer-following dot swells while over the labels
The resting list is fully legible with stable layout, and returns to it unchanged after every episode
adaptable_details: Exact number of labels, as long as the set stays short enough to read as one block
Wording of labels, numbering format and the content of the prose passage
Typeface, type scale, and any colour or surround treatment, provided the labels keep comfortable reading contrast and the numbers and prose stay lower-contrast than them
Dwell duration, stagger interval, flip speed, lag amount, tilt limits and drop distance
Which side letters depart to and arrive from
Photo aspect ratio, size and offset from the pointer anchor
Placement of the prose passage and numbers relative to the list
Size and styling of the pointer dot
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits pointer-driven views with a short list of concise text entries where each entry has one representative image worth previewing and the list must stay clean and readable at rest, such as landing menus, project or chapter indexes and category lists. It stops fitting when entries are long or numerous enough to require scrolling within the list, when several images must be comparable at once, or when the primary context is touch-only where dwell, lag and direction-of-travel tilt cannot be expressed. Making the imagery permanently visible in a grid, keeping the focused state latched after the pointer leaves, or animating all entries simultaneously instead of one subject at a time would each create a different skill.
