name: endless_oversized_title_column
description: A whole-view column of very large serif titles stacked toward one side that scrolls endlessly in both directions, with the pointed-at title nudging sideways, changing typographic style and shifting to a clearly separated tone, and gaining a small marker line to show it is the one that will open.

canonical_document.name: endless_oversized_title_column
canonical_document.description: A whole-view column of very large serif titles stacked toward one side that scrolls endlessly in both directions, with the pointed-at title nudging sideways, changing typographic style and shifting to a clearly separated tone, and gaining a small marker line to show it is the one that will open.
canonical_document.experience_scope: Whole-view experience that begins the moment the view opens, occupying the entire screen as the primary browsing surface; it has no end state of its own and ends only when a highlighted title is committed and the view is left.
content_and_composition: One vertical column of titles as the sole foreground content, set in oversized serif type and stacked toward one side of the view rather than centered as a symmetrical block
A finite collection of short text entries, repeated in sequence so the same names recur as browsing continues
Generous empty surface around and opposite the column, giving the composition the quiet, sparse feel of an index page
Each entry supports a transient marker line placed beside it, present only while that entry is singled out
No visible navigation bar, no visible scrollbar and no visible progress or position indicator
experience_progression: Arrival: the full-view stacked title column is already present and immediately responsive, with no intro sequence separating arrival from browsing
Traversal: continuous scrolling advances the column in the chosen direction at any moment, in either direction, without discrete steps or pages

Wrap: as the sequence passes either extreme it continues seamlessly and earlier names come back around, giving the sense of having seen the whole collection while still being able to return to any of it
Selection: one title is singled out and visibly set apart, and that singled-out title is what gets committed
attention_and_information_flow: Scale carries all initial prominence: the oversized type makes the titles the only thing competing for attention on arrival
During traversal, prominence shifts with position in the column as entries move through the view, no single entry claiming permanent focus
Pointing collapses attention onto exactly one title at a time, which separates from its neighbors through offset, restyling, a clear tonal shift away from the resting treatment, and its marker line
The marker line adds no new text, only confirmation of which entry is currently picked
Removing the pointer returns attention to the undifferentiated column, so no entry stays privileged

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Responds in both directions from the very first gesture, including upward immediately after the view opens; scrolling the opposite way retraces the sequence at any time
interaction_model.state_change: The column advances continuously along its axis by the scrolled amount
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Titles glide through the view together, entries leaving one edge while others enter the opposite edge, with no scrollbar appearing
interaction_model.input: Scroll gesture anywhere over the titles, in either direction
interaction_model.affected_object: The stacked title column as a whole

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: No boundary exists to recover from; there is no first or last entry to be blocked against in either direction
interaction_model.state_change: The sequence wraps and earlier names reappear as the natural continuation
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Motion continues uninterrupted with no visible jump, gap, snap-back or repositioning at the wrap point
interaction_model.input: Continued scrolling past either extreme of the collection
interaction_model.affected_object: The sequence order of titles in the column

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Fully reverts to the resting treatment as soon as the pointer leaves; only one title is singled out at a time and pointing elsewhere transfers the state
interaction_model.state_change: The title becomes the singled-out, pickable entry while all others stay in their resting treatment
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The title nudges sideways, changes typographic style and shifts to a tone clearly separated from the resting titles, and a small marker line appears beside it
interaction_model.input: Pointing at a single title
interaction_model.affected_object: That one title and its adjacent marker slot

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Nothing is committed while merely pointing; withdrawing the pointer without committing leaves the column unchanged
interaction_model.state_change: That entry is chosen and its destination opens
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The highlighted entry is unambiguously the one acted on, so the pick is confirmed visually before it is committed
interaction_model.input: Committing the singled-out title
interaction_model.affected_object: The currently highlighted entry

experience_qualities: Quiet, sparse and editorial rather than utilitarian
Monumental in scale, with type large enough to feel like a printed index page
Boundless and continuous, with no sense of hitting an edge
Immediately responsive, reacting to the first gesture in either direction
Deliberate two-step feel: a choice is visibly picked before it is committed
completion_and_return: The sequence loops indefinitely and has no completion state of its own
Any entry can be reached again by continuing to scroll in either direction, so revisiting is always possible
Pointer-driven highlighting is transient and leaves no residue once the pointer leaves
Leaving the view happens only through committing a highlighted title
locked_observable_requirements: Oversized type dominating the whole view as the only foreground content
Titles stacked as a single column offset toward one side rather than centered symmetrically
Scrolling anywhere over the titles moves the column, responsive in both directions from the very first gesture including upward at open
Wrapping past either extreme with no visible jump, gap, snap-back or scrollbar, and no reachable first or last entry
Exactly one title singled out at a time via sideways nudge plus restyle plus a clearly perceptible tonal shift from the resting titles plus an adjacent marker line
Full reversion of the singled-out treatment when the pointer leaves
The singled-out title is the one that opens
adaptable_details: Which side the column is stacked toward
Specific serif face, weight, the resting-and-highlighted tone pair, and exact type scale
Number of entries in the collection and their wording
Nudge distance, marker line length and transition timing
Scroll speed and easing of the column motion
Treatment of the empty surface, as long as it stays quiet enough and separated enough for the type to dominate
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits short lists of comparable text entries that can each stand alone as a large, readable title and act as a destination — sections, chapters, projects, categories, issues. Long labels, dense descriptive text, thumbnails or mixed media alongside each entry break the typographic composition. Introducing reachable first and last entries, a visible scrollbar or position indicator, discrete paging or snapping, persistent selection of multiple entries, or shrinking the treatment into an edge-anchored bar rather than the full view would each create a different Skill.

name: hollow_giant_word_list_with_streaming_fill_and_tilted_photo_peek
description: Full-width outlined giant words stacked with small ordinal numbers; the pointed word loses its outline and repeats itself streaming sideways along the same line while its photograph rises in at the right at a slight tilt, and all other entries stay calm.

canonical_document.name: hollow_giant_word_list_with_streaming_fill_and_tilted_photo_peek
canonical_document.description: Full-width outlined giant words stacked with small ordinal numbers; the pointed word loses its outline and repeats itself streaming sideways along the same line while its photograph rises in at the right at a slight tilt, and all other entries stay calm.
canonical_document.experience_scope: A region occupying the full width and roughly the full height of the view at rest, used as a self-contained entry list; the experience begins when the stacked outlined list is visible, plays out per entry on pointing, and ends when pointing leaves the list, returning it to the resting outlined state.
content_and_composition: A short list of text labels, only a handful in total, each label short enough to read at headline scale
One label per full-width row, rows stacked vertically with poster-like spacing so only about three rows fill the view at once
A small ordinal marker paired with each label, subordinate in size to the label
Labels rendered hollow at rest: outline-only letterforms with no fill, the outline holding just enough contrast against the surround to read clearly at rest
One preview photograph per entry, hidden at rest, revealed at the right side of that entry's own row
Focused-state duplicate of the label repeated end to end across the full row width, sharing the same line as the original label
No surrounding bar, chrome or container framing; the stack reads as a printed poster rather than a navigation strip
Nothing may be layered above the letterforms in a way that blocks pointing, so every neighbouring entry stays directly reachable
Persistent elements: the stack order, the ordinals, and the row rhythm remain unchanged throughout
experience_progression: Rest: all entries outlined, quiet and evenly weighted, no imagery present
Focus onset: pointed entry's outline drops away almost immediately and the repeated-word stream begins travelling sideways along its line
Focus body: the entry's photograph eases in at the right, rising slightly into place and settling at a small tilt while the sideways travel continues
Handover: pointing moved directly onto another entry transfers the focused state cleanly, the previous entry returning to outline as the new one takes it up
Release: outline returns, streaming text and photograph clear, and the list settles back to the calm resting state ready for the next entry
Resumption: re-focusing an entry picks its sideways travel up from where it stopped rather than restarting from the beginning
attention_and_information_flow: Exactly one entry at a time is emphatic and restless; the remainder recede into quiet outlined form

The switch from hollow to solidly filled letterforms is the primary prominence signal, the filled form carrying markedly stronger contrast against the surround than its outlined neighbours, reinforced by the horizontal motion of the repeated word
The photograph adds a quick sense of what the entry contains without displacing the label or shifting the stack
Because only about three rows fill the view, the focused row dominates the visible field
Information revealed is momentary and non-committal: nothing persists once attention leaves

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Fully reversible at any moment by moving off the letterforms; the effect never blocks pointing at other entries
interaction_model.state_change: Entry moves from resting outlined state to focused emphatic state
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Outline drops away almost instantly, the same word repeats and streams sideways across the full row on the same line, and the photograph eases in at the right, rising slightly and settling at a small tilt
interaction_model.input: Pointing directly at the letterforms of one label (the glyph shape itself, not the empty row area around it)
interaction_model.affected_object: That entry's label, its repeated-word stream and its paired photograph

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Travel halts where it is when focus is released and resumes from that same position when the entry is focused again, never snapping back to a restart
interaction_model.state_change: Horizontal position of the repeated word advances continuously
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Restless sideways drift of the repeated word along the focused line
interaction_model.input: Continuous autonomous travel while an entry is focused
interaction_model.affected_object: The repeated-word stream on the focused row

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Settles rather than snaps; can be re-entered immediately
interaction_model.state_change: Focused emphatic state returns to resting outlined state
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Outline is restored, the streaming repeated word clears and the photograph is removed
interaction_model.input: Moving pointing off the letterforms
interaction_model.affected_object: The previously focused entry

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Handover is clean with no stuck or doubled focused entries; rapid movement across several labels still leaves at most one focused
interaction_model.state_change: Focus is handed over in one step without an intermediate all-quiet gap being required
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Outgoing entry returns to outline and clears its stream and image as the incoming entry fills and begins its own stream and image reveal
interaction_model.input: Sliding pointing straight from one label onto another
interaction_model.affected_object: Both the outgoing and incoming entries

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Deliberately inert so the trigger zone matches the visible letterforms
interaction_model.state_change: No state change
interaction_model.visible_feedback: List stays in its resting outlined state
interaction_model.input: Pointing at the empty area of a row beside the label
interaction_model.affected_object: Nothing

experience_qualities: Grainy, tactile, analog mood
Confident and a little playful
Poster-like and editorial rather than utilitarian
Calm at rest, restless and emphatic only where attention lands
Immediate response on focus, gentle settling on release
completion_and_return: No terminal completion: the experience cycles per entry indefinitely
Release always returns the whole list to the same calm outlined resting state
Per-entry horizontal travel position persists across focus cycles so returning continues rather than restarts
No other state carries over between focus cycles; imagery does not linger
locked_observable_requirements: Labels sit at oversized scale, one per full-width row, with only about three rows filling the view at once
Resting letterforms are hollow outline-only; focused letterforms lose the outline and become solidly filled, reading at clearly higher contrast against the surround than the resting entries
The focused entry shows the same word repeated and travelling sideways across the full row width on the same line as the label
Each entry carries a small ordinal marker
The focused entry's photograph appears at the right of that entry's row, easing in with a slight rise and settling at a small tilt
Exactly one entry is focused at a time; all others remain quiet and outlined
Only the letterforms trigger the effect, not the surrounding empty row area
Nothing layered over the type may intercept pointing, so neighbouring entries stay reachable
Sideways travel resumes from its stopped position instead of restarting
Stack order and row positions never shift as entries focus or unfocus
adaptable_details: Number of entries and their wording
Typeface, outline weight, fill treatment and grain intensity
Any hue family and any light-or-dark surround, provided outline, filled form and imagery keep readable separation from the surround and from each other
Ordinal format and its placement relative to the label
Speed and direction of the sideways travel
Exact tilt angle, rise distance, size and aspect of the photograph
Timing curves for the reveal and settle
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits short sets of a handful of brief labels where each label can be read at headline scale and paired with one representative image, presented as a standalone poster-like view, and works over any surround as long as outlined and filled type stay legibly separated from it. It stops being this Skill if labels become long or numerous enough that many rows must fit the view at once, if the resting state is filled rather than hollow letterforms, if the sideways-streaming repetition of the same word is dropped, if the preview image is moved out of the focused entry's own row into a shared or central stage, or if multiple entries can be emphatic at the same time.

name: warped_stroke_settling_text_list
description: A screen-filling list of very large names on a plain backdrop; pointing at one shifts its lettering into a distinct accent state clearly separated from the resting lettering and throws a decorative stroke across it that appears violently warped and noisy, then irons itself flat into a clean straight mark in a fraction of a second, with a distinct distortion character for each entry.

canonical_document.name: warped_stroke_settling_text_list
canonical_document.description: A screen-filling list of very large names on a plain backdrop; pointing at one shifts its lettering into a distinct accent state clearly separated from the resting lettering and throws a decorative stroke across it that appears violently warped and noisy, then irons itself flat into a clean straight mark in a fraction of a second, with a distinct distortion character for each entry.
canonical_document.experience_scope: Whole-view experience: it begins on arrival with the full list already filling the viewport and lasts as long as the view is present; each per-entry flare begins when pointing starts and ends when the stroke has settled or when pointing leaves, returning the whole list to a calm resting state.
content_and_composition: One vertically ordered list of around seven short text entries, each rendered at oversized display scale so the set fills the screen

Plain uniform low-distraction backdrop with no competing imagery, panels or secondary content, holding readable contrast with the lettering in either luminance direction, so the list is the only foreground
Per entry: the lettering itself plus one decorative stroke layer that spans across the entry, drawn over or through the text rather than beside it

An accent state reserved exclusively for the currently targeted entry's lettering, separated from the resting lettering by a clear, readable shift that stays legible against the backdrop; all untargeted entries share one calm resting appearance
Only one entry is in the flared/targeted state at a time; the decorative stroke exists only for that entry
The stroke layer is purely decorative and never intercepts pointer targeting or activation of the entry beneath it
experience_progression: Arrival: full list visible at rest, uniformly calm, inviting top-to-bottom reading
Targeting an entry: lettering switches to its accent state and the decorative stroke enters in a violently warped, noisy, unstable form
Settling: within well under a second the stroke's distortion irons out progressively until it is a clean straight crisp mark, confirming the live choice
Holding: the entry rests in its resolved accented state with the settled stroke held steady
Leaving: the entry snaps back to rest with no residual distortion, partial stroke or leftover accent state, returning the whole list to full calm
Moving down the list repeats the sequence with a visibly different distortion character each time, so working through the entries feels like discovery
attention_and_information_flow: At rest, prominence is distributed evenly across the oversized entries so the only task is reading the list
On targeting, prominence collapses onto a single entry via the high-salience accent shift plus motion, separating it clearly from its unchanged neighbours
The brief instability draws the eye first, then the resolution into a crisp mark reads as confirmation that this is the live selection
No new textual information is revealed; the added information is purely which entry is currently chosen
Because each entry distorts with its own character, attention is rewarded for continuing down the list rather than settling

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Entering another entry starts that entry's own sequence while the previous one returns to rest; only one entry is ever flared
interaction_model.state_change: Entry transitions from resting state to targeted state; the stroke is introduced in a maximally warped, noisy form and animates toward a flat straight form
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Lettering flips to its accent state immediately; a distorted, unstable stroke flares across the entry and visibly irons itself flat into a crisp straight mark in well under a second
interaction_model.input: Pointer moves onto a list entry
interaction_model.affected_object: That entry's lettering and its decorative stroke layer

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Full recovery to rest is guaranteed from any point in the sequence; the list as a whole returns to uniform calm
interaction_model.state_change: In-flight settling is interrupted and the entry returns to resting state
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The entry snaps back to its calm appearance with nothing frozen mid-distortion and no partial stroke or accent state left behind
interaction_model.input: Pointer leaves an entry while its stroke is still settling
interaction_model.affected_object: The in-flight entry's lettering and stroke

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Replay is always available; the effect is idempotent per pass
interaction_model.state_change: Sequence restarts from its beginning rather than resuming from where it stopped
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The full warped-to-flat flare plays again from the most distorted form
interaction_model.input: Pointer re-enters an entry that was just left
interaction_model.affected_object: That entry's stroke and lettering

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Overlapping passes always resolve to either one settling stroke or a fully calm entry
interaction_model.state_change: Each new pass supersedes the previous one instead of accumulating
interaction_model.visible_feedback: No stacking, doubling, speed-up or lingering ghost strokes; the effect stays a single clean flare per pass
interaction_model.input: Rapid repeated passes across one or several entries
interaction_model.affected_object: Per-entry stroke animations

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: The decorative layer is never an interaction obstacle regardless of its animated state
interaction_model.state_change: Activation proceeds normally with the decorative layer transparent to input
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The decoration never blocks or swallows the activation; targeting feedback remains consistent through the click
interaction_model.input: Clicking or activating a targeted entry
interaction_model.affected_object: The entry as an actionable target

experience_qualities: Bold and screen-filling, with reading as the only task
Playful and slightly unruly, then decisive
Brief and snappy rather than lingering; the flare is well under a second
Handmade and imperfect at onset, crisp and precise at resolution
Individual per entry, so the set feels discovered rather than mechanical
Calm and quiet whenever nothing is targeted
completion_and_return: Each pass completes when the stroke has fully flattened into its crisp form and holds steady while targeting continues
Leaving returns the entry to rest immediately and completely, with no persisted distortion or accent state
The list has no accumulated or remembered per-entry state; every pass starts from the same resting baseline
The overall view returns to full uniform calm whenever no entry is targeted
locked_observable_requirements: Oversized text entries fill the screen against a plain low-distraction backdrop that holds readable contrast with the lettering and carries no competing foreground content
Exactly one entry is in the targeted state at a time

Targeting shifts the entry's lettering into a distinct accent state, separated from the resting lettering strongly enough to be read at a glance, with no particular hue or luminance direction required
A decorative stroke is drawn across the targeted entry, not merely beside or under it
The stroke enters visibly warped and noisy and then irons itself flat into a clean straight form
The warped-to-flat resolution completes in well under a second
Each entry has its own distinct distortion character, so no two entries behave identically
Leaving mid-flight snaps the entry fully back to rest with nothing frozen or partially drawn
Re-targeting replays the sequence from the start
Rapid repeated passes never stack or compound
The decorative layer never intercepts clicks or activation
adaptable_details: Exact number of entries and their wording
Specific accent hue and backdrop tone, including whether the surround is lighter or darker than the lettering
Typeface, weight, letter case and exact display size
Whether the stroke reads as an underline, strike-through, slash or sweep across the entry
Precise duration within the sub-second range and the easing of the flattening
The specific shape, amplitude and grain of each entry's distortion character
Vertical spacing and alignment of the list
Whether entries are centred or left-aligned
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits short lists of a handful of text-only entries that can be rendered at display scale on an unadorned backdrop of any tone, where each entry is a discrete target: section indexes, chapter or archive lists, full-screen menu overlays and oversized link lists. It stops being this Skill if the entries carry thumbnails, descriptions or other supporting content that competes with the lettering, if the list grows dense enough that entries can no longer be oversized, if the stroke settles slowly enough to read as ambient motion rather than a brief flare, if all entries share one identical distortion, or if the decoration persists after attention leaves.

name: sketchy_mark_shudder_on_word_hover
description: Pointing at an ordinary word instantly draws a rough hand-sketched mark on it that erupts into a brief violent wobble and calms into a crisp held shape; pulling away snaps it straight and hides it, and returning replays it from the start.

canonical_document.name: sketchy_mark_shudder_on_word_hover
canonical_document.description: Pointing at an ordinary word instantly draws a rough hand-sketched mark on it that erupts into a brief violent wobble and calms into a crisp held shape; pulling away snaps it straight and hides it, and returning replays it from the start.
canonical_document.experience_scope: Region experience at the level of a single inline word or link, repeated across a still page of labelled word groups; each instance begins on pointer entry over one word and ends when the pointer leaves that word. No whole-view takeover, no page-level motion.
content_and_composition: Many short inline text items (single words or very short phrases) rendered as plain ordinary type with no decoration at rest
Items collected into several small groups, each group preceded by a small quiet label naming the family of mark that group demonstrates
Groups stacked in reading order down the view so variants can be compared by scanning downward

One transient mark layer per item, drawn on or around the word: hairline rule beneath, strike through the middle, diagonal stroke corner-to-corner, paired rules above and below, or a closed loop (circle or square) centered on the word
The mark occupies the same visual slot as the word rather than reflowing neighbours; enclosing shapes surround the word, linear marks cross or bound it
One variant group in which the word's own glyphs distort in concert with its mark instead of the mark distorting alone
Marks read as hand-made and imprecise in line quality, distinct from the clean type they annotate
Persistent elements: the plain words and their group labels, which never move
experience_progression: Rest: no mark visible, nothing in motion anywhere in the view
Entry: the mark appears immediately and already present, not slowly drawn in
Agitation: the mark shudders and deforms violently, at maximum irregularity right at the start
Settling: the deformation decays rapidly to a clean crisp figure within a fraction of a second
Hold: the settled mark stays steady and motionless for as long as the pointer remains
Exit at any stage: deformation is cut to straight/clean and the mark disappears with no residual twitching
attention_and_information_flow: At rest the page gives no focal point; all items read as equal ordinary words and the labels stay subordinate
The eruption creates a single sharp focus on exactly one word; only one item is ever active
The wobble makes the mark's identity legible faster than a static mark would, then the calm state lets it be judged precisely
Group labels supply the naming information; the effect itself supplies the demonstration, so no explanatory copy is needed
Moving down the groups accumulates comparison without ever leaving more than one mark on screen

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Only the hovered item activates; hovering a different word starts that word's effect independently and leaves no trace on the previous one
interaction_model.state_change: Hidden and inert to visible and agitated
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The mark appears at once and immediately shakes at its most violent, then rapidly calms to a clean crisp shape and holds
interaction_model.input: Pointer enters a word
interaction_model.affected_object: That word's mark layer

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Interruption is allowed at any point in the sequence and always resolves to the clean hidden rest state rather than freezing mid-deformation
interaction_model.state_change: Agitated to straightened, then hidden
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The wobble is cut immediately, the shape snaps to straight/clean, and the mark disappears leaving the word plain with nothing still moving
interaction_model.input: Pointer leaves a word mid-agitation
interaction_model.affected_object: That word's mark layer

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Repeated rapid entry and exit never accumulates leftover distortion or stacked marks
interaction_model.state_change: Hidden to agitated from the beginning
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The full eruption-and-settle plays again from its start rather than resuming partway
interaction_model.input: Pointer re-enters a word that was just left
interaction_model.affected_object: That word's mark layer

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Leaving restores the word to undistorted type and hides the mark with no residual warp
interaction_model.state_change: Static crisp type to jointly deforming type and mark, then jointly settled
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Word and mark wobble as one linked object and calm together into a crisp held pair
interaction_model.input: Pointer enters a word in the co-warping group
interaction_model.affected_object: The word's glyphs together with its mark

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: The decorative layer stays non-interactive regardless of its size or whether it encloses the word
interaction_model.state_change: None in the mark's interactive role
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The click activates the word itself; the mark is purely visible decoration and never intercepts the pointer or takes focus
interaction_model.input: Attempt to click or keyboard-focus the word
interaction_model.affected_object: The underlying link and its mark layer

experience_qualities: Quiet, plain and completely still at rest
Rough, hand-made, imprecise line character against clean type
Playful and abrupt — an eruption rather than a fade
Very short-lived agitation resolving into precision
Self-explanatory: each variant demonstrates itself without captions
Restrained overall, because only one word is ever animated
completion_and_return: Each activation completes by holding a steady crisp mark; there is no loop or autonomous replay
Removing the pointer returns the item exactly to its plain undecorated rest state
Nothing persists between activations; every hover is a fresh full replay
The page as a whole returns to total stillness whenever no word is hovered
locked_observable_requirements: Nothing is in motion until a word is pointed at
The mark appears immediately on entry, not progressively drawn
Agitation is strongest at the very beginning and decays to a clean crisp shape, holding still afterwards
The whole eruption-to-settle happens within a fraction of a second
The mark reads as rough and hand-made rather than geometrically exact while agitating
Only one word is decorated at a time
Leaving mid-animation snaps the shape straight and hides it with no residual movement
Re-entry replays from the beginning rather than resuming
At least one variant warps the word's own glyphs together with its mark
The mark never swallows clicks or steals focus from the underlying link
Items are grouped under small quiet labels naming each mark family so variants can be compared by scanning down
adaptable_details: Which mark families are included and how many groups exist
Exact mark geometry: line weight, inset, enclosure padding, diagonal angle, gap between paired rules
Amplitude, frequency and decay curve of the wobble within the sub-second budget
Any hue, opacity and contrast treatment of marks and type, provided the mark stays clearly separated from and readable against the type and its surround
Typeface, item size, and whether groups are stacked in one column or arranged in a wider grid
Wording of the group labels and of the words themselves
Whether the same effect is also triggered by keyboard focus in addition to pointing
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits short inline text targets — menu entries, single words, tags, in-copy links — where the mark can span or enclose a single line of type and the surrounding layout stays still. Applying it to multi-line paragraphs, image tiles, buttons with their own fill states, or making the marks persist, loop continuously, or animate several items at once would be a different Skill. Replacing the immediate-eruption-then-calm signature with a smooth draw-on, fade or slide, or making the mark clickable or focusable, also changes identity.

name: pointer_trailed_elastic_readout_face
description: A centred, always-readable circular readout whose numerals and hands each chase the pointer one beat after the other, stringing the face out into a soft elastic trail that resolves back into one tidy face wherever the pointer rests.

canonical_document.name: pointer_trailed_elastic_readout_face
canonical_document.description: A centred, always-readable circular readout whose numerals and hands each chase the pointer one beat after the other, stringing the face out into a soft elastic trail that resolves back into one tidy face wherever the pointer rests.
canonical_document.experience_scope: Whole-view experience: it begins on arrival with the assembled readout centred in a near-empty field, is active anywhere the pointer travels within the view, and ends whenever the pointer stops and the pieces reassemble into one face. There is no separate entry or exit region.
content_and_composition: One near-empty low-distraction field with no chrome, framing or competing content, holding enough luminance separation from the readout for crisp legibility; the readout is the only foreground object
One composite readout face, initially centred, crisp and instantly legible
A ring of individual numeral marks around the face, each an independently movable piece
Several pointer-like indicator pieces (short, long and fast-moving) sharing the face centre, each independently movable
One small leader dot that persistently marks the current pointer position and acts as the target the other pieces move toward
Layer relationship: leader dot on top as the target, indicator pieces and numerals as the trailing body; all pieces stay in the same flat plane, never overlapping into illegibility
experience_progression: Arrival: quiet empty field with the readout assembled, centred and still
First pointer movement: the leader dot snaps to the pointer with no delay while the readout is still at rest
Chase: pieces release in a fixed order, each starting one beat after the previous, so the face pulls apart into a strung-out trail behind the pointer
Sustained movement: the trail lengthens and curves along the pointer path, with indicator pieces nearest the dot and numerals furthest behind
Pause: the cascade runs itself out, each piece arriving in its release order
Resolve: all pieces converge on the leader dot and settle back into a single tidy readout at the resting position
The cycle re-triggers from wherever the pieces currently sit on the next pointer movement
attention_and_information_flow: At rest, attention lands immediately on the one centred readout because the surrounding field is empty
During movement, the leader dot holds the highest prominence as the destination, with the trail reading as a tail pointing back to where the pointer came from
The staggered order makes the trail readable as a sequence rather than a blur: nearest pieces are the most recently caught up, furthest are the most behind
The value being displayed stays continuously readable throughout dispersal; no stage hides, blurs or scrambles the reading
Resolution returns prominence to the single assembled readout, ending the motion story at the pointer's resting place

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: The dot always tracks the pointer, so the target is never lost; when the pointer stops, the dot simply holds position
interaction_model.state_change: Target position updates to the pointer position with no easing
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The small dot appears locked to the pointer, snapping instantly and never lagging
interaction_model.input: Pointer movement anywhere in the view (the only user input)
interaction_model.affected_object: Leader dot marking the target position

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Motion is continuous and interruptible at any moment; nothing detaches permanently or leaves the view
interaction_model.state_change: Each piece begins travelling toward the leader dot, released in a fixed staggered order with a consistent beat between successive releases
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The assembled face comes apart into a soft elastic trail behind the pointer, indicator pieces catching up first and numerals arriving last
interaction_model.input: Pointer movement
interaction_model.affected_object: Each numeral and each indicator piece of the readout

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Redirection is the recovery mechanism: any amount of erratic movement only reshapes the trail, it never breaks or resets the composition
interaction_model.state_change: Each piece re-aims toward the new target from wherever it currently sits, preserving its current position and momentum
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The trail bends toward the new direction with no restart, snap-back or positional jump
interaction_model.input: Further pointer movement while pieces are still in flight
interaction_model.affected_object: All pieces currently in motion

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Resolution always completes; a stationary pointer guarantees return to one assembled face
interaction_model.state_change: The staggered cascade completes and every piece converges on the leader dot position
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The trail shortens and gathers until a single tidy readout stands at the resting point
interaction_model.input: Pointer held still (pause)
interaction_model.affected_object: The full set of pieces

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: The value display is never paused, frozen or invalidated by the motion
interaction_model.state_change: Their orientation keeps advancing with the real value regardless of whether pieces are assembled or in flight
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The reading stays correct and legible during dispersal, so the object never looks broken while scattered
interaction_model.input: Autonomous passage of the underlying live value
interaction_model.affected_object: Indicator pieces representing the value

experience_qualities: Quiet and sparse at rest, playful in motion
Loosely tethered rather than solid: pieces feel connected by soft elastic rather than rigid structure
Forgiving: no state where the object looks broken, scattered permanently or lost
Legible throughout: expressiveness never costs readability
Sequenced rather than chaotic, thanks to the consistent beat between piece releases
completion_and_return: Every interaction burst completes by converging into one tidy assembled readout at the pointer's last position
There is no terminal state; the behaviour re-arms indefinitely with each new pointer movement
The resting position persists wherever the pointer stopped rather than snapping back to the original centre
The initial centred, assembled arrangement is the state shown on arrival
locked_observable_requirements: One composite readout that comes apart into individually moving pieces and always reassembles into a single tidy whole
A small target marker that follows the pointer instantly, in contrast to the lagging pieces
Staggered release with a consistent beat between pieces, producing a readable trail order rather than simultaneous movement
A fixed, recognizable ordering of which piece types lead and which trail
Mid-flight redirection continues from current positions with no restart, jump or snap-back
The displayed value remains correct and instantly readable at every stage, including full dispersal
Sparse, near-empty surroundings with the readout as the only foreground object, separated from the surround by contrast sufficient for continuous legibility
Guaranteed convergence when input stops
adaptable_details: Exact lag duration, stagger interval and easing character of the elastic motion
Hue choices, surround luminance level, typography and stroke weight, in any combination that keeps the readout legible against its surround
Size and visual prominence of the target marker, including making it subtle
Number and styling of pieces and whether marks are numerals, ticks or short labels
Overall scale of the composite object within the view
Face shape or arrangement of the surrounding marks
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits any small, fixed set of legible pieces that together form one composite foreground readout or emblem sitting alone in a sparse view, where the composite must stay readable while playing. It stops being this Skill if the pieces lose legibility while scattered, if they never reassemble into a single whole, if the trail becomes generic ornament or particles with no readable composite, if the driver becomes scroll or time instead of pointer position, or if the effect is placed behind dense foreground content as a background layer.

name: submerged_drifting_type_menu
description: Opening the menu sinks the page into a deep, enveloping water-like field where all destination names lie on one enormous horizontal line; only the stretch under the pointer or keyboard focus reads clearly, filling with slow shifting grain, while the rest ripples, stretches and dissolves back into the surrounding field.

canonical_document.name: submerged_drifting_type_menu
canonical_document.description: Opening the menu sinks the page into a deep, enveloping water-like field where all destination names lie on one enormous horizontal line; only the stretch under the pointer or keyboard focus reads clearly, filling with slow shifting grain, while the rest ripples, stretches and dissolves back into the surrounding field.
canonical_document.experience_scope: A whole-view mode, not an inset panel: it begins when the open control is activated from the ordinary reading view, occupies the entire viewport for as long as it is open, and ends either by closing back to the untouched reading view or by committing to a destination.
content_and_composition: Base reading layer beneath: one headline, one date line, and a small set of short numbered text excerpts, plus one persistent control that opens the menu.

Overlay field: a deep, uniform, water-like medium held far enough in luminance from the lettering to keep it readable, which the base layer sinks into and into which the far ends of the lettering dissolve.
One continuous horizontal line of large destination words — a handful of short labels — running past both edges of the viewport rather than stacked as a list.
A single soft clear reading zone: a moving window of legibility on that line, centred on the pointer position or on the keyboard-focused name.
Distortion gradient: ripple, stretching and fade into the surrounding field increasing with distance from the clear zone in both directions.
One persistent close control available while the overlay is open.
experience_progression: Reading state: attention lands on the headline, then the date, then the numbered excerpts, all static.
Entry: the reading layer loses contrast and sinks away as the enveloping water field takes over and the lettering line surfaces through it.
Browsing: an open-ended, non-terminating state — the line glides and settles as attention moves; there are no fixed steps or ordered stages.
Commitment: the currently legible name is chosen and the view resolves to that destination.
Exit: the enveloping field lifts and the reading layer returns exactly as it was left.
attention_and_information_flow: While the overlay is open, the base reading content loses all prominence and merges into the uniform overlay field.
Only one name, at most two, is legible at any instant; everything else is present as rhythm and mass rather than readable words.
Legibility is spatially scarce and follows the visitor: prominence is granted by proximity to the clear zone, not by order or size differences between names.
Slowly shifting grain inside the lettering marks which single name is currently actionable, distinguishing it from names that are merely close to legible.
Names far from attention communicate that more destinations exist without disclosing which, encouraging lateral exploration.

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: A separate close control, also pointer- and keyboard-reachable, returns to the reading view with its content unchanged; the transition can be reversed at any time without committing to a destination
interaction_model.state_change: Reading view transitions into the submerged menu mode
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The headline, date and excerpts lose contrast and sink into the uniform field while the large lettering line emerges through drifting water
interaction_model.input: Activating the open control by pointer or keyboard
interaction_model.affected_object: The whole view: base reading layer and the overlay field

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Movement is continuously reversible; when the pointer stops, the line eases to rest rather than halting abruptly, and reversing direction retraces earlier names
interaction_model.state_change: The line glides in the direction opposite the pointer motion while the clear zone recentres on the pointer
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Different names are drawn through the legible window; rippling, stretching and fading into the surrounding field strengthen with distance from the pointer
interaction_model.input: Moving the pointer sideways
interaction_model.affected_object: The entire lettering line and the clear reading zone

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Moving away drains the grain and lets the name fall back into the distorted field; no commitment has been made
interaction_model.state_change: That name becomes the actionable destination
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The name fills with slowly shifting grain while reading clearly against its lower-contrast, rippling neighbours
interaction_model.input: Pointer resting over a name
interaction_model.affected_object: The letterforms of that single name

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Closing instead of clicking abandons the choice; a release that ended a drag never counts as a commitment
interaction_model.state_change: Navigation to the corresponding section
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The overlay resolves and the chosen destination takes over the view
interaction_model.input: Click or tap on the legible name
interaction_model.affected_object: The whole view

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Releasing after a drag returns to browsing without jumping anywhere; a press with no drag is still read as a choice, so accidental navigation while pulling is impossible
interaction_model.state_change: The line is pulled directly along under the held pointer and the pending release is disarmed
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The line follows the drag and keeps easing onward after release instead of stopping dead
interaction_model.input: Press and drag horizontally
interaction_model.affected_object: The entire lettering line

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Reverse traversal eases back the other way; the open and close controls are reachable in the same focus path, so the mode can be entered and left without a pointer
interaction_model.state_change: Focus advances to the next or previous name in line order
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The line eases sideways until the focused name occupies the clear reading zone with its grain fill, while its neighbours ripple away
interaction_model.input: Tab and reverse-tab
interaction_model.affected_object: Focus among the destination names and the position of the line

experience_qualities: Calm, unhurried and drifting rather than precise or snappy
Deep, submerged and enveloping, with a sense of thickness between viewer and lettering
Approximate: names are found by sweeping and settling, not by aiming
Physical and weighted when dragged, as if pulling something heavy through liquid
Hushed and monumental, with legibility as a scarce moving privilege
completion_and_return: Browsing has no completion state; the line continues to drift and settle for as long as the mode is open.
Closing restores the previous reading view with its headline, date and numbered excerpts unchanged.
Choosing a name ends the mode by moving on to that section.
Motion always resolves to a settled, readable rest position rather than stopping mid-distortion.
locked_observable_requirements: The mode fills the whole view and suppresses everything else into one uniform, low-distraction field; the previous content returns unchanged on close.
All destinations share one continuous horizontal line of large lettering rather than a stacked or gridded list.
Exactly one clear reading zone exists, and it tracks the pointer position or the keyboard-focused name.
Ripple, stretching and fade into the surrounding field increase with distance from that zone, so distant names are unreadable.
Horizontal pointer movement glides the line in the opposite direction.
The single attended name fills with slowly shifting grain.
Dragging pulls the line and suppresses navigation on release, while a click or tap without dragging commits.
Keyboard traversal eases the line so the focused name becomes the legible one.
All motion reads as slow easing and settling; nothing snaps into place.
adaptable_details: Number and wording of destination labels and the typeface used
Exact ripple amplitude, wavelength and drift speed, and how far legibility extends
Character, colouring and texture of the shifting grain fill
Easing durations and how far the line coasts after a drag
Whether the line loops endlessly or has soft, resisting ends
Which content types make up the base reading layer
Appearance and placement of the open and close controls
Whether the line's position is remembered when the mode is reopened
Presence of ambient sound
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits a small set of short, text-only destinations on atmospheric entry pages that can hand the whole view over to one enveloping, low-distraction field, where slow, exploratory browsing is acceptable and the underlying content is quiet editorial text. Labels must be brief enough to read inside one narrow legible window. It becomes a different Skill if destinations need thumbnails or descriptions, if there are enough items that visitors must scan or compare them, if the interface must feel precise and immediately legible, or if the drifting distorted lettering is repurposed as a permanent backdrop beneath readable foreground content instead of a mode that takes over and hands the page back.

name: panel_run_of_shatterable_buttons
description: Full-bleed panels scrolled one by one, each on its own distinct flat surface, and each with a single centered labeled button that wipes away from one edge while flinging tiny fading fragments, then rebuilds from those fragments when a small corner restore control is clicked.

canonical_document.name: panel_run_of_shatterable_buttons
canonical_document.description: Full-bleed panels scrolled one by one, each on its own distinct flat surface, and each with a single centered labeled button that wipes away from one edge while flinging tiny fading fragments, then rebuilds from those fragments when a small corner restore control is clicked.
canonical_document.experience_scope: Whole-view experience: begins on a calm full-bleed title panel and continues through a vertical run of full-bleed panels; each individual burst-and-restore episode is contained entirely within its own panel and ends when the button stands whole again.
content_and_composition: One opening full-bleed title panel with quiet centered introductory text and no interactive item, setting a calm baseline before the run
A sequence of full-bleed panels, one per showcased item, each on its own flat uninterrupted surface that reads as clearly separated from the surfaces of neighbouring panels
Exactly one large labeled interactive element per panel, centered and isolated as that panel's sole focus
A short text label bound to the interactive element, rendered on top of it with enough contrast against it to stay readable at rest
Transient fragment layer occupying the element's immediate surroundings, appearing only during transitions and overlapping the panel surface
A small restore control that appears only after a burst completes, pinned to the panel's top corner rather than near the vacated element
Panels remain visually parallel in structure so items read as members of one set despite their differing surfaces and burst characters
experience_progression: Calm title panel at rest invites downward movement
Downward travel brings one panel at a time to fill the view, each presenting a single element at rest
On activation, the element disappears progressively from one side across the element rather than vanishing at once
Fragments spray outward off the advancing receding edge and fade as they travel
The label stays fixed in place until the last sliver of the element is gone
Panel reaches a momentarily bare state, visibly missing its element
Restore control pops into the top corner, marking the bare state as temporary
Activating the restore control removes that control and draws fragments back inward
Fragments converge until the element stands whole, labeled and clickable at its original rest appearance
Cycle can repeat indefinitely on the same panel and independently on any other panel
attention_and_information_flow: Opening title panel deliberately withholds interaction so the first attention is on the invitation to move downward
Each panel's uninterrupted full-bleed surface and single centered element collapse attention onto one item at a time
During the burst, prominence shifts from the intact element to the motion of the fragments and the advancing edge
The persisting label keeps the item's identity legible while its body is being consumed
The bare panel briefly reads as an absence, creating a question that the corner restore control immediately answers
The corner restore control is small and appears late, signaling recoverability without competing with the panel's main focus
After restoration attention returns to the intact element, with no residue indicating anything happened

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Free movement in both directions; panels retain whatever state they were left in, whether intact or bare
interaction_model.state_change: Successive panels move into view, each becoming the current single-item stage
interaction_model.visible_feedback: One large full-bleed panel at a time fills the view with its lone labeled element, its surface plainly distinct from the panel before it
interaction_model.input: Downward scrolling through the page
interaction_model.affected_object: Sequence of full-bleed panels

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Clicks are ignored for the duration of the disappearance; the transition always runs to completion and always ends in a recoverable bare state; only the clicked panel is affected
interaction_model.state_change: Intact state transitions to bare state via a directional disappearance
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The element is eaten away progressively from one side while tiny fragments fling outward from the receding edge and fade; the label holds position until the final sliver disappears; the panel is left bare
interaction_model.input: Click on a panel's labeled element
interaction_model.affected_object: That element, its label and the fragment layer inside that panel

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Appears only once the fragments have died out, so it never overlaps the burst; persists until used
interaction_model.state_change: Hidden restore control becomes present
interaction_model.visible_feedback: A small control pops into the top corner of the bare panel, readable against that panel's surface
interaction_model.input: Burst reaching its end
interaction_model.affected_object: Restore control in the panel's top corner

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Clicks are ignored during the rebuild; on completion the element is clickable again and looks exactly as it did at rest, so the cycle can be repeated
interaction_model.state_change: Bare state transitions back to intact state via reversed fragment motion
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The restore control leaves the corner and fragments are drawn back inward until the element stands whole and labeled again
interaction_model.input: Click on the restore control
interaction_model.affected_object: Restore control, fragment layer and the absent element

experience_qualities: Playful and lively rather than mechanical
Calm, spacious opening contrasted against energetic per-item bursts
Consequence-free: destruction always reads as temporary and plainly reversible
Each panel's burst carries its own character, so the set feels varied rather than repeated
Tactile and satisfying, rewarding repeated triggering
Focused, one-item-at-a-time viewing with no visual competition
completion_and_return: Each episode completes when fragments finish converging and the element is whole, labeled and clickable
Restored appearance matches the pre-click rest appearance exactly, with no leftover fragments or offsets
Bare state persists indefinitely until the restore control is used, including while scrolled away and back
Panels hold their own state independently; one panel being bare never changes another
The burst-and-restore cycle is fully repeatable on any panel any number of times
locked_observable_requirements: Calm full-bleed title panel opens the experience with no interactive item
One full-bleed panel per item, each on its own flat surface clearly separated from neighbouring panels' surfaces, containing exactly one large labeled interactive element as its sole focus
Disappearance is progressive and directional from one side, never an all-at-once removal or simple fade of the whole element
Tiny fragments spray outward from the receding edge and fade as they go
The element's label stays in place until the last sliver of the element is gone, remaining readable against the element throughout
A visibly bare panel state follows the burst
A small restore control appears in the panel's top corner only after the burst finishes
Restoration reverses the fragment motion inward rather than simply re-showing the element
Restored element is pixel-faithful to its rest appearance and immediately clickable again
Input during either transition is ignored
Each panel responds only for itself
Each panel's burst has its own distinguishable character
adaptable_details: Number of panels and items in the run
The specific surface treatment chosen for each panel, element shapes, sizes and label wording
Which side the disappearance advances from and its speed
Fragment count, size, spray spread, trajectory and fade timing
Exact character that differentiates each panel's burst
Which top corner holds the restore control and how it is depicted
Title panel copy and typography
Panel height and vertical spacing so long as each panel dominates the view
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits sets of small, self-contained, individually activatable labeled elements presented one per full-bleed section, where each element can be destroyed and rebuilt without losing anything. Content-dense elements, elements holding entered or accumulated state, or elements whose disappearance carries real consequence do not fit. Moving the burst onto large content regions, running many panels' bursts simultaneously, removing the bare-then-restore cycle, collapsing the panels into indistinguishable surfaces, or replacing the directional fragment disintegration with a plain fade or transform would create a different Skill.

name: corner_cascading_flat_block_menu_takeover
description: A sparse title-only opening whose single corner text line opens a full-screen field of flat, evenly filled blocks that swell one at a time out of a bottom corner, smallest to largest, each carrying one destination label, and retract in the same order after a choice.

canonical_document.name: corner_cascading_flat_block_menu_takeover
canonical_document.description: A sparse title-only opening whose single corner text line opens a full-screen field of flat, evenly filled blocks that swell one at a time out of a bottom corner, smallest to largest, each carrying one destination label, and retract in the same order after a choice.
canonical_document.experience_scope: Whole-view experience layered over the site's reading content. It begins at the sparse arrival view (identity facts plus one corner invitation line), expands to cover the entire viewport when that line is activated, and ends when a destination label or the in-block dismiss control is activated and every block has retracted, leaving the reading view visible again.
content_and_composition: One arrival text group of essential identity facts: a primary name plus two short supporting lines (dates and place), set on an otherwise empty field
Exactly one small, quiet, text-only invitation line placed in a lower corner; it is the only entry point into navigation

A stepped cascade of several flat blocks (roughly four to six), each filled with a single uniform tone that separates it clearly from the block it overlays, all anchored to the same bottom corner, nested so each is visibly larger than the one before it, together covering the full viewport when the run completes
One short destination label per block, settling into place as its block finishes growing
One dismiss control living inside one of the blocks rather than outside the field
The current section's reading content persists behind the block field and is never removed, only covered
experience_progression: Arrival: only the identity facts and the lone corner invitation line are visible; no navigation is exposed
Opening run: on activation, blocks swell outward from the bottom corner one at a time, tiniest first, each starting only after the previous has finished, so the field builds in strict order
Destinations arrive in turn as each block's label settles, until the full set of choices is present and the view is entirely covered
Choice: the section behind swaps immediately, then the closing run begins
Closing run: blocks retract one at a time in the same order they arrived, uncovering the reading view
Return: the sparse-to-full cycle can be repeated identically from any section
attention_and_information_flow: Attention starts extremely narrow, held by a few identity lines with nothing competing
The single corner line is the only interactive prominence on arrival, so the way in is unambiguous despite being quiet
During opening, attention widens outward from the corner in step with the growing blocks; each new, larger block adds one more readable destination rather than revealing all options at once
Pointing at a label lowers its emphasis faintly, confirming which destination is targeted without adding decoration
After a choice, prominence transfers back to the newly present section content as the blocks withdraw

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Once started, the run continues to a fully open field; additional activations during the run are ignored so the arrangement is never left half-built
interaction_model.state_change: Closed to fully open
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Flat, evenly filled blocks swell out of the bottom corner in sequence, smallest first and each larger than the last, progressively covering the whole view while their labels settle in
interaction_model.input: Activating the single corner invitation line
interaction_model.affected_object: The full-view block field

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Reverts to its resting appearance as soon as the pointer leaves; no other block or label is affected
interaction_model.state_change: Resting to pointed
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The label's emphasis drops faintly while pointed at
interaction_model.input: Pointing at a destination label
interaction_model.affected_object: That destination label

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Further activations are ignored until the closing run finishes; the run always ends with the field fully closed on the chosen section
interaction_model.state_change: Section swaps immediately; field goes from open to closing
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The chosen section is already present behind as blocks retract one at a time in the order they arrived, uncovering it
interaction_model.input: Activating a destination label
interaction_model.affected_object: The section content behind the field and the block field itself

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Ignored while an opening or closing run is in progress; guarantees a way out that does not commit to a new destination
interaction_model.state_change: Open to closing, with the current section unchanged
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Every block retracts in arrival order, revealing the same section that was being read before
interaction_model.input: Activating the dismiss control inside one of the blocks
interaction_model.affected_object: The block field only

experience_qualities: Sparse and quiet on arrival, with almost nothing competing for attention
Stepped and rhythmic rather than simultaneous, each block waiting its turn
Expansive: the field grows outward from a single corner until it owns the view
Flat and graphic, built from plain uniform-tone areas and short text
Decisive and calm at the moment of choosing, with an exit that is always obvious
completion_and_return: Every opening or closing run plays through to its end state; the field is only ever fully open or fully closed at rest
Choosing a destination ends with the field closed and the chosen section already in place, so reading resumes without a further step
Dismissing ends with the field closed and the previous section unchanged
The field resets to its closed state and can be reopened from the corner line in exactly the same way from any section
locked_observable_requirements: Arrival exposes only essential identity facts plus one small text invitation in a lower corner, and that line is the only way into navigation
The open field covers the entire view, not a panel or partial region
Blocks are flat areas of a single uniform tone each, distinguishable from the block they overlay, carrying short text labels at readable contrast, with no imagery or ornament
All blocks originate from the same bottom corner and are strictly increasing in size, smallest first
Blocks appear and disappear strictly one at a time, each waiting for the previous to finish
Closing retracts blocks in the same order they arrived
Labels drop faintly in emphasis while pointed at, while staying readable
Choosing swaps the section behind before the blocks finish retracting, so reading resumes on the chosen section
A dismiss control sits inside one of the blocks and closes everything without changing section
Inputs are ignored while an opening or closing run is in progress
adaptable_details: Number of destinations and therefore number of blocks
Which tones fill the blocks and how much separation and label contrast sits between them
Which bottom corner anchors the cascade and the direction it widens
Typography, size and casing of labels and of the invitation line
Exact timing, easing and shape of each block's growth
Wording of the arrival identity facts
Which block hosts the dismiss control and how that control is drawn
Whether activation comes from pointer, keyboard or touch
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits small sites with a handful of flat top-level destinations whose names fit in a few words, and whose opening view is intentionally sparse. Content-heavy menus with many entries, nested or multi-level destination structures, blocks filled with imagery, previews or long descriptions, all blocks appearing at once, a partially covering panel, or a persistent always-visible navigation bar would each produce a different skill.

name: inverting_trailing_marker_on_split_field
description: The viewport is divided into two tonal fields separated by a wide luminance gap, with a small label group resting in a corner; a marker trails the pointer with soft lag, inverts the field beneath it so it stays visible on either side, and swells while the pointer rests on a label.

canonical_document.name: inverting_trailing_marker_on_split_field
canonical_document.description: The viewport is divided into two tonal fields separated by a wide luminance gap, with a small label group resting in a corner; a marker trails the pointer with soft lag, inverts the field beneath it so it stays visible on either side, and swells while the pointer rests on a label.
canonical_document.experience_scope: Whole-view experience covering the entire viewport: the split field is the persistent substrate, the marker is active wherever the pointer moves inside the view, and the experience has no start or end state beyond the calm resting composition it returns to.
content_and_composition: Exactly two large tonal fields held far apart in luminance, dividing the full viewport with a hard edge and no intermediate decoration
One quiet label group of a few short text links placed in a single corner rather than centered or spread across the view
One travelling marker layered above both fields and above the labels, small relative to the viewport
The marker reads as inverting the tone of whatever field or text lies beneath it, so it is never lost against either side
No other foreground imagery competing with the fields, labels and marker
attention_and_information_flow: At rest the composition is calm and the eye is held by the field split and the corner labels
During pointer movement the marker becomes the primary moving focus, its lag making its path legible
As the pointer approaches and enters a label, the swelling marker raises that label's apparent reachability without changing the label's own styling into a busy control
When the pointer leaves the labels, prominence returns to the static composition

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Inversion is continuous with position, so crossing the field edge mid-motion produces no flicker or momentary loss of the marker
interaction_model.state_change: Marker's rendered tone relationship inverts against the tone underneath it
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The marker appears to punch through and reverse whatever lies beneath, remaining clearly legible on either tonal field and across the dividing edge
interaction_model.input: Pointer crossing over any part of the view where the tonal field or label tone changes
interaction_model.affected_object: Region of field or label beneath the marker

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Leaving the label shrinks the marker back to resting size along the same smooth path
interaction_model.state_change: Marker grows smoothly from resting size to an enlarged hover size
interaction_model.visible_feedback: A soft swell of the marker around the label, making the label read as reachable
interaction_model.input: Pointer entering a label
interaction_model.affected_object: Travelling marker

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Any number of quick in-and-out passes stays smooth and eventually settles at the size matching the final pointer position
interaction_model.state_change: Size transition reverses from its current in-between value toward the newly targeted size
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Continuous growth or shrinkage with no snap, jump or restart from the beginning of the transition
interaction_model.input: Rapid pointer entry and exit of a label before the size change finishes
interaction_model.affected_object: Marker size state

experience_qualities: Stark, with a wide tonal separation between the two fields
Minimal and quiet at rest
Weighted, fluid and worth watching in motion
Legible everywhere, never losing the marker against the substrate beneath it
Responsive without being twitchy
completion_and_return: No completion state; the experience idles indefinitely
Marker always comes to rest exactly under the stopped pointer
Marker returns to resting size when the pointer is on no label
Composition settles back to its calm resting appearance once pointer attention drifts away
locked_observable_requirements: Viewport split into two tonal fields whose luminance separation is wide enough to read as opposed, serving as the substrate

adaptable_details: Orientation and position of the field division (vertical, horizontal or diagonal)
Which corner holds the labels and how many labels there are

canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits sparse whole-view compositions with a small label or link set and large flat tonal areas, where a pointer-driven marker can be the main moving element. Dense content, imagery-heavy or scrolling views break the inversion legibility and the calm resting state. Removing the tonal split, narrowing the two fields' luminance separation until inversion stops reading, removing the inversion behavior, or making the marker lock rigidly to the pointer would each produce a different Skill.

canonical_document.name: blooming_form_wait_screen_family
canonical_document.description: A single form blooms at the center of a full-bleed field of one uniform tone, holds a calm hypnotic rhythm for several seconds, then rushes forward until the field drains away and a quiet page with one word settles in; replay and small markers or arrow keys move between eight sibling screens without a reload jolt.

content_and_composition: One edge-to-edge field of a single uniform tone filling the viewport as the sole backdrop during the wait, with no chrome or copy over it
Exactly one generated form as the single focal object, centered in the field
One resolved page carrying a single one-word name as its only foreground content, quiet and plainly finished
One row of eight small markers as variant selectors, the active one visibly highlighted
One replay control available on the settled page

Eight sibling screens sharing the same composition grammar (single centered form, flat full-bleed uniform field, one-word resolution) while differing in form, field tone and rhythm so they read as one family
experience_progression: Bloom: the form emerges from nothing at the center of the full-bleed uniform field
Hold: the form sustains a calm, hypnotic, rhythmic motion for several seconds so the wait reads as intentional

Settle: the quiet page with the one-word name arrives and comes to rest, visibly complete

attention_and_information_flow: During the wait, attention is fully held by one centered object on an otherwise empty uniform field; nothing competes and no text is shown
The forward rush transfers attention from the object to the draining field, then to the incoming resolved page
The only piece of revealed information is the single word at the end, which becomes the sole foreground element

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: The active marker cannot be re-selected; switching never causes a reload flash, and choosing another marker again simply fades out and starts that screen
interaction_model.state_change: Current screen is retired and the chosen sibling becomes active and starts its own run
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The current view fades out completely, then the chosen screen appears and begins its own bloom-hold-rush-settle sequence; the newly active marker is highlighted
interaction_model.input: Choosing one of the small markers (an inactive one)
interaction_model.affected_object: The active screen of the family

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Wraparound means neither end is a dead stop; stepping repeatedly keeps cycling through the family
interaction_model.state_change: Selection steps one position back or forward through the fixed set, wrapping around at either end
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Same fade-out of the current view followed by the incoming screen's own run, with the highlighted marker moving to the new position
interaction_model.input: Pressing the left or right key
interaction_model.affected_object: The active screen of the family

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Refitting never restarts or interrupts the sequence in progress
interaction_model.state_change: Scene refits to the new viewport dimensions

interaction_model.affected_object: Uniform field and centered form

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Resumption is automatic; the visitor never has to restart to see the part they missed
interaction_model.state_change: Progression holds while the view is hidden instead of racing ahead
interaction_model.visible_feedback: On return the motion continues from the moment it was left, with no jump forward and no skipped stage
