interaction_model.affected_object: The running sequence's motion and timing

experience_qualities: Calm and hypnotic rather than busy or anxious
The wait feels intentional and composed, not stalled
Unhurried hold followed by a decisive forward release
Minimal, quiet resolution that reads as plainly finished
Family resemblance across all members despite visibly different forms and field tones
Seamless movement between screens with no reload jolt
Worth watching again
completion_and_return: Each run ends in a stable settled page that does not auto-advance or loop on its own
Replay resets the whole view and re-runs the sequence from nothing, identically enough to be re-watched
Switching screens resets the view and starts the incoming screen from its own first moment
The active selection persists as a marker highlight after the sequence settles
Interrupted timing resumes rather than being discarded when the view becomes visible again
locked_observable_requirements: One single form as the only focal object, centered on an edge-to-edge field of one uniform tone with no other foreground content during the wait
A multi-second calm, rhythmic hold between the bloom and the resolution
Resolution by rushing the view forward until the uniform field drains fully away
A settled minimal page whose only content is one short name, visibly complete
A replay control that restarts from the very first moment, with content dropping away, the uniform field returning and the form rebuilding from nothing
A fixed small set of sibling screens selectable both by small markers and by left/right key stepping with wraparound
Full fade-out of the current view before the incoming screen appears and starts its own run
Active marker highlighted and not re-selectable
Scene continues to fill the viewport on resize, without restarting

No full page reload when replaying or switching
adaptable_details: Number of siblings in the set and how many markers appear
The specific geometry, texture and motion character of each form
The tone of each field, in any hue or luminance, provided it reads as one uniform surface clearly separated from the form and from the settled page's low-distraction surround

canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits any context wanting a full-viewport, single-focus motion moment that resolves into a near-empty titled state, or a browsable family of such moments as a page's main attraction; content must stay minimal (one focal object during the run, one short word at rest). Placing the field and form behind readable page content as a persistent substrate, filling the wait with multiple informational elements or copy, removing the forward-rush resolution into a named settled page, or tying the progression to determinate real-load progress reporting would each create a different Skill.

name: dwell_triggered_container_peek

canonical_document.name: dwell_triggered_container_peek
canonical_document.description: Point steadily at a closed container icon and its lid tips open while the items inside spring outward around it; move away and everything snaps back closed.
canonical_document.experience_scope: Region-level effect attached to a single compact interactive object. Resting composition shows only the closed container with no trace of the preview items
Surrounding duplicate containers rendered dimmed and inert as visual context only

canonical_document.name: blooming_accent_sheet_card_reveal

canonical_document.experience_scope: A per-card region experience inside a multi-card page. It begins when the pointer crosses into a single card's picture area and ends when the pointer leaves and that card has returned fully to rest; the surrounding page and other cards are unaffected and there is no whole-view takeover.

interaction_model.input: Pointer crosses into a card's picture area

Surprising through unpredictable variation in kind and scale
Snappy and residue-free: instant appearance after a hair-trigger pause, instant clearance
Tactile and held, so the reader feels in direct control of how long the surprise lasts
Colour-fused, with media and letters contaminating each other's tones rather than staying separate
completion_and_return: No overall completion state; the page ends when the reading ends
Each reveal completes the moment the hold stops, restoring the untouched reading view
Reveals do not accumulate, mark used words, or persist as visited state — every return to a word is a fresh performance from the start
Any running motion or sound is terminated by return to reading rather than allowed to finish
locked_observable_requirements: The experience is presented only once its imagery is ready, never partially armed
A dense text wall held at strong contrast against its page surface is the standing foreground; media is always secondary and transient
A handful of emphasised words visibly promise hidden content before anything is revealed
A barely perceptible pause precedes every reveal, and quick skimming cancels pending reveals instead of flashing them
Media is anchored centred on its own trigger word and stays correct wherever that word sits or wraps
Reveals differ in kind and scale across the set, including at least one inline snapshot-sized item and at least one that briefly covers the whole screen
Revealed media and surrounding letters share a colour treatment so they bleed into each other instead of reading as a separate card, in whatever hue family the host page uses
Some reveals move or make sound while held
Media exists only while the word is held; leaving or lifting clears it at once and stops any playback
Revealed media never catches the pointer or blocks the words underneath
Re-entering a word replays its entrance from the beginning, and no residue of past reveals remains
adaptable_details: Number and spacing of emphasised words down the page
Typeface, hue family and surface tone, column width and exact emphasis styling
Subject matter of the hidden media and the proportion that moves or sounds
Exact length of the pre-reveal pause and the form of the entrance animation
Precise sizes between the inline and screen-covering extremes
How the colour bleed is achieved visually and how strong it reads
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits any text-first page where continuous prose is the main foreground and a curated handful of words can each carry one hand-picked media item — long essays, manifestos, annotated writing, personal or campaign pages, in any hue family or light-versus-dark treatment the host provides. It stops being this Skill if reveals persist after release or stack up, if triggers become clickable navigation that opens panels, lightboxes or new views, if media is relocated to a fixed frame, sidebar or gallery instead of being anchored on the word, if every term is uniformly annotated as an informational tooltip, or if the media becomes interactive and takes the pointer away from the text.

name: self_resetting_button_distortion_gallery

canonical_document.name: self_resetting_button_distortion_gallery
canonical_document.description: A bold title opens a long run of numbered, widely spaced slots, each holding one plain-looking button that briefly turns liquid, swells and drifts under the pointer, or tears apart and recomposes when pressed, then settles back to exactly how it looked before.
canonical_document.experience_scope: Whole-view experience: begins at the opening title and runs through the full sequence of specimen slots, with no destination or exit. Inside it, each specimen episode begins on pointer entry or press and ends when that specimen is back at its resting appearance.
content_and_composition: One bold opening title block establishing that the view is a set of specimens
A run of many separately numbered slots, one per specimen, with generous spacing so a single specimen occupies attention at a time
Exactly one interactive control specimen per slot, presented at a plain resting appearance that reads as ordinary uniform type on a uniform shape
Persistent per-slot number as the only framing element besides empty surround
Short specimen labels; on the one persistent-state specimen the label doubles as an announcement of what the next press will do
No navigation chrome, destinations, forms, or shared multi-specimen composition
experience_progression: Opening title sets expectation of a comparable set
Free traversal down the numbered run with no required order
Per specimen: plain rest, onset of distortion on hover or press, peak deformation where solid material behaves like liquid or breaks apart, recomposition, return to identical rest
Traversal continues indefinitely with unlimited retries in any order
attention_and_information_flow: Title carries prominence first, then spacing hands prominence to one specimen at a time
At rest a specimen conceals its behavior, so the transformation reads as a small surprise rather than an advertised feature
During an episode all prominence collapses onto the single deforming specimen; its neighbors stay inert
Returning to rest re-levels prominence across the set so specimens stay mutually comparable
The persistent-state specimen is the only one that reveals forthcoming behavior in advance, through its label

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Moving the pointer away unwinds the deformation smoothly back to rest with no residue; no press required and none is implied
interaction_model.state_change: Rest to continuously engaged while the pointer remains over it
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Edges swell outward and the inner mass drifts after the pointer's position
interaction_model.input: Pointer rests over a hover-responsive specimen
interaction_model.affected_object: That specimen's outline and its inner mass

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Pressing again mid-effect restarts the effect cleanly from the beginning instead of stacking or overlapping; the specimen always lands back at its plain resting appearance
interaction_model.state_change: Rest to a single playing distortion and back to rest
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Solid type and shape behave like liquid, or momentarily tear apart and then recompose
interaction_model.input: Press on a momentary specimen
interaction_model.affected_object: The whole specimen, its type and its shape

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: A new press restarts the radiation from the new contact point rather than adding a second overlapping wave
interaction_model.state_change: Rest to outward propagation from the contact point and back to rest
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The effect visibly emanates from exactly where the press landed, not from a fixed centre
interaction_model.input: Press on a specimen whose effect radiates outward
interaction_model.affected_object: The origin and spread of the radiating deformation

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: The state is fully reversible by pressing again, which settles the specimen back to rest; the label always describes the currently available next change
interaction_model.state_change: Settled to continuously restless, and back to settled on the next press
interaction_model.visible_feedback: A continuous unsettled motion runs indefinitely while active; the label switches to name the outcome of the next press
interaction_model.input: Press on the persistent-state specimen
interaction_model.affected_object: That specimen's ongoing motion and its own label

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Every attempt is consequence-free and endlessly repeatable in any order
interaction_model.state_change: None; no navigation, submission or accumulated consequence
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Nothing beyond the addressed specimen changes
interaction_model.input: Any hover or press anywhere in the set
interaction_model.affected_object: The page as a whole

experience_qualities: Playful and low-stakes
Surprising, because plain-looking material misbehaves
Tactile and physically suggestive: liquid, swelling, drifting, tearing
Momentary and self-cleaning rather than cumulative
Calm, uncluttered and comparison-friendly between episodes
Restless and alive only where a state is deliberately held
completion_and_return: Every momentary effect completes by returning the specimen to an appearance identical to its start state
No effect leaves accumulated or partial deformation behind
Interrupting an effect resolves into a clean restart rather than a broken intermediate state
The one held state persists until the user presses again, and its label continually reflects the next outcome
The view itself never completes; it stays open to unlimited retries in any order
locked_observable_requirements: Bold opening title followed by individually numbered, generously spaced slots holding exactly one specimen each
Every specimen looks like ordinary uniform type on a uniform shape while at rest, with the type held at readable contrast against that shape
At least one specimen makes solid material behave like liquid, and at least one momentarily breaks apart and recomposes
Hover-responsive specimens swell at the edges and let their inner mass drift after the pointer, then unwind smoothly on pointer exit
Radiating effects originate exactly at the point that was pressed
Pressing again mid-effect restarts that effect cleanly instead of stacking
Every momentary effect ends at the same plain resting appearance, and nothing navigates or submits
One specimen holds a continuous restless state until pressed again, with its label naming the next press's outcome
Only one specimen is animating at a time as a result of user attention
adaptable_details: Number of specimens and the vocabulary of additional distortions beyond the required liquid and break-apart kinds
Colour scheme, typography, shape language and specimen size
Slot arrangement as a vertical run or another one-specimen-at-a-time layout, and numbering style
Effect durations, easing and deformation intensity
Which specimens respond to hover versus press
Label wording, including the phrasing of the next-press announcement
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits sets of small, self-contained control specimens shown for inspection, trial and comparison, and also single specimens lifted into a real page where a press should feel playful but carry no consequence. It becomes a different Skill if the controls gain real destinations or submissions with lasting consequence, if deformations persist or accumulate instead of resetting, if many specimens animate together as one shared composition, or if the transformations are applied to large content regions rather than compact type-on-shape elements.

name: pulsing_sense_point_with_inward_symbol_draw
description: A lone prompt contracts on tap into a small round pulsing point that appears to pull streams of small symbols in from beyond the screen edges, then grows upward into a compact player-style result panel that can be dismissed back to the original prompt.

canonical_document.name: pulsing_sense_point_with_inward_symbol_draw
canonical_document.description: A lone prompt contracts on tap into a small round pulsing point that appears to pull streams of small symbols in from beyond the screen edges, then grows upward into a compact player-style result panel that can be dismissed back to the original prompt.
canonical_document.experience_scope: One self-contained calm view (full screen or a single dominant card region) that begins at the idle prompt, runs through sensing and result, and ends when the result collapses back to that same idle prompt; nothing else in the view participates or changes.
content_and_composition: Exactly one inviting prompt/trigger, centered and visually unmistakable as the only available action
One small round indicator that occupies the prompt's own position after activation, replacing it in place
Many small themed symbols traveling inward from beyond all view edges along converging paths toward the indicator

One result panel laid out as a compact media player: primary title line, secondary attribution line, an artwork/thumbnail block and player-style controls arranged so the panel explains itself without instructions
One small dismiss mark in a corner of the result panel
Quiet, uncluttered surroundings in every stage, with no competing content or secondary controls
experience_progression: Idle: single prompt at rest, obviously the only thing to do
Activation: on first press the prompt contracts in place into a small round pulsing point
Sensing: the point keeps pulsing while symbols stream continuously inward and converge on it for a few seconds
Resolution: the point grows upward and outward into the full result panel
Settle: panel contents arrive and come to rest, becoming readable as a compact player
Return: dismiss collapses the panel back into the original prompt, immediately ready for another run
attention_and_information_flow: At rest, all prominence is concentrated in one prompt so there is no competing candidate for the first action
During sensing, attention narrows as the prompt shrinks, and the continuous inward motion keeps pointing at the small point, communicating gathering without any text
At resolution, information expands outward from the same point, so the answer visibly comes from where the attention already was
With the panel open, the result is the only focus and its layout carries the meaning of each field
After dismissal, prominence snaps back to the single prompt with no residue of the previous result

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: The transition is immediate and one-way; the view leaves idle only through this press
interaction_model.state_change: Idle becomes sensing on the first press, without delay or confirmation
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The prompt contracts in place into a small round pulsing indicator and the inward symbol stream begins immediately
interaction_model.input: Single click or tap on the idle prompt
interaction_model.affected_object: The prompt itself and the surrounding view

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: The control becomes live again only after the cycle has returned to idle
interaction_model.state_change: No state change at all: sensing neither restarts nor ends early
interaction_model.visible_feedback: No reaction to the press; the pulse and inflow continue undisturbed
interaction_model.input: Further presses on the trigger area while sensing runs
interaction_model.affected_object: The trigger, now inert

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Occurs without user input; the panel remains open until explicitly dismissed
interaction_model.state_change: Sensing becomes result
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The indicator grows upward into the full panel and its contents settle into place
interaction_model.input: Autonomous completion of the sensing interval
interaction_model.affected_object: The pulsing indicator

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Returns the view to its exact starting state with the trigger instantly usable again
interaction_model.state_change: Result returns to idle
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The panel collapses back down into the original prompt in its original position
interaction_model.input: Click or tap on the small dismiss mark in the panel corner
interaction_model.affected_object: The result panel and the whole view

experience_qualities: Calm and single-minded: one obvious thing to do at any moment
A sense of absorption, as if the small point is drawing the surroundings into itself
Waiting that reads as active work rather than a stall
Self-explanatory result that needs no labels or instructions to interpret
Tidy, fully reversible loop with a clean return to rest
completion_and_return: A cycle completes only when the user dismisses the result
Dismissal restores the identical initial prompt in the same place, with no lingering panel, indicator or symbols
The result is not retained after dismissal and no history accumulates in the view
The cycle can be repeated indefinitely, re-armed immediately on return
locked_observable_requirements: Exactly one interactive prompt is visible while idle
The prompt contracts in place into a small round pulsing indicator rather than being replaced by a control elsewhere
Continuous inward convergence of many small symbols entering from beyond the view edges and aiming at that indicator throughout the wait
The trigger is fully inert during sensing: no restart, no cancel, no visible reaction to presses
The result emerges by growing upward out of the indicator into a compact player-style panel whose contents settle in, not as a separate overlay appearing elsewhere
A single small corner dismiss mark collapses everything back into the original prompt, immediately reusable
Surroundings stay quiet with no competing content in any stage
adaptable_details: Prompt wording, shape and size
Symbol motif, count, density, entry angles and travel speed
Pulse rate, indicator size and its color treatment
Result panel field labels, artwork treatment and control styling
Exact wait duration, easing and timing of the settle
Palette, typography, and whether the view is full-screen or a single dominant card
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits single-purpose sense, capture, detect or look-up interactions where one press begins a short indeterminate wait and yields exactly one compact structured result that can be read at a glance and then dismissed. Replacing the single result with a list, a persistent history or a multi-field form, adding other competing controls to the view, making the wait cancelable or restartable while it runs, or reversing the motion so symbols radiate outward instead of converging inward would each produce a different Skill; the symbol motif, color treatment and result field set may change freely.

name: unfolding_button_into_springy_progress_track
description: A compact round button that unbends into a horizontal track, sends its arrow hopping onto the line as a percentage capsule, bounces the line as the number climbs, states completion in words, then draws itself back into a button.

canonical_document.name: unfolding_button_into_springy_progress_track
canonical_document.description: A compact round button that unbends into a horizontal track, sends its arrow hopping onto the line as a percentage capsule, bounces the line as the number climbs, states completion in words, then draws itself back into a button.
canonical_document.experience_scope: A region experience anchored to one control's location. It begins with the control at rest, expands horizontally to the width of its container band during the run, and ends when the control has retracted to its original resting form in the same place. The surrounding page is untouched.
content_and_composition: One small round control as the only resting element in its area, with nothing to read or decide beforehand
A ring outline enclosing the control, which is the same material that later becomes the horizontal track
One directional arrow glyph inside the control, which is the same material that later becomes the moving capsule
One full-width horizontal track line occupying the control's own row during a run
Exactly one rounded capsule riding on the track, carrying a numeric percentage as its only text
One short completion sentence shown in the same spot at the end, in words rather than as an implied state
A focus outline drawn on the control while it is keyboard-focused, separated clearly enough from the control's own edge to remain distinguishable from it
No secondary status area, legend, or duplicate progress display elsewhere
experience_progression: Rest: one compact round control, obvious to act on, nothing to read first
Launch: the ring unbends into a full-width horizontal track while the arrow hops upward, drops onto the line, and widens into a rounded capsule reading 0%
Run: each progress report slides the capsule further along the track, dragging the line down beneath it before it springs back level, while the number climbs
Finish: completion is stated explicitly in words
Return: the track draws itself back into the round control, which is pressable again for an identical second run
attention_and_information_flow: At rest attention has a single target and no text to process
Attention never relocates: the launching point becomes the watching point
During the run precision comes from the number and capsule position, liveliness comes from the sagging and rebounding line
Exact standing stays readable at a glance even while the line is in motion
Completion is promoted from inferred to explicitly worded before the control resets
After return, prominence collapses back to the single resting control

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Returns to its resting size when the pointer leaves
interaction_model.state_change: Rest to hovered
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The control swells slightly
interaction_model.input: Pointer hover over the resting control
interaction_model.affected_object: The round control as a whole

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Springs back out on release; abandoning the press without activating restores the resting or hovered form
interaction_model.state_change: Hovered to pressed
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The control squashes inward
interaction_model.input: Press down on the control
interaction_model.affected_object: The round control as a whole

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Focus outline persists while focused; keyboard activation is subject to the same ignore-while-running rule as pointer activation
interaction_model.state_change: Unfocused to focused, then focused to activated
interaction_model.visible_feedback: A clearly separated focus outline appears on the control, and activation produces the same swell/squash and launch behavior as pointer use
interaction_model.input: Keyboard focus and activation
interaction_model.affected_object: The round control as a whole

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Further activation is ignored for the whole duration of the run, with no queued or duplicate run
interaction_model.state_change: Resting control to running progress display
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The ring unbends into a full-width horizontal track; the arrow hops upward, drops onto the line, and widens into a rounded capsule reading 0%
interaction_model.input: Activation of the control
interaction_model.affected_object: Ring, arrow glyph, and the control's footprint

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: The capsule stays within the track's two ends; a long gap between reports leaves the capsule parked but the arrival motion always resolves back to a level line rather than stalling mid-deformation
interaction_model.state_change: Previous reported standing to the new reported standing
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The capsule slides along the track to its new position and its number climbs, while the line is dragged down beneath the capsule and then springs back level
interaction_model.input: Each incoming progress report (autonomous driver, not user input)
interaction_model.affected_object: Percentage capsule and track line

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: The control becomes pressable again in exactly its starting form, so a second run needs no relearning
interaction_model.state_change: Running to finished to rest
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Completion is spelled out in words, then the track draws itself back into the round control in its original position and size
interaction_model.input: Run reaches its end
interaction_model.affected_object: The whole control region

experience_qualities: Springy and physical rather than mechanical or ticking
Alive even when the underlying transfer is slow or reports arrive rarely
Single-focus and low-decision: one thing to act on, one thing to watch
Precise standing readable at a glance despite the playful motion
Continuous identity: the same material becomes the track and the capsule, so the transformation reads as one object rather than a swap
Explicit and closed-out at the end, not silently finished
completion_and_return: Completion is announced in words before any reset happens
The expanded track retracts into the original round control rather than disappearing or being replaced
Final state is visually identical to the initial resting state, with no residual progress artifact
The experience is fully repeatable and behaves the same on every subsequent run
No progress state persists after return
locked_observable_requirements: At rest, a single compact round control with no accompanying text to read or choice to make
Hover swells the control and pressing squashes it inward; keyboard activation behaves identically once a focus outline is shown
On activation the enclosing ring unbends into a full-width horizontal track in the control's own row
The arrow hops upward, drops onto the track line, and widens into a rounded capsule whose initial reading is 0%
Each progress report slides the capsule along the track and drags the line downward beneath it before the line springs back level
The numeric percentage climbs and remains legible throughout the run, holding readable contrast against the capsule it sits on
Activation is ignored while a run is underway
Completion is stated in explicit words, not merely implied by a full track
The track draws itself back into the original round control, which is pressable again
adaptable_details: The glyph used at rest and the direction it hops
Exact swell, squash, sag and rebound magnitudes and their timings

How the control, track and capsule are tinted or shaded, provided the moving capsule stays the most distinct element on the track and both remain clearly separated from the surrounding surface; also the thickness of the track and capsule, and corner rounding
Numeric formatting of the percentage and the exact completion wording
How wide the expanded track is relative to its container
How long the completion wording is held before retraction
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits any single user-triggered operation whose advance can be reported as a determinate quantity and whose status belongs at the point of action: file transfers, uploads, exports, renders, or submit-and-process actions in sparse areas, cards, form footers or toolbars. It requires exactly one action, one concurrent run, and real measurable progress values. It becomes a different skill if progress is indeterminate or spinner-only, if several runs must be displayed at once, if the status is shown somewhere other than the control's own location, or if the control does not return to its original resting form.

name: elastic_edge_menu_panel
description: A concealed side panel whose leading boundary bows outward like stretched rubber, whips back past straight and wobbles to rest while the panel body follows behind and its few links drop into place one after another over a dimmed, inert page.

canonical_document.name: elastic_edge_menu_panel
canonical_document.description: A concealed side panel whose leading boundary bows outward like stretched rubber, whips back past straight and wobbles to rest while the panel body follows behind and its few links drop into place one after another over a dimmed, inert page.
canonical_document.experience_scope: Region experience anchored to one lateral view edge, paired with a view-wide dimming layer; it begins from the resting state where only a small edge handle is visible and ends when the panel has either settled fully open or returned fully concealed.
content_and_composition: A small persistent handle sitting on the panel's visible edge, present in both resting and open states
A single panel body occupying a minority of the view width and anchored to one lateral edge
A handful of primary destination links (roughly three to six) stacked in a single sequence inside the panel
A deformable boundary line forming the panel's leading edge, curving independently of the panel body
A view-wide dimming layer between the panel and the underlying page content
The existing page content as the background substrate, unchanged in layout but visually demoted while the panel is open
experience_progression: At rest: page content holds attention, only the small edge handle hints that more exists
On activation the boundary line immediately bows outward in the direction the panel is travelling, leading the motion
The bowed line whips back past straight and wobbles with decreasing amplitude until it settles flat
The panel body slides in just behind the deforming line, arriving after the bow rather than with it
The stacked links drop into place one after another in sequence rather than appearing together
Open steady state: panel settled and focal, page dimmed and inert
On dismissal the same chain runs in reverse until the panel is concealed and only the handle remains
attention_and_information_flow: At rest, prominence sits entirely with page content and the handle is a minimal peripheral cue
The bowing boundary is the first thing to move, announcing direction and character before content appears
Dimming removes the page from competition so the small set of destinations becomes the only live focus
Link prominence accumulates in reading order as each one lands, so the set is read sequentially rather than all at once
On reverse, attention is handed back to page content as dimming lifts and the panel withdraws

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Pressing again reverses the whole chain back to the concealed state, making the change as easy to undo as to trigger
interaction_model.state_change: Concealed resting state transitions to open settled state
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Boundary bows outward, whips back past straight and wobbles to rest; panel body slides in behind it; links drop in one after another; the page dims; the handle's bars fold into a close mark
interaction_model.input: Press on the edge handle while the panel is concealed
interaction_model.affected_object: Boundary line, panel body, stacked links, dimming layer and handle mark

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Returns to the resting state with the handle hint intact
interaction_model.state_change: Open settled state transitions back to concealed resting state
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The same elastic bend, overshoot and wobble play in the opposite travel direction as the panel withdraws, links leave and dimming lifts; the close mark unfolds back into bars
interaction_model.input: Press on the handle while the panel is open
interaction_model.affected_object: Boundary line, panel body, stacked links, dimming layer and handle mark

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Any number of mid-flight reversals remain continuous; the motion always resolves into either a settled open or settled concealed state
interaction_model.state_change: Travel direction reverses from the in-flight position rather than resetting
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The bending line redirects from wherever it currently sits and continues bending the other way, with no jump back to a starting shape
interaction_model.input: Repeated presses while the motion is still in flight
interaction_model.affected_object: Deforming boundary line and panel travel

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Interactivity of the page returns only after the panel has closed
interaction_model.state_change: No change to underlying page content; the region stays inert
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The dimmed page visibly reads as unavailable and does not respond
interaction_model.input: Press or click anywhere outside the panel while it is open
interaction_model.affected_object: Dimming layer over page content

experience_qualities: Playful and tactile, reading as flexible material giving way and settling
Soft and physical rather than rigid or mechanical
Obvious at a glance: direction, state and reversibility are readable without explanation
Uninterruptible-feeling continuity, since rapid toggling bends rather than stutters
Restrained at rest, so the effect never competes with page content until invoked
completion_and_return: Completion of opening is marked by the boundary line settling flat and the last link landing
Completion of closing returns the view to the resting state with only the small edge handle visible
The handle mark persists in both states and always reflects the current state through its bars-or-close form
No looping; the experience rests in one of two stable states and is fully reversible from either
locked_observable_requirements: A small hint at the view edge is the only visible affordance while concealed
The boundary line deforms outward in the direction of travel before the panel body arrives
The bow overshoots past straight and wobbles with decaying amplitude before settling
The panel body trails behind the deforming boundary rather than moving with it
Links enter in sequence, one after another, not simultaneously
The area outside the panel is both visibly dimmed and unresponsive while open
The handle mark transforms between an open indicator and a close mark
Mid-flight re-triggering redirects the bend from its current shape instead of restarting the sequence
The whole sequence is symmetrically reversible
adaptable_details: Which lateral edge the panel is anchored to
Panel width and proportion of the view it occupies
Exact number of destinations within a small set
Colour, dim strength, typography and handle icon styling
Amplitude and duration of the bend, overshoot and wobble
Direction from which individual links enter as they land
Whether the panel holds destinations or another compact set of items
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits any view where a small, scannable set of primary items should stay concealed at an edge and come forward over demoted page content. Replacing the deforming boundary with a rigid instant slide, expanding it into a full-screen fading overlay without a leading elastic edge, or filling the panel with long scrolling dense content would produce a different skill.

name: arrow_summoned_neighbour_preview_stages

canonical_document.name: arrow_summoned_neighbour_preview_stages
canonical_document.description: Each item fills one flat-field screen with its name set large and an arrow at each side edge; pointing at an arrow makes it grow and drags the adjacent item's headline, credit and picture in from that edge, clipped to the screen, then reverses smoothly back to a bare rest state.
canonical_document.experience_scope: Whole-view vertical experience: it begins on a full-height opening title screen that signals more content below, continues through a series of full-height item stages, and ends on a closing screen of pointers to related sets. Each stage is also a self-contained region: the hover preview effect lives and dies entirely within the bounds of one stage.
content_and_composition: One opening full-height title card whose composition makes clear that content continues below it
A sequence of full-height stages, one per collected item, each filling the viewport
Each stage carries a single flat uniform field as its own background, held at a clearly perceptible separation from the fields of the stages either side of it
Each stage shows the item's name as the dominant large-type element, centred as the resting focus and held at readable contrast against its own field
Two persistent controls per stage: a back arrow pinned at the left edge, a forward arrow pinned at the right edge
Per stage, two latent preview groups (previous and next), each combining the neighbour's headline, its credit line and its picture, parked off-screen beyond the corresponding edge
A hard clipping boundary at the stage edges so previews never bleed into the stage above or below
A closing full-height screen listing pointers to related collections
No instructional or explanatory copy anywhere: the arrows and their behaviour must be self-explaining
experience_progression: Opening title screen establishes the collection and cues downward continuation
Downward movement lands on one item stage at a time, each occupying the full view
Within a stage: resting state showing only the flat field, large name and two arrows
Hover on an arrow: arrow swells and the neighbour preview travels inward from that edge
Fully arrived state: preview held in view alongside the shifted or re-toned arrow mark
Withdrawal: preview travels back out and the arrow returns, restoring the clean resting state so the item can be judged again
Continued downward movement repeats the same cycle on the next stage
Closing screen ends the sequence with pointers to related sets
attention_and_information_flow: At rest, attention belongs to the uninterrupted field and the oversized item name; the arrows read as quiet edge marks
Hovering shifts prominence to the hovered edge: the arrow's growth is the first visible change and it acts as the origin of the incoming content
Neighbour information appears only transiently and only in layers — headline, credit and picture arrive together as a single preview group, never becoming the stage's main subject
The current item's name stays present throughout, so the preview reads as an aside rather than a replacement
Returning to rest strips the view back to a single-item reading state, keeping judgement of each item uncluttered
Progression information is carried by the change of field and name from stage to stage rather than by counters or labels

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Reversible at any moment by moving the pointer away; the incoming motion can be interrupted before completion without leaving the stage in a broken half state
interaction_model.state_change: Arrow moves from resting to expanded state while the preview group moves from off-stage to in-view
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The arrow visibly enlarges and its mark shifts position or flips to a high-contrast counter-tone as the preview slides in from the adjacent screen edge, coming to a held arrived state
interaction_model.input: Pointer enters or rests on the left or right edge arrow of the current stage
interaction_model.affected_object: The hovered arrow plus the corresponding neighbour preview group (headline, credit, picture)

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Ends in the clean resting composition; re-entering the arrow starts the inward motion again
interaction_model.state_change: Full return from arrived state to resting state
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The whole treatment plays backwards at the same pace it played forwards — preview retreating out through the same edge, arrow shrinking and its mark returning to its original position and resting tone
interaction_model.input: Pointer leaves the arrow after the preview has fully arrived
interaction_model.affected_object: Expanded arrow and the shown preview group

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Symmetric: re-entering mid-retreat resumes inward motion from the current position, so rapid pointer movement produces continuous back-and-forth rather than queued animations
interaction_model.state_change: Direction flips at the reached position instead of snapping or completing
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Motion reverses from exactly where it had got to, retracing the same path back out at the same pace with no jump or restart
interaction_model.input: Pointer leaves the arrow while the preview is still travelling inward
interaction_model.affected_object: Partially revealed preview group and partially expanded arrow

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Nothing to recover from; the hover treatment continues to work normally after a click
interaction_model.state_change: None — the control is deliberately inert as a destination
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The view stays on the same stage; the arrow behaves only as a preview trigger and nothing is navigated to
interaction_model.input: Click or press on either arrow
interaction_model.affected_object: The current view

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Free movement in both directions; every stage is always re-enterable in its clean resting state
interaction_model.state_change: One stage at a time comes into view, each with its own distinct field, name and pair of arrows
interaction_model.visible_feedback: A new full-screen field, clearly separated from the one before it, and a new large name fill the screen; the previous stage's preview state does not carry across because previews are clipped to their own stage
interaction_model.input: Downward or upward movement through the page
interaction_model.affected_object: Which full-height stage occupies the view

experience_qualities: Bold, poster-like and field-driven: one loud statement per screen
Self-explaining — the arrows teach their own behaviour through motion alone
Playful and physical: content feels dragged in from just beyond the edge by the control itself
Precisely reversible, with motion that feels tied to the pointer rather than fired and forgotten
Calm at rest, so each item can be assessed without residue from the previous interaction
Contained: nothing spills between stages, keeping each screen a tidy exhibit
completion_and_return: Every hover cycle completes by returning the stage to its exact clean resting composition
Interrupted cycles resolve at the resting state rather than persisting in a partial state
No preview state persists after leaving a stage; re-entering a stage always shows it at rest
The overall sequence completes on a closing screen of pointers to related sets rather than looping
locked_observable_requirements: One full-height stage per item, each carrying a single flat uniform field that is visibly separated from the fields of the stages adjacent to it
Item name presented as the dominant oversized element and the resting focus of the stage, legible against its own field
A back control fixed at the left edge and a forward control fixed at the right edge of every stage
Hovering a control visibly expands it as part of the same treatment that reveals the preview
The neighbour preview always combines headline, credit and picture and always enters from the screen edge adjacent to the hovered control
The arrow mark itself changes — shifting position or flipping to a high-contrast counter-tone — as the preview arrives
Previews are hard-clipped to the bounds of their own stage and never overlap neighbouring stages
Withdrawal replays the entire treatment in reverse at the same pace as the forward motion
Interruption mid-motion reverses from the exact reached position, with no snapping, restarting or queueing
Controls are inert as links: activating one must not navigate anywhere
No instructional text explains the arrows; the behaviour is discovered by pointing
An opening full-height title screen signals that more lies below, and a closing screen offers onward pointers
adaptable_details: Which tonal scheme is used and how a field is assigned to each stage, in any hues and at any lightness, as long as consecutive stages stay clearly separated and the name stays readable
Typeface, weight and exact scale of the large name
Arrow glyph shape, whether the mark shifts or flips tone, and how far it expands
Preview layout: relative placement of headline, credit and picture, and picture aspect ratio
Number of item stages and their order
Timing and easing curve, as long as forward and reverse remain matched in pace
How far the preview travels inward before coming to rest
Composition of the opening title screen and the closing pointer screen
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits collections of discrete items where each entry earns a whole screen and each has a headline, a credit or attribution and a representative image available for its neighbours to preview — showcase sets, idea galleries, portfolio pieces, feature or product line-ups. It stops being this Skill if the controls become real navigation that moves the view, if previews escape their stage or open as overlays and modals, if stages shrink into a scrollable grid or list instead of full-height screens, if consecutive stages stop reading as separated fields, if the reveal is triggered by click or automatic timing rather than continuous pointer presence, or if the return is a snap or fade instead of a paced reversal of the same motion.

name: sketched_mark_answer_sheet
description: A calm sheet of question blocks on alternating surface levels where each pick is stroked over by hand in a quick sketch mark, its held-back wording resolves to full strength, and finished list items are struck through so answers and completions stay obvious.

canonical_document.name: sketched_mark_answer_sheet
canonical_document.description: A calm sheet of question blocks on alternating surface levels where each pick is stroked over by hand in a quick sketch mark, its held-back wording resolves to full strength, and finished list items are struck through so answers and completions stay obvious.
canonical_document.experience_scope: Whole-view experience covering the full sequence of question blocks and the short checklist within one page; begins at the first block on arrival and ends with the completed sheet in a review-readable state. Individual blocks are regions of the same experience, not separate experiences.
content_and_composition: A handful of stacked full-width blocks, each occupying enough vertical space that one is comfortably read at a time
Exactly one large prompt per block as the dominant element
A few short option rows per block, each option having two coupled parts: a small marker area and its wording
Adjacent blocks alternate between two surface levels, separated just enough that block boundaries are read as separate reading beats
One short list of task items whose visible unit is the wording itself rather than a marker
Unselected option wording and markers held at reduced emphasis and low separation from their surface; the prompt is the only fully weighted text in an untouched block
Marks are drawn as visible strokes layered over the option marker or wording rather than as filled controls
experience_progression: Single relaxed downward pass: one block enters attention, its prompt is read, one or more options are taken
Attention releases and moves to the next alternating block; taken marks remain behind as settled strokes
Checklist items are struck through as they are completed, accumulating visible strike lines
Closing review pass back over the whole sheet where accumulated marks and strikes are read together without re-opening any block
attention_and_information_flow: Within an untouched block, prominence sits on the prompt because options are held back at low emphasis
Selecting shifts prominence to the chosen option as its wording rises from held-back to full strength, making the answer, not the question, the block's residual signal
The alternating surface levels keep only the current block in the foreground of attention while neighbours stay quiet
After the pass, information flow inverts: the sheet is read as a summary of marks and strikes, and unmarked options recede into a low-contrast field

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Both marker and wording are equally valid targets; the same activation on a taken option clears it
interaction_model.state_change: Option moves from untaken to taken
interaction_model.visible_feedback: A hand-sketched stroke draws quickly across the option while the wording resolves from held-back to full strength
interaction_model.input: Activating an option either by its marker or anywhere on its wording
interaction_model.affected_object: The option's marker and its wording as one coupled unit

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Removal is instant and fully reversible by taking the option again
interaction_model.state_change: Taken returns to untaken
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The mark disappears immediately with no drawing-out animation while the wording settles back to its reduced-emphasis state
interaction_model.input: Clearing an already taken option
interaction_model.affected_object: The taken option's mark and wording

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Ordering is enforced so two marks are never simultaneously settled in a single-answer block
interaction_model.state_change: Exclusive selection transfers from one option to another
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The previous mark is wiped away first, then the new stroke is drawn onto the new option; the old wording drops back as the new one resolves to full strength
interaction_model.input: Choosing a different option inside a single-answer block
interaction_model.affected_object: The previously taken option and the newly chosen option

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Any interrupted drawing or wiping resolves rather than leaving a partial or orphaned mark
interaction_model.state_change: Multiple queued transitions collapse to the final selection
interaction_model.visible_feedback: In-progress strokes give way to the newest change and the sheet comes to rest showing marks that match exactly the real current selection
interaction_model.input: Rapid or repeated switching and toggling
interaction_model.affected_object: All marks within the affected block

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Reversing removes the strike line and returns the wording to its open appearance
interaction_model.state_change: Open item becomes finished
interaction_model.visible_feedback: A line is struck through the wording, distinct in form from the option strokes
interaction_model.input: Completing a checklist item
interaction_model.affected_object: The list item's wording

experience_qualities: Playful and made-by-hand rather than mechanical
Relaxed, unhurried, single-pass rhythm
Confirmation felt as satisfying and self-explanatory, needing no supporting label or message
Quiet until touched: low-emphasis defaults keep the sheet visually calm
Glanceable afterwards, with completion legible without re-reading
completion_and_return: No end-state animation or celebration; the experience completes when the last block has been passed
All marks and strike lines persist in place as the readable record of the pass
Clearing and re-taking returns options to their exact untouched or taken appearance, so the sheet can be reworked without visual residue
Revisiting the sheet resumes at the settled marks rather than replaying the drawing strokes
locked_observable_requirements: Selection confirmation is a visibly hand-made stroke drawn across the option in a quick sketching motion, not a solid filled or swapped control
Untaken option wording sits at reduced emphasis and resolves to full readable strength only when taken
Clearing removes a mark immediately while drawing a mark is animated, an intentional asymmetry
Single-answer blocks wipe the previous mark before drawing the new one, never showing two settled marks
Checklist completion uses a strike line through the wording, visually distinct from option marks
Both the marker and the wording activate the same option
Prompts are one-per-block and dominant; adjacent blocks alternate between two separated surface levels so one block reads at a time
After rapid changes the visible marks always match the true selection
adaptable_details: Number of blocks and number of options per block
Exact stroke shape (cross, tick, scribble, circle) and its accent treatment, thickness and speed
Which pair of surface levels carries the block alternation, and the host palette and theme direction
Prompt typography and block padding or vertical rhythm
Whether the checklist sits at the end, between blocks, or in its own block
Subject matter and wording of prompts, options and list items
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits any sequence of discrete choice groups with short option wording plus completable task items, where a single downward pass and later glanceable review both matter. It stops fitting when answers are free text, continuous ranges, or long paragraph options that cannot carry a stroke across them, or when many prompts must be visible and compared simultaneously. Replacing the hand-drawn stroke with an instant solid state change, dropping the held-back-to-full-strength wording shift, or allowing marks to lag behind the real selection produces a different skill.

source_sites.title: Animated Checkboxes and Radio Buttons with SVG

name: inward_growing_frame_icon_menu
description: Activating a corner toggle draws a thick, strongly separated border inward from all window edges, veils the still-visible page inside it so it drops in contrast, and brings a few destination icons in one after another along the thickened edge; a second activation or a press on the veiled area springs everything back.

canonical_document.name: inward_growing_frame_icon_menu
canonical_document.description: Activating a corner toggle draws a thick, strongly separated border inward from all window edges, veils the still-visible page inside it so it drops in contrast, and brings a few destination icons in one after another along the thickened edge; a second activation or a press on the veiled area springs everything back.
canonical_document.experience_scope: A whole-view overlay layer bounded by the window edges, plus one small control fixed in a corner that persists in both states; begins on activation of that control and ends when the frame retracts and the underlying page is fully returned. The underlying page itself is unchanged content, not part of the effect.
content_and_composition: One persistent small toggle control pinned in a screen corner, always on top of both states
A thick frame that reads as clearly separated from the page behind it, occupying a band along all window edges when open; zero thickness when closed
A small set of destination items rendered as compact icons, arranged along the thickened frame band so they read as one instantly scannable group
The original page content held inside the frame, veiled to a lower contrast but still legible as context rather than hidden or removed
Layer order from back to front: page content, muting veil, edge frame with destinations, corner toggle
experience_progression: Closed rest state: only the corner control is visible over undecorated content
Opening: the frame grows inward from the window edges to its full band thickness while the page behind drops in contrast under the veil
Population: destination icons arrive sequentially along the settled band rather than all at once
Open rest state: frame, veiled page and full destination set held steady, toggle glyph showing the open state
Closing: destinations and frame reverse quickly and springily back toward the window edges as the page returns to full contrast
Return to closed rest state with the page presented exactly as before
attention_and_information_flow: In the closed state the control is the only navigational signal: findable but subordinate to content
On opening, prominence shifts outward to the edges as the interior loses contrast, so the destinations become the highest-contrast, most salient elements
Sequential arrival of icons paces the eye across the destination set instead of presenting a simultaneous block
Veiled content remains readable enough to reassure the user about where they are, without competing for attention
On closing, prominence returns fully to the content and the control recedes again

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Re-activating the control at any time returns to closed; an activation during the opening motion is honored and reverses it rather than being ignored
interaction_model.state_change: Closed to open
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Frame thickens inward from the window edges, interior page drops in contrast under the veil, destination icons enter one after another along the band, and the mark on the control flips from a plus to a minus
interaction_model.input: Activation of the corner toggle control while closed (pointer or keyboard)
interaction_model.affected_object: Edge frame, muting veil, destination icons, toggle glyph

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: The page is handed back exactly as it was before opening, including scroll position and any in-progress content state
interaction_model.state_change: Open to closed
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Destinations and frame withdraw quickly and springily toward the window edges, the interior returns to full contrast, and the mark flips from minus back to plus
interaction_model.input: Activation of the corner toggle control while open
interaction_model.affected_object: Edge frame, muting veil, destination icons, toggle glyph, underlying page

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Dismissal only; the press does not activate whatever content sits under it
interaction_model.state_change: Open to closed
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The same reversal as toggling the control, so dismissal feels identical from either route
interaction_model.input: Press anywhere on the veiled interior area while open
interaction_model.affected_object: Edge frame, muting veil, destination icons, toggle glyph

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Highlight follows the pointer or focus and clears when it leaves; keyboard focus can traverse the whole destination set without the pointer
interaction_model.state_change: Item unhighlighted to highlighted, one at a time
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The targeted destination visibly lifts out from its neighbors on the frame band
interaction_model.input: Pointer hover or keyboard focus moving across destination items while open
interaction_model.affected_object: The individual destination item under the pointer or focus

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: If no navigation occurs, the closed rest state is restored with the page intact
interaction_model.state_change: Open to closed as navigation proceeds
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The frame and destinations give way so the destination view is not entered behind a lingering overlay
interaction_model.input: Selecting a destination
interaction_model.affected_object: Overlay layer

experience_qualities: Uncluttered and content-first while closed
Quick and springy in both directions, never ponderous
Calming shift as the interior quiets down and the edges take over
Instantly readable destination set, small enough to grasp at a glance
Reassuring, because the page is veiled rather than replaced
Non-destructive: leaving feels as cheap as entering
completion_and_return: The experience is a reversible two-state toggle, not a one-shot or looping animation
Closing fully restores the prior page appearance and state with no residue of frame, veil or icons
The corner control persists across both states and always reports the current state through its plus or minus mark
Interrupted opening or closing resolves cleanly into one of the two rest states
locked_observable_requirements: A single small control fixed in a screen corner is the only navigation affordance in the closed state
The frame grows inward from the window edges into a thick band and retracts the same way
The interior page is veiled to a lower contrast but stays visible as context and is never removed or reflowed
The frame band and its destinations hold enough separation from the veiled interior to read as the salient layer
Destination items appear sequentially along the thickened band, not simultaneously
The control's own mark flips between a plus and a minus to signal open versus closed
Both the control and a press on the veiled area dismiss the overlay with the identical reversal
Every destination shows an individual highlight under pointer hover or keyboard focus
Closing returns the page exactly as it was, at full contrast
adaptable_details: Frame band thickness, corner radius and the exact tone or treatment that gives it its separation
Strength of the interior's contrast reduction
Which corner hosts the control and its size
Number and arrangement of destinations along the band, and whether they sit on one edge or wrap around several
Icon style, and whether short labels accompany icons
Exact timing, stagger interval and springiness of the entrance and exit
Highlight treatment used for hover and focus
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits content-led pages with a small, flat set of top-level destinations that can be represented as compact glancealbe items and that benefit from keeping the current view visible while choosing. It transfers to any foreground content type and any host palette, light or dark, because the effect only frames and mutes what is behind it and is defined by separation and contrast rather than by particular tones. It becomes a different Skill if the destination set grows large or hierarchical enough to need scrolling or submenus, if the overlay must cover or replace the content instead of framing and muting it, if the navigation must remain permanently visible, or if the panel enters from a single side as a sliding surface rather than as a band closing in from all window edges.

name: scroll_staged_header_form_sequence
description: A wide title-and-links header that snaps through a series of plainly different forms — compact, half-hidden, expanded with extra links, tiny badge, full-view takeover — one per text block passed, and walks back through them in reverse when scrolling up.

canonical_document.name: scroll_staged_header_form_sequence
canonical_document.description: A wide title-and-links header that snaps through a series of plainly different forms — compact, half-hidden, expanded with extra links, tiny badge, full-view takeover — one per text block passed, and walks back through them in reverse when scrolling up.
canonical_document.experience_scope: Region experience anchored to the top of the viewport, active for the entire length of one long scrolling text column; begins in the opening broad form when the article top is in view and ends when the reader returns to that same opening form at the top.
content_and_composition: One persistent header region pinned at the top edge of the view, always occupying the same anchor position regardless of form
Header carries a title and a short horizontal row of primary links in its opening form
One secondary set of links exists but is only exposed in the expanded form
Single long text column of sequential paragraph blocks fills the main reading area beneath the header
Five or more visibly distinct header forms: broad opening bar, compact bar, partially tucked-away bar, expanded bar revealing the second link set, minimal badge, and a form claiming the whole view
Exactly one header form is visible at any moment; forms never overlap or coexist
An explicit invitation-to-continue cue accompanies the opening state above the first paragraphs
experience_progression: Opening stage: broad header with title and link row sits clear above the first paragraphs, with a visible prompt to keep scrolling
Each successive text block whose top edge reaches the bottom of the view acts as a trigger point that switches the header to the form assigned to that point
Downward reading therefore steps the header through the assigned ordered series of forms, one calm beat per trigger
Upward reading crosses the same trigger points and restores the form assigned for the upward direction, so the earlier forms return in reverse order
Returning to the article top ends the sequence on the original opening form
attention_and_information_flow: Opening form gives the header maximum prominence and pairs it with a continue cue, directing attention downward into the text
Mid-sequence compact, tucked and badge forms cede prominence to the reading column while keeping the header identifiable
Expanded form momentarily raises header prominence and reveals a second, previously hidden set of links
Full-view form takes attention entirely from the text for one beat before the sequence continues
Every form retains recognizable header identity cues so the change reads as the same element transformed rather than a new element

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Exactly reversible — crossing the same trigger point upward restores the form assigned for the upward direction; fast, stalled or reversed scrolling always settles into a single correct form
interaction_model.state_change: Active header form switches from the current form to the form assigned to that trigger point
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Header visibly changes shape, height, density or view occupancy as one calm, legible transition beat; expanded form additionally reveals the second link set
interaction_model.input: Vertical scrolling downward past a text block whose top edge reaches the bottom of the visible area
interaction_model.affected_object: Persistent header region

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Reversal is symmetric with the downward path; no accumulated or stuck intermediate appearance
interaction_model.state_change: Active form steps backward through the earlier forms in reverse order until the opening form is restored
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Each earlier header form reappears in turn, ending on the broad opening bar at the top of the article
interaction_model.input: Vertical scrolling upward back through previously passed trigger points
interaction_model.affected_object: Persistent header region

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Link availability is never lost by a form change; the header keeps its place across all forms
interaction_model.state_change: Link remains active and actionable independent of the current header form
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Links stay visible and clickable in every form that displays them, in the header's fixed anchor position
interaction_model.input: Clicking a link in the header in any form
interaction_model.affected_object: Header link row or exposed secondary link set

experience_qualities: Calm, legible, one-beat-at-a-time shifts rather than continuous jitter
Continuity of identity: the header is always recognizable as the same element
Deliberate variety — each form is plainly different from its neighbours
Fully reversible and predictable, so scrolling feels like a controllable scrubber over header states
Reading remains the main activity; transformations punctuate rather than interrupt it
completion_and_return: No terminal end state: the sequence is bounded by the article length in both directions
Scrolling to the article top always returns the opening broad form
Header form is derived from current scroll position rather than accumulated history, so any position yields one deterministic form
Interrupted or rapid traversal resolves to the single form correct for the resting position
locked_observable_requirements: One persistent header element that keeps a fixed anchor position at the top of the view across all forms
At least several visibly and categorically distinct header forms, including a reduced/minimal form, an expanded form revealing additional links, and a form that claims the whole view
Text-block boundaries reaching the bottom of the view act as the trigger points for form changes
Exactly one form active at a time
Every change is exactly reversible, returning earlier forms in reverse order and ending on the opening form
Header links remain visible and clickable in every form that includes them
Transitions read as single calm beats that preserve header recognizability
Vertical scrolling is the only input
adaptable_details: Number, order and exact styling of the header forms
Which trigger point is assigned to which form
Title wording, number of links and content of the secondary link set
Transition duration, easing and motion style of each beat
Typography, color and spacing of the header and reading column
Length and subject of the scrolling text content
Form of the initial continue-scrolling cue
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits any single long vertically scrolling content column — articles, documentation, long marketing narratives, showcase pages — where one top-anchored header should stay present and available while visibly restating itself as the reader advances. Requires enough content length to accommodate several trigger points. Driving the transformation from something other than reading position, allowing multiple header variants to coexist, making the changes non-reversible, or dropping the persistent single-header identity in favour of swapped-in independent bars would create a different Skill.

name: hinged_book_row_page_fan_link_reveal
description: A calm row of closed books, each labelled beside it, where pointing at one swings its cover open on the left edge and fans the inner sheets out at staggered speeds to uncover a clickable link printed inside.

canonical_document.name: hinged_book_row_page_fan_link_reveal
canonical_document.description: A calm row of closed books, each labelled beside it, where pointing at one swings its cover open on the left edge and fans the inner sheets out at staggered speeds to uncover a clickable link printed inside.
canonical_document.experience_scope: A self-contained region holding the full set of items; the experience begins when the pointer enters one item's book or its adjacent text and ends when the pointer leaves, returning the region to its resting row state. Not a whole-view or page-level takeover.
content_and_composition: A single horizontal row of a few closed objects rendered as books, evenly spaced and visually equal in weight at rest
Each item pairs a book graphic with adjacent text: title, secondary attribution line, and a one-line note — all legible before any interaction
Each book has a front cover as a hinged layer on its left edge, and several inner sheets stacked behind it as separate layers
One action link per item, printed on the inner pages and hidden while the book is closed
Cover surfaces and sheet surfaces read as physical material with light playfulness rather than flat panels
The row itself is the persistent element: spacing, alignment and resting angles are unchanged by any single item's activity
experience_progression: Rest: entire set closed, skimmable at a glance, all label text readable
Focus: the pointed item's cover rotates open about its left edge
Unfolding: inner sheets fan outward one after another at slightly different speeds, so the opening reads as a sequence rather than a single move
Open: the inside link is fully uncovered and interactive
Release: cover and sheets return to resting angles, reversing from whatever point the motion had reached
attention_and_information_flow: At rest attention is distributed evenly across the row so the whole set can be compared by title, attribution and note
On focus attention narrows to one item, which gains depth and motion while its neighbours stay still and closed
Information is layered: identity and description are always visible, the action is revealed only inside the opened object
The staggered sheet fan draws the eye inward toward the revealed link rather than outward to the page
Withdrawing the pointer restores even distribution with no residual emphasis

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Only the pointed item reacts; other items remain untouched and the row layout is unaffected
interaction_model.state_change: Item transitions from closed resting state to open state
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Cover swings open around its left edge while inner sheets fan out in sequence at slightly different speeds, uncovering the link inside
interaction_model.input: Pointer enters the book graphic or the adjacent text block of one item
interaction_model.affected_object: That item's cover layer and inner sheet layers

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Leaving mid-motion reverses continuously from wherever the opening had reached, with no snap-to-open or snap-to-closed jump
interaction_model.state_change: Item returns from its current open or partly open state to closed rest
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Cover and sheets fold back to their resting angles
interaction_model.input: Pointer leaves the item's book or text region
interaction_model.affected_object: That item's cover layer and inner sheet layers

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: The book stays open and the link stays clickable while the pointer is on it; moving off the whole item closes the book as usual
interaction_model.state_change: Link enters an emphasised, actionable state
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Link highlights under the pointer
interaction_model.input: Pointer moves onto the revealed inside link
interaction_model.affected_object: The link printed on the inner pages

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Interruption is safe in either direction; each item resolves independently to open or closed
interaction_model.state_change: Previous item begins closing while the new item begins opening
interaction_model.visible_feedback: One book folds shut as the next unfolds, keeping at most one item emphasised
interaction_model.input: Pointer moves from one item to another
interaction_model.affected_object: Both the previously focused and the newly focused item

experience_qualities: Calm and tidy at rest, uncluttered enough to skim the whole set
Physical and hinged rather than sliding or fading
Lightly playful without becoming showy
Rewarding: the action feels discovered inside the object rather than advertised on its surface
Reversible and forgiving, with motion that follows the pointer's intent
completion_and_return: No completion state or one-way progression; the interaction is a fully reversible open/close cycle
Withdrawing the pointer always returns the item to its exact resting angles
The row is left precisely as it was, ready for the next pick, with no persisted opened state
Following the revealed link is the only exit from the region; the region itself never latches open
locked_observable_requirements: Items are visibly closed at rest, with identity and description text readable without interacting
Opening is hinged about the object's left edge, not a fade, slide, scale or flip in place
Inner sheets are multiple distinct layers that fan out sequentially at differing speeds
