canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits mid-page selection or comparison regions where a small number of offers, plans, features, audiences or capability groups divide into two families and should be weighed against each other; it depends on pointer input for the border light and on card sets small enough to compare at a glance. It becomes a different Skill if the two categories grow into many filters or facets, if the cards turn into a long scrolling feed, or if the pointer effect moves onto the card body as a spotlight, tilt or image reveal instead of tracing the border.
content_and_composition: one clearly framed panel whose boundary separates it from the surrounding page
two mutually exclusive category labels acting as the panel's switch, with exactly one active at any time
one card set per category, only one set visible at a time, each set small enough to be taken in at a glance
each card carries a short title, a brief description, and a visible border that hosts the light effect
frame, labels and overall panel footprint persist unchanged across switches
attention_and_information_flow: the visible frame localizes attention, marking the region as one contained decision area
the two labels announce that a choice exists and which one is currently answered
showing only one set at a time keeps the comparison between the two categories rather than across everything at once
the traced border light identifies which single card the cursor is addressing and points back toward the cursor, so the nearest card feels targeted without any layout shift or loss of text

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: the other label can be chosen again at any time, one category is always active, and switching never moves the panel or the surrounding page
interaction_model.visible_feedback: the active and inactive label appearances swap and the cards on show change within the unchanged frame
interaction_model.input: selecting one of the two category labels
interaction_model.state_change: the active category changes and the shown card set is replaced by the other set
interaction_model.affected_object: the visible card set and the active state of the labels

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: moving away fades the arc out gradually rather than cutting it; the effect is per-card, so moving between cards hands the light over; without pointer input the cards remain complete and fully readable
interaction_model.visible_feedback: a bright arc travels along the border and points toward the pointer, following it as it moves; only the addressed card lights
interaction_model.input: cursor approaches or moves over a card
interaction_model.state_change: idle border becomes an illuminated border oriented to the pointer
interaction_model.affected_object: that card's border

adaptable_details: label wording and what the two categories represent
number of cards per set and their layout as a row or grid
arc colour, thickness, length and travel speed
frame styling and panel proportions
whether the cards animate slightly as a set is swapped
card copy, typography and palette
canonical_document.description: Cards whose outlines act as a reactive field: as the cursor nears a card, a bright arc ignites on that card's own border pointing back toward the pointer and slides along the edge as the pointer moves, so exactly one card reads as addressed; crossing to a neighbour hands the light over, and leaving fades the arc out gradually to a plain idle border. Card size, position and text never shift or dim — the reaction lives only on the edges. The cards sit inside a fixed frame where two mutually exclusive category labels swap which small set of cards currently hosts the effect, without moving the frame or reflowing the page. Transferable to any small cluster of cards, tiles or plan panels that should feel alive at their outlines under pointer movement without any body-level spotlight, tilt or image reveal.
experience_progression: the panel rests with one category preselected and its cards shown
choosing the other label replaces the visible card set in place while the frame, labels and layout hold their position
no further advance: the panel simply remains in whichever category is currently chosen
completion_and_return: no completion state; the panel is a resting region
the chosen category persists while the visitor remains on the page
the border light is transient and always returns the card to its plain idle border

name: edge_aware_wash_reveal_photo_tile_grid
description: A quiet grid of full-bleed photo tiles that show nothing but their images until pointed at, when the touched tile sinks under a soft translucent wash that carries the photo's luminance clear of the name's tone, glides a short distance away from the exact edge the pointer crossed, and fades its plain name up in front of the wash as the clickable way onward.

experience_qualities: Composed and photo-forward: legible at a glance as one block instead of a list
Uncluttered at rest, with naming withheld until wanted
Immediate and soft rather than abrupt — a gentle sink and a short glide rather than a jump
Direction-aware, so the tile appears to give way from wherever the pointer came in
Steady and settled: no flipping, jitter or re-triggering while the pointer is inside
Orientation-preserving and effortless to sweep between neighbors
Balanced and readable across narrow phone through wide desktop widths
locked_observable_requirements: At rest tiles show photography only, with no visible naming text anywhere in the block

Entry produces three coordinated simultaneous changes: a translucent wash settling over the photo that carries its luminance far enough from the name's tone for the name to read clearly, a short photo displacement, and the name fading up in front of the wash
The displacement direction is away from the specific edge the pointer crossed, not a fixed direction and not continuous tracking of the pointer
That direction is decided at the instant of entry and held unchanged for as long as the pointer stays inside the tile
Sibling tiles remain visible, in place and unaltered throughout; the active tile does not expand over or obscure them
Leaving reverses every part completely back to the bare photograph
The revealed name is the element clicked to go onward
All tiles carry equal visual weight at rest so no single label or tile dominates
The grid stays balanced and legible from a narrow single-column phone width to a wide desktop width
canonical_document.name: edge_aware_wash_reveal_photo_tile_grid
canonical_document.experience_scope: A region experience occupying one composed grid block within a page. The resting composition exists as long as the region is in view; each reveal episode begins the instant the pointer crosses a single tile's edge and ends either when the pointer leaves that tile or when the revealed name is activated, at which point the experience hands off to a separate destination view outside its scope.
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits any set of comparable, roughly equally important destinations where each one is best represented by a single strong photograph plus a short name, and where the page's job is to let a visitor survey the whole set and pick one — section indexes, collection or topic overviews, place directories, portfolio groupings. It requires multiple sibling tiles, short labels and image-dominant content. It becomes a different Skill if the photo displacement follows the pointer continuously or uses one fixed direction regardless of entry edge, if the direction can change while the pointer is still inside, if names are permanently visible so there is no reveal, if the active tile grows over or hides its neighbors, or if long descriptive copy replaces the single short name.
content_and_composition: One composed grid block read as a single unit, containing many sibling tiles of equal visual weight (typically several to a dozen or more); no tile is emphasized at rest

Each tile carries three stacked roles: a full-bleed photograph as the base layer, a translucent wash layer above it that shifts the photograph's luminance to one consistent level, and one short plain text name above the wash whose tone reads clearly against that washed level
At rest only the photograph layer is visible; wash and name are fully absent, so no label competes for attention anywhere in the block
Names are single short labels in plain type, placed consistently across all tiles so the revealed state looks the same wherever it happens
Tiles keep a consistent shape and rhythm and the grid reflows from a single narrow-phone column up to a wide multi-column desktop arrangement while staying balanced and legible
All sibling tiles stay present, in place and untouched while one tile is active; the active tile never expands beyond or covers its neighbors
attention_and_information_flow: At rest, prominence is deliberately flat: photographic content carries meaning and no naming text is available to draw the eye
On entry the pointed tile becomes the single focus through three simultaneous cues — the wash's luminance shift, motion, and the only visible text on the surface
The revealed short name is the one new piece of information; sibling tiles remain fully visible so the sense of the whole set and of position within it is never lost
Because the name is also the activation target, identification and the onward affordance appear in the same moment and place
Sweeping across tiles produces a continuous handoff of prominence, one tile at a time, with the resting state restored behind the pointer

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Only the entered tile changes; siblings hold. Leaving before the transition finishes reverses from wherever it has reached
interaction_model.visible_feedback: A soft translucent wash sinks over the photo and carries its luminance clear of the name's tone, the photo glides a short distance directly away from the crossed edge, and the short name fades up in front of the wash
interaction_model.input: Pointer crosses into a tile over one of its edges
interaction_model.state_change: Tile moves from rest to revealed; the crossed edge is captured at the instant of entry and fixed for the episode
interaction_model.affected_object: That tile's photo layer, wash layer and name

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Direction remains as decided at entry until the pointer actually leaves; re-entering later from a different edge establishes a fresh direction
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The wash, offset and name hold steady — the photo does not swing to a new direction and nothing re-animates or flickers as the pointer wanders
interaction_model.input: Pointer keeps moving inside a tile that is already revealed
interaction_model.state_change: No state change; the captured direction and revealed composition persist
interaction_model.affected_object: The active tile's revealed state and its fixed displacement direction

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Reversal is complete with no residual wash, luminance shift or offset; the tile can be re-entered immediately, and re-entry mid-reversal starts a new episode from the new crossed edge
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The wash lifts away and the photo's original luminance returns, the photo returns to its original position, and the name fades out, leaving the bare photograph exactly as before
interaction_model.input: Pointer leaves the tile
interaction_model.state_change: Revealed back to rest
interaction_model.affected_object: The same tile's photo, wash and name

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: The reveal episode ends with the handoff; coming back to the grid finds every tile at rest with no remembered active tile
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The revealed name behaves as the target being pressed, then the destination view takes over
interaction_model.input: Activating the revealed name on a tile
interaction_model.state_change: The grid hands off to the destination view belonging to that tile
interaction_model.affected_object: That tile's onward destination

adaptable_details: Photographic subject matter and what the tiles stand for
Tile count, column counts per width, gaps and tile aspect ratio
Wash tone and opacity, including whether it carries the photo's luminance lower or higher, and how far the photo displaces
Timing and easing of the sink, glide, fade-up and reversal
Name typography, casing and placement within the tile
Whether the whole tile or only the name region is the pressable area, provided the revealed name is what the user aims at
How the state is surfaced where no pointer exists (unspecified by this experience)
The nature of the destination reached after activation

experience_progression: Arrival: the whole block is taken in at a glance as photography only, with attention spread evenly and no text hierarchy

Entry on one tile: the wash settles over the photo and carries its luminance clear of the name's tone, the photo displaces a short way away from the crossed edge, and the name fades up in front of the wash — the three changes read as one coordinated step forward
Held state: while the pointer keeps moving inside the tile, the revealed composition and the chosen displacement direction stay steady with no flipping, re-triggering or jitter
Exit: every part reverses back to the bare photograph, returning the tile to the resting composition
Optional close: activating the revealed name leaves the grid for that tile's own destination view
completion_and_return: Each reveal is a self-contained, fully reversible episode; exiting restores the exact resting appearance
No accumulated or persistent state: nothing stays washed, displaced or named after the pointer leaves
Only one tile is in the revealed state at a time; moving on completes the previous tile's return

name: inward_gathering_speck_button
description: A quiet button surrounded by a few low-contrast stray specks that all rush inward and intensify into a concentrated cluster at its center the moment it is hovered or pressed, while its small emblem swells and its label switches to active wording, then spring back out to their own original spots and their faint resting intensity when engagement ends.

experience_qualities: Tactile and alive, as though the control briefly exerts a pull on the space around it
Playful without being loud; the resting state is deliberately calm and ordinary
Springy and elastic on the way back out
Brief and tightly localized, with attention concentrated at one point
Immediately legible: the wording says what the motion implies
Endlessly repeatable with no learning cost and no penalty for hesitant or rapid engagement
locked_observable_requirements: A calm, ordinary-looking resting state in which the specks sit at low contrast against their surround, sparse and separated
On engagement every speck travels inward and gathers at the control's center, rising in intensity against its surround as it travels
Each speck returns to its own original resting position, reproducing the same resting arrangement rather than a new scatter
The emblem's slight growth and the label's swap to active wording happen together with the gathering, so the state change is confirmed in words as well as motion
Re-engagement partway through the return redirects the specks smoothly from their current positions with no jump or restart
The inviting resting look is always restored, identically, after every engagement
On touch, pressing and holding sustains the active state without dragging or scrolling the page
canonical_document.name: inward_gathering_speck_button
canonical_document.experience_scope: Region-level experience confined to one compact control and the small area of breathing room immediately around it. It begins the instant a pointer enters or a finger presses the control, holds while engagement continues, and ends only when the identical resting appearance has been fully restored. Nothing outside the control's neighborhood changes, and the experience is repeatable without limit.
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits any compact, self-contained interactive element whose label can carry a short state confirmation and that has a little empty space around it to host the specks — component-library buttons, a lone call-to-action, a badge-sized action on a card. It is content-agnostic beyond needing one short label and one small companion emblem, and it inherits whatever surface tones the host provides, reading equally well over a light or a dark surround as long as the specks' resting-to-gathered intensity step stays visible. It becomes a different skill if the specks scatter outward or wander freely instead of gathering inward to a single center, if they settle in new positions instead of returning to their own resting spots, if the motion spreads across a whole view or serves as a background substrate rather than orbiting one control, or if engagement leaves a persistent changed state instead of always relaxing back to the same inviting rest.
content_and_composition: One primary control surface acting as the focal object, calm and ordinary-looking at rest
One short text label on the control whose resting wording plainly invites the visitor to try it
One small emblem sitting beside the label, sized as a companion to the text rather than a competing graphic
A small set of faint specks scattered at individual resting positions in the space around the control, sparse enough to read as stray flecks rather than a field or cloud
Specks are non-interactive decoration layered around and over the control's surroundings, never covering or obscuring the label
Persistent across both states: the control surface, the label slot, the emblem slot, and the same speck set — only their position, size, wording and intensity change

At rest the control, the specks and the surround sit close together in tone with only weak separation, low-distraction either way the host is toned; the active moment concentrates peak intensity at a single point, the control's center
attention_and_information_flow: At rest the specks are low enough in contrast that the label carries the message and the control reads as an ordinary surface
On engagement, simultaneous inward travel and rising intensity funnel the eye from the surrounding space to a single point at the control's center
The state change is stated in words by the label swap and reinforced non-verbally by the emblem's slight growth, so the meaning does not depend on noticing the motion
During the active moment prominence is at its peak and tightly localized; nothing else in the neighborhood gains weight
On release prominence dissolves outward and the control settles back to ordinary, non-attention-grabbing weight

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Fully reversible at any time by moving the cursor away; if engagement returns while the specks are still travelling back out, each one is redirected inward from wherever it currently is along a continuous path, never snapping to a start position or restarting the motion
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Every speck immediately travels inward, gaining intensity as it goes, converging at the center point

interaction_model.state_change: Resting scatter becomes a gathered cluster at the control's center

interaction_model.affected_object: The gathered specks

interaction_model.state_change: Base size becomes slightly enlarged

Which engagement signals trigger it (hover, press, or keyboard focus) as long as engagement and disengagement stay symmetrical
How much intensity separation the gathered center gains over the resting specks
canonical_document.description: A quiet button surrounded by a few low-contrast stray specks that all rush inward and intensify into a concentrated cluster at its center the moment it is hovered or pressed, while its small emblem swells and its label switches to active wording, then spring back out to their own original spots and their faint resting intensity when engagement ends.
experience_progression: Rest: calm control surface, low-intensity specks sitting apart at their own home spots, inviting label wording, emblem at base size
Engagement onset: every speck immediately starts travelling inward while gaining intensity, the emblem scales up slightly, and the label swaps to its active wording — all in the same moment
Held active: specks gathered as one high-intensity cluster at the control's center, attention tightly concentrated, active wording confirming the state
Release: each speck springs back out toward its own original resting spot while easing back to resting intensity; label, emblem size and intensity return
Loop: the resting state reached is identical to the one before engagement, with no accumulated drift or change, ready for the next engagement

name: flip_card_profile_with_holographic_reverse
description: One card alone on a quiet, uncluttered stage that sets it clearly apart: an at-a-glance profile side that leans and glows toward the pointer, and a reverse side of full-bleed artwork that tilts and catches sliding iridescent light while the pointer moves anywhere on screen.

experience_qualities: Quiet, low-distraction and single-focused, with nothing competing for attention
Tangible and object-like, as if a physical card were being held and turned
Playful and collectible, with the reverse feeling like a prize
Iridescent and alive under attention, responsive rather than static
Effortlessly reversible and low-risk, with no state to lose
Unhurried, readable at a glance before any interaction
locked_observable_requirements: Exactly one card as the sole focal object on a quiet, otherwise empty full-view stage that stays clearly separated from the card by luminance
Two distinct faces — a readable information face and a full-bleed artwork face — with only one visible at a time
On the information face, pointer-driven lean plus an accent-hued glow that follows the pointer, relaxing back to rest on pointer exit
A single activation turns the card; the same activation turns it back, so the change is always reversible
Activating an outbound link on the information face never turns the card
The reverse face carries shifting iridescent sheen with a highlight that slides as the pointer moves
While the reverse faces the viewer, pointer movement anywhere on screen steers the tilt, clamped to a limited range
The information face is reachable in one step from any point in the experience
Card footprint, position and the stage behind it stay constant across both faces
canonical_document.name: flip_card_profile_with_holographic_reverse
canonical_document.experience_scope: Whole-view experience: a quiet, low-distraction full-view stage, held far enough from the card in luminance for the card to read as the single focus, whose only focal object is a single centered card. It begins on arrival with the information face at rest and has no terminal end; it alternates between two stable faces. Pointer sensitivity is limited to the card while the information face shows, and extends to the entire screen once the reverse faces the viewer.
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits any single-subject showcase where one compact card can hold a complete short profile — one image, a name, a couple of qualifying labels, a few lines of description and a small set of outbound links — on one face, and one prized full-bleed image worth staring at on the other. Content type matters only insofar as the front must be sparse enough to read at a glance and the reverse must be a single continuous image rather than more text. Turning it into a grid, deck or carousel of many cards, adding scrolling long-form content, data tables or input fields to either face, using the reverse for additional text and detail instead of one artwork, revealing the reverse without a reversible turn, or placing the card inside a busy, content-crowded page instead of a quiet single-focus stage would each create a different Skill.
content_and_composition: One quiet, internally low-contrast, otherwise empty stage filling the view, set a clear luminance step apart from the card, with no competing content or surrounding layout blocks
Exactly one card object, centered, as the sole focal element
Two mutually exclusive faces on that one object; only one is visible at any moment
Information face: one portrait image, one primary name label, one secondary role label, one short home-base/location line, a few lines of short bio text, and one small set of outbound link controls
Reverse face: one full-bleed artwork filling the card edge to edge, carrying no text or controls
A sheen layer above the reverse artwork holding a movable highlight and shifting iridescent color
A soft accent-hued glow attached to the pointer position over the information face
Persistent across both faces: card footprint, position and the unchanged quiet stage behind it
attention_and_information_flow: At rest all identity information is already visible; portrait and name dominate, role and home base sit under them, bio lines and links read as secondary
Lean and pointer glow shift attention from reading the text to handling the card as an object, signaling a hidden other side
The flip removes all text at once and replaces it with a single uninterrupted image, so attention collapses onto the artwork and its moving light
The reverse reveals no new information beyond the artwork itself; the payoff is material and visual, not informational
The way back to the information side stays obvious and constant, one activation from anywhere in the experience

interaction_model.state_change: Tilt and highlight position update continuously against pointer position, clamped to a limited range

name: escaping_refusal_and_glowing_acceptance_ask
description: A gentle ask on a soft, low-contrast living backdrop that arrives piece by piece and offers two answers, where the declining answer keeps springing away in widening arcs while begging in new words, and the accepting answer swells, dips under the press and bursts into sparkling confirmation as the scene keeps living.

experience_qualities: Cute, soft and low-stakes rather than slick or serious
Comedic escalation that builds from cheeky to hopeless
Springy, chase-like playfulness where the interface feels animate
Tactile responsiveness on the accepting side (swell, dip)
Gentle, small-scale celebration rather than a loud fanfare
Continuously alive: nothing ever freezes, before or after the answer
Teasing but never punishing — the joke stays reachable and friendly instead of frustrating
locked_observable_requirements: The refusing option must be visibly impossible to click, escaping by motion rather than by being disabled or hidden
Escape must travel along an arc whose reach widens with successive attempts
Each escape must swap the refusing option's wording for the next line of an escalating pleading series
The pleading series must be finite and end in a plain refusal wording, after which dodging continues without further escalation
The refusing option must always remain visible and within reach — never off-scene, never unreachable
The refusing option must also drift subtly in response to ordinary cursor movement, not only when approached
The accepting option must stay in place, swell on hover and dip while pressed
Acceptance must reveal short confirmation wording through a spreading twinkle
Arrival must be staged in sequence — greeting, then illustration, then the two answers — so the question is legible at a glance
Ambient scene motion must continue after acceptance so the scene keeps living
canonical_document.name: escaping_refusal_and_glowing_acceptance_ask
canonical_document.experience_scope: A self-contained, attention-owning scene built around one question: it begins the moment the view is entered with a staged arrival and continues through the teasing choice into an accepted state that never fully stops moving. It can be hosted as a whole-view experience or as one centered region, but while active it holds the entire foreground of that view; there is no separate outer content competing with it.
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits single-question, two-option asks with very little foreground content and a light emotional stake — invitations, playful requests, whimsical opt-ins, coaxing keepsake or greeting pages — where declining costs the visitor nothing and being teased is part of the fun. It requires that refusal is genuinely inconsequential: if the negative option must be honored, or the choice carries real consequence (payment, deletion, consent, account or safety decisions), the evasive treatment no longer applies. Growing the foreground into multi-step forms, dense information or more than a couple of answer options also breaks it. Making the refusing option clickable with its own outcome, replacing escape-and-plead with a plain disabled control, or ending on a static finished screen instead of a scene that keeps living would each produce a different skill.

name: machined_glass_state_toggle
description: One heavy machined object with a translucent half, floating above a quiet ruled stage: it settles down with a springy dip and tightening shadow under the pointer, glows from inside its translucent half while lit, and slides its opaque half aside to uncover bared machined plates when switched unlit.

name: cursor_following_glow_on_solitary_field

Gentle ramping and decay rather than abrupt on/off switching

Unobtrusive and forgiving: the effect never gets in the way of writing or clicking
locked_observable_requirements: Exactly one text entry region as the sole foreground element, centered on a calm, evenly toned surround whose luminance sits clearly below the light's peak, with generous surrounding emptiness

Light appears through a gradual rise when the field is entered, never an instant switch-on
Light position matches the cursor after every cursor change, whatever caused it: typing, deleting, keyboard stepping, or pointer placement
While the field is empty the light rests under the beginning of the hint text

canonical_document.name: cursor_following_glow_on_solitary_field
canonical_document.experience_scope: A region experience bound to one single-line text field, but the field is the sole foreground element of a whole calm, low-distraction view, so the resting composition reads as a full-screen experience. canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits any single-line entry that is the sole or dominant action in its view — prompt boxes, search-first opening screens, single-question steps, command entry — holding short text on a calm, evenly toned surface whose luminance stays clearly below the light's peak. Long wrapping text, multi-line editors, dense multi-field forms, or surrounds whose luminance sits too close to the light's peak, where the glow reads as a smudge, break the effect. Driving the light from something other than the text cursor (pointer position, audio, scroll), attaching it to several fields at once, or making it a permanent always-on decoration instead of a focus-driven awakening would create a different Skill.

One soft light layer sitting under the text line, horizontally centered on the current text cursor position, rendered beneath or behind the glyphs so text stays fully legible

The light layer is purely decorative and non-interactive, occupying the same area as the text without receiving pointer input

On entry, luminance and emphasis concentrate at the writing point, making the cursor the most luminous region of the view and the field the unmistakable subject

name: escalating_note_card_driven_by_amount
description: A short handwritten-feeling note sitting under an amount control, whose styling becomes visibly richer and more celebratory as the chosen value rises and plainer as it falls, previewed verbatim and then locked into an unmistakable review before a grateful closing moment.

experience_qualities: Escalating intensity: generosity is read as visual richness rather than as a larger number
One-to-one immediacy between a held gesture and the artifact's appearance
Intimate, note-like smallness rather than transactional form-filling
Plain and unadorned at zero, unmistakably celebratory at the top
Reassuring finality at review, where nothing shown can differ from what is delivered
Grateful, unhurried closing rather than an abrupt dismissal
locked_observable_requirements: The note's appearance is driven by the current value only, and changes within the same continuous gesture with no perceptible delay

The message is previewed verbatim in the exact form it will be delivered
An empty message shows placeholder text held at reduced contrast inside the note instead of a blank gap
The review restates the same value and the same unaltered note text before any commit

canonical_document.name: escalating_note_card_driven_by_amount

It becomes a different Skill if the styling is chosen from decorative themes rather than derived from the value, if several recipients or messages are composed at once, if the escalation does not reverse when the value drops, or if the value is entered as a bare field with no artifact whose appearance responds to it.

canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits any full-screen opening or headline view that pairs one focal title with a surrounding body of small decorative media pieces and needs to reveal a short, glanceable set of primary choices or an immersive secondary view over the whole frame. Content type matters only in that the surrounding pieces must be image-like enough to read as a scattered composition and the revealed set must be small enough to scan at once. It stops being this Skill if the reveal covers only part of the frame or slides from an edge instead of growing from a center point, if the surrounding pieces stay put or merely fade in place instead of dispersing outward in distance-ordered waves, if opening and dismissal use different movements or cut instantly, if mid-motion reversal restarts or snaps, or if the revealed view holds a long scrollable body of content rather than a scannable set.

name: covered_section_handover_with_assembling_names
description: Pressing a persistent section link plays a full-screen handover: the current view is pulled away or hidden behind a sweeping cover, then the next section takes over in its own distinct colour identity — any hue, only required to read as clearly separated from the section left behind — while its name assembles into place in readable contrast against it, with each destination arriving in a visibly different way.

canonical_document.name: covered_section_handover_with_assembling_names
canonical_document.description: Pressing a persistent section link plays a full-screen handover: the current view is pulled away or hidden behind a sweeping cover, then the next section takes over in its own distinct colour identity — any hue, only required to read as clearly separated from the section left behind — while its name assembles into place in readable contrast against it, with each destination arriving in a visibly different way.
canonical_document.experience_scope: Whole-view experience spanning the entire site: it begins the instant a section link or a browser history step is triggered and ends when the incoming section is fully in place, its name assembled, and the view interactive. The persistent navigation menu is the only element outside the transitioning area.
content_and_composition: A persistent, always-visible navigation menu listing a small fixed set of named sections (about half a dozen), never hidden or replaced by the transition

One full-view section shown at a time, each carrying its own distinct surface colour identity: the hue is unspecified and may sit anywhere on the light-to-dark range, but it must be clearly separated from the other sections' identities and hold readable contrast with the name and body content it carries
A prominent short section name per destination, treated as the arrival headline of that view and legible against its section's surface
A full-screen cover layer that can rise above the outgoing view to conceal the exchange, distinguishable from both the outgoing and incoming surfaces while it holds the screen
Ordinary section body content beneath the name, layered under the cover and menu during the handover
experience_progression: Trigger: a link press or history step starts the change immediately, with no blank or loading interstitial
Departure: the outgoing view is drawn away or swallowed as the full-screen cover takes over
Exchange: under cover, the destination becomes the active view and its own colour identity is established
Arrival: the cover clears in the destination's own manner and the section name assembles into place
Settle: the section is complete and interactive; navigation accepts input again
attention_and_information_flow: During departure, attention is deliberately emptied of the old content as the cover claims the screen
The shift to the destination's own colour identity lands first as the coarse signal that somewhere new has been reached
The assembling name is the single highest-prominence element at arrival, so attention settles on identity before body content
Body content gains prominence only after the name has finished composing
The menu stays continuously visible as the stable reference point across the whole exchange

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Links stop accepting presses for the duration so a second request cannot overlap or strand the running change; input is restored only when arrival finishes
interaction_model.state_change: Transition begins at once and runs to completion, ending with the new section active and interactive
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Outgoing view is drawn away or swallowed by the full-screen cover, then the new section appears in its own distinct colour identity with its name assembling into place in readable contrast against it
interaction_model.input: Press of a menu link for a section other than the one shown
interaction_model.affected_object: The whole view: outgoing section, cover layer, incoming section and its name

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Deliberate no-op that prevents redundant re-entry animations
interaction_model.state_change: No state change; the transition is not replayed
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Nothing happens; the view stays settled
interaction_model.input: Press of the menu link for the section already shown
interaction_model.affected_object: Current view

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: History travel obeys the same lock against overlapping changes; reverse direction stays predictable even though forward destinations vary
interaction_model.state_change: Same handover plays, mirrored in direction, moving to the adjacent visited section instead of jumping hard
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The identical cover-and-arrival choreography runs with its motion reversed, so backward travel reads as retracing
interaction_model.input: Browser back or forward step between visited sections
interaction_model.affected_object: The whole view and the direction of the handover

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: No pending or partial state remains; the section is stable until the next trigger
interaction_model.state_change: View becomes fully settled and interactive
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Name finishes assembling into its final position and the section reads as a normal, usable view
interaction_model.input: Completion of the arrival stage (autonomous)
interaction_model.affected_object: Section name and section content

experience_qualities: Composed and authored rather than page-like
Continuous, with no visible gap or blank waiting step
Varied on the way out and predictable on the way back
Identity-forward: the destination's colour identity and its name announce arrival before detail
Deliberately paced, exploration feels rewarded
completion_and_return: Each handover completes at a settled, fully interactive section with no leftover overlay
Returning to a previously visited section replays the same choreography in mirrored direction rather than restoring instantly
Re-selecting the current section is a no-op, so the settled state persists
The persistent menu survives every transition unchanged
locked_observable_requirements: A persistently visible menu of named section links that remains present through every transition
Every section change is played as an animated handover; no instant swap and no blank loading step between views
A full-screen cover moment where the outgoing view is drawn away or concealed before the next view is revealed

Each destination has its own colour identity that is clearly separated from every other destination's, so a change of section is legible as a change of colour; specific hues, and any light or dark bias, are not part of the requirement
Each destination's name assembles into place on arrival as the dominant attention point, with contrast against its section sufficient to read it throughout the assembly
Arrivals differ visibly between destinations, while reverse travel mirrors the same choreography and stays predictable
Navigation input is blocked while a change runs so transitions cannot overlap or be stranded
Selecting the currently shown section does nothing
The destination is in place and interactive the moment arrival finishes
adaptable_details: Exact number of sections and their names
The actual hues assigned to each section's colour identity, and whether the set as a whole sits light, dark or mixed, provided the sections stay separable and their text stays readable
Direction, shape and timing of the cover sweep, and how the cover layer is coloured relative to the views it hides
The particular manner in which each name assembles
Which arrival variant is assigned to which destination
Menu placement and styling
Body content type and density within each section
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits sites with a small, fixed set of equal-weight named full-view destinations where each can own a separable colour identity and a short name, and where every move between them can be authored. It stops fitting when destinations are numerous, dynamically generated, deeply nested, or scrolled through in one continuous view; making the handover a single uniform effect for all destinations, dropping the covered exchange, letting destinations become visually indistinguishable from one another, or moving the section name out of the arrival moment would each produce a different Skill.

name: scrubbed_tile_conversion_front
description: Two angled surfaces sit in one scene: a picture built from thousands of tiny square tiles and a second surface carrying a repeating pattern. Dragging one control drives a travelling front along the seam where they meet, flipping tiles from graduated shading into one of two maximally separated extreme tones a few at a time, and dragging back rewinds every flip in exact reverse.

canonical_document.name: scrubbed_tile_conversion_front
canonical_document.description: Two angled surfaces sit in one scene: a picture built from thousands of tiny square tiles and a second surface carrying a repeating pattern. Dragging one control drives a travelling front along the seam where they meet, flipping tiles from graduated shading into one of two maximally separated extreme tones a few at a time, and dragging back rewinds every flip in exact reverse.
canonical_document.experience_scope: A self-contained scene region with a fixed framing: it begins on arrival with the untouched tiled picture and the full pattern surface both visible, and ends when the front has crossed the whole subject leaving only the finished two-tone picture. The region is the whole experience; nothing outside it moves and the viewpoint is never part of the interaction.
content_and_composition: One primary subject surface: a single image rendered as a dense grid of thousands of small square tiles that reads as continuous tone at rest
One secondary surface: a repeating comparison pattern, held clearly apart from the subject surface as a distinct plane
One meeting seam between the two surfaces where the change is concentrated
One persistent draggable progress control positioned outside the surfaces
Fixed raised three-quarter viewpoint showing both surfaces together in the same frame, with their separation legible as depth
Two coexisting tile appearances during the middle of the range: softly graduated intermediate-tone tiles ahead of the front, fully quantized extreme-tone tiles behind it
experience_progression: Rest state: full-tone tiled picture and complete pattern surface, no conversion anywhere
Advance: the subject surface creeps forward and a travelling front moves along the seam, converting tiles in small batches
Midpoints: a legible partly converted picture, part continuous tone and part two-tone, with the pattern surface partially consumed
End state: the whole subject is two-tone and the pattern surface is gone, consumed by the passage of the front
The full range is traversable in both directions and stops cleanly at each end
attention_and_information_flow: On arrival attention rests on the dense continuous-tone surface and its separation from the patterned second surface
Once the control moves, attention is pulled to the travelling front, which is the only place change occurs
The front reads as the cause of conversion: tiles change because it reaches them, not because a filter was applied to the whole picture
Converted regions become visually calmer and recede behind the active front
At slow drag speeds the eye can follow individual tile flips; at fast drag speeds the front reads as a sweep
At the end attention returns to the completed two-tone picture as a whole

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Motion tracks the drag continuously; releasing leaves the scene exactly where the control stopped
interaction_model.state_change: Front advances a short distance; a small number of tiles cross from graduated tone to one of the two extreme tones; the pattern surface is consumed by the same amount
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The tile surface creeps forward and only a few tiles visibly flip per moment, updating on the next frame after each value change
interaction_model.input: Dragging the progress control slowly
interaction_model.affected_object: Subject tile surface, pattern surface and the travelling front

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Fully reversible with no residue; any earlier state is recoverable by dragging back
interaction_model.state_change: Travel reverses and conversions undo in exact reverse order
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The front retreats, extreme-tone tiles return to their graduated tone, and the pattern surface reappears
interaction_model.input: Dragging the control backwards
interaction_model.affected_object: Front position and every already-converted tile

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Any position may be set at any time; the previous position is reachable again the same way
interaction_model.state_change: Scene jumps straight to the state for that value without passing through intermediate states
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The front, converted region and remaining pattern all appear immediately at the matching stage, still legible as a partly converted picture
interaction_model.input: Setting the control directly to an arbitrary position
interaction_model.affected_object: Whole scene state

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Both ends are stable resting states; dragging inward resumes normally
interaction_model.state_change: Value clamps at the limit
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The scene holds the untouched state or the finished two-tone state without overshoot or wrap
interaction_model.input: Pushing the control past either end of its range
interaction_model.affected_object: Progress value and front position

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: The user is the sole driver; there is no autoplay to interrupt or resume
interaction_model.state_change: None
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The scene stays frozen at the last released position; nothing animates or drifts on its own
interaction_model.input: No input
interaction_model.affected_object: Whole scene

experience_qualities: Causal rather than decorative: change appears to spread from a moving front
Tactile and materially granular, with per-tile detail visible under slow movement
Deliberate and unhurried, paced entirely by the hand
Precisely reversible and trustworthy, with no hidden state
Spatially calm: the subject changes while the viewpoint stays put
Legible at every midpoint, so any paused state is a readable picture
completion_and_return: Completion is the fully converted two-tone picture with the pattern surface entirely consumed
No loop and no autonomous replay; the finished state simply persists
Return to the start is achieved only by dragging the control back, which replays the conversion in reverse
The scene persists at whatever value the control holds, including both endpoints
locked_observable_requirements: Two distinct surfaces visible together in one frame from a single raised, angled viewpoint
The viewpoint never shifts during the experience
The subject reads as one continuous-tone picture composed of thousands of tiny square tiles
Change is localized to a travelling front at the seam between the two surfaces, not applied uniformly to the whole picture
Conversion happens tile by tile, with only a few tiles flipping at a time under slow input
Tiles end in exactly two maximally separated tone values, replacing the intermediate graduated tones
Midpoints remain legible as partly converted pictures
One draggable control scrubs the entire range, and reverse dragging undoes flips in exact reverse
Nothing advances autonomously; the scene rests where released
Arbitrary positions can be set directly without stepping through intermediate states
Values clamp cleanly at both ends
The pattern surface is consumed as the front passes, and is absent at completion
adaptable_details: Tile count and density, provided the surface still reads as continuous tone at rest
Subject image content and framing
Appearance and repeat scale of the secondary pattern surface
Exact angle of the raised viewpoint and the spacing between surfaces
Direction the front travels across the subject
Styling, size and orientation of the progress control
Hue and tone pairing chosen for the two final values, provided they stay strongly separated from each other
Batch size of flips at a given drag speed
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits a single dense raster-like subject where a per-cell change is meaningful and where a second reference surface can be shown alongside it, placed as a focal explanatory or showcase region on a page. Removing the travelling front in favour of a whole-image crossfade, dropping the second surface, moving the camera as part of the interaction, or driving progress autonomously instead of by drag each produce a different Skill.

name: scroll_assembled_image_grid_parting_to_text
description: Images gather from above and below into a three-column block behind a headline, then magnify and split apart to clear the centre so the headline lifts and the intro text and link fade in as the payoff.

canonical_document.name: scroll_assembled_image_grid_parting_to_text
canonical_document.description: Images gather from above and below into a three-column block behind a headline, then magnify and split apart to clear the centre so the headline lifts and the intro text and link fade in as the payoff.
canonical_document.experience_scope: A single full-viewport region that begins with one quiet full-bleed image at rest and ends when the centre of the composition is cleared and the supporting text and link are readable and clickable; the stage itself stays fixed for the whole passage, so it reads as one whole-view experience that can sit as the opening section of an otherwise ordinary page.
content_and_composition: One quiet full-bleed opening image filling the entire view, unadorned, establishing mood before any motion
A modest set of photos (about a dozen) that resolve into exactly three columns of stacked images forming one rectangular block
One short headline as the persistent central foreground element, layered in front of the image block with enough separation from the imagery behind it to stay legible
One short supporting paragraph and one single follow-through link, absent from view until the final stage, revealed at readable contrast in the cleared centre
A held stage: the framing view does not travel while images, block scale and text move within it
Depth ordering is fixed: images behind, headline and later text in front
experience_progression: Rest state: one full-bleed picture holds the whole view, nothing else present
Gathering: images sweep inward from above and below, adjacent columns entering from opposite directions
Lock: the images settle into an ordered three-column block sitting behind the headline; the composition is at its densest and attention is tightest
Opening: the locked block magnifies, the outer columns drive sideways out of frame and the middle columns part until the centre is clear
Payoff: the headline lifts and the supporting paragraph and link fade in and become clickable
Retrace: reverse scroll replays every stage backwards to the untouched opening state
attention_and_information_flow: Attention starts wide and atmospheric on a single uninterrupted picture with no text competing for it
Incoming motion from two opposite directions pulls the eye toward the centre of the stage
At the locked composition, prominence is concentrated on the headline read against the densest field of imagery
Magnification and parting release that tension outward, imagery yielding frame and visual weight
The supporting words and the link are the last information revealed and read as the conclusion rather than as an introduction
Revealed information only ever increases going forward and decreases going backward, never appears out of order

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Progress is bound to scroll position, so reversing scroll immediately runs the motion backwards and stopping freezes the exact intermediate frame
interaction_model.state_change: Progress advances from the full-bleed opening through gathering to the locked three-column composition
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The stage stays still while images sweep in from above and below in alternating columns and settle into an ordered block behind the headline
interaction_model.input: Forward vertical scrolling from the opening rest state
interaction_model.affected_object: The photo set and the held stage

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Fully reversible by scrolling back; partial states show partially parted columns and partially faded text rather than snapping
interaction_model.state_change: The block scales up and separates; the centre clears; the text stage becomes active
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Outer columns drive sideways out of frame, middle columns part, the headline lifts, and the paragraph and link fade in
interaction_model.input: Continued forward vertical scrolling past the locked composition
interaction_model.affected_object: The three-column block, the headline, the supporting paragraph and the link

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Scrolling back before completion returns the link to a non-interactive state along with its fade-out
interaction_model.state_change: The link changes from revealed-but-inert to clickable
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The fully faded-in link reads as active, carrying a distinct accent treatment against the surrounding text, and responds to pointer interaction
interaction_model.input: Reaching the end of the sequence
interaction_model.affected_object: The follow-through link

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: The untouched opening state is always reachable; no stage is one-way
interaction_model.state_change: Progress decreases stage by stage back toward the untouched opening
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Text fades out, columns close and shrink back into the locked block, images retreat upward and downward, and the single full-bleed picture is restored
interaction_model.input: Reverse vertical scrolling at any point
interaction_model.affected_object: Every element of the sequence

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Resumption in either direction continues from that held frame
interaction_model.state_change: Progress holds at its current value with no autonomous continuation
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The exact in-between frame remains on screen, images and text held part-way
interaction_model.input: Stopping scrolling mid-sequence
interaction_model.affected_object: The whole composition

experience_qualities: Calm and deliberate rather than energetic
Cinematic and atmospheric at the opening
Precise and ordered at the locked composition
Expansive and releasing as the centre clears
Fully scrubbable — the visitor feels they are moving the composition, not watching a clip
Trustworthy, because nothing is lost or unreachable once passed
completion_and_return: Completion is a stable final frame with the cleared centre, lifted headline, readable paragraph and active link
No looping and no autoplay at any point
Full reverse scroll returns to the pristine full-bleed opening with no residue of the sequence
Held intermediate frames persist for as long as scrolling stops
locked_observable_requirements: Opens on one quiet full-bleed image occupying the whole view before any motion occurs
The stage holds still while its contents animate; vertical scroll position, not elapsed time, drives every stage
Images enter from above and below with adjacent columns alternating direction
Images lock into a three-column block positioned behind the headline, which stays readable against it
The locked block then magnifies, outer columns move sideways and middle columns part until the centre is clear
The headline lifts and the supporting text and single link fade in at readable contrast only after the centre clears, arriving last
The link becomes clickable only at the completed state, where it reads as the most salient interactive element in the cleared centre
Every stage reverses on reverse scroll and stopping anywhere holds that exact frame
The untouched opening state remains reachable from any point in the sequence
adaptable_details: Exact image count around a dozen, and image subject matter, cropping and aspect ratio
Easing curves, sweep distances, magnification amount and stage lengths
Headline wording and typographic treatment, paragraph length, link presented as inline text or button
Any hue choice, the luminance level of the surround and how the accent is expressed, plus gutter width and block proportions
Whether the stage releases into normal page scrolling after completion or remains the final view
Behaviour on narrower views, including reducing how many columns are visible while keeping the gather-and-part reading
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits a modest, roughly grid-sized set of pictures paired with exactly one short headline, one short paragraph and one follow-through link, where the pictures exist to set mood and frame those words rather than to be inspected individually. It transfers to any photo-led introduction, project opener or gallery landing with that content shape, in any hue scheme or surround luminance that keeps the headline and payoff text readable. It becomes a different skill if the sequence autoplays on a timer, advances by clicks or discrete steps instead of continuous scroll, is one-way and non-retraceable, requires per-image selection, captions, zooming or lightbox browsing, or must carry long-form copy that cannot arrive last as a single short payoff block.

name: word_crumbles_to_drifting_debris_on_cue
description: One centred serif word alone on a plain, near-empty ground that, when a labelled control below it is clicked, drains from a warmer saturated tone toward a desaturated neutral while its strokes tear apart unevenly from inside and lift away as slow floating debris, leaving quiet emptiness until it is restored whole and replayed.

canonical_document.name: word_crumbles_to_drifting_debris_on_cue
canonical_document.description: One centred serif word alone on a plain, near-empty ground that, when a labelled control below it is clicked, drains from a warmer saturated tone toward a desaturated neutral while its strokes tear apart unevenly from inside and lift away as slow floating debris, leaving quiet emptiness until it is restored whole and replayed.
canonical_document.experience_scope: Whole-view experience of a single sparse stage: begins at arrival with the intact word at rest, ends when the lettering has fully dispersed and the view has settled into emptiness; the control below persists across the whole cycle.
content_and_composition: Exactly one short word or very short phrase as the sole foreground content, held at the optical centre of the view
Elegant serif lettering as the single focal object, set at strong readable contrast against its ground and generously surrounded by empty space
Near-empty uniform ground acting as a quiet stage held well clear in tone from the lettering, with no competing imagery, decoration or copy
One labelled trigger placed directly below the lettering, visually subordinate and the only interface element present
Transient debris layer that exists only during the sequence, occupying the space immediately around and above the lettering
experience_progression: Arrival: still, silent, fully intact lettering at rest; the lone labelled control below implies the next move without instructions
Onset: the warmer saturated tone begins draining toward a flat desaturated neutral while the lettering still reads as whole
Break-up: strokes fracture unevenly from within, interior fragments separating before outer contours, so the word is consumed rather than faded out
Dispersal: freed fragments drift slowly upward and outward as thinning debris, legibility lost progressively rather than at once
Settle: motion decays to nothing and the view returns to quiet emptiness
Restore: on a later activation the intact lettering is presented whole again and the same sequence replays from its beginning
attention_and_information_flow: Centred lettering holds sole prominence at arrival because nothing else carries emphasis or movement
The control earns just enough presence to be found as the obvious starting action without narrating itself
Once running, prominence stays locked on the lettering; the control recedes as its presence drops
Interest migrates from the word's form to the texture of its break-up and then to the drifting debris
Final emptiness carries the aftermath, holding attention on absence before the option to begin again

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: The sequence cannot be stopped, shortened or influenced partway; it always runs through to its settled end
interaction_model.state_change: Rest state advances to a self-running dissolution that continues to completion without further input
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The warmer tone drains toward a desaturated neutral, strokes fracture from within, fragments lift and thin into slow debris until the view is empty
interaction_model.input: Single click on the labelled trigger below the lettering
interaction_model.affected_object: The centred word and the surrounding empty space

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Repeat, stacked or overlapping runs are prevented; the control returns to its normal usable appearance shortly after the sequence settles
interaction_model.state_change: Control is unavailable for the duration of the sequence and refuses activation
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Trigger visibly drops in prominence to a muted, clearly inactive appearance while the lettering dissolves
interaction_model.input: Any further click attempt while the sequence is running
interaction_model.affected_object: The trigger control

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Unlimited repeats are possible, each one a complete cycle starting from a fully restored word
interaction_model.state_change: Emptiness resets to the intact lettering, then the full dissolution plays again from its start
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The whole word reappears in its original warmer, fully saturated intact form before beginning to drain and break apart again
interaction_model.input: Click on the re-enabled trigger after the sequence has finished
interaction_model.affected_object: The word and the debris space

experience_qualities: Hushed, ceremonial and unhurried
Sombre, with a felt shift from warm to cool as the tone drains out
Physical and material rather than digital: consumed, eroded, carried off
Sparse and confident, relying on emptiness instead of explanation
Self-evident to start, with no instructional copy required
completion_and_return: The cycle completes in stillness and near-total emptiness rather than snapping back
No automatic replay; the aftermath is allowed to hold
The control becomes usable again a short beat after the sequence settles
Re-activation always restores the lettering whole first, so every run begins from the same intact starting image
locked_observable_requirements: A single short piece of centred lettering is the only foreground content, sitting on a plain, near-empty ground clearly separated from it in tone
The effect is user-initiated by one labelled control located below the lettering, not autonomous on arrival
The lettering drains from a warmer, more saturated tone toward a desaturated neutral as part of the same event that destroys it
Strokes break apart unevenly from within; a uniform fade, wipe or slide is not a substitute
Freed material becomes slow-lifting debris in the space around the lettering rather than vanishing instantly
The sequence runs to completion from one activation with no further input and cannot be cut short partway
During the run the control is visibly muted and non-accepting so the sequence cannot be double-started or stacked
The end state is quiet emptiness, and any replay begins from fully restored intact lettering
adaptable_details: The specific word or short phrase and its language
Exact serif face, weight, size and letter spacing
Which starting hue is used and how far its saturation and lightness settle by the end
Total duration and pacing of drain, break-up and dispersal
Debris density, fragment scale and drift direction bias
Trigger wording, shape and muted appearance
Length of the pause before the control becomes usable again
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits any context where one very short piece of text is the entire foreground on a minimal, uncompetitive stage and is meant to be witnessed being destroyed on cue. Applying it to paragraphs, lists, dense layouts, imagery or interface content, making it run automatically or continuously loop, letting it be scrubbed or interrupted midway, or reversing it into an assembly-in effect would each produce a different Skill.

name: centered_focus_line_procession
description: Cryptic lines rise from the lower edge into a high-contrast, sharp center of attention, then lose contrast and drift out the top, each line scrambling through random glyphs before locking into real words, closing with further-viewing cards that replace a fading wordmark.

canonical_document.name: centered_focus_line_procession
canonical_document.description: Cryptic lines rise from the lower edge into a high-contrast, sharp center of attention, then lose contrast and drift out the top, each line scrambling through random glyphs before locking into real words, closing with further-viewing cards that replace a fading wordmark.
canonical_document.experience_scope: Whole-view experience spanning the entire page: begins on an empty, uniform low-distraction field holding only a centered wordmark, continues through the full scroll-driven line procession, and ends in the closing further-viewing card set; reversible along its whole length.
content_and_composition: Persistent centered wordmark on an otherwise empty, uniform field at the opening, remaining visible through the line procession until the closing section
Sequence of short cryptic text lines arriving in clusters rather than at even spacing
Occasional single oversized letters used as scale-contrast punctuation between clusters
Occasional brief blocked-access style notices, each trailing a pulsing block caret
A single privileged center-of-view focus zone where exactly one line at a time holds sharp legibility
Closing set of further-viewing cards presented as the terminal composition, in the region the wordmark previously occupied
Sparse, low-distraction background acting as empty space around all type; no imagery layer
experience_progression: Opening stillness: empty, uniform field with only the centered wordmark
Arrival: lines begin entering from below the lower edge in clusters, interspersed with oversized letters and caret-trailing notices
Sustained procession: each line ascends toward center, peaks in sharpness and contrast against the field while owning the center, then recedes toward the top edge
Handoff: continuing downward fades the centered wordmark out
Closing: further-viewing cards sweep in one after another as the terminal state
Full reversal: scrolling back up rewinds the closing handoff and the line procession in exact reverse order
attention_and_information_flow: Attention is anchored to the vertical middle of the view; prominence is a function of distance from that center
Only the line currently owning the center is fully legible; entering and exiting lines sit at reduced contrast and are softer, so unread and already-read text both recede
Text meaning is withheld on entry by glyph churn and granted only when the characters lock into real words
Oversized letters and caret-trailing notices spike prominence briefly, breaking the rhythm of the ordinary lines
At the end, attention transfers from the single centered wordmark to the multi-item card set, shifting from reading to choosing

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Reversing scroll direction rewinds the movement exactly; stopping holds the line mid-transition at its current appearance; no snapping or auto-completion
interaction_model.state_change: Indent, vertical gap, contrast against the field and softness advance in continuous step with scroll position as the line rises from below the lower edge to the middle of the view, then travel back toward their starting placement as it exits the top edge
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Line visibly shifts horizontally and vertically while sharpening and gaining contrast into peak legibility at center, then softening and losing contrast as it drifts away
interaction_model.input: Vertical scrolling, the only control, with damped rather than snapping response
interaction_model.affected_object: Each text line in the procession
