canonical_document.name: macro_unit_to_whole_conversion_loop
canonical_document.description: A calm self-playing loop that starts inches from the tiny raised units composing a picture, eases back to the full square frame while a slow wave crossing the field briefly reveals an intermediate patterned stage, then settles on the completed two-tone image — one mark tone clearly separated from one field tone, in any hue pairing — and begins again.
canonical_document.experience_scope: A whole-view experience occupying one square field that is always kept entirely visible. It begins automatically when the view is shown, runs from macro close-up to settled final result, and returns to its opening state to run again indefinitely; there is no surrounding interactive chrome inside the experience.
content_and_composition: One primary image subject, rendered not as a continuous photograph but as a dense field of small discrete repeated units
The units read as slightly raised tiles with visible relief when viewed at the opening oblique close-up angle
A transient intermediate patterned layer that exists only along and behind the travelling wave, sitting visually between the raw subject and the final rendering

A flat uniform single-tone background field that the finished result rests on, giving a two-tone pairing in which the mark tone holds readable contrast against the field tone, with the specific hues and their lightness order unconstrained
Square framing as the persistent container: the composition is always fully inside the frame, never cropped or stretched
No labels, controls, captions or step indicators are required for the sequence to be understood
experience_progression: Open in extreme close-up at an oblique angle on a handful of raised units, so the smallest building block registers before the picture does
Ease the viewpoint continuously outward and toward flat-on until the whole subject is framed
While the pull-back is underway, a single slow wave travels across the field, briefly surfacing the patterned intermediate layer at its front so the conversion becomes legible in motion
The wave completes its pass and the finished two-tone rendering settles, flat and still, on the uniform single-tone field
After a brief settled beat, return cleanly to the opening macro state and repeat the same progression
attention_and_information_flow: Attention is pinned to grain first: the unit and its relief are the only readable information at the start
As the frame widens, recognition shifts from unit to overall image, so the viewer learns what the units add up to
During the wave pass, prominence concentrates on the moving boundary, which is where the intermediate stage and therefore the conversion logic is visible
At the end all motion stops, so the completed image is the sole subject and reads as the conclusion
The restart re-establishes the macro framing distinctly enough that a late arrival understands they are seeing the beginning

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: No stage waits on the viewer and no stage can be skipped or held; the sequence always plays through in the same order
interaction_model.state_change: Advances from oblique macro, through outward reframing and the wave pass, to the settled complete result
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Continuous unbroken motion: widening frame, angle flattening, wave crossing the field, patterned layer surfacing and then resolving into the finished image
interaction_model.input: Autonomous timeline that starts on its own with nothing to press
interaction_model.affected_object: Viewpoint framing, the unit field, the intermediate patterned layer and the final two-tone rendering

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Looping is indefinite, so anyone arriving late still sees the full progression from the close-up onward
interaction_model.state_change: Settled final state returns to the opening macro state and the progression restarts
interaction_model.visible_feedback: A clean return to the close-up rather than a visible snap mid-motion or a partial replay
interaction_model.input: Reaching the end of the sequence
interaction_model.affected_object: The whole experience

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Resizing never restarts, pauses or desynchronizes the sequence
interaction_model.state_change: Framing is recomputed immediately for the new dimensions while the running sequence keeps its timing
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The square field stays wholly in view with correct proportions, no stretching, squashing or cropping, and no visible stall or jump in what is already underway
interaction_model.input: Window or container resize
interaction_model.affected_object: Square field framing and current playback position

experience_qualities: Calm and unhurried, with slow easing rather than sharp cuts
Self-explanatory: the order of what is shown does the teaching, without text
Tactile at the opening, where relief and raking oblique illumination make the units feel physical, whatever the overall lightness of the surface
Orderly and inevitable, with a single travelling change rather than scattered activity
Quietly repeatable, inviting a second viewing without demanding attention
completion_and_return: The settled two-tone result is the completion state and is held briefly so it reads as finished
The experience then resets fully to its opening macro framing and loops
No progress, position or viewer state persists between loops; every pass is identical
There is no terminal stop, dismissal or end card
locked_observable_requirements: The experience opens in extreme close-up at an oblique angle on the discrete raised units, not on the whole picture
A single continuous outward reframing carries the view from that macro state to the complete composition
Exactly one slow wave crosses the field and briefly surfaces an intermediate patterned layer that makes the conversion legible

The sequence ends with a still, complete two-tone rendering — one mark tone clearly separated from one field tone at readable contrast — resting on a flat uniform field, with the particular hues left free
The whole progression is autonomous: no controls, no hover or scroll dependency, and no stage waiting on the viewer
It loops cleanly back to the opening close-up so a late arrival sees the entire progression
The square field remains entirely in view and undistorted at any size, and resizing does not disturb the timing of motion already underway
adaptable_details: The specific subject depicted in the image
The two tones used for marks and field, in any hue pairing and either lightness order, provided they stay clearly separated
Unit shape, grid density and apparent relief height
Opening oblique angle and how far the view pulls back
Wave direction, width, speed and easing curve
Total loop duration and the length of the settled beat before restart
The exact visual character of the intermediate patterned layer
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits any single-subject demonstration where a continuous surface or image is converted into a dense field of discrete repeated units and the conversion itself should be understood by watching; it needs content whose smallest unit is visually interesting enough to hold the opening close-up and whose whole is recognizable once framed, and any two clearly separated tones may carry the final rendering. Introducing viewer-driven scrubbing or step controls, splitting the subject into multiple simultaneous comparison panels, dropping either the macro opening or the single travelling reveal wave, collapsing the mark and field tones into indistinguishable values, or abandoning the fully visible square field would create a different Skill.

name: accumulating_word_stack_reveal
description: One enormous word at a time swells up from below into a single fixed line while previously shown words slide up one line and crop at the top edge, building into a settled stack of the full statement that a playback bar can pause, restart or scrub through.

canonical_document.name: accumulating_word_stack_reveal
canonical_document.description: One enormous word at a time swells up from below into a single fixed line while previously shown words slide up one line and crop at the top edge, building into a settled stack of the full statement that a playback bar can pause, restart or scrub through.
canonical_document.experience_scope: A whole-view opening region occupying the full screen on arrival; it begins once the page and its typeface are ready and ends when the last word has arrived and the completed stack rests in place, with the playback control persisting so the sequence can be replayed or re-scrubbed.
content_and_composition: A short ordered set of single words or very short phrases, typically three to six items, forming one cumulative statement
One anchored reveal line: the fixed on-screen position where every new word arrives, identical for each item
A stack of already-revealed words positioned directly above the anchored line, one line apart, in reading order
A hard crop at the top edge of the view: words pushed beyond it are cut off rather than shrunk, faded out of the layout, or wrapped
Typography as the only foreground material at very large scale; no imagery, ornament, secondary copy or competing elements in the view
A persistent playback bar with pause/resume, restart and a draggable playhead, visually subordinate to the words
experience_progression: Held still and empty until the page and its typeface are genuinely ready, so no word appears in a substitute or unsettled form
The sequence starts on its own without a user trigger
For each item in order: the next word swells up from below into the anchored line while the existing stack slides up by exactly one line
Words displaced above the top edge are progressively cropped away as the stack grows
After the final word arrives, motion stops and the completed stack holds at rest as the resting composition
attention_and_information_flow: Attention is pinned to the single anchored line where every new word emerges, making arrival the focal event
Meaning accumulates rather than replaces: earlier words remain readable above the anchor so the statement reads as a growing whole
Prominence gradually shifts from a single dominating word to the composite stack as more items are revealed
The playback bar stays quiet during the reveal and becomes the point of control only when the viewer wants to intervene
The final resting stack is the lasting message the viewer carries forward

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Readiness gates the start so the reveal is never seen mid-preparation; if start is delayed the view simply stays still
interaction_model.state_change: From a held, motionless empty state to playing from the first item
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Nothing moves at all, then the first word swells up into the anchored line
interaction_model.input: Autonomous start once page and typeface are ready
interaction_model.affected_object: The whole word sequence

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Deliberate, self-assured pacing between arrivals; the same anchored position and step distance for every item
interaction_model.state_change: Next item becomes current; all prior items shift up one line position
interaction_model.visible_feedback: New word rises from below into the fixed line while the stack above moves up one line and the topmost words are clipped at the view edge
interaction_model.input: Sequence advance over time
interaction_model.affected_object: Incoming word and the existing stack

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Resume continues from the paused moment rather than restarting
interaction_model.state_change: Playing to paused at the current moment
interaction_model.visible_feedback: All motion halts and the composition holds exactly as it was mid-reveal
interaction_model.input: Pause on the playback bar
interaction_model.affected_object: Sequence playback

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Available both mid-reveal and after the sequence has settled
interaction_model.state_change: Returns to the beginning with an empty stack and plays forward again
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The stack clears and the first word rises again from below
interaction_model.input: Restart on the playback bar
interaction_model.affected_object: Sequence playback and word stack

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: On release, playback continues from wherever the playhead was left; scrubbing can be repeated freely in either direction without breaking the sequence
interaction_model.state_change: Composition jumps to the exact state belonging to that moment, including partially arrived words
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Words snap to that moment's positions; dragging backwards runs the reveal in reverse with words sinking back down and the stack sliding down one line at a time
interaction_model.input: Drag the playhead to any moment
interaction_model.affected_object: Word stack composition

experience_qualities: Monumental and purely typographic
Deliberate, unhurried, self-assured pacing
Cumulative rather than substitutive: the statement visibly grows
Singular focus with nothing competing for attention
Mechanically precise repetition of the same arrival position and step
Scrubbable and inspectable, so any moment can be re-examined
completion_and_return: Completes on the full stack at rest and holds indefinitely rather than looping
Restart returns to the empty state and replays the accumulation from the first word
A paused or scrubbed state persists exactly where it was left until resumed or released
After release from scrubbing, forward playback resumes toward the same settled ending
locked_observable_requirements: One item revealed at a time, never several simultaneously
Every new item arrives at the same single anchored on-screen line
Arrival motion comes upward from below into that line
Previously revealed items remain visible and shift upward by exactly one line per arrival
Items pushed past the top edge are hard-cropped, not faded or reflowed
Text is the only foreground content, at dominating scale, with no competing elements, and it holds strong readable separation from a low-distraction surround
Nothing moves until the page and its typeface are ready
The sequence starts autonomously without user action
Ends on the complete stack at rest and holds
A playback control provides pause/resume, restart and drag-to-any-moment scrubbing that snaps to exact state and reverses while dragged backwards, continuing from the release point
adaptable_details: Number and wording of items in the statement
Typeface, weight, case and color treatment of the words, in any hue, as long as they stay clearly separated from their surround
Exact interval between arrivals and duration of each rise
Horizontal alignment of the anchored line and its vertical placement in the view
Whether the crop edge is the exact viewport top or a defined boundary above the anchor
Visual styling and placement of the playback bar, provided it stays subordinate to the words
Surround treatment behind the text, lighter or darker than the words and in any hue, including subtle contrast variation, so long as the words remain comfortably readable
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits short ordered word or phrase sets that read as one cumulative statement in a full-view opening or standalone statement region, where oversized text can carry the whole composition. It stops being this Skill if items replace each other instead of accumulating in a visible stack, if arrivals happen at varying positions instead of one anchored line, if imagery or other foreground content shares the view, if the sequence requires user input to advance step by step, or if it loops continuously instead of settling into a finished stack.

name: scroll_wiped_concept_walk
description: A held picture frame whose front image erases upward from its lower edge to uncover the next one as its blurb advances, with slow photo drift and a page-wide ambient colour atmosphere that shifts progressively in one direction, every part scrubbed by scroll position.

canonical_document.name: scroll_wiped_concept_walk
canonical_document.description: A held picture frame whose front image erases upward from its lower edge to uncover the next one as its blurb advances, with slow photo drift and a page-wide ambient colour atmosphere that shifts progressively in one direction, every part scrubbed by scroll position.
canonical_document.experience_scope: Begins when the sequence takes over the view and the picture area locks its position on screen; occupies the whole view for the duration of the set; ends when the final concept stands fully uncovered and the section releases to whatever follows. Region-anchored but whole-view while active.
content_and_composition: A small ordered set of concept entries (four in the source case; a handful in general), each entry being one large image plus one short blurb
One persistent picture area that holds its place in view for the entire sequence while content passes through it
Images stacked as ordered layers within that area, the current one in front and the next waiting directly behind it
A text region carrying the blurb of the current concept, advancing while the picture area stays still
A page-wide colour atmosphere layer sitting behind all content, shared by picture area and text, kept low enough in intensity that images and text stay clearly readable against it
No counter, index, dots or progress bar; no thumbnails or overview of the remaining items
experience_progression: Single linear advance through the ordered set, one concept at a time holding full attention
Each transition: the front image erases upward from its lower edge, progressively uncovering the image behind it, while the incoming blurb takes over the text region
Partial states are legitimate resting points: a half-erased image with the transition suspended
The page's ambient colour atmosphere shifts steadily in one consistent direction across the whole set, so how far along the visitor is can be felt without any numeric or graphic indicator
The sequence comes to rest on the last concept and ends quietly; it does not loop or auto-restart
Scrolling backwards unwinds every stage in reverse along the identical path
attention_and_information_flow: Exactly one concept is legible at a time; its picture and words land together as a single unit
Neighbouring concepts are concealed rather than competing: the next image is hidden behind the front one, the others are outside the reading position
Prominence transfers gradually during a transition, so attention is handed over rather than cut
Progress information is carried by how far the ambient atmosphere has travelled from its opening state and by how much of the next picture has been uncovered, never by explicit counters
Attention settles rather than terminating at the end: the final concept remains the sole focus with nothing further revealed

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Pausing mid-scroll holds a half-uncovered state indefinitely; scrolling back unwinds the erase exactly to its earlier appearance; there is no snapping to whole items and no minimum committed transition
interaction_model.state_change: The uncovered fraction of the image behind advances or retreats in direct proportion to scroll offset
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The front picture erases upward from its lower edge, its receding boundary revealing the next picture underneath
interaction_model.input: Vertical scrolling (the only input required)
interaction_model.affected_object: Front image layer in the held picture area

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Text position is a function of scroll offset, so reversing scroll returns the previous blurb to its previous position without re-running any separate animation
interaction_model.state_change: The current blurb gives way to the next concept's blurb in step with the picture transition
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Text advances through the view while the picture area visibly holds its place, pairing each blurb with the picture being uncovered
interaction_model.input: Vertical scrolling
interaction_model.affected_object: Blurb text region

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Drift is positional rather than timed; it stops when scrolling stops and rewinds precisely when scrolling reverses
interaction_model.state_change: The photo's offset within its frame changes slowly and continuously
interaction_model.visible_feedback: A slow drift of the image inside its fixed frame, giving quiet life to an otherwise still composition
interaction_model.input: Scroll position (as a continuous value, not a discrete event)
interaction_model.affected_object: Each photograph inside the picture frame

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Bound to overall progress, so any pause holds an intermediate tint and reversal restores the earlier one exactly
interaction_model.state_change: The ambient colour atmosphere shifts progressively along a single consistent direction across the whole set
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The entire page's tint drifts steadily further from its opening state as the visitor advances, returning towards that opening state on the way back, while staying subdued enough not to compete with the picture or the text
interaction_model.input: Scroll position
interaction_model.affected_object: Page-wide colour atmosphere behind all content

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: A new gesture can interrupt a settling motion at any moment and take over from the current position without discontinuity
interaction_model.state_change: Motion accelerates and decelerates smoothly instead of jumping between fixed positions
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Scrolling glides and settles, so transitions feel like a continuous walk past the concepts rather than steps between separate items
interaction_model.input: Scroll gesture and its momentum
interaction_model.affected_object: Overall motion of the sequence

experience_qualities: Calm and gallery-like
Singular focus: one picture and its words at a time, nothing competing
Continuous walk rather than a sequence of jumps
Directly scrubbable and exactly reversible, so the visitor feels in control of the pace
Ambient sense of progress through an accumulating atmospheric shift rather than measured progress
Quiet, restful ending
completion_and_return: Completes by coming to rest on the final concept, fully uncovered, with the atmosphere at the far end of its progression
No looping, no automatic return to the first concept, no closing flourish
Every visual state is a pure function of scroll position, so returning to any scroll offset reproduces exactly the same appearance
Reversing all the way back restores the opening concept, its untouched picture and the atmosphere at its starting point
locked_observable_requirements: The picture area holds its place in view while the text advances
Transitions happen by the front picture erasing upward from its lower edge to uncover the one behind, not by sliding, fading or swapping
Uncovered amount, in-frame photo drift and atmospheric colour change are all bound to scroll position, never to elapsed time
Pausing mid-transition holds a partial state; reversing unwinds it exactly along the same path
One concept commands attention at a time; the others are concealed
The ambient colour atmosphere changes progressively in one direction across the set, conveying progress with no counter or indicator, while keeping images and blurbs readable throughout
The set rests on its last item and ends quietly, without looping
Scroll motion glides and settles rather than stepping between fixed positions
adaptable_details: Number of entries, as long as it stays a small curated set
Subject matter of the images and length of the blurbs, within a short-copy range
Shape, size and placement of the held picture frame and the position of the text region relative to it
Start and end points of the colour progression, which hue direction it travels in, and how strong the shift is
Distance and direction of the in-frame photo drift
Typography and text entry treatment
Total scroll length allotted to the sequence and how much scroll each transition consumes
Whether the erase boundary is hard or softly feathered
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits small, ordered sets of image-plus-short-text items where each item deserves undivided attention and the order carries meaning, such as concept showcases, feature walkthroughs, curated portfolio pieces or chaptered narratives. It works with any host palette, since only the direction and extent of the atmospheric shift matter, not particular hues. It stops working for large collections needing browsing or comparison, for long-form text needing an independent reading pace, or for grids where items must be seen side by side. Replacing scroll-bound scrubbing with timed autoplay, allowing arbitrary jumps between items, or substituting slides, fades or carousel movement for the upward erase would create a different skill.

name: scroll_paced_object_relay_between_outlined_slots
description: A single object is parked in a marked square slot and, as you scroll, glides to further slots waiting empty further down the page, changing size to match each slot and tumbling as it travels, with a soft catch-up lag and a full rewind when you scroll back up.

canonical_document.name: scroll_paced_object_relay_between_outlined_slots
canonical_document.description: A single object is parked in a marked square slot and, as you scroll, glides to further slots waiting empty further down the page, changing size to match each slot and tumbling as it travels, with a soft catch-up lag and a full rewind when you scroll back up.
canonical_document.experience_scope: Whole-view experience spanning the full scrollable length of a short single-purpose page: it begins with the object parked in the first marked slot beneath an opening cue and ends when the object comes to rest in the final slot beside a closing cue.
content_and_composition: One foreground object as the sole moving subject, present and visible for the entire page

Three marked square slots stacked down the page at distinct vertical positions, each outlined with enough separation from its surround to read clearly; the two not yet reached read as empty and awaiting arrival
Slots differ in size, so at least one destination is visibly larger and one visibly smaller than another
A short opening text cue above the first slot and a short closing text cue at the final slot
Generous empty vertical space between slots so the object is seen travelling rather than jumping between dense blocks
The object sits within or aligned to whichever slot it currently occupies; the slot outlines persist whether occupied or empty
experience_progression: Object parked at rest in the first slot, orientation and size settled, opening cue readable above it
First move: object leaves the first slot and travels toward the second, tumbling and resizing to match the destination slot
Settled beat: object rests in the intermediate slot with a noticeable hold before the next move begins
Second move: object travels to the final slot, again tumbling and resizing to fit
Final rest: object settles in the last slot and the closing cue reads as the end of the journey
Any point in this order can be re-entered in either direction; the sequence is a retraceable path, not a one-time playback
attention_and_information_flow: The next destination is legible before the object gets there, because the empty outlined slot is already visible
Attention stays anchored on the single travelling object; text cues take prominence only at the start and the end
Each arrival gives a moment of stability that makes the just-completed step readable before the next begins
Size change signals which slot the object now belongs to, reinforcing arrival without extra labels

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Stopping partway leaves the object mid-move at exactly the state that scroll position implies; no snap to the nearest slot
interaction_model.state_change: Scroll depth maps directly onto progress along the path, advancing position, scale and rotation together
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The object glides toward the next outlined slot, tumbling as it goes and growing or shrinking toward the destination slot's size
interaction_model.input: Scrolling downward through the document
interaction_model.affected_object: The single foreground object and its relationship to the marked slots

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Resuming scroll in either direction picks up from wherever the object currently is, without a jump
interaction_model.state_change: Motion continues briefly then eases to the state matching the current scroll position
interaction_model.visible_feedback: A soft catch-up glide instead of an abrupt halt, so the object settles rather than stops dead
interaction_model.input: Stopping scroll movement
interaction_model.affected_object: The object's motion

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Direction can be reversed at any moment, including mid-move; the state is always a function of scroll depth
interaction_model.state_change: Progress rewinds through exactly the same intermediate states in reverse
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The object retraces its path backward, untumbling and resizing back, returning to its original slot and original orientation at the top
interaction_model.input: Scrolling back upward
interaction_model.affected_object: The object's position, size and orientation

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Current scroll progress is preserved through the resize; the journey continues from the same point
interaction_model.state_change: Slot positions and the object's path recompute for the new dimensions
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The object stays correctly seated in or aligned to its slot rather than drifting offset from the outlines
interaction_model.input: Resizing the viewport
interaction_model.affected_object: Slot placement and the object's alignment to slots

experience_qualities: Unhurried and easy to follow, never rushed or twitchy
Reads as one continuous relocation journey rather than separate animations per section
Soft and weighted, with trailing momentum instead of mechanical lockstep
Fully retraceable, so the whole path feels inspectable in both directions
Anticipatory: destinations are known before arrival
completion_and_return: Completion is the object at rest in the final slot with the closing cue present; no loop or autoplay
No reset button: the journey is undone purely by scrolling back up
Returning to the top restores the exact starting slot, size and orientation
State is always derived from scroll depth, so there is no lingering or stale progress
locked_observable_requirements: Vertical scroll position is the only driver of the object's progress; nothing autoplays on a timer
Position, size change and rotation advance and rewind together through identical states in both directions
Destination slots are outlined with clear separation from their surround and readable as empty before the object arrives
At least two sequential moves with a settled resting beat between them
The object changes size between a larger and a smaller slot
Motion trails scroll with an eased catch-up that continues briefly after scrolling stops
Stopping mid-move leaves the object mid-move, not snapped to a slot
Scrolling back to the top restores the original slot and orientation exactly
Slot positions and object alignment stay correct across viewport size changes
A short cue opens the journey above the first slot and a short cue closes it at the final slot
adaptable_details: Identity, silhouette and surface treatment of the travelling object, including its coloring
Outline styling, proportions and exact sizes of the slots
Exact wording of the opening and closing cues
Length of the catch-up delay and the resting beat
Number of hops beyond the required minimum of two
Vertical spacing between slots and total page length
Path shape between slots and the number of turns in the tumble
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits short, sparse pages built around one hero object with abundant open empty space and only brief framing text, where the object is the reason to scroll. It stops being this Skill if the motion is driven by time, autoplay or clicks rather than scroll depth, if progress cannot be rewound to identical states, if multiple objects travel at once, if destination slots are hidden until arrival so anticipation disappears, or if dense text and content blocks occupy the space between slots so the travel is no longer the visible subject.

name: momentum_text_rise_reveal_with_speed_ripple
description: Sparse copy that lands one block at a time: each heading or paragraph lifts from beneath its own baseline while uncovering from its bottom edge upward, carried by smooth momentum scrolling, while fast scrolling ripples the whole view and pulls its colour fringes apart before settling crisp.

canonical_document.name: momentum_text_rise_reveal_with_speed_ripple
canonical_document.description: Sparse copy that lands one block at a time: each heading or paragraph lifts from beneath its own baseline while uncovering from its bottom edge upward, carried by smooth momentum scrolling, while fast scrolling ripples the whole view and pulls its colour fringes apart before settling crisp.
canonical_document.experience_scope: Whole-view single-page reading experience: begins with a short hold that keeps the view withheld until the type is ready, covers the full vertical column of copy from the opening headline through the short final line, and ends when the reader reaches that closing line; the speed-driven distortion applies to the entire view rather than to a single region.
content_and_composition: One dominant opening headline as the first and largest reading beat
A small number of short body paragraphs stacked below it in a single narrow reading column, ordinary selectable text throughout
One short closing line that terminates the sequence
Each text block occupies its own reveal band aligned to its own baseline, with hidden-below-the-line and fully-shown as its two resting states
A whole-view distortion layer sitting over all copy, visually inert at rest and only expressed while movement is fast
A brief pre-reading hold state that withholds the copy until the lettering is ready to be shown
experience_progression: Short hold: the view is withheld and no block is revealed until the type is ready
Landing: the reader arrives on the headline, which reveals first and holds attention alone
Descent: scrolling brings each following paragraph to its reveal point one at a time, so a single block becomes present at a time
Closing: the final short line reveals and completes the sequence with nothing further below
Reverse traversal: scrolling back conceals blocks again and re-reveals them on the next approach, so the sequence can be walked in either direction indefinitely
attention_and_information_flow: Attention is handed forward block by block; the currently arriving block is the only thing changing, so it owns focus
The headline holds sole attention before any paragraph is legible
Concealed blocks give away nothing until their own reveal begins, so information is disclosed strictly in reading order
At rest everything is calm and fully legible; the visible energy lives only in the moment of movement
Fast movement momentarily reduces legibility everywhere, which discourages skimming and rewards stopping

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: New input during a glide blends into the existing motion instead of restarting it; motion settles to a stable rest position on its own
interaction_model.state_change: Continuous eased advance or retreat of reading position that keeps gliding briefly after the input stops
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The column glides rather than stepping, so blocks approach their reveal thresholds gradually
interaction_model.input: Scrolling (the only input), with smooth carried momentum rather than discrete jumps
interaction_model.affected_object: The reading column's vertical position and, through it, which blocks are at their reveal points

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: A reveal interrupted midway is smoothly redirected toward its new target rather than snapping or restarting
interaction_model.state_change: Hidden below its own line to fully present and legible
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The lettering rises from beneath its baseline while uncovering progressively from its bottom edge upward until the whole block is shown, feeling faintly physical and unstable while it moves and calm once it settles
interaction_model.input: A text block entering view as reading position advances
interaction_model.affected_object: That single heading or paragraph

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Returning to the block reveals it again from its concealed state, so repeated passes remain consistent and reversible
interaction_model.state_change: Fully present back to hidden
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The reveal plays in reverse, sinking and re-covering to its concealed state
interaction_model.input: A text block leaving view as reading position moves away
interaction_model.affected_object: That same block

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: The distortion eases continuously back to fully crisp once movement slows or stops, with no residual artefact; slow reading never triggers it
interaction_model.state_change: Crisp and undistorted to rippling with separated colour fringes, scaled to how fast the movement is
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The whole view wobbles and its colour edges pull apart, strongest at peak speed
interaction_model.input: Scroll speed rising above a calm pace
interaction_model.affected_object: The entire view including all visible copy

experience_qualities: Physical, weighty lettering that feels faintly unstable in motion and settled at rest
Unhurried, one-thing-at-a-time reading rhythm
Momentum-driven glide rather than mechanical stepping
Speed felt as visible strain on the view itself
Calm, fully legible resting state after every movement
completion_and_return: The short final line ends the sequence; nothing continues past it and there is no loop
Reveal state is derived from reading position, so leaving and returning to any block reproduces the same conceal-then-reveal behaviour
The view always resolves to a crisp, calm, fully readable state whenever movement stops, including after an interrupted reveal
locked_observable_requirements: Copy is withheld until the type is ready, and no block appears revealed before that point
The headline is the first block the reader lands on, before any paragraph becomes legible
Each block reveals independently and one at a time, not as a whole-page fade
Reveal direction is a rise from beneath the block's own line combined with uncovering from the bottom edge upward
Reveals reverse on exit and replay on return
Interrupting a reveal redirects it smoothly; snapping or restarting is not acceptable
Scrolling carries eased momentum and never jumps
Distortion is speed-proportional, affects the whole view including colour fringing, and eases back to crisp at rest
All text remains ordinary copy that can be selected, found by in-page search, and read by assistive tools
adaptable_details: Number and length of paragraphs, and exact wording of headline and closing line
Typeface, type scale, colour palette and column width
Reveal duration, easing curves and momentum damping
Speed threshold and maximum intensity of the ripple and colour separation
Length and visual character of the initial hold before the copy appears
Whether blocks are centred or aligned to one edge
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits sparse, text-first single-column pieces where a headline plus a handful of short paragraphs is the entire foreground content and vertical scrolling is the only way through. Dense multi-column text, media-heavy galleries, interactive controls inside the reading flow, or making the copy non-selectable decorative rendering would break it. Replacing per-block baseline-rise reveals with a single whole-page transition, removing the speed-proportional whole-view distortion, or driving the sequence by pointer, time or navigation instead of scroll position would create a different Skill.

name: scroll_scrubbed_luminous_core
description: A small point of light at the centre of a near-empty view swells and spreads its halo as the visitor scrolls, while concentric rings glide inward and rotate, a ruled backdrop fades away, and small edge readouts rewrite their numbers and words to keep the change legible; scrolling back rewinds every state exactly.

canonical_document.name: scroll_scrubbed_luminous_core
canonical_document.description: A small point of light at the centre of a near-empty view swells and spreads its halo as the visitor scrolls, while concentric rings glide inward and rotate, a ruled backdrop fades away, and small edge readouts rewrite their numbers and words to keep the change legible; scrolling back rewinds every state exactly.
canonical_document.experience_scope: Whole-view experience spanning the full scroll length after arrival, ending in a calm closing reflection that reads as an arrival point; it is the entire journey rather than one section within a conventional page.
content_and_composition: One small central point of light as the permanent attention anchor, with a surrounding halo
A set of concentric rings arranged around the centre
One ruled or gridded field sitting behind the rings as the initial sense of empty structure
Small measured status readouts placed at the edges of the view, combining numbers and short words
A calm closing reflection presented at the end of the passage

A quiet, near-empty field throughout, held at one uniform low-activity tone that stays far enough from the central light in luminance for its glow to read, with all elements layered around a single centre
Low sustained music persisting underneath, plus a faint textured noise layer tied to movement
experience_progression: Opening stage of stillness and emptiness: the point is small, the halo tight, the rings wide, the ruled field present
Middle stage of gathering expansion: the point swells, the halo spreads, the rings close in and rotate, the ruled field thins away
Late stage of radiance where the central light dominates the view, its luminance risen well clear of the surround
Closing stage: a calm reflection that settles the passage rather than cutting it off
The whole progression is continuous and fully reversible along the scroll rather than a series of discrete slides
attention_and_information_flow: Prominence gathers steadily on the single central point as the passage advances
The surrounding structure gives up prominence: rings tighten and the ruled field fades, so nothing competes with the centre
The edge readouts never take the foreground but continuously report where the visitor is, making the change measurable
At the end, attention releases from the light onto the closing reflection

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Scrolling is the only driver, so the visitor sets the pace and can stop anywhere; values clamp at the far end so the composition cannot be pushed past its final state
interaction_model.state_change: Every element advances proportionally with scroll position toward its expanded, radiant end state
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The point swells and its halo spreads, rings glide inward while rotating, the ruled field fades out, and the edge readouts rewrite their numbers and words
interaction_model.input: Continuous scrolling forward
interaction_model.affected_object: Central point and halo, concentric rings, ruled backdrop, edge readouts

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Reversal is exact and can be interrupted or resumed at any point; values clamp at the start so the opening state is the floor
interaction_model.state_change: Each state runs backwards through the identical range it advanced through
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The light shrinks, the halo contracts, rings glide back outward, the ruled field returns, and the readouts count back down
interaction_model.input: Scrolling back upward
interaction_model.affected_object: All of the same elements together

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: The cut-out is delayed slightly so brief pauses do not chop the sound; stopping always returns to silence without visitor action
interaction_model.state_change: Noise becomes audible only while the view is genuinely moving and falls silent shortly after it settles
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Motion is accompanied by audible texture; stillness returns to the quiet underlying music
interaction_model.input: Presence or absence of actual page movement
interaction_model.affected_object: Faint textured noise layer in the soundtrack

experience_qualities: Meditative and unhurried, paced entirely by the visitor
Legible without instruction: the readouts explain progress on their own
A felt passage from emptiness toward radiance rather than a sequence of separate sections
Precise and instrument-like at the edges, soft and atmospheric at the centre
Reliable: nothing runs away on its own and every state can be revisited
completion_and_return: Ends by settling into a calm closing reflection that reads as arrival, with no automatic loop or restart
Every intermediate state is addressable simply by returning to that scroll position
Values hold clamped at both extremes so the beginning and end are stable resting places
Movement-linked sound texture always resolves back to silence when the page is still
locked_observable_requirements: Scroll position alone drives the entire transformation; no stage advances on its own timer
Every state reverses exactly when scrolling back, and clamps at both extremes

A single small central point of light, held clearly separated in luminance from its surround so its glow and halo remain visible, stays the attention anchor for the whole passage and grows toward radiance
Surrounding structure recedes as the centre grows: rings move inward with rotation, and the ruled backdrop fades out
Small edge readouts rewrite both numbers and words in step with position so the change is legible
The faint noise texture sounds only during actual movement and cuts out shortly after stopping
The passage ends on a calm closing reflection rather than an abrupt stop
adaptable_details: Number, spacing and rotation amount of the rings
Hue family, surround tone and glow character of the central light, provided the luminance separation keeps the glow readable
Wording, units and corner placement of the edge readouts
Density and styling of the ruled backdrop
Total scroll length and pacing curve
Content of the closing reflection
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits sparse, single-idea content that can be paced across a long scroll in a low-density view whose surround stays quiet and uniform enough, and far enough from the central light in luminance, for one centre to carry attention. Introducing independently timed animation, non-reversible transitions, or several competing focal regions instead of one central anchor produces a different skill, as does replacing the measured edge readouts with ordinary navigation chrome.

name: quiet_stage_confetti_eruption_poster
description: A quiet low-distraction surface pauses, then bursts: a big headline snaps together while multi-toned shapes, streaks and paper scraps fling outward and fall away, leaving a clean legible poster; a press anywhere replays the burst from the first frame.

canonical_document.name: quiet_stage_confetti_eruption_poster
canonical_document.description: A quiet low-distraction surface pauses, then bursts: a big headline snaps together while multi-toned shapes, streaks and paper scraps fling outward and fall away, leaving a clean legible poster; a press anywhere replays the burst from the first frame.
canonical_document.experience_scope: Whole-view experience occupying the full surface. It begins on a quiet, empty, motionless stage of uniform low-distraction tone and ends when all motion has come to rest in a static legible arrangement that persists until the next press. Replay restarts the same scope from its first frame.
content_and_composition: One short large display headline as the single primary content, centered as the compositional anchor of the finished arrangement

Many small decorative pieces in three distinct visual kinds: solid filled shapes, elongated streaks, and scattered paper-like bits, carrying several clearly separated accent tones so the scatter reads as varied rather than uniform
Uniform low-distraction background stage, well separated in tone from the headline and pieces, acting as a persistent substrate for the whole moment
Decorative pieces occupy the layer around and over the headline area while it is in motion; the headline remains the topmost readable element once motion settles
Decorative pieces originate from a hidden starting position near the burst origin behind or beneath the headline area, not from visible edge controls
No visible button, control affordance, progress indicator or instructional label; the entire surface is the only interactive target
experience_progression: Stage 1 — held stillness: quiet empty surface with a deliberate pause and no motion, building anticipation
Stage 2 — eruption: on the beat, the headline snaps together while decorative pieces fling outward from the origin in a single simultaneous explosive impulse
Stage 3 — fall away: outward motion decays and pieces fall away and thin out while the headline completes its assembly
Stage 4 — rest: all motion ceases and the composition settles into a static poster-like arrangement with the headline fully legible
The full sequence completes within roughly a couple of seconds and then holds at rest rather than looping automatically
attention_and_information_flow: Initial emptiness and stillness suppress all information so attention is unclaimed and primed
At eruption, attention is captured by the mass and spread of flung decorative motion rather than by the text
As outward motion decays, prominence transfers from the decorative pieces to the assembled headline
At rest, decorative motion no longer competes and the headline carries the message alone as the sole readable element
Brevity and the clean resting state make the moment feel obviously repeatable, inviting a replay press

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Runs once to completion and settles at rest; it does not loop or re-fire on its own
interaction_model.state_change: Hidden, motionless start state transitions to actively erupting state
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Headline snaps together while multi-toned shapes, streaks and paper bits fling outward from the origin, clearly separated from the quiet background stage
interaction_model.input: Autonomous timed trigger after the initial held pause on the quiet stage
interaction_model.affected_object: Headline and all decorative pieces

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Unlimited repeat presses are permitted; each press yields exactly one clean run
interaction_model.state_change: Resting state resets to the hidden start state and immediately begins a new run
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The settled poster clears and the same eruption plays again, visibly identical to the first run
interaction_model.input: Press anywhere on the surface while the composition is at rest
interaction_model.affected_object: Entire burst composition

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Restart replaces rather than overlaps or queues; rapid repeated presses never accumulate runs and the visible result always matches a single clean run from the start
interaction_model.state_change: Current run is interrupted and abandoned, every piece snaps back to its hidden starting position, and a fresh run starts from the first frame
interaction_model.visible_feedback: In-flight motion is cut and instantly replaced by a new eruption from the origin, with no doubled, layered or ghosted pieces and no visible leftovers of the abandoned run
interaction_model.input: Press anywhere on the surface mid-burst, before motion has come to rest
interaction_model.affected_object: In-flight burst run

experience_qualities: Exuberant and celebratory
Cartoonish and playful rather than realistic or physically precise
Brief and punchy, over in roughly a couple of seconds
Anticipatory at the opening because of the held quiet empty beat
Explosive at the peak, with outward spread and fall-away decay
Legible and composed at rest, poster-like
Obviously and immediately repeatable
completion_and_return: Completes when all motion comes to rest in the static legible arrangement
The rested arrangement persists indefinitely and stays readable until the next press
No automatic looping; replay is user-initiated
Every replay returns all pieces to the hidden starting position first, so each run is identical to the first
Interruption resolves to a full reset rather than a partial resume or continuation
locked_observable_requirements: Opens on a quiet, motionless, uniform low-distraction stage with a deliberate pause before anything happens
The burst is a single outward-flinging eruption from an origin, followed by pieces falling away
The headline snaps together as part of the eruption rather than fading or appearing statically

Decorative pieces include visually distinct kinds — solid filled shapes, elongated streaks and scattered paper bits — carrying several clearly separated accent tones that stay distinguishable from each other and from the background stage
The whole sequence is brief, on the order of a couple of seconds, and finishes at rest
The final state is a static, legible poster-like arrangement with the headline readable at strong contrast against the stage and unobstructed
The entire surface is the replay target; there is no button or small hit area to find
A mid-burst press interrupts and immediately restarts from the first frame instead of overlapping or queueing
All pieces return to their hidden starting position before each replay so runs are visually identical
adaptable_details: Exact headline wording, language, typeface, weight and size
Specific accent tones and their hues, and the number, size and mix ratio of shapes, streaks and paper bits
Precise length of the opening pause and total duration within a brief window
Spread angles, spread distance and fall-away trajectories of the decorative pieces
Exact origin placement and final poster arrangement of headline and decorative accents
Presence of a small secondary line of supporting text within the resting poster
Exact background tone, whether light or dark, and any subtle background texture
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits short single-message celebratory or announcement screens where one large headline plus decorative accents is the whole foreground and the moment can own the full view. It stops fitting when the surface must carry dense readable content, scrolling regions or interactive controls, since a whole-surface replay press and full-view eruption would conflict with them. Making the burst loop continuously, letting runs overlap and accumulate, tying it to a small button target, replacing the held quiet opening and outward eruption with a gradual or ambient reveal, or letting the stage compete in tone so the headline and pieces lose separation would each create a different Skill.

name: scroll_paced_dormant_to_rimlit_card_sequence
description: On a uniform, low-distraction reading surface, widely spaced text cards each start dormant, gain full presence with a high-luminance light travelling around their border at peak visibility, then settle back to plain, all driven by how far the card has passed through the screen.

canonical_document.name: scroll_paced_dormant_to_rimlit_card_sequence
canonical_document.description: On a uniform, low-distraction reading surface, widely spaced text cards each start dormant, gain full presence with a high-luminance light travelling around their border at peak visibility, then settle back to plain, all driven by how far the card has passed through the screen.
canonical_document.experience_scope: Whole-view scrolling experience for one continuous page section: it begins with a small label heading at the top of the quiet surface and ends after the final denser tile cluster and a short closing line. Each individual card's effect begins when it enters the visible area and ends when it leaves; the surrounding atmosphere persists for the entire view.
content_and_composition: One persistent uniform low-distraction reading surface spanning the whole view as the base layer, held at a luminance clearly separated from the rim accent
One small quiet label heading near the start, acting as a low-emphasis orientation cue rather than a hero title
A short ordered series of standalone text cards (roughly three to six), one per vertical station, each holding a single short passage of text
Generous empty vertical space between cards, sized so at most one card occupies the attention zone at any scroll position
Per card: a plain resting card body plus a high-luminance rim/edge light layer that appears only during the card's most visible phase
One tighter cluster of smaller highlight tiles near the end, laid out at visibly higher density than the preceding one-per-view cards
One brief closing line of gratitude/sign-off text as the final element after the cluster
experience_progression: Quiet opening: low-distraction surface and small label read as calm and nearly empty, with no card yet asserting itself

Per-card three-phase lifecycle repeated down the page: dormant and recessed on entry, then rising to full presence with the high-salience travelling rim at peak visibility, then relaxing back to plain as the card moves on
Rhythmic advance: because spacing isolates each card, the page reads as a sequence of single moments rather than a continuous field of motion
Density shift at the end: the tighter tile cluster breaks the one-at-a-time rhythm and signals the sequence is closing
Closing beat: the short thank-you line terminates the sequence with no further reveal
attention_and_information_flow: The low-distraction surface and generous emptiness suppress ambient competition so prominence is almost entirely carried by the currently active card
Prominence transfers smoothly from one card to the next as scrolling proceeds; two cards are never both at peak presence
The travelling rim light is the single highest-salience accent in the view and marks exactly which card should be read now
Cards that have been read fall back to plain and become quiet background context rather than disappearing
The tile cluster redistributes attention from one focal item to a small grouped set, reading as summary rather than statement
The closing line is the lowest-emphasis text and ends information flow

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Progress is bound to scroll position only; no timer runs, so the effect can never get ahead of or behind the visitor
interaction_model.state_change: That card advances continuously along its own dormant → fully present → settled-plain progression, indexed to its position in the viewport rather than to elapsed time
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The card lifts out of its recessed dormant look, rises to full presence, and shows a high-luminance light travelling around its rim at peak visibility before relaxing back to a plain card
interaction_model.input: Downward vertical scrolling
interaction_model.affected_object: The card currently crossing the visible area

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Reversal is fully symmetric and repeatable any number of times with no drift or replay-from-start behaviour
interaction_model.state_change: The card's progression rewinds through exactly the states it passed on the way down, in reverse order
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Rim light and presence retrace their earlier appearance identically, so the reverse pass looks like the forward pass played backwards
interaction_model.input: Upward vertical scrolling
interaction_model.affected_object: The same card being scrolled back through

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Resuming scroll in either direction continues from precisely that held state
interaction_model.state_change: The card holds at its exact intermediate state and does not continue or relax on its own
interaction_model.visible_feedback: A frozen partial rise in presence with the rim light held at its current point around the edge
interaction_model.input: Stopping scrolling at any position
interaction_model.affected_object: Whichever card is mid-progression

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Clamped ends are stable resting states, so fast scrolling or jumps land on a valid look rather than a half-broken one
interaction_model.state_change: The card clamps to its first or last state instead of overshooting or resetting
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Not-yet-reached cards rest dormant and recessed; already-passed cards rest plain and quiet with no rim light
interaction_model.input: Scroll position beyond a card's range (not yet reached, or already passed)
interaction_model.affected_object: Cards outside the visible attention zone

experience_qualities: Calm and unhurried, with emptiness treated as part of the design
Directly hand-controlled — the visitor feels they are driving the light
Reversible and trustworthy, never surprising the visitor with autonomous motion
Visually restrained, with a single high-salience accent doing all the emphasising
Sequential and paced, reading as a series of separate moments
Clearly finite, with an unmistakable ending rather than an open-ended scroll
completion_and_return: The sequence completes at the closing line; nothing loops or restarts automatically
Scrolling back up re-enters the sequence at whatever state the current position implies, so return is always coherent
No card retains a 'seen' badge or permanently altered look — passed cards rest plain and can be re-lit by scrolling up
State is derived entirely from scroll position, so a re-entry at any depth shows the correct clamped or intermediate look immediately
locked_observable_requirements: Each item's visual state is a function of its own passage through the visible area, never of a timer or one-shot trigger
Forward and backward scrolling traverse exactly the same visual states in opposite order
Stopping holds the intermediate state indefinitely with no autonomous settling or continuation
Items outside their active range clamp to a stable first or last appearance
A three-phase per-item lifecycle: dormant/recessed on arrival, peak presence with a high-luminance light travelling along the item's rim, then a calm return to plain
At most one item is at peak presence at any scroll position, enforced by generous spacing
A uniform, low-distraction surface whose luminance sits far enough from the rim accent that the travelling rim reads as the highest-salience element in view, in either a light or dark scheme
A visible density increase (tighter grouped tiles) plus a short closing line to mark the end of the sequence
adaptable_details: Whether the surround is light or dark, and its hue and temperature, so long as the rim's luminance separation is preserved
Rim light thickness, colour, sharpness and travel speed around the edge
Number of sequential cards and number of tiles in the closing cluster
Amount of vertical emptiness, card width and corner treatment
Wording of the label heading and closing line
Whether the text in each card is a quote, principle, statistic or short claim
Additional quiet secondary emphasis on the active card (slight lift, contrast, letter spacing)
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits sparse, sequential, short-text foreground content on a deliberately quiet, low-distraction page where the owner wants scrolling to pace reading one item at a time and wants an unmistakable end. It stops being this Skill if items become dense or simultaneously active, if progression is driven by timers, autoplay or one-shot entrance triggers that cannot rewind, if the effect is pinned behind other foreground content as an ambient substrate, or if the illumination becomes a hover/click highlight on a grid rather than a scroll-position-bound lifecycle.

name: opaque_sheet_menu_over_photo_cover
description: A calm photographic cover that an opaque sheet of clearly separated luminance sweeps down over, revealing oversized destination names that light up one at a time in a single accent with two pictures opening beside them, and unwinding back to the cover on the same toggle.

canonical_document.name: opaque_sheet_menu_over_photo_cover
canonical_document.description: A calm photographic cover that an opaque sheet of clearly separated luminance sweeps down over, revealing oversized destination names that light up one at a time in a single accent with two pictures opening beside them, and unwinding back to the cover on the same toggle.
canonical_document.experience_scope: Whole-view experience: begins at the landing cover that fills the view, extends through the menu that fully displaces that cover, and ends when the menu unwinds and the original cover is returned unchanged; the top-bar toggle persists across both states.
content_and_composition: Base layer: a single full-bleed photographic cover set as a calm, low-noise backdrop whose overall luminance sits far from that of the overlay surface
Cover foreground: one short headline plus a couple of small secondary labels, nothing else
Persistent top bar containing a single two-bar toggle that is present in both closed and open states
Overlay layer: one fully opaque surface, clearly separated in luminance from the cover, that covers the entire view and hides the cover rather than tinting it
Menu content: a short vertical stack of oversized destination names, immediately scannable, separated by thin horizontal rules
Small ordinal numbers positioned beside each destination name
Per-destination imagery: two pictures flanking the focused destination name, one on each side, appearing only while that name is focused
Exactly one destination is visually elevated at any moment; all others stay in a plain resting treatment
experience_progression: Arrival: photographic cover at rest with headline and small labels, toggle showing its two-bar closed form

Opening: the opaque surface sweeps downward across the view as one unhurried movement, the cover's headline fades out, and the toggle's bars re-contrast against the arriving surface and pinch together
Assembly during the same sweep: destination names rise into their positions and thin rules draw in between them
Settled: once everything has arrived, small ordinal numbers appear beside the names, marking the open state as complete
Browsing: focus moves between destinations, one at a time, each bringing its own paired imagery
Closing: the entire opening unwinds in reverse and the cover is handed back untouched
attention_and_information_flow: At rest, attention rests on the image with only a short headline to read; almost no competing information
During opening, attention follows the advancing edge of the opaque surface downward as cover text recedes and destination names take over the view
Once open, the destination names are the only dense information; ordinals arrive last as a quiet confirmation rather than a competing element
While browsing, prominence collapses onto the single focused destination through the accent treatment and motion, with its two pictures widening the focus without stealing the name's lead
Open versus shut is never ambiguous: the toggle's form and the presence of the opaque surface both report state at all times
Closing returns attention to the untouched cover with no residue of the menu

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Pressing the toggle again reverses the whole sequence; pressing it mid-transition abandons the current motion and starts the opposite one from where it is
interaction_model.state_change: Closed cover state transitions to fully open menu state as one coordinated sequence
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Opaque surface sweeps down over the cover; destination names rise into place; thin rules draw between them; the headline fades out; the toggle's bars re-contrast against the new surface and pinch together; ordinal numbers appear beside the names only after everything has arrived
interaction_model.input: Press the two-bar toggle in the top bar while the cover is showing
interaction_model.affected_object: Whole view: opaque overlay surface, destination list, rules, cover headline, toggle mark

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Interruptible at any point; a press during the unwind restarts the opening instead
interaction_model.state_change: Open menu state unwinds back to the closed cover state
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The opening plays in reverse and the photographic cover reappears with its headline and small labels exactly as they were
interaction_model.input: Press the toggle while the menu is open
interaction_model.affected_object: Opaque overlay surface, destination list and underlying cover

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Moving away undoes the swap and the imagery reveal, returning the destination to its plain resting treatment; only one destination is focused at a time
interaction_model.state_change: That single destination becomes the focused one; any previously focused destination returns to rest
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The label's characters slide upward and are swapped for an accent-colored copy while the two pictures beside it wipe open and ease down from slightly oversized to their settled size
interaction_model.input: Point at a destination name in the open menu
interaction_model.affected_object: That destination's characters and its two flanking pictures

experience_qualities: Calm and image-led at rest, stark and open once the menu takes over
Unhurried, single-gesture takeover rather than a stack of separate animations
Sparse and editorial: very few words, very large type, generous emptiness
Unambiguous state: the user always knows whether the menu is open
Precise, mechanical letter swap and image wipe that reward pointing without feeling busy
Fully reversible and forgiving of impatient input
completion_and_return: The open state completes when the ordinal numbers have appeared beside every destination name
Closing completes only when the cover is fully restored, headline and small labels included, with no leftover menu artifacts
Destination focus has no completion of its own; it fully reverts when focus leaves
Interrupted transitions always resolve into one of the two stable states, never a partial state
locked_observable_requirements: A full-bleed, low-noise photographic cover carrying only a short headline and a couple of small labels
An opaque surface, clearly separated in luminance from the cover, that displaces it across the whole view by sweeping downward, not a translucent tint or a partial panel
A single persistent toggle whose two bars re-contrast against the overlay surface and pinch together to report the open state
Oversized, instantly scannable destination names in a short vertical stack with thin rules drawn between them
The cover headline fades out as part of the same opening movement
Small ordinal numbers that appear beside the names only after the opening has fully arrived
Exactly one focused destination at a time, its characters sliding upward and swapping to an accent-colored copy
Two pictures flanking the focused destination that wipe open and ease down from slightly oversized
Focus effects fully reverse when the pointer leaves
Closing unwinds the entire opening and returns the cover untouched
A press during any transition abandons that motion and starts the opposite one
adaptable_details: Number of destinations in the stack and the wording of their names
Subject matter of the cover photograph and of the per-destination pictures
Exact accent hue used for the swapped characters, provided it reads at high salience against the overlay surface and stays clearly distinct from the resting text
Typeface, rule thickness, ordinal number format and spacing
Exact durations and easing of the sweep, rise, wipe and character slide
Placement of the toggle within the top bar and the content of the cover's small labels
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits landing or cover views with a small set of top-level destinations where each destination has representative imagery and the foreground text is deliberately sparse. It stops being this Skill if the menu becomes an inline or compact panel that leaves the cover visible, if the destination list grows dense enough to need scrolling or grouping, if destinations have no imagery to reveal on focus, or if the toggle no longer morphs to report state.

name: eroding_image_dissolve_toggle
description: A centered picture that erodes and melts into a plain backdrop when a single toggle is pressed, and gathers itself back into a stable, readable image when pressed again, with softly alive outer edges and smooth reversal at any point mid-change.

canonical_document.name: eroding_image_dissolve_toggle
canonical_document.description: A centered picture that erodes and melts into a plain backdrop when a single toggle is pressed, and gathers itself back into a stable, readable image when pressed again, with softly alive outer edges and smooth reversal at any point mid-change.
canonical_document.experience_scope: A self-contained region occupying the visual center of a small, quiet page: the framed image area plus one nearby toggle. Begins at page load with the image already fully visible and ends whenever the image rests fully visible or fully dissolved; the surrounding page stays static and uninvolved.
content_and_composition: Exactly one focal picture, centered in the view, sized to be the unmistakable subject
A plain, quiet, low-contrast backdrop layer behind the picture that reads as the substance the picture dissolves into
One plainly visible on-page toggle control, persistently present in both states, positioned near the image without competing with it

Immediately responsive, with visible change starting on the same beat as the press

Mid-transition activation smoothly redirects from the current partial state with no jump or restart

canonical_document.name: chunky_block_mosaic_image_swap
canonical_document.description: A lone square photo on a quiet, uniform stage that shatters into a coarse screen of solid blocks, briefly hides itself behind them, then clears onto a second photo, running back to the first when attention withdraws.

A uniform, quiet backdrop set clearly apart from the picture in tone so it isolates the image and lets the solid blocks read as flat opaque shapes

name: scrambled_rows_settling_into_one_sentence
description: A centered stack of character rows fills in as unreadable clutter, holds one clearly legible sentence for a beat, then loses coherence and empties, restarting forever with the rows out of sync.

canonical_document.name: scrambled_rows_settling_into_one_sentence
canonical_document.description: A centered stack of character rows fills in as unreadable clutter, holds one clearly legible sentence for a beat, then loses coherence and empties, restarting forever with the rows out of sync.
canonical_document.experience_scope: A self-contained centered typographic region that can occupy a whole view or sit as a block inside one. It begins automatically on load from a completely empty field and has no end state: the cycle continues for as long as the view is open.
content_and_composition: One short evocative sentence is the only meaningful content; it is the payload of the entire piece.
The sentence is distributed across a small stack of horizontal rows of uniform-width characters, read top to bottom.
Each row is a fixed-length run of characters that is mostly unreadable clutter, so the stack reads as a dense field of glyphs rather than as prose.

The stack is centered in its container against a plain, low-distraction ground that sits far enough from the glyph tone to keep characters comfortably readable, with no surrounding chrome, controls, labels or navigation.
The character field itself is the only persistent element; nothing else enters or leaves the composition.
experience_progression: Empty field: no characters present.
Accumulation: rows enter one after another in sequence, each filling with unreadable clutter, so the field builds up rather than appearing at once.

Landing: the full sentence resolves and is held clearly for a distinct beat, the single peak of the cycle.
Loss of coherence: legibility decays back into clutter.
Emptying: rows clear out, returning the field toward empty.
Renewal: the cycle begins again immediately, with rows progressively drifting out of phase with one another so no two cycles look identically synchronized.

Prominence rises as legible fragments increase in density, concentrating attention on the emerging words.
The held legible beat is the informational climax: the sentence is fully readable and unambiguous for a moment.
Prominence falls as coherence dissolves, releasing attention back to texture and mood rather than meaning.
Row desynchronization keeps the eye wandering between lines instead of locking to a single predictable rhythm.

interaction_model.state_change: Advances continuously through empty, accumulating clutter, resolved sentence, decay and emptying, then repeats
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Characters churn, words snap into readability, hold, then break apart and clear
interaction_model.input: Autonomous time-based playback with no user action required
interaction_model.affected_object: The stack of character rows and their per-character legibility

interaction_model.state_change: Resets to the empty field and enters the accumulation stage from the beginning
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The opening build-in replays: rows enter in sequence into an empty space
interaction_model.input: Fresh page load
interaction_model.affected_object: The whole character field

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Absence and return are never treated as events; the piece never announces an interruption.
interaction_model.state_change: No restart or resynchronization; the ongoing cycle is rejoined wherever it stands

interaction_model.affected_object: Cycle position

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Layout changes are absorbed silently at any stage of the cycle.
interaction_model.state_change: The stack stays centered in the new dimensions while the cycle continues undisturbed
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The block recenters; no flash, restart, blank frame or timing reset is visible
interaction_model.input: Resizing or reflowing the container or window
interaction_model.affected_object: Placement of the row stack

experience_qualities: Feels like a faint signal tuning into focus and slipping out again
Calm, unhurried and hypnotic enough to sit with for a long time
Atmospheric and understated, carried by glyph texture and legibility contrast rather than any particular hue or ornament
Quietly suspenseful in the moment before the sentence lands
Never demanding: nothing asks to be clicked or figured out
