The cycle loops indefinitely and renews immediately after emptying.
Row phases progressively diverge, so the loop reads as ongoing rather than as a repeated clip.
Reload is the only reset and always replays the empty-to-accumulating opening.

adaptable_details: Which short words or fragments appear and how many

canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits contexts where a short phrase or a purely atmospheric mood is the entire message and the view can be given over to a single text field: opening screens, holding and standby pages, teaser or statement views. Making the words permanently legible, driving the noise from pointer or scroll input, resolving to a final frame or payoff, or replacing the character grid with image or particle material would each create a different Skill.

name: beat_timed_lyric_stage_show

A frozen state persists indefinitely until resumed, holding both sound and visuals at the same point

Replacing the paced single line with several simultaneous text blocks, driving advance by scroll or visitor pacing instead of playback position, looping as ambient background behind other content, or opening the stage up to exploration and manipulation would each create a different Skill.

canonical_document.experience_scope: Whole-view experience occupying the entire visible surface; it begins in the fully covered state on arrival and continues indefinitely as alternating covering and clearing passes, each pass beginning at a press and ending only when the view is fully covered or fully clear.

During clearing, the calm ground is progressively revealed from the bottom upward as the curtain exits the top

interaction_model.visible_feedback: The curtain travels upward with a soft wobbling boundary and slips away past the top edge, leaving calm low-distraction emptiness

interaction_model.affected_object: The stacked gradient curtain layers and the calm ground beneath

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: The pass always runs to full completion; the next press reverses it
interaction_model.state_change: Clear resolves to covered
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The saturated gradient grows up from the bottom edge behind a soft wobbling boundary until the whole view is covered
interaction_model.input: Press anywhere on the surface while fully clear
interaction_model.affected_object: The stacked gradient curtain layers and the calm ground beneath

interaction_model.affected_object: The full-view pressable surface

experience_qualities: Playful and vivid in the curtain against a calm, restrained counter-state
Soft, liquid and layered rather than hard-edged or mechanical
Unhurried pacing with a rhythm that is never quite the same twice
Reads unmistakably as a curtain between states, not a decorative still image

Cleared state is a calm, low-distraction ground clearly separated in luminance and intensity from the covered state
Passes always resolve fully to covered or clear; mid-pass presses are ignored
The entire area is pressable and reads as pressable
Pass rhythm varies between runs rather than repeating identically
Initial state is fully covered

Exact luminance and tint of the cleared ground, and whether it sits lighter or darker than the curtain

name: mosaic_block_assembly_statement_reveal
description: Each oversized word or mark is built up by a sweep of high-salience blocks that passes across its area and leaves crisp legible content behind, on an otherwise near-empty low-distraction stage; scrolling away sweeps it back into blocks and away.

canonical_document.name: mosaic_block_assembly_statement_reveal
canonical_document.description: Each oversized word or mark is built up by a sweep of high-salience blocks that passes across its area and leaves crisp legible content behind, on an otherwise near-empty low-distraction stage; scrolling away sweeps it back into blocks and away.
canonical_document.experience_scope: Whole-view experience spanning the ordered sequence of statement frames: it begins on arrival with the opening mark frame and ends after the closing mark frame. Each individual statement is also a self-contained region whose reveal is scoped to its own bounds, so the effect can be applied to a single frame or repeated down a longer view.
content_and_composition: One uniform, near-empty low-distraction background stage shared by all frames, with no competing decoration or supporting text
An ordered set of a few statement items: an opening mark item, several oversized single-word or very short text items, and a closing mark item
Exactly one statement item holds the frame at a time; each item is sized to dominate its view

The final resolved state of every item is crisp, fully legible content at readable contrast against the stage, with no residual blocks or artifacts
The mosaic layer stays registered to its own item's bounds rather than to the page or window

On becoming essentially fully visible, a brief still beat passes with nothing shown
The high-salience block mosaic sweeps through the item's area at its own steady pace, independent of how fast the user scrolls

interaction_model.state_change: Blank to a brief hold, then to assembling, then to fully resolved
interaction_model.visible_feedback: After the beat, a high-salience block mosaic sweeps across the item's area at a steady self-paced rate and leaves crisp legible content behind it
interaction_model.input: Scrolling until an item sits essentially fully inside the viewport
interaction_model.affected_object: That statement item and its block mosaic layer

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Interruption is always resolved to a clean end state; nothing is ever left stuck half-drawn
interaction_model.state_change: Resolved or partially assembled back to blank
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The assembly plays backwards entering from the opposite side, content breaks apart into high-salience blocks and vanishes, leaving an empty quiet frame
interaction_model.input: Scrolling an already revealed or mid-revealing item back out of full view
interaction_model.affected_object: The same statement item and its block mosaic layer

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Repeat visits are unlimited and always start from a clean blank state rather than resuming a partial one
interaction_model.state_change: Blank to a fresh full reveal from the beginning
interaction_model.visible_feedback: A clean new mosaic assembly runs identically to the first time, so any moment of the sequence can be revisited
interaction_model.input: Returning to an item that was interrupted or previously seen
interaction_model.affected_object: That statement item

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Alignment is maintained through layout changes without restarting or breaking an in-progress reveal
interaction_model.state_change: Effect bounds re-register to the item's current position and size
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The mosaic and resolved content stay pinned to their own item with no drift, offset or misalignment against the statement
interaction_model.input: Continued scrolling and window resizing while items are on screen
interaction_model.affected_object: Each item's effect area and its content

Energetic and constructive rather than instantaneous
Rhythmic and quickly learnable through identical repetition
Deliberate, with a short suspenseful beat before each build
Legibility that feels earned rather than given
Robust and forgiving: no half-finished or stranded states
completion_and_return: An item completes when its content is fully crisp and legible, then holds indefinitely while in full view
Leaving full view returns the item to blank via the reversed assembly, restoring the empty stage
There is no one-shot lock-in: every item can be replayed by re-entering full view, and the whole sequence is fully revisitable in either scroll direction
The sequence's own completion is the closing mark frame resolving, mirroring the opening mark

Every item in the sequence resolves by the identical treatment, producing a learnable rhythm

The effect stays pinned to its own item through scrolling and window resizing
The sequence is bookended by mark items with word items between them

canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits short, high-impact statement content where each item is a few words, a single word, or a compact mark that can own an entire quiet frame alone, and where items are encountered one at a time along a scroll. It does not fit dense paragraphs, multi-column layouts, or several simultaneous focal items, because the mosaic build depends on one large legible shape per frame. Driving assembly progress directly from scroll position, letting items reveal while only partly in view, giving different items different reveal treatments, or keeping revealed items permanently resolved instead of reversing them out would each produce a different Skill.

name: looping_icon_morph_with_scrub_strip

interaction_model.affected_object: Every keyword currently in flight through the depth field

interaction_model.affected_object: The whole depth field

Playful and spectacle-like while every word stays legible at its moment
Depth-first: progress feels like distance covered, not like page length consumed
Precisely hand-driven, with motion that feels physically attached to the scroll gesture
Sparse and paced, so attention is guided rather than overwhelmed
Scrubbable and reversible, inviting the user to hold, back up and re-watch a passage
completion_and_return: Completion is an intentionally empty view after the last keyword passes, not a summary or call to action
No looping or auto-restart
Full reversibility: scrolling back reconstructs any earlier moment exactly, including the opening composition
State is entirely a function of scroll position, so the same offset always yields the same frame
locked_observable_requirements: Vertical scroll is the only driver; nothing advances on its own or on a timer
Position within the field maps directly to scroll offset, so stopping freezes the field and reversing retraces paths exactly
Keywords follow an approach-hold-pass arc with a readable beat at legible size
One oversized keyword owns the center from the first frame and names the subject
Only a few keywords are in readable range at once; arrivals are staggered
The field fills the screen and the frame itself stays still, so change reads as depth gained
Hard limits at the top and bottom of the page, with no looping
The view is left empty after the final keyword passes
A plainly readable static rendering of the same keywords exists when motion is unwanted or unavailable

Backdrop tone, contrast and any atmospheric fading of distant words

canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits short, self-contained text items of comparable length that can be read in a glance and carry meaning alone, such as feature words, values or capability labels, presented as a standalone full-viewport showcase. Long phrases, paragraphs, images or items requiring side-by-side comparison break it because they cannot stay legible while approaching and passing. interaction_model.visible_feedback: Ink follows the finger while the view stays perfectly still underneath it

interaction_model.affected_object: The surface gesture handling

interaction_model.visible_feedback: Pigment thins gradually toward emptiness rather than snapping off

Unhurried, with slow spreading and gentle self-thinning
Playful and self-explanatory: no instruction needed because the first movement already responds
Endlessly repeatable, with no completion, score or dead end
Airy and mostly empty, so the single word carries all the meaning
completion_and_return: No completion state and no finish line

Streaks keep curling and spreading briefly after motion stops, then thin out on their own

name: sliced_channel_ghost_word_scroll_statement

canonical_document.name: sliced_channel_ghost_word_scroll_statement
canonical_document.description: One giant word at a time on a single continuous field carrying a faint photographic wash; scrolling shears each word into narrow vertical slices that offset into three distinctly hued ghost copies by how fast you move, then relaxes to sharp type when you stop.
canonical_document.experience_scope: Whole-view experience spanning the full statement sequence: it begins on the first word view and ends when the final word lands with the phrase complete; the continuous field and photographic wash read as one uninterrupted space across all word views rather than as separate sections.
content_and_composition: Foreground: a short statement of about three words, exactly one word visible per full viewport, set at giant display scale and centered so it owns the view alone
Background: a single continuous space that persists unbroken across all word views, held at one steady luminance level with no visible seams or panel edges between words
Mid layer: a faint photographic wash behind the type, kept low in contrast against the surround so it never competes with the word
Transient layer: per-word narrow vertical slices of the glyphs plus offset duplicates of those slices in three mutually distinct hues, appearing only while motion is happening
No competing foreground elements, captions or decorative accents beside the word
experience_progression: First word alone in the continuous field, clean and sharp at rest
Movement begins: the current word slices and splits into hue-offset ghosts while advancing toward the next word view
Each subsequent word takes over the full view alone, adding one beat to the phrase
Final word lands as an arrival point, read as the completed statement
Reverse advance re-enters earlier word views in the same tearing-and-restoring manner
attention_and_information_flow: Attention rests on exactly one idea at a time because only one word is ever present
Distortion peaks during transit and drains at rest, so legibility and comprehension arrive at every stopping point
The photographic wash stays subordinate, supplying mood and depth without pulling focus from the word
Information accumulates as remembered beats; the phrase is understood as complete at the final word rather than by seeing all words simultaneously

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Fully reversible at any point; reversing direction tears and restores earlier words the same way with nothing left stuck in a distorted state
interaction_model.state_change: Advance or retreat through word views while the visible word enters a torn, hue-split state
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Glyphs break into narrow vertical slices that slide up or down and pull apart into offset ghosts in three distinct hues
interaction_model.input: Vertical scrolling, the only driver of the experience
interaction_model.affected_object: The currently visible giant word and the word sequence position

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Bounded so the statement never becomes unreadable or looks broken; extreme input reaches a ceiling rather than destroying the text
interaction_model.state_change: Distortion magnitude scales continuously with velocity, from near-still to violent
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Gentle movement makes letters barely shimmer; hard flicks smear slices and ghosts well beyond the word's own outline
interaction_model.input: Scroll speed
interaction_model.affected_object: Amount of slicing and hue separation on the visible word

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Direction change is picked up immediately without a stutter or leftover offset from the previous direction
interaction_model.state_change: Slice offsets flip orientation with travel direction
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Slices slide upward or downward according to whether the visitor heads down or up
interaction_model.input: Scroll direction
interaction_model.affected_object: Direction of slice displacement

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Settling can be interrupted by resuming scrolling at any moment, picking up from the current partial distortion rather than snapping
interaction_model.state_change: Distorted state relaxes back to the rest state
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Slices and hue-offset ghosts converge smoothly into clean, sharp type with no residue, fringing or ghost remnants

interaction_model.affected_object: The visible word

experience_qualities: Moody and atmospheric, with quiet photographic depth in a restrained, low-distraction surround
Charged and physically unstable in motion, as if the type is close to coming apart
Always legible: never actually unreadable or broken-looking
Deliberate, beat-by-beat pacing with a clear arrival at the end
Direct one-to-one sense of the visitor's own hand driving the distortion
completion_and_return: Completion is the final word landing with the whole phrase read as assembled
Every rest point returns the visible word to clean, sharp type
Reverse traversal fully restores earlier word views with no accumulated distortion

locked_observable_requirements: Exactly one word occupies the full view at a time; words are never shown together
One continuous space at a single steady luminance, carrying a faint photographic wash, reads as unbroken across the whole sequence

Distortion magnitude follows movement speed and displacement direction follows movement direction
Scrolling is the sole driver of both advance and distortion
Text holds clear contrast against the field and remains readable at all distortion levels, never appearing broken
At rest the word returns smoothly to clean, sharp type with zero residue
Reverse traversal produces the same tear-and-restore behavior on earlier words
adaptable_details: Exact number of words in the statement while it stays a very short phrase
Typeface, weight, casing and letter scale
Specific photographic imagery, its overall luminance level and how faint the wash is

canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits very short declarative phrases where each word can carry a view on its own and mood matters more than density. It stops being this Skill if multiple words or paragraphs share a view, if the distortion is driven by time, hover or pointer position instead of scroll velocity and direction, if the tearing is replaced by a different visual treatment such as blur, fade or mask reveal, if the background stops reading as one continuous photographic space at a steady luminance, or if distortion is allowed to persist at rest or render the statement illegible.

canonical_document.description: A calm, fixed-width uppercase list of enumerated records under small low-contrast group labels, overlaid by a faint horizontal line texture, in which the single record being pointed at scrambles and then decodes itself character by character back to full legibility while every other row stays perfectly still. interaction_model.input: Pointer targets a standalone link outside the list
interaction_model.affected_object: That single link's own text

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Guaranteed terminal legibility is the recovery rule — every interrupted run ends readable
interaction_model.state_change: Row settles to its true, fully legible text
interaction_model.visible_feedback: No partial scramble persists; the row appears exactly as it did at rest

name: scroll_resolved_passage_reading

canonical_document.name: scroll_resolved_passage_reading
canonical_document.description: A calm full-page reading sequence: an oversized greeting opens the view, then each short passage resolves from soft, faint and barely separated from its surround to sharp and fully legible at full contrast, sweeping first word to last exactly in step with how far scrolling has carried it up the screen.
canonical_document.experience_scope: Whole-view experience covering the entire page, beginning with the opening typographic greeting, continuing through each passage's own held view, and ending in a settled state after the final passage; each passage is a self-contained region inside that single continuous experience.

The opening greeting is the single loudest element by scale, then hands attention to the passage sequence

interaction_model.visible_feedback: Clarity retreats from the last word back toward the first, letters returning to soft, faint and barely separated from the surround

interaction_model.affected_object: The same passage, in its current resolved state

canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits short, self-contained text-dominant passages meant to be read in a fixed order at a leisurely pace, where withholding legibility until the reader arrives is acceptable and even desirable. It does not fit dense long-form text, scannable or utility copy, or any content a reader must be able to search or skim immediately. Replacing scroll with a timed or autoplaying driver, applying the treatment to images, cards or interface elements instead of type, resolving whole blocks uniformly instead of sweeping in reading order, or showing several passages readable at once would each produce a different skill.

canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits any sizable set of visually similar card-like or tile-like items whose individual identity matters at first read but whose collective scale is the real message — collectibles, product releases, assets, editions, portfolio pieces. Requires enough items for the flight to feel dense and enough page length to carry chaptered progression. It becomes a different Skill if items must stay readable throughout, if the motion plays autonomously or on a timeline instead of by scroll, if chapters persist and layer over each other, or if the experience is reduced to a single embedded region inside an otherwise conventional page.

name: scroll_scrubbed_lettered_picture_panel_story
description: A patient scroll story of full-view panels where giant letters build in one by one, glide across the photograph they are cut out of, and the picture behind drifts, scales or shifts in tone, with short titled prose passages as rest between panels and every motion tied exactly to scroll position, all held in a quiet low-salience surround that lets the imagery carry the colour.

canonical_document.name: scroll_scrubbed_lettered_picture_panel_story
canonical_document.description: A patient scroll story of full-view panels where giant letters build in one by one, glide across the photograph they are cut out of, and the picture behind drifts, scales or shifts in tone, with short titled prose passages as rest between panels and every motion tied exactly to scroll position, all held in a quiet low-salience surround that lets the imagery carry the colour.
canonical_document.experience_scope: Whole-view experience covering the entire page: it begins with a quiet uniform cover that withholds the story until the imagery is ready, runs through the full alternating sequence of oversized lettered panels and prose interludes, and ends in a settled closing zone with a few related pieces and a credit line.
content_and_composition: A sequence of many (in the source case nine) oversized lettered picture panels, each taking over the full view as one dominant composition

Short titled prose passages placed between panels, each a small title plus a brief paragraph at low visual density and narrow measure
At least one panel holds several alternate pictures behind the same lettering instead of a single image
A persistent quiet, low-salience ground and mood shared by panels, interludes and cover, sitting well back from the imagery in prominence
An entry cover layer that holds the whole view until artwork is ready
A closing rest zone containing a few related pieces and a single credit line
Each panel's typographic treatment is visibly different from the others while remaining legible
experience_progression: A quiet, uniform cover holds the view; nothing of the story is shown yet
Once the artwork is ready the cover clears and the first panel becomes available
Each panel enters the view in turn and occupies it fully
While a panel crosses the view its letters build in one after another rather than appearing together
During the same pass the lettering glides across its picture and the picture drifts, scales, or shifts in tone and luminance

A titled prose passage follows, dropping intensity so the eye rests and the narrative moves on
Panel and prose alternate at a slow, even rhythm through the whole sequence
The piece settles at the closing zone with related pieces and the credit line

Letters gaining presence one after another stages the reading order inside a panel instead of presenting the word at once

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: The story does not begin, and no partial or unready panel is shown, until the cover clears

interaction_model.affected_object: Quiet, low-salience entry cover over the whole view

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Stopping freezes the letters mid-build with no drift or auto-completion; scrolling up unwinds the same letters back through the same states in reverse
interaction_model.state_change: Letters advance from absent to fully present, in sequence, bound to how far the panel has crossed
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Individual letters build in one after another as the reader scrolls
interaction_model.input: Vertical scroll while a panel crosses the view
interaction_model.affected_object: The panel's letterforms

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Position is a direct function of scroll, so the glide holds exactly still on stop and retraces itself on reverse scroll
interaction_model.state_change: Type offset relative to the image it is cut from changes continuously
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The giant lettering glides across the picture visible through it
interaction_model.input: Vertical scroll while a panel crosses the view
interaction_model.affected_object: The lettering layer relative to its picture

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Fully scroll-bound and reversible; no residual motion once scrolling stops
interaction_model.state_change: Image transform and tone advance: drift, scale change, or shift in tone and luminance
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The photograph slowly moves, grows or changes tone behind the type
interaction_model.input: Vertical scroll while a panel crosses the view
interaction_model.affected_object: The picture layer behind the lettering

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Scrolling back restores the earlier pictures in reverse order at the same positions
interaction_model.state_change: The active picture is exchanged at points along the pass
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The imagery seen through the unchanged lettering swaps to a different picture a few times
interaction_model.input: Vertical scroll across the multi-image panel
interaction_model.affected_object: The set of alternate pictures behind that panel's lettering

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Resumption always continues from the frozen state; off-view panels never play catch-up or replay when re-entered, they simply match their scroll position
interaction_model.state_change: Active panel freezes or unwinds; panels outside the view return to idle
interaction_model.visible_feedback: A perfectly still frame when the reader stops, an exact retrace when the reader scrolls up, and no animation in off-view panels
interaction_model.input: Stopping, reversing, or scrolling past a panel
interaction_model.affected_object: All motion in the sequence

experience_qualities: Hushed and atmospheric, dominated by a restrained low-salience ground that leaves the imagery as the only source of colour
Slow, patient, deliberately paced rather than energetic
Monumental and immersive: each panel commands the whole view
Typographically inventive and surprising panel to panel, yet consistently legible
Mechanically precise: motion feels physically attached to the reader's scroll, never independently animated
Editorial and narrative in tone, with breathing space between intense moments
completion_and_return: The sequence does not loop; it terminates in a settled low-intensity closing zone with related pieces and a credit line
Every visual state is derived from scroll position, so returning to any position reproduces exactly the same appearance
Reverse scrolling is a complete return path through all intermediate states, including letter build-in and picture swaps
No state accumulates or persists beyond scroll position; there is nothing to reset
Panels left behind become idle and re-activate only from the position they are re-entered at
locked_observable_requirements: Each lettered panel occupies the full view and reads as the single dominant element while present
Letters enter one after another during the panel's pass, never all at once
The lettering visibly moves relative to the picture it is cut out of, so type and image are coupled but not fixed together
The picture layer visibly transforms during the pass through drift, scaling, or tone/luminance shift
Every panel is a visibly distinct typographic treatment while remaining legible
Motion is strictly bound to scroll position: absolutely still when scrolling stops, exactly reversed when scrolling up
Panels outside the view remain idle
Short titled prose passages separate the panels and provide lower-intensity rest
One consistent quiet, low-salience surround is shared across the whole piece, held far enough back in contrast and prominence that the imagery always dominates
The view is withheld behind a quiet, uniform cover until the imagery is ready to be shown
At least one panel exchanges several pictures behind unchanged lettering during its pass
The sequence ends in a settled closing zone rather than mid-panel
adaptable_details: Exact number of panels, as long as it remains a multi-panel sequence
The specific words or letterforms used, and each panel's particular typographic experiment
Subject matter and framing of the photographs
Which transformation each picture uses (drift, scale, or tone shift) and its magnitude
Exact palette and luminance level of the surround, as long as it stays low-salience and clearly separated from the imagery
Length, wording and titling of the prose interludes
How many alternate pictures the swapping panel cycles through
Appearance and wording of the entry cover and closing credit line
Number and arrangement of the related pieces in the closing zone
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits image-and-type led narrative, editorial or showcase content where a small number of words per unit can carry an entire view and imagery is strong enough to be read through cut-out lettering, with short prose available for rest between units. It stops being this Skill if motion becomes time-based autoplay or one-way, non-reversible animation; if scenes snap as discrete slides instead of scrubbing continuously with scroll; if the type stops acting as a window onto its picture and becomes a caption or overlay on plain photographs; or if the panels must host dense multi-column body content instead of monumental lettering.

name: scroll_assembled_giant_word_sequence
description: Enormous single words that first read as pulled-apart vertical fragments and snap into exact register as they rise, alternating with quiet small verses over faint, slowly pivoting background photography on a uniform low-distraction page ground.

canonical_document.name: scroll_assembled_giant_word_sequence
canonical_document.description: Enormous single words that first read as pulled-apart vertical fragments and snap into exact register as they rise, alternating with quiet small verses over faint, slowly pivoting background photography on a uniform low-distraction page ground.
canonical_document.experience_scope: A whole-view, top-to-bottom experience covering the entire page: it begins once type and imagery are ready and the page opens from a quiet hold, and ends when the final featured word resolves as a deliberate close. Every scroll-linked moment belongs to one continuous vertical run rather than to an isolated widget.
content_and_composition: A single uniform, low-distraction page ground shared by all moments, keeping type-to-ground separation deliberately soft while still readable
Several small verse blocks of a few short lines each, set at reduced contrast against the ground and modest scale
A few full-height featured moments, each occupied by exactly one enormous word that owns the whole view
Each featured word is composed of vertical fragments (slices of the word) that can be individually displaced before resolving into a single crisp form
Faint portrait-style photography layered behind the type as ambience, attenuated far below the type in contrast and subordinate so it never competes for legibility
Strict alternation between small verse passages and full-height single-word views, creating a repeating rhythm
No persistent chrome, counters or navigation overlay competing with the type
experience_progression: Page held in a quiet, contentless state until type and imagery are ready
Opening into the low-distraction reading view
A small low-contrast verse passage reads at normal reading scale
A full-height moment enters with its word visibly unresolved as displaced fragments
Fragments converge and lock into exact register as the word reaches the upper part of the view
Rhythm repeats: verse, then another full-height word, each resolving the same way
The final featured word resolves last and holds as the deliberate close
attention_and_information_flow: Attention is monopolized by whichever featured word is currently in view; everything else recedes
Meaning of a featured word is withheld while fragmented and granted only on registration, so reading feels like coming into focus
Small verses carry connective meaning at lower prominence between the loud single-word beats
Background imagery contributes mood and depth but never draws focus away from the words
The repeating verse/word alternation acts as the reader's orientation cue in place of explicit position indicators

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Fully reversible; new input during glide redirects smoothly, and releasing lets motion decay naturally
interaction_model.state_change: Scroll offset advances with weighted, damped glide rather than discrete jumps per notch
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Content drifts upward with inertial, unhurried motion that settles instead of stopping abruptly
interaction_model.input: Continuous vertical scroll (wheel, trackpad, touch drag, keyboard)
interaction_model.affected_object: The whole vertical run of verses, featured words and background layers

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: State is bound to scroll position, so stopping halfway holds a stable half-assembled word and scrolling back disassembles it along the identical path
interaction_model.state_change: Fragments move from pulled-apart offsets — displaced sideways, tilted, stretched or staggered up and down — into exact register
interaction_model.visible_feedback: An illegible, broken form visibly tightens into one crisp, unmistakable word just as it reaches the upper part of the view
interaction_model.input: Scroll position as a featured word travels through the view
interaction_model.affected_object: The vertical fragments of that enormous word

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Reversible and position-bound in the same way as the featured words
interaction_model.state_change: The same fragment-to-register resolution at gentler amplitude
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Lines settle with a subtle, quieter version of the featured-word assembly, keeping the whole page one visual language
interaction_model.input: Scroll position as a small verse passes through the view
interaction_model.affected_object: Short verse lines

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Reverses with scroll direction and rests when scrolling rests
interaction_model.state_change: Slow pivot/rotation tied to travel through the view
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Barely perceptible turning of the attenuated image, adding drift and depth behind the type
interaction_model.input: Scroll position as background imagery passes
interaction_model.affected_object: Faint photographic backdrop layer

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Scroll-linked state persists across the resize so the reader stays at the same moment in the piece
interaction_model.state_change: Fragment geometry recomputed against the new view
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Resolved words remain perfectly aligned with no residual seams or drift, and in-progress words keep a coherent partial state
interaction_model.input: Window resize
interaction_model.affected_object: All fragmented words and verses

experience_qualities: Restrained, moody and hushed, with a deliberately quiet surround
Cinematic and unhurried, with weight to every movement
Monumental scale contrasted with sparse, quiet text
A sense of steadily coming into focus
Rhythmic and orienting despite minimal interface
Ambient rather than busy; imagery felt more than looked at
completion_and_return: No looping: the sequence ends on the final resolved word as an intentional closing beat
No reset or replay control; re-experiencing happens by scrolling back
Scrolling upward returns every element to its earlier unresolved state along the same path
Position in the piece is preserved through resize, so the current moment survives layout change
locked_observable_requirements: Each featured word must first be perceived as unresolved vertical fragments and then as one crisp, exactly registered form
Resolution must complete as the word reaches the upper part of the view, not at arbitrary moments
All motion state must be bound to scroll position so stopping holds a stable partial state and reversing retraces the identical path
One enormous word owns an entire full-height view, with nothing else competing in that moment
Full-height single-word moments must alternate with lower-contrast small verse passages in a repeating rhythm
Background imagery must stay faint and clearly subordinate to the type
Scrolling must feel weighted and damped rather than stepping per input notch
Fragments must remain exactly aligned after a window resize
A single uniform, low-distraction ground with soft-but-readable type separation must be maintained throughout, in whatever hue family the host uses
The last featured word must land as a deliberate ending rather than looping
adaptable_details: Exact fragment displacement mix (sideways offset, tilt, stretch, vertical stagger) and its amplitude
Number of fragments per word and number of featured moments
Typeface, letterforms and language of the text
Specific palette, hues and overall lightness of the ground, and the exact degree of contrast within the soft-yet-readable range
Subject and treatment of the ambient imagery, and the amount of pivot
Damping weight and settle duration of the scroll glide
Length and line count of the small verse passages
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits short, sparse, emotionally weighted text where a handful of words can each claim a full view over a quiet, low-distraction ambient backdrop — poems, manifestos, statements, memorials, atmospheric intros. It stops working with dense body copy, data, or content that must be scanned or compared, since the withheld-then-resolved legibility becomes an obstacle. Replacing scroll-bound reversible state with timed or click-triggered playback, making the imagery a foreground subject, or driving many words at once instead of one per view would each create a different Skill.

canonical_document.name: click_driven_image_wipe_verse_swap
canonical_document.description: A full-screen verse sits alone in the frame; clicking anywhere sends a run of stacked pictures wiping upward through the view while the headline and stanza slide out and their replacements slide in as the last picture lifts away, alternating between two verses.
canonical_document.experience_scope: Whole-view experience covering the entire page. It begins with a brief holding state on first arrival, until imagery is ready, and continues indefinitely as an alternating two-state cycle; there is no terminal end.
content_and_composition: One short verse per state, composed of a headline and a single stanza, occupying the full view as the only reading content
A stack of full-frame images tied to the current verse, sitting behind or across the whole view and used sequentially during transitions

interaction_model.state_change: Resting verse state advances to the other verse state through a single uninterrupted run

interaction_model.input: Click anywhere on the page except the small corner links
interaction_model.affected_object: Whole view: the image stack plus the headline and stanza

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Clicks become effective again as soon as the run finishes and the verse has settled
interaction_model.state_change: No state change; the input is discarded rather than queued
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The current run continues undisturbed with no additional motion, no overlapping wipes and no text left stranded off frame
interaction_model.input: Click during an in-progress run
interaction_model.affected_object: The running transition

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: The rest of the surface remains the page-wide trigger
interaction_model.state_change: No verse change is triggered
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The view stays in its resting state; the link behaves as itself
interaction_model.input: Click on a small corner link
interaction_model.affected_object: Only that link

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: The hold persists as long as needed so nothing half-formed is exposed
interaction_model.state_change: Holding state resolves into the first fully composed verse view
interaction_model.visible_feedback: A brief hold, then the complete verse and imagery appear at once rather than assembling piecemeal
interaction_model.input: Autonomous driver: initial readiness of the first verse's imagery
interaction_model.affected_object: The whole opening view

experience_qualities: Atmospheric and quiet while reading, with the verse alone in the frame
Fast, cinematic and forceful during the transition, driven by successive full-frame sweeps
Decisive rather than fussy: one click, one complete run, no stacking or stutter
Clean legibility on arrival, with text settling rather than drifting
Whole-surface interactivity made explicit by a hand-made, informal badge
completion_and_return: Each run completes fully before another can be accepted
The two verses alternate, so the cycle returns the visitor to the starting verse on the following run
No end state or exit; the view rests in whichever verse was last reached
Repeat clicks loop the pair indefinitely with no accumulated change
locked_observable_requirements: One short verse, as headline plus stanza, holds the entire view at rest
A brief holding state precedes the first reveal so no half-formed composition is visible
A click anywhere on the surface triggers the change, with small corner links excluded
Multiple stacked pictures wipe upward across the full view one after another, not as a single crossfade
The outgoing headline and stanza slide out of frame and replacements slide in, with arrival timed to the final picture lifting away
Exactly two verse states alternate, so the visitor circles back to where they started

adaptable_details: Number of pictures in the stack and the pacing, spacing and easing of the successive wipes
Image subject matter and treatment
Typography, scale and placement of headline and stanza within the full view

canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits short, self-contained passages of foreground text paired with full-frame imagery, where only a couple of states exist and each fits on one screen with room to breathe. Long scrolling copy, dense multi-column layouts, or a set of many items needing direct selection would break the click-anywhere, two-state cycle. Replacing the sequential upward picture wipes with per-element hover treatments, scroll-driven progression, or a browsable gallery with indexed navigation would create a different Skill.

name: decoding_scramble_line_stepper
description: One short line held centre-stage that, on each advance, scrambles through random characters and resolves in place into the next line, growing or shrinking to fit, with the last line framed in a dashed outline before wrapping to the first.

canonical_document.name: decoding_scramble_line_stepper
canonical_document.description: One short line held centre-stage that, on each advance, scrambles through random characters and resolves in place into the next line, growing or shrinking to fit, with the last line framed in a dashed outline before wrapping to the first.
canonical_document.experience_scope: A whole-view experience centred on one text stage plus a single advance control; it begins when the first line is displayed and continues indefinitely as a looping stepped cycle, with no separate entry or exit sequence.
content_and_composition: One short single-line text item visible at a time, held at the visual centre of the stage
An ordered set of short lines (two or more) forming the full sequence; only the current one is present on screen
A persistent advance control that remains available during and between transitions
Deliberately empty surroundings: nothing else competes with the line for attention
The text occupies a stable anchored position so surrounding layout never shifts as the line's length changes
A dashed outline frame that appears around the resolved characters only for the final line of the sequence
experience_progression: Stage 1: a single readable line rests centre-stage, static and uncontested
Stage 2: on advance, the visible characters churn through rapidly changing random letters and the line reads as briefly illegible
Stage 3: resolution sweeps from the start of the line onward, characters locking into their final values one after another while the unresolved remainder keeps churning
Stage 4: the run of text stretches or shrinks toward the new line's length during the same pass, so the change reads as one continuous in-place decode
Stage 5: the full next line rests readable and static, awaiting the next advance
Stage 6: on the final line, the resolved text settles inside a dashed outline, marking the end of the sequence
Stage 7: the next advance from the final line returns to the first line using the same decode transition, and the cycle repeats
attention_and_information_flow: Attention is pinned to a single point on the stage because only one line exists at a time and nothing surrounds it
Legibility is deliberately withheld during the churn, then handed back progressively from the start of the line to its end
The reader's eye follows the resolution front as it moves along the line, so meaning accumulates rather than appearing at once
Length change is the only spatial cue that the message has become shorter or longer; the anchor point stays fixed so the page itself never jumps
The dashed outline is the sole signal that the reader has reached the end of the sequence and the next press restarts it

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: The transition always terminates in the fully resolved target line; the control stays usable throughout rather than blocking
interaction_model.state_change: From resting readable text to an in-progress decode toward the next line in the sequence
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Visible characters immediately churn through random letters, then lock into the next line from its start onward while the run of text grows or shrinks toward the new length
interaction_model.input: Press of the advance control while a line is at rest
interaction_model.affected_object: The current centre-stage line of text

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Repeated or rapid presses always leave exactly one decode running and always settle on the correct line for the number of presses made
interaction_model.state_change: The running change is dropped and a new decode begins toward the following line, starting from whatever characters are currently on screen
interaction_model.visible_feedback: A single continuous churn-and-resolve that hands off seamlessly to the new target; no doubled, stacked, stuttering or garbled text and no leftover characters from the abandoned target
interaction_model.input: Press of the advance control mid-transition
interaction_model.affected_object: The in-progress decode and the target line

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Wrapping is unlimited; the sequence can be cycled through repeatedly with no dead end
interaction_model.state_change: Sequence position wraps from last back to first, and the end-of-sequence framing is removed
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The framed text decodes into the first line and the dashed outline disappears, restoring the plain resting appearance
interaction_model.input: Press of the advance control while the final line is resting inside its dashed outline
interaction_model.affected_object: The line sequence position and the dashed outline frame

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: The frame is present only while the final line rests and clears as soon as the sequence advances past it
interaction_model.state_change: From plain resting text to end-of-sequence framed text
interaction_model.visible_feedback: A dashed outline appears around the resolved characters, hugging the settled line
interaction_model.input: Arrival at the final line of the sequence
interaction_model.affected_object: The resolved line of text

experience_qualities: Machine-like and cryptographic: text feels descrambled rather than replaced
Sparse and focused, with a single message owning the whole view
Kinetic in place, calm in layout: motion is confined to the glyphs while the composition stays still
Reader-paced, since nothing advances without an explicit press
Responsive under impatience: fast repeated presses feel crisp instead of glitchy
Cyclical and closed, with a clear end marker rather than an open-ended list
completion_and_return: Each transition completes only when the target line is fully resolved and readable
The sequence loops endlessly from the last line back to the first
The final line's dashed outline marks completion of a pass and clears on the next advance
Interrupting a transition does not leave a partially resolved resting state; the current target always finishes resolving
No progress is preserved beyond the current visit; the experience simply resumes at whichever line is on screen
locked_observable_requirements: Exactly one short line of text visible at a time, centre-stage with nothing competing for attention
Transitions read as in-place decoding: a churn of random characters followed by resolution, never a plain swap, fade or slide
Resolution proceeds from the start of the line onward while the unresolved remainder continues churning
The run of text stretches or shrinks toward the new line's length during the same transition
The text anchor stays fixed so the surrounding page never jumps as length changes
Advancing mid-transition drops the running change and retargets from the characters currently on screen, with no stacking, doubling or garbling
The final line's resolved characters are framed in a dashed outline
Advancing past the final line wraps back to the first line using the same transition
adaptable_details: Number and wording of the lines in the sequence
The pool of characters used for the churn
Churn speed, resolution pace and overall transition duration
Typeface, size, weight, colour and letter spacing of the line
Background treatment of the empty stage
Appearance, label and placement of the advance control
Styling of the dashed outline (thickness, dash rhythm, padding, colour)
Whether additional autonomous or keyboard triggers also advance the sequence
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits short single-line statements of roughly comparable length where every character can be legibly churned and read in place, in a sparse view whose visitor controls pacing. Multi-line paragraphs, long body copy, mixed media cards, or simultaneously visible items would break the single-anchor in-place decode and make it a different Skill; so would replacing the glyph-level decode with a positional transition such as sliding, flipping or fading between lines, or removing visitor-driven stepping in favour of unattended auto-cycling.

canonical_document.name: sliced_band_image_reveal_typographic_index

Each entry carries three text roles: a date, a headline that is the link target, and a link cue or label
Each entry owns one associated image that is absent from the resting composition and appears only as a layer behind or beside that entry's own text, never spilling across neighbours
The revealed image is composed of several parallel bands that read as one picture only when converged; band direction and the single entering edge are consistent for every entry
Resting state is purely typographic: no thumbnails, no frames, no decorative dividers competing with the wording
Only one entry can be in the revealed state at a time; all others remain plain text
experience_progression: Brief holding moment before landing while imagery is readied, so the first painted state is already complete rather than assembling piecemeal
Landing on the calm state: oversized heading plus fully legible text-only list

Per entry on focus: bands enter from one edge at alternating scattered offsets, then converge into a single seamless image while that entry's characters cycle through random letters and symbols and resolve to the true words
Per entry on focus loss: characters and image reverse — bands scatter back to alternating offsets, the picture slides back out and fades, text returns plain
No accumulation across entries: the list returns to the same calm baseline after every reveal
attention_and_information_flow: At rest, prominence belongs to the oversized heading and the uniform wording, so entries are compared as text
On focus, prominence collapses onto one entry: it is the only one carrying imagery and the only one whose letters are in motion, removing any doubt about which is active
The scramble briefly withholds the wording, then returns it, so the entry is read twice — once as motion, once as legible content
Neighbouring entries stay quiet and readable throughout, keeping the list scannable while one entry is dramatised
Revealed imagery adds subject information for the focused entry only and withdraws completely, so information density stays flat when nothing is focused

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: A new focus arriving before assembly finishes restarts that entry's reveal cleanly from its current appearance; no half-assembled or stranded image is left behind
interaction_model.state_change: Image goes from absent to fully assembled
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Parallel bands slide in from one edge at alternating offsets, then converge into one seamless picture behind that entry
interaction_model.input: Pointer moves onto an entry row
interaction_model.affected_object: That entry's associated image layer

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Interruption always resolves to the true words; scrambled characters must never persist after focus changes or leaves
interaction_model.state_change: Text goes from settled true wording to scrambled and back to settled
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Characters flicker through random letters and symbols, then snap to the correct words
interaction_model.input: Pointer moves onto an entry row
interaction_model.affected_object: That entry's date, headline and link text

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Re-entering during the exit reverses back into assembly without restarting from an empty state or duplicating the image
interaction_model.state_change: Revealed state reverts to the resting text-only state
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Bands scatter apart again, the picture slides back out toward its entry edge and fades away, leaving plain text
interaction_model.input: Pointer leaves an entry row
interaction_model.affected_object: That entry's image layer and text

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Every traversed entry settles back to plain text on its own; the list self-cleans to baseline once the pointer leaves
interaction_model.state_change: Each entry's reveal starts and unwinds independently while only the current entry stays revealed
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Reveals restart cleanly per entry with no lingering scrambled glyphs, no stacked images and no more than one entry showing imagery
interaction_model.input: Pointer sweeps quickly across several neighbouring entries
interaction_model.affected_object: Each traversed entry and the list as a whole

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Animation never blocks, displaces or swallows the click target at any phase
interaction_model.state_change: Navigation proceeds regardless of reveal or scramble phase
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Link remains hittable and visibly distinguished as a link during scramble and image motion
interaction_model.input: Activating the focused entry's link
interaction_model.affected_object: The entry's link target

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Reveals are only offered once the calm state is presented, so a first focus never produces a partial picture
interaction_model.state_change: Holding moment resolves into the calm landing state
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The typographic list and oversized heading appear already settled and legible
interaction_model.input: Initial view load
interaction_model.affected_object: Whole list region

experience_qualities: Stark and editorial at rest; deliberately restrained typography-first composition
Mechanical, glitch-like energy in the letter scramble
Sliced, shuttered assembly rather than a soft fade for imagery
Decisive and unambiguous about which entry is active
Non-accumulating and self-cleaning, so rapid scanning stays calm
Directional: imagery always arrives from and departs to the same edge
completion_and_return: Each reveal completes at a fully converged image with fully resolved wording
Focus loss completes a full reverse to the original text-only entry with nothing residual
No state persists between entries or across repeat visits to the same entry; every focus starts from the same baseline
The list is always returnable to its calm all-text composition simply by removing focus
locked_observable_requirements: Resting list is purely typographic with no imagery for any entry
An oversized section heading sits above the list and stays text-only
Only the single focused entry shows imagery; siblings remain plain text
The image arrives as multiple parallel bands entering from one edge, starting at alternating scattered offsets and converging into one seamless picture
The focused entry's date, headline and link characters scramble through random letters and symbols and then resolve to the true wording
Focus loss plays the reverse: bands scatter, picture slides out and fades, text returns plain
Rapid traversal restarts reveals cleanly with no stranded half-image and no leftover scrambled characters
The entry's link stays clickable and legibly readable against whatever sits behind it through every phase
Imagery is ready before the calm landing state is presented
adaptable_details: Number of entries and length of the list
Wording, dating format and label text of entries
Which edge the bands enter from and band count or thickness
Duration and cadence of band convergence and glyph cycling
Character set used while scrambling
Typeface, scale of the oversized heading, any hue or tonal treatment, and spacing
Image subject, crop and aspect
Placement of the image layer relative to the entry text
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits any flat run of comparable text-led entries that each own one representative image — dated archives, project or case listings, catalogue rows, people or credit lists — where the resting view must stay text-first and imagery is supplementary, in any host tonality as long as the wording keeps readable contrast over both the bare surface and the revealed image. It stops being this Skill if imagery is persistently visible for all entries, if more than one entry can stay revealed at once, if the image simply fades or scales instead of assembling from offset parallel bands, if the wording does not destabilise and resettle, or if the revealed state persists after focus leaves.

name: scattered_fragment_backdrop_name_list_to_full_detail
description: On one quiet, low-distraction screen a stack of item names invites slow scanning; pointing at a name slides it forward with a one-line summary while four scattered image pieces fade up behind it, and choosing it sends the letters out of view, gathers the pieces into a single whole photograph, and brings in a large title, description, back control and de-emphasised neighbour previews.

canonical_document.name: scattered_fragment_backdrop_name_list_to_full_detail
canonical_document.description: On one quiet, low-distraction screen a stack of item names invites slow scanning; pointing at a name slides it forward with a one-line summary while four scattered image pieces fade up behind it, and choosing it sends the letters out of view, gathers the pieces into a single whole photograph, and brings in a large title, description, back control and de-emphasised neighbour previews.
canonical_document.experience_scope: Whole-view experience occupying one screen with no scrolling between states: it begins with the resting stack of names, extends through the hover-preview state and the selected detail state, and ends when the back control returns the view to the resting stack ready for the next choice.
content_and_composition: One uniform, low-noise full-screen field held at a lower visual weight than everything placed on it, acting as the common stage for both browsing and detail states

A vertical stack of short item names as the persistent foreground text layer, set at readable contrast against the field and sized as a small lineup (a handful of entries, all visible at once without scrolling)
One short one-line summary attached to the name currently under consideration, appearing beside or beneath it rather than as a detached tooltip
A backdrop image layer that belongs to the item under consideration, composed of four separate image pieces placed at scattered offsets across the field rather than as a single rectangle
In the detail state, one large whole photograph of the chosen item as the dominant visual, paired with the item's full name as a large title and a longer description block
A back control present only in the detail state
Reduced, clearly de-emphasised previews of neighbouring items — smaller and lower in contrast than the active content — placed to the side in the detail state, implying that more of the lineup exists
Only one item's imagery and text are ever active at a time; the stack, the fragment layer and the detail content are coordinated layers of a single composition
experience_progression: Resting state: the quiet field carries only the plain stack of names, with no active imagery
Consideration state: the pointed-at name slides into place and volunteers its one-line summary while its four image pieces fade up one after another in sequence
Commitment transition: the name's letters slide out of sight, then the four scattered pieces travel inward and pack into a tight block that merges into one continuous picture
Detail state: the large title, full description, back control and de-emphasised side previews arrive over the assembled photograph
Return transition: the same stages play in reverse, the picture splits back into travelling pieces and the stack of names reassembles
The lineup returns to the resting state, ready for another choice; the cycle can repeat indefinitely with any entry
attention_and_information_flow: At rest, attention is spread evenly across equally weighted names, encouraging unhurried scanning rather than pushing one entry
On consideration, prominence shifts to the single pointed-at name through its forward slide, and the first new information revealed is a one-line summary
The staggered fade of the four pieces adds atmosphere and a visual hint of the item after the words, so text leads and imagery answers
During commitment, the names give up their prominence by leaving before the imagery consolidates, so no two layers compete for attention
In the detail state the single large photograph and large title dominate, with the longer description as the next tier and the de-emphasised neighbour previews and back control as the quietest tier
Returning re-flattens the hierarchy back to the even stack, discarding item-specific information

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Moving attention away reverses the same motion and fade so the row settles back and the pieces fade out; moving between names hands the considered state to the new name so only one is ever active
interaction_model.state_change: The row moves from resting to considered; its summary becomes present; the item's fragment layer becomes visible
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The name slides into its forward position, the one-line summary appears with it, and the four scattered pieces fade up one after another rather than all at once
interaction_model.input: Pointing at (hovering or otherwise focusing) one name in the stack
interaction_model.affected_object: That name's text row plus its four backdrop image pieces

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Input is ignored while this transition is running, so the sequence always completes; once open, the detail state remains until the back control is used
interaction_model.state_change: Browsing state transitions to detail state for that item
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The letters of the name slide out of sight, the four scattered pieces are drawn in from their offsets into a tight block that merges into one whole picture, and then the large title, full description, back control and de-emphasised side previews arrive
interaction_model.input: Selecting the considered name
interaction_model.affected_object: The whole composition: the name stack, the fragment layer and the incoming detail content

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Input is ignored for the duration of the reverse transition; on completion the lineup is left in its neutral resting state with no item selected
interaction_model.state_change: Detail state transitions back to the resting browsing state
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The whole sequence plays in reverse: detail text, back control and side previews leave, the single picture separates into pieces that travel back to their scattered spots, and the names slide back into the stack
interaction_model.input: Activating the back control
interaction_model.affected_object: The detail content, the assembled photograph and the name stack

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Responsiveness resumes automatically as soon as the transition finishes and the view is back in the browsing state
interaction_model.state_change: No state change occurs; the input is discarded
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Nothing responds — names do not slide forward and no summaries or fragments appear
interaction_model.input: Any pointing or selecting attempt made mid-transition or while a detail view is open
interaction_model.affected_object: The name stack and its consideration behaviour

experience_qualities: Quiet, subdued and atmospheric rather than glaring or busy
Unhurried and invitational, rewarding slow scanning
Alive and answering — the surroundings react to where attention rests
Assembling and resolving: scattered hints coalescing into one clear whole
Continuous and single-screen, never feeling like a page reload
Fully reversible and predictable, with each transition completing cleanly
completion_and_return: The detail state is the completion of the forward sequence and persists until the back control is used
Return restores the resting stack exactly, with no item considered and no imagery visible
No progress is accumulated between visits; each selection is an independent round trip that can be repeated with any entry
After returning, the lineup is immediately ready for the next choice with full responsiveness restored
locked_observable_requirements: One uniform, low-distraction full-screen stage, kept at a lower visual weight than its content, hosts both the browsing and detail states with no scrolling or page change between them
A small vertical stack of short item names, clearly readable against the field, is the resting foreground, with all entries visible at once
Consideration of a name produces both a positional slide of that name and its own one-line summary
The considered item's imagery appears as multiple separate scattered pieces that fade in sequentially, not as a single instantly shown image
Selection removes the name's letters before the imagery consolidates
The scattered pieces travel inward and merge into one continuous whole photograph as the detail visual
The detail state shows the large photograph together with a large full title, a longer description, a back control and reduced, clearly de-emphasised previews of neighbouring items
The return plays the same stages in reverse rather than cutting away
Input is ignored during transitions and while the detail view is open, and responsiveness returns automatically afterwards
adaptable_details: The exact number of entries in the lineup, as long as it stays a small set that fits one screen
The subject matter of the items and their imagery
Exact placement of the summary relative to the name and of the description relative to the photograph
Wording and form of the back control
Timing, easing and stagger interval of the slides, fades and convergence
Direction the letters travel when leaving and the scatter offsets the pieces start from
Which side the de-emphasised neighbour previews occupy and how many are shown
Typography, the accent hue, and the specific tone and luminance level of the field (light or dark), provided it stays low-noise and the text keeps readable contrast
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits any small curated lineup of a handful of entries where each entry has a short name, a one-line summary, a longer description and one strong image, and where the whole experience can live on one uncluttered, low-distraction screen whose surround stays quieter than the text and imagery on it. It stops being this Skill if the set grows into a long scrolling or paginated list, if the detail view becomes a separate page or dense multi-section layout, if the imagery arrives as one whole image instead of scattered pieces that converge, or if the entries need to stay simultaneously active with their own imagery rather than yielding to one considered item at a time.

name: peel_to_reveal_settling_duplicate
description: Hovering an image marks it active and wipes or peels its visible surface away to expose an identical copy beneath, which snaps out of a strongly colour-cast, over-scaled state — the cast may be any hue — into a plain one; leaving plays the whole thing backwards from wherever it stands.

canonical_document.name: peel_to_reveal_settling_duplicate
canonical_document.description: Hovering an image marks it active and wipes or peels its visible surface away to expose an identical copy beneath, which snaps out of a strongly colour-cast, over-scaled state — the cast may be any hue — into a plain one; leaving plays the whole thing backwards from wherever it stands.
canonical_document.experience_scope: Per-item region experience: begins when the pointer enters a single media item and ends when the item has fully returned to its resting appearance; scoped to that one item and never to the page.
content_and_composition: One media item per instance, presented as a discrete hoverable surface
Two stacked renderings of the same subject: an upper visible surface and an identical copy directly beneath it
A wipe or peel edge that travels across the item, acting as the boundary between surface and underlayer
An active/inactive distinction on the item itself while the pointer is over it
Surrounding items remain in their resting state and are unaffected
experience_progression: Rest: only the upper surface reads; the item looks plain and complete
Engage: the upper surface wipes or peels away along a travelling edge
Expose: the identical underlayer appears carrying a strong colour cast of any hue and over-scaled
Settle: the underlayer snaps out of that exaggerated state into a plain, uncast, correctly scaled rendering
Withdraw: the same chain plays in reverse back to rest
attention_and_information_flow: The hovered item becomes the singular active object; its transformation is the loudest event in view
The reveal delivers no new subject information — the payoff is the transformation itself, rewarding the pause
Prominence returns fully to the resting composition once the pointer leaves
Because only the pointed item reacts, attention tracks the pointer exactly

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Reversible at any moment; the item never queues a second run
interaction_model.state_change: Item becomes active; surface wipes or peels away and the underlayer transitions from strongly colour-cast and over-scaled to plain, uncast and correctly scaled
interaction_model.visible_feedback: A travelling wipe or peel edge crosses the item, the exaggerated colour-cast oversized copy flashes into view, then snaps down into a plain rendering
interaction_model.input: Pointer enters a media item
interaction_model.affected_object: That item's visible surface and the identical copy beneath it

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Returns to a clean resting state with no residue of the reveal
interaction_model.state_change: Item becomes inactive; the transformation plays back the other way to the resting surface
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The wipe or peel edge retreats and the plain rendering gives way to the original surface
interaction_model.input: Pointer leaves a media item
interaction_model.affected_object: Same item

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: No queuing; the item always converges on the state matching where the pointer actually is
interaction_model.state_change: Running motion is cancelled and reversed from its current position
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The wipe or peel visibly turns around mid-travel; no restart from the beginning and no replay after the fact
interaction_model.input: Pointer enters or leaves while a change is still running
interaction_model.affected_object: The in-flight transformation on that item

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: No item's state is coupled to another's; leaving the whole area lets every item settle back to rest
interaction_model.state_change: Each item resolves its own state on its own timeline
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Multiple items can be seen mid-transformation in different directions at once
interaction_model.input: Pointer moves across several items in succession
interaction_model.affected_object: Each item independently

experience_qualities: Unexpected and brief — a surprise that resolves quickly
Snappy contrast between an exaggerated intermediate state and a plain settled one
Responsive and always truthful to pointer position
Rewarding to trigger repeatedly
completion_and_return: Completes when the item matches the pointer's presence or absence
Always returns fully to the resting surface after withdrawal; nothing persists
Interrupted runs resolve by reversal rather than by finishing or replaying
locked_observable_requirements: The exposed layer is an identical copy of the same subject, not different content
Exposure happens through a travelling wipe or peel of the surface, not a plain crossfade
The exposed copy first appears under a strong colour cast — any hue satisfies this — and over-scaled, then snaps to a plain, uncast, correctly scaled state
Pointer withdrawal plays the transformation in reverse
Mid-change entry or exit cancels and reverses from the current position, with no queuing or replay
Each item reacts independently of its neighbours
Hover marks the item as active for the duration
adaptable_details: Direction, shape and softness of the wipe or peel edge
Which hue carries the intermediate colour cast and how far that cast is pushed
Amount of over-scaling and the snap timing
Item aspect ratio, size and framing
Layout context in which the items sit
Subject matter of the media
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits any context where media appears as discrete pointer-addressable items worth inspecting — sequences, galleries, indexes, card grids, feature strips. Swapping the underlayer for different content turns it into a comparison or before/after Skill; replacing the peel and the colour-cast over-scaled snap with a simple fade, zoom or overlay caption removes its identity; requiring a click or a full-view takeover makes it a different Skill, as does driving the effect from scroll position instead of the pointer.
