name: scroll_scrubbed_headline_resolution_journey
description: A low-glare full-height reading descent where each numbered section's headline starts scattered or unreadable and resolves into clean type exactly as it reaches the reader, scrubbed frame-by-frame by scroll, with a few weighty statements holding the page in place until they fully resolve.

canonical_document.name: scroll_scrubbed_headline_resolution_journey
canonical_document.description: A low-glare full-height reading descent where each numbered section's headline starts scattered or unreadable and resolves into clean type exactly as it reaches the reader, scrubbed frame-by-frame by scroll, with a few weighty statements holding the page in place until they fully resolve.
canonical_document.experience_scope: Whole-view experience covering the entire page: begins with a short hold before anything is shown, opens on a full-height title screen, continues as one uninterrupted downward run through all numbered sections, and ends on a settled closing passage. Not a detachable widget; the sequence and its shared surface are the experience.
content_and_composition: Single continuous vertical column on one low-glare, low-distraction surface whose tone is held constant from title screen to closing passage.
One full-height opening title screen carrying the primary title plus a small quiet cue inviting a slow pace.
An ordered series of sections (several to many), each identified by a visible sequence number.
Per section: one display headline as the dominant visual object, preceded/followed by a short prose passage in calm, secondary type.
Prose passages act as rest intervals and connective thought between headline moments; they are visually quieter and denser than the headlines.
A small subset of sections are marked as weightier statements, given more vertical room and a longer resolution than the rest.
A final closing passage that resolves the sequence and remains settled with no further transformation pending.
experience_progression: Initial hold: nothing readable is shown until type is ready, so no half-formed letters are ever glimpsed.
Opening: full-height title screen appears in a settled state with a pacing cue.
Descent: sections are encountered in numbered order; each headline enters in its scattered/unreadable state and resolves toward legibility as it moves into the reading zone.
Rest: prose passage between headlines is read at normal travel speed with no transformation demand.
Emphasis beats: at a few statements the downward travel is suspended while continued scrolling completes that headline's resolution, then travel is released and resumes.
Close: the sequence ends on the settled closing passage with all prior sections resolved.
attention_and_information_flow: Attention is pulled to whichever headline is currently in the reading zone because it is the only element actively changing.
A headline withholds its meaning while scattered and surrenders it precisely as the reader arrives, so information is delivered on approach rather than in advance.
Prose passages lower visual intensity between peaks, resetting attention before the next headline moment.
Weightier statements raise prominence further by refusing to release the page until resolved, making them the strongest beats in the sequence.
Sequence numbers give a persistent sense of position and remaining distance.
The uniform low-glare surround holds strong readable contrast against the type and suppresses competing luminance.

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Reversing scroll glides back the same way; the damped motion always settles rather than oscillating, and the reader can stop anywhere
interaction_model.state_change: View position advances or retreats with damping, trailing slightly behind the raw input instead of snapping
interaction_model.visible_feedback: A gliding, weighted descent that keeps moving briefly and eases to rest rather than stopping abruptly
interaction_model.input: Scroll input (the only control), continuous and in either direction
interaction_model.affected_object: Overall page travel

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Stopping freezes the headline mid-transformation and it stays there; nothing continues on its own
interaction_model.state_change: Transformation progress is bound one-to-one to scroll position between scattered/unreadable and fully legible
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Small scroll movements produce small movements of words and letters; the headline visibly converges toward clean type as the reader descends
interaction_model.input: Incremental scroll while a headline is within its section's range
interaction_model.affected_object: The words and letters of that headline

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Fully reversible at any point; repeated back-and-forth scrubbing is stable and repeatable
interaction_model.state_change: Progress unwinds along the same path back toward the original scattered state
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The headline rewinds exactly, returning to its starting scatter rather than re-animating differently
interaction_model.input: Reverse scroll over an already-resolved or partially resolved headline
interaction_model.affected_object: That headline's letters and words

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Reversing during the hold rewinds that statement and re-enters the hold from the other side; leaving in either direction restores normal travel
interaction_model.state_change: Downward travel is pinned while scroll drives that headline's transformation to completion, then travel is released
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The view appears to hold still while the statement alone works toward legibility, then normal descent resumes past it
interaction_model.input: Continued scrolling at a weighty statement
interaction_model.affected_object: Page travel plus that statement's headline

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Scrolling continues seamlessly from the current position after resize
interaction_model.state_change: Each section's progress is recomputed against its new on-screen position
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Headlines remain consistent with where their section now sits, with no jump to a wrong stage or loss of place in the journey
interaction_model.input: Window resize partway through the sequence
interaction_model.affected_object: All sections' transformation states

experience_qualities: Deliberate and unhurried; the pacing cue and damping discourage rushing.
Meditative and low-glare, with the restrained surround making resolved type feel calm rather than loud.
Tactile and directly manipulable: the reader feels they are personally pulling each headline into focus.
Rhythmic alternation between effortful headline moments and restful prose.
Anticipation and payoff, with a few moments demanding visible patience before releasing their meaning.
Composed and finished rather than performative; nothing plays by itself.
completion_and_return: No looping: the journey terminates on the settled closing passage.
Every section's state persists as a function of scroll position, so returning upward shows earlier headlines in the state their position dictates.
Scrubbing back to the top restores the opening title screen and all scattered starting states.
Weighty statements release travel only once their transformation is complete in the forward direction.
locked_observable_requirements: Scroll is the sole driver; no headline transformation ever self-plays or continues without input.
Every section headline begins visibly scattered or unreadable and ends in clean, fully legible type.
Transformation progress is bound directly to scroll position, so stopping freezes mid-transformation and reversing rewinds exactly to the scattered start.
Page travel is damped and trails slightly behind input rather than jumping.
An initial hold prevents any glimpse of half-formed type before the experience opens.
A full-height opening title screen with a quiet slow-pace cue precedes the sequence.

Sections are numbered and read as one continuous downward sequence on a single shared low-glare surface whose tone stays constant throughout, with headline type holding clearly readable contrast against it.
Prose passages between headlines are visually quieter and carry no transformation demand.
A few designated statements pin travel until scroll completes their resolution, then release it.
The sequence ends on a settled closing passage.
Resizing keeps each section's transformation aligned with its on-screen position.
adaptable_details: The specific scattering/unreadability treatment of headlines (displacement, disorder, obscured glyph forms) and its exact motion character.
Number of sections and which ones are designated as weighty statements.
Typeface choices, headline size and prose length.

Which hues and which luminance direction the surface takes, and the accent used for numbers and the pacing cue, as long as glare stays low and the accent reads as distinct from both surround and body type.
Form of the sequence numbering and its placement.
Amount of damping and the length of the initial hold.
Wording of the pacing cue and the closing passage.
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits sparse, text-led single-page sequences where short display statements alternate with brief connective prose and the reading order is fixed and linear: essays, manifestos, statement or quote sequences, single-message showcase pages. It does not fit dense reference content, scannable or randomly accessed pages, or layouts with multiple simultaneous columns of competing content. Replacing the scroll-bound scrubbing with self-playing reveals, dropping the exact-rewind reversibility, letting headlines appear already legible, or making images rather than words the transforming subject would each produce a different Skill.

name: self_decoding_text_screen_with_replayable_rhythms
description: Short text lines start as churning illegible symbols and sweep into readable words on a low-distraction single-tone-family screen with faint low-contrast line art behind them; a small labelled row along the bottom replays the decode with a different rhythm and travel direction, always ending on the exact original wording.

canonical_document.name: self_decoding_text_screen_with_replayable_rhythms
canonical_document.description: Short text lines start as churning illegible symbols and sweep into readable words on a low-distraction single-tone-family screen with faint low-contrast line art behind them; a small labelled row along the bottom replays the decode with a different rhythm and travel direction, always ending on the exact original wording.
canonical_document.experience_scope: Whole-view experience covering one single-screen text presentation: it begins when the view is first shown and the text is unreadable, ends when every line has settled into clean still readable text, and can be re-entered on demand from the persistent trigger row without leaving the view.
content_and_composition: A small set of short text entries as the sole foreground content, read top to bottom: one prominent primary line (identity/name role), one secondary line (role/subtitle), and one short multi-word block (brief bio).
A faint decorative line-art layer sitting behind the text as a low-contrast substrate that never competes with the words.
A single persistent row of a few plainly labelled trigger choices anchored along the bottom edge, visually minor relative to the text.

One restrained tonal treatment shared by all layers, with only small tonal separation between them, so text, background art and triggers read as one screen while the text keeps comfortable reading contrast against its surround.
All text entries occupy their final layout positions from the first frame; only the characters themselves change, so nothing shifts or reflows.
experience_progression: Initial state: every character of every entry is an illegible churning symbol in its final position.
Sweep stage: a settling front travels across characters and lines in one direction, characters cycling through symbols before locking to their true value.
Progressive readability: earlier-reached entries are already clean and still while later ones are still churning, so partial meaning accumulates.
Settled state: all characters hold the exact original wording, motion stops entirely, and the screen is calm and comfortable to read.
Optional replay: a trigger choice restarts the whole sequence from the illegible state with a different rhythm and direction, ending again in the same settled state.
attention_and_information_flow: Attention follows the moving settling front, which acts as the only motion on screen and pulls the eye along the reading order.
Meaning is disclosed incrementally: the primary line typically becomes legible before the longer bio block, so identity registers before detail.
Once settled, motion prominence drops to zero and the text holds attention purely as static content.
The trigger row stays quietly available and only becomes the focus when the user chooses to watch the reveal again.
Background line art remains subordinate throughout and never gains prominence.

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: The run always terminates in the correct final wording; no user action is required to reach the readable state
interaction_model.state_change: Illegible churning characters transition to fully settled original wording
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Symbols cycle and a settling front sweeps across lines until the text is clean and motionless
interaction_model.input: Autonomous start when the view is first presented
interaction_model.affected_object: All foreground text entries

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: The new run always resolves back to the exact original wording, so repeated replays never drift or corrupt the content
interaction_model.state_change: Settled state returns immediately to the illegible state and a new run begins with a noticeably different rhythm and travel direction
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Text scrambles again at once and the sweep replays with a perceptibly different pace and direction of travel
interaction_model.input: Selecting one of the labelled trigger choices while the text is settled
interaction_model.affected_object: The whole text block and the decode sequence

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Input acceptance resumes automatically once everything has settled, guaranteeing no scrambled leftovers and never more than one run at a time
interaction_model.state_change: No state change; the press is ignored and the current run continues uninterrupted
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The ongoing sweep continues without restarting, stuttering, or overlapping a second run
interaction_model.input: Selecting a trigger choice while a run is still in progress
interaction_model.affected_object: The in-progress decode run

experience_qualities: Machine-like decoding and unscrambling rather than fading or sliding in
Tonally restrained, low-contrast surround and quietly technical mood, with the text as the only clearly separated layer
Anticipation during the sweep resolving into calm stillness
Watchable and repeatable without feeling unstable or lossy
Restrained: one moving element at a time, no layout movement
completion_and_return: Completion is the fully settled, motionless, exactly-correct text; the experience does not loop on its own.
Each replay is a complete run that returns to the identical settled end state.
The settled state is the resting state of the view and remains readable indefinitely.
Trigger availability resets to accepting input only at completion.
locked_observable_requirements: Text is initially unreadable as churning symbols and becomes readable through character-level settling, not through opacity or position animation.
Settling advances directionally across characters and lines rather than resolving everywhere at once.
Every run finishes on the exact original wording with all motion stopped.
Final text layout positions are stable from start to finish; no reflow while decoding.

A tonally restrained treatment in which the text holds clear reading contrast against a low-distraction surround while a faint decorative line-art layer sits behind it at distinctly lower contrast than the words.
A small row of plainly labelled trigger choices along the bottom edge that restarts the reveal.
Different trigger choices produce noticeably different rhythm and travel direction.
Only one run may be active: inputs during a run are ignored and accepted again only after settling.
adaptable_details: Number and labels of the trigger choices
Exact pacing, symbol churn density and specific travel directions offered
Character set used for the illegible intermediate symbols
Motif, density and placement of the faint background line art
Hue family, overall lightness direction and exact contrast level of text, surround and line art, as long as the text stays comfortably readable and the line art stays subordinate
Number of text entries and their typographic scale, as long as the block stays short
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits short, high-value text blocks of a few lines that must ultimately be read comfortably, such as an identity and role introduction, a tagline plus one short paragraph, a quote, or a compact single-screen statement. Long-form body copy, dense lists or content the user must scroll through breaks the experience because prolonged illegibility becomes an obstacle. Replacing the illegible-symbol settling with typing, fading, sliding or blur-in, allowing text to remain partly scrambled, or driving the reveal by scroll or pointer position instead of discrete replay triggers would create a different Skill.

name: folding_full_height_panel_scroll_loop
description: Full-height panels advanced by a smoothed, weighted scroll, each unfolding into full presence as it reaches the centre and folding flat as it hands off, in an endless seamless run.

canonical_document.name: folding_full_height_panel_scroll_loop
canonical_document.description: Full-height panels advanced by a smoothed, weighted scroll, each unfolding into full presence as it reaches the centre and folding flat as it hands off, in an endless seamless run.
canonical_document.experience_scope: Region-as-whole-view: the experience occupies the full viewport and begins after a quiet held state resolves into the sequence's first panel; it has no end point, continuing for as long as the visitor scrolls in either direction.
content_and_composition: A vertical run of full-height, viewport-filling panels, each holding exactly one primary content item
Two distinct panel content roles present: a typographic/lettering panel and a single full-bleed picture panel
Exactly one panel occupies the centre of attention at any moment; neighbours are present only in their folded or not-yet-emerged states
The run is circular in composition: the panel after the last is the first panel again, with no visible boundary marker between the two
No competing persistent foreground content, chrome or overlay controls compete with the centred panel
experience_progression: Entry: a quiet holding state while imagery is not yet presentable, then a clean reveal into the first panel
Advance: continuous, unhurried procession in which the centred panel yields and the next takes the centre, one at a time
Per-panel arc: emerge from nothing at the leading edge, reach full presence when centred, compress to nothing past centre
Loop: passing the last panel carries directly into the first panel and vice versa, with no seam, jump or reset, so the run never bottoms out
Fresh visit: the sequence starts again from the opening panel
attention_and_information_flow: Attention is single-focus: only the centred panel is fully legible or fully sized, so prominence is granted to one item at a time
Information is revealed by arrival rather than by disclosure controls: content becomes readable/complete as it approaches centre and withdraws as it leaves
Fold and scale states act as positional cues, telling the visitor whether an item is arriving or departing
Because the run is endless, no progress terminus or completion cue is presented

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Motion can be interrupted mid-glide by new input and picks up from the current position; stopping input lets the run ease to rest
interaction_model.state_change: Scroll input is smoothed into weighted, easing motion rather than immediate or snapped displacement
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Panels glide with perceptible inertia and settle rather than snapping between positions
interaction_model.input: Vertical scroll (wheel, trackpad, touch drag) as the sole control
interaction_model.affected_object: The whole panel run and the position of each panel

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Because the mapping is positional rather than triggered, reversing scroll direction rewinds the fold exactly at any intermediate point
interaction_model.state_change: Fold amount is mapped one-to-one to travel distance
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The lettering flattens downward onto its lower edge as the panel leaves upward, fully flat at hand-off
interaction_model.input: Distance a panel has travelled through the viewport (scroll progress, autonomous consequence of scrolling)
interaction_model.affected_object: The lettering/typographic panel

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Reversing direction rewinds the swell/collapse exactly; no state is latched
interaction_model.state_change: Scale/presence mapped one-to-one to travel distance
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The picture swells from nothing at its leading edge to full size exactly when centred, then collapses to nothing again past centre
interaction_model.input: Distance a panel has travelled through the viewport
interaction_model.affected_object: The picture panel

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Further input during the settle is accepted and redirects the run without a visual jump
interaction_model.state_change: Momentum resolves into a settled arrangement rather than an arbitrary partial one
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Panels land in clean finished states instead of resting half-folded or half-scaled
interaction_model.input: Fast flick or abrupt high-velocity scroll
interaction_model.affected_object: Panel positions and fold/scale states

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Wrapping is bidirectional and repeatable indefinitely in both directions
interaction_model.state_change: Traversal wraps around to the opposite end of the run
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Motion carries straight on into the sequence with no seam, jump, blank gap or reset
interaction_model.input: Continuing to scroll past either end of the run
interaction_model.affected_object: The sequence order and panel continuity

experience_qualities: Calm, unhurried and deliberate rather than energetic
Weighted and physical, with glide and settle instead of stepping
Single-minded: one thing to look at, fully, at a time
Continuous and boundless, with no sense of running out of content
Exactly reversible, so the visitor feels in direct control of the transformation
completion_and_return: No completion state: the run loops endlessly in both directions
Loop return is seamless — arriving back at the opening panel is not announced or visually marked
No traversal position persists: every fresh visit begins from the opening panel
Reversal returns any panel to its earlier appearance precisely, so the visitor can always get back to a prior view
locked_observable_requirements: One full-height, viewport-filling panel holds attention at a time
Vertical scroll is the only control, with smoothed weighted motion and no snapping between panels
Panel travel distance maps one-to-one and continuously onto its fold/scale state, so reversing rewinds exactly
Lettering-type content flattens downward onto its lower edge as it exits upward
Picture content grows from nothing at its leading edge to full size at centre and collapses to nothing past centre
The run is endless and wraps in both directions with no seam, jump or reset
Fast input resolves into clean finished panel states
Traversal position does not persist across visits
adaptable_details: How the initial holding state and its reveal are treated visually
Panel count and the mix of typographic versus image panels
Easing curve, glide duration and perceived weight
Subject matter of the picture panels and the specific wording of typographic panels
Surface treatment, colour scheme and typography of panel content, in any host palette, provided the centred panel stays clearly readable against its surround
Fold axis details and depth cues used to express folding, provided the travel-to-fold mapping stays one-to-one
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits small curated sets of self-contained, visually dominant items — marks, statements, single images, featured works or product shots — where each item deserves the whole viewport and order carries no strict meaning. It stops being this Skill if panels must hold dense scannable text or multiple simultaneous items, if the sequence needs a definite beginning and end with progress or completion, if navigation controls, jumps or deep links into specific panels are required, or if advance becomes automatic, snapped or triggered rather than continuously mapped to scroll travel.

source_sites.title: Getting Creative with Infinite Loop Scrolling

name: preview_origin_background_takeover
description: A cluster of small look previews sits over a full-view backdrop; picking one makes that look grow outward from the preview's own position until it has covered the whole viewport and become the new backdrop, with foreground wording legible the entire time.

canonical_document.name: preview_origin_background_takeover
canonical_document.description: A cluster of small look previews sits over a full-view backdrop; picking one makes that look grow outward from the preview's own position until it has covered the whole viewport and become the new backdrop, with foreground wording legible the entire time.
canonical_document.experience_scope: Whole-view experience: the backdrop layer spans the entire viewport and the preview cluster is a small persistent region on top of it. The experience begins on arrival with one look already applied and continues indefinitely, each selection running one covering sweep from pick to full coverage.
content_and_composition: One full-viewport backdrop layer forming the bottom of the visual stack, always showing exactly one current look once a change settles
A small fixed set of look previews (a handful, not a long list), each a miniature readable sample of the look it applies, arranged as one compact cluster at a stable position over the backdrop
One transient covering layer that carries the incoming look and is only present while a change travels, stacked above the outgoing backdrop and below the foreground content
Foreground wording and controls sitting above both backdrop layers, unchanged in position and readable before, during and after any change
A persistent current-selection indication attached to the preview cluster so the applied look is identifiable at rest
experience_progression: Arrival: one look is already in effect as the full backdrop, and the alternatives read as previews without explanation
Pick: the incoming look appears anchored at the picked preview's own on-screen place
Sweep: the incoming look expands outward from that anchor in one continuous, unhurried motion, progressively displacing the previous backdrop
Settle: coverage reaches the full viewport, the incoming look becomes the resting backdrop, and the transient layer is no longer distinguishable
Rest: the preview cluster remains fully available with the new current look marked, ready for another pick, including returning to a previously applied look
attention_and_information_flow: At rest, the backdrop is ambient and the previews plus foreground wording hold attention
A pick briefly localizes attention at the picked preview, which becomes the visible origin of the change
Attention widens outward with the growing coverage as the new look progressively becomes the dominant surface
After settling, attention returns to the foreground content while the previews recede to a quiet, still-inviting role
Revealed information shifts from 'these are alternative looks' to 'this look is now current and the others are still open'

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: The sweep always completes to full coverage so the screen is never left partly covered; any earlier look can be restored simply by picking its preview again
interaction_model.state_change: Current look transitions from the previous one to the picked one, passing through a travelling covering state
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The picked look appears at that preview's own position and grows outward in one continuous unhurried sweep until it fills the viewport, displacing the previous backdrop, while foreground wording stays legible
interaction_model.input: Picking a preview that is not the current look
interaction_model.affected_object: Full-viewport backdrop layer plus the transient covering layer

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: The no-op is silent and leaves the view immediately re-pickable, so a redundant pick costs nothing
interaction_model.state_change: No state change
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Nothing happens; the backdrop and previews remain exactly as they are
interaction_model.input: Picking the preview of the look already in effect
interaction_model.affected_object: Backdrop layer and preview cluster

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: The view always resolves to exactly one fully applied look that matches the marked current preview, after which normal picking resumes
interaction_model.state_change: Additional picks do not queue up as a chain of sweeps and do not abandon the in-flight coverage
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The viewport shows a single coherent covering motion resolving to one full-viewport look rather than stacked or overlapping sweeps or a stranded half-covered surface
interaction_model.input: Further picks made while a change is still travelling
interaction_model.affected_object: Travelling covering layer and pending look

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Return needs no separate undo affordance; every look stays reachable at all times, so trying options never feels risky
interaction_model.state_change: Current look returns to that earlier look through the same covering behavior
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The earlier look grows outward from its own preview position and retakes the viewport, identical in character to any other change
interaction_model.input: Picking a previously applied look again after other changes
interaction_model.affected_object: Full-viewport backdrop layer

experience_qualities: Continuous and unhurried rather than an abrupt jump
Spatially causal: the change visibly originates from the thing that was picked
Self-explanatory, because the previews show what they will do
Low-risk and reversible-feeling, since every alternative stays one pick away
Calm and non-obstructive: foreground reading is never interrupted or obscured
completion_and_return: Each change completes only when the incoming look covers the full viewport and becomes the resting backdrop
The applied look persists at rest and stays identifiable through the current-selection indication in the preview cluster
No automatic looping or reversion; the view holds the last applied look until another pick
The preview cluster returns to its full, unrestricted resting state after every change
locked_observable_requirements: One look is already applied on arrival, without requiring a first pick
Alternatives are shown as small readable previews of the looks they apply, needing no explanatory copy
The incoming look expands outward from the picked preview's own on-screen position, not from a generic centre or edge
Expansion is one continuous unhurried sweep that displaces the previous backdrop and ends at full viewport coverage
Foreground wording remains legible throughout the change
The currently applied look stays identifiable at rest and all alternatives remain available
Picking the already-applied look does nothing
Rapid or repeated picks never stack into chained sweeps and never leave a partly covered viewport
adaptable_details: Number of alternatives, as long as it stays a small directly-visible set
What each look is made of visually, and how rich or plain the previews are
Placement, shape, spacing and arrangement of the preview cluster
How the current look is marked at rest
Sweep duration, easing and the exact shape of the outward growth
Foreground content itself, provided it stays readable over every look
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits any view with a single large backdrop surface, sparse readable foreground content, and a small fixed set of alternative full-view looks chosen directly on screen. It stays the same Skill across different kinds of backdrop material and different foreground copy. It becomes a different Skill if the alternatives are hidden behind a menu or long scrollable list instead of readable previews, if the change is an instant swap or a uniform whole-screen crossfade with no visible origin point, if the new look only fills a contained panel rather than the whole viewport, or if the previews change page content and layout rather than re-dressing the backdrop behind unchanged foreground content.

name: liquid_echo_word_pointer_chase
description: One giant bold word on a plain, near-empty stage splits into a small stack of identical copies that chase the pointer in sequence, the solid front copy arriving first and outlined echoes bending behind it into a trail, all closing back into a single clean word when movement stops.

canonical_document.name: liquid_echo_word_pointer_chase
canonical_document.description: One giant bold word on a plain, near-empty stage splits into a small stack of identical copies that chase the pointer in sequence, the solid front copy arriving first and outlined echoes bending behind it into a trail, all closing back into a single clean word when movement stops.
canonical_document.experience_scope: Whole-view experience covering the entire page area: it begins on arrival with a single resting word and is re-entered by any pointer movement anywhere in the view; it ends by resolving back to the resting single word whenever the pointer holds still. There is no separate region, panel or entry control.
content_and_composition: One short piece of display text (a single big bold word) as the only foreground content
A small stack of identical copies of that same word, layered front-to-back, typically a handful rather than a crowd
Frontmost copy rendered solid/filled; the copies behind it rendered as outlines only, so depth order is visually readable
Near-empty, low-distraction surround as the persistent backdrop, uniform enough that the word separates from it at a glance, with no competing imagery, chrome, labels, instructions or controls
At rest the whole stack is aligned in one position so it reads as a single clean word rather than a cluster
No configuration UI, legend, hint text or reset affordance anywhere in the view
experience_progression: Arrival: one still, clean word on a quiet, uncluttered stage reading as an invitation
Activation: first pointer movement makes the word turn liquid and separate into its layered copies
Pursuit: continuous movement keeps the stack strung out along the recent path, front copy nearest the pointer, outlined echoes trailing behind
Settling: when movement slows or stops, the copies close up and re-align
Rest: back to the single clean word, ready to activate again with no accumulated state
attention_and_information_flow: Attention starts on the single word as the sole focal object of an otherwise empty view
During movement attention follows the pointer, because the solid copy is always closest to it and is the visually heaviest element
Outlined echoes carry secondary attention and reveal where the pointer has just been, turning motion history into visible information
Layer order plus solid-versus-outline contrast communicates depth and speed without any text or numeric readout
On settling, prominence collapses back to one object so the view returns to a single unambiguous focus

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Always available; there is nothing to enable or dismiss, and pointer position alone determines the state
interaction_model.state_change: Each copy re-aims toward the pointer as a destination, staggered so the solid front copy leads and outlined copies follow in order
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The stack strings out along the travelled path as a trail of echoes; the front copy sits closest to the pointer
interaction_model.input: Pointer position anywhere in the view (the only input)
interaction_model.affected_object: The stack of word copies

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Interruption mid-flight is the normal case and is absorbed as a curve; no discontinuity or restart is ever visible
interaction_model.state_change: The group is re-aimed smoothly from wherever the copies currently are, rather than being repositioned from scratch
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The trail bends and curves through the direction change instead of snapping, jumping or breaking apart
interaction_model.input: Continuous pointer movement, including sudden reversals or jerky direction changes
interaction_model.affected_object: The whole group of copies in flight

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Self-resolving; any new movement re-activates the effect from the current resting position
interaction_model.state_change: Copies converge on the same position and re-align
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Echoes close up into one solid-looking clean word, the trail disappearing without a flash or fade-out of content
interaction_model.input: Holding the pointer still (autonomous settling)
interaction_model.affected_object: The stack of word copies

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: The copies never intercept the pointer, so they cannot block, capture or stall the motion
interaction_model.state_change: None; the copies are non-interactive and transparent to the pointer
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Motion continues uninterrupted and nothing highlights, selects or reacts as a control
interaction_model.input: Attempted clicks or hovers on the moving copies
interaction_model.affected_object: The copies themselves

experience_qualities: Liquid, alive and playful rather than mechanical
Spacious and stage-like, the empty surround making the word feel lit and isolated
Fast and depth-suggesting, the layered echoes reading as motion blur in space
Effortless: nothing to learn, nothing to configure, no instructions
Self-cleaning: never accumulates clutter and never needs an explicit reset
Inviting rather than declarative, closer to a toy than a headline
completion_and_return: No end state or completion goal; the experience loops indefinitely between resting word and trailing echoes
Pausing is the return path: settling into one aligned word is the canonical resting state
No persistent state carries over, so the view always looks the same at rest regardless of prior movement
locked_observable_requirements: A single short display word is the only foreground content on an otherwise empty, low-distraction stage from which it separates clearly
Multiple identical copies of that same word, layered front-to-back, with the frontmost solid and the ones behind outlined
Pointer position is the sole driver; the stack targets the pointer with the front copy arriving first and the rest in sequence
The trail follows the path just travelled and bends continuously through reversals instead of snapping
Holding still collapses the copies into one aligned clean word
The copies are never clickable and never intercept the pointer
No visible controls, instructions, configuration or reset affordance
adaptable_details: The particular word, typeface, weight and letter case
Exact number of copies in the stack
Surround luminance and tone, word colouring and outline weight, as long as the word stays clearly separated from the surround and solid-versus-outline layer contrast stays readable
Chase responsiveness, stagger spacing and settling duration
Overall text scale and how it adapts to viewport size
Resting position of the word within the view
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits views where one very short piece of text can be the entire subject and the surface is otherwise empty and uniform enough for echoes to read as depth: splash screens, playful typography demos, minimal intro views, sparse hero areas. It stops being this Skill if the copies become readable content, links or controls, if the trail is made of shapes, particles or images instead of duplicates of the same word, if long text or dense surrounding content makes the layered echoes illegible, or if the accumulated trail persists instead of resolving back to one word at rest.

name: scroll_scrubbed_word_chorus
description: An oversized single-word heading multiplies into an evenly spaced chorus of identical copies as it rises through the viewport, peaks, then resolves back into one legible word.

canonical_document.name: scroll_scrubbed_word_chorus
canonical_document.description: An oversized single-word heading multiplies into an evenly spaced chorus of identical copies as it rises through the viewport, peaks, then resolves back into one legible word.
canonical_document.experience_scope: A repeated region-level experience: each oversized one-word heading placed between prose blocks owns its own instance, beginning when that word enters from the bottom of the viewport and ending when it has resolved to a single word near the top. The surrounding long-text page is the host view; the whole page also has one entry moment (plain full-cover holding state resolving into a single clean reveal) so no heading shifts mid-read.
content_and_composition: Continuous body prose as the primary reading layer, set at calm ordinary reading scale
Multiple oversized one-word headings interleaved between paragraphs, each acting as a focal punctuation point
Per heading: one base word plus N identical copies of itself, distributed at even intervals along a single consistent direction, forming a symmetrical chorus around the legible word
A quiet dimmed attribution line closing the passage, lower in contrast than body prose
A plain full-cover holding surface present only before the first reveal
Headings share one typographic treatment so the effect reads as a repeated device rather than isolated decoration
experience_progression: Plain full-cover holding state while display type is readied
Everything reveals in one clean step, already at correct positions and spreads
Per heading, as it rises from the bottom of the viewport: copies fan progressively outward from the single word
Peak spread reached at the heading's high point of travel
Copies converge back and resolve into one legible word as travel completes
Prose rhythm resumes between headings; the cycle repeats for each subsequent heading
Passage closes on the dimmed attribution
attention_and_information_flow: Prominence oscillates: prose is calm and continuous, then a heading briefly dominates the view as its chorus expands
The multiplying copies raise visual density and pull the eye without adding new information, so nothing must be read twice
Legibility is deliberately returned at the end of each cycle so the word is readable as a word, not only as texture
Several headings may be at different stages simultaneously, producing layered emphasis down a long scroll
Attention drops off at the close, where the dimmed attribution signals the end without competing

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Scrolling back retraces the same spread values in reverse and re-collapses the word exactly; there is no triggered one-shot state to get stuck in
interaction_model.state_change: Spread amount advances continuously as a direct function of how far that heading has travelled from the bottom of the viewport toward the top
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Copies fan open at even spacing as the word rises, reaching maximum separation at peak travel then converging to a single word
interaction_model.input: Reader scrolls the page forward
interaction_model.affected_object: An oversized one-word heading and its copies

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Resuming scroll in either direction continues from the held value with no jump or replay
interaction_model.state_change: Each holds the exact intermediate spread implied by its current position
interaction_model.visible_feedback: A frozen partially fanned chorus that stays stable and inspectable rather than settling or continuing on its own
interaction_model.input: Reader stops scrolling at any point
interaction_model.affected_object: Every heading currently in view

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: No global sequencing to fall out of step; each region self-corrects from position alone
interaction_model.state_change: Each answers only to its own viewport position, unsynchronised from the others
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Simultaneous headings sit at visibly different stages of fanning and collapsing
interaction_model.input: Multiple headings visible at once
interaction_model.affected_object: Each heading independently

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Reveal is withheld behind the plain full-cover holding state until display type is ready, so the first thing seen is already correct
interaction_model.state_change: State is derived from current position rather than from having been scrolled past
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Every heading appears already at its correct spread on first paint, with no start-from-zero animation or catch-up
interaction_model.input: Entering or reloading part-way down the page
interaction_model.affected_object: All headings on the page

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: No reload required and no visible reset of reading position or effect stage
interaction_model.state_change: Spacing and spread mapping recompute against the new viewport
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Copies stay evenly spaced and correctly positioned at the current scroll location
interaction_model.input: Viewport resize
interaction_model.affected_object: Chorus spacing and heading layout

experience_qualities: Self-explanatory: the relationship between scrolling and spreading is legible without instruction
Calm and rhythmic, with emphasis arriving in punctuated moments rather than constant motion
Precisely reversible, giving a sense of direct manual control over the effect
Stable while idle; nothing drifts or animates on its own
Typographic and restrained in palette, with the word itself doing the expressive work
Reading is never interrupted by layout shift or unexpected jumps
completion_and_return: Each heading completes by resolving to one legible word and remains legible afterward
The device repeats per heading down the page rather than playing once
Scrolling back returns any heading to its earlier state exactly; there is no consumed or one-time state
Page-level completion is the dimmed attribution at the close of the passage
Re-entry at any depth reconstitutes the correct state instantly from position
locked_observable_requirements: Spread is scrubbed continuously by the heading's own travel from viewport bottom toward top, not triggered at a threshold
Copies are identical to the base word and evenly spaced
Each heading resolves back to exactly one legible word
Each heading responds only to its own position, so several can occupy different stages at once
Stopping anywhere holds the intermediate spread without settling or continuing
Reverse scrolling re-collapses along the same path exactly
Deep entry or reload part-way down shows every heading already at its correct spread
Resize keeps spacing correct with no reload and no reset
First paint happens as one clean reveal after a plain full-cover holding state, so no heading reflows mid-read
Surrounding prose keeps ordinary calm reading rhythm and is not itself animated
Closing attribution is present and visibly dimmed
adaptable_details: Number of copies in the chorus
Axis and direction of the fan (horizontal, vertical or diagonal)
Maximum spread distance and where in travel the peak sits
Typeface, weight, casing, colour and background palette
Length and number of prose blocks and headings
Whether copies vary in opacity or remain uniform
Exact dimming level and wording of the closing attribution
Appearance of the holding surface before reveal
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits text-led long-form pages where short single words can serve as oversized punctuation between prose blocks, and any repeated element that should scrub reversibly with its own scroll travel. Replacing the single word with multi-word phrases, images or full paragraphs, driving the effect by timer or one-shot trigger instead of continuous position, synchronising all headings to one global timeline, or leaving the word permanently multiplied instead of resolving to one legible form would each create a different Skill.

name: bowed_opaque_wipe_screen_handoff

canonical_document.name: bowed_opaque_wipe_screen_handoff
canonical_document.description: A single fully opaque shape with a curved, trailing leading edge sweeps in from one side until it blankets the viewport, the underlying screen changes while hidden, then the shape exits the opposite side to uncover the new screen.
canonical_document.experience_scope: Whole-view experience covering the entire viewport. It begins when the switch control on the currently visible screen is pressed and ends when the covering shape has fully left the viewport and one complete screen is settled and idle. Between sweeps the page is simply one static full-height panel.

Each screen carries its own flat uniform background whose surface value is clearly separated from the other screen's, so the two are immediately distinguishable at a glance
Each screen contains modest foreground content and one switch control that triggers the handoff to the other screen

Layer order is fixed: sweeping shape in front, active screen panel behind it

Cover: the opaque shape enters from the leading side edge and advances across the viewport, its bowed edge trailing, until coverage is total

Uncover: the shape continues in the same direction and slides off the opposite edge, progressively revealing the newly current screen
Idle again: the other screen is fully settled with its own control ready; pressing it repeats the identical sequence back
The forward and return passes are symmetrical in feel and duration, making the cycle comfortably repeatable
attention_and_information_flow: Attention is pulled from page content to the sweep of the moving opaque mass as soon as the control is pressed
The curved trailing edge gives the motion a clear direction and a sense of a single continuous pass rather than two separate animations

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Unlimited repetition in either direction with no accumulated drift or change in feel
interaction_model.state_change: Returns to the previous screen through an identical handoff
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The same sweep, same bowed edge, same coverage-and-exit rhythm, so forward and back feel indistinguishable
interaction_model.input: Press of the switch control on the newly revealed screen
interaction_model.affected_object: Same overlay shape and screen panel

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Guarantees the experience can never be left mid-swap or on a partially covered viewport; control becomes effective again once the shape has left the viewport

interaction_model.visible_feedback: The running sweep continues undisturbed with no stutter, restart, or queued second pass
interaction_model.input: Additional presses that land while a sweep is already running
interaction_model.affected_object: The in-progress handoff

experience_qualities: Deliberate and decisive rather than instantaneous

Directional and physical, thanks to the bowed trailing edge
Reliably symmetrical and repeatable in both directions
Always resolved: never a blended or ambiguous in-between state
completion_and_return: Each handoff completes with exactly one screen fully visible and the overlay entirely off-viewport
The return trip uses the identical sweep, so the pair of screens forms a closed two-state loop
Which screen is current persists until the control is pressed again; there is no timed or automatic return
No residual overlay, partial coverage, or leftover motion after completion
locked_observable_requirements: Exactly two alternate full-height screens, each with its own flat uniform background that is clearly separated from the other's, by whatever means the host site's palette provides
A single fully opaque shape that enters from one viewport edge, achieves complete viewport coverage with nothing showing through, and exits the opposite edge in one continuous directional pass
The shape's leading edge is bowed with its center leading and its flanks trailing
The underlying screen changes only at the moment of total coverage, never visible to the user
Forward and return handoffs are perceptually identical
Inputs during a running sweep are ignored so the experience always settles on one complete screen

canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits any site with a small fixed set of whole-viewport views that should be presented one at a time and swapped as a single event, especially calm low-density panels where the motion itself carries the moment, and it adopts whichever surfaces and accents the host site already uses. Content density can vary as long as each view reads as one self-contained full-height panel. Making the transition partial or region-scoped, allowing both views to be visible simultaneously, blending or letting the overlay be see-through instead of fully covering, scaling to many scrollable views, or revealing the swap to the user would each create a different Skill.

canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits any view whose navigation is a handful of top-level destinations and whose opening screen carries one dominant title or name over a full-bleed image or tone — launches, collections, events, portfolios, single-announcement landing pages. It remains itself when the wording, imagery, palette, luminance direction or timing change. It becomes a different skill if the navigation must present dense or multi-level lists, tables of many items, or persist alongside content as an inline bar; if the menu appears as a partial panel, drawer or overlay that leaves the underlying view visible; if the transition stops fully concealing the screen mid-way or loses the single continuous rise; or if the opening screen becomes a multi-section scrolling composition rather than one poster-like screen.

name: typographic_flood_detail_transition

canonical_document.name: typographic_flood_detail_transition
canonical_document.description: A few illustrated items float above enormous, barely-separated lettering; picking one makes the collection sink away while the lettering rushes forward and floods the screen, then the chosen piece's number, title, intro, body and image arrive together in a calm reading state that a single back control unwinds.
canonical_document.experience_scope: Whole-view experience covering one small self-contained page: it begins with the composed arrival of the collection level, spans the transition into and out of a single item, and ends when the collection level is restored and usable again. content_and_composition: Persistent background layer of a single piece of enormous lettering held at very low contrast against its own backdrop, larger than the viewport's comfortable reading scale, sitting behind everything at both levels

Return: the same stages replayed in reverse — reading content leaves, the lettering floods and recedes, the collection and header rise back into their original arrangement

attention_and_information_flow: At the collection level attention is spread evenly across the small set of items; the lettering reads as atmosphere rather than content because it sits so close to its backdrop in contrast and so far above it in scale
Pointing at an item raises that item slightly above its neighbours without hiding them
During the takeover attention is deliberately taken away from all content and given to the lettering, which briefly becomes the only thing on screen
At the detail level attention narrows to one piece and its image, with information density stepping up from a short caption to number, title, intro and full body

Returning restores the even, low-density overview reading so the two levels stay easy to tell apart

interaction_model.input: Pointer leaves the hovered item
interaction_model.affected_object: The previously hovered item

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: The sequence runs to completion as a unit; any input attempted while it runs is ignored, and the reading state is the guaranteed end point
interaction_model.state_change: Level changes from overview to reading through one ordered sequence
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Collection and header sink out of view, the low-contrast lettering surges forward and floods the screen, then the chosen number, title, intro, body and image appear together and settle into a quiet reading state

interaction_model.affected_object: Whole view

experience_qualities: Composed and deliberate rather than snappy
Cinematic, screen-filling handoff between two levels
Typographic and atmospheric instead of decorative or illustrative
Symmetrical and predictable — going in and coming back mirror each other
Quiet, still reading state with no residual motion
Clear level separation, so the viewer always knows whether they are browsing or reading
completion_and_return: Each transition completes on its own once started and always lands on a fully settled level
The reading state persists indefinitely until the back control is used
Return restores the collection exactly as it was, including item arrangement and the persistent lettering substrate
No progress or partial state is carried between visits to different items; the collection is the stable home state
The forward-and-back cycle can loop any number of times
locked_observable_requirements: Enormous lettering, kept at low enough contrast against its backdrop to read as atmosphere rather than content, must be present as a background substrate at both levels, not only during the transition
The transition into a single item must be one continuous ordered sequence: overview and header leave, lettering takes over the full screen, then the item's content arrives
The item's number, title, intro, body and image must arrive together as one settling group, not one by one as separate reveals
The return must be the reverse of the same sequence and must restore the collection unchanged

While reading, the back control must be the only responsive target

The overview and reading states must remain visually distinguishable as two levels
adaptable_details: Exact number of items in the collection, as long as it stays a small browsable set
Arrangement of the collection (row, grid, staggered) and its alignment
Which word or characters form the background lettering, its typeface, weight and how close it sits to its backdrop in contrast
Direction and distance of the hover separation between picture and caption
Direction in which the overview and header sink out of view
Timing, easing and total duration of the transitions
Surface-and-text contrast relationship, image treatment and typographic scale of the reading state, provided body text stays comfortably readable
Placement and styling of the back control
A brief composed hold before the collection first appears
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits small curated sets of short illustrated pieces where each item has one image and a modest amount of text — story or essay collections, project or case snapshots, editorial features, product or place vignettes — and where a strong word or short phrase can plausibly sit behind everything as atmosphere. It stops working for large or paginated collections, items whose detail view needs scrolling through long or heavily structured content, or levels that must be independently addressable rather than two states of one view. Replacing the lettering takeover with imagery, a plain fade or a route-based page change, letting the detail view remain interactive beyond a single exit control, or revealing the item's content pieces one at a time would each produce a different Skill.

canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits text-light views built from a few short, ordered statements where mood and a sense of arrival matter more than information density, and where a single abstract form can legitimately stand in for the subject. interaction_model.visible_feedback: A gliding accent-filled window with a hairline ring drifting slightly behind the pointer, with the accent treatment and dot texture blooming across letter shapes it covers and fading back to outline behind it
interaction_model.input: Pointer movement anywhere across the screen
interaction_model.affected_object: Circular opening, halo ring, and the lettering beneath them

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Motion always converges to the current pointer position; abrupt direction changes are absorbed by the easing instead of breaking continuity
interaction_model.state_change: Follow motion remains continuous and smoothly damped rather than snapping or accumulating queued motion
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The opening keeps gliding along a smooth path without jumping, stuttering or piling up behind the pointer
interaction_model.input: Fast, erratic or long-distance pointer movement
interaction_model.affected_object: Circular opening and halo ring

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: If pointer input later occurs, tracking begins from the resting position with the same trailing ease
interaction_model.state_change: Reveal remains present in a resting position instead of disappearing
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The accent-filled opening and halo sit centred, showing a static fragment of the textured twin lettering
interaction_model.input: No pointer available or no pointer input at all
interaction_model.affected_object: Circular opening and halo ring

experience_qualities: Bold and typographic: the words are the whole composition
Deliberate, paced arrival followed by playful open exploration
Smooth, gliding, slightly weighted motion rather than snapping
Hidden-material intrigue: plain surface concealing a saturated, textured twin
Never-finished and curiosity-rewarding, with nothing to complete or dismiss
completion_and_return: The assembly sequence completes once per arrival and does not replay while the view is active
The reveal has no completion state: it continues for as long as the visitor remains, with no finished or fully revealed configuration
Reveal state is purely positional and not accumulated, so leaving and re-entering an area yields an identical appearance
When input stops, the experience rests in place; with no pointer at all it rests centred
locked_observable_requirements: Headline must assemble letter by letter on arrival, before any reveal is visible
Two visual states of the same lettering must coexist in identical position: a plain outlined base and a saturated, dot-textured accent twin, with the accent hue itself unconstrained
The twin must be visible only inside a small roaming circular opening, never across the whole headline at once
A slim halo ring must accompany the opening and appear as it widens open after the assembly finishes
Opening and halo must follow the pointer with a soft trailing lag rather than exact instantaneous placement
Revealed appearance must be purely a function of the current opening position, so retracing restores exactly the previous look
Motion must stay smooth and continuous under fast erratic input, without jumping or queue build-up
Pointer tracking must not begin until the assembly sequence has finished
With no pointer available the reveal must rest centred rather than vanish
adaptable_details: Exact wording, language and number of words in the headline
Typeface, weight, letter case and outline thickness of the base type
Accent hue family, saturation level and texture density of the twin, as long as it stays clearly separated from the base outline treatment
Opening diameter, halo thickness and the amount of trailing lag
Speed and rhythm of the letter-by-letter assembly, including whether letters fade, slide or pop in
Surround luminance level and headline alignment or placement within the region, provided the headline keeps readable contrast against it
Whether the region is a full screen or a large banded hero area
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits a single short display statement of a few words that can be rendered twice in identical position, on an otherwise uncluttered arrival screen or hero band where exploration is welcome and no reading task is urgent. Long paragraphs, dense multi-element layouts or content that must be legible in full at once do not fit. Revealing images or scenes instead of the same lettering, revealing the whole headline permanently as the pointer passes, or replacing the roaming circular opening with a full-width or non-pointer-driven transition would each create a different Skill.

Magnetic, tactile pointer feedback that makes targets feel physically attracted
Crisp, mechanical kinetic typography contrasted with slow image motion
Fully reversible, smooth hover states with no abrupt snapping
Immersive, quiet single-column reading once committed, with a low-distraction surround
Uninterrupted continuity of browsing position across open and return
completion_and_return: Every hover state resolves fully back to rest when the pointer leaves
Expansion has no end state of its own: it persists until the back control collapses it
Collapsing restores the listing exactly as it was, including scroll position within the sequence
The opened story's internal scroll position resets so each opening begins at the top
The browse and open cycle repeats indefinitely without accumulating leftover state
locked_observable_requirements: Each entry announces one story with an oversized title held at readable contrast across a single wide photograph plus a short meta line and a few teaser lines
Two distinct hover targets per entry - a round marker and a read-more cue - trigger the identical coordinated response
Hover simultaneously draws the photograph inward and contracts its frame

canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits sparse, image-led listings where each entry is one dominant headline over one large photograph with brief supporting text - editorial stories, case studies, project features, exhibition entries. Content type matters only in that each entry must have one big image and one long title worth animating letter by letter. Moving to a dense grid of small thumbnails with short labels, or replacing in-place expansion with navigation to a separate page, would produce a different Skill.
