name: concentric_word_ring_threshold_gate
description: Nested rings of huge curved words settle in from small to full size until they crop past every edge and enclose the viewer, with one round control glowing quietly at the center; hovering swells the control and spins the whole ring stack a half turn from the inside out, and pressing it blows the rings outward into a fade as the page's words and header rise in behind them.

canonical_document.name: concentric_word_ring_threshold_gate
canonical_document.description: Nested rings of huge curved words settle in from small to full size until they crop past every edge and enclose the viewer, with one round control glowing quietly at the center; hovering swells the control and spins the whole ring stack a half turn from the inside out, and pressing it blows the rings outward into a fade as the page's words and header rise in behind them.
canonical_document.experience_scope: Whole-view experience that begins the moment the site is entered and ends when the rings have cleared and the plain content page with its header is in place; it occupies the entire viewport while active and does not return afterward.
content_and_composition: Several nested rings of oversized text set on circular baselines, sharing one common center, each ring at a different radius
Outer rings deliberately larger than the viewport so their type is cropped by the view edges, producing a sense of enclosure rather than a complete visible circle
A single small round control at the exact center, containing a filled disc, as the only interactive element and the only quiet, uncrowded area of the composition
Center-weighted radial composition: dense oversized type at the periphery, calm negative space converging on the middle
A plain readable content page with a header waiting beneath, hidden until the gate resolves
No instructional text, labels or hints anywhere in the gate
experience_progression: Arrival: rings appear small and settle outward to full size, ending cropped by the view edges so the frame feels closed in around the visitor
Waiting: rings hold as a live, breathing enclosure with attention resting on the quiet center control; anticipation accumulates without instruction

Courting: each hover on the control swells its disc and drives the ring stack through a staggered half revolution, innermost first and outer rings trailing; repeated hovers push the rotation further along so the scene reads as responsive and alive
Commit: activation cuts over from whatever motion is still running; the rings scale outward past the edges and fade out
Landing: the statement words and header rise into place on the plain page as the rings vanish, and the threshold is gone for good
attention_and_information_flow: Oversized cropped type at the edges creates pressure that funnels the eye inward to the empty middle
The center control is the smallest but most isolated element, so it reads as the obvious way onward without a caption
Hover feedback concentrates attention on the center (swelling disc) while the periphery confirms responsiveness (whole stack turning)
On commit, prominence inverts: the ring material leaves the frame outward while the real page content becomes the new focal content
Information revealed grows from none (mood only) to the actual statement and header

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Runs once on entry; settles into a stable waiting state that persists indefinitely until the visitor acts
interaction_model.state_change: From small scale to full enclosing scale at rest
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Rings settle outward until their type is cut off by the view edges, closing the frame around the visitor
interaction_model.input: Site arrival (autonomous)
interaction_model.affected_object: Nested word rings

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Interruptible by leaving; the rotation is a committed motion once begun rather than a state bound to hover
interaction_model.state_change: Disc grows from resting to enlarged size; ring stack begins a half revolution with staggered start times from inner to outer
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The filled disc swells at the center while the whole nest of words turns, innermost ring leading and outer rings visibly lagging behind it
interaction_model.input: Pointer moves onto the central round control
interaction_model.affected_object: Center control disc and the entire ring stack

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: No reversal of rotation; angular position is retained as the new resting state
interaction_model.state_change: Disc returns to resting size; ring rotation continues to its intended end rather than aborting
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Disc eases smoothly back down while the words keep turning and come to rest naturally, never snapping back to a previous angle
interaction_model.input: Pointer leaves the central control
interaction_model.affected_object: Center control disc and in-flight ring rotation

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Repeatable without limit; never resets to the initial angle while the gate is active
interaction_model.state_change: Rotation extends further from the current angle instead of restarting from the original one
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The nest keeps advancing in the same direction, accumulating turns as the visitor plays with the control
interaction_model.input: Pointer returns to the control before or after the previous turn finishes
interaction_model.affected_object: Ring stack rotation

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: One-way and single-fire: no cancel, no repeat activation, and no route back to the threshold once it has resolved
interaction_model.state_change: Any running motion is overridden immediately; the control is retired so it cannot fire again; rings move from enclosing to dispersed-and-gone; page content moves from hidden to placed
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Rings swell outward past the view edges and fade out, as if the visitor passes through them, while the statement words and header rise into place on the plain page
interaction_model.input: Activating the central control
interaction_model.affected_object: Whole gate: rings, control, and the page beneath

experience_qualities: Moody, hushed and ceremonial
Enclosing and slightly confining, as though standing inside a sealed opening
Alive and waiting rather than decorative, because motion answers presence
Anticipatory, with tension gathering in the empty center
Playful under the pointer through accumulating, never-resetting rotation
Releasing and decisive at the moment of commitment
Self-evident: the way onward is understood without being told
completion_and_return: Completes exactly once, when activation resolves into the plain content view
The control is retired at commit and cannot be triggered a second time
No return path to the threshold within the session; the gate does not replay after landing
Before commit, the waiting state is indefinite and the accumulated rotation angle persists across hovers
locked_observable_requirements: Multiple nested rings of oversized text on circular baselines sharing one center
Outer rings must overflow and be cropped by the view edges so the composition encloses the visitor rather than showing a complete circle
Entry settle runs from small to full enclosing size
The middle stays quiet and uncrowded and holds the single round control with a filled disc
Hover swells the disc and drives a half revolution of the entire stack
Rotation is staggered inner-to-outer, with the innermost ring leading and outer rings trailing
Leaving during motion lets the turn finish naturally; no snap-back to the prior angle
Re-hovering advances rotation further instead of resetting it
Activation immediately supersedes any running motion
The control is retired at activation so it cannot fire twice
Exit reads as passing outward through the rings: rings scale beyond the edges and fade
Page words and header rise into place as the rings clear
No going back to the threshold once committed
No instructional copy explaining what to do
adaptable_details: The words carried on the rings and the page copy revealed afterward
Number of rings and their spacing or radii
Typeface, weight, letter spacing and color palette
Rotation direction and the exact stagger and easing between rings
Resting and swollen sizes of the center disc
Durations of the settle, turn and exit
How far outward the rings travel before fully fading
Whether the page content rises as one block or in a short sequence
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits sites whose ring material is short, large-set text (a name, tagline, repeated single words) and whose destination is a plain readable content view with a header, where a one-time mood-setting threshold before that content is desirable. It stays the same Skill across different copy, ring counts, palettes and timings. It becomes a different Skill if the rings persist as a looping decorative substrate behind ongoing foreground content, if the gate becomes reusable or re-enterable navigation, if the rings are replaced by imagery or non-text shapes as the primary material, if the rings fit entirely inside the view so enclosure is lost, or if the center control gains explicit instructional labeling instead of communicating through swell and motion alone.

name: centre_pile_assembly_intro
description: A brief still hold, then all items appear stacked into one leaning pile at the centre beneath a single oversized word, before the pile unfolds into the real browsable layout and releases control.

canonical_document.name: centre_pile_assembly_intro
canonical_document.description: A brief still hold, then all items appear stacked into one leaning pile at the centre beneath a single oversized word, before the pile unfolds into the real browsable layout and releases control.
canonical_document.experience_scope: Whole-view experience that begins on first arrival and ends the moment items reach their final browsable positions and interactive responses are enabled; it does not recur during normal browsing.
content_and_composition: One oversized word or short phrase as the dominant upper/central typographic layer, present throughout the sequence
The full set of collection items (many, same kind) as the second layer, initially co-located as a single centred pile with slight rotational offsets so edges read as leaning sheets
Item captions (name plus secondary detail) belonging to each item, not legible as individual labels while the pile is stacked
Background surface remains plain and unchanged so the pile and the word carry all contrast
Final state is the ordinary browsable arrangement of the same items, in place of the pile
experience_progression: Quiet hold: view is settled and near-empty, nothing moving, no input invited
Gather: items become present already collected as one leaning centre pile beneath the oversized word
Resolve: the pile unfolds and items travel outward to their real positions in the collection layout
Hand-over: motion comes to rest and pointer and advance responses become active
attention_and_information_flow: Attention is first held by emptiness, then by the oversized word
The centred pile reads as a single mass, so no individual item competes for attention during the opening
As the pile resolves, prominence spreads from the centre outward to the whole arrangement
Per-item information (titles, credits) only becomes individually legible after the arrangement has settled

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Runs to completion on its own; nothing is demanded of the visitor while it plays and premature input does not derail it
interaction_model.state_change: Empty hold to gathered centre pile to resolved browsable arrangement
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Stillness, then a leaning centred stack of items under the large word, then items travelling outward into their places and easing to rest
interaction_model.input: Page arrival (autonomous timed driver, no user input)
interaction_model.affected_object: Oversized word, item pile and final collection layout

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Single one-way gate: once handed over, responsiveness stays on for the rest of the visit
interaction_model.state_change: Interactive responses remain inert until hand-over, then become active together
interaction_model.visible_feedback: No hover growth, no caption change and no advancing motion during the opening; after hand-over the same inputs produce their full response
interaction_model.input: Any pointer or advance input attempted before the sequence finishes
interaction_model.affected_object: Item hover response and collection advancing

experience_qualities: Calm and unhurried
Deliberate and staged rather than instant
Physical, like a stack of sheets being set down and spread out
Undemanding: the visitor is a spectator until it ends
completion_and_return: Completes once by resolving into the live layout and enabling interaction
Does not loop and is not replayed while the visitor stays in the view
The resolved arrangement is the persistent state afterwards
locked_observable_requirements: An initial quiet hold with no motion and no invited input
All items first appear gathered as one leaning pile at the centre, not entering individually into place

The pile resolves into the actual usable arrangement of the same items, not into a decorative end state
Interactive responses stay inert until the resolve finishes, then become active

Exact wording of the oversized word and its typeface
Number of items and the geometry of the final arrangement
Degree of lean and overlap in the pile
Easing character of the outward travel
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits any view whose main content is a set of many similar items that can plausibly stack as sheets and whose arrival deserves one commanding phrase. Content with a single hero item, or items that must be individually readable immediately, does not fit. Changing it so items fly in one by one from off-view, or so the opening ends in a decorative state separate from the real layout, produces a different Skill.

name: springing_sagging_edge_panel_arrival
description: After a long quiet scroll through an almost empty, low-emphasis field, a visually distinct panel arrives from the bottom with its top edge sagging inward; the edge snaps up past flat, wobbles with a strength matching how fast you scrolled, and settles level as the deliberate end of the page.

canonical_document.name: springing_sagging_edge_panel_arrival
canonical_document.description: After a long quiet scroll through an almost empty, low-emphasis field, a visually distinct panel arrives from the bottom with its top edge sagging inward; the edge snaps up past flat, wobbles with a strength matching how fast you scrolled, and settles level as the deliberate end of the page.

content_and_composition: One large quiet, low-emphasis, near-empty field occupying the opening view with no competing elements
Exactly one small line of short guidance text as the single readable item at the start
A long low-density scroll stretch between the opening and the ending, deliberately withholding content to build anticipation
One visually distinct, high-salience panel spanning the full width at the very bottom of the page, separated from the surrounding field by a strong luminance and contrast step

The panel's upper boundary is a single deformable horizontal edge that at rest before arrival curves downward into the panel body (sagging inward), while the panel's own contents stay stable and readable
Panel is terminal: nothing follows it in the scroll order

Stage 2 — anticipation: continued downward scrolling through sparse space with no payoff yet, the sagging edge hinting at tension

Stage 4 — decay: a few diminishing wobbles around the flat line
Stage 5 — rest: the boundary holds flat and the distinct panel reads as a settled, deliberate page ending
Return loop: leaving upward and coming back replays stages 3–5 in full

During the sparse middle, prominence stays low so the eye keeps moving downward
Prominence shifts abruptly to the bottom edge at the trigger moment — strong contrast against the surround plus motion make the panel the sole focus
As the wobble decays, attention transfers from the moving edge to the panel's contents, which become the final readable information
At rest the panel remains the visual terminus of the page without further motion pulling focus

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Scrolling is free in both directions at any time; no scroll capture, no forced pause
interaction_model.state_change: Page advances from quiet opening through low-density space until the panel's top edge reaches the lower window edge
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Progressive emptiness giving way to the high-contrast panel edge entering from below
interaction_model.input: Downward scrolling as the only required visitor action
interaction_model.affected_object: The sparse low-emphasis view and the position of the bottom panel relative to the viewport

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: The motion always resolves to the flat resting state; it never remains deformed or oscillating indefinitely
interaction_model.state_change: Boundary transitions from sagging-inward rest to an upward overshoot past level, then damped oscillation, then flat rest
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The edge springs up beyond the flat line and wobbles with visibly decreasing amplitude until it is straight
interaction_model.input: The instant the panel's top edge first reaches the lower window edge
interaction_model.affected_object: The panel's sagging upper boundary

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Both extremes end in the same flat rest; a faint ripple still reads as intentional life rather than a failed effect
interaction_model.state_change: Bounce intensity scales with how fast the visitor was moving: fast scrolling yields a stronger, tighter wobble; slow creeping yields only a faint ripple
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Visibly different amplitude and tightness of the same wobble, so the panel feels physically responsive to the visitor's own pace
interaction_model.input: Scroll speed at the trigger moment
interaction_model.affected_object: Character of the boundary's spring motion

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Re-arming is tied to crossing back above the trigger point, so lingering near the panel does not cause repeated firing
interaction_model.state_change: Effect re-arms on exit and fires a fresh full-strength bounce on the next arrival
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The panel feels just as lively on every revisit as it did the first time
interaction_model.input: Scrolling back up above the trigger point and then returning downward
interaction_model.affected_object: The panel's upper boundary

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Interruption is graceful: the edge continues from where it is into the new bounce and still ends flat
interaction_model.state_change: The new bounce cleanly replaces the running one instead of stacking or competing with it
interaction_model.visible_feedback: One single continuous edge motion at all times — never doubled, jittering, or fighting itself
interaction_model.input: A new trigger arriving while a previous wobble is still in motion
interaction_model.affected_object: The in-flight boundary motion

experience_qualities: Quiet, restrained, almost empty at the start
Anticipatory during the sparse middle stretch
Briefly elastic and physically alive at arrival rather than simply appearing
Playful and high-salience in sharp contrast to the restrained, minimal surround
Responsive — the motion reflects the visitor's own scroll pace
Calm and conclusive once settled
completion_and_return: Completes when the boundary rests flat and the panel reads as the settled end of the page
No looping while the visitor stays at the bottom; the rest state is stable and silent
Fully repeatable: exiting upward past the trigger point and returning replays the arrival at full liveliness
No persistent 'already seen' suppression — the effect does not degrade on later visits
locked_observable_requirements: The opening view is nearly empty with exactly one small line of guidance as the single readable item
The distinct panel is the terminal element and separates strongly from the surrounding field by a clear luminance and contrast step
Before arrival the panel's upper boundary visibly sags downward into the panel rather than being straight
The trigger is the exact moment the panel's top edge first meets the lower window edge
The boundary overshoots past level upward, wobbles with decaying amplitude, and ends perfectly flat
Bounce strength and tightness scale with scroll speed at the trigger moment, with a faint ripple at slow speeds
Leaving upward past the trigger point and returning produces a fresh bounce
A new bounce replaces any bounce still in motion, never stacking or conflicting
Scrolling downward is the only action required of the visitor
adaptable_details: Panel palette, hue relationships, and internal layout or contents, in either contrast direction, as long as the panel stays clearly separated from the surround and its contents stay readable
Wording of the single guidance line
Length of the sparse scroll stretch and total page height
Panel height and edge curvature depth at rest
Exact number of wobbles and settle duration
Whether the quiet field is flat or subtly textured, and its own tone, as long as it stays low-distraction
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits a single terminal or bottom-anchored region reached at the end of a sparse, low-density page, where one full-width edge can deform and the surrounding view stays quiet enough for the arrival to be the only event. It transfers to any surround tone and any panel content whose readability survives a brief edge deformation. It becomes a different Skill if the deformation is driven continuously by scroll position instead of firing as one discrete bounce, if many repeated sections each bounce on entry, if the panel captures or blocks scrolling, or if the surrounding view is dense enough that the arrival no longer reads as the sole payoff.

source_sites.title: Footer Bounce Based on Scroll Speed

name: mirrored_scatter_slide_exchange
description: One set at a time fills the view: attenuated pictures read as low-emphasis texture behind a short, crisply legible title, and edge arrows trigger a single decisive exchange in which the old letters and pictures scatter away while the new ones fly in from the mirrored side and settle.

canonical_document.name: mirrored_scatter_slide_exchange
canonical_document.description: One set at a time fills the view: attenuated pictures read as low-emphasis texture behind a short, crisply legible title, and edge arrows trigger a single decisive exchange in which the old letters and pictures scatter away while the new ones fly in from the mirrored side and settle.
canonical_document.experience_scope: A whole-view experience occupying the entire visible area from first arrival onward; one set always holds the view, and each exchange begins at an arrow activation and ends when the arriving set has fully settled into the same resting composition.
content_and_composition: Exactly one active set holds the view at any moment and fills it, with no sibling or adjacent set visible
Each set carries two content roles: a small fixed group of pictures (four in the source case) and one short title of a few words
Pictures sit as an attenuated lower layer, pushed down in contrast and emphasis so they read as texture rather than as items to inspect individually
The title sits above the pictures as the meaning-bearing layer and holds enough separation from them to stay legible at all times
Two persistent arrow markers, one backward and one forward, are pinned at the left and right edges and vertically centred, remaining in place across all sets and during exchanges
The ordered set list is a closed ring with no visible start or end boundary
experience_progression: Resting state: one set fully settled, pictures attenuated to texture, title legible and still
Activation: the standing set begins leaving as a whole — title letters break out of their lines and the pictures depart along separate diagonal paths while fading
Overlapping handoff: the arriving title's letters enter from the side opposite the departure while its pictures fly in from mirrored offsets
Settling: arriving pictures come to rest in the resting composition and the arriving title lines re-form into legible wording
Return to resting state, ready for the next activation in either direction
The sequence loops: stepping past either end continues around the ring indefinitely
attention_and_information_flow: The words hold semantic prominence throughout; the pictures stay subordinate as atmosphere even though they cover the full view
Because only one set is ever present, prominence never has to be split between competing items
Arrow markers stay quiet at the edges and only assert themselves when pointed at, nudging slightly toward their own direction
During an exchange, attention follows the coordinated outward and inward motion of letters and pictures, then resettles on the newly legible title
Direction of travel is communicated by motion itself: departure and arrival always come from opposite sides

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Withdrawing attention returns the marker to its neutral resting position; the nudge never affects the active set
interaction_model.state_change: Marker shifts from neutral to attended
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The marker nudges slightly toward the direction it represents
interaction_model.input: Pointing at either edge arrow marker
interaction_model.affected_object: The arrow marker under attention

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: The exchange always runs to completion and resolves into a fully settled set; direction chosen determines which side letters and pictures come from and go to
interaction_model.state_change: The view transitions from the standing set to the neighbouring set in the chosen direction as one unbroken exchange
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Standing title letters leave their lines and disperse while the pictures move away along separate diagonal paths and fade; the arriving title's letters enter from the opposite side and its pictures fly in from mirrored offsets and settle into place
interaction_model.input: Choosing the forward or backward arrow while a set is at rest
interaction_model.affected_object: The whole active set — its title letters and its group of pictures — plus the incoming set

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Control becomes available again as soon as the current exchange settles; the ignored activation is not queued or replayed
interaction_model.state_change: No new transition starts; the current one continues undisturbed
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Nothing additional happens on screen — no overlapping departures, no half-finished set, no visual stutter
interaction_model.input: Choosing any arrow again while an exchange is already running
interaction_model.affected_object: The in-progress exchange

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Reversal is always available and exact — one step back lands on the immediately preceding set, letting a viewer undo any step
interaction_model.state_change: The view steps back to the set just left
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The same exchange plays with departure and arrival sides mirrored, so the previous set returns from the direction it originally left toward
interaction_model.input: Choosing the opposite arrow after an exchange has settled
interaction_model.affected_object: The active set

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Both arrows stay usable at every position, so a viewer can keep going in one direction and eventually arrive back where they started
interaction_model.state_change: Position wraps around to the opposite end
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The exchange looks identical to any other step, with no edge stop, bounce or dead arrow
interaction_model.input: Continuing past the first or last set in either direction
interaction_model.affected_object: The ordered ring of sets

experience_qualities: Decisive and unbroken — a change reads as one exchange, not a queue shuffling past
Uncluttered and immersive, since a single set owns the whole view
Atmospheric, low-emphasis imagery paired with confidently legible wording
Symmetrical and directionally honest: forward and backward feel like mirror images of each other
Composed and glitch-free, never showing two overlapping or partially completed sets
Endless and non-punishing to explore, with free movement in either direction
completion_and_return: Each exchange completes in a fully settled resting composition identical in structure to the one it replaced
The sequence never terminates: it loops in both directions around a closed ring
Any step can be walked straight back by choosing the opposite arrow
Continuing in one direction eventually returns the viewer to the set they began with
The active position persists between exchanges; no automatic advance or reset occurs while at rest
locked_observable_requirements: Only one set is ever visible and it fills the view, with nothing competing for attention
Every set pairs a group of pictures held back as attenuated, low-contrast texture with one short title layered above and kept clearly legible against them
Stepping between sets is a single continuous exchange, never a queued or sliding train of neighbouring sets
Title change is letter-level: letters leave their lines outward and arriving letters enter from the opposite side before re-forming into readable lines
The picture group departs along separate diagonal paths while fading and arrives from mirrored offsets before settling
Departure and arrival directions are always mirrored and always follow the chosen direction of travel
Two arrow markers persist at the left and right edges, vertically centred, each nudging toward its own direction when pointed at
Activations during an exchange are ignored so nothing overlaps or half-finishes
Choosing the opposite arrow after a change returns exactly to the set just left
The order loops in both directions with no visible end
adaptable_details: Exact number of pictures per set, as long as it stays a small fixed group reading as texture
Resting arrangement of the pictures within the view
Direction and degree of attenuation, and any overlay treatment used to hold the title legible
Title length, wording, typeface, line count and placement within the view
Motion timing, easing, stagger order of letters and pictures, and diagonal angles
Arrow marker shape, size and nudge distance
Number of sets in the ring
Whether keyboard or other equivalent activation is offered alongside the arrows
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits any ordered sequence of short, self-contained statements where a few pictures supply mood and a handful of words carry the message — introductory views, chaptered showcases, or stepped highlight sequences. It stops being this Skill if multiple sets become visible at once or slide past as a strip, if the pictures become the readable focal content to be inspected individually rather than attenuated texture, if the title stops being short enough to re-form legibly as a whole, if the sequence gains hard ends instead of looping, or if changes are allowed to overlap and interrupt each other.

name: letter_by_letter_text_state_swap
description: A tall, almost empty view holds one oversized statement as the only thing to read; a single toggle sweeps its letters out one after another and draws the next text's letters in the same rippling order in the very same space, the overall ambient tone shifting to a different register as it settles and a picture arriving a beat behind the words, with the reverse motion returning to the opening statement and the original tone.

canonical_document.name: letter_by_letter_text_state_swap
canonical_document.description: A tall, almost empty view holds one oversized statement as the only thing to read; a single toggle sweeps its letters out one after another and draws the next text's letters in the same rippling order in the very same space, the overall ambient tone shifting to a different register as it settles and a picture arriving a beat behind the words, with the reverse motion returning to the opening statement and the original tone.
canonical_document.experience_scope: Whole-view, single-page experience. It begins with a short quiet hold on arrival before any lettering is readable, continues through repeated switches between two text states, and ends whenever the visitor is left resting on either settled state; the toggle control, the small identity mark and the ambient tone layer persist throughout.
content_and_composition: One oversized primary statement text: short, the sole readable element on arrival, centered in a tall, deliberately near-empty view.
One secondary body text (longer, descriptive) that occupies the exact same region of the view as the statement rather than sitting elsewhere on the page.
One supporting image belonging to the secondary text state, entering after the text and secondary to it in prominence.
One always-present toggle control whose wording describes the action it will next perform (open the second text, or close it again).
One small persistent identity mark that acts as a return affordance to the opening state.

One full-view ambient tone/background layer behind all text that shifts to a distinctly different tonal register with the active state while staying a low-distraction surround that keeps the lettering readable.
No competing panels, columns or secondary reading targets: emptiness is a composition element.
experience_progression: Quiet hold: the view is empty of readable lettering for a brief moment.
Opening reveal: the oversized statement lands as the only thing to read in the tall, sparse view.
Outgoing sweep: on activation, the letters of the currently visible text leave one after another in sequence.
Incoming draw: the letters of the arriving text appear in the same rippling order, in the same space the previous text occupied.
Settling: the overall page tone transitions to its second register as the second state comes to rest.
Delayed image: the picture arrives a beat behind the words rather than with them.
Reverse pass: the same movement runs in the opposite direction and ends on the opening statement.
attention_and_information_flow: Only one reading target exists at any moment; the other text is fully absent rather than dimmed or pushed aside.
Emptiness and scale keep prominence on the lettering itself; the sequential letter cadence pulls the eye along the text as it forms.
The image is deliberately subordinate: its late arrival lets the words be read first before the visual joins them.
The tone shift signals a change of subject at whole-view scale without adding anything to read.
The toggle's changing wording is the only place where the next step is stated.
Only the text that is actually visible accepts clicks, so the departed text never draws stray interaction.

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: The same control performs the reverse pass, and its wording updates to name the reversal so the visitor can always undo the switch
interaction_model.state_change: The active text state is exchanged for the other in the same space; the ambient tone moves to the register belonging to the newly active state and back again on reversal
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Current letters sweep out one after another, incoming letters draw in the same rippling order, the overall tone shifts to the other register as it settles, and the picture arrives a beat behind the words
interaction_model.input: Activating the always-present toggle
interaction_model.affected_object: The visible text, the arriving text, the ambient tone layer and the supporting image

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Repeated interruptions remain continuous; the experience always resolves into one of the two settled states
interaction_model.state_change: Direction reverses from the exact point the motion has currently reached
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Motion continues smoothly from wherever the letters currently stand, with no restart, jump or snap back to a start position
interaction_model.input: Activating the toggle again part-way through the motion
interaction_model.affected_object: The in-progress letter sweep

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Acting at the boundary is silently inert rather than error-like, so the mark can be pressed freely
interaction_model.state_change: Returns to the opening statement state when the second text is showing; no state change otherwise
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The same reverse letter movement plays, or nothing at all happens when the opening statement is already showing
interaction_model.input: Activating the small identity mark
interaction_model.affected_object: The active text state

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Prevents stray activation during and after a swap
interaction_model.state_change: None
interaction_model.visible_feedback: No response; only currently visible text reacts to clicks
interaction_model.input: Clicking on text that has already left the view
interaction_model.affected_object: Departed text

experience_qualities: Quiet, sparse and editorial, with emptiness read as intentional rather than unfinished
One continuous change of subject instead of a page load or navigation
Rippling, per-letter cadence that makes the writing feel handled rather than replaced
Settling tonal atmosphere whose shift into a second register is tied to the second state
Uninterruptible-feeling smoothness: the motion is always resumable and never snaps
Staged reading rhythm where words lead and the image follows
completion_and_return: Each pass completes into a stable settled state with the incoming text fully formed and the tone at rest in its register.
The reverse pass always ends on the opening statement, restoring the original sparse view and its starting tone.
Repeated toggling does not accumulate or reset state; the experience simply alternates between the two settled states.
The active state persists until the visitor acts again; nothing auto-advances after settling.
locked_observable_requirements: Both texts occupy the very same region of the view; they never coexist side by side.
Letters leave and arrive sequentially, one after another, in the same rippling order for outgoing and incoming text.
The change never looks like arriving at a new view or a fresh load.
A brief hold precedes the first appearance of any lettering.

The whole-view ambient tone shifts to a clearly distinguishable second register with the second state and transitions back to the first register on the return, in both cases remaining a low-distraction surround with readable contrast against the lettering.
The supporting image arrives a measurable beat after its text, never simultaneously.
The single toggle is always present and its wording names the reversal it will perform.
Re-triggering mid-motion continues from the current visual position without restarting or snapping.
Only currently visible text is clickable.
The return path ends on the opening statement.
adaptable_details: Duration and direction of the letter stagger, and whether letters rise, fall or drift as they leave
Length of the opening hold
Typeface, letter scale and exact vertical proportions of the tall view
Which hues and luminance direction the two tonal registers use and how strongly the tone shifts between them
Shape, placement and size of the supporting image, and the exact size of its delay
Placement and wording of the toggle and the identity mark
Whether the second state's text is one block or a few short paragraphs
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits pages built around two short-to-medium written states where one is a single large statement and the other is a modest body text with at most one supporting image in a sparse full-view layout. It transfers to intros, about sections, quotes and single-claim landing views regardless of subject matter or host palette, since the tonal shift is defined by the separation between two registers rather than by any particular hue. Replacing letter-level sequential motion with whole-block fades or slides, adding many simultaneous text states, or filling the view with dense multi-column or long-scroll content would break the cadence and emptiness that define it and create a different skill.

source_sites.title: Making Stagger Reveal Animations for Text

name: melting_label_to_metadata_swap_list
description: A sparse list of a few huge text labels; the pointed-at label swells into thick fused rounded shapes, melts down, and its date rises out of that same mass and settles crisp, while the other labels stay quiet and readable.

canonical_document.name: melting_label_to_metadata_swap_list
canonical_document.description: A sparse list of a few huge text labels; the pointed-at label swells into thick fused rounded shapes, melts down, and its date rises out of that same mass and settles crisp, while the other labels stay quiet and readable.
canonical_document.experience_scope: A self-contained region that can occupy a whole otherwise-empty view: it begins when the small set of large labels appears together as one block of readable text and ends either when the pointer leaves and every label has resolved back to its name, or when a label is chosen and the visitor is carried to its destination.
content_and_composition: One flat list of a small number of entries (roughly three to six), presented as the sole foreground content on near-empty space
Each entry carries two text values occupying the same slot: a primary name and a secondary short value (here a date)
Each entry also carries one destination, exposed only through activation rather than as separate visible chrome
The secondary value never has its own space in the layout; it appears where the name was, so the list's footprint and rhythm stay stable
No supporting panels, thumbnails, captions, icons or decorative layers compete with the type; emptiness is part of the composition
Entries sit in a single stacked column-like reading order with generous void around and between them
All labels arrive as one complete, already-shaped set rather than appearing piecemeal or reflowing after arrival
experience_progression: Resting state: every entry shows its name, sharp and fully legible
Onset: the pointed-at entry's name thickens and swells, its letters spreading until their edges touch and fuse into one continuous rounded mass
Middle: the fused mass thins and drains away, losing its identity as the former name
Emergence: the secondary value forms out of that same mass, tightening from soft blobs into distinct characters
Settle: the secondary value comes to rest sharp and still, holding as long as the pointer stays
Release: the same stages run in reverse from whatever point was reached, ending on the crisp original name
attention_and_information_flow: Attention rests on exactly one entry at a time; only the pointed-at entry is in motion
Non-targeted entries remain calm and fully readable and are never reduced in contrast to the point of illegibility or pushed around
The revealed secondary information is earned per entry, so the list stays a set of names at rest and becomes informative only where the visitor is looking
Motion itself is the emphasis cue; no separate highlight, underline, badge or tooltip is needed
Because the swap is in-place, the eye stays on the same line rather than tracking to a detail area

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Progress is tracked continuously rather than as a discrete on/off, so the motion can be caught and reversed at any point
interaction_model.state_change: Entry moves from resting name state forward through the fuse-melt-emerge sequence toward the settled secondary value
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Letters visibly thicken, bleed together into a single rounded mass, thin away, then the date rises out of the mass and sharpens into place
interaction_model.input: Pointer enters an entry's area
interaction_model.affected_object: That entry's text slot (name becoming secondary value)

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Always resolves to the readable name; interruption is a normal path, not an error state, and repeated fast entries and exits never leave a half-melted or blank label
interaction_model.state_change: Sequence runs backwards from its exact current position back to the resting name state
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The same liquid motion played in reverse with no jump, snap or restart; a quick pass simply returns to the crisp name
interaction_model.input: Pointer leaves an entry, including mid-transformation
interaction_model.affected_object: That entry's text slot

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: No shared or global state; one entry's motion never cancels, resets or delays another's
interaction_model.state_change: Each entry advances or reverses on its own, so several can be at different points of the sequence at once
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Trailing entries visibly unwind back to their names while the newly targeted entry begins to swell
interaction_model.input: Pointer moves across several entries in succession
interaction_model.affected_object: Each entry independently

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Returning to the view finds the list intact; on the pointer leaving, the activated entry resolves back to its name as usual
interaction_model.state_change: Destination opens in a new tab while the list view is left standing
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The current view and the entry's transformation state are preserved rather than replaced
interaction_model.input: Activating an entry
interaction_model.affected_object: The entry's destination

experience_qualities: Tactile and liquid rather than mechanical or stepped
Soft, thick, rounded weight at the peak of the change, contrasted with sharp stillness at both ends
Quiet and stark overall, with motion confined to a single entry
Reversible and forgiving, so casual pointer movement never produces visual damage
Legibility-first: every state that lingers is readable text at full contrast against its surround, never permanent abstraction
completion_and_return: The forward sequence completes at the settled secondary value and holds without looping
The list always resolves back to its readable names once the pointer is away from every entry
No entry retains a transformed state after the pointer leaves; the resting state is the canonical one
The list view persists through activation rather than being torn down
locked_observable_requirements: Two text values share one slot; the second replaces the first in place with no layout shift
The transition passes through a genuinely fused, thickened, rounded mass where individual letters lose their separation
The second value must be seen emerging out of that same mass rather than cross-fading, sliding in or appearing beside it
Both endpoints are fully sharp, still and legible text, clearly separated from the surround
Reversal starts from the exact reached point of the motion, with no jump, snap or reset
Only the targeted entry animates; the others stay legible and unmoved
Entries transform independently and may be at different points simultaneously
The surrounding view stays sparse and low-distraction so the type carries the composition
Labels appear as one complete set, never partially formed or mid-swap on arrival
adaptable_details: Number of entries, exact type size, weight range and letter shapes
Hue choices, contrast level and surround treatment, in either a light or dark register, as long as the text-to-surround separation stays readable through every stage
Duration and easing of the swell, melt and emergence stages
What the secondary value is (date, category, role, count, short label)
Alignment and spacing of the list, and whether it fills the viewport or sits inside a larger page
Whether activation opens a new context or navigates in place
How keyboard focus or touch is mapped onto the same forward and reverse sequence
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits short single-line labels paired with one short secondary value, in a sparse region where the type is the primary content and each entry leads somewhere. It does not fit long strings, wrapping multi-line text, or dense lists where the huge type and per-entry quiet cannot be maintained. Replacing the fused-mass morph with a fade, slide, mask, scramble or split-flap change, letting the secondary value occupy its own space beside the name, animating all entries at once, or making reversal snap or restart each produce a different Skill.

name: scroll_locked_wipe_before_after
description: A short lead-in line sets up the comparison, then an image pair locks at screen center and a crisp vertical edge sweeps across it as you scroll, uncovering the newer version behind the older one and leaving the finished version in view.

canonical_document.name: scroll_locked_wipe_before_after
canonical_document.description: A short lead-in line sets up the comparison, then an image pair locks at screen center and a crisp vertical edge sweeps across it as you scroll, uncovering the newer version behind the older one and leaving the finished version in view.
canonical_document.experience_scope: A self-contained region within a normally scrolling page: it begins with a brief lead-in above the pair, takes over the viewport once the pair reaches screen center, and ends when the sweep is fully complete or fully rewound and the page resumes normal scrolling.
content_and_composition: One short self-explanatory lead-in text block preceding the visual, read before the comparison starts
Exactly two full-frame images of the same scene at identical framing and scale, stacked in perfect alignment so any pixel maps to the same place in both
Older version visible on top at the start; newer version underneath, revealed progressively
One crisp vertical reveal edge spanning the full frame height, the only moving element
The pair occupies the dominant visual area and is centered vertically while locked, with no competing foreground content during the sweep
Ordinary page content continues below the region
experience_progression: Lead-in is read while the page scrolls normally, establishing what is being compared
The image pair rises to the middle of the screen and locks there, taking over attention
Continued scrolling sweeps the vertical edge across the frame, uncovering the newer version proportionally and continuously
The sweep reaches full completion with only the newer version visible
The region releases and the page scrolls on, the finished version left in view as it exits
attention_and_information_flow: Attention moves from explanatory text to a single held visual, then narrows to the traveling edge
Information is revealed strictly along the edge position: only the already-swept portion shows the newer version, the rest still shows the older one
Both versions are simultaneously legible on either side of the edge, so differences read at the boundary rather than by memory
Prominence peaks while the pair is locked and decays once the page resumes normal flow

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Locking happens only at the centered position; scrolling back before or after the sequence returns the region to normal page flow
interaction_model.state_change: Region transitions from flowing with the page to locked at screen center
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The pair stops moving and holds steady in the middle of the viewport while the page appears to pause around it
interaction_model.input: Downward vertical scrolling that brings the pair to the middle of the screen
interaction_model.affected_object: The image pair region and page scrolling

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Motion is entirely scroll-bound; stopping scrolling freezes the edge exactly where it stands with no drift, settle or auto-advance
interaction_model.state_change: Reveal progress advances continuously in proportion to scroll distance
interaction_model.visible_feedback: A crisp vertical edge sweeps across the frame, the newer version appearing behind it while the older version remains on the unswept side, with no fading or jumping
interaction_model.input: Continued downward scrolling while locked
interaction_model.affected_object: Vertical reveal edge and the visibility of the newer version

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Fully reversible at any point and any speed; direction can be changed mid-sweep without losing position
interaction_model.state_change: Reveal progress decreases along the same continuous path
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The edge travels back the other way, re-covering the newer version with the older one at the same rate
interaction_model.input: Upward scrolling while locked
interaction_model.affected_object: Vertical reveal edge and the visibility of the newer version

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Re-entering the region re-locks it and resumes the sweep from the boundary state it was released at, so the experience can be replayed in either direction
interaction_model.state_change: Region unlocks and normal document scrolling resumes
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The pair begins moving with the page again, showing the fully revealed newer version when released forward or the original older version when released backward
interaction_model.input: Reaching full reveal or full rewind
interaction_model.affected_object: Page scrolling and the region lock

experience_qualities: Continuous and unhurried rather than a sudden swap
Steady and stable: the pair does not shift, scale or wobble while locked
Precisely aligned, making differences read instantly at the boundary
Fully user-paced, with the reader owning speed, pausing and direction
Single-focus and calm, one clear visual idea holding the whole screen
completion_and_return: Completion is the fully swept frame showing only the newer version, which stays in view as the page carries on
Full rewind returns the frame to the original older version and releases scrolling upward
No looping and no automatic replay; state persists at whatever edge position the reader left it while the region remains engaged
locked_observable_requirements: Two versions of the same subject held in exact alignment and identical framing throughout
A single crisp vertical reveal edge as the only moving element, with a hard boundary rather than a blend
Reveal progress bound proportionally to scroll distance in both directions, never time-driven
The pair stays locked and centered for the entire duration of the sweep
Stopping leaves the edge exactly in place; reversing retraces the same path
Scroll release occurs only at full completion or full rewind
A short explanatory lead-in precedes the comparison so its purpose is clear before it begins
The finished version remains visible after release
adaptable_details: Subject matter of the paired visuals
Wording and styling of the lead-in text
Frame aspect ratio and how much of the viewport the pair occupies
Sweep travel direction across the frame and scroll distance required to complete it
Optional visual treatment of the edge itself, such as thickness or a marker, as long as it stays crisp
Surrounding page content above and below the region
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits any pair of visuals captured or rendered at the same framing where the message is what changed between them, presented as one focal region in a scrolling page. Replacing scroll control with a draggable handle, autoplay or timed transition, using a soft cross-fade instead of a hard traveling edge, comparing more than two versions or unaligned different subjects, or letting the pair scroll freely instead of locking would each create a different Skill.

name: oversized_name_row_to_photo_plunge_arrival
description: An entry screen showing one giant row of section names spilling past both screen edges with only the middle name clearly alive; pressing it triggers a seconds-long plunge through full-bleed photographs that ends with that name standing alone above a scattered photo collage.

canonical_document.name: oversized_name_row_to_photo_plunge_arrival
canonical_document.description: An entry screen showing one giant row of section names spilling past both screen edges with only the middle name clearly alive; pressing it triggers a seconds-long plunge through full-bleed photographs that ends with that name standing alone above a scattered photo collage.
canonical_document.experience_scope: Whole-view experience. Begins at first arrival on the entry screen during a short waiting pause and ends when the destination section view has fully settled; it runs once per arrival and is not re-enterable from the destination.
content_and_composition: One oversized horizontal row of short section names, sized far larger than body text and laid out wider than the viewport so the row extends beyond both edges
Exactly one name occupies the visual middle and reads as fully alive: highest contrast, fully legible, the only pressable label
Two or more outer names remain dimmed and are cropped by the left and right screen edges, present as context rather than as offers
A brief non-interactive waiting state covering the entry view until the photographs are ready
A dense set of full-bleed photographs that exist only as transition material, layered and sequenced to fill the screen edge to edge
Destination composition: the chosen name alone as the section title, held above a scattered collage of multiple photo tiles in irregular placement
A quiet persistent hint at the lower edge indicating that content continues below the destination view
experience_progression: Waiting pause: entry view visible but inert until the photographs finish loading
Entry state: the row becomes live, the middle name clearly alive, outer names dimmed and edge-cropped
Press on the live name: the layered photo sweep starts immediately and takes over the whole view
Plunge: full-bleed photographs pass in a fast, dense, seconds-long burst that plays to its end on its own
Mid-sweep swap: the arrangement underneath is exchanged while covered, so the destination is already assembled behind the last frames
Reveal: the final full-screen photograph splits open and the collage tiles rise into place beneath the isolated title
Settled arrival: the destination holds, the names no longer accept presses, and the continuation hint invites downward movement
attention_and_information_flow: Attention is first suspended by the waiting pause, so no choice is presented before the media can support it
The oversized row concentrates attention on a single alive middle name while the dimmed cropped outer names communicate that a larger set exists without competing as targets
During the plunge, attention is pulled fully to imagery: text and interface recede and photographs carry the whole frame
The split-open reveal transfers attention from the moving imagery to the now-isolated title, which becomes the only text in view
After arrival the collage spreads attention outward across tiles, and the lower-edge hint moves it downward toward the continuing content

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: The gate clears automatically once the photographs are ready; presses before that produce nothing and are simply ignored rather than queued
interaction_model.state_change: View is held in a short waiting state where nothing is pressable
interaction_model.visible_feedback: A brief holding pause on the entry screen with no reactive response to input
interaction_model.input: Arrival on the entry view before media is ready
interaction_model.affected_object: Entire entry view including the oversized name row

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Committing is intentional and single-shot; only the alive name accepts the press, and dimmed outer names do not respond
interaction_model.state_change: Entry state ends and the transition sequence begins immediately
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The name row is overtaken by full-bleed photographs sweeping across the screen
interaction_model.input: Press on the alive middle name
interaction_model.affected_object: Whole view: name row plus the layered photograph stack

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Further input neither speeds, slows nor redirects the sweep; it always plays through to its own end so the view cannot be left half-transitioned
interaction_model.state_change: The sweep advances through its stages on its own, swapping the underlying arrangement part-way
interaction_model.visible_feedback: A fast, dense, cinematic run of full-screen photographs that reads as a plunge rather than a wait, ending in the final frame splitting open
interaction_model.input: Autonomous playback after commitment
interaction_model.affected_object: Layered photograph sweep and the arrangement hidden beneath it

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Arrival is final within the visit: there is no replay path back into the entry sequence, and the settled destination is the stable resting state
interaction_model.state_change: Destination settles and the entry choice becomes permanently inert
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Collage tiles rise into place beneath the lone title, and the names no longer react to presses
interaction_model.input: Sequence completion
interaction_model.affected_object: Destination title, collage tiles and the name row

experience_qualities: Cinematic and momentum-driven: the passage feels like being pulled inward, not like navigating
Fast and decisive, measured in seconds so it never registers as loading
Oversized and confident typography that treats section names as poster-scale objects
Deliberately partial: cropped, dimmed outer names create a sense of a larger world just off-screen
Image-saturated during transit and calm, curated and composed on arrival
Unmistakable finality: the arrival reads as a destination rather than an intermediate state
completion_and_return: Completes when the collage has risen and the title stands alone; no looping
The entry sequence is one-way and non-replayable once the destination has settled
The destination persists as the ongoing view, with continuation below the fold as the intended next move
No reset control is offered from the arrived state
locked_observable_requirements: A single oversized row of section names that visibly overflows both screen edges
Exactly one visually alive, pressable name in the middle with dimmed, edge-cropped neighbors
No interactive response at all until the photographs are ready
A layered full-bleed photograph sweep that plays through autonomously and ignores further input once started
A mid-sweep exchange of the underlying arrangement while it is fully covered, so the destination is never seen assembling from an empty state
The last full-screen photograph splitting open as the reveal moment
Collage tiles rising into place beneath the chosen name presented alone as the title
A quiet hint of continuing content below the settled destination
Names permanently inert after arrival so the sequence cannot be replayed
adaptable_details: Number and wording of section names, and how many outer names are visible when cropped
Exact photograph count, subjects, ordering and layering rhythm of the sweep
Total sweep duration within a seconds-long range, and easing character
Collage tile count, sizes and scatter pattern
Typeface, color treatment and dimming intensity of the outer names
Visual form of the waiting pause and of the lower-edge continuation hint
Direction and axis along which the final photograph splits open
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits image-rich sites with a small set of short, poster-scale section names and enough photographic material to fill a full-screen transition and a destination collage. It transfers to portfolio, editorial, campaign and story entrances. It becomes a different Skill if the row turns into a browsable, freely scrollable multi-choice selector, if the transition becomes interruptible or scrub-driven, if the destination arrival is repeatable and reversible as ordinary navigation, or if the transition material is not full-bleed imagery.

name: scroll_traced_arcing_quote_pass
description: Short quote lettering that enters from beyond one screen edge, travels along a curved path as you scroll, smears when you scroll fast, resolves crisp when you slow, and exits past the opposite edge near the top of the view.

canonical_document.name: scroll_traced_arcing_quote_pass
canonical_document.description: Short quote lettering that enters from beyond one screen edge, travels along a curved path as you scroll, smears when you scroll fast, resolves crisp when you slow, and exits past the opposite edge near the top of the view.
canonical_document.experience_scope: Region experience occupying the transitional band between two content blocks; begins when the quote band rises into view and ends when its lettering has passed beyond the opposite edge near the top of the view. Multiple independent instances can appear in one page.
content_and_composition: One short quote fragment per instance, set as a single line or small group of lettering
A curved travel path spanning the full width of the view, with both ends extending beyond the screen edges so entry and exit are off-frame
Open transitional space around the path so the lettering never collides with adjacent reading text or imagery
Surrounding content blocks remain visible and static during the pass, acting as the frame for the moving lettering
Path geometry aligned to the viewport rather than to a fixed pixel canvas
experience_progression: Approach: quote band nears the view and lettering waits beyond one screen edge
Entry: lettering slides onto the curve from off-frame as the band rises
Traverse: lettering continues along the arc in step with scroll, reaching peak legibility mid-view
Exit: lettering leaves past the opposite edge near the top of the view
Reversal is available at any stage by scrolling upward
attention_and_information_flow: The moving lettering claims attention briefly through motion rather than size or weight
The quote is fully legible only during the mid-path portion of its travel, making the reading window itself part of the effect
Legibility becomes a live indicator of scroll speed: fast scrolling smears the lettering, easing off resolves it crisply
Attention returns to adjacent static content once the lettering has exited
No additional information is disclosed beyond the quote itself

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Travel is fully bound to scroll position; there is no autonomous playback that can run away from the reader
interaction_model.state_change: Lettering advances along the arc from off-frame entry toward off-frame exit past the opposite edge near the top of the view
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Lettering glides along the curve, trailing the scroll slightly so it feels weighted rather than pinned
interaction_model.input: Downward vertical scrolling while the quote band is in view
interaction_model.affected_object: Quote lettering on its curved path

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Resuming scroll continues travel from the settled position with no jump or restart
interaction_model.state_change: Trailing motion decays to a settled rest position matching current scroll
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Lettering glides to a stop and holds still and crisp at its current point on the curve
interaction_model.input: Stopping scroll mid-pass
interaction_model.affected_object: Quote lettering

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Easing off restores crisp letterforms progressively; the smear never persists once motion slows
interaction_model.state_change: Lettering enters a smeared, motion-blurred state proportional to speed
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Letterforms streak along the direction of travel and become less legible
interaction_model.input: Fast scrolling
interaction_model.affected_object: Quote lettering rendering

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Reversal can be initiated at any point mid-pass; position stays continuous with scroll without snapping
interaction_model.state_change: Travel reverses along the identical path back toward the original entry edge
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The same arc is retraced in reverse with the same trailing and settling behavior
interaction_model.input: Upward scrolling
interaction_model.affected_object: Quote lettering on its curved path

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Current progress along the pass is preserved rather than reset
interaction_model.state_change: Path span and lettering position recompute to the new viewport
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Alignment with the screen edges and surrounding content stays correct, with entry and exit still occurring off-frame
interaction_model.input: Viewport resize or orientation change
interaction_model.affected_object: Curved path and lettering placement

experience_qualities: Physical and weighted, as if the lettering has inertia
Speed-responsive, rewarding slow scrolling with clarity
Fluid and continuous, never stepped or snapped
Momentary and airy, an accent rather than a destination
Fully reversible and reader-controlled
completion_and_return: Completes when the lettering has passed beyond the opposite edge near the top of the view
No looping or replay while off-frame; re-entry happens only by scrolling back
Reversing restores the earlier stages of the pass exactly, so the effect can be replayed indefinitely by scrolling
locked_observable_requirements: Travel follows a curved path, not a straight horizontal or vertical slide
Lettering enters from beyond one screen edge and exits beyond the opposite edge near the top of the view
Position along the path is bound to scroll position in both directions
Motion trails the scroll slightly and glides to rest when scrolling stops
Fast scrolling smears the lettering and slowing resolves it crisp again
Upward scrolling retraces the identical path
Alignment stays correct across viewport sizes with entry and exit remaining off-frame
adaptable_details: Curvature amount and direction of the arc
Which screen edge is the entry side
Quote length, typeface, size and color treatment
Amount of trailing lag and smear intensity
How many instances appear and how far apart they are placed
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits short quoted or slogan-length text placed in open transitional space between heavier content blocks in a scrolled view. Long paragraphs, text that must stay continuously readable, layouts with no free space around the path, or advancement driven by clicks, hover or timed playback would create a different Skill.

name: creased_sheet_type_scroller
description: Oversized words travel up one continuous creased surface, flat and legible only across a centered band while the stretches above and below tilt away into depth, driven purely by vertical scrolling with weightless trailing motion and clean stops at the first and last line.

canonical_document.name: creased_sheet_type_scroller
canonical_document.description: Oversized words travel up one continuous creased surface, flat and legible only across a centered band while the stretches above and below tilt away into depth, driven purely by vertical scrolling with weightless trailing motion and clean stops at the first and last line.
canonical_document.experience_scope: Whole-view experience occupying the full viewport from a brief opening hold through the final line; it begins when the typefaces settle and the words appear, and ends when scrolling clamps at the last line. No other view region competes with it.
content_and_composition: One long ordered run of short text items, each item a single oversized word or phrase rendered as its own line
One horizontal band across the middle of the view where lines sit flat, upright and fully legible, with the type clearly separated from the surface it sits on
Two angled bands, one above and one below the middle band, which are continuations of the same surface tilting away into depth so their lines foreshorten and lose legibility with distance

A visible crease where the flat band meets each angled stretch, readable as a change in surface orientation and shading rather than as a border; a line crossing it continues without a seam or gap onto the receding surface
The flat band, the crease positions and the depth framing are persistent; only the type moves through them
Definite first and last lines that read as the start and end of the run rather than an endless field
experience_progression: Quiet hold at open with nothing advancing while the typefaces settle into place
Words appear on the surface, establishing an obvious starting point at the first line
Continuous advance under scrolling: each word rises out of depth into the flat readable band, then bends over the crease and recedes on the far stretch
Advance is unbroken and repeatable in both directions across the whole run, with no chapters or interruptions
Arrival at a definite final line where forward motion ends
attention_and_information_flow: Legibility is the attention device: only the centered band delivers readable text, so the eye stays fixed at one place on screen while content streams through it
Prominence rises as a word approaches the band and falls as it tilts past the crease, giving each item a single peak moment of clarity
Words above and below register as context and volume of remaining content rather than as readable information, their contrast falling off with depth
Reaching the first or last line makes the extent of the run legible as a boundary rather than as more content

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Scroll input taken from the start of the run once the words are present; the opening hold is short and does not repeat
interaction_model.state_change: Idle settling state resolves into the composed starting state at the first line
interaction_model.visible_feedback: A brief quiet hold with no advance, then the words present themselves on the surface
interaction_model.input: Page load with no user input
interaction_model.affected_object: The type run and its surface

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: No other input drives the type; scrolling can be resumed at any time from the current position
interaction_model.state_change: Position along the run advances or retreats, all three bands shifting by exactly the same amount
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Words rise into the flat band, read clearly, then bend over the crease and recede; a word leaving the middle continues without a break onto the surface past the crease
interaction_model.input: Vertical scrolling only, by wheel turn or touch drag
interaction_model.affected_object: The flat middle band and both angled bands as one linked surface

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: A new gesture during the coast takes over immediately without a stall
interaction_model.state_change: Motion lags the input slightly, then decays to rest after the gesture ends
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Type trails the gesture rather than tracking it exactly, and coasts smoothly to a standstill instead of snapping
interaction_model.input: Continuing or stopping a gesture
interaction_model.affected_object: Advance of the whole surface

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Reversal is available at any point and needs no completion of the prior motion
interaction_model.state_change: Travel turns back at once
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Words immediately descend back toward and through the readable band, retracing the surface
interaction_model.input: Reversing scroll direction mid-motion
interaction_model.affected_object: Direction of travel along the run

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Scrolling in the opposite direction resumes travel instantly from the clamped boundary
interaction_model.state_change: Position clamps at the first or last line
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Motion stops cleanly at the boundary line with no overshoot, bounce or drift into empty surface
interaction_model.input: Scrolling past the beginning or the end of the run
interaction_model.affected_object: Position along the run

experience_qualities: Weightless and unbroken travel
Centered, steady attention with a single readable zone
Physical sense of one folded sheet rather than separate stacked panels
Calm, deliberate opening
Firm, non-elastic ends
completion_and_return: Completion is arrival at the definite final line, where forward travel simply stops
No looping or wrap-around back to the first line
Returning is done by scrolling back through the same continuous run
Current position along the run persists while the view stays open; the opening hold is not replayed on ordinary reversal
locked_observable_requirements: Vertical scrolling is the only driver of the type
Exactly one centered flat band is fully legible; stretches above and below tilt away into depth
Flat and angled bands move by exactly the same amount so a line crosses the crease with no break or discontinuity
Oversized single-line type as the primary visual material, held at readable contrast against its surface in the flat band
Motion trails input and coasts to rest after the gesture stops
Direction reversal takes effect immediately
Hard clamp at the first and last line with no overshoot into emptiness
A brief quiet hold before the words appear
An obvious starting point and a definite final line
adaptable_details: Number of items in the run and their wording
Typeface choices, weights, casing and any color or tonal treatment, so long as the type stays clearly readable against the surface in the flat band
Height of the readable band and the tilt angle of the receding stretches
Length of the opening hold and the exact manner in which the words first appear
How much trailing and how long the coast lasts
Surface and surround treatment, including its lightness and any static framing around the surface, kept low-distraction relative to the type
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits long ordered runs of short single-line text items where one item at a time should be read, such as word or typeface showcases, name indexes, chapter or section lists and chronologies. It stops being this Skill if items become multi-line blocks, images or cards that must be legible off the flat band, if the driving axis becomes horizontal or free camera movement, if the run loops endlessly or overshoots elastically at the ends, or if the angled stretches stop being continuations of the same surface and read as separate panels.
