name: staged_particle_mesh_explainer
description: A whole-view field of drifting dots and proximity lines that a seven-notch slider walks from the plainest few dots to a dense shimmering mesh, one caption line per stage, the motion continuing uninterrupted through every change, with the final stage letting the pointer widen the linking distance and raise the dot count live.

canonical_document.name: staged_particle_mesh_explainer
canonical_document.description: A whole-view field of drifting dots and proximity lines that a seven-notch slider walks from the plainest few dots to a dense shimmering mesh, one caption line per stage, the motion continuing uninterrupted through every change, with the final stage letting the pointer widen the linking distance and raise the dot count live.
canonical_document.experience_scope: A single continuous region-or-whole-view experience: it begins already running at the plainest stage as soon as the view is seen, persists as one uninterrupted animated surface for the entire visit, and has no terminal end state other than the final complete stage, which remains open-ended under pointer control.
content_and_composition: One continuously animating visual surface filling the view: many small drifting dots plus lines drawn between dots that are near each other, ranging from a sparse handful to a dense shimmering mesh depending on stage.
Exactly one short caption line visible at a time, in everyday non-technical words, naming what the current stage adds rather than describing the whole effect.
One horizontal slider with seven discrete positions, seated near the bottom edge, overlaid on the visual and persistent across all stages.
Layering: the animated field is the substrate of the region; caption and slider sit above it as the only persistent foreground elements, kept sparse so the field stays readable.
Stage count and slider position count are the same, so every notch is one stage and no stage is unreachable.
experience_progression: Opens on the plainest version of the effect: a few slowly drifting dots, with its caption naming that starting element.
Each later stage is visibly the previous picture plus one addition, so the accumulation reads as one learnable sequence rather than seven separate demos.
Middle stages progressively increase what is on screen and how the elements relate, moving from bare drifting dots toward connected structure.
Stage seven stands as the finished result: the full dense connected mesh, presented as the destination of the sequence.
Progression is non-consuming and bidirectional: earlier stages remain permanently available and look the same when returned to.
Only the final stage adds a second layer of progression, where the viewer's own pointer movement continuously reshapes the finished result.
attention_and_information_flow: Attention rests on the animated field; the caption is the only text and is short enough to read in one glance before returning to the visual.
On each stage change the caption swap and the newly appearing visual element are the two things that draw the eye, making the difference between stages self-evident.
Information is revealed one addition at a time, so complexity that would be unreadable if shown at once becomes legible in sequence.
The slider advertises how many stages exist and where the viewer currently is, so remaining depth is visible without explanation.
On the final stage attention shifts from reading captions to the viewer's own cursor, as the field visibly answers every movement.

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Never pauses, blanks or restarts for any reason, including stage changes; there is no start or stop state for the viewer to manage
interaction_model.state_change: Dots continuously drift and change position; links form and dissolve as pairs come within and pass out of linking range
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Perpetual slow motion and a shimmering, never-static surface, even when the viewer does nothing
interaction_model.input: Autonomous animation driver running at all times
interaction_model.affected_object: The dot field and the lines between nearby dots

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Fully reversible at any moment: sliding back returns to any earlier stage by the same in-place reconfiguration, with no penalty, replay or waiting; the visual identity of each stage is stable across repeat visits
interaction_model.state_change: Jumps straight to that stage's configuration rather than stepping through intervening stages; caption swaps to that stage's matching line
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The field reconfigures in place while still moving, elements appearing or dropping away without the surface going blank or resetting to a fresh start; the new caption reads as the description of what is now on screen
interaction_model.input: Moving the slider handle to any one of the seven discrete positions, in either direction
interaction_model.affected_object: The whole visual configuration plus the caption line

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Continuous and instantly reversible by moving back; the field keeps running at whatever value the pointer leaves it at, and stepping to an earlier stage with the slider hands control back to the staged presentation
interaction_model.state_change: The linking distance widens toward one side and tightens toward the other
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The mesh visibly thickens into a broadly interconnected web or thins toward loose, mostly unconnected dots, following the cursor without steps or delay
interaction_model.input: Pointer horizontal position, active on the final stage only, tracked continuously
interaction_model.affected_object: How far apart two dots may be and still be joined by a line

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Continuous and reversible by moving back; changes never empty the field to nothing or overwhelm it past readability, and the motion continues throughout
interaction_model.state_change: The participating population rises or falls
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The field visibly crowds toward a dense shimmering mass or empties toward a sparse scatter, changing smoothly as the cursor moves
interaction_model.input: Pointer vertical position, active on the final stage only, tracked continuously
interaction_model.affected_object: How many dots take part in the field

experience_qualities: Uninterrupted and alive: one motion that never breaks, so stage changes feel like the same thing transforming rather than new things loading.
Legible: each stage differs from the last by one visible thing, described in plain words.
Unhurried and self-paced: nothing advances on its own, and no stage expires.
Playful at the end: the finished stage feels like an instrument responding to the hand.
Sparse and calm in the foreground, with a single caption and single control against a busy but low-contrast, non-competing visual.
completion_and_return: The final stage is the completion of the sequence but not a dead end: it remains indefinitely interactive under the pointer.
No stage is consumed or locked; every earlier stage stays available and reachable at any time from any other stage.
There is no reset, replay or dismissal step, because the animation is never stopped or cleared.
The current stage and the current pointer-driven values persist as the standing state until the viewer changes them.
locked_observable_requirements: Stages are cumulative: each is visibly the previous picture plus one addition, never an unrelated alternative demo.
The opening state is the plainest, sparsest version of the effect.
Exactly one short plain-language caption is shown at a time, naming what the current stage adds.
Stage selection is discrete with one control position per stage, and is freely bidirectional with direct jumps to any stage.
The animation keeps running through every stage change: no blanking, no restarting, no reload gap.
The last stage is the complete effect and is the only stage that grants pointer control.
The two pointer axes drive two independent, visibly distinct density properties of the field, tracked continuously rather than in steps.
The control sits near one edge, overlaid on the visual, so the visual is never pushed aside by interface.
adaptable_details: The exact number of stages, as long as control positions match stage count and each stage remains one visible addition.
The specific wording of captions and their placement relative to the control.

Dot size, hue, luminosity, line weight, drift speed and surround tone, in any direction of luminance, as long as dots and links stay clearly separated from the surround and the caption and control stay readable over the field.
Which side of each pointer axis increases versus decreases the property.
The visual styling of the discrete control and whether stage positions carry short labels.
Whether the region is a full viewport or a bounded panel inside a longer page.
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits any generative or animated visual whose construction genuinely decomposes into cumulative visible layers, and any showcase where the finished layered result has one or two continuously tunable density-like properties; content beyond the field itself must stay minimal, since the experience carries only one caption line and one control. Presenting the stages as separate side-by-side or independently restarting demos, making stages non-cumulative alternatives, allowing the motion to blank or restart between stages, replacing the discrete stage control with automatic timed advance, or giving pointer control to every stage instead of only the finished one would each produce a different Skill.

name: fixed_frame_chaptered_scroll_journey
description: A full-view scene that fades up from a blank, evenly toned ground onto a title and one opening line, then travels through six numbered chapters of alternating image and passage across multiple screens of scrolling, with layered depth, easing lag and flick-induced warping and channel-splitting colour fringing, ending on a single closing line.

canonical_document.name: fixed_frame_chaptered_scroll_journey
canonical_document.description: A full-view scene that fades up from a blank, evenly toned ground onto a title and one opening line, then travels through six numbered chapters of alternating image and passage across multiple screens of scrolling, with layered depth, easing lag and flick-induced warping and channel-splitting colour fringing, ending on a single closing line.
canonical_document.experience_scope: Whole-view experience occupying the entire window from the first reveal out of the blank ground through the final closing line; the browser window itself never scrolls away, so the experience begins and ends inside one fixed frame while the scene moves within it.
content_and_composition: One opening title with exactly one short opening line, presented as the resting state after the initial reveal
Six sequential chapters, each pairing one photograph with one brief text passage
Chapter image and passage alternate which side they occupy from chapter to chapter, so the horizontal centre of attention swings back and forth
One oversized ghosted numeral per chapter, sitting behind the chapter content as a low-contrast typographic layer
Tilted geometric bands held close in tone to the ground as a mid-depth structural layer
Slowly drifting crystalline forms as an ambient layer
A single uniform, low-distraction ground tone behind all layers, persistent for the whole journey
One short closing line as the terminal content element
At least three distinguishable depth planes: foreground text and photographs, mid-depth numerals and bands, and ambient drifting forms, each moving at a visibly different rate
experience_progression: Holding a blank, uniformly toned ground while content is not yet ready
Surfacing out of the blank ground through a controlled luminance transition and settling on the title with its single opening line
Continuous single vertical advance through chapters one to six, each chapter's image and passage entering on the opposite side from the previous one
Total travel spanning roughly eight screens' worth of scrolling, continuous rather than snapped into discrete slides
Resolving on one final quiet closing line
Revisiting reproduces the same chapters in the same order
attention_and_information_flow: Attention starts fully centred on the title because nothing else has yet risen above the blank ground
Alternating sides deliberately relocate the focal point each chapter so the eye keeps re-seeking the new pairing
Each chapter reveals its photograph and passage together as one beat rather than staggering unrelated fragments
Ghosted numerals give position within the sequence without competing with the passage text
Depth layers stay quieter than foreground content; foreground text keeps readable contrast against the ground at every point along the travel
Prominence drops at the end to a single line, closing attention rather than opening new paths

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Scrolling upward retraces the identical states in reverse; there is no irreversible step and no hidden progress
interaction_model.state_change: Scene position advances or retreats along the single continuous journey; the window itself does not scroll
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Layers translate at their own rates, chapters enter and leave, numerals and bands drift behind, giving a sense of moving through depth
interaction_model.input: Vertical scrolling anywhere in the window, in either direction
interaction_model.affected_object: The entire layered scene and its chapter sequence

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Stopping scrolling mid-motion settles gently into place rather than snapping or overshooting visibly
interaction_model.state_change: Each element eases toward its scroll-derived target position instead of jumping to it
interaction_model.visible_feedback: A slight trailing lag, with nearer and farther layers arriving at slightly different times, reinforcing instability and depth
interaction_model.input: Any change in scroll position
interaction_model.affected_object: Every positioned element across all depth planes

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Distortion relaxes back to crisp and still within a moment of the input stopping; no residual artefacts and no loss of readability once at rest
interaction_model.state_change: Temporary velocity-driven distortion state
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Photographs and lettering momentarily bow, and their colour channels split into thin offset fringes
interaction_model.input: Quick, fast scroll flick
interaction_model.affected_object: Photographs and lettering

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: The reveal runs once per visit and always resolves into the title with its opening line
interaction_model.state_change: Held pre-reveal state
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The blank ground persists briefly, then the scene surfaces from it into the title state
interaction_model.input: Content not yet ready at entry
interaction_model.affected_object: The whole view

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Current position in the journey and chapter order are preserved through the re-fit
interaction_model.state_change: Layout re-fits to the new viewport
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The arrangement re-composes so chapters, numerals and layers remain properly framed and readable
interaction_model.input: Window resize or opening on a narrow screen
interaction_model.affected_object: All layers and the chapter pairings

experience_qualities: Immersive and atmospheric, with a low-distraction surround
Cinematic and deliberately paced
Layered depth that feels faintly unstable rather than rigid
Physical, weighted motion from easing lag rather than mechanical snapping
Momentarily analogue and stressed under fast input, calm and crisp at rest
Continuously readable at any point in the travel
completion_and_return: The journey terminates on one quiet closing line rather than looping
No further advance is possible past the closing line; upward scrolling remains available and retraces the same states
Returning to the experience presents the same six chapters in the same fixed order
The initial surfacing from the blank ground replays on a fresh visit
locked_observable_requirements: A uniform, low-distraction ground with a reveal that surfaces out of it through a controlled luminance transition and settles on a title plus one opening line
A single continuous vertical journey driven only by vertical scrolling, with the window frame staying fixed while the scene moves
A small fixed set of numbered chapters, each pairing one image with one brief passage
Image and passage alternate sides between consecutive chapters
Oversized ghosted chapter numerals as a background typographic layer
At least three depth layers receding at visibly different rates
Easing trailing lag on element positions instead of snapping
Fast flicks momentarily bow imagery and lettering and split colour into thin offset fringes, relaxing back to crisp within a moment of stopping
Foreground text holds readable contrast against the ground at every point in the travel
Reverse scrolling retraces identical states and mid-motion stops settle gently
Termination on a single closing line, with chapter order stable across visits
adaptable_details: Exact number of chapters and total screens of travel
Subject matter and tone of the photographs and passages
Specific hues of the ground, accents and layers, including whether the overall key is light or dark
Typeface choices for title, numerals and passages
Shape vocabulary of the ambient drifting forms and the angle of the tilted bands
Precise easing durations, lag amounts, bow magnitude and fringe width
Which side chapter one starts on
Narrow-screen composition strategy, including whether pairs stack vertically
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits any ordered, small, image-plus-short-text sequence meant to be consumed start to finish in an immersive, uniformly toned frame, including narrative features, project chronicles, and mood-led introductions. Requires curated imagery and short passages; it does not fit dense reference text, arbitrarily long or paginated feeds, or content users need to scan and jump within. Replacing scroll with discrete clicked slides, allowing the window to scroll normally, dropping the multi-rate depth layers, or removing the velocity-driven bow and colour-channel fringing would each produce a different Skill.

name: weighted_letter_drop_and_collapse
description: Short word labels fall from above with heavy, settling weight into a calm, low-distraction stage; individual letters can be struck away, dragging their word with them, until every row loses its footing, drops out of view, and the whole set returns from above in a colour set visibly different from the previous cycle's.

canonical_document.name: weighted_letter_drop_and_collapse
canonical_document.description: Short word labels fall from above with heavy, settling weight into a calm, low-distraction stage; individual letters can be struck away, dragging their word with them, until every row loses its footing, drops out of view, and the whole set returns from above in a colour set visibly different from the previous cycle's.
canonical_document.experience_scope: A whole-view experience: the low-distraction stage and the stack of word labels occupy the primary view from entry onward, and it never terminates — each destruction cycle is followed by a fresh arrival. It can also be scoped to a single full-width region that hosts the entire label set, but the labels and the stage they fall through are one inseparable experience.
content_and_composition: A small set of short word labels (a few items, readable at a glance) arranged as separate stacked rows filling the central area
Each label is composed of individually addressable letters that read as one word while at rest but can move independently
A calm, evenly lit empty surround acting as the space objects fall into and out of, held low in visual activity and clearly separated in luminance from the letters; no competing foreground chrome
One shared colour set applied across all letters at any given moment, readably separated from the surround, persisting for a full cycle
The bottom edge of the view functions as the exit boundary objects disappear past
Off-view space above the labels functions as the persistent origin height objects arrive from
experience_progression: Arrival: labels drop in from above the view with weighty acceleration and settle rather than gliding to a stop
Rest: motion ceases and the words become still and legible; the space reads as calm
Invitation: pointer movement across the words signals that individual letters are strikable targets
Strike: a struck letter is shoved away along the direction of the hit and pulls its word's neighbouring letters with it
Cascade: shortly after the first strike, the remaining rows lose their footing one after another until every word is falling
Exit: all letters tumble past the bottom edge and leave the view empty
Renewal: the full set returns to its original starting height in a colour set clearly distinct from the previous cycle's, and the arrival plays again
attention_and_information_flow: Attention is first captured by descending motion and impact, not by the words themselves
Legibility peaks only in the still resting state, so the message is read after the motion has resolved
Hover feedback shifts prominence from the word as a block to the single letter under the pointer, revealing that the text is made of separate pieces
During collapse, attention follows the spreading destruction from the struck row outward to the remaining rows
The emptied view creates a brief lull that makes the next arrival the focal event again
Each renewal cycle refreshes visual novelty through a change of colour set while keeping the same reading content

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Interaction is accepted during the arrival as well as at rest; a strike landing mid-arrival is honoured rather than queued or ignored
interaction_model.state_change: Labels move from an off-view starting height above the view to a resting arrangement in the stage
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Heavy downward motion with weighted settling, ending in still, legible rows
interaction_model.input: Entering the view (autonomous driver on load and on every renewal)
interaction_model.affected_object: The full set of word labels

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: The signal follows the pointer continuously and clears fully when the pointer leaves; no letter stays marked
interaction_model.state_change: That letter becomes marked as a strikable target while the rest stay unmarked
interaction_model.visible_feedback: A clear per-letter signal distinguishing the hovered letter from its neighbours, reading as 'this can be hit'
interaction_model.input: Pointer moving across the words
interaction_model.affected_object: The individual letter currently under the pointer

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Repeated clicks at any moment continue to take effect; nothing becomes wedged, frozen or unresponsive
interaction_model.state_change: The struck letter is displaced away along the direction of the strike and its word loses cohesion, its neighbours dragged after it
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The letter shoves off with direction-consistent motion and the rest of its word is pulled along and disordered
interaction_model.input: Clicking a letter
interaction_model.affected_object: The struck letter and the remaining letters of its word

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: The cascade always completes; further clicks during it are still accepted and add motion instead of stalling it
interaction_model.state_change: Each remaining row loses its footing in turn until no word is still supported
interaction_model.visible_feedback: A staggered row-by-row tumble spreading through the stack rather than a simultaneous drop
interaction_model.input: A strike having occurred (autonomous follow-through)
interaction_model.affected_object: The other rows of labels

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Renewal is automatic and requires no user action, guaranteeing the experience never reaches a dead end
interaction_model.state_change: The set is restored to its original starting height above the view and a colour set distinct from the previous cycle's is adopted
interaction_model.visible_feedback: An empty stage briefly, then an arrival in the newly adopted colour set replaying the weighted drop
interaction_model.input: The last letters passing the bottom edge (autonomous driver)
interaction_model.affected_object: The full set of word labels and the shared colour set

experience_qualities: Physically heavy: motion reads as mass and impact, not as easing decoration
Toy-like and inviting rather than formal or corporate
Calm and visually quiet between events, so motion stands out against stillness
Tactile and consequential: a single small strike visibly propagates to everything on screen
Endlessly replayable with no failure or stuck state
Legible-when-still, so playfulness does not cost readability
completion_and_return: No terminal state; the experience loops indefinitely between arrival, rest, destruction and renewal
Each cycle resets letters to the same original starting height and resting arrangement
The shared colour set changes on each renewal, so cycles are distinguishable while content stays the same
No score, progress or persistent user state carries between cycles
Input remains accepted across every phase, including during arrival and collapse
locked_observable_requirements: Labels arrive from above the view with weighted, gravity-like motion and settle instead of easing to a flat stop
A calm, low-activity stage of uniform tone, clearly separated in luminance from the letters, that the objects fall into and out of
Words come fully to rest and are plainly legible in the resting state
Individual letters are separately hoverable and separately strikable, signalled before the strike
The strike displaces the hit letter along the direction it was struck
The struck letter drags the neighbouring letters of its own word along with it, breaking word cohesion
Remaining rows collapse in turn, staggered rather than all at once
All letters exit past the bottom edge, leaving the view empty
Automatic return to starting height with a colour set visibly changed from the previous cycle's, with no user action required
Input is never blocked and no element is ever left stuck mid-motion
adaptable_details: Number and wording of the labels, as long as they remain few and short
Typeface, letter weight and letter size
The specific colour sets used, their hues, and the order they cycle in
Exact drop heights, timings, stagger intervals and settling character
How light or dark the stage reads and whether the light reads as ambient or directional
The visual form of the per-letter hover signal
Row alignment (centred, left, staggered) and row spacing
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits views whose foreground is a small set of short standalone words — menus, titles, name or category lists — where playfulness outweighs information density and losing the text temporarily is acceptable. It stops being this Skill if the text is long-form or must stay continuously readable, if arrival becomes weightless fading or sliding, if letters are not individually strikable with direction-following displacement, if collapse hits all rows simultaneously instead of in turn, or if renewal requires a manual reset instead of happening automatically with a visibly changed colour set.

name: self_demonstrating_word_stack
description: A vertical stack of oversized words where each word continuously animates to perform the action it names, with the motion rippling letter by letter across the word.

canonical_document.name: self_demonstrating_word_stack
canonical_document.description: A vertical stack of oversized words where each word continuously animates to perform the action it names, with the motion rippling letter by letter across the word.
canonical_document.experience_scope: A whole-view foreground experience that begins fully active at first paint and never ends; it can also be dropped in as a self-contained region, but the stack of words is the entire content of that region.
content_and_composition: One flat list of a handful of short words, each on its own line, stacked vertically in reading order
Words are oversized relative to the viewport so each occupies a substantial band of the view and is the dominant visual mass
Each word is an independent unit composed of individually addressable letters that share the word's baseline and identity
No headings, labels, captions, instructions, controls or chrome accompany the words; the type is the only content role
A single uninterrupted, low-distraction surround behind the stack, held far enough from the type in luminance that letter motion stays clearly readable
Every word is present and already moving on arrival; nothing is hidden, deferred or gated behind scroll or click
experience_progression: Arrival: the complete stack is visible and every word is already mid-cycle, with no wait, entrance sequence or onboarding
Per-word two-beat read: the word first registers as a legible word, then a beat later its motion resolves into a demonstration of its own meaning
Downward drift: attention moves one word at a time down the stack, each word delivering its own two-beat read
Indefinite continuation: each word restarts its own cycle on its own schedule so the set never reaches a finish or final state
attention_and_information_flow: Prominence comes from scale and motion rather than from accent treatments, ordering cues or interface framing
The word being looked at dominates because its motion is the local event; neighbors remain legible but recede as background rhythm
Meaning is revealed in two stages per word: literal reading first, then the enacted meaning, so the joke or point lands without any explanatory text
Letter-level ripple gives each word an internal direction of travel that leads the eye from one end of the word to the other
Because words are independently phased, no single global beat pulls attention away from wherever the visitor has settled

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: There is nothing to start, dismiss or configure; the state is the default and cannot be lost
interaction_model.state_change: All words begin their cycles immediately and simultaneously exist in an already-animating state
interaction_model.visible_feedback: A fully populated stack of oversized words in motion, with no blank, static or placeholder moment
interaction_model.input: Page arrival, with no user action required or requested
interaction_model.affected_object: Every word in the stack

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Cycles are self-restarting, so a word is never left frozen mid-pose or stranded out of step; each word recovers to a legible rest state on its own
interaction_model.state_change: The word advances through its own cycle and restarts from a clean rest state, then repeats indefinitely
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The word's letters move in a ripple that travels across the word from one end to the other, resolving into a visible enactment of the word's meaning, then settling and beginning again
interaction_model.input: Autonomous per-word timing loop
interaction_model.affected_object: The letters of a single word

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Nothing to resume or reset; continuity is guaranteed by self-restarting cycles rather than by user action
interaction_model.state_change: No accumulated or stale state; the stack is found in the same continuously running condition as before
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Words are mid-cycle and playful again on return, with no catch-up burst, no frozen poses and no words drifted out of alignment
interaction_model.input: Returning after looking away, changing tabs or leaving the view idle
interaction_model.affected_object: The whole stack

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Resizing at any point is safe and non-destructive; cycles run unbroken across the change
interaction_model.state_change: Word scale adapts so the entire set stays readable at the new size
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Words rescale to fit while their motion continues without stutter, restart or layout break
interaction_model.input: Viewport resize
interaction_model.affected_object: The word stack as a whole

experience_qualities: Playful and witty rather than decorative
Immediately complete and instantly impressive with zero wait
Demanding nothing of the visitor: watchable, not operable
Bold and oversized, with type as the sole subject
Loose and organic through letter-level ripple rather than mechanical unison
Endless and low-stakes, safe to enter or leave at any moment
completion_and_return: There is no completion state; every word loops independently and indefinitely
Each cycle returns its word to a clean, fully legible rest pose before the next cycle begins
No progress, score or history is retained; a return visit is indistinguishable from a first visit
Leaving and returning never requires a reset, and never reveals a stalled or desynchronized word
locked_observable_requirements: Several words stacked vertically, each oversized enough to dominate its band of the view
Each word's motion must depict that word's own meaning, so word and animation are inseparable
Motion within a word must ripple across its letters from one end to the other rather than moving all letters in unison
Every word animates from first paint with no wait, entrance gate, instruction or control
Cycles restart themselves indefinitely, never leaving a word frozen mid-pose or visibly out of step
Each word must be plainly readable as a word before its motion resolves into the demonstration, at readable contrast against its surround in any host color scheme
Resizing keeps the whole set readable while motion continues unbroken
adaptable_details: How many words appear and which actions they name
Typeface, weight, casing, letterspacing, and the color treatment of type and surround in either direction of luminance
Background treatment, as long as it stays uninterrupted and separated enough from the type to keep motion legible
Cycle duration, ripple delay between letters, easing and pause length between repeats
Whether the stack is centered, left-aligned or offset, and how much space separates the words
Whether words share one visual style or each carries its own distinct accent
Whether the stack fits one screen or extends beyond it
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits short single-word or very short-phrase content whose meaning can be acted out visually, such as verbs, states or sensations, presented as a small stack of oversized type with no surrounding interface. It does not fit sentences, paragraphs, data labels or abstract terms with no depictable action, since the word-and-motion pairing carries the whole point. Requiring hover, click, scroll or any other input to trigger the enactment, applying a single uniform motion to all words regardless of meaning, moving all letters in unison, or embedding the words behind or around other foreground content would each produce a different Skill.

name: word_per_screen_kinetic_verb_ride

canonical_document.name: word_per_screen_kinetic_verb_ride
canonical_document.description: Each screen is filled by one enormous word on a single uniform full-view ground, animating endlessly in a way that acts out what the word means; scrolling snaps to the next word with a clearly separated new ground and a new quality of movement.
canonical_document.experience_scope: Whole-view experience: begins on arrival with the first word already filling the viewport and ends at the final word of a short fixed sequence; there is no surrounding chrome, caption or instruction, and every state of the experience occupies the entire view.
content_and_composition: One very large word per screen, scaled to fill essentially the whole viewport as the sole foreground element
One flat uniform ground per word occupying the full background layer, clearly separated from the grounds of neighbouring words and holding its word at strong readable contrast
A short fixed ordered set of words (a handful, not an open-ended feed) with a definite first and last member
No captions, labels, legends, counters or instructional text anywhere in the view
Exactly one word visible at rest; during a gesture the outgoing and incoming word/ground pair may be partially co-visible as one is pulled up and the other away
No persistent interface furniture: the word plus its full-view ground is the entire composition
experience_progression: Arrival: the first word is already present, fully filling the view and already in motion
Reading: the viewer interprets the word's meaning purely from how it moves
Advance: a vertical gesture pulls the next word up into view and replaces the whole view, including the full-view ground and the movement character
Repeat one word at a time through the fixed order, each turn presenting a clearly separated ground and a different quality of movement
Arrival at the last word, from which the sequence can be walked back through in reverse to the first
attention_and_information_flow: Attention is monopolised by a single word at a time because it is the only content in the view
Meaning is revealed by motion rather than by added text, so the information channel is the animation itself
Each transition resets attention entirely: the previous word and its ground are gone rather than demoted to a secondary role
Because no word ever settles into a final still pose, attention can rest on one word indefinitely without a sense of the moment having passed
The full-field ground change per word signals that a new idea has begun and reinforces the boundary between entries

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Every release settles exactly onto one word rather than between two; the travel can be reversed by gesturing the other way
interaction_model.state_change: Advances from the current word to the adjacent word in the fixed sequence
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The next word and its full-view ground are pulled up into view while the current one travels out, ending with the new word filling the whole screen and animating in its own manner
interaction_model.input: Vertical scroll gesture (wheel, trackpad, or touch swipe)
interaction_model.affected_object: The full-view word-and-ground scene

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Always recovers to a valid single-word rest state; no partial or halfway state persists
interaction_model.state_change: Position resolves back to the nearest word instead of remaining in between
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The view springs back so that a single word again fills the screen with no seam or split view
interaction_model.input: Hesitant or partial gesture that does not carry far enough
interaction_model.affected_object: Current transition position between two words

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Interruption and reversal are always available; direction can be changed at any point during travel
interaction_model.state_change: Travel is interrupted and can be redirected to walk back through words already passed
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Motion changes direction mid-flight and lands on the word being returned to
interaction_model.input: Flick interrupted mid-travel by a new gesture
interaction_model.affected_object: In-progress transition

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Reversing direction resumes normal movement back through the sequence
interaction_model.state_change: No change of word; the sequence holds at its end
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Travel simply comes to a stop with the first or last word still filling the view, without wrapping around or overshooting past the edge
interaction_model.input: Continued gesture past the first or last word
interaction_model.affected_object: Sequence boundary

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Motion needs no user input to start and does not require completion; it simply continues while the word is current
interaction_model.state_change: Continuous, non-terminating motion that expresses the word's meaning
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The word keeps moving in its own characteristic way for as long as it is on screen and never freezes into a final pose
interaction_model.input: Autonomous driver: the per-word animation itself
interaction_model.affected_object: The currently displayed word

experience_qualities: Playful and self-explanatory: meaning arrives without being told
Bold and full-bleed, with a decisive, clearly separated full-field ground change between entries
Decisive and tidy: the view always rests on exactly one word
Unhurried: any word can be dwelt on indefinitely because nothing resolves or times out
Direct and physical, with gestures feeling like they pull content into place
Bounded rather than infinite: the set has a felt beginning and end
completion_and_return: No terminal completion state: each word's motion is perpetual and never freezes
The sequence has a clear first and last word and does not wrap around into a loop
The whole sequence can be returned through in reverse from last to first
At the ends the experience persists on the boundary word rather than exiting or resetting
The current word is the only persistent state; there is no progress record or accumulated result
locked_observable_requirements: One word at a time, scaled to fill essentially the entire viewport
A single uniform full-view ground behind each word, clearly separated from the grounds of the neighbouring words and holding the word at strong readable contrast
Each word's animation visibly expresses that word's own meaning
No caption, label, instruction or explanatory copy anywhere
Vertical scroll or swipe advances exactly one word per resolved gesture and always settles on a single word, never between two
Partial or hesitant gestures spring back to the nearest word
In-flight travel can be interrupted and reversed to revisit previous words
The sequence is bounded: pushing past the first or last word stops instead of wrapping or overshooting
No word ever settles into a final still pose
adaptable_details: The specific words chosen and how many are in the sequence, as long as it stays short and fixed
The particular hues, tonal range and intensity of the grounds and which ground is paired with which word, provided consecutive grounds stay clearly separated and the word stays legible
The typeface, weight and letterform styling
The exact character of each word's motion, so long as it reads as expressing that word
Transition duration, easing and the amount of travel visible during a gesture
Whether both neighbouring scenes are briefly co-visible during travel or the change reads as a harder swap
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits short curated sets of single words or very short phrases whose meaning can be dramatised by motion, presented as a standalone full-view showcase or opening sequence with no surrounding content. It stops being this Skill if entries carry supporting text, imagery or interface alongside the word, if multiple entries share the screen at once, if the words hold still after animating in, if the sequence becomes an open-ended or wrapping feed, or if advancing no longer resolves onto exactly one full-view entry.

canonical_document.name: scroll_scrubbed_quiet_statement_bursts
canonical_document.description: In a quiet, low-distraction space a lone title holds and recedes, then each downward scroll segment gathers a swarm of small geometric forms that blooms at centre screen beside one short statement and dissolves before the next, closing on a thank-you that remains.
canonical_document.experience_scope: Whole-view, full-screen experience occupying a single very long scrolling page; begins at the top with the isolated title and ends when the final burst has dissolved and the closing note of thanks remains on screen.
content_and_composition: One near-empty visual field of a single uniform, low-distraction tone acting as the persistent backdrop for the entire experience
One opening title shown alone with no competing content, centred in the field
A short ordered set of statement moments (a few, not many): each moment has exactly one short statement paired with one swarm of many small geometric forms
Swarm and statement occupy the same centred focal zone; the swarm blooms at centre screen and the statement reads as its caption or partner rather than as separate page copy
Only one statement and one swarm are present at any moment; no simultaneous overlap of two moments' content
One closing note of thanks as the final content, persisting after the last swarm is gone
Composition stays centred regardless of viewport size; no surrounding chrome, panels or navigation competing for attention
experience_progression: Stage 1: quiet, uniform field with the title standing alone at readable contrast, held long enough to register as a moment of its own
Stage 2: the title recedes, clearing the field

attention_and_information_flow: Attention starts on a single title with nothing else to look at, establishing quiet and scale
Attention then alternates between form and text within one shared centre: the gathering swarm draws the eye, the statement becomes fully legible at the bloom peak
Information is released one idea at a time; earlier statements are gone rather than accumulated, so there is no scanning or comparison across moments
Statement opacity tracks the swarm's formation, so partial formation reads as partial disclosure
Prominence collapses to the single closing line at the end, which is the only content left holding attention

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Progress is fully reader-owned; nothing continues on its own if scrolling stops
interaction_model.state_change: Sequence position advances continuously through gather, bloom and dissolve, then into the next moment
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Forms converge, expand into a full bloom at centre and disperse; the statement fades up to full and back out in step with the swarm
interaction_model.input: Continued downward vertical scrolling
interaction_model.affected_object: The whole moment sequence: current swarm and its paired statement

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Any intermediate position is a valid, displayable state; resuming scroll continues smoothly from it
interaction_model.state_change: Sequence position advances in small increments, resting mid-formation
interaction_model.visible_feedback: A burst is held part-formed with its statement half-faded, readable as an in-between state rather than snapping to a preset
interaction_model.input: Slow, eased downward scrolling
interaction_model.affected_object: Current swarm and its statement

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Fully reversible at any depth; returning to the top restores the isolated title state
interaction_model.state_change: Sequence position runs backwards through the same states
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Forms un-bloom and un-gather and text fades out in exact reverse of how it appeared, with no alternate reverse treatment

interaction_model.affected_object: Current and previous swarms and statements

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Held indefinitely until the reader scrolls again in either direction
interaction_model.state_change: Sequence position freezes at the current value
interaction_model.visible_feedback: A stable, static frame with no drift, idle motion or auto-completion
interaction_model.input: Stopping scrolling anywhere
interaction_model.affected_object: Entire view

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: No jump to a different moment and no loss of the reader's place
interaction_model.state_change: View refits to the new dimensions while sequence position is retained
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Composition stays centred and correctly scaled; the same moment and same point within it remain on screen
interaction_model.input: Viewport resize
interaction_model.affected_object: Backdrop, swarm and statement layout

experience_qualities: Quiet and atmospheric, with a calm uniform surround that leaves forms and text as the only points of contrast
Smooth and unhurried pacing with no rushed transitions
Meditative and singular — one idea in play at a time
Fully reader-controlled and scrubbable, never self-playing
Precise reversibility that makes the sequence feel like a physical mechanism
Spacious and uncluttered, with emptiness treated as part of the design
completion_and_return: Completion is reaching the end of the long page, where the closing note of thanks persists after the final dissolve
No looping and no automatic restart
Every load begins at the very top with the isolated title, regardless of prior position
Scrolling back up returns to any earlier state exactly, including the opening title moment
locked_observable_requirements: Near-empty visual field of a single uniform, low-distraction tone throughout, with forms and text held at clearly readable contrast against it
Opening title appears alone and holds before receding, before any moment begins
Each moment pairs exactly one short statement with one swarm of many small geometric forms
Swarm lifecycle is gather → bloom at centre screen → dissolve, completed before the next moment starts; no two moments visible at once
Progress is a direct continuous function of vertical scroll depth on a very long page; nothing animates on its own

adaptable_details: Number of statement moments (a small handful)
Exact wording and length of the title, statements and closing note
Specific geometry of the small forms and their hue, tone or luminosity, in any palette that keeps them clearly separated from the field
Bloom size, density and dispersal pattern of the swarm

canonical_document.name: corner_collapsing_intro_panel
canonical_document.description: A calm full-bleed introduction panel that, when entered, contracts toward one corner into a small square mark while its text slides away and the main content eases into final position; clicking the mark grows the panel back to full screen with the intro details returning intact.
canonical_document.experience_scope: Whole-view experience that begins with the opening panel covering the entire viewport on arrival and ends when the panel has fully collapsed to its corner mark and the main content becomes interactive; the collapsed mark persists for the remainder of the session and can restore the full-view state at any time.
content_and_composition: One full-bleed opening panel occupying the entire viewport as the topmost layer on arrival
Inside the panel: a single primary identity title, one short statement or philosophy note, one brief descriptive/about note, one location line and a small set of external pointers or links
One enter cue inside the panel that initiates the transition
One persistent small square mark anchored in a fixed screen corner, carrying a directional arrow indicator; it is the collapsed form of the panel and the only control that restores it
Beneath the panel: the main content region, a collection of multiple visual items presented in a settled framing (grid or sequence of showcase images)
Two layers only — the collapsible panel above, the content region below; the corner mark remains visible in both states
experience_progression: Stage 1 — rest: full-bleed panel covers the view, intro text is readable, underlying content is not competing for attention and does not accept input
Stage 2 — collapse: panel contracts continuously toward the anchored corner while intro text slips sideways out of view and the underlying items ease into their final framing
Stage 3 — settled: panel exists only as the small corner mark, content region is fully framed and now accepts input
Stage 4 — recall: the mark grows back out to fill the view and the intro text returns unchanged, restoring Stage 1
Progression loops between the two end states; there is no third state and no partial resting state
attention_and_information_flow: Arrival gives attention exclusively to identity and the short statement — nothing else is legible or actionable yet
During collapse, prominence transfers from words to imagery as the text leaves and the items settle
After collapse, the content items hold attention while the intro information is fully hidden but visibly represented by the persistent corner mark
The corner mark stays quiet and small so it signals availability without competing with content
Recall reverses the flow: content recedes behind the growing panel and the intro information becomes the only readable layer again

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Further activations during the transition are ignored; the transition always runs to the fully collapsed end state and never rests partway
interaction_model.state_change: Full-view state transitions to collapsed state; content region changes from inert to interactive only after the transition completes
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Panel contracts continuously toward its anchored corner down to a small square mark; intro text slides horizontally out of sight; content items ease into their final framing rather than appearing abruptly; the mark's arrow indicator flicks in acknowledgement
interaction_model.input: Activating the enter cue in the full-view opening panel
interaction_model.affected_object: Opening panel, its intro text, and the underlying content items

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Repeated or rapid clicks mid-transition are ignored; the panel always lands fully open, and the restored intro is identical to the arrival state
interaction_model.state_change: Collapsed state transitions back to full-view state
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The mark grows outward from its corner until the panel fills the screen; the intro title, statement, note, location and pointers return in their original arrangement, unchanged; the arrow indicator flicks upward as acknowledgement
interaction_model.input: Clicking the small corner mark while collapsed
interaction_model.affected_object: Opening panel and its intro text

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Responsiveness is granted only at the moment the collapsed state is reached
interaction_model.state_change: No state change; content remains inert until the collapse completes
interaction_model.visible_feedback: No response from the content items, keeping the opening uncontested
interaction_model.input: Any input directed at the content region while the panel is open or mid-transition
interaction_model.affected_object: Content items

experience_qualities: Calm and readable at rest; nothing competes with the opening statement
Continuous and directional — the opening appears to step aside toward a corner rather than disappear
Settled arrival: content eases into place instead of snapping
Quietly persistent: the corner mark makes the opening feel always available
Deterministic and unstallable; the transition never leaves an ambiguous halfway view
completion_and_return: Collapse completes only at the small corner mark; expansion completes only at full viewport coverage
Return restores the opening content unchanged, with no loss or reordering of the intro elements
The two states toggle indefinitely; the collapsed mark persists as the durable representation of the opening
locked_observable_requirements: A single full-bleed opening panel holds identity, a short statement, a brief note, a location line and external pointers, and is the only readable layer on arrival
One cue collapses the panel continuously toward a fixed corner until only a small square mark remains
Intro text departs by sliding laterally out of view during the collapse
Underlying content items ease into their final framing as part of the same transition
The content region accepts input only after the collapse completes
The small corner mark persists at all times and is the sole control that expands the panel back to full view
The mark carries a directional arrow that visibly flicks as acknowledgement in both directions
Additional or rapid activations during a transition are ignored; the panel always lands fully open or fully collapsed
adaptable_details: Which corner anchors the collapse and the mark
Direction the intro text departs, and transition duration or easing character
Exact size and shape treatment of the collapsed mark and the form of its directional indicator

Typography, palette, imagery and background treatment of the panel, in any hue family or luminance direction, provided the intro text stays clearly readable and the panel separates from the content region beneath it
Number, aspect ratio and arrangement of the content items
Form of the enter cue (labelled control, arrow, or the mark itself)
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits any site whose main content is a dense visual or item collection that benefits from being preceded by one short identity statement, and where the intro remains worth recalling later. Content type may be swapped freely (projects, products, articles, media). It becomes a different Skill if the opening leaves as a fade, slide-away or page navigation instead of a corner-anchored contraction, if the collapsed form is not a persistent restorable mark, if the panel can rest in intermediate sizes, or if multiple sections each get their own collapsing panel.

name: password_strength_photo_resolve
description: A large photograph beside the entry fields begins fully coarse and unrecognizable, then sharpens in clearly noticeable steps with every keystroke that strengthens the password, while a single plain word names the current level and full clarity marks the entry as good enough.

canonical_document.name: password_strength_photo_resolve
canonical_document.description: A large photograph beside the entry fields begins fully coarse and unrecognizable, then sharpens in clearly noticeable steps with every keystroke that strengthens the password, while a single plain word names the current level and full clarity marks the entry as good enough.
canonical_document.experience_scope: Whole-view experience for the signup screen: begins with a brief calm loading pause before the view appears, runs continuously as a two-part composition for the duration of form entry, and settles when the top level is reached; the resolving image occupies one persistent half of the view rather than appearing as a transient overlay.
content_and_composition: Two-part primary layout: one side holds the compact set of account input fields, the other holds a single large photograph occupying the full height of its side
Exactly one media subject at a time; no gallery, carousel or competing imagery
One short strength word rendered as plain text, positioned in association with the password field or the image, present only when the field has content
Photograph is persistent throughout the session; only its coarseness changes, never its subject, framing or position
Form-completion affordance remains available in the fields side and is not visually gated by the image
experience_progression: Calm entry: a brief loading pause with no content jitter, then the two-part view settles into place
Initial state: photograph at maximum coarseness, unrecognizable, no strength word shown
Improving state: discrete, clearly perceptible clarity steps as strength rises, each accompanied by an updated strength word
Weakening state: clarity walks straight back down through the same discrete steps toward the coarsest state
Final state: full clarity reached and held, with no further visual change while strength remains at the top
attention_and_information_flow: The coarse photograph draws initial curiosity without revealing its subject, creating an implicit goal before any instruction is read
Attention alternates between the typing field and the image because each keystroke produces an immediate change on the other side
The strength word supplies the only verbal information and stays minimal so the image carries the persuasion
Recognizability of the subject becomes the information channel: the moment the photo becomes readable is the moment progress is understood
At full clarity the visual goes quiet, releasing attention back to completing the form

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Every keystroke is independently evaluated; rapid typing lands on the level matching the current field content rather than lagging behind it
interaction_model.state_change: Strength is re-judged immediately and mapped to a matching coarseness step
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Photograph redraws at the new coarseness in the same moment the word updates, so image and wording never disagree
interaction_model.input: Typing a character into the password field
interaction_model.affected_object: Photograph coarseness level and strength word

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Regression is fully symmetric with progress; no earned level is sticky except the held top state described below
interaction_model.state_change: Level steps back down through the same discrete levels toward the coarsest state
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Image visibly coarsens step by step and the word changes to the lower level in the same moment
interaction_model.input: Deleting characters or otherwise weakening the entry
interaction_model.affected_object: Photograph coarseness level and strength word

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Typing again immediately re-establishes the word and matching clarity
interaction_model.state_change: Returns to the initial unjudged state
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The strength word is removed entirely and the photograph shows its coarsest, unrecognizable state
interaction_model.input: Emptying the password field completely
interaction_model.affected_object: Strength word and photograph

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: If the entry is later weakened, the image leaves the settled state and steps back down normally
interaction_model.state_change: Enters a settled, fully sharp state
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Photograph stays fully sharp with no further motion or change while strength stays at the top
interaction_model.input: Reaching top strength
interaction_model.affected_object: Photograph

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: The level already earned is never reset or downgraded by a resize
interaction_model.state_change: Panel refits to the new viewport dimensions
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Image re-lays out at the new size while showing the same clarity level as before the resize
interaction_model.input: Resizing the browser window
interaction_model.affected_object: Photograph panel

experience_qualities: Calm and unhurried on entry, with no abrupt arrival
Immediate and tightly coupled: keystroke and visual change feel simultaneous
Self-explanatory: the reward reads without instructions, labels or legends
Stepped rather than smooth, so each gain is unmistakably noticed
Curiosity-driven, since the hidden subject motivates continued strengthening
Quietly conclusive at the top level instead of celebratory
completion_and_return: Completion is signalled by held full clarity, which reads as permission to finish the form
No looping or autonomous animation; the visual only moves in response to input
The earned level persists across window resizing and continues to reflect the current field content
Clearing the field returns the experience to its initial coarse, wordless state
locked_observable_requirements: One large single media element paired side by side with the input fields in the primary view
Media begins in a state where its subject cannot be recognized
Clarity changes in discrete, clearly noticeable steps rather than an imperceptible continuous ramp
Clarity level and the plain wording update in the same moment as each keystroke
Weakening the entry regresses clarity through the same levels toward the coarsest state
An empty field shows no wording at all
Top level holds fully clear with no further change
Viewport resizing preserves the current level
The verbal component is one short plain word, not instructions or requirement checklists
adaptable_details: Which side of the view holds the fields and which holds the media
Number of discrete clarity levels and how coarse the initial state is
Subject matter and mood of the photograph
Vocabulary used for the level words
Exact placement and typography of the word
Duration and styling of the calm entry pause
Additional account fields present beside the password field
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits any single-view entry experience where one short input's quality can be mapped to ordered levels and rewarded by progressively revealing one persistent large visual: account creation, passphrase or key setup, profile-strength entry, or a single-answer quality gauge. It requires a monotonic quality reading from one field and a media element whose recognizability can be withheld. Replacing the single resolving media element with a gallery, a progress bar or a numeric score, driving it from multi-step form completion rather than one field's quality, letting it animate on its own without input, or making the reveal continuous and unnoticeable would each create a different Skill.

name: color_form_expansion_topic_reveal
description: Six soft color-identified forms settle behind a short list of topic names; choosing a name swells that form from its own center out past the view edges while the others shrink away, revealing an oversized headline, a single line of text and a return control that plays the whole sequence backwards. Each form carries whatever hue keeps it clearly separable from its neighbours, with no fixed palette, tone or theme implied.

canonical_document.name: color_form_expansion_topic_reveal
canonical_document.description: Six soft color-identified forms settle behind a short list of topic names; choosing a name swells that form from its own center out past the view edges while the others shrink away, revealing an oversized headline, a single line of text and a return control that plays the whole sequence backwards. Each form carries whatever hue keeps it clearly separable from its neighbours, with no fixed palette, tone or theme implied.
canonical_document.experience_scope: Whole-view experience covering one self-contained region that owns the entire viewport: it begins with the arrival settling of the color-identified forms and names, continues through the expanded single-topic state, and ends when return restores the original list state. No navigation away occurs at any point.
content_and_composition: A small fixed set of selectable topic names (six in the source case), presented as one short readable list that is the only actionable content on arrival
One soft color-identified form per topic, each holding a color identity separated enough from every other to be told apart at a glance, in any hue family and at any lightness

Layered, soft-edged forms act together as the low-distraction atmospheric substrate on arrival; the names sit above them as the legible foreground layer, held at readable contrast against whatever they overlap
Per-topic detail content revealed only in the expanded state: one oversized headline and exactly one line of supporting text
A single return control, present as the only actionable element while a topic is open and inert otherwise

In the expanded state the selected topic's own color fills the whole view and becomes the ground for its headline and line of text, both kept at readable contrast against that ground; no other topic content remains visible
experience_progression: Arrival: the forms settle softly into their layered background positions while the topic names resolve into legibility, establishing a calm, low-distraction surround
Resting list state: compact color-identified forms plus the short list of selectable names
Selection: the chosen form swells outward from its own center and grows beyond the edges of the view; the remaining forms shrink to nothing and fade out; names go quiet and stop accepting input
Reveal: as the growth nears completion, the oversized headline, the single line of text and the return control surface on the now full-view ground
Expanded rest: one topic's color identity owns the whole view with its headline and line of text held legible against it
Return: text clears, the enlarged form contracts back to its original compact outline, the other forms return, and the names become selectable again, restoring the opening surround
attention_and_information_flow: On arrival, attention is pulled from the settling ambient substrate to the short list of names, which reads as the one thing worth acting on
During expansion, attention narrows from the whole set to a single color identity as competing forms disappear

Detail information appears only after the selected form has taken over the view, so the headline and its single line are read against an uncontested full-view ground with enough contrast to stay legible
During return, prominence widens back from one topic to the equal, untouched set, with no residual detail content
Only one level of information is ever visible at a time: either the list of names or one topic's headline and line

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Input on names is refused for the whole duration of the transition and the expanded state, so overlapping or repeated selections cannot interleave; the state is fully reversible via the return control
interaction_model.state_change: List state transitions to expanded single-topic state; names become non-interactive for the duration
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The chosen form swells outward from its own center and grows past the edges of the view while the other forms shrink to nothing and fade out; the names drop to a visibly lower-prominence treatment
interaction_model.input: Choosing one topic name from the list
interaction_model.affected_object: The chosen topic's color-identified form, the other forms, and the list of names

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Reveal is tied to the tail of the growth rather than appearing before it, so detail never competes with the moving form; return becomes the only available action
interaction_model.state_change: Detail content and return affordance become present and active
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The oversized headline, the single line of text and the return control surface as the growth nears completion, legible against the full-view ground
interaction_model.input: Completion of the expansion growth (autonomous continuation of the selection)
interaction_model.affected_object: The selected topic's detail content and the return control

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: The whole chain reverses in order rather than cutting; the return control is inert whenever no topic is open, so it cannot fire from the list state
interaction_model.state_change: Expanded single-topic state reverses back to the original resting list state
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The text clears, the enlarged form contracts back to its original compact outline, the other forms come back, and the names regain their selectable prominence
interaction_model.input: Triggering the return control
interaction_model.affected_object: The expanded form, the detail content, the other forms and the names

experience_qualities: Calm and atmospheric on arrival, with soft settling rather than abrupt appearance
Chromatic, with each choice carrying its own recognizable color identity that is clearly distinct from the others, whichever hues are used
Decisive narrowing of focus: from a set of equals to one high-salience full-view statement
Reversible and self-contained, so returning feels obvious and effortless with no sense of having navigated away
Uninterruptible during the transition, giving the growth and shrink a deliberate, uncontested feel
completion_and_return: The expanded state persists until return is triggered; it does not auto-collapse
Return restores the exact original resting composition, including all previously hidden forms and the opening surround
No progress, scroll or partial state is carried between topics; each selection starts from the restored list state
The experience loops indefinitely between list state and expanded state
locked_observable_requirements: A small set of selectable names, each bound to its own form whose color identity is clearly separable from every other, with no particular hues required
Arrival in which soft layered forms settle into a background role while the names become legible against them
Selection expands the chosen form outward from its own center until it grows past the edges of the view
Non-selected forms shrink to nothing and fade out during that expansion
Names drop to a visibly lower-prominence treatment and refuse input for the whole duration of the transition and expanded state
Headline, single line of text and a single return control surface only as the growth nears completion
The expanded topic's own color occupies the whole view and serves as the ground for its detail content, which stays at readable contrast against that ground
Return reverses the full chain in order: text clears, form contracts to its original compact outline, other forms reappear, names become selectable
The return control is inert whenever no topic is open
No navigation away from the view at any stage
adaptable_details: Exact number of topics, as long as the list stays short enough to read at a glance
Which hues, lightness levels and overall color scheme are used and which identity belongs to which topic, as long as they stay mutually distinguishable and keep the overlaid text readable
Shape, softness and layered arrangement of the resting forms
Typographic treatment and placement of the names, oversized headline and single line
Visual form of the return control and its position
Timing, easing and exact overlap between growth, shrink and reveal
Subject matter of the topics and the wording of the blurbs
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits any small curated set of items where each item can own one distinguishable color identity, in any hue family and at any lightness, and can be summarized by one oversized headline plus a single short line. It stops working when the set grows large enough to need scanning, filtering or scrolling, or when the detail content is long or multi-part, because the full-view ground and the single-line reveal both depend on minimal detail, or when the item identities are too close to tell apart or leave the overlaid text unreadable. Replacing the center-out growth of the selected item's own form with a generic overlay, panel, slide or page change produces a different Skill, as does allowing multiple topics to be open, letting the list stay interactive during the transition, or making the detail state a destination that cannot reverse back into the untouched list.

name: wrapping_type_specimen_poster_deck
description: One oversized word centered on an edge-to-edge uniform field, surrounded by its own flurry of decorative shapes; stepping forward or back scatters the letters away, slides the field up or down to reveal the visibly different field underneath, and settles the next word and its decoration into place, looping endlessly in both directions.

canonical_document.name: wrapping_type_specimen_poster_deck
canonical_document.description: One oversized word centered on an edge-to-edge uniform field, surrounded by its own flurry of decorative shapes; stepping forward or back scatters the letters away, slides the field up or down to reveal the visibly different field underneath, and settles the next word and its decoration into place, looping endlessly in both directions.
canonical_document.experience_scope: Whole-view experience occupying the full viewport from first paint onward; it begins with the first word already composed dead-center and never ends, since stepping past either extreme wraps back into the run.
content_and_composition: One primary oversized text item at a time, optically centered in the viewport, sized so it dominates the composition
One uniform full-bleed field per item, edge to edge with no margins, framing or visible container, carrying enough separation from the central text to keep it comfortably readable
A set of decorative shape accents per item, scattered around and behind the central text without obscuring its readability
Per-item styling triple that changes together: typeface, field treatment, and decorative shape set
Persistent minimal back and forward controls as the only secondary elements in the view
Deliberately empty surroundings: no competing headings, body copy, chrome, counters or progress indicators near the central item
experience_progression: Landing state: a single word rests centered on its field with its decoration in place, nothing else competing for attention
On a step: the standing word's letters leave the composition
The current field slides away in the direction of travel — upward for forward, downward for back — progressively uncovering the next field beneath it
The incoming word and its decorative shapes arrive and settle on the newly revealed field
Rest state returns, identical in structure to the landing state but with a new typeface, field treatment and shape set
The sequence loops continuously in both directions with no visible first or last item
attention_and_information_flow: At rest, attention is pinned to the single centered word by scale, centering and the absence of competing content
Decorative shapes act as peripheral energy that frames the word without pulling focus from it
During a step, attention shifts to the moving field boundary, whose contrast against the departing field previews the next environment before its content is legible
Attention resolves back to the newly centered word as it settles
Only one item's information is available at any moment; neighbors are never previewed as thumbnails or lists

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Presses during the change are ignored rather than queued; the change always runs to a settled rest state, after which input is accepted again
interaction_model.state_change: Advance to the next item in the run; while advancing, the view is in a busy state that rejects further steps
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Letters of the standing word leave, the field slides upward to uncover the visibly different field beneath, then the next word and decoration come in and settle
interaction_model.input: Activating the forward control or pressing the right arrow key
interaction_model.affected_object: The whole composition: standing word, field, decorative shapes

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Ignored while busy; direction is unambiguous and never mixes with an in-flight opposite move
interaction_model.state_change: Return to the previous item in the run, with the same busy-state lockout
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Same staged change but mirrored: the field slides downward to uncover the previous item's field, so direction of travel is legible from the motion alone
interaction_model.input: Activating the back control or pressing the left arrow key
interaction_model.affected_object: The whole composition: standing word, field, decorative shapes
