interaction_model.control_and_recovery: The run is effectively endless in both directions; there is no disabled or terminal control state
interaction_model.state_change: Wrap around to the opposite extreme
interaction_model.visible_feedback: An ordinary step transition indistinguishable from any other, so no edge, bounce or dead end is ever perceived
interaction_model.input: Stepping beyond the last or before the first item
interaction_model.affected_object: The item sequence

experience_qualities: Playful and poster-like, closer to flipping through printed type specimens than browsing a web page
Bold at poster scale, with each step delivering a field and accent treatment clearly distinct from the one before
Uncluttered and singular: one subject, full attention
Physical and directional, because the environment itself moves rather than the content merely fading
Stable and unhurried under rapid input; changes never overlap, stutter or strand halfway
Endless and browsable, with no sense of reaching a boundary
completion_and_return: Each step completes at a fully settled rest state before any further step is honored
The sequence never completes as a whole: it loops indefinitely in both directions
Wrapping is silent, producing no end-of-list signal, and the same item can be revisited any number of times
No per-item progress or completion state persists; every rest state is equivalent in structure
locked_observable_requirements: Exactly one oversized text item visible at a time, centered, with nothing competing for attention around it
A uniform, edge-to-edge field per item with no visible framing or margins, and enough separation between field and text for the oversized word to stay readable
Typeface, field treatment and decorative shape set change together from item to item
Every step follows the same staged order: letters out, field slides away, next content in and settles
Slide direction encodes travel direction — upward for forward, downward for back — and the departing field uncovers a visibly different field beneath
Input during a change is ignored until the arriving item has fully settled; steps never stack or overlap
Both extremes wrap silently so no beginning or end is ever visible
Equivalent back/forward controls and left/right arrow keys drive the same behavior
adaptable_details: Number of items in the run
Specific words, typefaces and field/accent treatments, including which hues, tones and intensities are used
Kind, count, size and arrangement of decorative shapes
How the letters depart (scatter, rise, fall apart, per-letter offsets) and how the arriving word settles
Transition duration and easing, as long as the staged order and lockout hold
Visual style and placement of the back and forward controls
Whether additional equivalent inputs are offered alongside controls and arrow keys
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits any curated run of self-contained, visually expressive single items where one item can credibly fill a whole screen alone — display words, short phrases, posters, covers, single images or bold statements — each carrying its own field treatment and accent styling. It does not fit content that must be compared side by side, scanned in quantity, or read at length, since only one item is ever visible and no overview exists. Showing multiple items at once, previewing neighbors, exposing a true beginning and end, or replacing the uncovering field slide with a fade or in-place content swap would each produce a different Skill.

name: banded_dual_photo_poster_with_signal_retune_switching
description: A screen-filling poster whose backdrop is two photographs of the same place cut into fine alternating bands, topped by a handful of oversized words and a compact entry list; choosing another entry makes the type scatter away and re-form character by character while the imagery jitters, drops out and returns as that entry's photo pair, then everything settles calm and readable.

canonical_document.name: banded_dual_photo_poster_with_signal_retune_switching
canonical_document.description: A screen-filling poster whose backdrop is two photographs of the same place cut into fine alternating bands, topped by a handful of oversized words and a compact entry list; choosing another entry makes the type scatter away and re-form character by character while the imagery jitters, drops out and returns as that entry's photo pair, then everything settles calm and readable.
canonical_document.experience_scope: A whole-view experience filling the viewport. It begins with a short holding moment before the first entry's imagery appears, then persists as a standing poster; each entry change is a bounded episode inside the same view that starts on selection and ends when the new wording and imagery are settled and readable. There is no exit state — the view remains as the poster for whichever entry is current.
content_and_composition: Backdrop layer: one full-viewport image field composed from exactly two photographs of the same place, interleaved as many fine alternating bands so both pictures are visible at once as a single striped surface.
Foreground type block: a few short oversized text lines only — a name, a short line, a two-word phrase, and a dates line — set large enough to read as poster lettering rather than body copy.
Compact entry list: a small persistent set of place names acting as the selector, with exactly one name carrying a current marker at any time.
Layer relationship: type and list sit above the banded imagery with no intermediate panels or cards; the imagery is the only pictorial content and the type is the only reading content.
Persistent elements: the entry list, the marker, and the type slots keep their positions across every change; only their content and the photo pair swap.
experience_progression: Opening hold: a brief quiet moment where the poster is not yet asserted, then the first entry's banded imagery settles into place with the type readable over it.
Settled state: imagery stable, oversized wording calm and fully legible, current entry marked in the list.
Disturbance on switch: the current wording breaks up as its characters leave in scattered order while the backdrop simultaneously jitters and dips away — the moment reads as raw and unstable.

Return: the backdrop comes back carrying the newly selected entry's pair of photographs as fresh alternating bands, and the new wording arrives character by character in scattered order into the same slots.
Re-settle: motion stops, banding steadies, wording becomes calm and readable again; the cycle repeats identically for every later switch with no accumulating end state.
attention_and_information_flow: In the settled state attention rests on the oversized wording of the entry currently shown; the banded imagery reads as atmosphere behind it.
During the disturbance prominence shifts to motion itself — scattering characters and unstable imagery — so no wording is authoritative mid-change.
As the new imagery returns and characters land, prominence hands back to the wording, which is the last thing to stabilize and therefore the thing the eye finishes on.
The entry list stays quietly secondary but always tells the visitor which entry the wording and imagery belong to, because the marker is the one stable indicator through the change.
Only one entry's information is ever legible at a time; the outgoing and incoming wording never coexist as readable text.

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: The hold is short and self-resolving; the poster never appears in a partially formed or half-banded condition
interaction_model.state_change: From holding moment to the first entry fully composed and settled
interaction_model.visible_feedback: A brief quiet pause, then the interlaced imagery settles in with the oversized wording readable over it and the first entry marked in the list
interaction_model.input: Page opens with no entry yet asserted
interaction_model.affected_object: Banded backdrop and oversized type block

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: The change always runs to completion and ends in a settled readable state; the newly picked entry becomes the reversible baseline, and any earlier entry can be picked again at any later time
interaction_model.state_change: Marker moves to the picked name and leaves the previous one; wording swaps to the picked entry; backdrop swaps to that entry's pair of photographs
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Outgoing characters drop away in scattered, non-sequential order while the imagery jitters and dips out; the imagery returns as the new interlaced pair and the new characters arrive scattered into the same slots, then all motion settles into a calm readable poster
interaction_model.input: Visitor picks a different entry from the compact list
interaction_model.affected_object: Current marker, the oversized wording, and the banded photo backdrop together

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Re-picking the current entry is never treated as a change, so the disturbance is never played without a real switch
interaction_model.state_change: None
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Nothing moves — the poster stays exactly as it is, with the marker where it already was
interaction_model.input: Visitor picks the entry that is already shown
interaction_model.affected_object: Whole view

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Selection becomes responsive again as soon as the change finishes settling, so the visitor can immediately pick another entry, including one already visited
interaction_model.state_change: The extra picks are disregarded; the in-flight change continues undisturbed
interaction_model.visible_feedback: No second scatter or jitter starts on top of the first, no flicker, and no partly arrived imagery is ever shown
interaction_model.input: Visitor picks further entries while a change is still playing
interaction_model.affected_object: Pending change episode

experience_qualities: Poster-like and typographically dominant despite the imagery filling the screen
Two places-in-one texture from the fine alternating bands, ambiguous and layered rather than a clean single photograph
Raw, unstable, interference-like at the moment of change — a signal being retuned
Scattered, non-linear letter behavior that feels mechanical rather than gracefully sequential
Decisive calm at the end of each change: motion fully stops and legibility is restored
Orderly and non-overlapping — the view never looks jammed, doubled or half-loaded
completion_and_return: Each switch completes when the new imagery is fully returned, the new wording has finished arriving, and all instability has stopped.
There is no final destination: the experience loops through as many switch episodes as the visitor triggers, each ending in the same settled readable form.
The current entry persists as the standing state of the view after the change, including its marker in the list.
Any previously shown entry can be returned to, and doing so replays the same disturbance-and-settle cycle rather than restoring a remembered mid-state.
locked_observable_requirements: The backdrop is built from exactly two photographs of the same place interleaved as many fine alternating bands, both visible simultaneously as one surface.
Foreground reading content is limited to a few oversized short lines plus a compact entry list — never dense or long-form text.
Outgoing wording leaves and incoming wording arrives character by character in scattered order, not as a whole-block fade or in reading order.
The backdrop's jitter, dip-out and return happen at the same time as the wording change so the two read as one coordinated retune.
The imagery that returns is the newly selected entry's pair, and it is only revealed once it can appear complete — no half-loaded or flashing imagery.
Every change resolves into a fully stable, calm, legible state with all motion ceased.
Exactly one entry carries the current marker at all times, and the marker moves as part of the same change.
Selecting the already-current entry does nothing, and additional selections are ignored until the change finishes.
adaptable_details: Number of entries in the list and their names
Band thickness, count and orientation of the interlacing
Exact durations of the hold, disturbance and settle phases
Typeface, letter case, colour treatment and exact placement of the oversized lines
Position and styling of the compact list and of the current marker
Subject matter of the photographs and how much they differ from each other
Precise character of the instability — degree of jitter, how far the imagery dips away
The exact set of short text roles, as long as it stays a handful of short lines
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits views presenting a small set of parallel entries where each entry supplies a pair of photographs of a single subject plus only a few short text lines — announcements, editions, tour stops, seasonal or chapter posters. It stops being this Skill if entries carry long-form or dense copy that cannot be set at poster scale, if each entry has only one image so the fine alternating banding disappears, if the change becomes a smooth crossfade or instant swap instead of an unstable retune, if outgoing and incoming wording are legible at the same time, or if the imagery becomes a decorative strip inside a conventional scrolling page rather than the full-view substrate.

name: living_blob_collage_with_fullscreen_entry_takeover
description: A screen filled with soft-edged blobs that are clearly distinguishable from one another, each showing a number and a word, that lean and drift with the cursor; picking a word stretches that blob until it owns the whole view and eases in its headline, two small abstract graphics and a one-line note, while the rest shrink away until closed.

canonical_document.name: living_blob_collage_with_fullscreen_entry_takeover
canonical_document.description: A screen filled with soft-edged blobs that are clearly distinguishable from one another, each showing a number and a word, that lean and drift with the cursor; picking a word stretches that blob until it owns the whole view and eases in its headline, two small abstract graphics and a one-line note, while the rest shrink away until closed.
canonical_document.experience_scope: Whole-view experience covering the entire visible area: it begins on arrival with the complete collage and ends either in the idle collage state or in a single opened entry; closing returns to the same collage without leaving the view.
content_and_composition: Six labelled shape entries filling the entire view with no surrounding document chrome, read as one continuous collage rather than a grid of cards

Each entry is a large soft-textured organic blob with its own clearly separated fill treatment, distinct enough from its neighbours to read as an individual target, sized and placed so all six share the view simultaneously
Each blob carries two persistent labels: a short ordinal index and a single word, both held at readable contrast against their own blob so no instructional copy is needed
Opened-entry content occupies the expanded blob as its own layer: one oversized headline, exactly two small abstract decorative graphics, and one single-line note
A close affordance appears only with the opened content and sits within the expanded surface
Unopened blobs remain in place behind or beside the expansion rather than being reflowed into a new layout
experience_progression: Idle collage: all blobs visible, drifting and leaning in response to pointer position
Hover emphasis: the word under the cursor highlights while the collage keeps drifting
Opening: the chosen blob stretches and reshapes outward until it covers the view, its own word fades out, and remaining blobs shrink away in place
Opened detail: expanded surface holds headline, two graphics, single-line note and close affordance; drifting is suspended for the opened blob
Closing: the expansion reverses along the same path, content eases out and the other blobs and their words return
Return to idle collage, immediately ready for a different entry
attention_and_information_flow: On arrival attention is spread deliberately across the whole set; mutual fill distinction, scale and per-blob labels make all six choices equally readable at once
Pointer proximity creates a light, temporary focal pull through word highlighting without committing the visitor
Opening collapses attention to a single entry: the oversized headline dominates, the two graphics and single-line note read as supporting detail, and every competing element quietly clears
The opened entry's own word disappears once its headline takes over, so the same name is never shown twice
Closing redistributes attention back to the full set so comparison and repeat selection feel immediate

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Always interruptible and self-correcting; motion eases back to neutral as the pointer recentres, and leaning is paused for whichever blob is open
interaction_model.state_change: Each blob offsets and leans by its own small independent amount derived from pointer position, returning to neutral rest when the pointer is centred
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Continuous soft parallax-like drift and tilt that makes the collage feel alive and slightly elastic
interaction_model.input: Pointer movement across the view
interaction_model.affected_object: All unopened blobs as a loose group

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Reverts as soon as the pointer leaves; purely transient with no committed state
interaction_model.state_change: Word moves between normal and highlighted state
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The word visibly emphasises, signalling it is the selectable target
interaction_model.input: Pointer passing over an entry's word
interaction_model.affected_object: That entry's word label

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Presses landing while an opening or closing transition is running are ignored, so the transition always completes into a coherent state
interaction_model.state_change: Chosen entry transitions from collage member to full-view opened entry; others transition to shrunken-away state
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Chosen blob stretches and reshapes until it covers the view, its word fades out, its headline, two graphics and note ease in, and the other blobs shrink in place without relocating
interaction_model.input: Press on an entry's word
interaction_model.affected_object: The chosen blob plus all remaining blobs

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Presses during the closing transition are ignored; pointer-driven leaning resumes for all blobs once the collage is restored
interaction_model.state_change: Opened entry returns to its collage form; other entries return to full presence
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Expansion reverses, opened content eases out, the entry's word reappears, and the remaining blobs and their words grow back into place
interaction_model.input: Activating the close affordance on the opened entry
interaction_model.affected_object: Opened entry and the previously shrunken blobs

experience_qualities: Playful, hand-made and tactile rather than document-like
Strongly differentiated blob fills with soft, blurred or textured edges
Continuously alive at rest through small independent motion
Immediate legibility of choices without instructions
Decisive focus shift when an entry opens, with everything else quietly clearing
Effortless, low-friction return that invites trying another entry right away
completion_and_return: No terminal end state: the experience alternates indefinitely between the idle collage and one opened entry
Closing fully restores the collage, including every word label and the neutral resting arrangement
The opened entry returns to its original position and form rather than settling somewhere new
Only one entry can be open at a time; opening another requires returning to the collage first
locked_observable_requirements: All entries visible simultaneously as soft-edged shapes filling the whole view, each shape mutually distinguishable from the others and carrying its own index and word
Pointer-driven independent drift and lean per unopened shape, neutral at centre
Word highlighting on pointer pass
Selection expands the chosen shape by stretching and reshaping until it covers the entire view
The selected shape's word fades out as its detail content eases in
Non-selected shapes shrink away in place rather than sliding off or relaying out
Opened content comprises an oversized headline, two small abstract graphics and a single-line note, all held at readable contrast against the expanded surface
A close affordance presented with the opened content reverses the whole transformation and restores the other shapes and their words
Inputs during opening or closing transitions are ignored
Drift is suspended for the opened shape
adaptable_details: Number of entries, as long as all remain visible together and the set stays small
Specific hues, tones, overall palette and saturation level, texture treatment and blob silhouettes, provided the shapes stay mutually distinguishable and their labels stay readable
Exact placement and size of each blob within the shared view
Index labelling convention and typographic styling of words and headline
Timing, easing and stretch character of the open and close transitions
Drift magnitude and per-shape variation
Subject matter of the entries and wording of the single-line note
Visual form of the close affordance
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits any small fixed set of named entries where each needs only a headline, a couple of small graphics and one short line of text, and where a playful presentation built on strongly differentiated shapes is desired. It stops being this Skill if entries grow to scrollable long-form content, if the set becomes large enough to require paging or scrolling so the shapes no longer share one view, if the shapes become rectangular cards navigating to separate views, or if the collage is pushed behind foreground text as a decorative backdrop instead of being the selectable content itself.

name: flat_fill_panel_curtain_lift_entry
description: A full-screen announcement on one uniform flat fill with a single invitation that, when activated, rises away as a single curtain with a stretching curved bottom edge, permanently uncovering the photographic main screen underneath.

canonical_document.name: flat_fill_panel_curtain_lift_entry
canonical_document.description: A full-screen announcement on one uniform flat fill with a single invitation that, when activated, rises away as a single curtain with a stretching curved bottom edge, permanently uncovering the photographic main screen underneath.
canonical_document.experience_scope: Whole-view experience covering the entire viewport from arrival until the covering panel has fully left and the underlying photographic screen with its small set of choices is exposed and usable; one-way, with no return to the opening state.
content_and_composition: One opaque full-viewport panel of a single uniform flat fill as the topmost layer, carrying no imagery and reading as an unbroken field clearly separated from the view it hides
One dominant typographic block on that panel stating an identity and a role as its two text parts, held at readable contrast against the fill
Exactly one short textual invitation onward, the only interactive element on the panel
The panel's lower boundary is a visible curved edge rather than a straight line, acting as its shape signature
One full-viewport photographic main screen positioned beneath the panel, holding only a small set of choice links
No navigation, secondary actions or supporting copy anywhere on the covering panel
experience_progression: Arrival holds briefly and quietly while the imagery beneath becomes ready; nothing announces itself yet
The announcement settles into place: identity, role and the single invitation become fully present and static
A still dwell state where the only change available is the invitation's hover response
Activation begins a one-way reveal: the covering panel travels upward out of view while its curved lower edge simultaneously reshapes and stretches
The photographic screen stands fully exposed, its choice links become usable, and motion ends calmly with nothing of the opening left
attention_and_information_flow: During the holding moment attention is deliberately withheld, with nothing to read or act on
The settled announcement gives a single focal typographic mass and one clearly subordinate action
Hover response pulls the eye to the invitation without revealing additional information
During the reveal attention transfers to the imagery being progressively uncovered as the flat covering mass exits
After the reveal only the small set of choices remains prominent; the opening content is gone rather than minimised

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Not user-controllable; the settled state is stable and waits indefinitely for input
interaction_model.state_change: Held and unannounced to fully settled and readable
interaction_model.visible_feedback: A short quiet hold followed by the announcement and its single invitation coming to rest
interaction_model.input: Autonomous arrival readiness of the underlying imagery
interaction_model.affected_object: The opening announcement content

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Rapid in-and-out passes always resolve to one consistent state, never leaving letters faded, offset or mid-flip
interaction_model.state_change: Plain resting state to accented state and back
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Letters flip one after another in sequence and pick up a distinct accent that separates them clearly from their resting treatment; leaving replays the same motion in the opposite order back to plain
interaction_model.input: Pointer resting on the invitation, then moving away
interaction_model.affected_object: The invitation's individual letters

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Further activations during the reveal are ignored; the reveal cannot be reversed, paused or replayed, and the uncovered links stay inert until fully exposed
interaction_model.state_change: Covered to revealing to permanently revealed, in one direction only
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The covering panel rises away while its curved lower edge reshapes and stretches, progressively uncovering the photographic screen in place
interaction_model.input: Activating the invitation
interaction_model.affected_object: The covering panel and the photographic screen beneath it

experience_qualities: Bold and single-minded, with one message and one action
Theatrical, curtain-like departure rather than an abrupt swap
Calm and final at rest, with no residual motion
Uncluttered, editorial confidence in the opening composition
Tactile precision in the one available hover response
completion_and_return: Completes in a stable revealed state where the photographic screen is the resting view
No looping, replay or reverse path back to the opening announcement
The opening is only ever seen again on a fresh arrival
locked_observable_requirements: An opaque full-viewport layer of one uniform flat fill, clearly separated from the destination view, fully hides that destination at arrival
The opening carries one dominant identity-and-role text block and exactly one onward invitation, with nothing competing for attention
The invitation responds to pointer entry with per-letter sequential motion plus a distinct accent shift, and reverses in opposite order on exit without stuck intermediate letters
Moving onward is a single continuous departure of the covering layer, not a jump to another screen
The covering layer's curved lower edge visibly deforms and stretches while the layer leaves
The destination is uncovered in place beneath the departing layer and becomes interactive only once exposed
The reveal is one-way, and activations during it are ignored
adaptable_details: Panel fill hue or tone, the accent's hue or treatment, and typeface choices
Wording of the identity, role and invitation
Depth and exact profile of the curved edge
Duration and easing of the hold, settle and departure
Number and labelling of choices on the uncovered screen
Whether the uncovered screen is photographic or otherwise image-led
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits any site whose entry is a single-message gate over one primary image-led view that offers a small set of onward choices, with exactly one action on the gate. It becomes a different skill if the gate branches to several destinations, if it can be reopened or repeated, if the covering layer fades or slides without a deforming edge, or if the flat-fill layer stays as a substrate behind persistent foreground content instead of leaving entirely.

name: unwrapping_number_tile_field
description: A full field of patterned numbered tiles that tumble away from the pointer, lift toward the viewer and flood the page surround with their own distinguishing accent, whatever hue family that accent belongs to; clicking one launches it out of frame while the others shrink into the distance, leaving its short text and an oversized number alone on screen until one control flies the field back.

canonical_document.name: unwrapping_number_tile_field
canonical_document.description: A full field of patterned numbered tiles that tumble away from the pointer, lift toward the viewer and flood the page surround with their own distinguishing accent, whatever hue family that accent belongs to; clicking one launches it out of frame while the others shrink into the distance, leaving its short text and an oversized number alone on screen until one control flies the field back.
canonical_document.experience_scope: Whole-view experience: begins on entry with the entire set visible in one frame, spans hover-level reactions across the field and the transition into a single-item focus state, and ends when the reversing control restores the original field; the set and the detail state are two modes of the same view rather than separate pages.
content_and_composition: One field containing a fixed finite set of small numbered tiles, laid out so the entire set reads at a glance in one frame

Each tile carries a number as its primary label, a patterned surface with a physical, object-like feel, its own distinguishing accent that separates it from its neighbours under any hue set, and a short text payload with an attribution
Two visually distinct tile conditions: available (responsive, invites opening) and not-yet-available (inert)
Page surround acts as one large low-distraction surface behind the field, able to take on a single tile's accent
A corner text slot, empty at rest, that carries the hovered tile's short label

Focus state composition: the selected tile's short text plus its attribution as the primary content, an oversized version of the tile's number as a large graphic layer, and a single persistent return control
The field itself behaves as one shallow layered scene rather than a flat grid, tilting as a whole
experience_progression: Entry: the complete set appears as one playful field; availability is legible before any interaction
Browsing: pointer movement continuously tilts the whole field slightly while individual available tiles react as the pointer approaches and settles on them
Opening: the chosen tile launches out of frame as the remaining tiles shrink and scatter into the distance, clearing the field
Focus: the cleared view presents the tile's short text, its attribution and its oversized number with nothing competing
Return: one control reverses the whole sequence, flying the tiles back into their original positions
Browsing resumes from an unchanged field, ready for another opening
attention_and_information_flow: At rest, attention is distributed evenly across the whole set, with availability as the only differentiating signal
Pointer proximity concentrates attention on one tile by pushing it toward the viewer, moving it out of the pointer's path and shifting the entire surround to that tile's accent
The corner label spells itself out letter by letter, adding a second, delayed reading of what the hovered tile holds without breaking focus on the tile
Opening collapses attention from many items to one: everything else physically leaves, so the short text and attribution become the only readable content
The oversized number keeps the origin of the focused content identifiable while the set is absent
Return re-expands attention back to the full set in the same arrangement it was left in

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Pulling the pointer away undoes every part of the reaction, returning tile, surround and corner label to their rest state
interaction_model.state_change: Tile enters an engaged state; surround adopts that tile's own distinguishing accent; corner label begins revealing
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The tile tumbles away from the direction the pointer came from and pushes toward the viewer, the page surround shifts through a controlled transition to that tile's accent while keeping the tile's contrast readable, and its short label spells out letter by letter in a corner
interaction_model.input: Pointer moves onto an available tile
interaction_model.affected_object: That tile, the page surround and the corner label slot

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Tilt follows the pointer continuously and settles back toward neutral when movement stops or the pointer leaves the field
interaction_model.state_change: Continuous orientation shift of the entire field tracking pointer position
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The full set tilts slightly, as if looking around a shallow diorama
interaction_model.input: Pointer moves across the field without settling on a tile
interaction_model.affected_object: The whole set as one layered scene

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Non-reaction is itself the boundary signal; nothing to undo
interaction_model.state_change: No state change
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The tile stays completely inert, giving no lift, no tilt, no surround shift and no label
interaction_model.input: Pointer moves onto a not-yet-available tile
interaction_model.affected_object: That tile

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: A single control is available in the focus state to reverse the entire transition
interaction_model.state_change: View switches from field mode to single-item focus mode
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The clicked tile launches out of frame while the other tiles shrink and scatter into the distance, clearing the field to reveal the tile's short text, its attribution and an oversized version of its number
interaction_model.input: Click on an available tile
interaction_model.affected_object: The clicked tile, the remaining tiles and the view contents

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Restores the exact prior arrangement so browsing continues without reorientation; any tile can then be opened again
interaction_model.state_change: View returns from focus mode to field mode with the set restored unchanged
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The focused text and oversized number clear as the tiles fly back into their original positions and the field reads as it did before opening
interaction_model.input: Activating the single return control
interaction_model.affected_object: The focused content and the absent set

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Interaction becomes available again only once the transition has finished
interaction_model.state_change: Input is discarded rather than stored
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The running transition plays through uninterrupted, with no stacked or delayed reactions afterwards
interaction_model.input: Any input while an opening or returning transition is running
interaction_model.affected_object: The transition in progress

experience_qualities: Playful and toy-like: tiles behave as physical objects that can be nudged and unwrapped
Tactile surface character from patterning and object-like depth rather than flat panels
Shallow spatial depth, with tiles reading as slightly above and behind one another
Immediate legibility of what can and cannot be opened
Theatrical, whole-screen shift when a single item takes over
Effortless, non-punishing return that preserves the browsing context
Continuous responsiveness to pointer movement even when nothing is selected
completion_and_return: Opening a tile has a definite end state: the focus view holds until the user chooses to return
The reversal is symmetrical, flying the set back into place rather than cutting back
The field is restored exactly as it was left, so repeated open-and-return cycles feel continuous
The experience loops indefinitely across the set with no terminal state
Hover reactions are fully self-reversing and leave no residue on the field or surround
locked_observable_requirements: The whole set must be readable at a glance in one frame on entry, with available and unavailable items visibly distinguished
Tiles must feel like patterned physical objects, not flat abstract cells

Hovering an available tile must simultaneously tilt it away from the incoming pointer, push it toward the viewer, shift the whole page surround to that item's own distinguishing accent in any hue family, and reveal its short label letter by letter in a corner
Every part of the hover reaction must fully reverse when the pointer leaves
Pointer movement across the field must tilt the entire set as one shallow scene
Opening must launch the chosen item out of frame while the remaining items shrink and scatter into the distance, clearing the field
The focus state must present the item's short text and attribution as primary content alongside an oversized version of its number
Exactly one control must reverse the whole transition and fly the items back into their original positions, leaving the field unchanged
Unavailable items must give no visual reaction at all
Input during a transition must be ignored, never queued
adaptable_details: Number of items and the shape of the field
Surface patterning and the specific hues chosen for the overall scheme and for each item's accent
Which corner carries the hovered label and its typographic style
Pacing of the letter-by-letter reveal, tilt amount, lift distance and transition easing
Direction and choreography of the launch and scatter
Typography and placement of the oversized number and the focused text
Appearance and position of the single return control
The rule that determines which items are available
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits a fixed, finite set of small equal-weight items where each item has a short identifier, a short text payload with a source or attribution, and its own distinguishing accent drawn from any hue set, browsed in a pointer-driven context where the whole set fits in one frame. It transfers to any collection of brief statements, facts, profiles or entries revealed one at a time. It becomes a different Skill if the set grows into a scrolling or paginated feed that cannot be seen at once, if each item carries long-form or multi-section content instead of a short passage, if multiple items must be open simultaneously, or if the field must be navigated without a pointer position to drive the tilt and proximity reactions.

name: stacked_fullbleed_kinetic_word_showcases
description: Full-height, edge-to-edge screens each dominated by one oversized word; previous/next controls exchange words with the outgoing and arriving letters animating at the same time, one glyph slightly after the next, while scrolling moves between screens that each have their own typeface, foreground/ground contrast pairing and motion character.

canonical_document.name: stacked_fullbleed_kinetic_word_showcases
canonical_document.description: Full-height, edge-to-edge screens each dominated by one oversized word; previous/next controls exchange words with the outgoing and arriving letters animating at the same time, one glyph slightly after the next, while scrolling moves between screens that each have their own typeface, foreground/ground contrast pairing and motion character.
canonical_document.experience_scope: Whole-view experience. It begins when a short hold-back gate releases and the first full-bleed scene opens with nothing half-ready, spans a vertical series of full-viewport showcase panels, and has no terminal end: word lists wrap and showcases continue one after another.
content_and_composition: One oversized word per showcase, sole dominant element, sized to own the frame
Word composed of individually addressable glyphs that can move independently
Per-showcase visual identity: its own typeface, its own foreground/ground pairing held at comfortably readable contrast in either luminance direction, its own alignment position in the frame
Two persistent, visually quiet controls per showcase: previous and next
Deliberately minimal surrounding furniture so nothing competes with the letterforms
Multiple showcases stacked vertically, each full viewport height and full-bleed edge to edge
Each showcase holds its own ordered word list
experience_progression: Held-back entry: nothing partially formed is shown, then the first scene opens directly at full bleed
Within a showcase: ordered stepping through its word list, forward or backward, wrapping at both ends
Across showcases: continuous vertical succession of distinct type / contrast-pairing / motion identities, so comparing styles never dead-ends
attention_and_information_flow: Letterforms carry nearly all prominence; controls and surroundings stay subordinate
During an exchange attention shifts to glyph-level motion as the cascade runs across the word
Each newly entered showcase resets attention with a different typeface, a perceptibly different foreground/ground pairing and a different alignment
Style comparison builds cumulatively from sequential full-frame exposure rather than from side-by-side layout

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Stepping is accepted again only after both halves of the exchange finish; the wrap means the control never becomes inert
interaction_model.state_change: Advances one position in the word list, wrapping to the first word past the end, and locks further stepping for the duration of the exchange
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The visible word's letters animate away while the arriving word's letters animate in simultaneously, each glyph starting slightly after the one before it, in that showcase's own motion character
interaction_model.input: Press the next control
interaction_model.affected_object: The showcase's current word and the following word in its list

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Direction can be reversed freely between completed exchanges; stepping back is always available
interaction_model.state_change: Steps back one position, wrapping to the last word past the beginning, with the same lock
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Same simultaneous outgoing/incoming letter exchange with per-glyph offset, run backward through the list
interaction_model.input: Press the previous control
interaction_model.affected_object: The showcase's current word and the preceding word in its list

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Control returns automatically the moment both halves complete, with no user action needed
interaction_model.state_change: Extra presses are discarded rather than queued or overlapped
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The running exchange completes cleanly; no doubled transition, no letters stranded mid-flight, no visible stutter
interaction_model.input: Repeated or impatient presses while an exchange is running
interaction_model.affected_object: Pending word changes

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Scrolling works in both directions; each showcase retains the word it was left on, so returning shows continuity rather than a reset
interaction_model.state_change: Carries the visitor between adjacent showcases
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The next showcase fills the frame with its own typeface, its own foreground/ground pairing and its own alignment replacing the previous one
interaction_model.input: Vertical scrolling
interaction_model.affected_object: Which full-height showcase occupies the viewport

experience_qualities: Poster-like boldness: one word, full frame, no clutter
Typography-first, where motion serves the letterforms
Distinct personality per showcase rather than one uniform effect repeated
Composed and never overlapping, so exchanges always read as complete
Endless, non-terminating browsing in both stepping and scrolling
completion_and_return: No completion state: word lists wrap indefinitely and showcases continue in sequence
Each showcase keeps its own current word independently of the others
Returning to an earlier showcase shows it as it was left, not reset to its first word
The only one-time moment is the initial release into the first scene
locked_observable_requirements: A single oversized word owns the frame in each showcase
Showcases are full-bleed and full viewport height
Outgoing and arriving letters animate at the same time, not one after the other as separate phases
Per-glyph offset so each letter moves slightly after the one before it
Stepping input is ignored until both halves of an exchange finish, with no stranded glyphs
Wrap-around in both directions so stepping never stops

Each showcase brings its own typeface, its own word-to-ground pairing at readable contrast, its own alignment and its own motion character, and reads as perceptibly distinct from the showcases adjacent to it — which hues, tones or luminance direction achieve that is unconstrained
Surrounding furniture stays minimal and low-distraction so attention rests on letterforms
Nothing appears half-ready before the first scene opens
adaptable_details: The words themselves and how many are in each list
Number of showcases in the series
Specific typefaces, the actual hues, tones and light-on-dark or dark-on-light direction chosen for each pairing, and alignment positions
The particular kind of glyph motion (direction, rotation, scale, blur, mask, etc.) per showcase
Stagger interval and exchange duration
Styling and placement of the previous/next controls
Whether scrolling snaps or flows freely between showcases
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits short single-word or very short-phrase content where the letterforms carry the message and each screen can be given one typeface-and-contrast identity. It stops being this Skill if the frame must hold long-form text, imagery or several competing elements, if the word is reduced to a subordinate label beside other content, if the panels are no longer full-viewport specimens, or if exchanges are allowed to queue and overlap instead of running as one locked, letter-staggered swap.

name: layered_lettering_self_drawing_replay
description: Words already sit finished in their stacked, mutually distinguishable layers; pressing the control beneath a word makes it slip away and fade, then rebuild letter by letter with strokes drawing in from one end, landing back in the finished state.

canonical_document.name: layered_lettering_self_drawing_replay
canonical_document.description: Words already sit finished in their stacked, mutually distinguishable layers; pressing the control beneath a word makes it slip away and fade, then rebuild letter by letter with strokes drawing in from one end, landing back in the finished state.
canonical_document.experience_scope: A region experience: each lettering piece plus its own control forms one independent unit on the page. The experience begins with the piece already resting in its finished state, runs only for the duration of a triggered reveal, and ends back in that same finished state. Several such units coexist on one view without interacting.
content_and_composition: One short piece of display lettering per unit, treated as artwork rather than reading copy, typically a word or very short phrase
Each letter built from multiple stacked layers offset from one another and separated enough to be told apart, so the layering is legible as depth or overprint rather than a flat fill
Stroke outlines that are visibly path-like and hand-drawn in character, capable of being revealed progressively along their length
One plain, unadorned start control placed directly beneath the lettering it belongs to, persistent and always visible
A handful of separate lettering pieces on the same view, each with its own visibly distinct flavour of reveal timing, order or layer emphasis
The resting finished composition is the canonical visual state and is what the region shows both before any interaction and after every run
experience_progression: Rest: the full word stands complete, static, readable, layers already stacked
Clear-away: on trigger the whole word moves off together and fades out as a single object, leaving the region briefly empty
Return and build: letters come back one after another in quick succession, each arriving with a loose, springy, slightly overshooting settle
Stroke fill: each returning letter's outlines draw themselves in from one end to the other, and the stacked layers arrive so their stacking order reads clearly
Land: the last strokes complete and the word rests in exactly the same finished state it started from
attention_and_information_flow: Attention first belongs to the finished artwork, which is legible with no interaction required
The clear-away briefly empties the region, creating anticipation and making the rebuild the focus
During the build, prominence travels letter to letter in reading order, then along each stroke from one end to the other
Layer construction is progressively disclosed: the visitor learns how the piece is stacked, information that the static resting state only implies
The control stays visually quiet throughout and never competes with the lettering
Across the several pieces, differing reveal flavours invite comparison between units

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: The control remains live for the entire run. The run always terminates in the finished state, so no press can leave the piece partially drawn or missing.
interaction_model.state_change: From finished resting state into a full reveal run: cleared, then rebuilt letter by letter with strokes drawing in, then finished again
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The whole word slips away and fades together; the region empties; letters pop back in rapid succession with springy settling; outlines draw in directionally from one end; the separated layers stack up until the word is fully drawn
interaction_model.input: Press of the start control beneath a lettering piece
interaction_model.affected_object: That piece's lettering as a whole, then its individual letters and stroke layers

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Restart is the recovery path: repeated or impatient pressing is always safe and always resolves to the fully drawn word.
interaction_model.state_change: The current run is abandoned and a fresh reveal starts from the beginning
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Whatever was mid-build immediately gives way to a new clear-away and rebuild from the start
interaction_model.input: Further press of the same control at any moment during a run
interaction_model.affected_object: The in-progress reveal of that piece

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Units are isolated; nothing about one piece alters another.
interaction_model.state_change: That piece runs its own reveal independently
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Neighbouring pieces stay untouched in their finished state while the triggered one animates
interaction_model.input: Press of a control belonging to a different lettering piece
interaction_model.affected_object: Only that other piece

experience_qualities: Playful and hand-made rather than mechanical
Springy, loose timing with slight overshoot on arrival
Quick and snappy letter-to-letter cadence, short enough to watch repeatedly
Craft-revealing: the build teaches how the layered artwork is made
Reliable and forgiving, since every path leads back to the finished word
Calm at rest, with no idle motion demanding attention
completion_and_return: Every run completes at the fully drawn, fully layered finished state, identical to the arrival state
No looping or autoplay: motion happens only when the visitor asks for it
Interrupting a run does not strand it; the restarted run still ends finished
The finished state is the persistent state of the region between runs and across multiple pieces
locked_observable_requirements: Arrival shows the lettering already complete and readable, not blank or mid-animation
The reveal is triggered by a plain control placed directly beneath its own lettering piece
Clear-away moves the whole word away as one object while fading it out before any rebuild begins
Rebuild is per-letter and sequential in quick succession, not a single simultaneous fade-in
Stroke outlines draw in progressively and directionally, from one end of a stroke to the other
Stacked layers stay distinguishable from one another and arrive in a way that makes their stacking order legible
Return motion carries a loose, springy, hand-made character
The control remains live during a run and a further press restarts the reveal from the beginning
Every run, including interrupted ones, ends in exactly the finished state
Multiple pieces coexist, each with its own reveal flavour, and each affects only itself
adaptable_details: The specific words or phrases used
Number of lettering pieces on the view and their layout arrangement
How the layers are visually separated, number of stacked layers and layer offset direction
Exact durations, delays and springiness amount
Per-piece flavour choices such as letter order, stroke direction or which layer leads
Wording, shape and styling of the plain control
Whether letters return from a shared direction or from varied ones
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits short display lettering, wordmarks, titles or logotypes whose forms are stroke-based and built from stacked, mutually distinguishable layers, presented as artwork to be admired on a showcase, hero or gallery region. Reading-length body copy, photographic or raster artwork with no drawable strokes, or flat single-layer type would remove the stroke-draw and layer-stacking disclosure that define this experience. Making the reveal autoplay on scroll or loop continuously, removing the finished-on-arrival resting state, or letting one control animate all pieces at once would each create a different Skill.

name: single_control_depth_descent
description: A quiet full-view scene above a horizontal boundary shows only a name and a one-line promise; one corner control sinks the whole view beneath the boundary into a scene held at a distinctly deeper tonal register, where small icon-and-label highlights arrive one after another, and pressing the same control rises back to the opening calm.

canonical_document.name: single_control_depth_descent
canonical_document.description: A quiet full-view scene above a horizontal boundary shows only a name and a one-line promise; one corner control sinks the whole view beneath the boundary into a scene held at a distinctly deeper tonal register, where small icon-and-label highlights arrive one after another, and pressing the same control rises back to the opening calm.
canonical_document.experience_scope: Whole-view experience covering the entire landing view from first arrival through the descent, the submerged destination and the return; it has two persistent modes (above and below) and no separate region outside itself.
content_and_composition: One full-view upper scene containing a visible horizontal boundary line that reads as a surface between the two scenes
Exactly one short name line plus one single-line promise as the only foreground text above the boundary, centered and unaccompanied by other calls to action
One full-view lower scene occupying the same viewport area, held at a clearly deeper, more enclosed luminance register than the upper scene, in whatever hues the host uses
A small set of compact highlight items below (roughly three to six), each an icon paired with a short label, arranged as the destination content
One small persistent control anchored in a screen corner, present and in the same place in both modes, carrying a mark that indicates the current direction of travel
A brief entry holding state before the settled upper view, carrying an invitation to turn sound on and no competing content
An ambient trail layer that exists only in the lower scene, behind the highlight content and following the pointer
experience_progression: Short holding moment on arrival that invites enabling sound and shows nothing that competes for attention
Settled upper view: the name and its one-line promise hold all attention in a calm, still scene

Descent begins on the first press: the upper scene lifts away while the lower scene takes over the same viewport, the name is carried upward, and the tonal register and ambience deepen throughout the move
Arrival below: the highlights enter one after another and become clickable only once they have arrived
Ascent on a second press: the move reverses along the same axis and the opening calm view is restored
attention_and_information_flow: Above, attention is deliberately starved of alternatives so the two text lines are the only focus
During the move, attention follows the upward-travelling name and the incoming lower scene, so the transition itself is the object of interest rather than a gap between states
Below, attention spreads across the highlights in the order they arrive, giving each item a brief moment of prominence before the set reads as a group
The corner control stays the only persistent affordance in both modes and its mark tells the visitor which direction remains available
Revealed information increases only downward: identity above, specifics below, never both competing at once

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Resolves on its own or on acknowledgement; it does not reappear later in the session
interaction_model.state_change: Held opening moment resolves into the settled upper view
interaction_model.visible_feedback: A brief pause with a sound invitation, then the calm scene with name and promise
interaction_model.input: Autonomous arrival
interaction_model.affected_object: Entry holding state and the upper scene beneath it

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: A second press reverses the whole move; the transition is the only path between modes so there is no partial or stranded state
interaction_model.state_change: Above mode becomes below mode in one continuous vertical move
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The upper scene lifts away as the lower one takes over the same viewport, the name travels upward, and the tonal register and ambience deepen continuously during the descent in whatever hues the host uses
interaction_model.input: Press of the persistent corner control while above
interaction_model.affected_object: Both full-view scenes and the name line

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: The control never disappears or moves, so return is always one press away
interaction_model.state_change: Direction indicator flips between the descend mark and a return arrow
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The glyph visibly changes so the way back is always obvious from the same corner
interaction_model.input: Mode change in either direction
interaction_model.affected_object: The mark shown on the corner control

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: They are not clickable before arriving; ascending removes them and returns them to the inert state
interaction_model.state_change: Highlights go from absent to present and from inert to clickable
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Items settle in one after another with a staggered entry, and only then respond to pointer attention
interaction_model.input: Completion of the descent
interaction_model.affected_object: Highlight items in the lower scene

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Exists only in the below mode and stops on ascent; stopping the pointer simply lets the existing trail finish rising
interaction_model.state_change: Trail elements are emitted along the path the pointer travels
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Small bubbles rise from the pointer path, staying just separable from the surrounding scene, and fade as they ascend
interaction_model.input: Pointer movement while below
interaction_model.affected_object: Ambient trail layer behind the lower content

experience_qualities: Calm and unhurried above, with deliberate emptiness around the two text lines
A clear sense of vertical travel and depth rather than a swap between pages
Mood deepens continuously during the move instead of changing abruptly at the end
Fully reversible and symmetrical, so exploring downward feels safe
Quiet ambient liveliness below, responsive to the pointer without demanding action
completion_and_return: The descent is complete when every highlight has arrived and become clickable
The below state persists until the control is pressed again; it does not time out or auto-return
Ascent restores the opening upper view, its calm, and the original control mark
The two modes can be toggled repeatedly with the same result each time; there is no looping or one-way commitment
locked_observable_requirements: Exactly two full-view scenes related along a vertical axis, separated by a visible boundary in the upper view, the lower scene reading at a perceptibly deeper luminance level than the upper whatever hues are chosen
One persistent corner control drives both directions, and its mark flips to a return indicator once below
The change is one continuous move within the same viewport, with the upper scene lifting away as the lower takes over, never a discrete page swap
The name line is carried upward during the descent rather than simply disappearing
The upper view carries only a name and a single promise line as foreground content
Highlights arrive sequentially and become clickable only after arriving, holding readable contrast against the lower scene
The pointer leaves a rising, fading trail only in the lower scene
A second press fully restores the opening state
adaptable_details: All hues in both scenes, and how large the luminance step down to the lower scene is, as long as the step stays clearly perceptible
Styling of the boundary line and of each scene's texture
Number, labels and icon style of the highlights and their arrangement below
Transition duration, easing and stagger spacing
Which corner holds the control and the exact glyph shapes
Whether a sound invitation appears at all and what the ambience is
Size, density and lifetime of the trail elements
Typography of the name and promise
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits content-light introductions that lead with one identity line and one promise and then offer a small set of compact highlight items, where a two-level depth metaphor gives the step downward meaning. It stays the same skill across different scene imagery, hue families, luminance ranges, highlight counts and moods. It becomes a different skill if the travel is driven continuously by scrolling instead of one toggle, if there are more than two depth levels or stops, if the destination holds dense multi-section content that must be scrolled, or if the upper view must carry navigation and multiple calls to action alongside the name.

source_sites.title: Above & Beneath: Featured Content Layout Effect

name: directional_slab_wipe_screen_exchange
description: Small outward-pointing arrows ring the edges and corners of the view; clicking one sends broad fully opaque slabs sweeping in from that side or diagonal, blanketing the whole view while the screens trade places unseen, then continuing off the opposite side to reveal the new screen cleanly settled.

canonical_document.name: directional_slab_wipe_screen_exchange
canonical_document.description: Small outward-pointing arrows ring the edges and corners of the view; clicking one sends broad fully opaque slabs sweeping in from that side or diagonal, blanketing the whole view while the screens trade places unseen, then continuing off the opposite side to reveal the new screen cleanly settled.
canonical_document.experience_scope: Whole-view experience. It begins the instant a perimeter arrow is clicked and ends when the last slab has left the far side and the arriving screen stands alone and settled with all arrows live again. Between moves the view is a static minimal screen with its arrow ring; the ring itself persists across the whole experience.
content_and_composition: Two interchangeable full-view screens, each holding only a small amount of text-scale foreground content (a few words or one short passage) placed as a single calm focal block with generous empty space around it.

One perimeter control ring of eight small arrow affordances: one centred on each of the four sides and one in each of the four corners, each drawn pointing outward from the view along the direction of the move it performs.

A transient overlay layer of broad fully opaque slabs, clearly separated in surface treatment from both screens so their edges read crisply, sitting above all screen content while a move runs and absent at rest.
Layer order at rest: screen content beneath, arrow ring above and clear of it; during a move the slab layer occludes both content and, at full coverage, the entire view.
Only one screen is ever visible at rest; the outgoing and incoming screens are never both on show.
experience_progression: Rest: one screen visible with its few words, arrow ring quietly present and readable as an invitation that another view is one move away.
Arm: pointer over an arrow shifts that arrow into a visibly higher-emphasis state, confirming which direction is about to be taken.
Launch: on click, fully opaque slabs enter from the chosen edge or diagonal and advance across the view along that direction.
Cover: slabs occlude the entire view; the screen exchange happens fully hidden behind them.
Clear: slabs continue and exit off the opposite side, uncovering the arriving screen in their wake.
Settle: arriving screen rests as the new stable view, all eight arrows become live again, and the opposite arrow now performs the exact mirror move back.
attention_and_information_flow: At rest attention sits on the sparse focal words; the small arrows read as peripheral but unmistakable, communicating available directions without instructional copy.
The hover emphasis shift narrows attention to a single direction before commitment.
During the move attention is claimed wholly by the crossing opaque slabs; no content competes and the exchange is deliberately withheld from view.
Uncovering hands attention back to the arriving focal block, which lands with nothing else changing.
Travel direction stays legible throughout: the arrow chosen, the entry edge, the sweep direction and the exit side all agree, so the visitor knows how they arrived and how to undo it.

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Purely indicative and freely reversible; hovering commits nothing and moving away restores the resting appearance
interaction_model.state_change: Arrow moves from resting to highlighted state
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The arrow shifts to a distinctly higher-emphasis appearance while the pointer is over it and returns to rest on exit
interaction_model.input: Pointer hovers a perimeter arrow
interaction_model.affected_object: That single arrow control

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: The move always completes as a unit; the opposite arrow afterwards performs the mirror move and returns to the previous screen, feeling identical in the other direction
interaction_model.state_change: View goes from settled to running a directional handoff, and the visible screen is exchanged for the other while covered
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Fully opaque slabs enter from the edge or diagonal that the arrow points along, advance until the whole view is covered, then continue off the far side revealing the other screen already in place
interaction_model.input: Click on a perimeter arrow (side or corner)
interaction_model.affected_object: Whole view: slab overlay layer plus the pair of screens

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Moves cannot be interrupted, stacked or queued; the boundary self-clears the moment the slabs leave the view, at which point every arrow is live again
interaction_model.state_change: No state change; the input is discarded
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Nothing responds — no new slabs, no arrow emphasis change of consequence, the running sweep continues undisturbed
interaction_model.input: Any arrow click while a move is running
interaction_model.affected_object: The in-flight handoff

experience_qualities: Light and immediate on arrival, with almost nothing to read
Self-evident directionality without instructions
Deliberate, staged, theatrical handoff rather than a quick cut
Bold and graphic while covered; calm and settled once landed
Legible travel direction and exact symmetry on return
Reliable and unstackable, never leaving a half-finished or doubled state
completion_and_return: Each move completes only when the slabs have fully left the opposite side; there is no partial or aborted end state.
On completion the arriving screen is the new resting view and the full ring of eight arrows is interactive again.
Return is achieved by clicking the opposite arrow, producing the mirror move and restoring the earlier screen with the same staging.
The experience loops indefinitely between the two screens with no terminal state and no accumulated progress.
locked_observable_requirements: Eight arrow controls ringing the view: one centred per side, one per corner, each pointing outward along the move it triggers.
Arrows shift to a clearly higher-emphasis state under the pointer and revert when it leaves.
Slabs are broad and fully opaque, read as clearly separated from the screens they cover, and at some moment cover the entire view completely.
Slab entry direction matches the clicked arrow's direction, and slabs continue on to exit the opposite side rather than retreating.
The screen exchange is never visible; the other screen is already standing when the slabs clear.
Only one screen is on show at rest, carrying a small amount of focal content at readable contrast against its surround.
Input during a run is ignored outright — no interruption, no stacking, no queued moves.
All arrows become live again as soon as the view is clear, and the opposite arrow reverses the move symmetrically.
adaptable_details: Slab surface treatment, number of slabs, their widths and whether they advance in lockstep or slightly offset
Duration, easing and pacing of entry, coverage and exit
Arrow glyph shape, size, inset from the edge and the exact emphasis-shift treatment
Typography, wording and layout of each screen's focal block
Surround treatment of the resting screens, provided the focal block stays comfortably readable against it
Number of destination screens beyond two, provided each move stays a single covered exchange
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits sparse full-view screens whose content is a small focal block that can be swapped wholesale — short headings, statements, quotes, chapter or section title views — in contexts where switching views is itself the featured gesture. It stops being this Skill if the slabs become translucent or the exchange is shown, if the two screens are ever visible together or shift relative to each other, if the cover retreats the way it came instead of passing off the far side, if the direction chosen stops being expressed by an outward-pointing perimeter control, if moves can be interrupted or queued, or if the arriving views carry dense scrollable content that outlives the covered moment.

name: stroke_written_word_specimen_stack
description: An oversized letterform fills the opening view, then a vertical stack of full-bleed panels — each a flat uniform field clearly separated from its neighbours — each holds a single word that writes itself into existence from arcs and straight strokes, with a small replay control that disappears while the word draws and reappears once it settles.

canonical_document.name: stroke_written_word_specimen_stack
canonical_document.description: An oversized letterform fills the opening view, then a vertical stack of full-bleed panels — each a flat uniform field clearly separated from its neighbours — each holds a single word that writes itself into existence from arcs and straight strokes, with a small replay control that disappears while the word draws and reappears once it settles.
canonical_document.experience_scope: Whole-view experience beginning with an oversized letterform entry panel and continuing through a vertical stack of one-word panels; each panel is also an independently deployable region containing its own word, flat field and replay control. The experience ends at the last word panel, with each word left standing in finished legible form.
content_and_composition: One entry panel dominated by a single hugely oversized letterform used as mood-setting graphic rather than reading content; it may bleed past the viewport edges.
A vertical stack of several (roughly three to eight) panels below the entry, one panel per sample word.

Each panel: exactly one short word rendered as constructed letterforms, centred as the sole focal object, on its own flat uniform field that is visibly separated from the fields of neighbouring panels, with the word held at readable contrast against that field.
Letters within a word are visibly built from arc segments and straight strokes; stroke weight, scale and spacing rhythm differ from word to word so the stack demonstrates a range.
One small, quiet trigger affordance sits beside or beneath each word, subordinate in size and contrast to the word itself.
No competing imagery, captions or decoration inside a word panel; the field stays empty apart from word and trigger.
experience_progression: Entry: the oversized letterform holds attention alone, establishing scale and mood before any word is read.
Downward movement: attention leaves the letterform and arrives at the first word panel; the field change at each panel boundary marks the step.
Per word: on arrival or on trigger, the word clears to empty, then lays itself back down stroke by stroke, letters starting at staggered times rather than together.
Within a word, some letters retract their existing strokes before redrawing, so the performance reads as rewriting rather than only additive appearance.
Settling: strokes complete letter by letter until the last letter finishes and the word rests as static, fully legible type.
Continuing downward reveals the next word with its own weight, scale and rhythm, cumulatively showing the alphabet's range.
attention_and_information_flow: Opening prominence belongs entirely to the oversized letterform; it carries no information beyond mood and scale.
Each panel gives a single word uncontested prominence because it is alone on an otherwise empty flat field.
During a performance the word is unreadable-in-progress and the eye follows the moving stroke tips; the trigger recedes so nothing competes with the drawing.
Legibility is the payoff: information (the word) is only fully available once the performance settles.
State is always legible at a glance — mid-performance versus settled is unmistakable from the incomplete strokes and the absent trigger.
Across panels, comparison emerges: differing weights, scales and stroke rhythms let the visitor read the alphabet's range as a whole.

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Further presses during the performance are ignored so performances never overlap; the trigger returns only when the last letter settles, at which point the word is intact and ready to run again
interaction_model.state_change: Word goes from settled to cleared, then to performing; panel enters an exclusive performing state
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The word wipes away to an empty field, then letters reappear one after another as arcs and straight strokes are laid down at staggered start times, some letters retracting strokes before redrawing; the trigger recedes out of prominence
interaction_model.input: Press or activate the small trigger beside a settled word
interaction_model.affected_object: That panel's word and its trigger

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: The performance always runs to completion rather than being cancelled; recovery is the trigger reappearing at settle
interaction_model.state_change: No state change; input is absorbed
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Nothing interrupts or restarts; the recessed trigger visibly signals that it is not accepting input
interaction_model.input: Press the trigger while its word is already performing
interaction_model.affected_object: The in-progress performance

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Moving away and back leaves each word in its last settled, legible form; nothing is lost, and any word can be replayed from its own trigger
interaction_model.state_change: Panel becomes the focused one; its word moves from unseen to presented (drawing or settled)
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Full-bleed field change on panel change, the new field clearly separated from the previous one; the word occupies the field alone and its stroke-drawing performance is what greets the visitor
interaction_model.input: Downward movement through the page toward a word panel
interaction_model.affected_object: The panel's word and flat field

experience_qualities: Playful and specimen-like: reads as a type sample sheet with personality rather than a product page
Handmade or plotted feeling — words appear written into existence rather than faded or slid in
Deliberate, unhurried rhythm; staggered letter timing gives each word its own cadence
Bold and graphic through huge scale and flat, uniform, high-impact fields
Unambiguous state: performing versus finished is never in doubt
Calm exclusivity — only one performance at a time, no overlapping motion clutter
completion_and_return: Each performance completes at the last settling letter and leaves the word as static, fully legible type; it does not loop on its own.
The trigger reappears at completion, returning the panel to an idle, replay-ready state.
Replays are unlimited and identical in kind; each ends in the same settled form.
Settled state persists as the panel's resting appearance while the visitor moves elsewhere on the page.
The oversized entry letterform remains the page's fixed opening state and is not consumed or altered by word performances.
locked_observable_requirements: An oversized single letterform dominates the entry view before any word is read
One word per full-bleed flat field, alone, with adjacent fields visibly separated from one another and each word held at readable contrast against its own field
Words are visibly constructed from arc segments and straight strokes, not faded, typed or slid into place
Letters begin at staggered times rather than all at once
At least some letters retract existing strokes before being redrawn
Stroke weight, scale and rhythm vary between words so the set demonstrates range
A small subordinate trigger sits beside each word and recedes for the duration of that word's performance
