Input during a performance is ignored; performances never overlap
The trigger returns only after the last letter settles
Every performance ends in a static, fully legible word
adaptable_details: Number of word panels and choice of words
Which letterform occupies the entry panel
Specific hues, tones and light-or-dark direction of the fields and of the letterforms, so long as each word stays readable against its field and adjacent fields stay clearly separated
Trigger shape, icon, label and exact placement beside the word
Total performance duration and per-letter stagger offsets
Which particular letters retract before redrawing
Whether a word draws on first arrival or waits for its trigger
Panel height, word alignment within the field, and the letterform's exact overflow at the entry
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits short showcase strings — sample words, names, slogans, single terms — where the shape of the letters is itself the subject and each item deserves a full field of its own. It does not fit paragraphs, running body copy, dense lists or content that must be readable immediately on arrival, since legibility is deliberately delayed. Replacing stroke-by-stroke construction with fades, slides or typewriter character reveals, allowing overlapping simultaneous performances, or placing multiple words together on one shared field each produce a different skill.

name: depth_stacked_section_overview
description: A quiet full-screen section that sinks back on command to reveal the neighbouring sections stacked behind it and a rising list of section names, then floats the chosen one forward to full screen again.

canonical_document.name: depth_stacked_section_overview
canonical_document.description: A quiet full-screen section that sinks back on command to reveal the neighbouring sections stacked behind it and a rising list of section names, then floats the chosen one forward to full screen again.
canonical_document.experience_scope: Whole-view experience covering the entire site surface: it begins in the single full-screen reading view, expands into the pulled-back overview mode, and ends when a section is back at full screen; the corner control persists across both modes.
content_and_composition: Reading mode: exactly one section fills the viewport, composed of three roles — one large title, one short line of supporting text, one image — with nothing else competing for attention.
A single small control anchored in a screen corner, present in both modes, doubling as the entry and exit affordance.
Overview mode: the section that was in view sits forward-most but pushed down and back; the next two sections appear as cards stacked behind it, each further one smaller and fainter with distance.
Overview mode: a list of section names occupies the upper half of the screen, in two prominence tiers — primary names large and strong, secondary names smaller and dimmer.
Cards and names refer to the same set of sections, so either surface can be used to reach a section.
experience_progression: Single quiet section held at full screen for reading.
Overview invoked: current section recedes downward and backward, sibling cards emerge behind it, names rise into the upper half, corner control becomes a close mark.
Overview held: the reader can read the whole set and see which card is the current one.
Selection: chosen section floats forward to full screen, the remaining cards drop away below, names disappear.
Back to the single quiet reading view; the loop can be re-entered at any time.
attention_and_information_flow: In reading mode attention is unforced: one title, one line, one image, no secondary items to scan past.
Entering the overview trades reading detail for positional awareness — the set becomes legible at once and depth ordering communicates where the reader currently is.
Distance-based fading pushes attention to the front card while still confirming that more sections exist behind it.
Two name tiers signal which parts of the set are main and which are minor without adding density.
Selecting collapses attention back to a single screen; the index and siblings withdraw completely rather than lingering as chrome.

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Fully reversible from the same control, now a close mark; reversal restores the previous section untouched
interaction_model.state_change: Reading mode becomes overview mode
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The section in view sinks down and back, the next two sections appear stacked behind it and fade with distance, section names rise into the upper half with main names prominent and minor names smaller and dimmer, and the control turns into a close mark
interaction_model.input: Activating the small corner control from the reading view
interaction_model.affected_object: Current section, its neighbouring sections, the name index, the control itself

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: The overview can be re-opened from the corner control at any time; picking the name of the front card returns without changing section
interaction_model.state_change: Overview mode becomes reading mode on the chosen section
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The chosen section floats forward to fill the screen while the other cards drop away below and the names disappear
interaction_model.input: Choosing a name from the risen index
interaction_model.affected_object: Target section, remaining stacked cards, name index

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Clicking the front-most card is the no-op path: it closes the overview and returns the reader unchanged
interaction_model.state_change: Overview mode becomes reading mode on the clicked section
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Same forward float to full screen, with the rest dropping away below and the names disappearing
interaction_model.input: Clicking any visible stacked card
interaction_model.affected_object: That section, the other cards, name index

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Guaranteed non-destructive exit — the reader is left exactly where they were before opening the overview
interaction_model.state_change: Overview mode reverses back to reading mode on the section the reader came from
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The pulled-back arrangement plays in reverse: cards and names withdraw and the original section rises back to full screen
interaction_model.input: Pressing Escape, or activating the close mark, while in the overview
interaction_model.affected_object: Whole overview arrangement and the originating section

experience_qualities: Calm and uncluttered in reading mode; nothing to scan past.
Spatial and physical — sinking back, stacking in depth, floating forward, dropping away below.
Immediately orienting: position within the whole set is obvious at a glance.
Reversible and low-risk, with an obvious way back that costs the reader nothing.
completion_and_return: Each cycle completes when a section is back at full screen in the quiet reading view.
Escape, the close mark, or picking the front card returns to the originating section unchanged rather than resetting to a first section.
The mode toggle can be repeated indefinitely; there is no terminal end state.
Which section is current persists across overview open and close.
locked_observable_requirements: One section at a time fills the whole screen, carrying only a large title, one short line of text and one image.
A single small corner control opens the overview and visibly becomes a close mark while the overview is open.
On opening, the current section moves down and backward rather than sideways or away.
Sibling sections appear stacked behind the current one and fade with increasing depth distance.
Section names rise into the upper half of the screen in two visible prominence tiers.
Both a name and a visible card are valid ways to reach the same section.
Selection floats the target forward to full screen while the others drop away downward and the names disappear.
Escape and the close mark reverse the overview and restore the reader's previous section unchanged.
adaptable_details: Total number of sections in the set.
How many sibling cards are visible behind the front one.
Which corner holds the control and its exact mark shapes.
Typography, palette, mood and the subject matter of the single image.
Additional dismissal inputs alongside Escape.
How the reader moves between sections while in reading mode.
Exact timing and easing of the sink, stack, rise and float movements.
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits a small-to-moderate set of comparable, self-contained sections whose content is sparse enough to live on one screen with a title, one line and one image. It stops working when sections carry dense, scrolling or long-form content that cannot be represented by a single card, or when the set grows large enough that the overview needs a scrollable grid, paging or search — a browsable thumbnail grid or list index would be a different skill, as would an overview that discards the reader's place instead of returning them unchanged.

name: glowing_shape_to_letter_row
description: A short centred row of glowing outlines on a visually quiet ground, read at first as plain geometry, whose figures take turns easing into recognisable characters until the whole row reads as a word, then easing back to bare form and repeating calmly before settling readable.

canonical_document.name: glowing_shape_to_letter_row
canonical_document.description: A short centred row of glowing outlines on a visually quiet ground, read at first as plain geometry, whose figures take turns easing into recognisable characters until the whole row reads as a word, then easing back to bare form and repeating calmly before settling readable.
canonical_document.experience_scope: A self-contained central region that can occupy the whole opening view; it begins a short beat after the page settles and continues as a looping run, ending only when it comes to rest on the readable state.
content_and_composition: One visually quiet, low-distraction stage acting as the backdrop for the entire experience
A small fixed set of foreground figures, three in the observed case, arranged in a single horizontal row
The row is centred in the stage and remains the sole focal content; no surrounding chrome, labels or controls compete with it
Each figure is paired one-to-one with exactly one character, so the row as a whole spells one short readable string
Figures are rendered as glowing outlines held clearly apart from the backdrop by luminance, giving a single consistent luminous layer above the ground
The row's position, order and spacing persist across the whole run; only the form of each figure changes
experience_progression: Opening rest: the row is visible as bare geometry only, with nothing yet legible, and it holds still for a noticeable beat
Sequential becoming: attention travels along the row in order, each figure in turn easing from its plain form into its character while the others stay in their current form
Legible peak: once the last figure has turned, the row is held long enough to be read as text
Sequential undoing: the figures ease back to bare form, again taken in turn along the row, returning the row to pure geometry
Calm alternation: the becoming and undoing repeat at an unhurried pace without change of speed or urgency
Final settle: the run comes to rest on the readable state rather than on the geometric state
attention_and_information_flow: At first glance the row offers only form, so attention is on shape and glow rather than meaning
Prominence moves along the row one figure at a time, so the eye is led in a single direction rather than to the whole row at once
Each transition makes the kinship between one plain form and one character legible in isolation before the next begins
Meaning accumulates figure by figure until the row resolves into a single readable message
The reverse pass withdraws meaning again, returning attention to pure form and inviting a second reading of the pairing
Because the run ends readable, the final state a visitor is left with is the message, not the abstraction

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: No user action is required, offered or awaited; the run cannot be triggered early and needs no prompting to continue
interaction_model.state_change: The row leaves its untouched geometric rest state and enters the alternating run
interaction_model.visible_feedback: After a held pause, the first figure begins easing toward its character while the rest still read as geometry
interaction_model.input: Autonomous timer starting a short beat after the view settles
interaction_model.affected_object: The row of figures as an ordered set

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: The alternation continues unprompted at a steady calm pace and finally comes to rest on the readable state
interaction_model.state_change: A figure transitions between its plain form and its paired character, and the row alternates between geometric and readable overall states
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Eased, unhurried outline change per figure, with prominence handed along the row and the row's legibility building up and then dissolving
interaction_model.input: Autonomous advance through the run
interaction_model.affected_object: Each individual figure in row order

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: The run is not interrupted or restarted mid-flow; whatever stage it had reached continues from where it was
interaction_model.state_change: The composition rescales proportionally about its own centre
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The row grows or shrinks as a unit, stays centred, keeps its proportions, and is never clipped at any size
interaction_model.input: Resizing the viewport
interaction_model.affected_object: The whole composition: stage and row together

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Reload is the only way to restart the run; nothing from a previous visit is carried over
interaction_model.state_change: Everything returns to the untouched opening state
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The bare geometric row reappears, holds its opening beat, and the full run replays from the beginning
interaction_model.input: Reloading the page
interaction_model.affected_object: The whole experience

experience_qualities: Calm, unhurried and evenly paced, with no sudden or emphatic motion
Quiet and low-distraction, with glow and its luminance separation from the ground supplying the only visual energy
Legible and demonstrative: the relationship between a form and its character is easy to grasp
Sparse and centred, reading as a single deliberate display rather than a busy scene
Passive and ambient, watched rather than operated
Continuous rather than abrupt, since every change is eased instead of switched
completion_and_return: The run loops through becoming and undoing repeatedly without user input
It resolves by settling on the readable state, which is the resting end condition
Viewport changes do not reset progress; the run carries on across resizing
Reload fully resets to the untouched geometric opening and replays from the start
No progress, position or interaction state persists between visits
locked_observable_requirements: A visually quiet, low-distraction backdrop with the figures as the only foreground content
A single centred horizontal row of a small number of glowing figures, clearly separated from the backdrop in luminance
The row reads as plain geometry before anything becomes legible
One-to-one pairing of each figure with exactly one character, so the row spells one short string
Transitions happen one figure at a time in row order, not simultaneously across the row
Transitions are eased and unhurried, so form and character read as continuously related
The row reaches a fully legible state that is held long enough to read
The figures also return to bare form, so the alternation goes both ways
The run starts by itself after a held opening beat, with no click, hover or drag anywhere in the experience
Resizing rescales the whole composition proportionally about its centre, never cropping it and never restarting the run
The experience ends at rest on the readable state
Reload restores the untouched opening figures and replays the full run
adaptable_details: The particular forms used and the particular characters they resolve into
The short string spelled by the row, and the exact count of figures within a small handful
Hue of figures and ground, glow strength, and the direction and amount of luminance separation between them
Stroke weight and whether figures read as outlines or filled marks
Exact durations of the opening beat, each transition, the legible hold and the gaps between passes
The easing shape of each transition
How many alternating passes occur before the final settle
Row spacing and overall scale relative to the view
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits short one-word or few-glyph messages where every glyph can be credibly paired with one simple form, presented as a sparse centred focal display over a visually quiet, low-distraction ground that the glowing figures read clearly against. Scaling up to sentences, paragraphs or dense body text, requiring a click, hover, drag or scroll to drive the change, breaking the single centred row into a scattered or depth-staged scene, or letting the figures animate all at once instead of in turn would each produce a different skill.

name: teaser_grows_into_full_story_with_lens_pinch
description: Picture-led teasers on a faint geometric backdrop; picking one fades the rest away and lifts it out of its slot until it fills the window, its photograph pinching to a small round window and opening back out while the caption slips off and the full text rides up, with the backdrop lighting cell by cell only inside the growing footprint.

canonical_document.name: teaser_grows_into_full_story_with_lens_pinch
canonical_document.description: Picture-led teasers on a faint geometric backdrop; picking one fades the rest away and lifts it out of its slot until it fills the window, its photograph pinching to a small round window and opening back out while the caption slips off and the full text rides up, with the backdrop lighting cell by cell only inside the growing footprint.
canonical_document.experience_scope: Region-to-whole-view: begins in the main overview region holding the preview set and expands to occupy the full window as an open reading state; ends when the open item collapses back into its original slot and the overview is restored. Surrounding page furniture participates only by fading out and back.
content_and_composition: One overview set of many image-led teasers arranged in slots, each teaser composed of a full-bleed photograph with an overlaid short headline and a one-line hook only
A faint geometric (triangulated) pattern layer sitting behind the whole set as a low-contrast substrate
Exactly one item may be in the open state at a time; when open it fills the window and carries secondary metadata (byline, date) plus long-form body text that were not visible on the teaser
A close control persistently anchored at the top right of the open state
Surrounding page furniture (header/nav/other page chrome) present in the overview, faded out while an item is open
The open item's own photograph remains the visual anchor at the top of the reading view; the other teasers are absent (faded and shrunk) rather than rearranged
experience_progression: Overview: equal-weight picture-led teasers read as teasers, backdrop pattern unlit and faint
Selection: unchosen teasers fade and shrink away; page furniture fades; the chosen teaser detaches from its slot
Growth: the chosen item scales and travels continuously from its slot footprint toward filling the window, so the reading view visibly grows out of the teaser rather than replacing it

During growth: its photograph pinches inward to a small round window at its centre and then opens back out; the overlaid caption slips away; byline, date and body text ride up into place; the backdrop pattern lights cell by cell, only within the currently occupied footprint
Open reading state: page-level scrolling is off; reading scrolls inside the expanded item; the close control stays reachable at the top right

Close: the identical sequence runs backwards — text returns to its own top, the item shrinks and settles back into its original slot, the backdrop unlights, the other teasers and page furniture return
Return: overview appears exactly as before, ready for another pick
attention_and_information_flow: Overview gives all teasers comparable prominence; the photograph leads and text is deliberately minimal (headline plus one-line hook) so the set reads as pictures first
Selection collapses attention to a single item by removing competitors rather than by dimming an overlay on top of them
Information depth increases only as the footprint grows: teaser-level text is retired and byline, date and full body are revealed
The pinch-and-reopen of the photograph creates a brief focal point at the item's centre, handing attention from image to text
Backdrop illumination is a progress cue tied to the expanding footprint, so the growth reads as spreading into the page
Closing reverses the depth: body text scrolls back to its top and the set regains equal prominence

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Fully reversible by the close control, which replays the sequence backwards to the original slot and overview
interaction_model.state_change: Overview state becomes single-item open state; the chosen item is promoted out of its slot to window-filling
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Siblings fade and shrink away, page furniture fades, the chosen teaser lifts from its slot and grows to fill the window, its photograph pinches to a small round centre window then opens out, the overlaid caption slips away, byline/date/body ride up, and backdrop cells light one by one inside the growing footprint
interaction_model.input: Selecting a teaser's photograph in the overview
interaction_model.affected_object: The chosen item, the sibling teasers, the backdrop layer and surrounding page furniture

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Guarded no-op so repeated selection cannot restart or double-run the expansion
interaction_model.state_change: None
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Nothing changes; the reading state is undisturbed
interaction_model.input: Selecting the photograph of an already-open item
interaction_model.affected_object: The open item

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Page-level scrolling is restored when the item closes; the body's own scroll position is discarded on close
interaction_model.state_change: Reading position advances inside the expanded item only
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Text moves within the window-filling item; the page behind does not scroll
interaction_model.input: Scrolling while an item is open
interaction_model.affected_object: The expanded item's body content

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Lands on the unchanged overview with the same slot arrangement, ready for another selection
interaction_model.state_change: Single-item open state returns to overview state
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Body text returns to its top, the item shrinks and settles back into its original slot, backdrop cells unlight, siblings and page furniture reappear
interaction_model.input: Activating the close control at the top right
interaction_model.affected_object: The open item, the sibling teasers, the backdrop layer and page furniture

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Unlights in the same progressive manner during the reverse sequence
interaction_model.state_change: Pattern cells switch from faint to lit progressively
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Triangles illuminate one by one, clipped to the area the growing item currently covers
interaction_model.input: Footprint growth of the expanding item (autonomous driver during the transition)
interaction_model.affected_object: Backdrop geometric pattern

experience_qualities: Continuous and grown-from-source rather than page-to-page
Picture-led and sparse at the overview, text-rich once open
Focused: competitors are removed, not merely dimmed
Mechanically precise and symmetric — closing feels like the opening run in reverse
A small moment of lens-like drama at the photograph's centre during the handoff
Quietly decorative substrate that becomes briefly active only where the expansion reaches
completion_and_return: Reading has no forced end; the reader leaves via the close control at any point
Close restores the overview to its prior appearance with the item back in its original slot
Body scroll position resets to the top; no read/visited state is shown afterwards
The overview is immediately ready for another selection, and the cycle can repeat any number of times
locked_observable_requirements: Teasers show only a photograph with an overlaid headline and single-line hook in the overview
The chosen item expands out of its own slot footprint continuously to fill the window; no separate view arrives
Unchosen items fade and shrink away instead of remaining as visible siblings
The photograph pinches inward to a small round window at its centre and opens back out during the move
The overlaid teaser caption departs and the fuller text (with secondary metadata) rides up into place during the same move
A geometric backdrop pattern lights cell by cell, restricted to the expanding footprint
Page-level scrolling is disabled while open; reading scrolls inside the expanded item
Surrounding page furniture fades out while open and returns on close
A close control at the top right runs the entire sequence in reverse, returning the item to its original slot and the overview to its prior state
Only one item can be open at a time; re-selecting the open item's picture does nothing
Body text is returned to its top as part of the closing sequence
adaptable_details: Slot arrangement and count of the overview set (grid, staggered, list-like)
Durations, easing and the exact ordering overlap of the sub-moves
Geometry of the backdrop cells (triangles or another repeating tessellation) and their lit colour or brightness
Size and softness of the pinched round window
Direction and distance of the caption's exit and the text's rise
Visual form of the close control
Which secondary metadata fields appear once open
Typography, palette and image aspect ratios
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits sets of image-led previews whose detail view is a single continuous body of content worth reading or inspecting in place — feature stories, case studies, project or product write-ups, profiles. It needs a real photograph or dominant image per item for the pinch-and-reopen beat, and enough detail content to justify inner scrolling. It stops being this Skill if the detail view arrives as a separate page or overlay panel rather than growing from the item's own slot, if the other previews stay visible around it, if multiple items can be open at once, or if the detail content is short enough to need no inner scrolling.

name: gooey_blob_message_extrusion
description: Sent lines swell out of the bottom bar as a soft mass wearing the sender side's own fill, pinch free, glide into the thread and firm into a rounded bubble, while a bulging dot cluster stands in for the reply forming before it springs in from the other side.

canonical_document.name: gooey_blob_message_extrusion
canonical_document.description: Sent lines swell out of the bottom bar as a soft mass wearing the sender side's own fill, pinch free, glide into the thread and firm into a rounded bubble, while a bulging dot cluster stands in for the reply forming before it springs in from the other side.
canonical_document.experience_scope: A bounded panel region containing a scrolling thread plus a fixed composer bar at its foot; the experience begins on view entry with an exchange already in progress and continues turn by turn for as long as the panel is present. Each send-to-settle and each presence-to-reply cycle is a self-contained episode inside that region; nothing extends outside the panel.
content_and_composition: One scrolling thread region occupying most of the panel, holding a vertical sequence of short rounded text bubbles

Two opposed speaker sides: user entries aligned to one horizontal edge of the thread, counterpart entries aligned to the opposite edge, further distinguished by two clearly separated fill treatments (any hue, tone or weight, so long as each stays readable against the thread surround)
A small number of pre-existing opening lines visible on entry (enough to show both sides and imply the next turn without explanatory text)
One persistent composer bar pinned to the bottom edge: a growable single-field writing area plus one send affordance
One transient soft blob object that exists only between the composer bar and its destination bubble, wearing the user side's fill treatment
One transient presence cluster of small dots emerging from the bottom bar on the counterpart side, accompanied by a brief note that the other party is composing
The newest entry always occupying the visible bottom of the thread
experience_progression: Entry: the thread appears mid-conversation with a few short lines already settled and the newest one in view
Commit: typed words leave the field and the composer bar bulges upward into a filled mass carrying the user side's fill treatment
Detach: the mass stretches, necks and pinches free of the bar, which relaxes back to its resting shape
Travel: the freed blob glides along the panel toward the user side of the thread while the thread makes room for it
Settle: the blob firms into a rounded bubble carrying the text, taking its place as the newest entry
Presence: after a short beat, a dot cluster bulges out of the bottom bar on the counterpart side beneath a short composing note
Reply: the cluster and note sink back into the bar and the counterpart bubble springs in from the opposite side as the new newest entry
Return to ready: composer at resting size, thread scrolled to the newest line, awaiting the next turn (loops indefinitely)
attention_and_information_flow: On entry, attention lands on the last visible lines and then on the composer, because the short prior exchange makes the next action self-evident
During a send, prominence moves with the blob: the composer bar briefly dominates as it swells, then the moving mass owns attention until it firms into place
Once settled, the blob loses distinctness and reads as an ordinary thread entry, returning attention to the bottom of the thread
The presence cluster is deliberately small and low in the panel — enough to say a reply is forming, never enough to read as a progress or loading device
The incoming reply briefly claims attention through its entry motion from the opposite side, then settles into the thread's calm rhythm
Newly revealed information is only ever message text and the fact that the other side is composing

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: The flight is short and non-cancellable; a further send during flight starts an additional independent blob without disturbing the one already travelling
interaction_model.state_change: Field empties; a new user entry is created at the end of the thread
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The bar swells into a filled blob wearing the user side's fill treatment, stretches and pinches loose, glides to the user side of the thread and firms into a rounded bubble carrying the text
interaction_model.input: Typing text in the composer field and pressing the confirm key
interaction_model.affected_object: Field contents, composer bar, thread

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: The affordance always returns to its resting appearance after the flick, leaving the composer immediately usable
interaction_model.state_change: Identical send transition is triggered
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The icon flicks away and a fresh one returns in its place while the blob-to-bubble sequence runs
interaction_model.input: Activating the send affordance instead of the confirm key
interaction_model.affected_object: Send affordance and the same send sequence

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: The composer stays exactly as it was, so the failed attempt costs nothing
interaction_model.state_change: None
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Nothing moves, nothing is added, no error is shown
interaction_model.input: Confirming with an empty or whitespace-only field
interaction_model.affected_object: Composer and thread

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Growth is bounded so the thread is never crowded out; the space is always given back on send
interaction_model.state_change: Writing area grows to fit the text, then returns to resting size after sending
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The composer expands upward and the thread visibly yields the space, then reclaims it once the entry is sent
interaction_model.input: Entering a long multi-line message
interaction_model.affected_object: Composer writing area and the thread's available height

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: The view continues to settle on the newest entry when motion ends; the blob never detaches from or overshoots its target
interaction_model.state_change: The thread keeps chasing its newest entry while the blob stays bound to its destination
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The blob remains visually locked to the bubble it is becoming, landing correctly even though the view moved mid-flight
interaction_model.input: Scrolling the thread while a blob is in flight
interaction_model.affected_object: Thread scroll position and the travelling blob

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: The presence cluster always resolves — it withdraws into the bar rather than lingering or being dismissed — and the thread scrolls so the reply is in view
interaction_model.state_change: Presence state appears, then resolves into a counterpart entry
interaction_model.visible_feedback: A dot cluster bulges out of the bottom bar under a brief composing note, then sinks back in as the reply springs into the thread from the opposite side
interaction_model.input: Autonomous beat after a user entry settles
interaction_model.affected_object: Bottom bar and counterpart side of the thread

experience_qualities: Soft-bodied and physical: content behaves like cohesive matter that swells, necks, tears free and firms
Playful without being noisy
Continuous: input and placed content are one substance in motion, never a disappear-then-appear swap
Alive: the pause before a reply reads as another presence forming, not as machinery working
Calm and ready between turns, with the newest line reliably in view
Self-explanatory: the in-progress exchange teaches the next action with no instructional copy
completion_and_return: Each send completes when the blob firms into a settled bubble and the composer bar and send affordance are back at rest with an empty field
Each presence episode completes by withdrawing into the bottom bar as the counterpart entry lands
The thread returns to a resting state scrolled to its newest entry after every episode
The cycle loops per turn with no terminal end state; the accumulated thread persists for the life of the view
locked_observable_requirements: Sent content must appear to be extruded from the bottom edge as one soft mass that stretches, pinches free and firms into its final bubble — never faded, slid or inserted as a finished element
The travelling mass and the resulting bubble must be recognizably the same object, keeping one unchanged fill identity from extrusion to settle, whatever fill treatment the host assigns to that side
The composer bar must visibly deform and then relax as the mass leaves it
The send affordance must visibly flick away and be replaced by a fresh one
The waiting state must be a soft cluster bulging from the same bottom edge with a brief composing note, and must sink back into that edge rather than disappear in place
Incoming and outgoing entries must arrive from opposite sides of the thread, and the two sides' fills must stay clearly separated from each other and readable against the thread surround
The newest entry must remain in view, and a mass in flight must stay locked to its destination even if the view is scrolled mid-flight
Empty submission must produce no visible change at all
The view must open onto a short exchange already underway, with no instructional text
adaptable_details: Exact hues, fill treatments and bubble corner shapes for each side, and which of the two carries the heavier or lighter fill
Blob travel path, duration, springiness and the sharpness of the pinch
Number and wording of the pre-existing opening lines
Wording and typographic treatment of the composing note
Number of dots in the presence cluster and its bulge rhythm
Panel size, framing and whether it is embedded or full-view
Which side is assigned to the user and which to the counterpart
Icon shape used for the send affordance and the style of its flick-and-replace
Delay length before presence appears
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits any bounded turn-taking region where short text entries accumulate from two opposed sides with an entry field at the foot — assistant panels, support consoles, comment or reply threads, quick note streams — and generalizes to any commit-and-place interaction where an input field feeds an adjacent list. It carries into any host styling, since it asks only for two distinguishable side fills and one continuous fill identity per mass rather than particular colors. It stops fitting when entries are long-form, media-heavy or non-sequential, when there is no visible composer adjacent to the destination so the extrusion has no origin, or when many items arrive at once so individual masses cannot be followed. Replacing the soft extrude-and-tear substance with sliding, fading or stamped insertion, or replacing the bulging presence cluster with a conventional progress or status indicator, produces a different Skill.

name: jelly_panel_statement_slideshow
description: Each short saying fills the view on its own full-bleed panel whose surface tone is clearly distinct from its neighbours, with a small emblem above and a credit below; stepping sends the current panel squashing off one side while the neighbouring one springs in from the other, wobbling until it settles.

canonical_document.name: jelly_panel_statement_slideshow
canonical_document.description: Each short saying fills the view on its own full-bleed panel whose surface tone is clearly distinct from its neighbours, with a small emblem above and a credit below; stepping sends the current panel squashing off one side while the neighbouring one springs in from the other, wobbling until it settles.
canonical_document.experience_scope: A self-contained region or whole-view stage that begins on an opening title card and ends on a clearly final closing card; the experience lives entirely inside this stage and does not extend to surrounding page content.
content_and_composition: Exactly one panel visible at a time, filling the stage area
Each panel is a single solid surface field whose tone reads as clearly separate from the adjacent panels' surfaces
Per panel, three stacked content roles centred as a group: a small emblem or mark on top, the short statement text as the dominant element, an attribution credit beneath it
First item is a title card that introduces the run; last item is a closing card whose treatment makes the end of the set obvious
Persistent control layer: two circular arrow controls sitting near the bottom centre, above the panel and unaffected by panel motion
Short finite set whose limited length is perceivable to the visitor
experience_progression: Opens on the title card at rest
Each activation performs one discrete step: outgoing panel deforms and exits, incoming panel arrives and oscillates with decreasing amplitude until still
Steps accumulate forward through the finite set in a fixed order and can be retraced backwards item by item
Reaching the closing card is a visible terminal state rather than a wrap-around to the beginning
attention_and_information_flow: Attention rests on one saying at a time because nothing competes with it inside the stage
A clearly perceivable change of panel surface at every step signals that new content has arrived
Motion carries the eye horizontally in the direction of travel, then the settling wobble hands attention back to the text
Control affordances stay quiet until the visitor looks for a way forward; an arrow reduced to a low-salience treatment communicates that no further content exists in that direction
Panel-to-panel surface change plus the distinct opening and closing cards convey position within a short set without a numeric readout

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: The step can be undone immediately by activating the opposite direction, which returns to the item just seen
interaction_model.state_change: Advances one item forward in the finite sequence
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The next panel travels in from the right while the current panel squashes and leaves to the left; the arriving panel keeps wobbling with shrinking amplitude until it settles at rest
interaction_model.input: Activating the right-hand circular arrow control or pressing the right keyboard arrow
interaction_model.affected_object: Current panel and the next panel in the set

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Always available while earlier items exist and always lands on the immediately preceding item, so backtracking is exact
interaction_model.state_change: Steps one item backward in the sequence
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The previous panel enters from the left while the current panel squashes away to the right, then settles through the same damped wobble
interaction_model.input: Activating the left-hand circular arrow control or pressing the left keyboard arrow
interaction_model.affected_object: Current panel and the previous panel in the set

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: The visitor may act again as soon as the panel has settled; repeated impatient presses cannot desynchronise position from what is shown
interaction_model.state_change: No state change; the extra activation is discarded
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The running motion continues undisturbed with no added or stacked wobble and no jump; nothing is skipped
interaction_model.input: Any activation, by control or keyboard, arriving while a step is still in motion
interaction_model.affected_object: In-flight panel transition

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: The inward direction stays fully active, so the visitor is never trapped and regains normal stepping by moving back into the set
interaction_model.state_change: Direction becomes unavailable at the boundary
interaction_model.visible_feedback: That arrow drops to a visibly reduced-prominence state and produces no panel motion when activated or when its keyboard key is pressed
interaction_model.input: Attempting to continue past either end of the set
interaction_model.affected_object: The outward-pointing arrow control at that end

experience_qualities: Playful and toy-like rather than formal
Soft, springy, elastic weight in the motion
Bold and high-contrast, with the broad panel surface as the dominant visual element
Calm and singular at rest, with reading focus on one statement
Predictable and well-behaved: one activation always equals one clean step
completion_and_return: Finishes on the closing card, which reads unmistakably as the end of the run
No looping back to the start and no automatic advance
Any earlier item is reachable again by stepping backwards, always landing on the item previously seen
Panels always come to full rest; no residual motion persists between steps
locked_observable_requirements: One statement panel visible at a time, filling the stage
Each panel is a single solid surface field, and the surface changes clearly from one panel to the next while the statement stays comfortably readable against it
Emblem above the statement and attribution credit below it, as one centred group
Departing panel visibly squashes and deforms; arriving panel overshoots and wobbles with decaying amplitude before settling
Incoming panel enters from the activated side while the outgoing panel leaves the opposite side
Two circular arrow controls near bottom centre, with left/right keyboard keys performing the identical step
Activations during an in-progress step are ignored, so wobbles never stack and no item is skipped
At each end the outward arrow is visibly reduced in prominence and inert while the inward direction remains active
A finite run with an opening title card and a visibly final closing card
adaptable_details: Specific hues, saturation level, overall scheme and number of distinct panel surfaces
Number of items in the set, as long as it stays short and finite
Emblem shape or symbol per panel
Typography, text scale and exact vertical spacing of the three stacked roles
Spring stiffness, damping, squash amount and step duration
Size, styling and exact offset of the circular arrow controls
Visual treatment that marks the closing card as final
Whether the stage is a page section or occupies the full view
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits short, self-contained text items that carry an attribution or source line and are meant to be read one at a time from a small finite set. It stays the same Skill across different subject matter, surface schemes and item counts. It becomes a different Skill if multiple items are visible at once, if the set loops endlessly or auto-advances, if stepping is driven by scroll or drag instead of discrete arrow activation, if the elastic squash-and-wobble departure is replaced by a plain slide or fade, or if items grow into long-form content that must be scrolled inside the panel.

name: receding_stage_topic_slides
description: Each slide holds one topic with plain text leading on one side and a pair of images leaning back into depth on the other; picking another topic makes the current pair recoil and hurl off screen in a varying direction while the new pair flies in from far away, overshoots, and settles as its text fades up.

canonical_document.name: receding_stage_topic_slides
canonical_document.description: Each slide holds one topic with plain text leading on one side and a pair of images leaning back into depth on the other; picking another topic makes the current pair recoil and hurl off screen in a varying direction while the new pair flies in from far away, overshoots, and settles as its text fades up.
canonical_document.experience_scope: A bounded region: one framed slide area plus a small marker bar directly below it. The experience begins when a topic is displayed, spans each topic-to-topic transition, and ends when the arriving topic has settled. It is not a whole-page or full-viewport takeover, and the surrounding page remains unaffected.
content_and_composition: Exactly one topic occupies the frame at a time; each topic is a pair of a short written write-up and two accompanying images.
Text block sits plainly on one side of the frame, visually flat and legible against its surround, holding first attention.
Two images sit on the opposite side, arranged with perceptible depth offsets so one reads as nearer and the other further back, forming a small receding stage rather than a flat pair of thumbnails.
A persistent horizontal row of small bar markers below the frame, one per topic, communicating total count, current position and continued reachability of earlier topics.
The frame itself is a persistent container: its bounds, the text side and the media side stay in the same places across all topics, so only the contents change.
During a change, the leaving text/image group and the arriving text/image group briefly coexist in the same frame, the outgoing one heading away and the incoming one arriving.
experience_progression: Resting state: one topic settled, its text fully readable, its images at their depth-staged positions, its marker reading as active.
Commit: a non-current marker is chosen and immediately reads as active, before the content has moved.
Departure: the outgoing text fades out while its two images recoil slightly — a small opposite-direction wind-up — then hurl off screen along a direction that differs from one change to the next.
Arrival: the incoming images fly in from far depth toward the viewer, overshoot their resting positions, then settle back; the incoming text fades up.
Settled: the new topic rests as a stable single-topic frame, and the sequence can be re-entered from any marker.
No autonomous advance: progression only occurs on explicit topic selection, and any topic can be returned to later.
attention_and_information_flow: At rest, the written side wins attention first through plain, unmoving presentation; the imagery reads as supporting depth behind that claim.
During a change, attention shifts to motion on the media side while text prominence drops to near zero in both directions (fading out, then fading up).
The overshoot-and-settle on arrival lands attention on the new imagery, then releases it back to the newly readable text.
The marker bar continuously carries the structural information — how many topics, which is showing, that others remain available — without competing for attention during reading.
Marker activation leads the content change, so the user sees their choice acknowledged before the scene has finished moving.

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: The transition always runs to completion and is never cut short; once settled, any topic including the previous one can be selected again
interaction_model.state_change: Current topic changes to the chosen topic; the region enters a locked transitioning state until the change completes
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Chosen marker immediately reads as active through a clearly separated treatment from inactive markers; outgoing text fades out and its two images recoil then hurl off screen in a varying direction; incoming images fly in from far away, overshoot and settle while incoming text fades up
interaction_model.input: Click on a marker representing a topic other than the current one
interaction_model.affected_object: The whole slide contents: text block, image pair, and the marker bar

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Repeat clicks remain harmless; the resting topic stays readable
interaction_model.state_change: No state change
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Nothing moves; the frame and marker bar stay exactly as they are
interaction_model.input: Click on the marker of the already-showing topic
interaction_model.affected_object: None

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Selection becomes available again the moment the arriving topic settles, so a discarded intent can simply be clicked again
interaction_model.state_change: Input is ignored; the in-flight transition continues unchanged
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The running departure/arrival motion continues uninterrupted, with no second overlapping change starting and no visible jump or reset
interaction_model.input: Click on any marker while a change is in progress
interaction_model.affected_object: None

experience_qualities: Cinematic staged scene change rather than a slide or crossfade
Spatial depth: imagery reads as receding into the distance and rushing forward
Physical weight from recoil wind-up, hurl-away, and overshoot-then-settle
Unpredictable yet controlled — exit direction varies between changes while the resting composition is always the same
Calm, readable rest state contrasted against brief energetic motion
Never janky or clipped: one change at a time, always finished
completion_and_return: A change completes when the arriving images have settled from their overshoot and the arriving text is fully readable; selection unlocks at that moment.
The experience does not loop or auto-advance and has no terminal slide — it simply rests on whichever topic was last chosen.
Every topic stays reachable indefinitely, including ones already viewed, with no ordering restriction.
The active marker persists as the record of current position between changes.
locked_observable_requirements: One topic visible in the frame at a time, each pairing one short write-up with two images.
Text presented plainly on one side with readable contrast against its surround and taking first attention; images presented with perceptible receding depth on the other side.
One small bar marker per topic below the frame, showing count, current position and continued reachability.
The clicked marker reads as active immediately through an unmistakable distinction from inactive markers, ahead of the content settling.
Departure = text fade out plus a small image recoil followed by a hurl off screen; arrival = images flying in from far depth with overshoot and settle plus text fade up.
Exit direction varies from one change to the next rather than repeating identically.
Clicking the current marker does nothing; clicks during a change are ignored so transitions never overlap or get truncated.
The frame bounds and the side assignment of text versus imagery stay fixed across topics.
adaptable_details: Which side holds text and which holds imagery
Number of topics and the length of each write-up
Marker bar styling, size and spacing, and how 'active' is expressed
Exact timing, easing, recoil distance and overshoot amount
The set of possible exit directions and how variation is distributed
Depth spacing and relative offset between the two images
Typography, host palette and luminance level, and frame treatment
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits any short ordered set of self-contained topics where each entry is a brief written point supported by roughly two supporting images that benefit from feeling dimensional. It adopts whatever palette and luminance level the host provides, needing only readable text contrast and a visible active/inactive marker distinction. It stops being this Skill if the frame shows several topics at once, if imagery flattens into a plain thumbnail row without depth, if transitions become a simple fade or lateral slide without recoil, hurl-away and overshoot, if changes may overlap or be interrupted mid-flight, or if advancing becomes automatic or drag/scroll-driven instead of chosen from a per-topic marker bar.

name: one_shot_openable_object_to_greeting_reveal
description: A single wrapped, openable object sits alone on a quiet horizon with a small prompt; tapping it makes it shake, then it bursts into a full-screen scatter of tiny themed drawings and is gone, leaving only a calm greeting and steady falling flakes.

canonical_document.name: one_shot_openable_object_to_greeting_reveal
canonical_document.description: A single wrapped, openable object sits alone on a quiet horizon with a small prompt; tapping it makes it shake, then it bursts into a full-screen scatter of tiny themed drawings and is gone, leaving only a calm greeting and steady falling flakes.
canonical_document.experience_scope: Whole-view experience covering the entire page from first load through a single terminal resting state; it begins with the untouched object centered in an otherwise empty scene and ends when only the greeting and the ambient falling particles remain.
content_and_composition: Exactly one focal openable object, visually wrapped/closed so it reads unmistakably as something meant to be opened, placed alone and centered against a wide low horizon
One short prompt label attached to or directly beside the focal object, present only before activation
A sparse atmospheric backdrop (open horizon plus continuous gentle falling particles) that persists as a substrate through every stage
A transient full-viewport layer of many small themed drawings that appears above the scene only during the burst
One short greeting message as the final foreground element, occupying the space the object previously held
No secondary navigation, controls, or competing content anywhere in the view
experience_progression: Rest: the closed object sits alone with its prompt, ambient particles falling, nothing else competing for attention
Acknowledgement: on the single activation the object shakes in place immediately, confirming the tap landed
Burst: the object is consumed and small themed drawings flood outward across the entire view in a brief high-energy moment
Narrowing: the scattered drawings clear or settle away and attention funnels inward to the emerging greeting
Terminal rest: only the greeting and the continuing falling particles remain; the sequence does not loop or offer a next step
attention_and_information_flow: Before activation, prominence is entirely on the single object and its short prompt; the backdrop stays deliberately low-contrast and quiet
The shake concentrates attention even tighter on the object at the moment of activation
The burst deliberately widens attention to the full viewport for a short interval, revealing decorative content rather than information
Attention then narrows from full-view scatter down to one central text element, which becomes the only carrier of meaning
In the resting state the greeting holds all prominence while the ambient particles supply motion without pulling focus

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Not reversible; once activated the object never returns to its waiting state within the session
interaction_model.state_change: Transitions from waiting to activated, one time only
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The object shakes in place immediately, with no delay between the tap and the response
interaction_model.input: Single click or tap anywhere on the focal object (the only interaction in the experience)
interaction_model.affected_object: The closed focal object and its prompt

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Plays through to completion hands-free; cannot be paused, skipped or replayed, and the object does not reappear
interaction_model.state_change: Object is consumed and removed permanently; burst layer appears and then clears; greeting arrives and stays
interaction_model.visible_feedback: A brief flood of small themed drawings across the whole view, then a narrowing settle onto the centered greeting
interaction_model.input: Autonomous continuation after the shake (no further user input required)
interaction_model.affected_object: The focal object, the full-view drawing layer, and the greeting

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Activation is strictly single-fire; only a full page reload restores the unopened object
interaction_model.state_change: None; the input is ignored
interaction_model.visible_feedback: No visible response at all — no restart, no second burst, no stacked animation
interaction_model.input: Additional taps during or after the reveal
interaction_model.affected_object: The running or finished sequence

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Never stops or resets; unaffected by activation or by the burst
interaction_model.state_change: Runs uninterrupted through every stage, including the terminal state
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Steady gentle downward drift of flakes behind all foreground content
interaction_model.input: Continuous ambient drive with no user involvement
interaction_model.affected_object: Falling particle layer in the backdrop

experience_qualities: Unmistakably invitational before activation: the object reads as openable at a glance
Immediate and responsive at the moment of the tap
A short, dense burst of playful energy that feels generous rather than disorienting
Hands-free and self-completing once started
Calm, celebratory and finished at the end, with nothing further expected of the visitor
Continuously alive thanks to the persistent ambient motion, even while resting
completion_and_return: Ends in a single terminal resting state holding the greeting plus ambient falling particles
No loop, no replay affordance, no reset control, and no onward call to action
The focal object is permanently consumed for the remainder of the session
Only a page reload returns the experience to its unopened starting state
locked_observable_requirements: Exactly one closed, openable focal object alone in the initial view, carrying a short visible prompt
A single click or tap on that object is the only required and only accepted input
The object answers instantly with an in-place shake before anything else happens
After the shake the sequence advances entirely on its own with no further input
The burst momentarily fills the whole viewport with many small themed drawings
The focal object is consumed by the reveal and never returns
Attention narrows from the full-view burst down to one short centered message
The message is the terminal state: celebratory, calm, and demanding nothing further
Gentle falling particles run continuously before, during and after the reveal
Repeat activations are ignored outright — never queued, restarted or double-fired
adaptable_details: Visual style, material and silhouette of the openable object
Subject matter, count and art style of the small drawings in the burst
Wording, typography and scale of the prompt and of the final message
Color treatment, horizon rendering and overall mood of the backdrop scene, in any hue family, as long as it stays a low-distraction surround behind the focal content
Density, size and drift speed of the ambient falling particles
Exact durations and easing of shake, burst and narrowing stages
Whether the burst clears by fading, drifting away or settling out of view
Presence or absence of sound
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits any sparse whole-view page whose entire purpose is to deliver one short message as the payoff of a single tap on one inviting openable object, with a brief full-view decorative burst in between. It stops being this Skill if the object becomes repeatable or resettable within the session, if multiple objects must be opened in sequence, if the reveal is driven by scroll or timing instead of a deliberate single tap, if the burst carries information the visitor must read, or if the final message becomes an entry point into further navigation or content rather than a terminal resting state.

name: tilting_page_menu_reveal
description: The reading surface tips backwards into depth, swings aside at an angle and drops in luminance, exposing a short list of section labels that appear one after another; pressing the displaced page swings it forward to fill the screen again.

canonical_document.name: tilting_page_menu_reveal
canonical_document.description: The reading surface tips backwards into depth, swings aside at an angle and drops in luminance, exposing a short list of section labels that appear one after another; pressing the displaced page swings it forward to fill the screen again.
canonical_document.experience_scope: Whole-view experience covering the entire reading surface. It begins when the menu is requested from an ordinary, calm reading state and ends when the surface has swung fully forward and filled the screen again; between those points the view is a single displaced plane plus the exposed area around it.
content_and_composition: One primary content surface: the complete reading view, treated as a single rigid plane rather than as separate components.
One short list of section labels, small in number and legible at a glance, positioned in the space uncovered by the displaced surface.
One exposed background area revealed around and behind the displaced surface, held clearly separated from and less prominent than the labels, and used only as a stage.
Layer order: labels read as sitting behind or beneath the content plane in depth and become the attention focus while the plane sits in front of them, offset and angled.
The reading content remains continuously visible and identifiable on the displaced plane; it is never replaced by a separate menu screen.
A single affordance for requesting the reveal is present in the ordinary reading state and does not draw attention to itself.
experience_progression: Ordinary reading state: content fills the screen upright and undisturbed, destinations entirely out of sight.
Displacement: on request the whole surface tilts back into depth and swings aside at an angle while progressively dropping below its normal luminance.
Staged listing: section labels arrive one after another in the uncovered space rather than all at once, completing shortly after the surface settles.
Held open state: the angled, dimmed surface rests offset while the label list holds attention.
Return: the surface swings forward, rises back to its normal luminance and fills the screen, restoring the upright reading state.
attention_and_information_flow: In the reading state the text is the only prominent element and no destination information is shown.
As the surface recedes, angles and dims, it loses prominence without losing identity, so the reader still recognises the page they came from.
Prominence transfers to the label list, which gains information sequentially so the eye follows the labels in order instead of scanning a block.
The exposed area gains no prominence of its own and does not compete with the labels.
On return, prominence flows back to the restored text and the destination information leaves the view entirely.

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: The reveal can be dismissed as readily as it was opened; the same request path remains available and repeated requests do not stack additional displacement
interaction_model.state_change: Reading state becomes revealed state: the plane moves back in depth, rotates to an angle, offsets aside and drops in luminance; the label list becomes present
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Continuous tilt-back, angled swing-aside and luminance drop across the whole page, followed by labels appearing one after another in the uncovered space
interaction_model.input: Requesting the menu from the ordinary reading state
interaction_model.affected_object: The entire reading surface treated as one plane, plus the section label list

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: The displaced page is itself the way back, so return is always available from the whole surface; the restored view reads as an uninterrupted continuation with no sense of a lost place
interaction_model.state_change: Revealed state returns to reading state; labels leave the view
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The plane swings forward, straightens, returns to its normal luminance and grows to fill the screen again, ending on the same content the reader was on
interaction_model.input: Pressing anywhere on the displaced reading surface
interaction_model.affected_object: The displaced plane and the revealed label list

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Emphasis reverts when the pointer leaves; no other label or the surrounding surface is affected
interaction_model.state_change: Label shifts to an emphasised state while the pointer remains on it
interaction_model.visible_feedback: A local, clearly readable change on that label only, distinguishing it from its neighbours
interaction_model.input: Pointer moving over a section label
interaction_model.affected_object: The individual label under the pointer

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Deliberate inert boundary: the exposed stage is not a dismissal target, so accidental presses there cannot disturb the revealed state
interaction_model.state_change: No state change
interaction_model.visible_feedback: No visible response
interaction_model.input: Pressing the exposed area around the displaced surface
interaction_model.affected_object: Nothing

experience_qualities: Calm and ordinary while reading, with nothing competing with the text
A polite step-aside rather than a jump to a different screen
Physical and weighted, as if one solid surface is being swung on a hinge in depth
Legible and unhurried, with the labels arriving in sequence instead of appearing as a block
Continuous on return, so the reader never feels they left the page or lost their position
completion_and_return: The reveal completes when the surface settles at its angle and the last label has arrived; it then holds until dismissed.
Return completes when the surface has swung fully forward, is upright, back at its normal luminance and fills the screen.
The restored view shows the same content and reading position as before the reveal, presented as an uninterrupted continuation.
The cycle is repeatable any number of times, always returning to the same ordinary reading state.
No persistent visible trace of the reveal remains once the surface is restored.
locked_observable_requirements: The whole view moves as one rigid plane; content is never split into pieces or swapped for a separate menu screen.
The plane recedes in depth, rotates to a visible angle and offsets aside, all in one continuous gesture.
The plane drops noticeably below its normal luminance as it recedes and rises back to that normal luminance as it returns.
The reading content stays visible and recognisable on the displaced plane for the entire revealed state.
Section labels appear one after another rather than simultaneously.
The label list is short and legible at a glance.
Pressing anywhere on the displaced plane returns it, and the return is a forward swing back to a full-screen upright surface.
Pressing the exposed area around the plane produces no change.
Individual labels respond to the pointer independently of each other.
The restored reading state matches the pre-reveal state with no sense of interruption.
adaptable_details: Which side the plane swings toward and the exact angle, depth offset and size of the luminance drop
Timing, easing and the interval between successive label appearances
How each label enters and how it emphasises under the pointer
Typography, spacing and alignment of the label list
Appearance of the exposed area behind the plane, provided it stays recessive against the labels
Form and placement of the affordance that requests the reveal
The specific number of sections, within a short list
The kind of reading content carried on the surface
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits views whose main content is a single continuous readable surface with a small set of top-level destinations that can stay hidden during reading, in either a light or dark host treatment, since the dimming is relative to the surface's own normal luminance. Long destination lists that need scrolling, multi-level or grouped menus, and views built from several independently moving panels break it, because the effect depends on one rigid plane and a glanceable list. Making the plane fully leave the screen, replacing it with a separate menu view, keeping the destinations permanently visible, revealing all labels at once, or making the exposed area the dismissal target each produces a different skill.

name: self_assembling_hover_opening_day_timeline
description: A downward run of time-stamped stops that builds itself in on arrival — heading, teasing intro, then each stop in chronological order — and reads as clock times with oversized one-word keywords until a stop is hovered, at which point its small disc swells into a large circle, the keyword shrinks into a heading inside that circle, and an illustration with its figure scales up from nothing, with the last stop landing as the closing punchline.

canonical_document.name: self_assembling_hover_opening_day_timeline
canonical_document.description: A downward run of time-stamped stops that builds itself in on arrival — heading, teasing intro, then each stop in chronological order — and reads as clock times with oversized one-word keywords until a stop is hovered, at which point its small disc swells into a large circle, the keyword shrinks into a heading inside that circle, and an illustration with its figure scales up from nothing, with the last stop landing as the closing punchline.
canonical_document.experience_scope: A self-contained region experience spanning one continuous vertical run: it begins with the arrival assembly of the heading and intro, continues through every stop as the reader moves downward, and ends at the final stop that closes the sequence. The region may fill the view or sit as a block inside a longer page; each stop's open state is a local sub-experience bounded by the stop itself.
content_and_composition: One heading at the top of the region, stating the subject of the sequence
One short teasing intro directly under the heading, promising to reveal what the sequence is really made of
An ordered series of a handful of stops arranged along a single downward axis, read top to bottom in chronological order
Each stop carries four persistent-or-latent roles: a bar forming the stop's body, a clock time label, a small disc marker, and an oversized one-word keyword caption
Each stop holds back one payload: an illustration plus an accompanying figure, absent from view until the stop is opened
Collapsed stops together form a skimmable scaffold of time labels and keywords that is always present as the overview layer

When a stop opens, its own disc becomes a large circle that hosts the shrunken keyword as an inner heading and the scaled-up illustration and figure, layered over the stop's own footprint rather than over the neighbours' labels
The final stop occupies the punchline role that terminates the sequence
experience_progression: Arrival: the region assembles itself in front of the reader rather than appearing complete
Assembly order: heading first, then the teasing intro, then the stops one after another in chronological order
Reading phase: the reader advances downward through the assembled run, the overview staying legible throughout
Per-stop phase: each stop's substance is disclosed only once that stop has the reader's attention, then withdrawn again
Close: the final stop is reached and reads as the punchline that ends the sequence
attention_and_information_flow: In the collapsed baseline only the clock times and the oversized one-word keywords carry prominence, so the entire sequence is graspable at a glance

Opening a stop shifts prominence inside that stop: the keyword demotes from oversized caption to a smaller heading inside the grown circle, while the illustration and its figure become the dominant content
Substance is disclosed one stop at a time; unopened stops keep their skimmable form, so the overview is never traded away for detail
Attention leaving a stop returns prominence to the overview reading of times and keywords
The withheld payloads make the intro's promise of a reveal the driver of downward attention, and the last stop's payload is weighted as the concluding beat

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Runs once and settles into the complete, readable, collapsed overview; it does not block reading or replay on further interaction
interaction_model.state_change: Not-yet-present to fully assembled
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The heading appears, then the intro, then the stops arrive one after another following the sequence's own chronological order
interaction_model.input: Arrival in view (autonomous driver, no user action)
interaction_model.affected_object: Heading, teasing intro, and the full run of stops

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Any of the stop's parts is an equally valid target; stops open and close independently so opening one never closes or disturbs another
interaction_model.state_change: Closed to open, for that stop only
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The disc grows outward into a large circle, the oversized keyword shrinks down into a heading seated inside that circle, and the illustration with its accompanying figure scales up from nothing
interaction_model.input: Pointer hover anywhere within a stop — its bar, its clock label, or its small disc
interaction_model.affected_object: That stop's disc, its keyword caption, and its withheld illustration and figure

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Re-entering mid-close reverses the motion from wherever it is; fast or interrupted pointer movement always resolves to fully open or fully closed and never leaves a stop stuck half-open
interaction_model.state_change: Open back to closed
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The circle contracts to the small disc, the keyword grows back to its oversized caption size and position, and the illustration and figure scale back down to nothing along the same path they came
