interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Freely reversible; open and closed stop states are unaffected by scroll position
interaction_model.state_change: Viewport advances or retreats along the downward run
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Further stops come into reading position; scrolling itself performs no opening, transformation or scrubbing
interaction_model.input: Scrolling
interaction_model.affected_object: The reader's position along the sequence

experience_qualities: Playful and light rather than formal or data-dense
Glanceable: the whole sequence stays comprehensible without opening anything
Teasing and withholding, with each stop's substance treated as a small payoff
Continuous and reversible motion, with growth and shrinkage that read as one coordinated gesture per stop
Forgiving under hurried or erratic pointer movement
A composed arc with a deliberate concluding beat rather than an open-ended list
completion_and_return: The arrival assembly completes once and leaves the sequence in its readable collapsed state
Every opened stop returns to the exact collapsed baseline when attention leaves; no opened state is retained
Multiple stops may be opened and closed in any order and any number of times without accumulating changes
The sequence completes at the final punchline stop; no further stage or reset is offered
locked_observable_requirements: The region assembles itself on arrival in the order heading, teasing intro, then stops in sequence order
The collapsed sequence reads as a run of time-or-position labels paired with single-word oversized keywords, graspable at a glance
Each stop's substance is withheld until that stop has the reader's attention
Hovering anywhere within a stop's bar, label or disc opens that stop; the whole stop behaves as one target
Opening transforms the small disc outward into a large circle
Opening shrinks the oversized keyword into a heading positioned inside the grown circle
Opening scales an illustration and its accompanying figure up from nothing
Leaving reverses the same coordinated motion back to the collapsed state
Stops open and close independently of one another
Interrupted or rapid pointer movement never leaves a stop stuck in a partial state
The last stop functions as the closing beat of the sequence
Scrolling only advances reading position and never drives opening or closing
adaptable_details: Number of stops and how far apart they sit
Whether labels are clock times, dates, step numbers or stage names
The keyword vocabulary and typographic treatment
Illustration style and what the accompanying figure represents
Palette, surround treatment and playful decorative accents
Exact timing, easing and stagger of the assembly and of the open/close motion
Whether the region fills the viewport or is embedded in a longer page
Placement of the grown circle relative to the stop's bar, and the arrangement of illustration and figure inside it
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits short ordered sets of roughly a handful of entries where each entry can be summarised by a terse label plus one single-word keyword and backed by one small illustrated payload — daily routines, process or method steps, event schedules, itineraries, light chronologies — and where a concluding entry can plausibly carry the closing beat. It depends on low entry count and very short labels so the collapsed overview stays glanceable, and on pointer hover being the natural attention signal. Requiring persistent click-opened detail, long-form text or multiple paragraphs per entry, many entries needing paging or filtering, simultaneous always-visible detail for all entries, or scroll position rather than attention as the driver of the reveal would each produce a different skill.

name: bound_volume_sheet_turn_reader

canonical_document.name: bound_volume_sheet_turn_reader
canonical_document.description: One section of long text fills the view as a single sheet; stepping forward lifts the sheet from the right edge and lays it over to uncover the next section, stepping back turns it the other way, a slide-in list from the left shows all sections and marks the current one, and the sheet nudges and settles when there is nothing further in that direction.
canonical_document.experience_scope: Whole-view experience covering the entire reading surface, beginning when the first section opens and continuing across every section change; it persists for the whole reading session rather than being a bounded one-off animation, and ends only when the reader leaves the reader view.
content_and_composition: One active sheet occupying the full view, holding a section heading and its body text
Exactly one section visible at a time; the next or previous section is uncovered beneath the turning sheet
Small paired forward and back step controls placed together in a corner, persistently available over the sheet
A contents control that opens an overview list of all sections, entering from the left edge as a layer that pushes the reading surface aside rather than covering it
A current-section indicator inside the overview list, visually distinguishing the section being read from the others
Deliberately undecorated surroundings: no competing ornament, imagery or panels around the text column
A slim vertical scrollbar inside the sheet, present only while the pointer is over the text area
Finite ordered set of sections with a defined opening and closing member
experience_progression: Opens directly on the first section, heading and body text already filling the view
Each forward step turns one sheet, uncovering the next section as the current one lays over
Each backward step reverses the turn, restoring the previous section
Progression is strictly linear and finite: forward advance halts at the closing section without wrapping to the beginning
Backward movement remains available at every point after the opening section
A selection from the overview list jumps directly to any section, resuming the same step-by-step progression from there
attention_and_information_flow: The text column holds primary attention at all times; surroundings stay visually quiet so long passages remain comfortable
During a turn attention follows the lifting edge across the view, then settles on the newly uncovered heading
Step controls remain small and peripheral, readable but never competing with the text
Opening the overview list temporarily shifts attention to the full set of sections and the reader's place within it, then returns attention to the text once it closes
The scrollbar stays hidden until the pointer approaches the text, so it never signals more than reading progress within the current sheet
A step control's absence in one direction silently communicates that the set has an edge there

interaction_model.state_change: Advances the active section index by one

interaction_model.affected_object: The current sheet and the next section beneath it

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Available from any section after the opening one; ignored while a turn is already running
interaction_model.state_change: Decreases the active section index by one
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The sheet turns in the opposite direction, uncovering the previous section and settling it as the full-view sheet
interaction_model.input: Activating the backward step control
interaction_model.affected_object: The current sheet and the previous section

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Presses during an in-flight turn are ignored; opposite key reverses the change
interaction_model.state_change: Same forward or backward section change as the corresponding step control
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Identical sheet-turn motion and uncovering of the adjacent section

interaction_model.affected_object: The current sheet

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Additional swipes during a turn are ignored; swiping the other way reverses the change
interaction_model.state_change: Same forward or backward section change, directional with the swipe
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Identical sheet-turn motion and uncovering of the adjacent section
interaction_model.input: Horizontal swipe across the sheet
interaction_model.affected_object: The current sheet

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Self-recovering: the sheet returns to rest and remains fully readable; movement in the still-available direction is unaffected
interaction_model.state_change: No section change; the boundary of the finite set is asserted
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The sheet lifts only slightly and settles back into place, a short soft resistance rather than a completed turn
interaction_model.input: Forward input while on the closing section, or backward input while on the opening section

interaction_model.visible_feedback: Only the valid direction's control is visible in the corner
interaction_model.input: Reaching a direction with no further section
interaction_model.affected_object: The corresponding step control

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: The list can be dismissed to return the reading surface to its full-view position with the same section still shown
interaction_model.state_change: Overview list opens
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The list slides in from the left edge and displaces the reading surface sideways instead of covering it; the section being read is marked as current within the list
interaction_model.input: Activating the contents control
interaction_model.affected_object: The overview list layer and the reading surface

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Step controls resume normal forward and backward movement from the newly chosen position, with boundary behavior recalculated for it
interaction_model.state_change: Active section becomes the chosen one
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The list closes first, then the sheet turns directly to the chosen section; on reopening the list, that section is marked as current
interaction_model.input: Choosing an entry in the overview list
interaction_model.affected_object: The overview list and the current sheet

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: The indicator recedes when the pointer leaves the text; vertical scrolling never triggers a section change
interaction_model.state_change: Scroll indicator becomes visible
interaction_model.visible_feedback: A slim scrollbar surfaces alongside the text and the text scrolls vertically within the sheet without the sheet turning

experience_qualities: Physical and bound: movement reads as one sheet in a stack of sheets, not as a document being replaced
Calm and reading-first, with quiet undecorated surroundings supporting long passages
Oriented: the reader always knows the current section and can see the full set
Finite and bounded, with the beginning and end of the volume felt rather than announced
Composed motion, single-turn-at-a-time, never stuttering or stacking
Unobtrusive controls that recede behind the text
completion_and_return: No looping: forward movement completes at the closing section and stays there
Backward movement remains available all the way to the opening section
Each turn completes with the newly uncovered section resting as the full-view sheet
Boundary attempts complete by returning the sheet to rest with no change
Opening the overview list always reflects the current section as the persistent reading position
Vertical scroll position belongs to the sheet's own text and does not alter the section sequence
locked_observable_requirements: One section fills the whole view at a time as a single sheet
Forward movement lifts the sheet from the right edge and lays it over to uncover the next section; backward movement turns it the opposite way
The transition must read as a sheet turning within one bound object, not as a new document appearing
A finite ordered set with no wrap from the closing section back to the opening one
At either boundary the sheet lifts slightly and settles back rather than turning
The direction control with nothing beyond it is absent from the interface
The overview list enters from the left and pushes the reading surface aside instead of overlaying it
Choosing a list entry closes the list first, then turns to that section
The current section is marked within the overview list
Repeat inputs during an in-flight turn are ignored
Step controls, arrow keys and horizontal swipe all produce the same turn
Surroundings stay undecorated so the text keeps primary attention
Overflowing text scrolls vertically inside the sheet, with the slim scrollbar surfacing only on pointer presence over the text
adaptable_details: Turn duration, easing and the depth or curvature of the lifting edge
Corner chosen for the step controls and their iconography
Typography, column width, margins and the sheet's surface tone, provided body text keeps comfortable reading contrast against it
Overview list width, entry styling and the visual treatment marking the current section
How far the sheet lifts during the boundary nudge
Dismissal affordances for the overview list
Number of sections and length of each one
Whether the overview list can also be dismissed by interacting with the reading surface
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits any finite, ordered set of text-dominant sections meant to be read one at a time in a full-view surface with an accompanying section overview. It stops being this Skill if sections wrap continuously, if several sections are visible at once, if the transition becomes a fade, slide or page load without the bound-sheet reading, if the overview list overlays rather than displaces the reading surface, or if the surface becomes media-dense enough that the text no longer holds primary attention.

name: folding_three_panel_keepsake_with_recessing_detail_card
description: A closed printed cover that swings open into a three-panel paper spread of ordered sections; picking a marked entry lifts a centred photo-and-text card while the spread angles back behind it, and everything folds shut in reverse.

canonical_document.name: folding_three_panel_keepsake_with_recessing_detail_card
canonical_document.description: A closed printed cover that swings open into a three-panel paper spread of ordered sections; picking a marked entry lifts a centred photo-and-text card while the spread angles back behind it, and everything folds shut in reverse.
canonical_document.experience_scope: Whole-view experience. Begins with the artifact closed and centred as the only thing on screen, spans the opened three-panel reading spread and any raised detail card, and ends when the artifact is folded back to its closed cover state.
content_and_composition: One closed cover as the initial single focal object, carrying the identity name, an emblem mark and contact details
One unmistakable invitation affordance on the cover prompting the user to look inside
Three interior panels forming one continuous spread: a left panel hinged at its left edge, a fixed centre panel, and a right panel hinged at its right edge
Ordered content sections distributed across the panels following their natural sequence rather than arbitrary placement
Multiple marked entries within the sections, visually distinguished as selectable from surrounding text
One small close control that exists only while the artifact is open
One centred detail card layer above the spread, containing an image, a title, a descriptive body and one onward link to fuller content
Layer order: detail card in front, opened spread behind and set back in depth, closed cover replacing the whole composition when shut
experience_progression: Closed state: only the identity-bearing cover and its invitation are visible and readable
Opening: the cover swings away around its left edge and the right panel swings out around its right edge, uncovering the interior
Open reading state: the full three-panel spread lies flat and legible, with a close control now present
Focus state: a selected entry's detail card rises centred while the spread recedes and angles inward behind it
Return to open reading state on dismissal, with the spread settling flat again
Closing: panels fold back in reverse order of opening, returning to the closed cover
attention_and_information_flow: Attention starts on a single closed object where identity and the invitation to open are the only information offered
Opening transfers attention from the cover identity to the ordered content sections, which become the primary reading surface
The natural section order guides reading progression through the spread from first section to last
Selecting an entry moves prominence forward to a single item's richer content while the surrounding spread deliberately loses prominence through recession and tilt, remaining visible as context
Dismissal returns prominence to the whole spread; closing collapses attention back to the identity-bearing cover

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: The close control provides the reverse path at any time; the opened state persists until the user closes it
interaction_model.state_change: Closed artifact transitions to opened three-panel spread
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The cover swings open around its left edge and the right panel swings outward around its right edge, revealing the interior spread; a small close control appears
interaction_model.input: Activating the invitation affordance on the closed cover
interaction_model.affected_object: Cover and the right interior panel

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Returns to the original entry state so the artifact can be opened again; leaves no orphaned card layer
interaction_model.state_change: Opened spread returns to the closed cover state and any open card is put away
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Panels fold back in reverse order of the opening sequence until only the closed cover remains; an open detail card is dismissed as part of the same collapse
interaction_model.input: Activating the small close control while open
interaction_model.affected_object: Whole artifact including any raised detail card

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Dismissing the card restores the flat spread; the spread stays visible behind the card throughout so context is never lost
interaction_model.state_change: Open reading state becomes single-item focus state
interaction_model.visible_feedback: A centred card rises carrying that entry's image, name, description and onward link, while the opened spread recedes and angles inward behind it
interaction_model.input: Selecting a marked entry name in the spread
interaction_model.affected_object: Detail card layer and the opened spread behind it

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Any single dismissal still returns directly to the flat spread regardless of how many substitutions occurred
interaction_model.state_change: Focus state persists with substituted content
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The raised card's contents are replaced by the newly selected entry without the spread returning flat in between
interaction_model.input: Selecting a different marked entry while a card is raised
interaction_model.affected_object: Detail card contents

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Idempotent return to the open reading state; the spread's opened configuration is preserved
interaction_model.state_change: Focus state returns to open reading state
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The card is put away and the spread comes back forward to lie flat and fully legible again
interaction_model.input: Dismissing the raised detail card
interaction_model.affected_object: Detail card and opened spread

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Leaving via the link does not require closing the artifact first; the card remains the single place this onward path is offered
interaction_model.state_change: Navigation away from the focus state to fuller content for that entry
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The link is presented as part of the card's content alongside image, name and description
interaction_model.input: Following the onward link on the raised card
interaction_model.affected_object: Detail card's onward destination

experience_qualities: Tangible and paper-like: the artifact reads as a real folded printed keepsake rather than a screen panel
Ceremonial entry: content is earned by an opening gesture rather than presented immediately
Ordered and unhurried reading across a wide continuous spread
Depth-aware focus: one item comes forward while its source visibly settles back
Reversible and symmetric: every opening motion has a matching closing motion in reverse order
Keepsake formality carried by the cover's identity, emblem and contact details
completion_and_return: Detail focus completes by dismissal, returning the spread flat, or by substitution with another entry
The open reading state completes by the close control folding the artifact back in reverse order
Closing the artifact also puts away any open detail card, so the closed cover is always a clean terminal state
The closed cover is both the entry point and the return point, making the whole experience a repeatable loop
The opened spread's configuration persists across detail focus cycles until the artifact is explicitly closed
locked_observable_requirements: The experience must begin closed, showing an identity-bearing cover with an explicit invitation to open
Opening must read as unfolding paper, with the cover hinging around its left edge and the right panel hinging around its right edge
The opened interior must be a three-panel spread read as one continuous surface
Content sections must appear in their natural inherent order across the panels
A close control must exist only in the opened state and must fold the panels back in reverse order of opening
Selectable entries must be visibly marked within the reading surface
Selecting an entry must raise a single centred card carrying image, title, description and one onward link
The spread must visibly recede and angle inward behind the raised card, remaining present as context
Dismissal must restore the flat spread; another selection must replace card contents in place
Closing the artifact must also put away any open card
adaptable_details: Number, naming and count of ordered content sections
Number of marked entries and their distribution across panels
Typography, paper texture, palette and emblem styling
Exact hinge timing, easing and duration of the fold and recession motions
Placement and iconography of the small close control
Whether contact details sit on the cover front alongside identity or nearby on it
Card proportions and internal arrangement of image, title, description and link
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits any moderate body of curated, inherently ordered readable sections whose individual entries each deserve an image-plus-description detail view and an onward link, and where a formal keepsake or brochure framing is appropriate. Content type matters only in that the sections must have a natural sequence and the entries a richer payload. It stops fitting content too voluminous to lie readable on three panels or requiring search, filtering or free arrangement. Replacing the closed-cover opening with immediate content access, replacing the three-panel fold with scrolling or paging, or replacing the receding-spread detail card with a flat inline expansion or full-view replacement each produce a different Skill.

name: folding_disc_hidden_passage_card
description: A lone round paper card, closed and labelled, whose larger half folds over like thick stock when its jutting tab is pressed or the card is flicked sideways, revealing a short passage with a portrait and dates before folding shut again.

canonical_document.name: folding_disc_hidden_passage_card
canonical_document.description: A lone round paper card, closed and labelled, whose larger half folds over like thick stock when its jutting tab is pressed or the card is flicked sideways, revealing a short passage with a portrait and dates before folding shut again.
canonical_document.experience_scope: A single self-contained region occupied by one object, not a whole-view treatment. It begins with the object at rest in its closed state on arrival, spans each open and close turn, and ends whenever the object has settled back into the identical closed rest. The surrounding page is untouched by the experience.
content_and_composition: Exactly one round card-like disc, resting alone and centred within its region, with generous empty space around it so it reads as a solitary object rather than part of a set
Closed outward face carries only a single short label — no other content — so the closed state advertises itself as shut and unopened
A band or strip runs outward past the disc's rim, visibly crossing the boundary of the round silhouette and tying the closed state together
A tab protrudes beyond the rim as the one obviously grabbable part; a small hand-drawn cue sits beside the tab indicating where to act
Inner side, hidden while closed, carries the primary revealed content: a short quoted passage as the lead, a portrait image, and a pair of life dates
The disc is divided into a larger moving portion and a smaller portion that stays; the larger portion is what folds across onto the other side
Layering reads as physical stock: the folding portion passes over the rest of the object and casts a shadow that travels with it
experience_progression: Closed rest: solitary labelled disc, band running past the rim, drawn cue beside the tab
Turn outward: the larger portion swings over onto the other side with perceptible weight and a shade that travels across the surface beneath it as the fold sweeps
Open state: the hidden face now faces the reader with the passage, portrait and dates; the band is drawn out longer than in the closed state
Turn back: the same fold reverses with the same weight and travelling shade
Closed rest again: identical to the arrival state, with the revealed passage lingering briefly before it goes
attention_and_information_flow: On arrival, all prominence sits on the lone closed disc; the short label and the band crossing the rim are the only information offered
The protruding tab and the small drawn cue carry local prominence as the place to act
During the fold, attention follows the moving portion and its travelling shadow
Once open, prominence transfers from the label to the revealed passage first, then outward to the portrait and the dates now facing the reader
On closing, the revealed content holds attention an instant after the fold completes before releasing it, returning prominence to the plain closed face

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Pressing again performs the reverse fold and returns the object to the identical closed rest; the action is fully repeatable
interaction_model.state_change: Closed becomes open: the larger portion swings across onto the other side
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Weighted paper-like fold with a shadow travelling under the moving portion; the hidden face with passage, portrait and dates comes into view; the band draws out longer
interaction_model.input: Press on the tab protruding past the rim
interaction_model.affected_object: The larger portion of the disc and the hidden inner face

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Movements too small to count, and up-and-down movements, produce no change at all and leave the object exactly as it was
interaction_model.state_change: Release towards the right resolves to open; release towards the left resolves to closed; the gesture is equivalent in outcome to pressing the tab
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The same weighted fold with travelling shade resolves in the direction released, settling into either the revealed face or the plain closed face
interaction_model.input: Drag sideways across the disc and release
interaction_model.affected_object: The larger portion of the disc

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Interruption is always permitted mid-turn; the object always resolves into one of the two rest states
interaction_model.state_change: The turn is redirected towards the newly requested state without restarting
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The fold changes course smoothly and continuously from its current position, with no jump, snap-back or replay
interaction_model.input: Acting again while a turn is still in progress
interaction_model.affected_object: The in-flight folding portion

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: The object never accumulates queued turns; repeated same-direction acts are absorbed
interaction_model.state_change: None
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Nothing moves or re-animates; the object is visually inert to redundant requests
interaction_model.input: Repeating a request for the state the object is already in or already heading to
interaction_model.affected_object: The disc as a whole

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: The cue is persistent and passive; it never blocks or replaces acting on the object
interaction_model.state_change: None; a standing hint is present
interaction_model.visible_feedback: A small hand-drawn cue beside the tab marks where to act
interaction_model.input: Arriving at or idling on the region
interaction_model.affected_object: The area beside the tab

experience_qualities: Playful and handmade, like a paper keepsake rather than an interface control
Physically weighted: the fold has heft and a shadow that travels with the moving part
Secretive on arrival — visibly shut and worth opening
Tidy and self-restoring: every turn ends in exactly the same closed rest
Forgiving: half-finished and ambiguous gestures resolve cleanly instead of stalling
Intimate in scale, a single object rather than a scene
completion_and_return: Two stable rest states only: closed and open; every turn resolves into one of them
Closing returns the object to the identical arrival composition, with no residue of having been opened
The revealed passage persists a moment past the closing fold before it disappears
The experience is indefinitely repeatable with no exhaustion, counter or one-time-only behaviour
locked_observable_requirements: A single round closed object resting alone and centred within its region
The closed outward face carries only a short label and nothing else
A band visibly runs out past the round rim while closed and is drawn out longer once open
A tab protrudes beyond the rim as the primary place to act, with a small drawn cue beside it
Only the larger portion of the object folds, and it folds over onto the other side
The fold reads as thick paper: perceptible weight plus a shadow that travels with the moving portion
The hidden face leads with a short passage of text and also carries a portrait and a pair of dates
Attention order once open: passage first, then portrait and dates
Press-on-tab and sideways drag-release are interchangeable ways to open and close, with rightwards release opening and leftwards closing
Tiny and vertical movements produce no change; repeated same-direction requests produce no change
Mid-turn re-action redirects the fold smoothly from its current position
The object always settles back into the identical closed rest, with the revealed text lingering an instant before it goes
adaptable_details: Colour treatment, paper texture, label wording and the style of the drawn cue
Exact fold duration, easing weight and shadow softness
How far the band extends in each state and where it exits the rim
Proportion split between the moving and stationary portions, as long as the moving part is the larger one
Card diameter and the amount of surrounding empty space
Whether the hidden face is portrait-left or portrait-right, and typographic treatment of the passage and dates
Drag distance and direction thresholds that count as a deliberate sideways gesture
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits a small, prized, self-contained payload of text plus one identifying image and a short factual pair — a saying with its attribution, a dedication, a profile snippet, a gift note, a single fact card — held inside one object where the whole point is the act of uncovering it. It stays the same Skill across subject matter, colour treatment and copy. It becomes a different Skill if the object multiplies into a grid, deck or sequence of cards, if the round silhouette with a tab crossing its rim is dropped, if the payload grows into scrollable or paginated content that cannot rest on one hidden face, if the reveal loses its material fold in favour of a fade, slide or panel expansion, or if the object stops returning to an identical closed rest and instead stays open or advances through further states.

name: scroll_told_portrait_opening_handoff
description: A full-height portrait opening that shrinks in place while two oversized slogan lines drift in behind it, then lifts away as one unit to hand off to a continuous scroll story whose photo columns travel upward while the backdrop luminance rises from the low end of its range toward the high end, with the subject's name lockup staying legible above every stage.

experience_qualities: High-contrast and athletic
Cinematic and poster-like
Continuous rather than sectioned
Deliberate and legible at a glance
Layered depth without clutter
locked_observable_requirements: Scroll is the only driver of the sequence; no autoplay and no step controls
The opening portrait shrinks while staying anchored, it does not drift or slide during that stage
The oversized lines arrive behind the portrait layer, never in front of it
The opening leaves as one intact unit travelling upward, not by fading or by scattering its parts
Backdrop luminance progresses from the low end of its range toward the high end across the page while consecutive stretches still alternate low and high luminance
The name lockup stays above all layers and holds readable contrast in every stretch
Each stretch presents one graspable idea per screen
canonical_document.name: scroll_told_portrait_opening_handoff
canonical_document.experience_scope: Whole-view experience: begins with the first full-height opening view and continues without break through every following stretch of the page to the closing block; it is the page's spine, not a detachable region.
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits bold identity pages centred on one person, product or project with photo-heavy sequential content that benefits from a single uninterrupted reading order. It stops being this skill if the opening becomes a menu or hub that jumps to independent sections, if the sequence turns into discrete snapping slides or a stepped deck instead of continuous scroll, or if the low-to-high luminance progression is dropped so stretches no longer form one lighting arc.
content_and_composition: One full-height cut-out portrait of a single subject as the opening focal layer, anchored at a fixed position in the view

name: live_edited_point_field_title_crawl

canonical_document.experience_scope: Whole-view experience composed of two permanently co-visible regions: an editing surface and a cinematic viewer stage. Any stage lightness and any hue family may host it, so long as the depth points separate clearly from the stage and the words stay the most readable thing in the frame. Removing the co-visible editing surface and its read-before-motion pairing, replacing depth recession toward a horizon with flat scrolling or per-word kinetic typography, making images or video the primary content, or turning the run into an unbounded loop without a fixed scrubbable duration would each create a different Skill.

name: dot_cloud_word_sequence

canonical_document.name: dot_cloud_word_sequence
canonical_document.experience_scope: Whole-view experience that fills the viewport from the moment the page opens. canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits contexts where a very short, high-value line of text is the entire payload of a sparse full-view moment and the visitor is expected to linger, look around and re-watch. It does not carry paragraphs, lists, multi-element interfaces layered over the scene, or content that must be scrolled past. Replacing the readable words with non-textual shapes, turning the cloud into a passive substrate behind other foreground content, or removing the movable vantage point and reducing it to a fixed flat reveal each produce a different skill.
content_and_composition: One low-noise, low-distraction field acting as the ground for everything else, its tone chosen only so the dots stay clearly separated from it
One dense cloud of many tiny identical dots, centered in the view, as the only visual material of the scene
The same dot cloud serves two roles: ambient meaningless churn and the carrier of the readable message
One readable word form at a time, assembled out of the dots; a short sequence of a couple of words total, never more than one legible at once
One small, persistent standing caption laid over the scene, present from the first moment, indicating that the scene can be looked around and watched again
A movable vantage point around a fixed cloud center; no other chrome, panels or competing elements
attention_and_information_flow: The opening reads as ambience only; no message is available yet, so attention is on motion and mood
Convergence pulls the eye inward and narrows attention from the whole field to the forming shape
During hold, legibility peaks and the word is the only information in the view
Between words, information drops back to zero as form dissolves, then rebuilds, creating a pulse of meaning and noise
The caption stays deliberately low in prominence but is readable from the first moment so the look-around and re-watch affordances are known before anything happens
After the sequence, prominence returns entirely to ambient motion

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Available at all times, including mid-word; the running sequence continues undisturbed, and the cloud stays centered and reachable however far the viewer swings
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The cloud rotates in view with depth separation between nearer and farther dots; a forming or held word is seen from a new angle
interaction_model.input: Drag across the scene, beyond a small pixel threshold
interaction_model.state_change: Vantage point swings around the cloud center; the gesture is classified as camera movement rather than a press
interaction_model.affected_object: Viewpoint around the dot cloud

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Bounds clamp both extremes so the formation can never be entered past, shrunk into nothing or lost from view; the sequence keeps running throughout
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Dots grow larger and sparser when near, or the whole formation resolves as a compact readable mass when far
interaction_model.input: Zoom input
interaction_model.state_change: Vantage point moves nearer or farther within fixed near and far bounds
interaction_model.affected_object: Viewing distance to the cloud

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Can be triggered at any time, during a held word or during idle drift; a press that becomes a drag is treated as camera movement and does not restart anything, so exploration never accidentally interrupts the message
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Dots scatter out of whatever state they were in, then regather into the first word
interaction_model.input: Plain press and release anywhere in the scene, without exceeding the drag threshold
interaction_model.state_change: Sequence restarts from the first word
interaction_model.affected_object: The whole message sequence and the dot cloud

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: The assist is surrendered the instant the viewer moves the vantage point themselves and never fights or snaps back against them; the viewer's chosen angle stands even if the word reads less cleanly
interaction_model.visible_feedback: A gentle, unhurried drift of the view until the word reads clearly
interaction_model.input: Autonomous: a word reaches its readable state
interaction_model.state_change: Viewpoint eases toward a better reading angle for that word
interaction_model.affected_object: Viewpoint

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Advance is continuous and cannot leave the cloud in a half-formed dead state; a restart press overrides the pending step
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Loss of form and reflow of the same dots into the next arrangement, with no cut or snap
interaction_model.input: Autonomous: hold time for the current word elapses
interaction_model.state_change: Current word gives way to the next word, or to idle drift if it was the last
interaction_model.affected_object: Dot cloud

adaptable_details: The specific words, their language, and the exact count as long as the message stays very short
Dot count, dot size, cloud density, and the tones of dots and ground in either direction, as long as dot-to-ground contrast stays high enough to read and the surround stays low-distraction
Hold duration, gather and dissolve timing, and easing character
Character of the idle churn, from slow breathing to nervous turbulence
Caption wording and its placement within the view
Which concrete gestures map to swinging and zooming, and the exact pixel threshold
Whether the reading-angle assist re-arms for later words after the viewer has taken over
canonical_document.description: A quiet field of countless tiny dots churns meaninglessly across a low-distraction ground, then gathers inward to spell one clearly readable word at a time, held in strong contrast against that ground, before dissolving into the next; after the last word the cloud loosens back into aimless drift, and the viewer can swing and zoom the vantage point at any time or click to watch the message again from the start.
experience_progression: Idle: dots churn restlessly and read as texture with no meaning
Gather: dots converge inward and resolve into the first clearly readable word
Hold: the word stays legible long enough to be taken in without hurry
Yield: the word loses form and the dots reflow into the next word, which also gathers and holds
Release: after the final word the cloud loosens back into aimless drift, leaving no residual text
Replay on demand: a plain press and release restarts the sequence from the first word with a visible scatter and regather
completion_and_return: The sequence completes by dissolving the last word and returning to the same aimless drift it started in, with no end card or held final frame
Idle drift persists indefinitely and remains fully explorable
Replay is always available and always begins from the first word
Camera state belongs to the viewer and is not commandeered on completion or replay
The caption remains present through every stage

name: bright_dim_paired_media_view_switch
description: One header control flips the whole view between a bright-surround and a dimmed-surround appearance: every item photo cross-dissolves into its lit counterpart while backdrops, panels and type shift with it, so the same set can be judged by the light each object emits rather than only by its shape.

experience_qualities: Quiet and editorial rather than showy; a change of viewing condition, not a stylistic stunt
Coordinated and whole — nothing lags behind in the other appearance
Evaluative: the dimmed appearance exists so the emitted light can be judged
Continuous — place, reading position and content identity survive the switch
Effortless and reversible, with no confirmation or cost to trying either appearance
locked_observable_requirements: A single always-available control switches the entire view between exactly two coherent appearances
Each item has two paired media states of the same object in matched framing; the change between them is a cross-dissolve, not a hard cut or a swap of unrelated media
Item media and surrounding surfaces change together in one pass; no partial or mixed appearance is ever visible
In the dimmed appearance every item reads as active/lit against a surround of markedly lower luminance, so the light it gives can be judged
Attribution captions keep readable contrast and equal prominence in both appearances
The chosen appearance is remembered for later visits, and first-time visitors begin from the viewing-condition preference their environment already expresses
Switching never moves the viewer's place in the collection or closes what is open
canonical_document.name: bright_dim_paired_media_view_switch
canonical_document.experience_scope: Whole-view experience. It covers every item photo, the opening statement, all surrounding surfaces and any raised layer above them. It begins silently at first paint with an appearance resolved from a remembered prior choice or, for newcomers, from the environment's existing preference, and it has no end point: the view simply rests in one of two stable appearances until switched.
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits any collection whose subject genuinely has a second visual condition captured as paired media in matched framing — light sources off/on, screens idle/active, spaces under bright and dim ambient light, surfaces before/after treatment — presented as one whole-view mode that also carries the surrounding surfaces. It requires two real media states per item; if only the surrounding surface tones changed while item media stayed identical, if the second state were a different item or angle rather than the same object in another condition, or if the switch applied to a single item or a small isolated widget instead of the entire view, that is a different skill.
content_and_composition: One persistent appearance control in the header, visible and reachable in both appearances
A collection-scale set of item cards, each holding two paired photographs of the same object in identical framing: an inert/unlit state and an active/lit state
A compact attribution caption per item (name, author, year, price) that must stay legible in both appearances
Shared surrounding surfaces — page backdrop, section and card surfaces, type tone, raised-layer surfaces — that all belong to the same appearance at the same time
A short opening statement above the collection that also follows the appearance
No separate second page or duplicate collection: one collection, two appearances
attention_and_information_flow: In the bright appearance attention rests on silhouette, form, material and the caption facts
After the switch attention moves to emitted light and glow, the surround dropping to a low-distraction luminance that removes competing brightness so lit areas dominate
During the dissolve both states are briefly readable together, so the change reads as the same object changing condition rather than new content arriving
Caption prominence stays constant across appearances so cross-item comparison is never interrupted
Relative weighting between items does not change; no item gains emphasis from the switch

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Immediately reversible by activating again; activating mid-transition settles the view in the latest chosen appearance and never leaves items in mixed states
interaction_model.visible_feedback: All paired photos cross-dissolve into their counterpart states while backdrops, panels and type shift to the other appearance in one coordinated pass; the control reads as showing the now-active appearance
interaction_model.input: Activating the single appearance control in the header
interaction_model.state_change: View switches from the bright appearance to the dimmed appearance, or back
interaction_model.affected_object: Every item photo plus all surrounding surfaces and type in the view

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: The visitor can switch at any time, and the new choice replaces the remembered one for later visits
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The page simply appears already in the remembered appearance, with no flip or flash of the other one
interaction_model.input: A returning visitor arriving (autonomous)
interaction_model.state_change: Previously chosen appearance is restored before first read
interaction_model.affected_object: The whole view

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: An explicit switch overrides the inherited default from then on
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The page opens directly in that appearance as if it were the site's own default
interaction_model.input: A first-time visitor arriving (autonomous, environment preference)
interaction_model.state_change: Appearance initialised from the viewing-condition preference the visitor's environment already expresses
interaction_model.affected_object: The whole view

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Closing the layer returns to the collection in the currently chosen appearance and at the same spot
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The enlarged photo dissolves to its counterpart and layer surfaces follow, with the layer's content, scroll and position untouched
interaction_model.input: Switching while a raised layer is open above the collection
interaction_model.state_change: Raised layer adopts the same appearance as the view it sits over
interaction_model.affected_object: Media and surfaces inside the raised layer as well as the collection beneath

adaptable_details: Dissolve duration, easing, and whether items change simultaneously or with a very short stagger
Exact hues, contrast level and surface treatment of either appearance, as long as each stays internally coherent and the two remain clearly separated in luminance
Control label, icon, wording and exact header placement
Number of items, grid rhythm and image aspect
Which attribution fields appear in the caption
Subject matter, as long as it has a genuine second visual condition
canonical_document.description: One header control flips the whole view between a bright-surround and a dimmed-surround appearance: every item photo cross-dissolves into its lit counterpart while backdrops, panels and type shift with it, so the same set can be judged by the light each object emits rather than only by its shape.
experience_progression: Initial appearance is resolved before content is first read, so no visible flip greets the viewer
On activation, all item photos cross-dissolve to their counterpart states while surfaces and type transition in the same coordinated pass
The new appearance holds indefinitely as a resting state; activating again returns to the other appearance
Progression is a two-state flip rather than a sequence: there is no ordered journey and no completion
completion_and_return: No completion; two equally valid resting appearances
The chosen appearance persists across visits as the visitor's default
Switching back restores the previous appearance exactly, with the same items in the same order and position
Scroll position and any open layer are preserved through every switch

name: storm_approach_and_title_impact_intro
description: A rain-lashed storm broken by lightning flashes, where a lone figure rises, staggers straight toward the viewer and lands a blow whose impact slams the title into view; one key press releases the sequence and carries the viewer through it into the main view.

experience_qualities: Ominous and storm-heavy, oppressive rather than pretty
Dread built purely by proximity of one subject
Percussive, jolting title arrival instead of a gentle fade
Short, unhesitating and always escapable
Clear handoff into whatever follows
locked_observable_requirements: Storm environment as the sole backdrop, with rain and lightning flashes that read as sharp luminance spikes above the surround's ambient level
Exactly one figure, advancing toward the viewer's own vantage rather than crossing the frame
The title is absent until the impact beat delivers it
One key press both releases the sequence and advances past it
The sequence ends in the main view, never in a dead end
canonical_document.name: storm_approach_and_title_impact_intro
canonical_document.experience_scope: Begins on a waiting prompt over the storm scene and ends the instant the title has landed and the main view takes over; a whole-view, first-person experience filling the viewport rather than a panel inside a page.
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits entry points that want one short atmospheric approach-and-impact beat to deliver a single headline before content begins. Several simultaneous approaching subjects, a title that is already on screen before the beat, a scrollable or browsable intro, or an intro with no impact delivery would be a different skill.
content_and_composition: One full-view storm environment as the only backdrop: heavy rain, thunder flashes, and a low-salience ground plane whose luminance sits well below the flashes
Exactly one animated figure, the sole moving subject, closing distance from mid-distance toward the viewer's own vantage
One short prompt line inviting a single key press, present only before the sequence is released
One title element that does not exist on screen until the impact beat delivers it, then holds centered in view
The viewer's vantage sits inside the scene at the receiving end of the approach, not observing from outside
attention_and_information_flow: Attention starts on the prompt because nothing else is readable
After release, the single approaching figure is the only motion and holds the eye as proximity increases
The strike redirects attention violently from figure to title, which becomes the only readable element
The environment stays subordinate throughout, supplying mood at low salience and never competing for reading

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: The same single press also carries the viewer onward through the sequence, so no one is stuck waiting for the cinematic to finish
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The prompt clears and the figure begins to rise and advance
interaction_model.input: A single key press while the opening prompt waits
interaction_model.state_change: Waiting prompt state becomes a running cinematic
interaction_model.affected_object: The intro sequence as a whole

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: The sequence always terminates in the main view; skipping ahead arrives at the same state as watching it through
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The figure closes on the viewer, the blow lands, and the title snaps into view and holds
interaction_model.input: Autonomous timeline once released
interaction_model.state_change: Approach becomes strike, strike becomes title-landed
interaction_model.affected_object: Figure, storm environment and title

adaptable_details: Figure identity, silhouette and gait
Storm specifics: rain density, thunder cadence, ground material, and the host's own hue family and ambient luminance level
Title wording, typography and hold duration
Length of the approach and exact strike choreography
Presence of a subtitle or start hint alongside the prompt
canonical_document.description: A rain-lashed storm broken by lightning flashes, where a lone figure rises, staggers straight toward the viewer and lands a blow whose impact slams the title into view; one key press releases the sequence and carries the viewer through it into the main view.
experience_progression: Resting storm scene with the waiting prompt as the only readable element
A single key press releases the sequence and clears the prompt
The figure rises from the ground and staggers toward the viewer, growing as it closes
The figure swings and lands a blow on the viewer's vantage
The impact beat slams the title into view and holds it
Handoff into the main view; the same single key press can also carry the viewer straight through to that state
completion_and_return: Completes by settling into the main view with the title delivered
Does not loop during use
Replays only when the whole experience is restarted from its entry point

name: unsettled_text_resolve_headline
description: A short, prominent line of type arrives visibly unsettled — characters churning through wrong forms — and settles character by character into readable text; hovering replays the resolve, and the text is always left readable afterwards. It inherits the host's type and color treatment, needing only readable contrast and a quiet surround.

experience_qualities: A brief, deliberate moment of illegibility resolving into clarity
Mechanical, typographic tactility rather than decorative flourish
Discoverable playfulness inside an otherwise restrained page
Legibility guaranteed whenever the element is at rest
locked_observable_requirements: The text must begin unsettled and unreadable and resolve progressively per character, not fade or slide in whole.
The rest and final state must be the correct, fully readable string.
Pointing at the element must replay the resolve.
Pointer exit must never leave illegible text behind.
It must apply to a short, high-prominence string, not to body copy.
canonical_document.name: unsettled_text_resolve_headline
canonical_document.experience_scope: Region-level, scoped to a single short text element. It begins when that element enters the view (or on page entrance) and ends the moment the string is fully readable; it can be re-entered indefinitely through pointer hover without affecting anything else on the page.
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits short, high-prominence strings that lead a screen or section — names, headlines, taglines, wordmarks, section titles, prominent labels — in layouts calm enough that one moving line reads as intentional. Applying it to paragraphs or body copy imposes a real reading cost and would be a different skill. It also becomes a different skill if the churn runs continuously instead of resolving and resting, or if it decodes into content different from the final string, which turns it into a rotating-message device rather than a reveal.
content_and_composition: Exactly one short text element as the subject — a name, headline, wordmark or title of a few words at most.
The element is the largest or near-largest type in its region so the churn is legible at a glance.
It may sit beside a supporting image or block, but the text is the only animated role.

Surroundings stay a low-distraction surround — no competing motion and nothing else of comparable salience nearby — so the character churn is the only movement in view, whatever palette the host uses.
attention_and_information_flow: Motion claims the eye before any meaning is available, so the element is looked at before it is read.
Meaning arrives progressively as characters lock, turning reading into a brief unfolding.
Once resolved the element becomes the stable anchor of its region.
The hover replay reveals the text as responsive without adding any explicit affordance or hint.

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Completes on its own within a short moment; the resolved state is stable and never lapses back to unreadable
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Characters churn through wrong forms and lock into the real string one position at a time
interaction_model.input: Autonomous entrance — the element appearing on page open or scrolling into view
interaction_model.state_change: Unsettled and unreadable to fully resolved
interaction_model.affected_object: The short text element's characters

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Moving the pointer away — even mid-replay — leaves the text intact and readable; repeatable without limit; no state is left behind
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The character-by-character churn repeats and settles back into the same readable string
interaction_model.input: Pointer entering the text element
interaction_model.state_change: Resolved to replaying to resolved again
interaction_model.affected_object: The same short text element

adaptable_details: Total resolve duration and per-character timing
The substitute glyph set the characters churn through
Order and direction in which characters settle
Typeface, size, case and text color, provided the text holds readable contrast against whatever surface it sits on
Whether the entrance play triggers on load or on scroll into view
Whether the replay trigger is hover, keyboard focus or both
The specific words being resolved
canonical_document.description: A short, prominent line of type arrives visibly unsettled — characters churning through wrong forms — and settles character by character into readable text; hovering replays the resolve, and the text is always left readable afterwards. It inherits the host's type and color treatment, needing only readable contrast and a quiet surround.
experience_progression: The element appears with its characters in an unsettled, unreadable state.
Characters settle progressively in sequence until the whole string is legible.
Rest state: fully readable and static.
On hover the same stages replay from unsettled back to readable, on demand.
completion_and_return: Always terminates in the correct readable string, whichever way it was triggered or interrupted.
Replayable on demand through hover, with no cumulative or persistent altered state.
No looping or idle churn — the element is quiet unless triggered.

name: phrase_column_sentence_completion
description: A full-height statement in which a fixed lead line is finished by a vertical column of candidate phrases: the centered phrase is solid and fully legible while its neighbours sit paler with dissolving edges, and each scroll nudge glides the next phrase into the centre until the sequence releases the page onward.

experience_qualities: Unhurried, deliberate, one-at-a-time pacing that resists skimming
Constant legibility: the current ending is never blurred or faded below full readability
A single claim that keeps re-completing itself rather than a list being scanned
Soft dissolving edges that imply an ongoing set without cluttering the statement
Controlled, gentle hand-off between statement and page rather than an abrupt snap
locked_observable_requirements: A fixed, unchanging lead line combined with exactly one solid phrase that reads as the statement's current ending
A vertical column in which alternative phrases remain visible above and below the current one, paler and dissolving at the edges
Advance and retreat happen one phrase at a time, with the solid highlight transferring on each step
Vertical input nudges accumulate into discrete stepwise glides instead of free-scrubbing the page
The current phrase is always fully legible at full contrast
The statement holds the full view for as long as the sequence is running
Reaching either end releases control to normal page scrolling, and re-entering resumes at the last shown phrase
canonical_document.name: phrase_column_sentence_completion
canonical_document.experience_scope: A whole-view region experience covering the opening full-height statement. It begins as soon as that statement fills the viewport and the phrase sequence takes over vertical input, and ends when either end of the phrase set is reached and normal page scrolling resumes into the plainer reading that follows; it can be re-entered from below.
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits any short fixed statement that can be finished by a small set of interchangeable endings, placed as a full-height opening or a full-view section ahead of plainer reading, where the surrounding composition is sparse enough for one line to dominate. It stops being this Skill if the alternatives are scrubbed continuously or morphed letter by letter instead of stepped one phrase at a time, if the lead line itself changes so there is no stable anchor, if the column becomes a navigational menu that routes elsewhere, or if the set grows long enough that visitors need to scan or search it rather than read one ending at a time.
content_and_composition: One large lead line that stays fixed and unchanged for the whole experience, acting as the anchor of the statement
One vertical column of short interchangeable phrases placed beside the lead line, reading as its possible endings
Exactly one phrase at the column centre is the current ending, rendered in solid, high-contrast type
Neighbouring phrases above and below the centre appear paler, with their edges dissolving toward the top and bottom of the column window
The column occupies a fixed vertical window inside the composition; the whole statement occupies the full viewport height
Plainer explanatory or secondary body reading sits directly below in normal page flow, visually much quieter than the statement
attention_and_information_flow: The fixed lead line stays continuously readable, so all changing meaning is concentrated in the single centred phrase
The centred solid phrase holds nearly all prominence and is never degraded below full legibility
Paler dissolving neighbours reveal that a set of alternatives exists and hint at what is coming or just passed, without competing for reading
Prominence transfers cleanly from one phrase to the next on each step, so only one ending is ever asserted at a time
Attention walks steadily downward through the column and then hands off downward to the quieter explanatory reading

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Small nudges accumulate rather than jumping ahead; a nudge in the opposite direction immediately steps back; once the final phrase is current, further forward input is handed to the page instead of the column
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The column glides one step so the next phrase settles at the centre in solid type while the previous one pales and moves toward the dissolving edge
interaction_model.input: Wheel or trackpad nudge in the forward direction while the statement holds the view
interaction_model.state_change: Accumulated nudge progress crosses a threshold and the next phrase becomes the current ending
interaction_model.affected_object: The column of candidate phrases and the current-ending highlight

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Fully symmetric with forward stepping; at the first phrase further reverse input releases control upward to the page
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The column glides back one step and the solid highlight returns to the earlier phrase while the later one pales again
interaction_model.input: Wheel or trackpad nudge in the reverse direction while the statement holds the view
interaction_model.state_change: The previous phrase becomes the current ending
interaction_model.affected_object: The column of candidate phrases and the current-ending highlight

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: The hand-off is continuous rather than abrupt, and the sequence stays available by scrolling back to the statement
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The page begins to scroll past the statement into the plainer reading below, or back above it, with the final phrase left standing solid
interaction_model.input: Reaching either end of the phrase set
interaction_model.state_change: The statement stops absorbing vertical input and normal page scrolling resumes
interaction_model.affected_object: The relationship between the held statement and the surrounding page

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Stepping upward from the first phrase leaves the statement again in the same continuous way
interaction_model.visible_feedback: That phrase appears centred and solid again with its neighbours paled around it, with no forced restart from the first phrase
interaction_model.input: Scrolling back up into the statement after leaving it
interaction_model.state_change: The sequence re-enters at the phrase that was current when it was left
interaction_model.affected_object: The phrase sequence state

adaptable_details: Number and wording of the phrases and the length of the lead line
Typeface, weight, size and the specific contrast pair between solid and paled type
Side-by-side versus stacked placement of lead line and phrase column, and text alignment
Glide duration, easing and how far the fading neighbours drift
How many neighbouring phrases stay visible and how strong the edge dissolve is
Input sensitivity and threshold, plus additional drivers such as keys, touch drag or pointer input
The nature of the quieter content that follows the statement
canonical_document.description: A full-height statement in which a fixed lead line is finished by a vertical column of candidate phrases: the centered phrase is solid and fully legible while its neighbours sit paler with dissolving edges, and each scroll nudge glides the next phrase into the centre until the sequence releases the page onward.
experience_progression: Opens with the first phrase centred and solid, so the statement already reads as one complete claim
Each forward nudge advances the column by exactly one phrase: the incoming phrase takes the solid highlight as it reaches the centre while the outgoing one pales and drifts toward the dissolving edge
Advance continues one phrase at a time, unhurried, with the claim re-completing itself at every step
Reverse input steps back through the same phrases in the same manner
When the final phrase lands, the held view releases and attention falls downward into the plainer reading
Returning upward re-enters the sequence at the phrase it was left on rather than restarting
completion_and_return: The sequence completes at the final phrase and does not loop back to the first
On completion, scroll control returns to the page and the reading below takes over
Sequence position persists after leaving, so re-entry resumes mid-sequence
Backward traversal remains available at any time, making every step reversible

name: shearing_oversized_arrival_statement
description: An opening view filled by one oversized two-line statement whose lines slide apart in opposite directions when the pointer brushes them, then fall back into alignment before attention is handed to the content below.

experience_qualities: declarative and oversized
unsettled but elastic
tactile, as if the words respond to being touched
restrained: a single object with no ornament
locked_observable_requirements: one oversized text statement occupies the opening view as the only foreground element
the statement is composed of exactly two lines that displace as separate bands
pointer contact moves the two lines in opposite directions along their length
the displacement resolves back to aligned rest when contact ends
no imagery or secondary content competes with the statement in this view
canonical_document.name: shearing_oversized_arrival_statement
canonical_document.experience_scope: Begins with the first full view on arrival and ends when attention is handed downward to the content that follows; a whole-view region occupying the opening screen, not a persistent overlay.
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits any opening view or section opener whose message is carried by a short two-line text statement with no competing imagery, on sites that can spend a screen on voice before content. content_and_composition: one oversized statement of intent, sized to dominate the opening view, as the sole foreground object
the statement is set as exactly two stacked lines that can move independently as separate bands
generous empty field around the statement with no imagery or secondary blocks competing for attention
optional low-prominence persistent edge rail of a few section labels remains visible without competing
attention_and_information_flow: on arrival the statement holds virtually all prominence; nothing else asks to be read
the shear draws the eye along the two displaced bands and makes the text read as touchable rather than static
the statement never follows the visitor; it releases prominence completely once the next stage takes over

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: moving the pointer away lets both lines travel back and settle into alignment; the effect can be interrupted mid-travel and re-triggered immediately, leaving no residual offset
interaction_model.visible_feedback: the lines slide horizontally away from each other, breaking the block into two offset bands
interaction_model.input: pointer brushing or moving across the statement
interaction_model.state_change: aligned rest state becomes sheared apart in opposite directions
interaction_model.affected_object: the two text lines of the statement

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: returning upward restores the statement in its aligned rest state
interaction_model.visible_feedback: the statement leaves the view as the next content takes prominence
interaction_model.input: visitor advancing past the opening view
interaction_model.state_change: arrival stage yields to the following content stage
interaction_model.affected_object: the whole opening view

adaptable_details: wording, language, typeface, casing and colour
displacement distance, easing and settle behaviour
