Nothing outside the attended row changes, so the stack can also be dropped into a larger page as a self-contained section.
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits short curated sets of a few large text entries where each entry has one short second reading of similar length and the surrounding view can stay sparse and quiet, with the labels holding strong separation from their surround — indexes, menus, credits, schedules, bilingual or before/after labels. It becomes a different Skill if the stack grows into a long or dense list meant for scanning, if the second reading is a long text block, image or panel instead of a short in-place reading, if the change collapses into an instant swap or plain crossfade without the merged-blob midpoint, if the transformation cannot reverse from mid-flight, or if the treatment is pushed behind other content as a background texture.
content_and_composition: One near-empty full stage of a single uniform tone acting as the only backdrop, with no competing imagery, decoration or secondary panels
One small subordinate title held apart from the stack, legible but far below the entries in size and weight
A short vertical stack of a few oversized text entries (roughly three to six) centered as the single focal cluster
Each entry carries exactly two text readings: a resting primary label and a paired short secondary detail of comparable line length
The two readings of an entry occupy the same optical spot, superimposed rather than placed side by side or below one another
Each entry's full row is one continuous target region, larger than its glyphs
Generous empty space around the stack so the stack is the only dense area in the view
attention_and_information_flow: Arrival reads as deliberately empty so the oversized stack is the only place attention can land
The small title stays readable but never competes for prominence
Only the attended entry gains weight and motion; the others hold their resting appearance, so at most one entry is transformed at a time
The blob midpoint briefly withholds legibility, which is what makes the change read as one substance re-forming rather than two texts trading places
After resolve, the entry's second fact is delivered without opening any new region, so total information density is unchanged
Stack position, order and size never shift, so the reader never loses their place while scanning

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: One continuous interruptible progression; the row stays a reliable target for the whole change even while glyphs deform, so the transformation never causes the target to slip away
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The label fades out while the detail fades in over the same spot, letterforms swell and smear into sticky rounded blobs at the halfway point, then sharpen into the detail
interaction_model.input: Pointer or attention entering an entry row
interaction_model.state_change: Entry advances from resting label toward paired detail
interaction_model.affected_object: That entry's two superimposed text readings

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Reversal starts from wherever the change currently is rather than from the end state, so nothing snaps, restarts or freezes as a half-faded label
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The same swell-smear-sharpen path plays backwards; the detail fades out as the label returns to crisp form
interaction_model.input: Pointer or attention leaving the entry row
interaction_model.state_change: Entry reverses from its current point back to the resting label
interaction_model.affected_object: The same entry

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: No queued replays or restarts accumulate; every touched row settles at one of its two legible end states
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Overlapping partial morphs move smoothly in opposite directions; the departed entry flows back to its label while the newly attended one flows forward
interaction_model.input: Rapid on-off flicking, or attention moving directly from one entry to another
interaction_model.state_change: Each entry independently advances toward the detail or reverses toward its label according to whether attention is on it
interaction_model.affected_object: Two or more entries at once

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Returning to the view finds the list untouched and immediately ready for the next pick, with no reload flash or re-entry animation
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The stack stays exactly as it was — same entries, same position, attended entry still following the current attention state
interaction_model.input: Activating an entry
interaction_model.state_change: Destination opens in a separate tab or context while the current view persists
interaction_model.affected_object: The entry's destination and the surrounding list

adaptable_details: Number of entries within a short set, and exact type size, typeface and letter spacing
What the paired detail is: date, year, role, place, price, translation or other short value

Hue, overall lightness and whether the stage reads light or dark, provided the stage stays one quiet low-competition surround, the labels keep clearly readable separation from it and dominate the view
Exact stack alignment and where the small title sits
Morph duration, easing, blob roundness and how viscous the material reads
Whether entries link anywhere at all and where activation leads
Which input drives the change: pointer, keyboard focus or touch
canonical_document.description: A sparse, low-distraction view of one uniform tone with a short centered stack of oversized labels standing clearly out from it; the attended entry's word thickens, smears into rounded merged blobs and re-sharpens as its paired short detail, then flows back to the label when attention leaves.
experience_progression: Arrival: quiet, nearly empty stage; only resting primary labels and the small title are visible
Rest: the attended-entry effect is idle; every label is crisp and fully legible
Onset: the resting label starts fading as the paired detail starts appearing in the same spot; letterforms begin to thicken
Midpoint: strokes swell, smear and stick together into rounded merged blobs where both readings are least legible
Resolve: shapes tighten and sharpen into the fully legible paired detail
Return: the same stages run backwards to the resting label
The per-entry cycle repeats indefinitely as attention moves across the stack; the page itself has no overall progression
completion_and_return: Each morph completes at one of exactly two legible end states — resting label or paired detail — and never settles mid-blob
Whenever attention leaves, the entry returns to its resting label and the list is unchanged
Entering and leaving repeatedly loops the same forward and backward path indefinitely with no wear-out or one-shot behavior
Activation preserves the whole view, so stack state and reading position survive
No counters, badges or completion states accumulate; every entry stays re-triggerable

name: receding_card_stack_time_travel
description: A collection shown as a pile of cards receding into depth — the front card fully readable, the ones behind progressively smaller and progressively lower in contrast as they recede toward the surrounding field — where scrolling continuously pulls the pile forward or backward one entry at a time while a side rail keeps the current position marked.

experience_qualities: Physical and tactile: reads as a real pile with depth rather than a list
Calm and continuous, never stepped, snapped or jumpy during travel
Single-focus legibility: one entry is readable, everything else is atmosphere
Immediate sense of quantity and how far the collection extends
Directly responsive and instantly reversible, so travel feels hand-driven
Contained and deliberate: the rest of the page holds still while you move through the stack
locked_observable_requirements: Exactly one fully legible frontmost item at a time
Depth cues are monotonic: further back means smaller and progressively lower in contrast, receding toward the surrounding field along one consistent luminance direction
Travel is continuous and non-quantized, with valid resting half-states and immediate reversal from any point
Handoff is a dissolve of the outgoing front while the next glides forward into its place
A persistent ordinal rail always marks exactly one current position, kept in sync with the frontmost item and clickable for direct jumps
Hard clamped ends with no overshoot and no wrap-around
Only the frontmost item accepts clicks
The surrounding page never scrolls while travel is active
canonical_document.name: receding_card_stack_time_travel
canonical_document.experience_scope: A self-contained region that fills the primary view and owns wheel input while engaged; it begins on arrival with the first (most recent) entry at the front and the depth of the stack already visible behind it, and ends at the last (oldest) entry read as the far end of the pile. The surrounding page does not scroll while travel is happening.
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits a single ordered collection of comparable, individually readable items where position in the order is meaningful and the overall size of the collection is worth sensing at a glance — roughly tens to low hundreds of items, one collection per view, with the region taking over wheel input. It becomes a different skill if several items must be readable or compared side by side, if travel becomes stepped, paged or endlessly looping, if the stack is pushed behind other foreground content as a decorative substrate, or if items must be filtered, grouped or branched instead of traversed along one continuous order.
content_and_composition: One ordered collection of many comparable, individually readable items, traversed in a single fixed order
Exactly one frontmost item at full size, full contrast and full legibility, carrying the readable content

A receding column of following items behind it, each progressively smaller and progressively lower in contrast against the surround, so the quantity and remaining extent of the collection is sensed at a glance rather than read
A persistent side rail listing ordinal markers for the collection (dates in the source case), with exactly one marker rendered as the current position at clearly higher salience than the rest
A stationary surrounding frame/field, kept low in distraction, that does not move with the stack and sets the far end of the depth recession in whatever tone the host provides
Only the frontmost card is interactive; deeper cards are visual depth material
attention_and_information_flow: Prominence decreases monotonically with depth: nearest is largest, highest in contrast and readable; deeper items degrade toward flat, detail-free shape
Detailed information lives only in the frontmost item; depth layers convey volume and how much archive remains, not content
Current position is signalled redundantly by the front card itself and by the marked entry on the side rail, so it is always evident
During travel, attention transfers with the advancing card via the dissolve/glide handoff rather than splitting between two competing items

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Reversing scroll direction reverses travel immediately from any half-way point without first completing the in-flight transition; motion is fully interruptible and resumable
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Front card dissolves out as the next glides forward, scales up and gains contrast into the front slot; every deeper card moves one place nearer and separates further from the surround; the rail's current marker moves to the newly frontmost item
interaction_model.input: Wheel or trackpad scroll toward the older direction
interaction_model.state_change: Continuous, non-quantized advance through the order proportional to input, able to rest at any partial position between two items
interaction_model.affected_object: The whole depth stack and the side-rail current marker

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Symmetric with forward travel; direction can be flipped again at any moment from any partial position
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Cards recede back into depth toward the surround, the previous front card returns to full size and full contrast, and the rail marker tracks backward until the arrival state is restored
interaction_model.input: Wheel or trackpad scroll toward the newer direction
interaction_model.state_change: Continuous reverse travel back through the order toward the first/most recent item
interaction_model.affected_object: The whole depth stack and the side-rail current marker

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Scrolling back in the opposite direction resumes normal travel from the clamped end
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Travel stops cleanly with the end item held in the front slot, without overshoot, bounce or looping back around
interaction_model.input: Continued scrolling at the first or last item
interaction_model.state_change: Position is clamped; no movement past either end and no wrap to the other end
interaction_model.affected_object: Stack travel position

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Continuous scroll travel resumes from the jumped-to position; another marker can be clicked at any time, including mid-travel
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The chosen item arrives in the front slot fully legible, the previous front leaves, and the clicked marker takes the high-salience current treatment while others drop back to plain
interaction_model.input: Click on an ordinal marker in the side rail
interaction_model.state_change: Direct jump to the chosen item as the new frontmost item
interaction_model.affected_object: Stack position and rail marking

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Cards behind the front ignore clicks entirely, so partially advanced items cannot be mis-targeted; the settled state remains the current position
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The card settles precisely into alignment at the front instead of remaining part-way
interaction_model.input: Click on the frontmost card
interaction_model.state_change: Any in-between travel resolves and that card commits to the exact front position
interaction_model.affected_object: The frontmost card

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Normal page scrolling belongs outside the region; the stack never leaks scroll to the page mid-travel
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The page frame stays completely still; only the stack moves
interaction_model.input: Any scroll input while the experience is engaged
interaction_model.state_change: Outer page scrolling is suppressed for the duration
interaction_model.affected_object: Surrounding page

adaptable_details: Item content type (dated entries, releases, chapters, projects) as long as items are comparable and individually readable
Rail marker labels (dates, numbers, titles), how the current marker is distinguished, and which side or edge the rail occupies
Exact scale and contrast-falloff curve, including whether depth recedes toward a lighter or a darker surround, and how many depth layers stay visible
Card shape, framing, surface tone and typographic treatment, in whatever palette the host site supplies
Travel speed, easing and dissolve duration
Ordering direction and which end is the arrival state
Additional traversal inputs such as keyboard or drag, provided continuity and instant reversal are preserved
canonical_document.description: A collection shown as a pile of cards receding into depth — the front card fully readable, the ones behind progressively smaller and progressively lower in contrast as they recede toward the surrounding field — where scrolling continuously pulls the pile forward or backward one entry at a time while a side rail keeps the current position marked.
experience_progression: Arrival: first/newest item at the front, fully legible at full contrast, with the depth of the pile visible behind it and its marker shown as current on the rail
Continuous travel deeper: the front item dissolves away while the next glides forward, grows and gains contrast into the front slot; every deeper item moves one place nearer
Intermediate half-states are valid and can be rested in; only one item holds foreground attention at any moment
Far end: the last/oldest item reads as the end of the depth and travel stops there
Travelling the other way retraces the same path and lands back on the arrival state with the present/first item in front
completion_and_return: The far end is terminal, not a loop; there is no wrap from oldest back to newest
Travelling forward again returns to the arrival state with the first/most recent item in front
Position persists wherever the user stops; there is no auto-advance and no automatic reset
The rail's current marker persists as the standing record of position, including after a direct jump
Clicking the front card settles rather than restarts the experience

name: lure_led_gliding_creature_in_quiet_void
description: In a visually quiet, near-empty view a lifelike snake glides endlessly; a small self-luminous marker drifts to follow the pointer or finger across the ground, and the creature swings toward it in smooth curves, then orbits it in slow weaving circles.

canonical_document.name: lure_led_gliding_creature_in_quiet_void
canonical_document.description: In a visually quiet, near-empty view a lifelike snake glides endlessly; a small self-luminous marker drifts to follow the pointer or finger across the ground, and the creature swings toward it in smooth curves, then orbits it in slow weaving circles.
canonical_document.experience_scope: Whole-view ambient experience that is already running the moment the view appears; it has no entry sequence, no end state and no exit, and it occupies the entire visible area rather than sitting inside a page section as a widget.
content_and_composition: Exactly one animate creature as the sole subject, presented with visible body thickness, surface markings and a soft sheen so it reads as real flesh rather than a shape or line
Exactly one small self-luminous marker resting on the ground level below the creature, held at a clear luminance separation from its surround, acting as the lure it is drawn toward
A quiet, low-distraction, largely empty surrounding space kept to a single restrained tone with no scenery competing with the creature
An implied ground plane beneath the creature that the marker sits on, giving the creature's travel and circling a readable floor
No instructions, labels, controls, chrome or call-to-action anywhere in the view; the pair of creature and marker is the entire composition
Persistent elements across the whole session: the creature, the marker and the quiet empty surround
experience_progression: The creature is already in motion on arrival, mid-glide, with no build-up or reveal
Repeating cycle stage 1: the creature swings its heading toward the current marker position in a gradual curve
Repeating cycle stage 2: it travels across the space toward the marker while its body weaves up and down
Repeating cycle stage 3: it settles into slow circles around the marker, continuing the vertical weave
Repeating cycle stage 4: when the marker is placed far away, it breaks off the circling and sets out again, returning to stage 1
The cycle continues indefinitely; there is no completion, climax or return point
attention_and_information_flow: Attention lands first on the small luminous marker, the highest-salience point in an otherwise restrained, low-contrast view
Attention then transfers to the creature as it commits to a heading and travels, with its body detail — thickness, markings, sheen — becoming the thing being watched
During orbiting, prominence stays shared between the fixed luminous marker and the creature circling it, inviting sustained idle watching
The visitor discovers the cause-and-effect relationship without being told: moving the pointer moves the light, and the creature answers the light
No information is progressively unlocked; the only changing information is the creature's heading, position and body attitude

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Continuously interruptible: a new pointer position simply redirects the marker mid-drift with no discontinuity
interaction_model.state_change: Marker target position updates to the ground point matching the pointer, and the marker eases toward it continuously
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The luminous marker trails behind the pointer with visible lag and smooth easing rather than snapping to the exact position
interaction_model.input: Pointer moved across the view
interaction_model.affected_object: The small luminous marker on the ground

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Lifting the finger leaves the marker where it settled; nothing is cancelled or reset
interaction_model.state_change: Same target update as pointer movement, driven by the drag position
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Marker eases toward the dragged position with the same trailing behavior
interaction_model.input: Finger dragged across the view on touch
interaction_model.affected_object: The small luminous marker on the ground

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: A further marker move re-aims the turn while it is still in progress, always as a smooth continuation
interaction_model.state_change: Creature turns toward the marker and re-aims its travel
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The body curves gradually into the new heading, never kinking or snapping into a sharp angle
interaction_model.input: Marker settling at a new nearby position
interaction_model.affected_object: The creature's heading and path

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Moving the marker back near the creature mid-journey causes it to curve around and settle again; no state is stranded
interaction_model.state_change: Creature abandons the orbit and enters travel mode toward the distant marker
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The circling visibly unwinds into a long curving departure and an extended glide across the quiet empty space
interaction_model.input: Marker placed far from the creature
interaction_model.affected_object: The creature's current circling behavior

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Orbiting persists indefinitely until the marker moves far enough to trigger a new departure
interaction_model.state_change: Travel mode becomes sustained orbiting around the marker
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Slow circles around the luminous point while the body continues weaving up and down
interaction_model.input: Creature arriving at the marker
interaction_model.affected_object: The creature's motion pattern

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Resuming input immediately resumes marker following from wherever it was left
interaction_model.state_change: Marker holds its last position; creature keeps its ongoing behavior
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The circling and weaving simply continue with no pause, dimming, idle prompt or reset
interaction_model.input: Input stops entirely
interaction_model.affected_object: Marker and creature

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Cannot be stopped or paused by the visitor; there is no control surface for it
interaction_model.state_change: Perpetual forward glide with ongoing vertical weaving independent of input
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The creature never stops or stands still; it always reads as alive even when nothing is happening
interaction_model.input: Autonomous continuous motion driver
interaction_model.affected_object: The creature's body

experience_qualities: Calm, hushed and visually quiet, like stepping into a still space rather than opening an interface
Lifelike and organic — the creature reads as flesh with weight, not as a graphic or a trail
Unhurried and endless, with nothing to finish, win or return from
Effortlessly legible: the relationship between input, light and creature is understood without explanation
Gentle rather than responsive-snappy; lag and easing are felt as animal reluctance, not latency
Watchable — rewarding to leave running and to keep nudging out of idle curiosity
completion_and_return: No completion state, success state or ending exists
The behavior loops through approach, orbit and departure for as long as the view is open
No reset control and no return path; nothing accumulates that could be reset
When input stops, the last marker position persists and the creature's circling continues unattended
locked_observable_requirements: The creature is already alive and moving on arrival, with no instruction, prompt or onboarding anywhere in the view
The surrounding space is visually quiet and low in internal contrast, with the small self-luminous marker separated from it strongly enough to read as the highest-salience element in the view
The marker follows the pointer or drag with visible lag and easing and must never snap to the input position
The marker is placed on the ground level below, not directly under the pointer in mid-air
The creature is drawn toward the marker: it turns to it, travels to it, and settles into slow circles around it
All turning is gradual and curved; the body never kinks or bends sharply
The body weaves up and down continuously during both travel and circling
The creature reads as real flesh through visible thickness, surface markings and sheen
A distant marker placement makes the creature break off its orbit and set out again
When input stops the marker holds position and the circling continues; motion never halts
The experience is endless with no completion, reset or return
adaptable_details: Creature species, proportions, marking pattern and surface colouring
Overall luminance level of the surround, its hue and the warmth of the lighting, light or dark, as long as it stays low-distraction
Marker size, glow shape, hue and easing rate, as long as its separation from the surround holds
Orbit radius, circling speed, travel speed and weave amplitude
Distance threshold that counts as far enough to trigger a departure
Viewing angle, framing and apparent scale of the scene
Input device — pointer, touch drag or both
Ground surface treatment, as long as it stays visually quiet
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits ambient, wordless whole-view scenes and playful toy pages where a single animate subject is the entire foreground content and the visitor's pointer acts only as a lure. It does not transfer to views that must carry readable text or interface elements over it, since the quiet low-contrast surround and the roaming high-salience marker rely on having no competing foreground. Replacing the lagging lure with direct one-to-one control, making the creature snap or turn sharply, adding goals, scoring, levels or an ending, or populating the scene with many creatures or scenery would each produce a different Skill.

name: orbitable_water_basin_ripple_playground
description: A clearly lit tiled basin of still water holding one floating ball; pressing or dragging on the surface lays ripples that spread and rebound off the walls while light bends and drifts over the tiles beneath, and dragging off the water swings and zooms the viewpoint from high overhead to just below the waterline before everything fades flat again.

canonical_document.name: orbitable_water_basin_ripple_playground
canonical_document.description: A clearly lit tiled basin of still water holding one floating ball; pressing or dragging on the surface lays ripples that spread and rebound off the walls while light bends and drifts over the tiles beneath, and dragging off the water swings and zooms the viewpoint from high overhead to just below the waterline before everything fades flat again.
canonical_document.experience_scope: A single continuous scene that begins the moment the view appears, already showing the resting basin, and never ends or hands off to another view; it can occupy a whole view or a bounded region, but the basin, its water and its viewpoint controls are the entire experience inside that area.
content_and_composition: One enclosed rectangular-feeling basin with visible walls that bound both the water and any floating object
One continuous water surface as the sole primary content, occupying the basin from wall to wall
One tiled floor beneath the water, read through the surface and carrying the moving light pattern
One free-floating object resting on the surface, grabbable and confined inside the walls
One overhead illumination character, of any hue, that makes the surface reflective and bends light onto the floor below
Persistent elements: basin, water, floor pattern, floating object and current viewpoint all remain present at all times; no panels, labels or controls overlay the scene
Layering from the viewer inward: surface highlights and reflections, then the refracted view of the submerged floor, with the floating object breaking the surface plane
experience_progression: Resting state: flat, calm, plainly legible water reading as untouched and invitational
Disturbance: a raised ripple appears exactly where the pointer presses, or a continuous trail of ripples follows a held drag
Autonomous propagation: released disturbances keep spreading outward on their own and rebound off the walls, crossing and overlapping earlier waves
Decay: wave height diminishes over time and the light pattern on the floor calms with it
Return to resting state: the surface flattens completely, restoring the original calm and readiness for the next attempt
This cycle loops indefinitely and any new disturbance can begin at any stage without waiting for the previous one to finish
attention_and_information_flow: Arrival reads instantly: basin, water and ball are understood at a glance without instruction
After arrival, attention belongs to the water surface alone; nothing else competes for prominence
Prominence follows the disturbance: the newest ripple under the pointer is the highest-contrast, sharpest event and pulls the eye
Attention then travels outward with the spreading and rebounding waves, and downward to the light pattern shifting across the floor
Moving the floating object shifts attention to the mound of water ahead of it and the hollow trailing behind it

Changing the viewpoint reveals different information about the same scene: overhead emphasises wave spread and the floor pattern, near the waterline emphasises surface relief, reflection and light bending
As waves decay, prominence drains back to the whole calm basin, resetting the invitation

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Releasing ends the input while the ripple continues on its own; the disturbance always fades to flat, so no cleanup or undo is needed
interaction_model.state_change: A localized disturbance is introduced at the exact pointer position and begins propagating
interaction_model.visible_feedback: A ripple rises immediately under the pointer and starts spreading outward, with the surface highlights and the light pattern on the floor shifting in step
interaction_model.input: Press on the water surface
interaction_model.affected_object: Water surface at the pressed point

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Releasing or breaking off mid-gesture simply stops adding new ripples; existing waves continue and decay naturally with nothing left half-done
interaction_model.state_change: A continuous succession of disturbances is laid along the whole pointer path
interaction_model.visible_feedback: An unbroken trail of ripples follows the pointer, older parts of the trail already spreading and overlapping while new ripples appear at the current position
interaction_model.input: Hold and move across the water surface
interaction_model.affected_object: Water surface along the traversed path

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Cannot be cancelled, only added to; the guaranteed outcome is a return to flat calm
interaction_model.state_change: Waves keep travelling, reflect off the basin walls and interact with one another, then diminish
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Waves visibly bounce back from the walls, cross earlier waves, and gradually flatten until the surface is calm again
interaction_model.input: Autonomous continuation after release
interaction_model.affected_object: All existing waves

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Releasing leaves the object wherever it was let go and its wake continues then fades; interrupting mid-drag ends the drag cleanly with the object resting in place
interaction_model.state_change: The object follows the pointer while remaining confined inside the basin walls, continuously displacing the water it moves through
interaction_model.visible_feedback: A raised mound of water is pushed ahead of the object and a hollow trails behind it, with the disturbance radiating away as the object travels; at the walls the object stops advancing rather than passing through

interaction_model.state_change: The viewpoint moves nearer to or further from the basin between fixed near and far limits
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The basin grows or shrinks in view, moving between a whole-basin overhead read and a close read from just below the waterline; motion halts at each limit

Physically believable motion, including spreading, rebounding and overlapping waves and water displaced by a moving object

adaptable_details: Exact basin proportions, depth and wall treatment
Floor pattern style, its hue and tonal treatment, and tile scale
Direction, intensity and hue of the illumination, as long as the calm well-lit read and visible light bending remain
Identity and appearance of the floating object
Ripple size, wave speed and how long decay takes
Sensitivity of orbit and zoom, and the exact near and far distance limits
Whether the experience fills the whole view or a bounded region
Presence or absence of ambient sound
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits any small self-contained scene whose point is a single continuous reactive liquid or comparably yielding surface bounded by walls, with at most one manipulable floating object and no competing foreground content or copy on top of it; the surface must be large and quiet enough that a single ripple is clearly visible, and the surrounding scheme must leave enough luminance separation for waves, floor pattern and floating object to stay distinguishable in any host palette. Adding dense overlaid text, forms or a task to complete, or making the water a decorative backdrop behind foreground content, breaks it. Replacing the free-form poke-and-settle loop with a scored goal, a guided sequence or a fixed non-interactive animation creates a different Skill, as does removing the orbitable viewpoint so the basin can only be read from one fixed angle, or removing the bounded basin so waves never rebound.

name: blocky_video_shatter_playground
description: A looping clip fills the view as a coarse mosaic, then a wave from one point snaps every tile into a solid image-carrying block that tumbles loose into an orbitable, grabbable debris field which can be swept back into the intact picture on demand.

canonical_document.name: blocky_video_shatter_playground

interaction_model.affected_object: All tiles of the picture

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: The control locks and reports the running stage during the sweep, then re-arms for another break; the intact picture is always recoverable this way

Physical and weighty, with tumbling, resting and knocking
A little glitchy in character, closer to a rough toy than a refined presentation
Calm and open-ended after the break, with no timer or goal
Repeatable and safe to play with, since the whole picture can always be recovered
completion_and_return: No terminal completion; the experience loops between intact and scattered states as often as the visitor wants
The break stage ends by settling into a stable debris field that persists until the visitor acts

locked_observable_requirements: One looping clip fills the view and is presented as a coarse blocky picture, not a smooth one
The moving image keeps playing on every piece, before, during and after the break

Loosened tiles read as solid matter with thickness that tumbles and comes to rest
A single primary control drives both break and reassembly, locks during transitions and reports the current stage
The intact picture is always recoverable and the cycle repeatable
