adaptable_details: Tile density and coarseness of the mosaic
Subject and length of the looping clip
Wave origin, speed and shape
Block thickness, scatter spread and settling styling
Wording and placement of the control and its stage readout
Viewpoint range and limits
Duration and appearance of the opening loading beat
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits any single short looping moving image presented full-bleed as the sole foreground of a view, where the point is to play with the footage itself. Substituting reading-focused content such as text blocks or a still informational image, using it as a substrate behind foreground copy, removing the physical tumbling and grabbing, or making the break irreversible would each produce a different skill.

name: slingshot_shot_at_illuminated_target
description: A visually quiet, near-empty stage holds one illuminated target and one waiting ball; dragging the ball back stretches a high-contrast elastic guide line, release flings it on a physical arc that bounces off the target's parts, makes are celebrated at once, and a fresh ball resets the view for the next attempt.

canonical_document.name: slingshot_shot_at_illuminated_target
canonical_document.description: A visually quiet, near-empty stage holds one illuminated target and one waiting ball; dragging the ball back stretches a high-contrast elastic guide line, release flings it on a physical arc that bounces off the target's parts, makes are celebrated at once, and a fresh ball resets the view for the next attempt.
canonical_document.experience_scope: A single continuous interactive region or full-view stage that begins the moment the scene appears with one waiting ball and one illuminated target, runs as an open-ended session of repeated attempts, and has no ending state or exit condition of its own.
content_and_composition: One illuminated target structure as the sole high-salience focal point in an otherwise quiet, sparse setting
Exactly one interactive projectile at a time, staged in a waiting position within reach of the pointer
A transient high-contrast guide line that emerges from the projectile only while it is being pulled, oriented opposite to the intended shot
Minimal persistent readouts kept visually quiet and peripheral: accumulated successes and elapsed session time
Deliberately empty surroundings with no instructional text, decorative clutter or competing focal objects
Layering: low-distraction ground/backdrop behind, target and projectile as the illuminated foreground, guide line drawn above the projectile, readouts as the outermost quiet layer
experience_progression: Scene settles into a clear shooting angle where target and waiting projectile are simultaneously legible
Pointer arrives on the projectile and it is marked as grabbable
Press and downward pull stretches the guide line, growing with pull distance and tilting with sideways pull
Release launches the projectile and the guide line disappears
Projectile travels on an arc and behaves physically against the target's rim, backing and net
Outcome resolves: a success is celebrated immediately, a failure simply falls away with no penalty
A new projectile appears in the waiting position and the view settles again into the clear shooting angle
Cycle repeats indefinitely while elapsed time keeps accumulating
attention_and_information_flow: At rest, luminance separation and emptiness alone communicate the objective: the illuminated target and the single waiting projectile are the only things worth looking at
On hover, attention narrows to the projectile as the one manipulable object
During the pull, the guide line becomes the most informative element, carrying force and direction before commitment
On release, attention transfers to the projectile's arc and is held on the gap between arc and target
At contact, attention concentrates on the target as the outcome resolves
Success briefly raises celebratory feedback above everything else, then attention returns to the newly staged projectile
Score and elapsed time never compete for attention and are read only when the user chooses to look

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Moving the pointer away returns it to plain idle appearance with no other consequence
interaction_model.state_change: Idle becomes grabbable
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The projectile visibly marks itself as grabbable, distinguishing it from the static scene
interaction_model.input: Pointer moves onto the waiting projectile
interaction_model.affected_object: Waiting projectile

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: The pull can be adjusted freely in any direction while held; reducing the pull shortens the line again, so aiming is fully reversible before release
interaction_model.state_change: Grabbable becomes actively aimed, with pull distance and sideways offset continuously tracked
interaction_model.visible_feedback: A high-contrast guide line stretches out of the projectile, lengthening with pull distance and angling with sideways pull, previewing the pull-back
interaction_model.input: Press on the projectile and pull downward
interaction_model.affected_object: Projectile and its guide line

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Launch is committed and cannot be recalled; the attempt always resolves on its own into success or fall-away
interaction_model.state_change: Aimed becomes launched and physically simulated
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Guide line vanishes and the projectile leaves on an arc: farther pulls throw harder and higher, sideways pull steers it to the opposite side, and it then rebounds believably off rim, backing and net
interaction_model.input: Release after a downward pull
interaction_model.affected_object: Projectile

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Cancellation is harmless and repeatable; the same projectile remains available for another attempt
interaction_model.state_change: Aimed returns to waiting
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Guide line disappears and the projectile stays exactly where it was, unlaunched
interaction_model.input: Release without any downward pull
interaction_model.affected_object: Projectile and guide line

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Celebration is brief and self-clearing, handing the stage back to the next attempt
interaction_model.state_change: Attempt resolves as a success and the accumulated count increases
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Immediate celebratory feedback at the moment of the make, so the result feels earned rather than merely tallied
interaction_model.input: Projectile passes through the target
interaction_model.affected_object: Target region and success readout

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: A new projectile appears in the waiting position so retrying is immediate and unlimited
interaction_model.state_change: Attempt resolves as a failure with no cost
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The projectile simply falls away and leaves the stage quietly, without alarm, penalty or interruption
interaction_model.input: Projectile fails to pass through the target
interaction_model.affected_object: Projectile

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: No pass or fail threshold; the session is open-ended and the user leaves whenever they wish
interaction_model.state_change: Time accumulates continuously for as long as the scene is present
interaction_model.visible_feedback: A quietly advancing elapsed-time readout that never demands attention or imposes a deadline
interaction_model.input: Autonomous session clock
interaction_model.affected_object: Elapsed time readout

experience_qualities: Instantly self-explanatory without instructional copy
Sparse, quiet and focused, with illumination used to point at what matters
Tactile and elastic, with the pull physically promising the shot
Judgement-driven: the pleasure lies in reading the arc against the target
Forgiving and low-stakes, since failure costs nothing and retries are instant
Rewarding at the moment of success rather than in a delayed summary
Calm and unhurried despite being a scored activity
completion_and_return: Each attempt completes on its own into either a celebrated success or a quiet fall-away
After every attempt the stage self-restages: a fresh projectile waits and the view returns to the clear shooting angle
The session loops indefinitely with no win, lose or end screen
Accumulated successes and elapsed time persist across attempts for as long as the scene is present
A cancelled pull returns to the pre-pull waiting state with nothing consumed
locked_observable_requirements: Low-distraction, sparse stage in which an illuminated target and one waiting projectile stand clearly apart from the surround as the only things to look at
Exactly one manipulable projectile available at a time
Hovering the projectile visibly marks it as grabbable before any press
Pressing and pulling stretches a clearly separated guide line out of the projectile that previews the pull-back
Longer pull produces a harder, higher launch, and sideways pull steers the projectile to the opposite side
After launch the projectile behaves physically against the target's rim, backing and net rather than snapping to a result
Success is celebrated immediately at the moment it happens
Failure carries no penalty and the projectile simply falls away
Releasing without a pull cancels harmlessly and leaves the projectile waiting
The view settles back into a clear shooting angle for each new projectile
Open-ended session with a quietly accumulating elapsed time and no deadline
adaptable_details: Exact target and projectile forms, provided one is an illuminated aiming goal and the other a single throwable object
Palette, luminance level and lighting treatment of the stage and its surround, in any theme, as long as the separation keeps focus on the target and projectile
Styling, thickness and coloring of the guide line, provided it stays clearly readable against the surround
Form of the celebratory feedback at the moment of success
How grabbable state is signalled on the projectile
Placement and styling of the quiet score and elapsed-time readouts
Framing distance of the clear shooting angle and how the stage restages between attempts
Whether the region fills the viewport or sits as a large framed panel
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits any single-object launch-at-a-target play region where one throwable item, one illuminated goal and an empty low-distraction surround can carry the whole idea without instructions, embedded as a page centerpiece, interactive interlude or standalone play view. It stops being this Skill if the guide-line pull preview is removed, if release resolves to an outcome without an observable physical flight and rebound, if multiple projectiles are manipulable at once, if failure carries a penalty or ends the session, or if the stage becomes visually busy enough that the target and projectile are no longer the only focal points.

name: click_to_begin_open_sky_firework_show
description: An empty sky field of uniform low luminance sits behind an attenuated invitation layer; one click anywhere clears it and a shell immediately climbs, opens into a wide bloom of light far brighter than its surround that holds, dims and drifts down as a low boom lands on the flash, then bursts keep arriving unhurried and irregular in shifting hue combinations with no ending.

canonical_document.name: click_to_begin_open_sky_firework_show
canonical_document.description: An empty sky field of uniform low luminance sits behind an attenuated invitation layer; one click anywhere clears it and a shell immediately climbs, opens into a wide bloom of light far brighter than its surround that holds, dims and drifts down as a low boom lands on the flash, then bursts keep arriving unhurried and irregular in shifting hue combinations with no ending.
canonical_document.experience_scope: Whole-view experience filling the visible frame; begins on arrival with the still low-luminance field and attenuated prompt layer, opens at the first click and continues indefinitely with no terminal state.
content_and_composition: A single near-empty sky field of uniform, unpatterned low luminance occupying the entire view as the visual substrate, held far enough below the emitted light that bursts read as self-luminous
One attenuated overlay layer above the field on arrival, its luminance pulled close to the field so it recedes, carrying a minimal invitation to click and covering the full clickable area
One rising light point per launch, small and clearly brighter than the surrounding field, travelling upward into the emptiness
One wide bloom of hue-carrying light per launch, far larger and more luminous than the rising point, followed by dimming remnants that drift downward
Multiple concurrent or overlapping bursts at differing positions and heights across the field
A low percussive sound layer bound to each bloom, felt as much as heard
The field and its framing persist unchanged for the whole session; the overlay is the only element that disappears permanently
experience_progression: Arrival: low-luminance empty field plus attenuated prompt layer, silent, visibly still so the pause reads as intentional rather than broken
Unlock: click clears the overlay and sound becomes audible from that moment
First launch: a shell rises straight away without extra delay
Bloom: the rising point opens into a wide bloom of hue-carrying light with the blast landing on the flash
Decay: the bloom holds briefly, dims, and its remnants drift downward out of prominence
Sustained loop: further launches arrive autonomously at unhurried, irregular intervals in shifting hue combinations, endlessly, with no build to a finale or conclusion
attention_and_information_flow: On arrival attention rests on the single attenuated prompt because nothing else moves
After unlock the prompt is gone and the only high-luminance element, the climbing point, pulls the eye upward through empty space
Prominence transfers abruptly from the small climbing point to the wide bloom at detonation, amplified by the simultaneous low blast
Prominence fades gradually during hold, dim and downward drift, leaving the eye free to find the next launch
Irregular timing and varying positions keep attention roaming rather than fixed, so no single burst is the focal climax

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: The same single gesture is the only thing ever asked; if audio is being held back it recovers through this gesture, so the experience can never remain stuck in a silent or unstarted state
interaction_model.state_change: Locked and silent arrival state transitions to unlocked, audible, running display
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The overlay clears to reveal the full uninterrupted low-luminance field and a shell rises immediately and detonates with its boom on the flash
interaction_model.input: Single click or tap anywhere on the attenuated opening layer
interaction_model.affected_object: Attenuated overlay layer, audio audibility and the first launch

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Requires no further input and never halts or completes; bursts continue independent of user attention
interaction_model.state_change: New launches begin at unhurried irregular intervals with shifting hue combinations while earlier blooms decay
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Continuously varied bursts appear across the field, each with a rise, wide bloom, hold, dim and downward drift accompanied by a low blast
interaction_model.input: Autonomous timing driver after unlock
interaction_model.affected_object: Stream of launches, blooms and their hue combinations

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Ongoing bursts continue uninterrupted through the reshape; no restart, no leftover empty or misaligned areas
interaction_model.state_change: Frame adapts to the new dimensions while the display keeps running
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The entire field remains framed at the same apparent scale, with bursts neither cropped, stretched nor visibly resized relative to the view
interaction_model.input: Resizing or reshaping the window
interaction_model.affected_object: Whole sky frame and the display within it

experience_qualities: Low-luminance, spacious and quiet before it starts, with the wait reading as anticipation rather than failure
Weighted and physical, the low blast felt as much as heard and timed exactly to the flash
Unhurried and irregular rather than rhythmic or looping-obvious
Celebratory and vivid against emptiness, with hue combinations that keep shifting
Endless and ambient, watchable without goal or completion
completion_and_return: No ending, finale or summary state; the display sustains itself indefinitely
The unlock is one-way for the session: the attenuated prompt layer does not return once cleared
Sound remains audible for the rest of the session after the unlocking gesture
No progress, score or state is carried; a fresh arrival returns to the still, low-luminance prompt state
locked_observable_requirements: Near-empty full-view field of uniform low luminance as the only backdrop, held well below the luminance of the emitted light
An attenuated prompt layer on arrival that accepts a click anywhere and requires no other input
Silence before the gesture and audible sound from the moment of the gesture onward
A shell rises immediately on unlock rather than after a further wait
Each launch shows an ordered rise, wide bloom, hold, dim and downward drift of remnants
The low blast lands on the flash, not before or noticeably after
Bursts continue autonomously at unhurried, irregular intervals with shifting hue combinations and no ending
Held-back audio always recovers through the same first gesture so the experience cannot stay stuck
Reshaping the window keeps the whole field framed at the same apparent scale
adaptable_details: Wording and styling of the minimal invitation on the attenuated layer
Exact hues and specific hue combinations of blooms, and the exact tone of the low-luminance field
Bloom size, spread shape and number of simultaneous bursts
Average interval length and degree of irregularity between launches
Launch positions and rise heights across the field
Timbre and loudness balance of the low blast
Presence of a small amount of quiet foreground text over the field
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits any full-view page whose foreground is an ambient celebratory or contemplative light display over an empty field kept well below the luminance of that light, with at most minimal overlaid text, and which can legitimately ask for one unlocking gesture before sound. It stops being this Skill if the display becomes user-driven so bursts are triggered or aimed by continued input, if it acquires an ending, sequence or finale, if the empty low-luminance backdrop is replaced by dense readable content the display must sit behind, or if the single anywhere-click entry is replaced by ordinary controls or a targeted button.

name: elastic_pointer_latched_thread
description: A single thin high-contrast line across an empty low-distraction field that reads as a taut thread: it snaps to a nearby pointer just before contact, bulges to follow it while its ends stay pinned, then springs back through straightness and wobbles to rest.

canonical_document.name: elastic_pointer_latched_thread
canonical_document.description: A single thin high-contrast line across an empty low-distraction field that reads as a taut thread: it snaps to a nearby pointer just before contact, bulges to follow it while its ends stay pinned, then springs back through straightness and wobbles to rest.
canonical_document.experience_scope: A self-contained region or whole quiet view whose only subject is the line and the empty, uniformly toned field around it; the experience begins the moment the pointer enters the sensitive band near the resting line and ends when the line has wobbled back to straight rest, with the frame acting as the outer boundary of pointer control.
content_and_composition: Exactly one thin line, clearly separated in tone from its surround, as the sole foreground subject, stretched horizontally across an empty field
Both line ends permanently anchored at the left and right edges of the frame, never detaching or moving
One deformable midpoint region that becomes the visible peak of the bulge and is the only part that tracks the pointer
An invisible sensitive band of space surrounding the resting line, wider than the line itself, that governs capture
The uniform empty field as the low-distraction background layer, deliberately free of labels, captions, instructions or controls
No secondary content, no hint text, no visible affordance other than the line's own behavior
experience_progression: Rest: the line sits straight and still, the view feeling quiet and almost empty
Approach: the pointer enters the sensitive band and the line is caught slightly before the pointer visually touches it
Latched tracking: the midpoint holds onto the pointer and the peak follows it exactly, bulging up or down anywhere inside the frame
Release: the pointer leaves the frame and the line is let go
Spring return: the line rushes back through its rest position, overshoots to the opposite side, and wobbles with decreasing amplitude
Rest again: motion settles into the original straightness, leaving the view open for another provocation
Interrupted return: a pointer re-entering mid-spring cancels the return instantly and resumes latched tracking from wherever the line currently is
attention_and_information_flow: The resting state gives almost no information, keeping attention low and the field calm
The pre-contact catch is the key reveal: tension and material behavior become obvious in about a second, with no label needed
During tracking, all attention concentrates at the bulge peak, which is the point of highest salience and reads as directly attached to the pointer
Anchored ends stay visually quiet and constant, framing the deformation and making the stretch legible
The overshoot and wobble on release re-tell the material story a second time and read as an open invitation to try again
Interest is carried entirely by motion and shape, never by added explanatory content

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: If the pointer never enters the band, nothing happens; if it passes through and out again, the line follows the normal release and spring-back behavior
interaction_model.state_change: Transition from calm rest to captured, with the midpoint latching onto the pointer
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The line reaches toward the pointer and begins to bend before the pointer appears to touch it, immediately reading as taut and responsive
interaction_model.input: Pointer moving through the band of space around the resting line, still short of visual contact
interaction_model.affected_object: The line's midpoint region

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Tracking persists across the whole frame with no escape or detach threshold, so the amount of stretch stays fully under the user's control and is undone simply by moving back toward rest
interaction_model.state_change: Peak position continuously matched to the pointer while both ends remain fixed
interaction_model.visible_feedback: A smooth bulge above or below the resting axis whose tip sits exactly at the pointer, stretching farther the farther the pointer travels
interaction_model.input: Continued pointer movement anywhere inside the frame while captured
interaction_model.affected_object: The bulge peak of the line

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: The return always completes on its own and always ends at the original straight rest state, regardless of how far the line was stretched
interaction_model.state_change: Release from pointer control into free elastic return
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The line springs back through its straight rest position, overshoots past it, and wobbles with shrinking swings until still
interaction_model.input: Pointer leaving the frame
interaction_model.affected_object: The whole line

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Re-capture can happen at any moment of the return; leaving again simply restarts the spring-back from the new shape
interaction_model.state_change: Return motion cancelled instantly and control handed back to the pointer
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The bulge takes up from its current position and follows the pointer again with no jump, snap-back or visible fight between spring and pointer
interaction_model.input: Pointer re-entering the frame while the line is still springing or wobbling
interaction_model.affected_object: The line's current in-motion shape

experience_qualities: Quiet and almost empty at rest, so the first reaction feels like a discovery
Physical and taut rather than drawn or diagrammatic
Instantly self-explanatory without any instruction
Playful and provocative, rewarding repeated teasing
Direct and unlagged, with the peak feeling literally attached to the pointer
Springy and slightly overshooting rather than smoothly damped to a halt
Continuous and forgiving, never jumping or stuttering when control changes hands
completion_and_return: Every stretch resolves back to the same straight resting line, so the view always returns to its calm initial state
The overshoot and wobble form the visible completion of each cycle rather than an abrupt stop
No persistent state is kept between cycles: the line remembers nothing about previous stretches
The experience loops indefinitely on demand, driven only by pointer presence and absence
locked_observable_requirements: One thin line, readably separated in tone from an essentially empty surround, is the entire subject of the view
Both ends stay anchored at the left and right frame edges at all times
Capture happens slightly before the pointer visually touches the line, not on contact
While captured, the bulge peak follows the pointer exactly, both above and below the resting axis
Tracking continues anywhere inside the frame with no detach threshold
Leaving the frame releases the line, which returns through rest with a visible overshoot and decaying wobble
Re-entry during the return cancels it instantly and resumes tracking with no jump or visible conflict
No labels, hints or instructions explain the interaction
adaptable_details: Line color and thickness, and the color and lightness of the surrounding field, in either direction of contrast
Orientation of the anchored span and its position within the view
Width of the sensitive capture band
Springiness, number of wobbles and how long the settle takes
Bulge profile sharpness, from a soft swell to a narrow peak
Overall size of the region and how much empty space surrounds the line
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits sparse views or regions where a single simple linear element can be the whole subject and surrounding space stays empty enough for its deformation to read, including intro views, playful standalone pages and interactive dividers between content sections. It stops being this Skill if the line gains labels or becomes a data or navigation element, if the ends stop being anchored so the shape drifts freely, if capture waits for literal contact or requires a click, if the return snaps back without overshoot and wobble, if line and surround lose enough separation for the deformation to stop reading, or if the effect is multiplied into a field of many lines or pushed behind foreground content as decoration.

name: flooded_field_flatten_and_regrow
description: A flooded field filled with thousands of slender swaying stalks standing in a still reflective plane that reads clearly apart from them; the pointer presses a widening swathe flat as it sweeps, a click sends a ring racing outward cutting everything it crosses, and the crop always creeps back to calm fullness while the view orbits above the water.

canonical_document.name: flooded_field_flatten_and_regrow
canonical_document.description: A flooded field filled with thousands of slender swaying stalks standing in a still reflective plane that reads clearly apart from them; the pointer presses a widening swathe flat as it sweeps, a click sends a ring racing outward cutting everything it crosses, and the crop always creeps back to calm fullness while the view orbits above the water.
canonical_document.experience_scope: Whole-view experience filling the viewport from arrival. It begins already alive and settled, has no ending or exit state, and continues indefinitely; the only bounded episodes are disturbance-and-recovery cycles inside it.
content_and_composition: One continuous flat water surface acting as the base plane of the entire view, read as still and reflective rather than as textured ground, and held clearly distinct in tone from the stalk mass standing in it
A single dense mass of thousands of thin vertical stalks standing in the water, numerous enough to read as a soft haze rather than as countable individual objects
Low earthen bunds subdividing the water plane into adjoining plots, giving the field visible internal structure and edges
Per-plot variation: some plots visibly denser or tonally distinct from neighbours, so the field is not uniform
A single steady ambient light condition as the persistent state of the whole scene, low enough in stimulation that the field mass rather than the surround holds attention
A single viewpoint positioned above the water surface, looking across the field toward its far extent
No persistent interface panels, labels, counters, or instructional overlays
experience_progression: Resting state: the whole field stands at full density and drifts slowly in a continuous breeze
Disturbance: stalks the pointer passes over, or that an expanding ring crosses, drop flat immediately
Recovery begins: once undisturbed, flattened stalks start rising slowly, barely moving at first
Recovery accelerates: past roughly halfway upright the stalks spring back noticeably faster
Return to resting state: the field reaches full density again and rejoins the ambient drift, ready to be disturbed again with no accumulated damage
attention_and_information_flow: On arrival attention rests on the whole field as a single hazy mass, with plot boundaries and density differences giving the eye structure to read
During sweeping, attention locks to the negative trail carved behind the pointer; the trail's width itself communicates pointer speed
A click pulls attention outward from a single point as the ring travels toward the field's far edges, momentarily revealing the bare water surface behind it
During regrowth attention diffuses back from the cleared area to the whole field as the difference between stripped and intact regions fades
Viewpoint changes reframe which plots and which depth of the haze dominate, revealing that the field extends beyond any single framing

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Fully reversible by doing nothing: pausing shrinks the affected width and the flattened stalks rise again, slowly at first then springing back faster once past half upright. Continuous sweeping simply keeps carving; there is no failure state or limit.
interaction_model.state_change: Stalks under and near the path go from upright to pressed flat with no delay; the affected width grows with pointer travel speed
interaction_model.visible_feedback: A cleared swathe follows the pointer immediately, narrow for slow movement and noticeably wider for fast movement, exposing the bare water plane that reads clearly apart from the standing crop
interaction_model.input: Pointer swept across the field
interaction_model.affected_object: Stalks along the pointer's path

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Self-resolving: after the ring passes, the entire field grows back to full density. Further clicks are always allowed, including during a ring or during regrowth, and nothing about the effect is permanent.
interaction_model.state_change: A ring front travels outward from the click point, cutting each stalk down at the moment it is crossed
interaction_model.visible_feedback: A visible wave of flattening races away from the click across the field, leaving stripped ground in its wake, until the whole field is down
interaction_model.input: Click on a point in the field
interaction_model.affected_object: Every stalk crossed by an outward-expanding ring centred on that point

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Can be grabbed again mid-glide to redirect; rotation around the field is unrestricted and always leaves the field in view
interaction_model.state_change: The viewpoint swings around the field, changing which side of the paddy is faced
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The scene rotates with the drag and keeps gliding briefly after release before easing to a stop
interaction_model.input: Drag
interaction_model.affected_object: Viewpoint over the field

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Clamped at both limits so the view stops rather than breaking the horizon or going overhead; reversible at any time by zooming back out
interaction_model.state_change: The viewpoint pulls closer to or further from the field
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Closer views bring individual stalks and water surface detail forward; the view never drops to or below the water surface and never tips to look straight down
interaction_model.input: Zoom
interaction_model.affected_object: Viewpoint distance and height over the field

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Always running, never interrupted by interaction; recovered stalks rejoin the drift as they rise
interaction_model.state_change: Continuous slow drifting sway across the field
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The stalk mass shimmers and leans in slow travelling motion, making the field read as alive even when untouched
interaction_model.input: Autonomous ambient breeze
interaction_model.affected_object: All upright stalks

experience_qualities: Calm, hushed stillness as the baseline mood
Dense and hazy, with mass reading before detail
Yielding and tactile — the field visibly gives way under the pointer
Immediately satisfying and self-explanatory, requiring no prompt to understand
Forgiving and endless: nothing can be spoiled or used up
Weighted, unhurried camera movement rather than snappy repositioning
completion_and_return: No completion, score, or terminal state; the experience runs indefinitely
Every disturbance resolves on its own back to full, calm density
Recovery is asymmetric in time: instant to flatten, gradual to return, accelerating in the second half
The viewpoint keeps whatever orientation and distance the visitor left it at; it does not snap back to a default
locked_observable_requirements: Still reflective water plane held clearly distinct in tone from a dense haze of thousands of slender upright stalks standing in it
Low bunds dividing the water into adjoining plots, with visible density or tonal variation between plots
Continuous slow ambient drift of the standing stalks
Pointer sweeping flattens stalks immediately, with swathe width increasing with pointer speed
Pausing causes the flattened swathe to shrink and stalks to rise, slow at first and faster after roughly half recovered
Click produces an outward-travelling ring that cuts every stalk it crosses, followed by full field regrowth
Drag orbits the viewpoint with inertial glide that eases out after release
Zoom stays above the water surface and never reaches an overhead view
The field always returns to full density; damage never accumulates or persists
adaptable_details: Exact plant type and stalk silhouette, height, and thickness
Number and shape of plots and the bund layout
Precise palette, lighting key, and haze or sky treatment, provided the water plane stays legibly separate from the stalk mass
Stalk count and apparent field extent
Ring travel speed, sweep-width scaling factor, and recovery duration
Which concrete inputs map to sweep, clear, orbit, and zoom on different devices
Presence of secondary ambience such as reflections or faint water motion
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Transfers to any scene built from a dense mass of many similar slender elements standing on a flat plane, where the point is disturbing that mass and watching it restore itself; the crop identity matters only as the reason the mass reads as soft, uniform, and yielding. It becomes a different skill if disturbance becomes permanent, scored, or goal-driven, if the elements become sparse individually-identifiable objects, if the viewpoint becomes free-flying, first-person walking, or top-down, or if foreground reading content is placed over it so the pointer can no longer be spent freely on the field.

name: revolving_letter_drum_word
description: One huge word whose letters ride an unseen rotating cylinder: each letter tips up into sight, squares up to the reader for a beat, then rolls away as the next takes over, forever and without any input.

canonical_document.name: revolving_letter_drum_word
canonical_document.description: One huge word whose letters ride an unseen rotating cylinder: each letter tips up into sight, squares up to the reader for a beat, then rolls away as the next takes over, forever and without any input.
canonical_document.experience_scope: Whole-view experience owning the entire screen. It is already running in its finished form at the first moment anything is visible and has no end state, no entry animation from flat text and no exit; the view is the effect.
content_and_composition: Exactly one short word is the sole foreground content; no headings, captions, controls or secondary copy compete with it.
The word's letters are the individual moving units, kept in their reading order and distributed around the circumference of an implied cylinder whose axis runs across the view.
The word reads as a single line spanning the full width of the screen at very large scale, vertically centered in an otherwise empty field.

Only the letter currently facing the reader is fully square-on and legible; neighboring letters are foreshortened as they climb toward or fall away from the front face, implying depth without any visible cylinder, frame or shadowed enclosure.
The surrounding field is a plain uninterrupted low-distraction surround whose only role is to isolate the word at high contrast.
experience_progression: Continuous, evenly paced rotation in one consistent direction, with no beginning or end for the viewer to wait for.
Per-letter cycle repeating around the word: the letter tips up from below the sightline into view.
It settles square to the reader and holds legible for a short measured beat.
It rolls away out of sight as the following letter simultaneously tips up to take its place, handing off prominence without a gap.
After the last letter the first returns seamlessly, so the loop point is indistinguishable from any other handoff.
attention_and_information_flow: Prominence moves letter by letter at a fixed cadence; the front-facing letter is the single focal point at any instant.
The word is spelled out over time rather than grasped at a glance, so the reader assembles it across successive beats.
Foreshortened neighbors give a peripheral sense of what is arriving and what just left, keeping the motion readable as one rotating body rather than unrelated letters.
No information is ever added or removed by the viewer; the only changing information is which letter is currently presented.

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: The viewer cannot start, pause, speed, reverse or step the motion; there is nothing to click, drag or scroll. The cycle never blanks, stutters or visibly restarts.
interaction_model.state_change: Continuous advance of the rotation, cycling which letter occupies the front-facing position
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Letters tipping up, dwelling square-on, and rolling away in an even mechanical rhythm
interaction_model.input: Autonomous time-based rotation that starts by itself as soon as the letters are ready to be shown in final form
interaction_model.affected_object: The full set of letters as one rigid revolving body

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: If the effect cannot be presented in finished form yet, nothing partial is shown in its place; the reveal waits until the running form is what appears.
interaction_model.state_change: The experience is presented already mid-rotation in its finished styled form
interaction_model.visible_feedback: No glimpse of plain flat unstyled text and no separate build-in phase before the motion
interaction_model.input: First reveal of the view
interaction_model.affected_object: The word and its letters

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: No restart is ever triggered by attention or re-entry; the loop is treated as ongoing rather than replayed.
interaction_model.state_change: The rhythm is picked up wherever it currently stands rather than reset
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The same steady cadence, with no jump back to a first letter and no re-entry animation
interaction_model.input: Viewer arriving late, glancing away, or returning to the view
interaction_model.affected_object: Loop phase of the rotation

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Motion is never interrupted, snapped or restarted by the resize; wrapping to a second line or overflowing the view is not allowed.
interaction_model.state_change: The word rescales so it still reads as one screen-spanning line
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The word grows or shrinks to fit the new width while continuing to turn
interaction_model.input: Window or viewport resize
interaction_model.affected_object: Scale and typographic sizing of the word

experience_qualities: Monumental and poster-like in scale
Mechanical and metronomic, with an unwavering cadence
Hypnotic and calming through repetition without progress
Dimensional yet minimal, implying a solid rotating body from letters alone
Effortless for the viewer: watching is the only act required
completion_and_return: Never completes; the loop is endless and self-sustaining for as long as the view is present.
No reset, replay or finished state exists, and no completion cue is shown.
Loop phase persists across inattention and across resizing, so returning viewers rejoin the same continuous rhythm.
locked_observable_requirements: A single short word occupies the entire view as one line at very large scale.
The letters read unmistakably as one word wrapped around an unseen cylinder turning in a single consistent direction.
Each letter tips up into view, holds square to the reader for a measured beat, then rolls away as the next takes over, with no gap in the handoff.
Only the front-facing letter is fully legible while its neighbors are foreshortened by the implied rotation.
The cadence is even and mechanical, never accelerating, hesitating or drifting.
The effect is visible only in its finished running form; no flat unstyled text is ever glimpsed first.
The loop has no perceivable beginning or end and never blanks or visibly restarts.
No input is required or offered; the experience runs unattended.
Resizing rescales the word to remain one screen-spanning line without interrupting or restarting the motion.
adaptable_details: Which word is shown and how many letters it has
Typeface, weight, and the chosen letter and surround tones in either direction, provided the letter keeps strong readable separation from the field
Rotation speed and length of the square-on dwell beat
Rotation direction and the apparent radius or depth of the implied cylinder
Whether depth is suggested by shading, perspective or scale alone
Letter spacing and exact vertical placement within the view
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits any context where one very short word is the entire message of a full view, such as an opening screen, a between-sections statement panel or a sparse teaser view, and where the reader is expected to watch rather than act. It stops being this Skill if the payload grows into sentences or multi-line copy, if the rotation becomes driven by pointer, scroll or click instead of running on its own, if it gains start/stop or navigation controls, if the loop is given a visible beginning and ending, or if it is demoted behind readable foreground content as a backdrop, since the effect depends on the word owning the view and each letter being legible in turn.

name: luminous_ribbon_field_with_trailing_pointer_bloom
description: A quiet low-distraction expanse crossed by a few luminous ribbons that slowly breathe and drift in hue away from one another, dusted with faint twinkling specks and slow rings spreading from the center, where the ribbons bend toward the pointer and a soft pulsing halo blooms beneath it with a lazy delay.

canonical_document.name: luminous_ribbon_field_with_trailing_pointer_bloom
canonical_document.description: A quiet low-distraction expanse crossed by a few luminous ribbons that slowly breathe and drift in hue away from one another, dusted with faint twinkling specks and slow rings spreading from the center, where the ribbons bend toward the pointer and a soft pulsing halo blooms beneath it with a lazy delay.
canonical_document.experience_scope: Whole-view experience occupying the entire visible area as the page's primary content; it is already running at arrival and never begins or ends, so there is no entry sequence and no exit state. Can also be scoped to a single large region that behaves identically inside its own bounds.
content_and_composition: Base layer: a quiet low-distraction expanse filling the view, held far enough from the ribbons in luminance that it reads as depth rather than a flat panel

Primary layer: a small countable number of luminous ribbons crossing the expanse, each an elongated flowing band separated from the surround by luminance and hue, with soft glow rather than hard edges
Accent layer: faint twinkling specks scattered across the field at low density, subordinate in salience to the ribbons
Accent layer: slow rings expanding outward from the middle of the view, repeatedly and gently, sitting behind or among the ribbons
Transient layer: a single soft pulsing halo positioned at the pointer's trailing location, present only while a pointer is or has recently been over the view
No labels, captions, legends, instruction text, buttons or affordance hints anywhere in the experience
Optional sparse foreground text or mark may sit above the scene without competing with the ribbons
attention_and_information_flow: Ribbons hold primary prominence at all times through their luminance separation from the surround, their scale and their hue movement; specks and rings stay peripheral
Ribbon hues drift apart from one another over time, so the eye keeps re-reading the separating bands as the dominant subject
The whole field quietly breathes in luminance or scale, producing gentle rhythmic pull without any single focal event
When a pointer is present, local prominence shifts to the halo and the nearest ribbon deformation, making the visitor's own position the momentary focus
Prominence returns to the overall field once the pointer stops moving, with no residual highlight demanding attention
No information is revealed or unlocked; the only 'message' is that the scene notices a viewer, communicated purely visually

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Cannot be started, paused, completed or dismissed; it simply continues from wherever it is whenever the view is seen
interaction_model.state_change: Ongoing drift of ribbon shape and hue separation, twinkling of specks, repeated outward growth of rings, slow global breathing
interaction_model.visible_feedback: A scene that is visibly alive on arrival and never settles into stillness
interaction_model.input: Continuous autonomous animation with no user input
interaction_model.affected_object: Ribbons, specks, expanding rings and overall field luminance

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Reaction trails the pointer with a lazy delay rather than snapping; direction can be reversed mid-motion without jolt or discontinuity; leaving and re-entering the view simply resumes from the current field state
interaction_model.state_change: Ribbons bend and stretch toward the pointer position with strongest deflection immediately around it and falling off with distance; halo relocates toward that position
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Bands visibly lean and elongate toward the cursor while a soft pulsing halo blooms at the spot
interaction_model.input: Pointer moved anywhere over the view (no specific hit targets)
interaction_model.affected_object: Ribbons nearest the pointer and the halo layer

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: No jolt at direction changes; the lag guarantees continuity regardless of input speed
interaction_model.state_change: Response lags behind the input and smooths the path instead of tracking it exactly
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Quick movement reads as smooth drifting rather than jittering or snapping
interaction_model.input: Rapid pointer flick across the view
interaction_model.affected_object: Ribbon deformation and halo position

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Lifting the finger does not clear or reset anything; the field keeps flowing from the last position
interaction_model.state_change: Identical deformation and halo behavior driven by the touch position
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The same bending, stretching and blooming halo follows the finger
interaction_model.input: Finger drag on a touch surface
interaction_model.affected_object: Same ribbons and halo as pointer input

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Nothing to reset or dismiss; no completion state is ever reached
interaction_model.state_change: Deformation eases toward the resting influence point while ambient motion continues undiminished
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The scene keeps flowing on from its last position with no snap-back and no lingering marker
interaction_model.input: Movement stops while pointer remains over the view
interaction_model.affected_object: Whole field

experience_qualities: Dreamy and calming rather than energetic or attention-demanding
Deep and spacious, with luminous elements floating in an unadorned empty surround
Endless and loopless, with no beginning, milestone or conclusion
Lazily responsive: clearly aware of the viewer but never eager or twitchy
Self-explanatory without instruction; responsiveness is discovered by moving
Continuous and jolt-free under any input speed or direction change
completion_and_return: Never completes; there is no end state, success state or dismissal
Not a discrete loop with a visible seam; motion is perpetual and seamless
No reset control and no cleared state after interaction; the field continues from wherever it was
Returning after glancing away or leaving presents the same endless mood rather than a restart
Equally satisfying for a several-second glance or a long lingering session
locked_observable_requirements: Whole view is already in motion at arrival with no intro, entry animation or trigger
A low-distraction expanse as the base, clearly separated in luminance from the luminous ribbons, which stay the visually dominant elements
A few ribbons, not a dense mass, so individual bands remain readable
Ribbon hues drift apart from one another over time and the overall field breathes slowly
Faint twinkling specks and slow rings expanding from the middle are both present and remain subordinate to the ribbons
Pointer position anywhere over the view deforms ribbons toward it, strongest nearby and weaker with distance
A soft pulsing halo blooms at the pointer's trailing position
Response trails the pointer with a lazy delay; never snaps, never jolts on reversal
Touch drag produces the same behavior as pointer movement
Ambient motion continues unchanged when input stops; nothing resets or must be dismissed
No labels, hints, instructions or visible controls of any kind
adaptable_details: Exact ribbon count, thickness, curvature and crossing arrangement
Which hues the ribbons and surround take, whether the surround sits dark or light, and how far the hues drift apart
Speck density, twinkle rhythm and brightness
Ring spacing, expansion rate and fade profile
Halo size, pulse rate and softness
Amount of lag and the falloff distance of pointer influence
Breathing period and amplitude
Whether an optional sparse headline or mark sits above the scene
Whether it fills the browser view or a single large bounded region
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits any page where atmosphere is the primary content and foreground copy is sparse or absent: splash and landing views, title areas, section dividers, idle or ambient screens. It tolerates a light overlay of short text or a mark. It stops being this Skill if the ribbons become data-bearing or represent specific values, if the pointer reaction becomes discrete selection, hit-testing or navigation, if labels, instructions or controls are added, if the motion gains a start/finish or a scripted narrative sequence, or if the field becomes dense and high-contrast enough that it must recede behind substantial readable content instead of being the subject.

name: cube_procession_tracing_curves
description: A dense line of tiny cubes travels as one slender procession along an invisible geometric curve, thickest at its middle and thinning to nothing at both ends, so the shape being drawn becomes readable within seconds and then repeats forever.

canonical_document.name: cube_procession_tracing_curves
canonical_document.description: A dense line of tiny cubes travels as one slender procession along an invisible geometric curve, thickest at its middle and thinning to nothing at both ends, so the shape being drawn becomes readable within seconds and then repeats forever.
canonical_document.experience_scope: A whole-view, frame-filling piece that begins as soon as the view appears and never concludes; it occupies its own region or full screen, with a small control overlay as its only foreground addition.
content_and_composition: One primary moving subject: a single continuous procession made of many small identical cube forms following one another head to tail
Procession density varies along its own length: thickest and most solid at the middle, tapering and dissolving at the leading and trailing ends
One invisible-by-default guide path: the geometric curve the procession rides, occupying the same space as the motion
Optional visible form of that path: a low-salience dashed outline of the bare curve, sitting behind or beneath the cubes without competing with them
One persistent, compact control overlay layered above the scene: a short list of selectable curve arrangements plus a single on/off switch
A calm, uncluttered field around the procession, clearly separated from it in tone so the traced shape reads against empty space
A single fixed vantage point on the scene, never repositioned or reframed
experience_progression: The view opens with the procession already entering, reading at first as a still printed composition that turns out to be moving
Within seconds the procession has advanced far enough that the overall traced shape becomes recognizable
The procession continues without pause along the full length of the curve
The pass eases out at the end and begins again from the start, with no visible seam, ending or waiting state
Choosing a different arrangement restarts the cycle at the beginning of the newly chosen curve
attention_and_information_flow: Attention rests entirely on the moving procession because the vantage never shifts and nothing else in the frame moves
Information about the underlying shape accumulates from the swept trail rather than being shown all at once
The thick middle of the procession acts as the visual anchor the eye follows; the tapered ends recede and keep the form from reading as a hard-edged object
The control overlay stays quiet and secondary, legible against its own backing but never drawing attention away from the motion
Revealing the dashed guide shifts a small amount of attention to the path itself, making the relationship between cubes and curve explicit; hiding it returns full attention to the motion

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Runs indefinitely with no completion state; the loop is never left idle or blank between passes
interaction_model.state_change: The procession advances along the curve and, on reaching the end, eases out and restarts from the beginning
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Uninterrupted gliding motion that traces and retraces the shape, with a soft easing at the end of each pass instead of a stop
interaction_model.input: Autonomous continuous playback with no user input
interaction_model.affected_object: The cube procession and its position along the curve

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Selection can be changed at any moment, including mid-pass, without stalling, blanking or breaking the loop; any earlier choice can be reselected
interaction_model.state_change: The active curve is replaced and the flow restarts at the start of the newly chosen curve, adopting a pace suited to that shape
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The procession begins tracing a visibly different shape from its beginning; intricate figures unfold slowly while simple closed shapes sweep past quickly
interaction_model.input: Selecting one arrangement from the short overlaid list of curves
interaction_model.affected_object: The traced curve, and therefore the path and pacing of the procession

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Turning the switch off removes the dashed line and restores the clean view; the procession keeps moving throughout, unaffected by either change
interaction_model.state_change: The path changes from invisible to visibly drawn as a low-contrast dashed line
interaction_model.visible_feedback: A quiet dashed outline of the whole curve appears, held below the salience of the cubes, which are visibly riding along it
interaction_model.input: Toggling the guide switch on
interaction_model.affected_object: The bare curve underlying the motion

experience_qualities: Calm and unhurried, closer to a moving poster than an animation with events
Meditative and endless, with no beginning to catch or ending to wait for
Precise and geometric, built from many small identical forms rather than organic shapes
Legible: the traced shape becomes obvious quickly without explanation
Sparse and composed, with generous empty space around the motion
Responsive but never abrupt; changes feel like a fresh pass rather than an interruption
completion_and_return: Never completes; each pass eases out and immediately begins again as a seamless loop
The current arrangement and guide-visibility choice persist across loops until changed
Changing an arrangement resets the traced path to its starting point rather than resuming mid-shape
Leaving and returning to the view resumes a running loop in the same calm state
locked_observable_requirements: Motion is one single slender procession of many small identical cube forms, not a scattered cloud or a solid ribbon
The procession is visibly thickest at its middle and tapers away at both ends
The procession follows a definite geometric curve and traces it continuously without pause
The vantage point never shifts, rotates or zooms during the experience
Each pass eases out and restarts with no visible ending, seam or idle gap
The traced shape becomes readable within a few seconds of the view opening, the cubes carrying enough separation from the surround to be read at their smallest
A short overlaid list allows switching between several distinct curve arrangements, restarting the flow at the start of the new curve
Pace is matched to shape complexity: intricate figures advance slowly, simple ones sweep quickly
A single switch reveals the bare curve as a dashed guide the cubes ride along, kept below their salience, and hides it again for a clean view
Any choice can be changed at any moment without stalling or breaking the loop
adaptable_details: The specific set and number of curve arrangements offered
The count and relative size of the cube forms in the procession

The palette, luminance direction and surround treatment, in any hues and either lighter-on-darker or darker-on-lighter, as long as the cubes stay clearly separated from a low-distraction surround and the composition stays calm and sparse
How dense the thickest part of the procession is relative to its tapered ends
The absolute duration of a pass, provided slower shapes remain slower than simple ones
Dash spacing and how far the revealed guide sits below the cubes in salience
Placement, layout and styling of the overlay list and switch
The framing proportions of the region the piece occupies
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits any context wanting a self-contained, non-narrative decorative visual where the artwork itself is the content and any accompanying copy is brief: hero areas, portfolio centerpieces, idle or interlude views, section breaks. It adopts the host's palette and luminance direction, needing only enough separation between procession and surround for the traced shape to read. It does not fit places where the visual must sit behind dense reading content, or where the motion must encode real data, respond to scrolling or pointer position, or lead to an outcome. Replacing the single tapered procession with multiple simultaneous trails, letting the vantage point move or be dragged, giving the piece a definite ending, or binding the motion to external data would each create a different Skill.

name: endless_symmetrical_fractal_bloom

canonical_document.name: endless_symmetrical_fractal_bloom
canonical_document.description: A single edge-to-edge fractal pattern floating in a quiet, low-distraction ground that keeps unfolding in slow, mirrored waves of shifting hue pulling the eye into a luminous centre, running by itself with no beginning or end.
canonical_document.experience_scope: Whole-view experience: it fills the entire viewport from the moment the view appears and continues for as long as the view is open. There is no entry sequence, no framing chrome and no exit state; the artwork is the view rather than a region inside one.
content_and_composition: Exactly one continuous visual field occupying the full viewport, with no panels, borders, captions, labels, controls or instructional text of any kind
A uniform, undetailed ground held far enough away in luminance from the pattern that it reads as open depth rather than a flat backdrop, with the pattern appearing to float within it
One dominant luminous focal core positioned as the visual centre of the composition, brighter and denser than everything around it
Repeating self-similar pattern detail arranged in symmetrical relationships around that core, so the composition reads as balanced from every direction
Colour is carried by the pattern itself as shifting bands or waves; there is no separate colour layer, overlay or vignette element
The pattern extends past every edge of the frame so no blank margin, letterbox band or background gap is ever visible
Persistent elements across the whole experience: the recessive ground field, the central luminosity and the ongoing motion
experience_progression: No staged progression and no completion: the artwork is already fully present at first paint
Continuous unfolding advance — pattern detail and colour keep moving outward and inward in slow waves without arriving at a resolved final image
Hue shifts cycle gradually and indefinitely so that any moment looks like a plausible middle of the piece, never a start or finish
attention_and_information_flow: Attention is claimed immediately and entirely by the image because nothing else is on screen to read or decide about
Radial symmetry plus the luminance gradient continuously funnels the eye inward toward the luminous centre
Slow wave motion supplies gentle variation that renews interest without pulling attention to a new location or demanding tracking

canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits any single-subject contemplative view where one luminous form built from many fine particles is the entire content, staged in emptiness, with a constricted middle that justifies a natural brightest focal point and an outward-symmetric pulse. It transfers to other flowing-particle sculptures, vortices, columns or hourglass-like vessels. It stops fitting when the view must carry readable foreground content, headings or controls over it, when several subjects share the stage, when the flow must represent live data or measure real elapsed time, when the form must actually empty and require refilling, or when the viewpoint is fixed or scripted instead of freely orbitable — each of those becomes a different Skill.

name: magnetic_light_strand_field
description: Glowing strands weaving through a quiet depth field, held far enough from the strand luminance that they read as emitting light, magnetically pulled after the pointer, stretching into long streaks on quick flicks and coiling when it holds still, with a click instantly shifting the whole scene into a different color set.

Instantly understandable without instructions
Luminous depth carried by a wide luminance gap between strands and their surround
Playful and endlessly watchable, with no goal or payoff

locked_observable_requirements: A low-distraction ground with enough luminance separation that strands read as emitting light at multiple depths

name: taut_elastic_loop_around_drifting_pegs
description: An elastic band stretched around a handful of pegs on flat unbroken ground, band and pegs sharing one figure value set at strong luminance contrast against that ground, endlessly reshaping as the pegs drift so you can always tell at a glance which pegs it grips and which have slipped inside its outline.

canonical_document.description: An elastic band stretched around a handful of pegs on flat unbroken ground, band and pegs sharing one figure value set at strong luminance contrast against that ground, endlessly reshaping as the pegs drift so you can always tell at a glance which pegs it grips and which have slipped inside its outline.
canonical_document.experience_scope: Whole-view experience occupying the entire viewport with no surrounding chrome, headings or instructions. It begins already in motion at the moment the view appears and has no end point; the only external event it acknowledges is a change in frame size.
content_and_composition: Single flat uniform ground plane filling the view, unbroken by texture, gradient or imagery
One continuous closed band outline in the single figure value as the primary figure, drawn as a single elastic loop rather than segmented shapes
A small set of peg markers (a handful, low enough to be counted at a glance) sharing the band's figure value as the secondary figure

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Cannot be paused, advanced, stepped, restarted or knocked out of step; the loop self-sustains and never requires recovery
interaction_model.state_change: Peg positions advance; the band re-wraps to the outermost pegs, so pegs alternate between gripped and enclosed-slack
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The band outline stretches, tightens, bends around newly gripped pegs and releases pegs that fall inside, reading as elastic material under tension
interaction_model.input: Autonomous continuous time, running from first paint with no start trigger
interaction_model.affected_object: Drifting pegs and the elastic band outline

interaction_model.input: A drifting peg reaching the frame boundary

interaction_model.input: Window or container resize
interaction_model.affected_object: Whole composition: ground, pinned end pegs, drifting pegs, band outline

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Deliberate absence of controls; there is nothing to undo, and no input can put the scene into a bad state
interaction_model.state_change: No state change of any kind
interaction_model.visible_feedback: No cursor change, highlight, focus ring or response; the scene continues exactly as before
interaction_model.input: Pointer movement, clicks, hovers, scrolls, keys or taps
interaction_model.affected_object: Nothing

experience_qualities: Calm and endless, with no urgency, climax or call to attend
Physically convincing: the band reads as genuinely elastic and under tension rather than as a drawn shape
Immediately legible with zero onboarding, reading or setup
Self-running and unattended; feels alive without asking anything of the viewer
Minimal and high-contrast, figures held at strong luminance separation from a flat unbroken ground
Robust to reframing, never appearing to reload or start over
completion_and_return: No completion, resolution, score or terminal state
Endless loop with no visible seam, restart flash or return to a home state
Motion phase persists across frame changes; the experience is only ever continuing
locked_observable_requirements: One continuous closed elastic band whose stretched spans and bends make tension visible at a glance
Instantly readable distinction between pegs the band grips and pegs enclosed inside the outline without contact
Already in motion the moment the view appears, with nothing to set up, read or trigger

canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits whole-view or large-panel placements meant to be watched passively — atmospheric hero and landing backdrops, idle and standby screens, and single-idea demo pages — and tolerates only sparse overlaid foreground content, since its flat unbroken ground and low element count leave room but its constant motion competes with dense text. Giving the viewer control over the pegs (drag, click, hover attraction), adding a goal, score or ending, letting the band break or be released, or filling the frame with many pegs so contact can no longer be judged at a glance each produce a different skill.
