description: A hushed, dimly lit and nearly motionless view waits behind a start prompt; one press swells rain and its sound up from silence over a few seconds while the ground deepens in tone into glossy shimmering wetness, then holds an endless calm downpour punctuated by distant flares seen mostly in the reflections, all while the view slowly circles the wet patch and can be swung or zoomed by hand.

canonical_document.name: started_rain_scene_with_orbiting_view
canonical_document.description: A hushed, dimly lit and nearly motionless view waits behind a start prompt; one press swells rain and its sound up from silence over a few seconds while the ground deepens in tone into glossy shimmering wetness, then holds an endless calm downpour punctuated by distant flares seen mostly in the reflections, all while the view slowly circles the wet patch and can be swung or zoomed by hand.
canonical_document.experience_scope: Begins at page arrival in a dormant, dimly lit and quiet state with a visible start prompt and continues indefinitely after the press; occupies the full view as a single continuous scene with no exit, section boundary or end state.
content_and_composition: One environmental scene as the sole foreground subject, framed on a single ground-level wet patch that acts as the fixed center of attention
A ground plane that is the primary visual material: its tone deepens, it gains gloss and it carries shimmer and reflected light
Falling rain as continuous volumetric motion filling the space above the ground
An intermittent distant light event that is not shown directly but read through brightening in the reflective ground
A synchronized ambient sound layer treated as an equal part of the scene, not a decorative extra
One transient start prompt overlaid on the dormant scene, present only before activation
Overall low-luminance, restrained surround with a compressed tonal range so wetness, shimmer and flare read as the clearly brightest elements, with the hue family left open
experience_progression: Dormant stage: low ambient light, almost no motion, silence, and a single prompt making clear that nothing starts until the visitor chooses and that sound is part of the experience

Build stage: on activation the prompt disappears and rain intensity plus sound rise together from nothing over several seconds while the ground progressively deepens in tone, turns glossy and starts to shimmer, and the view begins its slow circling
Steady stage: an endless calm downpour with continuous orbiting, interrupted only by occasional distant flares felt mainly as brightening in the reflections
No return to the dormant stage; the steady stage continues for as long as the view is open
attention_and_information_flow: Before activation, attention is deliberately narrowed to the single prompt because the scene withholds motion and sound
During the build, attention is pulled downward from the falling rain to the ground as the ground becomes the most reflective and visually active surface
In the steady stage, prominence stays on the wet ground while the slow orbit continuously reveals new angles, silhouettes and reflection shapes of the same subject
Distant flares briefly redistribute prominence to reflected highlights, then attention relaxes back into the constant rain
Hand control momentarily shifts attention to the visitor's own framing choice, then returns to the scene when the gesture ends

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: One-way activation with no re-arm; the swell is continuous rather than instant so the change never snaps on
interaction_model.state_change: Dormant silent state transitions once into the building state
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Prompt disappears, rain and sound fade up from nothing over roughly five seconds, the ground deepens in tone and becomes glossy and shimmering, and the view starts circling
interaction_model.input: Single press on the start prompt
interaction_model.affected_object: Whole scene: prompt, rain, sound, ground treatment and view motion

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Runs indefinitely unless overridden by a held gesture
interaction_model.state_change: Continuous slow circular travel around the fixed subject
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Gradual angle change revealing the same patch from new directions with shifting reflections
interaction_model.input: Autonomous drift after activation
interaction_model.affected_object: Viewpoint around the wet patch

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Drift pauses only while the gesture is held and resumes on release; framing stays locked on the subject so no gesture can lose or overshoot it
interaction_model.state_change: Automatic drift pauses and the viewpoint follows the gesture freely
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The view swings responsively with the hand while remaining aimed at the same patch
interaction_model.input: Drag or swipe
interaction_model.affected_object: Viewpoint orientation

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Freely reversible in both directions and bounded so the subject stays framed
interaction_model.state_change: Viewpoint moves nearer or further from the subject
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The wet patch grows or recedes, changing how much of the quiet surround and falling rain is visible
interaction_model.input: Scroll or pinch
interaction_model.affected_object: Viewing distance

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Self-resolving; unaffected by and non-blocking to any viewer gesture
interaction_model.state_change: Occasional distant flare rises and falls
interaction_model.visible_feedback: A brief brightening read mostly through reflections rather than a directly visible source
interaction_model.input: Elapsed time in the steady stage
interaction_model.affected_object: Reflective ground and ambient light

experience_qualities: Calm, slow and unhurried
Hushed and intimate against a low-luminance surround, with wetness and reflection as the main visual interest
Deliberately gated so the visitor consents to sound and motion before anything happens
Gradual rather than abrupt at every transition
Endless and undemanding, with nothing to complete
Continuously steerable without ever feeling lost, because the subject is always held in frame
completion_and_return: No completion state; the rain loops indefinitely once established
Automatic orbit self-resumes after every held gesture rather than requiring a reset action
Viewpoint changes persist for as long as the visitor leaves them; there is no snap-back to a default angle
The dormant gated state does not reappear during the session
locked_observable_requirements: Opens with subdued ambient light, almost motionless and silent, with a single explicit start prompt that signals sound is part of the experience
Activation is a single press that removes the prompt and starts everything at once
Rain and sound rise together from nothing over several seconds instead of switching on instantly
The ground visibly transitions to a deeper tone with gloss and shimmer and becomes the attention anchor during the build
Steady state is an endless calm downpour, not a finite sequence
Distant flares are perceived mainly through reflected brightening that clearly exceeds the surrounding luminance rather than a directly displayed source
The view circles the subject on its own after activation
Dragging overrides the automatic circling and swings the viewpoint freely; scroll or pinch changes distance
Automatic circling pauses only while the gesture is held and resumes on release
The view remains locked on the same single subject under all gestures and distances
adaptable_details: Exact build duration and fade curve of rain and sound
Orbit speed, direction and radius
Flare frequency, brightness and interval variation
Palette and specific hues of the surround, gloss and highlights, as long as highlights stay clearly brighter than the surround
Density and scale of the falling rain
Near and far distance limits
Wording, styling and placement of the start prompt
Surrounding silhouettes or props around the wet patch
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits any single-subject low-illumination or weather-driven ambient scene meant to be watched at leisure, where a reflective ground-level surface can carry the mood and a fixed subject can be orbited; also fits a full-view tone-setting opener before content. It becomes a different Skill if the scene must run immediately without a consenting start gate, if it carries readable foreground content or navigation that competes with the ground for attention, if it resolves to an end state instead of looping endlessly, or if the viewpoint is fixed or free-roaming rather than always locked on one subject.

name: instrumented_console_audio_centerpiece
description: A low-distraction console view where one softly glowing form floats at the centre of a deep field of fine sparse points, pulsing with the playing audio while surrounding meters, numeric readouts and a scrolling status log report the same sound; the form can be dragged off centre against a resisting limit, flung and spun, and the viewpoint can be swung around it.

canonical_document.name: instrumented_console_audio_centerpiece
canonical_document.description: A low-distraction console view where one softly glowing form floats at the centre of a deep field of fine sparse points, pulsing with the playing audio while surrounding meters, numeric readouts and a scrolling status log report the same sound; the form can be dragged off centre against a resisting limit, flung and spun, and the viewpoint can be swung around it.
canonical_document.experience_scope: Whole-view experience: begins with a brief initializing sequence on arrival and persists as the entire view, from track selection through playback to the calm resting state after audio ends; it does not scroll away or hand off to other page regions.
content_and_composition: One central softly glowing form as the single focal subject, held at the centre of the view as its default resting position
A deep sparse point-field backdrop behind the form, establishing depth and a quiet low-distraction surround that stays clearly separated in luminance from the glowing centre
A frame of supporting readout roles around the centre: several level meters, numeric readouts, and one running status log that accumulates lines over time
A small source-selection role offering a few provided tracks plus an option to supply one's own audio file
A small set of tuning controls: a few sliders (reaction strength, spin rate, surface roughness) plus one reset control
Persistent elements across all states: the centred form, the point-field, the readout frame and the tuning controls; only their intensity and values change
experience_progression: Brief initializing sequence on arrival that resolves into the calm low-intensity resting scene
Idle resting state: form centred and calm, readouts and log present but quiet, awaiting a source
On a source starting, the view presses a little closer and the form plus every readout begin answering the sound in the same moment
Sustained sounding state where the scene feels wholly driven by the audio
When the audio ends, the closeness and reactivity ease back and the scene settles into the calm resting state, ready to start again
attention_and_information_flow: The glowing centre holds primary attention at all times; the readout frame is deliberately secondary and read at a glance
Starting audio raises the whole scene's intensity and pulls the viewpoint slightly closer, tightening focus on the centre
Meters and numeric readouts expose the moment-to-moment shape of the sound; the status log adds accumulating history so the experience reads as measured rather than merely decorated
Grabbing or flinging the form makes it momentarily dominant over the readouts; releasing returns attention to the steady centred composition
Tuning controls and reset stay quiet and peripheral, becoming briefly relevant only while being adjusted

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: A new source can be chosen to replace the current one; when the sound ends the scene eases back to the calm resting state on its own
interaction_model.state_change: Idle resting state transitions to sounding state; playback begins at once
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The form and every readout begin answering the sound simultaneously, the log reports the change, and the view presses slightly closer
interaction_model.input: Choosing one of a few provided sources, or supplying one's own audio file
interaction_model.affected_object: Whole scene: central form, meters, numeric readouts, status log, viewpoint distance

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Displacement is bounded; the form can never be dragged out of the scene and always relates back to the centre
interaction_model.state_change: Form leaves its centred resting position and is displaced only up to a fixed limit, past which it visibly resists
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The form follows the drag off centre and stiffens as the limit is approached, so the boundary is felt visually rather than announced
interaction_model.input: Grabbing and dragging the central form
interaction_model.affected_object: Central glowing form

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: The motion can be interrupted by grabbing the form again mid-flight; otherwise it always resolves to the centre without user action
interaction_model.state_change: Displaced form is flung with the release motion, spins, rebounds off the displacement limit, and damps back to the centre
interaction_model.visible_feedback: A visible throw with spin and one or more rebounds at the boundary, easing into the centred resting pose
interaction_model.input: Releasing the grabbed form
interaction_model.affected_object: Central glowing form

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Orbiting is continuous and reversible by dragging back; it never displaces the form or leaves the subject out of view
interaction_model.state_change: Viewpoint swings around the central form while the form keeps its place as the pivot
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The centre is seen from new angles as the point-field and readout framing shift with the swing
interaction_model.input: Dragging empty space around the form
interaction_model.affected_object: Viewpoint on the scene

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Each slider can be moved back at any time; changes take effect immediately without restarting the sound
interaction_model.state_change: Reactive behaviour and surface character change continuously while sliders move
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The centre answers the sound more or less strongly, spins faster or slower, and reads as smoother or rougher, updating live
interaction_model.input: Adjusting the tuning sliders (reaction strength, spin rate, surface roughness)
interaction_model.affected_object: The form's responsiveness to sound, its rotation, and its surface appearance

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Reset is always available and repeatable, and re-tuning after a reset is immediate
interaction_model.state_change: Every tuned value returns to its starting value and the scene returns to its default arrangement
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Sliders snap back and the centre visibly returns to its starting look, motion and centred position
interaction_model.input: Activating reset
interaction_model.affected_object: All tuning values and the scene's arrangement

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: No user action needed; starting another source re-enters the sounding state from wherever the scene has settled
interaction_model.state_change: Sounding state eases into the calm resting state
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Reactive motion and glow subside, meters and readouts fall back, the log notes the ending, and the view eases back out from its closer framing
interaction_model.input: Audio reaching its end (autonomous driver)
interaction_model.affected_object: Whole scene: form intensity, readouts, log, viewpoint distance

experience_qualities: Quiet and understated, with a single soft glow as the only high-luminance anchor
Deep and spatial, with the sparse point-field placing the subject in open, uncluttered space
Measured and instrumented: numbers, meters and an accumulating log make the sound feel read rather than merely illustrated
Tightly synchronous, so the centre and every readout answer the same instant of sound
Physical and springy under direct manipulation, with resistance, throw, spin and rebound
Self-settling and forgiving, always returning to a calm centred rest
completion_and_return: Ending audio completes the sounding stage and returns the scene to its calm resting state rather than ending the experience
The scene remains live and ready in rest, so a new source can start the cycle again
Any thrown or displaced form self-returns to centre
Reset restores all tuned values and the default arrangement; otherwise tuning persists across successive sources within the visit
locked_observable_requirements: One and only one glowing focal form holds the centre with clear luminance separation from a deep, sparsely speckled backdrop
A brief initializing sequence precedes the settled scene
The form and every surrounding readout answer the sound in the same moment while audio plays
Supporting readouts must include at least level meters, numeric values and a running accumulating log
The view presses closer while audio sounds and eases back when it ends
The form can be dragged off centre only up to a limit that visibly resists, and releasing flings, spins, rebounds and settles it back at the centre
Dragging empty space orbits the viewpoint around the form without moving the form
A small set of live tuning controls plus a reset that restores all starting values
Sound sources include both a few provided options and a user-supplied audio file, with playback starting immediately on selection
adaptable_details: Exact palette, glow hue and point-field density
The specific shape and surface character of the central form
Count, arrangement and labelling of meters and numeric readouts, and the placement of the log
Wording and verbosity of log lines
How many provided sources are offered
Which and how many tuning parameters the sliders expose
Timing and styling of the initializing sequence, the push-in and the ease-back
Stiffness, throw strength, spin and damping values within the bounded behaviour
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits any context whose whole view can be given to one live, continuously changing subject that a viewer both watches and handles, with only thin readouts and controls as supporting content; sound is the natural driver but any continuous live signal that can be metered, logged and rendered as intensity fits. It stops being this Skill if the centre becomes multiple co-equal subjects, if the surround becomes a high-salience or busy backdrop for unrelated foreground content, if the readouts and log are dropped so the subject reads as decoration only, or if the form is no longer directly grabbable and bounded so that throwing, rebounding and self-settling at the centre disappear.

source_sites.title: Audio Visualizer with Three.js and GSAP

name: self_healing_frost_trail_ice_slab
description: A thick, translucent sheet of ice seen from above, held at a uniform low-salience tone: the cursor grows high-contrast frosted blooms just behind it that immediately begin melting back to stillness, with a faint haze lifting off the same path, and dragging swings the viewing angle around the slab before coasting to rest.

canonical_document.name: self_healing_frost_trail_ice_slab
canonical_document.description: A thick, translucent sheet of ice seen from above, held at a uniform low-salience tone: the cursor grows high-contrast frosted blooms just behind it that immediately begin melting back to stillness, with a faint haze lifting off the same path, and dragging swings the viewing angle around the slab before coasting to rest.
canonical_document.experience_scope: A single whole-view region: the ice surface occupies its own viewport-scale panel and is the entire experience within it. It begins already at rest on arrival and never ends or completes; it can sit alone as the main view or serve as a substrate under sparse foreground content.
content_and_composition: One dominant surface role: a thick, translucent ice sheet read from above, held at a uniform low-salience tone that sits far from the marks in luminance, filling the region edge to edge
Depth stack of three readable layers: a glassy top skin, fracture/crack detail sitting visibly far beneath that skin, and a faint haze hanging above the surface

Transient frost marks as the only high-salience content, standing at a strong luminance separation from the surface, appearing on or near the top layer, unbounded in count and continuously being created and removed
A drifting faint haze that separates from the surface along the same path as the marks
No instructional text, labels, controls, cursors-as-UI or status indicators anywhere in the composition; the pointer itself is the implicit driver
Optional sparse overlaid foreground (a short heading or single action) sits above the surface without dividing it
experience_progression: No long-arc or staged progression; the field is always in its resting calm and always returns to it

Per-mark lifecycle, repeated and overlapping: a high-contrast frosted bloom emerges behind the moving cursor with a slight lag, grows along the traveled path, then softens and loses separation from the surface from the moment it appears until it is gone
Idle dwell resolves the whole field back to its uniform low-salience resting state as the last marks melt out
attention_and_information_flow: At rest, attention is unforced and diffuse: the eye settles wherever faint frost or crack detail happens to catch light on an otherwise uniform, low-activity field
The newest, most salient mark is the strongest focal point; prominence then decays continuously so focus naturally follows the pointer rather than being held by old marks
Depth information is revealed by angle change: turning the sheet separates the glassy top from the cracks beneath and exposes the thickness of the material
No information is signposted or explained; everything learned about the surface comes from marking it and turning it

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Nothing to undo: the mark begins losing salience immediately and disappears on its own; movement can stop or resume at any moment without penalty
interaction_model.state_change: A new frost bloom is created behind the pointer and extends along the traveled path with a slight trailing lag
interaction_model.visible_feedback: A high-contrast frosted bloom grows just behind the cursor, tracing where it has been rather than exactly where it is
interaction_model.input: Continuous cursor travel across the surface
interaction_model.affected_object: High-salience frosted mark on the ice top layer

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Fully continuous and instantly re-expressible by changing pace; no mode to exit
interaction_model.state_change: Mark geometry shifts between elongated-thin and compact-thick according to how fast the pointer moves
interaction_model.visible_feedback: A quick sweep pulls one long ragged streak; a slow drift leaves a fatter, denser patch
interaction_model.input: Speed of that cursor travel
interaction_model.affected_object: Shape and mass of the frost mark

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Dissipates unaided; leaves nothing behind
interaction_model.state_change: Haze detaches from the marked path and disperses
interaction_model.visible_feedback: A faint haze lifts off the traced path and drifts apart into the air above the sheet
interaction_model.input: Same cursor travel
interaction_model.affected_object: Haze layer above the surface

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: This is the recovery path itself; no reset action exists or is needed, and marking can begin again at any instant
interaction_model.state_change: Every mark, including the newest, continues softening until the field is uniform again
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Salient marks melt away and the sheet settles back into silent, uniform stillness
interaction_model.input: Pause or absence of pointer movement (autonomous decay driver)
interaction_model.affected_object: All existing frost marks and haze

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: On release the rotation coasts and settles smoothly to a stop; the reached angle persists, and angle change never interrupts or clears marking
interaction_model.state_change: The vantage point swings around the slab while the drag continues
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The sheet turns under the viewer, with the glassy top shifting against the cracks below so the material's thickness becomes apparent
interaction_model.input: Press-and-drag anywhere on the surface
interaction_model.affected_object: Viewing angle onto the ice sheet

experience_qualities: Quiet, cold and tonally restrained, with a jump in salience as a rare event
Thick and layered rather than flat; the surface reads as a solid material with depth below it
Tactile and instantly responsive, yet lagging just enough to feel like something is being pushed through
Impermanent and self-erasing, so nothing accumulates and nothing can be spoiled
Instruction-free and open-ended, rewarding idle lingering rather than task completion
completion_and_return: No completion state, goal or end; the experience loops implicitly through mark-and-melt cycles
Automatic full return to the resting calm whenever input stops, with no reset control
No accumulated or saved history of marks
The chosen viewing angle is the only state that persists after interaction stops
locked_observable_requirements: A translucent surface read as thick ice, uniform, calm and internally low-contrast at rest, with marks reading at a strong luminance separation from it
Visible depth separation between a glassy top skin and fracture detail sitting well beneath it, plus a faint haze layer above
Marks appear behind the pointer with a perceptible trailing lag, not locked to its exact position
Mark shape is determined by pointer speed: fast motion yields long ragged streaks, slow motion yields fatter patches
Every mark begins losing its separation from the surface the instant it appears and fully disappears without user action
The field always self-heals to its resting state; no reset or clear affordance exists
Haze rises from the marked path and drifts apart
Dragging reorients the view of the slab and coasts to a smooth stop on release
No instructional text or visible controls
adaptable_details: Which hue family the surface, frost and haze occupy, and whether the resting surround sits low or high in luminance, so long as the marks stay strongly separated from it
Mark lifetime and how fast the separation decays
Streak raggedness, thickness range and bloom softness
Crack density, pattern and apparent depth below the surface
Haze opacity and drift direction
Range and sensitivity of the viewing-angle swing and the length of its coast
Region size and aspect, and whether sparse foreground content is overlaid
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits calm, low-density contexts where a single material surface is the main visual interest and any foreground content is minimal: wordless landing views, mood-setting hero panels, contemplative section backdrops and idle playgrounds. It transfers to other cold, layered, translucent materials as long as marks stay temporary and self-healing. Making marks permanent or accumulative turns it into a drawing or trail-persistence experience; making the surround busy, internally high-contrast or visually loud destroys the resting calm that attention depends on; binding the marks to data, navigation targets or discrete content items makes it an information display rather than a material surface, all of which are different Skills.

name: living_flame_cursor_with_cooling_heat_trail
description: In a quiet, low-distraction and otherwise empty view a single burning flame replaces the pointer; dragging it paints a trail of heat that stretches and intensifies with speed, curls upward, cools and fades away, while a soft glow answers on the ground below.

canonical_document.name: living_flame_cursor_with_cooling_heat_trail
canonical_document.description: In a quiet, low-distraction and otherwise empty view a single burning flame replaces the pointer; dragging it paints a trail of heat that stretches and intensifies with speed, curls upward, cools and fades away, while a soft glow answers on the ground below.
canonical_document.experience_scope: Whole-view experience occupying the entire low-distraction viewport from the moment it opens; it begins with the flame present and idle, is active wherever the pointer or finger is inside the view, and ends only when the heat has burned down and the view returns to its quiet resting surround. No entry step, instruction or explanation precedes it.
content_and_composition: Background layer: a quiet, near-empty field with no competing content, held far enough from the emitter in luminance and saturation that the fire is clearly read against it
Single primary subject: one living flame, continuously animated even when still, positioned at the pointer or finger location and the only thing to look at
Trail layer behind and below the flame: a streak of burning heat left along the path just travelled, curling as it rises and cooling from high-salience to barely present before disappearing
Ground layer beneath the flame: a soft answering glow that tracks the flame's horizontal position and responds to its intensity
Persistent absence: the usual pointer marker is hidden while inside the view, so the flame itself is the only cursor
Cardinality is fixed at one flame and one glow; the trail is a continuous stream rather than a countable set of items
experience_progression: Opening state: quiet low-distraction view with a single idle flame, no instruction, nothing else to attend to
Stirring: pointer or finger movement carries the flame and begins laying down heat
Intensification: sustained faster strokes stretch the streak longer and push it to higher salience, and strengthen the ground glow
Burn-down: on pausing or leaving, existing heat curls, cools and dies out on its own with no abrupt cut
Settling: the scene returns to its quiet resting surround with the idle flame, ready to be stirred again
Loop: any next stroke resumes immediately from the current state without a reset
attention_and_information_flow: Attention is anchored to the flame because the view is deliberately near-empty and kept well separated from the flame's luminance
Movement transfers attention to the trail, which reads as a record of where the visitor just was
Streak length and intensity against the surround are the only readouts of stroke speed, so the visitor infers the rule without being told
The ground glow adds a secondary, lower-contrast cue that reinforces where the flame is and how strongly it burns
As heat cools, prominence drains back to the single flame and then to the quiet surround itself

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Movement can start, stop and resume at any moment; there is no committed gesture and nothing to cancel
interaction_model.state_change: Flame position follows the pointer continuously; new heat is emitted along the travelled path
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The flame appears to be led around and a burning streak lingers behind it, curling upward as it ages
interaction_model.input: Moving the pointer across the view
interaction_model.affected_object: The flame subject and the heat trail behind it

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Intensity is fully governed by ongoing motion, so slowing down immediately returns the effect to its quiet low end
interaction_model.state_change: Faster strokes extend the streak and raise its intensity; slow movement produces only a small ember
interaction_model.visible_feedback: A long, high-salience, hot streak for quick strokes; a faint, short ember for gentle movement, with the ground glow rising and falling in step
interaction_model.input: Stroke speed (fast sweeping versus slow drifting)
interaction_model.affected_object: Heat trail length and intensity, and ground glow strength

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Leaving the view restores ordinary pointer appearance outside it
interaction_model.state_change: The usual pointer marker gives way to the flame, which takes over as the visible cursor
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The system cursor disappears and the flame reads as the thing being moved
interaction_model.input: Pointer entering the view
interaction_model.affected_object: The default pointer marker and the flame

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Decay is self-completing and interruptible: the next stroke picks up immediately from whatever heat remains, with no reset, snap-back or restart
interaction_model.state_change: Emission stops and remaining heat decays on its own
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The streak curls, cools and dies out to nothing; the glow fades with it, leaving the quiet resting surround
interaction_model.input: Pausing in place or leaving the view
interaction_model.affected_object: Existing heat trail and ground glow

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Lifting the finger behaves like pausing or leaving: heat burns down and the next drag resumes without reset
interaction_model.state_change: Identical following, speed-scaled intensity and burn-down behavior as pointer movement
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The same flame-led streak and answering glow follow the finger
interaction_model.input: Finger dragging on touch input
interaction_model.affected_object: The flame, trail and ground glow

experience_qualities: Hot and physical, as if something real is being dragged through an empty, quiet field
Immediately legible with no explanation, instruction or affordance needed
Alive at rest, since the flame keeps burning even when untouched
Continuous and forgiving, never resetting or interrupting the visitor
Quiet and sparse between strokes, inviting rather than demanding play
completion_and_return: There is no goal state or completion; the experience loops indefinitely
Idle behavior is a self-completing burn-down back to the opening quiet surround with the single flame
State is continuous across strokes: resuming never replays an intro or clears the view
Re-entering the view after leaving resumes from the current, mostly cooled state
locked_observable_requirements: A quiet, near-empty view whose surround stays clearly separated in luminance and saturation from the flame, so the one flame is the sole focal subject, with no explanatory text or controls
The flame replaces the ordinary pointer marker while inside the view
Movement leaves a lingering heat trail along the travelled path that curls, cools and dies out on its own rather than being erased
Trail length and intensity against the surround scale with movement speed, with slow movement yielding only a small ember
A soft answering glow beneath the flame on the ground that responds to the flame's position and intensity
The flame remains visibly alive while idle
Pausing or leaving triggers burn-down to nothing and the scene settles back to its quiet resting surround
The next stroke resumes immediately with no reset or restart, including for finger dragging
adaptable_details: Exact flame silhouette, scale, hue and color temperature, provided it stays a distinct high-salience accent against the surround
How long the heat takes to burn down and how far the trail curls
Precise speed-to-length and speed-to-intensity mapping
Softness, spread and hue of the ground glow
Luminance level and hue family of the surround, light or dark, and whether it is flat or subtly textured, as long as separation from the emitter holds
Trail density and the visual grain of the heat
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits views that can be kept near-empty and low in distraction, with enough luminance separation for a single moving emitter to carry the whole experience, such as playful standalone demos, teaser screens and sparse full-view intro sections. It survives changes of flame styling, surround luminance and hue, decay timing and glow softness. It stops being this Skill if the trail no longer decays on its own, if the effect is reduced to a decorated cursor without lingering heat, if speed stops driving intensity, if the emitter is layered behind substantial foreground text or UI that competes for attention, or if the interaction is turned into a discrete tool, drawing surface or task with a completion state.

name: velocity_driven_glowing_smoke_trail
description: On an empty screen of one uniform tone, a softly lagging emitting point trails the cursor and releases inner-lit smoke: fast strokes bloom into wide high-intensity plumes, slow strokes barely whisper, and every wisp keeps curling, spreading, thinning and dissolving until only a faint resting glow remains.

canonical_document.name: velocity_driven_glowing_smoke_trail

Continuously accumulating field of glowing smoke wisps emitted along the recent pointer path, layered over the void and blending where they overlap

interaction_model.visible_feedback: A wide, high-intensity plume that dominates the view and becomes the region most strongly separated from the surround
interaction_model.input: Fast stroke
interaction_model.affected_object: Newly emitted smoke

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Continuous with fast strokes; speed can change mid-stroke and the trail thickness follows without any discrete switch
interaction_model.state_change: Emission narrows and weakens
interaction_model.visible_feedback: A barely visible whisper of glow along the path
interaction_model.input: Slow stroke
interaction_model.affected_object: Newly emitted smoke

interaction_model.state_change: Continuous swirling, spreading, thinning and dissolving toward the empty void

interaction_model.affected_object: All already-emitted smoke

Inner-lit and luminous, reading as light held inside the wisps against a quiet surround far from it in luminance
Soft lag that makes the trail feel like it is being pulled rather than pinned to the cursor
Expressive: stroke speed is directly legible as plume width and emission intensity
Calm, unspoilable and consequence-free, with nothing to finish or ruin
Immediately self-explanatory with zero instruction
completion_and_return: No completion state, score or end; the experience is endlessly repeatable
Every emitted trace expires by itself, returning the surface to a near-empty void
A small calm glow persists as the resting baseline instead of a fully blank frame
No accumulated state is retained or reloaded; the void is the permanent home condition
locked_observable_requirements: Effectively empty full-screen surface of one uniform tone, clearly separated in luminance from the emission, with no labels, instructions or foreground content
Emission point visibly lags behind the pointer instead of locking to it
Trail reads as glowing, inner-lit smoke that curls, spreads and thins rather than as hard lines, dots or rigid shapes
Stroke speed visibly maps to plume width and emission intensity, with fast strokes wide and strongly separated from the surround and slow strokes barely visible
Pausing reduces emission to a small faint resting glow rather than stopping abruptly or leaving nothing
Already-emitted smoke keeps evolving and fading autonomously with no user action
No undo, clear, reset or completion affordance exists

adaptable_details: Exact hue, hue range or hue shifting of the glow, and whether the surround sits below or above it in luminance
Amount of lag and easing feel of the emission point
Fade duration, drift direction and turbulence character of the smoke
Absolute intensity range and how strongly overlapping wisps accumulate
Intensity and size of the resting glow
Overall density scaling for different screen sizes
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits any label-free full-surface region of uniform tone or whole page whose only purpose is atmosphere and responsiveness to pointer motion, including intro screens, decorative playgrounds and interactive backdrops placed behind sparse or no foreground content. It stops being this Skill if the trail becomes crisp geometric shapes, discrete sprites or text, if the trace locks rigidly to the cursor without lag, if traces persist as a permanent drawing the user can save or clear, if stroke speed no longer changes the visible plume, or if it must sit behind dense readable content whose legibility constrains the glow.

name: squishy_heap_gathering_around_a_centred_orb
description: An open, expansive sky scene, revealed by a fully occluding cover lifting away in a controlled luminance transition, where soft jelly-like objects arrive a few at a time from all directions and build an endlessly jostling heap around one clearly set-apart ball you can orbit, zoom and knock upward with a press.

canonical_document.name: squishy_heap_gathering_around_a_centred_orb
canonical_document.description: An open, expansive sky scene, revealed by a fully occluding cover lifting away in a controlled luminance transition, where soft jelly-like objects arrive a few at a time from all directions and build an endlessly jostling heap around one clearly set-apart ball you can orbit, zoom and knock upward with a press.
canonical_document.experience_scope: Whole-view experience filling the viewport from page open onward: it begins with a short wait showing progress, opens with the cover lift, and never ends, closes or hands off to another state.
content_and_composition: One continuous open sky environment as the only backdrop, kept low-distraction, with strong directional light that casts shading and shadows so surface dents read clearly

Exactly one spherical core, held visually distinct from the arriving objects and the surround, suspended at the centre of the frame, persistent for the entire experience and the anchor everything gathers around
A growing population of soft, deformable objects (many, arriving in small batches) that fall toward the core, squash against it and against each other, and remain visible thereafter
A full-frame opaque cover layer present only during entry, above the scene, which lifts away to expose it
A simple progress indication visible during the pre-reveal wait
No labels, captions, instructions, controls or overlaid explanatory copy at any stage
experience_progression: Brief wait with a visible sense of progress before anything of the scene is shown
Opaque cover lifts away, shifting the frame from fully occluded to fully open, revealing the sky environment and the single distinct ball alone at the centre
Empty, quiet scene with the lone ball as the only subject
Objects begin arriving a few at a time from every direction and converge on the centre
The heap grows and thickens, every landing producing visible dents and rebounds
Arrival tapers and the scene settles into a calm, permanently jostling state that never completes, resets or restarts
attention_and_information_flow: Attention is first held by the waiting progress cue, then by the lifting edge of the cover as the scene is uncovered
Immediately after the reveal, the single centred ball is the sole focus in an otherwise empty frame
Focus spreads outward as objects stream in, following their arrival paths inward to the centre
As density rises, prominence shifts from individual arrivals to the collective mass and to local contacts, dents and rebounds
Softness and weight are communicated only through visible deformation and recoil; no text or symbol explains the material
In the settled state the scene rewards slow, close inspection: small ongoing shifts and squashes remain the only new information

interaction_model.state_change: Viewing angle swings around the centre, then coasts and decays to rest after release
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The whole scene turns smoothly around the centre; the heap is seen from new sides and light, shading and shadows shift with it
interaction_model.input: Drag across the view
interaction_model.affected_object: Viewpoint orbiting the central ball

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Freely reversible at any time; near and far limits prevent pushing inside the ball or letting the heap leave the frame
interaction_model.state_change: View draws nearer or pulls back within fixed limits
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The heap and ball grow to fill more of the frame or recede into the open surround
interaction_model.input: Pinch or wheel
interaction_model.affected_object: Viewing distance to the centre

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: No undo exists or is needed; the heap self-heals by resettling, and nudges may be repeated immediately and as often as wanted
interaction_model.state_change: A localized upward impulse is applied, strongest along the aimed line and fading to nothing a short distance out
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Nearby soft bodies burst upward, squash and stretch, arc off, tumble back down and resettle into the heap; distant bodies are untouched
interaction_model.input: Press or click anywhere in the view
interaction_model.affected_object: Soft objects nearest the aimed direction

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Runs on its own without any control; arrival simply tapers into the settled state and never rewinds or clears
interaction_model.state_change: Objects enter in small batches from all directions until the heap reaches a stable mass
interaction_model.visible_feedback: New bodies drop in from off-frame, land with visible dents, and jostle the existing pile
interaction_model.input: Autonomous arrival over time after the reveal
interaction_model.affected_object: Population of soft objects in the scene

experience_qualities: Tactile and squishy: every contact visibly deforms and rebounds
Calm, unhurried and endlessly watchable rather than goal-driven
Airy and open, with a spacious, uncluttered feeling around the centre
Toy-like and immediately legible without instruction
Physically satisfying response to a press, with obvious cause and direction
A quiet sense of accumulation: emptiness becoming abundance
completion_and_return: The experience never completes, wins, ends or resets
After disturbance the heap resettles on its own into the same calm jostling equilibrium
Orbit motion returns to rest after each drag while the reached angle and distance persist
The entry reveal happens once and is not replayed during the session
locked_observable_requirements: Softness must be visible through deformation: dents, squash and rebound on contact, never rigid collision
Exactly one distinct central body at the frame centre that everything gathers around and that stays visible throughout, readably separated from the objects heaped on it
Open, low-distraction sky environment with directional light strong enough that surface dents and cast shadows read clearly
Objects arrive gradually in small batches from many directions rather than appearing as a finished pile
Entry is a full-frame opaque cover lifting away to uncover the scene in a controlled luminance transition, preceded by a visible sense of progress
Orbit has inertia that coasts briefly and damps to a stop
Tilt and distance are bounded: no flipping past vertical, the heap never leaves the frame, the view never enters the central body
A press applies a directional upward impulse that is strongest along the aimed line and fades out a short distance away
No completion, reset, scoring or clearing of the scene
adaptable_details: Shape, colour, size variety and final count of the soft objects
Degree of squishiness and rebound liveliness
Environment treatment, overall luminance level and light direction, in any hue family
Visual style of the progress indication and the direction the cover lifts
Arrival cadence and how long accumulation takes
Impulse strength, falloff radius and coast duration
Whether input comes from pointer, touch or both, and exact sensitivity
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits low-text, full-bleed regions or whole landing views where one centred subject can host an accumulating mass of soft objects and copy stays minimal or overlaid; it adopts the host's own environment tones as long as directional light keeps dents readable and the central body stays distinct. Replacing the deformable bodies with rigid ones, removing the single central gathering anchor, letting the viewer roam freely instead of orbiting a bounded centre, or adding goals, scoring, completion or a reset would create a different skill.

name: lit_alcove_fluid_sculpture
description: A restless fluid mass displayed inside a recessed alcove under focused light; it fades in from a concealed surround, is shoved and made more luminous by pointer strokes, always settles back into a slow drift, and can be orbited and zoomed within a bounded front-facing view.

canonical_document.name: lit_alcove_fluid_sculpture
canonical_document.description: A restless fluid mass displayed inside a recessed alcove under focused light; it fades in from a concealed surround, is shoved and made more luminous by pointer strokes, always settles back into a slow drift, and can be orbited and zoomed within a bounded front-facing view.
canonical_document.experience_scope: Whole-view experience occupying the entire page from first paint to departure: begins with a quiet, featureless field at a single uniform tone carrying only a thin progress indicator, opens when that concealment lifts to reveal the alcove and its fluid, and never ends — there is no completion state, only continuous drift and repeated inspection.
content_and_composition: One primary subject: a single coherent fluid mass that is the only foreground content and the sole focus of the view

One containing enclosure: a recessed architectural alcove of heavy matte material held low in salience, which surrounds and visually holds the mass, with inner walls acting as visible limits of the subject's world

One lighting role: focused exhibit-style illumination that separates the strongly lit, active mass from a subdued, low-contrast surround, as a single object lit while everything around it is left unlit
Persistent quiet surround field, uniform and far from the subject in luminance, with no text, labels, captions, controls, legends, chrome or navigation competing with the subject
One transient pre-reveal element: a thin, quiet progress indicator on the empty surround field, present only before the reveal and never returning
Layer relationship: quiet surround behind, enclosure as a mid layer framing and cropping the subject, fluid mass innermost and always fully contained by the enclosure
experience_progression: Silent withheld state: an almost empty view at one uniform tone with only the thin progress indicator, deliberately withholding the subject
Reveal: the concealment lifts through a controlled luminance transition and the lit alcove with its fluid emerges, the indicator disappearing as the subject takes over the view
Open watching: the mass moves on its own indefinitely with nothing else asking for attention, inviting passive viewing
Optional engagement loops: pointer strokes disturb and brighten the mass, viewpoint changes let it be studied from a few angles, and each loop resolves back into unhurried drift
No terminal stage: the drift continues for as long as the visitor stays, with engagement loops re-enterable at any time
attention_and_information_flow: Attention starts intentionally empty on a featureless field so the reveal itself is the first event
After the reveal the lit subject is the single strongest element; enclosure and surround stay low in salience and read as frame, not content
Local brightening follows the pointer, so the disturbed region temporarily becomes the most luminous, most detailed part of the subject and marks where the visitor has acted
When input stops, prominence flows back to the whole mass evenly as brightness relaxes, restoring a single undivided focus
Viewpoint changes reveal new information about form, depth and internal structure rather than new content or text
No information is delivered by labels or explanation; everything learned comes from watching and moving

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Holding still stops pushing immediately; the disturbance and brightening relax on their own back into the subject's own motion, so no stroke can be wrong or need undoing
interaction_model.state_change: Material closest to the pointer is displaced along the pointer's direction of travel, with faster strokes displacing more and influence falling off with distance from the pointer
interaction_model.visible_feedback: A visible push, smear or wake forms in the direction of the stroke while the touched region rises in luminance for as long as it is being driven, fading with distance from the stroke
interaction_model.input: Pointer moved across the subject
interaction_model.affected_object: Fluid mass near the pointer path

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Containment is absolute and self-restoring; excess energy dissipates and the mass returns to calm drift
interaction_model.state_change: Displacement is bounded by the container: material cannot leave the alcove and reverses at the inner surfaces
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The mass visibly rebounds off the inner walls and folds back inward instead of escaping, spilling or breaking the frame
interaction_model.input: Continued or repeated strong strokes toward the enclosure
interaction_model.affected_object: Fluid mass at the enclosure's inner walls

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Rotation eases to a halt after release rather than stopping abruptly, and travel is bounded so the subject stays framed from the front and can never be viewed from behind
interaction_model.state_change: The viewpoint swings around the piece, changing the viewing angle within a limited arc
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The alcove and mass turn coherently as if walking around a lit sculpture, revealing other angles of the same subject
interaction_model.input: Drag across the view
interaction_model.affected_object: Viewpoint onto the exhibited subject

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Distance is clamped at both ends so the subject is never clipped into unreadable closeness nor lost as a distant speck; the motion settles gently at the limits
interaction_model.state_change: The view pulls closer for detail or backs off for the whole composition, within near and far limits
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Smooth approach or retreat with the subject growing or shrinking in frame while staying fully framed
interaction_model.input: Wheel scroll or pinch
interaction_model.affected_object: Viewing distance to the subject

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: The baseline drift is the resting state the experience always returns to from any disturbance
interaction_model.state_change: Perpetual self-motion continues, always relaxing toward an unhurried baseline drift
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Slow, non-repeating internal movement that keeps the piece alive and worth watching with hands off
interaction_model.input: No input (autonomous driver)
interaction_model.affected_object: Fluid mass

experience_qualities: Gallery-quiet and reverent: hushed, subdued, unhurried, with the subject presented rather than advertised
Sculptural and material: heavy matte surround, focused light, tangible mass with weight and depth
Responsive and physical: strokes feel like shoving real material, with direction, speed and falloff legible in the result
Self-restoring calm: every disturbance dissipates back into drift, so nothing accumulates or degrades
Endless and low-pressure: no goal, no finish line, no explanation, safe to linger or leave at any moment
completion_and_return: No completion or success state; the piece runs indefinitely
Every interaction returns to the same resting behavior: calm drift, even brightness, eased-to-rest viewpoint
The withheld-to-lit reveal happens once per visit and is not replayed during the session
The viewpoint persists where the visitor leaves it within its bounds rather than snapping back to a default pose
Disturbances leave no permanent trace on the subject
locked_observable_requirements: The view opens quiet and near-empty at a single uniform tone with only a thin progress indicator, and the subject is revealed by that concealment lifting through a controlled luminance transition rather than appearing instantly
A single continuously moving mass is the only foreground content, with no competing text, labels or controls
The mass is visibly held inside a recessed enclosure and lit like an exhibited object, clearly separated in luminance from a subdued, low-salience surround
Pointer movement displaces nearby material along the direction of travel, with more displacement for quicker strokes and weakening influence with distance
The disturbed region brightens only while it is being driven and relaxes back when driving stops
Stopping pointer movement stops the pushing at once and the mass returns to its own unhurried drift
The mass can never leave its enclosure and visibly rebounds off the inner walls
Dragging swings the viewpoint around the subject with rotation easing to a halt, and wheel or pinch changes viewing distance
Viewpoint travel and distance are bounded so the subject stays framed from the front and is never seen from behind or lost at a distance
The experience never terminates and always resettles into slow drift
adaptable_details: Substance character of the mass (liquid, smoke-like, molten, granular) and its coloration or tonal shifts
Exact geometry, proportions and surface treatment of the enclosure
Number, tonal quality and placement of the exhibit lights, including whether the surround sits below or above the subject in luminance
Form and position of the pre-reveal progress indicator and the duration or easing of the reveal transition
Precise strength, falloff radius and brightening intensity of pointer displacement
Exact rotation arc, distance limits and easing durations, as long as bounded front-facing framing is preserved
Optional ambience such as sound or subtle grain that does not compete for attention
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits any single-subject, low-text presentation where one continuously self-animating mass or material is meant to be watched and inspected as an exhibited object — art landings, material or texture showcases, brand-mood hero views, studio entry screens. It stops being this Skill if foreground text, navigation or product copy must share attention with the subject, if the subject is a static or discrete model with no perpetual self-motion and no self-restoring disturbance, if the enclosure and the exhibit-style lighting separation are dropped so the subject floats without a containing frame, if pointer input selects, navigates or leaves permanent marks instead of causing decaying physical displacement, or if the viewpoint becomes an unbounded free-fly or full 360-degree orbit rather than a curated front-facing arc.

name: submerged_drifting_creature_field
description: You surface into a deep body of water whose surround sits far below the creatures in luminance, already encircled by a scattered group of faintly self-luminous translucent creatures at different distances; near ones show patterned domes, gathered frills and hair-thin trailing threads while far ones dissolve into haze, and they endlessly drift out of view and refill from below.

canonical_document.name: submerged_drifting_creature_field
canonical_document.description: You surface into a deep body of water whose surround sits far below the creatures in luminance, already encircled by a scattered group of faintly self-luminous translucent creatures at different distances; near ones show patterned domes, gathered frills and hair-thin trailing threads while far ones dissolve into haze, and they endlessly drift out of view and refill from below.
canonical_document.experience_scope: Whole-view continuous experience: begins with a quiet hold at the low end of the scene's luminance range that resolves into an already-submerged view, then never ends or hands off; the scene fills the view and remains the only content region.
content_and_composition: One deep volumetric water environment in a single restrained hue family held well below the creatures' luminance, acting as the persistent substrate; no page chrome or instructional overlay
A scattered group of many translucent, faintly self-luminous soft-bodied creatures distributed across near, middle and far depth bands
At least one nearby creature legible in detail: patterned dome, gathered frills beneath it, and hair-thin trailing threads that lag behind its body

experience_progression: Quiet, nearly empty view held briefly at the bottom of the scene's luminance range with no progress indication
The view resolves into the sense of already being submerged mid-scene rather than arriving or descending into it
Attention widens across the whole scattered group as depth and haze become readable
Attention settles onto one nearby creature and its fine parts while the far group recedes into haze
Continuous unresolved drift thereafter: creatures rise out of the top of view while others surface from below, so the population never thins and no state ever concludes
attention_and_information_flow: The suppressed opening luminance hides all detail so the first legible thing is the collective glow of the group
Prominence is carried by proximity: nearer creatures gain brightness, edge definition, pattern and thread detail; distant ones lose all of it to haze
Detail is revealed by approach rather than by labels or captions; nothing is ever explained in text
A hovered creature temporarily becomes the brightest and most active element in the view, then relinquishes that prominence as it settles

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Never pauses, completes or requires attention; recycling is invisible, with no popping in or out at the view edges
interaction_model.state_change: Each creature continuously pulses and drifts upward at its own rhythm; creatures leaving the top of view are replaced by others entering from below
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Unbroken slow rising motion, soft asynchronous pulsing, trailing threads swaying behind each body, stable overall population and density

interaction_model.affected_object: The whole creature group and the water volume

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Drag can be interrupted and re-grabbed at any moment; vertical swing decelerates into a soft stop at its limits instead of snapping; releasing always returns to calm ambient drift
interaction_model.state_change: The viewpoint swings smoothly around the group, continuing briefly with inertia after release, and is prevented from tipping fully overhead or fully underneath
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Parallax between near and far creatures as the surrounding water rotates; motion eases to a stop rather than cutting; the horizon-sense stays upright and the scene never rolls or inverts

interaction_model.affected_object: Viewpoint orientation around the creature group

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Approaching either limit slows and stops the change rather than clipping; the scene remains fully watchable at both extremes
interaction_model.state_change: Distance changes smoothly between a near limit and a far limit
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Near creatures grow until their dome pattern, frills and threads are readable, and shrink back into the hazy group when pulled out; the camera never passes through a body and the group is never lost to emptiness

interaction_model.affected_object: Viewpoint distance from the group

interaction_model.visible_feedback: A localized flare of brightness and quickened pulsing, the body visibly fleeing the cursor, and its threads swept off-axis by the sudden movement

interaction_model.affected_object: That one creature and its trailing parts

Immersive sense of already being inside the water rather than looking at a picture of it
Weightless, slow, organic motion with soft asynchronous rhythms
Softly glowing, narrow-contrast depth against a low-distraction surround, with a felt but unseen vastness
Alive and responsive to presence without ever demanding action
completion_and_return: No completion state, score, ending or exit; the experience loops through population turnover indefinitely
Disturbed creatures self-recover to their resting state unaided
Viewpoint changes persist as the visitor left them; there is no forced re-centering or replay of the opening resolve
locked_observable_requirements: Quiet opening held at the low end of the scene's luminance range that resolves into an already-submerged mid-scene view rather than an entrance or descent
Multiple translucent, faintly glowing soft-bodied creatures scattered across distinct depth bands, not a single hero subject alone
Depth haze that swallows far creatures while near ones remain detailed
Nearby creature legible as patterned dome plus gathered frills plus hair-thin trailing threads that lag behind body motion
Continuous upward drift with off-view creatures replaced from below so the scene never empties or resets
Orbiting viewpoint with inertial easing that stays upright and never tips fully overhead or underneath
Distance limits that keep the group framed and prevent passing through any body
Hover-proximity agitation of exactly one creature: brighter, faster beating, pushed away, trailing parts displaced
Unaided settle back to rest within a couple of seconds after the cursor leaves
No instructions, labels or visible controls anywhere in the view
adaptable_details: Exact creature count, size spread and distribution across depth
Which hue family carries the water and the glow, their exact values, and how far the surround sits below the creatures in luminance
Length of the suppressed opening hold and the pacing of the resolve
Pulse rates, drift speeds and thread length or count
Dome pattern motifs and frill silhouettes
Inertia strength, orbit and distance limit values, and the exact settle duration within a second or two
Whether distance input comes from wheel, pinch or drag gesture
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits any view whose purpose is atmosphere and idle watching, carrying no foreground copy or only sparse text held at readable contrast against the surround, and whose subject is a group of slow, soft, self-luminous drifting bodies in a hazy volume; the same structure transfers to other suspended-in-a-medium groups such as drifting spores, lanterns or plankton-like motes. It becomes a different Skill if the scene gains a single fixed hero subject instead of a recycling group, if it acquires goals, progress, selection or navigation targets, if free inversion or unconstrained flight replaces the upright limited orbit, or if it must sit behind dense reading content where the recessive surround, haze and constant motion stop being the primary experience.

Reads as one heavy connected body, never as visible specks or separate droplets
Clear, glossy surface that refracts and reflects the surroundings, with a depth-dependent tint that deepens with thickness — any hue, or none beyond neutral density
A patterned surface beneath the liquid, with enough contrast within the pattern to remain visible through it, so refraction is readable
Pointer shove acts only where the pointer is over liquid and only within a bounded pocket around it, directed along pointer travel
Shove strength scales with pointer speed and saturates at very high speed
Dragging orbits the viewpoint without disturbing the liquid
Orbit is limited so the view never tips below the floor plane; distance is clamped between fixed limits
Liquid is fully contained; disturbances aimed at a wall are absorbed and nothing exits
No instructions, goals or end point
adaptable_details: Container shape, proportions and wall treatment
Tint hue and strength, gloss intensity, and the overall luminance level of the surrounding environment (light, mid or dark, provided reflections stay legible)
Floor pattern style, contrast and scale
Ambient sloshing amplitude and settling pace
Size of the pointer influence pocket and the speed at which force saturates
Orbit and zoom limit values and gesture sensitivity
Region size and whether it fills the viewport or sits within a page
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits any single contained volume of a continuous fluid-like substance presented as the sole focal content of a region, with a patterned backdrop of any tonality behind it — contrasty enough to make optical distortion legible. Replacing the connected liquid body with discrete particles, grains or objects, removing autonomous pre-touch motion, allowing the substance to escape its container, or introducing goals, scoring or narrated stages would produce a different Skill. name: shovable_glossy_blob_huddle
description: A quiet huddle of glossy blobs on a plain, low-distraction empty stage that scatter when swept or pressed, tumble into new orientations, invert the whole stage's tonal scheme on press, and always drift back into a calm cluster.

canonical_document.name: shovable_glossy_blob_huddle
canonical_document.description: A quiet huddle of glossy blobs on a plain, low-distraction empty stage that scatter when swept or pressed, tumble into new orientations, invert the whole stage's tonal scheme on press, and always drift back into a calm cluster.
canonical_document.experience_scope: Whole-view experience: the stage fills the entire viewport and is active from the moment the view opens until the view is left; there is no entry step, no completion state and no exit condition.
content_and_composition: A single low-distraction, nearly featureless stage surface covering the full view, acting as both surround and play area
One small group of glossy abstract blobs (a countable handful, not a crowd) resting close to the center of the stage
Blobs are the only foreground content; no text, controls, labels or instructional overlay compete with them
Blobs are volumetric enough to show a readable orientation, so rotation is visible as tumbling rather than as flat sliding

Loop: the resting huddle is identical in character to the opening state, so any number of disturbances can follow indefinitely
attention_and_information_flow: Attention is pinned to the center cluster at open because the surround is uniform and otherwise empty
During a sweep, attention follows the shoved blob outward along the sweep direction
A press pulls attention to the pressed point, then outward with the whole scattering group, then to the full-stage scheme change
As motion decays, attention returns to the reforming center cluster

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Displacement is never permanent; the blob decelerates and is drawn back toward the center cluster on its own once input stops

interaction_model.affected_object: The individual blob under the pointer

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Stillness is a safe neutral state that can be entered and left at any time
interaction_model.state_change: No state change; the scene stays in or continues toward rest
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Nothing moves; only the cursor indicates whether a blob is under the pointer

interaction_model.affected_object: All blobs

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Purely indicative and instantly reversible by moving away
interaction_model.state_change: Cursor switches between an over-blob signal and the default state
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Cursor appearance changes while over a blob and reverts on leaving
interaction_model.input: Pointer entering or leaving the area of a blob
interaction_model.affected_object: Cursor presentation

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Repeated presses are always allowed and interrupt any settling in progress; the scheme inverts again on the next press and the blobs regather regardless of how many presses occur
interaction_model.state_change: All blobs are impelled outward from the pressed point and the entire stage scheme, surround included, swaps to its alternate state in which blob and surround tones exchange roles
interaction_model.visible_feedback: A simultaneous outward burst radiating from the pressed spot and a whole-stage tonal inversion of blobs and surround together, with the blobs remaining clearly separated from the surround in both states

interaction_model.affected_object: Every blob plus the stage scheme

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Regathering can be interrupted at any moment by new sweeping or pressing and resumes afterward from wherever the blobs are
interaction_model.state_change: Blobs are drawn back toward the center and re-form a resting huddle
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Blobs drift inward, slow, and settle into a calm cluster near the middle
interaction_model.input: Absence of input after any disturbance (autonomous settling)
interaction_model.affected_object: All displaced blobs

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: The stage guarantees nothing can be lost, so no reset control is ever needed
interaction_model.state_change: Outward travel is bounded and redirected back into the visible stage
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Blobs stay on screen at all times; none disappear off the edges
