experience_qualities: Physical yet weightless: things have momentum but no heaviness or resistance
Immediately legible without instructions, understandable within about a second of moving the pointer
Calm at rest, lively under touch
Consequence-free and open-ended: no score, no failure, no end
Glossy and tactile, inviting repeated idle fiddling
Whole-stage responsiveness on press, so the environment feels alive rather than just the objects
completion_and_return: No completion state exists; the experience is an endless loop of disturb-and-regather
Every disturbance self-resolves back to the calm center huddle without user action
Whichever of the two scheme states is active persists after each press until the next press inverts it again
The resting state is always reachable, so the scene never needs an explicit reset or restart affordance
locked_observable_requirements: Opens directly onto a plain, low-distraction, nearly featureless full-view stage with a small blob huddle already at rest near the center
No instructions, labels or controls are shown; affordance is communicated only by cursor change and motion
Sweeping motion over a blob displaces that blob along the sweep direction and changes its resting orientation
A still pointer changes nothing
Cursor visibly signals when it is over a blob
Press anywhere pushes every blob outward from the pressed point
The same press inverts the entire stage scheme including the surround, not just the blobs, and the blobs stay clearly separated from the surround in both states
Displaced blobs autonomously return toward the center and re-cluster into a calm resting state
Blobs can never leave the visible stage and can never be destroyed or permanently lost
No failure, scoring or terminal state exists
adaptable_details: Exact blob count within a small huddle
Any specific hues, and how light or dark either of the two scheme states sits, as long as blobs stay readably separated from the surround in both
Blob silhouettes and the degree of glossiness or softness
Timing of shove decay, tumble and regathering, as long as it still reads as physical and weightless
Strength and radius falloff of the press-driven outward burst
Which cursor form signals being over a blob
Whether the scheme inversion is instantaneous or a brief crossfade
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits any context where a small set of abstract, meaning-free objects is the entire foreground and the user is invited to poke at it without purpose, such as a standalone play view, a wordless opening screen or an idle diversion area. It stops being this Skill if the blobs carry data, labels or navigation targets, if objects can be permanently removed or captured, if a goal, score or end state is added, if foreground text or controls must sit legibly over the stage while the scheme inverts, or if the cluster is confined to a small inset panel rather than owning the view.

name: glowing_speck_swarm_shape_morph
description: On an empty, low-distraction screen a cloud of tiny glowing specks sweeps in, gathers into a sculpted shape that never stops drifting and shimmering, and on any click unravels and streams into a second shape, flaring markedly brighter while in flight and easing back to its resting intensity as it settles.

canonical_document.name: glowing_speck_swarm_shape_morph
canonical_document.description: On an empty, low-distraction screen a cloud of tiny glowing specks sweeps in, gathers into a sculpted shape that never stops drifting and shimmering, and on any click unravels and streams into a second shape, flaring markedly brighter while in flight and easing back to its resting intensity as it settles.
canonical_document.experience_scope: A whole-view experience: it begins the moment the view is entered, with the stage empty and the subject absent, and never ends. It occupies the full frame as the only visual content, and can also be applied to a large self-contained section that behaves as its own uninterrupted stage.
content_and_composition: One subject at a time, formed entirely from a single population of many tiny glowing specks that share one visual material.
Exactly two target silhouettes are reachable; the same speck material composes both, so the two shapes read as one substance in different arrangements.
An empty, uniform stage whose tone sits far enough in luminance from the speck material for the specks to read clearly against it, with no competing imagery, panels, decoration or secondary content.
A resting luminance gradient across the gathered shape gives it internal depth and volume rather than a flat fill.
One short standing text label near the bottom edge, small and permanently visible, whose only job is to say that clicking is the single available action.
The subject is centred as the sole focal mass; the label sits well outside it and never overlaps or competes with it.
experience_progression: Arrival: the stage is empty and no shape exists yet.
Entry gathering: specks sweep in from one side of the frame as a cloud and converge until the first silhouette becomes recognizable without any explanation.
Resting shimmer: the gathered shape holds its silhouette while the specks keep drifting and shimmering inside it, so it never appears frozen.
Transition: on demand the whole swarm unravels from the current silhouette and streams across the stage.
Re-gathering: the same material converges into the other silhouette and returns to a calm settled state.
Endless alternation: resting and transition stages repeat indefinitely; either shape can be reached again as many times as wanted, with no final state and no completion screen.
attention_and_information_flow: Attention is held by the subject at all times because nothing else on the stage has visual weight.
The entry gathering teaches the subject: information is revealed by accumulation, from meaningless cloud to legible silhouette.
During travel the swarm becomes markedly brighter and more intense, pulling attention to the motion itself rather than to either silhouette; identity is briefly unreadable on purpose.
As specks arrive their intensity eases back toward the resting gradient, and attention shifts from movement to the newly legible shape.
The standing label is the only informational element and stays deliberately quiet, read once and then ignored.
Resting shimmer keeps a low continuous level of liveliness so the view never reads as a static image.

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Runs unprompted and needs no input; a click during the entry gathering is accepted like any other click and simply retargets the swarm from wherever it is
interaction_model.state_change: From absent subject to first gathered silhouette
interaction_model.visible_feedback: A cloud of glowing specks sweeps in from one side of the frame and condenses until the shape is recognizable
interaction_model.input: Autonomous start on arrival
interaction_model.affected_object: The speck population and the empty stage

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Accepted at any moment; no cooldown, no queueing and no rejection of input
interaction_model.state_change: Current target silhouette is replaced by the other one; the swarm leaves its resting state and enters travel
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Specks immediately break formation and stream toward the other shape, flaring markedly brighter and more intense while moving fast
interaction_model.input: Click anywhere on the stage surface
interaction_model.affected_object: The entire speck swarm

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Reversal is continuous from the current positions: no snapping to a start state, no reset of the shape, no queued second transition and no stuck or broken arrangement however rapidly clicks arrive
interaction_model.state_change: Target is swapped back while specks are still in motion
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The stream turns around from wherever the specks currently are and heads back, continuously and without a jump or restart
interaction_model.input: Click during an in-progress transformation
interaction_model.affected_object: The swarm mid-flight

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Resting is the stable state and is re-enterable from either shape any number of times; a new click can interrupt the settling at any point
interaction_model.state_change: Travel state resolves into resting state
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Brightness and intensity ease back into the resting gradient while specks slow and hover, drifting and shimmering inside the fixed silhouette
interaction_model.input: Arrival of specks at the target silhouette
interaction_model.affected_object: Swarm brightness, intensity and motion

experience_qualities: Atmospheric and calm at rest, energetic and intense during change
Alive rather than animated: the shape breathes and shimmers instead of holding still
Material continuity: both shapes are plainly made of the same substance
Legible without instruction beyond a single short prompt
Forgiving and unbreakable under impatient or repeated input
Minimal and undistracting, with a single point of light and focus
completion_and_return: There is no completion state, end screen or terminal shape.
Each transformation completes by resolving into a calm settled shape, which is the stable resting condition.
The experience alternates indefinitely between the two shapes and remains available for further changes forever.
No reset action exists or is needed; the current shape simply persists until the next click.
The standing prompt label persists unchanged through every stage.
locked_observable_requirements: The stage is a plain uninterrupted surround, clearly separated in luminance from the speck material, and holds no content other than the subject and one short standing prompt.
The subject is composed of many tiny glowing specks; the same population forms both shapes.
The first shape is not present on arrival: it must be seen assembling from a cloud that sweeps in from one side of the frame.
The gathered shape never freezes; continuous internal drift and shimmer inside a stable silhouette is required.
Transformation reads as unravelling and re-gathering of the same material, not as a fade, cut, wipe or replacement.
Specks flare noticeably brighter and more intense while travelling and ease back to the resting gradient as they arrive.
A click anywhere on the surface triggers the change; clicking is the only action.
Input is accepted at any moment, including mid-transformation, and mid-flight reversal continues from current speck positions with no reset and no queueing.
Exactly two reachable shapes, each re-reachable without limit, with no end state.
A small permanent bottom-edge label tells the visitor that clicking is the one thing to do.
adaptable_details: What the two silhouettes depict, and whether they are figurative, symbolic or purely abstract
Speck count, size and density, the hue family of specks and surround, which of the two is the lighter one, and the exact resting gradient
Which side of the frame the entry cloud sweeps in from
How long entry, travel and settling take, and the pacing curve of each
Intensity of shimmer at rest and of the bright flare in flight
Wording, size and typography of the standing prompt label
Whether the swarm reads as flat or volumetric, and the sense of depth in its motion
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits any context that can give up a full uninterrupted frame to one wordless subject and offers a single toggling action: opening screens, teaser and concept pages, mood-setting sections between text, and dual-identity or duality statements where two symbolic forms must feel made of the same substance. It does not fit stages that must also carry readable foreground text, imagery or controls over the subject, since the shimmer and bright flares would compete with them. Requiring more than two reachable shapes, sequencing the changes automatically instead of on demand, driving the swarm continuously by pointer position or scroll, or replacing granular speck material with a solid deforming body would each produce a different Skill.

name: stamped_mosaic_readout_of_a_picture
description: One large centred picture on a quiet low-distraction ground is read in order while notes play; each just-sounded spot is stamped as a flat solid-colour tile sampled from that spot and edged by a thin high-contrast outline, so a coarse mosaic creeps across the image marking the reading frontier, and the picture is left whole again when the run ends.

canonical_document.name: stamped_mosaic_readout_of_a_picture
canonical_document.description: One large centred picture on a quiet low-distraction ground is read in order while notes play; each just-sounded spot is stamped as a flat solid-colour tile sampled from that spot and edged by a thin high-contrast outline, so a coarse mosaic creeps across the image marking the reading frontier, and the picture is left whole again when the run ends.
canonical_document.experience_scope: A single centred stage region that holds one picture; the experience begins the moment a picture is chosen or handed over and ends when the run finishes on its own or is stopped, after which the stage shows the untouched picture again. content_and_composition: Exactly one picture at a time, presented large and centred as the sole focal subject
A quiet low-distraction background field, clearly separated in luminance from the picture, with nothing competing for attention around it

Selection or hand-over immediately places the picture on stage and starts the reading with no separate start step
Stepwise advance: one note sounds, the matching spot is stamped, and the pair repeats so position, colour and sound stay locked together
Accumulation: the stamped tiles grow into a coarse mosaic whose edge shows exactly how far the reading has reached
Self-conclusion: the run ends by itself once the whole picture has been read
Return: the overlay clears and the picture is shown whole again, inviting the next picture
attention_and_information_flow: Arrival gives the picture uncontested prominence against a surround that recedes from it
Attention shifts to the advancing stamped frontier, which reads as the current position in the run
Within seconds the viewer can connect three things at once: how far the reading has gone, the colours found there, and what is heard
Tile colours reveal the picture's local palette as a simplified swatch record of what has already sounded
On completion attention returns to the restored whole picture rather than to any summary or report

interaction_model.affected_object: The centred stage picture and the overlay layer

interaction_model.affected_object: The centred stage picture and the overlay layer

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: The run terminates on its own at the end and the picture is restored whole

interaction_model.visible_feedback: Each just-sounded spot becomes a flat tile of the colour found there, edged by a thin high-contrast outline, extending the mosaic in reading order
interaction_model.input: Autonomous step-by-step advance of the run
interaction_model.affected_object: The mosaic overlay and the audible sequence

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Starting again resumes from the first position at the top-left corner rather than from where it stopped
interaction_model.state_change: Playback halts and the overlay is discarded
interaction_model.visible_feedback: All sound ceases at once and the untouched picture reappears with no residual tiles

interaction_model.affected_object: Sound and the mosaic overlay

interaction_model.state_change: New settings take effect from the next step onward without interrupting the run
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The mosaic keeps advancing uninterrupted while the character of the sound changes at the next note
interaction_model.input: Adjusting loudness, pace, note length, tone character or musical scale
interaction_model.affected_object: The ongoing sequence while the visible stamping continues

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Acknowledging dismisses the confirmation, re-enables the controls and lets the reading begin normally
interaction_model.state_change: The experience holds in a pre-start state until acknowledged
interaction_model.visible_feedback: A small centred confirmation appears over the stage and the controls read as inert

interaction_model.affected_object: The stage and all adjusters

experience_qualities: Calm, uncluttered and single-subject
Explainable rather than random: cause and effect are visible and audible together
Playful and light in tone, toy-like rather than instrumental
Steady, creeping accumulation with a clear sense of progress
Quiet, gallery-like presentation whose surround recedes so the picture stays dominant
Non-destructive: the picture always survives the run intact
completion_and_return: The run ends by itself when the whole picture has been read
The stamped overlay is removed at the end so the picture is left whole
Stopping produces the same restored state immediately
Restarting always begins from the top-left corner rather than resuming mid-run
The restored whole picture acts as the invitation to load the next one; no mosaic state persists between runs
locked_observable_requirements: Exactly one picture presented large and centred against a low-distraction surround clearly separated from it in luminance, with nothing competing for attention
Reading starts immediately on selection or hand-over, with no separate start gesture
Each audible step stamps the corresponding spot as a single flat colour sampled from that spot, edged by a thin outline that stays high-contrast against the fill
Stamps accumulate into a coarse mosaic whose extent shows exactly how far the reading has reached

adaptable_details: Subject matter and aspect ratio of the pictures
Number of offered sample pictures
Coarseness of the mosaic tiles and thickness or contrast strength of the outline
Exact hue and luminance level of the surrounding field, whether light or dark, as long as it recedes from the picture

Which sound parameters are exposed and how the adjusters are arranged
Wording and styling of the pre-start confirmation
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits any single-image stage where a time-ordered process reads through the picture and must show its position, and where the picture must be returned unmodified afterwards; the picture may be supplied by the site or by the viewer, and the surround may be light or dark so long as it recedes from the picture. It becomes a different Skill if several pictures are read at once, if the mosaic persists as a finished artwork instead of clearing, if the transformation is a continuous filter or dissolve rather than discrete stamped tiles with visible outlines, if the position is driven by pointer or scroll instead of advancing on its own, or if the overlay no longer takes its colour from the picture underneath.

name: drifting_water_surface_vantage

Compositional weight settling toward the middle of the frame, where the eye is meant to rest
A brief uniform, detail-free full-frame holding field present only at entry, then absent for the rest of the experience

As the scene takes over, prominence gathers at the middle of the frame rather than at edges or corners
Within the sustained state, momentary prominence moves with the highest-luminance glints on the ripples while the lower-contrast depth stays recessive

adaptable_details: Water hue, overall tonal level and lighting temperature, including whether the scene reads light or dark

canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits any whole-view natural surface or atmosphere meant to be watched rather than used — water, cloud, mist, grass, sand — where a single continuously animating expanse is seen from one slowly moving vantage and the page carries no dense foreground content. It becomes a different Skill if the scene advances through discrete stops or destinations, if the drag moves or selects content instead of the vantage angle, if the motion accumulates so reversing no longer immediately undoes it, if the view snaps back to a default angle on release, or if substantial text, controls or navigation must remain legible over the frame.

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Repeated resizing in both directions refits correctly every time; the ongoing depth advance and hue turn continue uninterrupted, with no restart, jump or jolt
interaction_model.state_change: The unit refits to the new viewport: it scales down proportionally when space is tight and holds its natural size when space is ample
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The whole scene shrinks or holds as a single piece with breathing room preserved around it; the photograph is never cropped and nothing spills past the viewport edge or creates scrollbars
interaction_model.input: Viewer resizes the window
interaction_model.affected_object: The entire framed composition treated as one unit

experience_qualities: Meditative and unhurried
Cinematic — light and framing carry as much as content
Already-underway rather than introduced
Immersive: text felt as space rather than read as information
Endless with nothing to wait for and nothing to complete
Watch-only; stillness from the viewer is the intended posture
completion_and_return: No completion state and no terminal frame
Cycles by returning to the opening framing and continuing seamlessly
Suitable for indefinite unattended display on a screen
Resize does not reset the cycle; motion state persists across refits
locked_observable_requirements: Runs entirely on its own; no clicking, dragging, scrolling or hovering drives any part of it
Text appears at a scale where it constitutes the space, with only fragments legible at any moment and a few words dominant
A single small figure within a landscape anchors the scene and is the first thing to register along with the light
Depth advance is continuous and inward, never stepwise and never paused
Light hue turns continuously across the whole frame, affecting image and words alike, with no particular starting hue required
Framing returns to its opening state without a visible restart, and the loop is unbounded
No progress, duration, completion or control affordances are visible
The composition rescales as one framed unit: proportional shrink with margin when constrained, natural size when unconstrained, never cropping the image, never producing scrollbars
Resizing back and forth refits correctly and never restarts or jolts the motion in progress
adaptable_details: Subject of the photograph, as long as it stays a single figure within a wide space
Text content, language and line breaks
Typeface, letter treatment and how fragments are distributed in depth
Hue range and rate of the colour turn
Speed and length of the depth cycle
Frame aspect ratio and the amount of margin on narrow viewports
Which words are chosen as the dominant ones
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits evocative long-form text paired with one atmospheric image where partial legibility is acceptable and the goal is mood — opening views, standing display screens, idle states, poster-like landing views. It becomes a different Skill if the text must be fully read or navigated, if the viewer gains control of position, pacing or sequence, if the composition must reflow into a scrolling document instead of holding as one framed unit, or if it must sit behind separate foreground content as a substrate rather than being the view itself.

name: hazy_depth_creature_field_with_pointer_steered_vantage
description: An endless fogged field densely populated with small worm-like bodies, sharp and readable up close and dissolving into haze with distance, watched from a slowly self-swaying vantage whose elevation follows pointer height from horizon level up to a near top-down view.

canonical_document.name: hazy_depth_creature_field_with_pointer_steered_vantage
canonical_document.description: An endless fogged field densely populated with small worm-like bodies, sharp and readable up close and dissolving into haze with distance, watched from a slowly self-swaying vantage whose elevation follows pointer height from horizon level up to a near top-down view.
canonical_document.experience_scope: Whole-view experience that fills the visible surface from the moment the page opens; it has no entry screen, no boundaries within the view and no end, so it begins on load and simply continues while the view is open.
content_and_composition: One continuous scene volume presented as the entire view, with no panels, text, prompts or dismissible layers overlaid on it
Many small worm-like creature bodies distributed through the volume, densely enough that individuals are never the whole subject
Near creatures rendered legibly enough that individual bodies and their wriggling are distinguishable in detail
Mid and far creatures progressively softened by an atmospheric haze until they fade out entirely, so no hard edge or horizon of population is visible
A ground plane implied as the lower boundary of the field, which the vantage never passes beneath
The vantage point itself is a persistent element: always inside the field, never showing an outside frame or edge of the world
attention_and_information_flow: On open, attention lands immediately on the scene because nothing competes for reading or choosing
Prominence alternates naturally between the nearest wriggling body, which offers detail, and the fading depth, which offers extent
The slow autonomous sway of the vantage keeps re-weighting which bodies are nearest and most legible, so no single subject stays dominant
Raising the vantage toward top-down shifts the emphasis from individual near bodies to the overall spread and density of the field; lowering it toward horizon restores depth and the fade into haze
No stage ever reveals new information or content; only the reading of the same field changes

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Never stops, never visibly restarts or snaps; continues underneath and alongside any pointer-driven change
interaction_model.state_change: Vantage orientation and position sway slowly and unendingly without user involvement
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The whole field appears to breathe and shift gently, with bodies sliding between crisp foreground and hazy distance
interaction_model.input: Autonomous continuous drift of the vantage point
interaction_model.affected_object: The scene vantage and, through it, which creatures appear nearest

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Not user controllable; motion has no perceptible loop point or reset, so any arrived-at moment looks equally alive
interaction_model.state_change: Bodies wriggle continuously and independently
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Near bodies show legible articulated squirming; distant ones read only as faint stirring inside the haze
interaction_model.input: Autonomous motion of the creature bodies
interaction_model.affected_object: Individual creatures throughout the field

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Fully reversible: moving the pointer back retraces the same angles exactly; both ends are hard-clamped so the view can never tip past overhead or sink below the ground plane, and stopping the pointer simply holds that angle while the autonomous sway continues
interaction_model.state_change: Pointer toward the bottom of the view raises the vantage toward looking almost straight down; pointer toward the top settles it back to horizon level, mapped continuously across the range
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The view tilts and rises immediately and smoothly in step with the pointer, with the haze-fade and legible near bodies rearranging as the angle changes
interaction_model.input: Pointer vertical position moved anywhere over the view
interaction_model.affected_object: Vantage elevation and viewing angle onto the field

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: First pointer movement takes over continuously from this held angle without a jump
interaction_model.state_change: Holds a single fixed, slightly raised angled view
interaction_model.visible_feedback: An immediately legible three-quarter-style look into the field showing both near detail and receding haze
interaction_model.input: No pointer movement yet since opening
interaction_model.affected_object: Vantage elevation

experience_qualities: Damp, foggy and enveloping
Endless — no visible edge, wall or population boundary
Unhurried and unpressured, with nothing to complete
Alive at every moment rather than building toward a peak
Directly responsive: vantage change feels like leaning rather than triggering
completion_and_return: No completion, goal, score or return point
No visible loop seam or restart in either creature motion or vantage drift
No persisted state: reopening simply resumes the held slightly raised angle and the same unending liveliness
locked_observable_requirements: Opens directly into the scene with nothing to read, choose or dismiss
Many small creature bodies, not a single hero subject
Distance-based softening into haze that ends in complete fade-out, so the field reads as endless
Near bodies legible in individual detail while far ones are not
Vantage sways slowly on its own, independent of any input
Pointer height maps continuously and immediately to vantage elevation, with exact retracing on reverse movement
Hard clamps at near-top-down and horizon level; the view can never pass overhead or go below the ground
A fixed, slightly raised angled view held before any pointer movement
No perceptible restart in any motion
adaptable_details: Colour treatment and overall tonal register, including whether the field reads light or dark, plus fog density and light quality — any hue family works so long as near bodies stay clearly separated from the haze and the fade with distance stays smooth
Creature count, size distribution and body proportions
Exact wriggle rhythm and speed
Amplitude and period of the autonomous sway
Precise elevation values at the two clamped extremes and the resting angle in between
Whether the ground plane is textured, plain or barely visible
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits whole-view atmospheric pieces whose subject is a dense population of small autonomous bodies in a hazy depth volume and whose only interaction is steering the vantage. Adding readable foreground content, selectable or clickable creatures, navigation between scenes, a narrative or staged sequence, an end state, or replacing the swarm with a single focal subject or a static image would make it a different Skill; so would removing the distance fade-out or the continuous reversible pointer-to-elevation coupling, since those are what make the field feel endless and inhabited.

name: board_scene_scripted_buildup_to_final_move
description: A straight-down view of a grained game board on a woven surface with lidded solid containers beside it: the grid draws itself stroke by stroke, the containers open, a match plays out one slow move at a time as the piece supply visibly dwindles, and the last empty point becomes the viewer's single, irreversible move that captures a surrounded group into an upturned lid.

canonical_document.name: board_scene_scripted_buildup_to_final_move
canonical_document.description: A straight-down view of a grained game board on a woven surface with lidded solid containers beside it: the grid draws itself stroke by stroke, the containers open, a match plays out one slow move at a time as the piece supply visibly dwindles, and the last empty point becomes the viewer's single, irreversible move that captures a surrounded group into an upturned lid.
canonical_document.experience_scope: Whole-view single-region experience occupying the main viewing area. Begins automatically on page load with a bare board on its surrounding surface and ends in a terminal settled position immediately after the viewer's one action; there are no other regions, screens or modes.
content_and_composition: One central board object seen straight down, occupying most of the view, with visible material grain and thickness
A textured surface layer behind and around the board, filling the view edge to edge as the scene's floor
Two lidded containers resting on that surface at opposite sides of the board, each holding a visible heap of playing pieces belonging to one side
One container lid, turned upside down beside its container, used as the receptacle for removed pieces

Board grid of intersecting lines plus a few marker points; pieces sit on intersections in two clearly separated appearances that stay distinguishable at a glance, each with soft rounded highlights and cast shadows
Persistent throughout: board, surrounding surface, both containers, the upturned lid and every piece already placed
No interface chrome, buttons, captions or instructional text anywhere in the scene
experience_progression: Stage 1: bare board resting on its surface, grid not yet present, containers closed
Stage 2: grid appears stroke by stroke until the full lattice is complete
Stage 3: container lids lift away, revealing the two heaps of pieces
Stage 4: autonomous playback places pieces one at a time in alternating sides at an unhurried, readable cadence, each placement removing one piece from its own heap
Stage 5: the active area of the board tightens and the remaining choices narrow until a single empty point is left
Stage 6: playback stops and the turn plainly belongs to the viewer; that one point becomes the only targetable thing in the scene
Stage 7: the viewer activates it — the piece lands, the enclosed opposing group is lifted away and shown gathered in the upturned lid
Stage 8: the scene rests in its finished position with nothing further to do
attention_and_information_flow: Early attention is on the scene assembling itself: line strokes accumulating, then lids opening to reveal the supply
During playback attention follows each newly placed piece, with the shrinking heaps acting as a quiet progress reading of how far the sequence has gone
The unhurried one-at-a-time pacing keeps the developing shape of the position legible instead of arriving as a finished cluster
Late in playback interest contracts from the whole board to one contested cluster and the single vacancy inside it
At handoff the lone responsive point is the only affordance in the scene, so the required action reads without any written prompt
After the action attention moves to the removed pieces collected in the lid, which confirms the outcome and closes the sequence

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Runs to completion on its own; cannot be skipped, paused or replayed except by reloading the page
interaction_model.state_change: Empty board with no grid and closed containers becomes a fully drawn grid with open containers and exposed piece heaps
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Grid lines appear progressively stroke by stroke; lids lift off to reveal heaps of pieces
interaction_model.input: Page load, then an autonomous timeline
interaction_model.affected_object: Board grid and container lids

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: No pausing, scrubbing or speed control; the sequence always plays the same ordered moves
interaction_model.state_change: Each step adds one piece to a specific intersection and removes one piece from the corresponding heap, alternating between the two sides
interaction_model.visible_feedback: A piece settles onto an intersection at a calm, readable interval; the source heap visibly thins as the position fills in
interaction_model.input: Autonomous move clock after setup completes
interaction_model.affected_object: Board intersections and the two supply heaps

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Pointing can neither advance, interrupt nor alter the playback in any way
interaction_model.state_change: None
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Nothing responds — no highlight, no cursor affordance, no movement; the board reads as inert scenery
interaction_model.input: Pointing at, hovering over or clicking anywhere on the board while playback is still running
interaction_model.affected_object: All board intersections

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: One-way and final: the point stops responding, there is no undo, retry or reset control, and only reloading the page replays the whole scene from the bare board
interaction_model.state_change: The empty point becomes occupied by a piece of the acting side; the enclosed opposing-side group changes from on-board to removed; the lid changes from empty to holding those removed pieces; the acting heap loses the piece that was played
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The piece lands immediately with no hesitation, the surrounded pieces lift off the board, and they reappear gathered inside the upturned lid beside the container they were captured by
interaction_model.input: Activating the single remaining empty point after playback halts
interaction_model.affected_object: That intersection, the surrounded opposing group, the upturned lid and the acting side's heap

experience_qualities: Looking down into a real physical setting rather than at a diagram
Tangible materials: grain, weave, rounded pieces, soft shadows
Calm, unhurried cadence that keeps a developing situation readable
A sense of supply being consumed as the scene progresses
Tension narrowing from the whole board to one point
An obvious, instruction-free handoff of the turn to the viewer
A decisive, settled ending with nothing left to adjust
completion_and_return: Ends in a single terminal state; the experience does not loop or auto-restart
The finished position, the emptied portion of the heap and the collected pieces in the lid remain on screen indefinitely
No in-scene reset, replay or share affordance exists
A full page reload is the only way to see the sequence again, and it restarts from the bare board
locked_observable_requirements: Straight-down view of one physical board object with a surrounding material surface and side containers holding piece supplies
The grid is built by progressive stroke-by-stroke reveal before any piece appears
Containers visibly open before playback begins
Pieces are placed autonomously one at a time alternating between the two sides, whose pieces stay clearly separable at a glance, at a slow, readable cadence
Each supply heap visibly loses pieces in step with the placements it makes
Nothing on the board responds to pointing at any time before the handoff
Exactly one targetable empty point exists at handoff, and no written instruction explains it
Activating it immediately places the piece, lifts the fully enclosed opposing group off the board, and shows those pieces gathered in the upturned lid of the capturing side's container
The played piece is subtracted from its own heap
The action is irreversible: the point goes dead, no undo or replay control is offered, and only a reload restarts the scene
adaptable_details: Board dimensions and grid density
Number and identity of the scripted moves in the playback
Board and surface material tones, texture treatment, the specific appearance chosen for each side's pieces, and the character of the illumination
Exact stroke-reveal, lid-opening and per-move timing and easing
Amount of perspective or tilt in the top-down camera
How many pieces the final action removes
Container and lid placement relative to the board
Whether the final point is activated by click, tap or keyboard
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits any content that can be staged as one physical tabletop object whose state accumulates piece by piece toward a single decisive placement — turn-based grid games, puzzle boards, tile or token layouts, sample trays and similar finite arrangements with a visible supply. It requires a fixed scripted sequence, a visibly depleting source of items, and exactly one terminal viewer action. Any board, surface and piece finishes work as long as the two sides remain plainly separable and the pieces read against the board. It becomes a different skill if the viewer plays freely or takes multiple turns, if playback loops or exposes pause and scrub controls, if several points are interactive at once, or if the scene is flattened into an abstract diagram or panelled interface instead of a lit physical tableau.

name: click_shattered_glass_photo
description: One quiet centered photo that instantly breaks like glass at the exact clicked spot, splitting into displaced, unevenly lit pieces divided by seams that read clearly against the shard faces they border, with a different random break on every click and a key press to restore the pristine picture.

canonical_document.name: click_shattered_glass_photo
canonical_document.description: One quiet centered photo that instantly breaks like glass at the exact clicked spot, splitting into displaced, unevenly lit pieces divided by seams that read clearly against the shard faces they border, with a different random break on every click and a key press to restore the pristine picture.
canonical_document.experience_scope: A whole-view experience built around a single image region: it begins on landing with the untouched photo centered in a plain surround, continues through repeated break and restore states driven by the visitor, and never leaves the same framed picture area. The plain surround and a small persistent instruction line are part of the view; nothing scrolls away or navigates elsewhere.
content_and_composition: Exactly one photographic image as the sole subject, centered and sized to hold all attention
A plain, quiet, low-distraction surround behind and around the image with no competing content
A fracture layer bound to the image: crack seams and separated pieces occupying the same footprint as the original photo, so the picture reads as being seen through a cracked pane

Pieces are irregular polygonal shards of the photo, each slightly offset and rotated from its original position, edged by seam lines that stay clearly distinguishable from the shard faces they border, and carrying slightly uneven luminance relative to neighbors
Crack density varies spatially: crowded, fine fragmentation around the impact point, progressively sparser and larger pieces toward the outer areas
One small always-visible line of text stating both available actions (click to break, key to clear and restore), placed unobtrusively outside the image so it never competes with it
The image footprint stays fixed: breaking does not resize, reflow or move the overall picture area
experience_progression: Pristine state: a single quiet, whole photo centered and undisturbed
Impact: on click, fracture appears immediately at the clicked point with no perceptible delay or build-up
Cracked state persists: the photo remains readable through the crack pattern indefinitely, with no decay, settling or falling pieces
Re-break: a further click discards the entire previous pattern and replaces it with a completely different one centered on the new point
Restore: a key press wipes all damage back to the pristine photo; the next press brings the damage back, and the cycle can continue from any state
attention_and_information_flow: On arrival, attention is pulled to the single centered photo by isolation and emptiness around it
At the moment of impact, attention snaps to the exact clicked spot because that is where fragmentation is densest and finest
After impact, attention spreads outward along the crack seams toward the calmer, sparser outer areas
The photo's content stays legible throughout, so recognition of the subject never gives way to the effect
The instruction line stays quietly readable at all times, keeping both actions discoverable without drawing attention from the image
Each new break re-anchors attention at the new impact point, and the freshly different pattern signals that the result is not a repeat

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Every further click fully replaces the damage, so nothing can pile up irrecoverably; the pristine photo is always one key press away
interaction_model.state_change: Pristine or previously cracked photo becomes a newly fractured photo whose crack origin is the clicked point; any prior pattern is discarded outright rather than accumulated
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Cracks appear spreading out from the hit point with no delay: crowded and fine at the impact, sparser toward the edges; the resulting pieces are visibly nudged, tilted and outlined by seams that separate clearly from the shard faces, with uneven luminance between pieces, while the photo stays recognizable
interaction_model.input: Click anywhere on the picture
interaction_model.affected_object: The whole photo surface and its fracture layer

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: The toggle works from any state and is repeatable, giving an always-available return to the untouched picture and back again
interaction_model.state_change: Damage is toggled: present damage is wiped back to the pristine photo, and the following press brings the damage back
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The picture reads as whole and clean with all seams and displacement gone, then reappears broken on the next press
interaction_model.input: Key press (a single named key stated in the instruction line)
interaction_model.affected_object: The fracture layer over the photo

experience_qualities: Playful and tactile: the break feels physical and caused by the visitor's own hit
Instant and unhesitating, with no waiting, staging or easing before the result is visible
Locally violent but globally calm: intense at the impact, quiet toward the edges and quiet all around the image
Fresh each time, so repeated clicking feels like a new break rather than a replay
Reassuring: the undamaged original always feels one step away
Restrained overall, since a single picture on a plain surround carries the whole view
completion_and_return: No end state: the experience persists in whichever state the visitor last produced
Cracked state is stable and does not resolve, settle or animate onward by itself
A key press returns to the pristine photo; the next press restores the damage, making return fully reversible
Repeated clicking is an open loop of replacement rather than accumulation
locked_observable_requirements: One single photo, centered against a plain, low-distraction surround that keeps it clearly separated, holding all attention
Fracture originates at the exact clicked point with no perceptible delay
Crack density gradient: fine and crowded at the impact point, sparser and coarser toward the outer areas
Resulting pieces are visibly displaced, tilted and edged by seams that stay clearly distinguishable from the shard faces they border, with uneven luminance between neighbors
The photo remains perfectly recognizable while broken; it reads as seen through a cracked pane
Each break is visibly different from the last rather than a repeated pattern
A new click discards the previous damage entirely instead of adding to it
A key press wipes damage back to the pristine photo and a further press brings it back
A small always-visible line of text states both the click and key actions
The image footprint and layout stay fixed across all states
adaptable_details: Photo subject, aspect ratio and size
Surround treatment and tone, as long as it stays plain, quiet and clearly separated from the image
Which key performs the wipe and restore, and the exact wording and placement of the instruction line
Number, size and shape irregularity of the pieces
Magnitude of displacement and tilt, seam contrast direction, strength and thickness, and amount of luminance variation
How far the crack field extends toward the outer areas
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits any context where a single photographic image is the centerpiece of a view and can be acted on directly, including playful landing pages, a hero image, or a standalone showcase of one picture. It stops fitting where the image is one of many in a grid or gallery, is a background substrate behind reading content, or must stay pristine for its informational role. Making the pieces fall, scatter or settle over time, accumulating damage across multiple clicks, driving the effect by hover or scroll instead of a discrete hit, or applying it to text and interface surfaces instead of one photo would each create a different skill.

name: hanging_cloth_thread_tear_stage
description: A single sheet of cloth hangs alone in an empty, visually quiet field that stays clearly separated from it in lightness, swaying to a standstill; dragging a held pointer across it snaps the threads nearest the moving point so the weave slackens, tears widen with repeated sweeps, and loosened remnants swing and droop low in the frame for good.

canonical_document.name: hanging_cloth_thread_tear_stage
canonical_document.description: A single sheet of cloth hangs alone in an empty, visually quiet field that stays clearly separated from it in lightness, swaying to a standstill; dragging a held pointer across it snaps the threads nearest the moving point so the weave slackens, tears widen with repeated sweeps, and loosened remnants swing and droop low in the frame for good.
canonical_document.experience_scope: Whole-view experience that begins the moment the view opens, with the cloth already hanging in place and mid-sway; it has no end point and continues as long as the view is shown, whether or not the visitor keeps interacting.
content_and_composition: One hanging soft-material sheet as the sole foreground subject, suspended from a fixed upper edge or anchor line so its weight hangs downward
Empty, low-distraction surrounding field held at a clearly different lightness from the sheet, with no ornament, panels, labels or instructional copy competing with the cloth
The sheet reads as a woven mesh: many fine internal connections whose loss is individually visible as a gap and collectively visible as sag
Torn-free portions remain present as slack remnants and gather in the lower part of the frame rather than leaving the composition
No persistent interface elements; the pointer or touch point is the only implicit cursor of activity
experience_progression: Opening: the cloth is already installed and quietly swaying, its motion damping to a near standstill so the material's weight is legible before anything is touched
First contact: isolated severings create small local openings and a visible local slackening
Spreading damage: repeated sweeps over the same region widen existing openings into larger tears rather than adding scattered marks
Loosening: the sheet progressively loses support, hangs from fewer anchors and swings with looser, longer motion
Late state: only slack remnants remain, drooping and gathering low in the frame
No finish line: whatever state it has been left in simply keeps settling and swaying
attention_and_information_flow: Emptiness and the quiet, clearly separated surround push all prominence onto the single hanging object from the first frame
Before interaction, attention is carried by material behaviour: weight, stretch, sag and residual swing
During interaction, prominence shifts to the growing damage and the newly freed edges that move most
Sagging and swinging act as the only feedback channel about how much support has been lost, so structural state is read visually rather than reported
Late in the experience attention drifts downward with the remnants, following the material's accumulated collapse

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Releasing the press stops all cutting; movement away from the material, or beyond the short reach, has no effect and leaves the sheet untouched
interaction_model.state_change: Whichever connection lies closest to the moving point is severed, and only connections within a short reach of that point are eligible
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The severed strand disappears instantly and the surrounding weave immediately goes slack and starts swinging from whatever still holds it
interaction_model.input: Press and hold, then move the pointer across the hanging material
interaction_model.affected_object: The internal connections of the woven sheet nearest the moving point

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Cuts cannot be undone; there is no repair, restore or reset action, so the visitor can only stop, not reverse
interaction_model.state_change: Adjacent surviving connections are severed so the opening grows outward
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The tear visibly widens and the flaps on either side hang and swing more freely
interaction_model.input: Repeated sweeps of a held pointer across an already damaged region
interaction_model.affected_object: An existing opening in the sheet

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Lifting the finger stops cutting exactly as releasing the press does
interaction_model.state_change: Identical severing behaviour to pointer dragging
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Identical instant disappearance and local slackening
interaction_model.input: Touch drag
interaction_model.affected_object: The same nearest-connection targeting behaviour

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Resumes immediately whenever new cutting disturbs it; never restores lost structure
interaction_model.state_change: Motion damps toward rest under its own weight from whatever configuration exists
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Continued gentle swaying and sagging that gradually slows without fully freezing the sense of weight
interaction_model.input: Autonomous settling with no input
interaction_model.affected_object: The whole remaining sheet and its detached remnants

experience_qualities: Playful and immediately self-explanatory, with no onboarding needed
Physical and weighted: the material feels heavy, stretchy and slow rather than graphic or snappy
Tactile precision, since only what the pointer passes very close to is affected
Consequential, because every mark is permanent and visibly accumulates
Calm and open-ended, with quiet settling motion instead of a goal or score
Contained: destruction is messy but never leaves the visible frame
completion_and_return: No completion condition, success state, score or finish message
No reset, undo or repair path; the damaged configuration is the state going forward
The experience simply keeps settling in whatever condition it was left, remaining interactive if any material still holds
Detached pieces persist in the visible area instead of falling out of view
locked_observable_requirements: The material is already present and mid-motion when the view opens; no build-up, entrance sequence or explanatory prompt
The surrounding field is empty and visually quiet, and stays separated enough in lightness from the material that the material is the only foreground subject
Cutting requires a sustained press or touch plus movement, not a single click or hover
Only the connection closest to the moving point breaks, and only within a short reach, so movement off the material does nothing
A severed connection disappears instantly and the neighbouring material slackens and swings in the same moment
Damage is irreversible and cumulative: repeated passes over one area widen that opening
Loss of support is expressed through visible sag, longer swing and downward drift of remnants
Detached material stays inside the visible area and gathers low in the frame
There is no terminal state; motion continues to settle indefinitely from whatever configuration remains
adaptable_details: Exact material read of the sheet: cloth, netting, banner, curtain or comparable soft hanging surface
Suspension arrangement, aspect ratio and how much of the frame the sheet occupies
Coarseness of the weave and therefore how many severings a visible tear requires
Exact reach radius, damping rate and swing amplitude, as long as weight remains legible
Hue and lightness of both the material and the surrounding field, in either direction, as long as their separation stays clear, plus any subtle lighting or shading treatment
Whether a faint pointer trace or contact hint accompanies the drag
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits any page that can devote a full, otherwise empty view to one soft hanging object as its entire foreground, with the surround kept quiet and clearly separated from the material, where permanent visitor-made damage is acceptable and no reading, form input or navigation task shares the space. It also transfers to comparable suspended soft surfaces such as banners, nets or curtains. It becomes a different Skill if the object becomes rigid or shatters instead of sagging, if damage is repairable or resets, if cutting works by single clicks or hover instead of held dragging, if freed material falls out of view or accumulates as debris outside the frame, if a goal, score or completion state is introduced, or if the surrounding field carries competing foreground content and the material is reduced to a decorative backdrop.

name: cursor_ignited_rising_heat_field
description: A quiescent surface of chunky glowing blocks where the pointer paints instant peak-intensity fire that climbs, cools down through the ramp's mid and low stops, and burns itself out, with press-and-hold flaring the entire field hotter and taller.

canonical_document.name: cursor_ignited_rising_heat_field
canonical_document.description: A quiescent surface of chunky glowing blocks where the pointer paints instant peak-intensity fire that climbs, cools down through the ramp's mid and low stops, and burns itself out, with press-and-hold flaring the entire field hotter and taller.
canonical_document.experience_scope: A whole-view (or whole-panel) experience occupying the full surface with no chrome. It begins by itself on load from its unignited ground level and never ends: there is no completion state, only an idle burn that continues until the view is left or resized, at which point it restarts from that quiet ground.
content_and_composition: One single content role: a full-surface heat field, which is the entire foreground; no text, controls, HUD, counters or instructions
The field is rendered as visibly chunky, coarse blocks of heat, deliberately far coarser than the display's own pixel grid, so individual heat cells are readable as blocks

A single fixed intensity ramp maps heat from peak-luminance cores outward through progressively dimmer, more saturated mid stops, then a deep low-luminance stop, then into the unignited ground; each stop is clearly separable from its neighbours and luminance falls monotonically along the ramp
Heat is generated along the bottom edge of the field and travels upward, losing intensity as it climbs, so the composition reads as a bright dense base fading into the quiet ground above
One persistent idle flame anchored at the horizontal middle of the bottom edge whenever the user is not touching the surface
Transient user-made heat exists as an additional layer inside the same field: streaks and spots that share the same block grid and the same intensity ramp as the ambient burn
experience_progression: Opens at its unignited ground level, the whole surface sitting at the ramp's dimmest end with nothing yet burning
Unprompted, a flare of fire sweeps up from the bottom edge and burns itself out, demonstrating rise-and-cool behaviour so the metaphor is understood without instructions
Settles into a calm steady ambient state with a single flame alight at the middle
Enters open-ended play: user strokes and presses raise and drop intensity indefinitely, with no stage that ends the experience
On viewport resize the field refits the new dimensions and the sequence restarts from the unignited ground, replaying the opening flare
attention_and_information_flow: The peak-luminance cores are always the strongest attractor; the eye is then carried upward and outward along the cooling mid-to-low tail of the ramp
The opening flare briefly claims all attention, then deliberately releases it to a quiet ambient state that invites experimentation
The most recent point of contact is always the hottest and therefore the most prominent point on the surface, so attention tracks the user's own hand
During press-and-hold, prominence spreads from local streaks to the whole field as overall luminance and flame height rise together
As strokes cool, their information value fades to nothing, so the surface never becomes visually crowded or ambiguous

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: No undo is required or offered: each streak cools away by itself shortly after being drawn, so the surface self-clears and mistakes are impossible
interaction_model.state_change: Every crossed spot is set instantly to maximum heat, then rises and cools like the ambient fire
interaction_model.visible_feedback: An unbroken peak-intensity streak trails the movement and immediately begins climbing and fading behind it, remaining continuous rather than dotted even during fast motion
interaction_model.input: Pointer or finger moving across the surface, at any speed
interaction_model.affected_object: Heat cells along the traversed path

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Ends the moment the pointer moves on or leaves the surface; the spot then cools like any other stroke
interaction_model.state_change: Continuous heat injection at one point instead of along a path
interaction_model.visible_feedback: A single flame stays alight and steady at that spot, rising and cooling in place
interaction_model.input: Pointer held still on the surface
interaction_model.affected_object: Heat cells at that single location

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Fully released on release, with the field settling back to its base intensity; holding and releasing can be repeated freely and interrupting at any moment is safe
interaction_model.state_change: Global intensity raised for the duration of the hold
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The whole field burns hotter and taller: more peak-intensity cores, higher overall luminance, flames reaching further up the surface
interaction_model.input: Press and hold anywhere on the surface
interaction_model.affected_object: The entire heat field, ambient burn included

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Re-entering resumes injection immediately with no re-arming, delay or reset
interaction_model.state_change: Injection stops; all user heat decays back to the unignited ground while the ambient burn continues
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Streaks fade out and a single flame remains burning at the middle, so the surface is never fully dead
interaction_model.input: Pointer leaves the surface
interaction_model.affected_object: User-generated heat and the idle flame

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Repeatable at any time; the restart is the recovery, and no user-made state is expected to survive it
interaction_model.state_change: Field refits the new dimensions and restarts
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The surface returns to its unignited ground and the opening flare sweeps up from the bottom edge again
interaction_model.input: Viewport or container resize
interaction_model.affected_object: The heat field as a whole

experience_qualities: Instantly legible physical metaphor: heat rises and cools without any explanation
Coarse, chunky, low-resolution grain that reads as deliberate rather than degraded
Hot and luminous against a quiet low-luminance surround, with a distinctive multi-stop cooling signature that stays recognisable whatever hues fill it
Directly responsive: contact is felt as immediate maximum brightness with no lag or ramp-in
Self-cleaning and consequence-free, so play stays loose and repeatable
Calm and quietly alight when idle, violent and engulfing while pressed
Endless and unresolved: always something burning, never a finish
completion_and_return: No completion state and no success or failure; the experience is perpetual
Nothing accumulates: all user-injected heat decays on its own, so repeated play cannot saturate or permanently mark the surface
The resting state to which the experience always returns is the single centre flame over the quiet unignited ground
Resize is the only reset: it clears the field back to the unignited ground and replays the opening flare
No persisted state is carried between visits
locked_observable_requirements: Opens at its unignited ground with nothing burning, the surface reading as an even, quiet, low-energy field
An unprompted opening flare sweeps up from the bottom edge and burns itself out before any interaction
Heat is rendered as visibly chunky coarse blocks, clearly coarser than the display grid

Intensity is mapped through one fixed ramp of at least four separable stops whose luminance falls monotonically: a peak-bright core, then successively dimmer and more saturated mid stops, then a deep low-luminance stop, then the unignited ground
Heat originates at the bottom edge and rises upward while cooling
Any point the pointer touches becomes maximum-hot instantly, with no build-up delay
Fast movement still produces one unbroken continuous streak, not a dotted trail
Holding the pointer still keeps one single spot alight
Press-and-hold raises heat and flame height across the whole field and fully relaxes on release
User heat never accumulates: strokes cool away by themselves
One flame remains burning at the horizontal middle whenever the pointer is absent
Resize refits the field and restarts it from the unignited ground
No instructions, labels or controls anywhere on the surface
adaptable_details: Exact block size and field grid dimensions, as long as the blocks stay obviously coarse
Exact hues, saturation and stop positions along the intensity ramp, including whether it runs warm, cool or mixed, as long as the stops stay separable and the luminance order holds
Cooling and decay speed, and how long a streak remains visible
Maximum flame height at rest and the multiplier applied while pressed
Duration and shape of the opening flare
Whether the surface is the full viewport or a large self-contained panel
Input device (mouse, pen, touch) and whether multiple simultaneous contacts each ignite heat
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits full-bleed or large-panel surfaces of any base tone where the burning field is itself the content, or where only sparse light foreground elements sit over it; what makes it viable as either a standalone toy or a host substrate is the wide luminance separation between the quiet unignited ground and the glowing ramp above it, not any particular base colour. It stops being this Skill if user marks persist and accumulate into a drawing, if a goal, score, timer or completion is introduced, if the coarse blocks are replaced by smooth photoreal flame, if heat no longer rises and cools from a bottom edge, or if the surface must carry dense readable text or controls over the hot region.

name: grazing_block_field_with_travelling_pointer_swell
description: A full-bleed view skimming low across a vast field of small blocks under broad, open overhead illumination on a light, low-distraction surround of no fixed hue; the surface never fully rests, a soft bulge of blocks rises and follows the pointer then subsides behind it, and dragging, wheel or pinch, and a secondary drag swing, approach and slide the viewpoint with weighted, drifting motion inside limits that keep the field always in sight.

canonical_document.name: grazing_block_field_with_travelling_pointer_swell
canonical_document.description: A full-bleed view skimming low across a vast field of small blocks under broad, open overhead illumination on a light, low-distraction surround of no fixed hue; the surface never fully rests, a soft bulge of blocks rises and follows the pointer then subsides behind it, and dragging, wheel or pinch, and a secondary drag swing, approach and slide the viewpoint with weighted, drifting motion inside limits that keep the field always in sight.
canonical_document.experience_scope: Whole-view, single-region experience occupying the entire viewport. Begins when the brief setup wait ends and the visitor is placed in the low grazing view of the field; has no end state and continues indefinitely as an idle-alive scene between bouts of pointer and drag input.
content_and_composition: One primary content role: a single large field of many small repeated blocks forming one continuous surface, read as one physical toy-like object rather than a chart or diagram
One camera/viewpoint role: positioned low so the line of sight grazes across the surface, giving a wide horizon-ward overview of the whole field with foreground blocks nearest the viewer

One lighting role: broad, open illumination from above of any hue, bright enough that the surround reads as open rather than as a dark stage, giving soft shading and visible relief across the block tops and sides
Persistent elements: the field itself, its continuous low-amplitude idle motion, and the horizon beyond the surface as the upper spatial reference
No overlaid controls, labels, legends or panels are required; the surface is the entire foreground content
Preceding the view, a brief loading/setup wait state that resolves into the composed view
experience_progression: Brief loading and setup wait
Arrival directly in the composed wide grazing overview, oriented immediately with nothing to learn or finish
Open-ended drift between taking in the whole field and approaching small pockets of detail, in any order and any number of times
Wide overview remains reachable at any moment, so the experience loops back to its establishing state rather than progressing toward an ending
attention_and_information_flow: Initial attention is on the field as one whole object, carried by the wide low-angle framing and the uniform, evenly distributed light
Attention shifts to wherever the pointer is, because the rising bulge is the highest-salience change in an otherwise calm surface
Approaching the surface promotes local detail: individual block edges, shading and the texture of the field's relief
Pulling back demotes local detail and restores the reading of a single large physical mass
Continuous idle motion keeps low-level attention alive across the whole surface even when the visitor does nothing
No informational content is revealed; the revealed information is spatial and tactile only

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Leaving the region or stopping movement lets the bulge subside smoothly back into the idle surface; no state accumulates and nothing must be dismissed
interaction_model.state_change: Local surface height rises into a soft bulge that tracks the pointer position, swelling as the pointer approaches and relaxing after it passes
interaction_model.visible_feedback: A rounded travelling swell of raised blocks follows the pointer with a visible leading rise and trailing settle, making the movement-to-response link unmistakable
interaction_model.input: Pointer moved across the scene
interaction_model.affected_object: Blocks in the region of the surface beneath and around the pointer

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: A new drag interrupts and takes over the residual glide; orientation stays clamped above the horizon so the view can never slip beneath the blocks
interaction_model.state_change: Viewpoint swings around the field with weighted, damped momentum
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The field rotates under the camera and keeps gliding briefly after release before easing to rest
interaction_model.input: Primary drag
interaction_model.affected_object: Viewpoint orientation around the field

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Distance is clamped at both ends so the view can neither pass into the blocks nor drift off into empty space; the wide overview is always reachable by pulling back
interaction_model.state_change: View moves nearer or further within a bounded near-to-far range
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Blocks grow and separate into individual detail when nearing, and merge into one large mass when receding; motion decelerates at the range limits
interaction_model.input: Wheel or pinch
interaction_model.affected_object: Viewpoint distance from the surface

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Bounded so the field never leaves the frame entirely; releasing settles the drift and returns the surface to idle motion
interaction_model.state_change: The framed portion of the field slides laterally
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The field translates across the view with the same weighted, drifting feel, revealing neighbouring pockets of the surface
interaction_model.input: Secondary drag
interaction_model.affected_object: Framing position across the surface

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Idle motion is never suspended by interaction; every released input leaves the field back in this baseline state
interaction_model.state_change: Continuous low-amplitude surface motion that never fully stops
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The whole surface keeps subtly shifting, so the field always looks alive and physical rather than frozen
interaction_model.input: Autonomous idle driver (no input)
interaction_model.affected_object: The entire block field

experience_qualities: Playful and toy-like rather than technical or diagrammatic
Calm and tactile, with nothing urgent and nothing to complete
Physically weighted movement: inertia, damping and post-release drift
Immediately legible cause and effect between pointer movement and surface response
Openly and evenly lit, with a light low-distraction surround rather than a dark stage, and inviting rather than clinical
Safe to explore, because no input can produce a lost or unreadable view
completion_and_return: No completion state, score, goal or end of content
Releasing any input always returns the field to its continuous idle motion
Local pointer swells fully relax back to the resting surface, leaving no persistent deformation
The wide grazing overview is always recoverable by pulling the view back; the experience effectively loops around this establishing state
Viewpoint changes persist while the visitor stays in the view rather than snapping back on their own
locked_observable_requirements: One single full-bleed view of one continuous field of many small repeated blocks read as one physical object
Low grazing viewing angle across the surface toward a visible horizon
Broad overhead illumination of any hue, on an open rather than dark surround, producing soft relief shading with clear luminance separation between lit block tops and shaded sides
The surface is never completely still, even with no input
A soft localized bulge that follows pointer movement, swelling ahead of it and settling behind it
Weighted, damped viewpoint motion that keeps drifting briefly after release
Swing-around, near-far and lateral-slide viewpoint control all available
Viewpoint clamped above the horizon and within a bounded near-to-far distance range so the view never goes beneath the surface or into emptiness
Immediate orientation on arrival with no task, tutorial or completion
The wide overview always recoverable after any exploration
adaptable_details: Exact block size, spacing, count and footprint of the field
Colour palette of the blocks, the light and the surround, as long as the blocks stay clearly separated from the surround and the relief shading stays readable
Amplitude, radius and softness of the pointer swell
Character and speed of the idle surface motion
Amount of damping, drift duration and sensitivity of each viewpoint input
Precise clamp values for angle and near-far distance
Presentation of the brief loading and setup wait
Whether a light optional overlay of text sits above the view
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits any page that wants one spatial, material-feeling surface of many small repeated units as its main attraction, with little or no competing foreground content and no task to complete; the unit type and the palette of surface, light and surround may change as long as the field still reads as one continuous physical mass with visible relief. It stops being this Skill if the surface becomes flat or fully static, if the elements carry data or labels so the field reads as a chart, if the low grazing angle and bounded viewpoint are replaced by unconstrained or top-down framing, or if the pointer response becomes discrete selection of individual units instead of a soft travelling swell across the surface.
