name: pointer_chasing_gripping_creature
description: One small creature roams a quiet, softly lit patch of ground, easing toward wherever the pointer rests with a slight sink while chasing and a lift on arrival, turning to face its path a beat late, reaching thin limbs out to grip and peel off the ground as it travels, and blinking with slightly mismatched eyes when clicked.

canonical_document.name: pointer_chasing_gripping_creature
canonical_document.description: One small creature roams a quiet, softly lit patch of ground, easing toward wherever the pointer rests with a slight sink while chasing and a lift on arrival, turning to face its path a beat late, reaching thin limbs out to grip and peel off the ground as it travels, and blinking with slightly mismatched eyes when clicked.
canonical_document.experience_scope: A single self-contained region that behaves as the whole view's subject: it is already in motion the instant the view opens, has no entry, tutorial, objective or end state, and stays confined to a bounded central area of the recessive ground while continuing indefinitely.
content_and_composition: Exactly one creature body as the sole focal subject, small relative to the ground it occupies
A quiet, softly lit ground plane serving as the full backdrop, held to a narrow internal tonal range so it never competes with the subject
Several thin tapering limbs emerging from underneath the body, contacting discrete nearby patches of ground
Two eyes on the body as the only expressive facial feature
An unmarked bounded roaming region inset from the view edges that constrains where the body may travel
No labels, instructions, controls, counters or status text anywhere in the scene
experience_progression: No goal-based progression: nothing accumulates, completes or escalates
A repeating small approach cycle per pointer target: pursue, sink slightly while travelling, arrive and lift, re-orient to the direction just travelled, settle
Continuous ambient life between and during cycles, so the scene is never static and never resolves
attention_and_information_flow: All prominence sits on the single moving body; the ground stays recessive and informational only as a surface
Personality is communicated purely through motion timing rather than text: eagerness from the eased chase, weight from the sink, relief from the lift, clumsiness from the late turn
Limbs pull brief secondary attention along the travelled path as they attach and release, reinforcing where the body has just been
The blink acts as short punctuation that momentarily concentrates attention on the face without interrupting movement
Reaching the roaming boundary shifts attention from travel to a quietly waiting subject

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Moving the pointer mid-travel redirects the chase without a stop or restart; leaving the pointer still lets the creature arrive and settle in place
interaction_model.state_change: Idle or previously travelling body adopts the rested position as its destination and pursues it continuously
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Smooth eased approach rather than an instant snap, with the body sinking slightly lower while chasing and lifting back up as it arrives
interaction_model.input: Pointer resting at a position over the ground
interaction_model.affected_object: The creature body

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Bringing the pointer back inside the region resumes normal pursuit immediately from wherever the creature was parked
interaction_model.state_change: Destination is limited to the nearest point on the roaming boundary instead of following the pointer outward
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The creature parks at the boundary and waits there, remaining fully visible rather than drifting away or off-view
interaction_model.input: Pointer pushed far out toward the view edges, outside the roaming region
interaction_model.affected_object: The creature body's reachable area

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: The lag always resolves on its own; rapid direction changes simply produce repeated late turns without breaking the body's motion
interaction_model.state_change: Facing follows the new travel direction only after a short delay
interaction_model.visible_feedback: A brief visible mismatch between where the body is heading and where it is looking, then a catch-up turn
interaction_model.input: Change in the creature's own direction of travel (autonomous consequence of pursuit)
interaction_model.affected_object: The creature's facing orientation

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: When the body settles, the gripping rhythm quiets rather than stopping abruptly, and resumes as soon as travel begins again
interaction_model.state_change: Limbs cycle between reaching out to grip nearby ground patches and peeling back off as the body moves on
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Individual limbs extend, make contact, hold briefly, then release and retract in an ongoing overlapping rhythm tied to travel
interaction_model.input: The creature travelling across the ground
interaction_model.affected_object: The thin tapering limbs

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Eyes always return to open on their own, repeated clicks simply blink again, and the blink never interrupts chasing, parking or limb motion
interaction_model.state_change: Both eyes close and reopen once, offset slightly from each other
interaction_model.visible_feedback: A quick blink where one eye closes a touch before the other, reading as mildly comic rather than precise
interaction_model.input: Click anywhere
interaction_model.affected_object: The creature's two eyes

experience_qualities: Alive on arrival, with no need to press or learn anything
Calm and unhurried, mildly funny rather than energetic or comedic
Instantly legible personality: curious, eager, slightly clumsy
Toy-like and consequence-free, rewarding a ten-second glance and a ten-minute watch equally
Soft, quiet and low in internal contrast, with motion as the only strong signal
completion_and_return: No completion, success, failure or score exists
Continues indefinitely, idling in place when the pointer is still and resuming instantly on any new movement
Nothing is saved or carried across visits; leaving and returning simply presents the creature already alive again
The creature never becomes unreachable or lost, so no reset is ever needed
locked_observable_requirements: Exactly one creature subject, already moving before any input
Eased pursuit of the pointer's resting position, never an instant snap or rigid attachment
Slight downward sink while chasing and a lift on arrival
Facing rotation that trails the direction of travel by a noticeable beat
A bounded central roaming area where out-of-range pointer positions park the creature at the boundary and keep it visible
Thin tapering limbs from underneath that grip nearby ground patches and peel off as travel continues
Click produces a blink with the two eyes closing slightly out of sync

A quiet, softly lit, internally low-contrast ground as the only backdrop, separated enough from the body that the creature and its limbs stay clearly readable against it, with no instructions or interface
No objective, progression, score or end state
adaptable_details: Creature silhouette, species read and exact proportions
Number and length of limbs and how many grip at once
Exact easing durations, sink depth, lift height, turn delay and blink offset
Size and shape of the bounded roaming region and its inset from the edges
Hue, tone and subtle texture of the ground, in any softly lit range that keeps it recessive behind the subject
Whether occasional blinks or small idle stirrings also occur without input
Overall scale of the scene within its region
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits any sparse, minimal-content region or view where a single small subject is meant to be the foreground attraction, such as a toy page, a hidden-surprise corner, an empty or error state, or a calm intro panel. Adding foreground content on top of it, multiplying it into a crowd of competing creatures, giving it objectives, scores or a finish, or replacing the eased bounded pursuit with instant cursor attachment or a fixed scripted path would each create a different Skill.

name: grainy_specimen_creature_lens
description: A small round glass-like window on an otherwise empty page holding a breathing, grainy abstract creature that continuously re-proportions itself around the pointer, tips toward it, and swaps to the next specimen on each click.

canonical_document.name: grainy_specimen_creature_lens
canonical_document.description: A small round glass-like window on an otherwise empty page holding a breathing, grainy abstract creature that continuously re-proportions itself around the pointer, tips toward it, and swaps to the next specimen on each click.
canonical_document.experience_scope: A single compact region: one small circular viewport plus a tiny emblem and one short line of guidance directly above it, sitting alone in an otherwise empty view. The experience begins as soon as the view appears, since the creature is already alive, and never terminates: it continues autonomously whether or not the pointer is present.
content_and_composition: Exactly one small round viewport, centered in a deliberately bare surrounding field with no competing content
One tiny emblem and one single short line of guidance stacked above the viewport, persistent and unchanged throughout
Inside the viewport: one abstract creature drawing composed of outlines of varying weight and soft stains or blooms of tone

One clearly separated tracking form inside the viewport, set apart from the rest of the drawing by a marked luminance step in either direction, that follows the pointer and acts as the focal anchor of the drawing
A grain texture and gentle warp applied across the viewport contents, reading like a specimen viewed through glass
A soft shadow beneath the viewport that belongs to the frame rather than the creature
A small ordered set of interchangeable creatures, only one visible at a time, cycling back to the first
experience_progression: Arrival: the creature is already drifting and breathing by itself, inviting passive watching
Discovery of influence: moving the pointer visibly reshapes the drawing and tips the window, revealing that the visitor has control
Exploration: sustained pointer movement lets the visitor find the sharpest, most legible configurations of the current creature
Curiosity about the set: clicking reveals another specimen from a fresh starting arrangement
Endless return: continued clicking cycles through the specimens and brings the first one back, so nothing is finished or lost
attention_and_information_flow: The bare surroundings force all attention onto the small round viewport
The short guidance line above is read once, tells the visitor what is worth trying, and then recedes
Within the viewport, clarity is highest around the pointer-tracking focal form and falls off softly toward the rim, so legibility itself follows the pointer
Idle drifting and breathing keep the region attention-worthy even with no input
Each swap re-engages attention by presenting a visibly different creature from a clean starting state

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Never stops or waits for input; runs before, during and after any interaction
interaction_model.state_change: Continuous slow drift plus a rhythmic breathing expansion and contraction
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The creature is visibly alive on arrival, never static, with grain and gentle warping shimmering over it
interaction_model.input: Autonomous idle motion, always running
interaction_model.affected_object: The creature drawing inside the viewport

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Fully continuous and reversible by moving back; influence is bounded to the circular viewport, with no discrete steps or snapping
interaction_model.state_change: The separated focal form follows the pointer and its position continuously re-proportions the rest of the drawing
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Outlines thicken and thin, soft stains swell and shrink, and the picture reads sharpest around the focal form while softening toward the rim
interaction_model.input: Pointer movement over the round viewport
interaction_model.affected_object: The tracking focal form and, through it, the whole creature drawing

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Tilt follows the pointer continuously within a small limited range and settles back as the pointer position changes
interaction_model.state_change: The frame tips slightly toward the pointer position
interaction_model.visible_feedback: A small tilt of the window with its shadow sliding and spreading to match the tilt direction
interaction_model.input: Pointer movement over the round viewport
interaction_model.affected_object: The viewport frame and its shadow

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Returning the pointer resumes continuous control from the held state without a jump
interaction_model.state_change: The last pointer-derived influence is held in place rather than reset
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The drawing stays in its last shaped configuration while drifting and breathing continue on their own
interaction_model.input: Pointer leaves the viewport
interaction_model.affected_object: The creature drawing, frame tilt and shadow

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Repeated clicks keep advancing and wrap around so the first creature returns; nothing is consumed or permanently lost
interaction_model.state_change: The next creature in the set replaces the current one from a fresh starting arrangement
interaction_model.visible_feedback: A visibly different creature appears in the same window, immediately alive and pointer-responsive
interaction_model.input: Click inside the viewport
interaction_model.affected_object: The visible creature within the set

experience_qualities: Playful and toy-like, rewarding aimless fiddling
Alive and breathing rather than mechanical
Tactile and specimen-like, as if observed through grainy glass
Soft and continuous, with no hard snapping or abrupt states
Quiet and minimal, one small thing in a large emptiness
Inexhaustible, since the set loops and nothing can be completed or broken
completion_and_return: No end state: idle motion continues indefinitely
The specimen set cycles and wraps back to the first creature
Each swap starts its creature from a fresh arrangement rather than inheriting the previous pose
Pointer-derived influence persists after the pointer leaves and is resumed on return
locked_observable_requirements: One small circular viewport as the only interactive region, isolated in a near-empty view
A tiny emblem plus one short line of guidance above the viewport
The creature is already animated on arrival with self-driven drift and breathing

A clearly separated form, readable against the rest of the drawing by luminance contrast rather than any particular hue, tracks the pointer and its position continuously re-proportions the whole drawing
Outline weight and soft stain size respond continuously to that form's position
Clarity peaks around the tracking form and softens toward the viewport rim
Grain and gentle warping across the viewport contents
The viewport frame tips slightly toward the pointer with its shadow sliding and spreading to match
Click advances to the next creature from a fresh starting arrangement and cycling wraps back to the first
On pointer exit the last influence is held while autonomous motion continues
adaptable_details: Number of creatures in the cycling set
Exact silhouettes, hues and tonal register of each creature, including whether the tracking form reads lighter or darker than its surroundings
Grain density and warp strength
Tilt magnitude and shadow softness
Breathing rhythm and drift speed
Viewport diameter and its placement within the empty field
Wording of the single guidance line and the form of the tiny emblem
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits any context wanting one small, self-contained, endlessly pokeable alive object in a sparse view: a playful landing or profile centerpiece, a personality accent beside minimal text, or a compact exhibit of a few abstract characters or variants. It suits abstract, non-informational subjects whose shape can be freely re-proportioned, and it adopts whatever tonal scheme the host context uses as long as the tracking form keeps a readable separation from the rest of the drawing. Replacing the creature with content that must stay legible and undistorted, expanding the viewport to a full-view or background layer, requiring meaningful labels, selection or navigation from the clicks, or turning the cycle into a finite completable sequence would create a different Skill.

name: endless_liquid_mass_meditation
description: On an empty, uniformly toned field, one centred soft blob slowly stretches, swells, separates and rejoins itself in an endless loop, held clearly apart from its surround by luminance alone, revealed only once it can render cleanly, with no controls and nothing to complete.

canonical_document.name: endless_liquid_mass_meditation
canonical_document.description: On an empty, uniformly toned field, one centred soft blob slowly stretches, swells, separates and rejoins itself in an endless loop, held clearly apart from its surround by luminance alone, revealed only once it can render cleanly, with no controls and nothing to complete.
canonical_document.experience_scope: Whole-view experience: it occupies the entire viewport as the only content, begins with an empty, evenly toned field before the form appears, and never ends or hands off to another state; it can also be transplanted as a full-bleed region that fills its own frame.
content_and_composition: Exactly one foreground subject: a soft, rounded liquid-looking mass centred in the frame

Background: a single empty, uniformly toned field with no texture, copy, chrome or navigation competing with the form, and enough luminance separation from the mass that the silhouette reads unambiguously
No text, labels, buttons, indicators or affordances present at any point
The form is sized and positioned so it reads as one heavy mass within the frame rather than as a pattern filling it edge to edge
Persistent elements across the whole experience: the evenly toned field and the single centred form
experience_progression: Arrival: empty, uniformly toned field with nothing shown and nothing to read or decide
Reveal: the form becomes visible only once it can be drawn cleanly, appearing without stutter or partial/broken first frames
Settling: attention comes to rest on the single centred form
Continuous advance: the form keeps deforming — stretching, swelling, pinching apart and rejoining — with no terminal state, no phases the viewer must follow and no cue that anything has finished
attention_and_information_flow: Attention is undivided from the start because the form is the only thing present
No new information is ever revealed; interest is sustained by the changing silhouette alone
The impression of heavy liquid accumulates gradually from watching deformation over time rather than from any explanatory element
The experience tolerates inattention: the viewer can look away and return without missing anything or losing place

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Motion keeps advancing regardless of viewer presence or activity; there is nothing to interrupt, pause or resume
interaction_model.state_change: Continuous deformation of the silhouette: stretching, swelling, separating and rejoining, advancing purely with elapsed time
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Slow, smooth, unbroken movement of the form with no pauses, resets or repetition the viewer can pin down
interaction_model.input: Elapsed time (autonomous driver)
interaction_model.affected_object: The centred liquid mass

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: There is no wrong action and nothing to undo, because no input has any effect
interaction_model.state_change: No state change of any kind
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Nothing changes; the form ignores the input entirely and continues its motion
interaction_model.input: Pointing, hovering, clicking, dragging, scrolling or typing
interaction_model.affected_object: None

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Resizing is freely repeatable in any direction; motion continues from where it was rather than restarting, so no recovery step is needed
interaction_model.state_change: The composition immediately re-fits to the new frame dimensions and orientation
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The form refills the new frame at correct proportions with no squashing, stretching distortion, cropping mistake, flash, restart or interruption of the ongoing motion
interaction_model.input: Resizing or reorienting the window/frame
interaction_model.affected_object: The framing of the field and the form within it

experience_qualities: Quiet and undemanding on arrival
Slow, heavy and viscous in how the form moves
Soft-edged and rounded rather than sharp or geometric
Endless and non-goal-directed, pleasant to drift in and out of
Uninterrupted: no stutter, no visible restart, no broken first impression
completion_and_return: No completion state: the motion loops or advances endlessly with no natural end
No reset triggered by viewer action; the only re-fit event is a frame change and it preserves motion continuity
Returning attention after looking away lands mid-motion with nothing missed and nothing to catch up on
No persistent state or progress is carried between visits
locked_observable_requirements: Exactly one centred soft form is the sole foreground content
Background is an empty, uniformly toned field with nothing to read or decide, separated from the form by a consistent luminance difference in either direction so the silhouette stays legible
The form appears only once it can be drawn cleanly, never as a broken or partial first impression
Deformation is continuous and endless: stretching, swelling, separating and rejoining without a terminal state
Movement is slow enough that the mass reads as heavy liquid rather than as quick or bouncy motion
No viewer input other than frame change produces any visible response
Frame resize or reorientation refills the view at correct proportions without squashing, restarting or breaking motion
adaptable_details: Exact tones of the field and of the form and which of the two is lighter, including any subtle tint or gradient, as long as their separation stays clearly readable
Overall scale of the form relative to the frame
Deformation tempo within the range that still reads as slow and heavy
How pronounced the separation-and-rejoin events are, and how often they occur
Degree of softness, sheen or translucency on the form's surface
Whether the whole viewport or a large embedded region carries the experience
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits any wordless, contemplative view where a single abstract form is the entire foreground subject and the viewer is meant only to watch — standalone calm pages, quiet full-bleed interludes, or a hero-position centrepiece with nothing else on the page, in a light, mid-toned or deep surround alike. It stops being this Skill if additional foreground content or copy must compete with the form, if multiple forms or a repeating pattern replace the single centred mass, if the motion responds to pointer, scroll or click, if the form is required to sit behind readable foreground content as a substrate, if the surround loses enough luminance separation that the silhouette stops reading, or if the movement becomes fast, sharp or goal-directed rather than slow, soft and endless.

name: breathing_texture_clock_surface
description: A screen-filling organic texture that pulses gently with each second and re-forms the current hours, minutes and seconds out of its own material every second, while pointer or finger movement smears and thins the surface locally before it regrows.

canonical_document.name: breathing_texture_clock_surface
canonical_document.description: A screen-filling organic texture that pulses gently with each second and re-forms the current hours, minutes and seconds out of its own material every second, while pointer or finger movement smears and thins the surface locally before it regrows.
canonical_document.experience_scope: Whole-view experience occupying the entire viewport from load onward; it has no start, end or resting state and runs continuously for as long as the page is open, with no completion boundary.
content_and_composition: One continuous full-bleed generative surface as the sole visual substrate, appearing grown/organic rather than drawn with hard edges
One foreground time readout composed of the current hours, minutes and seconds, formed out of the same surface material rather than set as fixed type on top of it
One transient localized disturbance zone: a soft round region that follows pointer or touch position with slight lag
Layer relationship: the time readout and the disturbance zone are both expressions of the single surface, not separate stacked graphics; no chrome, controls, labels or persistent UI accompany them
experience_progression: Continuous ambient state: the surface breathes in step with passing seconds, never settling
Each second boundary: digits dissolve back into the surrounding texture and the next second's digits re-form out of it, so the readout is perpetually condensing and softening
Looping without cycle end: the second-by-second re-formation repeats indefinitely with no beginning, climax or terminal state
attention_and_information_flow: The time readout holds primary prominence and must be legible at a glance despite being made of texture, so it stays clearly separated from the surrounding material
The surrounding surface holds ambient secondary prominence, its motion slow and its variation low enough in contrast not to compete with the digits
Attention shifts locally and briefly to wherever the pointer disturbs the surface, then returns to the readout as the disturbance regrows
No information is progressively revealed beyond the changing time value; there is nothing to explore or unlock

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Not interruptible or pausable by the visitor; the loop always continues and the readout always resolves to a legible current time
interaction_model.state_change: Current second advances; digits for the outgoing value soften into the texture while the incoming value condenses out of it, and the surface's breathing pulse stays in step with the seconds
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Digits appear to grow from and melt back into the surrounding material each second, with the overall surface visibly breathing in the same rhythm
interaction_model.input: Autonomous passage of time (each second)
interaction_model.affected_object: Time readout and the whole surface

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Effect is inherently transient and bounded; leaving an area or leaving the surface simply lets it regrow, and no input can break, freeze or blank the display
interaction_model.state_change: Surface material within the zone is displaced along the direction of travel and locally thins; displacement magnitude scales with movement speed and falls to zero beyond a short influence radius
interaction_model.visible_feedback: A smeared, thinned streak drawn out behind the pointer as if pushing through a viscous film, with faster motion producing visibly greater displacement and no effect outside the short radius
interaction_model.input: Pointer movement across the surface
interaction_model.affected_object: Localized soft round zone of the surface trailing slightly behind the cursor

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Self-recovering with no user action required; regrowth resumes automatically after any interruption of movement
interaction_model.state_change: Trailing zone catches up to the pointer position and the disturbed region returns to full-thickness continuity with its surroundings
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The lag closes and the smeared, thinned patch heals back into the surrounding texture until no trace of the pass remains
interaction_model.input: Pausing pointer movement
interaction_model.affected_object: Trailing disturbance zone and the previously smeared area

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Lifting the finger leaves the disturbed area to regrow; repeated or rapid drags cannot destabilize or stop the readout
interaction_model.state_change: Same displacement, local thinning, speed scaling, radius falloff and regrowth as pointer movement
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Identical smearing and healing behavior under touch as under pointer
interaction_model.input: Finger drag on a touch surface
interaction_model.affected_object: Localized soft round zone of the surface trailing slightly behind the touch point

experience_qualities: Calm and meditative rather than energetic
Organic and grown, not geometric or typeset
Continuously alive with no idle or settled moment
Tactile and viscous under the pointer, as if pressing into a soft film
Legible at a glance despite unstable, material-formed digits
Unbreakable and forgiving: no failure, error or dead-end state
completion_and_return: No completion: the experience loops indefinitely while the page is open
Each second constitutes a micro-cycle that always returns to a fully legible readout
Local disturbances always return to the undisturbed surface state without persisting
No persistent state accumulates from visitor interaction
locked_observable_requirements: One continuous surface fills the whole screen with no framing, panels or visible container
The surface looks grown/organic rather than drawn and is never static
The surface's motion is paced to the passing seconds so the page reads as breathing in time
Hours, minutes and seconds are all present and readable at a glance, with enough separation from the surrounding texture to stay legible
Digits are formed from the surrounding texture and re-form each second instead of appearing as fixed type
Pointer or touch travel produces a soft round zone that lags slightly behind the input point
Within that zone the surface is displaced along the direction of travel and locally thins
Displacement scales with input speed and decays to nothing beyond a short radius
Pausing causes the trailing zone to catch up and the disturbed area to regrow into its surroundings
No visitor input can stop, break or blank the display
adaptable_details: Hue family, light or dark treatment, contrast level and overall luminance of the surface, provided the readout keeps its glance legibility
Specific organic character of the texture (fibrous, cloudy, fluid, granular, cellular)
Numeral proportions, weight, spacing and whether a separator is shown
Time format conventions such as 12- or 24-hour presentation
Exact amplitude and softness of the breathing pulse
Exact lag distance, influence radius, smear length and regrowth duration within the stated behaviors
Whether the re-formation reads as condensing, dissolving, sprouting or flowing, as long as digits emerge from and return to the material
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits full-viewport ambient displays whose only foreground content is a short, continuously updating numeric or few-character string that can be rendered as part of the surface material, in contexts where nothing must be clicked, entered or navigated. It also fits as a full-bleed substrate behind very sparse foreground text if the readout is retained as the surface's own content. Replacing the material-formed digits with ordinary typography over a moving background, removing the second-by-second re-formation, or making the surface a bounded widget beside conventional page content produces a different Skill; adding dense reading content, scrolling sections or interactive controls over the surface also falls outside this Skill, as does turning the pointer deformation into a persistent drawing or painting that does not regrow.

name: breathing_nested_ring_disc
description: One centred stack of nested outlines that reads as a disc tilted back into depth, breathing forever as a slow swell travels outward through the rings and a bloom of light rises on the rings wherever the swell peaks.

canonical_document.name: breathing_nested_ring_disc
canonical_document.description: One centred stack of nested outlines that reads as a disc tilted back into depth, breathing forever as a slow swell travels outward through the rings and a bloom of light rises on the rings wherever the swell peaks.
canonical_document.experience_scope: Whole-view experience that begins the instant the piece appears and never ends; the form occupies the centre of an otherwise empty field and there is no entry, exit or completion boundary.
content_and_composition: One single visual subject, centred, with no competing foreground content, labels, controls or chrome
A uniform, otherwise empty field filling the view at a luminance clearly separated from the outlines, acting as low-distraction negative space around the subject
Many nested outlines sharing a common centre, ordered from innermost to outermost, each outline flat and unfilled
Perceived tilt: although each outline is perfectly flat, the set as a whole reads as one disc leaning back into depth
A glow layer that is not a separate object but appears on the rings themselves, localized to the crests of the travelling swell and reading as emitted light rather than a change of line weight
The subject stays modest in visual scale relative to the field, so emptiness remains the dominant impression
experience_progression: The swell rises somewhere in the ring set and displaces the rings it passes through
It travels through successive neighbouring rings so that motion reads as one wave crossing the whole form rather than rings moving independently
The glow gains luminance with the swell crest, follows it across the rings and fades back to the rings' resting level as the crest passes
The cycle continues into the next swell without pause, final pose or visible restart, reading as sustained breathing rather than a sequence of takes
attention_and_information_flow: Attention lands immediately on the single centred form because nothing else asks for it
Within the form, prominence shifts continuously to wherever the swell is currently peaking, guided by the glow
The surrounding field never gains prominence and reveals no additional information at any point
No new information is disclosed over time; the interest is in the changing shape and glow, so it stays instantly understandable and endlessly watchable

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Runs unconditionally with no start, stop or settle; the motion must never stutter, freeze in a final pose or visibly jump back to a start state, so looking away and returning shows the same ongoing pulse
interaction_model.state_change: Swell position advances through the rings and glow intensity tracks the crest
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Rings deform in a travelling wave and light blooms and fades along the crest
interaction_model.input: Autonomous driver: continuous time, running from the moment the piece appears
interaction_model.affected_object: The nested outline set and its glow

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Nothing is asked of the viewer and nothing can be broken; input cannot begin, halt, speed, slow or reshape the motion
interaction_model.state_change: None
interaction_model.visible_feedback: No hover, press, cursor or scroll-linked response of any kind; the pulse continues identically
interaction_model.input: Pointer movement, clicking, tapping or scrolling
interaction_model.affected_object: The whole piece

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: The cycle carries on unbroken across the resize with no reset, restart flash or discontinuity in the motion
interaction_model.state_change: The form re-centres in the new field dimensions
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The subject settles back to the centre while the swell keeps travelling and the glow keeps blooming
interaction_model.input: Window or container resize
interaction_model.affected_object: Placement of the form within the field

experience_qualities: Calm and unhurried
Alive and organic, like slow breathing or a drifting sea creature
Depth felt from flat outlines alone
Emitted light standing out against a quiet, low-distraction surround
Instantly legible with no instruction
Endlessly watchable with no goal and no end state
completion_and_return: No completion, success state or terminal pose exists
Seamless perpetual loop: returning at any moment shows the same continuing pulse rather than a beginning
No persistent state is accumulated or restored; the piece is always mid-breath
locked_observable_requirements: Exactly one centred subject in a uniform, otherwise empty field with nothing else competing for attention
The subject is built from multiple nested flat outlines sharing a centre
The set reads as a tilted disc receding into depth despite every outline being flat
A swell travels through the rings as one coherent wave rather than unrelated per-ring motion
A soft glow reads as light where and when the swell peaks, clearly more luminous than the resting rings, and fades as it passes
Motion starts by itself on appearance and never stops, settles, stutters or visibly restarts
Viewer input never begins, halts or alters the motion
Resize only re-centres; the cycle is never interrupted
adaptable_details: Number of nested outlines and their spacing
Line weight and outline shape family, as long as nesting and perceived tilt survive
Apparent tilt angle and how deep the recession reads
Swell speed, amplitude and how many crests are visible at once
Glow hue or absence of hue, its softness and its brightness range, provided the crest stays clearly more luminous than the resting rings
Overall size of the form relative to the field and the field's own luminance level, light or dark, provided the outlines stay clearly separated from it
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits any view that can be given over to one quiet centred visual with little or no surrounding content, where the purpose is atmosphere rather than information. It stops being this Skill if the motion becomes driven by pointer, scroll or a progress timeline, if it is asked to sit behind readable foreground content as a background substrate, if it gains a start/end state or reaches a resting pose, or if the single nested-outline subject is replaced by multiple competing elements or a filled solid form that loses the flat-outline depth illusion.

name: dual_band_audio_reactive_fullscreen_field
description: A fullscreen visual field is driven directly by the playing audio through two separately mapped layers: low-frequency weight inflates a heavy large-scale layer so the whole image visibly swells and surges with the bass, while high-frequency content drives a fine, high-salience layer that sparkles and shimmers, making the sound-to-image correspondence readable within seconds. The field owns the entire view with no chrome, text or progress, and keeps re-forming indefinitely as the audio loops rather than resolving to an end state. Entry is a quiet, visibly dimmed-down screen with one plain cue that clearly separates from its surround and is clickable anywhere; the cue holds through audio preparation and clears precisely at the instant sound begins, so the image rising and the sound starting read as a single event, and viewport changes refit the field without stretching or restarting it. Transferable to any whole-view page where a single audio piece is the subject and the reactive field is the only foreground content.

canonical_document.name: dual_band_audio_reactive_fullscreen_field
canonical_document.description: A fullscreen visual field is driven directly by the playing audio through two separately mapped layers: low-frequency weight inflates a heavy large-scale layer so the whole image visibly swells and surges with the bass, while high-frequency content drives a fine, high-salience layer that sparkles and shimmers, making the sound-to-image correspondence readable within seconds. The field owns the entire view with no chrome, text or progress, and keeps re-forming indefinitely as the audio loops rather than resolving to an end state. Entry is a quiet, visibly dimmed-down screen with one plain cue that clearly separates from its surround and is clickable anywhere; the cue holds through audio preparation and clears precisely at the instant sound begins, so the image rising and the sound starting read as a single event, and viewport changes refit the field without stretching or restarting it. Transferable to any whole-view page where a single audio piece is the subject and the reactive field is the only foreground content.
canonical_document.experience_scope: Whole-view experience that owns the entire screen. It begins at arrival on the gated, visibly dimmed screen and never ends: after the start gesture there is no completion state, only continuous evolution.
content_and_composition: One fullscreen visual field as the sole primary content, filling the whole view once running
One single start cue, plain and unmistakable, centered in attention over the pre-start screen and clearly separated from it; exactly one cue, no secondary buttons, labels or instructions
A near-empty surround held at a visibly reduced, recessive luminance while the cue is present, so the cue is the only thing to look at
No persistent chrome, controls, progress indicator, timeline or navigation at any stage
Two visible expressive layers inside the running visual: a heavy, large-scale layer that reads as swelling and surging, and a fine, high-salience layer that reads as shimmering detail
experience_progression: Stage 1 — waiting: dimmed, low-distraction screen with the single start cue holding attention
Stage 2 — preparation: after the start gesture the cue stays put through a brief pause with nothing else changing, so the wait reads as intentional rather than broken

Stage 3 — onset: at the exact instant sound begins, the cue clears and the visual comes up with the sound in one coordinated transition, the surround lifting into the field in a single controlled luminance move
Stage 4 — endless run: the visual keeps reinventing itself indefinitely, with no destination, no finish and no return to the waiting state
attention_and_information_flow: Before start, all prominence is on the single cue; the dimmed emptiness removes competing information and makes the required action self-evident
At onset, prominence transfers wholly from the cue to the visual field — the cue's disappearance and the visual's arrival are read as the same event
While running, prominence shifts continuously inside the visual according to the sound: heavy low weight pulls the eye to large swelling movement, fine high-salience detail pulls it to shimmer
No new textual or numeric information is ever revealed; the only information communicated is the correspondence between what is heard and what is seen

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: One-way and irreversible by design; there is no cancel and no way back to the waiting screen. Because the cue only clears at true sound onset, the viewer never sees a cleared cue with silence behind it.
interaction_model.state_change: Waiting state commits to starting: audio is prepared, then sound begins and the visual becomes active
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The cue remains visibly in place through the brief preparation pause, then clears at the moment sound begins while the visual rises into the full view
interaction_model.input: A single click anywhere on the screen (the entire view is the target; no small hit area to hunt for)
interaction_model.affected_object: The waiting screen, its start cue, the audio and the fullscreen visual

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Guards against doubled or accidentally restarted sound; repeated or impatient clicking cannot produce overlapping audio or a visual reset
interaction_model.state_change: No state change; the start gesture is consumed once and only once
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Nothing changes; the visual continues uninterrupted
interaction_model.input: Any further click after the experience is running
interaction_model.affected_object: Audio playback and the visual field

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Self-sustaining; quiet passages read as calm rather than as failure, and the visual never freezes or empties out
interaction_model.state_change: Continuous moment-to-moment modulation: low-frequency weight maps to swelling and surging scale/mass, fine high-frequency detail maps to shimmer
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Instantly legible correspondence — loud low passages visibly swell and surge, high-frequency passages visibly sparkle and shimmer
interaction_model.input: The playing audio itself as the autonomous driver
interaction_model.affected_object: The two expressive layers of the fullscreen visual

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Guarantees the piece stays watchable indefinitely with no dead end and no need for the viewer to act again
interaction_model.state_change: Playback loops back and continues rather than stopping
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The visual carries on without interruption, blank-out or end-state screen
interaction_model.input: Track reaching its end
interaction_model.affected_object: Audio and visual continuity

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Refitting is continuous and non-destructive; the running experience is never interrupted by geometry changes
interaction_model.state_change: The visual refits to the new proportions
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Composition continues to fill the view with correct proportions — no stretching, squashing, cropping or letterboxing, and no restart of the visual
interaction_model.input: Resizing the window or changing viewport proportions
interaction_model.affected_object: The fullscreen visual field

experience_qualities: Hypnotic and sit-and-watch — rewards passive, sustained viewing
Unmistakably self-explanatory at entry: a single obvious cue standing clear of an otherwise empty, dimmed field
Immersive and undistracted: no chrome, no text, no measurable progress
Legibly sound-shaped: the audio-to-image correspondence is obvious within seconds, not something to be figured out
Calm, weighty and low-distraction, with contrast between slow massive swell and fast fine shimmer
Committed and low-effort: exactly one gesture, then nothing more is asked of the viewer
completion_and_return: No completion state exists; the experience is intentionally endless
Audio loops seamlessly instead of ending, and the visual keeps evolving rather than repeating a fixed cycle
No reset, replay or return to the waiting screen from within the running experience
The start gesture is single-use for the session; only a fresh arrival re-presents the waiting screen
locked_observable_requirements: Entry is an almost empty screen held at a visibly reduced luminance, carrying exactly one plain start cue that separates clearly from its surround
The whole screen is the start target — one click anywhere begins the experience
The cue persists visibly through the preparation pause and clears precisely at the moment sound begins, simultaneously with the visual coming up
Once running, the visual occupies the entire view with no controls, text or chrome
Sound-to-image correspondence must be instantly legible, with heavy low content reading as swelling/surging and fine high-frequency content as sparkling shimmer
Repeat clicks after start have no visible or audible effect
The piece never ends: audio loops and the visual keeps changing without a finish state
Viewport changes refit the visual to new proportions without stretching, cropping or restarting it
adaptable_details: The specific visual material and motion vocabulary of the two layers (fields, particles, waves, fluid, light, geometry)
Palette and overall luminance register of surround and field, in any direction, provided the pre-start surround stays low-distraction and the cue and running field separate clearly from it
The exact form of the single cue (word, symbol or shape) as long as it stays plain, singular and unmistakable
Length of the preparation pause, provided it stays brief and the cue holds through it
Character and speed of the transition at onset
Musical genre and track length
How 'reinvention' over time is expressed (drifting composition, evolving density, shifting motifs)
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits any single-audio-piece, whole-view experience whose only foreground content is the visual itself — track pages, release teasers, ambient or idle displays, meditative screens, in any host palette or luminance register. It does not fit views that must carry readable copy, controls or navigation over the visual. Adding transport controls, a progress timeline, track switching, replay, a defined ending, or making the visual a backdrop behind foreground text would create a different Skill; so would driving the visual from pointer movement or time alone instead of from sound, or requiring more than one gesture to begin.

name: springy_block_field_cursor_dip_and_wake
description: A level grid of tiny blocks that assembles outward from the center, keeps breathing faintly, and sinks into a soft rounded dip under the cursor that stretches into a trailing wake when the pointer moves fast, always easing back to calm; it reads through level, depth and motion rather than any particular palette.

canonical_document.name: springy_block_field_cursor_dip_and_wake
canonical_document.description: A level grid of tiny blocks that assembles outward from the center, keeps breathing faintly, and sinks into a soft rounded dip under the cursor that stretches into a trailing wake when the pointer moves fast, always easing back to calm; it reads through level, depth and motion rather than any particular palette.
canonical_document.experience_scope: A bounded surface region that fills its own area and can occupy the whole view; the experience begins with the entry assembly the moment the surface appears, continues indefinitely with idle motion and pointer response, and never ends or hands off to another state.
content_and_composition: One dense field of many small uniform blocks arranged as a single continuous surface, read collectively as one material rather than as individual items
A shared rest level that all blocks return to, acting as the baseline the eye measures deformation against
One transient depression region tied to the current pointer position, plus an elongated trailing region behind it during fast movement
The surface is persistent and always present; no panels, labels, controls, instructions or overlaid foreground content are part of the experience
The center of the surface has special meaning only during entry, as the origin of the assembly
experience_progression: Entry: the surface builds itself from the middle outward, blocks arriving and overshooting slightly before settling so the material reads as soft and springy
Settled: every block has come to rest at a level surface
Ongoing idle: a faint continuous breathing motion across the surface, low in amplitude and never resolving, so the surface stays alive without demanding attention
Interactive loop: pointer-driven deformation and relaxation layered on top of the idle breathing, entered and left freely with no terminal stage
attention_and_information_flow: During entry, attention starts at the middle and is pulled outward with the expanding assembly front until the whole surface is visible
Once settled, prominence is evenly distributed and low, so the surface reads as calm and the idle breathing only registers on a second look
During interaction, attention concentrates on the small deforming patch under the cursor, which is the clearest and most salient change on the surface however the surface is shaded
Faster movement widens the attended area along the trail, then attention contracts back to a single point as speed drops
No information is revealed beyond the material's own response; the experience communicates responsiveness and softness rather than content

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Runs once automatically without user input; pointer movement during entry is absorbed by the surface without breaking or restarting the assembly
interaction_model.state_change: From absent or unformed to a fully settled level surface, progressing outward from the center
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Blocks arrive in an expanding front from the middle, settle with a soft springy overshoot, and come to rest level
interaction_model.input: Surface first appearing
interaction_model.affected_object: Whole block field

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Always present underneath interaction; resumes as the sole motion once pointer deformation has relaxed away
interaction_model.state_change: Continuous low-amplitude undulation around the rest level
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Faint ongoing breathing across the surface, never freezing and never building up
interaction_model.input: Autonomous idle driver after settling
interaction_model.affected_object: Whole block field

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Continuous and instantly re-aimable; the dip smoothly follows direction changes without discrete steps
interaction_model.state_change: Local displacement into a soft rounded depression that follows the pointer with a slight lag
interaction_model.visible_feedback: A dip presses into the surface just behind the pointer position and travels with it, edges falling off smoothly into undisturbed blocks
interaction_model.input: Pointer moving slowly over the surface
interaction_model.affected_object: Blocks beneath and immediately around the pointer

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Reversible by slowing down; the wake shortens smoothly back toward a single dip with no snap between the fast and slow appearance
interaction_model.state_change: The depression stretches from a single dip into an elongated wake whose length scales with speed
interaction_model.visible_feedback: A longer trailing furrow behind the pointer, still soft-edged and continuous with the leading dip
interaction_model.input: Pointer moving quickly over the surface
interaction_model.affected_object: Blocks along the recent pointer path

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Interruptible at any moment: resuming movement re-deepens the depression from its current partly recovered position rather than restarting
interaction_model.state_change: Wake collapses to a dip, then the dip relaxes toward rest level
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Blocks rise smoothly back to level, revealing the faint idle breathing again
interaction_model.input: Pointer stopping on the surface
interaction_model.affected_object: Deformed blocks

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Self-recovering with no stuck depression left behind; re-entry begins a new dip smoothly from the current surface state
interaction_model.state_change: All deformation relaxes to the level rest state
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The surface eases fully back to calm and continues breathing
interaction_model.input: Pointer leaving the surface or the window
interaction_model.affected_object: Whole block field

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Excess energy is absorbed and settles back to level once movement calms
interaction_model.state_change: Response is bounded rather than growing without limit
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Deformation stays within the surface, never tearing, spiking, escaping the region or leaving visible artifacts
interaction_model.input: Very fast or erratic pointer movement
interaction_model.affected_object: Surface deformation extent and amplitude

experience_qualities: Soft and springy, reading as compliant material rather than moving graphics
Immediately understandable with no learning, prompt or instruction
Calm and low-stakes, with an always-available return to rest
Alive rather than static thanks to persistent faint idle motion
Continuous and smooth throughout, with nothing snapping, jumping or teleporting
Tactile and inviting, rewarding aimless pointer wandering
completion_and_return: No completion state, score, end screen or terminal condition
The entry assembly happens once and resolves into the settled surface
Every interaction resolves by relaxing back to the level rest state plus idle breathing
Idle motion loops indefinitely and the interactive loop can be re-entered any number of times
No state accumulates or persists between interactions; the surface always converges back to calm
locked_observable_requirements: The surface is composed of many small repeated units read collectively as one continuous material
Entry assembles the surface outward from the middle and settles with a soft springy quality
A faint continuous idle motion persists whenever the surface is untouched
Pointer presence creates a soft rounded local depression, not a hard-edged or blocky cutout
The depression lags slightly behind the pointer rather than tracking it exactly
Faster pointer movement lengthens the depression into a trailing wake, slower movement shortens it back to a single dip
Stopping or leaving lets the surface ease smoothly back to level with no residual dent
All transitions are continuous, with no snapping, jumping or popping at any speed
Deformation remains bounded inside the surface region however fast the pointer moves

There is no goal, end state or progression beyond returning to calm; depth and level differences must stay legible under whatever palette is chosen, and no specific hue, tone or stage brightness is required
adaptable_details: Unit size, spacing, count and overall density of the surface
Any palette, shading scheme and material finish for the blocks, light or dark, as long as units stay clearly separated from their surround and the depression stays readable against the rest level
Whether the surface reads as viewed flat-on or at an angle
Region footprint, aspect ratio and whether it fills the view or a bounded panel
Exact durations of the entry assembly and the relaxation back to level
Amplitude and rhythm of the idle breathing
Radius and depth of the dip and the proportionality between speed and wake length
Whether touch or other pointing input drives the same response
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits any surface-as-material experience where a dense field of small uniform units is the thing being looked at and the pointer is the only driver, with little or no foreground content competing for attention; it transfers to hero areas, standalone playful pages and calm interlude regions in any host palette or theme, since it depends on level, depth, lag and motion rather than on particular colors. It stops being this Skill if the units carry individual meaning or become selectable items, if the response encodes data or navigation, if deformation persists as a lasting mark or accumulates toward a goal or end state, if the reaction becomes hard-edged, instantaneous or snap-based rather than lagging and springy, or if the surface must sit behind dense readable foreground content where its motion would compete with reading.

name: squash_and_bounce_mascot_loop_with_orbit_stage
description: A cartoon block character drops fast, flattens hard on landing with a comic burst at the moment of impact, springs up again, and repeats endlessly on a soft hazy floor whose edges fall away into a low-emphasis surround, while the visitor swings the viewpoint around it, zooms in or out, and can freeze and resume the beat.

canonical_document.name: squash_and_bounce_mascot_loop_with_orbit_stage
canonical_document.description: A cartoon block character drops fast, flattens hard on landing with a comic burst at the moment of impact, springs up again, and repeats endlessly on a soft hazy floor whose edges fall away into a low-emphasis surround, while the visitor swings the viewpoint around it, zooms in or out, and can freeze and resume the beat.
canonical_document.experience_scope: A single self-contained stage region or whole view. It begins in a quiet held state with a visible invitation to start, becomes an endless motion loop once started, and never reaches an end state; it ends only when the visitor leaves or freezes it.
content_and_composition: Exactly one hero character: a simple cartoon block-shaped body that reads as heavy and elastic
One ground plane the character lands on, establishing a clear floor line and contact point
A soft hazy stage envelope whose edges fall off into a low-emphasis surround, framing and isolating the character as the only high-salience focus
One momentary impact effect that appears at the landing point and dissipates, spatially anchored to where the body meets the ground
One opening invitation element overlaid in front of the stage, present only before the loop starts
One persistent freeze/resume control that remains available for the whole session
No competing foreground text, imagery or secondary subjects inside the stage
experience_progression: Held opening state: the scene is composed and visibly ready but motionless, with the invitation in front
Start: the invitation fades out and the motion beat begins immediately from that moment
Plunge: the character rushes downward, reading as gathering weight
Landing: the body squashes flat and wide against the ground at maximum contact, with the comic impact burst appearing at that exact instant
Launch: the body stretches and springs upward, decelerating toward its high point
Apex hang: brief slowdown at the top before falling again
The beat repeats identically and indefinitely with no finish line, milestone or ending
attention_and_information_flow: Before start, prominence sits on the invitation, and the still scene behind it signals readiness rather than stalling
On start, the invitation's fade hands attention entirely to the character
The hazy stage and its falling-off edges suppress the periphery so the character stays the only place attention can settle
Attention spikes at each landing, where the flattened body and the burst coincide, then eases through the springy rise and apex
Viewpoint changes reveal new angles and silhouettes of the same performance without introducing new content or information layers

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: One-way transition out of the held state; the invitation does not return, and the loop is thereafter governed by the freeze/resume control
interaction_model.state_change: Held ready state becomes the running loop
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The invitation fades away and the character starts moving from that moment, with impact instants becoming audible
interaction_model.input: Tap or click on the opening invitation
interaction_model.affected_object: Opening invitation overlay and the character's motion beat

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Motion can be grabbed again mid-coast; the angle is clamped so the viewpoint never slips beneath the ground plane or tips over the top, and it settles rather than snapping at those limits
interaction_model.state_change: Viewing angle rotates continuously with the drag and continues briefly after release
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The stage swings around the character and coasts smoothly to rest instead of stopping abruptly
interaction_model.input: Drag anywhere in the stage
interaction_model.affected_object: Viewpoint around the character

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Distance is clamped at a near and a far bound so the subject can never be entered or lost; further input past a bound produces no further movement
interaction_model.state_change: Viewpoint moves closer or further
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The character grows or shrinks in frame while remaining centered and framed by the hazy falling-off edges
interaction_model.input: Pinch or wheel
interaction_model.affected_object: Viewing distance to the character

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Freely reversible any number of times; viewpoint dragging and zooming stay fully available while frozen, so the held pose can be studied from other angles
interaction_model.state_change: Running loop becomes frozen in place, or resumes from the exact frozen instant
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The body holds its current pose mid-fall, mid-squash or mid-rise as a still tableau, then continues from that same pose with no jump or restart
interaction_model.input: The freeze/resume control
interaction_model.affected_object: The character's motion beat and the impact effect

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Runs indefinitely without user input once started; interrupted only by freeze, and resumed at the same instant
interaction_model.state_change: The beat advances through plunge, squash, launch and apex and restarts
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Continuous exaggerated weight-and-spring motion with a burst at every landing
interaction_model.input: Autonomous loop driver
interaction_model.affected_object: Character body and impact effect

experience_qualities: Playful and comic rather than realistic
Exaggerated sense of weight and elasticity, with heavy falls and snappy recoveries
Punchy, well-timed impact accents
Calm, focused isolation from the hazy, softly falling-off surround
Smooth, unhurried viewpoint handling that coasts rather than jerks
Loitering-friendly: rewarding to keep watching and to re-angle
completion_and_return: No completion state, score, ending or call to move on
The motion beat loops endlessly and identically
Freeze preserves the exact instant and pose so resuming is seamless
The opening held state is a one-time entry and is not returned to
Chosen viewpoint angle and distance persist across freeze and resume
locked_observable_requirements: Exactly one hero character as the sole subject of the stage
A quiet, visibly ready held state with a tappable invitation that fades on start and starts motion at that moment
An exaggerated weight cycle with a fast plunge, a visibly flattened landing, and a springy stretch-and-launch
A momentary comic impact effect appearing at the landing point at the exact instant of contact
A hazy stage whose edges fall off into a de-emphasized surround, keeping the character the only high-salience focus
Endless repetition with no ending or finish line
Drag-to-orbit with inertial coast to rest on release
Pinch/wheel distance change
Viewpoint clamped above the ground plane, below overhead, and between a near and far distance
A single freeze control that holds the pose in place and resumes from that exact instant, with viewpoint control still usable while frozen
adaptable_details: Character silhouette, face, color treatment and surface style
Ground plane appearance and haze density or edge falloff strength, in either a light or a dark surround
Visual styling of the impact burst
Beat timing, fall height, squash depth and spring strength
Wording, styling and placement of the opening invitation
Placement and iconography of the freeze/resume control
Presence, character and volume of impact audio
Exact clamp angles and near/far distance values
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits any single hero character, mascot, prop or block-like object whose appeal is an exaggerated repeating motion beat watched from freely chosen angles, with no surrounding foreground content competing inside the stage, and in any host color scheme so long as the character stays clearly separated in salience from its falling-off surround. Adding multiple simultaneous performers, an ordered narrative with an ending, goal-directed play, or placing the loop behind readable foreground content as a substrate would create a different Skill, as would replacing the endless watched beat with a scroll- or progress-driven sequence.

name: tumbling_weighted_objects_settle_readout
description: Solid faced objects are thrown in from one side of an empty, low-distraction surface, tumble unpredictably, and each reports its upward face value as it individually comes to rest, with a single control that cuts any motion and throws again.

canonical_document.name: tumbling_weighted_objects_settle_readout
canonical_document.description: Solid faced objects are thrown in from one side of an empty, low-distraction surface, tumble unpredictably, and each reports its upward face value as it individually comes to rest, with a single control that cuts any motion and throws again.
canonical_document.experience_scope: A self-contained stage region that can fill the main view: it begins automatically on arrival with a throw already in flight and ends when every object has settled and its value is displayed; the cycle repeats for each throw and the readout persists between cycles.
content_and_composition: One open, plain, visually quiet surface acting as an uncluttered stage, held tonally distinct from the objects and carrying no decorative content competing for attention
A small set of solid, weighty, faced objects (two or more), each with face values that contrast enough against their own faces to stay readable from above when at rest
One persistent throw control, always reachable regardless of current motion state
One result readout region that accumulates one value per settled object, kept legible while the objects remain at rest
Objects, surface and readout share a single view; the readout sits alongside or beneath the stage rather than covering the objects' upward faces
experience_progression: Arrival: a throw is already under way, so the purpose is legible without instruction or an idle empty state
Launch: the previous result clears and the objects enter from one side edge of the surface with a fresh random trajectory and spin
Tumble: objects travel loose across the surface, colliding and reorienting, outcome not yet knowable or displayed
Settling: motion decays and objects come to rest at different moments rather than simultaneously
Reporting: each object's upward face value appears as that individual object stops, so the result assembles incrementally
Rest: all objects still, full result held legibly, ready for an immediate new throw
Loop: any throw returns to the launch stage
attention_and_information_flow: During flight, motion holds all attention and no numeric information is available anywhere
As motion decays, prominence shifts from the moving bodies to the upward faces of the stopped objects
Revealed information grows one item at a time, matching the staggered settling rather than appearing as a single block
Once everything is still, the readout becomes the stable focus while the stage stays quiet
The throw control remains visible but subordinate throughout, never competing with the tumble or the result

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: The user can intervene at any point with the throw control; the automatic opening throw is otherwise allowed to resolve normally
interaction_model.state_change: Idle never shown; the experience opens mid-throw with an empty readout
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Objects already tumbling across the surface, immediately communicating what the region does
interaction_model.input: Arrival at the view (autonomous driver, no user action)
interaction_model.affected_object: Whole stage: objects and readout

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Repeatable without limit; each activation fully replaces the prior cycle instead of queuing another one
interaction_model.state_change: Previous result cleared; objects re-enter from one side with a newly randomized tumble that differs from prior throws
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Readout empties and the objects sweep in from the side edge, spinning across the surface
interaction_model.input: Activating the single throw control
interaction_model.affected_object: All objects and the result readout

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Interruption is always permitted and never leaves stranded objects, doubled sets or stale partial results
interaction_model.state_change: Current motion is cut immediately and a clean new throw begins from the entry side
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The interrupted tumble disappears and a fresh entry begins at once, with the readout back to empty; no leftover values from the abandoned throw
interaction_model.input: Activating the throw control while objects are still moving
interaction_model.affected_object: In-flight objects and any partially filled readout

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: A new throw supersedes any partially reported result
interaction_model.state_change: Object transitions from moving to genuinely at rest on a flat face, and only then contributes its value
interaction_model.visible_feedback: That object's upward face value appears in the readout on its own, ahead of objects still moving
interaction_model.input: Autonomous settling of an individual object
interaction_model.affected_object: That single object and the readout

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: The result remains incomplete rather than guessed; throwing again abandons the unresolved state cleanly
interaction_model.state_change: The object stays uncounted while unresolved, then resolves when it topples onto a flat face
interaction_model.visible_feedback: No value is shown for it while balanced; its value appears only after it tips flat, so the reported set is never ambiguous
interaction_model.input: An object coming to rest balanced on an edge rather than flat
interaction_model.affected_object: That single object and its pending readout entry

experience_qualities: Objects read as heavy and physically solid rather than as flat graphics
Loose, unrepeated tumbles that make the outcome feel honestly uncertain
Quiet, spacious stage that keeps the motion and the result uncluttered
Immediate responsiveness: a new throw is always one step away and never has to be waited out
Staggered, suspenseful resolution rather than an instant answer
Self-explaining on arrival, requiring no instructions
completion_and_return: A cycle completes when every object is at rest on a flat face and its value has been reported
The completed result stays legible and stable until the next throw replaces it
The experience loops indefinitely through the same single control; no separate reset exists
Interrupting mid-cycle returns cleanly to the launch stage with an empty readout
locked_observable_requirements: The view opens with a throw already in progress, never with a static idle stage
Objects enter from one side of the surface rather than appearing in place
Every throw produces a visibly different tumble path and orientation
No value is displayed while any of its object is still in motion
Values appear one at a time, keyed to each object's own moment of rest
An object balanced on an edge stays uncounted until it falls onto a flat face
The throw control works at any moment, including mid-tumble, cutting current motion and restarting cleanly
The stage remains an otherwise empty, visually quiet surface that stays clearly separated from the objects resting on it
The reported result remains legible while the objects stay at rest
adaptable_details: Number of objects and number of faces per object
How face values are drawn (marks, numerals or symbols)
Object and surface coloring, material finish and lighting treatment, so long as objects stay separated from the stage and face values stay readable
Viewing angle and framing of the stage
Which side objects enter from and the vigor of the throw
Readout layout and whether an aggregate figure accompanies the individual values
Presence of accompanying sound and the wording of the throw control
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits any context where a small set of discrete objects must be tossed and where each object's resting orientation encodes a short readable outcome, such as randomizers, picks, draws or playful hero regions. Replacing the discrete resting-face outcome with a continuous readout, showing values before the objects come to rest, removing the honest uncertainty, or turning the readout into a persistent history, scoring or multi-round layout would create a different Skill. Filling the stage with surrounding content or scenery would also break its identity as a bare, uncluttered surface for tangible motion.
