name: boundless_living_cell_field
description: A viewport completely filled by an autonomously evolving population of discrete cells that you drag and zoom through, from a whole-world view where the population reads as drifting texture to a close view where single cells and recurring shapes are crisply legible, with edges that continue back into the field.

canonical_document.name: boundless_living_cell_field
canonical_document.description: A viewport completely filled by an autonomously evolving population of discrete cells that you drag and zoom through, from a whole-world view where the population reads as drifting texture to a close view where single cells and recurring shapes are crisply legible, with edges that continue back into the field.
canonical_document.experience_scope: Begins immediately on view load with the field already running and fills the entire visible area; it has no start step, no end state and no exit, so the region is the whole view for as long as it is open. Can also be scoped to a single large region if foreground content sits above it, but the field always occupies that region edge to edge.
content_and_composition: One primary content role: a very large population of small discrete cells on a regular field, far larger than the viewport at close scale
The population reads as two simultaneous compositional layers depending on scale: aggregate density and drifting texture when wide, individual cells and small recurring structures when close
No panels, controls, labels, setup screens or start affordances are part of the composition; the field is edge-to-edge with nothing framing it
The viewport itself is the only persistent element — a movable window onto a space that has no visible outer boundary or empty margin
Optional foreground overlay content, if any, sits above the field without interrupting it
experience_progression: Alive from the first moment shown: no idle, seeding or press-to-start stage
Continuous non-terminating advance of the population, with change visible at every moment rather than in discrete rounds a viewer must wait for
Viewer-driven scale traversal is a second, independent continuous progression between wide overview and close inspection, traversable in either direction at any time
No completion, resolution, level or ending stage exists at any point
attention_and_information_flow: At wide scale attention is drawn to global movement — density gradients, drifting fronts and large-scale pattern — while individual cells are below legibility
As scale increases, information shifts from aggregate texture to structure: clusters resolve into distinct cells and recognizable recurring shapes with identifiable behavior
Scale change is continuous and anchored so the viewer keeps a sense of place; nothing snaps, re-centers or reshuffles between overview and detail
Because motion never stops, attention can rest anywhere and still be rewarded; no element demands to be looked at first

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Never pauses, stalls or visibly stutters, including while the viewer is panning or scaling; there is no stop or resume state to recover from
interaction_model.state_change: Each cell's visible state changes over time so the population perpetually reorganizes
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Constant restless change everywhere in view — drifting and shifting texture when wide, individual cells appearing and disappearing when close
interaction_model.input: Autonomous evolution of the population, running from load onward
interaction_model.affected_object: The whole field of cells

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Reversible at any moment by dragging back; on release the view stays exactly where it was left with no drift, snap-back or recentering
interaction_model.state_change: The view translates so the grabbed point stays pinned directly under the pointer for the whole drag
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The field slides one-to-one with the pointer, as if the world itself were being pushed
interaction_model.input: Drag with pointer or touch across the field
interaction_model.affected_object: The viewport's position over the field

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Scaling stops cleanly at both the fully-out and fully-in ends with no rubber-band overshoot or continued travel past them, and the opposite gesture immediately reverses direction
interaction_model.state_change: The view rescales smoothly around the pointer or pinch position, spanning the full range from the entire world in view to crisp individual cells
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Cells grow or shrink under the anchor point while that point stays fixed on screen; detail resolves into legible individual cells or dissolves into aggregate texture
interaction_model.input: Wheel turn or pinch gesture
interaction_model.affected_object: The scale of the field within the viewport

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Travel in any direction remains unbounded, so no recovery from an edge is ever needed
interaction_model.state_change: The view continues into more of the field rather than reaching a limit
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Populated field keeps arriving; the viewer never sees emptiness, a border, an unfilled gap or a hard stop
interaction_model.input: Panning past an edge of the field
interaction_model.affected_object: The field content entering the viewport

experience_qualities: Immediately alive, with no sense of waiting or setup
Calm and open-ended rather than goal-driven or urgent
Continuous and unbroken — motion, panning and scaling all feel smooth and simultaneous
Spatially trustworthy: the viewer always knows where they are while moving between scales
Vast, giving the impression of a world much larger than the window onto it
completion_and_return: No completion state; the experience simply continues as long as it is shown
Releasing a drag or ending a zoom leaves the view resting exactly at the final position and scale
The population never resets, restarts or returns to an initial arrangement while in view
Interaction can be abandoned and resumed at will with the view preserved as left
locked_observable_requirements: Alive and changing from the first frame shown, with no start, setup or seed step
Fills its viewport edge to edge with the field and no framing chrome
Population change never pauses, stalls or visibly hitches, including during panning and scaling
Drag pans with the grabbed point pinned under the pointer
Zoom rescales around the pointer or pinch anchor, continuously across the full range
Range spans an entire-world overview at one end and crisply legible individual cells at the other
Scale stops cleanly at both ends with no overshoot
Panning past an edge continues into more populated field, never into emptiness or a boundary
View position and scale persist exactly where the viewer leaves them
adaptable_details: Cell shape, size, color treatment, contrast level and whether state is shown by fill, luminance or hue difference
The specific rule governing how the population changes and the initial arrangement
Speed of evolution and how much the population churns versus settles
Overall field dimensions and how dense the starting population is
Whether the smallest scale shows the field as fine texture or coarse blocks
Presence and styling of optional overlay content above the field
Cursor treatment and gesture tuning such as zoom step size and drag inertia
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits any subject that can be expressed as a very large, self-changing field of many small uniform elements meant to be watched and roamed — generative fields, simulated populations, dense particle or grid-based worlds — as the primary visual of a view or a large region beneath light overlay content. It stays the same Skill when the rule, color treatment, density or pacing change. It becomes a different Skill if the field stops evolving on its own, needs a start or configuration step, gains a bounded edge with visible emptiness or a frame, snaps between discrete zoom levels instead of scaling continuously, re-centers or resets the view on release, or turns into an editable or goal-driven surface where the visitor places and manipulates content rather than observing and navigating it.

canonical_document.name: endless_shaft_ricochet_descent

canonical_document.experience_scope: Whole-view, fully framed and centred region that fills the viewport with no scrollbars; it begins already in progress the instant the view appears and has no end point, continuing for as long as the view is displayed.

A vertical shaft or tunnel formed by many flat panels, each visibly separated from its neighbours, arranged around and down its length and receding into depth

An orbiting viewpoint that keeps the shaft interior and the moving object continuously framed and centred

Persistent elements: the shaft walls, the ball, and the circling viewpoint remain present at all times

interaction_model.state_change: Scene enters an already-underway state rather than an initial or empty state

interaction_model.visible_feedback: Steady, hypnotic plunge with the shaft continuing to recede below

interaction_model.state_change: Contact resolves into a rebound with a change of direction

interaction_model.affected_object: The struck panel and the object's trajectory

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Orbit is not steerable and never stops; it loops around the shaft indefinitely
interaction_model.state_change: Viewpoint circles the shaft at a slow, even rate
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Panels and shaft walls sweep past, making the tunnel's depth and dimensionality unmistakable
interaction_model.input: Autonomous slow viewpoint orbit
interaction_model.affected_object: Camera viewpoint around the shaft

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: The scene is deliberately inert to pointer input, so there is nothing to undo or recover from
interaction_model.state_change: None
interaction_model.visible_feedback: No hover, highlight, cursor affordance or change of any kind
interaction_model.input: Pointing at or clicking anywhere in the view
interaction_model.affected_object: Nothing

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Timing and continuity survive any number of resizes; motion never resets to a beginning
interaction_model.state_change: Scene reframes to the new dimensions while its ongoing motion state is preserved
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The shaft stays centred and fully framed at any size, with no scrollbars and no visible jump, stall, restart, or change of pace

locked_observable_requirements: Low-distraction, near-empty stage held clearly below the single lit focal object in luminance, with that object as the only subject and no labels or instructions

Two opposing side lights of clearly distinguishable tone, above a barely readable ground

name: hushed_cue_morphs_into_endless_breathing_scene
description: A visually restrained, nearly frozen full-screen scene with one central start cue; pressing it makes the cue shed its wording and mark, contract into a small filling capsule that shows how much of the track has arrived, then disappear as the scene wakes into vast, continuous swelling and contracting motion synchronized to the sound, with no ending.

canonical_document.description: A visually restrained, nearly frozen full-screen scene with one central start cue; pressing it makes the cue shed its wording and mark, contract into a small filling capsule that shows how much of the track has arrived, then disappear as the scene wakes into vast, continuous swelling and contracting motion synchronized to the sound, with no ending.
canonical_document.experience_scope: Whole-view experience. It begins the moment the view is presented in its restrained, near-still waiting state with the single cue, passes through a one-way commitment and preparation stage, and continues indefinitely in the awakened sound-driven state with no exit, ending or return-to-cue state.
content_and_composition: One full-view atmospheric visual field that occupies the entire frame and is present in every stage, first held almost motionless at low intensity and low internal contrast, later expanding and contracting at large scale
Exactly one entry cue centered in the view during waiting, composed of short invitation wording plus a single play mark, visually the only actionable and the highest-salience focal element
A single small capsule form that the cue becomes: compact, self-contained, and hosting an internal fill that grows from empty toward full
No persistent chrome, controls, counters, exits or secondary panels; after the cue retires the scene is the only content

Sustain: the scene continues breathing with the sound indefinitely, with no ending, exit or closing stage

During preparation attention stays at that same point but the information it carries changes from 'what to do' to 'how far along readiness is', delivered purely by the rising fill rather than by text
As the capsule vanishes prominence transfers outward from the small center accent to the full frame, so the scene becomes the sole subject
In sustain there is no competing focal element; the only information is the scene's changing scale and intensity, read as the shape of the sound
Revealed information only ever increases toward immersion; the invitation is never reoffered

completion_and_return: No completion, ending or exit state exists; the sustained state is the terminal state
The awakened scene continues indefinitely rather than looping to a closing frame or returning to the waiting state

Nothing in the view invites or enables a restart
locked_observable_requirements: Arrival is visually restrained in intensity and internal contrast, hushed and nearly motionless with exactly one visible actionable cue
The cue carries both short invitation wording and a single play mark before commitment

canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits any whole-view experience built around one continuous audio or time-based media piece that must not start unasked and needs a visible wait before immersion, where the frame carries almost no foreground copy and is meant to be left running. name: breathing_character_field_word

canonical_document.name: breathing_character_field_word

canonical_document.experience_scope: Whole-view experience occupying the entire page from arrival onward; it is already running when the page appears and never ends, with no separate entry, start or exit region.

name: endless_descending_block_shaft
description: Looking down into a bottomless vertical shaft whose walls are made of countless small blocks; the whole structure turns slowly and sinks forever, with uneven block ends passing as ragged teeth through the frame.

Immediately legible depth requiring nothing to explain or learn

Adding navigation, readable copy or clickable targets over it, giving the shaft a visible bottom or arrival, exposing controls that steer or pause the motion, or replacing the receding block-walled shaft with a different subject would each create a different Skill.

name: low_distraction_stage_sound_driven_depth_field
description: A quiet, almost empty view with a uniform low-distraction surround offers one centred invitation to begin; on press the invitation vanishes and a self-luminous pattern rises immediately, endlessly renewing itself in visible response to the sound while receding into depth, and can be orbited and zoomed around its unmoving centre until the sound ends.

canonical_document.name: low_distraction_stage_sound_driven_depth_field
canonical_document.description: A quiet, almost empty view with a uniform low-distraction surround offers one centred invitation to begin; on press the invitation vanishes and a self-luminous pattern rises immediately, endlessly renewing itself in visible response to the sound while receding into depth, and can be orbited and zoomed around its unmoving centre until the sound ends.
canonical_document.experience_scope: Whole-view experience occupying the entire viewport; begins on arrival with the pre-start quiet stage, continues unbroken through the entire duration of the sound, and ends by simply running out with no closing step or exit screen.
content_and_composition: Uniform, near-empty low-distraction surround that reads as an unlit stage of any tone and remains the visual ground throughout
Exactly one centred start invitation on arrival, the only prominent element before sound begins
One quiet corner label naming what will be heard, small and at low contrast against the surround, present from arrival

One self-luminous renewing pattern occupying the centre of the view after start, extending away from the viewer so nearer parts read larger and separate more strongly from the surround while farther parts converge toward it and fade into depth
A single fixed centre point that anchors the pattern and serves as the pivot for all viewpoint movement
experience_progression: Stage 1 — waiting: quiet, almost empty view with a uniform surround, one centred invitation and a quiet corner label; nothing moves prominently
Stage 2 — ignition: invitation disappears and the luminous pattern comes up immediately as sound starts, with no intermediate screen
Stage 3 — sustained run: pattern renews itself continuously and visibly tracks the sound, holding a calm hypnotic register for the full duration with no further prompts or stages
Stage 4 — natural end: sound finishes and the experience simply stops advancing; no completion prompt, summary or dismissal is presented
attention_and_information_flow: Before start, all prominence sits on the single centred invitation; the corner label supplies only the identity of what will play
At start, prominence transfers wholly to the pattern as the invitation is removed, leaving no competing controls
During the run, information is carried entirely by the pattern's changing shape, luminance and depth rather than by text or indicators
Viewpoint changes redistribute prominence within the pattern — nearer regions dominate, farther regions recede toward the surround — without introducing new interface elements
The corner label stays quiet and never competes for attention

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: One-way transition; the invitation does not return and no restart step is offered within the experience
interaction_model.state_change: Waiting state becomes running state in one step
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Invitation disappears and the luminous pattern appears immediately as a high-salience change and begins renewing in step with the sound
interaction_model.input: Single press on the centred start invitation
interaction_model.affected_object: Start invitation, the sound, and the luminous pattern

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Autonomous and uninterrupted for the whole duration; requires no user upkeep and offers no per-frame control
interaction_model.state_change: Pattern is continuously renewed so its form corresponds to the sound at that moment
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Unmistakable coupling between what is heard and the pattern's shifting shape and emitted light, constantly refreshed rather than looping a fixed animation
interaction_model.input: Continuous sound while running
interaction_model.affected_object: Luminous pattern

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Any exploratory swing is fully reversible by dragging back, since the centre never shifts; releasing simply leaves the current angle in place
interaction_model.state_change: Viewpoint swings around the pattern's fixed centre
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Pattern appears to rotate in place as it is seen from a new angle while its centre stays put
interaction_model.input: Drag across the view while running
interaction_model.affected_object: Viewpoint onto the pattern

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Reversible by wheeling the other way; the centre remains the anchor so the pattern is never lost off-view
interaction_model.state_change: Viewpoint moves nearer to or further from the fixed centre
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Pattern grows or shrinks in the view and its depth recession becomes more or less pronounced
interaction_model.input: Wheel input while running
interaction_model.affected_object: Viewing distance to the pattern

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Applies at any size; the running state, viewpoint angle and distance are preserved across the change
interaction_model.state_change: View extent updates to the new window
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Visual continues to fill the viewport completely with undistorted proportions, without interrupting the run or the sound
interaction_model.input: Change of window size
interaction_model.affected_object: Whole-view visual

experience_qualities: Quiet and low-key, with light reading as coming only from the pattern itself
Sparse before start, then wholly absorbing
Calm, hypnotic and continuous rather than punctuated by events
Unmistakably sound-driven, so the visual reads as caused by what is heard
Spatial and deep, inviting looking-around rather than reading
Guidance-free once begun
completion_and_return: Runs for the entire duration of the sound without requiring any step to finish
No completion screen, prompt, score or call to action at the end
Viewpoint angle and distance persist as left by the viewer; there is no automatic recentring
The pattern's renewal is continuous rather than a looping fixed sequence, so there is no seam to return to
locked_observable_requirements: Quiet, almost empty arrival view with a uniform low-distraction surround and exactly one prominent centred invitation to begin
A quiet corner label present from arrival identifying what will be heard, legible but clearly subordinate in contrast
One press removes the invitation, starts the sound and brings the visual up immediately as a high-salience change, with no intermediate state
After start, the luminous pattern is the sole focus with no further guidance or controls on screen
The pattern renews itself constantly and reads unmistakably as shaped by the sound
The pattern recedes into depth rather than reading as flat, with a controlled luminance transition from near to far
The pattern reads as self-luminous and stays clearly separated in luminance from the surround, whatever tone the surround takes
Drag swings the viewpoint around the pattern's centre and wheel moves nearer or further, with the centre always remaining the pivot

Visual fills the viewport at correct proportions at any window size; no step is required to finish and the experience ends when the sound does
adaptable_details: Hue and overall tone of the surround and of the pattern's glow, provided their luminance separation stays wide
The pattern's specific motif, density and grain
Visual form and wording of the start invitation
Which corner carries the quiet label and its typographic treatment
Speed and easing of the pattern's renewal within a calm register
Sensitivity of drag and wheel, and any limits on how near or far the viewpoint may travel
Length of the sound
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits any single continuous piece of sound presented as the sole content of a full view, where a bare uniform stage of any tone, one entry press and unguided immersion are acceptable. Adding transport controls, progress indicators, chapters, multiple selectable pieces, foreground text or imagery over the pattern, or driving the pattern from something other than the playing sound would create a different Skill; likewise, letting the pivot move freely, collapsing the luminance separation between pattern and surround, or turning the pattern into a flat non-receding surface would break its identity.

name: toppling_mirrored_block_wall
description: A stacked wall of mirrored blocks whose invitation is legible only inside the reflective faces; clicking a block shoves it away, knocks its neighbours and collapses the wall into a heap on the floor.

canonical_document.name: toppling_mirrored_block_wall
canonical_document.description: A stacked wall of mirrored blocks whose invitation is legible only inside the reflective faces; clicking a block shoves it away, knocks its neighbours and collapses the wall into a heap on the floor.
canonical_document.experience_scope: A self-contained mode or region occupying the same low-distraction surrounding scene; it begins with the wall intact and runs until every remaining piece has been pushed down and rests on the floor, with no in-place reset.

interaction_model.state_change: The whole arrangement tilts toward the pointer within a shallow, eased range

interaction_model.input: Pointer movement over the scene
interaction_model.affected_object: The wall or heap as one body

Weighty, physical give-way rather than a neat animation

name: mirrored_point_light_self_portrait_breathing_with_sound
description: A full-screen mirrored portrait of the visitor, set on a low-distraction surround and built from countless tiny points of light whose relief and chroma pulse with the playing track, and which eases flat and drains to a single uniform tone when the sound is clicked off.

interaction_model.visible_feedback: The picture keeps filling the window at its true proportions with no stretching or squashing of the likeness
interaction_model.input: Window resize
interaction_model.affected_object: The whole view and the portrait within it

experience_qualities: Low-distraction, hypnotic and endless
Immediately self-recognisable despite heavy stylisation
Causally legible without instruction: sound plainly shapes the image
Prepared and composed at the start rather than abrupt or broken
Rewardless by design: the pleasure is watching, not achieving
completion_and_return: No completion, goal or ending; the experience simply continues
Stopping the sound is a held state, not an end, and clicking returns fully to the live animated state
Nothing accumulates or persists across the session; every return lands in the same endless watching state
locked_observable_requirements: The visitor's live likeness is mirrored so it behaves like a reflection
The likeness is rendered as countless tiny points of light reading as illuminated specks against a plain low-distraction field with clear luminance separation, never as plain video
The portrait's relief and chroma are visibly driven by the running sound, so the coupling reads within seconds
A single click anywhere toggles the sound, and silence is shown as the portrait easing flat and draining to a single uniform low-chroma tone
Resuming the sound restores both relief and chroma
The opening is a brief quiet prepared wait, not a blank or apparently broken screen
When no camera image is available the view shows a short plain notice instead of nothing
Resizing refills the viewport without distorting the likeness
The experience is endless with no completion state and no visible interface competing with the subject
adaptable_details: Density, size and spacing of the points of light
Choice of hues and luminance levels used for the sound-driven chroma, the surround, and the depth of the relief
Choice and length of the soundtrack
Duration and styling of the quiet opening wait
Wording of the plain no-camera notice
Precise easing and duration of the flatten-and-drain and its reversal
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits any page where the visitor's own live image is the intended foreground subject and a continuous soundtrack is present, especially sparse full-screen views with no competing content. Replacing the live self-image with fixed imagery or abstract shapes removes the self-recognition that defines it, and replacing the single breathing subject with discrete meters, bars or a chart-like readout of the sound would be a different skill. Because it is an attention-owning full-view foreground subject that needs its surround kept quiet, it does not transfer to use as a substrate behind readable page content.

name: self_enacting_word_column
description: A compact vertical stack of a few single words, each permanently animating in the way it literally describes, so a reader understands each meaning by watching it perform.

canonical_document.name: self_enacting_word_column
canonical_document.description: A compact vertical stack of a few single words, each permanently animating in the way it literally describes, so a reader understands each meaning by watching it perform.
canonical_document.experience_scope: A self-contained region: one narrow centered column of words that is already running the moment the view appears and never ends. It can occupy a full arrival view or sit as a block inside a longer page; it has no entry gate and no exit state.
content_and_composition: One primary content role: a small ordered set of single words (roughly a half-dozen), each a self-describing action or state term.
Words are stacked as one narrow column, one word per line, read top to bottom.
Each word owns its own independent animation envelope; no shared timeline, master clock or synchronized beat between neighbours.
No labels, captions, numbering, legends or explanatory copy anywhere in the region — the motion is the only explanation.
No frames, cards, buttons, controls, progress indicators or decorative chrome around the words.
Motion is confined to each word's own line so the column layout stays stable and comparable while everything moves.
attention_and_information_flow: Meaning is legible within about a second of arrival: the first word encountered already demonstrates the pattern that the rest follow.
Attention slides downward through the column rather than jumping around; nothing competes for a first click.
The reader settles on one word long enough to read its behaviour, then shifts to the neighbour and compares the two — comparison between adjacent words is part of the point.
All words hold equal prominence; no word is highlighted, promoted, dimmed or staged as the featured item.
No new information is unlocked over time — everything on offer is visible and running from the start.

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Nothing to trigger or arm; there is no idle or pre-start appearance to recover from
interaction_model.state_change: All animations are already in progress, each on its own independent cycle
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The whole column is alive on arrival, with words moving out of phase with one another
interaction_model.input: Autonomous: the region becoming visible
interaction_model.affected_object: Every word in the column

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Scrolling back up rejoins the same continuous motion; nothing restarts or replays from the beginning
interaction_model.state_change: None; motion is unaffected by attention or scroll position
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Each word is simply found already performing at whatever point of its cycle is current
interaction_model.input: Reading only — eye movement or scrolling down the column
interaction_model.affected_object: The word entering the reader's view

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: There is deliberately nothing to start, pause, replay, step or reset, so nothing can be left in a wrong state
interaction_model.state_change: None — no word waits for or responds to input to perform
interaction_model.visible_feedback: No hover, press, focus or activation effect; behaviour is identical whether or not the reader interacts
interaction_model.input: Pointer hover, click, tap or keypress
interaction_model.affected_object: Words

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: No stored progress, no completion badge, no changed second-visit state; drift between words is expected and harmless
interaction_model.state_change: Cycles continue independently of the reader's attention
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The return looks the same in character — words mid-motion, not resuming from a saved position
interaction_model.input: Glancing away and returning, or leaving and revisiting later
interaction_model.affected_object: The column as a whole

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Selecting does not stop, disturb or desynchronize any animation
interaction_model.state_change: Words behave as ordinary selectable text
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Selection shows the platform's own normal highlight treatment and the words read as real text, not as opaque graphics
interaction_model.input: Text selection or copying
interaction_model.affected_object: The words

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: No reload, restart or manual re-trigger needed after resizing
interaction_model.state_change: Layout reflows while every behaviour stays intact
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Words keep performing recognizably at the new size; none flatten, clip away or fall out of step
interaction_model.input: Window resize or viewport change
interaction_model.affected_object: Column layout and every word's motion

experience_qualities: Playful and witty — the joke lands through motion instead of explanation
Immediately self-explanatory; understood before any reading of instructions
Calm and demanding nothing: purely watchable, with no task, prompt or reward
Alive and perpetual rather than staged as a one-time performance
Comparative — the pleasure comes from reading one behaviour against the next
Composed and compact rather than sprawling or spectacle-scaled
completion_and_return: No completion, no finish state, no unlocking and no end card.
Every word loops indefinitely on its own cycle, out of phase with the others.
No reset, no replay affordance and no persistent per-visitor state; a later visit feels the same as the first.
locked_observable_requirements: Each word's animation must depict that specific word's own meaning; a generic motion applied uniformly to all words breaks the Skill.
Meaning must be conveyed by motion alone — no captions, labels or explanatory text.
All words animate autonomously from the moment they are visible; none depends on hover, click, tap, keypress or scroll to perform.
Motion loops endlessly with no completion, pause, replay or reset affordance.
Words remain independent of one another, free to drift out of phase without appearing broken.
Words remain ordinary selectable text.
Every behaviour survives window resizing and remains recognizable at other viewport sizes.
A short vertical column read top to bottom, sparse enough to compare neighbouring words directly.
adaptable_details: The particular vocabulary chosen, as long as each term describes an observable behaviour
Exact word count, within a short comparable set
Typeface, weight, size, casing and tonal treatment — any hue family works, provided every word reads with equal prominence and comfortable contrast
Column alignment, line spacing and surrounding empty space
Speed, easing and amplitude of each individual behaviour
Whether the column fills the arrival view or sits within a longer page
Surround tone, light or dark or anything between, provided the words stay clearly legible throughout their motion
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits any short set of single words or very short phrases whose meanings are physically depictable, presented as the foreground subject with room to breathe. It stops being this Skill if the words become passive labels for something else, if animation is gated behind hover, click or scroll position, if a shared synchronized timeline or narrative sequence is imposed on the set, if captions explain the effects, if the motion becomes decorative rather than literal to each word, or if the content grows into paragraphs or a dense list where per-word comparison is no longer possible.

name: drag_seeded_rising_bubble_field
description: A quiet, near-empty expanse held at one uniform tone, already filled with hundreds of small rising, wobbling bubbles seen as if through moving water, where holding and dragging the pointer lays down a trail of new bubbles that join the rise and fade away by themselves.

canonical_document.name: drag_seeded_rising_bubble_field
canonical_document.description: A quiet, near-empty expanse held at one uniform tone, already filled with hundreds of small rising, wobbling bubbles seen as if through moving water, where holding and dragging the pointer lays down a trail of new bubbles that join the rise and fade away by themselves.
canonical_document.experience_scope: Whole-view experience that begins immediately on entry with the field already populated and running; it has no end state and continues idling for as long as the view is open, with the pointer-driven emission available anywhere across the full surface.
content_and_composition: A uniform, low-distraction full-surface ground that reads as depth rather than as a decorated panel
Hundreds of small bubbles distributed across the surface at varied sizes, each with its own tilt, drifting upward
Bubbles rendered with a watery, refractive quality so the ground appears to shift and wobble through them
One brief centered text prompt as the only foreground element, visually light and low in weight so it sits legibly over the field without blocking it
Newly created bubbles occupy the same visual layer and follow the same rules as the pre-existing ones, so authored and ambient bubbles are indistinguishable
experience_progression: Entry: the field is already in mid-motion, never starting from empty or building up
Idle: continuous upward rise, wobble and gradual self-removal keeps the population roughly stable and the view uncluttered
Optional user bursts: density rises locally where the pointer has been dragged, then relaxes back toward the ambient baseline as those bubbles shrink away
No completion, no score, no ending; the loop is endless
attention_and_information_flow: The moving field claims ambient attention first through sheer count and motion rather than through any single focal element
The centered prompt is read quickly as the one hint of what to try, then recedes because it stays small and static against continuous motion
Once the visitor drags, attention snaps to the pointer path where new bubbles appear instantly, making the gesture itself the focal content
After release, prominence drains back into the overall field as the drawn streak disperses upward and thins out

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Emission is bounded to the duration of the press; nothing is queued or delayed, so the visitor can stop contributing at any moment
interaction_model.state_change: A new bubble is created at each traversed position with a randomized small size and tilt, and immediately enters the same rising, wobbling behavior as the existing bubbles
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Bubbles appear with no delay along the pointer path, so a fast sweep leaves a dense streak and a slow drag leaves only a sparse trickle, and the whole trail begins drifting upward as it is drawn
interaction_model.input: Pressing the pointer down and moving it across the surface
interaction_model.affected_object: The bubble field at each position the pointer passes through

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Release is the natural stop; no confirmation and no interruption of the ongoing field motion
interaction_model.state_change: Creation of new bubbles stops at once while all existing bubbles keep rising
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The trail stops growing at the last position and the already-drawn bubbles continue on their own, leaving a visible record of the gesture that gradually disperses
interaction_model.input: Releasing the pointer
interaction_model.affected_object: The emission behavior

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Resumption is instantaneous and position-independent; repeated press-release cycles accumulate freely
interaction_model.state_change: Emission resumes from the new position with no clearing, resetting or restarting of the field
interaction_model.visible_feedback: New bubbles begin appearing at the new location while everything created earlier continues rising undisturbed
interaction_model.input: Pressing again anywhere on the surface
interaction_model.affected_object: The emission behavior and the existing bubble population

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Self-removal is the only cleanup mechanism, so there is no cleanup control to find and no way to over-fill the view permanently
interaction_model.state_change: Each bubble thins out and removes itself by shrinking away after its rise
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The view never clogs; dense streaks visibly relax back toward the calm baseline density without any sweep, clear or undo action
interaction_model.input: Autonomous passage of time
interaction_model.affected_object: Every bubble, whether ambient or visitor-created

experience_qualities: Calm, unhurried and atmospheric rather than energetic
Playful and immediately rewarding, with a one-gesture learning curve
Physically believable: floating, wobbling, refractive, buoyant
Deep and roomy, an expanse rather than a bounded widget
Consequence-free, since nothing can be broken, filled up or left messy
completion_and_return: No completion state, goal or ending; the experience is a permanent idle loop
Self-limiting rather than reset: population returns to its ambient density on its own
Repeated engagement leaves no accumulated state, so the view looks the same after a pause regardless of how much was drawn
Pressing again continues from the current field instead of restarting it
locked_observable_requirements: The field is already populated with a large number of small bubbles at first sight, never empty on entry
Bubbles rise continuously and wobble, with a watery refractive look that visibly distorts whatever ground lies behind them
Emission requires a held pointer and follows its path, creating one bubble per traversed position so drag speed visibly controls streak density
New bubbles appear instantly with randomized small size and tilt and are indistinguishable from ambient ones
Release stops emission immediately; pressing again resumes anywhere with no reset or clearing
Every bubble removes itself by shrinking away, so the view self-clears and offers no cleanup or undo control
A single brief centered prompt is the only foreground text, legible against the ground yet never dominating the field
The ground stays visually quiet, uniform and near-empty, separated enough in luminance from the bubbles that they and the prompt remain the only things to look at
adaptable_details: Exact bubble count, size range, rise speed and lifetime
Strength and character of the wobble and refraction
Overall color treatment, ground luminance level, and whether faint highlights or tints appear on the bubbles
Wording, typography and fade behavior of the centered prompt
Whether the rise direction is strictly vertical or has a slight drift
Density falloff and spread of a drawn streak as it ages
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits full-view atmospheric openings, idle or playful toy surfaces, and quiet uniform backdrops of any tone carrying only a short line of overlaid text; it survives transfer wherever many small self-removing floating elements can occupy an otherwise empty low-distraction surface that still separates them clearly from the ground, and a pointer drag is free to roam. It becomes a different Skill if the floating elements carry meaning such as data points, media items or navigation targets, if drawn elements persist and must be managed, cleared or saved, if emission is triggered by a single click or automation instead of a held drag path, or if dense foreground content forces the field into a small bounded panel where the sense of an open expanse is lost.

name: living_light_trail_stage
description: An open, deep expanse whose surround stays quiet and clearly separated in luminance from glowing trails that keep renewing and never repeat, a title that assembles in front of them, a viewpoint that eases toward the pointer and glides back, and a controlled luminance hand-off when another labelled visual is chosen.

canonical_document.name: living_light_trail_stage
canonical_document.description: An open, deep expanse whose surround stays quiet and clearly separated in luminance from glowing trails that keep renewing and never repeat, a title that assembles in front of them, a viewpoint that eases toward the pointer and glides back, and a controlled luminance hand-off when another labelled visual is chosen.
canonical_document.experience_scope: Whole-view experience filling the entire window from arrival onward; it has no end state of its own, and each visual's segment ends only when a sibling is chosen and the hand-off completes into the next arrival.
content_and_composition: One full-window open expanse read as deep space rather than a flat panel, its surround held quiet and uniform and clearly separated in luminance from the trails; it is the substrate for everything else
One continuously renewing field of glowing line trails living inside that depth, never repeating exactly
One title of the currently showing visual, assembled in front of the field and central to the viewer's attention on arrival
One persistent set of sibling labels, one per available visual, with the current one identifiable
Strict layering: trail field behind, title and labels in front; foreground text is sparse so the motion remains readable
Composition always fills the window undistorted, with no stretching or cropping of the motion field's proportions
experience_progression: Arrival: the view rises out of its quietest luminance extreme and the expanse settles into an open, deep stage
The title assembles in front of the viewer while the trail field comes alive behind it
Steady state: trails keep being born and finishing indefinitely, always a little different, with nothing to complete
Hand-off on choosing a sibling: the view sinks, the title withdraws, new trails stop appearing while the remaining ones finish out, and the whole view eases toward its quietest luminance extreme

Sibling labels stay quietly legible throughout so the presence of other visuals and the current one are always readable without competing with the motion
