interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Runs unattended and needs no user action; there is nothing to finish or get wrong
interaction_model.state_change: Trails continuously appear, run and finish; the field never resolves into a repeated arrangement
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Endless, slightly different light motion with no visible loop point or end
interaction_model.input: Autonomous renewal of the trail field
interaction_model.affected_object: Glowing line trails inside the open expanse

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Fully reversible: as the pointer returns, the viewpoint glides back just as smoothly to rest; drift magnitude stays small and bounded so it can never be pushed off-centre
interaction_model.state_change: Viewpoint eases toward the pointer offset instead of snapping, while its focus stays centred
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Small, smooth parallax drift of depth in the light field, following the pointer with a soft lag
interaction_model.input: Pointer movement across the view
interaction_model.affected_object: Viewpoint onto the trail field

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Returns smoothly to rest as the device levels; equivalent bounds and reversibility
interaction_model.state_change: Same eased offset of the viewpoint driven by tilt
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The same gentle bounded drift and centred focus as pointer steering
interaction_model.input: Device tilt where no pointer exists
interaction_model.affected_object: Viewpoint onto the trail field

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Never cuts; the outgoing stage is allowed to complete before the incoming one begins, and the currently showing visual stays identifiable by its label throughout
interaction_model.state_change: Staged hand-off from the current visual to the chosen one rather than an immediate swap
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The view sinks, the title withdraws, no new trails appear while existing ones finish, the view fades to its quietest luminance, and then the next visual arrives with its own title assembling
interaction_model.input: Choosing another visual by its label
interaction_model.affected_object: Whole view: expanse depth, title, trail field, overall luminance

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Applies at any size continuously; no interruption of motion or loss of the current visual
interaction_model.state_change: Field and foreground text refit to the new window
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Everything continues filling the window with no distortion or stretched motion, and the renewal keeps running
interaction_model.input: Window resize
interaction_model.affected_object: Whole composition

experience_qualities: Atmospheric and low-distraction, with a sense of open depth rather than a bounded panel
Unhurried and low-stakes: watching is the activity, with nothing to complete
Ever-changing but never startling, because renewal is constant and never exactly repeats
Responsive yet gentle: input is felt as easing and drift, never as snapping
Cinematic between visuals, so leaving one reads as a calm hand-off rather than a cut
completion_and_return: No completion state; the light field renews indefinitely
Viewpoint always returns to its centred rest position once input stops
Choosing a sibling loops the experience back through the arrival stages for the new visual
The current selection persists as a visible marker among the sibling labels
locked_observable_requirements: A deep, open, low-noise full-window expanse as the substrate, its luminance clearly separated from the trails so they read as luminous
Glowing line trails that keep renewing and never repeat exactly, with no visible end
The current visual's title assembles in front of the field on arrival
Viewpoint eases toward pointer offset with focus kept centred, small bounded drift, and an equally smooth glide back
Tilt substitutes for pointer where no pointer exists, with the same easing and bounds

Switching visuals is a staged luminance hand-off: sink, title withdrawal, no new trails while remaining ones finish, a controlled fade to the view's quietest luminance, then the next takes over — never an instant cut
It remains obvious which visual is showing and that sibling visuals exist
The whole composition fills the window undistorted at any size
adaptable_details: Trail and expanse colouring — any hues and any light-or-dark surround work provided the luminance separation holds — along with trail brightness, thickness, density and path character
Depth amount and exact easing durations of drift and hand-off
Number of sibling visuals and placement or styling of their labels
Title typography and the manner in which it assembles and withdraws
How far the hand-off's luminance transition travels at its quietest point
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits full-view atmospheric showcases where luminous motion is the subject and only a title plus a small label set sits in front of it, and where several sibling visuals are browsed one at a time. It becomes a different skill if the field must sit behind dense readable content or interactive controls, if switching becomes an instant cut or a paged list view, if the motion is replaced by a finite scripted or scroll-narrated sequence with an ending, or if input must directly manipulate the trails instead of gently steering the viewpoint.

name: beat_driven_receding_corridor
description: An endless corridor of luminous blocks that recedes to one vanishing point against a low-activity surround held far from the blocks in luminance; a single press starts sound and forward glide together, the blocks swell and shift chroma on the beat, the corridor bends toward the pointer, and press-and-hold reverses travel while inverting the whole picture's luminance relationships.

canonical_document.name: beat_driven_receding_corridor
canonical_document.description: An endless corridor of luminous blocks that recedes to one vanishing point against a low-activity surround held far from the blocks in luminance; a single press starts sound and forward glide together, the blocks swell and shift chroma on the beat, the corridor bends toward the pointer, and press-and-hold reverses travel while inverting the whole picture's luminance relationships.
canonical_document.experience_scope: Whole-view experience occupying the entire stage from first load to indefinitely; it begins in a near-still idle state at minimal luminous activity with an invitation to start, and it never completes — it loops forever while audio sounds and degrades to a minimal drifting version when nothing plays.
content_and_composition: One full-view depth scene as the only foreground subject; no competing content regions
Many repeating ranks of luminous blocks arranged in depth, converging on a single vanishing point held near the center of the view
A quiet, near-uniform surround sitting at the opposite end of the luminance range from the blocks; the blocks are the only luminous material, so brightness reads as structure
One persistent small status line, subordinate in scale, stating what is loading and which track is currently sounding
One persistent primary press control that reads as an unmistakable invitation to begin and afterwards serves as pause/resume
One secondary control for supplying the listener's own audio file
A reduced skeleton variant of the same corridor used whenever no sound is playing
experience_progression: Idle: luminous activity at its lowest and almost no motion; the invitation to begin is the most prominent thing in the view and the status line reports loading state
Ignition: one deliberate press starts sound and forward travel simultaneously, read as a single continuous glide rather than a scene change
Sustained flight: unbroken advance deeper into the corridor while blocks swell and shift chroma with the beat; attention settles at the vanishing point
Momentary luminance inversions and off-axis bends layer over the sustained flight without interrupting it
Silence fallback: strips back to a bare drifting skeleton of the same corridor that still reads as restartable
No terminal stage; the flight loops indefinitely
attention_and_information_flow: The vanishing point is the fixed attentional anchor; nearer blocks read as peripheral speed rather than as objects to inspect
Beat-linked swells periodically push brightness and scale outward from the center and settle back, creating a repeating pull-and-release of attention
The invitation dominates while idle and recedes in prominence once motion and sound begin
The status line is the only informational layer and stays quiet and secondary; it changes only to report loading and the currently sounding track
Pointer-driven bending temporarily moves the focal point off center, making the visitor aware they are steering
Luminance inversion during hold momentarily reverses the whole figure/ground reading of the scene

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: The same control remains present and immediately takes on pause/resume duty; nothing else is required to enter the experience
interaction_model.state_change: From quiet, silent and near-still to sounding and continuously gliding
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The corridor begins advancing toward the viewer, blocks light up and start swelling and shifting chroma with the beat, and the invitation gives way to the moving scene
interaction_model.input: One deliberate press of the primary control while idle
interaction_model.affected_object: Audio playback and the corridor's forward travel

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Freely repeatable in both directions; paused state is stable and never collapses to the idle invitation
interaction_model.state_change: Toggles between paused and resumed
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Motion and beat response halt in place and hold the current depth, then pick up from the same place on resume
interaction_model.input: Later presses of the same control
interaction_model.affected_object: Audio playback and corridor motion together

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Can be repeated at any time; if nothing ends up playing, the scene falls back to the drifting skeleton that still invites a restart
interaction_model.state_change: Playback swaps to the visitor's own audio and the visual response re-tunes to it
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The status line reports what is loading and then which track is sounding; block swelling and chroma shifting follow the new track's beat
interaction_model.input: Choosing an audio file through the file picker
interaction_model.affected_object: The sounding source driving the visuals

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Taking the pointer away is enough to recover: the axis creeps back to a centered view on its own with no explicit reset
interaction_model.state_change: The depth direction swings toward the pointer so the corridor bends off-axis
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The whole receding structure visibly leans and the vanishing point tracks the pointer's position continuously while forward travel continues
interaction_model.input: Moving the pointer across the view
interaction_model.affected_object: The corridor's depth axis and vanishing point

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Release eases travel, swirl and luminance relationships back to the prior forward state rather than snapping; the hold can be entered and released repeatedly
interaction_model.state_change: Travel and swirl reverse while the picture's luminance relationships flip
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The corridor pulls backward instead of forward, the swirl turns the other way, and the brighter and dimmer regions trade places across the entire view
interaction_model.input: Pressing and holding anywhere in the view
interaction_model.affected_object: Travel direction, the swirl of the corridor, and the overall luminance relationships of the view

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: When sound stops or is paused, modulation subsides to the bare drifting skeleton; it resumes as soon as audio sounds again
interaction_model.state_change: Blocks swell and their chroma shifts in time with the beat
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Pulses of size and chroma travel through the corridor in step with the music while the forward glide stays continuous
interaction_model.input: Autonomous beat and level of the sounding audio
interaction_model.affected_object: Scale and chroma of the luminous blocks

experience_qualities: Hypnotic and endless; nothing signals an ending
Sparse and mostly empty, with luminous structure as the only content
Continuous rather than staged — motion, sound and reaction feel like one unbroken glide
Legibly sound-driven: the visitor can tell the picture is listening
Steerable but self-correcting, so experimentation carries no risk
The held inversion feels like a suspended breath that relaxes on release
Idle state feels dormant rather than broken, and clearly restartable
completion_and_return: No completion state; the flight loops indefinitely while audio sounds
Off-axis bending self-recenters once the pointer leaves
Hold-driven reversal and luminance inversion self-reverse and ease back on release
Pause holds the current position and depth rather than resetting
Absence of sound returns the view to a bare drifting skeleton that keeps the invitation to restart available
Swapping the audio source restarts the sustained flight without leaving the view
locked_observable_requirements: Near-motionless idle state at minimal luminous activity carrying an unmistakable invitation to begin plus a small status line naming what is loading and what is sounding
One continuous forward glide into an endless corridor that recedes to a single vanishing point holding attention
Repeating luminous blocks whose scale and chroma swell and shift in time with the audio
One control that starts sound and motion together and afterwards toggles pause and resume
Pointer position bends the depth axis visibly off-center, and the view creeps back to centered on its own when the pointer leaves
Press-and-hold reverses both travel and swirl while inverting the luminance relationships of the whole picture, easing back on release
The experience never finishes and never reaches a final frame
When nothing plays, the scene reduces to a bare drifting skeleton that still reads as restartable
adaptable_details: Block shape, size, spacing and density in the corridor
Hue family, chroma range and glow intensity, and which end of the luminance range the surround sits at
Glide speed, bend sensitivity and easing durations for recentering and release
Wording, placement and styling of the status line and the start control
Whether the corridor swirl is subtle or pronounced
Whether audio comes from a bundled default track or only from a supplied file
How pronounced the drifting skeleton is while silent
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits any context where sound is actually present and a full stage with a low-distraction surround can be given over to motion with almost no competing foreground content — a listening or player view, an entrance or splash stage, or an ambient centerpiece for visitor-supplied audio. It stops being this Skill if the continuous depth travel is replaced by discrete scenes or slides, if the vanishing point stops anchoring attention, if beat-driven modulation is dropped so the motion is purely autonomous decoration, or if it is shrunk into a subordinate strip behind dense text where the glide, bend and inversion can no longer be felt as a single whole-view experience.

name: mirrored_line_bloom_driven_by_sound_and_pointer
description: A centered, radially symmetrical bloom of fine lines that pulses with the music, splitting low and high parts of the sound into separately readable layers, while pointer movement fans out more or fewer mirrored copies and pushes them nearer or farther from the center; the figure slackens into a still, calm shape whenever the sound is silent.

canonical_document.name: mirrored_line_bloom_driven_by_sound_and_pointer
canonical_document.description: A centered, radially symmetrical bloom of fine lines that pulses with the music, splitting low and high parts of the sound into separately readable layers, while pointer movement fans out more or fewer mirrored copies and pushes them nearer or farther from the center; the figure slackens into a still, calm shape whenever the sound is silent.
canonical_document.experience_scope: Whole-view experience. Begins with a short quiet wait while the sound is prepared, with nothing for the visitor to configure or trigger, then the figure occupies the entire view for as long as the page is open. It has no end point; it only rests or resumes.
content_and_composition: Exactly one primary visual subject: a single centered figure composed of many fine lines, symmetrical about the center.
The figure is built from mirrored copies of one line motif fanned out around the center point; the number of copies is variable and visible as a change in symmetry density.

At least two distinguishable motion layers within the same figure, one carrying the low part of the sound and one carrying the high part, differentiated so their movements read as separate rather than blended noise.
Radial reach of the figure from the center is a visible compositional variable, from tightly gathered to widely extended.

One small persistent control for stopping and resuming the sound, and one persistent way to supply a replacement audio file from the visitor's own device; both stay visually subordinate to the figure.
A brief preparation state before the piece takes over, and a busy state shown while a newly supplied sound is being made ready.
No headings, body copy, panels or chrome competing with the figure; empty space around the figure is part of the composition.
experience_progression: Quiet preparation: a short, low-key wait while sound is made ready, with no setup asked of the visitor.
Takeover: the figure fills the view and begins moving with the sound.
Endless sustain: continuous, non-goal-directed motion that never advances toward completion and never announces a stage.
Rest: on silence the motion slackens and the figure settles into a calm still picture.
Revival: on resumed sound the figure swells back out of rest into full motion, returning to endless sustain.
attention_and_information_flow: Attention stays fixed on the single centered figure for the whole experience; nothing else ever claims primary focus.
Loudness and energy of the sound read as amplitude and liveliness of the figure, so the visitor perceives the music's shape without any readout or labels.
Low and high parts of the sound are legible as distinct layers, so the visitor can track two things at once inside one form.
Pointer movement immediately makes the visitor aware they are shaping the figure, without instructions being shown.
Silence lowers visual intensity rather than removing the subject, so the view stays composed and calm instead of appearing empty or broken.
Preparation and busy states are quiet and momentary, never becoming the focus.

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Reverses the instant the pointer moves back; no committing, no dead zones, no way to reach an unrecoverable form. Leaving the pointer still holds the current form.
interaction_model.state_change: Symmetry count rises or falls continuously with horizontal position
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The figure becomes denser and more petal-like or sparser and more open, changing its perceived complexity in real time
interaction_model.input: Continuous pointer movement anywhere across the view, along the horizontal axis
interaction_model.affected_object: The number of mirrored copies fanned out around the center

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Reverses immediately on reverse movement; extent stays inside bounds that keep the figure whole and centered rather than clipped or vanishing.
interaction_model.state_change: Radial extent grows or shrinks continuously with vertical position
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The figure expands outward toward the edges of the view or gathers tightly around the center
interaction_model.input: Continuous pointer movement anywhere across the view, along the vertical axis
interaction_model.affected_object: How far the mirrored copies reach from the center

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Fully reversible from the same control; pointer shaping remains available while at rest so the resting picture can still be reshaped.
interaction_model.state_change: Sound stops and the figure transitions from active motion toward its resting shape
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Motion slackens and softens over a brief settling, ending in a calm, still, still-centered picture rather than a blank view
interaction_model.input: Activating the single stop/resume control while sound is playing
interaction_model.affected_object: The whole figure and its motion energy

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Can be toggled repeatedly; each transition is a smooth swell or slacken rather than an abrupt jump.
interaction_model.state_change: Sound resumes and the figure re-energizes from rest
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The figure swells back outward and regains layered motion, rejoining the endless sustain
interaction_model.input: Activating the same control while stopped
interaction_model.affected_object: The whole figure and its motion energy

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Can be repeated with another file; while busy the view stays composed rather than emptying, and the figure returns to its resting or active picture once ready.
interaction_model.state_change: The current piece is replaced by the supplied one, with a busy state until it is ready
interaction_model.visible_feedback: A brief busy indication, then the figure resumes moving to the new sound with the same centered symmetrical identity and the visitor's current pointer-set form
interaction_model.input: Choosing an audio file from the visitor's own device
interaction_model.affected_object: The sound source driving the figure

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: When sound is absent or silent, layers relax to rest instead of freezing mid-motion or behaving erratically.
interaction_model.state_change: Layer amplitudes track the low and high parts of the sound moment to moment
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Continuous breathing, pulsing and rippling of the fine lines that visibly corresponds to what is heard
interaction_model.input: Autonomous driver: the ongoing sound itself
interaction_model.affected_object: The two motion layers of the figure

experience_qualities: Hypnotic and unending, with no sense of progress toward a finish
Calm and quiet even at peak motion; energetic without becoming frantic
Legible rather than noisy: motion reads as two distinguishable layers instead of undifferentiated flicker
Delicate and fine-lined rather than heavy or solid
Immediately responsive, so pointer movement feels like direct handling of the form
Composed at every moment, including during silence, preparation and busy states
completion_and_return: No completion state; the experience loops indefinitely while sound plays.
Silence is a rest state, not an ending: the figure settles into a calm still picture that remains the subject of the view.
Resuming returns to the same endless sustain rather than restarting a sequence.
Pointer-set symmetry count and reach persist as the current form across stop, resume and sound replacement.
Replacing the sound does not reset the visual identity or the visitor's current form.
locked_observable_requirements: One single centered figure, radially symmetrical, made of fine lines, as the sole primary subject of a whole-view composition.
Symmetry is achieved by mirrored copies of a motif around the center, and the number of copies is visibly variable.
At least two motion layers driven by low and high parts of the sound, kept visually distinguishable.
Horizontal pointer movement changes mirrored-copy count; vertical pointer movement changes radial reach; both continuous and immediately reversible.
Pointer shaping works anywhere across the view, with no target, handle or widget to aim at.
Silence produces a slackening into a calm resting picture, never a blank or frozen view.
Resuming produces a swelling back into motion rather than an instant snap.
No setup, choices or start step required before the piece takes over; the only preparation is a short quiet wait.
No goal, score, timeline or completion is presented.
adaptable_details: Hue and luminance relationship between the fine lines and their surround, line weight, glow or trail treatment
The specific line motif that is mirrored
How many distinguishable motion layers beyond two, and how each is visually differentiated
Ranges for symmetry count and radial reach
Duration and easing of the slacken and swell transitions
Visual form of the stop/resume control, the file-choosing affordance, and the preparation and busy indications
Genre, length and source of the sound
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits any continuous sound with distinguishable low and high content that is meant to be watched rather than navigated, on a view where the figure can own the full screen and supporting controls stay minimal. It survives changes of hue and luminance scheme, motif and sound source. It becomes a different Skill if the single centered symmetrical figure is replaced by multiple scattered or off-center subjects, if the visual becomes a background substrate behind foreground reading content, if pointer position is replaced by discrete widgets or presets instead of continuous anywhere-on-view shaping, if the piece gains a timeline, goal or completion, or if silence produces an empty or frozen view instead of a calm resting picture.

name: flaring_light_source_silhouette_loop
description: A very low-luminance, point-flecked scene where a silhouetted figure's held light source swells into a saturated accent-hued flare that washes across layered scenery, separating foreground, midground and sky into depth while the view seems to drift closer, then fades back to the unlit baseline and begins again.

canonical_document.name: flaring_light_source_silhouette_loop
canonical_document.description: A very low-luminance, point-flecked scene where a silhouetted figure's held light source swells into a saturated accent-hued flare that washes across layered scenery, separating foreground, midground and sky into depth while the view seems to drift closer, then fades back to the unlit baseline and begins again.
canonical_document.experience_scope: Whole-view region covering the entire visible surface for the duration of a wait; begins the instant the screen appears and ends only when the surrounding application replaces the screen, with no internal end state of its own.
content_and_composition: One central silhouetted subject as the single focal figure, rendered as a flat low-luminance shape rather than detailed form
One localized light source attached to the subject, acting as the sole origin of illumination and chroma
Several stacked scenery bands at different depths (near ground/objects, mid-distance mass, far sky) that read as flat, near-uniform unlit masses until lit
A sparse field of faint points of light in the far layer, persistent and visible even in the least-illuminated phase
Accent-hued light spill from the source onto surrounding layers, with intensity falling off by distance from the source
No text, progress indicator, control affordance or interface chrome anywhere in the composition
experience_progression: Near-emptiness: only faint far-layer points and flat unlit masses are perceptible; the subject is barely distinguishable
Ignition: the light source begins to brighten, drawing the eye to the subject before the surroundings change
Flare and wash: light saturates outward in a distinct accent hue, and previously merged unlit shapes separate into distinct depth bands
Hold: illumination sustains at peak long enough for the scene's layering and subject silhouette to be read
Extinction: light recedes and the unlit baseline swallows the layers back into flatness
Immediate restart from the near-empty state, continuously and indefinitely, with no resolved or finished frame
attention_and_information_flow: Opens with attention unanchored because almost nothing is legible, creating anticipation
The brightening source becomes the strongest contrast point and pulls the eye to the subject first
Attention then expands outward from the subject as spill reveals surrounding layers, information increasing from silhouette to spatial arrangement
Depth information appears only during the lit phase, so the scene's structure is knowledge the viewer gains and then loses
A slow apparent approach adds gradual scale change that keeps the eye engaged during the hold
Extinction removes revealed information and resets the viewer's expectation for the next build

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Not advanceable, pausable or skippable; the cycle restarts cleanly on its own so any arrival instant shows a coherent phase rather than a stalled or drifting one
interaction_model.state_change: Advance through unlit, ignition, flare, hold and extinction phases
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Brightness and chroma saturation rise and fall; scenery layers emerge from and dissolve back into a flat, near-uniform unlit ground
interaction_model.input: Autonomous timeline starting when the screen becomes visible
interaction_model.affected_object: Light source and all illuminated scenery layers

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Returns to its starting relationship as the cycle restarts, never accumulating drift across repetitions
interaction_model.state_change: Gradual sense of moving closer to the subject
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Layers shift at different apparent rates and the subject grows subtly, reinforcing separation between depths
interaction_model.input: Autonomous slow viewpoint drift running alongside the light cycle
interaction_model.affected_object: Layered scenery bands and subject scale

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Deliberate absence of controls; nothing can knock the sequence out of step or require recovery
interaction_model.state_change: None
interaction_model.visible_feedback: No response of any kind; the sequence continues undisturbed
interaction_model.input: Any pointer movement, hover, click, key or other visitor action
interaction_model.affected_object: Entire scene

experience_qualities: Ominous and moody, dominated by a low-luminance surround with light as a scarce event
Cinematic staging with a clear build, peak and fade rather than uniform motion
Deliberately unresolved, communicating waiting rather than completion
Depth felt through revealed layer separation instead of literal perspective detail
Calm and hands-off; nothing invites or rewards interaction
completion_and_return: No completion state exists; the cycle loops indefinitely for as long as the wait lasts
Each restart returns to the identical minimally-lit opening condition, so repetitions are indistinguishable
Looks correct when entered or re-observed at any arbitrary moment, including after the viewer looks away and back
Ends only by external replacement of the screen, with no self-triggered exit or final frame
locked_observable_requirements: Starts at a low-luminance, low-chroma baseline where almost nothing but faint far points is legible
A single localized light source attached to a central silhouetted subject is the only illumination origin
The flare must visibly separate previously merged flat unlit masses into distinct depth layers
Illumination holds at peak long enough to be read, then fully extinguishes back to the opening baseline
The cycle repeats indefinitely and never resolves into a finished or completed state
Entirely autonomous: no input advances, pauses, skips or otherwise affects it
Any arrival instant shows a coherent phase of the cycle
adaptable_details: Specific hues of the light wash, the tone of the unlit baseline, and how many colors the wash blends
Identity and pose of the silhouetted subject and the nature of its light source
Number, shape and content of the scenery depth bands
Density and brightness of the faint far-layer points
Cycle duration and the relative lengths of build, hold and fade
Strength and direction of the apparent approach
Rendering fidelity, from crisp illustration to soft grain or haze
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits any full-view waiting or entrance moment centered on a single silhouetted subject with a light source and stacked scenery layers, where mood matters more than information and no readable text or progress content must remain legible. Adding viewer control, a progress or completion state, interactive response to pointer input, or foreground text and interface elements that must stay readable through the unlit and flare phases would make it a different Skill, as would replacing the single light-source reveal with ambient even lighting that removes the low-luminance-to-depth transformation.

name: streaming_wake_around_draggable_obstacle
description: Ribbons of material sweep steadily across a full-screen field, clearly separated in luminance from a quiet substrate, split around a distinctly marked solid shape and trail off as alternating swirls; dragging in the open stream pushes and curls it, dragging the shape relocates it and the flow immediately re-forms around it.

canonical_document.name: streaming_wake_around_draggable_obstacle
canonical_document.description: Ribbons of material sweep steadily across a full-screen field, clearly separated in luminance from a quiet substrate, split around a distinctly marked solid shape and trail off as alternating swirls; dragging in the open stream pushes and curls it, dragging the shape relocates it and the flow immediately re-forms around it.
canonical_document.experience_scope: Whole-view experience filling the entire viewport; it begins moving as soon as the view is present and never ends, with no entry sequence, finish state or reset boundary.
content_and_composition: A single continuous flow field occupying the full viewport, read as one current rather than separate animations
A uniform low-distraction background field serving as the substrate, held at a luminance clearly separated from the material
Ribbons or streaks of material as the primary visible content, carrying readable contrast against the substrate and moving in one dominant sweep direction across the field
Exactly one visually distinct solid shape marked as the obstacle, sitting within the stream and legible as a discrete object against the flowing material
A wake region immediately downstream of the obstacle where the material organizes into alternating swirls; this region is the compositional focal area
Pointer position acts as a transient local influence region with no persistent visible cursor decoration required
No labels, captions, legends, controls, progress indicators or explanatory text
experience_progression: No staged or terminating progression: the current advances continuously and indefinitely
Local disturbance cycle only — deformation appears under the pointer, propagates downstream with the flow, and dissipates back into the ongoing current within moments
attention_and_information_flow: The steady directional sweep establishes the field and reads as a single coherent current
Attention settles on the wake behind the obstacle because it is the only region with organized, rhythmic alternating structure against otherwise uniform streaming
The obstacle's effect on the surrounding material is understood purely from the visible divergence and trailing swirls, requiring no explanation
Pointer interaction temporarily shifts prominence to the disturbed area, strongest directly under the cursor and fading outward, then returns attention to the wake as the disturbance clears
Moving the obstacle re-anchors the focal wake to the new location

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Runs indefinitely; nothing to start, pause, finish or reset
interaction_model.state_change: Material advances steadily in the dominant direction; wake continually sheds alternating swirls behind the obstacle
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Uninterrupted sweeping ribbons and a rhythmically alternating trailing pattern
interaction_model.input: Autonomous continuous drive with no user input
interaction_model.affected_object: Whole flow field and its wake region

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Release, or the pointer leaving the surface, ends the push immediately; the flow continues and smooths itself out on its own with nothing to undo
interaction_model.state_change: Flow direction and speed are nudged toward the pointer's direction and speed, with influence strongest directly under the cursor and falling off outward
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Passing ribbons visibly bend and curl around the drag path, the deformation carried downstream by the current
interaction_model.input: Press and drag in open fluid away from the solid shape (mouse or touch, identical behavior)
interaction_model.affected_object: Local region of flowing material around the pointer

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Release or pointer exit ends the grab at once, leaving the shape where it was dropped as the flow keeps running; the state cannot be broken
interaction_model.state_change: The shape is grabbed and follows the pointer to a new position while the current re-forms around it without delay
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The shape tracks the pointer; material immediately splits around its new position and the alternating wake reattaches behind it there
interaction_model.input: Press and drag on the solid shape (mouse or touch, identical behavior)
interaction_model.affected_object: The obstacle and the surrounding flow field

experience_qualities: Continuous and unhurried, reading as one persistent current rather than a looping clip
Physical and self-evident — cause and effect are visible without wording
Calm and visually quiet overall, with the wake as the only busy region
Immediately responsive to touch and pointer, with influence that feels local and soft-edged
Forgiving: any disturbance heals itself within moments and no action is destructive
completion_and_return: No completion state, finish line, score or reset control
Disturbances self-resolve, returning the field to steady streaming
Obstacle position persists where released and becomes the new anchor of the wake
Watchable indefinitely with no degradation or accumulation of visible artifacts
locked_observable_requirements: Fills the whole viewport and reads as one continuous current, not separate motion elements
Material streaks clearly separated in luminance from a quiet substrate field, with the material's motion itself as the primary visible content
Exactly one visually marked solid obstacle sitting inside the stream
An alternating swirl pattern trailing behind the obstacle, forming the visual focal point
Pointer drag in open material bends and curls the passing streaks, strongest under the cursor and fading outward
Dragging the obstacle moves it and the surrounding flow re-forms around its new position immediately
Release or pointer exit ends any interaction instantly and the field self-smooths back into steady flow
Runs indefinitely with no finish, reset or explanatory text
Touch and mouse drags behave identically
adaptable_details: Exact hues and which side carries the higher luminance, so long as material and substrate stay clearly separated and the substrate stays low-distraction
Silhouette of the obstacle and its default position in the field
Dominant sweep direction and overall flow speed
Density, thickness and count of the visible ribbons
Rhythm and scale of the trailing swirls
Radius and strength profile of the pointer influence, and how quickly disturbances settle
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits any full-viewport ambient or explanatory surface that can carry continuous fluid motion with at most sparse foreground content over it, and any context where one object's influence on a moving medium is the message. Replacing the single marked obstacle with many scattered emitters, adding a goal, score, timer or reset, requiring the field to sit quietly behind dense readable content, or reducing it to a non-interactive playing loop would each create a different Skill.

name: per_letter_stunt_word
description: One oversized uppercase word centered on a flat field with strong figure-ground separation; tapping any single letter sends that letter alone through a short cartoonish stunt before it settles back upright in its original slot.

canonical_document.name: per_letter_stunt_word
canonical_document.description: One oversized uppercase word centered on a flat field with strong figure-ground separation; tapping any single letter sends that letter alone through a short cartoonish stunt before it settles back upright in its original slot.
canonical_document.experience_scope: Whole-view experience: begins on arrival with the static centered word and its short guidance line, and continues indefinitely as an idle, endlessly repeatable playground; each individual stunt begins on a press of one character and ends when that character has returned to rest.
content_and_composition: One short word rendered at oversized display scale in uppercase, horizontally and vertically centered as the single focal object
Each character is an independently addressable unit with its own press target, while the word reads as one continuous piece of typography
Flat, uniform background field that holds strong separation from the type, with no imagery, decoration or competing elements
One short line of guidance text, visually subordinate and secondary in size, positioned near the word to signal that the letters are interactive
Persistent elements: the word's position, letter spacing, baseline and per-character hit areas remain fixed regardless of any motion in progress

First press: one character animates while the rest hold still, revealing that letters are individually alive
Accumulating discovery: successive presses on different characters reveal different personalities, so the experience deepens by exploring characters rather than by repeating one effect
No end state: the composition always returns to the same resting arrangement, inviting further exploration
attention_and_information_flow: Attention starts wide on the whole word as a single bold statement, aided by the emptiness of the field
The guidance line briefly claims secondary attention only to establish that the letters can be pressed
After the first press, attention narrows from the word to the individual character in motion, which is momentarily the most prominent element
Prominence returns to the whole word once the character settles, resetting the visitor for the next choice
Information revealed over time is the distinct personality of each character rather than any new content or copy

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: The character self-recovers: it always returns upright to its exact original slot without further input, so no letter can be left displaced
interaction_model.state_change: The character moves from resting to an active stunt state while all neighbouring characters remain at rest
interaction_model.visible_feedback: A short, distinct cartoon-style movement belonging to that character, such as tipping over, leaping up, flipping, stretching tall or launching toward the very top of the view
interaction_model.input: Click or tap on a single character

interaction_model.visible_feedback: The ongoing movement continues smoothly with no restart, jump, stutter or stacked motion
interaction_model.input: Repeat clicks or taps on a character that is already in motion
interaction_model.affected_object: The in-motion character

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Each character resolves independently back to its resting position
interaction_model.state_change: The newly pressed character enters its own stunt independently of the one already moving
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Multiple characters can be in motion at once, each doing its own movement, with the word's spacing unchanged
interaction_model.input: Click or tap on a different character while one is already moving
interaction_model.affected_object: The newly pressed character

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Idle state is the stable baseline the experience always returns to
interaction_model.state_change: Remains in the resting arrangement
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Static, fully legible word on the flat field
interaction_model.input: No input (idle)
interaction_model.affected_object: Whole composition

experience_qualities: Bare and confident: emptiness makes the single word feel deliberate rather than unfinished
Cartoonish and playful in the character of the movement, with exaggerated, personality-driven gestures
Discovery-driven rather than repetitive: different characters behave differently
Safe and forgiving: nothing can be broken, stuck or half-finished by pressing
Legible throughout: the word remains readable even while a character is displaced
completion_and_return: Each stunt completes autonomously with the character upright in its original position
The overall composition resets to its arrival state after every interaction
No progress, score or persistent change accumulates; the experience is infinitely repeatable
Layout geometry, spacing and press targets persist unchanged across all interactions
locked_observable_requirements: A single short word at oversized display scale, centered, uppercase, on a flat field with strong type-to-field separation and no competing content
Characters are individually pressable and animate one at a time in isolation; neighbours do not move
Word spacing, letter positions and press targets never shift, even while a character is displaced
Different characters exhibit visibly different stunt personalities rather than one shared animation
Presses during an active stunt are ignored, never restarting or stacking motion
Every stunt self-returns the character upright to its original slot with no way to leave it displaced
A short, visually subordinate guidance line establishes that letters are the interactive attraction
The word stays readable at all times
adaptable_details: The specific word and its character count
Typeface, weight, and the letter/field tone pairing in any hue or luminance direction, provided figure-ground separation stays strong and the field stays flat

canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits any short single-word or very short-phrase focal statement where the type itself is the content and the surrounding field can stay empty — playful landing statements, slogans, wordmarks or a play page. It stops being this Skill if the text becomes a paragraph or multi-line body copy, if the whole word or line animates as one unit instead of per character, if letters can be dragged or left out of position, if the field must carry imagery or other foreground content, or if motion runs on its own loop instead of being triggered per character.

name: staged_liquid_release_and_settling_pool
description: A see-through container holds a staged block of liquid; one control releases it so it drops, bursts against the walls, throws spray and settles into a heavy level pool you can shove with the pointer, orbit around and zoom, before returning to stage another run.

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Releasing the press ends the orbit and leaves the new angle in place; clamped vertical range prevents disorienting or upside-down framing; pressing suppresses pushing so the two behaviours never conflict
interaction_model.state_change: The view orbits around the container instead of pushing the liquid
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The container and liquid rotate together as a solid subject, with the vertical swing stopping short of overhead and underneath extremes
interaction_model.input: Press-dragging in the running view
interaction_model.affected_object: The viewpoint on the scene

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Motion simply stops at each limit, so the subject can never be lost or clipped through
interaction_model.state_change: The viewpoint moves closer to or further from the container between fixed near and far limits
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The container and liquid grow or shrink in the frame, revealing surface and spray detail up close or the whole volume from afar
interaction_model.input: Wheel input in the running view
interaction_model.affected_object: The viewpoint distance

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Squashing a block to nothing removes it entirely; if nothing remains staged the release control becomes unavailable again; the drag can be reversed by dragging the same face back
interaction_model.state_change: The block grows or shrinks along that face in whole-unit steps
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The block snaps outward or inward one unit at a time, halting visibly against a container wall or a neighbouring block
interaction_model.input: Dragging a face of a staged block in the setup state
interaction_model.affected_object: That staged block

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Newly created blocks are editable and removable by the same face-drag rules, so staging is fully undoable by hand
interaction_model.state_change: A new block is blocked out over the dragged extent
interaction_model.visible_feedback: A unit-aligned block appears in the container, stopping at the walls and against existing blocks
interaction_model.input: Dragging across an empty container wall in the setup state
interaction_model.affected_object: A new staged block

experience_qualities: Reads as genuinely heavy and wet rather than as a decorative motion effect
Calm, unhurried and low-distraction, easy to keep watching without pressure to act
Toy-like tactility: input has immediate physical consequence and the substance keeps moving after you stop
Legible before it is impressive: what will happen is understood before it is triggered
Bounded and safe to explore, because every camera and editing action stops at a limit instead of breaking the view
completion_and_return: No terminal ending: settling is a resting state and watching is open-ended
Returning restores the setup state with no residual liquid, ready for a fresh run
The staged configuration is the only thing that carries meaning between modes; runs are freely repeatable
Camera orientation and distance persist as the viewer left them rather than snapping back mid-session
locked_observable_requirements: Two states in one view, staging and running, joined by a single control that flips between release and return labels
A see-through container whose walls are the visible boundary for both staged blocks and running liquid
The staged volume must be legible before release
Release must produce fall, burst against walls, airborne spray and decay into a level resting pool
Pointer movement over running liquid must displace it in the direction of travel within a soft radius, with momentum carried after the pointer stops
Press-drag orbits the view with a clamped vertical swing and does not push the liquid
Wheel changes viewpoint distance between fixed limits
Staged blocks are edited in whole-unit steps, stop at walls and at each other, and vanish when squashed to nothing
Release is unavailable whenever nothing is staged
adaptable_details: Container proportions and silhouette
Palette, surround luminance level and liquid tint or transparency depth, provided the liquid stays clearly separated from its surroundings
Unit granularity of block editing
Placement, wording and styling of the single control
Number of blocks that may be staged at once
Spray density, splash scale and settling duration
Exact camera angle and distance limits
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits single-subject, full-view showcases where a believable substance is itself the message and surrounding copy is sparse: interactive toys, capability demonstrations and watchable hero centerpieces. Content type matters only in that the substance must behave like a heavy pourable liquid within a hard visible boundary. Swapping the liquid for granular, soft-body or rigid objects, dropping the staging state so the scene merely autoplays, or demoting the scene to a passive background layer behind dense foreground text with no push or camera control would each produce a different Skill.

name: living_hand_drawn_character_vignette_with_portrait_switcher
description: A drawn animal character idles endlessly — breathing, blinking, glancing, tail moving, its outlines shimmering as if redrawn by hand — inside a quiet illustrated landscape, while small round portraits above the scene let the visitor swap characters and watch each performance from its start.

canonical_document.name: living_hand_drawn_character_vignette_with_portrait_switcher
canonical_document.description: A drawn animal character idles endlessly — breathing, blinking, glancing, tail moving, its outlines shimmering as if redrawn by hand — inside a quiet illustrated landscape, while small round portraits above the scene let the visitor swap characters and watch each performance from its start.
canonical_document.experience_scope: A self-contained region or whole-view vignette that begins as soon as the view appears and never concludes; it spans the illustrated scene plus the small row of character portraits sitting above it, and ends only when the visitor leaves the view.
content_and_composition: One foreground character figure per scene, centered as the sole subject and clearly the largest, most detailed element
One illustrated environment layer behind the character, low-contrast and visually quiet, establishing place and mood without competing detail
A small set of round character portraits (two in the observed case, a handful at most) persisting above the scene as the only interactive element
Portrait row and scene remain in a fixed spatial relationship: selectors above, performance below, never overlapping the character's silhouette
No text labels, captions, controls, counters or instructions inside the scene
Exactly one character world visible at a time; scenes do not coexist or tile
experience_progression: On appearance, the character reads as alive within roughly one to two seconds through its first breath, blink or glance
Settles into an open-ended idle performance whose small movements continue and recombine without an ending, climax or resolution
On selecting another portrait, the incoming character's world replaces the current one and its performance restarts from its own beginning, repeating the same read-as-alive onset
attention_and_information_flow: Attention lands immediately on the character because it is the only moving, high-detail element
The environment stays subordinate throughout and never pulls focus with independent motion or contrast
The portrait row reads as secondary and peripheral, noticed but not demanding action
The only information ever revealed is which character is currently being watched, communicated by the dimmed state of that character's portrait
No progressive disclosure, no hidden content, nothing that must be figured out

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Cannot be paused, scrubbed or completed; the performance simply continues, and re-entering or re-selecting the scene starts it cleanly from the beginning
interaction_model.state_change: Perpetual idle cycling of breathing, blinking, glancing about and tail movement, with every contour gently boiling as if hand-redrawn frame by frame
interaction_model.visible_feedback: A figure that never freezes: subtle body rise and fall, intermittent blinks and head turns, drifting tail, and a continuously wobbling line quality across the whole silhouette
interaction_model.input: Autonomous continuous playback with no user input
interaction_model.affected_object: The foreground character figure and its drawn outlines

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Switching is always available in either direction with no lockout; returning to a previously watched character replays it cleanly from the beginning rather than resuming mid-performance
interaction_model.state_change: Current world is replaced by the chosen character's world and that character's performance begins from its very start; the chosen portrait becomes the dimmed one
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The scene changes to the new character and setting, the new performance visibly begins from its opening moment, and the portrait of the character now on screen appears dimmed while the others stay at full prominence
interaction_model.input: Picking one of the round character portraits above the scene
interaction_model.affected_object: The entire character world — figure plus its environment layer — and the portrait row state

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Pointer movement over the scene never intercepts or blocks the portraits above, which stay reachable and responsive at all times
interaction_model.state_change: No state change whatsoever; the scene is watch-only
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Nothing responds — no highlight, follow, parallax, cursor change or reaction of any kind
interaction_model.input: Moving the pointer across the character or the landscape
interaction_model.affected_object: The scene contents

experience_qualities: Storybook and hand-made: the wobbling outlines make it feel drawn rather than rendered
Alive and companionable — the figure convincingly breathes and looks around rather than looping mechanically
Calm and undemanding, with nothing to solve or complete
Playful and warm in tone
Effortlessly legible: one subject, one quiet setting, one obvious choice
completion_and_return: The performance has no completion state and loops or recombines indefinitely
Switching characters is the only reset, and it always restarts the chosen performance from its beginning
No progress, position or preference is carried across visits; every arrival begins at the opening moment of a performance
The dimmed portrait persists for as long as its character is on screen, so current state is always readable
locked_observable_requirements: One illustrated character is the unmistakable focal subject, with the environment kept visually quiet behind it
The character must read as alive within a second or two of the scene appearing
Idle liveliness combines several independent small motions, at minimum breathing plus blinking plus a glance or tail movement
All outlines continuously boil or shimmer, giving a redrawn-by-hand quality across the entire figure
The performance never ends and never resolves into a still pose
Small round portraits of the available characters persist above the scene as the sole interactive affordance
Selecting a portrait replaces the whole world and restarts that character's performance from the beginning, never resuming mid-way
The portrait of the character currently on screen is visibly dimmed — clearly lower in prominence — relative to the others, in whatever palette the scene uses
Switching remains available at any moment in both directions
The scene itself is non-interactive and pointer movement over it must never block the portraits
adaptable_details: Which creature is depicted and how many characters are offered
Setting, season, palette and time of day, including any hue family, lighting mood and overall light-or-dark reading of the scene
Character pose and framing — sitting at a distance or coming up close
Exact repertoire, timing and cadence of the idle movements
Intensity and speed of the outline boiling
Placement, size and spacing of the portrait row above the scene
How the world change is presented at the moment of switching
Overall drawing style within a hand-made illustrated look
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits any context wanting a single illustrated figure to carry a view with personality and no task — playful landing views, mascot or persona introductions, character showcases where a few alternatives are offered as portraits. It requires purpose-drawn character artwork with multiple animated idle motions; it does not transfer to photographic subjects, text-dense views, or scenes that need to sit behind foreground content. Making the scene respond to the pointer, giving the performance a beginning-to-end narrative that concludes, resuming a character mid-performance instead of replaying it, or removing the hand-redrawn boiling outlines each produces a different Skill.
