name: breathing_luminous_plume_you_can_steer
description: A glowing smoke-like swarm gathers out of a quiet, near-featureless field it is barely separated from into a slowly breathing plume that leans and streams toward the pointer with visible lag, casts a soft shadow on the ground below, can be orbited and zoomed within limits, and never finishes — endlessly dying back and renewing until the visitor freezes it or leaves.

canonical_document.name: breathing_luminous_plume_you_can_steer
canonical_document.description: A glowing smoke-like swarm gathers out of a quiet, near-featureless field it is barely separated from into a slowly breathing plume that leans and streams toward the pointer with visible lag, casts a soft shadow on the ground below, can be orbited and zoomed within limits, and never finishes — endlessly dying back and renewing until the visitor freezes it or leaves.
canonical_document.experience_scope: Whole-view experience: it occupies the entire viewport from first load and persists for as long as the visitor stays, with no exit state, section boundary or hand-off to other content.
content_and_composition: One central luminous particle mass reading as smoke or glowing dust, the sole subject of the view
A quiet, low-detail surrounding field, separated from the mass in luminance by enough margin that the glow emerges from it and stays legible against it
A ground plane beneath the mass carrying a soft cast shadow that grounds it in space
One title mark held over the scene, resolving from soft blur
One short line of guidance plus small credits along the bottom edge
Layering: quiet surrounding field behind, mass and its shadow as the dimensional middle, title mark and bottom-edge text as flat overlays that persist through all motion
experience_progression: Arrival: the quiet field alone, with the swarm not yet formed and barely distinguishable from its surround
Waking: particles gather inward and assemble into a coherent plume, separating in luminance from the field as they mass
Title mark sharpens from soft blur; guidance line and credits ease upward into place along the bottom edge
Settled ambient state: slow breathing expansion and contraction, wisps drifting
Endless renewal: portions of the plume die back and are replenished so the mass is continuously reconstituted, never completing or resolving
attention_and_information_flow: Attention is pulled by emergence — the only motion in an otherwise still, low-detail field is the swarm assembling
Once formed, attention rests on drifting wisps and the soft shadow they cast rather than on any single focal point
Text arrives after the subject so the plume, not the copy, is read first; text then recedes to a quiet, permanently available support role
Pointer movement continuously redirects attention to wherever the visitor last pointed, since the mass leans that way
No new information is revealed over time; prominence shifts only between the mass, its shadow and the visitor's own steering

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Continuous and always reversible by pointing elsewhere; when the pointer stops the mass eases back to its ambient breathing drift with no abrupt cut
interaction_model.state_change: The chase target relocates and the swarm reorients toward it
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Wisps bend and stream toward the pointer, arriving behind it with visible lag and trailing tails instead of snapping into place
interaction_model.input: Pointer position moving across the view
interaction_model.affected_object: The luminous particle mass

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Bounded so the viewpoint never sinks below the ground plane; the glide can be interrupted by a new drag at any moment
interaction_model.state_change: Orbit angle changes, letting the plume be examined from any side
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The scene swings around the mass and continues with an eased glide after the hand stops, then settles
interaction_model.input: Drag across the view
interaction_model.affected_object: Viewpoint around the plume

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Clamped to a fixed near and far range so the view can neither pass into nor retreat away from the subject
interaction_model.state_change: The view pulls closer to or further from the mass
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The plume grows or shrinks in the frame, revealing individual wisps up close and the whole silhouette with its shadow when far
interaction_model.input: Wheel or pinch
interaction_model.affected_object: Viewpoint distance

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Pressing again resumes from exactly the frozen state rather than restarting; viewpoint orbit and zoom remain available while frozen
interaction_model.state_change: All motion and replenishment halt in place
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The plume freezes as a still luminous form, holding its exact shape and shadow for inspection
interaction_model.input: Space bar press
interaction_model.affected_object: Drift and renewal of the whole mass

experience_qualities: Calm and unhurried
Alive and breathing rather than mechanical
Soft and self-luminous, clearly set apart in brightness from a quiet surround
Responsive but lagging, so steering feels like nudging a fluid rather than moving a cursor
Endless and low-stakes — nothing to finish, nothing to lose by leaving
completion_and_return: No completion state exists; the plume perpetually dies back and renews
Freeze and resume is the only pause, and resumption continues from the held state instead of replaying arrival
The waking sequence plays once per visit; after it, the experience remains in its ambient loop indefinitely
Visitors may leave at any moment without a terminal or summary state
locked_observable_requirements: A single luminous particle mass emerging into visibility from a quiet, low-detail surround it is held apart from by luminance, as the sole subject of a full view
An arrival sequence in which the mass gathers, the title mark resolves from blur, and bottom-edge guidance with credits eases upward
Slow breathing expansion and contraction in the settled state
Pointer-driven steering where the mass streams toward the pointer with visible lag and trailing, never snapping
A soft cast shadow on a ground plane beneath the mass
Drag-to-orbit with eased glide and zoom, both bounded so the view stays above the ground and within a fixed distance range
Continuous die-back and renewal with no completion state
A freeze-in-place toggle that resumes from the identical held state
adaptable_details: Particle count, size and density of the mass
Hue family and overall lightness of the mass, its glow and its surround, in either direction of luminance, as long as the separation keeps the glow and shadow readable
Wording of the title mark, guidance line and credits
Duration and easing curves of the waking sequence, orbit glide and lag
Softness, spread and offset of the ground shadow
Specific near and far zoom limits and orbit range
Which key or alternate control performs the freeze toggle
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits pages whose purpose is atmosphere, play or presenting a single phenomenon, with foreground content limited to a title mark and a line or two of supporting text that can sit over a quiet, low-detail surround. It does not fit views carrying dense readable content or multiple competing focal elements. Replacing the freely drifting, endlessly renewing mass with a fixed shape, a data-mapped arrangement, or a sequence that resolves to a finished state would create a different Skill, as would removing the pointer-lag steering or the bounded orbit and leaving only a passive ambient animation.

name: pointer_aimed_air_stream_on_reacting_creature
description: A cartoon creature alone on a plain, low-distraction screen watches wherever the pointer goes; a small fan trails the pointer with a soft lag, and holding down spins the blades so a visible gust hits the creature, which leans in, squints, grins and has its fur and whiskers stream backwards until release lets everything coast back to calm.

canonical_document.name: pointer_aimed_air_stream_on_reacting_creature
canonical_document.description: A cartoon creature alone on a plain, low-distraction screen watches wherever the pointer goes; a small fan trails the pointer with a soft lag, and holding down spins the blades so a visible gust hits the creature, which leans in, squints, grins and has its fur and whiskers stream backwards until release lets everything coast back to calm.
canonical_document.experience_scope: Whole-view experience filling one uncluttered screen: it begins the moment the pointer or touch enters the view and the creature starts tracking, escalates while press or drag is held, and ends by returning to the same idle watching state; there is no completion, exit or next screen.
content_and_composition: One illustrated character occupying the visual centre as the single subject of attention, with articulated head, eyes, expression, stance and soft trailing details such as fur, ears and whiskers

One small movable emitter object (a fan-like device) that hovers in the same flat scene as the character and is positioned by the pointer, layered in front of or beside the character without hiding its face
A visible air-stream effect that appears between emitter and character only while input is held, reading as directional moving air rather than as a static overlay
A flat, calm, uniform background with no competing imagery, panels or decoration, kept at low visual prominence so the character reads as clearly separated from it
One small persistent line of instructional text sitting quietly at a screen edge telling newcomers to press and drag, never overlapping the character
experience_progression: Idle waiting: character rests in a relaxed neutral pose, blades still, no air visible
Noticed: pointer present, emitter glides toward the pointer with visible lag while the character turns head, eyes and stance toward that spot with a watchful, curious expression
Spin-up: input held, blades accelerate and the air stream becomes visible as it reaches the character
Bliss: character leans into the stream, squints, breaks into a grin, and mane, ears and whiskers stream backwards; intensity rises as the aim comes closer to the character
Coast-down on release: blades slow, air fades, fur, face and pose ease back
Return to idle waiting, identical to the starting state, so the sequence can be repeated endlessly
attention_and_information_flow: Attention stays on the character's face and mood at all times; the emitter is a small secondary object that never becomes the subject
Before input, the revealed information is only that the character is aware of the visitor's position
During held input, the visible information shifts to the intensity of pleasure: expression, lean and streaming fur all read stronger as aim moves closer
Aim distance is legible purely through effect strength on the character rather than through numbers, meters or labels
The instructional line is the lowest-prominence element and is meant to be ignored once the interaction is understood

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Near the edges of the screen the emitter stops at the limit of its travel and simply holds there while the pointer continues beyond; it resumes gliding as soon as the pointer returns inside the range
interaction_model.state_change: Emitter target position updates continuously and the emitter eases toward it
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Emitter glides after the pointer with a soft trailing lag rather than snapping to it
interaction_model.input: Pointer movement anywhere in the view, or touch drag position
interaction_model.affected_object: Movable emitter object

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Tracking is continuous and always available; it persists during and after the air-stream moment and settles back to neutral when attention is not drawn anywhere in particular
interaction_model.state_change: Character orientation shifts to keep facing the tracked spot
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Head turns, eyes follow and the standing pose shifts weight toward the spot with a watchful, curious expression
interaction_model.input: Pointer or touch position
interaction_model.affected_object: Character head, eyes and stance

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Release at any moment during spin-up or full speed lets blades coast down smoothly instead of stopping abruptly; input can be re-applied mid-coast and picks up from the current speed
interaction_model.state_change: Blades spin up from rest to running speed and a visible directional stream appears travelling toward the character
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Accelerating blade motion plus visible moving air reaching the character
interaction_model.input: Press and hold with a pointer, or sustained drag on a touch screen
interaction_model.affected_object: Emitter blades and the air-stream effect

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: On release, fur, face and pose ease back to the resting state continuously rather than snapping, and the character returns to the same relaxed waiting appearance
interaction_model.state_change: Mood transitions from watchful curiosity to unmistakable bliss
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Character leans into the stream, eyes squint, a grin appears, and mane, ears and whiskers stream backwards away from the emitter
interaction_model.input: Sustained air stream reaching the character
interaction_model.affected_object: Character expression, pose and trailing details

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Intensity follows aim continuously in both directions, so backing away immediately softens the reaction without any reset or dead state
interaction_model.state_change: Gust intensity scales up as aim approaches the character and stays gentle when aim is far away or pinned at the travel limit near the screen edges
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Stronger stream with deeper lean, tighter squint and more pronounced streaming of fur when aimed close; barely disturbed fur and a mild reaction when aimed at the far edges
interaction_model.input: Aim proximity, i.e. how close the held pointer is to the character
interaction_model.affected_object: Air-stream strength and the character's reaction magnitude

experience_qualities: Calm and uncluttered, with a quiet low-distraction surround that keeps the subject clearly readable against it
Instantly understandable with nothing to read, choose or configure first
Character feels alive and aware because it notices the visitor before anything is triggered
Motion feels soft and weighted through lag, spin-up and coast-down rather than instant switching
Emotionally readable: curiosity then unmistakable bliss, legible from expression alone
Endlessly repeatable and low-stakes, with no failure, score or ending
completion_and_return: No completion, ending or success state exists
Every release returns the scene to the identical relaxed waiting state
The pleasure moment can be re-triggered immediately and indefinitely
No progress, score or state accumulates between repetitions
The instructional line remains visible across all states
locked_observable_requirements: Single uncluttered view with one character alone at the centre as the sole attention target
Emitter position is driven by pointer or touch position and follows with a visible soft lag, never snapping
Character continuously tracks the pointed spot with head, eyes and stance even before any press
Press-and-hold or sustained drag is what starts the effect; the effect exists only while input is held
The travelling effect between emitter and character is visibly rendered, not implied
Character reaction escalates in a clearly readable way: lean toward the stream, squinted eyes, grin, and trailing details streaming away from the emitter
Effect strength scales with aim proximity to the character
Emitter stops at a hard travel limit near the view edges while the effect remains gentle there
Release causes smooth coast-down of the emitter and continuous easing of the character back to rest
Return state is identical to the initial idle state and the loop is infinitely repeatable
One small persistent low-prominence instruction line stating press and drag
adaptable_details: Which creature or character is used and its art style
The background treatment and overall colour scheme, provided the surround stays low-distraction and the character, emitter and air stream remain clearly separated from it
The specific emitter object as long as it plausibly emits a directional stream toward the subject
Placement and wording of the small instruction line
Exact lag, spin-up and coast-down timings
How the stream is visually depicted (lines, wisps, particles, ripples)
Which trailing features stream backwards (fur, hair, ears, clothing, foliage)
Whether extra idle micro-motion such as breathing or blinking is present
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits any single-subject playful scene, in any colour scheme, where one illustrated figure can plausibly track a visitor's pointer and visibly react with expression, pose and trailing details to a directional effect aimed from a pointer-following emitter, with strength depending on aim. It stops being this Skill if the subject stops reacting emotionally, if the emitter no longer follows the pointer, if the effect fires from a click instead of requiring sustained hold, if the reaction persists after release instead of easing back to an identical idle, or if the scene gains competing content, multiple subjects, reading material, scoring or a defined ending.

name: breathing_glow_blob_with_pointer_following_gaze
description: A lone soft luminous blob breathing slowly on a quiet field it clearly outshines, whose two eyes drift together toward the pointer with a springy overshoot and settle, always staying within its own body and easing back to centre when nothing is moving.

experience_qualities: Feels like meeting a small living thing rather than viewing a decorative graphic
Curious and attentive: it appears to notice whoever is present
Playful and toy-like responsiveness thanks to the springy overshoot
Calm, hypnotic and quietly luminous
Zero-learning and zero-obligation; comfortable to linger on indefinitely
locked_observable_requirements: Exactly one soft luminous body as the sole focal subject on an uncluttered field whose luminance sits clearly below the body's, so the body reads as emitting light
Two eyes that move together as a single coupled pair
Eye travel is only a small fraction of pointer travel and is hard-capped so the eyes can never slide off the body
Motion uses springy easing with slight overshoot and settle; never an instant snap and never a rigid lock to the pointer
Mid-settle input redirects the motion continuously from the current eye position
Neutral centred gaze whenever the pointer is absent or near the middle
A slow continuous breathing rhythm that runs independently of and simultaneously with the gaze response
No instructions, targets or completion of any kind
canonical_document.name: breathing_glow_blob_with_pointer_following_gaze
canonical_document.experience_scope: Whole-view experience: a quiet, evenly toned field held clearly below the body's luminance, with one centred luminous body that begins the moment the view appears and never ends. Pointer awareness spans the entire view surface, not only the body area; there is no entry sequence to complete and no exit state.
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits any single-subject creature, mascot or character presence meant to feel alive and aware on a quiet, sparse view with little foreground copy: hero or showcase openers, empty states, waiting screens, not-found pages. It needs a low-distraction surround whose luminance stays clearly under the body's, in whatever hue family the host uses, so the glow dominates, and a subject whose eyes or facial detail can carry gaze. Replacing the coupled, fractional, clamped gaze with a direct one-to-one pointer attachment, moving or deforming the whole body toward the pointer, populating the view with several independently behaving creatures, attaching a task with a completion state, or placing the creature behind dense text as a background substrate would each create a different Skill.
content_and_composition: Exactly one soft-edged luminous body as the sole subject, centred and occupying a modest share of an otherwise empty field
Exactly two eye marks on the body as its only detail; they read and move as one coupled pair, never independently
Evenly toned surrounding field with no competing visual elements and a luminance clearly lower than the body's, so the body's glow bleeds gently into the emptiness and defines the whole composition
Any supporting page copy stays minimal and clearly subordinate to the creature
Persistent spatial constraint: the eye pair always remains inside the body silhouette, never touching or crossing its edge
attention_and_information_flow: The empty, lower-luminance surroundings give the glowing body all prominence; there is nothing else to look at
Gaze direction is the only information channel: the small eye offset tells the visitor the creature has noticed where the pointer is
The breathing rhythm holds low-level attention without adding new information, making the subject pleasant to watch idly
No hidden content, reveals or progressive disclosure; everything visible is present from the first moment

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: A fresh movement during an unfinished settle simply redirects the motion continuously from the eyes' current position, with no restart, jump or queued catch-up
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Both eyes ease together in the pointer's direction with a springy settle and a hint of overshoot before resting, never snapping and never reaching the body edge
interaction_model.input: Pointer movement anywhere in the view
interaction_model.state_change: Gaze target shifts toward the pointer position, scaled to only a small fraction of the pointer's distance and hard-capped so the offset stays inside the body
interaction_model.affected_object: The coupled pair of eyes on the body

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Fully reversible at any time; the return can itself be interrupted and redirected by new movement
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Eyes glide back to their centred rest position with the same springy easing, so neutral is reached softly rather than abruptly
interaction_model.input: Pointer returning toward the middle of the view
interaction_model.state_change: Gaze target returns to neutral centre
interaction_model.affected_object: The eye pair

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: The first pointer appearance is acquired with the same easing instead of a jump to the new direction
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Eyes rest centred while the body keeps breathing, so the creature still looks alive rather than switched off
interaction_model.input: No pointer present at all
interaction_model.state_change: Gaze holds the neutral centred state
interaction_model.affected_object: The eye pair

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Never paused, reset or overridden by pointer activity; breathing and gaze run simultaneously and independently
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Soft rhythmic expansion and contraction with gentle modulation of the emitted brightness at a slow, hypnotic tempo
interaction_model.input: Autonomous time-based idle driver
interaction_model.state_change: Continuous slow swell-and-settle breathing cycle
interaction_model.affected_object: The whole luminous body and its surrounding glow

adaptable_details: Body silhouette, size and the glow's hue family or intensity, any hue allowed while it stays clearly brighter than the surround
Exact breathing tempo and amplitude
Spring stiffness and how pronounced the overshoot is

canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits any short display phrase, a few words up to a couple of short lines, that must stay legible with essentially nothing else on screen and can be given a quiet, low-distraction full-bleed area for idle play. It stops being this Skill if the text becomes paragraphs or dense copy, if interface elements or scrolling content are layered over the field, if the disturbance persists or must be completed or dismissed by the user, if the points form pictures or morph into other content, if the ambient speck layer starts reacting to the pointer, or if solid text merely translates instead of being constituted of separately repelled points.
content_and_composition: One short headline phrase, one to a few centered lines, visibly constituted of many discrete small bright points that resolve into legible letterforms rather than solid glyphs
A single quiet, unpatterned empty field filling the whole view as the only backdrop, separated enough in luminance from the points that they read as sources of light
A sparse secondary layer of fainter, smaller specks distributed through the surrounding emptiness, behind and around the phrase
Each letterform point owns an exact home position; the full set of home positions is the readable composition and the state the view returns to
No navigation, controls, instructions, secondary copy, imagery or call to action anywhere in the view
attention_and_information_flow: Attention settles immediately on the centered phrase because it is the brightest, densest and only legible thing present
Faint specks stay low-contrast against the surrounding field so they read as atmosphere and never compete with reading

No information is ever revealed, hidden or added; legibility of the one phrase is the whole payload and it is always restored

interaction_model.state_change: Each displaced point travels back to its exact original home position

name: pointer_steered_glowing_bloom

name: bass_punched_glitch_field

Resume continues from the stopped audio position; the track loops indefinitely

name: cursor_following_gaze_character

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Nothing can be entered or exited, so there is nothing to escape from; the visitor is never trapped in an interaction

interaction_model.affected_object: The whole decorative character layer

canonical_document.description: A single large character sits alone in a quiet, nearly empty field and watches the visitor: both pupils turn toward the cursor and keep pointing at it, gliding with a slight trailing lag, never leaving their eyes, and holding their last direction when the cursor rests.
experience_progression: Arrival: character visible at rest with pupils in a neutral centered position; field is quiet and the muted caption is read once

completion_and_return: No completion, progress, score or dismissal; the experience is open-ended for the whole visit

name: instant_redraw_dot_pattern_stage
description: A photograph is displayed rebuilt entirely out of patterned cells, with a hushed side panel of grouped sliders, menus, toggles and colour-value pickers that redraw the whole picture the instant any of them moves, and a one-press save that keeps precisely the visible frame.

canonical_document.name: instant_redraw_dot_pattern_stage
canonical_document.description: A photograph is displayed rebuilt entirely out of patterned cells, with a hushed side panel of grouped sliders, menus, toggles and colour-value pickers that redraw the whole picture the instant any of them moves, and a one-press save that keeps precisely the visible frame.
canonical_document.experience_scope: A whole-view experience: one dominant render stage plus one attached control edge. It begins the moment the view opens, already showing a finished sample render, and it continues indefinitely as a tuning loop; the only terminal act is writing out the current frame, after which the same stage remains live.
content_and_composition: Exactly one render stage as the visual centre, filling the majority of the view and always showing a complete, finished pattern rather than a partial or placeholder state
One source picture at a time feeding the stage; the source is never shown as a competing panel or side-by-side comparison
The render is composed of repeated discrete cells whose size, shape, spacing and colour value carry the tonal structure of the source picture, so the picture is legible only through the pattern
One recessive control region docked to a single edge of the view, held at lower visual weight and lower contrast against its surround than the stage

Controls arranged into a small number of labelled clusters, each cluster named after the visible facet it governs (overall structure and colour treatment, the rule that decides mark placement or density, the geometry of an individual cell), so the mapping from control group to visible consequence is readable before anything is touched
A source-picking affordance and a single save affordance are persistent and always reachable without leaving the stage
An optional slot for a supplied custom cell outline that replaces the default cell shape across the whole render
A transient notice surface for rejected input, overlaid or adjacent without displacing the render
experience_progression: Opens pre-rendered: a sample picture is already patterned, so the concept is understood before any input
Substitution: the user's own picture takes the sample's place and is re-patterned under the current settings
Open-ended tuning loop: each control change immediately produces a new complete render, with no accumulating steps, stages or history to manage
Capture: the currently visible frame is written out and the loop continues unchanged
attention_and_information_flow: The render holds primary attention at all times; controls stay deliberately subordinate and never take over the view
Information about what each control does is revealed by the render itself changing under the hand, not by explanatory copy
Cluster labels pre-narrow attention to the right group, so exploration starts local rather than exhaustive
Because the first frame is already complete, attention starts on the outcome instead of on setup
A refusal notice is the only element permitted to briefly outrank the render by contrast and salience, and it recedes without altering it

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Picking again replaces the source again; current settings are never reset by a source change
interaction_model.state_change: The previous picture is replaced as soon as the new one is readable, and the pattern is rebuilt under the settings already in force
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The stage swaps to a fully patterned version of the new picture; settings visibly persist across the swap
interaction_model.input: Choosing a picture file
interaction_model.affected_object: The render stage's source content

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Every numeric range is bounded so that no value can reach a degenerate or unrecoverable look; returning a control toward its former value returns the render to its former appearance, making all exploration reversible by hand
interaction_model.state_change: The whole result is recomputed and repainted at the moment of the change, with no apply or confirm step
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The pattern shifts continuously and coherently while the control moves, so cause and effect are seen together
interaction_model.input: Dragging a slider, choosing a menu option, flipping a toggle or picking a colour value from the offered set
interaction_model.affected_object: The entire render

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Rejection is non-destructive and retryable; the previously active cell shape stays in force
interaction_model.state_change: A usable outline becomes the repeated cell across the whole picture; an unusable one changes nothing
interaction_model.visible_feedback: On success the entire pattern re-forms out of the new shape; on failure a short notice appears and the existing pattern remains exactly as it was
interaction_model.input: Supplying a custom cell outline from a file
interaction_model.affected_object: The shape of every cell in the render

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Saving never alters or locks the render, so it can be repeated after further tuning
interaction_model.state_change: The frame is written out with no intermediate dialogs, prompts or option steps
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The stage is unchanged and continues to be tunable; what was on screen is what was kept
interaction_model.input: Pressing save once
interaction_model.affected_object: The currently visible frame

experience_qualities: Relaxed and low-stakes: nothing can be broken, so tuning feels like play rather than configuration
Immediately legible: the idea is understood at first sight because a finished example is already there
Continuous and responsive: the picture feels directly connected to the hand
Calm hierarchy: a high-contrast result against a low-distraction control surround
Trustworthy fidelity: the visible frame and the saved frame are the same thing
completion_and_return: No completion state; the tuning loop persists as the resting state of the view
Settings persist across source substitutions and across saves
Saving is repeatable and leaves the experience exactly where it was
Recovery is by re-adjustment rather than by an undo history
locked_observable_requirements: The view opens with a complete render already present, never empty and never awaiting setup
The picture is reconstructed out of repeated discrete cells that carry its tonal structure
The render stage dominates and the controls stay visually recessive at one edge, separated from it by weight and contrast rather than by any particular hue
Controls are grouped into a few labelled clusters whose names correspond to visible facets of the result
Every control change redraws the full result immediately, with no apply step
All numeric ranges are bounded so that moving a value back always recovers the earlier look
A rejected supplied input produces a notice that is momentarily the most salient element and leaves the current render fully intact
One press exports exactly the visible frame, with no intervening dialogs
adaptable_details: The specific pattern rule vocabulary and how marks are distributed
Cell geometry options and the default cell shape
Colour handling, including palette reduction, single-value rendering or colour taken from the source picture; any hue vocabulary satisfies this, and no particular one is required
Which edge the control region occupies and how the clusters are visually separated
The exact number and naming of clusters, provided each still names a visible facet
Export format and resolution
The content of the opening sample picture
Presentation of the refusal notice
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Transfers to any single-source visual stage where one supplied picture is re-rendered into a repeating graphic material under a small set of bounded, immediately applied visual parameters — stylised media heroes, generator and configurator pages, artwork-making tools. It depends on the source being a tonal image whose structure the cells can carry, and on the result being cheap enough to redraw on every change; it does not depend on any host palette, stage luminance or theme, since the stage-to-controls relationship is carried by contrast and weight. It becomes a different Skill if an apply or render-queue step is introduced, if the result is presented as a before/after comparison or multi-variant gallery, if a step-by-step or staged workflow replaces the open tuning loop, or if the controls become the dominant content with the render reduced to a small thumbnail.

name: editable_curve_travel_stage
description: A tall low-distraction stage marks labelled waypoint slots, draws the curve joining them with its anchors, handles and guide lines, sends an image travelling and resizing along that curve as you scroll, and lets you drag the handles to reshape the curve live and copy the resulting coordinates.

canonical_document.name: editable_curve_travel_stage
canonical_document.description: A tall low-distraction stage marks labelled waypoint slots, draws the curve joining them with its anchors, handles and guide lines, sends an image travelling and resizing along that curve as you scroll, and lets you drag the handles to reshape the curve live and copy the resulting coordinates.
canonical_document.experience_scope: A self-contained tall region that begins where the stage and its first labelled slot appear and ends after the last slot is reached; it occupies a full-height scrollable stage but does not take over the whole site, and the curve overlay, readouts and controls live inside the same region as the travelling image.
content_and_composition: One tall, quiet stage acting as the visual backdrop and coordinate space for everything else, held at a clear luminance separation from the drawn overlay and the traveller
An ordered sequence of at least three labelled target slots, each defining a position and its own width and height for the traveller
One travelling foreground element (an image) that is always somewhere on the curve
One openly drawn curve connecting the slots in order, rendered as a visible line rather than an implied path
Anchor markers at the slot ends of the curve and draggable handle markers that shape it, each handle tied to its anchor by a thin guide line
A coordinate readout displayed beside the curve for each handle, always showing current values
Persistent controls for resetting the handles and copying the current coordinates, plus a brief confirmation surface for the copy action
experience_progression: Arrival: the stage, labelled slots, curve, markers and numbers are all visible at once, so the geometry reads as a tuning bench before anything moves
Travel: scrolling forward carries the image from the first slot through the middle slot to the last, its width and height blending between each slot's dimensions
Judgement: attention settles on the shape of the drawn curve against the coordinate readouts beside it
Adjustment: handles are dragged, the curve and readouts change under the pointer, and the image re-seats on the new shape at the current scroll position
Departure: the settled coordinates are copied out for reuse
The travel stage is fully scrubbable rather than one-way: scrolling back rewinds the image to exactly the matching point
attention_and_information_flow: Prominence starts on the labelled slots and the drawn curve, which announce the structure of the region before motion begins
During scrolling, the moving and resizing image is the focal object while the curve stays visible behind it as reference
While a handle is held, prominence moves to that handle, its guide line and its coordinate readout, which change continuously under the pointer
Numeric information is always on screen rather than revealed on demand, so shape and numbers can be compared in one glance
The final attention shift is to the copy control and its confirmation, signalling that the values are the takeaway

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Motion is bound to scroll position rather than played back, so it stops wherever scrolling stops and is clamped at the first and last slot
interaction_model.state_change: Progress along the curve advances from the first slot through the middle slot toward the last, and the element's width and height blend between the dimensions of the slots being travelled between
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The image glides along the drawn curve while continuously changing size, staying visibly attached to the curve at all times
interaction_model.input: Scrolling forward through the stage
interaction_model.affected_object: The travelling image

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Any scroll position can be revisited repeatedly and always shows the same position and size
interaction_model.state_change: Progress reverses to the position that matches the current scroll offset
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The image rewinds along the same curve to exactly the matching point and size, with no drift or alternate return path
interaction_model.input: Scrolling backward through the stage
interaction_model.affected_object: The travelling image

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Releasing the pointer ends the adjustment and leaves the new shape in place; the traveller never loses its place on the curve during or after the edit
interaction_model.state_change: The handle relocates to follow the pointer and the curve geometry is recomputed
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The curve, the guide line tying the handle to its anchor and the coordinate readout redraw instantly with the pointer, while the image re-seats onto the new curve at the current scroll position instead of jumping
interaction_model.input: Pressing a handle marker and moving the pointer
interaction_model.affected_object: That handle, the curve it shapes, its guide line, its coordinate readout and the travelling image

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Reset is always available as the escape from any amount of experimentation
interaction_model.state_change: Handles return to their computed starting positions
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The curve snaps back to its original shape with guide lines and coordinate readouts showing the starting values, and the image re-seats on the restored curve at the current scroll position
interaction_model.input: Activating the reset control
interaction_model.affected_object: All handles, the curve, the guide lines and the readouts

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Repeatable at any time; copying changes nothing about the curve, the readouts or the traveller
interaction_model.state_change: The coordinates are placed on the clipboard
interaction_model.visible_feedback: A brief confirmation appears and then subsides, leaving the stage otherwise unchanged
interaction_model.input: Activating the copy control
interaction_model.affected_object: The current coordinate values

experience_qualities: Reads immediately as a workbench or instrument rather than a decorative section
Geometry is never guesswork: the path, its control points and its numbers are all shown openly
Motion feels directly hand-driven and reversible because it tracks scroll position exactly
Editing feels immediate and continuous, with shape and numbers changing under the pointer
Staging is quiet but strongly separated in contrast, whether the surround is light or dark, so the drawn line, markers and labels stay legible against the travelling image
The session ends with something concrete to carry away rather than only something to watch
completion_and_return: The travel has a defined end at the last slot and no autoplay loop; it rests wherever scrolling leaves it
Backward scrolling always returns the traveller to the exact matching point, so there is no one-way completion
Handle edits persist for the rest of the session until reset is used
Reset returns the whole curve to its computed starting state
The copy confirmation is transient and self-clearing, leaving the stage in its current tuned state
locked_observable_requirements: A tall stage with an ordered sequence of at least three labelled target slots
Each slot defines both a position and its own dimensions, and the traveller's width and height blend between consecutive slots
The path is visibly drawn, not implied, and remains visible while the element travels
Anchor markers, draggable handle markers and a guide line from each handle to its anchor are all visible
A live coordinate readout is shown beside the curve for the handles at all times
Scroll position maps to position along the path, and reverse scrolling retraces to exactly the matching point
Dragging a handle instantly redraws the curve, its guide line and its readout
During and after an edit the travelling element re-seats onto the new curve at the current scroll position rather than jumping
A reset restores the computed starting handles
A copy action exports the current coordinates and shows a brief confirmation
adaptable_details: The exact number of labelled slots beyond the ordered minimum
The nature of the travelling element (photo, product shot, illustration, card)
Stage and marker styling, including whether the surround is light or dark, as long as the drawn line, markers and labels keep readable contrast against both stage and traveller
Slot label wording and readout number formatting
Placement of the reset and copy controls and the visual form of the confirmation
Stage height and how much scrolling covers the full journey
Whether the readouts sit above, beside or below the curve
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits any tall scroll region where a single foreground element should travel and resize between a few named positions and where the path geometry itself is meant to be inspected and authored on the page, with the resulting values taken away for reuse. Hiding the drawn path, markers or readouts, driving the journey by autoplay or timed playback instead of scroll position, allowing the traveller to jump rather than re-seat while the path is edited, or animating several independent travellers at once would each produce a different Skill.

name: glossy_hue_drift_ribbon_painting
description: Dragging across a softly lit empty surface lays down a solid, glossy ribbon that sits physically in the lit space, drifts steadily and continuously through a full hue cycle as it grows, thickens with fast movement, and bounces light and mirrored highlights onto the surface behind it.

canonical_document.name: glossy_hue_drift_ribbon_painting
canonical_document.description: Dragging across a softly lit empty surface lays down a solid, glossy ribbon that sits physically in the lit space, drifts steadily and continuously through a full hue cycle as it grows, thickens with fast movement, and bounces light and mirrored highlights onto the surface behind it.
canonical_document.experience_scope: Begins the moment the view appears, since the surface is already empty and ready for a first mark with no intro, instructions or setup step; each stroke's own lifetime begins on press and ends on release, and the accumulated painting persists for as long as the view is open. Fills the whole view as a single continuous surface rather than being framed as one widget among other content.
content_and_composition: One bare backing surface filling the view, softly and unevenly lit so that it reads as a physical wall rather than a flat, evenly filled sheet, and carrying no text, controls or instructional content
Zero to many strokes accumulating on that surface, each an independent object with its own start and end
Each stroke reads as a solid, glossy, dimensional ribbon occupying space in front of the backing surface, not as flat pigment lying in it
Light and mirrored highlights cast from each ribbon onto the backing surface immediately behind and around it, spatially tied to that ribbon so the separation between ribbon and surface is visible
Varying ribbon thickness along the length of a single stroke as a readable trace of how fast the hand moved
Continuously drifting hue along the ribbon so a single long stroke reads as a smooth multi-hue gradient rather than one flat color
No persistent chrome: no palette, brush picker, toolbar, counter, progress element or reset affordance
experience_progression: Empty inviting surface with nothing painted
First press places a mark instantly at the touched point, confirming that the surface responds
Continued dragging extends a single ribbon that grows, varies in thickness and drifts in hue as it goes
Release closes that ribbon and leaves it standing on the surface
Repeated strokes accumulate into an increasingly dense, layered composition with no completion threshold, score or end state
attention_and_information_flow: Before any input, the empty softly lit surface is the whole subject and its emptiness carries the invitation
During a stroke, attention sits at the moving tip where new ribbon is being extruded, because that is the only changing region
Cast light and mirrored highlights pull secondary attention just behind the ribbon and communicate its depth without any explanation
Hue drift gives an implicit sense of how long the current stroke has run and which parts were made earlier
As strokes accumulate, prominence shifts from the surface to the painted mass, and the backing surface becomes visible only in the remaining gaps
No informational overlay ever competes with the marks

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Pressing anywhere, at any time, always starts a new stroke; there is no invalid area, no required order and no mode to enter first
interaction_model.state_change: A fresh, independent ribbon is started at the pressed location
interaction_model.visible_feedback: A mark appears immediately at the exact point where the pointer meets the surface, already glossy and already casting light onto the surface behind it

interaction_model.affected_object: A new stroke

interaction_model.state_change: The ribbon extends continuously, tracking the pointer in real time at the exact contact point on the surface
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Ribbon grows to follow the pointer with a slight smoothing lag so the path reads as a fluid curve rather than raw jitter; the tip trails marginally behind the pointer and catches up when movement stops

interaction_model.affected_object: The active stroke

interaction_model.visible_feedback: The ribbon swells thicker through fast passages and thins where the hand slows, so the finished stroke visibly records the tempo of the gesture
interaction_model.input: Speed of pointer movement while held
interaction_model.affected_object: Thickness of the active stroke

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Drift is autonomous and never selected by the user; there is no hue control to adjust or restore, and no particular hue is required
interaction_model.state_change: Hue advances steadily and continuously through a full hue cycle
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Hue drifts along the ribbon so long strokes become smooth multi-hue gradients and successive strokes begin at clearly different hues
interaction_model.input: Elapsed drawing along a stroke
interaction_model.affected_object: Ribbon hue

interaction_model.state_change: The stroke is closed and becomes a finished, static object
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The ribbon terminates with a rounded end rather than a cut or tapered-to-nothing edge, and keeps its gloss, highlights and cast light in place

interaction_model.affected_object: The active stroke

interaction_model.state_change: A separate stroke is added; nothing existing is modified or removed
interaction_model.visible_feedback: A new ribbon appears wherever pressed and layers over or beside earlier ribbons, casting its own light onto whatever lies behind it
interaction_model.input: Pressing again after a release
interaction_model.affected_object: The accumulated painting

experience_qualities: Immediately inviting: usable within a second of arrival with nothing to read, choose or dismiss
Physical and dimensional: marks feel like glossy objects standing in lit space rather than ink on a flat sheet
Playful and consequence-free, with no goal, score or wrong move
Fluid and responsive, with tracking tight enough to feel direct but smoothed enough to feel graceful
Expressive: speed and hue drift turn plain dragging into a visibly varied, personal result
Committed and cumulative, since every mark stays
completion_and_return: No finish state, target or success condition; painting simply accumulates
No looping, replay or autonomous animation once a stroke is finished; finished ribbons stay still
No erase, undo or clear path; new presses only ever add
Accumulated strokes persist for the life of the view; leaving and returning presents the inviting empty surface again
locked_observable_requirements: The surface starts bare and instantly markable, with no instructions, controls or setup between arrival and the first stroke

Strokes read as solid, glossy, dimensional ribbons sitting in front of the surface rather than as flat pigment, and stay clearly distinguishable from the backing surface at whatever luminance level that surface uses
Each ribbon casts light and mirrored highlights onto the surface behind it so its separation from that surface is visible

canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits any view whose purpose is to invite free, goal-free mark-making as the main content, including playful toys, blank invitations to participate, and creative showcases where no text must remain readable in front of the marks. It does not fit contexts needing legible foreground content over the surface, since marks accumulate opaquely and cast light across it. Adding erase, undo, saved output, precision editing, hue or brush selection, or a completion goal would make it a drawing tool rather than this toy; making marks fade or self-animate after release, flattening ribbons into flat pigment, or dropping the cast light and highlights would remove the physical-object quality that defines it.

canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits calm full-view ambient or playful surfaces with little or no competing foreground copy, where accumulation without cleanup is acceptable and visitors may stay indefinitely. It suits any climbing, sprouting or upward-growing organic motif rooted along a bottom edge, in either a light or dark host treatment. It becomes a different Skill if growth is cleared, faded, looped or reset; if plants become uniform repetitions of one template; if new input interrupts or replaces existing growth; if elements are placed freely across the surface rather than rooted at a shared bottom edge; or if the accumulation becomes opaque enough that individual plants stop reading as individuals.

completion_and_return: No terminal state; the experience loops indefinitely, one attempt at a time

locked_observable_requirements: A single persistent subject holds the visual centre throughout
A small set of draggable options rests at stable home positions arranged around the subject
Pickup requires press-and-hold, after which the item follows pointer or finger one-to-one
The held item is visibly lifted and tilts according to its direction of movement

canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits any context where a handful of items are tried one at a time on a single central subject that can visibly react — accessories or outfits on a figure, toppings on a dish, decals or finishes on a product, props on a mascot. It becomes a different skill if dropped items accumulate into multiple slots, if items stay wherever they are dropped instead of returning home, if selection happens by clicking a list or thumbnails instead of dragging, if the subject no longer reacts during the carry, or if the option set grows large enough to need scrolling or paging.

name: character_rendered_image_studio
description: A picture shown rebuilt entirely out of text characters, with a quiet side column of controls that regenerate the glyph artwork the instant any value changes, ending in a copyable or savable finished piece.

canonical_document.name: character_rendered_image_studio
canonical_document.description: A picture shown rebuilt entirely out of text characters, with a quiet side column of controls that regenerate the glyph artwork the instant any value changes, ending in a copyable or savable finished piece.
canonical_document.experience_scope: Whole-view experience for a dedicated working page: it begins already showing a finished character rendering before any user input, continues through an open-ended refinement loop, and ends when the result is copied out, saved as a picture, or every control and the rendering are restored to defaults. The rendering area and the tuning column both persist for the entire session.
content_and_composition: One dominant rendering area holding the entire artwork as a dense, uniformly aligned grid of text characters, where tonal value reads as character density rather than as pixels, with glyphs separated strongly enough from their surround that the density gradient stays legible
One persistent secondary tuning column beside the rendering, visually calmer and lower contrast than the artwork, listing its controls in a fixed order
Each control paired with its current value displayed immediately adjacent, so the whole configuration is readable without interacting
One source-selection affordance for supplying a picture from the visitor's own files
One small, separated group of terminal actions: copy the whole text out, save the result as a picture, restore everything to defaults
A seeded example rendering occupying the rendering area before the visitor supplies anything, in the same place and framing a user image will later occupy
One dependent control (edge sensitivity) that exists in the column only while its parent outline treatment is active, so the column's length changes slightly
Brief local notices near the terminal actions for confirmation and refusal, never overlaying or displacing the artwork
experience_progression: Opening state: a finished conversion is already on screen, so the character-based look explains itself before any effort is spent
Settle the subject: choosing a picture immediately replaces the rendering with that picture's conversion at the current settings

Work the surface: softening, grain style, inversion
Choose the glyph vocabulary, including collapsing to a single custom character
Refine how strongly outlines read, then their sensitivity once outline treatment is active
Adjust how large the rendering is displayed for inspection without changing its character count
Close out by copying the text, saving a picture, or restoring the opening defaults; the loop may otherwise continue indefinitely
Across every stage the artwork stays continuously legible, so each refinement reads as predictable incremental progress rather than a re-run
attention_and_information_flow: The rendering holds primary prominence at all times; the tuning column stays deliberately quiet reference material
Every control's current value is always visible beside it, so state is read rather than remembered
Adjusting a control briefly pulls attention to the artwork because the whole rendering visibly reforms in place
Coarse-to-fine control ordering means the visitor's attention moves from whole-image framing toward local texture and edges
The dependent sensitivity control appears only while relevant, so an inapplicable option never competes for attention
Confirmation and refusal notices are short, local, and self-clearing in emphasis, leaving the artwork undisturbed

experience_qualities: Self-explaining on arrival, because the finished effect is present before any effort
Immediate and predictable, since every change lands at once with no apply step
Continuously legible, never dropping to blank or placeholder states between adjustments

locked_observable_requirements: A finished conversion is visible before the visitor supplies anything
The source imagery is rendered entirely out of text characters, with tone carried by glyph density

canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits any single-view working page where one supplied media asset is visibly reinterpreted into a stylized rendering that a compact parameter column reshapes live and the visitor takes away as an artifact; the source only needs to be image-like enough that its tone and edges can drive the rendering, and subject matter is otherwise irrelevant. It becomes a different skill if regeneration is deferred behind an apply or queue step, if the artwork blanks or is replaced by intermediate states while tuning, if the control column takes primary prominence over the result, or if the output stays an in-place page effect with no keepable artifact.

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Steering the drift by re-aiming and re-firing is the way to clear a chosen area; cleared space can always be refilled by firing again, so play never stalls
interaction_model.state_change: Those marks disappear from the field
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Splatters vanish around the object's path, opening cleared space in the mess
