interaction_model.control_and_recovery: The drift is never controlled or reset by the user and simply continues cycling
interaction_model.state_change: Hue advances slowly and continuously, cycling through the full hue circle from whatever hue it starts on
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Freshly fired shots and freshly frozen splatters differ in color from older ones, so the field's overall character shifts the longer it is used
interaction_model.input: Elapsed time (autonomous driver)
interaction_model.affected_object: The global color state applied to new shots and new marks

experience_qualities: Immediately legible as a toy rather than as content to read
Loose, physical and slightly chaotic
Punchy and reactive, with squash and recoil making force feel felt
High-salience marks standing clearly apart from a quiet surround, erupting then settling
Messy but reversible, never punishing and never finished
completion_and_return: No score, goal, win, fail or ending
The accumulating mess is the entire outcome and persists for the whole session
Marks persist until erased by the drifting object; there is no automatic fade or timed cleanup
Thinning by proximity is the built-in way to reset space, so the field always returns to a usable state without a reset control
locked_observable_requirements: Opens as an essentially empty field of one uniform low-distraction tone, clearly separated from the object and marks, with exactly one small object at rest in its center
The object continuously faces the pointer without any click
Press-and-hold produces a fast continuous stream of small elongated shots from the object's nose; release stops it immediately
While firing, the object visibly squashes and is pushed backwards by recoil, drifting across the field
Drift is bounded by soft rebounds off the field edges
Shots travel until they reach an edge and only there burst into a spray of dots that fan out, slow and freeze in place
Frozen dots remain as lasting marks that build up over the session
Marks the drifting object travels close to vanish, clearing room
A single slowly drifting hue, of no fixed starting value, governs new shots and marks so accumulation spans many hues over time while every mark stays readable against the surround
No score, ending or explicit reset
adaptable_details: Silhouette and size of the central object
Exact projectile shape, length, rate and speed
Number of dots per burst, their spread angle and how quickly they slow
Recoil strength, drift damping and rebound softness
Hue drift speed, starting hue, saturation and range, and the field's own tone and lightness, whether light, mid or deep, as long as marks and object stay clearly separated from it
Erase radius around the drifting object
Field aspect ratio and whether it fills the viewport or a bounded panel
Presence of sound or subtle idle motion while not firing
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits any sparse region or view that can be handed over entirely to pointer play, where the surface starts near-empty and reads as a quiet surround, and the accumulating colored mess is itself the intended impression. It stops being this Skill if scoring, levels, targets or an ending are added, if marks are painted directly under the cursor instead of created by boundary bursts of travelling shots, if marks fade on their own instead of persisting and being wiped by the drifting object, if the object is fixed in place rather than shoved around by its own recoil, if the surround competes with the marks instead of staying low-distraction and clearly separated from them, or if the region must simultaneously carry dense readable content that the splatter layer would obscure.

name: electric_stroke_bloom_canvas
description: On a quiet empty expanse, a dragged stroke appears as a rough trail of tiny specks in a distinct accent tone, then on release snaps into a crisp thin high-contrast line that sprouts wandering, splitting filaments outward before everything fades to a faint lasting trace.

canonical_document.name: electric_stroke_bloom_canvas
canonical_document.description: On a quiet empty expanse, a dragged stroke appears as a rough trail of tiny specks in a distinct accent tone, then on release snaps into a crisp thin high-contrast line that sprouts wandering, splitting filaments outward before everything fades to a faint lasting trace.
canonical_document.experience_scope: Whole-view experience occupying the entire uninflected surface; it begins the moment the page is present and open to input and never ends, since there is no completion screen, level, or reset. Each individual mark is a self-contained episode from press to the fading of its filaments.
content_and_composition: Single full-bleed empty low-distraction expanse acting as both surround and the entire drawable area, with no framing panels, palettes, or controls
One quiet line of guidance text as the only pre-existing foreground content, present to signal that the whole surface can be drawn on
Transient layer: a trail of many tiny high-salience specks in a distinct accent tone, marking every pointer position recorded so far in the in-progress stroke
Committed layer: one crisp thin strongly separated line per finished stroke, following the recorded path
Growth layer: fine filaments extending outward from both sides of each committed line, wandering and splitting into thinner offshoots
Residual layer: faint low-contrast traces of all previously finished marks, accumulating and slowly increasing overall density
Unlimited number of accumulated marks; the most recent mark is always the most salient element in the composition
experience_progression: Stage 1 — invitation: empty low-distraction surface with one short line of guidance and no interface to learn
Stage 2 — provisional sketching: while pressed and moving, a rough speck trail in the accent tone grows along the travelled path, deliberately unrefined and clearly temporary
Stage 3 — commitment snap: on release the specks vanish and are replaced in place by a single crisp thin high-contrast line of the same path
Stage 4 — bloom: filaments spread outward from both sides of the committed line, wandering and splitting as they extend, unfolding on their own with no further input
Stage 5 — burn down: the whole mark loses separation from the surround and settles into a faint persistent trace
Stage 6 — accumulation: attention releases to the surface as a whole, which is now slightly denser; the cycle repeats for each new stroke without any reset or finish state
attention_and_information_flow: Initial prominence sits on the single guidance line because nothing else competes on the empty low-distraction field
The moment drawing starts, prominence transfers to the pointer's own path; the guidance recedes in importance
The bloom is the most salient, most energetic moment of the whole view, pulling attention outward from the drawn shape into the surrounding emptiness
As the mark burns down, prominence decays so the newest mark always outranks older ones, keeping attention on whatever was made last
Older marks read as faint accumulated history rather than active content, revealing the growing overall picture without competing with the live mark

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Pressing again always starts fresh; a press with no movement leaves the surface untouched and produces no mark
interaction_model.state_change: Idle surface enters active sketching for a new independent mark; any partially captured earlier path is discarded
interaction_model.visible_feedback: A speck appears at the press point and the surface is otherwise unchanged; no cursor, panel, or mode indicator appears
interaction_model.input: Press anywhere on the surface
interaction_model.affected_object: In-progress stroke record and the transient speck layer

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: The trail shows precisely what has been captured so far, so the visitor can judge the shape before committing; the whole in-progress trail is abandoned by starting another press
interaction_model.state_change: Each new pointer position is appended to the recorded path
interaction_model.visible_feedback: A lengthening trail of tiny high-salience specks in the accent tone traces exactly where the pointer has travelled, reading as rough and provisional
interaction_model.input: Drag while pressed, anywhere including over existing marks
interaction_model.affected_object: Transient speck trail

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Committed; no undo, erase, or step-back exists, and the mark cannot be edited afterward
interaction_model.state_change: Speck trail is cleared and replaced by one crisp thin high-contrast line along the recorded path; filament growth begins
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Specks disappear as the clean line appears in their place, then fine filaments push outward from both sides of the line, wandering and splitting
interaction_model.input: Release the press
interaction_model.affected_object: The stroke, transitioning from provisional to committed

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Runs to its end without further input and cannot be paused or cancelled; starting a new mark does not interrupt marks already blooming
interaction_model.state_change: Filaments extend, branch, and lose contrast until the mark settles into a faint trace
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Spreading, splitting growth that thins and fades out on its own, leaving a low-contrast remnant of the shape
interaction_model.input: Autonomous continuation after release
interaction_model.affected_object: Filaments and overall salience of the finished mark

experience_qualities: Immediately obvious with nothing to learn first
Rough and provisional while sketching, crisp and decisive on release
Sudden, crackling, energetic payoff at the moment of commitment
Organic, wandering, unrepeatable growth outward from the drawn shape
Quiet, low-distraction, high-contrast field where salience alone signals recency
Open-ended and consequence-bearing: every mark is permanent and the picture only grows denser
completion_and_return: No finish line, score, reset, or clear action anywhere in the experience
Each mark completes individually by burning down to a faint persistent trace
All earlier marks stay exactly where they were made and persist for the whole visit
The experience returns to a receptive idle state after every stroke, ready for the next independent mark, with density carried forward
locked_observable_requirements: Empty low-distraction full-surface drawing area where the entire surface accepts strokes and no controls are required
One quiet line of guidance as the only pre-existing foreground content
Two visually distinct stroke stages: a rough many-speck trail while pressed, and a crisp thin single line after release, with the specks removed as the line appears
The committed line follows the actual recorded pointer path
Filaments grow outward from both sides of the committed line, wandering and splitting, driven autonomously after release
Filaments and the mark fade toward the surround into a faint trace rather than disappearing
Finished marks persist and accumulate; no undo, erase, or reset
A new press starts an independent mark and discards any half-captured path
A press without movement leaves the surface untouched
adaptable_details: Exact hues of the provisional specks, the committed line and the filaments, and the surround's own tone and luminance direction, provided the provisional and committed stages remain visually distinct, marks stay clearly separated from the surround, and the newest mark stays the most salient
Wording of the single guidance line and whether it fades once drawing begins
Speck size and spacing, line thickness, filament reach, branching frequency, and fade duration
How faint the settled residual trace is
Whether many blooms can be in progress simultaneously and how much total density is retained
Pointer type support (mouse, pen, touch)
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits any context where the visitor's own freehand strokes are the entire foreground content on an otherwise empty low-distraction field — playful landing surfaces, idle creative toys, wordless full-bleed interactive sections. It does not fit surfaces that must also carry primary reading content, since accumulating high-salience marks would compete with it. Adding erase, undo, clear, saving, layered tools, or shape recognition, or driving the marks from data or automation instead of live pointer strokes, would create a different Skill; so would committing the stroke without the two-stage provisional-to-crisp swap or without the autonomous outward-spreading, self-fading growth.

name: elevated_cube_world_build_and_dig_sandbox
description: A compact square patch of uniform cube ground floating in an empty surround, viewed from slightly above; the face under the cursor is outlined so the next placement is obvious, a click stacks a new block of the chosen material onto it, a digging mode instead washes the whole hovered block in a single high-salience tonal shift for one-click removal, and held viewpoint controls glide the view around the structure that keeps standing.

canonical_document.name: elevated_cube_world_build_and_dig_sandbox
canonical_document.description: A compact square patch of uniform cube ground floating in an empty surround, viewed from slightly above; the face under the cursor is outlined so the next placement is obvious, a click stacks a new block of the chosen material onto it, a digging mode instead washes the whole hovered block in a single high-salience tonal shift for one-click removal, and held viewpoint controls glide the view around the structure that keeps standing.
canonical_document.experience_scope: A self-contained scene region or full-view canvas that begins as soon as the ground patch is shown and never ends: there is no start gate, no win state and no exit sequence, only continued building, removal and viewpoint movement within the bounded plot.
content_and_composition: One primary layer: a three-dimensional world of uniform stacked cubes, dominating the visual field
Initial world state is a single flat square patch of uniform ground-surface cubes of modest, readable extent
Surrounding emptiness with no horizon clutter and no competing detail, so the plot's edges and thickness separate clearly from the low-distraction surround
Default vantage point is slightly elevated and angled downward so depth, height and plot size read at a glance
One transient highlight role: an outline on a single cube face, or a uniform tonal wash over one whole cube, drawn exactly where the cursor points and held clearly apart from the surfaces around it
One persistent, deliberately quiet control strip placed at the edge and out of the way, holding the material choice, the build/dig mode choice and the viewpoint controls
Blocks accumulated by the visitor persist as the only record of activity; no score, timer, counter, progress bar or ending panel exists anywhere in the composition
experience_progression: Open on the bare flat ground patch with nothing built
Structure grows cube by cube as the visitor places blocks, each addition immediately part of the standing world
Removals thin or reshape the structure without resetting it
The accumulated structure stays standing continuously while the vantage point moves around it, so the world reads as increasingly built-up over time with no terminal stage
attention_and_information_flow: The terrain and the growing structure hold primary prominence at all times; controls stay visually subordinate
Prominence shifts moment to moment to whichever face or cube the cursor rests on, because it is the only highlighted element
The highlight communicates the precise target and, in build mode, implies the empty space that will be filled next
Switching to dig mode changes the highlight from a single face to the entire cube, signalling that the unit of action is now a whole block rather than a side
Moving the viewpoint reveals previously hidden sides, interiors and the underside relationship of the structure to the ground patch
Surfaces that cannot be acted on give no highlight, so absence of feedback itself communicates the boundary

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Highlight follows the cursor with no commitment; moving off the world or past the plot edge clears it, and nothing is changed by hovering alone
interaction_model.state_change: That face becomes the current target; any previous target is released
interaction_model.visible_feedback: A crisp outline, clearly separated from the surface it sits on, traces only that one face, following the cursor continuously as it slides across faces and cubes
interaction_model.input: Pointer hover over the world while build mode is active
interaction_model.affected_object: The single cube face directly under the cursor

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Any unwanted placement can be taken straight back out by switching to dig mode and clicking it, keeping every change effectively reversible
interaction_model.state_change: A new cube of the currently chosen material occupies that empty space and becomes part of the standing world
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The block appears immediately in place, with no delay or transition gap, and the highlight re-resolves onto whatever face the cursor now points at
interaction_model.input: Click on a highlighted face in build mode
interaction_model.affected_object: The empty space adjacent to that face

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: A removed block can be put back by switching to build mode and clicking an adjacent remaining face; removal never cascades beyond the single hovered cube
interaction_model.state_change: That cube is cleared from the world, exposing whatever lies behind or below it
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The cube takes on a uniform whole-body tonal shift that sets it apart from its neighbours while hovered, then disappears on the click, revealing the neighbouring surfaces
interaction_model.input: Click on a hovered cube in dig mode
interaction_model.affected_object: The whole hovered cube

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Freely switchable at any time and reversible by choosing another material; does not disturb the existing structure or the vantage point
interaction_model.state_change: The current material becomes the selected one; already-placed blocks are unaffected
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The strip shows which material is currently chosen, and the next placed block appears with that surface appearance
interaction_model.input: Choosing a material in the quiet control strip
interaction_model.affected_object: The material of blocks created by subsequent placements

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Switchable at any moment with no cost, giving an always-available opposite action to undo the previous kind of change
interaction_model.state_change: Targeting unit switches between a single face and a whole cube, and click meaning switches between add and remove
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The hover highlight visibly changes form, from a single-face outline to a whole-cube tonal wash and back
interaction_model.input: Choosing between building and digging in the quiet control strip
interaction_model.affected_object: The meaning of the hover highlight and of a click

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: The bounded plot acts as a hard limit that silently absorbs off-target clicks, so the visitor cannot build into the emptiness or lose the structure
interaction_model.state_change: No state change
interaction_model.visible_feedback: No highlight was shown and nothing appears or disappears; the world stays exactly as it was
interaction_model.input: Clicking on the empty surround or past the outer edge of the plot
interaction_model.affected_object: Nothing

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Every direction has an opposite control that can walk the view back; releasing interrupts motion at once and the reached vantage persists until moved again, with the structure never disturbed by view movement
interaction_model.state_change: The viewpoint moves continuously in that direction for exactly as long as the control is held, then stops
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The world glides smoothly past, revealing new sides, heights and angles of the standing structure; motion stops the moment the hold is released and the view stays exactly where it arrived
interaction_model.input: Holding a viewpoint control for raising, lowering, advancing, retreating, turning or tilting
interaction_model.affected_object: The vantage point on the whole scene

experience_qualities: Playful and toy-like, inviting immediate tinkering
Legible depth and scale from the slightly-elevated angle
Precise and predictable, because the exact target is always outlined before a click
Immediate: every click's result appears without hesitation
Low-stakes and forgiving, since every addition or removal has a direct opposite
Calm and unhurried, with no pressure from scores, timers or endings
Unbounded in creative direction but clearly bounded in space
completion_and_return: No completion, win, loss or ending state exists; the experience continues indefinitely
The built structure persists across all viewpoint movement and mode or material switches
The vantage point persists at whatever position was last reached rather than snapping back to the opening view
Return to a cleaner state happens only through the visitor's own digging, not through an automatic reset
locked_observable_requirements: World is composed of uniform stacked cubes on a compact bounded square ground patch surrounded by featureless emptiness
Default view is from slightly above and angled so depth, height and plot extent are readable at a glance
Hovering in build mode outlines exactly one cube face, the one under the cursor, with the outline clearly readable against that face
A single click in build mode places one block in the empty space on the highlighted side, immediately
Dig mode marks the entire hovered cube with one uniform tonal shift distinct from its neighbours, and a single click clears exactly that cube
Only solid blocks respond to clicks, so new blocks always attach to something already present
Clicks beyond the outer edge of the plot do nothing at all
Viewpoint controls move the view continuously while held and stop and stay at the reached vantage when released, with an opposite direction available for every direction
The structure remains standing and unchanged while the viewpoint moves
No score, timer, ending or progress indicator anywhere; the structure is the only record of progress
Material and viewpoint controls occupy a quiet strip out of the way, never competing with the terrain for attention
adaptable_details: Exact size of the starting ground patch and how many cubes it spans
The specific set of available materials and how their surfaces are differentiated from one another
Which surface theme the ground reads as, and how the surrounding emptiness is treated, whether tonally light, tonally dark or plain, as long as it stays low-distraction
Visual styling of the highlight, such as outline weight, hue, or strength of the whole-cube tonal shift
Placement, shape and styling of the quiet control strip
Speed of viewpoint movement and how the control strip's directional controls are labelled or arranged
Whether additional viewpoint directions are offered beyond the described set
Whether mode and material selection are combined into one strip or split into two quiet groups
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits any bounded, uniformly subdivided three-dimensional scene whose visible units the visitor is meant to add and remove one at a time from a movable elevated vantage, including creative toys, spatial demos and small embedded showcase worlds. It stops being this Skill if the world loses its bounded footprint and becomes an endless terrain, if placement targets stop being individual faces with per-face highlighting, if actions gain goals, scoring, resource limits or an ending, or if the vantage point becomes fixed or snaps between preset angles instead of gliding continuously while held.

name: two_ink_proof_sheet_form_composer
description: A portrait page-proportioned proof surface holding a few volumetric forms printed in two inks that visibly build and cancel where they overlap, with grab handles that appear on one selected form at a time while dragging elsewhere orbits the whole arrangement.

canonical_document.name: two_ink_proof_sheet_form_composer
canonical_document.description: A portrait page-proportioned proof surface holding a few volumetric forms printed in two inks that visibly build and cancel where they overlap, with grab handles that appear on one selected form at a time while dragging elsewhere orbits the whole arrangement.
canonical_document.experience_scope: Whole-view experience occupying a single working surface: it begins the moment the view opens, already showing the last kept arrangement and viewpoint in final ink coloring, and continues as one uninterrupted loop of selecting, handling, orbiting and keeping; it ends only when the arrangement is committed or handed off as separate per-ink outputs. There are no separate pages, modes or scenes.
content_and_composition: One portrait, page-proportioned working surface that frames the entire experience and keeps its page aspect regardless of surrounding window size
A small set (a handful, growable and shrinkable) of simple volumetric forms as the only foreground content, each carrying one of exactly two inks
Overlap regions where the two inks meet, rendered as visibly denser or cancelled color, forming the most information-rich part of the composition
At most one transient handle cluster, spatially attached to the currently selected form and absent whenever nothing is selected
Handles have two interchangeable roles, one for shifting position and one for changing size, only one role active at a time
A small set of persistent peripheral actions (add form, remove selected form, keep current state, hand off per-ink output) kept visually subordinate to the surface

No background scenery or decorative layers: an unmarked, evenly toned substrate ground sits behind the inked forms, held far enough in luminance from both inks that every form and overlap stays legible against it
experience_progression: Open state: the surface appears already composed, already in printed coloring, at the last kept viewpoint, so the outcome is readable before any input
Selection stage: one form becomes the active subject and gains handles, the rest recede to context
Handling stage: the selected form moves or resizes continuously under the dragged handle while the rest of the arrangement and the viewpoint hold still
Judging stage: with no handle engaged, the viewpoint swings around the whole arrangement so overlaps can be read from other angles
Keeping stage: arrangement plus viewpoint are committed as the state that a later visit resumes from
Hand-off stage: the composition is delivered as one output per ink with all handles suppressed, after which the loop continues unchanged
attention_and_information_flow: Ink and overlap density carry primary prominence at all times; controls stay quiet at the edges
Selecting narrows attention to exactly one form: its handles are the only manipulable affordance on screen
Deselecting returns attention to the composition as a whole with no residual highlight
During a handle drag, information is concentrated in the single changing form because the surrounding viewpoint is deliberately frozen
During an orbit, information shifts to relationships between forms as overlaps open, close and recombine
A newly added form announces itself by arriving pre-selected at the surface centre, immediately becoming the focused subject

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Selecting a different form transfers the handles; nothing about the arrangement changes on selection alone
interaction_model.state_change: Form becomes the single selected subject, replacing any previous selection
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Handles appear attached to the clicked form; any handles on a previously selected form disappear
interaction_model.input: Click or tap directly on a form
interaction_model.affected_object: That form and the handle cluster

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Fully reversible by clicking any form again; no geometry is affected
interaction_model.state_change: Selection is cleared
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Handles vanish and the composition returns to an unmarked printed appearance
interaction_model.input: Click or tap empty surface
interaction_model.affected_object: Selection state and handle cluster

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Freely toggled back and forth at any time without touching the form
interaction_model.state_change: Active handle role changes while the same form stays selected
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Handle appearance changes to indicate which kind of change a drag will produce
interaction_model.input: Switch the handle role between shifting and resizing
interaction_model.affected_object: Handle cluster on the selected form

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Releasing ends the drag and re-enables viewpoint swinging; the form simply stops where released, so an unwanted change is corrected by dragging back
interaction_model.state_change: Form position or size updates continuously while the drag is held; viewpoint change is suppressed for the duration
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The form follows the drag in real time and ink overlaps thicken, thin or disappear as it passes other forms; the surrounding view stays perfectly still
interaction_model.input: Drag a handle
interaction_model.affected_object: The selected form only

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Forgiving and continuously reversible by dragging the other way; orbiting can never alter or lose the arrangement, and is blocked only while a handle drag is in progress
interaction_model.state_change: Viewpoint swings around the composition
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Forms shift in parallax and overlap patterns recombine as inks separate and merge, while every form keeps its own position and size
interaction_model.input: Drag anywhere that is not a handle
interaction_model.affected_object: Viewpoint onto the whole arrangement

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Immediately removable via the remove action or draggable out of the centre
interaction_model.state_change: A new form appears at the surface centre and becomes the selected subject
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The new form is drawn in ink like the others, with handles already on it, immediately participating in overlaps
interaction_model.input: Add-form action
interaction_model.affected_object: Set of forms and selection state

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Available only while something is selected; a comparable form can be re-added and repositioned
interaction_model.state_change: That form leaves the arrangement and selection becomes empty
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The form and its handles disappear and the overlaps it contributed to thin back toward single-ink density or vanish
interaction_model.input: Remove action while a form is selected
interaction_model.affected_object: The selected form and its handles

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Repeatable at any time; a later keep replaces the earlier one
interaction_model.state_change: Current composition and angle become the remembered state
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The view is unchanged, confirming that what is on screen is what will return
interaction_model.input: Keep action
interaction_model.affected_object: Arrangement plus current viewpoint

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: The on-screen experience is untouched and editing resumes exactly where it was; the action can be repeated after further changes
interaction_model.state_change: One output is produced per ink from the current arrangement and viewpoint
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Handles and any selection marks are absent from the produced output, which matches the on-screen inking
interaction_model.input: Hand-off action
interaction_model.affected_object: The composition as printable output

experience_qualities: Reads like holding a proof sheet rather than operating a tool
Final printed coloring is truthful and legible before any interaction
Overlaps feel like real ink laying down or cancelling
Handling feels tangible and physical instead of parameter-driven
Calm and deliberate because only one form changes at a time
Forgiving inspection: viewpoint can be swung freely with no risk to the composition
Confidence that what is on screen equals what is handed off
completion_and_return: No terminal end state: the experience loops between handling, judging and keeping
The keep action persists both arrangement and viewpoint as one unit
Reopening resumes from the last kept arrangement and viewpoint, already inked, rather than a default view
Hand-off yields one output per ink and leaves the working surface exactly as it was
Selection is transient state and does not persist as part of the kept arrangement
locked_observable_requirements: Portrait, page-proportioned working surface as the framing of the whole experience
Exactly two inks, each clearly distinguishable from the other and from the substrate, with overlap regions visibly building up or cancelling
Printed coloring is present on first appearance, not applied later as a preview mode
At most one form selected at any moment, with handles spatially attached to it
Handles support two interchangeable roles, shifting and resizing, one active at a time
Clicking empty surface clears both selection and handles
A handle drag changes only its own form and freezes viewpoint movement until release
Dragging outside handles swings the viewpoint and never modifies the arrangement
A newly added form arrives at the surface centre already selected
Handed-off output contains no handles or selection marks and matches the on-screen inking
Kept state includes viewpoint as well as arrangement, and a later visit resumes from it
adaptable_details: Which two ink hues and which substrate tone are used, and the density behavior of the inks in overlap, as long as the two inks stay mutually distinguishable, stay separated from the substrate, and build-and-cancel remains visible
The specific silhouette family of the volumetric forms
How many forms are present and the practical upper count
Handle shapes, sizes and the visual cue distinguishing shift from resize
Placement, wording and iconography of the peripheral actions
Orbit sensitivity, damping and any angle limits
Exact page proportion within a portrait format
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits foreground surfaces where a small number of sculptural forms is the entire message and restricted-ink overprint is the visual identity, such as poster-like composers, art-print showcases and playful arrangement toys. It stays the same skill across different ink pairs, substrate tones, form silhouettes and form counts. It becomes a different skill if the restricted two-ink overprint is replaced by full-color or photographic rendering, if many objects require multi-select, grouping or layout tooling instead of one-at-a-time handling, if the page-proof framing is replaced by an immersive full-bleed or scrolling scene, or if manipulation moves from attached handles to numeric parameter panels.
