canonical_document.name: self_fading_ink_slab_with_trailing_brush
canonical_document.description: A low-distraction, side-lit water-like slab with one brush that glides after the pointer with soft lag, leaning into its travel and trailing wet ink that reads luminous against its surround, bleeds, creeps and fades away to a bare surface.
canonical_document.experience_scope: Whole-view experience: it begins the moment the view opens with an idle brush centred on an otherwise empty slab, occupies the entire surface as the only content, and has no end state — it continually returns to the bare slab and stays available.
content_and_composition: One full-bleed shallow-water surface, low in internal contrast and lit from a single side with a controlled luminance falloff, acting as the ground for everything else
Exactly one brush object that stands in for the pointer, resting at the centre before any input
Ink marks as the only accumulating content, layered above the slab and below nothing else, varying in colour as new ink is laid down
One small persistent text line stating the press-to-thicken behaviour
No panels, controls, labels or other foreground content competing with the marks
experience_progression: Rest: bare slab, brush waiting at centre, nothing drawn
Deposit: pointer movement lays fresh ink that reads as wet and luminous against the ground at the moment of contact
Spread: each mark bleeds outward from where it was laid
Drift: the spread creeps slowly in one consistent direction across the slab
Dim: the mark loses its luminance separation and weight until it disappears

Return to bare slab, immediately available for another pass, so every pass feels finished yet instantly restartable; the cycle loops indefinitely and overlapping passes run their own cycles concurrently
attention_and_information_flow: Before input, attention rests on the single brush because nothing else is present
During movement, prominence transfers to the freshest ink, which carries the strongest luminance separation from the ground
As marks spread, drift and dim, prominence decays with them so the newest gesture always dominates
The small text line stays quietly subordinate and only informs; it never draws attention away from the marks
Because old ink clears itself, the surface never accumulates visual noise and the view always resettles on emptiness plus the brush

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Aim can change at any instant; the brush simply redirects mid-glide with the same easing
interaction_model.state_change: Brush travels toward the aimed position with a soft delay rather than snapping to it, and orients itself into its direction of travel
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Brush glides across the slab leaning into its path, with a wet line issuing from its tip
interaction_model.input: Pointer aimed anywhere on the slab
interaction_model.affected_object: Brush object

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Weight follows speed continuously in both directions, so slowing down thins the line again without any reset
interaction_model.state_change: Line weight scales with travel speed
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Fast sweeps broaden the line; slow drifts narrow it to a hairline
interaction_model.input: Speed of pointer movement
interaction_model.affected_object: Trailing ink line

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Release springs the brush back to a fine point and returns the stroke to its normal weight
interaction_model.state_change: Brush squashes flatter and wider; the stroke it deposits swells accordingly
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Visibly flattened brush painting a thicker mark, with the small text line stating this behaviour
interaction_model.input: Press and hold
interaction_model.affected_object: Brush shape and the ink it lays

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Resuming movement immediately resumes depositing from the brush's current spot
interaction_model.state_change: New ink stops being laid while already-deposited ink continues its own lifecycle
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The trail ends, but the marks already on the slab keep bleeding, creeping and dimming
interaction_model.input: Halting pointer movement
interaction_model.affected_object: Ink emission versus existing marks

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Returning the pointer onto the slab resumes normal lag-following from that parked position
interaction_model.state_change: Brush stops tracking and parks at the last aimed position
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Brush comes to rest inside the surface instead of following off-view or vanishing
interaction_model.input: Pointer straying past the edge of the slab
interaction_model.affected_object: Brush object

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Lifting the finger behaves like halting: deposit stops, existing ink keeps living
interaction_model.state_change: Treated identically to a pointer aim
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Same glide, lean, trail and weight response as pointer movement
interaction_model.input: Dragged finger on a touch surface
interaction_model.affected_object: Brush object and ink

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Self-clearing needs no user action and cannot be halted; new passes can begin at any point during a fade
interaction_model.state_change: Each mark spreads, drifts one way and fades out of existence
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Marks soften and creep, then the slab returns to bare
interaction_model.input: Elapsed time after ink is laid (autonomous driver)
interaction_model.affected_object: Every deposited mark

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: The shift is continuous and needs no control; already-laid ink keeps the colour it was given
interaction_model.state_change: Hue of freshly laid ink keeps shifting
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Later marks read as a different colour than earlier ones while every mark keeps the same readable separation from the ground
interaction_model.input: Successive deposits over time (autonomous driver)
interaction_model.affected_object: Colour of new ink

experience_qualities: Calm, quiet and meditative rather than energetic
Physical and wet: the brush feels weighted and the ink feels like liquid on a shallow surface
Forgiving, because nothing is permanent and nothing can be spoiled
Expressive: speed and press translate directly into visible line character
Uncluttered and single-focus, with a low-distraction side-lit ground and one high-luminance mark stream
completion_and_return: Each stroke completes by fading fully; there is no save, submit or gallery step
The slab self-resets to bare with no clear action offered
Nothing persists between passes; the experience loops indefinitely and is always ready for a fresh pass
The brush persists at its last position as the stable resting state
locked_observable_requirements: Low-internal-contrast, water-like full-surface ground with a controlled luminance falloff from one side
Exactly one brush object standing in for the pointer, idle at the centre before input
Brush follows with a visible soft lag and leans into its direction of travel, never snapping
Ink trails from the brush tip and its weight responds continuously to travel speed
Press flattens and widens the brush and swells its stroke; release springs it back to a fine point
A small text line stating the press behaviour
Deposited ink reads as fresh and luminous against the ground, then bleeds outward, creeps in one consistent direction and dims to nothing so the surface self-clears
New ink keeps shifting colour over successive deposits
Halting stops deposit while existing marks keep evolving
Leaving the surface parks the brush at its last aimed spot instead of losing it
Touch dragging behaves the same as pointing
No other foreground content or controls compete with the marks
adaptable_details: Exact hue sequence and saturation of the shifting ink, and whether the ink sits lighter or darker than the ground
Which side the light comes from, how strong the falloff is, and the overall lightness level of the ground
How long spread, drift and fade take
Which direction the ink creeps
Silhouette and size of the brush object
Amount of follow lag and springiness on release
Wording and placement of the small hint line
Exact minimum and maximum line weights
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits sparse, low-density views whose purpose is calm free play or mood — full-view intro toys, idle or empty states, and single-purpose interactive panels where the visitor's own gesture is the only content. It does not fit views that must keep readable text, imagery or controls legible above the surface, since the oversized brush and luminous marks would compete with them. Making the marks persist as a keepable artwork, adding tools, colour pickers, undo or export, or requiring precise placement without follow lag would each produce a different skill — a drawing tool rather than a self-clearing ink toy.

name: pivot_marked_photo_sprouting_loop
description: A still photograph in a steady preview appears to sprout and unfurl as it is repeatedly stepped around a pivot point the visitor marks directly on the image; the marker fades while it plays and the original orientation returns when stopped.

canonical_document.name: pivot_marked_photo_sprouting_loop
canonical_document.description: A still photograph in a steady preview appears to sprout and unfurl as it is repeatedly stepped around a pivot point the visitor marks directly on the image; the marker fades while it plays and the original orientation returns when stopped.
canonical_document.experience_scope: Region experience occupying one main preview area plus its adjacent explanation, sample strip and small control set; begins when a subject image is present (a prepared example is already loaded on arrival) and ends when playback is stopped or the finished loop is exported. The preview never leaves the same view.
content_and_composition: One steady preview stage holding exactly one still photographic subject at a time, always the visual center of the layout
A short opening explanation of the spacing/step rhythm that makes the effect readable, placed before or beside the preview as persistent context
One pre-loaded example subject so the preview is never blank on arrival
A curated set of selectable sample photographs presented as a compact browsable group for quick trial before committing a personal image
A single visible pivot marker overlaid on the photograph, shown only while playback is stopped
A small control cluster: play/stop, a typed step-angle value with a one-tap return to its natural default, a view magnifier, and one export action
A progress indication that appears only while the finished loop is being written out
experience_progression: Arrive with the principle explained and an example subject already animatable
Browse curated samples or supply a personal image by drop, paste or file pick; the preview swaps immediately
With playback stopped, place the pivot marker on the photograph, refining by slow drag, single-pixel key nudges and magnified inspection
Start playback and watch the still image step around that point into a sprouting, unfurling loop while the marker fades away
Stop to return to the original untouched orientation with the marker visible, adjust pivot or step angle, and replay
Export the finished loop as a keepable clip or frame sequence and remain in the same view to try again
attention_and_information_flow: Explanation leads first, then hands attention permanently to the single preview
Sample browsing is deliberately quick and secondary so it never competes with the preview
While stopped, the pivot marker is the most salient overlay because placement is the decision being made
During playback the marker recedes and the unfurling motion alone carries attention, making the marker-to-result relationship legible by contrast between the two states
Controls stay quiet and peripheral; only export progress temporarily claims attention

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Another sample or file can be supplied at any time; switching subjects is always available and never blocks the rest of the experience
interaction_model.state_change: Current subject is replaced immediately by the new one
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The preview shows the new photograph at once, ready to be marked and played
interaction_model.input: Selecting a curated sample, or dropping, pasting or picking a file
interaction_model.affected_object: The subject photograph in the preview

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: A fast flick is interpreted as browsing and leaves the marker untouched; any later click re-places it
interaction_model.state_change: Marker relocates to the clicked point
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The marker appears at the chosen point on the image
interaction_model.input: Clicking a spot on the photograph while playback is stopped
interaction_model.affected_object: The pivot marker

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Positions taken outside the picture are pulled back inside its bounds, so the marker can never be lost off-image
interaction_model.state_change: Continuous fine repositioning
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Marker tracks the pointer smoothly
interaction_model.input: Slow drag on or near the marker
interaction_model.affected_object: The pivot marker position

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Opposite-direction nudges reverse the change; edge clamping still applies
interaction_model.state_change: Single-pixel steps in the pressed direction
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Marker shifts by the smallest visible amount
interaction_model.input: Directional key nudges
interaction_model.affected_object: The pivot marker position

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Returning to full view keeps the placed marker unchanged
interaction_model.state_change: Image region is enlarged for inspection
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Enlarged photograph with the marker still visible in place, making pixel-level placement judgeable
interaction_model.input: Magnifying the view
interaction_model.affected_object: Preview stage and marker overlay

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Stopping ends the motion, restores the photograph's original orientation exactly and brings the marker back for further adjustment
interaction_model.state_change: Image begins stepping repeatedly around the marked point; marker enters its hidden state
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The static subject appears to sprout and unfurl in continuous looping motion while the marker fades out
interaction_model.input: Starting playback
interaction_model.affected_object: The still photograph and the marker

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: One tap returns the value to its natural default rhythm
interaction_model.state_change: Rhythm and density of the growth pattern change
interaction_model.visible_feedback: A visibly different unfurl spacing on the next playback
interaction_model.input: Typing a step angle value
interaction_model.affected_object: The stepping increment that drives the unfurling

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: The view and current subject, marker and angle remain intact afterwards so another attempt can follow immediately
interaction_model.state_change: Loop is written out as an animated file or a frame sequence
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Progress is reported while writing, ending in a keepable result
interaction_model.input: Triggering the single export action
interaction_model.affected_object: The finished animated loop

experience_qualities: Playful and immediately learnable: one marked point visibly explains the whole result
Steady and focused rather than busy; a single stage, no layout churn
Precise on demand, with coarse placement and fine placement in the same gesture vocabulary
Forgiving: accidental fast gestures and out-of-bounds placements do not damage the setup
Organic, growing motion rather than mechanical spinning, ending in something worth keeping
completion_and_return: Playback loops continuously until stopped rather than ending on its own
Stopping is a true return: original orientation and visible marker are restored
Step angle has a one-tap return to its natural default
Export completes with a saved clip or frame sequence while the workspace state persists for repeat attempts
A prepared example subject means the experience always has a non-blank resting state
locked_observable_requirements: Exactly one still photographic subject animated in one steady preview at a time
A visible pivot marker placed by the user directly on the image, shown only while stopped
Playback is repeated incremental stepping of the whole image around that marked point, producing a sprouting/unfurling growth illusion
Marker fades away during playback and reappears when stopped
Stopping restores the untouched original orientation
Coarse click placement plus slow-drag, single-pixel-nudge and magnified refinement for the same marker
Fast flick gestures are ignored for placement; out-of-image positions are clamped back inside
A numeric step angle with a one-tap return to its natural default
One action produces a finished exportable loop with visible progress reporting
An opening explanation of the spacing rhythm and a pre-loaded example so nothing starts blank
adaptable_details: Marker shape, size and color, and how it fades
Layout position of explanation, sample group and controls around the preview
Number and subject matter of curated samples
Default step angle value and playback speed
Magnification levels and how zoom is invoked
Export formats offered and how progress is presented
Visual styling, typography and playful tone treatment
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits any single still photograph whose subject has a meaningful origin point from which apparent growth can radiate, in showcase, teaching or light creative-tool contexts where the image is the foreground. It remains the same Skill across different subject matter, styling and export formats. It becomes a different Skill if the motion is driven by a timeline of authored keyframes rather than repeated stepping around one user-marked point, if multiple images are composed or sequenced together, if the subject becomes a three-dimensional or generated scene rather than a supplied photograph, or if the pivot is fixed by the page instead of placed and refined by the visitor.

name: coiled_paper_relief_generator
description: A screen-filling field of nested paper-strip coils on a backing sheet, side-lit with soft shadows, that reads as a flat pattern head-on and as standing thin walls when swung to an angle, re-rolled or retuned at will and settling from rough to gallery-crisp after each change.

canonical_document.name: coiled_paper_relief_generator
canonical_document.description: A screen-filling field of nested paper-strip coils on a backing sheet, side-lit with soft shadows, that reads as a flat pattern head-on and as standing thin walls when swung to an angle, re-rolled or retuned at will and settling from rough to gallery-crisp after each change.
canonical_document.experience_scope: Whole-view experience: it occupies the entire viewport from first arrival with an already-finished piece, has no entry sequence, and persists as the only subject for the whole visit; it ends only when the visitor leaves, and resumes the same piece on a later visit.
content_and_composition: One primary subject: a dense field of many nested strip coils tiling the visible area edge to edge, with no empty framing margin
A continuous backing sheet behind and beneath all coils, acting as the ground plane and the lower limit of the viewable space
Each coil is a thin strip standing on edge off the backing sheet, so the field is a shallow relief rather than a flat drawing
A single dominant light from one side, producing consistent shading on strip walls and soft cast shadows into the gaps between coils

A multi-tone strip set of no fixed hues, distributed across the field with enough separation between neighbouring coils and against the backing sheet that the head-on read is a patterned surface rather than one undifferentiated sheet
A small, quiet set of persistent controls for generation values, strip and backing tone values, re-roll, step-back/step-forward, reset and save, kept subordinate to the artwork
No text, caption or explanatory content competing with the piece
experience_progression: Arrival: the finished piece is already there, dense and composed, with no build-up or placeholder stage
On every new variation or value change: the piece appears briefly coarse and unresolved in place
Immediately after: it quietly settles into a crisp, clean, still final state and stays still
Angle-driven progression: attention moves from overall flat pattern (face-on) to material depth and strip thickness (off-angle) and back, driven entirely by the visitor
No autonomous animation or drift once the piece has settled and the pointer has stopped
attention_and_information_flow: First read is the whole-field pattern: the rhythm of distinguishable strips and coil density dominate
Turning the view shifts prominence from pattern to material: strip height, wall thinness, shadow depth and the backing sheet become the new information
Closing in shifts prominence from the field to the individual coil and its edges; pulling back restores the whole-field read
Each change is announced only by the brief rough state and then the crisp settle, so attention returns to the artwork rather than to controls
Controls stay visually recessive, low in contrast against the piece, and never take the foreground from it

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Motion follows the pointer one-to-one and stops dead when the pointer stops, with no inertial drift; tilt is clamped before the view can pass beneath the backing sheet, so the underside is never seen; dragging back returns to any earlier angle
interaction_model.state_change: Viewing angle swings around the piece, continuously between face-on and low grazing angles
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Coils turn from flat pattern into standing thin walls; shading and cast shadows lengthen and shift with the new angle
interaction_model.input: Drag across the artwork
interaction_model.affected_object: Viewpoint on the coil field

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Movement is bounded at both near and far limits so the piece never leaves the frame or clips through itself; reversing the gesture immediately reverses the distance
interaction_model.state_change: View pulls closer to individual coils or further back toward the whole field
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Strip edges, thickness and shadow detail resolve when close; pattern rhythm and field density reassert when far
interaction_model.input: Wheel or pinch
interaction_model.affected_object: Viewing distance to the field

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Each edit is a discrete step that can be walked backwards and forwards one at a time
interaction_model.state_change: Piece rebuilds in place at the current viewpoint
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Field appears rough for an instant, then settles crisp; the view angle and distance are unchanged so the change itself is legible
interaction_model.input: Editing a generation value (density, coil size, layout and similar)
interaction_model.affected_object: The coil field structure

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Reversible one step at a time through the same step-back/step-forward control
interaction_model.state_change: Piece re-tones in place without changing its structure
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The visitor-set tones swap across the existing coils immediately, keeping neighbouring strips distinguishable, while shading and shadows stay consistent with the same side light
interaction_model.input: Editing a strip or backing tone value
interaction_model.affected_object: Strip and backing-sheet tone values

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Step-back returns to the previous variation; reset returns to the starting defaults
interaction_model.state_change: An entirely new variation replaces the current one
interaction_model.visible_feedback: A different coil field arrives rough for an instant and settles crisp, from the same viewpoint
interaction_model.input: One re-roll action
interaction_model.affected_object: The whole piece

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Reachable at any time from any state
interaction_model.state_change: Everything returns to the starting defaults
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The default piece re-forms in place with the same brief rough-to-crisp settle
interaction_model.input: Reset action
interaction_model.affected_object: All generation and tone values and the piece

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Non-destructive; can be repeated after any further change
interaction_model.state_change: The visible framing is captured as an image file
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The artwork is unchanged on screen; the saved image matches the current angle, distance and crisp settled state
interaction_model.input: Save action
interaction_model.affected_object: The current view of the piece

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Reset provides the way back to defaults
interaction_model.state_change: The last piece is restored instead of a fresh start
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The same coil field and the same tone values appear already finished on arrival
interaction_model.input: Returning in a later visit
interaction_model.affected_object: The whole piece and its values

experience_qualities: Handmade and craft-like rather than digital or geometric-clean
Tactile: paper thinness, standing edges and soft occlusion shadows
Dense and immersive, with no visual breathing room outside the piece
Calm and still: no ambient motion, everything at rest until the visitor acts
Immediate and direct: every control change is visible in the piece at once
Gallery-finished: each settled state looks like a deliberate final image worth keeping
completion_and_return: Each change completes in a stable, crisp still state that persists indefinitely
No looping or autoplay; the experience rests between interactions
Recent edits form an ordered history that can be stepped backwards and forwards one at a time
Reset returns the whole experience to its starting defaults
The current state persists across visits and is restored on return
The visitor's takeaway is an exported image of the current view
locked_observable_requirements: Opens directly onto an already-finished, screen-filling piece with no build-up or empty state
Dense field of nested strip coils standing on edge off a continuous backing sheet
Single-side dominant light producing consistent wall shading and soft shadows in the gaps
Face-on view reads as a flat pattern of distinguishable strips; off-angle views reveal strip thickness and standing walls
Drag orbits, wheel/pinch changes distance, with tilt clamped above the backing sheet so the underside is never visible
No drift or inertial continuation after the pointer stops
Every structural or tone change happens in place at the current viewpoint, passing briefly through a rough state before settling crisp
One action produces an entirely new variation
Settled state is a still, clean image with no residual animation
The current view can be saved as an image matching what is on screen
adaptable_details: Exact strip material read (paper, ribbon, felt, thin metal) as long as it stays thin-walled and craft-like
Hue family, tone count and distribution scheme for the strips and the backing sheet, including whether the set is many-hued, few-hued or purely light-to-dark
Coil shapes and how tightly they nest
Field density and coil scale ranges
Light direction and shadow softness
Control layout, styling and placement, and which generation values are exposed
How long the rough stage lasts before settling
Depth of the edit history
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits any subject that can be expressed as a dense repeated field of thin standing units on a ground plane, where the appeal is a flat-reading pattern that turns out to have real material depth, and where visitors are meant to tune, re-roll and keep results. It stays the same Skill across different strip materials, tone sets and hue families, coil geometries and control sets. It becomes a different Skill if the subject becomes a single hero object instead of an edge-to-edge field, if the relief flattens into genuinely two-dimensional artwork with no angle-dependent depth reveal, if free camera movement allows viewing beneath the backing sheet, if the piece animates continuously instead of settling into a still, or if the field is replaced by data-driven or narrative content that must be read rather than looked at.

name: self_growing_thread_field_print
description: On a plain, uniform empty surface, faint threads emerge on their own and slowly thicken and braid into dense swirling forms held in one coherent color mood, settling into something that reads as a finished print; a small corner control instantly clears it and starts a completely different piece.

canonical_document.name: self_growing_thread_field_print
canonical_document.description: On a plain, uniform empty surface, faint threads emerge on their own and slowly thicken and braid into dense swirling forms held in one coherent color mood, settling into something that reads as a finished print; a small corner control instantly clears it and starts a completely different piece.
canonical_document.experience_scope: Whole-view experience: it begins the moment the view opens on an empty uniform surface, occupies the full drawing area for as long as the view is shown, and ends only when the visitor leaves or restarts it. The single small control is the only foreground element layered over it.
content_and_composition: One full-area empty surface acting as the paper the image accumulates on, uniform in tone and separated enough in luminance from the marks that even the faintest thread is readable
Many thin flowing threads as the sole image content, growing and overlapping until they form dense swirling masses
A single unified color mood shared by every thread within one run — any hue family can supply it — so the whole image reads as one intentional composition rather than scattered noise
One small persistent control anchored in a bottom corner, visually minor and always on top of the artwork
No headings, captions, panels, progress indicators or other foreground content competing with the image
experience_progression: Opens on the empty uniform surface with nothing drawn
Threads appear unprompted, faint and sparse
Threads gradually thicken, lengthen and accumulate, weaving and braiding across the surface
Density builds into swirling forms with visible structure and depth of overlap
The composition reaches a settled, finished-print appearance and stops feeling like it is still becoming
A restart returns immediately to the empty surface and repeats the growth with a different color mood and a different arrangement of flow
attention_and_information_flow: Attention starts on emptiness, so the first faint marks are what pull the eye
Prominence shifts from individual visible threads to the overall woven composition as density increases
The corner control stays quietly available without ever claiming attention from the artwork
No numeric, textual or staged status information is revealed; the state of the piece is legible only from how much has accumulated

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Advances on its own without user input and needs no start action; it can be cut off at any instant by the restart control
interaction_model.state_change: From blank, to faint sparse threads, to thickened braided dense forms, to a settled finished composition
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Continuous slow growth and thickening of threads accumulating into swirling forms; earlier marks remain visible as the image builds on top of itself
interaction_model.input: Time passing after the view opens or after a restart (autonomous driver)
interaction_model.affected_object: The thread field on the empty surface

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Remains pressable at any moment including mid-growth; no confirmation, no disabled or waiting state, no loading step between attempts; repeated presses each start over immediately. The discarded image is not recoverable, which is part of the experience.
interaction_model.state_change: Whatever is in progress or finished is discarded at once and a fresh run begins from blank with a different color mood and a different flow arrangement
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The surface snaps back to its empty uniform state with no transition or waiting step, then new faint threads begin appearing again
interaction_model.input: Pressing the small always-visible corner control
interaction_model.affected_object: The entire accumulated image and the color mood of the run

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Resizing is never treated as a restart and never blocks the corner control
interaction_model.state_change: The drawing area refits to the new dimensions
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The artwork continues to grow without interruption in the resized area; the flow already in motion keeps running rather than resetting to blank
interaction_model.input: Resizing the viewport
interaction_model.affected_object: The drawing area occupied by the artwork

experience_qualities: Calm and unhurried, with growth slow enough to watch rather than glance at
Intentional and print-like rather than noisy, thanks to the single per-run color mood
Organic and woven, with threads braiding rather than drawing discrete shapes
Effortless and immediate to retry, with the possibility of a new piece always obvious
Sparse and gallery-like, with the surface and image doing nearly all the work
completion_and_return: A run completes by settling into a finished-print appearance and holding there instead of looping or dissolving
Restart is the only reset, and it always returns to the same empty uniform starting surface
Each restart yields a visibly different piece in color mood and flow arrangement, so no state carries over between runs
Nothing about a previous run persists or is retrievable
locked_observable_requirements: Starts from a genuinely empty, uniform surface every time, with enough luminance separation from the marks that the faintest thread is readable
The image appears by itself with no user action required to begin
Threads begin faint and visibly thicken and braid into dense swirling forms over time
All marks in a single run share one coherent color mood, whichever hue family that run uses
Accumulated marks persist within a run so the composition builds rather than animating and clearing
Growth is slow enough to read as calm and watchable
The run ends in a settled state that looks like a finished composition
Exactly one small, always-visible control in a bottom corner triggers a full restart
Restart is instantaneous and interrupts work in progress, with no confirmation, disabling or loading step
Each restart differs in both color mood and flow arrangement
Resizing refits the drawing area while the running growth continues uninterrupted
adaptable_details: Which corner holds the control and its exact styling or label
Which hue family or palette supplies the shared mood, and how that mood is chosen per run
Exact thread count, thickness range, curvature and swirl scale
Total time to reach the settled composition
The exact luminance and tone of the blank surface, as long as the marks keep readable separation from it
How densely the final image fills the surface
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits views where an abstract, content-free image is itself the point and foreground copy is absent or minimal, so slow accumulation and a full clear-and-regrow are acceptable. It stops being this Skill if the marks encode supplied data or meaning, if the piece must sit behind readable foreground content, if the visitor steers the drawing beyond restarting it, if multiple color moods coexist in one run, or if the image loops or continuously erases itself instead of settling into a finished print.

name: grainy_pencil_sketch_sheet
description: An empty, evenly toned sheet filling the view, its tone held well clear of the mark tone, marked with soft grainy pencil lines that build in passes and taper as the stroke lifts, while a tilting pencil with a soft shadow follows the pointer and settles onto the paper whenever a mark is being made.

canonical_document.name: grainy_pencil_sketch_sheet
canonical_document.description: An empty, evenly toned sheet filling the view, its tone held well clear of the mark tone, marked with soft grainy pencil lines that build in passes and taper as the stroke lifts, while a tilting pencil with a soft shadow follows the pointer and settles onto the paper whenever a mark is being made.
canonical_document.experience_scope: Whole-view experience: it begins the moment the view opens onto the blank sheet with no onboarding, occupies the entire visible surface for the whole session, and ends when the visitor keeps the drawing as an image or wipes the sheet back to blank.
content_and_composition: One evenly toned paper surface filling the view, separated far enough in luminance from the mark tone for strokes to read instantly, acting as both backdrop and drawing substrate
Accumulated strokes as the only growing content, layered onto the paper in the order they were drawn
One pencil implement drawn above the paper layer, anchored to the pointer position wherever it travels
A soft shadow tied to the pencil, sitting between pencil and paper
A small set of selectable mark-colour dots as the only visible palette
Two minimal end controls: wipe-to-blank and hand-back-as-image
No panels, titles, toolbars or instructional copy; almost nothing else in view
experience_progression: Opens as an untouched sheet with the resting pencil as the single cue that the surface is meant to be marked
Each stroke builds gradually in grainy passes rather than appearing complete at once
The sheet accumulates marks across the session and grows denser without any interface growing with it
Closes lightly in one of two ways — leaving with the finished sheet as an image, or wiping back to a clean blank sheet — both returning to the same bare surface
attention_and_information_flow: Prominence stays on the mark currently being laid down; no surrounding element competes for attention
The pencil's position, lean and pace continuously communicate where and how fast the hand is moving
Floating versus settled pencil, and the tightness of its shadow, is the only indicator of whether marking is currently active
Mark-colour selection is the only piece of state revealed beyond the marks themselves; nothing must be read or learned first

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Releasing ends the stroke; strokes are cumulative and the surface stays drawable indefinitely; the wipe control is the only reset; dragging never scrolls, pans or rubber-bands the page on either pointer or touch
interaction_model.state_change: A new stroke begins at the press point, grows along the drag path, and closes on release
interaction_model.visible_feedback: A soft grainy pencil line laid down in gradual passes: fine where the stroke starts, thickening as it gets under way, tapering off as the pencil lifts
interaction_model.input: Press and drag anywhere on the sheet, with mouse or finger
interaction_model.affected_object: The paper surface and the stroke being drawn on it

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Lean eases back upright on its own once movement stops; the pencil simply comes to rest as the standing cue when the visitor stops moving or leaves the surface
interaction_model.state_change: Pencil follows the pointer in an idle, lifted state and takes on a lean matching direction and pace of travel
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Pencil floats just clear of the paper with a looser offset shadow, leaning into the direction of movement and leaning further with faster movement
interaction_model.input: Pointer movement while not pressing
interaction_model.affected_object: The pencil implement and its shadow

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: The settle and lift are automatic and reversible with every press and release; interrupting a stroke mid-motion simply returns the pencil to its floating rest state
interaction_model.state_change: Pencil transitions between floating above the paper and settled onto it
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Pencil descends onto the sheet as marking starts, its shadow tightening beneath it, and lifts back clear when the mark ends
interaction_model.input: Press begins / press releases
interaction_model.affected_object: The pencil implement and its shadow

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Freely reversible at any moment by choosing another dot; no mode to exit and no effect on work already on the sheet
interaction_model.state_change: Active drawing colour changes for everything drawn afterwards
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The chosen dot reads as the active one through a clearly salient selected state; existing marks stay exactly as they were and new strokes appear in the newly chosen colour
interaction_model.input: Choosing one of the small mark-colour dots
interaction_model.affected_object: The colour of subsequent marks

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Available at any moment with nothing to confirm or learn; wiped marks are gone, and drawing can start again immediately on the blank sheet
interaction_model.state_change: All marks are removed and the surface returns to its initial blank state
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The sheet becomes clean bare paper again, back to the opening view with the pencil resting on it
interaction_model.input: Activating the wipe control
interaction_model.affected_object: The whole sheet

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Non-destructive: the drawing remains on screen and fully drawable afterwards, and can be handed back again or wiped
interaction_model.state_change: The current sheet is handed back to the visitor as an image to keep
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The sheet itself stays untouched and visible while the drawing is handed over
interaction_model.input: Activating the keep-as-image control
interaction_model.affected_object: The finished drawing

experience_qualities: Immediately legible as a surface meant to be marked, with nothing to learn first
Material and analog: bare paper, grainy pencil medium, marks that gain density through repeated passes rather than snapping into place
Tactile and hand-like, because the implement visibly leans, settles and lifts with the movement
Quiet and uncluttered, with interface presence kept near zero
Unhurried, gradual stroke build-up instead of instant flat lines
Equally direct with a finger or a mouse
completion_and_return: Two equally light exits: leave with the finished sheet as an image, or leave with a clean blank one
Wiping returns the view to its exact opening state, ready to be drawn on again
Handing back the image is repeatable and leaves the drawing intact
No mandatory saving, session history or persistent state is implied; the sheet is simply a surface that can be marked, kept or cleared
locked_observable_requirements: An evenly toned bare paper surface fills the view with almost nothing else visible on open, holding enough luminance separation from the mark tone for strokes to read at a glance
Marks read as soft grainy pencil medium built up in gradual passes, not as flat uniform lines
Every stroke shows the same width profile: fine at the start, thicker as it gets under way, tapering off at lift
A pencil implement stays under the pointer wherever it travels, with a soft shadow following it
The pencil floats clear of the paper when idle and settles onto it while a mark is being made
The pencil leans into the direction and pace of movement and eases back upright once movement stops
Mark-colour choice changes only marks drawn afterwards, never marks already on the sheet
Wipe-to-blank and hand-back-as-image are both reachable at any moment without instruction
Press-and-drag works identically for mouse and touch and never scrolls or rubber-bands the page
adaptable_details: Exact surface tone, its warmth or coolness, and the grain texture
Silhouette and styling of the depicted implement
Number, hue and arrangement of the mark-colour dots
Placement and iconography of the wipe and keep controls
Format of the handed-back image
Grain density, thickness range, taper length and shadow softness
Magnitude of the lean and the easing timings of settle, lift and return-to-upright
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits near-empty single-purpose surfaces whose foreground content is the visitor's own marks — doodle and sketch pages, signature or annotation panels, playful invite-a-mark moments — and transfers to other physical implements such as chalk, brush or marker, and to any surface tone as long as the mark stays clearly separated from it, so that the material grain, the pressure-like width profile and the implement that follows and settles all survive. It becomes a different Skill if the surface gains substantial tooling around it (layer lists, history panels, tool palettes beyond a few dots), if marks become precise uniform lines with no depicted implement, or if the drawing sits on top of existing page content or imagery rather than on a blank sheet that is itself the whole view.

name: wet_impasto_paint_canvas
description: One large evenly lit blank sheet, its surface luminance set clearly apart from the pigment it will hold, where a splaying bristle tip tracks the pointer and pressed drags lay down thick wet pigment that smears, swirls into whatever it crosses, catches light along ridges and thin patches, then slowly comes to rest after the gesture ends.

canonical_document.name: wet_impasto_paint_canvas
canonical_document.description: One large evenly lit blank sheet, its surface luminance set clearly apart from the pigment it will hold, where a splaying bristle tip tracks the pointer and pressed drags lay down thick wet pigment that smears, swirls into whatever it crosses, catches light along ridges and thin patches, then slowly comes to rest after the gesture ends.
canonical_document.experience_scope: Whole-view experience that begins the moment the sheet appears blank and continues indefinitely as an open-ended work surface; the painted result persists and the experience only resets on an explicit clear.
content_and_composition: One dominant sheet occupying most of the view, presented blank and evenly lit at entry, its surface luminance clearly separated from the pigment it will carry
Accumulated paint layer on the sheet: the single piece of persistent user-authored content, built from overlapping strokes with visible thickness variation
A tool-tip indicator drawn above the sheet that mirrors the pointer position and the current tip size, showing a fanned cluster of bristles rather than a plain cursor

One compact tool cluster tucked into a corner, deliberately small relative to the sheet: a colour ring with an inner square for shade selection, an opacity bar, step-back and step-forward controls, and a clear control
Layer order is fixed: sheet behind, wet paint on the sheet, tip indicator floating above, tool cluster pinned above everything at the edge
experience_progression: Entry: empty, evenly lit sheet with the tool cluster already in reach, nothing modal or introductory between the visitor and the surface
Hover: tip indicator tracks the pointer and previews size and reach while the sheet stays untouched
Press and drag: pigment is deposited only under the pressed bristles, the tip splays and trails behind the direction of travel, and paint smears and swirls into whatever it crosses
Release: deposition stops but the freshly laid paint keeps settling for a short moment before coming to rest
Accumulation: successive strokes build a thickening, cross-mixed surface that simply stays there for the rest of the session
attention_and_information_flow: Attention is on the sheet at all times; the tool cluster stays visually quiet and small so the invitation to start is immediate
The tip indicator carries all pre-commitment information: how large the mark will be and how far it reaches, before any pigment exists
During a drag, attention follows the moving tip and the wet edge trailing it; the settling moment after release briefly holds attention on the last stroke
Freshly laid, still-wet paint reads as the most active area; older paint recedes into the built-up surface
Colour and opacity choices are confirmed by the next stroke rather than by any separate readout

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Purely previewing; moving away leaves the sheet exactly as it was, and the indicator disappears or idles when the pointer leaves the sheet
interaction_model.state_change: Indicator position and splay follow the pointer; sheet content unchanged
interaction_model.visible_feedback: A fanned bristle tip tracking the pointer at the current size, previewing reach with no pigment committed
interaction_model.input: Pointer movement across the sheet without pressing
interaction_model.affected_object: Tool-tip indicator

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Lifting the press ends deposition; the stroke is a single reversible unit via step-back, so committing never feels costly
interaction_model.state_change: Continuous deposition along the gesture path where bristles press down; crossed paint is displaced and blended
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Loaded-bristle marks with ridges and thin patches catching light, the tip splaying and trailing behind the drag, wet paint smearing along the direction of travel and swirling colours together where strokes cross
interaction_model.input: Press and drag on the sheet
interaction_model.affected_object: Accumulated paint layer

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Starting a new press during settling is accepted and simply continues painting; the settled result is what remains
interaction_model.state_change: Deposition stops and the wet paint transitions from moving to at-rest over a brief settling moment
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The just-painted area keeps subtly shifting and levelling for a moment, then holds still as part of the surface
interaction_model.input: Release of the press
interaction_model.affected_object: Most recently deposited paint

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Reversible by scrolling the other way; bounded to a usable minimum and maximum tip size; already-painted marks are unaffected
interaction_model.state_change: Tip size grows or shrinks immediately
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The fanned tip visibly resizes at once under the pointer, previewing the new reach before the next stroke
interaction_model.input: Scroll over the sheet
interaction_model.affected_object: Tool-tip indicator and subsequent stroke width

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Freely re-draggable at any time; changing paint never alters strokes already on the sheet
interaction_model.state_change: Hue, shade, or opacity updates continuously during the drag
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The selection point on the ring, square or bar moves with the drag and the loaded colour updates immediately, so the very next stroke lays down the new paint
interaction_model.input: Drag on the colour ring, its inner square, or the opacity bar
interaction_model.affected_object: Loaded paint for following strokes

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Bounded by the retained recent history; stepping back and then painting again continues from that state
interaction_model.state_change: Sheet walks backward and forward through its recent states
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Recent strokes disappear and reappear on the sheet as whole marks
interaction_model.input: Step-back and step-forward controls
interaction_model.affected_object: Accumulated paint layer

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: A deliberate reset that is itself a recent state, so it can be stepped back out of
interaction_model.state_change: All paint is removed and the sheet returns to its opening blank, evenly lit state
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The sheet becomes empty again while the tool cluster and current loaded paint stay as they were
interaction_model.input: Clear control
interaction_model.affected_object: Whole sheet

experience_qualities: Physical and material: the sheet reads as a painted surface with body and light response, not flat fill
Wet and alive: paint continues to move briefly after the hand stops
Immediate and unceremonious: paintable on first sight with no setup
Low-stakes: every mark is cheap to undo or wipe away
Uncluttered: a small edge tool cluster against a dominant work area
completion_and_return: No completion state; the picture that builds up simply stays there as an open-ended surface
Loaded colour, shade, opacity and tip size persist across strokes until changed
Step-back and step-forward provide partial return through recent states
Clear is the only full return to the opening blank sheet
locked_observable_requirements: One large, evenly lit sheet dominating the view, its blank surface holding enough luminance separation from the pigment for marks to read clearly, with a compact tool cluster confined to a corner
A fanned bristle tip indicator that tracks the pointer and previews size and reach before anything is committed
Pigment deposited only under the pressed bristles, along the gesture path
Visible loaded-bristle character: ridges and thin patches that catch light so the surface looks physical
Colours mixing and swirling where strokes cross rather than simply overwriting
Smearing that trails behind the direction of the drag, with the tip splaying as it moves
A brief settling of paint after the press is released, then rest
Immediate tip resizing from scroll, and immediate paint reload from dragging the colour ring, inner square or opacity bar
Painted result persists until stepped back or explicitly cleared
adaptable_details: Sheet proportions, framing, and the surface's own luminance and cast, including whether it sits lighter or darker than its surround, so long as marks stay legible on it
Which corner holds the tool cluster and the arrangement of ring, square and bar within it
Exact settling duration and how pronounced the ridge lighting is
Tip size range and how many recent states are retained
Visual styling of the tip indicator so long as it reads as fanned bristles
How aggressively crossed colours blend versus layer
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits any page whose foreground is one open mark-making work area with edge-mounted tools and a persistent user-made result, whatever luminance range that page works in. Substituting a material that does not carry body, wetness or cross-stroke mixing — flat lines, vector shapes, hard-edged fills — or replacing the free continuous gesture with placement of discrete elements, constrained shape tools or a guided template, produces a different Skill. Reducing the surface to a small inset widget beside dominant page content, or removing the pre-commitment bristle preview and the post-release settling, also breaks its identity.

name: color_drain_into_filling_swatch_row
description: A large full-color photo on a visually quiet stage with an empty row of color wells beneath it; one press drains the photo to colorless while the wells fill one by one with colors and their hex-style values, and pressing again unwinds it back to the untouched photo.

canonical_document.name: color_drain_into_filling_swatch_row
canonical_document.description: A large full-color photo on a visually quiet stage with an empty row of color wells beneath it; one press drains the photo to colorless while the wells fill one by one with colors and their hex-style values, and pressing again unwinds it back to the untouched photo.
canonical_document.experience_scope: A self-contained region centered on one dominant image with its swatch row and controls; begins on arrival with the untouched full-color image and empty wells, and ends either back at that untouched state or with a complete settled palette. Can occupy a whole view or a bounded showcase block.
content_and_composition: One large featured image as the visual anchor, shown in full color against a low-chroma, low-distraction surround that holds enough separation from it for both the image and the swatches to read as lit objects
A single short horizontal row of a small fixed number of color wells directly beneath the image, present at all times
Each well has two states in the same slot: an empty placeholder appearance and a filled appearance showing the extracted color plus its readable value label
One sampling control that acts as the palette toggle
Two side stepping controls, one for previous and one for next image
Persistent elements: the image frame position, the well row and its slot count, and all three controls remain fixed and visible through every state
experience_progression: Resting state: image in full color, every well empty, purpose readable without instruction
On sampling: the image loses its color while the wells begin filling, so color reads as leaving the picture and being caught below
Staggered fill: wells resolve one after another in order, each replacing its placeholder with a color and its value
Settled state: all wells filled and legible, image colorless
On sampling again: the sequence unwinds, wells empty in reverse order and the image's color returns
Back to resting state, indistinguishable from the original arrival state
attention_and_information_flow: Initially the image holds nearly all prominence and the empty wells read as waiting slots that imply what will happen
During sampling, attention transfers downward as the image desaturates and loses visual weight while the wells gain color and text
The staggered order gives the eye a left-to-right (or row-order) path through the results rather than a single simultaneous flash
At rest after sampling, the readable values are the primary information and the colorless image becomes the supporting context
Reversal moves prominence back up to the image as values disappear
Stepping to another image resets prominence to the image alone with no values competing for attention

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: The same control remains available to unwind; the sequence runs to a stable settled state rather than leaving partial ambiguity
interaction_model.state_change: Image transitions from full color to colorless; wells transition from empty to filled in sequence
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The picture visibly drains of color while each well swaps its placeholder for an extracted color and its readable value, one after another in a quick staggered rhythm until all are settled
interaction_model.input: Press of the single sampling control while no palette is showing
interaction_model.affected_object: The featured image and the row of color wells

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Full reversal is always reachable from the settled state with one press; the toggle never leaves a mixed half-sampled resting state
interaction_model.state_change: Filled wells return to empty in reverse order; image returns to full color
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Wells empty back to placeholders in the opposite order from which they filled, and the photo's color comes back, ending exactly at the untouched view
interaction_model.input: Press of the same sampling control while a palette is showing
interaction_model.affected_object: The row of color wells and the featured image

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Stepping wraps at both ends so the set never dead-ends; presses arriving during an in-progress changeover are ignored so nothing drifts out of step or lands half-transitioned
interaction_model.state_change: A directional sliding changeover swaps in the adjacent image; any showing palette is cleared and the wells return to empty
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The current image slides away in the pressed direction as the next slides in; wells go empty so the new image starts with a clean row
interaction_model.input: Press of the previous or next stepping control
interaction_model.affected_object: The featured image and any showing palette

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Sampling is immediately available again on the new image
interaction_model.state_change: Wells rest empty regardless of the previous image's palette state
interaction_model.visible_feedback: An untouched full-color image above an empty row, identical in feel to first arrival
interaction_model.input: Arrival on a newly stepped-to image
interaction_model.affected_object: The color wells

experience_qualities: Playful and light rather than technical
Cause-and-effect legibility: color visibly leaves one place and arrives in another
Quick and staggered rather than instantaneous, so the extraction feels performed
Reassuring reversibility, with the original view always one press away
Calm, restrained surround that lets the extracted color be the most saturated material on screen
Steady and non-glitchy, because overlapping presses never take effect
completion_and_return: Sampling completes at a fully settled, readable palette with the image colorless
The same control returns the region exactly to its untouched arrival state
Palette state does not persist across image changes; each new image starts empty
Stepping loops endlessly in both directions, so there is no terminal end state
locked_observable_requirements: One dominant image plus a short row of empty slots visible together in the resting state, against a low-chroma surround that stays clearly separated from both
Sampling desaturates the image and fills the slots, so the transfer of color from image to slots is visually apparent
Slots fill one after another in a staggered order, not all at once
Each filled slot shows both the extracted color and its readable value in place of a placeholder
A single control both applies and unwinds the effect, and unwinding empties slots in reverse order while restoring the image's color
Directional sliding changeover between images that wraps at both ends
Any showing palette is cleared when the image changes
Inputs during a changeover produce no state change
adaptable_details: Number of slots in the row and their shape, size and spacing
Exact timing, easing and stagger interval of fill, drain and slide
Format of the readable value label
Placement of the row relative to the image (below, beside) as long as both are visible together
Visual styling of the placeholder and of the three controls
Specific surround luminance, hue and framing treatment of the image, as long as the image, swatches and labels stay separated and legible against it
Number of images in the steppable set
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits any foreground showcase where one prominent image or media item yields a small set of derived, color-bearing values that should be shown as filled slots beneath it, on a low-distraction surround of any luminance, with a reversible toggle and a small steppable set of items. Replacing the color-drain relationship with values that have no visible link back to the source, filling all slots simultaneously, making the change irreversible, or spreading the results away from the source item so the transfer is no longer visible would create a different Skill.

name: droplet_drag_color_flood_mockup
description: A framed sample website with a palette of color droplets parked along the edge; a droplet is dragged over the mockup, the region or text run under it outlines itself, and releasing bursts the droplet so the color floods outward from that point and stays, until one reset returns the whole mockup to its uncolored baseline appearance.

canonical_document.name: droplet_drag_color_flood_mockup
canonical_document.description: A framed sample website with a palette of color droplets parked along the edge; a droplet is dragged over the mockup, the region or text run under it outlines itself, and releasing bursts the droplet so the color floods outward from that point and stays, until one reset returns the whole mockup to its uncolored baseline appearance.
canonical_document.experience_scope: A self-contained region experience occupying one preview surface plus its adjacent palette edge; it begins with a short opening hint over the preview and continues indefinitely as an open-ended sandbox, ending only when the user leaves or resets. Surrounding page content is unaffected.
content_and_composition: One mock browser frame acting as a container that visually marks the inner content as a sample rather than the live page

Inside the frame, one complete sample site composed of many distinct sections stacked in normal reading order: a masthead, a hero, a set of feature cards, a quote, a team block, a blog block and a pricing block
Within those sections, two kinds of colorable roles: fillable area regions (backgrounds, cards, bands) and individual text runs (headings, labels, short copy)
A palette rail pinned permanently along one edge of the region, holding a fixed set of color droplets in slots so no color has to be hunted for or opened from a menu
One always-available reset control associated with the palette or frame
A transient opening hint layered over the preview explaining that colors are dragged onto the sample
A single dragged droplet that leaves the palette layer and floats above all sample content while in motion
A transient outline that appears on exactly one candidate target at a time
experience_progression: Opening hint is shown over the sample and acknowledged, after which it is gone for good and never reappears
Baseline state: the full sample site is visible in its uncolored low-chroma treatment with the palette parked at the edge
Pick-up: a droplet is pressed and lifts out of its slot onto the drag layer
Travel: the droplet follows the pointer across the mockup and, if flicked and released, keeps gliding briefly before settling
Targeting: once the droplet covers enough of a fillable region or a text run, that single target outlines itself, making the pending recipient unmistakable before commitment
Commit: release over an outlined target bursts the droplet and the color floods outward from the release point across that target
Settle: the applied color remains in place, the outline clears, and the droplet reappears in its palette slot ready for reuse
Accumulation: repeated passes layer more colored regions and text runs into an increasingly customized sample
Return: the reset control wipes every applied color at once, restoring the uncolored baseline sample without disturbing layout or palette
attention_and_information_flow: Attention starts on the brief hint, then is handed to the sample composition once acknowledged
The palette stays quietly present at the edge as a persistent affordance rather than competing for focus
During a drag the moving droplet is the highest-salience, topmost element and pulls the eye across the sample
Prominence narrows to exactly one candidate target at a time via its outline, so the consequence of releasing is known in advance
At release, attention snaps to the release point and follows the color spreading outward from it
After settling, attention diffuses back to the whole mockup so the cumulative recolored look can be judged as a composition
No numeric values, codes or property names are surfaced; the sample itself carries all the information

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Dismissal is final for the session and does not return on later interactions; the sandbox remains usable without it
interaction_model.state_change: Hint moves from shown to permanently dismissed
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The hint clears and the full sample site is unobstructed
interaction_model.input: Acknowledging the opening hint
interaction_model.affected_object: Transient instructional overlay above the preview

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: On touch, the required short hold keeps ordinary scrolling and reading of the page intact until intent is clear; abandoning the press leaves the palette unchanged
interaction_model.state_change: Droplet detaches from its slot onto a drag layer above the sample
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The droplet lifts free and reads as carried rather than docked; its origin slot remains identifiable
interaction_model.input: Pressing a color droplet in the palette (on touch, a brief hold precedes the drag)
interaction_model.affected_object: The droplet and its palette slot

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Motion can be redirected at any time during the drag; the glide is short and settles on its own without leaving the droplet stranded mid-air
interaction_model.state_change: Droplet position tracks the pointer; after a flick it continues with brief momentum before coming to rest
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The droplet glides smoothly under the pointer and coasts a short distance when thrown, giving it physical weight
interaction_model.input: Dragging the pointer across the mockup, including a flick-and-release
interaction_model.affected_object: The carried droplet

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Moving off the target withdraws the outline with nothing applied; the arming state continuously follows the droplet
interaction_model.state_change: That target becomes the armed recipient; any previously armed target disarms
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The candidate outlines itself with clear separation from its surroundings so the exact region or text run about to be colored is unmistakable, with only one target outlined at a time
interaction_model.input: Covering enough of a fillable region or text run with the droplet
interaction_model.affected_object: The single candidate target under the droplet

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: The applied color persists and can be replaced by dropping another color on the same target; the palette is never depleted, so any color can be reused immediately
interaction_model.state_change: Target changes from its current color to the dropped color and keeps it; droplet is consumed and restored to its slot
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The droplet bursts at the release point and the new color floods outward from that point across the target, then holds; the outline clears and the droplet reappears in the palette
interaction_model.input: Releasing over an outlined target
interaction_model.affected_object: The armed region or text run, and the droplet

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Invalid release is the natural escape from an unwanted drag and costs nothing, reinforcing the consequence-free feel
interaction_model.state_change: Drag is cancelled with no color change anywhere
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The droplet returns to its palette slot and the sample looks exactly as before
interaction_model.input: Releasing anywhere that is not a valid target
interaction_model.affected_object: The carried droplet and the sample content

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Available at any time regardless of how many colors were applied; the sandbox is immediately ready for a fresh round of experimentation
interaction_model.state_change: All accumulated colors are cleared at once back to the uncolored baseline treatment
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The whole mockup returns to its uncolored baseline look in one coordinated pass while layout, frame and palette stay put
interaction_model.input: Activating the reset control
interaction_model.affected_object: Every colored region and text run in the sample

experience_qualities: Toy-like and tactile: colors are physical droplets that are carried, thrown and burst rather than chosen from a form
Consequence-free and casual, because every drop is replaceable and everything can be wiped in one move
Unmistakable before commitment: the pending target is always announced by its outline
Legible at a glance: the outward flood from the release point makes each change register without hunting for what altered
Always-at-hand: the palette never hides, opens or has to be searched for
Coherent, because the change lands on a realistic complete composition rather than an isolated swatch
completion_and_return: No terminal completion state; the experience is an open sandbox that accumulates changes indefinitely

It stops being this Skill if color is applied by clicking a target and picking from a menu, if changes preview only while hovering instead of persisting, if the palette is hidden behind a toggle, if the pending target is not announced before release, if the color appears instantly instead of flooding outward from the release point, or if the changes apply to the real surrounding page rather than a framed mockup.

name: character_grid_picture_console

name: liquid_dot_image_with_cursor_wake
description: A picture rendered as a field of luminous dots on a single quiet, uninflected ground they clearly out-shine; dots near the moving cursor are pushed outward along its direction of travel and flicker, opening a soft ragged gap that trails the pointer, then spring back to their exact places when the motion stops. Any new picture drops straight into the same field, and the visible frame can be saved in one action.

Springy, self-healing and non-destructive — every disturbance undoes itself
Self-evident on arrival, requiring no explanation of what the tool does
Recognisable subject preserved throughout, so it reads as a picture and a material at once
locked_observable_requirements: The picture is always represented as a field of discrete luminous dots on a single uninflected ground that they clearly out-shine, never as a continuous photograph

The disturbance appears as a soft, ragged-edged gap that follows the pointer rather than a hard or geometric cutout
All displacement is fully reversible: dots return to their exact starting positions on pause or exit

canonical_document.name: liquid_dot_image_with_cursor_wake
canonical_document.experience_scope: A single framed display region that holds one picture at a time and may occupy most or all of the view. It begins already populated on arrival with an example rendering, persists as the page's focal surface with no end state, and covers the dot field plus the minimal bring-in and save affordances that sit around it.
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits any single-image-centric surface where one picture is the expressive focus and surrounding copy is minimal — portraits, product shots, artwork, curated hero imagery, or a visitor's own uploaded photo. It becomes a different Skill if the dot field no longer resolves into a recognisable picture (pure abstract particle art), if the disturbance persists as drawing or erasure (a paint or reveal tool), if the reaction is global warping of the whole image instead of a local gap that follows the pointer, or if the field must sit behind readable foreground text and controls, since the emissive dot surface and cursor-driven exploration require it to be the focus.
content_and_composition: One primary display surface on a single uninflected, low-activity ground, filled edge to edge over the picture's extent by a regular field of small luminous dots whose brightness and scale encode the source image's tone
Exactly one source picture represented at a time, fitted to the available frame so the whole subject is visible without cropping the composition away
A pre-loaded example picture present from arrival, so the surface is never empty and never needs explanatory text
A transient, soft-edged, ragged disturbance region that exists only where the pointer currently is: outward-pushed and flickering dots surrounded by exposed bare ground

No panels, captions or controls layered over the dot field itself; the field stays the sole visual subject
attention_and_information_flow: At rest attention is on the whole picture as a single subject; the dot grain is a secondary quality

Bringing in a new picture resets attention to whole-image reading before any local exploration resumes

name: character_grid_clip_conversion_console
description: A stark monospaced console with one distinct accent: a small looping sample of finished character output sets expectations, a clip dropped or browsed into the intake area is converted while a percentage advances on the action control itself, and the resulting character-grid frames then fill the view with a running position counter, a run/hold toggle and a reset back to the start.

Repeatable and self-clearing, inviting another attempt
locked_observable_requirements: Moving source imagery is presented as a grid of monospaced characters, never as a picture

A short autonomous loop of finished character output is visible before any file is handed over

canonical_document.name: character_grid_clip_conversion_console
canonical_document.experience_scope: A whole-view, single-purpose experience. canonical_document.name: console_character_art_conversion_bay
canonical_document.experience_scope: Whole-view, single-surface experience in one place: it begins on arrival with the idle worked example, carries the visitor through handover, settings, conversion and playback in the same view, and ends when the result is discarded and the opening state returns. name: live_tuned_drifting_character_pattern
description: A large pattern drawn entirely from text characters drifts continuously across the main stage while a quiet side panel of sliders, numbered geometry modes, a custom character run and independently chosen ink and backdrop tones reshapes it instantly and reversibly, never pausing or restarting the motion.

experience_qualities: Mesmerizing, calm, never-still
