interaction_model.visible_feedback: An instant change of direction mid-air or mid-roll, with the coat whipping to the new heading
interaction_model.input: A fresh press-and-drag while the object is still in flight or rolling
interaction_model.affected_object: The furred object

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Containment is absolute, so the object can never be lost and the view never needs resetting
interaction_model.state_change: Movement is contained rather than allowed to continue outward
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The object is turned back inward and stays fully in sight; it is never flung out of frame
interaction_model.input: The object reaching the edge of the invisible boundary
interaction_model.affected_object: The furred object and the framing of the view

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: The jolt resolves in a moment and never obstructs continued dragging
interaction_model.state_change: A brief jolt is applied to the entire view
interaction_model.visible_feedback: A short, quickly damped shake of everything on screen at the moment of impact
interaction_model.input: A hard landing or high-speed impact (driven by the object's own motion, not by direct input)
interaction_model.affected_object: The whole view

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Interruptible at any instant by a drag, which starts a new bout of play
interaction_model.state_change: Holds a resting state with a continuous slow rotation
interaction_model.visible_feedback: A lazy spin that keeps turning the coat over while the object sits on the ground
interaction_model.input: No input (idle)
interaction_model.affected_object: The furred object

experience_qualities: Soft, thick and lofty — the coat reads as deep rather than painted on
Weighty and satisfying to shove, with real follow-through instead of instant stops
Springy, with visible lag and rebound between the body and its coat
Self-explanatory: playability is understood from the entry drop alone
Calm and unhurried, always returning to quiet
Contained and safe — nothing can be broken, lost or made unrecoverable
Endlessly repeatable with no goal, score or ending
completion_and_return: Every bout of play ends the same way: the object comes to rest on the ground, still and quietly spinning, ready to be disturbed again
There is no success, failure, terminal state or reset control
The rest state is reached on its own through decay of motion, never by snapping back to a starting position
The rest-and-play cycle loops indefinitely for as long as the view is open
locked_observable_requirements: The experience opens with the object dropping in from above and settling, with no instructional text
Exactly one object holds attention, on a bare, evenly lit stage that stays lower in visual salience than the object, with no competing content or visible controls
Press-and-drag anywhere in the view shoves the object, with drag speed mapping to shove strength
The shove is directional along the ground; the object is never lifted straight up
The object keeps travelling after release, then falls, bounces and rolls before coasting to a standstill on its own
The coat visibly answers every shove by sweeping back and springing forward as the object moves
A shadow tracks underneath the object at all times, readable against the ground it falls on
A drag during flight or roll redirects the object immediately
An invisible boundary keeps the object in view at all times so it can never be flung out of sight
Heavy impacts give the whole view a short jolt
At rest the object keeps a slow, lazy spin
adaptable_details: Colour and character of the coat, and the exact fibre length or density
Colour treatment, luminance key and proportions of the bare room and its ground surface — light or dark, warm or cool — as long as the object stays clearly separated from it
Object size relative to the view and the camera framing or viewpoint height
Tuning of bounciness, friction, spin rate and how long a bout takes to decay
Strength and duration of the impact jolt
Softness and strength of the tracking shadow relative to the ground beneath it
Whether the entry drop happens once on open or can be replayed
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits any single soft or fibrous handleable object presented alone on a bare stage as the whole point of a small view, where play is open-ended and the material's give and heft are the message. It stays the same Skill for different creature-like or product-like objects, surround treatments and luminance keys, and physical tuning. It becomes a different Skill if several objects interact, if the stage turns into a scene or environment to travel through, if the surface is rigid and does not visibly answer the shove, if goals, aiming, scoring or progress are added, or if the object may be lifted straight up or flung out of sight.

name: streak_traced_liquid_canvas
description: A quiet, evenly toned liquid filling the whole viewport; sweeping a cursor or finger shoves the fluid along the stroke with a soft-edged push, drawing hair-thin streaks that read clearly against the surface, bunch and curl in the wake, hold long enough to follow, then dissolve back to stillness.

canonical_document.name: streak_traced_liquid_canvas
canonical_document.description: A quiet, evenly toned liquid filling the whole viewport; sweeping a cursor or finger shoves the fluid along the stroke with a soft-edged push, drawing hair-thin streaks that read clearly against the surface, bunch and curl in the wake, hold long enough to follow, then dissolve back to stillness.
canonical_document.experience_scope: Whole-view experience occupying the entire viewport from page arrival; it begins at rest with no prompt, is entered simply by moving a pointer or finger over the surface, and never ends — it always relaxes back to the resting surface and remains available.
content_and_composition: Single edge-to-edge liquid surface as the only visual subject, filling the full viewport
Resting state reads as a still, evenly toned sheet with no visible controls, labels, instructions or interface chrome
Fine hair-thin streaks layered on the surface as the sole readable structure, separated just enough from it to be legible and appearing only where flow exists
Streak density and contrast vary across the surface, with the busiest regions reading strongest and calm regions reading near-blank
Optional sparse foreground content, if present, sits above the surface without competing for the interaction
experience_progression: Rest: still, evenly toned surface, no streaks or only faint residual structure
Disturbance: while the hand moves, a broad soft push forms along the swept path and streaks appear almost immediately
Swirl: after the stroke ends, the flow coasts on its own momentum and swirls curl away from the travelled path, holding legibly long enough to follow
Settling: motion and streaks decay progressively and the surface eases back toward stillness by itself
Ready: returns to the resting surface, continuously available for another attempt with no restart
attention_and_information_flow: At rest, attention is drawn by emptiness and evident touchability rather than by any cue or call to action
Prominence follows the hand: the freshest part of the stroke is strongest and the surrounding surface stays quiet
Flow becomes legible almost immediately on first movement, so the visitor learns the rule from one gesture
Attention shifts from the pointer to the persisting swirl once the stroke ends, since the trace outlives the hand
As motion decays, visual prominence drains evenly back toward the undisturbed surface, releasing attention

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Force accumulates continuously while the hand keeps moving; there is no mode to exit and no error state to recover from
interaction_model.state_change: Fluid is shoved in the direction of travel with a broad soft-edged force, strongest along the centre line of the stroke and tapering to nothing at its rim
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Streaks form and bunch along the path and curl away from it, densest and most strongly separated from the surface where the hand has just passed
interaction_model.input: Moving a cursor or finger across the surface
interaction_model.affected_object: The liquid along the swept path and the streaks that reveal it

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Re-entering or resuming movement immediately resumes pushing and layers onto the still-moving flow rather than restarting it
interaction_model.state_change: The shove cuts cleanly and immediately, leaving only the momentum already imparted
interaction_model.visible_feedback: No new push appears; existing swirls continue coasting under their own momentum and gradually ease toward calm
interaction_model.input: Lifting the finger, releasing, or leaving the surface
interaction_model.affected_object: The applied push

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: The cap holds automatically with no user-visible failure; the surface still relaxes back to stillness afterwards
interaction_model.state_change: Applied force and resulting motion are capped so the simulation cannot blow apart or destabilize
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Streaks stay coherent and readable at extreme input instead of exploding into noise or artefacts
interaction_model.input: Very fast or violent strokes
interaction_model.affected_object: Overall motion magnitude of the liquid

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Contacts are independent: lifting one stops only its push while the others continue unaffected
interaction_model.state_change: Each contact contributes its own push, and the resulting currents interact where they meet
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Multiple simultaneous streak trails that collide, merge and curl around one another
interaction_model.input: Several fingers pushing at once
interaction_model.affected_object: Multiple regions of the liquid simultaneously

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: New input at any point during settling adds to the remaining motion instead of requiring a reset
interaction_model.state_change: Motion decays and the surface relaxes toward its resting state
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Swirls thin, fade and dissolve until the still, evenly toned surface remains
interaction_model.input: Time passing without input
interaction_model.affected_object: Existing currents and streaks

experience_qualities: Immediately legible without instruction or interface
Soft and calm, held in a low-contrast register rather than vivid or harsh
Tactile and physical: the surface feels shoved rather than drawn on
Traces persist long enough to follow, giving a sense of consequence
Self-quieting and forgiving, never breaking or demanding a restart
Continuously inviting, rewarding repeated idle experimentation
completion_and_return: No completion state or goal; the experience is open-ended
Each stroke resolves by decaying naturally back to the still resting surface
The surface remains permanently ready for another attempt with no reset, replay or restart affordance
No progress, score or accumulated state carries over between strokes
locked_observable_requirements: The liquid surface occupies the entire viewport and carries no visible interface or instructions
Resting state reads as a still, evenly toned, plainly disturbable surface
Flow is made visible by fine hair-thin streaks that stay legible against the surface and whose strength tracks local activity, strongest in the busiest regions
Pointer or finger movement pushes the fluid along the direction of travel with a broad soft-edged profile, strongest at the stroke centre and tapering to nothing at its rim
Streaks visibly bunch along and curl away from the travelled path
The push builds while movement continues and cuts cleanly the instant the input lifts or leaves the surface
After release, the flow coasts on its own momentum and eases back to stillness without user action
Swirls persist long enough to be visually followed before dissolving
Motion is capped so extreme input never destabilizes or visually breaks the surface
Multiple simultaneous contacts each push independently
The surface is always ready for another attempt; no restart is ever required
adaptable_details: Exact hue, tone and tint of the resting surface, light or dark
Streak thickness, spacing, contrast and hue within the hair-thin, low-emphasis register
Width and softness profile of the push relative to viewport size
How long swirls persist and how quickly the surface settles
Apparent viscosity or thickness of the liquid
Whether sparse foreground content is layered above the surface
Whether faint residual structure lingers at rest or the surface returns fully undisturbed
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits any view that can dedicate a full region or whole screen to an input-driven surface with little or no reading material, such as entry screens, brand playgrounds, ambient backdrops behind very sparse copy, or standalone interactive showpieces, and adopts whatever surface and streak tones the host uses. It stops fitting where dense text, forms or scroll-driven reading occupy the same area, since the surface needs sustained free pointer movement to be legible. Replacing the soft directional shove with click-to-emit bursts, replacing hair-thin streak tracing with broad filled blobs, splashes or image distortion, or requiring an explicit reset instead of natural settling would each create a different Skill.

name: booting_live_screen_stage
description: A full-size screen that wakes visibly — a short busy startup with load progress and a flickering activity light — then settles into a period-true working desktop that the visitor drives directly: pointer motion, clicks and typing all go into the screen, which redraws continuously and paints its own pointer instead of the visitor's.

canonical_document.name: booting_live_screen_stage
canonical_document.description: A full-size screen that wakes visibly — a short busy startup with load progress and a flickering activity light — then settles into a period-true working desktop that the visitor drives directly: pointer motion, clicks and typing all go into the screen, which redraws continuously and paints its own pointer instead of the visitor's.
canonical_document.experience_scope: Whole-view mode that begins when a chosen subject is activated and the screen takes over, spans startup, live use and idle suspension, and ends when the visitor exits back to whatever view they came from.
content_and_composition: One dominant full-size screen surface that owns the view while active
Startup layer shown on that surface: visible busy activity plus a reported load progress indication
A small activity indicator light that flickers while data is arriving
Settled state: a complete, period-consistent working environment filling the screen, styled as real hardware output rather than as web UI
A pointer drawn by the screen itself, replacing the visitor's own cursor inside the stage
Transient dismissible notices layered over the screen when something fails
Persistent element: an explicit exit path back to the originating view
experience_progression: Wake: the surface becomes full-size and startup begins immediately
Busy startup: visible activity with load progress reported and the activity light flickering as data arrives
Settle: startup resolves into a convincingly period working desktop
Live use: continuous redraw under the visitor's direct pointer and keyboard control, for as long as they stay
Suspend: an unattended screen quiets and holds its state
Resume: returning attention brings the held state back to life where it stopped
Exit: the stage releases the view and hands back to the previous context
attention_and_information_flow: Startup deliberately shows effort so the wait reads as machinery working rather than a blank wait
Progress and the flickering light are the only foreground information during startup
Once settled, all information comes from inside the environment itself; framing elements stay quiet
Failure notices briefly claim attention over the screen and then can be dismissed back to the environment

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Exit remains available during startup; leaving returns to the prior view
interaction_model.state_change: Dormant preview becomes a full-size screen entering startup
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The screen fills the view and immediately shows busy startup with load progress
interaction_model.input: Activation of a subject from a previous view
interaction_model.affected_object: The stage surface

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Stalls or failures surface as a dismissible notice rather than a silent dead screen
interaction_model.state_change: Progress advances while activity is intermittent
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Reported load progress plus an irregularly flickering activity light
interaction_model.input: Data arriving during startup
interaction_model.affected_object: Load progress readout and activity indicator light

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Moving outside the stage returns normal cursor behavior
interaction_model.state_change: Environment tracks position continuously
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The screen's self-painted pointer moves; the visitor's native cursor is not the thing that moves inside the stage
interaction_model.input: Pointer motion inside the stage
interaction_model.affected_object: The running environment and its own drawn pointer

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Input is captured only while the stage is active; failures appear as dismissible notices instead of breaking the session
interaction_model.state_change: Environment state advances as it would on real hardware
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Continuous redraw of the screen reflecting each action, with no page-level control response
interaction_model.input: Clicks and typing inside the stage
interaction_model.affected_object: The running environment's contents

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Returning attention resumes from the held state; nothing restarts from the beginning
interaction_model.state_change: Runs to suspended, holding its exact state
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Activity ceases and the screen becomes quiet rather than resetting
interaction_model.input: Visitor leaves the screen unattended
interaction_model.affected_object: The running environment

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Re-entry is available; the stage can be entered and left repeatedly
interaction_model.state_change: Stage releases the view
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The previous view returns at the position it was left
interaction_model.input: Visitor exits the stage
interaction_model.affected_object: The whole view

experience_qualities: Feels like real hardware waking up rather than a page loading
Startup is short but visibly effortful, making the wait part of the experience
Direct and unmediated: input goes into the world, not into controls around it
The self-drawn pointer makes the screen feel like a separate device rather than part of the page
Forgiving: idling, failing and leaving are all recoverable
completion_and_return: No completion condition; the environment runs as long as the visitor stays
Idle suspension holds state instead of resetting, and resumes on return
Exit hands the view back to the originating context at its prior position
Failures resolve by dismissing a notice and continuing, not by restarting the visit
locked_observable_requirements: The stage occupies the view at full size while active
Startup is visible and reports load progress with an activity indicator that flickers while data arrives
Startup resolves into a coherent, period-consistent working environment, not a static image
Pointer motion, clicks and typing are routed into the environment rather than to page controls
The environment redraws continuously and draws its own pointer in place of the visitor's cursor
Unattended state suspends and resumes rather than resetting
Failures appear as dismissible notices layered over the stage
Exiting restores the previous view and position
adaptable_details: Which era or style the environment portrays
Startup duration and the visual form of the busy activity
Shape, placement and color of the activity indicator light
Form of the progress readout
Wording and placement of failure notices
Whether the stage is framed as bare screen or as a screen within a device shell
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits any subject that can be presented as a self-contained operable environment or screen the visitor is meant to try firsthand, entered from a browse or detail context. Reducing input to a scripted playback, removing the visible startup, or letting the page's own cursor and controls stand in for the environment's self-drawn pointer and internal responses would create a different Skill.

name: glowing_ripple_liquid_surface
description: A still, uniform expanse of liquid filling the screen, visually silent at rest and revealed only by faint specular highlights, where sweeping a cursor or finger raises an unbroken glowing crest along the path and rings spread outward, cross each other and slowly flatten back into the resting field.

canonical_document.name: glowing_ripple_liquid_surface
canonical_document.description: A still, uniform expanse of liquid filling the screen, visually silent at rest and revealed only by faint specular highlights, where sweeping a cursor or finger raises an unbroken glowing crest along the path and rings spread outward, cross each other and slowly flatten back into the resting field.
canonical_document.experience_scope: Whole-view experience occupying the entire screen from arrival; it begins as a flat resting surface, is active only while the visitor maintains contact and while disturbances decay, and ends when the surface has fully relaxed back to its flat resting field. Can also be deployed as a single self-contained full-bleed region.
content_and_composition: One continuous liquid surface as the single dominant content, filling the full viewport edge to edge
Resting state is one uniform, low-salience tone and visually silent, with no text, labels, instructions, controls or affordance markers present
Faint specular light catching the surface is the only element that reveals the medium exists and that it has depth and relief
Transient disturbance layer sits on top of the resting surface: a glowing crest tracing the swept path plus expanding rings originating from that stroke
Multiple simultaneous ring sets coexist and visibly overlap where they cross, with no separate panel, frame or chrome around the surface
experience_progression: Arrival: flat, uniform, silent expanse with only faint surface light; nothing suggests reading or following steps
First contact: within roughly a second the visitor sees the surface answer exactly under their pointer, establishing what they are affecting without being told
Sustained contact: crest continues to be raised along the moving path and new rings keep being emitted for as long as contact lasts
Release: no new disturbance is created; existing crest and rings continue to travel outward and flatten on their own
Rest: surface returns to its flat resting field, identical to arrival, ready for the next attempt
attention_and_information_flow: Attention is drawn purely by luminance separation: the glowing crest and rings sit far from the resting field's luminance while the rest of the view stays low-salience
Prominence peaks at the point of contact and migrates outward with the spreading rings, so the eye follows the disturbance away from the hand
As rings flatten, luminance separation and relief fade together, returning attention to emptiness rather than to any UI element
No information is revealed other than the surface's own behavior; the interaction teaches itself through immediate correspondence between motion and response
Crossing rings create momentary higher-salience interference regions that briefly hold attention away from the pointer

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Pushing keeps working continuously for the entire duration of contact; the visitor can slow, reverse or curve the stroke at any time and the crest follows
interaction_model.state_change: A crest is lifted continuously along the traced path, including the gaps implied by fast movement, so the disturbance reads as one unbroken line rather than separated dots
interaction_model.visible_feedback: A glowing raised ridge appears exactly beneath and behind the moving pointer, tracking it without visible lag or beading
interaction_model.input: Sweeping a cursor or finger across the surface while maintaining contact
interaction_model.affected_object: Liquid surface along the swept path

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Decay proceeds on its own and cannot be stalled; new strokes add disturbance rather than cancelling existing rings
interaction_model.state_change: Rings are emitted from the stroke and travel outward, overlapping and interfering with rings from earlier or concurrent strokes, then decaying
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Expanding glowing rings spread away from the stroke, cross one another, and gradually flatten until indistinguishable from the resting field
interaction_model.input: Any stroke on the surface
interaction_model.affected_object: Surrounding surface area

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: The ceiling is always in force, so no sequence of aggressive input can put the surface into an unrecoverable or ugly state; it still relaxes to its flat resting field
interaction_model.state_change: Crest height is clamped at a ceiling so accumulated energy cannot push the surface past a legible maximum
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The surface stays a coherent lit liquid: luminous and lively but never blown out, flattened into a featureless uniform mass or visually broken
interaction_model.input: Heavy, repeated or overlapping strokes in the same area
interaction_model.affected_object: Crest amplitude of the surface

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Withdrawal is an instant, always-available stop; the surface self-restores with no action required
interaction_model.state_change: Generation of new disturbance stops immediately while already-emitted crest and rings continue their natural outward travel and decay
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The luminous ridge stops growing at once and the remaining light drifts outward and fades back into the resting field
interaction_model.input: Leaving the surface, lifting the finger or releasing the pointer
interaction_model.affected_object: Disturbance generation

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Each re-entry is independently clean, so repeated leaving and returning never accumulates artifacts
interaction_model.state_change: A fresh stroke begins at the new contact point with no continuity from the previous end position
interaction_model.visible_feedback: No streak, jump line or dragged-in trail spans the gap between where contact was lost and where it resumed
interaction_model.input: Returning to the surface after leaving it
interaction_model.affected_object: New stroke

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Rest is the stable default; the piece is left fresh and identical for the next visitor or attempt
interaction_model.state_change: All disturbance decays to zero and the surface returns to its resting state
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Rings quietly die away until only the flat resting field with its faint surface light remains
interaction_model.input: Absence of any contact over time (autonomous driver)
interaction_model.affected_object: Whole surface

experience_qualities: Calm, quiet and meditative rather than energetic or gamified
Low-noise and near-monochrome, with luminance rather than hue as the only descriptive material
Physically believable: disturbance travels, interferes and dies away instead of snapping off
Immediately self-explanatory, understood within about a second of first contact
Absorbing and repeatable, rewarding idle continued play with no goal, score or endpoint
Forgiving: nothing the visitor does can spoil the surface
completion_and_return: No completion condition; the experience is open-ended and driven entirely by the visitor's presence
Withdrawal always leads back to the same flat resting state, so each session ends in a clean reset
No persistent marks, history, accumulation or scoring carries across strokes or sessions
The piece is continuously re-enterable: a new stroke may begin at any moment, including while previous rings are still decaying
locked_observable_requirements: Surface fills the whole view and rests as a uniform, low-salience, textless expanse whose presence is conveyed only by faint light on it, with the resting level held far enough from the disturbance luminance that the crest and rings read clearly
No instructions, labels or visible controls; interactivity is discovered purely through response to movement
Crest is raised along the entire swept path and remains unbroken during fast motion, never rendering as separated dots or beads
Rings spread outward from the stroke, visibly cross one another, and gradually flatten rather than vanishing abruptly
Crest height is bounded so repeated or aggressive strokes cannot blow out the surface
Pushing continues for as long as contact is maintained
Leaving or lifting immediately stops new disturbance while existing disturbance decays naturally
Re-entry starts a fresh stroke with no streak connecting it to the previous contact point
Idle surface relaxes fully back to its flat resting field, matching arrival
adaptable_details: Exact hue, warmth and overall luminance level of the resting surface, its faint light and the glowing crest, as long as their separation stays legible
Ring spread speed, decay duration and how sharp or soft the falloff feels
Crest thickness, glow softness and the specific brightness ceiling
Apparent viscosity, wave density and how many ring sets can coexist
Whether interaction is driven by mouse, touch, stylus or several at once
Whether the surface occupies a full page or one full-bleed section
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits views whose entire point is a quiet, wordless interactive surface: unwinding or idle pages, art-piece screens, wordless entry views, and full-bleed sections that invite exploration through motion. It tolerates no foreground reading matter, since legibility over a rippling, luminance-shifting field and the requirement of an empty resting state would both be violated; placing text, cards or navigation on top makes it a different skill. Replacing continuous path-following crests with discrete tap-spawned splashes, making disturbance persistent or accumulating, adding goals, scoring or instructional overlays, or turning the resting state into a decorative, high-activity pattern each produce a different skill.

name: narrowing_block_tower_stack
description: A block slides back and forth above a growing tower; one click, tap or space bar locks it, only the overlapping slice stays, the leftover piece snaps off and tumbles out of frame, and the view climbs while the ambient tone drifts steadily toward its far endpoint until a total miss freezes the run.

canonical_document.name: narrowing_block_tower_stack
canonical_document.description: A block slides back and forth above a growing tower; one click, tap or space bar locks it, only the overlapping slice stays, the leftover piece snaps off and tumbles out of frame, and the view climbs while the ambient tone drifts steadily toward its far endpoint until a total miss freezes the run.
canonical_document.experience_scope: A self-contained play viewport that opens in an idle state with a short prompt, runs continuously from the first input until a miss, and can be restarted in place; it can fill the whole view or occupy a bounded region, but the tower, the traveling block, the counter and the failure notice all live inside that one frame.
content_and_composition: Exactly one traveling block in play at any moment, entering from a side edge and moving horizontally above the stack
A stack of previously locked layers forming the tower, drawn as a vertical column from a base layer upward
The topmost locked layer acting as the landing surface, whose width is the visible target and shrinks as overhangs are lost
A short onboarding prompt overlaying the idle state, brief enough to read in a couple of seconds
A persistent level or layer count displayed as a small peripheral readout
An ambient tone field on the background or the blocks that drifts gradually and one-directionally from its starting tone toward a clearly distinguishable end tone across the run as a progress marker
Transient offcut fragments that exist only while falling out of frame
A failure notice that appears over the frozen scene, paired with a visible one-step restart affordance
experience_progression: Idle invitation: prompt visible, no scoring pressure, a single block waiting or already traveling
First input starts the run and the prompt gives way to play
Repeating cycle: block travels, input locks it, overlap survives, offcut breaks away, count increments, next block enters from the perpendicular side
Tightening arc: each surviving surface is no wider than the previous one, so successive locks demand finer timing
Ascending arc: the tower grows taller, the viewpoint climbs to keep the active top layer framed, and the ambient tone drifts further toward its end tone
Failure: a lock with no overlap drops the block away, motion halts and the failure notice appears
Restart: a single step clears the tower and returns to an empty base with the count and the ambient tone reset
attention_and_information_flow: At entry the short prompt is the most prominent element so the aim is understood almost immediately
Once play begins attention narrows to two things only: the incoming block and the width of the surface it must land on
The count and the ambient tone drift stay deliberately peripheral, read as accumulated progress rather than moment-to-moment guidance
The climbing viewpoint keeps the decision zone at a stable place in the frame while the completed tower recedes below
Each lock briefly pulls the eye outward to the tumbling offcut, then back to the newly narrowed surface and the next entering block
On failure the notice becomes dominant and the play surface stops competing for attention

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: The same input is the only one needed; if no input is given the idle state persists indefinitely
interaction_model.state_change: Idle invitation becomes an active run
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The prompt clears and the traveling block begins its pass across the top of the stack
interaction_model.input: Click anywhere, tap, or space bar press while idle
interaction_model.affected_object: The play frame and the onboarding prompt

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: A lock is final and cannot be undone; the only recovery is the next attempt on the now-narrower surface
interaction_model.state_change: The block locks at its current position; the part overlapping the layer beneath is kept and becomes the new landing surface, the non-overlapping part is separated off
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The block stops mid-motion, the kept slice settles onto the tower as a new layer, the leftover slice visibly breaks off and tumbles away out of frame, the count ticks up, and the next block enters from the perpendicular side
interaction_model.input: Click anywhere, tap, or space bar press during a block's travel
interaction_model.affected_object: The traveling block, the top landing surface and the level count

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Motion continues without user input until the next lock; the ascent and the ambient drift only reset when the run resets
interaction_model.state_change: Continuous motion of the current block, upward camera adjustment as the tower grows, and a slow one-directional ambient tone progression from the starting tone toward the end tone
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The block sweeps steadily above the stack, the frame rises so the active top layer stays visible while lower layers move out of view, and the overall ambient tone shifts further toward its end tone as the run lengthens
interaction_model.input: Autonomous drive of the running scene
interaction_model.affected_object: Traveling block position, viewpoint height and the ambient tone field

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: No continuation of the failed run is possible; the frozen scene remains visible behind the notice with the restart step plainly offered
interaction_model.state_change: Run ends immediately
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The block drops away out of frame, all motion freezes at once, and an unmistakable failure notice appears over the stopped scene
interaction_model.input: A lock committed while the block has cleared the tower with nothing overlapping
interaction_model.affected_object: The whole play scene

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Restart is always available from the failure state and is reachable in one step, making repeat attempts feel immediate
interaction_model.state_change: Failed run is discarded and a fresh run begins from an empty base
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The failure notice clears, the tower returns to a single base layer at the starting viewpoint, the count returns to its start value and the ambient tone returns to its starting endpoint
interaction_model.input: Reset key or restart step after failure
interaction_model.affected_object: Tower, count, viewpoint and ambient tone field

experience_qualities: Immediately legible: the aim reads in a couple of seconds without instruction beyond a short prompt
Tight focus on a single moving object and a single shrinking target
Escalating tension as the landing surface narrows run after run
A tangible sense of height and accumulation from the climbing viewpoint and the tower left behind
Slow ambient change through the one-directional tone drift, felt more than read
Decisive, unambiguous failure with no confusion about what happened
Low-friction retry that encourages another attempt right away
completion_and_return: There is no win state; the run continues until a miss, so length of run is the outcome
Failure freezes the scene and holds the final tower visible as the result of the attempt
Restart fully clears state: empty base, initial count, initial viewpoint height and the initial ambient starting tone
No progress carries across runs beyond what the frozen final frame showed before reset
locked_observable_requirements: One universal commit input serves both starting the run and locking the traveling block
Only the overlapping portion of a locked block survives, and it becomes the next landing surface, so the target can only narrow
The non-overlapping leftover visibly separates and falls out of frame rather than vanishing in place
Successive blocks enter from perpendicular sides, alternating the axis of travel
The viewpoint climbs with the growing tower so the active top layer stays framed
A visible count of completed layers increases with each successful lock
A slow, one-directional ambient tone drift between two clearly distinguishable endpoints progresses across the run as an ambient distance marker
A total miss ends the attempt instantly: block falls away, motion freezes, explicit failure notice appears
Restart from failure is a single step and returns to an empty base
The aim must be graspable within a couple of seconds from a short prompt
adaptable_details: Shape, proportions and thickness of the stacked pieces
Travel speed, easing and whether speed changes with height
Which two tones anchor the start and end of the ambient drift and whether it tints background, blocks or both
Styling and placement of the count readout and the failure notice
Wording of the onboarding prompt and the restart hint
Look of the tumbling offcut, including spin, tilt and fall path
Smoothness and pacing of the camera climb
Viewport aspect ratio and whether the play area is full-view or an embedded region
Presence of sound or subtle impact accents on lock and miss
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits any sparse, self-contained play region where a single commit input freezes a moving element against a target that visibly shrinks with each imprecise commit, and where progress reads as vertical accumulation plus a slow ambient shift between two distinguishable endpoint tones. It does not fit content-dense regions that need reading attention alongside it, since focus must narrow to one block and one surface. Replacing the single universal input with directional or multi-key control, making imprecise commits forgiving so the target never narrows, removing the offcut separation, or turning failure into a soft continuation instead of an instant freeze would each produce a different skill.

name: breathing_dot_field_pulled_to_touch
description: A whole-screen field of faint, low-contrast dots rests in a still, faintly organic pattern under one large line of display text held at readable contrast against it; pressing and holding gathers the entire field inward around the held point with soft hue-shifted fringes trailing the motion, and releasing blooms it back outward until it settles at rest again.

canonical_document.name: breathing_dot_field_pulled_to_touch
canonical_document.description: A whole-screen field of faint, low-contrast dots rests in a still, faintly organic pattern under one large line of display text held at readable contrast against it; pressing and holding gathers the entire field inward around the held point with soft hue-shifted fringes trailing the motion, and releasing blooms it back outward until it settles at rest again.
canonical_document.experience_scope: Whole-view experience filling the entire viewport from the moment the view opens; it has no end state, only a resting state it always returns to, and it remains available for as long as the view is shown.
content_and_composition: One dense field of many small dots covering the full screen as the primary visual layer, each mark separated from the surround only faintly so the field reads as low-emphasis texture
The resting dot arrangement reads as a still, faintly organic pattern rather than a strict mechanical grid
Exactly one large line of display text resting over the field at clearly readable contrast as the only foreground content, persistent across all motion
No panels, controls, instructions or legends; the field itself is the only interactive surface
Soft fringes whose hue is shifted away from the field's own tone appear as a transient secondary layer trailing the dots while they move, absent at rest
A single gathering point exists as an invisible focus that the field organizes around; it is never drawn, only implied by dot density
experience_progression: Opens calm and unhurried: field already still, pattern faintly organic, text already legible, nothing to read or learn
Each interaction is one self-contained breath: the field gathers inward, swells, then eases
Each breath ends with the field settled back into the resting pattern rather than arriving at a conclusion
Breaths accumulate as a repeatable rhythm with no counter, no sequence and no final state
attention_and_information_flow: At rest attention goes straight to the field because the foreground text carries no reading or learning task
During a hold, prominence shifts to the region around the held point as dot density concentrates there and thins elsewhere
Hue-shifted fringes briefly draw the eye along the direction of movement, marking where motion is happening
On release, prominence spreads back outward and re-centres, returning the eye to the whole field evenly
No new information is ever revealed; the only changing signals are density, movement and the transient hue shift of the fringes

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Releasing at any moment reverses the gathering; the hold can last indefinitely without the effect running out or reaching a limit
interaction_model.state_change: Field transitions from resting pattern to gathering inward, organized around the pressed location rather than the geometric centre
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Dots draw inward and crowd around the held point while outer areas thin, with soft hue-shifted fringes trailing behind the moving dots
interaction_model.input: Press and hold anywhere on the field
interaction_model.affected_object: The entire dot field and its gathering point

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Following is continuous and interruptible; stopping movement lets the cluster catch up and settle under the pointer
interaction_model.state_change: Gathering point continuously eases toward the new pointer location instead of snapping to it
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The dense cluster of dots trails smoothly after the pointer with a slight lag, fringes stretching along the direction of travel
interaction_model.input: Moving the pointer while the press is still held
interaction_model.affected_object: The gathering point and the field organized around it

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: A new press during the bloom takes over from the current state and begins gathering again without a jump
interaction_model.state_change: Field blooms back outward toward the resting pattern while the gathering point drifts from the release location toward the centre
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Dots expand outward and ease into stillness, fringes fading back into the field's own tone as motion slows, cluster dissolving as its focus migrates to the middle
interaction_model.input: Releasing the press
interaction_model.affected_object: The dot field and the gathering point

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Rapid repeated input cannot compound or rush the rhythm; each stab resolves back to rest independently
interaction_model.state_change: The breath does not advance; the field quietly unwinds to the resting state instead
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Only a faint, brief disturbance that settles back, with no swelling breath and no visible acceleration however fast the taps repeat
interaction_model.input: A press released almost immediately (a stab or repeated stabbing)
interaction_model.affected_object: The breath rhythm of the whole field

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: No stranded held state is possible; the field always finds its way back to rest
interaction_model.state_change: The release still registers and the hold ends normally
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Field blooms back outward and re-centres exactly as with an in-bounds release, never leaving dots stuck in a gathered cluster
interaction_model.input: Releasing outside the visible area or otherwise losing the pointer
interaction_model.affected_object: The held state of the field

experience_qualities: Calm, unhurried and hypnotic
Breath-like: gathering, swelling, easing
Soft and organic rather than crisp or mechanical
Tactile and directly responsive, the field feels pulled by the finger
Forgiving and unrushable, resisting impatient input
Endless and low-stakes, with nothing to achieve or complete
completion_and_return: No completion or success state exists; the resting pattern is the only terminus
Every breath returns the field to a settled state visually equivalent to the opening
The gathering point always returns to the centre when no press is active
The experience loops indefinitely through user-initiated breaths and can be left idle at rest without decay
locked_observable_requirements: A dense field of dots covering the whole screen, each mark only faintly separated from a low-distraction surround, still and faintly organic at rest
Exactly one large line of display text resting over the field at readable contrast, requiring no reading or learning
Press-and-hold gathers the whole field inward around the held point, not around the screen centre
The gathering point continuously eases toward the pointer for as long as the press lasts, with visible lag rather than snapping
Soft fringes noticeably hue-shifted away from the field's own tone trail the dots only while they are moving
Release blooms the field outward while the gathering point drifts to the centre
Each interaction reads as one single breath that gathers, swells and eases
Every breath ends with the field settled again rather than at an end state
An almost-instant release quietly unwinds to rest without advancing the rhythm, so repeated stabbing cannot speed the experience up
A release outside the visible area still registers and returns the field to rest
adaptable_details: Dot size, spacing, density and how faintly each mark separates from the surround
Which hues the trailing fringes shift toward, and how strongly that shift reads
Breath duration and easing character
How far inward the field gathers and how far outward it blooms
Wording, typeface, size and placement of the single display line
Degree of organic irregularity in the resting pattern
Lag amount in how the gathering point follows the pointer
Threshold that counts a press as almost-instant
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits whole-viewport views whose foreground is at most one short line of display text and whose purpose is mood and idle play rather than conveying information, on any surface where press-and-hold plus pointer movement is available. It stays the same Skill across different dot densities, field and surround tones, light or dark treatments, fringe hues, breath timings and headline copy, as long as the dots stay low-emphasis against their surround, the text stays readable, and the moving fringes stay visibly hue-shifted away from the field's own tone. It becomes a different Skill if the field must carry readable dense foreground content, if the marks encode data or map to specific items so that gathering conveys meaning, if the motion runs autonomously without press-and-hold as its driver, if the effect is confined to a small bounded widget rather than the full screen, or if a breath resolves to a distinct end state instead of returning to rest.

name: hold_to_grow_stick_gap_crossing
description: Hold anywhere to grow a stick upward from your ledge edge, release to tip it flat across the gap, and walk across to the next ledge if the length was judged right — with double points for the marked centre and an instant fall-and-restart if it was short or long.

canonical_document.name: hold_to_grow_stick_gap_crossing
canonical_document.description: Hold anywhere to grow a stick upward from your ledge edge, release to tip it flat across the gap, and walk across to the next ledge if the length was judged right — with double points for the marked centre and an instant fall-and-restart if it was short or long.
canonical_document.experience_scope: A whole-view self-contained playable region. It begins with the character standing on a starting ledge under a one-line aim hint, continues open-endedly through one gap at a time, and ends only when a misjudged length drops the character; a restart returns it to the same starting state.
content_and_composition: One controllable character, always standing at the edge of the current ledge and the anchor point of the action
The current ledge the character stands on and exactly one next ledge ahead across a gap, with the gap distance and target width varying between attempts
A small visibly marked centre zone on the next ledge, distinct from the rest of its surface, signalling the precision target
A stick that grows upward from the current ledge's edge while input is held, its length the single visible variable of the moment
A persistent score readout that stays legible through play and after failure
A one-line hint stating the aim, present only at the start
A restart control that is absent during play and appears after a fall
A quiet, low-detail flat backdrop that sits clearly behind the ledges, stick and character with enough separation to stay unobtrusive and never compete with the gap
experience_progression: Rest state: hint line visible, character on starting ledge, one gap and one next ledge in view
The hint quietly fades out once the first run begins, leaving the scene wordless
Per attempt: hold to grow, release to tip, then either traverse or fall
Each success carries the world forward so the crossed ledge becomes the new standing ledge and a fresh single gap is presented, making the run open-ended with no completion point
Failure ends the run immediately with no continuation, followed by an available fresh start from zero
attention_and_information_flow: Attention starts on the single instructional line, then transfers to the gap as the hint fades
During the hold, the growing stick is the sole source of changing information and carries all prominence; the player reads its length against the perceived distance to the next ledge
The marked centre keeps a secondary, standing prominence as the higher-value target rather than a momentary cue
On success, prominence briefly shifts to the rising score, and more strongly when the reward is doubled, then returns to the newly framed gap as the world advances
On failure, the falling character pulls attention downward and the restart control becomes the most prominent element in an otherwise settled scene

interaction_model.visible_feedback: The stick visibly extends upward in real time, its length reading directly as the committed distance
interaction_model.input: Press and hold anywhere in the playable area
interaction_model.affected_object: The stick anchored at the current ledge's edge

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Irreversible commitment — once released, the length cannot be adjusted and the result plays out without further input
interaction_model.state_change: From upright and growing to tipping forward until it lies flat across the gap; the length is locked at release
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The stick rotates forward and settles flat, its far end landing somewhere relative to the next ledge, making the outcome readable before the character moves
interaction_model.input: Release the press
interaction_model.affected_object: The grown stick

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: The run continues seamlessly into the next attempt with no interruption or confirmation
interaction_model.state_change: Character crosses, score increases, and the world advances so the reached ledge becomes the new standing point with a new gap ahead
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The character walks along the laid stick onto the next ledge, the score ticks up, and the scene moves forward to frame the next single gap
interaction_model.input: Stick's far end reaches the next ledge
interaction_model.affected_object: Character, score and the world's forward position

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Purely additive on top of a successful crossing; missing the centre still allows the run to continue
interaction_model.state_change: The same successful crossing awards double the normal points
interaction_model.visible_feedback: A distinctly emphasised score gain that reads as better than an ordinary crossing, marking precision as its own reward
interaction_model.input: Stick's far end settles inside the small marked centre of the next ledge
interaction_model.affected_object: Score

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: No rescue or retry of the failed attempt; recovery is only a fresh run, immediately available through the revealed control

interaction_model.visible_feedback: The character walks to the stick's end, falls out of the scene, and the previously hidden restart control appears
interaction_model.input: Stick is too short or too long for the gap
interaction_model.affected_object: Character and run state

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Deliberate self-interruption always available without waiting for a failure; the abandoned run is not resumable
interaction_model.state_change: The run is abandoned mid-attempt and a fresh one starts from a score of zero
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The scene returns to the starting ledge and gap with the score reset
interaction_model.input: Keyboard shortcut during a run in progress
interaction_model.affected_object: The active run

experience_qualities: Calm and unhurried rather than tense or urgent
Instantly learnable from a single line of text and one gesture
Single-focus: one gap, one variable, one decision at a time
Judgement-based, rewarding accuracy over endurance
Open-ended with no finish line, so runs are measured by score
Unforgiving in the moment but frictionless to retry
completion_and_return: No completion state exists during success; the world keeps advancing indefinitely
A run terminates only on a misjudged length or a deliberate abandon
After failure the scene settles with the score still readable and a restart control offered
Restart returns the scene to the initial ledge, gap and zero score; the start hint does not return once it has faded
locked_observable_requirements: One continuous press is the only means of setting reach, and the reach grows visibly for exactly as long as the press is held
Release causes a visible forward tipping to a flat resting position, making the committed length legible before the outcome resolves
The character traverses the laid element on success and the score rises

adaptable_details: Visual style, palette, character form and ledge shapes, as long as the surround stays low-distraction and the ledges, stick, marked centre and character each stay clearly separated from it and from each other
How gap distances and target widths vary between attempts
Exact multiplier presentation and score styling
Wording of the opening hint and the label of the restart control
Which key abandons a run
Pacing of the walk, tip and forward world advance
Presence of sound or subtle ambient motion in the backdrop
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits any self-contained playable region where a single sustained press should map to one visible, committed quantity judged against a spatial target, and where failure is cheap and instantly repeatable. Content type is largely free — the ledges, gap and character can be restyled to other traversal metaphors. Replacing the single hold-length commitment with steering, repeated inputs or continuous control during flight, allowing recovery from a bad commitment, or removing the forward world advance so the same scene repeats in place would each create a different Skill.

name: open_lit_roam_and_vehicle_takeover_world
description: A brightly and evenly lit landscape of roads, ramps and water you roam on foot with weighty easing movement, where a prompt beside a parked machine walks you to its door, seats you, and turns the same keys into throttle, steering and braking until you step back out.

canonical_document.name: open_lit_roam_and_vehicle_takeover_world
canonical_document.description: A brightly and evenly lit landscape of roads, ramps and water you roam on foot with weighty easing movement, where a prompt beside a parked machine walks you to its door, seats you, and turns the same keys into throttle, steering and braking until you step back out.
canonical_document.experience_scope: Whole-view experience. Begins with a short load wait and a brief greeting overlay that hands over control once the world is ready, then continues indefinitely as open-ended play with no end state; the two embodied modes (on foot, in control of a machine) alternate within the same continuous view.
content_and_composition: One controllable character as the visitor's persistent embodiment, kept in view by a camera that orbits around it

One open, evenly lit outdoor landscape containing traversable ground, roads, ramps and water surfaces held clearly apart from each other in tone so they read as distinct traversable and non-traversable regions that motivate movement and jumping

Several drivable machines parked around the world as approachable, enterable objects, each separated enough from its surroundings to read as an object rather than scenery, and each with a nearest entry point
A persistent on-screen hint layer stating what the current controls do, held at readable contrast against whatever lies behind it, overlaid on the world without obstructing the character
An opening overlay: load wait indication followed by a brief greeting that yields to the world
Layer relationship: world and character in depth behind, hint layer and opening overlay flat above and separated from the world by contrast rather than by hue
A proximity prompt appearing near a machine only when the character stands close enough to take it over, arriving as a high-salience change against the otherwise low-distraction surround

Brief greeting that then hands control to the visitor
Open-ended on-foot roaming across the landscape with no ordered stages

Faster, speed-focused travel while in control of the machine
Optional exit: machine brakes to a stop if still rolling, character stands back outside, controls and attention return to the calm on-foot state
Loop between roaming and driving as often as the visitor chooses
attention_and_information_flow: Attention starts on the greeting overlay, then transfers to the character and the surrounding landscape once control is handed over
On foot, attention is diffuse and exploratory — spread across roads, ramps and water as possible destinations
Standing near a machine narrows attention to that machine via its action prompt, which is the most salient thing on screen at that moment
During boarding, attention follows the character's own walk to the door and the door opening, so the transition is watched rather than jumped
Once seated, attention shifts from wandering to speed and the path ahead
Hint layer continuously discloses only the currently valid actions at steady readable contrast, so the change of control scheme is read there as the modes swap
Exiting widens attention back out to the landscape and the on-foot character
