Exiting a machine returns the visitor to the same calm on-foot state that followed the greeting
Falling out of the world self-recovers to grounded rest with speed cleared
Machines remain in the world where they were left and can be taken over again
locked_observable_requirements: Whole-view three-dimensional world explored by a controlled figure, not a scrolled page
Pointer swings the camera around the figure; movement keys push it relative to the current view direction
Movement has visible weight: acceleration, easing stops, leaning turns and eased landings, never instant direction switches
A held modifier gives sustained faster movement and a separate key jumps
Enterable machines standing in the world, held apart from their surroundings clearly enough to read as objects, taken over by a single action key when nearby
Boarding is a visible sequence: self-directed walk to the nearest door, door opens, character seated
The same movement keys are handed over to throttle, steering and braking once seated
A persistent on-screen hint layer at readable contrast over the world that swaps to match the currently active control scheme
Exiting brakes a still-rolling machine to a stop before the figure steps out
Mid-approach directional input cancels boarding
Leaving world bounds returns the subject to solid ground with speed cleared
Opening load wait followed by a brief greeting that hands over control when the world is ready
adaptable_details: Landscape composition and specific terrain features beyond traversable ground, ramps and water

Lighting scheme, time of day and any colour treatment, as long as the world stays brightly and evenly enough lit for the figure and machines to read as lit and grounded, ground and water stay separated in tone, and the on-foot baseline reads as calm
Character and machine appearance, styling and number of machines
Visual form and placement of the hint layer and proximity prompt, as long as the prompt reads as a high-salience change against a low-distraction surround
Wording and styling of the greeting
Exact key bindings and specific speed, jump and braking values
Camera distance and framing offsets around the controlled subject
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits any full-view roaming play space where a visitor embodies a figure in an open landscape and can take over a second controllable object in place, with brand or product content expressed as things standing in the world to walk up to. It stops being this Skill if the world becomes goal-driven with objectives or scoring, if control collapses to a single embodiment with no takeover of a second controllable object, if the takeover happens as a cut or separate screen instead of a watched in-world boarding sequence, or if movement becomes instant and snapping instead of weighted and easing.

name: part_by_part_playable_stage_tour
description: A sequence of full-screen stages, each holding one large object made of many repeated parts; pressing a part makes it spring or swing back and shift to a strongly contrasting tone while it sounds, and holding while gliding across neighbouring parts fires them one after another.

canonical_document.name: part_by_part_playable_stage_tour
canonical_document.description: A sequence of full-screen stages, each holding one large object made of many repeated parts; pressing a part makes it spring or swing back and shift to a strongly contrasting tone while it sounds, and holding while gliding across neighbouring parts fires them one after another.
canonical_document.experience_scope: Whole-view experience spanning the page: begins at an opening title moment that asks the visitor to switch sound on and holds them there until the subjects are ready, continues through one full-viewport stage per subject family, and ends on a quiet closing panel of further suggestions. Each stage is itself a self-contained playable region.
content_and_composition: One full-viewport stage per subject family, presented in a fixed order (roughly half a dozen stages)
Each stage carries a single large object scaled and rendered so it reads as the real thing rather than an illustration of it
Each object is composed of many discrete repeated parts (keys, strings, bars, tines, pipes, heads), every part mapped to its own distinct sound
One short line of copy per stage, deliberately subordinate to the object
Opening title panel with an explicit request to enable sound; closing low-emphasis panel of further suggestions
Pointer shape changes over anything playable, marking the interactive surface without adding visible controls
experience_progression: Entry: bold title moment requests sound and holds the visitor until the subjects are ready to play
Advance stage by stage through the subject families, each occupying the full view alone
Within any stage, free order-independent experimentation with no required sequence or completion
Close on a quiet set of further suggestions after the last stage
attention_and_information_flow: The object dominates each stage; copy stays at one line so nothing competes with it
Prominence shifts to the pressed part while it is held, its tonal contrast shift and displacement separating it from the rest of the object
Playability is revealed before commitment through the pointer change, not through labels
Full-view staging means only one subject is ever explained at a time; revealed information is the object's behaviour rather than text

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Release restores the part's resting position and clears the contrast shift and the sound immediately; nothing is ever left sounding or marked
interaction_model.state_change: Part moves from resting to held-active for as long as the press lasts
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The part springs or swings out of place and back, and holds a clearly contrasting tone for the full duration of the hold, with its sound starting at the instant of press
interaction_model.input: Press on any single part of the object
interaction_model.affected_object: That individual part and its own sound

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Releasing or moving off the object ends the run and clears every active marker at once; the gesture can be restarted anywhere
interaction_model.state_change: Parts enter and leave the held-active state one after another along the path of the gesture
interaction_model.visible_feedback: A travelling cascade of parts displacing and taking on the contrasting tone under the pointer, each sounding as it is crossed, so runs, strums and glides come from one gesture
interaction_model.input: Keeping the press down and moving across neighbouring parts
interaction_model.affected_object: Each part crossed by the continuous gesture, in order

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Release stops the repetition instantly and returns the part to rest
interaction_model.state_change: Single strike becomes a continuous repetition while held
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The part repeats its rebound motion and holds its contrasting tone, reading as a roll
interaction_model.input: Sustained hold on a part whose behaviour is repetitive rather than sustained
interaction_model.affected_object: That part and its repeated sound

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Key release restores the part and stops the sound; simultaneous keys behave like simultaneous presses
interaction_model.state_change: Same held-active state as a pointer press
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The mapped part depresses and takes on the same contrasting tone while its sound plays, so keyboard and pointer produce the same visible result
interaction_model.input: Letter and number keys on the keyboard-family stage
interaction_model.affected_object: The part mapped to that key

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Stages can be revisited in any order and behave identically, with no accumulated or leftover state
interaction_model.state_change: One full-view subject is replaced by the next
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The incoming subject fills the view with its single line of copy; the departing stage leaves nothing sounding
interaction_model.input: Advancing to the next or previous stage
interaction_model.affected_object: The stage sequence

experience_qualities: Playful and consequence-free: no wrong press, nothing to break
Tactile and physical, because parts move and rebound rather than merely changing appearance in place
Immediate, with sound and reaction arriving on press rather than after it
Expressive, since one continuous gesture yields runs, strums and rolls
Unhurried and focused, one subject at a time, ending quietly rather than with a hard sell
completion_and_return: No completion condition or score; the tour simply ends on the quiet suggestions panel
Every press self-clears on release, and leaving a stage leaves nothing sounding
The visitor's sound-enable choice persists for the whole tour
Stages are endlessly re-playable and identical on return
locked_observable_requirements: Each part sounds and visibly reacts at the moment of press, not after a delay
The reaction is a physical-feeling displacement that returns to rest, plus a strong tonal contrast shift against the part's resting appearance that lasts exactly as long as the hold
A single continuous held gesture across neighbouring parts triggers each of them in turn
Release or moving away always stops the sound and clears the active marker; nothing is ever left active
One subject per full viewport, accompanied by at most a single line of copy
The pointer changes over anything playable
An opening moment explicitly asks for sound before the tour is playable
At least one stage answers to keyboard keys with the same visible part reaction
adaptable_details: Number and order of stages and which subject families appear
Part counts, part geometry and layout of each object
Exact rebound motion (spring, swing, tilt, bounce) and the direction and strength of the tonal contrast shift
Copy wording, palette, typography and how stages are advanced
Contents of the closing suggestions panel
Which stage additionally accepts key input
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits sets of subjects built from many repeated parts where each part has its own immediate sensory response and free trial is the whole point, such as instrument-like objects, keypads, mechanical assemblies or sample kits. It requires an instant per-part response the visitor can trigger at will; if pressing parts instead opens information panels, if the subject is a single indivisible object with no repeated parts, or if the stages become a linear narrative with required progress, it becomes a different Skill.

name: single_press_endless_chase_run
description: A cute blocky low-contrast world curves and turns toward you while a runner flees a pursuer; one press anywhere leaps over hazards and pops collectibles into tumbling cubes, the pace keeps quickening, and getting caught ends in a comic freeze that one more press restarts from zero.

canonical_document.name: single_press_endless_chase_run
canonical_document.description: A cute blocky low-contrast world curves and turns toward you while a runner flees a pursuer; one press anywhere leaps over hazards and pops collectibles into tumbling cubes, the pace keeps quickening, and getting caught ends in a comic freeze that one more press restarts from zero.
canonical_document.experience_scope: A whole-view experience that begins already in motion the moment the view appears — no title screen or idle state — and continues unbroken until capture, after which the ending settles in place and a single press returns the same view to a fresh run. Can be scoped down to a bounded rectangular region that occupies the visual center of a page, but the region owns all input inside it and remains the dominant element of the view.
content_and_composition: One player character held at a fixed screen position on the run line, seen from a trailing viewpoint so the path ahead is fully visible
One pursuer trailing behind at a distance that visibly grows and shrinks; it is always on screen and reads as the tension gauge
Ground presented as a small round world whose surface rotates toward the viewer, so upcoming content crests over a near horizon rather than sliding in from a flat distance

Scattered blocky, low-detail scenery (tree-like forms) on and beyond the path, finished in muted, low-contrast tones that sit clearly below the runner, pursuer, collectibles and hazards in salience, giving depth and speed cues without competing for attention
Collectibles suspended just above the run line, positioned so they can only be taken mid-leap
Ground-level hazards in the path, one active at a time, with a replacement appearing at the horizon after the active one is cleared or struck
One persistent numeric distance count overlaid at a screen edge, climbing continuously
One short line of guidance shown at the very start of a run, stating the single input and nothing else
A capture ending state that takes over the whole view with an exaggerated comic pose and a restart prompt
experience_progression: Open mid-run: the world is already turning, the pursuer is already behind, the guidance line is the only text
Easy jog: slow world speed, generous spacing between collectibles and hazards, leaps feel forgiving
Quickening: world speed rises continuously, scenery streams faster, the same spacing now demands tighter timing and the count climbs faster
Panic: high speed, high count, pursuer held close by accumulated hazard hits, every leap feels decisive
Capture: the pursuer reaches the runner, motion collapses into a comic ending and the scene settles
Return: one press restores the opening jog with the count at zero and the pursuer at its starting distance
attention_and_information_flow: Primary attention sits on the near horizon where the turning ground reveals what arrives next; reveal timing, not layout, sets the reading rhythm
The gap to the pursuer is the ambient tension readout — widening after a collectible, closing after a hazard hit — read peripherally without any explicit meter
The climbing count sits at low but constant prominence and gains felt weight as it grows

A hazard hit briefly seizes the entire view with a full-screen high-salience flash — a momentary surge that overrides the muted scene as an unmistakable alarm signal — plus the hazard tumbling away, then attention snaps back to the horizon
A collectible pickup rewards with a short-lived burst of tumbling debris at the point of contact
The ending overrides everything: the world stops competing for attention and the restart prompt becomes the only thing to act on

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Presses made while airborne are ignored and not queued or buffered; control returns exactly on landing, making the timing of that one press the entire skill
interaction_model.state_change: Grounded to airborne leap
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The character rises and falls through a readable arc while the ground keeps turning beneath, so the world advances during the whole leap
interaction_model.input: Single press or tap anywhere in the view
interaction_model.affected_object: Player character

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: A missed collectible simply passes by with no penalty and no interruption to the run
interaction_model.state_change: Collectible consumed; pursuit gap widens
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The collectible bursts into a scatter of small tumbling cubes that fall and fade, and the pursuer visibly drops back, buying ground
interaction_model.input: Leap that clears a suspended collectible
interaction_model.affected_object: Collectible and the gap to the pursuer

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: The run continues immediately with input still live; repeated hits keep closing the gap until capture, so recovery comes only from clearing subsequent collectibles
interaction_model.state_change: Hit state applied; pursuit gap shrinks
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The whole view flashes at high salience for an instant, clearly separated from the muted scene, the spiky hazard is knocked spinning away off the path, and the pursuer lunges noticeably closer before a new hazard appears at the horizon
interaction_model.input: Running into a ground-level hazard
interaction_model.affected_object: Whole view, the hazard, and the gap to the pursuer

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: The visitor cannot slow or pause the pace; it resets only through a new run
interaction_model.state_change: Continuous acceleration and continuous count increase
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Ground and scenery stream past faster and the count ticks upward more quickly, turning an easy jog into a panic without any announcement
interaction_model.input: Autonomous progression of the run
interaction_model.affected_object: World speed and distance count

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Presses stay inert while the ending plays out and the scene settles, so a panicked press cannot skip or accidentally consume the ending
interaction_model.state_change: Run active to run ended
interaction_model.visible_feedback: A comic, exaggerated capture moment that is unmistakably an ending rather than a stumble, after which motion settles
interaction_model.input: Pursuer reaching the runner
interaction_model.affected_object: Whole view

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Restart is always available from the ending state and always begins from the same baseline pace and count
interaction_model.state_change: Ended to a fresh run already in motion
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The view returns immediately to the opening jog with the count at zero, the pursuer back at starting distance and the guidance line shown again
interaction_model.input: Single press after the ending has settled
interaction_model.affected_object: Entire scene

experience_qualities: Cute and toy-like: low-contrast, evenly lit surfaces and blocky simplified forms keep the chase unthreatening
Immediate: play starts in motion with one line of text and no menus, setup or explanation
Single-skill purity: one input, one timing decision, nothing to learn beyond it
Rising panic built from pace and pursuer proximity rather than from warnings or numbers
Comic rather than punishing failure, so the ending reads as funny and restart feels worth doing at once
Legible at speed: what is coming is always readable before it must be answered
completion_and_return: No win condition; the run loops indefinitely until capture
Capture terminates the attempt and is the only ending
Restart is a full reset of count, pace and pursuit distance — nothing carries over as difficulty
The loop is designed as a fast retry cycle: ending, settle, one press, running again
locked_observable_requirements: Ground presented as a small curving world that rotates toward the viewer so upcoming content crests over a near horizon
Play begins already in motion with a single short guidance line and no title or idle state
Exactly one input, a press or tap anywhere, producing a leap; presses while airborne are ignored rather than buffered
Collectibles reachable only mid-leap, bursting into a scatter of tumbling cubes on pickup and visibly widening the pursuit gap
Hazard contact produces a brief full-view high-salience flash that plainly stands apart from the low-contrast scene, plus the hazard knocked spinning away, and visibly closes the pursuit gap
A pursuer that stays on screen and whose distance is the tension readout, with no abstract meter substituting for it
A continuously climbing distance count and a pace that quickens continuously without announcement
Capture ends the run with a comic, unmistakable ending during which input is inert until the scene settles, then one press restarts from zero
adaptable_details: Identity of runner, pursuer, collectible and hazard, and the specific scenery forms

Exact hues and overall palette, including which tone the hit flash uses, as long as scenery stays low-contrast beneath the play elements, the play elements stay readable against the ground, and the flash stays clearly higher in salience than anything else on screen
Viewpoint angle and distance, and how much of the curving world is visible
Leap arc height and duration, acceleration curve, and spacing rules for collectibles and hazards
Units and screen placement of the count, and whether a best count persists between attempts
Wording of the single guidance line, presence of sound, and the exact comic form of the capture ending
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits any full-view or centered bounded region where a small playable diversion is meant to be the foreground content and surrounding copy is minimal, and where a low-contrast cartoon world can carry a brand or mood in whatever hues that brand supplies. It depends on the visitor's attention being fully on the horizon, so it does not survive being placed behind readable content as a substrate. Replacing the single timed input with multi-directional or continuous control, removing the on-screen pursuer whose closing distance carries the tension, or exchanging the endlessly turning world for a flat authored level with a defined finish produces a different skill.

source_sites.title: The frantic run of the valorous rabbit

name: endless_flight_pickup_run
description: An endless flight over a curving sea and drifting clouds rendered in one soft, cohesive limited palette, where pointer height steers the craft and pointer sideways position sets speed while the view widens, good and bad items burst on contact, and emptying energy ends the attempt in a plunge with one-tap restart.

canonical_document.name: endless_flight_pickup_run
canonical_document.description: An endless flight over a curving sea and drifting clouds rendered in one soft, cohesive limited palette, where pointer height steers the craft and pointer sideways position sets speed while the view widens, good and bad items burst on contact, and emptying energy ends the attempt in a plunge with one-tap restart.
canonical_document.experience_scope: A whole-view experience that begins immediately on arrival with no menu or start gate, runs indefinitely as a single continuous flight, ends when the energy reading empties and the craft falls out of frame, and returns to a fresh attempt from a single input; it can occupy the full viewport or a large bounded panel that behaves as its own complete view.
content_and_composition: One steerable aircraft as the single focal actor, held near a fixed screen position and confined to a limited vertical altitude band
A continuously receding ground plane read as sea with visible curvature toward the horizon
A drifting cloud layer around and above the flight path that supplies depth and a sense of pace
A stream of oncoming items arriving from ahead toward the viewer, in exactly two visually distinguished classes: beneficial and harmful
A persistent low-emphasis overlay, held at readable contrast against the moving scene, containing a short title and a single line of hint text stating which class helps and which hurts
Three persistent, always-legible readings: current stage or level, distance travelled, and remaining energy
An end-of-attempt message with a plain invitation to begin again, shown over the stalled scene

One limited, softly rendered, toy-like palette shared by sea, clouds, aircraft and items, kept low-contrast across the surround while holding enough separation that the two item classes stay distinguishable by shape and by a clear tonal or chromatic contrast
experience_progression: Immediate entry straight into flight with the scene already in motion
Early calm phase where the hint line is readable and the item stream is sparse
Gradual escalation: forward pace increases and the oncoming stream becomes denser and busier, with the stage reading stepping up as travel accumulates
Continuous quiet energy drain across the whole run, so survival depends on collecting beneficial items
Critical phase: energy crosses a low threshold and its reading plainly changes to a high-salience warning read
Failure: energy empties, the aircraft tips over and falls out of frame, motion stops and the end message appears
Return: a single input clears the message, resets stage and distance to zero, refills energy and eases the aircraft back up into level flight, restarting the same progression
attention_and_information_flow: Primary attention stays on the oncoming item stream in the centre of the view, where classification and steering decisions are made
Readings sit peripheral and constantly legible without competing with the stream during normal flight
The energy reading is the only element that gains prominence over time, escalating to an unmistakable warning when critical
Accelerating widens the view and loosens the framing, revealing more of the incoming field while making each correction feel less precise
Contact events briefly seize attention: shard bursts locally, and harmful contact flashes the whole scene as a controlled luminance shift so the penalty cannot be missed
The hint line carries the most information in the first seconds and then recedes into ambient framing text
Failure collapses all attention onto the falling aircraft and then onto the restart message

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Movement is clamped softly at the top and bottom of the band; holding position steady always returns the craft to level flight; control is never taken away except during the failure fall
interaction_model.state_change: Aircraft rises or lowers to follow the tracked height, constrained inside a fixed altitude band
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Aircraft pitches and banks into each correction, then settles back to level once the tracked position is steady
interaction_model.input: Continuous pointer or finger vertical position
interaction_model.affected_object: The aircraft's altitude and attitude

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Moving back toward the slow end tightens the framing and slows the world again; the coupling is continuous and reversible at any moment
interaction_model.state_change: Speed rises toward a faster cruise and the view widens as it accelerates
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Sea and clouds stream past faster, the visible field grows and the framing loosens, making the craft appear smaller within a broader scene
interaction_model.input: Continuous pointer or finger horizontal position
interaction_model.affected_object: Cruising speed and the framing of the whole scene

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: No loss of control; if energy was in the warning state and rises past the threshold, the warning read returns to normal
interaction_model.state_change: Item is consumed and remaining energy increases
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Item bursts into shards at the point of contact and the energy reading rises
interaction_model.input: Flying into a beneficial item
interaction_model.affected_object: The item and the energy reading

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Steering authority returns automatically as the craft settles back onto the tracked position; the penalty is bounded and does not immediately end the run unless energy empties
interaction_model.state_change: Item is destroyed, a noticeably larger amount of energy is lost, and the aircraft is knocked off its tracked course
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Item bursts into shards, the entire scene flashes in a brief luminance shift, and the aircraft is shoved off course before drifting back under control
interaction_model.input: Clipping a harmful item
interaction_model.affected_object: The item, the whole scene, the aircraft's course and the energy reading

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Escalation is one-directional within an attempt and only resets when a new attempt begins
interaction_model.state_change: Pace and density increase and the stage reading steps up while distance accumulates
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Scenery streams faster, more items appear in the stream, and the readings climb
interaction_model.input: Autonomous passage of travel and time
interaction_model.affected_object: Flight pace, item density and the stage and distance readings

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Collecting beneficial items is the only recovery; emptying is terminal for the attempt and hands the visitor to the restart message
interaction_model.state_change: Remaining energy falls steadily and can cross into a critical state, then empty
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The reading visibly decreases, plainly switches to a high-salience warning read when critical, and reaching empty triggers the end of the attempt
interaction_model.input: Autonomous energy drain
interaction_model.affected_object: The energy reading

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: One input is the whole restart path; the new attempt starts from the same immediate-entry state as the first
interaction_model.state_change: Message clears, counters reset to zero, energy refills and a fresh attempt begins
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The aircraft eases back up into level flight from below as the scene resumes moving
interaction_model.input: Single click or tap on the end message
interaction_model.affected_object: The message overlay, all readings and the aircraft

experience_qualities: Immediately playable and understandable without a tutorial
Soft, smooth and toy-like rather than gritty or realistic
Physically weighty steering: the craft leans into corrections instead of snapping
Speed felt through framing and streaming scenery rather than reported as a number
Steadily rising pressure from drain, pace and density
Unmistakable, legible consequences for both reward and penalty
Failure that is dramatic but never confusing, with near-zero friction to try again
completion_and_return: No win condition or ending; the flight is open-ended and the only outcome is running out of energy
Failure is terminal for the attempt: the aircraft tips over, leaves the frame, and the scene rests behind a restart message
A single input resets stage, distance and energy to their starting values and re-enters flight, so the experience loops indefinitely
Each attempt starts from the same clean state; no progress from a previous attempt persists into the next
locked_observable_requirements: Entry drops straight into a scene already in motion, with no start gate
Continuous pointer or finger tracking, not discrete steps: vertical position sets altitude within a fixed band, horizontal position sets speed
Speed is visibly coupled to camera framing: faster flight widens the view and loosens the framing
The actor banks and pitches into each correction and settles level again
Exactly two visually distinguishable item classes, one beneficial and one harmful, arriving as a stream from ahead
Both classes burst into shards on contact
Harmful contact adds a whole-scene luminance flash, a knockback off course with automatic drift back under control, and a noticeably larger resource loss than the beneficial gain
A single depleting resource drains continuously and must be topped up by collecting; its reading plainly signals a critical state through a high-salience change
Stage, distance and remaining resource are always legible during flight
A short title and one line of text stating which class helps and which hurts remain present at readable contrast against the moving scene
Emptying the resource ends the attempt with the actor tipping over and falling out of frame
One click or tap clears the end message, resets counters to zero and eases the actor back up into flight
Receding curved ground plane plus a drifting cloud-like layer, rendered in one limited palette that keeps the surround lower in contrast than the actor and the item stream
adaptable_details: Which vehicle or creature serves as the actor
Exact shapes and iconography of the two item classes
The specific hues, temperature and light-or-dark direction of the limited palette, and which contrast carries the two-class distinction
The exact escalation curve, drain rate and critical threshold
Placement and typographic treatment of the readings, title and hint
Wording of the hint and the restart invitation
Shard count, burst duration and flash intensity
Whether the stage reading is numeric or named
Full viewport versus a large bounded panel
Whether the environment reads as sea, desert, cloudscape or another continuous plane
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits continuous-pointer-driven endless travel scenes with a single focal actor, a two-class reward/penalty stream and one depleting survival resource, where the whole view belongs to the experience and copy is limited to a title, a one-line rule and compact readings. Replacing continuous pointer tracking with discrete lane or keyboard control, dropping the depleting resource in favour of instant-loss obstacles, adding finite levels or a win state, splitting the resource into multiple meters, or placing the scene behind foreground text as a passive substrate would each produce a different Skill.

name: struck_object_kit_with_settling_surfaces
description: A full kit of large struck pieces arranged in one view; hitting any piece anywhere sounds its own tone while only its resonating surface reacts with a physical recoil — a suspended plate swinging and wobbling down, a shell flexing and springing level, a bracket-mounted piece dipping at its mount — before settling back to a ready rest state.

canonical_document.name: struck_object_kit_with_settling_surfaces
canonical_document.description: A full kit of large struck pieces arranged in one view; hitting any piece anywhere sounds its own tone while only its resonating surface reacts with a physical recoil — a suspended plate swinging and wobbling down, a shell flexing and springing level, a bracket-mounted piece dipping at its mount — before settling back to a ready rest state.
canonical_document.experience_scope: A whole-view foreground experience that begins fully assembled on arrival, with the entire set in frame and no configuration, tutorial or entry step; it has no end state and remains continuously playable, each hit being a self-contained momentary event inside the persistent scene.
content_and_composition: One complete set of several distinct struck pieces (about seven in the source case) presented together as a single arrangement rather than a list or gallery
Every piece is drawn large enough that its strike area is plainly inviting at a glance, with the whole set visible at once without scrolling or panning
Each piece is composed of two content roles: a resonating surface and its supporting hardware or mount; both belong visually to the piece and both accept hits, but only the resonating surface moves
Pieces differ from one another in size, silhouette, elevation and mounting style, implying a real physical arrangement and depth ordering with overlaps
Persistent elements: the arrangement, its scale and every piece's rest position never change between hits; there is no scoreboard, mode switch or status layer required
Each piece carries a fixed one-to-one relationship to a single dedicated letter key and to its own distinct sound
experience_progression: Per-hit micro-cycle stage 1: piece at settled rest, level and still
Stage 2: on contact, immediate displacement of that piece's resonating surface only, at full amplitude with no wind-up
Stage 3: damped return — swing decaying to a wobble, flex springing back level, dip easing up to its mount position
Stage 4: return to identical rest, ready to be struck again; the cycle loops per hit and never accumulates across hits
No global or session-level progression: the kit does not build up, unlock, degrade or change over time
attention_and_information_flow: At rest every piece holds equal prominence, so the eye reads the set as one available whole rather than being led to a primary target
Motion is the only prominence signal: the struck piece momentarily stands out purely because it is the thing moving while everything else stays still
Prominence is local and short-lived — attention returns to the whole set as the surface settles, so the player's focus can move freely and quickly between pieces
Overlapping hits on different pieces produce several simultaneous local highlights without any of them taking over the view
No informational overlay, readout or explanation competes with the pieces; the arrangement itself communicates what can be struck

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: The motion always resolves on its own back to the exact level rest position; hits cannot be cancelled but never leave a piece displaced, stuck or mid-motion
interaction_model.state_change: Piece transitions from settled rest to struck, then damps back to rest
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Instant physical recoil of the resonating surface only — suspended plate swings and wobbles, shell flexes and springs level, mounted piece dips at its bracket — accompanied by that piece's own tone starting immediately; hardware and all other pieces remain motionless
interaction_model.input: Tap or click anywhere on a piece, including its supporting hardware or mount
interaction_model.affected_object: That piece's resonating surface and its own sound

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Multiple keys may be held or struck together for two-handed playing; each key affects only its own piece and releasing a key never interrupts a sounding hit
interaction_model.state_change: Identical rest-to-struck-to-rest transition, independent of pointer position
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The same recoil and the same tone as a direct hit, so keyboard play is visually indistinguishable from pointing
interaction_model.input: Press the one dedicated letter key assigned to a piece
interaction_model.affected_object: The same piece as the pointer hit on that piece

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Retriggering is always accepted; the piece can never stall, lag behind the input or refuse a strike, and it still settles to rest once repeats stop
interaction_model.state_change: The in-progress hit is cut and a fresh hit begins from its start rather than layering onto or queueing behind the previous one
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The surface snaps back to full strike displacement and re-settles from the beginning, with the tone restarting cleanly — no doubling, thickening, smearing or dropped hits at high repeat rates
interaction_model.input: Fast repeated hits on the same piece, by pointer or key
interaction_model.affected_object: The already-moving resonating surface and its currently sounding tone

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Pieces are fully independent — one piece's state, motion or decay never blocks, mutes or alters another's
interaction_model.state_change: Each struck piece runs its own independent strike-and-settle cycle and its own tone concurrently
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Several surfaces move and several tones ring at the same time without cutting each other off or synchronising their motion
interaction_model.input: Hits on separate pieces at overlapping times
interaction_model.affected_object: Multiple pieces at once

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: The one-input-one-strike guarantee holds on both touch and pointer input and across rapid alternation between input methods
interaction_model.state_change: Exactly one strike is registered
interaction_model.visible_feedback: One recoil and one tone; a single contact never produces a visible double bounce or an audible double hit
interaction_model.input: A single touch or press on a piece
interaction_model.affected_object: That piece's strike event

experience_qualities: Immediate and latency-free — the reaction reads as simultaneous with the contact
Physical and material rather than button-like: nothing highlights, depresses or toggles; things swing, flex and dip
Weighted and believably damped, with each piece's motion matching how it appears to be mounted
Ready-to-play on arrival, with no setup, explanation or warm-up
Effortless under dense, fast, two-handed play; expressive and playful rather than task-oriented
Localised — only the struck surface moves, so the scene stays calm even during busy passages
completion_and_return: Every hit self-completes: the surface returns to the same settled, level rest position it started from
The set as a whole always returns to a uniform ready state, so long continuous play never requires a reset
No persistent state accumulates between hits — no residual displacement, no lockout period, no mode to exit
There is no finish, success or end screen; the experience simply remains available
locked_observable_requirements: The complete set is visible at once, at a scale where each piece plainly invites a strike
No configuration, instruction or entry step precedes play
A hit anywhere on a piece, hardware and mount included, counts as hitting that piece
Only the piece's resonating surface animates; its hardware and every other piece stay still
The recoil form is specific to how the piece is mounted: suspended pieces swing and wobble back down, shells flex and spring level, bracket-mounted pieces dip at the bracket
Visible reaction and the piece's own distinct sound start together, with no perceptible delay after input
Pointer/touch input and one dedicated letter key per piece produce identical results
Rapid repeats restart a hit from its beginning instead of stacking, queueing or stalling
Separate pieces sound and animate concurrently and independently
One input produces exactly one strike
Every piece always damps back to an identical settled rest position
adaptable_details: Number, kind and naming of the pieces in the set
Exact spatial layout, depth ordering and overlap of pieces
Visual style and rendering treatment of the pieces
The specific sound assigned to each piece
Which letter keys map to which pieces, and whether the mapping is surfaced anywhere
Precise displacement amplitude, damping curve and settle duration, as long as it reads as physically weighted and fully settles
How the arrangement scales or reflows to keep the whole set in view on different viewport sizes
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits any set of physically struck or contact-responsive objects meant for fast, free-form, repeated triggering — percussion sets, pad or toy panels, sound-making props, hardware parts demonstrated by tapping — where each object owns a distinct output and a distinct material reaction determined by how it appears mounted. It stays the same Skill when the pieces, styling, sounds and key mapping change. It becomes a different Skill if pieces are triggered by a sequencer, timeline or recorded pattern instead of live input, if pieces are browsed one at a time or scrolled rather than all present, if the whole element animates as a unit or highlights like a control instead of only its resonating surface reacting, or if hits are meant to accumulate lasting state in the scene.

name: hand_deflected_falling_grain_toy
description: A high-salience column of grains falls endlessly onto a broad floor while a clearly separated hand form that follows the pointer bursts, flings and catches the stream, closing into a fist when held and orbiting under drag.

canonical_document.name: hand_deflected_falling_grain_toy
canonical_document.description: A high-salience column of grains falls endlessly onto a broad floor while a clearly separated hand form that follows the pointer bursts, flings and catches the stream, closing into a fist when held and orbiting under drag.
canonical_document.experience_scope: Whole-view experience: begins automatically on first load with a descending cinematic framing and continues indefinitely as a single explorable scene with no exit state or subsequent view.
content_and_composition: One continuous falling column of many small high-salience grains as the visual focal element, lit so it reads as clearly separated from a softly illuminated ground plane
One hand form standing in the path of the stream, held distinct in tone from the grains and positioned as the viewer's own presence in the space
One flat floor surface that receives scattered grains and acts as the lower boundary of the viewable space
One short introductory title layer overlaid on the scene only during the opening moments
A quiet, low-distraction surround with no competing foreground content, panels or persistent labels
experience_progression: Opening: viewpoint eases in from high above the floor at a slow, unhurried pace while the title surfaces
Settling: title dissolves away as the framing comes to rest near the stream and the hand
Open play: indefinite, non-terminating state in which the stream keeps falling and the hand keeps responding to input from any chosen angle
attention_and_information_flow: Attention first belongs to the descending framing and the briefly surfacing title
As the title clears, prominence transfers to the stream and the hand, the most strongly lit and highest-contrast elements against the quiet surround
Reading the hand as the viewer's own stand-in is the only instruction given; capability is discovered by moving rather than announced
During play, the burst of grains at the point of contact carries the strongest moment-to-moment prominence
Because nothing ever completes, no progress, score or status information is ever introduced

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Movement can stop or reverse at any instant; when input stops the hand eases back to a resting position and the stream continues undisturbed
interaction_model.state_change: Hand travels through the space to the pointed position and becomes a solid obstacle in the stream's path
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Grains strike the fingers and palm and burst off in scattering directions instead of passing through
interaction_model.input: Pointer movement across the view
interaction_model.affected_object: Hand form and the grains in the falling column

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Effect is momentary and self-clearing; flung grains settle and the supply is continuously replenished so no sweep can exhaust or spoil the scene
interaction_model.state_change: Deflection strength scales with how fast the hand is swept
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Faster sweeps fling grains harder and farther; slow passes nudge them gently
interaction_model.input: Speed of pointer sweeps
interaction_model.affected_object: Grains contacting the hand

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Releasing eases the hand back open along the same smooth path; the gesture can be repeated freely and interrupted mid-way without any stuck state
interaction_model.state_change: Open hand transitions smoothly into a closed fist and remains closed while held
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Fingers curl in a continuous, unhurried motion, changing how much of the stream is intercepted
interaction_model.input: Press and hold
interaction_model.affected_object: Hand form

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Viewpoint is clamped so it never drops below the floor plane and never passes fixed near and far distance limits; at a limit it simply stops rather than snapping or flipping
interaction_model.state_change: Viewpoint swings around the stream and hand while the scene keeps running
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The column, hand and floor are seen from a new angle with continuous motion, never cutting
interaction_model.input: Drag with the button held
interaction_model.affected_object: Viewpoint on the scene

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Self-sustaining with no depletion, failure or reset requirement; the scene cannot be broken by any amount of interaction
interaction_model.state_change: Grains that have scattered or settled are continuously restored to the supply
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The pour never thins or empties, sustaining a steady, high-salience column at all times
interaction_model.input: Autonomous stream and replenishment
interaction_model.affected_object: Falling column and scattered grains

experience_qualities: Cinematic and calm on arrival rather than abrupt
Tactile and immediate: every pointer motion produces a visible burst
Unhurried and inexhaustible, encouraging aimless repetition
Embodied — the on-screen hand reads instantly as the viewer's own
Playful and consequence-free, with nothing to lose or complete
completion_and_return: No completion state; the pour and the scene run indefinitely
Hand returns to a resting pose whenever input stops
Fist gesture returns to the open pose on release
Scattered grains are continuously replenished so the scene self-restores to its full state
Viewpoint stays wherever the viewer left it; no automatic return to the opening framing
locked_observable_requirements: Opening viewpoint descent from high above with a briefly surfacing and dissolving title, ending in a settled framing
A continuous, never-emptying stream of many small elements that stay clearly separated from their surround, falling onto a floor in a quiet, softly lit setting
A pointer-following hand form, readably distinct from the stream, that intercepts it so elements burst off it instead of passing through
Deflection strength that visibly increases with pointer speed
Smooth, reversible curl-to-fist on press-and-hold and ease-back-open on release
Held-drag orbiting of the viewpoint that is clamped above the floor and within fixed distance limits
Continuous replenishment and a rest pose on idle, so no interaction can break or exhaust the scene
adaptable_details: Exact wording and typography of the brief opening title
Duration and easing of the opening descent
Grain count, size, hue family and floor material
Stream width, height and pour position within the view
Precise angular and distance limits of the orbit
Substitution of the intercepting form with another recognizable viewer-stand-in shape
Ambient lighting mood and overall surround luminance level, light or dark, as long as separation holds
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits single-focus playful or showcase views whose foreground is the interactive scene itself, with little or no reading content competing for attention, and where a continuous mass of many small reactive elements plus one pointer-driven interceptor is the whole message. Adding goals, scoring, depletion or an end state, replacing the endless stream with discrete one-shot bursts, fixing the viewpoint so the scene cannot be circled, or embedding it behind dense foreground text would create a different Skill.

name: luminous_stroke_flow_field
description: On an empty unmarked field held quiet and far in luminance from the light it carries, pressing and dragging pushes a fluid medium along the exact path travelled and lays glowing colour into it; faster strokes shove harder and flare toward the brightest, near-hueless end of the range, released motion keeps coasting, and whatever formed slowly drifts and fades back into the bare field.

canonical_document.name: luminous_stroke_flow_field
canonical_document.description: On an empty unmarked field held quiet and far in luminance from the light it carries, pressing and dragging pushes a fluid medium along the exact path travelled and lays glowing colour into it; faster strokes shove harder and flare toward the brightest, near-hueless end of the range, released motion keeps coasting, and whatever formed slowly drifts and fades back into the bare field.
canonical_document.experience_scope: A single continuous region experience occupying the whole view: it begins the moment the empty unmarked surface is shown, is driven entirely inside that surface, and never ends on its own — it returns to the empty state by fading or by an explicit clear rather than by completing.
content_and_composition: One full-view unmarked base field acting as both surround and working surface, held at a low-distraction tone clearly separated in luminance from the light it will carry, empty of text, controls or setup at entry
One evolving luminous layer of coloured streams occupying the same surface, growing denser, brighter and more intricate as strokes accumulate
One invisible moving medium underneath that carries the deposited colour, so colour spreads and drifts beyond the drawn line
Brightest, most desaturated highlights concentrated on the most recently and most quickly drawn paths
Window edges act as persistent containing boundaries of the composition
No persistent labels, panels, legends or instructional copy anywhere in the composition
experience_progression: Entry: wholly empty unmarked field, nothing to read and nothing to configure
First contact: a faint glow appears immediately along the first stroke, so the surface explains itself within a second or two
Build-up: repeated strokes accumulate into denser, brighter, more intricate luminous structure
Coast: after release, the already-moving medium keeps carrying and deforming the colour without new input
Decay: brightness and structure gradually dim and dissolve back toward the bare field
Reopen: the emptied field stands as an open invitation for another pass, looping indefinitely with no finish line
attention_and_information_flow: Attention starts on the quiet empty field itself because nothing else competes for it
The first faint glow pulls attention to the pointer path, teaching the interaction without explanation
Prominence follows recency and speed: the newest and fastest strokes are the brightest, most washed-out focal points
As structure accumulates, attention widens from the single stroke to the whole drifting composition
During decay attention relaxes into a calm, hypnotic hold as detail slowly withdraws into the bare field
Reduced brightness signals fading relevance and prompts renewed input

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Lifting the press stops any further addition at once; the stroke can be resumed at any time and a new stroke can steer or cancel motion already in progress
interaction_model.state_change: Medium is shoved along the exact path travelled and glowing colour is deposited into it
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Luminous streams appear along the traced path and immediately begin spreading and curling with the pushed medium
interaction_model.input: Press and hold while moving the cursor
interaction_model.affected_object: Underlying moving medium and the luminous colour layer

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Lifting the finger ends deposition; further drags behave the same
interaction_model.state_change: Identical push-and-deposit behaviour as the cursor drag
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Same glowing streams following the traced path with no difference in character between touch and cursor
interaction_model.input: Touch press and drag
interaction_model.affected_object: Underlying moving medium and the luminous colour layer

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Continuously reversible within the same stroke by simply slowing down or speeding up
interaction_model.state_change: Faster movement increases displacement force and pushes colour toward a brighter, hotter, less saturated appearance; slower movement yields gentler, dimmer, more saturated deposits
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Fast strokes flare to the top of the luminance range and throw the medium visibly further; slow strokes lay soft coloured glow that barely disturbs the field
interaction_model.input: Stroke speed within a drag (fast versus slow)
interaction_model.affected_object: Strength of the push and brightness of the deposited colour

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: A fresh stroke can redirect or cancel the coasting motion; doing nothing lets it wind down
interaction_model.state_change: Deposition stops while existing motion continues under its own momentum
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Formed structure keeps drifting, stretching and folding after the hand stops
interaction_model.input: Release of press or touch
interaction_model.affected_object: Motion already imparted to the medium and the colour it carries

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Any new stroke re-energises and re-brightens the field, interrupting the fade
interaction_model.state_change: Brightness and structure gradually decay toward the empty starting state
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Whatever has formed dims and dissolves back into the bare field until nothing luminous remains
interaction_model.input: Passage of time with no input
interaction_model.affected_object: Entire luminous layer

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Content stays inside the view at all times; strokes started near an edge behave predictably instead of being lost
interaction_model.state_change: Motion is deflected to run along the boundary instead of leaving the surface
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Streams visibly slide and turn along the window edges rather than disappearing off-screen
interaction_model.input: Flow reaching the edge of the view
interaction_model.affected_object: Moving medium and the colour it carries

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: The cleared surface is immediately drawable again, returning to the entry condition
interaction_model.state_change: All accumulated colour and motion is removed and the starting empty state is restored
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Everything wipes back to the bare entry field
interaction_model.input: One clearing command
interaction_model.affected_object: Whole field

experience_qualities: Immediately self-explanatory with no reading, setup or onboarding
Calm, hypnotic and continuous rather than task-like
Physically tactile: motion feels like shoving a real medium rather than drawing a line
Expressive dynamic range between soft slow saturated glow and hot, near-hueless fast flare
Ephemeral and forgiving, since everything fades and nothing accumulates permanently
Endless and open, with an emptiness that keeps inviting another attempt
completion_and_return: No completion state, target or finish line exists
Unattended, the experience returns itself to the empty entry field by gradual fading
The clearing command provides an immediate deliberate return to that same empty state
Nothing is retained between passes; each return is a fresh bare surface
The loop entry-build-coast-fade-entry can repeat indefinitely
locked_observable_requirements: Opens on a wholly empty unmarked field, low in distraction and clearly separated in luminance from the light it will carry, with no text, controls or setup
Visible glowing response appears within a second or two of the very first input, teaching the interaction without instructions
Colour and push are laid along the exact path the pointer travelled, not at discrete or snapped positions
Deposited colour is carried by a moving medium so it spreads and drifts beyond the traced line
Stroke speed visibly maps to both push strength and brightness, with fast strokes flaring toward the brightest, near-hueless end of the range
Motion continues coasting after release, and new strokes can steer or cancel that coasting motion
Structure continuously dims back toward the empty entry field when left alone
Flow is contained by the view boundaries and slides along them instead of escaping
A single command clears everything back to the empty entry field
Touch dragging behaves identically to cursor dragging
adaptable_details: Which hues are deposited, the base field's tone and position in the luminance range, and how hue is chosen or cycled
Exact decay speed and how long structure lingers before vanishing
Stroke width, glow softness and maximum brightness ceiling
Visual texture of the medium and how far colour spreads from the path
How the clearing command is issued
Region size and aspect ratio, from a large panel to the entire viewport
Whether faint autonomous drift exists before any input
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits wordless full-view or large-region surfaces with a quiet, low-distraction backdrop where the visual is the content and free press-and-drag across the whole area is available, such as experiential openings, standalone play pages and immersive feature moments. It becomes a different Skill if readable foreground content must sit on top and consume drags, if strokes become permanent non-decaying marks or saved artwork, if the response is driven by hover or scroll instead of a held stroke path, or if the medium stops carrying colour so the deposit is just a line following the cursor.

name: adjustable_open_water_scene
description: Endlessly rolling open water running to the horizon, with a flat downwind arrow and two marked tracks lying on the surface that you drag to change wind, swell scale and crest sharpness while the same sea keeps moving, and free press-drag swiveling and tilting of the viewpoint.

canonical_document.name: adjustable_open_water_scene
canonical_document.description: Endlessly rolling open water running to the horizon, with a flat downwind arrow and two marked tracks lying on the surface that you drag to change wind, swell scale and crest sharpness while the same sea keeps moving, and free press-drag swiveling and tilting of the viewpoint.
canonical_document.experience_scope: Whole-view experience that begins already running the moment the view appears and has no end state; it continues in whatever conditions were last set, from whatever viewing angle was last chosen.
content_and_composition: A continuous animated water surface filling the view and reaching an open horizon line, established as calm and physically convincing before any input
One flat directional arrow lying on the surface, aligned with the surface plane, pointing downwind; its length or extent expresses strength and its head is the grab point
Two marked linear tracks lying on the same surface, each carrying a single sliding handle, one for swell scale and one for crest sharpness
A numeric present value shown with each control, plus a small profile line that depicts the current wave shape
All markers are planted on the surface rather than floating in screen space, so they turn and tilt with the scene as the viewpoint moves
No separate panel, legend or overlay chrome competing with the surface
attention_and_information_flow: First attention is on the moving water itself; the on-surface markers read as instruments belonging to the water rather than interface placed over it
During a drag, attention narrows to the grabbed marker, its live number and the profile line, while the surface behind keeps advancing
On release, attention returns to the whole surface, now sustained in the new conditions
Every value is visible at all times, so the meaning of each control is legible without explanation or tooltips

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Never pauses, completes or resets; parameter changes and viewpoint changes are absorbed into the ongoing motion
interaction_model.state_change: Surface advances perpetually under the current conditions
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Swell rolls toward and past the viewer without pause, seam or restart
interaction_model.input: Autonomous continuous motion, running from arrival onward
interaction_model.affected_object: Water surface and horizon

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Arrow stops at its heading and strength limits instead of running past them; dragging back along the same path restores previous values continuously
interaction_model.state_change: Arrow swings to a new heading and lengthens or shortens; wind reading updates
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Arrow follows the pointer continuously, its number tracks the drag, the profile line updates, and the surface reshapes as the same sea shifting rather than a new one beginning
interaction_model.input: Press and drag the arrow head
interaction_model.affected_object: Wind direction and strength, and the whole surface

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Handle stops at the ends of its track; dragging back undoes the change continuously with no confirm step
interaction_model.state_change: Handle slides along its track to a new position; the corresponding reading updates
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Handle follows the drag along its track, its number and the profile line change in step, and the surface swells higher or lower, or crests soften or sharpen, without interruption
interaction_model.input: Press and drag a track handle
interaction_model.affected_object: Swell scale or crest sharpness, and the whole surface

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Viewpoint remains where it is left; tilt is bounded so the surface stays readable; dragging back returns the previous angle
interaction_model.state_change: View swivels around the scene and tilts up or down
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Surface and horizon rotate and pitch under the pointer while the markers stay planted on the surface, turning with it; conditions keep running unchanged
interaction_model.input: Press and drag bare water away from any marker
interaction_model.affected_object: Viewpoint

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Purely indicative; no change to conditions or viewpoint
interaction_model.state_change: Cursor indicates whether the thing under it can be grabbed or will move the viewpoint
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Cursor form distinguishes grabbable markers from bare water
interaction_model.input: Hover over the surface or a marker
interaction_model.affected_object: Cursor

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Current values are kept rather than reverted or snapped; a new drag can resume from there
interaction_model.state_change: Drag ends
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Marker settles at its current position and the surface keeps rolling in exactly those conditions
interaction_model.input: Release, or leave the window mid-drag
interaction_model.affected_object: Active drag

experience_qualities: Physical and weighty rather than decorative
Calm and unhurried on arrival
Continuous: no restarts, jumps or loading seams between states
Self-explanatory, because each control shows its own present value in place
Directly manipulable, as if handling the scene rather than operating a panel
Freely inspectable from the angle the viewer finds most telling
completion_and_return: No completion, ending or success state; the surface runs indefinitely
Conditions and viewpoint persist as left, with no automatic return to defaults
Interrupted drags end cleanly with the values reached at that moment
locked_observable_requirements: The view opens already in motion, convincing and calm, before any input
Motion never stops, restarts or visibly reloads when a parameter changes; a change reads as the same subject shifting
Controls lie on the depicted surface, share its plane and orientation, and stay planted as the viewpoint turns
Each control continuously displays its own current numeric value plus a shape-profile readout that follows the drag
All interaction is press-and-drag on the scene: markers adjust conditions, bare scene adjusts viewpoint
Controls stop at their limits rather than overrunning, and dragging back reverses a change continuously
Cursor distinguishes grabbable markers from bare scene
Releasing or leaving the window mid-drag ends the drag and keeps the current values
adaptable_details: Exact number of conditions exposed and their labels
Numeric ranges, units and default starting values
Marker styling: arrow proportions, track markings, handle shape, typography of readouts
Overall color treatment, lighting, time of day and horizon treatment, in any hue family or overall brightness, provided markers and readouts stay separable from the surface behind them
Initial camera height and angle, and how far tilt may travel
Placement of the tracks relative to the arrow on the surface
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits any continuously animated environmental or material surface whose character is governed by a few readable conditions and which benefits from being viewed from a chosen angle, with the controls able to sit within the depicted world. It stops being this Skill if the controls move into a panel or overlay detached from the scene, if changes cause a restart, reload or discrete transition instead of a continuous shift, if the motion has a beginning and end rather than running indefinitely, or if the viewpoint is fixed so the surface cannot be inspected from other angles.

name: mechanical_transport_deck_with_reel_wound_progress
description: A tape-deck-style panel where a cassette with two reels sits behind a row of chunky keys; pressing a key visibly sinks it with a clunk, the reels turn while content plays, wound tape shifting from one reel to the other is the only sign of progress, and each end of a side lands as a firm stop with the other side still to hear.

canonical_document.name: mechanical_transport_deck_with_reel_wound_progress
canonical_document.description: A tape-deck-style panel where a cassette with two reels sits behind a row of chunky keys; pressing a key visibly sinks it with a clunk, the reels turn while content plays, wound tape shifting from one reel to the other is the only sign of progress, and each end of a side lands as a firm stop with the other side still to hear.
canonical_document.experience_scope: A self-contained region occupying one focal area of a view: it begins with a short readying pause before the cassette is present and operable, and ends when the visitor stops or reaches the end of a side; the device remains on screen and operable throughout, and nothing outside the region is required for the experience to read.
content_and_composition: One device housing acting as the persistent frame for everything else
One cassette seated in the housing as the visual centerpiece, showing two reels and the tape spanning between them
Two reels with visibly different amounts of wound tape, whose relative fullness encodes position within the current side
One current-side identity, with exactly two sides that together hold all available content
Each side presented as one continuous recording rather than a list of separately addressable entries
One row of chunky transport keys: play, stop, rewind, fast-forward, plus a separate key that turns the cassette over
No numeric readout, timestamp, percentage or draggable progress track anywhere in the region
experience_progression: Readying: a short wait during which the deck is present but the tape is not yet ready to start
Waiting: the cassette sits loaded and still, visibly ready to be started, reels stationary at the current tape position
Playing: reels turn steadily and tape accumulates on the take-up reel while content plays from exactly where the tape currently sits
Winding: reels spin much faster in the direction matching the pressed key with a whirring sound and no content playing, until interrupted or a side boundary is reached
End of side: motion and content halt definitely at either extreme, with the second side still unheard
Turned over: the cassette flips, sides swap roles, and the deck returns to a waiting state for the newly exposed side
attention_and_information_flow: Attention rests on the cassette while content plays, because reel rotation and shifting tape volume are the only changing information
Progress information is revealed continuously and approximately: the visitor reads position from how much tape has moved between reels, never from a figure
Pressing a key briefly pulls attention to that key through its visible sinking and sound, then returns attention to the reels
Winding raises the visual energy of the reels sharply and suppresses content, making the transport action itself momentarily the loudest element
Reaching an end of a side removes all motion, and the stillness plus the lopsided reels signal that this side is finished while the other remains

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Every key gives this same physical acknowledgement whether or not the requested action is permitted, so a refused action still reads as a real press
interaction_model.state_change: Key moves from raised to depressed and back as it is actuated
interaction_model.visible_feedback: The key visibly sinks under the press, accompanied by a mechanical clunk
interaction_model.input: Press of any transport key
interaction_model.affected_object: The pressed key within the device housing

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Playback always resumes from where the tape currently sits, including after winding; reaching the end of the side ends playback on its own
interaction_model.state_change: From waiting or stopped to playing from the current tape position
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Reels begin turning at playback pace and tape gradually transfers from one reel to the other while content is heard
interaction_model.input: Press of the play key
interaction_model.affected_object: Reels, tape distribution and the played content

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Winding can be interrupted at any moment and resumed later, and refuses to run past either end of the side, halting at the boundary instead of overrunning
interaction_model.state_change: From any non-winding state to winding in the direction matching the pressed key
interaction_model.visible_feedback: Reels spin much faster than during playback in the matching direction with a whirring sound and no content playing
interaction_model.input: Press of the rewind or fast-forward key
interaction_model.affected_object: Reels and tape distribution

interaction_model.control_and_recovery: Position is preserved exactly, so a later play continues from the same point rather than restarting
interaction_model.state_change: From playing or winding to stopped
interaction_model.visible_feedback: All reel motion and sound halt, with the reels holding their current tape distribution

canonical_document.name: simulated_desktop_workspace_environment
canonical_document.experience_scope: Whole-view experience that owns the entire viewport from first load until the visitor leaves. It begins with a short power-on moment, hands off to the persistent desktop, and never reverts to a conventional scrolling page; individual frames are regions inside it, not separate experiences.
canonical_document.portability_boundary: Fits content that divides cleanly into a handful of self-contained sections, each worth its own frame and worth keeping open beside the others: showcase pieces, project write-ups, reference material, playful mini-tools, contact or about panels. It assumes a wide viewport and pointer input with hover and right-press, and assumes the visitor is willing to explore rather than be led. Content that must be read as one linear narrative, or delivered small-screen-first, does not fit. Replacing freely overlapping frames with a single fixed panel or an auto-tiled non-movable layout, dropping the persistent top strip and icon row, or swapping the desktop metaphor for a handheld-device, console or terminal metaphor each produces a different Skill.
content_and_composition: One full-viewport wallpaper surface as the permanent base layer, visible behind every other element
One persistent top strip spanning the full width: a live running clock, the name of the frontmost frame, and a small set of menu titles that drop open one at a time
One persistent bottom row of recognisable app icons (roughly five to a dozen), each with a name label revealed only on hover and a small dot beneath marking that the app is already open

Hovering an icon creates momentary local emphasis: it lifts, enlarges and shows its name, then settles back when the pointer leaves

Wallpaper cards stay informative but subordinate, being covered by any frame that moves over them

experience_progression: Arrival on a bare surface where labels are the only visible information and nothing is open
